from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.actionpolicy import evaluateactionpolicy


router = APIRouter(prefix="/guard", tags=["action-guard"])


GuardVerdict = Literal["allow", "review", "quarantine", "deny"]


class ActionGuardRequest(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str = Field(..., description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="Execution target such as URL, shell, file path, or tool id.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Prompt or action content to guard.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score for guard evaluation.")
    clientid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Client or actor identifier.")
    sessionid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Session or workflow identifier.")
    filepath: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional source filepath for audit attribution.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional metadata from retrieved docs, tools, or external sources.",
    )


class GuardReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class ActionGuardResponse(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    verdict: GuardVerdict
    allowed: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    requiresreview: bool
    quarantined: bool
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    filepath: str
    reason: str
    reasons: list[GuardReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def guardaction(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    policy = evaluateactionpolicy(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata,
    )

    policy_action = policy["action"]
    if policy_action == "allow":
        verdict: GuardVerdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        requiresreview = False
        quarantined = False
        reason = "Guard allowed the action."
    elif policy_action == "review":
        verdict = "review"
        allowed = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        requiresreview = True
        quarantined = False
        reason = "Guard routed the action for review."
    elif policy_action == "quarantine":
        verdict = "quarantine"
        allowed = False
        haltedbyboundary = True
        requiresreview = False
        quarantined = True
        reason = "Guard quarantined the action."
    else:
        verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        haltedbyboundary = True
        requiresreview = False
        quarantined = False
        reason = "Guard denied the action."

    return {
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "allowed": allowed,
        "haltedbyboundary": haltedbyboundary,
        "requiresreview": requiresreview,
        "quarantined": quarantined,
        "baseriskscore": policy["baseriskscore"],
        "adjustedriskscore": policy["adjustedriskscore"],
        "filepath": policy["filepath"],
        "reason": reason,
        "reasons": policy["reasons"],
        "promptinjection": policy["promptinjection"],
    }


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=ActionGuardResponse,
    summary="Guard a runtime action before execution with prompt injection awareness.",
)
def actionguard(payload: ActionGuardRequest) -> ActionGuardResponse:
    result = guardaction(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return ActionGuardResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.security.promptinjection import scanpromptinjectiondict


router = APIRouter(prefix="/policy", tags=["action-policy"])


PolicyVerdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]
PolicyAction = Literal["allow", "review", "quarantine", "deny"]


class ActionPolicyRequest(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str = Field(..., description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="Target such as URL, shell, filesystem path, or tool id.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Action content, prompt, or instruction text.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score before policy adjustments.")
    clientid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Session or conversation id.")
    filepath: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description="Optional source file path for audit attribution.",
    )
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional contextual metadata from retrieved content, tool outputs, or files.",
    )


class PolicyReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class ActionPolicyResponse(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    verdict: PolicyVerdict
    action: PolicyAction
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    promptinjectionflagged: bool
    indirectpromptinjectionflagged: bool
    shouldreview: bool
    shouldquarantine: bool
    shouldblock: bool
    filepath: str
    summary: str
    reasons: list[PolicyReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _build_policy_reason(source: str, label: str, details: str, score: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "source": source,
        "label": label,
        "details": details,
        "score": score,
    }


def evaluateactionpolicy(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    effective_filepath = filepath or "app/api/actionexecute.py"
    effectivemetadata = dict(metadata or {})
    if clientid:
        effectivemetadata.setdefault("clientid", clientid)
    if sessionid:
        effectivemetadata.setdefault("sessionid", sessionid)
    effectivemetadata.setdefault("filepath", effective_filepath)

    promptscan = scanpromptinjectiondict(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        filepath=effective_filepath,
        metadata=effectivemetadata,
    )

    adjustedriskscore = max(0, min(100, int(riskscore) + int(promptscan.get("riskdelta", 0))))
    categories = set(promptscan.get("categories", []))

    shouldquarantine = bool(promptscan.get("shouldquarantine"))
    shouldblock = adjustedriskscore >= 85 and not shouldquarantine
    shouldreview = bool(promptscan.get("shouldreview")) or adjustedriskscore >= 50

    if shouldquarantine:
        verdict: PolicyVerdict = "quarantine"
        action: PolicyAction = "quarantine"
        summary = "Policy quarantined the action because prompt injection indicators crossed containment thresholds."
    elif shouldblock:
        verdict = "block"
        action = "deny"
        summary = "Policy blocked the action because adjusted runtime risk exceeded the execution threshold."
    elif shouldreview:
        verdict = "warn"
        action = "review"
        summary = "Policy routed the action for review because prompt injection or indirect instruction indicators were detected."
    else:
        verdict = "allow"
        action = "allow"
        summary = "Policy allowed the action because no blocking or review threshold was crossed."

    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        _build_policy_reason(
            source="policy",
            label="Risk policy evaluation",
            details=(
                f"Policy evaluated action '{actiontype}' on target '{target}' with base risk {int(riskscore)} "
                f"and adjusted risk {adjustedriskscore}."
            ),
            score=adjustedriskscore,
        )
    ]

    for item in promptscan.get("reasons", []):
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": str(item.get("source", "promptinjection")),
                    "label": str(item.get("label", "Prompt injection indicator")),
                    "details": str(item.get("details", "")),
                    "score": int(item.get("score", 0)),
                }
            )
        else:
            reasons.append(
                _build_policy_reason(
                    source="promptinjection",
                    label="Prompt injection indicator",
                    details=str(item),
                    score=0,
                )
            )

    return {
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "action": action,
        "baseriskscore": int(riskscore),
        "adjustedriskscore": adjustedriskscore,
        "promptinjectionflagged": bool(promptscan.get("flagged")),
        "indirectpromptinjectionflagged": "indirect_prompt_injection" in categories,
        "shouldreview": shouldreview,
        "shouldquarantine": shouldquarantine,
        "shouldblock": shouldblock,
        "filepath": effective_filepath,
        "summary": summary,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "promptinjection": promptscan,
    }


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=ActionPolicyResponse,
    summary="Evaluate runtime action policy with prompt injection awareness.",
)
def actionpolicy(payload: ActionPolicyRequest) -> ActionPolicyResponse:
    result = evaluateactionpolicy(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return ActionPolicyResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict, field_validator

from app.api.actiondecision import decideaction


router = APIRouter(prefix="/audit", tags=["audit"])


AuditEventType = Literal[
    "execution_allowed",
    "execution_review",
    "execution_quarantined",
    "execution_denied",
]
AuditSeverity = Literal["info", "warning", "high", "critical"]


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _newid(prefix: str) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}_{uuid4().hex}"


def _coerceoutcome(value: Any) -> str:
    outcome = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if outcome in {"allow", "review", "quarantine", "deny", "denied", "block", "blocked"}:
        return outcome
    return "deny"


def _eventshape(outcome: str) -> tuple[AuditEventType, AuditSeverity, str]:
    if outcome == "allow":
        return (
            "execution_allowed",
            "info",
            "Audit recorded an allowed execution path.",
        )
    if outcome == "review":
        return (
            "execution_review",
            "warning",
            "Audit recorded a review-required execution path.",
        )
    if outcome == "quarantine":
        return (
            "execution_quarantined",
            "critical",
            "Audit recorded a quarantined execution path.",
        )
    return (
        "execution_denied",
        "high",
        "Audit recorded a denied execution path.",
    )


class AuditReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class AuditRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    actiontype: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Execution target such as URL, shell, or file path.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Prompt or action content that produced the audit event.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score supplied to the audit pipeline.")
    clientid: str | None = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: str | None = Field(None, description="Session or workflow id.")
    filepath: str | None = Field(None, description="Optional source filepath for attribution.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional external context, tool outputs, retrieved content, or file text.",
    )

    @field_validator("actiontype", "target", "content", "clientid", "sessionid", "filepath", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _stripstrings(cls, value: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            value = value.strip()
        return value

    @field_validator("actiontype", "target")
    @classmethod
    def _requirenonempty(cls, value: str) -> str:
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("must not be empty")
        return value


class AuditResponse(BaseModel):
    auditeventid: str
    eventtype: AuditEventType
    severity: AuditSeverity
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    filepath: str
    traceid: str
    requestid: str
    decisionid: str
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    summary: str
    reasons: list[AuditReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    hostilecontext: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    createdat: str


def createauditevent(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    safe_metadata = metadata or {}
    decision = decideaction(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=safe_metadata,
    )

    outcome = _coerceoutcome(decision.get("outcome"))
    eventtype, severity, summary = _eventshape(outcome)

    return {
        "auditeventid": _newid("audit"),
        "eventtype": eventtype,
        "severity": severity,
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "filepath": str(decision.get("filepath") or filepath or ""),
        "traceid": str(decision.get("traceid") or _newid("trace")),
        "requestid": str(decision.get("requestid") or _newid("req")),
        "decisionid": str(decision.get("decisionid") or _newid("dec")),
        "baseriskscore": int(decision.get("baseriskscore", riskscore)),
        "adjustedriskscore": int(decision.get("adjustedriskscore", riskscore)),
        "summary": str(decision.get("summary") or summary),
        "reasons": decision.get("reasons") or [],
        "promptinjection": decision.get("promptinjection") or {},
        "hostilecontext": decision.get("hostilecontext") or {},
        "createdat": _utcnow(),
    }


@router.post(
    "/event",
    response_model=AuditResponse,
    summary="Create an audit event from the secured action decision path.",
)
def auditevent(payload: AuditRequest) -> AuditResponse:
    result = createauditevent(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return AuditResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query

from app.dependencies.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.auditlogservice import AuditLogService, get_audit_log_service

    prefix="/api/audit",
    tags=["audit"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],

@router.get(
    "/events",
    summary="List Audit Events",

FILE: app\api\backup.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.backupservice import (
    BackupManifest,
    BackupService,
    build_default_backup_service,
)


router = APIRouter(prefix="/backup", tags=["backup"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def get_backup_service() -> BackupService:
    return build_default_backup_service()


def _raise_backup_http_error(exc: Exception) -> None:
    if isinstance(exc, KeyError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    raise exc


class BackupTargetResponse(BaseModel):
    name: str
    kind: str
    format: str
    base_path: str
    rotation_policy: dict[str, Any]
    encrypt_at_rest: bool
    checksum_required: bool


class BackupManifestResponse(BaseModel):
    target_name: str
    target_kind: str
    backup_format: str
    backup_path: str
    created_at: str
    size_bytes: int
    sha256: str | None
    rotation_tier: str
    encryption_applied: bool
    meta: dict[str, Any]


class BackupStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Backup Control"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    targets: list[BackupTargetResponse]
    summary: dict[str, Any]


class BackupActionRequest(BaseModel):
    target_name: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    action: Literal["snapshot", "export", "rotate"] = "snapshot"


class BackupActionResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Backup Action"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    action: Literal["snapshot", "export", "rotate"]
    target_name: str
    result: dict[str, Any]


def _manifest_to_response(manifest: BackupManifest) -> BackupManifestResponse:
    return BackupManifestResponse(**manifest.to_dict())


@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=BackupStatusResponse,
    summary="Get backup control status",
)
def get_backup_status(
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> BackupStatusResponse:
    targets = service.list_targets()
    typed_targets = [BackupTargetResponse(**target) for target in targets]

    return BackupStatusResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        targets=typed_targets,
        summary={
            "target_count": len(typed_targets),
            "snapshot_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.kind == "snapshot"),
            "export_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.kind == "export"),
            "checksum_enforced_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.checksum_required),
            "encrypted_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.encrypt_at_rest),
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/targets",
    response_model=list[BackupTargetResponse],
    summary="List configured backup targets",
)
def list_backup_targets(
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> list[BackupTargetResponse]:
    return [BackupTargetResponse(**target) for target in service.list_targets()]


@router.post(
    "/snapshot",
    response_model=BackupManifestResponse,
    summary="Run an on-demand snapshot backup",
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def run_backup_snapshot(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> BackupManifestResponse:
    try:
        manifest = service.run_snapshot(target_name)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_backup_http_error(exc)

    return _manifest_to_response(manifest)


@router.post(
    "/export",
    response_model=BackupManifestResponse,
    summary="Run an on-demand export backup",
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def run_backup_export(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> BackupManifestResponse:
    try:
        manifest = service.run_export(target_name)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_backup_http_error(exc)

    return _manifest_to_response(manifest)


@router.post(
    "/rotate",
    response_model=BackupActionResponse,
    summary="Apply rotation policy to a backup target",
)
def rotate_backups(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> BackupActionResponse:
    try:
        removed = service.rotate(target_name)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_backup_http_error(exc)

    return BackupActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action="rotate",
        target_name=target_name,
        result={
            "removed_count": len(removed),
            "removed_paths": [str(path) for path in removed],
        },
    )


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=BackupActionResponse,
    summary="Run a generic backup control action",
)
def run_backup_action(
    request: BackupActionRequest,
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> BackupActionResponse:
    try:
        if request.action == "snapshot":
            manifest = service.run_snapshot(request.target_name)
            result: dict[str, Any] = _manifest_to_response(manifest).model_dump()
        elif request.action == "export":
            manifest = service.run_export(request.target_name)
            result = _manifest_to_response(manifest).model_dump()
        else:
            removed = service.rotate(request.target_name)
            result = {
                "removed_count": len(removed),
                "removed_paths": [str(path) for path in removed],
            }
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_backup_http_error(exc)

    return BackupActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action=request.action,
        target_name=request.target_name,
        result=result,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status

PACKAGE_CATALOG: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "single-user": {
        "name": "Single User",
        "price_usd": 20,
        "included_units": 20_000,
        "description": (
            "Prepaid protection units for individual builders who want guarded prompt handling, "
            "tool-call review, source inspection, and safe response release."
        ),
    },
    "team-security": {
        "name": "Team Security",
        "price_usd": 90,
        "included_units": 100_000,
        "description": (
            "Prepaid protection units for teams running higher volumes of AI-assisted development, "
            "research, and guarded agent workflows."
        ),
    },
    "enterprise-security": {
        "name": "Enterprise Security",
        "price_usd": 150,
        "included_units": 200_000,
        "description": (
            "Prepaid protection units for organizations protecting large-scale agent operations, "
            "sensitive workflows, and high-frequency prompt activity."
        ),
    },
}


class BillingPackageView(BaseModel):
    package_id: str
    name: str
    price_usd: float
    included_units: int
    description: str


class ProtectionValueView(BaseModel):
    title: str
    detail: str


class UnitPolicyView(BaseModel):
    unit_definition: str
    delivery_model: str
    buyer_positioning: str
    protection_layers: list[ProtectionValueView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    market_context: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class BillingPackagePurchaseRequest(BaseModel):
    package_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    buyer_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    buyer_email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class BillingPackagePurchaseView(BaseModel):
    purchase_id: str
    package_id: str
    package_name: str
    buyer_name: str
    buyer_email: str
    price_usd: float
    granted_units: int
    created_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class BillingPackagesResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    packages: list[BillingPackageView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    unit_policy: UnitPolicyView


class BillingPackagePurchaseResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    purchase: BillingPackagePurchaseView


_PURCHASES: list[BillingPackagePurchaseView] = []


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _package_to_view(package_id: str, package_data: dict[str, Any]) -> BillingPackageView:
    return BillingPackageView(package_id=package_id, **package_data)


def _require_known_package(package_id: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    normalized = package_id.strip().lower()
    package = PACKAGE_CATALOG.get(normalized)
    if package is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown billing package: {package_id}")
    return normalized, package


def _build_unit_policy() -> UnitPolicyView:
    return UnitPolicyView(
        unit_definition="1 protection unit = 1 IronClaw protection event.",
        delivery_model="All packages are prepaid unit bundles with no recurring subscription requirement.",
        buyer_positioning=(
            "Customers are buying protected AI usage, not raw API calls. "
            "Each unit funds layered security checks around prompts, tool activity, returned content, and release decisions."
        ),
        protection_layers=[
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Prompt ingress protection",
                detail="Screens incoming prompts before risky instructions begin spreading through the workflow.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Tool-call guardrails",
                detail="Reviews agent actions before external tools, files, or execution paths are allowed to continue.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Source inspection",
                detail="Checks returned web or external content for hostile prompt-injection patterns and suspicious payloads.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Response release control",
                detail="Applies final safety review before content is released back into the user session or downstream agent flow.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Sandbox-backed isolation",
                detail="Pairs AI judgment with runtime boundaries so suspicious content can be contained instead of trusted.",
            ),
        ],
        market_context=[
            "Agent platforms process untrusted instructions from websites, files, repositories, docs, and generated artifacts.",
            "Prompt-injection attacks target AI systems specifically because they can redirect tools, leak data, or manipulate autonomous workflows.",
            "IronClaw protection units are designed to add security coverage around every stage where hostile content can enter or spread.",
        ],
    )


@router.get("/packages", response_model=BillingPackagesResponse)
def list_billing_packages() -> BillingPackagesResponse:
    packages = [
        _package_to_view(package_id, package_data)
        for package_id, package_data in PACKAGE_CATALOG.items()
    ]

    return BillingPackagesResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        packages=packages,
        unit_policy=_build_unit_policy(),
    )


@router.post(
    "/packages/purchase",
    response_model=BillingPackagePurchaseResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def purchase_billing_package(
    payload: BillingPackagePurchaseRequest,
) -> BillingPackagePurchaseResponse:
    package_id, package = _require_known_package(payload.package_id)
    purchase = BillingPackagePurchaseView(
        purchase_id=f"pkg_{len(_PURCHASES) + 1}",
        package_id=package_id,
        package_name=str(package["name"]),
        buyer_name=payload.buyer_name.strip(),
        buyer_email=payload.buyer_email.strip(),
        price_usd=float(package["price_usd"]),
        granted_units=int(package["included_units"]),
        created_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    _PURCHASES.append(purchase)

    return BillingPackagePurchaseResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        purchase=purchase,
    )

FILE: app\api\claude_bootstrap.py

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Literal, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Header, Request, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/bootstrap",
    tags=["claude-bootstrap"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


class ClaudeGuardMode(str):
    ENFORCE = "enforce"
    ASSIST = "assist"
    DRYRUN = "dryrun"


class ClaudePlatform(str):
    CLAUDE_CODE = "claude-code"


class ClaudeGuardClientConfig(BaseModel):
    guard_base_url: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Base URL for IronClaw guard endpoints reachable from Claude Code.",
        examples=["https://ironclaw.local", "https://ironclaw.company.com"],
    )
    api_key: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="API key Claude Code should send as X-API-Key when calling IronClaw.",
        min_length=1,
    )
    guard_mode: Literal["enforce", "assist", "dryrun"] = Field(
        "enforce",
        description="Guard behavior mode: enforce (block), assist (warn only), or dryrun.",
    )
    default_timeout_ms: int = Field(
        8000,
        ge=1000,
        le=30000,
        description="Default timeout for guard calls from the Claude Code proxy.",
    )
    max_payload_kb: int = Field(
        256,
        ge=16,
        le=2048,
        description="Maximum size (in KB) of prompt/output bundles Claude Code should send.",
    )
    use_bundle_guard: bool = Field(
        True,
        description="If true, Claude Code sends consolidated prompt/output bundles to /policy/guard-bundle.",
    )
    use_guard_execute: bool = Field(
        True,
        description="If true, tool calls and external actions are sent to /guard/execute.",
    )


class ClaudeBootstrapRequest(BaseModel):
    platform: Literal["claude-code"] = Field(
        "claude-code",
        description="Target platform; currently fixed to claude-code.",
    )
    display_name: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Human-readable name for this Claude Code workspace/project.",
        min_length=1,
        max_length=128,
    )
    base_guard_url: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description=(
            "Optional override for IronClaw's externally reachable base URL. "
            "If omitted, this is derived from the current request."
        ),
    )
    guard_mode: Literal["enforce", "assist", "dryrun"] = Field(
        "enforce",
        description="Guard mode to advertise to Claude Code clients.",
    )
    default_timeout_ms: int = Field(
        8000,
        ge=1000,
        le=30000,
        description="Default timeout in ms Claude Code should use when calling IronClaw.",
    )
    max_payload_kb: int = Field(
        256,
        ge=16,
        le=2048,
        description="Maximum bundle size Claude Code should send.",
    )


class ClaudeBootstrapResponse(BaseModel):
    generated_at: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when this config was generated.",
    )
    platform: Literal["claude-code"]
    workspace_name: str
    client_config: ClaudeGuardClientConfig
    one_command_snippet: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Copy-paste shell snippet for wiring Claude Code's proxy to IronClaw.",
    )
    notes: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="Implementation notes and next steps.",
    )


def _infer_external_base_url(request: Request) -> str:
    scheme = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto") or request.url.scheme
    host = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Host") or request.headers.get("Host") or request.url.netloc
    return f"{scheme}://{host}".rstrip("/")


def _build_one_command_snippet(
    config: ClaudeGuardClientConfig,
    workspace_name: str,
) -> str:
    safe_name = workspace_name.replace('"', r"\"")
    return (
        "# One-command wiring for Claude Code -> IronClaw guard\n"
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL="{config.guard_base_url}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY="{config.api_key}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE="{config.guard_mode}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS="{config.default_timeout_ms}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_MAX_PAYLOAD_KB="{config.max_payload_kb}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_WORKSPACE_NAME="{safe_name}"\n'
        "# Configure your Claude Code proxy/tooling to:\n"
        "#  - Send guarded actions to:  $IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL/guard/execute\n"
        "#  - Send prompt/output bundles to: $IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL/policy/guard-bundle\n"
        "#  - Include header: X-API-Key=$IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY on every call\n"
    )


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=ClaudeBootstrapResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
def bootstrap_claude_code_guard(
    request: Request,
    payload: ClaudeBootstrapRequest,
    x_api_key: str = Header(..., alias="X-API-Key"),
) -> ClaudeBootstrapResponse:
    base_url = payload.base_guard_url or _infer_external_base_url(request)

    client_config = ClaudeGuardClientConfig(
        guard_base_url=base_url,
        api_key=x_api_key,
        guard_mode=payload.guard_mode,
        default_timeout_ms=payload.default_timeout_ms,
        max_payload_kb=payload.max_payload_kb,
        use_bundle_guard=True,
        use_guard_execute=True,
    )

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    snippet = _build_one_command_snippet(
        config=client_config,
        workspace_name=payload.display_name,
    )

    notes = [
        "Configure Claude Code's proxy to send all external tool calls through /guard/execute.",
        "Send combined prompt/context/model output bundles to /policy/guard-bundle before showing them to the user.",
        "Always include X-API-Key using the value from IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY.",
        "Use IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE to decide whether to enforce blocks or only warn in the UI.",
    ]

    return ClaudeBootstrapResponse(
        generated_at=now,
        platform="claude-code",
        workspace_name=payload.display_name,
        client_config=client_config,
        one_command_snippet=snippet,
        notes=notes,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict, Optional

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, StreamingResponse
from starlette.background import BackgroundTask

from app.core.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/guard-router",
    tags=["claude-guard-router"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


async def _scan_with_policy_guard(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    partial_text: str,
    *,
    context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "userprompt": context.get("userprompt") if context else None,
        "retrieveddoc": context.get("retrieveddoc") if context else None,
        "tooloutput": context.get("tooloutput") if context else None,
        "modeloutput": partial_text,
    }

    resp = await client.post(
        f"{guard_base_url.rstrip('/')}/policy/guard-bundle",
        headers={"X-API-Key": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=payload,
        timeout=5.0,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]


def _build_guard_warning(reason: str, verdict: str) -> bytes:
    return (
        "\n\n[IRONCLAW-GUARD] Stream truncated due to high-risk content. "
        f"Reason: {reason or 'policy guard verdict: ' + verdict}.\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


async def _guarded_upstream_stream(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
    *,
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    request_body: Dict[str, Any],
    guard_mode: str,
    scan_interval_chars: int = 256,
) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
    context = {
        "userprompt": request_body.get("user_prompt"),
        "retrieveddoc": request_body.get("retrieved_docs"),
        "tooloutput": request_body.get("tool_outputs"),
    }

    buffer = ""
    scanned_upto = 0
    blocked = False

    async for chunk in upstream.aiter_text():
        if not chunk:
            continue

        buffer += chunk

        if len(buffer) - scanned_upto >= scan_interval_chars and not blocked:
            verdict_data = await _scan_with_policy_guard(
                client=client,
                guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                api_key=api_key,
                partial_text=buffer,
                context=context,
            )
            verdict = str(verdict_data.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")).lower()
            reason = str(verdict_data.get("reason", ""))

            if guard_mode == "enforce" and verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
                blocked = True
                yield _build_guard_warning(reason, verdict)
                break

            scanned_upto = len(buffer)

        if not blocked:
            yield chunk.encode("utf-8")

    if not blocked and len(buffer) > scanned_upto:
        verdict_data = await _scan_with_policy_guard(
            client=client,
            guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
            api_key=api_key,
            partial_text=buffer,
            context=context,
        )
        verdict = str(verdict_data.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")).lower()
        reason = str(verdict_data.get("reason", ""))

        if guard_mode == "enforce" and verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
            yield _build_guard_warning(reason, verdict)


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
async def claude_guard_router_proxy(
    request: Request,
) -> Response:
    body = await request.json()

    upstream_url = body.get("upstream_url")
    upstream_payload = body.get("upstream_payload") or {}
    guard_base_url = body.get("guard_base_url") or _infer_guard_base_url(request)
    guard_mode = str(body.get("guard_mode") or "enforce").lower()

    if not upstream_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Missing 'upstream_url' in request body.",
        )

    if guard_mode not in {"enforce", "assist", "dryrun"}:
        guard_mode = "enforce"

    api_key = request.headers.get("X-API-Key")
    if not api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Missing X-API-Key header.",
        )

    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None)
    upstream: httpx.Response | None = None
    try:
        upstream = await client.send(
            client.build_request(
                "POST",
                upstream_url,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                content=json.dumps(upstream_payload, separators=(",", ":")),
            ),
            stream=True,
        )

        if upstream.status_code != status.HTTP_200_OK:
            error_text = (await upstream.aread()).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            return PlainTextResponse(
                error_text,
                status_code=upstream.status_code,
                background=BackgroundTask(_close_client_and_upstream, upstream, client),
            )

        async def event_stream() -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
            prelude = {
                "type": "ironclaw_guard_info",
                "generated_at": _now_iso(),
                "guard_mode": guard_mode,
            }
            yield (json.dumps(prelude) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

            async for chunk in _guarded_upstream_stream(
                upstream,
                client=client,
                guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                api_key=api_key,
                request_body=upstream_payload,
                guard_mode=guard_mode,
            ):
                yield chunk

        return StreamingResponse(
            event_stream(),
            media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
            background=BackgroundTask(_close_client_and_upstream, upstream, client),
        )
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        if upstream is not None:
            await upstream.aclose()
        await client.aclose()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Upstream proxy error: {exc!r}",
        ) from exc
    except Exception:
        if upstream is not None:
            await upstream.aclose()
        await client.aclose()
        raise


async def _close_client_and_upstream(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    await upstream.aclose()
    await client.aclose()


def _infer_guard_base_url(request: Request) -> str:
    scheme = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto") or request.url.scheme
    host = (
        request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Host")
        or request.headers.get("Host")
        or request.url.netloc
    )
    return f"{scheme}://{host}".rstrip("/")

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, StreamingResponse
from starlette.background import BackgroundTask

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/router-proxy",
    tags=["claude-router-proxy"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


async def _proxy_upstream_stream(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
    async for chunk in upstream.aiter_bytes():
        if chunk:
            yield chunk


async def _close_upstream_and_client(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    await upstream.aclose()
    await client.aclose()


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
async def claude_router_proxy(
    request: Request,
) -> Response:
    body = await request.json()

    upstream_url = body.get("upstream_url")
    upstream_payload = body.get("upstream_payload") or {}

    if not upstream_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Missing 'upstream_url' in request body.",
        )

    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None)
    try:
        upstream = await client.send(
            client.build_request(
                "POST",
                upstream_url,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                content=json.dumps(upstream_payload, separators=(",", ":")),
            ),
            stream=True,
        )

        if upstream.status_code != status.HTTP_200_OK:
            error_text = (await upstream.aread()).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            await upstream.aclose()
            await client.aclose()
            return PlainTextResponse(
                error_text,
                status_code=upstream.status_code,
            )

        return StreamingResponse(
            _proxy_upstream_stream(upstream),
            media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
            background=BackgroundTask(_close_upstream_and_client, upstream, client),
        )
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        await client.aclose()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Upstream proxy error: {exc!r}",
        ) from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict, Optional

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/stream-guard",
    tags=["claude-stream-guard"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],

class StreamGuardError(Exception):
    pass


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


async def _scan_chunk_with_policy_guard(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    partial_text: str,
    *,
    context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "userprompt": context.get("userprompt") if context else None,
        "retrieveddoc": context.get("retrieveddoc") if context else None,
        "tooloutput": context.get("tooloutput") if context else None,
        "modeloutput": partial_text,
    }

    url = f"{guard_base_url.rstrip('/')}/policy/guard-bundle"
    resp = await client.post(
        url,
        headers={"X-API-Key": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=payload,
        timeout=5.0,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]


def _build_block_warning(reason: str, bundle_verdict: str) -> bytes:
    warning = (
        "\n\n[IRONCLAW-GUARD] Stream truncated due to high-risk content. "
        f"Reason: {reason or 'policy guard verdict: ' + bundle_verdict}.\n"
    )
    return warning.encode("utf-8")


async def _proxy_stream_with_guard(
    upstream_url: str,
    *,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    request_body: Dict[str, Any],
    guard_mode: str = "enforce",
    scan_interval_chars: int = 256,
) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
    context = {
        "userprompt": request_body.get("user_prompt"),
        "retrieveddoc": request_body.get("retrieved_docs"),
        "tooloutput": request_body.get("tool_outputs"),
    }

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
        try:
            async with client.stream(
                "POST",
                upstream_url,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                json=request_body,
            ) as upstream:
                if upstream.status_code != status.HTTP_200_OK:
                    text = await upstream.aread()
                    raise StreamGuardError(
                        f"Upstream returned {upstream.status_code}: {text!r}"
                    )

                buffer = ""
                scanned_upto = 0
                blocked = False

                async for chunk in upstream.aiter_text():
                    if not chunk:
                        continue

                    buffer += chunk

                    if len(buffer) - scanned_upto >= scan_interval_chars and not blocked:
                        verdict = await _scan_chunk_with_policy_guard(
                            client=client,
                            guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                            api_key=api_key,
                            partial_text=buffer,
                            context=context,
                        )

                        bundle_verdict = str(
                            verdict.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")
                        ).lower()
                        reason = str(verdict.get("reason", ""))

                        if guard_mode == "enforce" and bundle_verdict in {
                            "block",
                            "quarantine",
                        }:
                            blocked = True
                            yield _build_block_warning(reason, bundle_verdict)
                            break

                        scanned_upto = len(buffer)

                    if not blocked:
                        yield chunk.encode("utf-8")

                if not blocked and len(buffer) > scanned_upto:
                    verdict = await _scan_chunk_with_policy_guard(
                        client=client,
                        guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                        api_key=api_key,
                        partial_text=buffer,
                        context=context,
                    )

                    bundle_verdict = str(
                        verdict.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")
                    ).lower()
                    reason = str(verdict.get("reason", ""))

                    if guard_mode == "enforce" and bundle_verdict in {
                        "block",
                        "quarantine",
                    }:
                        yield _build_block_warning(reason, bundle_verdict)

        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            error_msg = f"[IRONCLAW-GUARD] Upstream streaming error: {exc!r}"
            yield error_msg.encode("utf-8")


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
async def claude_stream_guard_proxy(
    request: Request,
) -> StreamingResponse:
    body = await request.json()

    upstream_url = body.get("upstream_url")
    upstream_payload = body.get("upstream_payload") or {}
    guard_base_url = body.get("guard_base_url") or _infer_guard_base_url(request)
    guard_mode = str(body.get("guard_mode") or "enforce").lower()

    if not upstream_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Missing 'upstream_url' in request body.",
        )

    if guard_mode not in {"enforce", "assist", "dryrun"}:
        guard_mode = "enforce"

    api_key = request.headers.get("X-API-Key")
    if not api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Missing X-API-Key header.",
        )

    async def event_stream() -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
        prelude = {
            "type": "ironclaw_guard_info",
            "generated_at": _now_iso(),
            "guard_mode": guard_mode,
        }
        import json

        yield (json.dumps(prelude) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

        async for chunk in _proxy_stream_with_guard(
            upstream_url=upstream_url,
            guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
            api_key=api_key,
            request_body=upstream_payload,
            guard_mode=guard_mode,
        ):
            yield chunk

    return StreamingResponse(
        event_stream(),
        media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
    )

        or request.headers.get("Host")

from __future__ import annotations


from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


from app.core.api_keys import (
    APIKeyRecord,
    generate_api_key,
    get_api_key_registry,
    mask_api_key,
)
from app.core.auth import require_api_key



router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/customer-keys",
    tags=["customer-keys"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)



class CustomerKeyCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class CustomerKeyView(BaseModel):
    key_id: str
    display_name: str
    masked_key: str
    created_at: str
    last_used_at: str | None = None
    active: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class CustomerKeyCreateResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    api_key: str
    key: CustomerKeyView



class CustomerKeyListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_keys: int
    keys: list[CustomerKeyView] = Field(default_factory=list)



class CustomerKeyRevokeResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    revoked_key_id: str



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _to_iso(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _to_view(record: APIKeyRecord, masked_value: str | None = None) -> CustomerKeyView:
    return CustomerKeyView(
        key_id=record.key_id,
        display_name=record.display_name,
        masked_key=masked_value or mask_api_key(record.hashed_secret),
        created_at=_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        active=record.active,
        metadata=record.metadata or {},
    )



@router.get("", response_model=CustomerKeyListResponse)
def list_customer_keys() -> CustomerKeyListResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    records = list(getattr(registry, "_keys_by_id", {}).values())
    records = sorted(records, key=lambda record: record.created_at, reverse=True)


    return CustomerKeyListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_keys=len(records),
        keys=[_to_view(record) for record in records],
    )



@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=CustomerKeyCreateResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def create_customer_key(payload: CustomerKeyCreateRequest) -> CustomerKeyCreateResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    raw_api_key = generate_api_key()
    record = registry.register_key(
        display_name=payload.display_name.strip(),
        raw_secret=raw_api_key,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )


    return CustomerKeyCreateResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        api_key=raw_api_key,
        key=_to_view(record, masked_value=mask_api_key(raw_api_key)),
    )



@router.post("/{key_id}/revoke", response_model=CustomerKeyRevokeResponse)
def revoke_customer_key(key_id: str) -> CustomerKeyRevokeResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    registry.deactivate_key(key_id)


    return CustomerKeyRevokeResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        revoked_key_id=key_id,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter()

SERVICE_NAME = "IronClaw-Security"
OK_STATUS = "ok"


class RequestMeta(BaseModel):
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    path: str
    method: str


class HeadersPresent(BaseModel):
    x_request_id: bool
    x_trace_id: bool
    user_agent: bool


class ClientInfo(BaseModel):
    host: str | None = None
    port: int | None = None


class DiagnosticsDetails(BaseModel):
    request: RequestMeta
    headers_present: HeadersPresent
    client: ClientInfo


class DiagnosticsResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    diagnostics: DiagnosticsDetails


def _request_meta(request: Request) -> RequestMeta:
    return RequestMeta(
        request_id=getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
        trace_id=getattr(request.state, "trace_id", None),
        path=request.url.path,
        method=request.method,
    )


def _client_info(request: Request) -> ClientInfo:
    client = request.client
    return ClientInfo(
        host=client.host if client else None,
        port=client.port if client else None,
    )


def _headers_present(request: Request) -> HeadersPresent:
    return HeadersPresent(
        x_request_id=request.headers.get("x-request-id") is not None,
        x_trace_id=request.headers.get("x-trace-id") is not None,
        user_agent=request.headers.get("user-agent") is not None,
    )


def _safe_append_telemetry_event(event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(event_name, payload)
    except Exception:
        pass


@router.get("/diagnostics", response_model=DiagnosticsResponse, tags=["system"], summary="Diagnostics")
def diagnostics(request: Request) -> DiagnosticsResponse:
    request_meta = _request_meta(request)
    client_info = _client_info(request)
    headers_present = _headers_present(request)

    payload = DiagnosticsResponse(
        status=OK_STATUS,
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        diagnostics=DiagnosticsDetails(
            request=request_meta,
            headers_present=headers_present,
            client=client_info,
        ),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "diagnostics_requested",
        {
            **request_meta.model_dump(),
            "client_host": client_info.host,
            "client_port": client_info.port,
            "headers_present": headers_present.model_dump(),
        },
    )

    return payload

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from app.api.executeresult import ExecuteRequest, ExecuteResponse
from app.executeservice import get_action_execute_pipeline, guard_and_execute_action

router = APIRouter(prefix="/guard", tags=["guard"])


def _normalize_response_status(raw: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(raw, str):
        normalized = raw.strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
        if normalized in {"completed", "queued_for_review", "denied"}:
            return normalized

    if raw == 200:
        return "completed"
    if raw in {202, 206, 409}:
        return "queued_for_review"
    if raw in {400, 401, 403}:
        return "denied"

    return "denied"


def _ensure_filepath(summary: dict) -> dict:
    executor_result = summary.get("executor_result")
    if isinstance(executor_result, dict) and not executor_result.get("filepath"):
        executor_result["filepath"] = "app/api/action_execute.py"
    return summary


@router.post("/execute", response_model=ExecuteResponse)
def guarded_execute(
    payload: ExecuteRequest,
    pipeline=Depends(get_action_execute_pipeline),
) -> ExecuteResponse:
    response_payload = guard_and_execute_action(payload, pipeline=pipeline)

    if not isinstance(response_payload, dict):
        response_payload = {"response_status": "denied", "summary": {}}

    response_payload = _ensure_filepath(response_payload)
    response_payload["response_status"] = _normalize_response_status(
        response_payload.get("response_status")
    )

    return ExecuteResponse(**response_payload)

FILE: app\api\health.py

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.dependencies.action_execute import get_action_execute_pipeline
from app.orchestrator.secure_runtime_pipeline import (
    get_secure_runtime_health_snapshot,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/health", tags=["health"])

SERVICE_NAME = "IronClaw-Security"
SERVICE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
HEALTH_PURPOSE = "compact-readiness"
OK_STATUSES = frozenset({"ok", "healthy"})
WARN_STATUSES = frozenset({"warn", "warning", "degraded"})


class HealthStatus(str, Enum):
    ok = "ok"
    warn = "warn"
    degraded = "degraded"
    error = "error"
    unknown = "unknown"


class ComponentHealth(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: HealthStatus
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class HealthSnapshot(BaseModel):
    status: HealthStatus
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    version: str
    components: list[ComponentHealth] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _normalize_component_status(raw_status: Any) -> HealthStatus:
    value = str(raw_status or "").strip().lower()
    if value in OK_STATUSES:
        return HealthStatus.ok
    if value in WARN_STATUSES:
        return HealthStatus.warn
    if value == HealthStatus.error.value:
        return HealthStatus.error
    return HealthStatus.unknown


def _resolve_overall_status(components: list[ComponentHealth]) -> HealthStatus:
    if any(component.status == HealthStatus.error for component in components):
        return HealthStatus.degraded
    if any(component.status == HealthStatus.unknown for component in components):
        return HealthStatus.degraded
    if any(component.status == HealthStatus.warn for component in components):
        return HealthStatus.warn
    return HealthStatus.ok


def _build_api_component() -> ComponentHealth:
    return ComponentHealth(
        name="api",
        status=HealthStatus.ok,
        details={"reachable": True},
    )


def _build_secure_runtime_component() -> ComponentHealth:
    try:
        pipeline = get_action_execute_pipeline()
        pipeline_health = get_secure_runtime_health_snapshot(pipeline)

        if not isinstance(pipeline_health, dict):
            return ComponentHealth(
                name="secure_runtime_pipeline",
                status=HealthStatus.unknown,
                details={
                    "error": "invalid-health-payload",
                    "observed_type": type(pipeline_health).__name__,
                },
            )

        normalized_status = _normalize_component_status(pipeline_health.get("status"))
        return ComponentHealth(
            name="secure_runtime_pipeline",
            status=normalized_status,
            details=pipeline_health,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return ComponentHealth(
            name="secure_runtime_pipeline",
            status=HealthStatus.error,
            details={"error": repr(exc)},
        )


@router.get("", response_model=HealthSnapshot)
def read_compact_health() -> HealthSnapshot:
    """
    Compact health snapshot for readiness and operational dashboards.

    This endpoint is designed to be:
    - Lightweight enough for frequent polling (readiness / uptime checks),
    - Structured enough to power the UI health snapshot panel,
    - Stable as a public contract for external monitoring tools.
    """
    components = [
        _build_api_component(),
        _build_secure_runtime_component(),
    ]
    overall_status = _resolve_overall_status(components)

    return HealthSnapshot(
        status=overall_status,
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        components=components,
        metadata={
            "purpose": HEALTH_PURPOSE,
            "notes": [
                "This snapshot is safe for external uptime monitoring.",
                "The secure_runtime_pipeline details field is intentionally compact and stable.",
            ],
            "component_count": len(components),
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

class HealthProbeResponse(BaseModel):

    service: str
    probe: str
    timestamp: str



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



@router.get("/live", response_model=HealthProbeResponse)
def liveness_probe() -> HealthProbeResponse:
    return HealthProbeResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        probe="liveness",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
    )



@router.get("/ready", response_model=HealthProbeResponse)
def readiness_probe(request: Request) -> JSONResponse | HealthProbeResponse:
    pipeline = get_action_execute_pipeline()
    app_pipeline = getattr(request.app.state, "action_execute_pipeline", None)


    if pipeline is None or app_pipeline is None:
        body = HealthProbeResponse(
            status="not_ready",
            service="IronClaw-Security",
            probe="readiness",
            timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),

        return JSONResponse(
            status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
            content=body.model_dump(),
        )


    return HealthProbeResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        probe="readiness",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from time import monotonic

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

SERVICE_NAME = "ironclaw-security"
SERVICE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
PROCESS_STARTED_AT = monotonic()

router = APIRouter(tags=["system"])


class ComponentStatus(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    details: dict[str, object] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class LivenessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int


class ReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    ready: bool
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    live: bool
    ready: bool
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


def _timestamp() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _uptime_seconds() -> int:
    return max(0, int(monotonic() - PROCESS_STARTED_AT))


def _readiness_checks() -> list[ComponentStatus]:
    return [
        ComponentStatus(
            name="api_router",
            status="ok",
            details={"registered": True},
        ),
        ComponentStatus(
            name="process",
            status="ok",
            details={"uptime_seconds": _uptime_seconds()},
        ),
    ]


@router.get(
    "/system/live",
    response_model=LivenessResponse,
    summary="Liveness probe",
    description="Fast, dependency-light probe that answers: is the process alive and serving requests?",
)
def get_liveness() -> LivenessResponse:
    return LivenessResponse(
        status="ok",
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        timestamp=_timestamp(),
        uptime_seconds=_uptime_seconds(),
    )


@router.get(
    "/system/ready",
    response_model=ReadinessResponse,
    summary="Readiness probe",
    description="Readiness probe that checks whether core in-process services initialized enough to safely receive traffic.",
)
def get_readiness() -> ReadinessResponse:
    checks = _readiness_checks()
    ready = all(check.status == "ok" for check in checks)
    return ReadinessResponse(
        status="ok" if ready else "degraded",
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        timestamp=_timestamp(),
        uptime_seconds=_uptime_seconds(),
        ready=ready,
        checks=checks,
    )


@router.get(
    "/system/health",
    response_model=HealthResponse,
    summary="Combined health snapshot",
    description="Combined operational health snapshot for dashboards and lightweight UI polling.",
)
def get_health() -> HealthResponse:
    checks = _readiness_checks()
    ready = all(check.status == "ok" for check in checks)
    return HealthResponse(
        status="ok" if ready else "degraded",
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        timestamp=_timestamp(),
        uptime_seconds=_uptime_seconds(),
        live=True,
        ready=ready,
        checks=checks,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Literal, Mapping, cast

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from app.core.errors import AppError, NotFoundError
from app.schemas.scan import ScanHistoryItem, ScanHistoryResponse
from app.services.audit_log_service import (
    list_audit_events,
    list_audit_events_for_actor,
    list_audit_events_for_session,
)
from app.services.history import get_scan_by_id, read_scan_history, update_scan_by_id

router = APIRouter()

_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_DEFAULT = 100
_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX = 1000
_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_DEFAULT = 20
_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_MAX = 200
_REVIEWABLE_VERDICT = "quarantine"
_HEURISTIC_PROMPT_INJECTION_SCORE_ID = "heuristic_prompt_injection_score"
_REVIEW_STATUS_NONE = "none"
_REVIEW_STATUS_APPROVED = "approved"
_REVIEW_STATUS_REJECTED = "rejected"
_VERDICT_ALLOW = "allow"
_VERDICT_BLOCK = "block"
_DEFAULT_SAFE_SUMMARY = "No risky patterns detected."


class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request body for reviewing a quarantined scan record."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    action: Literal["approve", "reject"]


def _coerce_list(value: Any) -> List[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if value is None:
        return []
    return []


def _derive_summary(matched_patterns: List[Any]) -> str:
    if matched_patterns:
        return f"Detected {len(matched_patterns)} risky pattern(s)."
    return _DEFAULT_SAFE_SUMMARY


def _derive_risk_score(matched_patterns: List[Any]) -> int:
    heuristic_bonus = 0
    for pattern in matched_patterns:
        identifier: Any = None
        if isinstance(pattern, Mapping):
            identifier = pattern.get("id") or pattern.get("name")
        elif isinstance(pattern, str):
            identifier = pattern

        if identifier == _HEURISTIC_PROMPT_INJECTION_SCORE_ID:
            heuristic_bonus = 5
            break

    base_score = len(matched_patterns) * 15 + heuristic_bonus
    return max(0, min(100, base_score))


def _build_review_summary(summary: Any, action: Literal["approve", "reject"]) -> str:
    base_summary = str(summary or "").strip()
    review_suffix = f"Review action: {action}."
    if not base_summary:
        return review_suffix
    if base_summary.endswith(review_suffix):
        return base_summary
    return f"{base_summary} {review_suffix}"


def _normalize_history_item(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Normalize a raw scan history item so downstream code and UI always see
    the expected keys and safe default values.
    """
    normalized: Dict[str, Any] = dict(item)

    matched_patterns = _coerce_list(normalized.get("matched_patterns"))
    normalized["matched_patterns"] = matched_patterns

    if not normalized.get("summary"):
        normalized["summary"] = _derive_summary(matched_patterns)

    risk_score = normalized.get("risk_score")
    if risk_score is None:
        normalized["risk_score"] = _derive_risk_score(matched_patterns)
    else:
        try:
            normalized["risk_score"] = max(0, min(100, int(risk_score)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            normalized["risk_score"] = _derive_risk_score(matched_patterns)

    normalized["risky_files"] = _coerce_list(normalized.get("risky_files"))
    normalized["checks_loaded"] = _coerce_list(normalized.get("checks_loaded"))
    normalized["failed_checks"] = _coerce_list(normalized.get("failed_checks"))
    normalized.setdefault("quarantine_reason", None)
    normalized.setdefault("review_status", _REVIEW_STATUS_NONE)
    normalized["untrusted"] = bool(normalized.get("untrusted", False))

    return normalized


@router.get("/events")
def get_history_events(
    limit: int = Query(
        default=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_DEFAULT,
        ge=1,
        le=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Return recent security history events, newest-first.
    """
    return cast(List[Dict[str, Any]], list_audit_events(limit=limit))


@router.get("/events/by-session/{session_id}")
def get_history_events_by_session(
    session_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(
        default=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_DEFAULT,
        ge=1,
        le=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Return recent security history events for a given session_id, newest-first.
    """
    return cast(
        List[Dict[str, Any]],
        list_audit_events_for_session(session_id=session_id, limit=limit),
    )


@router.get("/events/by-actor/{actor_id}")
def get_history_events_by_actor(
    actor_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(
        default=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_DEFAULT,
        ge=1,
        le=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Return recent security history events for a given actor_id, newest-first.
    """
    return cast(
        List[Dict[str, Any]],
        list_audit_events_for_actor(actor_id=actor_id, limit=limit),
    )


@router.get("/", response_model=ScanHistoryResponse)
def get_scan_history(
    limit: int = Query(
        default=_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_DEFAULT,
        ge=1,
        le=_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),
) -> ScanHistoryResponse:
    """
    Return recent scan history records, normalized for UI consumption.
    """
    history = read_scan_history(limit=limit)
    items = history.get("items", [])
    normalized_items = [_normalize_history_item(item) for item in items]

    return ScanHistoryResponse(
        count=len(normalized_items),
        items=normalized_items,
    )


@router.get("/{scan_id}", response_model=ScanHistoryItem)
def get_scan_record(scan_id: str) -> ScanHistoryItem:
    """
    Return a single normalized scan history record by its identifier.
    """
    item = get_scan_by_id(scan_id)
    if not item:
        raise NotFoundError(
            message="Scan not found",
            details={"scan_id": scan_id},
        )
    return ScanHistoryItem(**_normalize_history_item(item))


@router.post("/{scan_id}/review", response_model=ScanHistoryItem)
def review_scan_record(scan_id: str, request: ReviewRequest) -> ScanHistoryItem:
    """
    Review a quarantined scan record and update its verdict + review status.

    Only scans with verdict == "quarantine" are eligible for review.
    """
    item = get_scan_by_id(scan_id)
    if not item:
        raise NotFoundError(
            message="Scan not found",
            details={"scan_id": scan_id},
        )

    item = _normalize_history_item(item)

    if item.get("verdict") != _REVIEWABLE_VERDICT:
        raise AppError(
            error="invalid_review_state",
            message="Only quarantined scans can be reviewed",
            status_code=400,
            details={
                "scan_id": scan_id,
                "verdict": item.get("verdict"),
                "review_action": request.action,
            },
        )

    approved = request.action == "approve"
    updates: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "review_status": _REVIEW_STATUS_APPROVED if approved else _REVIEW_STATUS_REJECTED,
        "untrusted": not approved,
        "verdict": _VERDICT_ALLOW if approved else _VERDICT_BLOCK,
        "summary": _build_review_summary(item.get("summary"), request.action),
    }

    updated = update_scan_by_id(scan_id, updates)
    if not updated:
        raise NotFoundError(
            message="Scan not found",
            details={"scan_id": scan_id},
        )

    return ScanHistoryItem(**_normalize_history_item(updated))

def get_attack_correlation_service() -> AttackCorrelationService:
    return AttackCorrelationService()


@router.post(
    "/correlate",
    response_model=CorrelateResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
def correlate_incidents(
    payload: CorrelateRequest,
    organization_id: str = Depends(get_current_organization_id),
    service: AttackCorrelationService = Depends(get_attack_correlation_service),
    session_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
    actor_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
) -> CorrelateResponse:
    if not payload.signals:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="At least one signal is required for correlation",
        )

    result = service.correlate(
        [signal.model_dump() for signal in payload.signals],
        session_id=payload.session_id or session_id,
        actor_id=payload.actor_id or actor_id,
        organization_id=organization_id,
        request_id=payload.request_id,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    return CorrelateResponse.model_validate(result)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
