def _record_slug(record: Any) -> str:
    slug = str(record.metadata.get("slug", "")).strip()
    if slug:
        return slug

    platform = str(record.platform).strip().lower()
    if platform == "claude":
        return "claude-code"
    return str(record.integrationid).strip().lower().replace("_", "-")


def _integration_type(record: Any) -> str:
    return str(record.metadata.get("integration_type", "adapter")).strip() or "adapter"


def _matches_platform(record: Any, platform: str | None) -> bool:
    if not platform:
        return True
    target = platform.strip().lower()
    return _record_slug(record) == target


def _matches_capability(record: Any, capability: str | None) -> bool:
    if not capability:
        return True
    target = capability.strip().lower()
    return any(
        str(item.name).strip().lower() == target and bool(item.enabled)
        for item in record.capabilities
    )


def _serialize_record(record: Any) -> IntegrationRecordResponse:
    slug = _record_slug(record)
    return IntegrationRecordResponse(
        integration_id=record.integrationid,
        slug=slug,
        platform=slug,
        integration_type=_integration_type(record),
        display_name=record.displayname,
        status=record.status,
        description=record.description,
        version=record.version,
        adapter_module=record.adaptermodule,
        verification_route=record.verificationroute,
        settings_route=record.settingsroute,
        manifest_route=record.manifestroute,
        installed_at=record.installedat,
        verified_at=record.verifiedat,
        tags=list(record.tags),
        capabilities=[
            IntegrationCapabilityResponse(
                name=capability.name,
                enabled=capability.enabled,
                maturity=capability.maturity,
                notes=capability.notes,
            )
            for capability in record.capabilities
        ],
        metadata=dict(record.metadata),
    )


def _find_record(integration_id: str) -> Any | None:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    normalized = integration_id.strip().lower()
    for record in registry.list_integrations():
        if str(record.integrationid).strip().lower() == normalized:
            return record
        if _record_slug(record) == normalized:
            return record
    return None


@router.get("", response_model=IntegrationRegistryResponse)
def read_integrations(
    platform: str | None = Query(default=None),
    capability: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> IntegrationRegistryResponse:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    items = [
        item
        for item in registry.list_integrations()
        if _matches_platform(item, platform) and _matches_capability(item, capability)
    ]
    return IntegrationRegistryResponse(
        total=len(items),
        summary=registry.integration_summary(),
        items=[_serialize_record(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.get("/summary", response_model=IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse)
def read_integrations_summary() -> IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    items = registry.list_integrations()
    summary = registry.integration_summary()
    platforms = sorted({_record_slug(item) for item in items})
    capabilities = sorted(
        {
            str(capability.name)
            for item in items
            for capability in item.capabilities
            if capability.enabled
        }
    )
    one_command_ready_targets = sorted(
        _record_slug(item) for item in items if item.status in ("available", "ready")
    )
    return IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse(
        total_integrations=summary["total_integrations"],
        statuses=summary,
        platforms=platforms,
        capabilities=capabilities,
        one_command_ready_targets=one_command_ready_targets,
    )


@router.get("/{integration_id}", response_model=IntegrationRecordResponse)
def read_integration(integration_id: str) -> IntegrationRecordResponse:
    record = _find_record(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")
    return _serialize_record(record)


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/verify",
    response_model=IntegrationVerificationResponse,
)
def verify_integration_route(
    integration_id: str,
    strict: bool = False,
    requested_by: str = "system",
) -> IntegrationVerificationResponse:
    record = _find_record(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    verifier = get_integration_verifier()
    result = verifier.verify_integration(
        record.integrationid,
        strict=strict,
        requestedby=requested_by,
    )
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    return IntegrationVerificationResponse(
        integration_id=result.integrationid,
        platform=_record_slug(record),
        status=result.status,
        verified=result.verified,
        verified_at=result.verifiedat,
        requested_by=result.requestedby,
        strict=result.strict,
        checks=[
            IntegrationVerificationCheckResponse(
                check_id=check.checkid,
                label=check.label,
                passed=check.passed,
                detail=check.detail,
            )
            for check in result.checks
        ],
        missing_capabilities=list(result.missingcapabilities),
        summary=result.summary,
    )


@router.post(
    "/{integration_id}/install",
    response_model=IntegrationInstallResponse,
)
def install_integration_route(
    integration_id: str,
    payload: IntegrationInstallRequest,
) -> IntegrationInstallResponse:
    record = _find_record(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    installer = get_integration_installer()
    result = installer.install_integration(
        record.integrationid,
        requestedby=payload.requested_by or "system",
    )
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    return IntegrationInstallResponse(
        integration_id=result.integrationid,
        platform=_record_slug(record),
        status=result.status,
        installed=result.installed,
        installed_at=result.installedat,
        requested_by=result.requestedby,
        steps=[
            IntegrationInstallStepResponse(
                step_id=step.stepid,
                label=step.label,
                completed=step.completed,
                detail=step.detail,
            )
            for step in result.steps
        ],
        summary=result.summary,
    )


@router.post(
    "/policy-bundles/sign",
    response_model=SignedPolicyBundleResponse,
)
def sign_policy_bundle_route(
    payload: PolicyBundleSignRequest,
) -> SignedPolicyBundleResponse:
    created_at = str(
        payload.metadata.get("created_at") or datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    )
    return SignedPolicyBundleResponse(
        bundle_id=payload.bundle_id,
        version=payload.version,
        created_at=created_at,
        signature=f"sig-{payload.bundle_id}-{payload.version}",
        key_id="ironclaw-gen1",
        policies=list(payload.policies),
        metadata=dict(payload.metadata),
    )


@router.post(
    "/policy-bundles/import",
    response_model=SignedPolicyBundleResponse,
)
def import_policy_bundle_route(
    payload: PolicyBundleImportRequest,
) -> SignedPolicyBundleResponse:
    return SignedPolicyBundleResponse(
        bundle_id="imported-bundle",
        version="gen1",
        created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        signature=payload.serialized[:64],
        key_id="ironclaw-gen1",
        policies=[],
        metadata={"source": "import"},
    )


@router.post(
    "/policy-bundles/verify",
    response_model=PolicyBundleVerificationResponse,
)
def verify_policy_bundle_route(
    payload: PolicyBundleImportRequest,
) -> PolicyBundleVerificationResponse:
    valid = bool(payload.serialized.strip())
    return PolicyBundleVerificationResponse(
        valid=valid,
        bundle_id="imported-bundle",
        key_id="ironclaw-gen1",
        verified_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        reason="signature accepted" if valid else "signature missing",
    )

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.dependencies.rate_limit import limit_policy_routes

router = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(limit_policy_routes)])


class GuardBundleRequest(BaseModel):
    user_prompt: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20000)
    retrieved_doc: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50000)
    tool_output: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50000)
    model_output: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50000)


class PolicyBundleDecisionResponse(BaseModel):
    highest_verdict: str
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    user_prompt: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    retrieved_doc: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    tool_output: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    model_output: dict[str, Any] | None = None


class SystemStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    policy: PolicyStatus
    review_summary: dict[str, Any]


def _has_meaningful_content(value: str | None) -> bool:
    return bool(value and value.strip())


def _request_meta(request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
        "trace_id": getattr(request.state, "trace_id", None),
        "path": request.url.path,
        "method": request.method,
    }


@router.get("/status", response_model=PolicyStatus)
def read_policy_status(request: Request) -> PolicyStatus:
    status = PolicyStatus(**get_policy_status())

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "policy_status_requested",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "mode": getattr(status, "mode", None),
                "enforcement_enabled": getattr(status, "enforcement_enabled", None),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return status


@router.get("/system-status", response_model=SystemStatusResponse)
def read_system_status(request: Request) -> SystemStatusResponse:
    policy_status = PolicyStatus(**get_policy_status())
    review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "policy_system_status_requested",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "policy_mode": getattr(policy_status, "mode", None),
                "pending_reviews": review_summary.get("pending_items"),
                "critical_items": review_summary.get("critical_items"),
                "total_items": review_summary.get("total_items"),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return SystemStatusResponse(
        policy=policy_status,
        review_summary=review_summary,
    )


@router.post("/guard-bundle", response_model=PolicyBundleDecisionResponse)
def guard_prompt_bundle(
    payload: GuardBundleRequest,
    request: Request,
) -> PolicyBundleDecisionResponse:
    """
    Internal policy route for guarding multi-source prompt context.

    Expected optional JSON fields:
    - user_prompt
    - retrieved_doc
    - tool_output
    - model_output

    Returns a consolidated verdict bundle using:
    allow < warn < quarantine < block
    """
    if not any(
        [
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.user_prompt),
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.retrieved_doc),
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.tool_output),
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.model_output),
        ]
    ):
        raise AppError(
            error="empty_policy_bundle",
            message="At least one non-empty prompt bundle field must be provided",
            status_code=400,
            details={
                "allowed_fields": [
                    "user_prompt",
                    "retrieved_doc",
                    "tool_output",
                    "model_output",
                ]
            },
        )

    result = analyze_prompt_bundle(
        user_prompt=payload.user_prompt.strip() if payload.user_prompt else None,
        retrieved_doc=payload.retrieved_doc.strip() if payload.retrieved_doc else None,
        tool_output=payload.tool_output.strip() if payload.tool_output else None,
        model_output=payload.model_output.strip() if payload.model_output else None,
    )

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "policy_bundle_decision",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "highest_verdict": result.get("highest_verdict"),
                "should_halt": result.get("should_halt"),
                "should_warn": result.get("should_warn"),
                "has_user_prompt": _has_meaningful_content(payload.user_prompt),
                "has_retrieved_doc": _has_meaningful_content(payload.retrieved_doc),
                "has_tool_output": _has_meaningful_content(payload.tool_output),
                "has_model_output": _has_meaningful_content(payload.model_output),
                "user_prompt_verdict": (result.get("user_prompt") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "user_prompt_risk_score": (result.get("user_prompt") or {}).get("risk_score"),
                "retrieved_doc_verdict": (result.get("retrieved_doc") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "retrieved_doc_risk_score": (result.get("retrieved_doc") or {}).get("risk_score"),
                "tool_output_verdict": (result.get("tool_output") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "tool_output_risk_score": (result.get("tool_output") or {}).get("risk_score"),
                "model_output_verdict": (result.get("model_output") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "model_output_risk_score": (result.get("model_output") or {}).get("risk_score"),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return PolicyBundleDecisionResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.dependencies.request_context import get_request_context
from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter(prefix="/request-context", tags=["request-context"])


class RequestContextResponse(BaseModel):
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    request_started_at: float | None = None
    client_host: str | None = None
    path: str
    method: str
    headers: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


@router.get("", response_model=RequestContextResponse)
def read_request_context(request: Request) -> RequestContextResponse:
    context = get_request_context(request)

    safe_headers = {
        "x-request-id": request.headers.get("X-Request-ID"),
        "x-trace-id": request.headers.get("X-Trace-ID"),
        "user-agent": request.headers.get("User-Agent"),
    }

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "request_context_requested",
            {
                "request_id": context.get("request_id"),
                "trace_id": context.get("trace_id"),
                "path": context.get("path"),
                "method": context.get("method"),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return RequestContextResponse(
        request_id=context.get("request_id"),
        trace_id=context.get("trace_id"),
        request_started_at=context.get("request_started_at"),
        client_host=context.get("client_host"),
        path=context.get("path") or request.url.path,
        method=context.get("method") or request.method,
        headers=safe_headers,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request, Security

from app.dependencies.requestcontext import get_request_context
from app.schemas.requestcontext import RequestContextResponse
from app.security.apikey import api_key_header_auth

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/request-context",
    tags=["request-context"],
)


@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=RequestContextResponse,
    summary="Read Request Context",
    include_in_schema=True,
)
async def read_request_context(
    request: Request,
    context: Annotated[RequestContextResponse, Depends(get_request_context)],
    api_key: Annotated[str, Security(api_key_header_auth)],
) -> RequestContextResponse:
    """
    Return a normalized snapshot of the current HTTP request context.

    This is primarily used by UI and diagnostics tooling to quickly inspect
    how IronClaw-Security sees the inbound request at the security boundary.
    All normalization, redaction, and correlation logic is centralized in
    `get_request_context`; this handler simply returns the validated model.
    """
    # We intentionally depend on `get_request_context` so that all normalization,
    # redaction, and correlation logic lives in a single shared dependency.
    # The handler simply returns the already-validated Pydantic model.
    _ = request  # accessed to keep the signature stable and avoid linter warnings
    return context

FILE: app\api\restore.py

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.restoreservice import (
    RestoreManifest,
    RestoreService,
    build_default_restore_service,
)


router = APIRouter(prefix="/restore", tags=["restore"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def get_restore_service() -> RestoreService:
    return build_default_restore_service()


def _raise_restore_http_error(exc: Exception) -> None:
    if isinstance(exc, KeyError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    raise exc


class RestoreTargetResponse(BaseModel):
    name: str
    kind: str
    source_path: str
    restore_path: str
    checksum_required: bool
    dry_run_supported: bool


class RestoreManifestResponse(BaseModel):
    target_name: str
    target_kind: str
    source_path: str
    restore_path: str
    restored_at: str
    files_restored: int
    bytes_restored: int
    checksum_verified: bool
    dry_run: bool
    meta: dict[str, Any]


class RestoreStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Restore Control"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    targets: list[RestoreTargetResponse]
    summary: dict[str, Any]


class RestoreActionRequest(BaseModel):
    target_name: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    action: Literal["restore", "validate"] = "restore"
    dry_run: bool = False


class RestoreActionResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Restore Action"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    action: Literal["restore", "validate"]
    target_name: str
    dry_run: bool
    result: dict[str, Any]


def _manifest_to_response(manifest: RestoreManifest) -> RestoreManifestResponse:
    return RestoreManifestResponse(**manifest.to_dict())


@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=RestoreStatusResponse,
    summary="Get restore control status",
)
def get_restore_status(
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> RestoreStatusResponse:
    targets = service.list_targets()
    typed_targets = [RestoreTargetResponse(**target) for target in targets]

    return RestoreStatusResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        targets=typed_targets,
        summary={
            "target_count": len(typed_targets),
            "checksum_enforced_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.checksum_required),
            "dry_run_supported_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.dry_run_supported),
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/targets",
    response_model=list[RestoreTargetResponse],
    summary="List configured restore targets",
)
def list_restore_targets(
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> list[RestoreTargetResponse]:
    return [RestoreTargetResponse(**target) for target in service.list_targets()]


@router.post(
    "/validate",
    response_model=RestoreActionResponse,
    summary="Validate a restore target before restore",
)
def validate_restore_target(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> RestoreActionResponse:
    try:
        result = service.validate(target_name)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_restore_http_error(exc)

    return RestoreActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action="validate",
        target_name=target_name,
        dry_run=True,
        result=result,
    )


@router.post(
    "/run",
    response_model=RestoreManifestResponse,
    summary="Run an on-demand restore",
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def run_restore(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    dry_run: Annotated[bool, Query()] = False,
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)] = None,
) -> RestoreManifestResponse:
    if service is None:
        service = get_restore_service()

    try:
        manifest = service.run_restore(target_name, dry_run=dry_run)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_restore_http_error(exc)

    return _manifest_to_response(manifest)


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=RestoreActionResponse,
    summary="Run a generic restore control action",
)
def run_restore_action(
    request: RestoreActionRequest,
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> RestoreActionResponse:
    try:
        if request.action == "validate":
            result: dict[str, Any] = service.validate(request.target_name)
        else:
            manifest = service.run_restore(request.target_name, dry_run=request.dry_run)
            result = _manifest_to_response(manifest).model_dump()
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_restore_http_error(exc)

    return RestoreActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action=request.action,
        target_name=request.target_name,
        dry_run=request.dry_run if request.action == "restore" else True,
        result=result,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict

from app.api.actiondecision import decideaction


router = APIRouter(prefix="/review", tags=["review"])


ReviewStatus = Literal["pending", "approved", "rejected", "quarantined"]
ReviewResolution = Literal["allow", "deny", "quarantine", "needsreview"]


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


class ReviewReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int | None = None


class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    actiontype: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=1,
        description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.",
    )
    target: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=1,
        description="Execution target such as URL, shell, or file path.",
    )
    content: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Prompt or action content under review.",
    )
    riskscore: int = Field(
        ...,
        ge=0,
        le=100,
        description="Base risk score supplied to review.",
    )
    clientid: str | None = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: str | None = Field(None, description="Session or workflow id.")
    filepath: str | None = Field(None, description="Optional source filepath for attribution.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional external context, tool outputs, file text, or retrieved content.",
    )


class ReviewResponse(BaseModel):
    reviewitemid: str
    status: ReviewStatus
    resolution: ReviewResolution
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    filepath: str
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    reason: str
    reasons: list[ReviewReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    hostilecontext: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    createdat: str


def createreviewitem(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    decision = decideaction(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )

    outcome = decision.get("outcome", "deny")
    if outcome == "allow":
        status: ReviewStatus = "approved"
        resolution: ReviewResolution = "allow"
        reason = "Review workflow approved the action because it remained within safe execution bounds."
    elif outcome == "review":
        status = "pending"
        resolution = "needsreview"
        reason = "Review workflow created a pending item because the action requires human review."
    elif outcome == "quarantine":
        status = "quarantined"
        resolution = "quarantine"
        reason = "Review workflow quarantined the action because the runtime detected containment-level risk."
    else:
        status = "rejected"
        resolution = "deny"
        reason = "Review workflow rejected the action because the runtime denied execution."

    return {
        "reviewitemid": f"review_{uuid4().hex}",
        "status": status,
        "resolution": resolution,
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "filepath": str(decision.get("filepath") or filepath or ""),
        "baseriskscore": int(decision.get("baseriskscore", riskscore)),
        "adjustedriskscore": int(decision.get("adjustedriskscore", riskscore)),
        "reason": reason,
        "reasons": decision.get("reasons", []),
        "promptinjection": decision.get("promptinjection") or {},
        "hostilecontext": decision.get("hostilecontext") or {},
        "createdat": _utcnow(),
    }


@router.post(
    "/item",
    response_model=ReviewResponse,
    summary="Create a review workflow item from an action decision.",
)
def createreview(payload: ReviewRequest) -> ReviewResponse:
    result = createreviewitem(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return ReviewResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status

from app.dependencies.api_key import require_api_key

    ReviewActionRequest,
    ReviewItemResponse,
    ReviewQueueSummaryResponse,
)
from app.services.review_queue import (
    approve_review_item,
    get_all_reviews,
    get_pending_reviews,
    get_review_by_id,
    get_review_summary,
    reject_review_item,
)

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/guard/reviews",
    tags=["review-queue"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _not_found_review_item() -> HTTPException:
    return HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
        detail="Review item not found",
    )


@router.get("/summary", response_model=ReviewQueueSummaryResponse)
def read_review_summary() -> ReviewQueueSummaryResponse:
    return ReviewQueueSummaryResponse(**get_review_summary())


@router.get("", response_model=list[ReviewItemResponse])
def read_all_reviews() -> list[ReviewItemResponse]:
    return [ReviewItemResponse(**item) for item in get_all_reviews()]


@router.get("/pending", response_model=list[ReviewItemResponse])
def read_pending_reviews() -> list[ReviewItemResponse]:
    return [ReviewItemResponse(**item) for item in get_pending_reviews()]


@router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def read_review(review_id: str) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    item = get_review_by_id(review_id)
    if item is None:
        raise _not_found_review_item()
    return ReviewItemResponse(**item)


@router.post("/{review_id}/approve", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def approve_review(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewActionRequest,
) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    item = approve_review_item(review_id, payload)
    if item is None:
        raise _not_found_review_item()
    return ReviewItemResponse(**item)


@router.post("/{review_id}/reject", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def reject_review(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewActionRequest,
) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    item = reject_review_item(review_id, payload)
    if item is None:
        raise _not_found_review_item()
    return ReviewItemResponse(**item)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/", summary="Root")
def root() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Root endpoint for IronClaw-Security.

    Returns a minimal capability and docs pointer payload so that
    clients and humans landing on / have something structured to read.
    """
    return {
        "service": "IronClaw-Security",
        "description": "Local-first security scanning API with reviewed verdict handling.",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "endpoints": {
            "docs": "/docs",
            "openapi": "/openapi.json",
            "health": "/system/health",
            "policy_status": "/policy/status",
            "guard_execute": "/guard/execute",
            "history": "/history",
            "audit": "/audit/events",
        },
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from importlib import import_module
from typing import Final, cast

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.routing import APIRoute


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["api"])
inventory_router = APIRouter(tags=["api-inventory"])


OPTIONAL_API_MODULES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.api.routes.incidents",
    "app.api.routes.integrations",
    "app.api.routes.reviewqueue",
)

CORE_API_MODULES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.api.ui_manifest",
    "app.ui.groq_registry",
    "app.api.routes.unit_wallet",
    "app.api.routes.unit_ledger",
    "app.api.routes.actionhistorytest",
)


def _optional_router(module_path: str) -> APIRouter | None:
    try:
        module = import_module(module_path)
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        missing_name = getattr(exc, "name", "") or ""
        if missing_name == module_path or module_path.endswith(f".{missing_name}"):
            return None
        raise

    candidate = getattr(module, "router", None)
    return candidate if isinstance(candidate, APIRouter) else None


def _route_signature(route: APIRoute) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str]:
    methods = tuple(sorted(method for method in (route.methods or set()) if method != "HEAD"))
    return (route.path, methods, route.name)


def _router_label(api_router: APIRouter) -> str:
    prefix = str(getattr(api_router, "prefix", "") or "<no-prefix>")
    return f"{prefix} ({len(api_router.routes)} routes)"


def get_api_routers() -> list[APIRouter]:
    routers: list[APIRouter] = []

    for module_path in CORE_API_MODULES:
        core_router = _optional_router(module_path)
        if core_router is not None:
            routers.append(core_router)

    for module_path in OPTIONAL_API_MODULES:
        optional_router = _optional_router(module_path)
        if optional_router is not None:
            routers.append(optional_router)

    return routers


def validate_api_routers() -> None:
    seen_router_objects: set[int] = set()
    seen_route_signatures: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str], str] = {}

    for api_router in get_api_routers():
        router_id = id(api_router)
        label = _router_label(api_router)

        if router_id in seen_router_objects:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate API router object registration detected: {label}")
        seen_router_objects.add(router_id)

        if not api_router.routes:
            raise ValueError(f"API router has no routes: {label}")

        for route in api_router.routes:
            if not isinstance(route, APIRoute):
                continue

            signature = _route_signature(route)
            path, methods, _ = signature

            if not path:
                raise ValueError(f"API router contains a route with an empty path: {label}")

            if signature in seen_route_signatures:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"duplicate API route registration detected: {path} {methods} "
                    f"already registered under {seen_route_signatures[signature]}"
                )

            seen_route_signatures[signature] = label

def include_api_routers() -> None:
    """
    Build the /api aggregate router from legacy/compat modules only.

    Important:
    - app.main now treats app.api.* as the canonical API surface.
    - This file should remain a compat aggregator for modules mounted under /api.
    - Do not include this router separately anywhere that already mounts the same
      logical endpoints directly, or duplicate routes/OpenAPI collisions will occur.
    """
    validate_api_routers()

    existing_route_signatures = {
        _route_signature(cast(APIRoute, route))
        for route in router.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }

    for api_router in get_api_routers():
        router_signatures = {
            _route_signature(cast(APIRoute, route))
            for route in api_router.routes
            if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
        }

        if router_signatures and router_signatures.issubset(existing_route_signatures):
            continue

        router.include_router(api_router)
        existing_route_signatures.update(router_signatures)

    inventory_signatures = {
        _route_signature(cast(APIRoute, route))
        for route in inventory_router.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }

    if not inventory_signatures.issubset(existing_route_signatures):
        router.include_router(inventory_router)


include_api_routers()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services import history as history_svc
from app.services import scanner as scanner_svc
from app.services import action_guard as action_guard_svc
from app.services import action_policy as action_policy_svc
from app.services import action_decision as action_decision_svc

router = APIRouter()

Verdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class ScanRequest(BaseModel):
    target_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target_value: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class ScanResponse(BaseModel):
    scan_id: str
    verdict: Verdict
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    risky_files: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    checks_loaded: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    review_status: str | None = None
    untrusted: bool | None = None
    quarantine_reason: str | None = None


class HistoryItem(BaseModel):
    scan_id: str
    target_type: str
    target_value: str
    verdict: Verdict
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    review_status: str | None = None
    untrusted: bool | None = None
    quarantine_reason: str | None = None


class HistoryListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[HistoryItem]


class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    action: Literal["approve", "reject"]


class GuardActionRequest(BaseModel):
    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str
    client_id: str
    session_id: str


class GuardActionResponse(BaseModel):
    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str
    verdict: Verdict
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    matched_patterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    client_id: str
    session_id: str


class GuardPolicyResponse(BaseModel):
    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str
    policy_mode: Literal["allow", "review", "block"]
    verdict: Verdict
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    client_id: str
    session_id: str


class GuardDecisionResponse(BaseModel):
    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str
    policy_mode: Literal["allow", "review", "block"]
    verdict: Verdict
    decision_source: Literal["policy", "scan"]
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    matched_patterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    client_id: str
    session_id: str


@router.post("/scan/", response_model=ScanResponse)
def scan_target(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResponse:
    ttype = request.target_type
    tvalue = request.target_value

    normalized_value = " ".join(tvalue.split())
    if ttype == "text" and not normalized_value:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target_value is empty after normalization")

    if ttype == "text":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_text(normalized_value)
    elif ttype == "url":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_url(tvalue)
    elif ttype == "github_repo":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_github_repo(tvalue)
    elif ttype == "archive":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_archive(tvalue)
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"unsupported target_type={ttype}")

    stored = history_svc.record_scan_result(
        target_type=ttype,
        target_value=tvalue,
        result=result,
    )

    return ScanResponse(
        scan_id=stored.scan_id,
        verdict=stored.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        summary=stored.summary,
        risk_score=stored.riskscore,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(stored, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        risky_files=list(getattr(stored, "riskyfiles", [])),
        checks_loaded=list(getattr(stored, "checksloaded", [])),
        failed_checks=list(getattr(stored, "failedchecks", [])),
        review_status=getattr(stored, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(stored, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(stored, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.get("/history/", response_model=HistoryListResponse)
def list_history() -> HistoryListResponse:
    items = history_svc.get_history_items()
    return HistoryListResponse(
        items=[
            HistoryItem(
                scan_id=i.scan_id,
                target_type=i.targettype,
                target_value=i.targetvalue,
                verdict=i.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
                summary=i.summary,
                risk_score=i.riskscore,
                matched_patterns=list(getattr(i, "matchedpatterns", [])),
                review_status=getattr(i, "reviewstatus", None),
                untrusted=getattr(i, "untrusted", None),
                quarantine_reason=getattr(i, "quarantinereason", None),
            )
            for i in items
        ]
    )


@router.get("/history/{scan_id}", response_model=HistoryItem)
def get_history(scan_id: str) -> HistoryItem:
    item = history_svc.get_history_item(scan_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="scan_id not found")

    return HistoryItem(
        scan_id=item.scan_id,
        target_type=item.targettype,
        target_value=item.targetvalue,
        verdict=item.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        summary=item.summary,
        risk_score=item.riskscore,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(item, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        review_status=getattr(item, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(item, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(item, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.post("/history/{scan_id}/review")
def review_history_item(scan_id: str, request: ReviewRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        updated = history_svc.review_scan(scan_id=scan_id, action=request.action)
    except KeyError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="scan_id not found")

    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="review not applicable for this scan")

    history_svc.apply_review_action(updated, request.action)
    return {"status": "ok", "scan_id": scan_id, "action": request.action}


@router.post("/guard/action", response_model=GuardActionResponse)
def guard_action(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardActionResponse:
    # delegate to existing service; it should return verdict + patterns
    scan_result = action_guard_svc.evaluate_action(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
    )

    verdict: Verdict = scan_result.verdict  # type: ignore[assignment]
    matched_patterns = list(getattr(scan_result, "matchedpatterns", []))

    should_halt = verdict in ("block", "quarantine")
    should_warn = verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")

    return GuardActionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_halt=bool(should_halt),
        should_warn=bool(should_warn),
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-policy", response_model=GuardPolicyResponse)
def guard_action_policy(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardPolicyResponse:
    policy = action_policy_svc.evaluate_policy(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
    )

    return GuardPolicyResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=policy.mode,  # "allow" | "review" | "block"
        verdict=policy.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        should_halt=policy.should_halt,
        should_warn=policy.should_warn,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-decision", response_model=GuardDecisionResponse)
def guard_action_decision(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardDecisionResponse:
    decision = action_decision_svc.evaluate_action_decision(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
    )

    return GuardDecisionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=decision.policy_mode,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        verdict=decision.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        decision_source=decision.source,  # "policy" | "scan"
        should_halt=decision.should_halt,
        should_warn=decision.should_warn,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(decision, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )

    )

    return GuardPolicyResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=result.mode,
        verdict=result.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        should_halt=result.should_halt,
        should_warn=result.should_warn,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-decision", response_model=GuardDecisionResponse)
def guard_action_decision(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardDecisionResponse:
    result = action_decision_svc.evaluate_action_decision(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
    )

    return GuardDecisionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=result.policy_mode,
        verdict=result.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        decision_source=result.source,
        should_halt=result.should_halt,
        should_warn=result.should_warn,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(result, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )

router.include_router(unit_ledger_router)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.alert_store import (
    AlertEndpointRecord as StoredAlertEndpointRecord,
    get_alert_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/alerts",
    tags=["alerts"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


AlertChannel = Literal["email", "webhook", "slack"]
AlertEventType = Literal["incident_created", "incident_updated", "quarantine_created", "policy_changed"]
AlertDeliveryStatus = Literal["active", "paused", "failed"]


class AlertEndpointView(BaseModel):
    endpoint_id: str
    channel: AlertChannel
    name: str
    target: str
    subscribed_events: list[AlertEventType] = Field(default_factory=list)
    status: AlertDeliveryStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class AlertEndpointCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    channel: AlertChannel
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    target: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    subscribed_events: list[AlertEventType] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class AlertEndpointUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    subscribed_events: list[AlertEventType] = Field(default_factory=list)
    status: AlertDeliveryStatus
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class AlertEndpointListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    items: list[AlertEndpointView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AlertEndpointResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    endpoint: AlertEndpointView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _to_view(endpoint: StoredAlertEndpointRecord) -> AlertEndpointView:
    return AlertEndpointView(**endpoint.to_dict())


def _find_endpoint_or_404(endpoint_id: str) -> StoredAlertEndpointRecord:
    endpoint = get_alert_store().get_endpoint(endpoint_id)
    if endpoint is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown alert endpoint: {endpoint_id}",
        )
    return endpoint


@router.get("/endpoints", response_model=AlertEndpointListResponse)
def list_alert_endpoints(
    channel: AlertChannel | None = Query(default=None),
    status_filter: AlertDeliveryStatus | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
) -> AlertEndpointListResponse:
    items = get_alert_store().list_endpoints(
        channel=channel,
        status=status_filter,
    )

    return AlertEndpointListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.post("/endpoints", response_model=AlertEndpointResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_alert_endpoint(payload: AlertEndpointCreateRequest) -> AlertEndpointResponse:
    endpoint = get_alert_store().create_endpoint(
        channel=payload.channel,
        name=payload.name,
        target=payload.target,
        subscribed_events=payload.subscribed_events,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    return AlertEndpointResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        endpoint=_to_view(endpoint),
    )


@router.get("/endpoints/{endpoint_id}", response_model=AlertEndpointResponse)
def get_alert_endpoint(endpoint_id: str) -> AlertEndpointResponse:
    endpoint = _find_endpoint_or_404(endpoint_id)
    return AlertEndpointResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        endpoint=_to_view(endpoint),
    )


@router.put("/endpoints/{endpoint_id}", response_model=AlertEndpointResponse)
def update_alert_endpoint(
    endpoint_id: str,
    payload: AlertEndpointUpdateRequest,
) -> AlertEndpointResponse:
    _find_endpoint_or_404(endpoint_id)

    updated = get_alert_store().update_endpoint(
        endpoint_id,
        subscribed_events=payload.subscribed_events,
        status=payload.status,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown alert endpoint: {endpoint_id}",
        )

    return AlertEndpointResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        endpoint=_to_view(updated),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],

AuditSeverity = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]
AuditCategory = Literal["policy", "incident", "quarantine", "review", "execution", "auth", "system"]
AuditOutcome = Literal["success", "warning", "blocked", "failure"]
ExportFormat = Literal["json", "csv"]


class AuditEventView(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    timestamp: str
    severity: AuditSeverity
    category: AuditCategory
    action: str
    outcome: AuditOutcome
    actor_id: str | None = None

    resource_type: str | None = None

def _filter_events(
    events: list[AuditEventView],
    *,
    severity: AuditSeverity | None,
    category: AuditCategory | None,
    outcome: AuditOutcome | None,
    actor_id: str | None,
    request_id: str | None,
    trace_id: str | None,
    resource_id: str | None,
    search: str | None,
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    filtered = list(events)

    if severity is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.severity == severity]
    if category is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.category == category]
    if outcome is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.outcome == outcome]
    if actor_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.actor_id == actor_id]
    if request_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.request_id == request_id]
    if trace_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.trace_id == trace_id]
    if resource_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.resource_id == resource_id]
    if search:
        needle = search.strip().lower()
        filtered = [
            event
            for event in filtered
            if needle in event.summary.lower()
            or needle in event.action.lower()
            or any(needle in tag.lower() for tag in event.tags)
        ]

    return filtered


def _build_kpis(events: list[AuditEventView]) -> list[AuditKpiView]:
    return [
        AuditKpiView(label="total_events", value=len(events)),
        AuditKpiView(label="blocked_events", value=sum(1 for item in events if item.outcome == "blocked"), status="alert"),
        AuditKpiView(label="warning_events", value=sum(1 for item in events if item.outcome == "warning"), status="warning"),
        AuditKpiView(label="failure_events", value=sum(1 for item in events if item.outcome == "failure"), status="critical"),
    ]


def _build_timeline(events: list[AuditEventView]) -> list[AuditTimelinePoint]:
    points: list[AuditTimelinePoint] = []
    for event in events:
        points.append(
            AuditTimelinePoint(
                timestamp=event.timestamp,
                total_events=1,
                blocked_events=1 if event.outcome == "blocked" else 0,
                warning_events=1 if event.outcome == "warning" else 0,
                failure_events=1 if event.outcome == "failure" else 0,
            )
        )
    return points


def _build_filters(events: list[AuditEventView]) -> list[AuditFilterView]:
    def unique(values: list[str | None]) -> list[str]:
        return sorted({value for value in values if value})

    return [
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="severity", values=unique([event.severity for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="category", values=unique([event.category for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="outcome", values=unique([event.outcome for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="actor_id", values=unique([event.actor_id for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="resource_id", values=unique([event.resource_id for event in events])),
    ]


def _build_export_content(events: list[AuditEventView], export_format: ExportFormat) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    if export_format == "json":
        import json

        content = json.dumps([event.model_dump() for event in events], indent=2)
        return "application/json", "audit-export.json", content

    header = [
        "event_id",
        "timestamp",
        "severity",
        "category",
        "action",
        "outcome",
        "actor_id",
        "session_id",
        "request_id",
        "trace_id",
        "resource_type",
        "resource_id",
        "summary",
        "tags",
    ]
    lines = [",".join(header)]
    for event in events:
        row = [
            event.event_id,
            event.timestamp,
            event.severity,
            event.category,
            event.action,
            event.outcome,
            event.actor_id or "",
            event.session_id or "",
            event.request_id or "",
            event.trace_id or "",
            event.resource_type or "",
            event.resource_id or "",
            event.summary.replace(",", ";"),
            "|".join(event.tags),
        ]
        lines.append(",".join(row))
    return "text/csv", "audit-export.csv", "\n".join(lines)


@router.get("/", response_model=AuditExplorerResponse)
def read_audit_explorer(
    severity: AuditSeverity | None = Query(default=None),
    category: AuditCategory | None = Query(default=None),
    outcome: AuditOutcome | None = Query(default=None),
    actor_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    request_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    trace_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    resource_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    search: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=200),
) -> AuditExplorerResponse:
    seeded = _seed_events()
    filtered = _filter_events(
        seeded,
        severity=severity,
        category=category,
        outcome=outcome,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        request_id=request_id,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        resource_id=resource_id,
        search=search,
    )

    return AuditExplorerResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(filtered),
        applied_filters={
            "severity": severity,
            "category": category,
            "outcome": outcome,
            "actor_id": actor_id,
            "request_id": request_id,
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "resource_id": resource_id,
            "search": search,
        },
        kpis=_build_kpis(filtered),
        timeline=_build_timeline(filtered),
        filters=_build_filters(seeded),
        items=filtered,
        notes=[
            "This explorer currently serves seeded in-memory audit data.",
            "Next upgrade can connect these views to the persistent audit/event pipeline.",
        ],
    )


@router.get("/export", response_model=AuditExportResponse)
def export_audit_explorer(
    export_format: ExportFormat = Query(default="json"),
    severity: AuditSeverity | None = Query(default=None),
    category: AuditCategory | None = Query(default=None),
    outcome: AuditOutcome | None = Query(default=None),
) -> AuditExportResponse:
    seeded = _seed_events()
    filtered = _filter_events(
        seeded,
        severity=severity,
        category=category,
        outcome=outcome,
        actor_id=None,
        request_id=None,
        trace_id=None,
        resource_id=None,
        search=None,
    )
    content_type, filename, content = _build_export_content(filtered, export_format)

    return AuditExportResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        export_format=export_format,
        total=len(filtered),
        content_type=content_type,
        filename=filename,
        content=content,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key

class TelemetrySummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_events: int
    severity_counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    event_type_counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _filter_events(
    *,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    actor_id: str | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    items = list(_SAMPLE_AUDIT_EVENTS)

    if session_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.session_id == session_id]

    if actor_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.client_id == actor_id]

    if request_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.request_id == request_id]

    if trace_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.trace_id == trace_id]

    return items


@router.get("/events", response_model=list[AuditEventView])
def get_audit_events(
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=1000),
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    return list(_SAMPLE_AUDIT_EVENTS[:limit])


@router.get("/events/by-session/{session_id}", response_model=list[AuditEventView])
def get_audit_events_by_session(
    session_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=1000),
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    return _filter_events(session_id=session_id)[:limit]


@router.get("/events/by-actor/{actor_id}", response_model=list[AuditEventView])
def get_audit_events_by_actor(
    actor_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=1000),
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    return _filter_events(actor_id=actor_id)[:limit]


@router.get("/events/by-request/{request_id}", response_model=list[AuditEventView])
def get_audit_events_by_request(request_id: str) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    return _filter_events(request_id=request_id)


@router.get("/events/by-trace/{trace_id}", response_model=list[AuditEventView])
def get_audit_events_by_trace(trace_id: str) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    return _filter_events(trace_id=trace_id)


@router.get("/telemetry/events", response_model=list[AuditEventView])
def get_telemetry_events(
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=1000),
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    return list(_SAMPLE_AUDIT_EVENTS[:limit])


@router.get("/telemetry/summary", response_model=TelemetrySummaryResponse)
def get_telemetry_summary(
    limit: int = Query(default=500, ge=1, le=5000),
) -> TelemetrySummaryResponse:
    items = list(_SAMPLE_AUDIT_EVENTS[:limit])

    severity_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    event_type_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for item in items:
        severity_counts[item.severity] = severity_counts.get(item.severity, 0) + 1
        event_type_counts[item.event_type] = event_type_counts.get(item.event_type, 0) + 1

    return TelemetrySummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_events=len(items),
        severity_counts=severity_counts,
        event_type_counts=event_type_counts,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.core.unit_wallet import get_unit_wallet_registry


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/billing",
    tags=["billing"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


PACKAGE_CATALOG: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "single-user": {
        "name": "Single User",
        "price_usd": 20.0,
        "included_units": 20_000,
        "description": (
            "Prepaid protection units for individual builders who want guarded prompt handling, "
            "tool-call review, source inspection, and safe response release."
        ),
    },
    "team-security": {
        "name": "Team Security",
        "price_usd": 90.0,
        "included_units": 100_000,
        "description": (
            "Prepaid protection units for teams running higher volumes of AI-assisted development, "
            "research, and guarded agent workflows."
        ),
    },
    "enterprise-security": {
        "name": "Enterprise Security",
        "price_usd": 150.0,
        "included_units": 200_000,
        "description": (
            "Prepaid protection units for organizations protecting large-scale agent operations, "
            "sensitive workflows, and high-frequency prompt activity."
        ),
    },
}


class BillingPackageView(BaseModel):
    package_id: str
    name: str
    price_usd: float
    included_units: int
    description: str

    title: str
    detail: str

    unit_definition: str
    delivery_model: str
    buyer_positioning: str
    protection_layers: list[ProtectionValueView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    market_context: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class BillingPackagePurchaseRequest(BaseModel):
    package_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    buyer_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    buyer_email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class BillingPackagePurchaseView(BaseModel):
    purchase_id: str
    package_id: str
    package_name: str
    buyer_name: str
    buyer_email: str
    price_usd: float
    granted_units: int

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

_PURCHASES: list[BillingPackagePurchaseView] = []


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _package_to_view(package_id: str, package_data: dict[str, Any]) -> BillingPackageView:
    return BillingPackageView(package_id=package_id, **package_data)


def _require_known_package(package_id: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    normalized = package_id.strip().lower()
    package = PACKAGE_CATALOG.get(normalized)
    if package is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown billing package: {package_id}",
        )
    return normalized, package


def _build_unit_policy() -> UnitPolicyView:
    return UnitPolicyView(
        unit_definition="1 protection unit = 1 IronClaw protection event.",
        delivery_model="All packages are prepaid unit bundles with no recurring subscription requirement.",
        buyer_positioning=(
            "Customers are buying protected AI usage, not raw API calls. "
            "Each unit funds layered security checks around prompts, tool activity, returned content, and release decisions."
        ),
        protection_layers=[
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Prompt ingress protection",
                detail="Screens incoming prompts before risky instructions begin spreading through the workflow.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Tool-call guardrails",
                detail="Reviews agent actions before external tools, files, or execution paths are allowed to continue.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Source inspection",
                detail="Checks returned web or external content for hostile prompt-injection patterns and suspicious payloads.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Response release control",
                detail="Applies final safety review before content is released back into the user session or downstream agent flow.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Sandbox-backed isolation",
                detail="Pairs AI judgment with runtime boundaries so suspicious content can be contained instead of trusted.",
            ),
        ],
        market_context=[
            "Agent platforms process untrusted instructions from websites, files, repositories, docs, and generated artifacts.",
            "Prompt-injection attacks target AI systems specifically because they can redirect tools, leak data, or manipulate autonomous workflows.",
            "IronClaw protection units are designed to add security coverage around every stage where hostile content can enter or spread.",
        ],
    )


def _wallet_to_view(wallet: Any) -> WalletBalanceView:
    return WalletBalanceView(
        wallet_id=wallet.wallet_id,
        owner_key=wallet.owner_key,
        balance_units=wallet.balance_units,
        total_purchased_units=wallet.total_purchased_units,
        total_consumed_units=wallet.total_consumed_units,
        updated_at=wallet.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        metadata=wallet.metadata,
    )


def _ledger_entry_to_view(entry: Any) -> WalletLedgerEntryView:
    return WalletLedgerEntryView(
        entry_id=entry.entry_id,
        wallet_id=entry.wallet_id,
        owner_key=entry.owner_key,
        entry_type=entry.entry_type,
        units=entry.units,
        balance_after=entry.balance_after,
        created_at=entry.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        metadata=entry.metadata,
    )


@router.get("/packages", response_model=BillingPackagesResponse)
def list_billing_packages() -> BillingPackagesResponse:
    packages = [
        _package_to_view(package_id, package_data)
        for package_id, package_data in PACKAGE_CATALOG.items()
    ]

    return BillingPackagesResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        packages=packages,
        unit_policy=_build_unit_policy(),
    )


@router.post(
    "/packages/purchase",
    response_model=BillingPackagePurchaseResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def purchase_billing_package(
    payload: BillingPackagePurchaseRequest,
) -> BillingPackagePurchaseResponse:
    package_id, package = _require_known_package(payload.package_id)
    purchase = BillingPackagePurchaseView(
        purchase_id=f"pkg_{len(_PURCHASES) + 1}",
        package_id=package_id,
        package_name=str(package["name"]),
        buyer_name=payload.buyer_name.strip(),
        buyer_email=payload.buyer_email.strip().lower(),
        price_usd=float(package["price_usd"]),
        granted_units=int(package["included_units"]),
        created_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    _PURCHASES.append(purchase)

    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()
    wallet = wallet_registry.credit_units(
        owner_key=purchase.buyer_email,
        units=int(package["included_units"]),
        metadata={
            "source": "billing_package_purchase",
            "purchase_id": purchase.purchase_id,
            "package_id": package_id,
            "package_name": purchase.package_name,
            "buyer_name": purchase.buyer_name,
            **payload.metadata,
        },
    )

    return BillingPackagePurchaseResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        purchase=purchase,
        wallet=_wallet_to_view(wallet),
    )


@router.get("/wallet/{owner_key}", response_model=BillingWalletBalanceResponse)
def get_billing_wallet_balance(owner_key: str) -> BillingWalletBalanceResponse:
    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()
    wallet = wallet_registry.get_wallet(owner_key)

    if wallet is None:
        wallet = wallet_registry.get_or_create_wallet(owner_key=owner_key)

    return BillingWalletBalanceResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        wallet=_wallet_to_view(wallet),
    )


@router.get("/ledger", response_model=BillingLedgerResponse)
def list_billing_ledger(
    owner_key: str | None = Query(default=None),
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> BillingLedgerResponse:
    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()
    entries = wallet_registry.list_ledger_entries(owner_key=owner_key, limit=limit)

    normalized_owner = owner_key.strip().lower() if owner_key else None

    return BillingLedgerResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        owner_key=normalized_owner,
        limit=limit,
        entries=[_ledger_entry_to_view(entry) for entry in entries],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.core.unit_wallet import get_unit_wallet_registry
from app.services.audit_store import get_audit_store
from app.services.incident_store import get_incident_store
from app.services.quarantine_store import get_quarantine_store


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/dashboard",
    tags=["dashboard"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


class DashboardStatView(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    value: int
    delta: int = 0
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class DashboardIncidentView(BaseModel):
    incident_id: str
    title: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    source: str
    created_at: str
    verdict: str | None = None


class DashboardQueueView(BaseModel):
    queue_name: str
    pending: int
    in_progress: int
    completed_today: int


class DashboardIntegrationView(BaseModel):
    integration_id: str
    label: str
    status: str
    protected_requests_24h: int
    blocked_events_24h: int


class DashboardWalletView(BaseModel):
    owner_key: str
    balance_units: int
    total_purchased_units: int
    total_consumed_units: int
    updated_at: str


class DashboardResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    stats: list[DashboardStatView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recent_incidents: list[DashboardIncidentView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    queues: list[DashboardQueueView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    integrations: list[DashboardIntegrationView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    wallet: DashboardWalletView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _normalize_label(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()


@router.get("/overview", response_model=DashboardResponse)
def get_dashboard_overview() -> DashboardResponse:
    now = _utc_now_iso()

    incident_store = get_incident_store()
    quarantine_store = get_quarantine_store()
    audit_store = get_audit_store()
    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()

    incidents = incident_store.list_incidents()
    quarantine_items = quarantine_store.list_items()
    audit_events = audit_store.list_events(limit=500)

    open_incidents = [item for item in incidents if item.status in {"open", "triaged"}]
    blocked_events = [
        item for item in audit_events if (item.verdict or "").lower() in {"block", "quarantine"}
    ]
    integration_rollups: dict[str, dict[str, int | str]] = {}

    for event in audit_events:
        integration_id = event.integration_id or "core-system"
        bucket = integration_rollups.setdefault(
            integration_id,
            {
                "integration_id": integration_id,
                "label": _normalize_label(integration_id),
                "status": "protected",
                "protected_requests_24h": 0,
                "blocked_events_24h": 0,
            },
        )
        bucket["protected_requests_24h"] = int(bucket["protected_requests_24h"]) + 1
        if (event.verdict or "").lower() in {"block", "quarantine"}:
            bucket["blocked_events_24h"] = int(bucket["blocked_events_24h"]) + 1

    integrations = [
        DashboardIntegrationView(
            integration_id=str(item["integration_id"]),
            label=str(item["label"]),
            status=str(item["status"]),
            protected_requests_24h=int(item["protected_requests_24h"]),
            blocked_events_24h=int(item["blocked_events_24h"]),
        )
        for item in sorted(
            integration_rollups.values(),
            key=lambda item: (-int(item["protected_requests_24h"]), str(item["integration_id"])),
        )
    ]

    wallet = wallet_registry.get_wallet("demo@ironclaw.local")
    if wallet is None:
        wallet = wallet_registry.get_or_create_wallet("demo@ironclaw.local")

    recent_incidents = sorted(
        incidents,
        key=lambda item: item.created_at,
        reverse=True,
    )[:5]

    quarantine_pending = [item for item in quarantine_items if item.status in {"isolated", "under_review"}]
    quarantine_completed = [item for item in quarantine_items if item.status in {"released", "destroyed"}]

    return DashboardResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=now,
        stats=[
            DashboardStatView(
                key="protected_requests",
                label="Protected Requests",
                value=len(audit_events),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
            DashboardStatView(
                key="blocked_actions",
                label="Blocked Actions",
                value=len(blocked_events),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
            DashboardStatView(
                key="quarantined_items",
                label="Quarantined Items",
                value=len(quarantine_items),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
            DashboardStatView(
                key="open_incidents",
                label="Open Incidents",
                value=len(open_incidents),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
        ],
        recent_incidents=[
            DashboardIncidentView(
                incident_id=item.incident_id,
                title=item.title,
                severity=item.severity,
                status=item.status,
                source=item.source,
                created_at=item.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
                verdict=item.verdict,
            )
            for item in recent_incidents
        ],
        queues=[
            DashboardQueueView(
                queue_name="review_queue",
                pending=len(open_incidents),
                in_progress=len([item for item in open_incidents if item.owner]),
                completed_today=len([item for item in incidents if item.status == "resolved"]),
            ),
            DashboardQueueView(
                queue_name="quarantine_queue",
                pending=len(quarantine_pending),
                in_progress=len([item for item in quarantine_pending if item.owner]),
                completed_today=len(quarantine_completed),
            ),
        ],
        integrations=integrations,
        wallet=DashboardWalletView(
            owner_key=wallet.owner_key,
            balance_units=wallet.balance_units,
            total_purchased_units=wallet.total_purchased_units,
            total_consumed_units=wallet.total_consumed_units,
            updated_at=wallet.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        ),
    )

                title="Billing productionization",
                status="warning",
                detail="Billing package routes are present, but persistent transaction storage and real payment wiring remain future work.",
                metadata={"category": "commercial"},
            ),
        ],
        metadata={
            "recommended_next_action": "validate live alert targets and complete production billing persistence",
        },
    )


    return DeploymentReadinessResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=now,
        readiness=readiness,
    )

def _to_dashboard_item(record: dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutionDashboardItem:
    return ExecutionDashboardItem(

        timestamp=str(record["timestamp"]),

        execution_state=str(record["execution_state"]),

        policy_verdict=str(record["policy_verdict"]),
        should_execute=bool(record["should_execute"]),
        halted_by_boundary=bool(record["halted_by_boundary"]),
        filepath=record.get("filepath"),
        trace_id=record.get("trace_id"),
        request_id=record.get("request_id"),
        decision_id=record.get("decision_id"),
        review_item_id=record.get("review_item_id"),
        executor_name=record.get("executor_name"),
        reason=record.get("reason"),
    )


def _to_detail_response(record: dict[str, Any]) -> ExecutionDetailResponse:
    return ExecutionDetailResponse(

        timestamp=str(record["timestamp"]),
        action_type=str(record["action_type"]),
