        risk_score=int(record["risk_score"]),
        client_id=record.get("client_id"),
        session_id=record.get("session_id"),
        filepath=record.get("filepath"),
        execution_state=str(record["execution_state"]),
        response_action=str(record["response_action"]),
        response_status=str(record["response_status"]),
        policy_verdict=str(record["policy_verdict"]),
        should_execute=bool(record["should_execute"]),
        halted_by_boundary=bool(record["halted_by_boundary"]),
        trace_id=str(record["trace_id"]),
        request_id=str(record["request_id"]),
        decision_id=str(record["decision_id"]),
        review_item_id=record.get("review_item_id"),
        executor_name=record.get("executor_name"),
        executor_result=record.get("executor_result"),
        reason=record.get("reason"),
        reasons=[
            ExecutionReasonView(
                source=str(item["source"]),
                label=str(item["label"]),
                details=str(item["details"]),
                score=item.get("score"),
            )
            for item in record.get("reasons", [])
        ],
    )


@router.get("", response_model=ExecutionDashboardResponse)
def get_execution_dashboard(
    limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=500),
) -> ExecutionDashboardResponse:
    items = [_to_dashboard_item(record) for record in _SAMPLE_EXECUTIONS[:limit]]
    return ExecutionDashboardResponse(items=items, total=len(items))


@router.get("/{execution_id}", response_model=ExecutionDetailResponse)
def get_execution_detail(execution_id: str) -> ExecutionDetailResponse:
    for record in _SAMPLE_EXECUTIONS:
        if record["execution_id"] == execution_id:
            return _to_detail_response(record)

    fallback = {
        "execution_id": execution_id,
        "timestamp": _utc_now_iso(),
        "action_type": "unknown",
        "target": "unknown",
        "content": "",
        "risk_score": 0,
        "client_id": None,
        "session_id": None,
        "filepath": None,
        "execution_state": "failed",
        "response_action": "review",
        "response_status": "denied",
        "policy_verdict": "warn",
        "should_execute": False,
        "halted_by_boundary": False,
        "trace_id": f"trace_{execution_id}",
        "request_id": f"req_{execution_id}",
        "decision_id": f"dec_{execution_id}",
        "review_item_id": None,
        "executor_name": None,
        "executor_result": None,
        "reason": "Execution record not found in the current in-memory dashboard snapshot.",
        "reasons": [
            {
                "source": "policy",
                "label": "Missing record",
                "details": "No execution record matched the provided execution ID.",
                "score": 0,
            }
        ],
    }
    return _to_detail_response(fallback)

================================================================================
FILE: app\api\routes\guard.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Request, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.orchestrator.execution_trace import build_trace_id
from app.orchestrator.policy_enforcer import enforce_policy, initialize_policy_engine
from app.services.action_decision import evaluate_action_execution

router = APIRouter(prefix="/guard", tags=["guard"])


_ENGINE = initialize_policy_engine(mode="enforce")
_AUDIT_EVENTS: list[dict[str, Any]] = []


class ActionDecisionRequest(BaseModel):
    action_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    content: str = ""
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    file_path: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ExecuteRequest(BaseModel):
    action_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    content: str = ""
    risk_score: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=100)
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    file_path: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _merge_metadata(payload_metadata: dict[str, Any], *, session_id: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged = dict(payload_metadata or {})
    if session_id and "session_id" not in merged:
        merged["session_id"] = session_id
    return merged


def _append_audit_event(event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    _AUDIT_EVENTS.append(event)
    if len(_AUDIT_EVENTS) > 500:
        del _AUDIT_EVENTS[:-500]


@router.post("/action-decision", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def action_decision(payload: ActionDecisionRequest, request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trace_id = build_trace_id()

    tool_decision = evaluate_action_execution(
        action_type=payload.action_type,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        client_id=payload.client_id,
        session_id=payload.session_id,
    )

    response = {
        "trace_id": trace_id,
        "verdict": tool_decision["verdict"],
        "risk_score": int(tool_decision["risk_score"]),
        "should_halt": bool(tool_decision["should_halt"]),
        "summary": tool_decision.get("summary", ""),
        "decision_source": tool_decision.get("decision_source", "unknown"),
        "matched_patterns": list(tool_decision.get("matched_patterns", [])),
    }

    _append_audit_event(
        {
            "event_type": "action_decision",
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "path": str(request.url.path),
            "client_id": payload.client_id,
            "session_id": payload.session_id,
            "action_type": payload.action_type,
            "target": payload.target,
            "response": response,
        }
    )

    return response


@router.post("/execute", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def guarded_execute(payload: ExecuteRequest, request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trace_id = build_trace_id()

    policy_decision = enforce_policy(
        _ENGINE,
        action_type=payload.action_type,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        risk_score=payload.risk_score,
        agent_id=payload.client_id,
        file_path=payload.file_path,
        metadata=_merge_metadata(payload.metadata, session_id=payload.session_id),
    )

    if policy_decision.verdict == "block":
        response_status = "denied"
        execution_state = "denied"
    elif policy_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        execution_state = "held"
    elif policy_decision.allow_execution:
        response_status = "completed"
        execution_state = "executed"
    else:
        response_status = "denied"
        execution_state = "failed"

    response = {
        "execution_id": policy_decision.decision_id,
        "trace_id": trace_id,
        "response_status": response_status,
        "execution_state": execution_state,
        "policy_verdict": policy_decision.verdict,
        "risk_score": int(policy_decision.risk_score),
        "risk_level": policy_decision.risk_level,
        "allow_execution": policy_decision.allow_execution,
        "requires_review": policy_decision.requires_review,
        "matched_rules": [match.to_dict() for match in policy_decision.matched_rules],
        "reasons": list(policy_decision.reasons),
        "target": payload.target,
        "action_type": payload.action_type,
        "file_path": payload.file_path,
    }

    _append_audit_event(
        {
            "event_type": "execute",
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "path": str(request.url.path),
            "client_id": payload.client_id,
            "session_id": payload.session_id,
            "action_type": payload.action_type,
            "target": payload.target,
            "response": response,
        }
    )

    return response


@router.get("/audit/events", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def get_audit_events(limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=200)) -> dict[str, Any]:
    events = list(reversed(_AUDIT_EVENTS[-limit:]))
    return {
        "events": events,
        "count": len(events),
        "limit": limit,
    }

FILE: app\api\routes\incidents.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.incidentstore import (
    IncidentRecord as StoredIncidentRecord,
    build_incident_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/incidents",
    tags=["incidents"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


IncidentSeverity = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]
IncidentStatus = Literal["open", "triaged", "contained", "resolved"]
IncidentSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system", "ironclaw"]


class IncidentRecordView(BaseModel):
    incidentid: str = Field(..., description="Stable incident identifier.")
    title: str = Field(..., description="Short incident title.")
    summary: str = Field(..., description="Human-readable incident summary.")
    severity: IncidentSeverity = Field(..., description="Incident severity.")
    status: IncidentStatus = Field(..., description="Current incident status.")
    source: IncidentSource = Field(..., description="Origin of the incident.")
    createdat: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO-8601 timestamp.")
    updatedat: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO-8601 timestamp.")
    requestid: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related request identifier.")
    traceid: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related trace identifier.")
    assetref: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related asset or object reference.")
    verdict: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related security verdict if available.")
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Assigned owner.")
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Search and routing tags.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Additional incident metadata.")


class IncidentListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int = Field(..., description="Total incidents returned.")
    items: list[IncidentRecordView] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Incident records.")


class IncidentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=200)
    summary: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=2000)
    severity: IncidentSeverity
    source: IncidentSource
    status: IncidentStatus = "open"
    requestid: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    traceid: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    assetref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    verdict: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=100)
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IncidentStatusUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    status: IncidentStatus
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IncidentResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    incident: IncidentRecordView


def utcnowiso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _normalize_severity(value: Any) -> IncidentSeverity:
    normalized = str(value or "medium").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"low", "medium", "high", "critical"}:
        return normalized  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "medium"


def _normalize_status(value: Any) -> IncidentStatus:
    normalized = str(value or "open").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"open", "triaged", "contained", "resolved"}:
        return normalized  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "open"


def _normalize_source(value: Any) -> IncidentSource:
    normalized = str(value or "system").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system", "ironclaw"}:
        return normalized  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "system"


def _string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        items = value
    elif isinstance(value, tuple):
        items = list(value)
    elif isinstance(value, set):
        items = list(value)
    else:
        items = [value]
    return [str(item) for item in items if str(item).strip()]


def toview(item: StoredIncidentRecord | dict[str, Any]) -> IncidentRecordView:
    payload = item.to_dict() if hasattr(item, "to_dict") and callable(item.to_dict) else dict(item)

    raw_metadata = payload.get("metadata")
    metadata = dict(raw_metadata) if isinstance(raw_metadata, dict) else {}

    return IncidentRecordView(
        incidentid=str(payload.get("incidentid") or payload.get("incident_id") or payload.get("id") or ""),
        title=str(payload.get("title") or "Security incident"),
        summary=str(payload.get("summary") or payload.get("description") or payload.get("title") or ""),
        severity=_normalize_severity(payload.get("severity")),
        status=_normalize_status(payload.get("status")),
        source=_normalize_source(payload.get("source")),
        createdat=str(payload.get("createdat") or payload.get("created_at") or utcnowiso()),
        updatedat=str(payload.get("updatedat") or payload.get("updated_at") or utcnowiso()),
        requestid=(
            str(payload["requestid"])
            if payload.get("requestid") is not None
            else str(payload["request_id"])
            if payload.get("request_id") is not None
            else None
        ),
        traceid=(
            str(payload["traceid"])
            if payload.get("traceid") is not None
            else str(payload["trace_id"])
            if payload.get("trace_id") is not None
            else None
        ),
        assetref=(
            str(payload["assetref"])
            if payload.get("assetref") is not None
            else str(payload["asset_ref"])
            if payload.get("asset_ref") is not None
            else None
        ),
        verdict=str(payload["verdict"]) if payload.get("verdict") is not None else None,
        owner=(
            str(payload["owner"])
            if payload.get("owner") is not None
            else str(payload["assigned_to"])
            if payload.get("assigned_to") is not None
            else str(payload["owner_id"])
            if payload.get("owner_id") is not None
            else None
        ),
        tags=_string_list(payload.get("tags")),
        metadata=metadata,
    )


@router.get("/", response_model=IncidentListResponse)
def listincidents(
    severity: IncidentSeverity | None = Query(default=None),
    status: IncidentStatus | None = Query(default=None),
    source: IncidentSource | None = Query(default=None),
) -> IncidentListResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    items = store.listincidents(
        severity=severity,
        status=status,
        source=source,
    )
    return IncidentListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[toview(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.get("/{incidentid}", response_model=IncidentResponse)
def getincident(incidentid: str) -> IncidentResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    item = store.getincident(incidentid)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown incident: {incidentid}",
        )

    return IncidentResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        incident=toview(item),
    )


@router.post("/", response_model=IncidentResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def createincident(payload: IncidentCreateRequest) -> IncidentResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    item = store.createincident(
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        severity=payload.severity,
        source=payload.source,
        status=payload.status,
        requestid=payload.requestid,
        traceid=payload.traceid,
        assetref=payload.assetref,
        verdict=payload.verdict,
        owner=payload.owner,
        tags=payload.tags,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return IncidentResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        incident=toview(item),
    )


@router.put("/{incidentid}/status", response_model=IncidentResponse)
def updateincidentstatus(
    incidentid: str,
    payload: IncidentStatusUpdateRequest,
) -> IncidentResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    item = store.updateincidentstatus(
        incidentid,
        status=payload.status,
        owner=payload.owner,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown incident: {incidentid}",
        )

    return IncidentResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        incident=toview(item),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.organization_store import (
    OrganizationMemberRecord as StoredOrganizationMemberRecord,
    OrganizationRecord as StoredOrganizationRecord,
    get_organization_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/organizations",
    tags=["organizations"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


OrganizationRole = Literal["owner", "admin", "analyst", "viewer"]
OrganizationStatus = Literal["active", "suspended", "invited"]


class OrganizationMemberView(BaseModel):
    member_id: str
    email: str
    display_name: str
    role: OrganizationRole
    status: OrganizationStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationView(BaseModel):
    organization_id: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    status: Literal["active", "suspended"]
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    owner_email: str
    members: list[OrganizationMemberView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    items: list[OrganizationView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class OrganizationCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    slug: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    owner_email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    owner_display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationMemberCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    role: OrganizationRole
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    organization: OrganizationView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _member_to_view(member: StoredOrganizationMemberRecord) -> OrganizationMemberView:
    return OrganizationMemberView(**member.to_dict())


def _organization_to_view(organization: StoredOrganizationRecord) -> OrganizationView:
    data = organization.to_dict()
    return OrganizationView(
        organization_id=data["organization_id"],
        name=data["name"],
        slug=data["slug"],
        status=data["status"],
        created_at=data["created_at"],
        updated_at=data["updated_at"],
        owner_email=data["owner_email"],
        members=[OrganizationMemberView(**member) for member in data["members"]],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


def _find_organization_or_404(organization_id: str) -> StoredOrganizationRecord:
    organization = get_organization_store().get_organization(organization_id)
    if organization is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {organization_id}",
        )
    return organization


@router.get("/", response_model=OrganizationListResponse)
def list_organizations(
    status_filter: Literal["active", "suspended"] | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
) -> OrganizationListResponse:
    items = get_organization_store().list_organizations(status=status_filter)

    return OrganizationListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_organization_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.post("/", response_model=OrganizationResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_organization(payload: OrganizationCreateRequest) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = get_organization_store().create_organization(
        name=payload.name,
        slug=payload.slug,
        owner_email=payload.owner_email,
        owner_display_name=payload.owner_display_name,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        _, normalized_slug = result
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=f"Organization slug already exists: {normalized_slug}",
        )

    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )


@router.get("/{organization_id}", response_model=OrganizationResponse)
def get_organization(organization_id: str) -> OrganizationResponse:
    organization = _find_organization_or_404(organization_id)
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(organization),
    )


@router.post(
    "/{organization_id}/members",
    response_model=OrganizationResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def add_organization_member(
    organization_id: str,
    payload: OrganizationMemberCreateRequest,
) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = get_organization_store().add_member(
        organization_id,
        email=payload.email,
        display_name=payload.display_name,
        role=payload.role,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        error_type, value = result
        if error_type == "member_exists":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Organization member already exists: {value}",
            )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {value}",
        )

    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status

    OrgMemberRecord as StoredOrgMemberRecord,

)

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/orgs",

    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)

OrgRole = Literal["owner", "admin", "analyst", "viewer"]
OrgMemberStatus = Literal["active", "invited", "suspended"]
OrgStatus = Literal["active", "trialing", "suspended"]


class OrgMemberView(BaseModel):

    email: str
    display_name: str

    items: list[OrganizationView] = Field(default_factory=list)

    slug: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    owner_user_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    owner_email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=200)
    owner_display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    plan_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)

        email=payload["email"],

        role=payload["role"],

        joined_at=payload["joined_at"],
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )

        status=payload["status"],
        created_at=payload["created_at"],
        updated_at=payload["updated_at"],
        owner_user_id=payload["owner_user_id"],
        plan_name=payload["plan_name"],
        members=[_member_to_view(member) for member in org.members],
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )

        status="ok",

        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),

    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.policy_store import (
    PolicySettingsRecord as StoredPolicySettingsRecord,
    PolicyThresholdRecord,
    get_policy_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/policy",
    tags=["policy"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


PolicyMode = Literal["monitor", "enforce", "lockdown"]
PolicyDecision = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class PolicyThresholdsView(BaseModel):
    prompt_injection_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    malware_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    exfiltration_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    tool_abuse_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class PolicySettingsView(BaseModel):
    policy_id: str
    mode: PolicyMode
    default_decision: PolicyDecision
    require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool
    sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool
    block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool
    strict_prompt_ingress: bool
    thresholds: PolicyThresholdsView
    updated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PolicySettingsResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    settings: PolicySettingsView


class PolicyUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    mode: PolicyMode
    default_decision: PolicyDecision
    require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool
    sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool
    block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool
    strict_prompt_ingress: bool
    thresholds: PolicyThresholdsView
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _to_view(settings: StoredPolicySettingsRecord) -> PolicySettingsView:
    data = settings.to_dict()
    return PolicySettingsView(
        policy_id=data["policy_id"],
        mode=data["mode"],
        default_decision=data["default_decision"],
        require_human_review_for_quarantine=data["require_human_review_for_quarantine"],
        sandbox_all_untrusted_content=data["sandbox_all_untrusted_content"],
        block_high_risk_tool_calls=data["block_high_risk_tool_calls"],
        strict_prompt_ingress=data["strict_prompt_ingress"],
        thresholds=PolicyThresholdsView(**data["thresholds"]),
        updated_at=data["updated_at"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


@router.get("/settings", response_model=PolicySettingsResponse)
def get_policy_settings() -> PolicySettingsResponse:
    settings = get_policy_store().get_settings()
    return PolicySettingsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        settings=_to_view(settings),
    )


@router.put("/settings", response_model=PolicySettingsResponse)
def update_policy_settings(payload: PolicyUpdateRequest) -> PolicySettingsResponse:
    settings = get_policy_store().update_settings(
        mode=payload.mode,
        default_decision=payload.default_decision,
        require_human_review_for_quarantine=payload.require_human_review_for_quarantine,
        sandbox_all_untrusted_content=payload.sandbox_all_untrusted_content,
        block_high_risk_tool_calls=payload.block_high_risk_tool_calls,
        strict_prompt_ingress=payload.strict_prompt_ingress,
        thresholds=PolicyThresholdRecord(
            prompt_injection_score=payload.thresholds.prompt_injection_score,
            malware_score=payload.thresholds.malware_score,
            exfiltration_score=payload.thresholds.exfiltration_score,
            tool_abuse_score=payload.thresholds.tool_abuse_score,
        ),
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    return PolicySettingsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        settings=_to_view(settings),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.quarantine_store import (
    QuarantineRecord as StoredQuarantineRecord,
    get_quarantine_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/quarantine",
    tags=["quarantine"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


QuarantineStatus = Literal["isolated", "under_review", "released", "destroyed"]
QuarantineSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system"]
RiskLevel = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]


class QuarantineItemView(BaseModel):
    quarantine_id: str
    status: QuarantineStatus
    source: QuarantineSource
    title: str
    summary: str
    risk_level: RiskLevel
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    incident_id: str | None = None
    asset_ref: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    release_reason: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    items: list[QuarantineItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    source: QuarantineSource
    title: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=200)
    summary: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=2000)
    risk_level: RiskLevel
    status: QuarantineStatus = "isolated"
    request_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    trace_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    incident_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    asset_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    release_reason: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    owner: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class QuarantineReleaseRequest(BaseModel):
    release_reason: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    released_by: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class QuarantineDestroyRequest(BaseModel):
    destroyed_by: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    destroy_reason: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class QuarantineActionResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    item: QuarantineItemView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _to_view(item: StoredQuarantineRecord) -> QuarantineItemView:
    return QuarantineItemView(**item.to_dict())


def _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id: str) -> StoredQuarantineRecord:
    item = get_quarantine_store().get_item(quarantine_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )
    return item


@router.get("/", response_model=QuarantineListResponse)
def list_quarantine_items(
    status_filter: QuarantineStatus | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
    source: QuarantineSource | None = Query(default=None),
    risk_level: RiskLevel | None = Query(default=None),
) -> QuarantineListResponse:
    items = get_quarantine_store().list_items(
        status=status_filter,
        source=source,
        risk_level=risk_level,
    )

    return QuarantineListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.get("/{quarantine_id}", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def get_quarantine_item(quarantine_id: str) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)
    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(item),
    )


@router.post("/", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_quarantine_item(payload: QuarantineCreateRequest) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = get_quarantine_store().create_item(
        source=payload.source,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        risk_level=payload.risk_level,
        status=payload.status,
        request_id=payload.request_id,
        trace_id=payload.trace_id,
        incident_id=payload.incident_id,
        asset_ref=payload.asset_ref,
        owner=payload.owner,
        release_reason=payload.release_reason,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
        tags=payload.tags,
    )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(item),
    )


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/review", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def review_quarantine_item(
    quarantine_id: str,
    payload: QuarantineReviewRequest,
) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)

    if item.status in {"released", "destroyed"}:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Released or destroyed quarantine items cannot return to review.",
        )

    updated = get_quarantine_store().update_item(
        quarantine_id,
        status="under_review",
        owner=payload.owner.strip(),
        metadata={
            **payload.metadata,
            "reviewed_by": payload.owner.strip(),
        },
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(updated),
    )


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/release", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def release_quarantine_item(
    quarantine_id: str,
    payload: QuarantineReleaseRequest,
) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)

    if item.status == "destroyed":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Destroyed quarantine items cannot be released.",
        )

    updated = get_quarantine_store().update_item(
        quarantine_id,
        status="released",
        owner=payload.released_by.strip(),
        release_reason=payload.release_reason.strip(),
        metadata={
            **payload.metadata,
            "released_by": payload.released_by.strip(),
            "release_reason": payload.release_reason.strip(),
        },
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(updated),
    )


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/destroy", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def destroy_quarantine_item(
    quarantine_id: str,
    payload: QuarantineDestroyRequest,
) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)

    if item.status == "released":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Released quarantine items cannot be destroyed.",
        )

    updated = get_quarantine_store().update_item(
        quarantine_id,
        status="destroyed",
        owner=payload.destroyed_by.strip(),
        metadata={
            **payload.metadata,
            "destroyed_by": payload.destroyed_by.strip(),
            "destroy_reason": payload.destroy_reason.strip(),
        },
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(updated),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/guard/reviews",
    tags=["review-queue"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class ReviewReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int | None = None


class ReviewActionRequest(BaseModel):
    reviewer: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    notes: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class ReviewItemResponse(BaseModel):
    review_id: str
    status: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    risk_score: int
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    requested_by: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    policy_verdict: str
    recommended_action: str
    final_action: str | None = None
    reason: str
    reasons: list[ReviewReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReviewQueueSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    pending: int
    approved: int
    rejected: int

    },

        "created_at": _utc_now_iso(),

        "reasons": [

                "details": "The destination is unknown and returned suspicious content indicators.",
                "score": 72,
            }
        ],
        "metadata": {"url": "https://unknown.example/payload"},
    },
]


def _to_review_item(record: dict[str, Any]) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    return ReviewItemResponse(
        review_id=str(record["review_id"]),
        status=str(record["status"]),
        action_type=str(record["action_type"]),
        target=str(record["target"]),
        risk_score=int(record["risk_score"]),
        created_at=str(record["created_at"]),
        updated_at=str(record["updated_at"]),
        requested_by=record.get("requested_by"),
        session_id=record.get("session_id"),
        actor_id=record.get("actor_id"),
        policy_verdict=str(record["policy_verdict"]),
        recommended_action=str(record["recommended_action"]),
        final_action=record.get("final_action"),
        reason=str(record["reason"]),
        reasons=[
            ReviewReasonView(
                source=str(item["source"]),
                label=str(item["label"]),
                details=str(item["details"]),
                score=item.get("score"),
            )
            for item in record.get("reasons", [])
        ],
        metadata=dict(record.get("metadata", {})),
    )


def _find_review(review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    for record in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS:
        if record["review_id"] == review_id:
            return record
    return None


@router.get("/summary", response_model=ReviewQueueSummaryResponse)
def get_review_summary() -> ReviewQueueSummaryResponse:
    total = len(_SAMPLE_REVIEWS)
    pending = sum(1 for item in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if item["status"] == "pending")
    approved = sum(1 for item in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if item["status"] == "approved")
    rejected = sum(1 for item in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if item["status"] == "rejected")

    return ReviewQueueSummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=total,
        pending=pending,
        approved=approved,
        rejected=rejected,
    )


@router.get("", response_model=list[ReviewItemResponse])
def get_all_reviews(
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> list[ReviewItemResponse]:
    return [_to_review_item(record) for record in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS[:limit]]


@router.get("/pending", response_model=list[ReviewItemResponse])
def get_pending_reviews(
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> list[ReviewItemResponse]:
    pending_items = [record for record in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if record["status"] == "pending"]
    return [_to_review_item(record) for record in pending_items[:limit]]


@router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def get_review(review_id: str) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    record = _find_review(review_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown review item: {review_id}",
        )
    return _to_review_item(record)


@router.post("/{review_id}/approve", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def approve_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewActionRequest,
) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    record = _find_review(review_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown review item: {review_id}",
        )

    record["status"] = "approved"
    record["final_action"] = "approve"
    record["updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()
    record["metadata"] = {
        **dict(record.get("metadata", {})),
        "reviewer": payload.reviewer,
        "review_notes": payload.notes,
    }
    return _to_review_item(record)


@router.post("/{review_id}/reject", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def reject_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewActionRequest,
) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    record = _find_review(review_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown review item: {review_id}",
        )

    record["status"] = "rejected"
    record["final_action"] = "reject"
    record["updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()
    record["metadata"] = {
        **dict(record.get("metadata", {})),
        "reviewer": payload.reviewer,
        "review_notes": payload.notes,
    }
    return _to_review_item(record)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.C_gen1 import scan_text, scan_url, scan_github_repo, scan_archive
from app.C_gen1service import (
    apply_review_action,
    get_history_items,
    get_history_item,
    record_scan_result,
    review_scan,
)

router = APIRouter()

Verdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class ScanRequest(BaseModel):
    target_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target_value: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

@router.post("/scan/", response_model=ScanResponse)
def scan_target(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResponse:
    target_type = request.target_type
    target_value = request.target_value

    normalized_value = " ".join(target_value.split())
    if target_type == "text" and not normalized_value:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target_value is empty after normalization")

    if target_type == "text":
        result = scan_text(normalized_value)
    elif target_type == "url":
        result = scan_url(target_value)
    elif target_type == "github_repo":
        result = scan_github_repo(target_value)
    elif target_type == "archive":
        result = scan_archive(target_value)
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"unsupported target_type={target_type}")

    stored = record_scan_result(
        target_type=target_type,
        target_value=target_value,
        result=result,
    )

    return ScanResponse(
        scan_id=stored.scan_id,
        verdict=stored.verdict,
        summary=stored.summary,
        risk_score=stored.risk_score,
        matched_patterns=list(stored.matchedpatterns),
        risky_files=list(getattr(stored, "riskyfiles", [])),
        checks_loaded=list(getattr(stored, "checksloaded", [])),
        failed_checks=list(getattr(stored, "failedchecks", [])),
        review_status=getattr(stored, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(stored, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(stored, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.get("/history/", response_model=HistoryListResponse)
def list_history() -> HistoryListResponse:
    items = get_history_items()
    return HistoryListResponse(
        items=[
            HistoryItem(
                scan_id=i.scan_id,
                target_type=i.targettype,
                target_value=i.targetvalue,
                verdict=i.verdict,
                summary=i.summary,
                risk_score=i.riskscore,
                matched_patterns=list(getattr(i, "matchedpatterns", [])),
                review_status=getattr(i, "reviewstatus", None),
                untrusted=getattr(i, "untrusted", None),
                quarantine_reason=getattr(i, "quarantinereason", None),
            )
            for i in items
        ]
    )


@router.get("/history/{scan_id}", response_model=HistoryItem)
def get_history(scan_id: str) -> HistoryItem:

    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="scan_id not found")

    return HistoryItem(

        target_type=item.targettype,
        target_value=item.targetvalue,
        verdict=item.verdict,
        summary=item.summary,
        risk_score=item.riskscore,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(item, "matchedpatterns", [])),

        untrusted=getattr(item, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(item, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.post("/history/{scan_id}/review")
def review_history_item(scan_id: str, request: ReviewRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        updated = review_scan(scan_id=scan_id, action=request.action)
    except KeyError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="scan_id not found")

    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="review not applicable for this scan")

    apply_review_action(updated, request.action)
    return {"status": "ok", "scan_id": scan_id, "action": request.action}


@router.post("/guard/action", response_model=GuardActionResponse)
def guard_action(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardActionResponse:
    scan_result = scan_text(request.content)
    verdict: Verdict = scan_result.verdict  # type: ignore[assignment]

    should_halt = verdict in ("block", "quarantine")
    should_warn = verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")

    return GuardActionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_halt=bool(should_halt),
        should_warn=bool(should_warn),
        matched_patterns=list(scan_result.matchedpatterns),
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-policy", response_model=GuardPolicyResponse)
def guard_action_policy(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardPolicyResponse:
    content = request.content.lower()
    if "powershell" in content:
        policy_mode: Literal["review", "allow", "block"] = "review"
        verdict: Verdict = "warn"
        should_halt = False
        should_warn = True
    else:
        policy_mode = "allow"
        verdict = "allow"
        should_halt = False
        should_warn = False

    return GuardPolicyResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=policy_mode,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_halt=should_halt,
        should_warn=should_warn,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-decision", response_model=GuardDecisionResponse)
def guard_action_decision(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardDecisionResponse:
    scan_result = scan_text(request.content)
    scan_verdict: Verdict = scan_result.verdict  # type: ignore[assignment]

    policy_resp = guard_action_policy(request)
    policy_mode = policy_resp.policy_mode

    matched_patterns = list(scan_result.matchedpatterns)

    if scan_verdict in ("block", "quarantine"):
        final_verdict = "block"
        decision_source: Literal["scan", "policy"] = "scan"
        should_halt = True
        should_warn = False
    else:
        final_verdict = policy_resp.verdict
        decision_source = "policy"
        should_halt = policy_resp.should_halt
        should_warn = policy_resp.should_warn

    return GuardDecisionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=policy_mode,
        verdict=final_verdict,
        decision_source=decision_source,
        should_halt=should_halt,
        should_warn=should_warn,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )

    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


LedgerEntryType = Literal["purchase", "debit", "credit", "adjustment", "refund"]


class UnitLedgerItem(BaseModel):
    entry_id: str
    timestamp: str
    entry_type: LedgerEntryType
    units: int
    balance_after: int = Field(ge=0)
    amount_usd: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)

class UnitLedgerTotalsView(BaseModel):
    total_entries: int = Field(ge=0)
    purchase_entries: int = Field(ge=0)
    debit_entries: int = Field(ge=0)
    credit_entries: int = Field(ge=0)
    adjustment_entries: int = Field(ge=0)
    refund_entries: int = Field(ge=0)
    total_purchased_units: int = Field(ge=0)
    total_consumed_units: int = Field(ge=0)
    total_credited_units: int = Field(ge=0)
    total_refunded_units: int = Field(ge=0)

    current_balance_units: int = Field(ge=0)

def _filter_items(
    items: list[UnitLedgerItem],
    entry_type: LedgerEntryType | None = None,
    reference_id: str | None = None,
) -> list[UnitLedgerItem]:
    filtered = items

    if entry_type is not None:
        filtered = [item for item in filtered if item.entry_type == entry_type]

    if reference_id:
        reference_value = reference_id.strip().lower()
        filtered = [
            item
            for item in filtered
            if item.reference_id and reference_value in item.reference_id.lower()
        ]

    return filtered


def _build_totals(items: list[UnitLedgerItem]) -> UnitLedgerTotalsView:
    purchase_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "purchase")
    debit_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "debit")
    credit_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "credit")
    adjustment_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "adjustment")
    refund_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "refund")

    total_purchased_units = sum(item.units for item in items if item.entry_type == "purchase")
    total_consumed_units = sum(abs(item.units) for item in items if item.entry_type == "debit")
    total_credited_units = sum(
        item.units for item in items if item.entry_type in {"credit", "adjustment"}
    )
    total_refunded_units = sum(item.units for item in items if item.entry_type == "refund")
    total_purchase_amount_usd = round(
        sum(item.amount_usd or 0 for item in items if item.entry_type == "purchase"),
        2,
    )

    current_balance_units = max(sum(item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER), 0)

    return UnitLedgerTotalsView(
        total_entries=len(items),
        purchase_entries=purchase_entries,
        debit_entries=debit_entries,
        credit_entries=credit_entries,
        adjustment_entries=adjustment_entries,
        refund_entries=refund_entries,
        total_purchased_units=max(total_purchased_units, 0),
        total_consumed_units=total_consumed_units,
        total_credited_units=max(total_credited_units, 0),
        total_refunded_units=max(total_refunded_units, 0),
        total_purchase_amount_usd=total_purchase_amount_usd,
        current_balance_units=current_balance_units,
    )


def _find_entry(entry_id: str) -> UnitLedgerItem | None:
    for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER:
        if item.entry_id == entry_id:
            return item
    return None


@router.get("/ledger", response_model=UnitLedgerListResponse)
def get_unit_ledger(
    entry_type: LedgerEntryType | None = Query(default=None),
    reference_id: str | None = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
    limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200),
) -> UnitLedgerListResponse:
    filtered_items = _filter_items(
        _SAMPLE_LEDGER,
        entry_type=entry_type,
        reference_id=reference_id,
    )
    limited_items = filtered_items[:limit]

    return UnitLedgerListResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(filtered_items),
        applied_filters={
            "entry_type": entry_type,
            "reference_id": reference_id,
            "limit": limit,
        },
        totals=_build_totals(filtered_items),
        items=limited_items,
        notes=[
            "Ledger route provides UI-facing billing activity for wallet purchases, usage debits, and manual adjustments.",
            "Sample data is returned from in-memory entries for scaffolding and frontend integration.",
            "Package pricing reflected in related purchase entries includes 100,000 units for $90.00 USD and 200,000 units for $150.00 USD.",
        ],
    )


@router.get("/ledger/{entry_id}", response_model=UnitLedgerDetailResponse)
def get_unit_ledger_entry(entry_id: str) -> UnitLedgerDetailResponse:
    item = _find_entry(entry_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ledger entry not found")

    return UnitLedgerDetailResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=item,
        notes=[
            "Ledger detail route returns a single wallet activity record for UI drill-down views.",
            "This scaffold currently serves in-memory sample data only.",
        ],
    )

def _build_wallet_balance() -> UnitWalletBalanceView:
    purchased_units = sum(item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type == "purchase")
    credited_units = sum(
        item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type in {"credit", "adjustment", "refund"}
    )
    consumed_units = sum(abs(item.units) for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type == "debit")
    balance_units = max(sum(item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER), 0)

    return UnitWalletBalanceView(
        balance_units=balance_units,
        lifetime_purchased_units=max(purchased_units + credited_units, 0),
        lifetime_consumed_units=consumed_units,
        pending_units=0,
        last_updated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
    )


def _build_usage_summary() -> UnitUsageSummaryView:
    total_units = sum(abs(item.units) for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type == "debit")
    total_requests = sum(
        int(item.metadata.get("request_count", 0))
        for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER
        if item.entry_type == "debit"
    )
    average_units_per_request = round(total_units / total_requests, 2) if total_requests else 0.0
    last_seen_at = _SAMPLE_LEDGER[0].timestamp if _SAMPLE_LEDGER else None

    return UnitUsageSummaryView(
        total_requests=total_requests,
        total_units=total_units,
        average_units_per_request=average_units_per_request,
        last_seen_at=last_seen_at,
    )


def _find_package(package_id: str) -> UnitPackageView | None:
    for package in _SAMPLE_PACKAGES:
        if package.package_id == package_id:
            return package
    return None


@router.get("/wallet", response_model=UnitWalletResponse)
def get_unit_wallet() -> UnitWalletResponse:
    return UnitWalletResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        wallet=_build_wallet_balance(),
        usage=_build_usage_summary(),
        packages=_SAMPLE_PACKAGES,
        recent_ledger=_SAMPLE_LEDGER,
        notes=[
            "Prepaid wallet model: units are purchased in fixed packages and consumed by usage.",
            "Available packages are 20,000 units for $20.00 USD, 100,000 units for $90.00 USD, and 200,000 units for $150.00 USD.",
            "No recurring subscription state is tracked in this route.",
            "Current implementation returns in-memory sample data for UI scaffolding.",
        ],
    )


@router.post("/purchase", response_model=UnitPurchaseResponse)
def purchase_units(payload: UnitPurchaseRequest) -> UnitPurchaseResponse:
    package = _find_package(payload.package_id)
    if package is None:
        package = UnitPackageView(
            package_id=payload.package_id,
            name="20,000 Units",
            unit_count=20_000,
            price_usd=20.0,
            price_display="$20.00",
            active=True,
            featured=False,
            description="Fallback package for unknown package ids in the UI scaffold.",
            effective_price_per_1k_units=_price_per_1k_units(20.0, 20_000),
        )

    credited_units = package.unit_count * payload.quantity
    amount_usd = round(package.price_usd * payload.quantity, 2)

    current_balance = _build_wallet_balance()
    new_balance = current_balance.balance_units + credited_units
    timestamp = _utc_now_iso()

    ledger_entry = UnitLedgerItem(
        entry_id=f"ledger_purchase_{payload.package_id}_{payload.quantity}",
        timestamp=timestamp,
        entry_type="purchase",
        units=credited_units,
        balance_after=new_balance,
        amount_usd=amount_usd,
        description=f"Purchased {payload.quantity} x {package.name}.",
        reference_id=f"order_{payload.package_id}_{payload.quantity}",
        metadata={
            "package_id": package.package_id,
            "package_name": package.name,
            "quantity": payload.quantity,
        },
    )

    wallet = UnitWalletBalanceView(
        balance_units=new_balance,
        lifetime_purchased_units=current_balance.lifetime_purchased_units + credited_units,
        lifetime_consumed_units=current_balance.lifetime_consumed_units,
        pending_units=current_balance.pending_units,
        last_updated_at=timestamp,
    )

    return UnitPurchaseResponse(
        status="ok",
        purchased_package=package,
        quantity=payload.quantity,
        credited_units=credited_units,
        amount_usd=amount_usd,
        wallet=wallet,
        ledger_entry=ledger_entry,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/usage",
    tags=["usage"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


class UsageSample(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    units_consumed: int
    source: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageSummaryView(BaseModel):
    owner_key: str
    total_units_consumed: int
    window_start: str
    window_end: str
    samples: list[UsageSample] = Field(default_factory=list)


class UsageSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    summary: UsageSummaryView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


# In-memory usage registry for API-key scoped metering.
# This is intentionally simple for Gen1; persistence can be added behind the same interface later.
class UsageRegistry:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._by_owner: dict[str, list[UsageSample]] = {}

    def record_usage(
        self,
        owner_key: str,
        units_consumed: int,
        source: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        normalized_owner = owner_key.strip().lower()
        sample = UsageSample(
            timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
            units_consumed=max(0, int(units_consumed)),
            source=source,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        self._by_owner.setdefault(normalized_owner, []).append(sample)

    def summarize_owner(
        self,
        owner_key: str,
    ) -> UsageSummaryView:
        normalized_owner = owner_key.strip().lower()
        samples = self._by_owner.get(normalized_owner, [])

        if not samples:
            now = _utc_now_iso()
            return UsageSummaryView(
                owner_key=normalized_owner,
                total_units_consumed=0,
                window_start=now,
                window_end=now,
                samples=[],
            )

        total = sum(s.units_consumed for s in samples)
        window_start = samples[0].timestamp
        window_end = samples[-1].timestamp

        return UsageSummaryView(
            owner_key=normalized_owner,
            total_units_consumed=total,
            window_start=window_start,
            window_end=window_end,
            samples=samples[-250:],  # cap for response size
        )


_usage_registry = UsageRegistry()


def get_usage_registry() -> UsageRegistry:
    return _usage_registry


@router.get(
    "/owner/{owner_key}",
    response_model=UsageSummaryResponse,
)
def get_owner_usage(owner_key: str) -> UsageSummaryResponse:
    """
    Return a metered view of IronClaw-Security protection usage for this owner key.

    In Gen1 this is backed by an in-memory registry. In a production deployment
    the same shape can be hydrated from logs or a billing database.
    """
    summary = _usage_registry.summarize_owner(owner_key=owner_key)

    return UsageSummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        summary=summary,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections import deque, defaultdict

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, Response

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.schemas.scan import (
    BatchScanRequest,
    BatchScanResponse,
    ScanRequest,
    ScanResult,
)
from app.services.history import append_scan_result
from app.services.intake_service import prepare_intake
from app.services.sandbox_service import apply_sandbox_policy, evaluate_sandbox
from app.services.scanner import RULE_INDEX, get_rule_severities, perform_scan
from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter()

_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60
_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS = 30
_rate_limit_buckets: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)


def _apply_scan_security_headers(response: Response) -> None:
    response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
    response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
    response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer"
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"


def _client_rate_limit_key(request: Request, payload: ScanRequest | None = None) -> str:
    forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for", "")
    if forwarded.strip():
        first_ip = forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
        if first_ip:
            return first_ip

    if payload is not None and payload.client_id:
        client_id = str(payload.client_id).strip()
        if client_id:
            return f"client:{client_id}"

    host = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
    return f"ip:{host}"


def _enforce_scan_rate_limit(key: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    now = time.time()
    bucket = _rate_limit_buckets[key]

    while bucket and now - bucket[0] > _RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS:
        bucket.popleft()

    if len(bucket) >= _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS:
        retry_after = max(1, int(_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS - (now - bucket[0])))
        raise AppError(
            error="scan_rate_limit_exceeded",
            message="Too many scan requests. Please retry shortly.",
            status_code=429,
            details={
                "rate_limit_key": key,
                "window_seconds": _RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS,
                "max_requests": _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS,
                "retry_after_seconds": retry_after,
            },
        )

    bucket.append(now)
    remaining = max(0, _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS - len(bucket))
    return _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS, remaining


def _sandbox_decision_to_dict(sandbox_decision):
    if hasattr(sandbox_decision, "model_dump"):
        return sandbox_decision.model_dump()
    if hasattr(sandbox_decision, "dict"):
        return sandbox_decision.dict()
    return getattr(sandbox_decision, "__dict__", sandbox_decision)


def _severity_rank(severity: str) -> int:
    order = {
        "low": 1,
        "medium": 2,
        "high": 3,
        "critical": 4,
    }
    return order.get(severity, 0)


def _max_severity(matched_patterns: list[str]) -> str | None:
    severities = get_rule_severities(matched_patterns)
    if not severities:
        return None
    return max(severities, key=_severity_rank)


def _primary_category(matched_patterns: list[str]) -> str | None:
    for match in matched_patterns:
        if match in RULE_INDEX:
            return RULE_INDEX[match]["category"]
    return None


def _build_explanation(result: dict) -> str:
    matched_patterns = result.get("matched_patterns", [])
    verdict = result.get("verdict", "allow")
    max_severity = _max_severity(matched_patterns)
    primary_category = _primary_category(matched_patterns)

    if not matched_patterns:
        return "No risky patterns were matched."

    parts = [f"Matched {len(matched_patterns)} pattern(s)"]
    if primary_category:
        parts.append(f"primary category: {primary_category}")
    if max_severity:
        parts.append(f"max severity: {max_severity}")
    parts.append(f"final verdict: {verdict}")
    return "; ".join(parts) + "."


def _run_scan(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResult:
    try:
        intake = prepare_intake(request.target_type, request.target_value)
    except ValueError as exc:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "scan_intake_error",
            {
                "target_type": request.target_type,
                "target_value": request.target_value,
                "client_id": request.client_id,
                "error": str(exc),
            },
        )
        raise AppError(
            error="invalid_scan_input",
            message=str(exc),
            status_code=400,
            details={
                "target_type": request.target_type,
                "target_value": request.target_value,
            },
        ) from exc

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_intake_prepared",
        {
            "target_type": intake.target_type,
            "target_value": intake.target_value,
            "client_id": request.client_id,
            "route_mode": intake.route_mode,
            "requires_sandbox": intake.requires_sandbox,
        },
    )

    result = perform_scan(intake.target_type, intake.target_value)

    sandbox_decision = evaluate_sandbox(
        intake.target_type,
        intake.route_mode,
        intake.requires_sandbox,
    )

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_sandbox_evaluated",
        {
            "target_type": intake.target_type,
            "route_mode": intake.route_mode,
            "requires_sandbox": intake.requires_sandbox,
            "client_id": request.client_id,
            "sandbox_decision": _sandbox_decision_to_dict(sandbox_decision),
        },
    )

    result = apply_sandbox_policy(result, sandbox_decision)
    result["client_id"] = request.client_id
    result["max_severity"] = _max_severity(result.get("matched_patterns", []))
    result["primary_category"] = _primary_category(result.get("matched_patterns", []))
    result["explanation"] = _build_explanation(result)

    saved = append_scan_result(result)
    saved["client_id"] = request.client_id

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_completed",
        {
            "scan_id": saved.get("scan_id"),
            "verdict": saved.get("verdict"),
            "risk_score": saved.get("risk_score"),
            "target_type": saved.get("target_type"),
            "untrusted": saved.get("untrusted"),
            "client_id": request.client_id,
            "max_severity": saved.get("max_severity"),
            "primary_category": saved.get("primary_category"),
        },
    )

    return ScanResult(**saved)


@router.post("/", response_model=ScanResult)
def create_scan(request: ScanRequest, http_request: Request, response: Response):
    key = _client_rate_limit_key(http_request, request)
    limit, remaining = _enforce_scan_rate_limit(key)

    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Limit"] = str(limit)
    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Remaining"] = str(remaining)
    _apply_scan_security_headers(response)

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_rate_limit_checked",
        {
            "rate_limit_key": key,
            "limit": limit,
            "remaining": remaining,
            "client_id": request.client_id,
        },
    )

    return _run_scan(request)


@router.post("/batch", response_model=BatchScanResponse)
def create_scan_batch(
    request: BatchScanRequest,
    http_request: Request,
    response: Response,
):
    key = _client_rate_limit_key(http_request)
    limit, remaining = _enforce_scan_rate_limit(key)

    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Limit"] = str(limit)
    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Remaining"] = str(remaining)
    _apply_scan_security_headers(response)

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_batch_rate_limit_checked",
        {
            "rate_limit_key": key,
            "limit": limit,
            "remaining": remaining,
            "item_count": len(request.items),
        },
    )

    results = [_run_scan(item) for item in request.items]
    return BatchScanResponse(
        count=len(results),
        items=results,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.secretservice import build_secret_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/secrets", tags=["secrets"])


class SecretsInspectRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str | None = None
    arguments: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    content: Any | None = None
    tool_name: str | None = None
    context: str | None = None
    redact_secrets: bool = True
    block_unsafe_commands: bool = True


def _service():
    return build_secret_service()


@router.get("")
def get_secrets_api_overview() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "name": "IronClaw secrets api",
        "routes": [
            "/api/secrets",
            "/api/secrets/inspect",
            "/api/secrets/inspect/text",
            "/api/secrets/inspect/arguments",
            "/api/secrets/inspect/metadata",
            "/api/secrets/health",
        ],
    }


@router.get("/health")
def get_secrets_api_health() -> dict[str, Any]:
    service = _service()
    result = service.inspect_text(
        "health probe",
        context="health_check",
        metadata={"direction": "internal"},
    )
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "service": "secrets",
        "verdict": result.verdict,
        "blocked": result.blocked,
    }


@router.post("/inspect")
def inspect_secret_payload(request: SecretsInspectRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    service = _service()

    if request.text is not None:
        result = service.inspect_text(
            request.text,
            context=request.context,
            metadata=request.metadata,
            redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
            block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        return result.as_dict()

    if request.arguments:
        result = service.inspect_arguments(
            request.arguments,
            context=request.context,
            metadata=request.metadata,
            redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
            block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        return result.as_dict()

    if request.metadata and not request.arguments and request.content is None:
        result = service.inspect_metadata(
            request.metadata,
            context=request.context,
            redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
            block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        return result.as_dict()

    result = service.inspect_payload(
        tool_name=request.tool_name,
        arguments=request.arguments,
        metadata=request.metadata,
        content=request.content,
        context=request.context,
        redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
        block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
    )
    return result.as_dict()

def inspect_secret_text(request: SecretsInspectRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
