from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.review_queue_service import get_review_queue_summary
from app.services.telemetry import (
    append_telemetry_event,
    read_telemetry_events,
    summarize_telemetry_events,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/system", tags=["system"])

SERVICE_NAME = "IronClaw-Security"
SERVICE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
DEGRADED_STATUS = "degraded"
OK_STATUS = "ok"
START_TIME = datetime.now(UTC)


class ComponentStatus(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class LivenessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int


class ReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    live: bool
    ready: bool
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


class MetricsSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any]
    review_summary: dict[str, Any]
    recent_telemetry_events: list[dict[str, Any]]


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _iso(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _uptime_seconds() -> int:
    return max(0, int((_utc_now() - START_TIME).total_seconds()))


def _base_response_fields() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "service": SERVICE_NAME,
        "version": _resolve_version(),
        "timestamp": _iso(_utc_now()),
        "uptime_seconds": _uptime_seconds(),
    }


def _safe_append_telemetry_event(event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(event_name, payload)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _resolve_version() -> str:
    return SERVICE_VERSION


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _load_action_execute_pipeline_factory():
    from app.dependencies.action_execute import get_action_execute_pipeline

    return get_action_execute_pipeline


def _build_component_status(
    *,
    name: str,
    ok: bool,
    details: dict[str, Any],
) -> ComponentStatus:
    return ComponentStatus(
        name=name,
        status=OK_STATUS if ok else DEGRADED_STATUS,
        details=details,
    )


def _build_readiness_checks() -> list[ComponentStatus]:
    checks: list[ComponentStatus] = []

    pipeline = None
    pipeline_close_available = False
    pipeline_ready = False
    pipeline_error: str | None = None
    try:
        get_action_execute_pipeline = _load_action_execute_pipeline_factory()
        pipeline = get_action_execute_pipeline()
        pipeline_ready = pipeline is not None
        pipeline_close_available = callable(getattr(pipeline, "close", None)) if pipeline is not None else False
    except Exception as exc:
        pipeline_error = str(exc)

    checks.append(
        _build_component_status(
            name="action_execute_pipeline",
            ok=pipeline_ready,
            details={
                "initialized": pipeline_ready,
                "close_supported": pipeline_close_available,
                **({"error": pipeline_error} if pipeline_error else {}),
            },
        )
    )

    telemetry_ok = True
    telemetry_error: str | None = None
    telemetry_recent_count = 0
    try:
        recent = read_telemetry_events(limit=5)
        telemetry_recent_count = len(recent)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_ok = False
        telemetry_error = str(exc)

    checks.append(
        _build_component_status(
            name="telemetry_store",
            ok=telemetry_ok,
            details={
                "recent_events_checked": telemetry_recent_count,
                **({"error": telemetry_error} if telemetry_error else {}),
            },
        )
    )

    review_ok = True
    review_error: str | None = None
    review_summary: dict[str, Any] = {}
    try:
        review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()
    except Exception as exc:
        review_ok = False
        review_error = str(exc)

    checks.append(
        _build_component_status(
            name="review_queue",
            ok=review_ok,
            details={
                "pending_items": review_summary.get("pending_items"),
                "critical_items": review_summary.get("critical_items"),
                "total_items": review_summary.get("total_items"),
                **({"error": review_error} if review_error else {}),
            },
        )
    )

    return checks


def _overall_status_from_checks(checks: list[ComponentStatus]) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    ready = all(check.status == OK_STATUS for check in checks)
    return (OK_STATUS if ready else DEGRADED_STATUS, ready)


def _status_from_summary_payloads(*payloads: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    degraded_values = {DEGRADED_STATUS, "error", "failed", "unavailable"}
    for payload in payloads:
        if payload.get("status") in degraded_values or "error" in payload:
            return DEGRADED_STATUS
    return OK_STATUS


@router.get("/live", response_model=LivenessResponse, summary="Liveness probe")
def get_liveness() -> LivenessResponse:
    """
    Fast, dependency-light probe that answers:
    is the process alive and serving requests?
    """
    response = LivenessResponse(
        status=OK_STATUS,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_liveness_requested",
        {
            "status": response.status,
            "uptime_seconds": response.uptime_seconds,
        },
    )

    return response


@router.get("/ready", response_model=ReadinessResponse, summary="Readiness probe")
def get_readiness(response: Response) -> ReadinessResponse:
    """
    Readiness probe that checks whether core in-process services
    are initialized enough to safely receive traffic.
    """
    checks = _build_readiness_checks()
    overall_status, ready = _overall_status_from_checks(checks)

    if not ready:
        response.status_code = status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

    result = ReadinessResponse(
        status=overall_status,
        checks=checks,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_readiness_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "ready": ready,
            "check_count": len(checks),
        },
    )

    return result


@router.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse, summary="Combined health snapshot")
def get_health(response: Response) -> HealthResponse:
    """
    Combined operational health snapshot for dashboards and lightweight UI polling.
    """
    checks = _build_readiness_checks()
    overall_status, ready = _overall_status_from_checks(checks)

    if not ready:
        response.status_code = status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

    result = HealthResponse(
        status=overall_status,
        live=True,
        ready=ready,
        checks=checks,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_health_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "live": result.live,
            "ready": result.ready,
            "check_count": len(checks),
        },
    )

    return result


@router.get(
    "/metrics/summary",
    response_model=MetricsSummaryResponse,
    summary="Lightweight metrics and telemetry summary",
)
def get_metrics_summary() -> MetricsSummaryResponse:
    """
    Lightweight operational summary intended for internal dashboards.
    """
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any]
    try:
        telemetry_summary = summarize_telemetry_events(limit=500)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_summary = {
            "status": DEGRADED_STATUS,
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    review_summary: dict[str, Any]
    try:
        review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()
    except Exception as exc:
        review_summary = {
            "status": DEGRADED_STATUS,
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]]
    try:
        recent_events = read_telemetry_events(limit=25)
    except Exception as exc:
        recent_events = [
            {
                "type": "telemetry_read_error",
                "error": str(exc),
            }
        ]

    overall_status = _status_from_summary_payloads(telemetry_summary, review_summary)

    result = MetricsSummaryResponse(
        status=overall_status,
        telemetry_summary=telemetry_summary,
        review_summary=review_summary,
        recent_telemetry_events=recent_events,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_metrics_summary_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "telemetry_event_count": len(recent_events),
            "has_review_summary": bool(review_summary),
        },
    )

    return result

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

from app.schemas.telemetry import TelemetryEvent, TelemetryResponse
from app.services.telemetry import read_telemetry_events

@router.get(
    "/",
    response_model=TelemetryResponse,
    summary="Get telemetry events",
    description="Return recent telemetry events for operational visibility, newest-first.",
)
def get_telemetry(
    limit: int = Query(
        default=50,
        ge=1,
        le=500,
        description="Maximum number of telemetry events to return.",
    ),
) -> TelemetryResponse:
    events_raw = read_telemetry_events(limit=limit)
    items = [TelemetryEvent(**event) for event in events_raw]
    return TelemetryResponse(count=len(items), items=items)

@dataclass(slots=True)

_STATE = _ThreatIntelState(feed=initialize_default_threat_feed())

def _build_match_response(match: ThreatIntelMatch) -> ThreatIntelMatchResponse:
    return ThreatIntelMatchResponse(
        indicator_id=match.indicator_id,
        indicator_type=match.indicator_type,
        value=match.value,
        severity=match.severity,
        matched_on=match.matched_on,
        reason=match.reason,
        metadata=dict(match.metadata),
    )


def _build_scan_response(result: ThreatIntelScanResult) -> ThreatIntelScanResponse:
    return ThreatIntelScanResponse(
        scanned_text=result.scanned_text,
        checked_at=result.checked_at,
        matches=[_build_match_response(match) for match in result.matches],
        highest_severity=result.highest_severity,
        metadata=dict(result.metadata),
    )


@router.get("/feed", response_model=ThreatIntelFeedResponse)
def get_threat_intel_feed() -> ThreatIntelFeedResponse:
    feed = _STATE.feed
    data = feed.to_dict()
    return ThreatIntelFeedResponse(
        feed_id=data["feed_id"],
        name=data["name"],
        source=data["source"],
        indicators=data["indicators"],
        created_at=data["created_at"],
        updated_at=data["updated_at"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


@router.post("/scan", response_model=ThreatIntelScanResponse)
def scan_threat_intel(request: ThreatIntelScanRequest) -> ThreatIntelScanResponse:
    result = scan_text_against_threat_feed(request.text, _STATE.feed)
    _STATE.last_scan_result = result
    return _build_scan_response(result)


@router.get("/scan/summary", response_model=ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse)
def get_last_threat_intel_scan_summary() -> ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse:
    result = _STATE.last_scan_result
    if result is None:
        return ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse(
            checked_at="",
            match_count=0,
            highest_severity="low",
            severity_counts={},
        )

    summary = summarize_threat_scan_result(result)
    return ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse(
        checked_at=summary["checked_at"],
        match_count=summary["match_count"],
        highest_severity=summary["highest_severity"],
        severity_counts=summary["severity_counts"],
    )

FILE: app\api\ui\health_snapshot.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.services.integrationtelemetry import get_integration_telemetry_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/health-snapshot", tags=["ui-health-snapshot"])


@router.get("")
def read_health_snapshot() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    telemetry_service = get_integration_telemetry_service()

    integrations = registry.list_integrations()
    events = telemetry_service.list_events()

    healthy_statuses = {"available", "configured", "ready"}

    total_integrations = len(integrations)
    healthy_integrations = sum(
        1 for integration in integrations if integration.status in healthy_statuses
    )
    degraded_integrations = total_integrations - healthy_integrations
    total_events = len(events)
    warning_events = sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "warning")

    score = 100
    score -= degraded_integrations * 10
    score -= warning_events * 2
    score = max(score, 0)

    return {
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "environment": "local",
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "health_score": score,
        "status": (
            "healthy" if degraded_integrations == 0 and warning_events == 0 else "degraded"
        ),
        "totals": {
            "integrations": total_integrations,
            "healthy_integrations": healthy_integrations,
            "degraded_integrations": degraded_integrations,
            "events": total_events,
            "warning_events": warning_events,
        },
        "highlights": [
            {
                "label": "Registered integrations",
                "value": total_integrations,
            },
            {
                "label": "Healthy integrations",
                "value": healthy_integrations,
            },
            {
                "label": "Warning telemetry events",
                "value": warning_events,
            },
        ],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

from app.api.integrations import _record_slug
from app.services.integrationrollout import get_integration_rollout_service
from app.services.integrationstatemachine import get_integration_state_machine
from app.services.integrationtelemetry import get_integration_telemetry_service
from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.ui.uiintegrations import get_ui_integrations_page


router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/integrations", tags=["ui-integrations"])


@router.get("")
def read_ui_integrations() -> dict[str, object]:
    return get_ui_integrations_page()


@router.get("/{integration_id}")
def read_ui_integration_detail(integration_id: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    record = registry.get_integration(integration_id)

    if record is None:
        normalized_id = integration_id.strip().lower()
        for item in registry.list_integrations():
            if _record_slug(item) == normalized_id:
                record = item
                break

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    slug = _record_slug(record)
    rollout_service = get_integration_rollout_service()
    telemetry_service = get_integration_telemetry_service()
    state_machine = get_integration_state_machine()

    rollout = rollout_service.plan_rollout(record.integrationid)
    telemetry = telemetry_service.list_events(record.integrationid)
    allowed_targets = state_machine.allowed_targets(record.integrationid) or []

    return {
        "pageid": "ui-integration-detail",
        "title": record.displayname,
        "section": "platform",
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "IronClaw-Security",
        "integration": {
            "integration_id": record.integrationid,
            "slug": slug,
            "platform": slug,
            "display_name": record.displayname,
            "status": record.status,
            "description": record.description,
            "version": record.version,
            "adapter_module": record.adaptermodule,
            "settings_route": record.settingsroute,
            "verification_route": record.verificationroute,
            "manifest_route": record.manifestroute,
            "tags": list(record.tags),
            "metadata": dict(record.metadata),
            "capabilities": [
                {
                    "name": capability.name,
                    "enabled": capability.enabled,
                    "maturity": capability.maturity,
                    "notes": capability.notes,
                }
                for capability in record.capabilities
            ],
        },
        "rollout": (
            {
                "stage": rollout.stage,
                "ready": rollout.ready,
                "updated_at": rollout.updatedat,
                "summary": rollout.summary,
                "steps": [
                    {
                        "step_id": step.stepid,
                        "label": step.label,
                        "completed": step.completed,
                        "detail": step.detail,
                    }
                    for step in rollout.steps
                ],
            }
            if rollout is not None
            else None
        ),
        "allowed_state_targets": allowed_targets,
        "telemetry": [
            {
                "event_id": event.eventid,
                "event_type": event.eventtype,
                "level": event.level,
                "message": event.message,
                "created_at": event.createdat,
                "metadata": dict(event.metadata),
            }
            for event in telemetry
        ],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.services.integrationtelemetry import get_integration_telemetry_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/runtime-status", tags=["ui-runtime-status"])


@router.get("")
def read_runtime_status() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    telemetry_service = get_integration_telemetry_service()

    integrations = registry.list_integrations()
    events = telemetry_service.list_events()

    healthy_statuses = {"available", "configured", "ready"}
    degraded_statuses = {"degraded", "disabled"}

    latest_event_at = max((event.createdat for event in events), default=None)

    return {
        "environment": "local",
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "status": (
            "healthy"
            if all(item.status in healthy_statuses for item in integrations)
            else "degraded"
        ),
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "latest_event_at": latest_event_at,
        "integration_summary": {
            "total": len(integrations),
            "healthy": sum(1 for item in integrations if item.status in healthy_statuses),
            "degraded": sum(1 for item in integrations if item.status in degraded_statuses),
            "other": sum(
                1
                for item in integrations
                if item.status not in healthy_statuses
                and item.status not in degraded_statuses
            ),
        },
        "telemetry_summary": {
            "total_events": len(events),
            "info_events": sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "info"),
            "warning_events": sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "warning"),
        },
        "items": [
            {
                "integration_id": item.integrationid,
                "platform": item.platform,
                "display_name": item.displayname,
                "status": item.status,
                "status_tone": (
                    "healthy" if item.status in healthy_statuses else "warning"
                ),
                "settings_route": item.settingsroute,
                "verification_route": item.verificationroute,
            }
            for item in integrations
        ],
    }

================================================================================
FILE: app\api\ui\telemetry_access_summary.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.services.integrationtelemetry import get_integration_telemetry_service


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/telemetry-access-summary",
    tags=["ui-telemetry-access-summary"],
)


@router.get("")
def read_telemetry_access_summary() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    telemetry_service = get_integration_telemetry_service()

    integrations = registry.list_integrations()
    events = telemetry_service.list_events()

    healthy_statuses = {"available", "configured", "ready"}

    integration_summaries = []
    for integration in integrations:
        integration_events = [
            event for event in events if event.integrationid == integration.integrationid
        ]
        integration_summaries.append(
            {
                "integration_id": integration.integrationid,
                "platform": integration.platform,
                "display_name": integration.displayname,
                "status": integration.status,
                "status_tone": (
                    "healthy" if integration.status in healthy_statuses else "warning"
                ),
                "event_count": len(integration_events),
                "latest_event_at": (
                    max((event.createdat for event in integration_events), default=None)
                ),
            }
        )

    info_events = sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "info")
    warning_events = sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "warning")

    return {
        "total_integrations": len(integrations),
        "healthy_integrations": sum(
            1 for integration in integrations if integration.status in healthy_statuses
        ),
        "warning_integrations": sum(
            1 for integration in integrations if integration.status not in healthy_statuses
        ),
        "total_events": len(events),
        "info_events": info_events,
        "warning_events": warning_events,
        "items": integration_summaries,
    }

    requested_by: str = Query("ui-incident-triage", min_length=1),
) -> IncidentTriageResponse:
    items = _build_incident_items()
    open_count = sum(1 for item in items if item.status == "open")

        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        requested_by=requested_by,
        total=len(items),
        open_count=open_count,
        acknowledged_count=acknowledged_count,
        resolved_count=resolved_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

FILE: app\api\ui_manifest.py

from __future__ import annotations


from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


from app.ui.router import get_ui_routers



router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui-manifest", tags=["ui-manifest"])



class UIManifestRoute(BaseModel):
    prefix: str
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    slug: str
    label: str
    category: str
    enabled: bool = True
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class UIManifestResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_routes: int
    routes: list[UIManifestRoute] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _slug_from_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(prefix or "").strip("/")
    return normalized.replace("/", "-") or "root"



def _label_from_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(prefix or "").strip("/")
    if not normalized:
        return "Root"
    parts = [part.replace("-", " ").strip() for part in normalized.split("/") if part.strip()]
    return " / ".join(part.title() for part in parts)



def _category_from_tags(tags: list[str]) -> str:
    if not tags:
        return "general"


    tag = tags[0].strip().lower()


    if tag in {
        "execution-dashboard",
        "execution-detail",
        "execution-explorer",
        "execution-test-console",
    }:
        return "executions"


    if tag in {"review-queue", "review-detail"}:
        return "reviews"


    if tag in {"policy-insights", "request-context"}:
        return "policy"


    if tag in {"client-session-activity", "client-profile", "session-timeline"}:
        return "activity"


    if tag in {"runtime-status", "system-diagnostics", "alerts-notifications", "incident-triage"}:
        return "operations"


    if tag in {"operator-management", "access-control-roles", "settings-configuration"}:
        return "administration"


    if tag in {"integration-settings"}:
        return "integrations"


    if tag in {"audit-log", "data-retention"}:
        return "governance"


    if tag in {"customer-keys", "customer-key-detail", "usage-reports", "usage-event-detail"}:
        return "customer-access"


    if tag in {"ui-manifest"}:
        return "platform"


    if tag.startswith("groq"):
        return "groq"


    if tag.startswith("billing"):
        return "billing"


    return "general"



def _route_metadata(prefix: str, tags: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    slug = _slug_from_prefix(prefix)


    return {
        "slug": slug,
        "label": _label_from_prefix(prefix),
        "category": _category_from_tags(tags),
        "has_detail_view": any(token in slug for token in ("detail", "profile", "timeline")),
    }



@router.get("", response_model=UIManifestResponse)
def read_ui_manifest() -> UIManifestResponse:
    ui_routers = get_ui_routers()


    routes = []
    for ui_router in ui_routers:
        prefix = str(ui_router.prefix or "")
        tags = [str(tag) for tag in (ui_router.tags or [])]
        metadata = _route_metadata(prefix, tags)


        routes.append(
            UIManifestRoute(
                prefix=prefix,
                tags=tags,
                slug=str(metadata["slug"]),
                label=str(metadata["label"]),
                category=str(metadata["category"]),
                enabled=True,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )


    routes = sorted(routes, key=lambda route: route.prefix)


    categories = sorted({route.category for route in routes})
    tags_index = sorted({tag for route in routes for tag in route.tags})


    return UIManifestResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_routes=len(routes),
        routes=routes,
        metadata={
            "ui_router_registry": "app.ui.router",
            "sorted_by": "prefix",
            "categories": categories,
            "tags_index": tags_index,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui",
    tags=["request-stream"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class RequestStreamItemView(BaseModel):
    request_id: str
    timestamp: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    route: str
    method: str
    status: str
    risk_level: str
    action_type: str | None = None
    verdict: str | None = None
    summary: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class RequestStreamResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    requested_by: str
    total: int
    items: list[RequestStreamItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

@router.get("/request-stream", response_model=RequestStreamResponse)
def get_request_stream(
    requested_by: str = Query("ui-request-stream", min_length=1),
    limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500),
) -> RequestStreamResponse:

def include_ui_routers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    app.include_router(ui_integrations_router)
    app.include_router(ui_execution_test_console_router)
    app.include_router(ui_runtime_status_router)
    app.include_router(ui_audit_log_router)
    app.include_router(ui_system_diagnostics_router)
    app.include_router(ui_data_retention_router)
    app.include_router(ui_incident_triage_router)
    app.include_router(ui_admin_operators_router)
    app.include_router(ui_admin_roles_router)
    app.include_router(ui_request_stream_router)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui",
    tags=["runtime-status"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class RuntimeDependencyView(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class RuntimeStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    environment: str
    runtime_state: str
    request_guard_enabled: bool
    protected_docs_enabled: bool
    telemetry_enabled: bool
    dependencies: list[RuntimeDependencyView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _build_dependencies() -> list[RuntimeDependencyView]:
    return [
        RuntimeDependencyView(
            name="api-key-auth",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Protected API key dependency is active for guarded routes.",
            metadata={"scope": "request-ingress"},
        ),
        RuntimeDependencyView(
            name="runtime-boundary",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Guarded execution boundary is available for protected actions.",
            metadata={"scope": "execution"},
        ),
        RuntimeDependencyView(
            name="telemetry-pipeline",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Telemetry summary and event collection are enabled for UI monitoring.",
            metadata={"scope": "telemetry"},
        ),
        RuntimeDependencyView(
            name="protected-docs",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Protected OpenAPI and docs endpoints are enabled behind authentication.",
            metadata={"scope": "documentation"},
        ),
    ]


@router.get("/runtime-status", response_model=RuntimeStatusResponse)
def get_runtime_status(
    requested_by: str = Query("ui-runtime-status", min_length=1),
) -> RuntimeStatusResponse:
    dependencies = _build_dependencies()

    return RuntimeStatusResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        environment="local",
        runtime_state="healthy",
        request_guard_enabled=True,
        protected_docs_enabled=True,
        telemetry_enabled=True,
        dependencies=dependencies,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
            "dependency_count": len(dependencies),
        },
    )

FILE: app\api\ui_status.py

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.review_queue_service import get_review_queue_summary
from app.services.telemetry import (
    append_telemetry_event,
    read_telemetry_events,
    summarize_telemetry_events,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui-status", tags=["ui-status"])


class UIStatusCounts(BaseModel):
    pending_reviews: int = 0
    critical_reviews: int = 0
    total_reviews: int = 0
    recent_telemetry_events: int = 0


class UIStatusFlags(BaseModel):
    has_pending_reviews: bool
    has_critical_reviews: bool
    telemetry_available: bool
    system_degraded: bool


class UIStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    counts: UIStatusCounts
    flags: UIStatusFlags
    review_summary: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _safe_append_telemetry_event(event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(event_name, payload)
    except Exception:
        pass


@router.get("", response_model=UIStatusResponse)
def read_ui_status() -> UIStatusResponse:
    review_summary: dict[str, Any]
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any]
    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]]

    review_error = False
    telemetry_error = False

    try:
        review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()
    except Exception as exc:
        review_error = True
        review_summary = {
            "status": "degraded",
            "error": str(exc),
            "pending_items": 0,
            "critical_items": 0,
            "total_items": 0,
        }

    try:
        telemetry_summary = summarize_telemetry_events(limit=250)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_error = True
        telemetry_summary = {
            "status": "degraded",
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    try:
        recent_events = read_telemetry_events(limit=20)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_error = True
        recent_events = [
            {
                "type": "telemetry_read_error",
                "error": str(exc),
            }
        ]

    pending_reviews = int(review_summary.get("pending_items") or 0)
    critical_reviews = int(review_summary.get("critical_items") or 0)
    total_reviews = int(review_summary.get("total_items") or 0)
    recent_telemetry_events = len(recent_events)

    system_degraded = review_error or telemetry_error
    telemetry_available = not telemetry_error

    result = UIStatusResponse(
        status="degraded" if system_degraded else "ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        counts=UIStatusCounts(
            pending_reviews=pending_reviews,
            critical_reviews=critical_reviews,
            total_reviews=total_reviews,
            recent_telemetry_events=recent_telemetry_events,
        ),
        flags=UIStatusFlags(
            has_pending_reviews=pending_reviews > 0,
            has_critical_reviews=critical_reviews > 0,
            telemetry_available=telemetry_available,
            system_degraded=system_degraded,
        ),
        review_summary=review_summary,
        telemetry_summary=telemetry_summary,
        recent_events=recent_events,
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "ui_status_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "pending_reviews": pending_reviews,
            "critical_reviews": critical_reviews,
            "total_reviews": total_reviews,
            "recent_telemetry_events": recent_telemetry_events,
            "telemetry_available": telemetry_available,
            "system_degraded": system_degraded,
        },
    )

    return result

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui",
    tags=["system-diagnostics"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class DiagnosticCheckView(BaseModel):
    check_id: str
    name: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    severity: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class SystemDiagnosticsResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    requested_by: str
    overall_status: str
    healthy_count: int
    warning_count: int
    error_count: int
    checks: list[DiagnosticCheckView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _build_checks() -> list[DiagnosticCheckView]:
    return [
        DiagnosticCheckView(
            check_id="runtime-boundary",
            name="Runtime boundary",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Execution boundary is available and enforcing protected actions.",
            severity="low",
            metadata={"component": "guard-runtime"},
        ),
        DiagnosticCheckView(
            check_id="api-auth",
            name="API auth",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Protected UI and operational routes require API key authentication.",
            severity="low",
            metadata={"component": "auth"},
        ),
        DiagnosticCheckView(
            check_id="telemetry-pipeline",
            name="Telemetry pipeline",
            status="healthy",
            detail="Telemetry summary and event endpoints are producing data for dashboards.",
            severity="low",
            metadata={"component": "telemetry"},
        ),
        DiagnosticCheckView(
            check_id="review-queue",
            name="Review queue",
            status="warning",
            detail="Manual review queue has pending items that may require operator attention.",
            severity="medium",
            metadata={"component": "review-queue"},
        ),
    ]


@router.get("/system-diagnostics", response_model=SystemDiagnosticsResponse)
def get_system_diagnostics(
    requested_by: str = Query("ui-system-diagnostics", min_length=1),
) -> SystemDiagnosticsResponse:
    checks = _build_checks()
    healthy_count = sum(1 for check in checks if check.status == "healthy")
    warning_count = sum(1 for check in checks if check.status == "warning")
    error_count = sum(1 for check in checks if check.status == "error")

    overall_status = "healthy"
    if error_count > 0:
        overall_status = "error"
    elif warning_count > 0:
        overall_status = "warning"

    return SystemDiagnosticsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        requested_by=requested_by,
        overall_status=overall_status,
        healthy_count=healthy_count,
        warning_count=warning_count,
        error_count=error_count,
        checks=checks,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
            "check_count": len(checks),
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(tags=["data-retention"])


class DataRetentionPolicyItem(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    domain: str = Field(min_length=1)
    retention_days: int = Field(ge=0)
    storage_class: Literal["standard", "hot", "protected", "archive"]
    status: Literal["active", "review_required"]


class DataRetentionSummary(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    total_policies: int = Field(ge=0)
    active: int = Field(ge=0)
    review_required: int = Field(ge=0)


class DataRetentionResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    title: str
    status: Literal["ok"]
    summary: DataRetentionSummary
    policies: list[DataRetentionPolicyItem]
    request_id: str | None = None


_POLICIES: tuple[DataRetentionPolicyItem, ...] = (
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="audit_logs",
        retention_days=365,
        storage_class="standard",
        status="active",
    ),
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="request_stream",
        retention_days=30,
        storage_class="hot",
        status="active",
    ),
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="detonation_artifacts",
        retention_days=90,
        storage_class="protected",
        status="active",
    ),
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="telemetry_rollups",
        retention_days=180,
        storage_class="archive",
        status="active",
    ),
)


@router.get(
    "/admin/data-retention",
    response_model=DataRetentionResponse,
    summary="Get Data Retention",
)
def get_data_retention_settings(
    request: Request,
    _: str | None = Depends(require_api_key),
) -> DataRetentionResponse:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)

    policies = list(_POLICIES)
    summary = DataRetentionSummary(
        total_policies=len(policies),
        active=sum(1 for policy in policies if policy.status == "active"),
        review_required=sum(
            1 for policy in policies if policy.status == "review_required"
        ),
    )

    return DataRetentionResponse(
        title="Data Retention",
        status="ok",
        summary=summary,
        policies=policies,
        request_id=request_id,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from app.auth import require_operator
from app.ui.runtimestatus import get_runtime_status_page


router = APIRouter(tags=["runtime-status"])


class RuntimeExecutorStatus(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    executorname: str = Field(default="")
    fallbackexecutorname: str = Field(default="")
    defaultmode: str = Field(default="")
    sandboxrequired: bool = Field(default=False)


class RuntimeMetricsStatus(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    totalrequests: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    allowcount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    reviewcount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    blockedcount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    quarantinecount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    latesteventat: str | None = Field(default=None)


class RuntimePolicyStatus(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    policymode: Literal["dryrun", "enforce", "lockdown"] = Field(default="dryrun")
    defaultaction: Literal["allow", "review", "block"] = Field(default="review")


class RuntimeStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    pageid: str
    title: str
    path: str
    summary: str
    generatedat: str
    runtimeavailable: bool
    boundaryactive: bool
    reviewqueueenabled: bool
    executor: RuntimeExecutorStatus
    metrics: RuntimeMetricsStatus
    policy: RuntimePolicyStatus
    defaultfilepath: str
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


@router.get(
    "/ui/runtime/status",
    response_model=RuntimeStatusResponse,
    summary="Get Runtime Status",
    dependencies=[Depends(require_operator)],
)
def runtime_status_page() -> RuntimeStatusResponse:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = get_runtime_status_page()

    metrics: Dict[str, Any] = dict(payload.get("metrics", {}))
    if "totalrequests" not in metrics:
        metrics["totalrequests"] = int(metrics.get("totalevents", 0) or 0)
    metrics.pop("totalevents", None)

    if not metrics.get("latesteventat"):
        metrics["latesteventat"] = None

    payload["metrics"] = metrics

    if "policy" not in payload or not isinstance(payload["policy"], dict):
        payload["policy"] = {
            "policymode": "dryrun",
            "defaultaction": "review",
        }

    return RuntimeStatusResponse.model_validate(payload)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Final

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request

from app.core.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(tags=["system-diagnostics"])

_DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKS: Final[tuple[dict[str, str], ...]] = (
    {
        "check_id": "api-health",
        "label": "API Health",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Core API routes responding within expected thresholds.",
    },
    {
        "check_id": "runtime-guard",
        "label": "Runtime Guard",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Guard pipeline loaded and enforcing protected execution boundaries.",
    },
    {
        "check_id": "review-queue",
        "label": "Review Queue",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Human review queue available for operator escalation workflows.",
    },
    {
        "check_id": "telemetry-pipeline",
        "label": "Telemetry Pipeline",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Telemetry ingestion and usage events are available for operator review.",
    },
)


def _build_checks() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    return [dict(check) for check in _DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKS]


def _build_summary(checks: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, int]:
    return {
        "total": len(checks),
        "ok": sum(1 for check in checks if check["status"] == "ok"),
        "warn": sum(1 for check in checks if check["status"] == "warn"),
        "error": sum(1 for check in checks if check["status"] == "error"),
    }


def _overall_status(summary: dict[str, int]) -> str:
    if summary["error"] > 0:
        return "error"
    if summary["warn"] > 0:
        return "warn"
    return "ok"


@router.get("/admin/system-diagnostics")
def get_system_diagnostics(
    request: Request,
    _: str | None = Depends(require_api_key),
) -> dict[str, object]:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    checks = _build_checks()
    summary = _build_summary(checks)

    return {
        "title": "System Diagnostics",
        "status": _overall_status(summary),
        "summary": summary,
        "checks": checks,
        "request_id": request_id,
    }

from __future__ import annotations


from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.core.usage_metering import UsageEvent, UsageSummary, get_usage_metering_registry



router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/usage-reports",
    tags=["usage-reports"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)



class UsageRouteCount(BaseModel):
    route: str
    requests: int



class UsageSummaryView(BaseModel):
    api_key_id: str
    total_requests: int
    total_units: int
    last_seen_at: str | None = None
    routes: list[UsageRouteCount] = Field(default_factory=list)



class UsageEventView(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    api_key_id: str
    route: str
    method: str
    status_code: int
    units: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class UsageSummaryListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_keys: int
    summaries: list[UsageSummaryView] = Field(default_factory=list)



class UsageEventListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_events: int
    events: list[UsageEventView] = Field(default_factory=list)



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _to_iso(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _summary_to_view(summary: UsageSummary) -> UsageSummaryView:
    routes = [
        UsageRouteCount(route=route, requests=requests)
        for route, requests in sorted(
            summary.routes.items(),
            key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
        )
    ]
    return UsageSummaryView(
        api_key_id=summary.api_key_id,
        total_requests=summary.total_requests,
        total_units=summary.total_units,
        last_seen_at=_to_iso(summary.last_seen_at),
        routes=routes,
    )



def _event_to_view(event: UsageEvent) -> UsageEventView:
    return UsageEventView(
        timestamp=_to_iso(event.timestamp) or _utc_now_iso(),
        api_key_id=event.api_key_id,
        route=event.route,
        method=event.method,
        status_code=event.status_code,
        units=event.units,
        metadata=event.metadata or {},
    )



@router.get("", response_model=UsageSummaryListResponse)
def list_usage_summaries() -> UsageSummaryListResponse:
    registry = get_usage_metering_registry()
    summaries = registry.list_summaries()
    summaries = sorted(
        summaries,
        key=lambda summary: (-summary.total_units, -summary.total_requests, summary.api_key_id),
    )


    return UsageSummaryListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_keys=len(summaries),
        summaries=[_summary_to_view(summary) for summary in summaries],
    )



@router.get("/events", response_model=UsageEventListResponse)
def list_usage_events(
    limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200),
) -> UsageEventListResponse:
    registry = get_usage_metering_registry()
    events = registry.recent_events(limit=limit)


    return UsageEventListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_events=len(events),
        events=[_event_to_view(event) for event in reversed(events)],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditExplorerFacet:
    key: str
    label: str
    count: int

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "label": self.label,
            "count": self.count,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditExplorerRecord:
    event_id: str
    timestamp: datetime
    event_type: str
    severity: str
    result: str
    actor: str
    resource: str
    summary: str
    request_id: str = ""
    trace_id: str = ""
    org_id: str = ""
    review_state: str = "none"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "timestamp": _isoformat(self.timestamp),
            "event_type": self.event_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "result": self.result,
            "actor": self.actor,
            "resource": self.resource,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "trace_id": self.trace_id,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "review_state": self.review_state,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditExplorer:
    query: str = ""
    total_results: int = 0
    returned_results: int = 0
    page: int = 1
    page_size: int = 25
    has_more: bool = False
    severity_facets: tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...] = ()
    result_facets: tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...] = ()
    event_type_facets: tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...] = ()
    records: tuple[AuditExplorerRecord, ...] = ()
    generated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "query": self.query,
            "total_results": self.total_results,
            "returned_results": self.returned_results,
            "page": self.page,
            "page_size": self.page_size,
            "has_more": self.has_more,
            "severity_facets": [item.to_dict() for item in self.severity_facets],
            "result_facets": [item.to_dict() for item in self.result_facets],
            "event_type_facets": [item.to_dict() for item in self.event_type_facets],
            "records": [item.to_dict() for item in self.records],
            "generated_at": _isoformat(self.generated_at),
        }


def _normalize_facet(value: Any) -> AuditExplorerFacet | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    key = _coerce_str(value.get("key"))
    label = _coerce_str(value.get("label"), key)
    if not key and not label:
        return None

    return AuditExplorerFacet(
        key=key or label.lower().replace(" ", "_"),
        label=label or key,
        count=max(0, _coerce_int(value.get("count"), 0)),
    )


def _normalize_record(value: Any) -> AuditExplorerRecord | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    event_id = _coerce_str(value.get("event_id"))
    event_type = _coerce_str(value.get("event_type"))
    summary = _coerce_str(value.get("summary") or value.get("message"))
    if not any([event_id, event_type, summary]):
        return None

    actor_value = value.get("actor")
    if isinstance(actor_value, dict):
        actor = _coerce_str(actor_value.get("display_name") or actor_value.get("actor_id") or actor_value.get("actor_type"), "System")
    else:
        actor = _coerce_str(actor_value, "System") or "System"

    return AuditExplorerRecord(
        event_id=event_id or "audit-event",
        timestamp=_coerce_datetime(value.get("timestamp") or value.get("created_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        event_type=event_type or "audit.event",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "info") or "info",
        result=_coerce_str(value.get("result"), "success") or "success",
        actor=actor,
        resource=_coerce_str(value.get("resource"), "system") or "system",
        summary=summary or "Audit explorer event recorded.",
        request_id=_coerce_str(value.get("request_id")),
        trace_id=_coerce_str(value.get("trace_id")),
        org_id=_coerce_str(value.get("org_id")),
        review_state=_coerce_str(value.get("review_state"), "none") or "none",
    )


def _normalize_facet_list(values: Any) -> tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...]:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return ()
    return tuple(item for value in values if (item := _normalize_facet(value)) is not None)


def _normalize_record_list(values: Any) -> tuple[AuditExplorerRecord, ...]:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return ()
    return tuple(item for value in values if (item := _normalize_record(value)) is not None)


def default_audit_explorer() -> AuditExplorer:
    return AuditExplorer()


def build_audit_explorer(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: AuditExplorer | None = None,
) -> AuditExplorer:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_audit_explorer()

    records = _normalize_record_list(source.get("records")) or current.records
    page = max(1, _coerce_int(source.get("page"), current.page))
    page_size = max(1, _coerce_int(source.get("page_size"), current.page_size))
    returned_results = _coerce_int(source.get("returned_results"), len(records))
    total_results = _coerce_int(source.get("total_results"), returned_results)

    if total_results < returned_results:
        total_results = returned_results

    return AuditExplorer(
        query=_coerce_str(source.get("query"), current.query),
        total_results=total_results,
        returned_results=max(0, returned_results),
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        has_more=_coerce_bool(source.get("has_more"), total_results > page * page_size),
        severity_facets=_normalize_facet_list(source.get("severity_facets")) or current.severity_facets,
        result_facets=_normalize_facet_list(source.get("result_facets")) or current.result_facets,
        event_type_facets=_normalize_facet_list(source.get("event_type_facets")) or current.event_type_facets,
        records=records,
        generated_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("generated_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def audit_explorer_summary(explorer: AuditExplorer) -> dict[str, Any]:
    critical_results = sum(1 for record in explorer.records if record.severity.lower() == "critical")
    review_queue_results = sum(1 for record in explorer.records if record.review_state.lower() not in {"", "none", "closed", "resolved"})

    return {
        "query": explorer.query,
        "pagination": {
            "page": explorer.page,
            "page_size": explorer.page_size,
            "returned_results": explorer.returned_results,
            "total_results": explorer.total_results,
            "has_more": explorer.has_more,
        },
        "facets": {
            "severity": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.severity_facets],
            "result": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.result_facets],
            "event_type": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.event_type_facets],
        },
        "records": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.records],
        "signals": {
            "critical_results": critical_results,
            "review_queue_results": review_queue_results,
        },
        "generated_at": _isoformat(explorer.generated_at),
    }

def _normalize_actor(value: Any) -> AuditActor:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return AuditActor(actor_id="", actor_type="system", display_name="System")

    return AuditActor(
        actor_id=_coerce_str(value.get("actor_id")),
        actor_type=_coerce_str(value.get("actor_type"), "system") or "system",
        display_name=_coerce_str(value.get("display_name"), "System") or "System",
    )


def _normalize_event(value: Any) -> AuditEvent | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    event_id = _coerce_str(value.get("event_id"))
    event_type = _coerce_str(value.get("event_type"))
    if not event_id and not event_type:
        return None

    return AuditEvent(
        event_id=event_id or "audit-event",
        event_type=event_type or "audit.event",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "info") or "info",
        action=_coerce_str(value.get("action"), "observe") or "observe",
        result=_coerce_str(value.get("result"), "success") or "success",
        resource=_coerce_str(value.get("resource"), "system") or "system",
        message=_coerce_str(value.get("message"), "Audit event recorded.") or "Audit event recorded.",
        actor=_normalize_actor(value.get("actor")),
        created_at=_coerce_datetime(value.get("created_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        request_id=_coerce_str(value.get("request_id")),
        org_id=_coerce_str(value.get("org_id")),
        trace_id=_coerce_str(value.get("trace_id")),
        requires_review=_coerce_bool(value.get("requires_review"), False),
    )


def default_audit_log() -> AuditLog:
    return AuditLog()


def build_audit_log(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: AuditLog | None = None,
) -> AuditLog:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_audit_log()

    raw_events = source.get("events")
    if isinstance(raw_events, list):
        events = tuple(item for entry in raw_events if (item := _normalize_event(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        events = current.events

    total_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("total_events"), current.total_events or len(events)))
    critical_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("critical_events"), current.critical_events))
    warning_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("warning_events"), current.warning_events))
    review_required_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("review_required_events"), current.review_required_events))

    if not source.get("total_events") and events:
        total_events = len(events)
    if not source.get("critical_events") and events:
        critical_events = sum(1 for item in events if item.severity.lower() == "critical")
    if not source.get("warning_events") and events:
        warning_events = sum(1 for item in events if item.severity.lower() in {"warning", "warn"})
    if not source.get("review_required_events") and events:
        review_required_events = sum(1 for item in events if item.requires_review)

    return AuditLog(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        total_events=total_events,
        critical_events=critical_events,
        warning_events=warning_events,
        review_required_events=review_required_events,
        events=events,
        checked_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def audit_log_summary(log: AuditLog) -> dict[str, Any]:
    denied_events = sum(1 for item in log.events if item.result.lower() in {"denied", "blocked", "quarantined"})
    human_actor_events = sum(1 for item in log.events if item.actor.actor_type.lower() in {"human", "operator", "analyst"})

    return {
        "service": log.service,
        "environment": log.environment,
        "counts": {
            "total_events": log.total_events,
            "critical_events": log.critical_events,
            "warning_events": log.warning_events,
            "review_required_events": log.review_required_events,
            "denied_events": denied_events,
            "human_actor_events": human_actor_events,
        },
        "events": [item.to_dict() for item in log.events],
        "checked_at": _isoformat(log.checked_at),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from time import perf_counter
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

from app.core.settings import get_settings


class InMemoryHistoryService:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def append_scan_result(self, result: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._items.append(dict(result))

    def list_results(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list(self._items)

    def get_result(self, scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        for item in self._items:
            if item.get("scan_id") == scan_id:
                return dict(item)
        return None


class DefaultScannerService:
    def perform_scan(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


class DefaultGuardService:
    def evaluate(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


class DefaultActionPolicyService:
    def evaluate(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


class DefaultActionDecisionService:
    def evaluate(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


def configure_app_state(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "settings"):
        app.state.settings = settings

    if not hasattr(app.state, "scanner_service"):
        app.state.scanner_service = DefaultScannerService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "history_service"):
        app.state.history_service = InMemoryHistoryService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "guard_service"):
        app.state.guard_service = DefaultGuardService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "action_policy_service"):
        app.state.action_policy_service = DefaultActionPolicyService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "action_decision_service"):
        app.state.action_decision_service = DefaultActionDecisionService()

    return app


def add_request_tracing_middleware(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    if getattr(app.state, "_request_tracing_middleware_installed", False):
        return app

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def add_request_tracing(request: Request, call_next):
        request_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-ID") or str(uuid4())
        trace_id = request.headers.get("X-Trace-ID") or request_id
        started_at = perf_counter()

        request.state.request_id = request_id
        request.state.trace_id = trace_id
        request.state.request_started_at = started_at

        response = await call_next(request)

        duration_ms = max(0, int((perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000))

        response.headers.setdefault("X-Request-ID", request_id)
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Trace-ID", trace_id)
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Response-Time-Ms", str(duration_ms))

        return response

    app.state._request_tracing_middleware_installed = True
    return app


def add_security_middleware(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    if getattr(app.state, "_security_middleware_installed", False):
        return app

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def add_security_headers(request: Request, call_next):
        response = await call_next(request)
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        response.headers.setdefault("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin")
        response.headers.setdefault("X-XSS-Protection", "1; mode=block")
        response.headers.setdefault("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()")
        response.headers.setdefault("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", "same-origin")
        response.headers.setdefault("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin")
        if request.url.scheme == "https":
            response.headers.setdefault(
                "Strict-Transport-Security",
                "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains",
            )
        return response

    app.state._security_middleware_installed = True
    return app


def bootstrap_app(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    """
    Entry point to configure global app state and middleware.
    Call this once, right after creating the FastAPI() instance.
    """
    app = configure_app_state(app)
    app = add_request_tracing_middleware(app)
    app = add_security_middleware(app)
    return app

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_installer import (
    IntegrationInstallResult,
    install_integration,
    summarize_install_result,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    initialize_integration_registry,
)


def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def build_install_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw install",
        description="Install an IronClaw integration.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    parser.add_argument("--install-target", default=None)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )
    return parser


def run_install_command(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    requested_by: str | None = "cli",
    install_target: str | None = None,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
    compact: bool = False,
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    result: IntegrationInstallResult = install_integration(
        active_registry,
        integration_id,
        dry_run=dry_run,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        install_target=install_target,
    )
    summary = summarize_install_result(result)
    payload = {
        "command": "install",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not compact)
    exit_code = 0 if summary.get("installed", False) or dry_run else 1
    return exit_code, payload


def handle_install_args(
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> int:
    exit_code, _ = run_install_command(
        args.integration_id,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        install_target=args.install_target,
        registry=registry,
        compact=args.compact,
    )
    return exit_code


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_install_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return handle_install_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_installer import (
    IntegrationInstallResult,
    install_integration,
    summarize_install_result,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    initialize_integration_registry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


def _serialize_items(items: list[Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    serialized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in items:
        if hasattr(item, "to_dict"):
            serialized.append(item.to_dict())
        elif isinstance(item, dict):
            serialized.append(dict(item))
        else:
            serialized.append(vars(item))
    return serialized


def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def _build_registry() -> IntegrationRegistry:
    return initialize_integration_registry()


def _add_common_output_arguments(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit machine-readable JSON output.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw",
        description="IronClaw integration management CLI.",
    )
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    list_parser = subparsers.add_parser("list", help="List available integrations.")
    list_parser.add_argument("--status", default=None)
    list_parser.add_argument("--platform", default=None)
    _add_common_output_arguments(list_parser)
    list_parser.set_defaults(handler=_handle_list)

    install_parser = subparsers.add_parser("install", help="Install an integration.")
    install_parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    install_parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    install_parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    install_parser.add_argument("--install-target", default=None)
    _add_common_output_arguments(install_parser)
    install_parser.set_defaults(handler=_handle_install)

    verify_parser = subparsers.add_parser("verify", help="Verify an integration.")
    verify_parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    verify_parser.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true")
    verify_parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    _add_common_output_arguments(verify_parser)
    verify_parser.set_defaults(handler=_handle_verify)

    return parser


def _handle_list(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> int:
    items = list_integrations(
        registry,
        status=args.status,
        platform=args.platform,
    )
    payload = {
        "command": "list",
        "total": len(items),
        "items": _serialize_items(items),
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not args.compact)
    return 0


def _handle_install(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> int:
    result: IntegrationInstallResult = install_integration(
        registry,
        args.integration_id,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        install_target=args.install_target,
    )
    summary = summarize_install_result(result)
    payload = {
        "command": "install",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not args.compact)
    return 0 if summary.get("installed", False) or args.dry_run else 1


def _handle_verify(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> int:
    result = verify_integration(
        registry,
        args.integration_id,
        strict=args.strict,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
    )
    summary = summarize_verification_result(result)
    payload = {
        "command": "verify",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not args.compact)
    return 0


def run_cli(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = _build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    registry = _build_registry()

    handler = getattr(args, "handler", None)
    if handler is None:
        parser.error("unknown command")
        return 2

    try:
        return int(handler(args, registry))
    except KeyError as exc:
        _emit(
            {
                "error": "not_found",
                "detail": str(exc),
                "command": getattr(args, "command", None),
            },
            pretty=not getattr(args, "compact", False),
        )
        return 1
    except ValueError as exc:
        _emit(
            {
                "error": "invalid_request",
                "detail": str(exc),
                "command": getattr(args, "command", None),
            },
            pretty=not getattr(args, "compact", False),
        )
        return 1


def main() -> int:
    return run_cli()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from typing import Any

from app.services.adapter_manifest import (
    build_adapter_manifest,
    summarize_adapter_manifest,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    get_integration,
    initialize_integration_registry,
)
from app.services.policy_bundle_signing import (
    PolicyBundle,
    export_signed_bundle,
    initialize_policy_signing_keys,
    sign_policy_bundle,
)


def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def build_package_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw package",
        description="Build a portable installer/security package for an IronClaw integration.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )
    return parser


def run_package_command(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    requested_by: str | None = "cli",
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
    compact: bool = False,
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    record = get_integration(active_registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    manifest = build_adapter_manifest(
        record,
        extra_metadata={"requested_by": requested_by, "package_operation": "bundle"},
    )
    manifest_summary = summarize_adapter_manifest(manifest)

    keyset = initialize_policy_signing_keys()
    bundle = PolicyBundle(
        bundle_id=f"bundle-{record.slug}",
        version=record.version,
        created_at=manifest.generated_at,
        policies=[
            {
                "type": "adapter_manifest",
                "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                "slug": record.slug,
                "manifest": manifest.to_dict(),
            }
        ],
        metadata={
            "integration_id": record.integration_id,
            "slug": record.slug,
            "platform": record.platform,
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )
    signed_bundle = sign_policy_bundle(bundle, keyset)

    payload = {
        "command": "package",
        "integration_id": record.integration_id,
        "slug": record.slug,
        "platform": record.platform,
        "requested_by": requested_by,
        "manifest": manifest_summary,
        "bundle": {
            "bundle_id": signed_bundle.bundle.bundle_id,
            "version": signed_bundle.bundle.version,
            "key_id": signed_bundle.key_id,
            "algorithm": signed_bundle.algorithm,
            "signed_at": signed_bundle.signed_at,
            "export_json": export_signed_bundle(signed_bundle, format="json"),
            "export_compact": export_signed_bundle(signed_bundle, format="compact"),
        },
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not compact)
    return 0, payload


def handle_package_args(
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> int:
    exit_code, _ = run_package_command(
        args.integration_id,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        registry=registry,
        compact=args.compact,
    )
    return exit_code


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_package_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return handle_package_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
