from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_float(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

            "label": self.label,
            "value": self.value,
            "unit": self.unit,
            "trend_direction": self.trend_direction,
            "trend_value": self.trend_value,

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DashboardOverview:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    status: str = "healthy"
    risk_level: str = "moderate"
    total_requests: int = 0
    guarded_requests: int = 0
    blocked_actions: int = 0
    quarantined_actions: int = 0
    active_incidents: int = 0
    pending_reviews: int = 0
    policy_coverage_percent: float = 0.0
    tool_execution_allow_rate: float = 0.0
    telemetry_online: bool = True
    review_backlog_present: bool = False
    quarantine_pressure: bool = False
    kpis: tuple[DashboardKPI, ...] = ()
    alerts: tuple[DashboardAlert, ...] = ()
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "status": self.status,
            "risk_level": self.risk_level,
            "total_requests": self.total_requests,
            "guarded_requests": self.guarded_requests,
            "blocked_actions": self.blocked_actions,
            "quarantined_actions": self.quarantined_actions,
            "active_incidents": self.active_incidents,
            "pending_reviews": self.pending_reviews,
            "policy_coverage_percent": self.policy_coverage_percent,
            "tool_execution_allow_rate": self.tool_execution_allow_rate,
            "telemetry_online": self.telemetry_online,
            "review_backlog_present": self.review_backlog_present,
            "quarantine_pressure": self.quarantine_pressure,
            "kpis": [item.to_dict() for item in self.kpis],
            "alerts": [item.to_dict() for item in self.alerts],
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def _normalize_kpi(value: Any) -> DashboardKPI | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    key = _coerce_str(value.get("key"))
    label = _coerce_str(value.get("label"))
    if not key and not label:
        return None

    return DashboardKPI(
        key=key or label.lower().replace(" ", "_") or "metric",
        label=label or "Metric",
        value=_coerce_float(value.get("value"), 0.0),
        unit=_coerce_str(value.get("unit")),
        trend_direction=_coerce_str(value.get("trend_direction"), "steady") or "steady",
        trend_value=_coerce_float(value.get("trend_value"), 0.0),
        status=_coerce_str(value.get("status"), "ok") or "ok",
    )


def _normalize_alert(value: Any) -> DashboardAlert | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    alert_id = _coerce_str(value.get("alert_id"))
    title = _coerce_str(value.get("title"))
    if not alert_id and not title:
        return None

    return DashboardAlert(
        alert_id=alert_id or title.lower().replace(" ", "-") or "alert",
        title=title or "Alert",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "medium") or "medium",
        status=_coerce_str(value.get("status"), "open") or "open",
        source=_coerce_str(value.get("source"), "runtime") or "runtime",
        created_at=_coerce_datetime(value.get("created_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        summary=_coerce_str(value.get("summary"), "No alert summary provided.") or "No alert summary provided.",
    )


def default_dashboard_overview() -> DashboardOverview:
    return DashboardOverview()


def build_dashboard_overview(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: DashboardOverview | None = None,
) -> DashboardOverview:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_dashboard_overview()

    raw_kpis = source.get("kpis")
    if isinstance(raw_kpis, list):
        kpis = tuple(item for entry in raw_kpis if (item := _normalize_kpi(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        kpis = current.kpis

    raw_alerts = source.get("alerts")
    if isinstance(raw_alerts, list):
        alerts = tuple(item for entry in raw_alerts if (item := _normalize_alert(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        alerts = current.alerts

    active_incidents = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("active_incidents"), current.active_incidents))
    pending_reviews = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("pending_reviews"), current.pending_reviews))
    quarantined_actions = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("quarantined_actions"), current.quarantined_actions))

    review_backlog_present = _coerce_bool(
        source.get("review_backlog_present"),
        current.review_backlog_present or pending_reviews > 0,
    )
    quarantine_pressure = _coerce_bool(
        source.get("quarantine_pressure"),
        current.quarantine_pressure or quarantined_actions > 0,
    )

    return DashboardOverview(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        status=_coerce_str(source.get("status"), current.status) or current.status,
        risk_level=_coerce_str(source.get("risk_level"), current.risk_level) or current.risk_level,
        total_requests=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("total_requests"), current.total_requests)),
        guarded_requests=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("guarded_requests"), current.guarded_requests)),
        blocked_actions=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("blocked_actions"), current.blocked_actions)),
        quarantined_actions=quarantined_actions,
        active_incidents=active_incidents,
        pending_reviews=pending_reviews,
        policy_coverage_percent=max(0.0, _coerce_float(source.get("policy_coverage_percent"), current.policy_coverage_percent)),
        tool_execution_allow_rate=max(0.0, _coerce_float(source.get("tool_execution_allow_rate"), current.tool_execution_allow_rate)),
        telemetry_online=_coerce_bool(source.get("telemetry_online"), current.telemetry_online),
        review_backlog_present=review_backlog_present,
        quarantine_pressure=quarantine_pressure,
        kpis=kpis,
        alerts=alerts,
        checked_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def dashboard_overview_summary(overview: DashboardOverview) -> dict[str, Any]:
    protection_rate = 0.0
    if overview.total_requests > 0:
        protected_events = overview.blocked_actions + overview.quarantined_actions
        protection_rate = round((protected_events / overview.total_requests) * 100.0, 2)

    return {
        "service": overview.service,
        "environment": overview.environment,
        "status": overview.status,
        "risk_level": overview.risk_level,
        "telemetry_online": overview.telemetry_online,
        "signals": {
            "total_requests": overview.total_requests,
            "guarded_requests": overview.guarded_requests,
            "blocked_actions": overview.blocked_actions,
            "quarantined_actions": overview.quarantined_actions,
            "active_incidents": overview.active_incidents,
            "pending_reviews": overview.pending_reviews,
        },
        "coverage": {
            "policy_coverage_percent": round(overview.policy_coverage_percent, 2),
            "tool_execution_allow_rate": round(overview.tool_execution_allow_rate, 2),
            "protection_rate": protection_rate,
        },
        "pressure": {
            "review_backlog_present": overview.review_backlog_present,
            "quarantine_pressure": overview.quarantine_pressure,
        },
        "kpis": [item.to_dict() for item in overview.kpis],
        "alerts": [item.to_dict() for item in overview.alerts],
        "checked_at": _isoformat(overview.checked_at),
    }

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DataRetentionPolicy:
    policy_id: str = "default"
    display_name: str = "Default Retention Policy"
    event_retention_days: int = 30
    audit_log_retention_days: int = 365
    incident_retention_days: int = 180
    review_retention_days: int = 90
    execution_retention_days: int = 30
    telemetry_retention_days: int = 30
    quarantine_retention_days: int = 180
    deleted_record_tombstone_days: int = 30
    hard_delete_enabled: bool = False
    purge_enabled: bool = True
    legal_hold_enabled: bool = True
    minimum_allowed_days: int = 1
    maximum_allowed_days: int = 3650
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "policy_id": self.policy_id,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "event_retention_days": self.event_retention_days,
            "audit_log_retention_days": self.audit_log_retention_days,
            "incident_retention_days": self.incident_retention_days,
            "review_retention_days": self.review_retention_days,
            "execution_retention_days": self.execution_retention_days,
            "telemetry_retention_days": self.telemetry_retention_days,
            "quarantine_retention_days": self.quarantine_retention_days,
            "deleted_record_tombstone_days": self.deleted_record_tombstone_days,
            "hard_delete_enabled": self.hard_delete_enabled,
            "purge_enabled": self.purge_enabled,
            "legal_hold_enabled": self.legal_hold_enabled,
            "minimum_allowed_days": self.minimum_allowed_days,
            "maximum_allowed_days": self.maximum_allowed_days,
            "created_at": _isoformat(self.created_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(self.updated_at),
        }


def default_retention_policy() -> DataRetentionPolicy:
    return DataRetentionPolicy()


def build_retention_policy(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: DataRetentionPolicy | None = None,
) -> DataRetentionPolicy:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_retention_policy()

    minimum_allowed_days = max(1, _coerce_int(source.get("minimum_allowed_days"), current.minimum_allowed_days))
    maximum_allowed_days = max(minimum_allowed_days, _coerce_int(source.get("maximum_allowed_days"), current.maximum_allowed_days))

    def clamp_days(key: str, fallback: int) -> int:
        return max(minimum_allowed_days, min(maximum_allowed_days, _coerce_int(source.get(key), fallback)))

    created_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("created_at"), current.created_at) or _utc_now()
    updated_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("updated_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    return DataRetentionPolicy(
        policy_id=_coerce_str(source.get("policy_id"), current.policy_id) or current.policy_id,
        display_name=_coerce_str(source.get("display_name"), current.display_name) or current.display_name,
        event_retention_days=clamp_days("event_retention_days", current.event_retention_days),
        audit_log_retention_days=clamp_days("audit_log_retention_days", current.audit_log_retention_days),
        incident_retention_days=clamp_days("incident_retention_days", current.incident_retention_days),
        review_retention_days=clamp_days("review_retention_days", current.review_retention_days),
        execution_retention_days=clamp_days("execution_retention_days", current.execution_retention_days),
        telemetry_retention_days=clamp_days("telemetry_retention_days", current.telemetry_retention_days),
        quarantine_retention_days=clamp_days("quarantine_retention_days", current.quarantine_retention_days),
        deleted_record_tombstone_days=clamp_days("deleted_record_tombstone_days", current.deleted_record_tombstone_days),
        hard_delete_enabled=_coerce_bool(source.get("hard_delete_enabled"), current.hard_delete_enabled),
        purge_enabled=_coerce_bool(source.get("purge_enabled"), current.purge_enabled),
        legal_hold_enabled=_coerce_bool(source.get("legal_hold_enabled"), current.legal_hold_enabled),
        minimum_allowed_days=minimum_allowed_days,
        maximum_allowed_days=maximum_allowed_days,
        created_at=created_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
    )


def retention_summary(policy: DataRetentionPolicy) -> dict[str, Any]:
    retention_windows = {
        "events": policy.event_retention_days,
        "audit_logs": policy.audit_log_retention_days,
        "incidents": policy.incident_retention_days,
        "reviews": policy.review_retention_days,
        "executions": policy.execution_retention_days,
        "telemetry": policy.telemetry_retention_days,
        "quarantine": policy.quarantine_retention_days,
        "deleted_record_tombstones": policy.deleted_record_tombstone_days,
    }

    shortest_window = min(retention_windows.values())
    longest_window = max(retention_windows.values())

    return {
        "policy_id": policy.policy_id,
        "display_name": policy.display_name,
        "retention_windows": retention_windows,
        "safeguards": {
            "purge_enabled": policy.purge_enabled,
            "hard_delete_enabled": policy.hard_delete_enabled,
            "legal_hold_enabled": policy.legal_hold_enabled,
        },
        "limits": {
            "minimum_allowed_days": policy.minimum_allowed_days,
            "maximum_allowed_days": policy.maximum_allowed_days,
            "shortest_window_days": shortest_window,
            "longest_window_days": longest_window,
        },
        "timestamps": {
            "created_at": _isoformat(policy.created_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(policy.updated_at),
        },
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from app.clients.release_policy_client import ReleasePolicyClient
from app.providers.service_registry import ServiceRegistry, build_service_registry

# Module-level singleton registry used across the app.
_service_registry: Optional[ServiceRegistry] = None


def get_service_registry() -> ServiceRegistry:
    """
    Return the shared ServiceRegistry instance.

    The registry is created lazily on first access so that imports
    remain cheap and we avoid initialization ordering issues.
    """
    global _service_registry
    if _service_registry is None:
        _service_registry = build_service_registry()
    return _service_registry


def get_release_policy_client() -> ReleasePolicyClient:
    """
    Convenience accessor for the ReleasePolicyClient.

    This is the main entry point most callers will use when they need
    to evaluate release policy from routes, tasks, or scripts.
    """
    return get_service_registry().get_release_policy_client()


def _reset_dependencies_for_tests() -> None:
    """
    Test-only helper to reset the global registry.

    This should not be used in application code, but can be imported
    in test suites to ensure isolation between test cases.
    """
    global _service_registry
    _service_registry = None

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Mapping

from fastapi import Header, Request

from app.core.access_control import require_access
from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.org_isolation import require_same_org
from app.core.permissions import require_permission


def _clean(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip()


def _clean_lower(value: object) -> str:
    return _clean(value).lower()


def _normalize_string_list(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if value is None:
        return ()

    items: list[object]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        items = [part for part in value.split(",")]
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        items = list(value)
    else:
        return ()

    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for item in items:
        cleaned = _clean_lower(item)
        if not cleaned or cleaned in seen:
            continue
        normalized.append(cleaned)
        seen.add(cleaned)

    return tuple(normalized)


def _normalize_metadata(value: object) -> dict[str, str]:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(item) for key, item in value.items()}


def _extract_auth_payload(request: Request) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    payload = getattr(request.state, "auth", None)
    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        return payload

    payload = getattr(request.state, "auth_context", None)
    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        return payload

    return {}


def build_auth_context(request: Request) -> AuthContext:
    payload = _extract_auth_payload(request)

    return AuthContext(
        authenticated=bool(payload.get("authenticated", False)),
        principal_id=_clean(payload.get("principal_id")) or None,
        principal_type=_clean_lower(payload.get("principal_type")) or "anonymous",
        org_id=_clean(payload.get("org_id")) or None,
        roles=_normalize_string_list(payload.get("roles")),
        permissions=_normalize_string_list(payload.get("permissions")),
        session_id=_clean(payload.get("session_id")) or None,
        auth_method=_clean_lower(payload.get("auth_method")) or None,
        metadata=_normalize_metadata(payload.get("metadata")),
    )


async def get_auth_context(request: Request) -> AuthContext:
    return build_auth_context(request)


async def get_authenticated_auth_context(request: Request) -> AuthContext:
    context = build_auth_context(request)
    require_access(

FILE: app\dependencies\org_context.py

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from fastapi import Header, Query, Request

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.org_isolation import require_matching_org_ids, require_same_org
from app.dependencies.auth import build_auth_context


def _clean(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrgContext:
    actor_org_id: str | None
    target_org_id: str
    source: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, str | None]:
        return {
            "actor_org_id": self.actor_org_id,
            "target_org_id": self.target_org_id,
            "source": self.source,
        }


def resolve_target_org_id(
    *,
    auth_context: AuthContext,
    header_org_id: str | None = None,
    query_org_id: str | None = None,
    default_to_actor_org: bool = True,
) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    normalized_header_org_id = _clean(header_org_id) or None
    normalized_query_org_id = _clean(query_org_id) or None

    if normalized_header_org_id:
        return normalized_header_org_id, "header"

    if normalized_query_org_id:
        return normalized_query_org_id, "query"

    if default_to_actor_org and auth_context.org_id:
        return auth_context.org_id, "actor"

    return None, "missing"


def build_org_context(
    auth_context: AuthContext,
    *,
    target_org_id: str,
    source: str,
) -> OrgContext:
    return OrgContext(
        actor_org_id=auth_context.org_id,
        target_org_id=target_org_id,
        source=source,
    )


async def get_org_context(
    request: Request,
    x_org_id: str | None = Header(default=None),
    org_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> OrgContext:
    auth_context = build_auth_context(request)
    target_org_id, source = resolve_target_org_id(
        auth_context=auth_context,
        header_org_id=x_org_id,
        query_org_id=org_id,
        default_to_actor_org=True,
    )
    resolved_target_org_id = require_matching_org_ids(
        auth_context.org_id,
        target_org_id,
        metadata={"dependency": "get_org_context", "source": source},
    )
    return build_org_context(
        auth_context,
        target_org_id=resolved_target_org_id,
        source=source,
    )


async def require_org_context(
    request: Request,
    x_org_id: str | None = Header(default=None),
    org_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> OrgContext:
    auth_context = build_auth_context(request)
    target_org_id, source = resolve_target_org_id(
        auth_context=auth_context,
        header_org_id=x_org_id,
        query_org_id=org_id,
        default_to_actor_org=False,
    )
    require_same_org(
        auth_context,
        target_org_id=target_org_id,
        metadata={"dependency": "require_org_context", "source": source},
    )
    return build_org_context(
        auth_context,
        target_org_id=target_org_id or "",
        source=source,
    )


def require_explicit_org_context():
    async def dependency(
        request: Request,
        x_org_id: str | None = Header(default=None),
        org_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    ) -> OrgContext:
        auth_context = build_auth_context(request)
        target_org_id, source = resolve_target_org_id(
            auth_context=auth_context,
            header_org_id=x_org_id,
            query_org_id=org_id,
            default_to_actor_org=False,
        )
        resolved_target_org_id = require_matching_org_ids(
            auth_context.org_id,
            target_org_id,
            metadata={
                "dependency": "require_explicit_org_context",
                "source": source,
            },
        )
        return build_org_context(
            auth_context,
            target_org_id=resolved_target_org_id,
            source=source,
        )

    return dependency

        "permissions:write",
        metadata={"dependency": "require_permissions_write"},
    )

def require_permission_dependency(permission: str):
    async def dependency(request: Request) -> AuthContext:
        context = build_auth_context(request)
        require_permission(
            context,
            permission,
            metadata={
                "dependency": "require_permission_dependency",
                "permission": permission,
            },
        )
        return context

    return dependency


def require_any_permission(*permissions: str):
    normalized_permissions = tuple(
        permission.strip().lower()
        for permission in permissions
        if isinstance(permission, str) and permission.strip()
    )

    async def dependency(request: Request) -> AuthContext:
        context = build_auth_context(request)

        for permission in normalized_permissions:
            decision = evaluate_permission(
                context,
                permission,
                metadata={
                    "dependency": "require_any_permission",
                    "permission": permission,
                },
            )
            if decision.allowed:
                return context

        fallback_permission = normalized_permissions[0] if normalized_permissions else ""
        require_permission(
            context,
            fallback_permission,
            metadata={
                "dependency": "require_any_permission",
                "permissions": ",".join(normalized_permissions),
            },
        )
        return context

    return dependency


def require_all_permissions(*permissions: str):
    normalized_permissions = tuple(
        permission.strip().lower()
        for permission in permissions
        if isinstance(permission, str) and permission.strip()
    )

    async def dependency(request: Request) -> AuthContext:
        context = build_auth_context(request)
        for permission in normalized_permissions:
            require_permission(
                context,
                permission,
                metadata={
                    "dependency": "require_all_permissions",
                    "permission": permission,
                },
            )
        return context

    return dependency

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Awaitable, Callable

from fastapi import Depends, Request

from app.core.auth import get_api_key
from app.core.ratelimit import rate_limit_dependency


def require_api_key(api_key: str = Depends(get_api_key)) -> str:
    return api_key


def build_rate_limit_dependency(
    scope: str,
    *,
    limit: int,
    window_seconds: int,
    key_func: Callable[[Request], str | Awaitable[str]] | None = None,
):
    async def dependency(
        request: Request,
        api_key: str = Depends(require_api_key),
    ) -> str:
        limiter = rate_limit_dependency(
            scope=scope,
            limit=limit,
            window_seconds=window_seconds,
            key_func=key_func,
        )
        await limiter(request)
        return api_key

    return dependency


__all__ = [
    "build_rate_limit_dependency",
    "require_api_key",
]

        "client_host": get_client_host(request),

    }

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from fastapi import Header, Request

from app.core.requestid import get_or_create_request_id


def _clean_optional_header(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    cleaned = value.strip()
    return cleaned or None


def _derive_client_ip(request: Request) -> str | None:
    forwarded_for = _clean_optional_header(request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for"))
    if forwarded_for:
        first_hop = forwarded_for.split(",")[0].strip()
        if first_hop:
            return first_hop

    real_ip = _clean_optional_header(request.headers.get("x-real-ip"))
    if real_ip:
        return real_ip

    if request.client and request.client.host:
        return request.client.host

    return None


def build_request_context(
    request: Request,
    *,
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
    integration_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    request_id = get_or_create_request_id(request)
    context: dict[str, Any] = {
        "request_id": request_id,
        "trace_id": _clean_optional_header(trace_id) or request_id,
        "client_id": _clean_optional_header(client_id),
        "session_id": _clean_optional_header(session_id),
        "integration_id": _clean_optional_header(integration_id),
        "method": request.method,
        "path": request.url.path,
        "client_ip": _derive_client_ip(request),
        "user_agent": _clean_optional_header(request.headers.get("user-agent")),
        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    }
    return context


async def get_request_context(
    request: Request,
    x_client_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Client-Id"),
    x_session_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Session-Id"),
    x_trace_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Trace-Id"),
    x_integration_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Integration-Id"),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return build_request_context(
        request,
        client_id=x_client_id,
        session_id=x_session_id,
        trace_id=x_trace_id,
        integration_id=x_integration_id,
    )


async def read_request_context(
    request: Request,
    x_client_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Client-Id"),
    x_session_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Session-Id"),
    x_trace_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Trace-Id"),
    x_integration_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-Integration-Id"),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await get_request_context(
        request=request,
        x_client_id=x_client_id,
        x_session_id=x_session_id,
        x_trace_id=x_trace_id,
        x_integration_id=x_integration_id,
    )

================================================================================
FILE: app\detection\artifact_analyzer.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import PurePath
from typing import Any, Mapping


HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".exe",
    ".dll",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".vbs",
    ".jar",
    ".apk",
    ".scr",
    ".msi",
    ".com",
    ".reg",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".zip",
    ".rar",
    ".7z",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".tgz",
    ".docm",
    ".xlsm",
    ".pptm",
    ".html",
    ".svg",
    ".js",
    ".pdf",
}

HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS = {
    "obfuscated": 25,
    "payload": 25,
    "macro": 25,
    "persistence": 20,
    "autorun": 20,
    "credential": 20,
    "token": 15,
    "password": 15,
    "keylogger": 30,
    "powershell": 20,
    "registry": 20,
    "download and execute": 30,
}

MEDIUM_RISK_PATTERNS = {
    "download": 10,
    "archive": 10,
    "embedded": 10,
    "external link": 10,
    "javascript": 10,
    "script": 10,
    "remote content": 10,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArtifactAnalysis:
    detected: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    artifact_name: str
    artifact_path: str
    artifact_extension: str
    reason: str
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_extension(path_value: str, name_value: str) -> str:
    candidate = path_value or name_value
    if not candidate:
        return ""
    return PurePath(candidate).suffix.lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], artifact_name: str, artifact_path: str) -> str:
    parts = [artifact_name, artifact_path]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "description",
        "content_type",
        "source",
        "origin",
        "scan_summary",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("matched_patterns", "failed_checks", "alerts", "tags", "reasons"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _score_extension(extension: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if extension in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 45, [f"high-risk artifact extension detected: {extension}"]
    if extension in MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 20, [f"reviewable artifact extension detected: {extension}"]
    return 0, []


def _score_patterns(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    matched: list[str] = []

    for pattern, weight in HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    for pattern, weight in MEDIUM_RISK_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    return min(100, score), matched


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 70:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 35:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def analyze_artifact(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ArtifactAnalysis:
    artifact_name = str(_get_value(payload, "artifact_name", "file_name", "name") or "")
    artifact_path = str(_get_value(payload, "artifact_path", "file_path", "filepath", "path") or "")
    artifact_extension = _extract_extension(artifact_path, artifact_name)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, artifact_name, artifact_path)
    extension_score, extension_reasons = _score_extension(artifact_extension)
    pattern_score, matched_patterns = _score_patterns(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + extension_score + pattern_score)
    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(total_risk)

    failed_checks = list(extension_reasons)
    if matched_patterns:
        failed_checks.append("artifact content indicators triggered review")

    if any(pattern in {"macro", "payload", "download and execute"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("artifact shows active execution behavior")

    if any(pattern in {"credential", "token", "password", "keylogger"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("artifact shows credential-risk indicators")

    reason = (
        extension_reasons[0]
        if extension_reasons
        else matched_patterns[0]
        if matched_patterns
        else "no artifact threats detected"
    )

    return ArtifactAnalysis(
        detected=total_risk >= 35,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        artifact_name=artifact_name,
        artifact_path=artifact_path,
        artifact_extension=artifact_extension,
        reason=reason,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "artifact_analyzer"},
    )


def summarize_artifact_analysis(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return analyze_artifact(payload).to_dict()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
from typing import Any

from app.services.threatintel import ThreatIntelService, build_default_threatintel_service
from app.services.malwareservice import MalwareService, build_malware_service
from app.services.detonationservice import DetonationService, build_detonation_service


SEVERITY_RANK = {
    "low": 1,
    "medium": 2,
    "high": 3,
    "critical": 4,
}

VERDICT_RANK = {
    "allow": 1,
    "monitor": 2,
    "review": 3,
    "block": 4,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArtifactAnalysisComponent:
    name: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArtifactAnalysisResult:
    artifact_id: str
    file_name: str | None
    sha256: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    reasons: list[str]
    indicators: list[str]
    components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]
    assessed_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "artifact_id": self.artifact_id,
            "file_name": self.file_name,
            "sha256": self.sha256,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": self.score,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "indicators": list(self.indicators),
            "components": [
                {
                    "name": component.name,
                    "verdict": component.verdict,
                    "severity": component.severity,
                    "score": component.score,
                    "confidence": component.confidence,
                    "details": component.details,
                }
                for component in self.components
            ],
            "assessed_at": self.assessed_at,
        }


class ArtifactAnalyzer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
        malware_service: MalwareService | None = None,
        detonation_service: DetonationService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._threatintel = threatintel_service or build_default_threatintel_service()
        self._malware = malware_service or build_malware_service()
        self._detonation = detonation_service or build_detonation_service()

    def analyze_bytes(
        self,
        payload: bytes,
        *,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        source_url: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
        sandbox_profile: str = "windows-office-user",
    ) -> ArtifactAnalysisResult:
        decoded_text = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        artifact_id = self._build_artifact_id(sha256, file_name=file_name)

        threat_assessment = self._threatintel.assess_artifact(
            url=source_url,
            hashes=[sha256],
            text=decoded_text if decoded_text else None,
            context=context or "artifact-analysis",
        )
        malware_assessment = self._malware.analyze_bytes(payload, file_name=file_name)
        detonation_assessment = self._detonation.detonate_bytes(
            payload,
            file_name=file_name,
            sandbox_profile=sandbox_profile,
        )

        components = self._build_components(
            threat_assessment=threat_assessment,
            malware_assessment=malware_assessment,
            detonation_assessment=detonation_assessment,
        )
        score = self._resolve_score(components)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(components, score)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(components, score)
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(components)
        indicators = self._collect_indicators(
            sha256=sha256,
            source_url=source_url,
            threat_assessment=threat_assessment,
            malware_assessment=malware_assessment,
        )
        reasons = self._build_reasons(
            components=components,
            threat_assessment=threat_assessment,
            malware_assessment=malware_assessment,
            detonation_assessment=detonation_assessment,
            source_url=source_url,
        )

        return ArtifactAnalysisResult(
            artifact_id=artifact_id,
            file_name=file_name,
            sha256=sha256,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            reasons=reasons,
            indicators=indicators,
            components=components,
        )

    def analyze_text(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        source_url: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
        sandbox_profile: str = "windows-office-user",
    ) -> ArtifactAnalysisResult:
        return self.analyze_bytes(
            text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"),
            file_name=file_name,
            source_url=source_url,
            context=context,
            sandbox_profile=sandbox_profile,
        )

    def _build_artifact_id(self, sha256: str, *, file_name: str | None) -> str:
        suffix = (file_name or "artifact").replace(" ", "-").lower()
        return f"artifact-{suffix}-{sha256[:12]}"

    def _build_components(
        self,
        *,
        threat_assessment: Any,
        malware_assessment: Any,
        detonation_assessment: Any,
    ) -> list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]:
        threat_details = {
            "match_count": len(getattr(threat_assessment, "matches", [])),
            "risk_families": list(getattr(threat_assessment, "risk_families", [])),
            "extracted_indicators": list(getattr(threat_assessment, "extracted_indicators", [])),
        }
        malware_details = {
            "detected_family": getattr(malware_assessment, "detected_family", None),
            "signal_count": len(getattr(malware_assessment, "signals", [])),
            "is_probably_binary": bool(getattr(malware_assessment, "is_probably_binary", False)),
        }
        detonation_details = {
            "behavior_tags": list(getattr(detonation_assessment, "behavior_tags", [])),
            "artifact_count": len(getattr(detonation_assessment, "artifacts", [])),
            "execution_time_ms": int(getattr(detonation_assessment, "execution_time_ms", 0)),
        }

        return [
            ArtifactAnalysisComponent(
                name="threatintel",
                verdict=str(getattr(threat_assessment, "verdict", "allow")),
                severity=str(getattr(threat_assessment, "severity", "low")),
                score=round(float(getattr(threat_assessment, "score", 0.0)), 4),
                confidence=round(min(max(float(getattr(threat_assessment, "score", 0.0)) + 0.2, 0.0), 1.0), 4),
                details=threat_details,
            ),
            ArtifactAnalysisComponent(
                name="malware",
                verdict=str(getattr(malware_assessment, "verdict", "allow")),
                severity=str(getattr(malware_assessment, "severity", "low")),
                score=round(float(getattr(malware_assessment, "score", 0.0)), 4),
                confidence=round(float(getattr(malware_assessment, "confidence", 0.0)), 4),
                details=malware_details,
            ),
            ArtifactAnalysisComponent(
                name="detonation",
                verdict=str(getattr(detonation_assessment, "verdict", "allow")),
                severity=str(getattr(detonation_assessment, "severity", "low")),
                score=round(float(getattr(detonation_assessment, "score", 0.0)), 4),
                confidence=round(float(getattr(detonation_assessment, "confidence", 0.0)), 4),
                details=detonation_details,
            ),
        ]

    def _resolve_score(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]) -> float:
        weights = {
            "threatintel": 0.30,
            "malware": 0.35,
            "detonation": 0.35,
        }
        weighted = 0.0
        for component in components:
            weighted += component.score * weights.get(component.name, 0.0)

        max_component = max((component.score for component in components), default=0.0)
        if max_component >= 0.85:
            weighted = max(weighted, max_component * 0.92)

        return round(min(weighted, 1.0), 4)

    def _resolve_verdict(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent], score: float) -> str:
        strongest = max((VERDICT_RANK.get(component.verdict, 1) for component in components), default=1)

        if strongest >= VERDICT_RANK["block"]:
            return "block"
        if score >= 0.70 or strongest >= VERDICT_RANK["review"]:
            return "review"
        if score >= 0.32 or strongest >= VERDICT_RANK["monitor"]:
            return "monitor"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_severity(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent], score: float) -> str:
        strongest = max((SEVERITY_RANK.get(component.severity, 1) for component in components), default=1)

        if strongest >= SEVERITY_RANK["critical"] or score >= 0.85:
            return "critical"
        if strongest >= SEVERITY_RANK["high"] or score >= 0.60:
            return "high"
        if strongest >= SEVERITY_RANK["medium"] or score >= 0.28:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_confidence(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]) -> float:
        if not components:
            return 0.0
        total = sum(component.confidence for component in components)
        return round(min(total / len(components), 1.0), 4)

    def _collect_indicators(
        self,
        *,
        sha256: str,
        source_url: str | None,
        threat_assessment: Any,
        malware_assessment: Any,
    ) -> list[str]:
        indicators: list[str] = [sha256]
        if source_url:
            indicators.append(source_url)

        indicators.extend(list(getattr(threat_assessment, "extracted_indicators", [])))

        family = getattr(malware_assessment, "detected_family", None)
        if family:
            indicators.append(f"family:{family}")

        deduped: list[str] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for item in indicators:
            normalized = str(item).strip()
            if not normalized or normalized in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(normalized)
            deduped.append(normalized)
        return deduped

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        *,
        components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent],
        threat_assessment: Any,
        malware_assessment: Any,
        detonation_assessment: Any,
        source_url: str | None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons: list[str] = []

        if source_url:
            reasons.append(f"Source URL supplied for correlation: {source_url}")

        matches = getattr(threat_assessment, "matches", [])
        if matches:
            reasons.append(f"Threat intel matched {len(matches)} known indicator(s).")

        malware_family = getattr(malware_assessment, "detected_family", None)
        if malware_family:
            reasons.append(f"Static malware analysis resembles {malware_family} behavior.")

        malware_signals = getattr(malware_assessment, "signals", [])
        if malware_signals:
            top_malware = sorted(malware_signals, key=lambda signal: signal.weight, reverse=True)[:3]
            for signal in top_malware:
                reasons.append(f"Static signal {signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        detonation_signals = getattr(detonation_assessment, "signals", [])
        if detonation_signals:
            top_detonation = sorted(detonation_signals, key=lambda signal: signal.weight, reverse=True)[:3]
            for signal in top_detonation:
                reasons.append(f"Detonation signal {signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        strongest_component = max(components, key=lambda component: component.score)
        reasons.append(
            f"Strongest contributing subsystem was {strongest_component.name} with score {strongest_component.score:.4f}."
        )

        if not reasons:
            reasons.append("No material risk indicators were detected across artifact analysis subsystems.")

        return reasons


def build_artifact_analyzer(
    *,
    threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
    malware_service: MalwareService | None = None,
    detonation_service: DetonationService | None = None,
) -> ArtifactAnalyzer:
    return ArtifactAnalyzer(
        threatintel_service=threatintel_service,
        malware_service=malware_service,
        detonation_service=detonation_service,
    )


__all__ = [
    "ArtifactAnalysisComponent",
    "ArtifactAnalysisResult",
    "ArtifactAnalyzer",
    "build_artifact_analyzer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import PurePath
from typing import Any, Mapping
from urllib.parse import urlparse


HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".exe",
    ".dll",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".msi",
    ".scr",
    ".jar",
    ".apk",
    ".reg",
    ".vbs",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".zip",
    ".rar",
    ".7z",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".tgz",
    ".xz",
    ".iso",
    ".img",
    ".docm",
    ".xlsm",
    ".pptm",
    ".html",
    ".svg",
    ".pdf",
    ".js",
}

HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "dropper": 30,
    "payload": 30,
    "macro": 25,
    "autorun": 20,
    "obfuscated": 25,
    "executable": 20,
    "credential": 20,
    "token": 15,
    "password": 15,
    "download and execute": 35,
    "remote script": 25,
}

MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "archive": 10,
    "embedded": 10,
    "attachment": 10,
    "redirect": 10,
    "external": 10,
    "script": 10,
    "installer": 10,
}

HIGH_RISK_HOST_PATTERNS = {
    "raw.githubusercontent.com": 10,
    "pastebin": 25,
    "bit.ly": 25,
    "tinyurl": 25,
    "anonfiles": 25,
    "mediafire": 20,
    "mega.nz": 20,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DownloadAnalysis:
    detected: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    url: str
    hostname: str
    file_name: str
    file_extension: str
    reason: str
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_url(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    return str(_get_value(payload, "url", "target", "target_value", "download_url") or "")


def _extract_file_name(payload: Mapping[str, Any], url: str) -> str:
    explicit = str(_get_value(payload, "file_name", "name") or "")
    if explicit:
        return explicit

    parsed = urlparse(url if "://" in url else f"https://{url}" if url else "")
    return PurePath(parsed.path).name


def _extract_extension(file_name: str) -> str:
    if not file_name:
        return ""
    return PurePath(file_name).suffix.lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], url: str, file_name: str) -> str:
    parts = [url, file_name]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "description",
        "target_type",
        "content_type",
        "source",
        "origin",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("matched_patterns", "failed_checks", "alerts", "tags", "reasons"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _score_extension(extension: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if extension in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 45, [f"high-risk download extension detected: {extension}"]
    if extension in MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 20, [f"reviewable download extension detected: {extension}"]
    return 0, []


def _score_keywords(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    matched: list[str] = []

    for keyword, weight in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS.items():
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(keyword)

    for keyword, weight in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS.items():
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(keyword)

    return min(100, score), matched


def _score_host(hostname: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for host_pattern, weight in HIGH_RISK_HOST_PATTERNS.items():
        if host_pattern in hostname:
            score += weight
            reasons.append(f"reviewable download host detected: {host_pattern}")

    return score, reasons


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 70:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 35:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def analyze_download(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> DownloadAnalysis:
    url = _extract_url(payload)
    parsed = urlparse(url if "://" in url else f"https://{url}" if url else "")
    hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
    file_name = _extract_file_name(payload, url)
    file_extension = _extract_extension(file_name)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, url, file_name)
    extension_score, extension_reasons = _score_extension(file_extension)
    keyword_score, matched_patterns = _score_keywords(signal_text)
    host_score, host_reasons = _score_host(hostname)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + extension_score + keyword_score + host_score)
    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(total_risk)

    failed_checks = [*extension_reasons, *host_reasons]
    if matched_patterns:
        failed_checks.append("download content indicators triggered review")

    if any(pattern in {"dropper", "payload", "download and execute", "remote script"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("download shows executable delivery behavior")

    if any(pattern in {"credential", "token", "password"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("download shows secret-risk indicators")

    reason = (
        extension_reasons[0]
        if extension_reasons
        else host_reasons[0]
        if host_reasons
        else matched_patterns[0]
        if matched_patterns
        else "no download threats detected"
    )

    return DownloadAnalysis(
        detected=total_risk >= 35,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        url=url,
        hostname=hostname,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_extension=file_extension,
        reason=reason,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "download_analyzer"},
    )


def summarize_download_analysis(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return analyze_download(payload).to_dict()

    "MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "HIGH_RISK_HOST_PATTERNS",
    "DownloadAnalysis",
    "analyze_download",
    "summarize_download_analysis",

@dataclass(slots=True)
class DownloadSignal:
    name: str
    weight: float
    evidence: str
    category: str = "download"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DownloadAnalysisResult:
    download_id: str
    url: str | None
    file_name: str | None
    sha256: str | None
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    reasons: list[str]
    signals: list[DownloadSignal]
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    analyzed_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "download_id": self.download_id,
            "url": self.url,
            "file_name": self.file_name,
            "sha256": self.sha256,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": self.score,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "signals": [
                {
                    "name": signal.name,
                    "weight": signal.weight,
                    "evidence": signal.evidence,
                    "category": signal.category,
                }
                for signal in self.signals
            ],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "artifact_analysis": self.artifact_analysis,
            "analyzed_at": self.analyzed_at,
        }


class DownloadAnalyzer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer | None = None,
        threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._artifact_analyzer = artifact_analyzer or build_artifact_analyzer()
        self._threatintel = threatintel_service or build_default_threatintel_service()

    def analyze(
        self,
        *,
        url: str | None = None,
        payload: bytes | None = None,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        content_type: str | None = None,
        referrer: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> DownloadAnalysisResult:
        normalized_url = (url or "").strip() or None
        normalized_name = (file_name or "").strip() or None
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() if payload is not None else None
        download_id = self._build_download_id(
            url=normalized_url,
            file_name=normalized_name,
            sha256=sha256,
        )

        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        metadata = {
            "content_type": content_type,
            "referrer": referrer,
            "has_payload": payload is not None,
            "payload_size": len(payload) if payload is not None else 0,
        }

        if normalized_url:
            signals.extend(self._analyze_url(normalized_url))
            threat = self._threatintel.assess_artifact(
                url=normalized_url,
                hashes=[sha256] if sha256 else [],
                text=normalized_name,
                context=context or "download-analysis",
            )
            signals.extend(self._signals_from_threatintel(threat))

        if normalized_name:
            signals.extend(self._analyze_file_name(normalized_name))

        if payload is not None:
            signals.extend(self._analyze_payload(payload, normalized_name, content_type))

        artifact_analysis = None
        if payload is not None:
            artifact_result = self._artifact_analyzer.analyze_bytes(
                payload,
                file_name=normalized_name,
                source_url=normalized_url,
                context=context or "download-analysis",
            )
            artifact_analysis = artifact_result.as_dict()
            signals.extend(self._signals_from_artifact(artifact_result))

        signals = self._dedupe_signals(signals)
        score = self._resolve_score(signals)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(score)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(score, signals)
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(signals, payload_present=payload is not None, artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis)
        reasons = self._build_reasons(signals, verdict, severity, normalized_url, normalized_name, artifact_analysis)

        metadata["signal_count"] = len(signals)
        metadata["host"] = self._extract_host(normalized_url) if normalized_url else None

        return DownloadAnalysisResult(
            download_id=download_id,
            url=normalized_url,
            file_name=normalized_name,
            sha256=sha256,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            reasons=reasons,
            signals=signals,
            metadata=metadata,
            artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
        )

    def analyze_url(
        self,
        url: str,
        *,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        referrer: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> DownloadAnalysisResult:
        return self.analyze(
            url=url,
            file_name=file_name,
            referrer=referrer,
            context=context,
        )

    def analyze_bytes(
        self,
        payload: bytes,
        *,
        url: str | None = None,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        content_type: str | None = None,
        referrer: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> DownloadAnalysisResult:
        return self.analyze(
            url=url,
            payload=payload,
            file_name=file_name,
            content_type=content_type,
            referrer=referrer,
            context=context,
        )

    def _build_download_id(self, *, url: str | None, file_name: str | None, sha256: str | None) -> str:
        seed = "|".join(part for part in [url or "", file_name or "", sha256 or ""] if part)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(seed.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12] if seed else "unknown"
        return f"download-{digest}"

    def _analyze_url(self, url: str) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        host = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
        path = parsed.path or ""
        query = parsed.query or ""

        if parsed.scheme and parsed.scheme.lower() not in {"http", "https"}:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="non_http_scheme",
                    weight=0.30,
                    evidence=f"Download URL uses {parsed.scheme} scheme.",
                )
            )

        if host in URL_SHORTENER_HOSTS:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="url_shortener",
                    weight=0.28,
                    evidence=f"Host {host} is a known shortening service.",
                )
            )

        tld = host.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in host else ""
        if tld in SUSPICIOUS_TLDS:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="suspicious_tld",
                    weight=0.26,
                    evidence=f"Host uses high-risk top-level domain .{tld}.",
                )
            )

        if IP_LITERAL_PATTERN.match(host):
            try:
                ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
                if not ip.is_private:
                    signals.append(
                        DownloadSignal(
                            name="ip_literal_host",
                            weight=0.24,
                            evidence=f"URL uses literal IP host {host}.",
                        )
                    )
            except ValueError:
                pass

        if REPEATED_SUBDOMAIN_PATTERN.search(host):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="deep_subdomain_chain",
                    weight=0.14,
                    evidence=f"Host {host} contains many chained subdomains.",
                )
            )

        if "@" in parsed.netloc and CREDENTIAL_STYLE_PATTERN.match(parsed.netloc):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="credential_style_url",
                    weight=0.32,
                    evidence="URL contains credential-style userinfo before host.",
                )
            )

        lowered_target = f"{path}?{query}".lower()
        if DOUBLE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.search(lowered_target):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="double_extension_url",
                    weight=0.42,
                    evidence=f"URL path suggests disguised executable: {path}",
                )
            )

        for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
            if lowered_target.endswith(ext):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="executable_download_url",
                        weight=0.38,
                        evidence=f"URL path ends with executable extension {ext}.",
                    )
                )
                break

        if any(token in lowered_target for token in ("download=1", "export=1", "attachment=", "raw=1")) and HEX_ESCAPE_PATTERN.search(query):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="obfuscated_download_query",
                    weight=0.18,
                    evidence="Download query uses encoded characters alongside forced attachment semantics.",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _analyze_file_name(self, file_name: str) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        lowered = file_name.lower()

        if DOUBLE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.search(lowered):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="double_extension_name",
                    weight=0.46,
                    evidence=f"Filename appears disguised with double extension: {file_name}",
                )
            )

        for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
            if lowered.endswith(ext):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="high_risk_extension",
                        weight=0.34,
                        evidence=f"Filename uses high-risk extension {ext}.",
                    )
                )
                break

        archive_match = next((ext for ext in ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS if lowered.endswith(ext)), None)
        if archive_match:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="archive_container",
                    weight=0.12,
                    evidence=f"Filename is an archive container {archive_match}.",
                )
            )

        if any(char in file_name for char in ("\u202e", "\u202d", "\u2066", "\u2067", "\u2068", "\u2069")):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="unicode_direction_override",
                    weight=0.54,
                    evidence="Filename contains Unicode direction override characters.",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _analyze_payload(
        self,
        payload: bytes,
        file_name: str | None,
        content_type: str | None,
    ) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        prefix = payload[:32]
        lowered_name = (file_name or "").lower()

        if prefix.startswith(b"MZ"):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="portable_executable_header",
                    weight=0.48,
                    evidence="Payload starts with MZ executable header.",
                )
            )
        elif prefix.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="zip_container_header",
                    weight=0.12,
                    evidence="Payload starts with ZIP archive header.",
                )
            )
        elif prefix.startswith(b"%PDF"):
            if any(ext in lowered_name for ext in (".exe", ".scr", ".js", ".bat")):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="extension_mime_mismatch",
                        weight=0.40,
                        evidence="Payload header appears to be PDF but filename extension is executable-like.",
                    )
                )

        if content_type:
            lowered_type = content_type.lower()
            if "octet-stream" in lowered_type and not any(lowered_name.endswith(ext) for ext in ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS | HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="generic_binary_content_type",
                        weight=0.10,
                        evidence=f"Content-Type is generic binary: {content_type}",
                    )
                )
            if "text/html" in lowered_type and any(lowered_name.endswith(ext) for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="content_type_filename_mismatch",
                        weight=0.35,
                        evidence=f"Executable-like filename conflicts with content type {content_type}.",
                    )
                )

        if len(payload) < 180 and any(lowered_name.endswith(ext) for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="tiny_executable_payload",
                    weight=0.14,
                    evidence="Executable-like payload is unusually small and may be a staged dropper or broken lure.",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _signals_from_threatintel(self, assessment: Any) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        matches = list(getattr(assessment, "matches", []))
        if matches:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="threatintel_match",
                    weight=min(0.50, 0.16 + len(matches) * 0.08),
                    evidence=f"Threat intel matched {len(matches)} indicator(s).",
                    category="threatintel",
                )
            )

        for family in list(getattr(assessment, "risk_families", []))[:3]:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="threatintel_family",
                    weight=0.12,
                    evidence=f"Threat intel associated the target with {family}.",
                    category="threatintel",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _signals_from_artifact(self, result: Any) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        score = float(getattr(result, "score", 0.0))
        verdict = str(getattr(result, "verdict", "allow"))
        severity = str(getattr(result, "severity", "low"))

        if score >= 0.20:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="artifact_risk_score",
                    weight=min(0.55, score * 0.50),
                    evidence=f"Artifact analysis returned score {score:.4f}, verdict {verdict}, severity {severity}.",
                    category="artifact",
                )
            )

        components = list(getattr(result, "components", []))
        for component in components:
            component_score = float(getattr(component, "score", 0.0))
            if component_score < 0.40:
                continue
            component_name = str(getattr(component, "name", "component"))
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name=f"artifact_component_{component_name}",
                    weight=min(0.22, component_score * 0.18),
                    evidence=f"{component_name} component contributed score {component_score:.4f}.",
                    category="artifact",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _resolve_score(self, signals: list[DownloadSignal]) -> float:
        total = sum(signal.weight for signal in signals)
        return round(min(total, 1.0), 4)

    def _resolve_severity(self, score: float) -> str:
        if score >= 0.85:
            return "critical"
        if score >= 0.58:
            return "high"
        if score >= 0.28:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_verdict(self, score: float, signals: list[DownloadSignal]) -> str:
        names = {signal.name for signal in signals}

        if score >= 0.82 or "unicode_direction_override" in names or "portable_executable_header" in names and "double_extension_name" in names:
            return "block"
        if score >= 0.52 or "threatintel_match" in names:
            return "review"
        if score >= 0.22:
            return "monitor"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_confidence(
        self,
        signals: list[DownloadSignal],
        *,
        payload_present: bool,
        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> float:
        base = 0.35
        if payload_present:
            base += 0.18
        if artifact_analysis:
            base += 0.18
        base += min(len(signals) * 0.04, 0.25)
        return round(min(base, 0.99), 4)

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        signals: list[DownloadSignal],
        verdict: str,
        severity: str,
        url: str | None,
        file_name: str | None,
        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons: list[str] = [
            f"Download risk classified as {verdict} with {severity} severity."
        ]

        if url:
            reasons.append(f"Evaluated download source {url}.")
        if file_name:
            reasons.append(f"Evaluated target filename {file_name}.")

        for signal in sorted(signals, key=lambda item: item.weight, reverse=True)[:5]:
            reasons.append(f"{signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        if artifact_analysis:
            reasons.append(
                f"Artifact analysis also returned verdict {artifact_analysis.get('verdict')} with score {artifact_analysis.get('score')}."
            )

        if len(reasons) == 1:
            reasons.append("No strong download-specific risk indicators were detected.")

        return reasons

    def _extract_host(self, url: str) -> str | None:
        try:
            return (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower() or None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _dedupe_signals(self, signals: list[DownloadSignal]) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        deduped: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        for signal in signals:
            key = (signal.name, signal.evidence)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(signal)
        return deduped


def build_download_analyzer(
    *,
    artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer | None = None,
    threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
) -> DownloadAnalyzer:
    return DownloadAnalyzer(
        artifact_analyzer=artifact_analyzer,
        threatintel_service=threatintel_service,
    )


__all__ = [
    "DownloadSignal",
    "DownloadAnalysisResult",
    "DownloadAnalyzer",
    "build_download_analyzer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping


SECRET_PATTERNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "openai_api_key": r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b",
    "aws_access_key": r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b",
    "github_token": r"\bghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b",
    "slack_token": r"\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}\b",
    "jwt": r"\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b",
    "private_key_block": r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+PRIVATE KEY-----",
}

DANGEROUS_OUTPUT_PATTERNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "powershell_encoded": r"powershell\s+-enc\b",
    "curl_pipe_bash": r"curl\s+[^|]+\|\s*(bash|sh)\b",
    "wget_pipe_shell": r"wget\s+[^|]+\|\s*(bash|sh)\b",
    "command_chaining_delete": r"(rm\s+-rf|del\s+/f\s+/q|format\s+c:)",
    "script_tag": r"<script\b",
    "data_exfil_url": r"https?://[^\s]+/(collect|exfil|beacon|callback)\b",
}

REDACTION_TOKEN = "[REDACTED]"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OutputSanitizationResult:
    sanitized_text: str
    modified: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    reason: str
    redacted_items: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _extract_text(payload: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        return payload

    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        for key in ("content", "text", "output", "message", "result", "summary"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                return value
        return str(payload)

    return str(payload)


def _redact_patterns(
    text: str,
    patterns: Mapping[str, str],
    failed_checks: list[str],
    redacted_items: list[str],
) -> tuple[str, int]:
    total_hits = 0
    sanitized = text

    for label, pattern in patterns.items():
        matches = re.findall(pattern, sanitized, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if matches:
            sanitized = re.sub(pattern, REDACTION_TOKEN, sanitized, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            total_hits += len(matches)
            redacted_items.append(label)
            failed_checks.append(f"redacted {label}")

    return sanitized, total_hits


def sanitize_output(payload: Any) -> OutputSanitizationResult:
    original_text = _extract_text(payload)
    failed_checks: list[str] = []
    redacted_items: list[str] = []

    sanitized_text, secret_hits = _redact_patterns(
        original_text,
        SECRET_PATTERNS,
        failed_checks,
        redacted_items,
    )
    sanitized_text, dangerous_hits = _redact_patterns(
        sanitized_text,
        DANGEROUS_OUTPUT_PATTERNS,
        failed_checks,
        redacted_items,
    )

    total_hits = secret_hits + dangerous_hits
    modified = sanitized_text != original_text
    risk_score = min(100, secret_hits * 30 + dangerous_hits * 20)

    if secret_hits > 0:
        verdict = "quarantine"
        reason = "sensitive secret material detected in output"
    elif dangerous_hits > 0:
        verdict = "warn"
        reason = "dangerous executable or exfiltration-style output detected"
    else:
        verdict = "allow"
        reason = "output passed sanitization checks"

    return OutputSanitizationResult(
        sanitized_text=sanitized_text,
        modified=modified,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        verdict=verdict,
        reason=reason,
        redacted_items=redacted_items,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "output_sanitizer"},
    )


def summarize_output_sanitizer(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return sanitize_output(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "SECRET_PATTERNS",
    "DANGEROUS_OUTPUT_PATTERNS",
    "REDACTION_TOKEN",
    "OutputSanitizationResult",
    "sanitize_output",
    "summarize_output_sanitizer",
]
