@dataclass(slots=True)
class SanitizerSignal:
    name: str
    weight: float
    evidence: str
    category: str


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SanitizationAction:
    kind: str
    start: int | None = None
    end: int | None = None
    replacement: str | None = None
    detail: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OutputSanitizationResult:
    original_text: str
    sanitized_text: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    reasons: list[str]
    signals: list[SanitizerSignal]
    actions: list[SanitizationAction]
    blocked: bool
    sanitized: bool
    analyzed_at: str = field(
        default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    )

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "original_text": self.original_text,
            "sanitized_text": self.sanitized_text,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": float(self.score),
            "confidence": float(self.confidence),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "signals": [
                {
                    "name": signal.name,
                    "weight": float(signal.weight),
                    "evidence": signal.evidence,
                    "category": signal.category,
                }
                for signal in self.signals
            ],
            "actions": [
                {
                    "kind": action.kind,
                    "start": action.start,
                    "end": action.end,
                    "replacement": action.replacement,
                    "detail": action.detail,
                }
                for action in self.actions
            ],
            "blocked": bool(self.blocked),
            "sanitized": bool(self.sanitized),
            "analyzed_at": self.analyzed_at,
        }


class OutputSanitizer:
    def sanitize(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        context: str | None = None,
        redact_secrets: bool = True,
        block_unsafe_commands: bool = True,
    ) -> OutputSanitizationResult:
        working = text or ""
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        actions: list[SanitizationAction] = []

        if redact_secrets and working:
            working, secret_signals, secret_actions = self._redact_by_patterns(
                working,
                SECRET_PATTERNS,
                replacement_builder=lambda name: f"[REDACTED_{name.upper()}]",
                category="secret",
            )
            signals.extend(secret_signals)
            actions.extend(secret_actions)

        if working:
            working, path_signals, path_actions = self._redact_by_patterns(
                working,
                PATH_PATTERNS,
                replacement_builder=lambda _name: "[REDACTED_PATH]",
                category="path",
            )
            signals.extend(path_signals)
            actions.extend(path_actions)

        if working:
            command_signals, command_actions = self._scan_commands(
                working,
                block_unsafe_commands=block_unsafe_commands,
            )
            signals.extend(command_signals)
            actions.extend(command_actions)

        if working:
            leak_signals = self._scan_prompt_leaks(working, context=context)
            signals.extend(leak_signals)

        deduped_signals = self._dedupe_signals(signals)
        score = self._resolve_score(deduped_signals)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(score)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(
            deduped_signals,
            score,
            block_unsafe_commands=block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        blocked = verdict == "block"

        if blocked:
            blocked_message = self._blocked_message(deduped_signals)
            working = blocked_message
            actions.append(
                SanitizationAction(
                    kind="replace_all",
                    start=0,
                    end=len(blocked_message),
                    replacement=blocked_message,
                    detail="Replaced entire output because blocking indicators were present.",
                )
            )

        sanitized = working != text
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(
            deduped_signals,
            sanitized=sanitized,
            blocked=blocked,
        )
        reasons = self._build_reasons(
            signals=deduped_signals,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            context=context,
            sanitized=sanitized,
            blocked=blocked,
        )

        return OutputSanitizationResult(
            original_text=text,
            sanitized_text=working,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            reasons=reasons,
            signals=deduped_signals,
            actions=actions,
            blocked=blocked,
            sanitized=sanitized,
        )

    def _redact_by_patterns(
        self,
        text: str,
        pattern_specs: Iterable[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str], float]],
        *,
        replacement_builder: Callable[[str], str],
        category: str,
    ) -> tuple[str, list[SanitizerSignal], list[SanitizationAction]]:
        updated = text
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        actions: list[SanitizationAction] = []

        for name, pattern, weight in pattern_specs:
            search_offset = 0
            replacement_label = replacement_builder(name)
            while True:
                match = pattern.search(updated, search_offset)
                if not match:
                    break

                matched_value = match.group(0)
                start, end = match.span()
                updated = f"{updated[:start]}{replacement_label}{updated[end:]}"
                search_offset = start + len(replacement_label)

                signals.append(
                    SanitizerSignal(
                        name=name,
                        weight=float(weight),
                        evidence=self._clip_evidence(matched_value),
                        category=category,
                    )
                )
                actions.append(
                    SanitizationAction(
                        kind="redact",
                        start=start,
                        end=start + len(replacement_label),
                        replacement=replacement_label,
                        detail=f"Redacted {name}.",
                    )
                )

        return updated, signals, actions

    def _scan_commands(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        block_unsafe_commands: bool,
    ) -> tuple[list[SanitizerSignal], list[SanitizationAction]]:
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        actions: list[SanitizationAction] = []

        if not text:
            return signals, actions

        for name, pattern, disposition, weight in COMMAND_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                evidence = self._clip_evidence(match.group(0))
                adjusted_weight = float(weight) if block_unsafe_commands else float(
                    min(weight, 0.22)
                )
                signals.append(
                    SanitizerSignal(
                        name=name,
                        weight=adjusted_weight,
                        evidence=evidence,
                        category="command",
                    )
                )
                actions.append(
                    SanitizationAction(
                        kind="flag",
                        start=match.start(),
                        end=match.end(),
                        detail=f"Detected command pattern {name} with disposition {disposition}.",
                    )
                )

        return signals, actions

    def _scan_prompt_leaks(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        context: str | None,
    ) -> list[SanitizerSignal]:
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        if not text:
            return signals

        context_lower = context.lower() if context else ""
        is_prompt_context = "prompt" in context_lower

        for name, pattern, weight in PROMPT_LEAK_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                adjusted = float(weight)
                if is_prompt_context:
                    adjusted = min(adjusted + 0.06, 0.5)
                signals.append(
                    SanitizerSignal(
                        name=name,
                        weight=adjusted,
                        evidence=self._clip_evidence(match.group(0)),
                        category="policy",
                    )
                )
        return signals

    def _resolve_score(self, signals: list[SanitizerSignal]) -> float:
        if not signals:
            return 0.0
        total = sum(float(signal.weight) for signal in signals)
        if any(signal.name == "private_key_block" for signal in signals):
            total = max(total, 0.92)
        return round(min(total, 1.0), 4)

    def _resolve_severity(self, score: float) -> str:
        if score >= 0.85:
            return "critical"
        if score >= 0.55:
            return "high"
        if score >= 0.25:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_verdict(
        self,
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal],
        score: float,
        *,
        block_unsafe_commands: bool,
    ) -> str:
        if not signals:
            return "allow"

        names = {signal.name for signal in signals}
        secret_hits = sum(1 for signal in signals if signal.category == "secret")
        command_hits = sum(1 for signal in signals if signal.category == "command")

        if "private_key_block" in names:
            return "block"
        if block_unsafe_commands and command_hits > 0 and score >= 0.48:
            return "block"
        if secret_hits >= 2 or score >= 0.48:
            return "sanitize"
        if score >= 0.18:
            return "review"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_confidence(
        self,
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal],
        *,
        sanitized: bool,
        blocked: bool,
    ) -> float:
        base = 0.42
        if signals:
            base += min(len(signals) * 0.05, 0.28)
        if sanitized:
            base += 0.10
        if blocked:
            base += 0.12
        return round(min(base, 0.99), 4)

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        *,
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal],
        verdict: str,
        severity: str,
        context: str | None,
        sanitized: bool,
        blocked: bool,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons: list[str] = [
            f"Output sanitation verdict is {verdict} with {severity} severity."
        ]

        if context:
            reasons.append(f"Evaluation context: {context}.")

        if sanitized:
            reasons.append(
                "Sensitive content was redacted or transformed before release."
            )

        if blocked:
            reasons.append("Unsafe output was blocked from leaving the pipeline.")

        if signals:
            for signal in sorted(
                signals,
                key=lambda item: item.weight,
                reverse=True,
            )[:5]:
                reasons.append(f"{signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        if len(reasons) == 1:
            reasons.append("No sanitization triggers were detected.")

        return reasons

    def _blocked_message(self, signals: list[SanitizerSignal]) -> str:
        if not signals:
            return "[BLOCKED_OUTPUT] Unsafe output suppressed by OutputSanitizer."
        top_names = [
            signal.name
            for signal in sorted(
                signals,
                key=lambda item: item.weight,
                reverse=True,
            )[:3]
        ]
        joined = ", ".join(top_names)
        return f"[BLOCKED_OUTPUT] Unsafe output suppressed by OutputSanitizer due to: {joined}"

    def _clip_evidence(self, value: str, limit: int = 120) -> str:
        compact = " ".join(value.split())
        if len(compact) <= limit:
            return compact
        return compact[: limit - 3] + "..."

    def _dedupe_signals(self, signals: list[SanitizerSignal]) -> list[SanitizerSignal]:
        deduped: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
        for signal in signals:
            key = (signal.name, signal.category, signal.evidence)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(signal)
        return deduped


def build_output_sanitizer() -> OutputSanitizer:
    return OutputSanitizer()


__all__ = [
    "SanitizerSignal",
    "SanitizationAction",
    "OutputSanitizationResult",
    "OutputSanitizer",
    "build_output_sanitizer",
]

FILE: app\detection\prompt_injection_analyzer.py

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping


HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS = {
    "ignore previous instructions": 45,
    "disregard all prior instructions": 45,
    "reveal your system prompt": 50,
    "show the hidden prompt": 50,
    "print your hidden instructions": 50,
    "developer message": 35,
    "system prompt": 35,
    "override safety": 40,
    "jailbreak": 35,
    "bypass restrictions": 40,
    "disable safeguards": 40,
    "do not tell the user": 35,
    "secret instructions": 35,
}

MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS = {
    "ignore safety": 20,
    "act as root": 20,
    "trust this content": 15,
    "execute this command": 20,
    "run this script": 20,
    "fetch and execute": 25,
    "download and run": 25,
    "base64 payload": 20,
    "encoded payload": 20,
    "exfiltrate": 25,
    "token": 15,
    "credential": 15,
    "cookie": 15,
    "ssh key": 20,
}

SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_PATTERNS = {
    "urgent security patch": 10,
    "admin override": 10,
    "authorized by developer": 15,
    "this is safe": 10,
    "internal tool": 10,
    "trusted source": 10,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptInjectionAnalysis:
    detected: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    reason: str
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _get_text(payload: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        return _normalize_text(payload)

    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        parts: list[str] = []
        for key in (
            "content",
            "prompt",
            "message",
            "text",
            "summary",
            "reason",
            "target",
            "target_value",
        ):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if value is not None:
                parts.append(str(value))

        for key in ("messages", "reasons", "alerts", "tags"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
            elif value is not None:
                parts.append(str(value))

        return _normalize_text(" | ".join(parts))

    return _normalize_text(payload)


def _score_patterns(text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    matched: list[str] = []

    for pattern, weight in HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    for pattern, weight in MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    for pattern, weight in SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    return min(100, score), matched


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 70:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 35:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def analyze_prompt_injection(payload: Any) -> PromptInjectionAnalysis:
    text = _get_text(payload)
    score, matched_patterns = _score_patterns(text)
    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(score)

    detected = score >= 35
    failed_checks = []

    if matched_patterns:
        failed_checks.append("prompt injection indicators detected")

    if any("system prompt" in pattern or "hidden" in pattern for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("sensitive instruction extraction attempt detected")

    if any("execute" in pattern or "run" in pattern for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("execution coercion language detected")

    if any("token" in pattern or "credential" in pattern or "cookie" in pattern for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("secret extraction language detected")

    reason = (
        matched_patterns[0]
        if matched_patterns
        else "no prompt injection indicators detected"
    )

    return PromptInjectionAnalysis(
        detected=detected,
        risk_score=score,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        reason=reason,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "prompt_injection_analyzer"},
    )


def summarize_prompt_injection(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return analyze_prompt_injection(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS",
    "MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS",
    "SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_PATTERNS",
    "PromptInjectionAnalysis",
    "analyze_prompt_injection",
    "summarize_prompt_injection",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import binascii
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretFinding:
    label: str
    secret_type: str
    severity: str
    confidence: float
    start: int
    end: int
    match_text: str
    redacted_value: str
    risk_delta: int
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "label": self.label,
            "secret_type": self.secret_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "start": self.start,
            "end": self.end,
            "match_text": self.match_text,
            "redacted_value": self.redacted_value,
            "risk_delta": self.risk_delta,
            "details": dict(self.details),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretScanResult:
    found: bool
    findings: list[SecretFinding]
    risk_delta: int
    scanned_bytes: int
    truncated: bool
    summary: dict[str, int]

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "found": self.found,
            "findings": [finding.as_dict() for finding in self.findings],
            "risk_delta": self.risk_delta,
            "scanned_bytes": self.scanned_bytes,
            "truncated": self.truncated,
            "summary": dict(self.summary),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _SecretRule:
    label: str
    secret_type: str
    severity: str
    risk_delta: int
    confidence: float
    pattern: re.Pattern[str]
    min_match_length: int = 0


class SecretScanner:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        max_scan_bytes: int = 512_000,
        max_findings: int = 100,
    ) -> None:
        self.max_scan_bytes = max_scan_bytes
        self.max_findings = max_findings
        self._rules = _build_rules()

    def scan_text(self, value: Any) -> SecretScanResult:
        text = self._to_text(value)
        scanned_text, truncated = self._truncate_text(text)
        findings = self._scan_string(scanned_text)
        return SecretScanResult(
            found=bool(findings),
            findings=findings,
            risk_delta=sum(finding.risk_delta for finding in findings),
            scanned_bytes=len(scanned_text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")),
            truncated=truncated,
            summary=self._summarize(findings),
        )

    def scan_arguments(self, arguments: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        normalized = self._serialize_json(arguments or {})
        return self.scan_text(normalized)

    def scan_metadata(self, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        normalized = self._serialize_json(metadata or {})
        return self.scan_text(normalized)

    def scan_payload(
        self,
        *,
        tool_name: str | None = None,
        arguments: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        content: Any = None,
    ) -> SecretScanResult:
        payload = {
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "arguments": arguments or {},
            "metadata": metadata or {},
            "content": content,
        }
        return self.scan_text(self._serialize_json(payload))

    def scan_lines(self, lines: Sequence[str] | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        return self.scan_text("\n".join(lines or []))

    def scan_bytes(self, value: bytes | bytearray | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        if not value:
            return SecretScanResult(
                found=False,
                findings=[],
                risk_delta=0,
                scanned_bytes=0,
                truncated=False,
                summary={},
            )
        text = value.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        return self.scan_text(text)

    def _scan_string(self, text: str) -> list[SecretFinding]:
        findings: list[SecretFinding] = []
        occupied: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []

        for rule in self._rules:
            for match in rule.pattern.finditer(text):
                start, end = match.span()
                token = match.group(0)

                if len(token.strip()) < rule.min_match_length:
                    continue
                if self._should_skip_match(rule, token):
                    continue
                if self._overlaps_more_specific(occupied, start, end, rule.secret_type):
                    continue

                findings.append(
                    SecretFinding(
                        label=rule.label,
                        secret_type=rule.secret_type,
                        severity=rule.severity,
                        confidence=rule.confidence,
                        start=start,
                        end=end,
                        match_text=token,
                        redacted_value=self._redact_token(token),
                        risk_delta=rule.risk_delta,
                        details={
                            "fingerprint": self._fingerprint(token),
                            "length": len(token),
                        },
                    )
                )
                occupied.append((start, end, rule.secret_type))

                if len(findings) >= self.max_findings:
                    return findings

        return findings

    def _should_skip_match(self, rule: _SecretRule, token: str) -> bool:
        lowered = token.lower().strip()

        if "example" in lowered or "sample" in lowered or "test" in lowered:
            if rule.secret_type in {
                "aws_secret_key",
                "github_token",
                "slack_token",
                "private_key",
                "jwt",
                "bearer_token",
                "generic_api_key",
            }:
                return True

        if rule.secret_type == "generic_api_key":
            return self._looks_low_entropy(token)

        if rule.secret_type == "bearer_token":
            return self._looks_low_entropy(token.split(None, 1)[-1])

        if rule.secret_type == "jwt":
            return not self._looks_like_jwt(token)

        if rule.secret_type == "base64_blob":
            return self._looks_low_entropy(token)

        return False

    def _looks_low_entropy(self, token: str) -> bool:
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]", "", token)
        if len(cleaned) < 16:
            return True

        unique_ratio = len(set(cleaned)) / max(len(cleaned), 1)
        if unique_ratio < 0.22:
            return True

        entropy = self._shannon_entropy(cleaned)
        return entropy < 3.2

    def _looks_like_jwt(self, token: str) -> bool:
        parts = token.split(".")
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return False
        for part in parts[:2]:
            if not self._is_base64url_segment(part):
                return False
        return True

    def _is_base64url_segment(self, value: str) -> bool:
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", value):
            return False
        padding = "=" * ((4 - len(value) % 4) % 4)
        try:
            base64.urlsafe_b64decode(value + padding)
        except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
            return False
        return True

    def _shannon_entropy(self, value: str) -> float:
        if not value:
            return 0.0
        counts = {char: value.count(char) for char in set(value)}
        length = len(value)
        return -sum((count / length) * math.log2(count / length) for count in counts.values())

    def _overlaps_more_specific(
        self,
        occupied: Iterable[tuple[int, int, str]],
        start: int,
        end: int,
        secret_type: str,
    ) -> bool:
        for existing_start, existing_end, existing_type in occupied:
            overlap = not (end <= existing_start or start >= existing_end)
            if overlap and existing_type != secret_type:
                return True
        return False

    def _redact_token(self, token: str) -> str:
        stripped = token.strip()
        if len(stripped) <= 8:
            return "[REDACTED]"
        return f"{stripped[:4]}...[REDACTED]...{stripped[-4:]}"

    def _fingerprint(self, token: str) -> str:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")).hexdigest()
        return digest[:16]

    def _to_text(self, value: Any) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
            return value.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            return self._serialize_json(value)
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            return self._serialize_json(list(value))
        return str(value)

    def _serialize_json(self, value: Any) -> str:
        try:
            return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str)
        except Exception:
            return str(value)

    def _truncate_text(self, text: str) -> tuple[str, bool]:
        raw = text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if len(raw) <= self.max_scan_bytes:
            return text, False
        truncated = raw[: self.max_scan_bytes].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        return truncated, True

    def _summarize(self, findings: Sequence[SecretFinding]) -> dict[str, int]:
        summary: dict[str, int] = {}
        for finding in findings:
            summary[finding.secret_type] = summary.get(finding.secret_type, 0) + 1
        return summary


def build_secret_scanner(
    *,
    max_scan_bytes: int = 512_000,
    max_findings: int = 100,
) -> SecretScanner:
    return SecretScanner(
        max_scan_bytes=max_scan_bytes,
        max_findings=max_findings,
    )


def _build_rules() -> list[_SecretRule]:
    return [
        _SecretRule(
            label="aws-access-key-id",
            secret_type="aws_access_key_id",
            severity="high",
            risk_delta=30,
            confidence=0.99,
            pattern=re.compile(r"\b(?:A3T|AKIA|ASIA|AGPA|AIDA|AROA|ANPA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b"),
            min_match_length=20,
        ),
        _SecretRule(
            label="aws-secret-access-key",
            secret_type="aws_secret_key",
            severity="critical",
            risk_delta=60,
            confidence=0.95,
            pattern=re.compile(

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.detection.artifact_analyzer import analyze_artifact
from app.detection.download_analyzer import analyze_download
from app.detection.prompt_injection_analyzer import analyze_prompt_injection
from app.detection.output_sanitizer import sanitize_output


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SessionRiskAssessment:
    session_id: str
    client_id: str
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    reason: str
    component_scores: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 80:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 40:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def assess_session_risk(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> SessionRiskAssessment:
    session_id = str(_get_value(payload, "session_id") or "")
    client_id = str(_get_value(payload, "client_id", "actor_id") or "")

    prompt_result = analyze_prompt_injection(payload)
    download_result = analyze_download(payload)
    artifact_result = analyze_artifact(payload)
    output_result = sanitize_output(payload)

    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    component_scores = {
        "base": base_risk,
        "prompt_injection": prompt_result.risk_score,
        "download": download_result.risk_score,
        "artifact": artifact_result.risk_score,
        "output": output_result.risk_score,
    }

    weighted_score = min(
        100,
        base_risk
        + int(prompt_result.risk_score * 0.35)
        + int(download_result.risk_score * 0.20)
        + int(artifact_result.risk_score * 0.20)
        + int(output_result.risk_score * 0.25),
    )

    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(weighted_score)

    matched_patterns = [
        *prompt_result.matched_patterns,
        *download_result.matched_patterns,
        *artifact_result.matched_patterns,
        *output_result.redacted_items,
    ]

    failed_checks = [
        *prompt_result.failed_checks,
        *download_result.failed_checks,
        *artifact_result.failed_checks,
        *output_result.failed_checks,
    ]

    reason = (
        prompt_result.reason
        if prompt_result.detected
        else download_result.reason
        if download_result.detected
        else artifact_result.reason
        if artifact_result.detected
        else output_result.reason
    )

    return SessionRiskAssessment(
        session_id=session_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        risk_score=weighted_score,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        reason=reason,
        component_scores=component_scores,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "session_risk"},
    )


def summarize_session_risk(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return assess_session_risk(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "SessionRiskAssessment",
    "assess_session_risk",
    "summarize_session_risk",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any


VERDICT_RANK = {
    "allow": 1,
    "monitor": 2,
    "review": 3,
    "block": 4,
}

SEVERITY_RANK = {
    "low": 1,
    "medium": 2,
    "high": 3,
    "critical": 4,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SessionEvent:
    source: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    timestamp: str
    detail: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SessionRiskFactor:
    name: str
    weight: float
    evidence: str
    category: str


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SessionRiskResult:
    session_id: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    event_count: int
    factors: list[SessionRiskFactor]
    reasons: list[str]
    escalated: bool
    first_seen_at: str | None
    last_seen_at: str | None
    analyzed_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": self.score,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "event_count": self.event_count,
            "factors": [
                {
                    "name": factor.name,
                    "weight": factor.weight,
                    "evidence": factor.evidence,
                    "category": factor.category,
                }
                for factor in self.factors
            ],
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "escalated": self.escalated,
            "first_seen_at": self.first_seen_at,
            "last_seen_at": self.last_seen_at,
            "analyzed_at": self.analyzed_at,
        }


class SessionRiskAnalyzer:
    def analyze(
        self,
        *,
        session_id: str,
        events: list[SessionEvent | dict[str, Any]],
        active_review: bool = False,
        recent_window_minutes: int = 30,
    ) -> SessionRiskResult:
        normalized_events = [self._normalize_event(event) for event in events]
        normalized_events.sort(key=lambda item: item.timestamp)

        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        if not normalized_events:
            return SessionRiskResult(
                session_id=session_id,
                verdict="allow",
                severity="low",
                score=0.0,
                confidence=0.42,
                event_count=0,
                factors=[],
                reasons=["No session events were available for risk aggregation."],
                escalated=False,
                first_seen_at=None,
                last_seen_at=None,
            )

        factors.extend(self._score_verdict_pressure(normalized_events))
        factors.extend(self._score_severity_pressure(normalized_events))
        factors.extend(self._score_repeat_hits(normalized_events))
        factors.extend(self._score_burst_activity(normalized_events, recent_window_minutes=recent_window_minutes))
        factors.extend(self._score_multi_source_activity(normalized_events))
        factors.extend(self._score_recentness(normalized_events, recent_window_minutes=recent_window_minutes))

        if active_review:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="active_review_queue",
                    weight=0.16,
                    evidence="Session is already attached to an active human or policy review workflow.",
                    category="workflow",
                )
            )

        factors = self._dedupe_factors(factors)
        score = self._resolve_score(normalized_events, factors)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(normalized_events, score, active_review=active_review)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(normalized_events, score)
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(normalized_events, factors, active_review=active_review)
        reasons = self._build_reasons(
            normalized_events,
            factors,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            active_review=active_review,
        )

        return SessionRiskResult(
            session_id=session_id,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            event_count=len(normalized_events),
            factors=factors,
            reasons=reasons,
            escalated=verdict in {"review", "block"},
            first_seen_at=normalized_events[0].timestamp,
            last_seen_at=normalized_events[-1].timestamp,
        )

    def _normalize_event(self, event: SessionEvent | dict[str, Any]) -> SessionEvent:
        if isinstance(event, SessionEvent):
            return event

        return SessionEvent(
            source=str(event.get("source", "unknown")),
            verdict=str(event.get("verdict", "allow")),
            severity=str(event.get("severity", "low")),
            score=float(event.get("score", 0.0)),
            timestamp=self._normalize_timestamp(event.get("timestamp")),
            detail=event.get("detail"),
            metadata=dict(event.get("metadata", {}) or {}),
        )

    def _normalize_timestamp(self, value: Any) -> str:
        if isinstance(value, datetime):
            if value.tzinfo is None:
                value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()

        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            if parsed.tzinfo is None:
                parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()

        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _score_verdict_pressure(self, events: list[SessionEvent]) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        review_count = sum(1 for event in events if event.verdict == "review")
        block_count = sum(1 for event in events if event.verdict == "block")
        monitor_count = sum(1 for event in events if event.verdict == "monitor")

        if monitor_count:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="monitor_verdicts",
                    weight=min(0.20, monitor_count * 0.05),
                    evidence=f"Session accumulated {monitor_count} monitor verdict event(s).",
                    category="verdict",
                )
            )
        if review_count:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="review_verdicts",
                    weight=min(0.36, review_count * 0.12),
                    evidence=f"Session accumulated {review_count} review verdict event(s).",
                    category="verdict",
                )
            )
        if block_count:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="block_verdicts",
                    weight=min(0.55, block_count * 0.22),
                    evidence=f"Session accumulated {block_count} block verdict event(s).",
                    category="verdict",
                )
            )

        return factors

    def _score_severity_pressure(self, events: list[SessionEvent]) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        high_events = [event for event in events if event.severity in {"high", "critical"}]
        critical_events = [event for event in events if event.severity == "critical"]

        if high_events:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="high_severity_presence",
                    weight=min(0.30, len(high_events) * 0.08),
                    evidence=f"{len(high_events)} event(s) were marked high or critical severity.",
                    category="severity",
                )
            )
        if critical_events:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="critical_severity_presence",
                    weight=min(0.44, len(critical_events) * 0.16),
                    evidence=f"{len(critical_events)} event(s) were marked critical severity.",
                    category="severity",
                )
            )

        return factors

    def _score_repeat_hits(self, events: list[SessionEvent]) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        source_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for event in events:
            source_counts[event.source] = source_counts.get(event.source, 0) + 1

        repeat_sources = {source: count for source, count in source_counts.items() if count >= 3}
        if repeat_sources:
            details = ", ".join(f"{source}:{count}" for source, count in sorted(repeat_sources.items()))
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="repeat_detector_hits",
                    weight=min(0.24, sum(repeat_sources.values()) * 0.03),
                    evidence=f"Repeated activity across detectors: {details}.",
                    category="pattern",
                )
            )

        return factors

    def _score_burst_activity(
        self,
        events: list[SessionEvent],
        *,
        recent_window_minutes: int,
    ) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        parsed_times = [datetime.fromisoformat(event.timestamp) for event in events]
        if not parsed_times:
            return factors

        window = timedelta(minutes=recent_window_minutes)
        max_hits = 0
        for index, anchor in enumerate(parsed_times):
            hits = 0
            for candidate in parsed_times[index:]:
                if candidate - anchor <= window:
                    hits += 1
            max_hits = max(max_hits, hits)

        if max_hits >= 4:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="burst_activity",
                    weight=min(0.22, max_hits * 0.04),
                    evidence=f"Session produced {max_hits} events within a {recent_window_minutes}-minute window.",
                    category="tempo",
                )
            )

        return factors

    def _score_multi_source_activity(self, events: list[SessionEvent]) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        unique_sources = {event.source for event in events}
        if len(unique_sources) >= 3:
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="multi_source_correlation",
                    weight=min(0.18, len(unique_sources) * 0.04),
                    evidence=f"Risk surfaced across {len(unique_sources)} independent sources.",
                    category="correlation",
                )
            )
        return factors

    def _score_recentness(
        self,
        events: list[SessionEvent],
        *,
        recent_window_minutes: int,
    ) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        last_seen = datetime.fromisoformat(events[-1].timestamp)
        age = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - last_seen

        if age <= timedelta(minutes=recent_window_minutes):
            factors.append(
                SessionRiskFactor(
                    name="recent_risk_activity",
                    weight=0.10,
                    evidence=f"Latest risky event was observed within the past {recent_window_minutes} minutes.",
                    category="tempo",
                )
            )

        return factors

    def _resolve_score(self, events: list[SessionEvent], factors: list[SessionRiskFactor]) -> float:
        event_pressure = 0.0
        for event in events:
            verdict_weight = {
                "allow": 0.00,
                "monitor": 0.05,
                "review": 0.12,
                "block": 0.24,
            }.get(event.verdict, 0.0)
            severity_weight = {
                "low": 0.00,
                "medium": 0.04,
                "high": 0.08,
                "critical": 0.14,
            }.get(event.severity, 0.0)
            event_pressure += min(event.score, 1.0) * 0.20 + verdict_weight + severity_weight

        factor_pressure = sum(factor.weight for factor in factors)
        total = min(event_pressure + factor_pressure, 1.0)
        return round(total, 4)

    def _resolve_verdict(self, events: list[SessionEvent], score: float, *, active_review: bool) -> str:
        strongest_verdict = max((VERDICT_RANK.get(event.verdict, 1) for event in events), default=1)

        if strongest_verdict >= VERDICT_RANK["block"] and score >= 0.68:
            return "block"
        if active_review or score >= 0.46 or strongest_verdict >= VERDICT_RANK["review"]:
            return "review"
        if score >= 0.18 or strongest_verdict >= VERDICT_RANK["monitor"]:
            return "monitor"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_severity(self, events: list[SessionEvent], score: float) -> str:
        strongest_severity = max((SEVERITY_RANK.get(event.severity, 1) for event in events), default=1)

        if strongest_severity >= SEVERITY_RANK["critical"] or score >= 0.82:
            return "critical"
        if strongest_severity >= SEVERITY_RANK["high"] or score >= 0.54:
            return "high"
        if strongest_severity >= SEVERITY_RANK["medium"] or score >= 0.24:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_confidence(
        self,
        events: list[SessionEvent],
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor],
        *,
        active_review: bool,
    ) -> float:
        base = 0.40
        base += min(len(events) * 0.04, 0.24)
        base += min(len(factors) * 0.05, 0.20)
        if active_review:
            base += 0.08
        return round(min(base, 0.99), 4)

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        events: list[SessionEvent],
        factors: list[SessionRiskFactor],
        *,
        verdict: str,
        severity: str,
        active_review: bool,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons = [
            f"Session risk resolved to {verdict} with {severity} severity across {len(events)} event(s)."
        ]

        if active_review:
            reasons.append("Session is already connected to an active review workflow.")

        for factor in sorted(factors, key=lambda item: item.weight, reverse=True)[:6]:
            reasons.append(f"{factor.name}: {factor.evidence}")

        strongest_event = max(events, key=lambda event: (event.score, VERDICT_RANK.get(event.verdict, 1)))
        reasons.append(
            f"Strongest single event came from {strongest_event.source} with verdict {strongest_event.verdict} and score {strongest_event.score:.4f}."
        )

        return reasons

    def _dedupe_factors(self, factors: list[SessionRiskFactor]) -> list[SessionRiskFactor]:
        deduped: list[SessionRiskFactor] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
        for factor in factors:
            key = (factor.name, factor.category, factor.evidence)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(factor)
        return deduped


def build_session_risk_analyzer() -> SessionRiskAnalyzer:
    return SessionRiskAnalyzer()


__all__ = [
    "SessionEvent",
    "SessionRiskFactor",
    "SessionRiskResult",
    "SessionRiskAnalyzer",
    "build_session_risk_analyzer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.orchestrator.secureruntimepipeline import SecureRuntimePipeline, getactionexecutepipeline
from app.service import ActionExecuteResult, ExecutionReason, executeguardedaction


router = APIRouter()


ResponseStatus = Literal["completed", "queuedforreview", "denied"]
ExecutionState = Literal["executed", "denied", "queuedforreview"]
PolicyVerdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class ExecuteRequest(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str = Field(..., description="Action type, such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="Execution target such as URL, shell, or tool name.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Prompt, content, or execution description.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score for the action.")
    clientid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Client or actor identifier.")
    sessionid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Session or conversation identifier.")
    filepath: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description="Optional source filepath for attribution and audit visibility.",
    )


class ExecuteReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class ExecuteResponse(BaseModel):
    executionid: Optional[str] = None
    executionstate: ExecutionState
    responseaction: str
    responsestatus: ResponseStatus
    traceid: Optional[str] = None
    requestid: Optional[str] = None
    decisionid: Optional[str] = None
    policyverdict: PolicyVerdict
    riskscore: int
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    reviewitemid: Optional[str] = None
    executorname: Optional[str] = None
    executorresult: Optional[dict] = None
    reason: Optional[str] = None
    reasons: list[ExecuteReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    filepath: Optional[str] = None
    promptinjection: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _normalize_responsestatus(value: str | None) -> ResponseStatus:
    if not value:
        return "completed"

    lowered = str(value).lower()
    if lowered in {"completed", "done", "ok", "success"}:
        return "completed"
    if lowered in {"queuedforreview", "queued", "pending_review", "review"}:
        return "queuedforreview"
    if lowered in {"denied", "blocked", "forbidden", "403"}:
        return "denied"

    if lowered in {"200", "201", "202"}:
        return "completed"
    return "denied"


def _normalize_executionstate(value: str | None) -> ExecutionState:
    if not value:
        return "executed"

    lowered = str(value).lower()
    if lowered in {"executed", "completed", "succeeded"}:
        return "executed"
    if lowered in {"queuedforreview", "queued", "pending_review", "review"}:
        return "queuedforreview"
    if lowered in {"denied", "blocked", "forbidden", "failed"}:
        return "denied"
    return "executed"


def _normalize_policyverdict(value: str | None) -> PolicyVerdict:
    if not value:
        return "allow"

    lowered = str(value).lower()
    if lowered in {"allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"}:
        return lowered  # type: ignore[return-value]
    if lowered in {"deny", "denied", "forbidden"}:
        return "block"
    return "allow"


def _normalize_reason(reason: ExecutionReason | dict | str) -> ExecuteReasonView:
    if isinstance(reason, ExecutionReason):
        return ExecuteReasonView(
            source=reason.source,
            label=reason.label,
            details=reason.details,
            score=reason.score,
        )

    if isinstance(reason, dict):
        return ExecuteReasonView(
            source=str(reason.get("source", "runtime")),
            label=str(reason.get("label", "Execution reason")),
            details=str(reason.get("details", "")),
            score=int(reason.get("score", 0)),
        )

    return ExecuteReasonView(
        source="runtime",
        label="Execution reason",
        details=str(reason),
        score=0,
    )


def _normalize_reasons(reasons: list[ExecutionReason] | list[dict] | list[str] | None) -> list[ExecuteReasonView]:
    if not reasons:
        return []
    return [_normalize_reason(reason) for reason in reasons]


def guardandexecuteraw(
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> ActionExecuteResult:
    return executeguardedaction(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        pipeline=pipeline,
    )


def guardandexecuteaction(
    payload: ExecuteRequest,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> ExecuteResponse:
    result = guardandexecuteraw(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        pipeline=pipeline,
    )

    return ExecuteResponse(
        executionid=result.executionid,
        executionstate=_normalize_executionstate(result.executionstate),
        responseaction=result.responseaction,
        responsestatus=_normalize_responsestatus(result.responsestatus),
        traceid=result.traceid,
        requestid=result.requestid,
        decisionid=result.decisionid,
        policyverdict=_normalize_policyverdict(result.policyverdict),
        riskscore=result.riskscore,
        shouldexecute=result.shouldexecute,
        haltedbyboundary=result.haltedbyboundary,
        reviewitemid=result.reviewitemid,
        executorname=result.executorname,
        executorresult=result.executorresult,
        reason=result.reason,
        reasons=_normalize_reasons(result.reasons),
        filepath=result.filepath,
        promptinjection=dict(result.promptinjection or {}),
    )


@router.post(
    "/guard/execute",
    response_model=ExecuteResponse,
    summary="Guard and execute an action through the secure runtime pipeline.",
)
def guardedexecute(
    payload: ExecuteRequest,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline = Depends(getactionexecutepipeline),
) -> ExecuteResponse:
    return guardandexecuteaction(payload, pipeline)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from app.dependencies.action_execute import get_action_execute_pipeline
from app.models.action_execute_result import ActionExecuteResult, ExecutionReason
from app.orchestrator.executor_boundary import (
    execute_with_boundary,
    summarize_execution_receipt,
)
from app.orchestrator.secure_runtime_pipeline import SecureRuntimePipeline


def executeguardedaction(
    *,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    risk_score: int,
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> ActionExecuteResult:
    active_pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline = (
        pipeline if pipeline is not None else get_action_execute_pipeline()
    )

    effective_file_path = file_path or "app/api/action_execute.py"

    receipt, runtime_result = execute_with_boundary(
        pipeline=active_pipeline,
        actor_id=client_id,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        session_id=session_id,
        file_path=effective_file_path,
        metadata={"source": "service.execute"},
        executor=None,
    )

    summary: dict[str, Any] = summarize_execution_receipt(receipt, runtime_result)

    raw_reasons = summary.get("reasons") or []
    reasons: list[ExecutionReason] = []
    for raw in raw_reasons:
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": raw.get("source", "policy"),
                    "label": raw.get("label", raw.get("reason", "reason")),
                    "details": raw.get("details", str(raw)),
                    "score": raw.get("score"),
                }
            )
        else:
            text = str(raw)
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "policy",
                    "label": text[:80],
                    "details": text,
                    "score": None,
                }
            )

    result: ActionExecuteResult = {
        "execution_id": summary["execution_id"],
        "execution_state": summary["execution_state"],
        "response_action": summary["response_action"],
        "response_status": summary["response_status"],
        "trace_id": summary["trace_id"],
        "request_id": summary["request_id"],
        "decision_id": summary["decision_id"],
        "policy_verdict": summary["policy_verdict"],
        "risk_score": risk_score,
        "should_execute": summary["should_execute"],
        "halted_by_boundary": summary["halted_by_boundary"],
        "review_item_id": summary["review_item_id"],
        "executor_name": summary["executor_name"],
        "executor_result": summary["executor_result"],
        "reason": summary["reason"],
        "reasons": reasons,
    }

    return result

from __future__ import annotations

from app.orchestrator.secureruntimepipeline import SecureRuntimePipeline


DEFAULT_FILEPATH = "app/api/action_execute.py"


def _normalize_executor_result(summary: dict) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(summary, dict):
        return {}

    executor_result = summary.get("executor_result")
    if isinstance(executor_result, dict):
        executor_result.setdefault("filepath", DEFAULT_FILEPATH)

    return summary


def get_action_execute_pipeline() -> SecureRuntimePipeline:
    return SecureRuntimePipeline()


def guard_and_execute_action(payload, pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None) -> dict:
    pipeline = pipeline or get_action_execute_pipeline()

    summary = pipeline.guard_and_execute(
        action_type=payload.action_type,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        risk_score=payload.risk_score,
        client_id=payload.client_id,
        session_id=payload.session_id,
        filepath=payload.filepath or DEFAULT_FILEPATH,
    )

    if not isinstance(summary, dict):
        summary = {}

    summary = _normalize_executor_result(summary)

    if "response_status" not in summary:
        if summary.get("should_execute") is False or summary.get("halted_by_boundary") is True:
            summary["response_status"] = "denied"
        elif summary.get("execution_state") == "executed":
            summary["response_status"] = "completed"
        else:
            summary["response_status"] = "queued_for_review"

    return summary

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

import anyio
import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.routes.billing import PACKAGE_CATALOG  # If you need pricing context
from app.core.unit_wallet import get_unit_wallet_registry


router = APIRouter(prefix="/claude-guard-router", tags=["claude-guard-router"])


GuardMode = Literal["assist", "enforce"]
VerdictType = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class GuardedStreamConfig(BaseModel):
    upstream_url: str
    guard_base_url: str
    guard_mode: GuardMode = Field(description="assist = never truncate, enforce = truncate on block")
    timeout_seconds: float = 30.0
    connect_timeout_seconds: float = 5.0


class GuardBundleVerdict(BaseModel):
    verdict: VerdictType
    reason: str = ""
    truncated: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class GuardProxyRequest(BaseModel):
    upstream_url: str
    guard_base_url: str
    guard_mode: GuardMode = "enforce"
    upstreampayload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    guard_payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class GuardProxyResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    mode: GuardMode
    verdict: VerdictType
    reason: str
    truncated: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class _GuardHttpClient:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None

    async def startup(self) -> None:
        if self._client is None:
            self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(30.0))

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        if self._client is not None:
            await self._client.aclose()
            self._client = None

    @property
    def client(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        if self._client is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Guard HTTP client not initialized")
        return self._client


_guard_http_client = _GuardHttpClient()


@router.on_event("startup")
async def _startup_guard_http_client() -> None:
    await _guard_http_client.startup()


@router.on_event("shutdown")
async def _shutdown_guard_http_client() -> None:
    await _guard_http_client.shutdown()


async def scan_with_policy_guard(
    guard_base_url: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> GuardBundleVerdict:
    """
    Call the policy guard bundle route once per request using the shared AsyncClient.
    This function is intentionally small; tests monkeypatch httpx.AsyncClient to
    intercept POSTs to the guard bundle URL.
    """
    client = _guard_http_client.client
    url = guard_base_url.rstrip("/") + "/policy/guard-bundle"

    try:
        response = await client.post(url, json=payload)
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Guard service error: {exc}") from exc

    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Guard service returned {response.status_code}")

    data = response.json()
    verdict = str(data.get("verdict", "allow"))
    reason = str(data.get("reason", ""))
    truncated = bool(data.get("truncated", False))
    metadata = dict(data.get("metadata") or {})

    return GuardBundleVerdict(
        verdict=verdict,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        reason=reason,
        truncated=truncated,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


async def _stream_upstream(
    upstream_url: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
    """
    Minimal upstream streaming helper; tests will usually mock this path, so we
    keep behavior simple and predictable.
    """
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(30.0)) as client:
        async with client.stream("POST", upstream_url, json=payload) as response:
            async for chunk in response.aiter_bytes():
                if not chunk:
                    continue
                yield chunk


async def _guarded_upstream_stream(
    cfg: GuardedStreamConfig,
    upstreampayload: dict[str, Any],
    guard_payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
    """
    Wrap the upstream stream with a policy guard decision.

    - assist mode: never truncates the upstream; just annotates metadata.
    - enforce mode: if guard verdict is block, truncate the stream and yield
      a short blocked message instead of the full upstream payload.
    """
    verdict = await scan_with_policy_guard(cfg.guard_base_url, guard_payload)
    mode = cfg.guard_mode

    if mode == "enforce" and verdict.verdict == "block":
        # Enforce truncation: yield a short blocked message for the stream.
        message = verdict.reason or "Request blocked by policy guard."
        yield message.encode("utf-8")
        return

    async for chunk in _stream_upstream(cfg.upstream_url, upstreampayload):
        yield chunk


@asynccontextmanager
async def _guarded_stream_context(
    cfg: GuardedStreamConfig,
    upstreampayload: dict[str, Any],
    guard_payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> AsyncIterator[AsyncIterator[bytes]]:
    """
    Async context manager to provide a guarded upstream stream suitable for use
    in StreamingResponse, while making it easy to reason about lifecycle in tests.
    """
    gen = _guarded_upstream_stream(cfg, upstreampayload, guard_payload)
    try:
        yield gen
    finally:
        # Make sure the async generator is fully closed even on error.
        await gen.aclose()


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_model=GuardProxyResponse,
)
async def guard_proxy_summary(payload: GuardProxyRequest) -> GuardProxyResponse:
    """
    Non-streaming summary endpoint that simply calls the guard bundle and
    returns the decision in a structured response.
    """
    verdict = await scan_with_policy_guard(payload.guard_base_url, payload.guard_payload)

    truncated = verdict.truncated or (payload.guard_mode == "enforce" and verdict.verdict == "block")

    return GuardProxyResponse(
        status="ok",
        mode=payload.guard_mode,
        verdict=verdict.verdict,
        reason=verdict.reason,
        truncated=truncated,
        metadata=verdict.metadata,
    )


@router.post(
    "/proxy-stream",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
)
async def guard_proxy_stream(
    payload: GuardProxyRequest,
    request: Request,
) -> StreamingResponse:
    """
    Streaming proxy endpoint used by tests:

    - Calls the guard bundle first to get a verdict.
    - In enforce mode, truncates the upstream stream on block.
    - In assist mode, always passes through the upstream stream.
    """
    cfg = GuardedStreamConfig(
        upstream_url=payload.upstream_url,
        guard_base_url=payload.guard_base_url,
        guard_mode=payload.guard_mode,
    )

    stream_cm = _guarded_stream_context(cfg, payload.upstreampayload, payload.guard_payload)

    async def event_stream() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        async with stream_cm as guarded_stream:
            async for chunk in guarded_stream:
                # Allow client disconnects to gracefully stop iteration
                if await request.is_disconnected():
                    break
                yield chunk

    return StreamingResponse(
        event_stream(),
        media_type="application/json",
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IncidentOwner:
    owner_id: str
    display_name: str
    team: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "owner_id": self.owner_id,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "team": self.team,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IncidentRecord:
    incident_id: str
    title: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    source: str
    affected_surface: str
    opened_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    owner: IncidentOwner
    requires_human_review: bool = False
    quarantined_actions: int = 0
    blocked_actions: int = 0
    evidence_count: int = 0

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "incident_id": self.incident_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "status": self.status,
            "source": self.source,
            "affected_surface": self.affected_surface,
            "opened_at": _isoformat(self.opened_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(self.updated_at),
            "owner": self.owner.to_dict(),
            "requires_human_review": self.requires_human_review,
            "quarantined_actions": self.quarantined_actions,
            "blocked_actions": self.blocked_actions,
            "evidence_count": self.evidence_count,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IncidentsOverview:
    total_open: int = 0
    critical_open: int = 0
    high_open: int = 0
    under_review: int = 0
    contained: int = 0
    mean_time_to_contain_minutes: int = 0
    incidents: tuple[IncidentRecord, ...] = ()
    generated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "total_open": self.total_open,
            "critical_open": self.critical_open,
            "high_open": self.high_open,
            "under_review": self.under_review,
            "contained": self.contained,
            "mean_time_to_contain_minutes": self.mean_time_to_contain_minutes,
            "incidents": [item.to_dict() for item in self.incidents],
            "generated_at": _isoformat(self.generated_at),
        }


def _normalize_owner(value: Any) -> IncidentOwner:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return IncidentOwner(owner_id="", display_name="Unassigned", team="")
    return IncidentOwner(
        owner_id=_coerce_str(value.get("owner_id")),
        display_name=_coerce_str(value.get("display_name"), "Unassigned") or "Unassigned",
        team=_coerce_str(value.get("team")),
    )


def _normalize_incident(value: Any) -> IncidentRecord | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    incident_id = _coerce_str(value.get("incident_id"))
    title = _coerce_str(value.get("title"))
    if not incident_id and not title:
        return None

    opened_at = _coerce_datetime(value.get("opened_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()
    updated_at = _coerce_datetime(value.get("updated_at"), opened_at) or opened_at

    return IncidentRecord(
        incident_id=incident_id or "incident",
        title=title or "Untitled incident",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "medium") or "medium",
        status=_coerce_str(value.get("status"), "open") or "open",
        source=_coerce_str(value.get("source"), "runtime") or "runtime",
        affected_surface=_coerce_str(value.get("affected_surface"), "agent") or "agent",
        opened_at=opened_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
        owner=_normalize_owner(value.get("owner")),
        requires_human_review=_coerce_bool(value.get("requires_human_review"), False),
        quarantined_actions=max(0, _coerce_int(value.get("quarantined_actions"), 0)),
        blocked_actions=max(0, _coerce_int(value.get("blocked_actions"), 0)),
        evidence_count=max(0, _coerce_int(value.get("evidence_count"), 0)),
    )


def default_incidents_overview() -> IncidentsOverview:
    return IncidentsOverview()


def build_incidents_overview(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: IncidentsOverview | None = None,
) -> IncidentsOverview:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_incidents_overview()

    raw_incidents = source.get("incidents")
    if isinstance(raw_incidents, list):
        incidents = tuple(item for entry in raw_incidents if (item := _normalize_incident(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        incidents = current.incidents

    total_open = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("total_open"), current.total_open or len(incidents)))
    critical_open = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("critical_open"), current.critical_open))
    high_open = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("high_open"), current.high_open))
    under_review = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("under_review"), current.under_review))
    contained = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("contained"), current.contained))
    mean_time_to_contain_minutes = max(
        0,
        _coerce_int(source.get("mean_time_to_contain_minutes"), current.mean_time_to_contain_minutes),
    )

    if not source.get("total_open") and incidents:
        total_open = sum(1 for item in incidents if item.status.lower() in {"open", "investigating", "triage", "contained", "under_review"})
    if not source.get("critical_open") and incidents:
        critical_open = sum(
            1
            for item in incidents
            if item.severity.lower() == "critical" and item.status.lower() not in {"resolved", "closed"}
        )
    if not source.get("high_open") and incidents:
        high_open = sum(
            1
            for item in incidents
            if item.severity.lower() == "high" and item.status.lower() not in {"resolved", "closed"}
        )
    if not source.get("under_review") and incidents:
        under_review = sum(
            1
            for item in incidents
            if item.requires_human_review or item.status.lower() in {"under_review", "triage", "investigating"}
        )
    if not source.get("contained") and incidents:
        contained = sum(1 for item in incidents if item.status.lower() == "contained")

    return IncidentsOverview(
        total_open=total_open,
        critical_open=critical_open,
        high_open=high_open,
        under_review=under_review,
        contained=contained,
        mean_time_to_contain_minutes=mean_time_to_contain_minutes,
        incidents=incidents,
        generated_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("generated_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def incidents_overview_summary(overview: IncidentsOverview) -> dict[str, Any]:
    total_quarantined_actions = sum(item.quarantined_actions for item in overview.incidents)
    total_blocked_actions = sum(item.blocked_actions for item in overview.incidents)
    total_evidence = sum(item.evidence_count for item in overview.incidents)

    return {
        "counts": {
            "total_open": overview.total_open,
            "critical_open": overview.critical_open,
            "high_open": overview.high_open,
            "under_review": overview.under_review,
            "contained": overview.contained,
        },
        "metrics": {
            "mean_time_to_contain_minutes": overview.mean_time_to_contain_minutes,
            "total_quarantined_actions": total_quarantined_actions,
            "total_blocked_actions": total_blocked_actions,
            "total_evidence": total_evidence,
        },
        "incidents": [item.to_dict() for item in overview.incidents],
        "generated_at": _isoformat(overview.generated_at),
    }
