from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TriageDecision:
    decision: str
    confidence: str
    rationale: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "decision": self.decision,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "rationale": self.rationale,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TriageAssignment:
    owner_id: str
    display_name: str
    queue: str
    team: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "owner_id": self.owner_id,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "queue": self.queue,
            "team": self.team,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TriageArtifact:
    artifact_id: str
    artifact_type: str
    label: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "artifact_id": self.artifact_id,
            "artifact_type": self.artifact_type,
            "label": self.label,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IncidentTriage:
    incident_id: str
    title: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    source: str
    summary: str
    opened_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    assignment: TriageAssignment
    decision: TriageDecision
    evidence: tuple[TriageArtifact, ...] = ()
    requires_human_review: bool = False
    containment_recommended: bool = False
    blocked_actions: int = 0
    quarantined_actions: int = 0
    generated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "incident_id": self.incident_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "status": self.status,
            "source": self.source,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "opened_at": _isoformat(self.opened_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(self.updated_at),
            "assignment": self.assignment.to_dict(),
            "decision": self.decision.to_dict(),
            "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in self.evidence],
            "requires_human_review": self.requires_human_review,
            "containment_recommended": self.containment_recommended,
            "blocked_actions": self.blocked_actions,
            "quarantined_actions": self.quarantined_actions,
            "generated_at": _isoformat(self.generated_at),
        }


def _normalize_assignment(value: Any) -> TriageAssignment:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return TriageAssignment(owner_id="", display_name="Unassigned", queue="incident-triage", team="")
    return TriageAssignment(
        owner_id=_coerce_str(value.get("owner_id")),
        display_name=_coerce_str(value.get("display_name"), "Unassigned") or "Unassigned",
        queue=_coerce_str(value.get("queue"), "incident-triage") or "incident-triage",
        team=_coerce_str(value.get("team")),
    )


def _normalize_decision(value: Any) -> TriageDecision:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return TriageDecision(
            decision="investigate",
            confidence="medium",
            rationale="Insufficient structured decision data provided.",
        )
    return TriageDecision(
        decision=_coerce_str(value.get("decision"), "investigate") or "investigate",
        confidence=_coerce_str(value.get("confidence"), "medium") or "medium",
        rationale=_coerce_str(value.get("rationale"), "No triage rationale provided.") or "No triage rationale provided.",
    )


def _normalize_artifact(value: Any) -> TriageArtifact | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    artifact_id = _coerce_str(value.get("artifact_id"))
    artifact_type = _coerce_str(value.get("artifact_type"))
    label = _coerce_str(value.get("label"))
    if not any([artifact_id, artifact_type, label]):
        return None

    return TriageArtifact(
        artifact_id=artifact_id or "artifact",
        artifact_type=artifact_type or "evidence",
        label=label or artifact_type or artifact_id or "Evidence artifact",
    )


def default_incident_triage() -> IncidentTriage:
    now = _utc_now()
    return IncidentTriage(
        incident_id="",
        title="",
        severity="medium",
        status="triage",
        source="runtime",
        summary="",
        opened_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        assignment=_normalize_assignment(None),
        decision=_normalize_decision(None),
    )


def build_incident_triage(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: IncidentTriage | None = None,
) -> IncidentTriage:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_incident_triage()

    raw_evidence = source.get("evidence")
    if isinstance(raw_evidence, list):
        evidence = tuple(item for entry in raw_evidence if (item := _normalize_artifact(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        evidence = current.evidence

    opened_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("opened_at"), current.opened_at) or current.opened_at
    updated_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("updated_at"), current.updated_at) or current.updated_at

    return IncidentTriage(
        incident_id=_coerce_str(source.get("incident_id"), current.incident_id),
        title=_coerce_str(source.get("title"), current.title),
        severity=_coerce_str(source.get("severity"), current.severity) or current.severity,
        status=_coerce_str(source.get("status"), current.status) or current.status,
        source=_coerce_str(source.get("source"), current.source) or current.source,
        summary=_coerce_str(source.get("summary"), current.summary),
        opened_at=opened_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
        assignment=_normalize_assignment(source.get("assignment")) if "assignment" in source else current.assignment,
        decision=_normalize_decision(source.get("decision")) if "decision" in source else current.decision,
        evidence=evidence,
        requires_human_review=_coerce_bool(source.get("requires_human_review"), current.requires_human_review),
        containment_recommended=_coerce_bool(source.get("containment_recommended"), current.containment_recommended),
        blocked_actions=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("blocked_actions"), current.blocked_actions)),
        quarantined_actions=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("quarantined_actions"), current.quarantined_actions)),
        generated_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("generated_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def incident_triage_summary(triage: IncidentTriage) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "incident_id": triage.incident_id,
        "title": triage.title,
        "severity": triage.severity,
        "status": triage.status,
        "source": triage.source,
        "summary": triage.summary,
        "timeline": {
            "opened_at": _isoformat(triage.opened_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(triage.updated_at),
            "generated_at": _isoformat(triage.generated_at),
        },
        "assignment": triage.assignment.to_dict(),
        "decision": triage.decision.to_dict(),
        "signals": {
            "requires_human_review": triage.requires_human_review,
            "containment_recommended": triage.containment_recommended,
            "blocked_actions": triage.blocked_actions,
            "quarantined_actions": triage.quarantined_actions,
            "evidence_count": len(triage.evidence),
        },
        "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in triage.evidence],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.secretservice import SecretService


router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integrations"])

_service = SecretService()


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_metadata(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


class IntegrationSecretSetRequest(BaseModel):
    key: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    value: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=10000)
    updated_by: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationSecretDeleteRequest(BaseModel):
    deleted_by: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationSecretValueView(BaseModel):
    key: str
    masked_value: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    updated_by: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationSecretListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    total: int
    items: list[IntegrationSecretValueView]


class IntegrationSecretResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    secret: IntegrationSecretValueView


class IntegrationSecretDeleteResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    key: str
    deleted: bool


def _build_secret_view(key: str, record: Any) -> IntegrationSecretValueView:
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        data = record.model_dump()
    elif isinstance(record, dict):
        data = dict(record)
    else:
        data = {
            "value": str(record),
        }

    raw_value = str(data.get("value", ""))
    masked_value = data.get("masked_value") or _service.mask(raw_value)
    created_at = data.get("created_at") or data.get("createdat") or _utcnow()
    updated_at = data.get("updated_at") or data.get("updatedat") or created_at
    updated_by = data.get("updated_by") or data.get("updatedby")
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(data.get("metadata"))

    return IntegrationSecretValueView(
        key=key,
        masked_value=masked_value,
        created_at=created_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
        updated_by=updated_by,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _list_secret_items(integration_id: str) -> list[IntegrationSecretValueView]:
    records = _service.list_for_integration(integration_id)
    items: list[IntegrationSecretValueView] = []

    if isinstance(records, dict):
        iterable = records.items()
    else:
        iterable = []
        for entry in records or []:
            if isinstance(entry, tuple) and len(entry) == 2:
                iterable.append(entry)
            elif isinstance(entry, dict):
                key = entry.get("key")
                if key:
                    iterable.append((key, entry))
            elif hasattr(entry, "key"):
                iterable.append((getattr(entry, "key"), entry))

    for key, record in iterable:
        items.append(_build_secret_view(str(key), record))

    items.sort(key=lambda item: item.key.lower())
    return items


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/secrets",
    response_model=IntegrationSecretListResponse,
    summary="List integration secrets",
)
def list_integration_secrets(integration_id: str) -> IntegrationSecretListResponse:
    items = _list_secret_items(integration_id)
    return IntegrationSecretListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-secrets",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        total=len(items),
        items=items,
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/secrets/{key}",
    response_model=IntegrationSecretResponse,
    summary="Get integration secret",
)
def get_integration_secret(integration_id: str, key: str) -> IntegrationSecretResponse:
    record = _service.get(integration_id, key)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"secret '{key}' not found for integration '{integration_id}'",
        )

    return IntegrationSecretResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-secrets",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        secret=_build_secret_view(key, record),
    )


@router.put(
    "/{integration_id}/secrets/{key}",
    response_model=IntegrationSecretResponse,
    summary="Set integration secret",
)
def set_integration_secret(
    integration_id: str,
    key: str,
    request: IntegrationSecretSetRequest,
) -> IntegrationSecretResponse:
    payload = request.model_dump()
    payload["key"] = key

    try:
        record = _service.set(
            integration_id=integration_id,
            key=key,
            value=request.value,
            updated_by=request.updated_by,
            metadata=request.metadata,
        )
    except TypeError:
        try:
            record = _service.set(integration_id, key, request.value)
        except TypeError:
            record = _service.set(integration_id, payload)

    return IntegrationSecretResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-secrets",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        secret=_build_secret_view(key, record),
    )


@router.delete(
    "/{integration_id}/secrets/{key}",
    response_model=IntegrationSecretDeleteResponse,
    summary="Delete integration secret",
)
def delete_integration_secret(
    integration_id: str,
    key: str,
    request: IntegrationSecretDeleteRequest | None = None,
) -> IntegrationSecretDeleteResponse:
    deleted = False

    try:
        deleted = bool(
            _service.delete(
                integration_id=integration_id,
                key=key,
                deleted_by=request.deleted_by if request else None,
                metadata=request.metadata if request else {},
            )
        )
    except TypeError:
        try:
            deleted = bool(_service.delete(integration_id, key))
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=str(exc),
            ) from exc

    if not deleted:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"secret '{key}' not found for integration '{integration_id}'",
        )

    return IntegrationSecretDeleteResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-secrets",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        key=key,
        deleted=True,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from importlib import import_module
from inspect import isawaitable
from typing import Any, Callable, cast

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
from fastapi.routing import APIRoute

ProtectedDependencyFactory = Callable[[], Any]


def _optional_module(module_path: str) -> Any | None:
    try:
        return import_module(module_path)
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        if exc.name != module_path:
            raise
        return None


def _optional_router(module_path: str) -> Any | None:
    module = _optional_module(module_path)
    if module is None:
        return None
    return getattr(module, "router", None)


def _optional_attr(module_path: str, attr_name: str) -> Any | None:
    module = _optional_module(module_path)
    if module is None:
        return None
    return getattr(module, attr_name, None)


def _include_optional_router(
    app: FastAPI,
    module_path: str,
    *,
    prefix: str | None = None,
    dependencies: list[Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    router = _optional_router(module_path)
    if router is None:
        return

    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if prefix is not None:
        kwargs["prefix"] = prefix
    if dependencies is not None:
        kwargs["dependencies"] = dependencies

    app.include_router(router, **kwargs)


def _include_router_group(
    app: FastAPI,
    routers: list[tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    for router, kwargs in routers:
        if router is None:
            continue
        app.include_router(router, **kwargs)


def _normalize_dependency_metadata(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    for route in app.routes:
        if not isinstance(route, APIRoute):
            continue

        for dependant in route.dependant.dependencies:
            if getattr(dependant, "dependency", None) is None:
                call = getattr(dependant, "call", None)
                if call is not None:
                    setattr(dependant, "dependency", call)


def _build_openapi(app: FastAPI) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if app.openapi_schema is not None:
        return cast(dict[str, Any], app.openapi_schema)

    app.openapi_schema = get_openapi(
        title=app.title,
        version=app.version,
        description=app.description,
        routes=app.routes,
    )
    return cast(dict[str, Any], app.openapi_schema)


def _install_openapi_factory(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    def custom_openapi() -> dict[str, Any]:
        return _build_openapi(app)

    app.openapi = custom_openapi


def _protected_dependencies() -> list[Any]:
    require_api_key = _optional_attr("app.core.auth", "require_api_key")
    if require_api_key is None:
        return []
    return [Depends(require_api_key)]


def _public_router_configs() -> list[tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]]:
    return [
        (_optional_router("app.api.system"), {}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.ui_status"), {}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.ui_pages"), {}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.telemetry_access"), {}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.scan"), {"prefix": "/scan"}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.router"), {}),
    ]


def _protected_router_configs() -> list[tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """
    Canonical protected routers for the IronClaw-Security app.

    Rule: treat app.api.* as the primary API surface. app.api.routes.* modules
    are considered legacy/compat and should NOT be wired here to avoid
    double-registration of the same logical endpoints.
    """
    dependencies = _protected_dependencies()
    return [
        (_optional_router("app.api.request_context"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.history"), {"prefix": "/history", "dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.action_guard"), {"prefix": "/guard", "dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.action_execute"), {"prefix": "/guard", "dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.review_queue"), {"prefix": "/guard", "dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.audit_log"), {"prefix": "/guard", "dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.policy"), {"prefix": "/policy", "dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.release_policy_routes"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.integrations"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.customer_keys"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.usage_reports"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.auth"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.operator_auth"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.customer_auth"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.session_security"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.access_control"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
        (_optional_router("app.api.org_context"), {"dependencies": dependencies}),
    ]


def _include_optional_protected_routers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    """
    Optional legacy/compat routers under app.api.routes.*.

    These are kept isolated from the main protected router configs so we can
    phase them out safely once tests and imports stop relying on them.
    """
    dependencies = _protected_dependencies()
    optional_modules = [
        "app.api.routes.reviewqueue",
        "app.api.routes.unitledger",
        "app.api.routes.unitwallet",
    ]
    for module_path in optional_modules:
        _include_optional_router(
            app,
            module_path,
            dependencies=dependencies,
        )


def _install_core_middleware(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    if getattr(app.state, "_core_middleware_installed", False):
        return

    request_id_middleware = _optional_attr("app.core.request_id", "RequestIDMiddleware")
    request_context_middleware = _optional_attr("app.core.logging", "RequestContextMiddleware")
    usage_metering_middleware = _optional_attr("app.core.middleware", "UsageMeteringMiddleware")

    for middleware_cls in (
        request_id_middleware,
        request_context_middleware,
        usage_metering_middleware,
    ):
        if middleware_cls is not None:
            app.add_middleware(middleware_cls)

    app.state._core_middleware_installed = True


def _safe_call(call: Callable[[], Any] | None, default: Any) -> Any:
    if not callable(call):
        return default
    try:
        return call()
    except Exception:
        return default

    @app.get("/ui/status", tags=["ui"])

                "status": "ok",
                "service": "IronClaw-Security",
            },
        )

    @app.get("/ui/runtime-status", tags=["ui"])
    def ui_runtime_status() -> Any:
        return _safe_call(
            get_runtime_status,
            {
                "status": "ok",
                "runtimeavailable": True,
                "boundaryactive": True,
                "reviewqueueenabled": True,
            },
        )

    app.state._core_routes_installed = True


def _install_all_routers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    if getattr(app.state, "_routers_installed", False):
        return

    _include_router_group(app, _public_router_configs())
    _include_router_group(app, _protected_router_configs())
    _include_optional_protected_routers(app)

    include_ui_routers = _optional_attr("app.ui.router", "include_ui_routers")
    if callable(include_ui_routers):
        include_ui_routers(app)

    app.state._routers_installed = True


def _initialize_scan_history_repository() -> None:
    """
    Wire the Supabase-backed scan history repository into the history service
    at application startup so IronClaw persistence layer is active by default.
    """
    set_scan_history_repository = _optional_attr(
        "app.services.history",
        "set_scan_history_repository",
    )
    build_scan_history_repository = _optional_attr(
        "app.repositories.scan_history_repository",
        "build_scan_history_repository",
    )

    if callable(set_scan_history_repository) and callable(build_scan_history_repository):
        try:
            repository = build_scan_history_repository()
            set_scan_history_repository(repository)
        except Exception:
            pass


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    pipeline = None
    initialize_secure_runtime_pipeline = _optional_attr(
        "app.orchestrator.secure_runtime_pipeline",
        "initialize_secure_runtime_pipeline",
    )
    set_action_execute_pipeline = _optional_attr(
        "app.dependencies.action_execute",
        "set_action_execute_pipeline",
    )
    reset_action_execute_pipeline = _optional_attr(
        "app.dependencies.action_execute",
        "reset_action_execute_pipeline",
    )
    reset_scan_history_repository = _optional_attr(
        "app.services.history",
        "reset_scan_history_repository",
    )

    _initialize_scan_history_repository()

    if callable(initialize_secure_runtime_pipeline):
        pipeline = initialize_secure_runtime_pipeline()

    app.state.action_execute_pipeline = pipeline
    if pipeline is not None and callable(set_action_execute_pipeline):
        set_action_execute_pipeline(pipeline)

    try:
        yield
    finally:
        try:
            close = getattr(pipeline, "close", None)
            if callable(close):
                result = close()
                if isawaitable(result):
                    await result
        finally:
            app.state.action_execute_pipeline = None
            if callable(reset_action_execute_pipeline):
                reset_action_execute_pipeline()
            if callable(reset_scan_history_repository):
                reset_scan_history_repository()


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    app = FastAPI(
        title="IronClaw-Security",
        version="1.0.0",
        description=(
            "Local-first AI security API for prompt inspection, guarded execution, "
            "review workflows, and protected runtime controls."
        ),
        docs_url=None,
        redoc_url=None,
        openapi_url=None,
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )

    _install_openapi_factory(app)
    _install_core_middleware(app)

    bootstrap_app = _optional_attr("app.bootstrap", "bootstrap_app")
    if callable(bootstrap_app):
        bootstrap_app(app)

    register_exception_handlers = _optional_attr("app.core.errors", "register_exception_handlers")
    if callable(register_exception_handlers):
        register_exception_handlers(app)

    _install_core_routes(app)
    _install_all_routers(app)

    install_protected_docs = _optional_attr("app.core.docs", "install_protected_docs")
    if callable(install_protected_docs):
        install_protected_docs(app)

    _normalize_dependency_metadata(app)

    return app


app = create_app()

    action_type: ActionType
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    content: str = Field(default="")
    client_id: str | None = Field(default=None)
    session_id: str | None = Field(default=None)

    @field_validator("target")
    @classmethod
    def validate_target(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("Target must not be blank")
        return normalized

    @field_validator("content")
    @classmethod
    def normalize_content(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return value.strip()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Literal

from app.orchestrator.agent_registry import AgentDescriptor, ProtectedAction


AgentRole = Literal[
    "file_guardian",
    "security_sentinel",
    "execution_watcher",
    "integration_monitor",
    "documentation_observer",
]

AutonomyLevel = Literal[
    "observe_only",
    "review_before_action",
    "restricted_execution",
    "isolated_quarantine_only",
]

EscalationMode = Literal[
    "none",
    "operator_review",
    "security_review",
    "automatic_quarantine",
]

ProfileFocus = Literal[
    "code_integrity",
    "execution_safety",
    "network_boundary",
    "integration_control",
    "documentation_integrity",
]


@dataclass
class AgentProfile:
    agent_id: str
    file_path: str
    role: AgentRole
    autonomy_level: AutonomyLevel
    escalation_mode: EscalationMode
    primary_focus: ProfileFocus
    system_prompt: str
    protected_actions: list[ProtectedAction] = field(default_factory=list)
    risk_tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    owner_scope: str = "page_of_code"
    can_propose_changes: bool = True
    can_execute_directly: bool = False
    must_use_guard_api: bool = True
    must_log_all_actions: bool = True
    quarantine_on_uncertainty: bool = True
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


def _role_for_descriptor(descriptor: AgentDescriptor) -> AgentRole:
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "security_critical":
        return "security_sentinel"
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "execution_capable":
        return "execution_watcher"
    if "api" in descriptor.tags or "integration" in descriptor.tags:
        return "integration_monitor"
    if descriptor.language in {"markdown", "json", "yaml", "html", "css"}:
        return "documentation_observer"
    return "file_guardian"


def _autonomy_for_descriptor(descriptor: AgentDescriptor) -> AutonomyLevel:
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "security_critical":
        return "isolated_quarantine_only"
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "execution_capable":
        return "restricted_execution"
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "sensitive":
        return "review_before_action"
    return "observe_only"


def _escalation_for_descriptor(descriptor: AgentDescriptor) -> EscalationMode:
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "security_critical":
        return "automatic_quarantine"
    if descriptor.threat_profile in {"execution_capable", "sensitive"}:
        return "security_review"
    return "operator_review"


def _focus_for_descriptor(descriptor: AgentDescriptor) -> ProfileFocus:
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "security_critical":
        return "integration_control" if "api" in descriptor.tags else "code_integrity"
    if descriptor.threat_profile == "execution_capable":
        return "execution_safety"
    if "network" in descriptor.tags:
        return "network_boundary"
    if descriptor.language in {"markdown", "json", "yaml", "html", "css"}:
        return "documentation_integrity"
    return "code_integrity"


def _system_prompt_for_descriptor(
    descriptor: AgentDescriptor,
    role: AgentRole,
    autonomy_level: AutonomyLevel,
    focus: ProfileFocus,
) -> str:
    protected = ", ".join(descriptor.protected_actions) if descriptor.protected_actions else "none"
    tags = ", ".join(descriptor.tags) if descriptor.tags else "none"

    return (
        f"You are the IronClaw-assigned security agent for file '{descriptor.relative_path}'. "
        f"Your role is '{role}'. Your autonomy level is '{autonomy_level}'. "
        f"Your primary focus is '{focus}'. "
        f"You protect this file as a dedicated page-of-code security agent. "
        f"You must treat uncertainty as a reason to escalate into guarded review or quarantine. "
        f"Protected actions in your scope: {protected}. "
        f"Risk tags associated with this file: {tags}. "
        f"You must preserve code integrity, avoid unsafe execution, require guarded action routing, "
        f"and maintain auditability for every meaningful action."
    )


def build_agent_profile(descriptor: AgentDescriptor) -> AgentProfile:
    role = _role_for_descriptor(descriptor)
    autonomy_level = _autonomy_for_descriptor(descriptor)
    escalation_mode = _escalation_for_descriptor(descriptor)
    focus = _focus_for_descriptor(descriptor)

    can_execute_directly = autonomy_level == "restricted_execution" and descriptor.threat_profile != "security_critical"

    notes = [
        "This profile is generated by the IronClaw-Security orchestrator.",
        "This agent is assigned to a single file as part of the page-of-code protection model.",
        "Future versions may attach live LLM reasoning, sandbox lanes, and self-upgrade policies.",
    ]

    if descriptor.threat_profile in {"security_critical", "execution_capable"}:
        notes.append("High-sensitivity profile: prefer review or isolation over direct execution.")

    return AgentProfile(
        agent_id=descriptor.agent_id,
        file_path=descriptor.relative_path,
        role=role,
        autonomy_level=autonomy_level,
        escalation_mode=escalation_mode,
        primary_focus=focus,
        system_prompt=_system_prompt_for_descriptor(
            descriptor=descriptor,
            role=role,
            autonomy_level=autonomy_level,
            focus=focus,
        ),
        protected_actions=descriptor.protected_actions,
        risk_tags=descriptor.tags,
        owner_scope="page_of_code",
        can_propose_changes=True,
        can_execute_directly=can_execute_directly,
        must_use_guard_api=True,
        must_log_all_actions=True,
        quarantine_on_uncertainty=True,
        notes=notes,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from pathlib import Path

    from app.orchestrator.agent_registry import discover_agents

    registry = discover_agents(Path(".").resolve())
    if not registry.items:
        print({"error": "No agents discovered."})
    else:
        profile = build_agent_profile(registry.items[0])
        print(profile.to_dict())

FILE: app\orchestrator\agent_registry.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable, Literal


AgentLanguage = Literal[
    "python",
    "javascript",
    "typescript",
    "json",
    "yaml",
    "markdown",
    "html",
    "css",
    "shell",
    "powershell",
    "unknown",
]

ThreatProfile = Literal[
    "low_risk",
    "standard",
    "sensitive",
    "execution_capable",
    "security_critical",
]

ProtectedAction = Literal[
    "file_write",
    "file_edit",
    "shell_command",
    "network_request",
    "git_operation",
    "tool_call",
]

DEFAULT_INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".jsx",
    ".json",
    ".yml",
    ".yaml",
    ".md",
    ".html",
    ".css",
    ".sh",
    ".ps1",
}

DEFAULT_EXCLUDED_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "__pycache__",
    "node_modules",
    "dist",
    "build",
    ".next",
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
}


@dataclass
class AgentDescriptor:
    agent_id: str
    relative_path: str
    absolute_path: str
    language: AgentLanguage
    threat_profile: ThreatProfile
    protected_actions: list[ProtectedAction] = field(default_factory=list)
    exists: bool = True
    size_bytes: int = 0
    file_hash: str | None = None
    last_modified_ts: float | None = None
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass
class AgentRegistry:
    project_root: str
    count: int
    items: list[AgentDescriptor] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "project_root": self.project_root,
            "count": self.count,
            "items": [asdict(item) for item in self.items],
        }


def _normalize_root(project_root: str | Path) -> Path:
    return Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()


def _infer_language(path: Path) -> AgentLanguage:
    suffix = path.suffix.lower()

    if suffix == ".py":
        return "python"
    if suffix in {".js", ".jsx"}:
        return "javascript"
    if suffix in {".ts", ".tsx"}:
        return "typescript"
    if suffix == ".json":
        return "json"
    if suffix in {".yml", ".yaml"}:
        return "yaml"
    if suffix == ".md":
        return "markdown"
    if suffix == ".html":
        return "html"
    if suffix == ".css":
        return "css"
    if suffix == ".sh":
        return "shell"
    if suffix == ".ps1":
        return "powershell"
    return "unknown"


def _read_text_safe(path: Path, max_chars: int = 5000) -> str:
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")[:max_chars]
    except OSError:
        return ""


def _hash_file(path: Path) -> str | None:
    try:
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with path.open("rb") as f:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
                digest.update(chunk)
        return digest.hexdigest()
    except OSError:
        return None


def _stable_agent_id(relative_path: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(relative_path.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    return f"ic-agent-{digest[:16]}"


def _protected_actions_for(language: AgentLanguage, path: Path, content: str) -> list[ProtectedAction]:
    actions: set[ProtectedAction] = {"file_edit"}

    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
    lowered_path = str(path).lower()
    lowered = content.lower()

    if language in {"python", "javascript", "typescript", "shell", "powershell"}:
        actions.add("tool_call")

    if language in {"shell", "powershell"}:
        actions.add("shell_command")
        actions.add("file_write")

    if any(token in lowered for token in ["subprocess", "os.system", "invoke-webrequest", "start-process", "iex "]):
        actions.add("shell_command")

    if any(token in lowered for token in ["requests.", "httpx.", "fetch(", "curl", "wget", "invoke-webrequest"]):
        actions.add("network_request")

    if any(token in lowered for token in ["git", "github", "gitlab"]):
        actions.add("git_operation")

    if any(token in lowered for token in ["write_text(", "open(", "path.write", "outfile", "set-content", "add-content"]):
        actions.add("file_write")

    if "docker" in lowered or "kubectl" in lowered or "terraform" in lowered:
        actions.add("shell_command")

    if "api" in lowered_path or "service" in lowered_path or "guard" in lowered_path or "scanner" in lowered_path:
        actions.add("tool_call")

    return sorted(actions)


def _threat_profile_for(path: Path, language: AgentLanguage, content: str) -> ThreatProfile:
    lowered_path = str(path).lower()
    lowered = content.lower()

    if any(part in lowered_path for part in ["security", "guard", "scanner", "policy", "telemetry", "orchestrator"]):
        return "security_critical"

    if any(token in lowered for token in [
        "subprocess",
        "os.system",
        "invoke-webrequest",
        "start-process",
        "curl",
        "wget",
        "requests.",
        "httpx.",
        "socket",
        "ssh",
        "token",
        "secret",
        "credential",
    ]):
        return "execution_capable"

    if any(part in lowered_path for part in ["auth", "history", "client", "api", "service"]):
        return "sensitive"

    if language in {"python", "javascript", "typescript", "shell", "powershell"}:
        return "standard"

    return "low_risk"


def _tags_for(path: Path, language: AgentLanguage, content: str) -> list[str]:
    tags: set[str] = {language}

    lowered_path = str(path).lower()
    lowered = content.lower()

    keyword_map = {
        "security": ["security", "scanner", "guard", "policy"],
        "network": ["requests.", "httpx.", "fetch(", "curl", "wget", "invoke-webrequest"],
        "execution": ["subprocess", "os.system", "start-process", "iex "],
        "history": ["history", "scan_id"],
        "telemetry": ["telemetry", "event"],
        "orchestrator": ["orchestrator", "agent_registry", "agent"],
        "api": ["apirouter", "fastapi", "router"],
    }

    for tag, needles in keyword_map.items():
        if tag in lowered_path or any(needle in lowered for needle in needles):
            tags.add(tag)

    return sorted(tags)


def _iter_candidate_files(
    project_root: Path,
    include_extensions: set[str] | None = None,
    excluded_dirs: set[str] | None = None,
) -> Iterable[Path]:
    include_extensions = include_extensions or DEFAULT_INCLUDE_EXTENSIONS
    excluded_dirs = excluded_dirs or DEFAULT_EXCLUDED_DIRS

    for path in project_root.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue

        parts = set(path.parts)
        if parts & excluded_dirs:
            continue

        if path.suffix.lower() not in include_extensions:
            continue

        yield path


def build_agent_descriptor(project_root: str | Path, file_path: str | Path) -> AgentDescriptor:
    root = _normalize_root(project_root)
    path = Path(file_path).expanduser().resolve()

    relative_path = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    language = _infer_language(path)
    content = _read_text_safe(path)

    try:
        stat = path.stat()
        size_bytes = stat.st_size
        last_modified_ts = stat.st_mtime
        exists = True
    except OSError:
        size_bytes = 0
        last_modified_ts = None
        exists = False

    return AgentDescriptor(
        agent_id=_stable_agent_id(relative_path),
        relative_path=relative_path,
        absolute_path=str(path),
        language=language,
        threat_profile=_threat_profile_for(path, language, content),
        protected_actions=_protected_actions_for(language, path, content),
        exists=exists,
        size_bytes=size_bytes,
        file_hash=_hash_file(path) if exists else None,
        last_modified_ts=last_modified_ts,
        tags=_tags_for(path, language, content),
    )


def discover_agents(
    project_root: str | Path,
    include_extensions: set[str] | None = None,
    excluded_dirs: set[str] | None = None,
) -> AgentRegistry:
    root = _normalize_root(project_root)

    items = [
        build_agent_descriptor(root, path)
        for path in _iter_candidate_files(
            root,
            include_extensions=include_extensions,
            excluded_dirs=excluded_dirs,
        )
    ]

    items.sort(key=lambda item: item.relative_path)

    return AgentRegistry(
        project_root=str(root),
        count=len(items),
        items=items,
    )


def get_agent_by_path(
    registry: AgentRegistry,
    relative_path: str,
) -> AgentDescriptor | None:
    normalized = relative_path.replace("\\", "/").strip()
    for item in registry.items:
        if item.relative_path == normalized:
            return item
    return None


def get_agent_by_id(
    registry: AgentRegistry,
    agent_id: str,
) -> AgentDescriptor | None:
    for item in registry.items:
        if item.agent_id == agent_id:
            return item
    return None


def save_registry(
    registry: AgentRegistry,
    output_path: str | Path,
) -> Path:
    path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(registry.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = Path(".").resolve()
    registry = discover_agents(root)
    print(json.dumps(registry.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

FILE: app\orchestrator\audit_ledger.py

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.decision_trace import DecisionTrace
from app.orchestrator.remediation_gate import GateReviewOutcome, RemediationGateReport
from app.orchestrator.replay_controller import ReplayReport
from app.orchestrator.supervisor import SupervisorEscalation


LedgerEventType = str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AuditLedgerEntry:
    entry_id: str
    timestamp: str
    event_type: LedgerEventType
    source: str
    target: str
    decision: str
    risk_score: int
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    previous_hash: str = ""
    entry_hash: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _stable_hash(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    encoded = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def build_audit_entry(
    *,
    event_type: LedgerEventType,
    source: str,
    target: str,
    decision: str,
    risk_score: int,
    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    previous_hash: str = "",
) -> AuditLedgerEntry:
    base_payload = {
        "entry_id": f"led-{uuid4().hex[:16]}",
        "timestamp": _utcnow(),
        "event_type": event_type,
        "source": source,
        "target": target,
        "decision": decision,
        "risk_score": risk_score,
        "details": details or {},
        "previous_hash": previous_hash,
    }
    entry_hash = _stable_hash(base_payload)
    return AuditLedgerEntry(**base_payload, entry_hash=entry_hash)


def append_audit_entry(
    output_path: str | Path,
    entry: AuditLedgerEntry,
) -> Path:
    path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(entry.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return path


def load_audit_entries(input_path: str | Path) -> list[AuditLedgerEntry]:
    path = Path(input_path).expanduser().resolve()
    if not path.exists():
        return []

    entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry] = []
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            entries.append(AuditLedgerEntry(**json.loads(line)))
    return entries


def verify_audit_chain(entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    valid = True
    broken_index: int | None = None
    expected_previous = ""

    for index, entry in enumerate(entries):
        payload = {
            "entry_id": entry.entry_id,
            "timestamp": entry.timestamp,
            "event_type": entry.event_type,
            "source": entry.source,
            "target": entry.target,
            "decision": entry.decision,
            "risk_score": entry.risk_score,
            "details": entry.details,
            "previous_hash": entry.previous_hash,
        }
        recomputed_hash = _stable_hash(payload)

        if entry.previous_hash != expected_previous or entry.entry_hash != recomputed_hash:
            valid = False
            broken_index = index
            break

        expected_previous = entry.entry_hash

    return {
        "valid": valid,
        "entry_count": len(entries),
        "broken_index": broken_index,
        "last_hash": expected_previous if valid else None,
    }


def _last_hash(entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry]) -> str:
    return entries[-1].entry_hash if entries else ""


def record_decision_trace(
    existing_entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry],
    trace: DecisionTrace,
) -> AuditLedgerEntry:
    plan = trace.execution_plan
    return build_audit_entry(
        event_type="decision-trace",
        source=f"trace:{trace.trace_id}",
        target=trace.target,
        decision=plan.verdict,
        risk_score=plan.risk_score,
        details={
            "session_id": trace.session_id,
            "action_type": trace.action_type,
            "matched_patterns": getattr(plan, "matched_patterns", []),
        },
        previous_hash=_last_hash(existing_entries),
    )


def record_escalation(
    existing_entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry],
    escalation: SupervisorEscalation,
) -> AuditLedgerEntry:
    return build_audit_entry(
        event_type="supervisor-escalation",
        source=f"escalation:{escalation.escalation_id}",
        target=escalation.file_path,
        decision=escalation.verdict,
        risk_score=escalation.risk_score,
        details={
            "level": escalation.level,
            "reason": escalation.reason,
            "session_id": escalation.session_id,
            "agent_id": escalation.agent_id,
        },
        previous_hash=_last_hash(existing_entries),
    )


def record_gate_outcome(
    existing_entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry],
    outcome: GateReviewOutcome,
) -> AuditLedgerEntry:
    score = 0
    if outcome.decision == "reject":
        score = 100
    elif outcome.decision == "isolate":
        score = 70
    elif outcome.decision == "review":
        score = 50

    return build_audit_entry(
        event_type="remediation-outcome",
        source=f"gate-outcome:{outcome.outcome_id}",
        target=outcome.request_id,
        decision=outcome.decision,
        risk_score=score,
        details={
            "status": outcome.status,
            "action": outcome.action,
            "rationale": outcome.rationale,
        },
        previous_hash=_last_hash(existing_entries),
    )


def record_replay_report(
    existing_entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry],
    report: ReplayReport,
) -> AuditLedgerEntry:
    return build_audit_entry(
        event_type="replay-report",
        source=f"replay:{report.replay_id}",
        target=report.checkpoint_id,
        decision=report.status,
        risk_score=max(report.blocked_trace_count * 25, report.quarantined_trace_count * 15),
        details={
            "mode": report.mode,
            "replayed_trace_count": report.replayed_trace_count,
            "blocked_trace_count": report.blocked_trace_count,
            "quarantined_trace_count": report.quarantined_trace_count,
            "warning_trace_count": report.warning_trace_count,
            "allow_trace_count": report.allow_trace_count,
        },
        previous_hash=_last_hash(existing_entries),
    )


def record_gate_report(
    existing_entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry],
    report: RemediationGateReport,
) -> AuditLedgerEntry:
    risk_score = max(report.rejected_count * 25, report.quarantined_count * 20, report.manual_review_count * 10)
    return build_audit_entry(
        event_type="gate-report",
        source=f"gate:{report.gate_id}",
        target="remediation-gate",
        decision="completed",
        risk_score=risk_score,
        details={
            "request_count": report.request_count,
            "approved_count": report.approved_count,
            "rejected_count": report.rejected_count,
            "quarantined_count": report.quarantined_count,
            "manual_review_count": report.manual_review_count,
        },
        previous_hash=_last_hash(existing_entries),
    )


def summarize_audit_entries(entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for entry in entries:
        counts[entry.event_type] = counts.get(entry.event_type, 0) + 1

    verification = verify_audit_chain(entries)

    return {
        "entry_count": len(entries),
        "event_type_counts": counts,
        "verification": verification,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.audit_ledger import AuditLedgerEntry
from app.orchestrator.decision_trace import DecisionTrace
from app.orchestrator.human_review_queue import ReviewDecisionRecord, ReviewPacket
from app.orchestrator.remediation_gate import GateReviewOutcome
from app.orchestrator.supervisor import SupervisorEscalation


CaseStatus = str
EvidenceKind = str


@dataclass
class EvidenceItem:
    evidence_id: str
    kind: EvidenceKind
    source_id: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class CaseTimelineEvent:
    event_id: str
    event_type: str
    timestamp: str
    actor: str
    summary: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class CaseFile:
    case_id: str
    title: str
    target: str
    status: CaseStatus
    severity: str
    risk_score: int
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    summary: str
    source_packet_id: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    evidence: list[EvidenceItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    timeline: list[CaseTimelineEvent] = field(default_factory=list)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    related_ids: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "case_id": self.case_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "target": self.target,
            "status": self.status,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "source_packet_id": self.source_packet_id,
            "owner": self.owner,
            "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in self.evidence],
            "timeline": [item.to_dict() for item in self.timeline],
            "tags": self.tags,
            "related_ids": self.related_ids,
        }


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _severity_from_risk(risk_score: int) -> str:
    if risk_score >= 90:
        return "critical"
    if risk_score >= 70:
        return "high"
    if risk_score >= 40:
        return "medium"
    return "low"


def _timeline_event(
    *,
    event_type: str,
    actor: str,
    summary: str,
    timestamp: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> CaseTimelineEvent:
    return CaseTimelineEvent(
        event_id=f"cte-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        event_type=event_type,
        timestamp=timestamp or _utcnow(),
        actor=actor,
        summary=summary,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )


def _evidence_item(
    *,
    kind: EvidenceKind,
    source_id: str,
    title: str,
    summary: str,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> EvidenceItem:
    return EvidenceItem(
        evidence_id=f"evd-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        kind=kind,
        source_id=source_id,
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )


def create_case_file_from_packet(packet: ReviewPacket) -> CaseFile:
    now = _utcnow()
    severity = _severity_from_risk(packet.risk_score)

    evidence = [
        _evidence_item(
            kind="review_packet",
            source_id=packet.packet_id,
            title=f"Review packet for {packet.target}",
            summary=packet.summary,
            metadata={
                "priority": packet.priority,
                "status": packet.status,
                "assignee": packet.assignee,
                "due_at": packet.due_at,
                **packet.metadata,
            },
        )
    ]

    timeline = [
        _timeline_event(
            event_type="case_created",
            actor="system",
            summary=f"Case opened from review packet {packet.packet_id}.",
            timestamp=packet.created_at,
            metadata={"source_type": packet.source_type},
        )
    ]

    return CaseFile(
        case_id=f"case-{uuid4().hex[:16]}",
        title=f"{severity.upper()} review for {packet.target}",
        target=packet.target,
        status="open",
        severity=severity,
        risk_score=packet.risk_score,
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        summary=packet.summary,
        source_packet_id=packet.packet_id,
        owner=packet.assignee,
        evidence=evidence,
        timeline=timeline,
        tags=[packet.source_type, severity],
        related_ids={"packet_id": packet.packet_id, "source_id": packet.source_id},
    )


def attach_decision_trace(case_file: CaseFile, trace: DecisionTrace) -> CaseFile:
    plan = trace.execution_plan
    evidence = [
        *case_file.evidence,
        _evidence_item(
            kind="decision_trace",
            source_id=trace.trace_id,
            title=f"Decision trace {trace.trace_id}",
            summary=f"{trace.action_type} on {trace.target} produced verdict {plan.verdict}.",
            metadata={
                "session_id": trace.session_id,
                "action_type": trace.action_type,
                "verdict": plan.verdict,
                "risk_score": plan.risk_score,
                "matched_patterns": getattr(plan, "matched_patterns", []),
            },
        ),
    ]
    timeline = [
        *case_file.timeline,
        _timeline_event(
            event_type="decision_trace_attached",
            actor="system",
            summary=f"Attached decision trace {trace.trace_id}.",
            metadata={"verdict": plan.verdict, "risk_score": plan.risk_score},
        ),
    ]

    return CaseFile(
        case_id=case_file.case_id,
        title=case_file.title,
        target=case_file.target,
        status=case_file.status,
        severity=max(case_file.severity, _severity_from_risk(plan.risk_score), key=lambda s: ["low", "medium", "high", "critical"].index(s)),
        risk_score=max(case_file.risk_score, plan.risk_score),
        created_at=case_file.created_at,
        updated_at=_utcnow(),
        summary=case_file.summary,
        source_packet_id=case_file.source_packet_id,
        owner=case_file.owner,
        evidence=evidence,
        timeline=timeline,
        tags=sorted(set([*case_file.tags, trace.action_type, plan.verdict])),
        related_ids={**case_file.related_ids, "trace_id": trace.trace_id},
    )


def attach_escalation(case_file: CaseFile, escalation: SupervisorEscalation) -> CaseFile:
    evidence = [
        *case_file.evidence,
        _evidence_item(
            kind="supervisor_escalation",
            source_id=escalation.escalation_id,
            title=f"Supervisor escalation {escalation.level}",
            summary=escalation.reason,
            metadata={
                "session_id": escalation.session_id,
                "agent_id": escalation.agent_id,
                "verdict": escalation.verdict,
                "risk_score": escalation.risk_score,
            },
        ),
    ]
    timeline = [
        *case_file.timeline,
        _timeline_event(
            event_type="escalation_attached",
            actor="supervisor",
            summary=f"Supervisor escalation {escalation.escalation_id} attached.",
            metadata={"level": escalation.level, "verdict": escalation.verdict},
        ),
    ]

    return CaseFile(
        case_id=case_file.case_id,
        title=case_file.title,
        target=case_file.target,
        status="escalated" if escalation.level in {"high", "critical"} else case_file.status,
        severity=max(case_file.severity, _severity_from_risk(escalation.risk_score), key=lambda s: ["low", "medium", "high", "critical"].index(s)),
        risk_score=max(case_file.risk_score, escalation.risk_score),
        created_at=case_file.created_at,
        updated_at=_utcnow(),
        summary=case_file.summary,
        source_packet_id=case_file.source_packet_id,
        owner=case_file.owner,
        evidence=evidence,
        timeline=timeline,
        tags=sorted(set([*case_file.tags, "escalation", escalation.level])),
        related_ids={**case_file.related_ids, "escalation_id": escalation.escalation_id},
    )


def attach_gate_outcome(case_file: CaseFile, outcome: GateReviewOutcome) -> CaseFile:
    evidence = [

    return CaseFile(
        case_id=case_file.case_id,
        title=case_file.title,
        target=case_file.target,
        status=status_map.get(outcome.decision, case_file.status),

        risk_score=case_file.risk_score,
        created_at=case_file.created_at,
        updated_at=_utcnow(),
        summary=case_file.summary,
        source_packet_id=case_file.source_packet_id,
        owner=case_file.owner,
        evidence=evidence,
        timeline=timeline,
        tags=sorted(set([*case_file.tags, outcome.decision])),
        related_ids={**case_file.related_ids, "gate_outcome_id": outcome.outcome_id},
    )


def attach_review_decision(case_file: CaseFile, decision: ReviewDecisionRecord) -> CaseFile:
    evidence = [

        _evidence_item(
            kind="review_decision",

        related_ids={**case_file.related_ids, "decision_id": decision.decision_id},
    )


def attach_audit_entries(case_file: CaseFile, entries: list[AuditLedgerEntry]) -> CaseFile:
    relevant_entries = [
        entry
        for entry in entries
        if entry.target == case_file.target
        or entry.source in case_file.related_ids.values()
        or entry.target in case_file.related_ids.values()
    ]

    added_evidence = [
        _evidence_item(
            kind="audit_entry",
            source_id=entry.entry_id,
            title=f"Audit entry {entry.event_type}",
            summary=f"{entry.decision} decision with risk score {entry.risk_score}.",
            metadata={
                "event_type": entry.event_type,
                "timestamp": entry.timestamp,
                "target": entry.target,
                "details": entry.details,
            },
        )
        for entry in relevant_entries
    ]

    if not added_evidence:
        return case_file

    timeline = [
        *case_file.timeline,
        _timeline_event(
            event_type="audit_entries_attached",
            actor="audit_ledger",
            summary=f"Attached {len(added_evidence)} audit entries.",
            metadata={"entry_count": len(added_evidence)},
        ),
    ]

    return CaseFile(
        case_id=case_file.case_id,
        title=case_file.title,
        target=case_file.target,
        status=case_file.status,
        severity=case_file.severity,
        risk_score=case_file.risk_score,
        created_at=case_file.created_at,
        updated_at=_utcnow(),
        summary=case_file.summary,
        source_packet_id=case_file.source_packet_id,
        owner=case_file.owner,
        evidence=[*case_file.evidence, *added_evidence],
        timeline=timeline,
        tags=case_file.tags,
        related_ids=case_file.related_ids,
    )


def summarize_case_file(case_file: CaseFile) -> dict[str, Any]:
    evidence_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for item in case_file.evidence:
        evidence_counts[item.kind] = evidence_counts.get(item.kind, 0) + 1

    return {
        "case_id": case_file.case_id,
        "status": case_file.status,
        "severity": case_file.severity,
        "risk_score": case_file.risk_score,
        "owner": case_file.owner,
        "evidence_count": len(case_file.evidence),
        "timeline_count": len(case_file.timeline),
        "evidence_counts": evidence_counts,
        "related_ids": case_file.related_ids,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.decision_trace import DecisionTrace
from app.orchestrator.runtime_session import RuntimeSession
from app.orchestrator.supervisor import SupervisorSnapshot, summarize_supervisor


CheckpointStatus = str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CheckpointManifest:
    checkpoint_id: str
    created_at: str
    status: CheckpointStatus
    project_root: str
    supervisor_id: str
    session_count: int
    execution_count: int
    escalation_count: int
    trace_count: int
    label: str
    notes: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CheckpointBundle:
    manifest: CheckpointManifest
    supervisor: dict[str, Any]
    sessions: list[dict[str, Any]]
    traces: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "manifest": self.manifest.to_dict(),
            "supervisor": self.supervisor,
            "sessions": self.sessions,
            "traces": self.traces,
            "metadata": self.metadata,
        }


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def build_checkpoint_bundle(
    supervisor: SupervisorSnapshot,
    *,
    sessions: list[RuntimeSession] | None = None,
    traces: list[DecisionTrace] | None = None,
    label: str = "runtime-checkpoint",
    notes: str = "",
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> CheckpointBundle:
    resolved_sessions = sessions or list(supervisor.active_sessions.values())
    resolved_traces = traces or []

    manifest = CheckpointManifest(
        checkpoint_id=f"ckpt-{uuid4().hex[:16]}",
        created_at=_now(),
        status="created",
        project_root=supervisor.project_root,
        supervisor_id=supervisor.supervisor_id,
        session_count=len(resolved_sessions),
        execution_count=len(supervisor.execution_history),
        escalation_count=len(supervisor.escalations),
        trace_count=len(resolved_traces),
        label=label,
        notes=notes,
    )

    return CheckpointBundle(
        manifest=manifest,
        supervisor=supervisor.to_dict(),
        sessions=[session.to_dict() for session in resolved_sessions],
        traces=[trace.to_dict() for trace in resolved_traces],
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )


def save_checkpoint_bundle(
    checkpoint: CheckpointBundle,
    output_path: str | Path,
) -> Path:
    path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(checkpoint.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


def append_checkpoint_manifest_jsonl(
    checkpoint: CheckpointBundle,
    output_path: str | Path,
) -> Path:
    path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(checkpoint.manifest.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return path


def load_checkpoint_bundle(input_path: str | Path) -> CheckpointBundle:
    path = Path(input_path).expanduser().resolve()
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    manifest = CheckpointManifest(**payload["manifest"])
    supervisor = payload["supervisor"]
    sessions = payload.get("sessions", [])
    traces = payload.get("traces", [])
    metadata = payload.get("metadata", {})

    return CheckpointBundle(
        manifest=manifest,
        supervisor=supervisor,
        sessions=sessions,
        traces=traces,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def summarize_checkpoint(checkpoint: CheckpointBundle) -> dict[str, Any]:
    supervisor_summary: dict[str, Any] = {}
    supervisor_payload = checkpoint.supervisor

    if isinstance(supervisor_payload, dict):
        try:
            active_sessions = supervisor_payload.get("active_sessions", {})
            execution_history = supervisor_payload.get("execution_history", [])
            escalations = supervisor_payload.get("escalations", [])

            reconstructed = SupervisorSnapshot(
                supervisor_id=supervisor_payload["supervisor_id"],
                project_root=supervisor_payload["project_root"],
                status=supervisor_payload["status"],
                created_at=supervisor_payload["created_at"],
                updated_at=supervisor_payload["updated_at"],
                active_sessions=active_sessions,
                execution_history=execution_history,
                escalations=escalations,
            )
            supervisor_summary = summarize_supervisor(reconstructed)
        except Exception:
            supervisor_summary = {
                "status": supervisor_payload.get("status"),
                "active_session_count": len(supervisor_payload.get("active_sessions", {})),
                "execution_count": len(supervisor_payload.get("execution_history", [])),
                "escalation_count": len(supervisor_payload.get("escalations", [])),
            }

    return {
        "checkpoint_id": checkpoint.manifest.checkpoint_id,
        "label": checkpoint.manifest.label,
        "status": checkpoint.manifest.status,
        "created_at": checkpoint.manifest.created_at,
        "session_count": checkpoint.manifest.session_count,
        "execution_count": checkpoint.manifest.execution_count,
        "escalation_count": checkpoint.manifest.escalation_count,
        "trace_count": checkpoint.manifest.trace_count,
        "supervisor": supervisor_summary,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, Literal, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable

from app.orchestrator.secure_runtime_pipeline import (
    ActionExecutionContext,
    GuardedActionRequest,
    GuardedActionResult,
)

ExecutionMode = Literal["dryrun", "sandboxed", "direct"]


@runtime_checkable
class SandboxRunner(Protocol):
    """
    Minimal protocol for a sandbox runner.

    A concrete implementation could:
      - talk to a firecracker/microVM pool,
      - use containerized sandboxes,
      - or isolate via a dedicated constrained worker process.
    """

    def run(
        self,
        action_type: str,
        target: str,
        payload: Dict[str, Any],
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float,
        read_only_fs: bool = True,
        network_enabled: bool = False,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        ...


@dataclass
class SandboxExecutorConfig:
    """
    Configuration for the Claude-focused sandbox executor.
    """

    name: str = "claude-sandbox-executor"
    mode: ExecutionMode = "dryrun"
    timeout_seconds: float = 8.0
    require_sandbox_for_shell: bool = True
    require_sandbox_for_network: bool = True


class NoopSandboxRunner:
    """
    Default in-process sandbox runner placeholder.

    This does NOT provide real isolation. It exists purely to keep the
    orchestration path wired while a real sandbox backend is integrated.
    """

    def run(
        self,
        action_type: str,
        target: str,
        payload: Dict[str, Any],
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float,
        read_only_fs: bool = True,
        network_enabled: bool = False,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        # TODO: replace with a real sandbox driver.
        return {
            "status": "simulated",
            "executor": "noop",
            "action_type": action_type,
            "target": target,
            "timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds,
            "read_only_fs": read_only_fs,
            "network_enabled": network_enabled,
        }


class ClaudeSandboxExecutor:
    """
    Executor implementation focused on Claude Code workflows.

    Responsibilities:
      - Respect guard verdicts from the secure runtime pipeline.
      - Decide whether to:
          * simulate execution (dryrun),
          * run in a sandbox,
          * or decline to execute.
      - Return a GuardedActionResult suitable for API responses and UI.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Optional[SandboxExecutorConfig] = None,
        sandbox_runner: Optional[SandboxRunner] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._config = config or SandboxExecutorConfig()
        self._runner: SandboxRunner = sandbox_runner or NoopSandboxRunner()

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self._config.name

    @property
    def mode(self) -> ExecutionMode:
        return self._config.mode

    def _should_use_sandbox(self, action_type: str, target: str) -> bool:
        action = action_type.lower()

        if action == "toolcall" and target.lower() == "shell":
            return self._config.require_sandbox_for_shell

        if action in {"httpfetch", "network"}:
            return self._config.require_sandbox_for_network

        return False

    def _now_iso(self) -> str:
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def execute(
        self,
        ctx: ActionExecutionContext,
        guarded_request: GuardedActionRequest,
    ) -> GuardedActionResult:
        """
        Execute a guarded action, respecting the guard verdict and executor mode.
        """
        verdict = guarded_request.policy_verdict.lower()
        should_execute = guarded_request.should_execute
        halted_by_boundary = guarded_request.halted_by_boundary

        if not should_execute or halted_by_boundary or verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
            return GuardedActionResult(
                execution_state="denied",
                response_action="block",
                response_status="denied",
                policy_verdict=verdict or "block",
                should_execute=False,
                halted_by_boundary=True,
                executor_name=self.name,
                reason=guarded_request.reason
                or "Guard policy prevented execution in Claude sandbox executor.",
                raw_result=None,
                started_at=self._now_iso(),
                completed_at=self._now_iso(),
                metadata={
                    "mode": self.mode,
                    "context": ctx.to_dict(),
                },
            )

        execution_state: str
        response_status: str
        raw_result: Any = None

        started_at = self._now_iso()

        if self.mode == "dryrun":
            execution_state = "dryrun"
            response_status = "simulated"
            raw_result = {
                "status": "dryrun",
                "executor": self.name,
                "action_type": guarded_request.action_type,
                "target": guarded_request.target,
            }
        else:
            use_sandbox = self._should_use_sandbox(
                guarded_request.action_type,
                guarded_request.target,
            )

            if self.mode == "sandboxed" and use_sandbox:
                sandbox_result = self._runner.run(
                    guarded_request.action_type,
                    guarded_request.target,
                    guarded_request.content,
                    timeout_seconds=self._config.timeout_seconds,
                    read_only_fs=True,
                    network_enabled=False,
                )
                execution_state = "executed"
                response_status = "completed"
                raw_result = sandbox_result
            else:
                execution_state = "skipped"
                response_status = "bypassed"
                raw_result = {
                    "status": "bypassed",
                    "executor": self.name,
                    "mode": self.mode,
                    "reason": "No sandbox backend configured for this action.",
                }

        completed_at = self._now_iso()

        return GuardedActionResult(
            execution_state=execution_state,
            response_action="allow",
            response_status=response_status,
            policy_verdict=verdict or "allow",
            should_execute=True,
            halted_by_boundary=False,
            executor_name=self.name,
            reason=guarded_request.reason
            or "Execution handled by Claude sandbox executor.",
            raw_result=raw_result,
            started_at=started_at,
            completed_at=completed_at,
            metadata={
                "mode": self.mode,
                "context": ctx.to_dict(),
            },
        )
