from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.case_file import CaseFile
from app.orchestrator.human_review_queue import ReviewDecisionRecord
from app.orchestrator.remediation_gate import GateReviewOutcome
from app.orchestrator.supervisor import SupervisorEscalation


PlaybookStatus = str
PlaybookTrigger = str
ActionKind = str


@dataclass
class PlaybookAction:
    action_id: str
    kind: ActionKind
    label: str
    status: str
    summary: str
    automated: bool = True
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class PlaybookExecution:
    execution_id: str
    playbook_name: str
    trigger: PlaybookTrigger
    case_id: str
    target: str
    status: PlaybookStatus
    started_at: str
    updated_at: str
    rationale: str
    actions: list[PlaybookAction] = field(default_factory=list)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "execution_id": self.execution_id,
            "playbook_name": self.playbook_name,
            "trigger": self.trigger,
            "case_id": self.case_id,
            "target": self.target,
            "status": self.status,
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "rationale": self.rationale,
            "actions": [action.to_dict() for action in self.actions],
            "tags": self.tags,
        }


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _make_action(
    *,
    kind: ActionKind,
    label: str,
    status: str,
    summary: str,
    automated: bool = True,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> PlaybookAction:
    return PlaybookAction(
        action_id=f"act-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        kind=kind,
        label=label,
        status=status,
        summary=summary,
        automated=automated,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )


def _base_execution(
    *,
    playbook_name: str,
    trigger: PlaybookTrigger,
    case_file: CaseFile,
    rationale: str,
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
) -> PlaybookExecution:
    now = _utcnow()
    return PlaybookExecution(
        execution_id=f"pbx-{uuid4().hex[:16]}",
        playbook_name=playbook_name,
        trigger=trigger,
        case_id=case_file.case_id,
        target=case_file.target,
        status="running",
        started_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        rationale=rationale,
        actions=[],
        tags=tags or [],
    )


def _finalize_execution(
    execution: PlaybookExecution,
    *,
    actions: list[PlaybookAction],
    status: PlaybookStatus,
) -> PlaybookExecution:
    return PlaybookExecution(
        execution_id=execution.execution_id,
        playbook_name=execution.playbook_name,
        trigger=execution.trigger,
        case_id=execution.case_id,
        target=execution.target,
        status=status,
        started_at=execution.started_at,
        updated_at=_utcnow(),
        rationale=execution.rationale,
        actions=actions,
        tags=execution.tags,
    )


def _review_decision_actions(case_file: CaseFile, decision: ReviewDecisionRecord) -> list[PlaybookAction]:
    if decision.decision == "approve":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="release_target",
                label="Release target",
                status="completed",
                summary=f"Approved item for target {case_file.target} released from controlled review.",
                metadata={"reviewer": decision.reviewer, "decision_id": decision.decision_id},
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="record_audit_note",
                label="Record audit note",
                status="completed",
                summary="Approval recorded for downstream audit and reporting.",
                metadata={"packet_id": decision.packet_id},
            ),
        ]

    if decision.decision == "reject":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="deny_target",
                label="Deny target",
                status="completed",
                summary=f"Rejected item for target {case_file.target} remains blocked or quarantined.",
                metadata={"reviewer": decision.reviewer, "decision_id": decision.decision_id},
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="preserve_evidence",
                label="Preserve evidence",
                status="completed",
                summary="Evidence preserved for later forensic review.",
                metadata={"case_id": case_file.case_id},
            ),
        ]

    if decision.decision == "escalate":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="notify_supervisor",
                label="Notify supervisor",
                status="completed",
                summary="Supervisor escalation requested from human review decision.",
                automated=False,
                metadata={"reviewer": decision.reviewer},
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="hold_execution",
                label="Hold execution",
                status="completed",
                summary="Execution remains paused pending elevated review.",
            ),
        ]

    return [
        _make_action(
            kind="defer_case",
            label="Defer case",
            status="completed",
            summary="Decision deferred and case kept open for additional context.",
            automated=False,
            metadata={"reviewer": decision.reviewer},
        )
    ]


def run_review_decision_playbook(
    case_file: CaseFile,
    decision: ReviewDecisionRecord,
) -> PlaybookExecution:
    execution = _base_execution(
        playbook_name="human-review-resolution",
        trigger="review_decision",
        case_file=case_file,
        rationale=f"Apply post-review handling for decision {decision.decision}.",
        tags=["review", decision.decision, case_file.severity],
    )
    actions = _review_decision_actions(case_file, decision)
    final_status = "completed" if decision.decision != "escalate" else "awaiting_manual_action"
    return _finalize_execution(execution, actions=actions, status=final_status)


def _gate_outcome_actions(case_file: CaseFile, outcome: GateReviewOutcome) -> list[PlaybookAction]:
    decision = outcome.decision

    if decision == "approve":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="commit_remediation",
                label="Commit remediation",
                status="completed",
                summary="Approved remediation path marked ready for execution.",
                metadata={"request_id": outcome.request_id, "action": outcome.action},
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="notify_case_owner",
                label="Notify case owner",
                status="completed",
                summary="Case owner notified that remediation was approved.",
            ),
        ]

    if decision == "reject":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="rollback_or_block",
                label="Rollback or block",
                status="completed",
                summary="Rejected remediation path blocked from execution.",
                metadata={"request_id": outcome.request_id},
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="raise_followup_task",
                label="Raise follow-up task",
                status="completed",
                summary="Follow-up work item created for safer alternative handling.",
                automated=False,
            ),
        ]

    if decision == "isolate":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="isolate_target",
                label="Isolate target",
                status="completed",
                summary=f"Target {case_file.target} marked for isolation workflow.",
                metadata={"action": outcome.action},
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="preserve_case_state",
                label="Preserve case state",
                status="completed",
                summary="Case state preserved before isolation changes propagate.",
            ),
        ]

    if decision == "escalate":
        return [
            _make_action(
                kind="notify_incident_commander",
                label="Notify incident commander",
                status="completed",
                summary="Escalated gate outcome forwarded for higher-level review.",
                automated=False,
            ),
            _make_action(
                kind="freeze_automation",
                label="Freeze automation",
                status="completed",
                summary="Automated remediation paused until manual authorization is granted.",
            ),
        ]

    return [
        _make_action(
            kind="queue_manual_review",
            label="Queue manual review",
            status="completed",
            summary="Outcome requires further analyst validation before action.",
            automated=False,
        )
    ]


def run_gate_outcome_playbook(
    case_file: CaseFile,
    outcome: GateReviewOutcome,
) -> PlaybookExecution:
    execution = _base_execution(
        playbook_name="remediation-gate-resolution",
        trigger="gate_outcome",
        case_file=case_file,
        rationale=f"Apply response steps for gate decision {outcome.decision}.",
        tags=["gate", outcome.decision, case_file.status],
    )
    actions = _gate_outcome_actions(case_file, outcome)
    final_status = "awaiting_manual_action" if outcome.decision in {"escalate", "review"} else "completed"
    return _finalize_execution(execution, actions=actions, status=final_status)


def run_supervisor_escalation_playbook(
    case_file: CaseFile,
    escalation: SupervisorEscalation,
) -> PlaybookExecution:
    execution = _base_execution(
        playbook_name="supervisor-escalation-response",
        trigger="supervisor_escalation",
        case_file=case_file,
        rationale=f"Escalation level {escalation.level} requires coordinated response handling.",
        tags=["supervisor", escalation.level, escalation.verdict],
    )

    actions = [
        _make_action(
            kind="freeze_related_execution",
            label="Freeze related execution",
            status="completed",
            summary=f"Execution for session {escalation.session_id} frozen pending review.",
            metadata={"agent_id": escalation.agent_id},
        ),
        _make_action(
            kind="open_priority_investigation",
            label="Open priority investigation",
            status="completed",
            summary="Priority investigation path opened from supervisor escalation.",
            automated=False,
            metadata={"escalation_id": escalation.escalation_id},
        ),
    ]

    if escalation.level in {"high", "critical"}:
        actions.append(
            _make_action(
                kind="notify_security_lead",
                label="Notify security lead",
                status="completed",
                summary="Security lead notified due to elevated escalation severity.",
                automated=False,
                metadata={"risk_score": escalation.risk_score},
            )
        )

    return _finalize_execution(execution, actions=actions, status="awaiting_manual_action")


def select_playbook_for_case(
    case_file: CaseFile,
    *,
    review_decision: ReviewDecisionRecord | None = None,
    gate_outcome: GateReviewOutcome | None = None,
    supervisor_escalation: SupervisorEscalation | None = None,
) -> PlaybookExecution:
    provided = [
        review_decision is not None,
        gate_outcome is not None,
        supervisor_escalation is not None,
    ]
    if sum(provided) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Provide exactly one trigger object to select a playbook.")

    if review_decision is not None:
        return run_review_decision_playbook(case_file, review_decision)
    if gate_outcome is not None:
        return run_gate_outcome_playbook(case_file, gate_outcome)
    return run_supervisor_escalation_playbook(case_file, supervisor_escalation)  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def summarize_playbook_execution(execution: PlaybookExecution) -> dict[str, Any]:
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for action in execution.actions:
        counts[action.kind] = counts.get(action.kind, 0) + 1

    return {
        "execution_id": execution.execution_id,
        "playbook_name": execution.playbook_name,
        "trigger": execution.trigger,
        "status": execution.status,
        "action_count": len(execution.actions),
        "action_kind_counts": counts,
        "tags": execution.tags,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping

from app.orchestrator.reviewqueue import ReviewQueue, build_review_queue
from app.orchestrator.reviewstatestore import ReviewStateStore, build_review_state_store
from app.orchestrator.runtimesession import RuntimeSessionStore, build_runtime_session_store
from app.orchestrator.secureruntimepipeline import (
    SecureRuntimeDecision,
    SecureRuntimePipeline,
    initialize_secureruntimepipeline,
)
from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    lowered = str(value).strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"1", "true", "yes", "y", "on", "enabled", "active"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"0", "false", "no", "n", "off", "disabled", "inactive"}:
        return False
    return default


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "as_dict") and callable(value.as_dict):
        dumped = value.as_dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: item
            for key, item in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(item)
        }
    return {}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CoordinatedResponse:
    decision: SecureRuntimeDecision
    session_state: dict[str, Any]
    review_state: dict[str, Any] | None
    queued_for_review: bool
    review_leased: bool
    persistencedegraded: bool
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "decision": _as_dict(self.decision),
            "session_state": dict(self.session_state),
            "review_state": dict(self.review_state) if self.review_state is not None else None,
            "queued_for_review": self.queued_for_review,
            "review_leased": self.review_leased,
            "persistencedegraded": self.persistencedegraded,
            "reasons": [dict(r) for r in self.reasons],
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ResponseCoordinator:
    runtime_sessions: RuntimeSessionStore
    review_states: ReviewStateStore
    review_queue: ReviewQueue
    runtime_pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline
    name: str = "responsecoordinator"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "runtime_sessions": self.runtime_sessions.as_dict(),
            "review_states": self.review_states.as_dict(),
            "review_queue": self.review_queue.as_dict(),
        }

    def healthcheck(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        sessions_ok = self.runtime_sessions.healthcheck()
        reviews_ok = self.review_states.healthcheck()
        backend_ok = bool(sessions_ok and reviews_ok and self.review_queue.healthcheck())
        return {
            "runtime_sessions_ok": bool(sessions_ok),
            "review_states_ok": bool(reviews_ok),
            "review_queue_ok": bool(self.review_queue.healthcheck()),
            "backend_ok": backend_ok,
        }

    def _persistencedegraded(self) -> bool:
        hc = self.healthcheck()
        return not bool(hc.get("backend_ok", False))

    def coordinate_decision(
        self,
        *,
        session_id: str,
        actorid: str,
        actiontype: str,
        target: str,
        content: str,
        riskscore: int,
        filepath: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> CoordinatedResponse:
        session = self.runtime_sessions.get_session(session_id)
        if session is None:
            raise ValueError(f"runtime session '{session_id}' not found")

        persistencedegraded = self._persistencedegraded()

        decision = self.runtime_pipeline.evaluate(
            actorid=actorid,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            content=content,
            riskscore=riskscore,
            sessionid=session_id,
            filepath=filepath or _text(session.get("filepath")),
            metadata=_as_dict(metadata),
            persistencedegraded=persistencedegraded,
        )

        review_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        queued_for_review = False
        review_leased = False
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        if decision.reviewrequired or decision.quarantine:
            base_review_payload: dict[str, Any] = {
                "review_id": session.get("review_id") or None,
                "request_id": session.get("request_id"),
                "organization_id": session.get("organization_id"),
                "owner_id": session.get("owner_id"),
                "severity": "high" if decision.quarantine else "medium",
                "status": "queued" if decision.reviewrequired else "pending",
                "decision": None,
                "resolution": None,
                "source": "responsecoordinator",
                "notes": (
                    f"Executionstate={decision.executionstate}, "
                    f"policyverdict={decision.policyverdict}, "
                    f"responseaction={decision.responseaction}."
                ),
                "tags": ["runtime_decision"],
                "metadata": {
                    "session_id": session_id,
                    "actorid": actorid,
                    "actiontype": actiontype,
                    "target": target,
                    "filepath": filepath or _text(session.get("filepath")),
                    "degradedmode": decision.degradedmode,
                    "persistencedegraded": persistencedegraded,
                },
            }

            review_state = self.review_states.upsert_state(base_review_payload)
            queued_for_review = True

            queue_item = self.review_queue.enqueue(
                review_state,
                queue_id=_text(review_state.get("queue_id")) or self.review_queue.queue_id,
            )
            review_state = queue_item
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "responsecoordinator",
                    "label": "Review enqueue",
                    "details": f"Queued review '{queue_item.get('review_id')}' for session '{session_id}'.",
                    "score": decision.adjustedriskscore,
                }
            )

        if queued_for_review and not decision.degradedmode:
            leased = self.review_queue.lease_next(reviewer_id=None)
            if leased is not None:
                review_leased = True
                review_state = leased
                reasons.append(
                    {
                        "source": "responsecoordinator",
                        "label": "Review lease",
                        "details": f"Leased review '{leased.get('review_id')}' for active handling.",
                        "score": decision.adjustedriskscore,
                    }
                )

        session_updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": decision.executionstate,
            "last_updated_at": _utc_now_iso(),
        }
        if review_state is not None:
            session_updates["review_id"] = review_state.get("review_id") or review_state.get("id")
        session_state = self.runtime_sessions.update_session(session_id, session_updates) or session

        summary_reason = {
            "source": "responsecoordinator",
            "label": "Decision coordination",
            "details": (
                f"Coordinated decision '{decision.policyverdict}' "
                f"for session '{session_id}' with executionstate '{decision.executionstate}'."
            ),
            "score": decision.adjustedriskscore,
        }
        reasons.append(summary_reason)

        return CoordinatedResponse(
            decision=decision,
            session_state=session_state,
            review_state=review_state,
            queued_for_review=queued_for_review,
            review_leased=review_leased,
            persistencedegraded=persistencedegraded,
            reasons=reasons,
        )


def build_response_coordinator(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    session_backend: Any | None = None,
    review_backend: Any | None = None,
    queue_backend: Any | None = None,
    queue_id: str = "default",
    **backend_kwargs: Any,
) -> ResponseCoordinator:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**backend_kwargs)

    runtime_sessions = build_runtime_session_store(
        backend=session_backend or resolved_backend,
    )
    review_states = build_review_state_store(
        backend=review_backend or resolved_backend,
    )
    review_queue = build_review_queue(
        backend=queue_backend or resolved_backend,
        queue_id=queue_id,
    )

    runtime_pipeline = initialize_secureruntimepipeline()

    return ResponseCoordinator(
        runtime_sessions=runtime_sessions,
        review_states=review_states,
        review_queue=review_queue,
        runtime_pipeline=runtime_pipeline,
    )


def create_response_coordinator(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    **backend_kwargs: Any,
) -> ResponseCoordinator:
    return build_response_coordinator(backend=backend, **backend_kwargs)


def get_response_coordinator(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    **backend_kwargs: Any,
) -> ResponseCoordinator:
    return build_response_coordinator(backend=backend, **backend_kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Literal


ReviewStatus = Literal["pending", "approved", "rejected"]
ReviewPriority = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReviewItem:
    review_id: str
    actor_id: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    verdict: str
    risk_score: int
    priority: ReviewPriority
    reason: str
    status: ReviewStatus = "pending"
    file_path: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
    reviewed_at: str | None = None
    reviewed_by: str | None = None
    review_note: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ReviewQueue:
    items: list[ReviewItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
        }


def initialize_review_queue() -> ReviewQueue:
    return ReviewQueue()


def create_review_item(
    *,
    actor_id: str,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    verdict: str,
    risk_score: int,
    reason: str,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> ReviewItem:
    return ReviewItem(
        review_id=_build_review_id(),
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        verdict=verdict,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        priority=_priority_from_risk_score(risk_score),
        reason=reason,
        file_path=file_path,
        session_id=session_id,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )


def enqueue_review_item(queue: ReviewQueue, item: ReviewItem) -> ReviewQueue:
    return ReviewQueue(
        items=[*queue.items, item],
        created_at=queue.created_at,
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    )


def get_review_item(queue: ReviewQueue, review_id: str) -> ReviewItem | None:
    for item in queue.items:
        if item.review_id == review_id:
            return item
    return None


def list_pending_review_items(queue: ReviewQueue) -> list[ReviewItem]:
    return [item for item in queue.items if item.status == "pending"]


def approve_review_item(
    queue: ReviewQueue,
    *,
    review_id: str,
    reviewed_by: str,
    review_note: str | None = None,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    return _update_review_status(
        queue,
        review_id=review_id,
        status="approved",
        reviewed_by=reviewed_by,
        review_note=review_note,
    )


def reject_review_item(
    queue: ReviewQueue,
    *,
    review_id: str,
    reviewed_by: str,
    review_note: str | None = None,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    return _update_review_status(
        queue,
        review_id=review_id,
        status="rejected",
        reviewed_by=reviewed_by,
        review_note=review_note,
    )


def summarize_review_queue(queue: ReviewQueue) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "total_items": len(queue.items),
        "pending_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.status == "pending"),
        "approved_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.status == "approved"),
        "rejected_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.status == "rejected"),
        "critical_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.priority == "critical"),
        "high_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.priority == "high"),
        "medium_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.priority == "medium"),
        "low_items": sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.priority == "low"),
        "updated_at": queue.updated_at,
    }


def _update_review_status(
    queue: ReviewQueue,
    *,
    review_id: str,
    status: ReviewStatus,
    reviewed_by: str,
    review_note: str | None,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    found = False
    updated_items: list[ReviewItem] = []

    for item in queue.items:
        if item.review_id != review_id:
            updated_items.append(item)
            continue

        found = True
        updated_items.append(
            ReviewItem(
                review_id=item.review_id,
                actor_id=item.actor_id,
                action_type=item.action_type,
                target=item.target,
                verdict=item.verdict,
                risk_score=item.risk_score,
                priority=item.priority,
                reason=item.reason,
                status=status,
                file_path=item.file_path,
                session_id=item.session_id,
                metadata=item.metadata,
                created_at=item.created_at,
                reviewed_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                reviewed_by=reviewed_by,
                review_note=review_note,
            )
        )

    if not found:
        raise ValueError(f"Review item not found: {review_id}")

    return ReviewQueue(
        items=updated_items,
        created_at=queue.created_at,
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    )


def _priority_from_risk_score(risk_score: int) -> ReviewPriority:
    if risk_score >= 90:
        return "critical"
    if risk_score >= 70:
        return "high"
    if risk_score >= 40:
        return "medium"
    return "low"


def _build_review_id() -> str:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    return f"review-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}"

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable, Literal

ReviewStatus = Literal["pending", "approved", "rejected"]
ReceiptStatus = Literal["not_executed", "executed", "blocked", "expired"]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReviewStateRecord:
    review_item_id: str
    scan_id: str
    actor_id: str
    target_type: str
    target_value: str
    risk_score: int
    reason: str
    status: ReviewStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    file_path: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReviewDecisionRecord:
    review_item_id: str
    decision: ReviewStatus
    decided_by: str
    decided_at: str
    notes: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExecutionReceipt:
    receipt_id: str
    review_item_id: str
    status: ReceiptStatus
    action_type: str
    target: str
    executed_by: str
    executed_at: str
    output_ref: str | None = None
    blocked_reason: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class ReviewStateSnapshot:
    item: ReviewStateRecord
    decisions: list[ReviewDecisionRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    receipts: list[ExecutionReceipt] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "item": self.item.to_dict(),
            "decisions": [record.to_dict() for record in self.decisions],
            "receipts": [record.to_dict() for record in self.receipts],
        }


class ReviewStateStore:
    def __init__(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
        self.path = Path(path)
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._items: dict[str, ReviewStateRecord] = {}
        self._decisions: dict[str, list[ReviewDecisionRecord]] = {}
        self._receipts: dict[str, list[ExecutionReceipt]] = {}
        self._load()

    def create_item(
        self,
        *,
        review_item_id: str,
        scan_id: str,
        actor_id: str,
        target_type: str,
        target_value: str,
        risk_score: int,
        reason: str,
        file_path: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ReviewStateRecord:
        if review_item_id in self._items:
            raise ValueError(f"Review item already exists: {review_item_id}")

        now = _utc_now()
        record = ReviewStateRecord(
            review_item_id=review_item_id,
            scan_id=scan_id,
            actor_id=actor_id,
            target_type=target_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            reason=reason,
            status="pending",
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            file_path=file_path,
            session_id=session_id,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        self._items[review_item_id] = record
        self._append_event("review_item_created", record.to_dict())
        return record

    def set_decision(
        self,
        *,
        review_item_id: str,
        decision: Literal["approved", "rejected"],
        decided_by: str,
        notes: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ReviewStateRecord:
        item = self.require_item(review_item_id)

        decision_record = ReviewDecisionRecord(
            review_item_id=review_item_id,
            decision=decision,
            decided_by=decided_by,
            decided_at=_utc_now(),
            notes=notes,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        self._decisions.setdefault(review_item_id, []).append(decision_record)

        updated_item = ReviewStateRecord(
            **{
                **item.to_dict(),
                "status": decision,
                "updated_at": decision_record.decided_at,
            }
        )
        self._items[review_item_id] = updated_item

        self._append_event("review_decision_recorded", decision_record.to_dict())
        self._append_event("review_item_updated", updated_item.to_dict())
        return updated_item

    def add_execution_receipt(
        self,
        *,
        review_item_id: str,
        action_type: str,
        target: str,
        executed_by: str,
        status: ReceiptStatus,
        output_ref: str | None = None,
        blocked_reason: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ExecutionReceipt:
        item = self.require_item(review_item_id)

        receipt = ExecutionReceipt(
            receipt_id=_build_receipt_id(),
            review_item_id=review_item_id,
            status=status,
            action_type=action_type,
            target=target,
            executed_by=executed_by,
            executed_at=_utc_now(),
            output_ref=output_ref,
            blocked_reason=blocked_reason,
            metadata={
                "review_status_at_execution": item.status,
                **(metadata or {}),
            },
        )
        self._receipts.setdefault(review_item_id, []).append(receipt)
        self._append_event("execution_receipt_recorded", receipt.to_dict())
        return receipt

    def get_snapshot(self, review_item_id: str) -> ReviewStateSnapshot:
        item = self.require_item(review_item_id)
        return ReviewStateSnapshot(
            item=item,
            decisions=list(self._decisions.get(review_item_id, [])),
            receipts=list(self._receipts.get(review_item_id, [])),
        )

    def list_items(
        self,
        *,
        status: ReviewStatus | None = None,
    ) -> list[ReviewStateRecord]:
        items = list(self._items.values())
        if status is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.status == status]
        return sorted(items, key=lambda item: item.updated_at, reverse=True)

    def list_pending(self) -> list[ReviewStateRecord]:
        return self.list_items(status="pending")

    def list_approved(self) -> list[ReviewStateRecord]:
        return self.list_items(status="approved")

    def list_rejected(self) -> list[ReviewStateRecord]:
        return self.list_items(status="rejected")

    def require_item(self, review_item_id: str) -> ReviewStateRecord:
        item = self._items.get(review_item_id)
        if item is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Unknown review item: {review_item_id}")
        return item

    def _append_event(self, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        event = {
            "event_type": event_type,
            "timestamp": _utc_now(),
            "payload": payload,
        }
        with self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def _load(self) -> None:
        if not self.path.exists():
            return

        for raw_event in self._read_lines():
            event_type = raw_event.get("event_type")
            payload = raw_event.get("payload", {})

            if event_type in {"review_item_created", "review_item_updated"}:
                item = ReviewStateRecord(**payload)
                self._items[item.review_item_id] = item
            elif event_type == "review_decision_recorded":
                decision = ReviewDecisionRecord(**payload)
                self._decisions.setdefault(decision.review_item_id, []).append(decision)
            elif event_type == "execution_receipt_recorded":
                receipt = ExecutionReceipt(**payload)
                self._receipts.setdefault(receipt.review_item_id, []).append(receipt)

    def _read_lines(self) -> Iterable[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            for line in handle:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                yield json.loads(line)


def initialize_review_state_store(
    path: str = "output/review-state-store.jsonl",
) -> ReviewStateStore:
    return ReviewStateStore(path)


def summarize_review_snapshot(snapshot: ReviewStateSnapshot) -> dict[str, Any]:
    last_decision = snapshot.decisions[-1].decision if snapshot.decisions else None
    latest_receipt = snapshot.receipts[-1].status if snapshot.receipts else "not_executed"
    return {
        "review_item_id": snapshot.item.review_item_id,
        "scan_id": snapshot.item.scan_id,
        "status": snapshot.item.status,
        "last_decision": last_decision,
        "decision_count": len(snapshot.decisions),
        "receipt_count": len(snapshot.receipts),
        "latest_receipt_status": latest_receipt,
        "risk_score": snapshot.item.risk_score,
        "target_type": snapshot.item.target_type,
        "target_value": snapshot.item.target_value,
    }


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _build_receipt_id() -> str:
    return f"receipt-{datetime.now(UTC).strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}"

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from heapq import heappop, heappush
from itertools import count
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.reviewstatestore import ReviewStateStore, build_review_state_store


DEFAULT_QUEUE_ID = "default"
DEFAULT_PRIORITY = 100

_STATUS_QUEUED = "queued"
_STATUS_IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
_STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGED = "acknowledged"
_STATUS_RESOLVED = "resolved"
_STATUS_DISMISSED = "dismissed"
_STATUS_CLOSED = "closed"

_TERMINAL_STATUSES = {
    _STATUS_RESOLVED,
    _STATUS_DISMISSED,
    _STATUS_CLOSED,
}


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _int(value: Any, default: int = DEFAULT_PRIORITY) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    lowered = str(value).strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"1", "true", "yes", "y", "on", "enabled", "active"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"0", "false", "no", "n", "off", "disabled", "inactive"}:
        return False
    return default


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: item
            for key, item in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(item)
        }
    raise TypeError("queue item payload must be mapping-like")


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, set):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _merge_metadata(*parts: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for part in parts:
        if part is None:
            continue
        merged.update(_as_dict(part))
    return merged


def _normalize_queue_item_payload(
    payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    review_id: str | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    incident_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    reviewer_id: str | None = None,
    queue_id: str | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    priority: int | str | None = None,
    attempts: int | str | None = None,
    max_attempts: int | str | None = None,
    available_at: str | None = None,
    lease_expires_at: str | None = None,
    resolution: str | None = None,
    decision: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    tags: Iterable[Any] | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
    created_at: str | None = None,
    updated_at: str | None = None,
    enqueued_at: str | None = None,
    dequeued_at: str | None = None,
    acknowledged_at: str | None = None,
    resolved_at: str | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _as_dict(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    now_iso = _utc_now_iso()

    resolved_review_id = (
        _text(review_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("review_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_request_id = (
        _text(request_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("request_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("scan_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("execution_id"))
    )

    resolved_org_id = (
        _text(organization_id)
        or _text(org_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("organization_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("org_id"))
    )

    resolved_status = (
        _text(status)
        or _text(source_payload.get("status"))
        or _STATUS_QUEUED
    )

    resolved_queue_id = (
        _text(queue_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("queue_id"))
        or DEFAULT_QUEUE_ID
    )

    resolved_priority = _int(
        priority if priority is not None else source_payload.get("priority"),
        default=DEFAULT_PRIORITY,
    )

    resolved_attempts = max(
        0,
        _int(attempts if attempts is not None else source_payload.get("attempts"), default=0),
    )
    resolved_max_attempts = max(
        1,
        _int(max_attempts if max_attempts is not None else source_payload.get("max_attempts"), default=3),
    )

    resolved_created_at = _text(created_at) or _text(source_payload.get("created_at")) or now_iso
    resolved_updated_at = _text(updated_at) or _text(source_payload.get("updated_at")) or resolved_created_at
    resolved_enqueued_at = _text(enqueued_at) or _text(source_payload.get("enqueued_at")) or resolved_created_at

    return {
        "review_id": resolved_review_id,
        "id": resolved_review_id,
        "request_id": resolved_request_id or None,
        "incident_id": _text(incident_id) or _text(source_payload.get("incident_id")) or None,
        "organization_id": resolved_org_id or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org_id or None,
        "owner_id": _text(owner_id) or _text(source_payload.get("owner_id")) or None,
        "reviewer_id": _text(reviewer_id) or _text(source_payload.get("reviewer_id")) or None,
        "queue_id": resolved_queue_id,
        "source": _text(source) or _text(source_payload.get("source")) or "orchestrator_queue",
        "status": resolved_status,
        "priority": resolved_priority,
        "attempts": resolved_attempts,
        "max_attempts": resolved_max_attempts,
        "available_at": _text(available_at) or _text(source_payload.get("available_at")) or resolved_updated_at,
        "lease_expires_at": _text(lease_expires_at) or _text(source_payload.get("lease_expires_at")) or None,
        "resolution": _text(resolution) or _text(source_payload.get("resolution")) or None,
        "decision": _text(decision) or _text(source_payload.get("decision")) or None,
        "severity": _text(severity) or _text(source_payload.get("severity")) or "medium",
        "notes": _text(notes) or _text(source_payload.get("notes")),
        "tags": _as_list(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),
        "metadata": _merge_metadata(source_payload.get("metadata"), metadata),
        "created_at": resolved_created_at,
        "updated_at": resolved_updated_at,
        "enqueued_at": resolved_enqueued_at,
        "dequeued_at": _text(dequeued_at) or _text(source_payload.get("dequeued_at")) or None,
        "acknowledged_at": _text(acknowledged_at) or _text(source_payload.get("acknowledged_at")) or None,
        "resolved_at": _text(resolved_at) or _text(source_payload.get("resolved_at")) or None,
        "open": _bool(
            source_payload.get("open"),
            default=resolved_status.lower() not in _TERMINAL_STATUSES,
        ),
    }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewQueue:
    state_store: ReviewStateStore = field(default_factory=build_review_state_store)
    queue_id: str = DEFAULT_QUEUE_ID
    _heap: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = field(default_factory=list, init=False, repr=False)
    _seq: Any = field(default_factory=count, init=False, repr=False)

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return self.state_store.backend_name

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "queue_id": self.queue_id,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.state_store.healthcheck())

    def recover(self, *, queue_id: str | None = None, limit: int = 10_000) -> dict[str, Any]:
        resolved_queue_id = _text(queue_id) or self.queue_id
        states = self.state_store.list_states(limit=limit, queue_id=resolved_queue_id)
        self._heap.clear()

        recovered = 0
        skipped_terminal = 0

        for state in states:
            status = _text(state.get("status")).lower()
            if status in _TERMINAL_STATUSES or not _bool(
                state.get("open"),
                default=status not in _TERMINAL_STATUSES,
            ):
                skipped_terminal += 1
                continue

            normalized = _normalize_queue_item_payload(state, queue_id=resolved_queue_id)

            if status in {_STATUS_IN_REVIEW, _STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGED}:
                normalized["status"] = _STATUS_QUEUED
                normalized["reviewer_id"] = None
                normalized["lease_expires_at"] = None
                normalized["dequeued_at"] = None
                normalized["updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()
                self.state_store.update_state(normalized["review_id"], normalized)

            self._push_heap(normalized)
            recovered += 1

        return {
            "queue_id": resolved_queue_id,
            "recovered": recovered,
            "skipped_terminal": skipped_terminal,
            "in_memory_depth": len(self._heap),
        }

    def enqueue(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        item = _normalize_queue_item_payload(
            payload,
            queue_id=kwargs.pop("queue_id", None) or self.queue_id,
            status=_STATUS_QUEUED,
            enqueued_at=_utc_now_iso(),
            updated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
            **kwargs,
        )
        persisted = self.state_store.upsert_state(item)
        self._push_heap(persisted)
        return persisted

    def requeue(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        priority: int | None = None,
        delay_until: str | None = None,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        existing = self.state_store.get_state(review_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": _STATUS_QUEUED,
            "open": True,
            "reviewer_id": None,
            "lease_expires_at": None,
            "dequeued_at": None,
            "updated_at": _utc_now_iso(),
        }

        if priority is not None:
            updates["priority"] = _int(priority, default=DEFAULT_PRIORITY)
        if delay_until:
            updates["available_at"] = _text(delay_until)
        if notes:
            updates["notes"] = notes

        updated = self.state_store.update_state(review_id, updates)
        if updated is not None:
            self._push_heap(updated)
        return updated

    def lease_next(self, *, reviewer_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        now_iso = _utc_now_iso()

        while self._heap:
            _, _, review_id = heappop(self._heap)
            state = self.state_store.get_state(review_id)
            if state is None:
                continue

            status = _text(state.get("status")).lower()
            if status in _TERMINAL_STATUSES:
                continue

            if _text(state.get("queue_id"), self.queue_id) != self.queue_id:
                continue

            available_at = _text(state.get("available_at"))
            if available_at and available_at > now_iso:
                self._push_heap(state)
                return None

            leased = self.state_store.update_state(
                review_id,
                {
                    "status": _STATUS_IN_REVIEW,
                    "reviewer_id": _text(reviewer_id) or state.get("reviewer_id"),
                    "dequeued_at": now_iso,
                    "last_seen_at": now_iso,
                    "attempts": _int(state.get("attempts"), default=0) + 1,
                    "updated_at": now_iso,
                    "open": True,
                },
            )
            if leased is not None:
                return leased

        return None

    def acknowledge(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.state_store.acknowledge(review_id, reviewer_id=reviewer_id)

    def resolve(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        decision: str = "approved",
        resolution: str | None = None,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.state_store.resolve(
            review_id,
            decision=decision,
            resolution=resolution,
            notes=notes,
        )

    def dismiss(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        resolution: str | None = None,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.state_store.dismiss(
            review_id,
            resolution=resolution,
            notes=notes,
        )

    def get(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.state_store.get_state(review_id)

    def list_items(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        status: str | None = None,
        open_only: bool | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.state_store.list_states(
            limit=limit,
            queue_id=self.queue_id,
            status=status,
            open_only=open_only,
        )

    def summarize(self, *, limit: int = 1_000) -> dict[str, Any]:
        summary = self.state_store.summarize(limit=limit)
        summary["queue_id"] = self.queue_id
        summary["in_memory_depth"] = len(self._heap)
        return summary

    def _push_heap(self, item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
        normalized = _normalize_queue_item_payload(item, queue_id=_text(item.get("queue_id")) or self.queue_id)
        heappush(
            self._heap,
            (
                _int(normalized.get("priority"), default=DEFAULT_PRIORITY),
                next(self._seq),
                normalized["review_id"],
            ),
        )


def build_review_queue(
    *,
    state_store: ReviewStateStore | None = None,
    queue_id: str = DEFAULT_QUEUE_ID,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    resolved_state_store = state_store if state_store is not None else build_review_state_store(**store_kwargs)
    queue = ReviewQueue(state_store=resolved_state_store, queue_id=queue_id)
    queue.recover(queue_id=queue_id)  # persisted item recovery is core queue durability behavior [web:178][web:180]
    return queue


def create_review_queue(
    *,
    state_store: ReviewStateStore | None = None,
    queue_id: str = DEFAULT_QUEUE_ID,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    return build_review_queue(state_store=state_store, queue_id=queue_id, **store_kwargs)


def get_review_queue(
    *,
    state_store: ReviewStateStore | None = None,
    queue_id: str = DEFAULT_QUEUE_ID,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    return build_review_queue(state_store=state_store, queue_id=queue_id, **store_kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store


DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATE_TABLE = "review_states"


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    lowered = str(value).strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"1", "true", "yes", "y", "on", "enabled", "active"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"0", "false", "no", "n", "off", "disabled", "inactive"}:
        return False
    return default


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):  # Mapping covers dict and mapping-like objects [web:115]
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: item
            for key, item in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(item)
        }
    raise TypeError("review state payload must be a mapping-like object")


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, set):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _normalize_review_state_payload(
    payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    review_id: str | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    incident_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    reviewer_id: str | None = None,
    queue_id: str | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    decision: str | None = None,
    resolution: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    tags: Iterable[Any] | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
    created_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    updated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    first_seen_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    last_seen_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    acknowledged_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    resolved_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _as_dict(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_review_id = (
        _text(review_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("review_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_request_id = (
        _text(request_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("request_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("scan_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("execution_id"))
    )

    resolved_incident_id = (
        _text(incident_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("incident_id"))
    )

    resolved_org_id = (
        _text(organization_id)
        or _text(org_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("organization_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("org_id"))
    )

    resolved_owner_id = (
        _text(owner_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("owner_id"))
    )

    resolved_reviewer_id = (
        _text(reviewer_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("reviewer_id"))
        or _text(source_payload.get("assigned_to"))
    )

    resolved_queue_id = (
        _text(queue_id)
        or _text(source_payload.get("queue_id"))
        or "default"
    )

    resolved_source = (
        _text(source)
        or _text(source_payload.get("source"))
        or "orchestrator"
    )

    resolved_status = (
        _text(status)
        or _text(source_payload.get("status"))
        or "pending"
    )

    resolved_decision = (
        _text(decision)
        or _text(source_payload.get("decision"))
    )

    resolved_resolution = (
        _text(resolution)
        or _text(source_payload.get("resolution"))
    )

    resolved_severity = (
        _text(severity)
        or _text(source_payload.get("severity"))
        or "medium"
    )

    now_iso = _utc_now_iso()
    created_iso = (
        created_at if isinstance(created_at, str) else None
    ) or _text(source_payload.get("created_at")) or now_iso
    updated_iso = (
        updated_at if isinstance(updated_at, str) else None
    ) or _text(source_payload.get("updated_at")) or created_iso

    return {
        "review_id": resolved_review_id,
        "id": resolved_review_id,
        "request_id": resolved_request_id or None,
        "incident_id": resolved_incident_id or None,
        "organization_id": resolved_org_id or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org_id or None,
        "owner_id": resolved_owner_id or None,
        "reviewer_id": resolved_reviewer_id or None,
        "queue_id": resolved_queue_id,
        "source": resolved_source,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "decision": resolved_decision or None,
        "resolution": resolved_resolution or None,
        "severity": resolved_severity,
        "notes": _text(notes) or _text(source_payload.get("notes")),
        "tags": _as_list(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),
        "metadata": _as_dict(metadata if metadata is not None else source_payload.get("metadata")),
        "created_at": created_iso,
        "updated_at": updated_iso,
        "first_seen_at": (
            _text(first_seen_at) or _text(source_payload.get("first_seen_at")) or created_iso
        ),
        "last_seen_at": (
            _text(last_seen_at) or _text(source_payload.get("last_seen_at")) or updated_iso
        ),
        "acknowledged_at": _text(
            acknowledged_at if isinstance(acknowledged_at, str) else source_payload.get("acknowledged_at")
        ) or None,
        "resolved_at": _text(
            resolved_at if isinstance(resolved_at, str) else source_payload.get("resolved_at")
        ) or None,
        "open": _bool(
            source_payload.get("open"),
            default=resolved_status.lower() not in {"resolved", "dismissed", "closed"},
        ),
    }


@dataclass(slots=True)  # slots keep this orchestration state container lean [web:121][web:124]
class ReviewStateStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATE_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        probe = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(probe):
            return bool(probe())
        return True

    # Core CRUD

    def create_state(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = _normalize_review_state_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, record)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return dict(inserted[0])
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return dict(inserted)
        return record

    def create(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_state(payload, **kwargs)

    def upsert_state(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = _normalize_review_state_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        existing = self.get_state(record["review_id"])
        if existing is None and record.get("request_id"):
            existing = self.get_by_request_id(record["request_id"])
        if existing is None:
            return self.create_state(record)
        return self.update_state(record["review_id"], record) or record

    # Lookup

    def get_state(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _text(review_id):
            raise ValueError("review_id is required")

        for key in ("review_id", "id"):
            rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={key: review_id}, limit=1)
            if rows:
                return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def get(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_state(review_id)

    def get_by_request_id(self, request_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        normalized = _text(request_id)
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("request_id is required")

        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"request_id": normalized}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def exists(self, review_id: str) -> bool:
        return self.get_state(review_id) is not None

    # Listing

    def list_states(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        queue_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        open_only: bool | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if owner_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("owner_id", owner_id)
        if queue_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("queue_id", queue_id)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", status)
        if open_only:
            query_filters.setdefault("open", True)

        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters=query_filters or None, limit=limit)
        items = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        items.sort(
            key=lambda row: _text(row.get("updated_at") or row.get("created_at")),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return items

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_states(**kwargs)

    # Updates

    def update_state(self, review_id: str, updates: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        existing = self.get_state(review_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = dict(existing)
        merged.update(_as_dict(updates))
        merged["review_id"] = existing.get("review_id") or existing.get("id") or review_id
        merged["id"] = merged["review_id"]
        merged["updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()

        normalized = _normalize_review_state_payload(merged)

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"review_id": review_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"id": review_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        return normalized

    def update(self, review_id: str, updates: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_state(review_id, updates)

    # State transitions

    def mark_in_queue(self, review_id: str, queue_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {"status": "queued"}
        if queue_id:
            updates["queue_id"] = _text(queue_id)
        return self.update_state(review_id, updates)

    def mark_in_review(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {"status": "in_review", "open": True}
        if reviewer_id:
            updates["reviewer_id"] = _text(reviewer_id)
        return self.update_state(review_id, updates)

    def acknowledge(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "acknowledged",
            "acknowledged_at": _utc_now_iso(),
            "open": True,
        }
        if reviewer_id:
            updates["reviewer_id"] = _text(reviewer_id)
        return self.update_state(review_id, updates)

    def resolve(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        decision: str = "approved",
        resolution: str | None = None,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "resolved",
            "decision": _text(decision),
            "resolution": _text(resolution) or _text(notes),
            "resolved_at": _utc_now_iso(),
            "open": False,
        }
        return self.update_state(review_id, updates)

    def dismiss(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        resolution: str | None = None,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "dismissed",
            "decision": "dismissed",
            "resolution": _text(resolution) or _text(notes),
            "resolved_at": _utc_now_iso(),
            "open": False,
        }
        return self.update_state(review_id, updates)

    # Delete

    def delete_state(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _text(review_id):
            raise ValueError("review_id is required")

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"review_id": review_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"id": review_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        return None

    def delete(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.delete_state(review_id)

    # Summary

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1_000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        states = self.list_states(
            limit=limit,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            owner_id=owner_id,
        )

        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_decision: dict[str, int] = {}
        open_count = 0

        for state in states:
            status = _text(state.get("status"), "unknown")
            decision = _text(state.get("decision"), "unknown")
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1
            by_decision[decision] = by_decision.get(decision, 0) + 1
            if _bool(state.get("open"), default=status.lower() not in {"resolved", "dismissed", "closed"}):
                open_count += 1

        return {
            "total_reviews": len(states),
            "open_reviews": open_count,
            "by_status": by_status,
            "by_decision": by_decision,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }


def build_review_state_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATE_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReviewStateStore:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    return ReviewStateStore(backend=resolved_backend, table_name=table_name)


def create_review_state_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATE_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReviewStateStore:
    return build_review_state_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_review_state_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATE_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReviewStateStore:
    return build_review_state_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.agent_profile import AgentProfile, build_agent_profile
from app.orchestrator.coordination_state import (
    CoordinationEvent,
    CoordinationSnapshot,
    apply_execution_plan,
)
from app.orchestrator.execution_plan import ExecutionPlan
from app.orchestrator.orchestrator import IronClawOrchestrator
from app.orchestrator.task_router import RoutedTask, RoutedTaskResult, route_and_plan


RuntimeSessionStatus = str


@dataclass
class RuntimeSessionEvent:
    event_id: str
    session_id: str
    agent_id: str
    file_path: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    verdict: str
    lane: str
    summary: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
    risk_score: int = 0
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    scan_id: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class RuntimeSession:
    session_id: str
    agent_id: str
    file_path: str
    profile: AgentProfile
    status: RuntimeSessionStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    current_plan: ExecutionPlan | None = None
    event_log: list[RuntimeSessionEvent] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "file_path": self.file_path,
            "profile": self.profile.to_dict(),
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "current_plan": self.current_plan.to_dict() if self.current_plan else None,
            "event_log": [event.to_dict() for event in self.event_log],
        }


def _status_from_plan(plan: ExecutionPlan) -> RuntimeSessionStatus:
    if plan.verdict == "block":
        return "blocked"
    if plan.verdict == "quarantine":
        return "quarantined"
    if plan.verdict == "warn":
        return "review"
    return "active"


def _build_runtime_event(result: RoutedTaskResult, session_id: str) -> RuntimeSessionEvent:
    plan = result.execution_plan
    return RuntimeSessionEvent(
        event_id=f"rse-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        session_id=session_id,
        agent_id=result.task.agent_id,
        file_path=result.task.file_path,
        action_type=result.task.action_type,
        target=result.task.target,
        verdict=plan.verdict,
        lane=plan.lane,
        summary=plan.summary,
        risk_score=plan.risk_score,
        matched_patterns=plan.matched_patterns,
        scan_id=plan.scan_id,
    )


def create_runtime_session(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    *,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    agent_id: str | None = None,
) -> RuntimeSession:
    descriptor = orchestrator.get_agent(file_path=file_path, agent_id=agent_id)
    profile = build_agent_profile(descriptor)
    now = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()

    return RuntimeSession(
        session_id=f"ics-{uuid4().hex}",
        agent_id=descriptor.agent_id,
        file_path=descriptor.relative_path,
        profile=profile,
        status="initialized",
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        current_plan=None,
        event_log=[],
    )


def execute_routed_task_in_session(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    snapshot: CoordinationSnapshot,
    session: RuntimeSession,
    *,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    use_guard_api: bool = True,
) -> tuple[RuntimeSession, CoordinationSnapshot, RoutedTaskResult]:
    result = route_and_plan(
        orchestrator,
        snapshot,
        action_type=action_type,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        target=target,
        content=content,
        agent_id=session.agent_id,
        session_id=session.session_id,
        use_guard_api=use_guard_api,
    )

    plan = result.execution_plan
    runtime_event = _build_runtime_event(result, session.session_id)
    updated_snapshot = apply_execution_plan(snapshot, plan)

    updated_session = RuntimeSession(
        session_id=session.session_id,
        agent_id=session.agent_id,
        file_path=session.file_path,
        profile=session.profile,
        status=_status_from_plan(plan),
        created_at=session.created_at,
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        current_plan=plan,
        event_log=[*session.event_log, runtime_event],
    )

    return updated_session, updated_snapshot, result


def coordination_events_from_session(session: RuntimeSession) -> list[CoordinationEvent]:
    events: list[CoordinationEvent] = []
    for event in session.event_log:
        if event.verdict == "block":
            status = "blocked"
            priority = "critical"
        elif event.verdict == "quarantine":
            status = "quarantined"
            priority = "high"
        elif event.verdict == "warn":
            status = "review"
            priority = "normal"
        else:
            status = "observing"
            priority = "low"

        events.append(
            CoordinationEvent(
                agent_id=event.agent_id,
                file_path=event.file_path,
                verdict=event.verdict,
                status=status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                priority=priority,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                summary=event.summary,
                risk_score=event.risk_score,
                matched_patterns=event.matched_patterns,
                scan_id=event.scan_id,
                created_at=event.created_at,
            )
        )
    return events


def save_runtime_session(
    session: RuntimeSession,
    output_path: str | Path,
) -> Path:
    path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(session.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from app.orchestrator.coordination_state import initialize_coordination_state

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

DEFAULT_SESSION_TABLE = "runtime_sessions"


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: item
            for key, item in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(item)
        }
    raise TypeError("runtime session payload must be a mapping-like object")


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, set):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _merge_metadata(*parts: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for part in parts:
        if part is None:
            continue
        merged.update(_as_dict(part))
    return merged


@dataclass(slots=True)  # slots keep these data containers lean [web:121][web:124]

            "request": self.request.as_dict() if hasattr(self.request, "as_dict") else None,

            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
            "last_updated_at": self.last_updated_at,
            "status": self.status,
            "steps_completed": self.steps_completed,

            "checkpoints": list(self.checkpoints),
