from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.deploymentreadiness import DeploymentReadiness

router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integration-readiness"])

_service = DeploymentReadiness()


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    return [str(value)]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)

    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class ReadinessCheckView(BaseModel):
    check_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReadinessSummaryView(BaseModel):
    overall_status: str
    updated_at: str
    environment: str
    release_id: str | None = None
    total_checks: int
    ready_checks: int
    warning_checks: int
    blocked_checks: int
    blockers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recommendations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    readiness: ReadinessSummaryView
    checks: list[ReadinessCheckView] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _normalize_check_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "ready", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "ready"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error"}:
        return "blocked"
    return normalized or "ready"


def _normalize_overall_status(value: Any, checks: list[ReadinessCheckView]) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "ready", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "ready"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error"}:
        return "blocked"

    blocked_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "blocked")
    warning_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "warning")
    if blocked_checks:
        return "blocked"
    if warning_checks:
        return "warning"
    return "ready"


def _build_check_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> ReadinessCheckView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    check_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "check_id", "checkid", "id", "name", "key")
        or f"check-{fallback_index}"
    )
    title = str(
        _extract_value(data, "title", "label", "name", "summary")
        or check_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()
    )
    detail = str(
        _extract_value(data, "detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description") or ""
    )
    status_value = _normalize_check_status(
        _extract_value(data, "status", "state", "result")
    )

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("category", "severity", "component"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return ReadinessCheckView(
        check_id=check_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_readiness_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str,
) -> IntegrationReadinessResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    readiness = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "readiness") or result)

    raw_checks = _extract_value(readiness, "checks", "items") or []
    checks = [
        _build_check_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(raw_checks)
    ]

    ready_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "ready")
    warning_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "warning")
    blocked_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "blocked")

    overall_status = _normalize_overall_status(
        _extract_value(readiness, "overall_status", "status", "state"),
        checks,
    )

    updated_at_value = _extract_value(readiness, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at")
    release_id = _extract_value(readiness, "release_id", "integration_release_id")

    blockers = _normalize_list(_extract_value(readiness, "blockers", "errors"))
    recommendations = _normalize_list(_extract_value(readiness, "recommendations", "notes"))
    metadata = _normalize_dict(readiness.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("platform", "adapter_version", "provider"):
        if key in readiness and key not in metadata and readiness.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = readiness.get(key)

    return IntegrationReadinessResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        readiness=ReadinessSummaryView(
            overall_status=overall_status,
            updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(updated_at_value) or _utc_now_iso(),
            environment=str(_extract_value(readiness, "environment") or environment),
            release_id=str(release_id) if release_id is not None else None,
            total_checks=len(checks),
            ready_checks=ready_checks,
            warning_checks=warning_checks,
            blocked_checks=blocked_checks,
            blockers=blockers,
            recommendations=recommendations,
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        checks=checks,
    )


def _run_readiness(integration_id: str, environment: str) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.evaluate(release_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.check(release_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.check(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.check(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.check(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.get(release_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="deployment readiness service does not expose a supported readiness method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/readiness",
    response_model=IntegrationReadinessResponse,
    summary="Get integration deployment readiness",
)
def get_integration_readiness(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    environment: str = Query(default="production", min_length=1, max_length=100),
) -> IntegrationReadinessResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    normalized_environment = environment.strip()

    result = _run_readiness(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        environment=normalized_environment,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{normalized_integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_readiness_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        result=result,
        environment=normalized_environment,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationrollout import IntegrationRollout

router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integration-rollouts"])

_service = IntegrationRollout()


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    return [str(value)]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)

    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class RolloutStageView(BaseModel):
    stage_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class RolloutSummaryView(BaseModel):
    rollout_id: str | None = None
    state: str
    environment: str
    adapter_version: str | None = None
    target_percentage: int | None = None
    current_percentage: int | None = None
    updated_at: str
    blockers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationRolloutResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    rollout: RolloutSummaryView
    stages: list[RolloutStageView] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _normalize_stage_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "complete", "completed", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "completed"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error", "rolled_back", "rollback"}:
        return "failed"
    if normalized in {"pending", "queued", "running", "in_progress", "promoting"}:
        return "in_progress"

    return normalized or "in_progress"


def _normalize_rollout_state(value: Any, stages: list[RolloutStageView]) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "complete", "completed", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "completed"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error", "rolled_back", "rollback"}:
        return "failed"
    if normalized in {"pending", "queued", "running", "in_progress", "promoting"}:
        return "in_progress"

    if any(stage.status == "failed" for stage in stages):
        return "failed"
    if any(stage.status == "warning" for stage in stages):
        return "warning"
    if stages and all(stage.status == "completed" for stage in stages):
        return "completed"

    return "in_progress"


def _normalize_percent(value: Any) -> int | None:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    try:
        numeric = int(float(str(value)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return max(0, min(100, numeric))


def _build_stage_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> RolloutStageView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    stage_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "stage_id", "stageid", "id", "name", "key")
        or f"stage-{fallback_index}"
    )
    title = str(
        _extract_value(data, "title", "label", "name", "summary")
        or stage_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()
    )
    detail = str(_extract_value(data, "detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description") or "")
    status_value = _normalize_stage_status(_extract_value(data, "status", "state", "result"))

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("percentage", "wave", "cohort", "started_at", "completed_at"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return RolloutStageView(
        stage_id=stage_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_rollout_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str,
) -> IntegrationRolloutResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    rollout = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "rollout") or result)

    raw_stages = _extract_value(rollout, "stages", "steps", "items") or []
    stages = [_build_stage_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(raw_stages)]

    summary_metadata = _normalize_dict(rollout.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("platform", "provider", "release_id"):
        if key in rollout and key not in summary_metadata and rollout.get(key) is not None:
            summary_metadata[key] = rollout.get(key)

    rollout_id_value = _extract_value(rollout, "rollout_id", "id")
    adapter_version_value = _extract_value(rollout, "adapter_version", "version")
    updated_at_value = _extract_value(rollout, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at")

    return IntegrationRolloutResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        rollout=RolloutSummaryView(
            rollout_id=str(rollout_id_value) if rollout_id_value is not None else None,
            state=_normalize_rollout_state(
                _extract_value(rollout, "state", "status", "rollout_state"),
                stages,
            ),
            environment=str(_extract_value(rollout, "environment") or environment),
            adapter_version=str(adapter_version_value) if adapter_version_value is not None else None,
            target_percentage=_normalize_percent(
                _extract_value(rollout, "target_percentage", "target_percent")
            ),
            current_percentage=_normalize_percent(
                _extract_value(rollout, "current_percentage", "current_percent", "percentage")
            ),
            updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(updated_at_value) or _utc_now_iso(),
            blockers=_normalize_list(_extract_value(rollout, "blockers", "errors")),
            warnings=_normalize_list(_extract_value(rollout, "warnings")),
            metadata=summary_metadata,
        ),
        stages=stages,
    )


def _run_rollout_lookup(integration_id: str, environment: str) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.status(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.status(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.status(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.rollout(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.rollout(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.rollout(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration rollout service does not expose a supported rollout method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/rollouts",
    response_model=IntegrationRolloutResponse,
    summary="Get integration rollout state",
)
def get_integration_rollout(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    environment: str = Query(default="production", min_length=1, max_length=100),
) -> IntegrationRolloutResponse:
    result = _run_rollout_lookup(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        environment=environment.strip(),

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(

        result=result,

def _status_for_record(record: SecretRecord) -> str:
    return "active" if getattr(record, "active", False) else "revoked"


def _record_belongs_to_integration(record: SecretRecord, integration_id: str) -> bool:
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(record, "metadata", {}))
    candidates = {
        str(metadata.get("integration_id", "")).strip(),
        str(metadata.get("integration", "")).strip(),
        str(metadata.get("adapter_id", "")).strip(),
        str(metadata.get("release_id", "")).strip(),
    }
    candidates.discard("")
    return integration_id in candidates


def _filtered_records(integration_id: str) -> list[SecretRecord]:
    service = get_secret_service()
    records = service.list_secrets(include_inactive=True)
    return [record for record in records if _record_belongs_to_integration(record, integration_id)]


def _get_record_for_integration(integration_id: str, secret_id: str) -> SecretRecord | None:
    for record in _filtered_records(integration_id):
        if record.secret_id == secret_id:
            return record
    return None


def _build_action_response(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    operation: str,
    record: SecretRecord,
    revealed_once_value: str | None = None,
    notes: list[str] | None = None,
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(record, "metadata", {}))
    return SecretActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        operation=operation,
        secret_id=record.secret_id,
        name=record.name,
        provider=record.provider,
        kind=record.kind,
        secret_status=_status_for_record(record),
        masked_value=record.masked_value,
        revealed_once_value=revealed_once_value,
        created_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.updated_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        metadata=metadata,
        notes=notes or [],
    )


def _build_summary_item(record: SecretRecord) -> SecretSummaryItem:
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(record, "metadata", {}))
    return SecretSummaryItem(
        secret_id=record.secret_id,
        name=record.name,
        provider=record.provider,
        kind=record.kind,
        secret_status=_status_for_record(record),
        masked_value=record.masked_value,
        created_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.updated_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        metadata=metadata,
    )


@router.get("/{integration_id}/secrets", response_model=SecretListResponse)
def list_integration_secrets(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretListResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    records = _filtered_records(normalized_integration_id)

    return SecretListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        total=len(records),
        active=sum(1 for record in records if getattr(record, "active", False)),
        inactive=sum(1 for record in records if not getattr(record, "active", False)),
        secrets=[_build_summary_item(record) for record in records],
    )


@router.post("/{integration_id}/secrets", response_model=SecretActionResponse)
def create_integration_secret(
    payload: SecretCreateRequest,
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    service = get_secret_service()

    metadata = _normalize_metadata(payload.metadata)
    metadata.setdefault("integration_id", normalized_integration_id)

    try:
        record = service.create_secret(
            name=payload.name.strip(),
            value=payload.value,
            provider=payload.provider.strip(),
            kind=payload.kind.strip(),
            metadata=metadata,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    return _build_action_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        operation="create",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_value=getattr(record, "raw_value", None),
        notes=[
            "The raw secret is only returned once during creation.",
            "Store the revealed secret securely before leaving this response.",
            "The secret is now bound to this integration for install, verify, and rollout workflows.",
        ],
    )


@router.post("/{integration_id}/secrets/{secret_id}/rotate", response_model=SecretActionResponse)
def rotate_integration_secret(
    payload: SecretRotateRequest,
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    secret_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    normalized_secret_id = secret_id.strip()

    existing = _get_record_for_integration(normalized_integration_id, normalized_secret_id)
    if existing is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found")

    service = get_secret_service()
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(payload.metadata)
    existing_metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(existing, "metadata", {}))
    merged_metadata = {**existing_metadata, **metadata, "integration_id": normalized_integration_id}

    try:
        record = service.rotate_secret(
            secret_id=normalized_secret_id,
            new_value=payload.value,
            metadata=merged_metadata,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found or inactive")

    return _build_action_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        operation="rotate",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_value=getattr(record, "raw_value", None),
        notes=[
            "The previous secret value should be considered replaced immediately.",
            "The new secret is only returned once during rotation.",
            "Update any dependent integration configurations after rotating this secret.",
        ],
    )


@router.post("/{integration_id}/secrets/{secret_id}/revoke", response_model=SecretActionResponse)
def revoke_integration_secret(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    secret_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    normalized_secret_id = secret_id.strip()

    existing = _get_record_for_integration(normalized_integration_id, normalized_secret_id)
    if existing is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found")

    service = get_secret_service()
    record = service.revoke_secret(normalized_secret_id)

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found")

    return _build_action_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        operation="revoke",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_value=None,
        notes=[
            "Revoked secrets can no longer be used by active integrations.",
            "The secret remains visible in the integration inventory for operator auditability.",
            "Create or rotate a replacement secret before revoking production credentials.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationtelemetry import IntegrationTelemetry


router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integrations"])

_service = IntegrationTelemetry()


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)
    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class TelemetrySeriesPoint(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    value: float
    label: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySeriesView(BaseModel):
    metric: str
    unit: str | None = None
    points: list[TelemetrySeriesPoint] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySignalView(BaseModel):
    signal_id: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    title: str
    detail: str
    timestamp: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryView(BaseModel):
    environment: str
    window: str
    updated_at: str
    total_signals: int
    healthy_signals: int
    warning_signals: int
    critical_signals: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationTelemetryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    telemetry: TelemetrySummaryView
    metrics: list[TelemetrySeriesView]
    signals: list[TelemetrySignalView]


def _normalize_signal_severity(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "info", "normal", "healthy"}:
        return "healthy"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "medium", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"critical", "high", "error", "failed"}:
        return "critical"
    return normalized or "healthy"


def _normalize_signal_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"open", "active", "firing"}:
        return "active"
    if normalized in {"closed", "resolved", "cleared"}:
        return "resolved"
    if normalized in {"suppressed", "muted"}:
        return "suppressed"
    return normalized or "active"


def _coerce_float(value: Any) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _build_series_point(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> TelemetrySeriesPoint:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    timestamp = str(_extract_value(data, "timestamp", "time", "at") or _utcnow())
    value = _coerce_float(_extract_value(data, "value", "count", "metric"))
    label = _extract_value(data, "label", "name")
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("min", "max", "avg", "p95"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    if not label and fallback_index >= 0:
        label = f"point-{fallback_index}"

    return TelemetrySeriesPoint(
        timestamp=timestamp,
        value=value,
        label=str(label) if label is not None else None,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_series_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> TelemetrySeriesView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    metric = str(_extract_value(data, "metric", "name", "id") or f"metric-{fallback_index}")
    unit = _extract_value(data, "unit")
    raw_points = _extract_value(data, "points", "values", "samples") or []
    points = [_build_series_point(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_points))]
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("source", "aggregation", "platform"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return TelemetrySeriesView(
        metric=metric,
        unit=str(unit) if unit is not None else None,
        points=points,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_signal_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> TelemetrySignalView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    signal_id = str(_extract_value(data, "signal_id", "id", "event_id") or f"signal-{fallback_index}")
    category = str(_extract_value(data, "category", "type") or "general")
    severity = _normalize_signal_severity(_extract_value(data, "severity", "level"))
    signal_status = _normalize_signal_status(_extract_value(data, "status", "state"))
    title = str(_extract_value(data, "title", "name", "summary") or signal_id.replace("-", " ").title())
    detail = str(_extract_value(data, "detail", "message", "description") or "")
    timestamp = str(_extract_value(data, "timestamp", "occurred_at", "created_at") or _utcnow())
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("platform", "provider", "component", "metric"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return TelemetrySignalView(
        signal_id=signal_id,
        category=category,
        severity=severity,
        status=signal_status,
        title=title,
        detail=detail,
        timestamp=timestamp,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_telemetry_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str,
    window: str,
) -> IntegrationTelemetryResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    payload = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "telemetry") or result)

    raw_metrics = _extract_value(payload, "metrics", "series") or []
    metrics = [_build_series_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_metrics))]

    raw_signals = _extract_value(payload, "signals", "events", "alerts") or []
    signals = [_build_signal_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_signals))]

    healthy_signals = sum(1 for item in signals if item.severity == "healthy")
    warning_signals = sum(1 for item in signals if item.severity == "warning")
    critical_signals = sum(1 for item in signals if item.severity == "critical")

    metadata = _normalize_dict(payload.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("platform", "adapter_version", "provider"):
        if key in payload and key not in metadata and payload.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = payload.get(key)

    return IntegrationTelemetryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-telemetry",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        telemetry=TelemetrySummaryView(
            environment=str(_extract_value(payload, "environment") or environment),
            window=str(_extract_value(payload, "window", "time_window") or window),
            updated_at=str(_extract_value(payload, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at") or _utcnow()),
            total_signals=len(signals),
            healthy_signals=healthy_signals,
            warning_signals=warning_signals,
            critical_signals=critical_signals,
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        metrics=metrics,
        signals=signals,
    )


def _run_telemetry_lookup(integration_id: str, environment: str, window: str) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment, window=window),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id, environment, window),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.summary(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment, window=window),
        lambda: _service.summary(integration_id, environment, window),
        lambda: _service.summary(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.metrics(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment, window=window),
        lambda: _service.metrics(integration_id, environment, window),
        lambda: _service.metrics(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration telemetry service does not expose a supported telemetry method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/telemetry",
    response_model=IntegrationTelemetryResponse,
    summary="Get integration telemetry and observability signals",
)
def get_integration_telemetry(
    integration_id: str,
    environment: str = Query(default="production"),
    window: str = Query(default="24h"),
) -> IntegrationTelemetryResponse:
    result = _run_telemetry_lookup(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        environment=environment,
        window=window,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_telemetry_response(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        result=result,
        environment=environment,
        window=window,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationverifier import IntegrationVerifier


router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integrations"])

_service = IntegrationVerifier()


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    return [str(value)]


class VerificationCheckView(BaseModel):
    check_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class VerificationSummaryView(BaseModel):
    state: str
    passed: int
    warned: int
    failed: int
    total: int
    blockers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recommendations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationVerificationResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    platform: str | None = None
    adapter_version: str | None = None
    verification: VerificationSummaryView
    checks: list[VerificationCheckView]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)
    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_check_id(data: dict[str, Any], fallback_index: int) -> str:
    for key in ("check_id", "checkid", "id", "name", "key"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return f"check-{fallback_index}"


def _extract_title(data: dict[str, Any], check_id: str) -> str:
    for key in ("title", "label", "name", "summary"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return check_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()


def _extract_status(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("status", "state", "result", "verdict"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
            if normalized in {"pass", "passed", "ok", "ready", "success"}:
                return "pass"
            if normalized in {"warn", "warning"}:
                return "warn"
            if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "error", "blocked"}:
                return "fail"
            return normalized
    return "pass"


def _extract_detail(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return ""


def _build_check_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> VerificationCheckView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    check_id = _extract_check_id(data, fallback_index)
    title = _extract_title(data, check_id)
    status_value = _extract_status(data)
    detail = _extract_detail(data)

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("severity", "category", "platform", "adapter_version"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return VerificationCheckView(
        check_id=check_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_response(integration_id: str, result: Any) -> IntegrationVerificationResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)

    raw_checks = data.get("checks") or data.get("items") or []
    checks = [
        _build_check_view(record, index + 1)
        for index, record in enumerate(raw_checks)
    ]

    passed = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "pass")
    warned = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "warn")
    failed = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "fail")
    total = len(checks)

    state = (
        data.get("state")
        or data.get("verification_state")
        or data.get("overall_status")
        or data.get("status")
        or ("failed" if failed else "warning" if warned else "passed")
    )
    state = str(state).strip().lower()

    blockers = _normalize_list(data.get("blockers"))
    recommendations = _normalize_list(data.get("recommendations"))
    platform = data.get("platform")
    adapter_version = data.get("adapter_version") or data.get("version")

    summary_metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("provider", "adapter_name", "compatibility_matrix_version"):
        if key in data and key not in summary_metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            summary_metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return IntegrationVerificationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-verifier",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        platform=str(platform) if platform is not None else None,
        adapter_version=str(adapter_version) if adapter_version is not None else None,
        verification=VerificationSummaryView(
            state=state,
            passed=passed,
            warned=warned,
            failed=failed,
            total=total,
            blockers=blockers,
            recommendations=recommendations,
            metadata=summary_metadata,
        ),
        checks=checks,
    )


def _run_verification(integration_id: str, deep: bool) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id, deep),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id=integration_id),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.run(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep),
        lambda: _service.run(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration verifier service does not expose a supported verify method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/verify",
    response_model=IntegrationVerificationResponse,
    summary="Verify integration compatibility",
)
def verify_integration(
    integration_id: str,
    deep: bool = Query(default=False),
) -> IntegrationVerificationResponse:
    result = _run_verification(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep)

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_response(integration_id=integration_id, result=result)

FILE: app\routes\organizations.py

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.organizationstore import (
    OrganizationMemberRecord as StoredOrganizationMemberRecord,
    OrganizationRecord as StoredOrganizationRecord,
    getorganizationstore,
)

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/organizations",
    tags=["organizations"],
)

OrganizationRole = Literal["owner", "admin", "analyst", "viewer"]
OrganizationMemberStatus = Literal["active", "suspended", "invited"]
OrganizationStatus = Literal["active", "suspended"]


class OrganizationMemberView(BaseModel):
    memberid: str
    email: str
    displayname: str
    role: OrganizationRole
    status: OrganizationMemberStatus
    createdat: str
    updatedat: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationView(BaseModel):
    organizationid: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    status: OrganizationStatus
    createdat: str
    updatedat: str
    owneremail: str
    members: list[OrganizationMemberView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    items: list[OrganizationView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class OrganizationCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    slug: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    owneremail: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    ownerdisplayname: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationMemberCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    displayname: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    role: OrganizationRole
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    organization: OrganizationView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _member_to_view(member: StoredOrganizationMemberRecord) -> OrganizationMemberView:
    payload = member.to_dict()
    return OrganizationMemberView(
        memberid=payload["memberid"],
        email=payload["email"],
        displayname=payload["displayname"],
        role=payload["role"],
        status=payload["status"],
        createdat=payload["createdat"],
        updatedat=payload["updatedat"],
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )


def _organization_to_view(organization: StoredOrganizationRecord) -> OrganizationView:
    payload = organization.to_dict()
    return OrganizationView(
        organizationid=payload["organizationid"],
        name=payload["name"],
        slug=payload["slug"],
        status=payload["status"],
        createdat=payload["createdat"],
        updatedat=payload["updatedat"],
        owneremail=payload["owneremail"],
        members=[_member_to_view(member) for member in organization.members],
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )


def _find_organization_or_404(organizationid: str) -> StoredOrganizationRecord:
    organization = getorganizationstore().getorganization(organizationid)
    if organization is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {organizationid}",
        )
    return organization


@router.get("", response_model=OrganizationListResponse)
def list_organizations(
    status_filter: OrganizationStatus | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
) -> OrganizationListResponse:
    items = getorganizationstore().listorganizations(status=status_filter)
    return OrganizationListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_organization_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.post("", response_model=OrganizationResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_organization(payload: OrganizationCreateRequest) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = getorganizationstore().createorganization(
        name=payload.name,
        slug=payload.slug,
        owneremail=payload.owneremail,
        ownerdisplayname=payload.ownerdisplayname,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        _, normalized_slug = result
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=f"Organization slug already exists: {normalized_slug}",
        )
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )


@router.get("/{organizationid}", response_model=OrganizationResponse)
def get_organization(organizationid: str) -> OrganizationResponse:
    organization = _find_organization_or_404(organizationid)
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(organization),
    )


@router.post(
    "/{organizationid}/members",
    response_model=OrganizationResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def add_organization_member(
    organizationid: str,
    payload: OrganizationMemberCreateRequest,
) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = getorganizationstore().addmember(
        organizationid,
        email=payload.email,
        displayname=payload.displayname,
        role=payload.role,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        error_type, value = result
        if error_type == "member_exists":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Organization member already exists: {value}",
            )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {value}",
        )
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Annotated, Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

from app.review.reviewqueueservice import (
    ReviewPriority,
    ReviewQueueItem,
    ReviewQueueService,
    ReviewSource,
    ReviewStatus,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/review-queue", tags=["review-queue"])


class ReviewQueueListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[ReviewQueueItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReviewQueueCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    source: ReviewSource
    source_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    priority: ReviewPriority = ReviewPriority.MEDIUM
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    summary: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @field_validator("source_id", "title", "summary")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_non_blank_text(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("must not be blank")
        return normalized

    @field_validator("reasons")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_reasons(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [reason.strip() for reason in value if reason.strip()]
        return normalized


class ReviewQueueAssignRequest(BaseModel):
    reviewer_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

    @field_validator("reviewer_id")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_reviewer_id(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("must not be blank")
        return normalized


class ReviewQueueDismissRequest(BaseModel):
    reason: str | None = None

    @field_validator("reason")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_reason(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return None
        normalized = value.strip()
        return normalized or None


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_review_queue_service() -> ReviewQueueService:
    return ReviewQueueService()


def _get_item_or_404(review_id: str) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    item = get_review_queue_service().get(review_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"review item not found: {review_id}",
        )
    return item


def _parse_review_status(status_filter: str | None) -> ReviewStatus | None:
    if status_filter is None:
        return None
    normalized = status_filter.strip().lower()
    if not normalized:
        return None
    try:
        return ReviewStatus(normalized)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=f"invalid status filter: {status_filter}",
        ) from exc


@router.get("", response_model=ReviewQueueListResponse)
def list_review_queue(
    status_filter: Annotated[str | None, Query(default=None, alias="status")] = None,
    assigned_to: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> ReviewQueueListResponse:
    service = get_review_queue_service()
    normalized_assigned_to = assigned_to.strip() if assigned_to is not None else None
    if normalized_assigned_to == "":
        normalized_assigned_to = None
    items = service.list_items(
        status=_parse_review_status(status_filter),
        assigned_to=normalized_assigned_to,
    )
    return ReviewQueueListResponse(
        items=items,
        counts=service.counts(),
    )


@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=ReviewQueueItem,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def create_review_item(payload: ReviewQueueCreateRequest) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    return get_review_queue_service().enqueue(
        source=payload.source,
        source_id=payload.source_id,
        priority=payload.priority,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        reasons=payload.reasons,
        evidence=payload.evidence,
    )


@router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def get_review_item(review_id: str) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    return _get_item_or_404(review_id)


@router.post("/{review_id}/assign", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def assign_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewQueueAssignRequest,
) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    _get_item_or_404(review_id)
    return get_review_queue_service().assign(review_id, payload.reviewer_id)


@router.post("/{review_id}/complete", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def complete_review_item(review_id: str) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    _get_item_or_404(review_id)
    return get_review_queue_service().complete(review_id)


@router.post("/{review_id}/dismiss", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def dismiss_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewQueueDismissRequest,
) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    _get_item_or_404(review_id)
    return get_review_queue_service().dismiss(review_id, payload.reason)


@router.post("/{review_id}/reopen", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def reopen_review_item(review_id: str) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    _get_item_or_404(review_id)
    return get_review_queue_service().reopen(review_id)


@router.post("/{review_id}/claim", response_model=ReviewQueueItem, include_in_schema=False)
def claim_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewQueueAssignRequest,
) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    _get_item_or_404(review_id)
    return get_review_queue_service().assign(review_id, payload.reviewer_id)


@router.post("/claim-next", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def claim_next_review_item(payload: ReviewQueueAssignRequest) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    item = get_review_queue_service().claim_next(payload.reviewer_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="no pending review items available",
        )
    return item

    "/{review_id}",
    status_code=status.HTTP_405_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED,
    response_model=None,

    _get_item_or_404(review_id)
    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_405_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED,
        detail="review queue items cannot be deleted",
    )

FILE: app\runtime\command_supervisor.py

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.runtime.tool_call_guard import evaluate_tool_call


DANGEROUS_COMMAND_PATTERNS = {
    "rm -rf",
    "del /f /q",
    "format c:",
    "mkfs",
    "shutdown",
    "reboot",
    "net user",
    "reg add",
    "sc config",
    "powershell -enc",
    "curl | bash",
    "wget | sh",
    "Invoke-Expression",
    "Start-Process",
}

SENSITIVE_PATH_PATTERNS = {
    "/etc/",
    "/root/",
    "/home/",
    "c:\\windows",
    "c:\\users",
    "appdata\\",
    ".ssh",
    ".aws",
    ".env",
    "id_rsa",
    "known_hosts",
}

RESTRICTED_COMMANDS = {
    "powershell",
    "pwsh",
    "cmd",
    "bash",
    "sh",
    "zsh",
    "python",
    "python3",
    "pip",
    "npm",
    "npx",
    "curl",
    "wget",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandSupervisorDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    risk_score: int
    should_execute: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    sandbox_lane: str
    command: str
    command_name: str
    target: str
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    sanitized_command: str = ""
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip()


def _normalize_lower(value: Any) -> str:
    return _normalize_text(value).lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_command(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    return str(_get_value(payload, "command", "target", "content", "input") or "")


def _extract_command_name(command: str) -> str:
    stripped = command.strip()
    if not stripped:
        return ""
    return stripped.split()[0].lower()


def _score_command(command: str, command_name: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []
    command_lower = command.lower()

    if command_name in RESTRICTED_COMMANDS:
        score += 25
        reasons.append(f"restricted command detected: {command_name}")

    for pattern in DANGEROUS_COMMAND_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.lower() in command_lower:
            score += 50
            reasons.append(f"dangerous command pattern detected: {pattern}")

    for pattern in SENSITIVE_PATH_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.lower() in command_lower:
            score += 20
            reasons.append(f"sensitive path access detected: {pattern}")

    return score, reasons


def _sanitize_command(command: str) -> str:
    sanitized = command
    redactions = [
        "authorization=",
        "token=",
        "apikey=",
        "api_key=",
        "password=",
        "secret=",
    ]

    for marker in redactions:
        lower = sanitized.lower()
        index = lower.find(marker)
        if index >= 0:
            end_index = sanitized.find(" ", index)
            if end_index == -1:
                end_index = len(sanitized)
            sanitized = sanitized[:index] + marker + "[REDACTED]" + sanitized[end_index:]

    return sanitized


def evaluate_command(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandSupervisorDecision:
    command = _extract_command(payload)
    command_name = _extract_command_name(command)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    command_score, reasons = _score_command(command, command_name)
    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + command_score)

    tool_payload = {
        "tool_name": "shell",
        "action_type": "toolcall",
        "target": command,
        "content": command,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict"),
    }
    tool_decision = evaluate_tool_call(tool_payload)

    if not reasons:
        reasons = list(tool_decision.reasons)

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("command accepted under current supervision policy")

    return CommandSupervisorDecision(
        allowed=tool_decision.allowed,
        response_status=tool_decision.response_status,
        policy_verdict=tool_decision.policy_verdict,
        risk_score=tool_decision.risk_score,
        should_execute=tool_decision.should_execute,
        halted_by_boundary=tool_decision.halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=tool_decision.requires_review,
        sandbox_lane=tool_decision.sandbox_lane,
        command=command,
        command_name=command_name,
        target=str(_get_value(payload, "target") or command),
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        sanitized_command=_sanitize_command(command),
        metadata={"source": "command_supervisor"},
    )


def summarize_command_supervisor(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_command(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "DANGEROUS_COMMAND_PATTERNS",
    "SENSITIVE_PATH_PATTERNS",
    "RESTRICTED_COMMANDS",
    "CommandSupervisorDecision",
    "evaluate_command",
    "summarize_command_supervisor",
]

    "certutil",
    "bitsadmin",
    "regsvr32",
    "mshta",
    "rundll32",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int = 0

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "source": self.source,
            "label": self.label,
            "details": self.details,
            "score": int(self.score),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandPolicy:
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    should_review: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    risk_delta: int
    normalized_command: str
    executable: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cwd: str | None = None
    environment_scope: str = "sandbox"
    command_kind: str = "shell"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.risk_delta),
            "normalizedcommand": self.normalized_command,
            "executable": self.executable,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "cwd": self.cwd,
            "environmentscope": self.environment_scope,
            "commandkind": self.command_kind,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandSupervisor:
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80
    max_command_length: int = 4000
    allowed_binaries: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_BINARIES))
    blocked_basenames: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_BLOCKED_BASENAMES))
    blocked_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATTERNS

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        command: str | Sequence[str],
        actiontype: str = "command",
        target: str = "shell",
        cwd: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> CommandPolicy:
        normalized_command = self._normalize_command(command)
        executable = self._extract_executable(command)
        normalized_action = str(actiontype or "").strip().lower()
        normalized_target = str(target or "").strip().lower()
        command_kind = "shell" if normalized_target in SHELL_LIKE_TARGETS else "subprocess"
        environment_scope = str((metadata or {}).get("environment_scope") or "sandbox")

        reasons: list[CommandReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not normalized_command:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Empty command",
                    details="Command execution was denied because no command content was provided.",
                    score=60,
                )
            )
            return self._finalize(
                reasons=reasons,
                matched_rules=["empty_command"],
                risk_delta=60,
                normalized_command=normalized_command,
                executable=executable,
                cwd=cwd,
                environment_scope=environment_scope,
                command_kind=command_kind,
            )

        if len(normalized_command) > self.max_command_length:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Command too large",
                    details=(
                        f"Command length {len(normalized_command)} exceeded the allowed maximum "
                        f"of {self.max_command_length} characters."
                    ),
                    score=35,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("oversized_command")
            risk_delta += 35

        if normalized_action in COMMAND_LIKE_ACTIONS or normalized_target in SHELL_LIKE_TARGETS:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Execution boundary",
                    details=(
                        f"Command supervision applied hardened policy for action '{actiontype}' "
                        f"targeting '{target}'."
                    ),
                    score=10,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("execution_boundary")
            risk_delta += 10

        if executable:
            basename = executable.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].rsplit("\\", 1)[-1].lower()
            if basename in self.blocked_basenames:
                reasons.append(
                    CommandReason(
                        source="commandsupervisor",
                        label="Blocked executable",
                        details=f"Executable '{basename}' is explicitly blocked by command policy.",
                        score=70,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"blocked_basename:{basename}")
                risk_delta += 70
            elif basename not in {item.lower() for item in self.allowed_binaries}:
                reasons.append(
                    CommandReason(
                        source="commandsupervisor",
                        label="Unapproved executable",
                        details=(
                            f"Executable '{basename}' is outside the approved sandbox command set "
                            "and requires review."
                        ),
                        score=20,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_basename:{basename}")
                risk_delta += 20
        else:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Unknown executable",
                    details="Unable to determine the executable from the provided command payload.",
                    score=15,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("unknown_executable")
            risk_delta += 15

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.blocked_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, normalized_command):
                reasons.append(
                    CommandReason(
                        source="commandsupervisor",
                        label="Command policy match",
                        details=f"Command matched supervised rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        if self._looks_like_chained_execution(normalized_command):
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Chained execution",
                    details="Command contains chained execution operators and needs stricter review.",
                    score=15,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("chained_execution")
            risk_delta += 15

        if self._references_parent_escape(cwd=cwd, command=normalized_command):
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Path escape attempt",
                    details="Command appears to reference parent-directory traversal outside the sandbox.",
                    score=40,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("path_escape")
            risk_delta += 40

        if self._requests_interactive_session(normalized_command):
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Interactive session request",
                    details="Interactive or long-lived shell behavior was detected.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("interactive_session")
            risk_delta += 25

        if environment_scope.lower() != "sandbox":
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Non-sandbox environment",
                    details=(
                        f"Environment scope '{environment_scope}' is outside the default sandbox "
                        "boundary and requires escalation."
                    ),
                    score=45,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("non_sandbox_environment")
            risk_delta += 45

        return self._finalize(
            reasons=reasons,
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            risk_delta=risk_delta,
            normalized_command=normalized_command,
            executable=executable,
            cwd=cwd,
            environment_scope=environment_scope,
            command_kind=command_kind,
        )

    def allow(
        self,
        *,
        command: str | Sequence[str],
        actiontype: str = "command",
        target: str = "shell",
        cwd: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(
            command=command,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            cwd=cwd,
            metadata=metadata,
        ).allowed

    def _finalize(
        self,
        *,
        reasons: Iterable[CommandReason],
        matched_rules: list[str],
        risk_delta: int,
        normalized_command: str,
        executable: str,
        cwd: str | None,
        environment_scope: str,
        command_kind: str,
    ) -> CommandPolicy:
        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        if normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True

        return CommandPolicy(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            normalized_command=normalized_command,
            executable=executable,
            reasons=[reason.as_dict() for reason in reasons],
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            cwd=cwd,
            environment_scope=environment_scope,
            command_kind=command_kind,
        )

    def _normalize_command(self, command: str | Sequence[str]) -> str:
        if isinstance(command, str):
            return command.strip()
        parts = [str(part).strip() for part in command if str(part).strip()]
        return " ".join(parts).strip()

    def _extract_executable(self, command: str | Sequence[str]) -> str:
        if isinstance(command, str):
            try:
                parts = shlex.split(command, posix=False)
            except ValueError:
                parts = command.strip().split()
        else:
            parts = [str(part).strip() for part in command if str(part).strip()]
        return parts[0] if parts else ""

    def _looks_like_chained_execution(self, command: str) -> bool:
        return any(token in command for token in ("&&", "||", "|", ";"))

    def _references_parent_escape(self, *, cwd: str | None, command: str) -> bool:
        if ".." in command.replace("\\", "/"):
            return True
        if cwd and ".." in str(cwd).replace("\\", "/"):
            return True
        return False

    def _requests_interactive_session(self, command: str) -> bool:
        patterns = (
            r"(?i)\bssh\b",
            r"(?i)\btelnet\b",
            r"(?i)\bftp\b",
            r"(?i)\bpython\b.*\s-i\b",
            r"(?i)\bbash\b.*\s-i\b",
            r"(?i)\bpowershell(?:\.exe)?\b.*\s-noexit\b",
        )
        return any(re.search(pattern, command) for pattern in patterns)


def initialize_commandsupervisor(
    *,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
    max_command_length: int = 4000,
    allowed_binaries: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_basenames: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_patterns: Sequence[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
) -> CommandSupervisor:
    return CommandSupervisor(
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
        max_command_length=max_command_length,
        allowed_binaries=set(allowed_binaries or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_BINARIES),
        blocked_basenames=set(blocked_basenames or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_BASENAMES),
        blocked_patterns=tuple(blocked_patterns or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATTERNS),
    )


def build_command_supervisor() -> CommandSupervisor:
    return initialize_commandsupervisor()
