from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import PurePath
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.runtime.sandbox_router import SandboxLane, route_to_sandbox


HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".exe",
    ".dll",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".msi",
    ".scr",
    ".jar",
    ".vbs",
    ".js",
    ".hta",
    ".com",
    ".reg",
    ".apk",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".zip",
    ".rar",
    ".7z",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".tgz",
    ".xz",
    ".iso",
    ".img",
    ".docm",
    ".xlsm",
    ".pptm",
    ".html",
    ".svg",
    ".pdf",
}

HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "macro",
    "payload",
    "dropper",
    "persistence",
    "autorun",
    "credential",
    "token",
    "keylogger",
    "obfuscated",
    "powershell",
    "javascript",
    "executable",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "archive",
    "embedded",
    "downloaded",
    "script",
    "external link",
    "remote content",
    "attachment",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class FileReturnGuardDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    sandbox_lane: str
    risk_score: int
    should_release: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    file_name: str
    file_path: str
    file_extension: str
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _detect_extension(file_path: str, file_name: str) -> str:
    candidate = file_path or file_name
    if not candidate:
        return ""
    return PurePath(candidate).suffix.lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], file_name: str, file_path: str) -> str:
    parts = [file_name, file_path]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "quarantine_reason",
        "content_type",
        "description",
        "source",
        "origin",
        "scan_summary",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("tags", "alerts", "matched_patterns", "failed_checks", "reasons"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _score_extension(file_extension: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if file_extension in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 70, [f"high-risk file extension detected: {file_extension}"]
    if file_extension in MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 25, [f"reviewable file extension detected: {file_extension}"]
    return 0, []


def _score_keywords(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for keyword in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 25
            reasons.append(f"high-risk file keyword detected: {keyword}")

    for keyword in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 10
            reasons.append(f"review keyword detected: {keyword}")

    return score, reasons


def evaluate_file_return(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> FileReturnGuardDecision:
    file_name = str(_get_value(payload, "file_name", "name") or "")
    file_path = str(_get_value(payload, "file_path", "filepath", "path") or "")
    file_extension = _detect_extension(file_path, file_name)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, file_name, file_path)
    extension_score, extension_reasons = _score_extension(file_extension)
    keyword_score, keyword_reasons = _score_keywords(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + extension_score + keyword_score)
    reasons = [*extension_reasons, *keyword_reasons]

    route_payload = {
        "target": file_path or file_name,
        "content": signal_text,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict") or payload.get("verdict"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "quarantine_reason": payload.get("quarantine_reason"),
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
    }
    route_decision = route_to_sandbox(route_payload)

    if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK:
        response_status = "denied"
        policy_verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
        should_release = False
    elif route_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        policy_verdict = "quarantine" if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.FILE_QUARANTINE else "warn"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
        should_release = False
    else:
        response_status = "completed"
        policy_verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        halted_by_boundary = False
        should_release = True

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("file return accepted under current low-risk policy")

    return FileReturnGuardDecision(
        allowed=allowed,
        response_status=response_status,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict,
        sandbox_lane=route_decision.lane.value,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        should_release=should_release,
        halted_by_boundary=halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=route_decision.requires_review,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        file_extension=file_extension,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        metadata={"source": "file_return_guard"},
    )


def summarize_file_return_guard(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_file_return(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS",
    "HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "FileReturnGuardDecision",
    "evaluate_file_return",
    "summarize_file_return_guard",
]

@dataclass(slots=True)
class FileReturnGuard:
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80
    max_file_size_bytes: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024
    max_text_inspection_bytes: int = 256 * 1024
    allowed_extensions: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))
    blocked_extensions: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS))
    blocked_mime_prefixes: tuple[str, ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_MIME_PREFIXES
    allowed_root_names: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_ROOT_NAMES))
    sensitive_name_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_NAME_PATTERNS
    file_inspection_service: Any | None = None

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        path: str,
        content: str | bytes | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> FileReturnPolicy:
        normalized_path = str(path or "").strip()
        metadata_dict = dict(metadata or {})
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] = {}
        download_analysis: dict[str, Any] = {}
        output_sanitization: dict[str, Any] = {}
        file_inspection: dict[str, Any] = {}

        if not normalized_path:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Missing path",
                    details="Artifact return was denied because no file path was provided.",
                    score=80,
                )
            )
            return self._finalize(
                reasons=reasons,
                matched_rules=["missing_path"],
                risk_delta=80,
                path="",
                filename="",
                extension="",
                mime_type="application/octet-stream",
                size_bytes=0,
                artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
                download_analysis=download_analysis,
                output_sanitization=output_sanitization,
                file_inspection=file_inspection,
            )

        candidate = Path(normalized_path)
        normalized_posix = candidate.as_posix().replace("\\", "/")
        filename = candidate.name
        extension = candidate.suffix.lower()
        mime_type = mimetypes.guess_type(filename)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
        size_bytes = self._resolve_size_bytes(candidate=candidate, content=content)

        if self._has_parent_escape(normalized_posix):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Path escape attempt",
                    details="Artifact path references parent-directory traversal outside the return boundary.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("path_escape")
            risk_delta += 85

        if self._has_absolute_path(normalized_posix):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Absolute path denied",
                    details="Artifact path must remain relative to an approved sandbox return directory.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("absolute_path")
            risk_delta += 85

        root_name = self._resolve_root_name(candidate)
        allowed_roots = {item.lower() for item in self.allowed_root_names}
        if root_name and root_name not in allowed_roots:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Unapproved artifact root",
                    details=f"Artifact root '{root_name}' is outside the approved return directories.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_root:{root_name}")
            risk_delta += 25

        if extension in self.blocked_extensions:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Blocked file type",
                    details=f"Extension '{extension}' is blocked from leaving the sandbox.",
                    score=90,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"blocked_extension:{extension}")
            risk_delta += 90
        elif extension and extension not in self.allowed_extensions:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Unapproved file type",
                    details=f"Extension '{extension}' is not in the approved artifact return set.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_extension:{extension}")
            risk_delta += 25
        elif not extension:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Missing extension",
                    details="Artifact has no extension and requires review before return.",
                    score=20,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("missing_extension")
            risk_delta += 20

        for blocked_prefix in self.blocked_mime_prefixes:
            if mime_type.startswith(blocked_prefix):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Blocked MIME type",
                        details=f"MIME type '{mime_type}' is blocked by artifact return policy.",
                        score=85,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"blocked_mime:{blocked_prefix}")
                risk_delta += 85

        allowed_mimes = _ALLOWED_MIME_OVERRIDES.get(extension)
        if allowed_mimes and mime_type not in allowed_mimes:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Unexpected MIME type",
                    details=f"MIME type '{mime_type}' does not match the expected type set for '{extension}'.",
                    score=35,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"mime_mismatch:{extension}")
            risk_delta += 35

        if size_bytes > self.max_file_size_bytes:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Oversized artifact",
                    details=(
                        f"Artifact size {size_bytes} bytes exceeded the allowed maximum "
                        f"of {self.max_file_size_bytes} bytes."
                    ),
                    score=55,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("oversized_artifact")
            risk_delta += 55
        elif size_bytes == 0:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Empty artifact",
                    details="Artifact is empty and requires review before return.",
                    score=10,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("empty_artifact")
            risk_delta += 10

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.sensitive_name_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, normalized_posix):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Sensitive artifact name",
                        details=f"Artifact path matched sensitive rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        payload_bytes = self._resolve_payload_bytes(candidate=candidate, content=content)
        payload_text = self._decode_payload_text(payload_bytes)

        binary_risk, binary_reasons, binary_rules = self._inspect_binary_signature(
            filename=filename or normalized_posix,
            extension=extension,
            payload_bytes=payload_bytes,
        )
        reasons.extend(binary_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(binary_rules)
        risk_delta += binary_risk

        archive_risk, archive_reasons, archive_rules = self._inspect_archive_entries(
            filename=filename or normalized_posix,
            extension=extension,
            payload_bytes=payload_bytes,
        )
        reasons.extend(archive_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(archive_rules)
        risk_delta += archive_risk

        artifact_analysis = analyze_artifact_dict(
            artifact_name=filename or normalized_posix,
            content=payload_text or normalized_posix,
            metadata={
                "path": normalized_posix,
                "mimetype": mime_type,
                "sizebytes": size_bytes,
                **metadata_dict,
            },
        )
        artifact_risk, artifact_reasons, artifact_rules = self._consume_analysis(
            source_default="artifactanalyzer",
            label_default="Artifact analysis",
            analysis=artifact_analysis,
        )
        reasons.extend(artifact_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(artifact_rules)
        risk_delta += artifact_risk

        download_analysis = analyze_download_dict(
            actiontype="artifact_return",
            target=filename or normalized_posix,
            content=payload_text or normalized_posix,
            filepath=normalized_posix,
            metadata={
                "path": normalized_posix,
                "mimetype": mime_type,
                "sizebytes": size_bytes,
                **metadata_dict,
            },
        )
        download_risk, download_reasons, download_rules = self._consume_analysis(
            source_default="downloadanalyzer",
            label_default="Download analysis",
            analysis=download_analysis,
        )
        reasons.extend(download_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(download_rules)
        risk_delta += download_risk

        inspection_service = self.file_inspection_service or build_file_inspection_service(
            max_file_size_bytes=self.max_file_size_bytes,
            max_inline_text_bytes=self.max_text_inspection_bytes,
        )
        inspection_result = inspection_service.inspect_artifact(
            file_name=filename or normalized_posix,
            content=payload_bytes,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            metadata={
                "path": normalized_posix,
                "sizebytes": size_bytes,
                **metadata_dict,
            },
            context="sandbox_return",
        )
        file_inspection = inspection_result.as_dict()
        file_inspection_risk = int(file_inspection.get("riskdelta", 0) or 0)
        risk_delta += file_inspection_risk
        if file_inspection.get("shouldquarantine"):
            matched_rules.append("fileinspection:quarantine")
        elif file_inspection.get("blocked"):
            matched_rules.append("fileinspection:block")
        elif file_inspection.get("shouldreview"):
            matched_rules.append("fileinspection:review")
        for item in file_inspection.get("reasons", []) or []:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="fileinspectionservice",
                        label=str(item.get("label", "File inspection")),
                        details=str(item.get("details", item.get("label", "File inspection detected."))),
                        score=int(item.get("score", 0) or 0),
                    )
                )
            else:
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="fileinspectionservice",
                        label="File inspection",
                        details=str(item),
                        score=0,
                    )
                )

        sanitizer = build_output_sanitizer()
        sanitized = sanitizer.sanitize(
            payload_text or filename or normalized_posix,
            context=f"artifact_return:{normalized_posix}",
            redact_secrets=True,
            block_unsafe_commands=True,
        )
        output_sanitization = sanitized.as_dict()
        if output_sanitization.get("blocked"):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Sanitized output blocked",
                    details="Artifact content triggered output sanitization blocking rules.",
                    score=70,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("output_sanitizer_block")
            risk_delta += 70
        else:
            sanitizer_score = int(round(float(output_sanitization.get("score", 0.0)) * 100))
            if sanitizer_score > 0:
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Sanitized output risk",
                        details="Artifact content triggered output sanitization review signals.",
                        score=sanitizer_score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append("output_sanitizer_risk")
                risk_delta += sanitizer_score

        return self._finalize(
            reasons=reasons,
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            risk_delta=risk_delta,
            path=normalized_posix,
            filename=filename,
            extension=extension,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            size_bytes=size_bytes,
            artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
            download_analysis=download_analysis,
            output_sanitization=output_sanitization,
            file_inspection=file_inspection,
        )

    def allow(
        self,
        *,
        path: str,
        content: str | bytes | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(path=path, content=content, metadata=metadata).allowed

    def _resolve_size_bytes(self, *, candidate: Path, content: str | bytes | None) -> int:
        if content is not None:
            if isinstance(content, bytes):
                return len(content)
            return len(content.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        if candidate.exists() and candidate.is_file():
            try:
                return candidate.stat().st_size
            except OSError:
                return 0
        return 0

    def _resolve_payload_bytes(self, *, candidate: Path, content: str | bytes | None) -> bytes:
        if isinstance(content, bytes):
            return content[: self.max_text_inspection_bytes]
        if isinstance(content, str):
            return content.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")[: self.max_text_inspection_bytes]
        if candidate.exists() and candidate.is_file():
            try:
                with candidate.open("rb") as handle:
                    return handle.read(self.max_text_inspection_bytes)
            except OSError:
                return b""
        return b""

    def _decode_payload_text(self, payload: bytes) -> str:
        if not payload:
            return ""
        return payload.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")

    def _resolve_root_name(self, candidate: Path) -> str:
        parts = [part.lower() for part in candidate.parts if part not in {os.sep, ""}]
        if not parts:
            return ""
        if parts[0] == "." and len(parts) > 1:
            return parts[1]
        return parts[0]

    def _has_parent_escape(self, normalized_posix: str) -> bool:
        parts = [part for part in normalized_posix.replace("\\", "/").split("/") if part]
        return ".." in parts

    def _has_absolute_path(self, normalized_posix: str) -> bool:
        if normalized_posix.startswith("/"):
            return True
        return bool(re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:/", normalized_posix))

    def _inspect_binary_signature(
        self,
        *,
        filename: str,
        extension: str,
        payload_bytes: bytes,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[FileReturnReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for magic, label, score in _BINARY_MAGIC_LABELS:
            if payload_bytes.startswith(magic):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Dangerous binary signature",
                        details=f"Artifact '{filename}' matched binary signature '{label}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"binary_signature:{label}")
                risk_delta += score

        if extension in {".zip", ".jar"} and payload_bytes.startswith(b"MZ"):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Extension/content mismatch",
                    details="Artifact extension indicates an archive but payload signature indicates an executable.",
                    score=90,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("extension_content_mismatch")
            risk_delta += 90

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _inspect_archive_entries(
        self,
        *,
        filename: str,
        extension: str,
        payload_bytes: bytes,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[FileReturnReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if extension != ".zip" and not zipfile.is_zipfile(io.BytesIO(payload_bytes)):
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload_bytes), "r") as archive:
                for info in archive.infolist():
                    entry_name = info.filename.replace("\\", "/")
                    if _SUSPICIOUS_ARCHIVE_ENTRY_RE.search(entry_name):
                        reasons.append(
                            FileReturnReason(
                                source="filereturnguard",
                                label="Archive path traversal",
                                details=f"Archive '{filename}' contains suspicious entry '{entry_name}'.",
                                score=85,
                            )
                        )
                        matched_rules.append("archive_path_traversal")
                        risk_delta += 85
                    entry_extension = Path(entry_name).suffix.lower()
                    if entry_extension in self.blocked_extensions:
                        reasons.append(
                            FileReturnReason(
                                source="filereturnguard",
                                label="Archive contains blocked file",
                                details=f"Archive '{filename}' contains blocked entry '{entry_name}'.",
                                score=90,
                            )
                        )
                        matched_rules.append(f"archive_blocked_extension:{entry_extension}")
                        risk_delta += 90
        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Invalid archive",
                    details=f"Artifact '{filename}' claims to be an archive but could not be parsed.",
                    score=60,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("invalid_archive")
            risk_delta += 60

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _consume_analysis(
        self,
        *,
        source_default: str,
        label_default: str,
        analysis: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> tuple[int, list[FileReturnReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = int(analysis.get("riskdelta", 0) or 0)

        for item in analysis.get("reasons", []) or []:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source=str(item.get("source", source_default)),
                        label=str(item.get("label", label_default)),
                        details=str(item.get("details", f"{label_default} detected.")),
                        score=int(item.get("score", 0) or 0),
                    )
                )
            else:
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source=source_default,
                        label=label_default,
                        details=str(item),
                        score=0,
                    )
                )

        if analysis.get("shouldquarantine"):
            matched_rules.append(f"{source_default}:quarantine")
        elif analysis.get("shouldblock") or analysis.get("blocked"):
            matched_rules.append(f"{source_default}:block")
        elif analysis.get("shouldreview"):
            matched_rules.append(f"{source_default}:review")

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _finalize(
        self,
        *,
        reasons: Iterable[FileReturnReason],
        matched_rules: list[str],
        risk_delta: int,
        path: str,
        filename: str,
        extension: str,
        mime_type: str,
        size_bytes: int,
        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any],
        download_analysis: dict[str, Any],
        output_sanitization: dict[str, Any],
        file_inspection: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> FileReturnPolicy:
        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        should_quarantine = (
            bool(artifact_analysis.get("shouldquarantine"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("shouldquarantine"))
            or bool(file_inspection.get("shouldquarantine"))
        )
        should_review = (
            bool(artifact_analysis.get("shouldreview"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("shouldreview"))
            or bool(file_inspection.get("shouldreview"))
        )
        should_block = (
            bool(artifact_analysis.get("shouldblock"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("shouldblock"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("blocked"))
            or bool(file_inspection.get("blocked"))
        )

        if normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold or should_quarantine:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
            should_review = False
        elif normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold or output_sanitization.get("blocked") or should_block:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold or should_review:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True

        deduped_rules = list(dict.fromkeys(item for item in matched_rules if item))
        materialized_reasons = self._dedupe_reasons(reasons)

        return FileReturnPolicy(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            path=path,
            filename=filename,
            extension=extension,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            size_bytes=size_bytes,
            reasons=[reason.as_dict() for reason in materialized_reasons],
            matched_rules=deduped_rules,
            artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
            download_analysis=download_analysis,
            output_sanitization=output_sanitization,
            file_inspection=file_inspection,
        )

    def _dedupe_reasons(self, reasons: Iterable[FileReturnReason]) -> list[FileReturnReason]:
        deduped: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = set()
        for reason in reasons:
            key = (reason.source, reason.label, reason.details, int(reason.score))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(reason)
        return deduped[:20]


def initialize_filereturnguard(
    *,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
    max_file_size_bytes: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024,
    max_text_inspection_bytes: int = 256 * 1024,
    allowed_extensions: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_extensions: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_mime_prefixes: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    allowed_root_names: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    sensitive_name_patterns: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
    file_inspection_service: Any | None = None,
) -> FileReturnGuard:
    return FileReturnGuard(
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
        max_file_size_bytes=max_file_size_bytes,
        max_text_inspection_bytes=max_text_inspection_bytes,
        allowed_extensions=set(allowed_extensions or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS),
        blocked_extensions=set(blocked_extensions or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS),
        blocked_mime_prefixes=tuple(blocked_mime_prefixes or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_MIME_PREFIXES),
        allowed_root_names=set(allowed_root_names or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_ROOT_NAMES),
        sensitive_name_patterns=tuple(sensitive_name_patterns or DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_NAME_PATTERNS),
        file_inspection_service=file_inspection_service,
    )


def build_file_return_guard() -> FileReturnGuard:
    return initialize_filereturnguard()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from app.runtime.sandbox_router import SandboxLane, route_to_sandbox


LOCAL_HOSTS = {
    "localhost",
    "127.0.0.1",
    "::1",
    "0.0.0.0",
    "host.docker.internal",
}

HIGH_RISK_SCHEMES = {
    "file",
    "ftp",
    "smb",
    "ssh",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "download",
    "upload",
    "fetch",
    "webhook",
    "remote",
    "external",
    "redirect",
    "archive",
}

HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "metadata",
    "credential",
    "token",
    "cookie",
    "exfiltrate",
    "callback",
    "beacon",
    "command and control",
    "c2",
    "internal service",
    "169.254.169.254",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkGuardDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    sandbox_lane: str
    risk_score: int
    should_execute: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    url: str
    hostname: str
    scheme: str
    is_local_target: bool
    is_private_target: bool
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_url(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    value = _get_value(payload, "url", "target", "target_value", "resource")
    return str(value or "")


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], url: str) -> str:
    parts = [url]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "content",
        "description",
        "action_type",
        "target_type",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("reasons", "failed_checks", "matched_patterns", "tags", "alerts"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _is_private_target(hostname: str) -> bool:
    if not hostname:
        return False

    hostname = hostname.lower()

    if hostname in LOCAL_HOSTS:
        return True

    private_prefixes = (
        "10.",
        "192.168.",
        "172.16.",
        "172.17.",
        "172.18.",
        "172.19.",
        "172.20.",
        "172.21.",
        "172.22.",
        "172.23.",
        "172.24.",
        "172.25.",
        "172.26.",
        "172.27.",
        "172.28.",
        "172.29.",
        "172.30.",
        "172.31.",
    )

    return hostname.startswith(private_prefixes)


def _scheme_score(scheme: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if scheme in HIGH_RISK_SCHEMES:
        return 50, [f"high-risk network scheme detected: {scheme}"]
    if scheme in {"http", "https"}:
        return 10, [f"external network request detected: {scheme}"]
    if scheme:
        return 20, [f"unrecognized network scheme detected: {scheme}"]
    return 0, []


def _target_score(hostname: str, is_private_target: bool) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    reasons: list[str] = []
    score = 0

    if not hostname:
        return 20, ["missing hostname in network request"]

    if hostname.lower() in LOCAL_HOSTS:
        score += 70
        reasons.append(f"local target detected: {hostname}")
    elif is_private_target:
        score += 60
        reasons.append(f"private-network target detected: {hostname}")

    if hostname.endswith(".local"):
        score += 40
        reasons.append(f"local-domain target detected: {hostname}")

    return score, reasons


def _keyword_score(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for keyword in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 30
            reasons.append(f"high-risk network keyword detected: {keyword}")

    for keyword in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 10
            reasons.append(f"network review keyword detected: {keyword}")

    return score, reasons


def evaluate_network_request(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> NetworkGuardDecision:
    url = _extract_url(payload)
    parsed = urlparse(url if "://" in url else f"https://{url}" if url else "")
    hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
    scheme = _normalize_text(parsed.scheme)
    is_private_target = _is_private_target(hostname)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, url)
    scheme_score, scheme_reasons = _scheme_score(scheme)
    target_score, target_reasons = _target_score(hostname, is_private_target)
    keyword_score, keyword_reasons = _keyword_score(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + scheme_score + target_score + keyword_score)
    reasons = [*scheme_reasons, *target_reasons, *keyword_reasons]

    route_payload = {
        "action_type": payload.get("action_type") or "network_request",
        "target": url,
        "content": signal_text,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict") or payload.get("verdict"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
    }
    route_decision = route_to_sandbox(route_payload)

    if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK:
        response_status = "denied"
        policy_verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
    elif route_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        policy_verdict = "warn"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
    else:
        response_status = "completed"
        policy_verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        halted_by_boundary = False

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("network request accepted under current low-risk policy")

    return NetworkGuardDecision(
        allowed=allowed,
        response_status=response_status,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict,
        sandbox_lane=route_decision.lane.value,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        should_execute=route_decision.should_execute and allowed,
        halted_by_boundary=halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=route_decision.requires_review,
        url=url,
        hostname=hostname,
        scheme=scheme,
        is_local_target=hostname in LOCAL_HOSTS,
        is_private_target=is_private_target,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        metadata={"source": "network_guard"},
    )


def summarize_network_guard(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_network_request(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "LOCAL_HOSTS",
    "HIGH_RISK_SCHEMES",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "NetworkGuardDecision",
    "evaluate_network_request",
    "summarize_network_guard",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import ipaddress
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlparse

from app.detection.secretscanner import build_secret_scanner


DEFAULT_ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https"}
DEFAULT_BLOCKED_SCHEMES = {
    "file",
    "ftp",
    "ftps",
    "gopher",
    "ldap",
    "ldaps",
    "dict",
    "smb",
    "ssh",
    "telnet",
    "ws",
    "wss",
}
DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS = {
    "api.openai.com",
    "api.groq.com",
    "github.com",
    "raw.githubusercontent.com",
    "pypi.org",
    "files.pythonhosted.org",
}
DEFAULT_BLOCKED_HOST_PATTERNS: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = (

    ("loopback_name", r"(?i)^localhost\.localdomain$", 80),
    ("metadata_service", r"(?i)^169\.254\.169\.254$", 100),

    ("docker_socket_like", r"(?i)/var/run/docker\.sock", 100),
    ("sensitive_admin_path", r"(?i)/(admin|debug|actuator|internal)(?:/|$)", 30),

    ("api_key_field", r"(?i)(api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|refresh[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|secret)$", 45),
    ("password_field", r"(?i)(password|passwd|pwd)$", 50),

    ("kubeconfig_reference", r"(?i)kubeconfig", 35),

    ("archive_exfil_pattern", r"(?i)\b(tar|zip|gzip|base64)\b", 10),
)

@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int = 0

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "source": self.source,
            "label": self.label,
            "details": self.details,
            "score": int(self.score),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkPolicy:
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    should_review: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    risk_delta: int
    scheme: str
    host: str
    port: int | None
    path: str
    normalized_url: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    direction: str = "egress"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.risk_delta),
            "scheme": self.scheme,
            "host": self.host,
            "port": self.port,
            "path": self.path,
            "normalizedurl": self.normalized_url,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "direction": self.direction,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkGuard:
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80
    allowed_schemes: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_SCHEMES))
    blocked_schemes: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_BLOCKED_SCHEMES))
    allowed_hosts: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS))
    blocked_host_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_HOST_PATTERNS
    blocked_path_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATH_PATTERNS
    sensitive_field_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_FIELD_PATTERNS
    exfil_content_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_EXFIL_CONTENT_PATTERNS
    high_risk_ports: dict[int, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: dict(DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_PORTS))
    allow_private_hosts: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.allowed_schemes = {item.strip().lower() for item in self.allowed_schemes if str(item).strip()}
        self.blocked_schemes = {item.strip().lower() for item in self.blocked_schemes if str(item).strip()}
        self.allowed_hosts = {item.strip().lower() for item in self.allowed_hosts if str(item).strip()}
        self._allowed_host_suffixes = self._expand_allowed_host_suffixes(self.allowed_hosts)
        self._secret_scanner = build_secret_scanner()

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        url: str,
        method: str = "GET",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> NetworkPolicy:
        normalized_url = str(url or "").strip()
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0
        metadata_map = dict(metadata or {})
        direction = str(metadata_map.get("direction") or "egress").strip().lower() or "egress"

        if not normalized_url:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Missing URL",
                    details="Network request was denied because no URL was provided.",
                    score=80,
                )
            )
            return self._finalize(
                reasons=reasons,
                matched_rules=["missing_url"],
                risk_delta=80,
                scheme="",
                host="",
                port=None,
                path="",
                normalized_url=normalized_url,
                direction=direction,
            )

        parsed = urlparse(normalized_url)
        scheme = (parsed.scheme or "").strip().lower()
        host = (parsed.hostname or "").strip().lower()
        port = parsed.port
        path = parsed.path or "/"
        normalized_method = str(method or "GET").upper()

        if not scheme:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Missing scheme",
                    details="Network request must include an explicit scheme such as https.",
                    score=60,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("missing_scheme")
            risk_delta += 60

        if scheme in self.blocked_schemes:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Blocked scheme",
                    details=f"Scheme '{scheme}' is blocked by runtime network policy.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"blocked_scheme:{scheme}")
            risk_delta += 85
        elif scheme and scheme not in self.allowed_schemes:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Unapproved scheme",
                    details=f"Scheme '{scheme}' is outside the approved network policy set.",
                    score=35,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_scheme:{scheme}")
            risk_delta += 35

        if not host:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Missing host",
                    details="Network request URL did not resolve to a host component.",
                    score=70,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("missing_host")
            risk_delta += 70
        else:
            host_risk, host_reasons, host_rules = self._evaluate_host(host)
            reasons.extend(host_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(host_rules)
            risk_delta += host_risk

        path_risk, path_reasons, path_rules = self._evaluate_path(path)
        reasons.extend(path_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(path_rules)
        risk_delta += path_risk

        port_risk, port_reasons, port_rules = self._evaluate_port(port=port, scheme=scheme)
        reasons.extend(port_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(port_rules)
        risk_delta += port_risk

        query_risk, query_reasons, query_rules = self._evaluate_query(parsed.query)
        reasons.extend(query_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(query_rules)
        risk_delta += query_risk

        header_risk, header_reasons, header_rules = self._evaluate_headers(metadata_map.get("headers"))
        reasons.extend(header_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(header_rules)
        risk_delta += header_risk

        body_risk, body_reasons, body_rules = self._evaluate_outbound_content(metadata_map)
        reasons.extend(body_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(body_rules)
        risk_delta += body_risk

        if normalized_method not in {"GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Unexpected method",
                    details=f"HTTP method '{normalized_method}' is non-standard for this runtime profile.",
                    score=10,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unexpected_method:{normalized_method}")
            risk_delta += 10

        if host and self._is_explicitly_allowed_host(host):
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Approved destination",
                    details=f"Host '{host}' is explicitly allowlisted for sandbox egress.",
                    score=0,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"allowed_host:{host}")

        return self._finalize(
            reasons=reasons,
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            risk_delta=risk_delta,
            scheme=scheme,
            host=host,
            port=port,
            path=path,
            normalized_url=normalized_url,
            direction=direction,
        )

    def allow(
        self,
        *,
        url: str,
        method: str = "GET",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(url=url, method=method, metadata=metadata).allowed

    def _evaluate_host(self, host: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.blocked_host_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, host):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Blocked destination",
                        details=f"Destination host matched blocked rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        ip_risk, ip_reasons, ip_rules = self._evaluate_ip_host(host)
        reasons.extend(ip_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(ip_rules)
        risk_delta += ip_risk

        if "." not in host and host not in {"localhost"}:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Single-label host",
                    details=f"Host '{host}' is a single-label destination and requires review.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("single_label_host")
            risk_delta += 25

        if host and not self._is_explicitly_allowed_host(host):
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Unapproved destination",
                    details=f"Host '{host}' is not on the approved egress allowlist.",
                    score=20,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("host_not_allowlisted")
            risk_delta += 20

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_ip_host(self, host: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        try:
            ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
        except ValueError:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        if ip.is_loopback:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Loopback destination",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is loopback and is blocked.",
                    score=95,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("loopback_ip")
            risk_delta += 95

        if ip.is_link_local:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Link-local destination",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is link-local and is blocked.",
                    score=95,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("link_local_ip")
            risk_delta += 95

        if ip.is_multicast or ip.is_reserved or ip.is_unspecified:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Restricted IP range",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is in a restricted address range.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("restricted_ip_range")
            risk_delta += 85

        if ip.is_private and not self.allow_private_hosts:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Private network destination",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is private and blocked by sandbox egress policy.",
                    score=90,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("private_ip")
            risk_delta += 90

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_path(self, path: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.blocked_path_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, path):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Blocked path",
                        details=f"Request path matched blocked rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_port(self, *, port: int | None, scheme: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if port is None:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        default_port = 443 if scheme == "https" else 80 if scheme == "http" else None
        if default_port is not None and port != default_port:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Non-standard port",
                    details=f"Port '{port}' is non-standard for scheme '{scheme}'.",
                    score=15,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"non_standard_port:{port}")
            risk_delta += 15

        if port in self.high_risk_ports:
            score = int(self.high_risk_ports[port])
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="High-risk port",
                    details=f"Port '{port}' is high risk for sandbox egress.",
                    score=score,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"high_risk_port:{port}")
            risk_delta += score

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_query(self, query: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not query:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        pairs = parse_qsl(query, keep_blank_values=True)

        for key, value in pairs:
            field_risk, field_reasons, field_rules = self._evaluate_sensitive_field_name(
                field_name=key,
                location="query parameter",
            )
            reasons.extend(field_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(field_rules)
            risk_delta += field_risk

            combined = f"{key}={value}"
            secret_scan = self._secret_scanner.scan_text(combined)
            if secret_scan.found:
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Secret in query string",
                        details=f"Query parameter '{key}' appears to contain credential or secret material.",
                        score=70,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"secret_query_param:{key.lower()}")
                risk_delta += 70

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_headers(self, headers: Any) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not isinstance(headers, Mapping):
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        for key, value in headers.items():
            header_name = str(key)
            field_risk, field_reasons, field_rules = self._evaluate_sensitive_field_name(
                field_name=header_name,
                location="header",
            )
            reasons.extend(field_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(field_rules)
            risk_delta += field_risk

            combined = f"{header_name}: {self._to_text(value)}"
            secret_scan = self._secret_scanner.scan_text(combined)
            if secret_scan.found:
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Secret-bearing header",
                        details=f"Header '{header_name}' appears to carry secret or credential material.",
                        score=75,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"secret_header:{header_name.lower()}")
                risk_delta += 75

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_outbound_content(self, metadata: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        content_candidates: list[tuple[str, Any]] = [
            ("body", metadata.get("body")),
            ("payload", metadata.get("payload")),
            ("content", metadata.get("content")),
            ("data", metadata.get("data")),
            ("json", metadata.get("json")),
            ("files", metadata.get("files")),
        ]

        for location, value in content_candidates:
            if value in {None, "", b"", bytearray()}:
                continue

            text = self._to_text(value)
            if not text:
                continue

            secret_scan = self._secret_scanner.scan_text(text)
            if secret_scan.found:
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Secret-bearing outbound content",
                        details=f"Outbound {location} appears to contain secret or credential material.",
                        score=min(90, 35 + secret_scan.risk_delta),
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"secret_outbound_content:{location}")
                risk_delta += min(90, 35 + secret_scan.risk_delta)

            pattern_risk, pattern_reasons, pattern_rules = self._evaluate_exfil_text_patterns(
                text=text,
                location=location,
            )
            reasons.extend(pattern_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(pattern_rules)
            risk_delta += pattern_risk

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_sensitive_field_name(
        self,
        *,
        field_name: str,
        location: str,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        normalized = str(field_name or "").strip()
        if not normalized:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.sensitive_field_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, normalized):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Sensitive outbound field",
                        details=f"{location.title()} '{normalized}' matched sensitive field rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"{location.replace(' ', '_')}:{rule_name}")
                risk_delta += int(score)

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_exfil_text_patterns(
        self,
        *,
        text: str,
        location: str,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.exfil_content_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, text):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Exfiltration indicator",
                        details=f"Outbound {location} matched exfiltration rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"content:{rule_name}")
                risk_delta += int(score)

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _expand_allowed_host_suffixes(self, hosts: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
        suffixes: set[str] = set()
        for host in hosts:
            normalized = host.strip().lower()
            if not normalized:
                continue
            suffixes.add(normalized)
            suffixes.add(f".{normalized}")
        return suffixes

    def _is_explicitly_allowed_host(self, host: str) -> bool:
        normalized = host.strip().lower()
        if normalized in self.allowed_hosts:
            return True
        return any(normalized.endswith(suffix) for suffix in self._allowed_host_suffixes if suffix.startswith("."))

    def _to_text(self, value: Any) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
            return value.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            return self._serialize_mapping(value)
        if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            return "\n".join(self._to_text(item) for item in value)
        return str(value)

    def _serialize_mapping(self, value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
        return "\n".join(f"{key}: {self._to_text(item)}" for key, item in value.items())

    def _dedupe_reasons(self, reasons: Iterable[NetworkReason]) -> list[NetworkReason]:
        deduped: list[NetworkReason] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = set()
        for reason in reasons:
            key = (reason.source, reason.label, reason.details, int(reason.score))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(reason)
        return deduped

    def _dedupe_rules(self, matched_rules: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
        deduped: list[str] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for item in matched_rules:
            if item in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(item)
            deduped.append(item)
        return deduped

    def _finalize(
        self,
        *,
        reasons: Iterable[NetworkReason],
        matched_rules: list[str],
        risk_delta: int,
        scheme: str,
        host: str,
        port: int | None,
        path: str,
        normalized_url: str,
        direction: str,
    ) -> NetworkPolicy:
        deduped_reasons = self._dedupe_reasons(reasons)
        deduped_rules = self._dedupe_rules(matched_rules)
        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        if normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True

        return NetworkPolicy(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            scheme=scheme,
            host=host,
            port=port,
            path=path,
            normalized_url=normalized_url,
            reasons=[reason.as_dict() for reason in deduped_reasons],
            matched_rules=deduped_rules,
            direction=direction,
        )


def initialize_networkguard(
    *,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
    allowed_schemes: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_schemes: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    allowed_hosts: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_host_patterns: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
    blocked_path_patterns: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
    sensitive_field_patterns: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
    exfil_content_patterns: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
    high_risk_ports: Mapping[int, int] | None = None,
    allow_private_hosts: bool = False,
) -> NetworkGuard:
    return NetworkGuard(
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
        allowed_schemes=set(allowed_schemes or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_SCHEMES),
        blocked_schemes=set(blocked_schemes or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_SCHEMES),
        allowed_hosts=set(allowed_hosts or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS),
        blocked_host_patterns=tuple(blocked_host_patterns or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_HOST_PATTERNS),
        blocked_path_patterns=tuple(blocked_path_patterns or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATH_PATTERNS),
        sensitive_field_patterns=tuple(sensitive_field_patterns or DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_FIELD_PATTERNS),
        exfil_content_patterns=tuple(exfil_content_patterns or DEFAULT_EXFIL_CONTENT_PATTERNS),
        high_risk_ports=dict(high_risk_ports or DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_PORTS),
        allow_private_hosts=allow_private_hosts,
    )


def build_network_guard() -> NetworkGuard:
    return initialize_networkguard()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Mapping


class SandboxLane(str, Enum):
    SAFE_READONLY = "safe_readonly"
    PROMPT_INJECTION = "prompt_injection"
    DOWNLOAD_REVIEW = "download_review"
    FILE_QUARANTINE = "file_quarantine"
    NETWORK_RESTRICTED = "network_restricted"
    TOOL_CALL_RESTRICTED = "tool_call_restricted"
    HUMAN_REVIEW = "human_review"
    HARD_BLOCK = "hard_block"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxRouteDecision:
    lane: SandboxLane
    should_execute: bool
    requires_review: bool
    isolate_output: bool
    allow_network: bool
    allow_tool_calls: bool
    allow_file_write: bool
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    risk_score: int = 0
    policy_verdict: str = "allow"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _as_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple | set):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []

    for key in (
        "reason",
        "summary",
        "quarantine_reason",
        "action_type",
        "target",
        "target_type",
        "target_value",
        "content",
        "policy_verdict",
        "review_status",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("reasons", "failed_checks", "matched_patterns", "alerts", "tags"):
        for item in _as_list(payload.get(key)):
            if item:
                parts.append(str(item))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _extract_policy_verdict(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("policy_verdict", "verdict", "response_status"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value:
            return _normalize_text(value)
    return "allow"


def _extract_risk_score(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int:
    for key in ("risk_score", "score", "severity"):
        if key in payload:
            return _as_int(payload.get(key), 0)
    return 0


def route_to_sandbox(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> SandboxRouteDecision:
    risk_score = _extract_risk_score(payload)
    policy_verdict = _extract_policy_verdict(payload)
    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload)

    reasons: list[str] = []

    if policy_verdict in {"block", "blocked", "deny", "denied"} or risk_score >= 95:
        reasons.append("hard block triggered by policy or extreme risk score")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=False,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "deny",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "prompt injection" in signal_text
        or "jailbreak" in signal_text
        or "ignore previous instructions" in signal_text
        or "system prompt" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("prompt injection indicators detected")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.PROMPT_INJECTION,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "quarantine",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "quarantine" in signal_text
        or "malware" in signal_text
        or "payload" in signal_text
        or "executable" in signal_text
        or "macro" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("file or artifact should be isolated in quarantine lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.FILE_QUARANTINE,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "quarantine",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "download" in signal_text
        or "dependency" in signal_text
        or "package" in signal_text
        or "repository" in signal_text
        or "repo" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("downloaded or imported material requires restricted review lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.DOWNLOAD_REVIEW,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "http" in signal_text
        or "network" in signal_text
        or "fetch" in signal_text
        or "url" in signal_text
        or risk_score >= 70
    ):
        reasons.append("network-linked action routed to restricted network lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.NETWORK_RESTRICTED,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "toolcall" in signal_text
        or "tool call" in signal_text
        or "shell" in signal_text
        or "command" in signal_text
        or "subprocess" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("tool or command execution requires restricted tool-call lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.TOOL_CALL_RESTRICTED,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if policy_verdict in {"warn", "review"} or risk_score >= 40:
        reasons.append("moderate risk routed for human review")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.HUMAN_REVIEW,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    reasons.append("request qualifies for safe readonly handling")
    return SandboxRouteDecision(
        lane=SandboxLane.SAFE_READONLY,
        should_execute=True,
        requires_review=False,
        isolate_output=False,
        allow_network=False,
        allow_tool_calls=False,
        allow_file_write=False,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "allow",
        metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
    )


def summarize_sandbox_route(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return route_to_sandbox(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "SandboxLane",
    "SandboxRouteDecision",
    "route_to_sandbox",
    "summarize_sandbox_route",
]
