from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, MutableMapping, Sequence

from app.runtime.commandsupervisor import CommandPolicy, build_command_supervisor
from app.runtime.filereturnguard import FileReturnPolicy, build_file_return_guard
from app.runtime.networkguard import NetworkPolicy, build_network_guard


ExecutorCallable = Callable[..., Any]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxExecutionRequest:
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    command: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
    network_url: str | None = None
    network_method: str = "GET"
    artifact_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    content: str | bytes | None = None
    cwd: str | None = None
    timeout_seconds: int = 30
    environment_scope: str = "sandbox"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "actiontype": self.actiontype,
            "target": self.target,
            "command": self.command,
            "networkurl": self.network_url,
            "networkmethod": self.network_method,
            "artifactpaths": list(self.artifact_paths),
            "cwd": self.cwd,
            "timeoutseconds": int(self.timeout_seconds),
            "environmentscope": self.environment_scope,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxExecutionDecision:
    executionstate: str
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    shouldreview: bool
    shouldblock: bool
    shouldquarantine: bool
    riskdelta: int
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    commandsupervision: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    networkpolicy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    artifactpolicies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "executionstate": self.executionstate,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.shouldreview,
            "shouldblock": self.shouldblock,
            "shouldquarantine": self.shouldquarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.riskdelta),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "commandsupervision": dict(self.commandsupervision),
            "networkpolicy": dict(self.networkpolicy),
            "artifactpolicies": list(self.artifactpolicies),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxExecutionResult:
    executionstate: str
    verdict: str
    executed: bool
    result: Any = None
    decision: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    telemetry: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "executionstate": self.executionstate,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "executed": self.executed,
            "result": self.result,
            "decision": dict(self.decision),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "telemetry": dict(self.telemetry),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxRouter:
    command_supervisor: Any = field(default_factory=build_command_supervisor)
    network_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_network_guard)
    file_return_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_file_return_guard)
    default_executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None
    max_timeout_seconds: int = 300
    name: str = "sandboxrouter"

    def route(
        self,
        *,
        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,
        executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None,
    ) -> SandboxExecutionResult:
        decision = self.evaluate(request=request)

        if not decision.allowed:
            return SandboxExecutionResult(
                executionstate="denied",
                verdict=decision.verdict,
                executed=False,
                result=None,
                decision=decision.as_dict(),
                reasons=list(decision.reasons),
                telemetry=self._build_telemetry(request=request, decision=decision, executed=False),
            )

        runtime_executor = executor or self.default_executor
        if runtime_executor is None:
            return SandboxExecutionResult(
                executionstate="approved",
                verdict=decision.verdict,
                executed=False,
                result=None,
                decision=decision.as_dict(),
                reasons=list(decision.reasons),
                telemetry=self._build_telemetry(request=request, decision=decision, executed=False),
            )

        payload = self._build_executor_payload(request=request, decision=decision)
        result = runtime_executor(**payload)

        return SandboxExecutionResult(
            executionstate="executed",
            verdict=decision.verdict,
            executed=True,
            result=result,
            decision=decision.as_dict(),
            reasons=list(decision.reasons),
            telemetry=self._build_telemetry(request=request, decision=decision, executed=True),
        )

    def evaluate(self, *, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> SandboxExecutionDecision:
        normalized_request = self._normalize_request(request)
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        riskdelta = 0

        command_policy = self._evaluate_command_policy(normalized_request)
        if command_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(command_policy.reasons)
            riskdelta += int(command_policy.risk_delta)

        network_policy = self._evaluate_network_policy(normalized_request)
        if network_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(network_policy.reasons)
            riskdelta += int(network_policy.risk_delta)

        artifact_policies = self._evaluate_artifact_policies(normalized_request)
        for policy in artifact_policies:
            reasons.extend(policy.reasons)
            riskdelta += int(policy.risk_delta)

        if normalized_request.environment_scope.lower() != "sandbox":
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "sandboxrouter",
                    "label": "Environment boundary",
                    "details": (
                        f"Execution requested environment scope '{normalized_request.environment_scope}' "
                        "outside the default sandbox boundary."
                    ),
                    "score": 45,
                }
            )
            riskdelta += 45

        verdict = "allow"
        executionstate = "approved"
        allowed = True
        shouldreview = False
        shouldblock = False
        shouldquarantine = False

        policies = [policy for policy in (command_policy, network_policy, *artifact_policies) if policy is not None]

        if any(getattr(policy, "should_quarantine", False) for policy in policies):
            verdict = "quarantine"
            executionstate = "denied"
            allowed = False
            shouldblock = True
            shouldquarantine = True
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_block", False) for policy in policies):
            verdict = "block"
            executionstate = "denied"
            allowed = False
            shouldblock = True
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_review", False) for policy in policies):
            verdict = "review"
            executionstate = "queuedforreview"
            shouldreview = True

        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(riskdelta)))

        reasons.insert(
            0,
            {
                "source": "sandboxrouter",
                "label": "Sandbox routing",
                "details": (
                    f"Sandbox router evaluated action '{normalized_request.actiontype}' "
                    f"for target '{normalized_request.target}' with cumulative risk {normalized_risk}."
                ),
                "score": normalized_risk,
            },
        )

        return SandboxExecutionDecision(
            executionstate=executionstate,
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            shouldreview=shouldreview,
            shouldblock=shouldblock,
            shouldquarantine=shouldquarantine,
            riskdelta=normalized_risk,
            reasons=reasons,
            commandsupervision=command_policy.as_dict() if command_policy is not None else {},
            networkpolicy=network_policy.as_dict() if network_policy is not None else {},
            artifactpolicies=[policy.as_dict() for policy in artifact_policies],
        )

    def _normalize_request(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> SandboxExecutionRequest:
        timeout_seconds = max(1, min(int(request.timeout_seconds), int(self.max_timeout_seconds)))
        metadata = dict(request.metadata or {})
        metadata.setdefault("router", self.name)
        metadata.setdefault("environment_scope", request.environment_scope)

        return SandboxExecutionRequest(
            actiontype=str(request.actiontype or "").strip().lower(),
            target=str(request.target or "").strip().lower(),
            command=request.command,
            network_url=str(request.network_url or "").strip() or None,
            network_method=str(request.network_method or "GET").upper(),
            artifact_paths=[str(item).strip() for item in request.artifact_paths if str(item).strip()],
            content=request.content,
            cwd=str(request.cwd).strip() if request.cwd else None,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            environment_scope=str(request.environment_scope or "sandbox").strip(),
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def _evaluate_command_policy(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> CommandPolicy | None:
        if request.command is None:
            return None
        return self.command_supervisor.evaluate(
            command=request.command,
            actiontype=request.actiontype,
            target=request.target,
            cwd=request.cwd,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "environment_scope": request.environment_scope,
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_network_policy(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> NetworkPolicy | None:
        if not request.network_url:
            return None
        return self.network_guard.evaluate(
            url=request.network_url,
            method=request.network_method,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "direction": "egress",
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_artifact_policies(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> list[FileReturnPolicy]:
        policies: list[FileReturnPolicy] = []
        for artifact_path in request.artifact_paths:
            policies.append(
                self.file_return_guard.evaluate(
                    path=artifact_path,
                    content=request.content,
                    metadata=request.metadata,
                )
            )
        return policies

    def _build_executor_payload(
        self,
        *,
        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,
        decision: SandboxExecutionDecision,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload: MutableMapping[str, Any] = {
            "actiontype": request.actiontype,
            "target": request.target,
            "timeout_seconds": request.timeout_seconds,
            "cwd": request.cwd,
            "environment_scope": request.environment_scope,
            "metadata": {
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "sandboxdecision": decision.as_dict(),
            },
        }
        if request.command is not None:
            payload["command"] = request.command
        if request.network_url is not None:
            payload["network_url"] = request.network_url
            payload["network_method"] = request.network_method
        if request.artifact_paths:
            payload["artifact_paths"] = list(request.artifact_paths)
        if request.content is not None:
            payload["content"] = request.content
        return dict(payload)

    def _build_telemetry(
        self,
        *,
        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,
        decision: SandboxExecutionDecision,
        executed: bool,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "router": self.name,
            "actiontype": request.actiontype,
            "target": request.target,
            "executed": executed,
            "timeoutseconds": int(request.timeout_seconds),
            "environmentscope": request.environment_scope,
            "artifactcount": len(request.artifact_paths),
            "hascommand": request.command is not None,
            "hasnetwork": bool(request.network_url),
            "verdict": decision.verdict,
            "riskdelta": int(decision.riskdelta),
        }


def initialize_sandboxrouter(
    *,
    command_supervisor: Any | None = None,
    network_guard: Any | None = None,
    file_return_guard: Any | None = None,
    default_executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None,
    max_timeout_seconds: int = 300,
) -> SandboxRouter:
    return SandboxRouter(
        command_supervisor=command_supervisor or build_command_supervisor(),
        network_guard=network_guard or build_network_guard(),
        file_return_guard=file_return_guard or build_file_return_guard(),
        default_executor=default_executor,
        max_timeout_seconds=max_timeout_seconds,
    )


def build_sandbox_router() -> SandboxRouter:
    return initialize_sandboxrouter()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled", "healthy", "ready"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled", "unhealthy", "not_ready"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


def _derive_health(ready: bool, degraded: bool, incident_count: int) -> str:
    if not ready:
        return "down"
    if degraded or incident_count > 0:
        return "degraded"
    return "healthy"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RuntimeStatus:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    version: str = "dev"
    runtime_id: str = "primary"
    health: str = "healthy"
    ready: bool = True
    degraded: bool = False
    enforcement_mode: str = "enforce"
    sandbox_available: bool = True
    policy_engine_loaded: bool = True
    telemetry_pipeline_ready: bool = True
    review_queue_available: bool = True
    active_sessions: int = 0
    queued_reviews: int = 0
    quarantined_items: int = 0
    open_incidents: int = 0
    uptime_seconds: int = 0
    started_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "version": self.version,
            "runtime_id": self.runtime_id,
            "health": self.health,
            "ready": self.ready,
            "degraded": self.degraded,
            "enforcement_mode": self.enforcement_mode,
            "sandbox_available": self.sandbox_available,
            "policy_engine_loaded": self.policy_engine_loaded,
            "telemetry_pipeline_ready": self.telemetry_pipeline_ready,
            "review_queue_available": self.review_queue_available,
            "active_sessions": self.active_sessions,
            "queued_reviews": self.queued_reviews,
            "quarantined_items": self.quarantined_items,
            "open_incidents": self.open_incidents,
            "uptime_seconds": self.uptime_seconds,
            "started_at": _isoformat(self.started_at),
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def default_runtime_status() -> RuntimeStatus:
    return RuntimeStatus()


def build_runtime_status(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: RuntimeStatus | None = None,
) -> RuntimeStatus:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_runtime_status()

    ready = _coerce_bool(source.get("ready"), current.ready)
    degraded = _coerce_bool(source.get("degraded"), current.degraded)
    open_incidents = _coerce_int(source.get("open_incidents"), current.open_incidents)

    health = _coerce_str(source.get("health"))
    if not health:
        health = _derive_health(ready=ready, degraded=degraded, incident_count=open_incidents)

    started_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("started_at"), current.started_at) or _utc_now()
    checked_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    return RuntimeStatus(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        version=_coerce_str(source.get("version"), current.version) or current.version,
        runtime_id=_coerce_str(source.get("runtime_id"), current.runtime_id) or current.runtime_id,
        health=health,
        ready=ready,
        degraded=degraded,
        enforcement_mode=_coerce_str(source.get("enforcement_mode"), current.enforcement_mode) or current.enforcement_mode,
        sandbox_available=_coerce_bool(source.get("sandbox_available"), current.sandbox_available),
        policy_engine_loaded=_coerce_bool(source.get("policy_engine_loaded"), current.policy_engine_loaded),
        telemetry_pipeline_ready=_coerce_bool(source.get("telemetry_pipeline_ready"), current.telemetry_pipeline_ready),
        review_queue_available=_coerce_bool(source.get("review_queue_available"), current.review_queue_available),
        active_sessions=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("active_sessions"), current.active_sessions)),
        queued_reviews=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("queued_reviews"), current.queued_reviews)),
        quarantined_items=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("quarantined_items"), current.quarantined_items)),
        open_incidents=max(0, open_incidents),
        uptime_seconds=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("uptime_seconds"), current.uptime_seconds)),
        started_at=started_at,
        checked_at=checked_at,
    )


def runtime_status_summary(status: RuntimeStatus) -> dict[str, Any]:
    control_plane_ready = all(
        (
            status.ready,
            status.sandbox_available,
            status.policy_engine_loaded,
            status.telemetry_pipeline_ready,
            status.review_queue_available,
        )
    )

    return {
        "service": status.service,
        "runtime_id": status.runtime_id,
        "environment": status.environment,
        "version": status.version,
        "health": status.health,
        "ready": status.ready,
        "degraded": status.degraded,
        "control_plane_ready": control_plane_ready,
        "enforcement_mode": status.enforcement_mode,
        "capabilities": {
            "sandbox_available": status.sandbox_available,
            "policy_engine_loaded": status.policy_engine_loaded,
            "telemetry_pipeline_ready": status.telemetry_pipeline_ready,
            "review_queue_available": status.review_queue_available,
        },
        "load": {
            "active_sessions": status.active_sessions,
            "queued_reviews": status.queued_reviews,
            "quarantined_items": status.quarantined_items,
            "open_incidents": status.open_incidents,
        },
        "timing": {
            "uptime_seconds": status.uptime_seconds,
            "started_at": _isoformat(status.started_at),
            "checked_at": _isoformat(status.checked_at),
        },
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.runtime.sandbox_router import SandboxLane, route_to_sandbox


HIGH_RISK_TOOL_NAMES = {
    "shell",
    "terminal",
    "subprocess",
    "powershell",
    "bash",
    "cmd",
    "python_exec",
    "code_interpreter",
    "file_write",
    "filesystem_write",
    "registry_edit",
    "package_install",
    "browser_open_external",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_TOOL_NAMES = {
    "http_fetch",
    "httpfetch",
    "web_request",
    "browser_open",
    "download_file",
    "read_file",
    "filesystem_read",
    "grep",
    "search",
}

HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "ignore previous instructions",
    "system prompt",
    "developer prompt",
    "hidden prompt",
    "exfiltrate",
    "credential",
    "token",
    "cookie",
    "ssh key",
    "private key",
    "download and execute",
    "powershell -enc",
    "curl | bash",
    "rm -rf",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "download",
    "install",
    "execute",
    "script",
    "command",
    "shell",
    "network",
    "fetch",
    "browser",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallGuardDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    sandbox_lane: str
    risk_score: int
    should_execute: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    tool_name: str
    target: str
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    sanitized_payload: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _payload_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _combined_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []
    for key in (
        "action_type",
        "tool_name",
        "target",
        "content",
        "prompt",
        "input",
        "arguments",
        "command",
        "url",
        "reason",
        "summary",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))
    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _keyword_score(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for keyword in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 40
            reasons.append(f"high-risk keyword detected: {keyword}")

    for keyword in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 10
            reasons.append(f"medium-risk keyword detected: {keyword}")

    return score, reasons


def _tool_score(tool_name: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if tool_name in HIGH_RISK_TOOL_NAMES:
        return 60, [f"high-risk tool detected: {tool_name}"]
    if tool_name in MEDIUM_RISK_TOOL_NAMES:
        return 20, [f"medium-risk tool detected: {tool_name}"]
    return 0, []


def _sanitize_payload(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sanitized = dict(payload)

    for sensitive_key in (
        "authorization",
        "api_key",
        "access_token",
        "refresh_token",
        "password",
        "secret",
        "cookie",
    ):
        if sensitive_key in sanitized:
            sanitized[sensitive_key] = "[REDACTED]"

    return sanitized


def evaluate_tool_call(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ToolCallGuardDecision:
    tool_name = _normalize_text(_payload_value(payload, "tool_name", "action_type"))
    target = str(_payload_value(payload, "target", "url", "command") or "")
    base_risk = _safe_int(_payload_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _combined_text(payload)
    tool_score, tool_reasons = _tool_score(tool_name)
    keyword_score, keyword_reasons = _keyword_score(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + tool_score + keyword_score)
    reasons = [*tool_reasons, *keyword_reasons]

    route_payload = {
        "action_type": tool_name,
        "target": target,
        "content": signal_text,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
    }
    route_decision = route_to_sandbox(route_payload)

    if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK:
        response_status = "denied"
        policy_verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
    elif route_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        policy_verdict = "warn"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
    else:
        response_status = "completed"
        policy_verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        halted_by_boundary = False

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("tool call accepted under current low-risk policy")

    return ToolCallGuardDecision(
        allowed=allowed,
        response_status=response_status,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict,
        sandbox_lane=route_decision.lane.value,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        should_execute=route_decision.should_execute and allowed,
        halted_by_boundary=halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=route_decision.requires_review,
        tool_name=tool_name,
        target=target,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        sanitized_payload=_sanitize_payload(payload),
        metadata={"source": "tool_call_guard"},
    )


def summarize_tool_call_guard(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_tool_call(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "HIGH_RISK_TOOL_NAMES",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_TOOL_NAMES",
    "HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "ToolCallGuardDecision",
    "evaluate_tool_call",
    "summarize_tool_call_guard",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence

from app.runtime.commandsupervisor import CommandPolicy, build_command_supervisor
from app.runtime.filereturnguard import FileReturnPolicy, build_file_return_guard

@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallRequest:
    tool_name: str
    actiontype: str = "toolcall"
    target: str = "runtime"
    command: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
    network_url: str | None = None
    network_method: str = "GET"
    artifact_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    content: str | bytes | None = None
    cwd: str | None = None
    environment_scope: str = "sandbox"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

            "toolname": self.tool_name,
            "actiontype": self.actiontype,
            "target": self.target,
            "command": self.command,
            "networkurl": self.network_url,
            "networkmethod": self.network_method,
            "artifactpaths": list(self.artifact_paths),
            "cwd": self.cwd,
            "environmentscope": self.environment_scope,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallDecision:
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    should_review: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    risk_delta: int
    tool_name: str
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    command_policy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    network_policy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    artifact_policies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.risk_delta),
            "toolname": self.tool_name,
            "actiontype": self.actiontype,
            "target": self.target,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "commandpolicy": dict(self.command_policy),
            "networkpolicy": dict(self.network_policy),
            "artifactpolicies": list(self.artifact_policies),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallGuard:
    command_supervisor: Any = field(default_factory=build_command_supervisor)
    network_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_network_guard)
    file_return_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_file_return_guard)
    high_risk_tools: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_TOOLS))
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80

    def evaluate(self, *, request: ToolCallRequest) -> ToolCallDecision:
        normalized = self._normalize_request(request)
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        command_policy = self._evaluate_command_policy(normalized)
        if command_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(command_policy.reasons)
            risk_delta += int(command_policy.risk_delta)
            matched_rules.extend(getattr(command_policy, "matched_rules", []))

        network_policy = self._evaluate_network_policy(normalized)
        if network_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(network_policy.reasons)
            risk_delta += int(network_policy.risk_delta)
            matched_rules.extend(getattr(network_policy, "matched_rules", []))

        artifact_policies = self._evaluate_artifact_policies(normalized)
        for artifact_policy in artifact_policies:
            reasons.extend(artifact_policy.reasons)
            risk_delta += int(artifact_policy.risk_delta)
            matched_rules.extend(getattr(artifact_policy, "matched_rules", []))

        tool_risk, tool_reasons, tool_rules = self._evaluate_tool_identity(normalized)
        reasons.extend(tool_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(tool_rules)
        risk_delta += tool_risk

        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        policies = [policy for policy in (command_policy, network_policy, *artifact_policies) if policy is not None]

        if any(getattr(policy, "should_quarantine", False) for policy in policies) or normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
            should_review = False
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:quarantine")
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_block", False) for policy in policies) or normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:block")
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_review", False) for policy in policies) or normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:review")

        reasons.insert(
            0,
            {
                "source": "toolcallguard",
                "label": "Tool call review",
                "details": (
                    f"Tool '{normalized.tool_name}' was evaluated for action '{normalized.actiontype}' "
                    f"against target '{normalized.target}' with cumulative risk {normalized_risk}."
                ),
                "score": normalized_risk,
            },
        )

        materialized_reasons = self._dedupe_reasons(reasons)
        deduped_rules = list(dict.fromkeys(rule for rule in matched_rules if rule))

        return ToolCallDecision(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            tool_name=normalized.tool_name,
            actiontype=normalized.actiontype,
            target=normalized.target,
            reasons=materialized_reasons,
            command_policy=command_policy.as_dict() if command_policy is not None else {},
            network_policy=network_policy.as_dict() if network_policy is not None else {},
            artifact_policies=[policy.as_dict() for policy in artifact_policies],
            matched_rules=deduped_rules,
        )

    def allow(self, *, request: ToolCallRequest) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(request=request).allowed

    def _normalize_request(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> ToolCallRequest:
        return ToolCallRequest(
            tool_name=str(request.tool_name or "").strip().lower(),
            actiontype=str(request.actiontype or "toolcall").strip().lower(),
            target=str(request.target or "runtime").strip().lower(),
            command=request.command,
            network_url=str(request.network_url or "").strip() or None,
            network_method=str(request.network_method or "GET").upper(),
            artifact_paths=[str(item).strip() for item in request.artifact_paths if str(item).strip()],
            content=request.content,
            cwd=str(request.cwd).strip() if request.cwd else None,
            environment_scope=str(request.environment_scope or "sandbox").strip(),
            metadata=dict(request.metadata or {}),
        )

    def _evaluate_tool_identity(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> tuple[int, list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not request.tool_name:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing tool name",
                    "details": "Tool call was denied because no tool name was provided.",
                    "score": 75,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_tool_name")
            return 75, reasons, matched_rules

        if request.tool_name in self.high_risk_tools:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "High-risk tool",
                    "details": f"Tool '{request.tool_name}' is classified as high risk.",
                    "score": 25,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"toolcallguard:high_risk:{request.tool_name}")
            risk_delta += 25

        if request.environment_scope.lower() != "sandbox":
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Non-sandbox scope",
                    "details": (
                        f"Tool '{request.tool_name}' requested environment scope "
                        f"'{request.environment_scope}' outside the sandbox boundary."
                    ),
                    "score": 45,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:non_sandbox_scope")
            risk_delta += 45

        if request.tool_name in COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES and request.command is None:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing command payload",
                    "details": f"Command-like tool '{request.tool_name}' did not provide a command payload.",
                    "score": 40,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_command")
            risk_delta += 40

        if request.tool_name in NETWORK_TOOL_NAMES and not request.network_url:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing network URL",
                    "details": f"Network-like tool '{request.tool_name}' did not provide a network URL.",
                    "score": 40,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_network_url")
            risk_delta += 40

        if request.tool_name in FILE_TOOL_NAMES and not request.artifact_paths:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing artifact paths",
                    "details": f"File-like tool '{request.tool_name}' did not provide any artifact paths.",
                    "score": 30,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_artifact_paths")
            risk_delta += 30

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_command_policy(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> CommandPolicy | None:
        if request.command is None and request.tool_name not in COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES:
            return None
        command_value = request.command if request.command is not None else request.tool_name
        return self.command_supervisor.evaluate(
            command=command_value,
            actiontype=request.actiontype,
            target=request.target or request.tool_name,
            cwd=request.cwd,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "environment_scope": request.environment_scope,
                "tool_name": request.tool_name,
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_network_policy(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> NetworkPolicy | None:
        if not request.network_url and request.tool_name not in NETWORK_TOOL_NAMES:
            return None
        if not request.network_url:
            return None
        return self.network_guard.evaluate(
            url=request.network_url,
            method=request.network_method,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "direction": "egress",
                "tool_name": request.tool_name,
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_artifact_policies(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> list[FileReturnPolicy]:
        if not request.artifact_paths and request.tool_name not in FILE_TOOL_NAMES:
            return []

        policies: list[FileReturnPolicy] = []
        for artifact_path in request.artifact_paths:
            policies.append(
                self.file_return_guard.evaluate(
                    path=artifact_path,
                    content=request.content,
                    metadata={
                        **dict(request.metadata),
                        "tool_name": request.tool_name,
                    },
                )
            )
        return policies

    def _dedupe_reasons(self, reasons: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        deduped: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = set()
        for item in reasons:
            source = str(item.get("source", "toolcallguard"))
            label = str(item.get("label", "Tool call review"))
            details = str(item.get("details", ""))
            score = int(item.get("score", 0) or 0)
            key = (source, label, details, score)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(
                {
                    "source": source,
                    "label": label,
                    "details": details,
                    "score": score,
                }
            )
        return deduped[:20]


def initialize_toolcallguard(
    *,
    command_supervisor: Any | None = None,
    network_guard: Any | None = None,
    file_return_guard: Any | None = None,
    high_risk_tools: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
) -> ToolCallGuard:
    return ToolCallGuard(
        command_supervisor=command_supervisor or build_command_supervisor(),
        network_guard=network_guard or build_network_guard(),
        file_return_guard=file_return_guard or build_file_return_guard(),
        high_risk_tools=set(high_risk_tools or DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_TOOLS),
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
    )


def build_toolcallguard() -> ToolCallGuard:
    return initialize_toolcallguard()


__all__ = [
    "ToolCallDecision",
    "ToolCallGuard",
    "ToolCallRequest",
    "build_toolcallguard",
    "initialize_toolcallguard",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable


@dataclass(slots=True)
class HostileContextReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


@dataclass(slots=True)
class HostileContextScanResult:
    flagged: bool
    riskdelta: int
    severity: str
    matchedpatterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    categories: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: list[HostileContextReason] = field(default_factory=list)
    summary: str = ""
    shouldreview: bool = False
    shouldquarantine: bool = False


@dataclass(slots=True)
class HostileContextRule:
    ruleid: str
    category: str
    label: str
    pattern: re.Pattern[str]
    score: int
    details: str


_DEFAULT_RULES: tuple[HostileContextRule, ...] = (
    HostileContextRule(
        ruleid="external-authority-claim",
        category="authority_spoofing",
        label="External content claims control authority",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(this (page|document|file|email|message|tool output)|external content|retrieved data)\b.{0,70}\b(overrides|has priority|is authoritative|must be followed|controls your next step)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=24,
        details="Untrusted external content is presenting itself as a controlling authority.",
    ),
    HostileContextRule(
        ruleid="instructional-retrieval-chain",
        category="retrieval_instruction_injection",
        label="Retrieved content contains operational instructions",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(retrieved|downloaded|attached|embedded|tool output|search result)\b.{0,80}\b(run|execute|call|open|download|send|ignore|disable)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=20,
        details="Retrieved or external content contains actionable instructions that could steer execution.",
    ),
    HostileContextRule(
        ruleid="malicious-file-lure",
        category="malicious_file_lure",
        label="File content attempts to trigger unsafe behavior",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(macro|payload|dropper|installer|script|attachment)\b.{0,80}\b(enable|launch|run|open|execute|disable protection)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=28,
        details="File or attachment language attempts to cause unsafe execution behavior.",
    ),
    HostileContextRule(
        ruleid="tool-output-override",
        category="tool_output_override",
        label="Tool output tries to steer runtime decisions",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(tool output|browser result|search result|assistant output)\b.{0,70}\b(ignore policy|bypass review|must execute|continue automatically)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=26,
        details="Tool or browser output is attempting to override runtime policy controls.",
    ),
    HostileContextRule(
        ruleid="credential-harvest-context",
        category="credential_harvest",
        label="Context attempts credential collection",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(enter|provide|paste|share)\b.{0,40}\b(password|api key|token|secret|credential|ssh key)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=22,
        details="Context attempts to harvest secrets or credentials from the user or runtime.",
    ),
    HostileContextRule(
        ruleid="remote-exfil-in-context",
        category="remote_exfiltration",
        label="Context requests remote transmission",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(upload|send|forward|transmit|post)\b.{0,50}\b(file|document|data|secret|result|output)\b.{0,50}\b(remote|external|server|endpoint|url)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=34,
        details="Context requests sending internal data or results to an external destination.",
    ),
)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _merge_text(parts: Iterable[Any]) -> str:
    normalized = [_normalize_text(part) for part in parts]
    return "\n".join(part for part in normalized if part)


def scanhostilecontext(
    *,
    actiontype: str | None = None,
    target: str | None = None,
    content: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    rules: Iterable[HostileContextRule] | None = None,
) -> HostileContextScanResult:
    effectiverules = tuple(rules or _DEFAULT_RULES)
    metadata = metadata or {}

    combinedtext = _merge_text(
        [
            actiontype,
            target,
            content,
            filepath,
            metadata.get("source"),
            metadata.get("origin"),
            metadata.get("retrievedfrom"),
            metadata.get("documenttext"),
            metadata.get("tooloutput"),
            metadata.get("emailbody"),
            metadata.get("filename"),
            metadata.get("attachmenttext"),
            metadata.get("retrievedcontent"),
        ]
    )

    matchedpatterns: list[str] = []
    categories: list[str] = []
    reasons: list[HostileContextReason] = []
    totalscore = 0

    for rule in effectiverules:
        if not combinedtext:
            continue
        match = rule.pattern.search(combinedtext)
        if not match:
            continue

        matchedpatterns.append(rule.ruleid)
        if rule.category not in categories:
            categories.append(rule.category)

        excerpt = match.group(0).strip().replace("\n", " ")
        reasons.append(
            HostileContextReason(
                source="hostilecontext",
                label=rule.label,
                details=f"{rule.details} Matched content: {excerpt[:220]}",
                score=rule.score,
            )
        )
        totalscore += rule.score

    flagged = bool(reasons)

    if totalscore >= 70:
        severity = "critical"
    elif totalscore >= 40:
        severity = "high"
    elif totalscore >= 20:
        severity = "medium"
    elif totalscore > 0:
        severity = "low"
    else:
        severity = "none"

    shouldreview = totalscore >= 20
    shouldquarantine = totalscore >= 70 or (
        "remote_exfiltration" in categories and "tool_output_override" in categories
    )

    if not flagged:
        summary = "No hostile external context indicators were detected."
    else:
        summary = "Detected hostile or instruction-bearing external context that may influence runtime behavior."

    return HostileContextScanResult(
        flagged=flagged,
        riskdelta=totalscore,
        severity=severity,
        matchedpatterns=matchedpatterns,
        categories=categories,
        reasons=reasons,
        summary=summary,
        shouldreview=shouldreview,
        shouldquarantine=shouldquarantine,
    )


def scanhostilecontextdict(
    *,
    actiontype: str | None = None,
    target: str | None = None,
    content: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    rules: Iterable[HostileContextRule] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = scanhostilecontext(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata,
        rules=rules,
    )
    return {
        "flagged": result.flagged,
        "riskdelta": result.riskdelta,
        "severity": result.severity,
        "matchedpatterns": list(result.matchedpatterns),
        "categories": list(result.categories),
        "summary": result.summary,
        "shouldreview": result.shouldreview,
        "shouldquarantine": result.shouldquarantine,
        "reasons": [
            {
                "source": reason.source,
                "label": reason.label,
                "details": reason.details,
                "score": reason.score,
            }
            for reason in result.reasons
        ],
    }

    PromptInjectionRule(
        ruleid="local-file-discovery",
        category="sensitive_discovery",
        label="Sensitive file discovery",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\b(find|search|locate|read|open)\b.{0,40}\b(/etc/passwd|\.env|secrets?\.|credentials?|ssh|id_rsa|config\.json)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=28,
        details="Content appears to search for sensitive local files or secrets.",
    ),
    PromptInjectionRule(
        ruleid="multistep-escalation",
        category="unsafe_tool_escalation",
        label="Multi-step tool escalation",
        pattern=re.compile(
            r"\bstep\s*1\b.{0,120}\b(scan|search|read|collect)\b.{0,120}\b(files?|data|documents?)\b.{0,160}\bstep\s*2\b.{0,120}\b(upload|send|transmit|exfiltrate)\b.{0,120}\b(external|remote|server|endpoint|url)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        ),
        score=32,
        details="Multi-step instructions lead from local access to external exfiltration.",
    ),
)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _join_text_parts(parts: Iterable[Any]) -> str:
    normalized = [_normalize_text(part) for part in parts]
    return "\n".join(part for part in normalized if part)


def scanpromptinjection(
    *,
    actiontype: str | None = None,
    target: str | None = None,
    content: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    rules: Iterable[PromptInjectionRule] | None = None,
) -> PromptInjectionScanResult:
    effectiverules = tuple(rules or _DEFAULT_RULES)
    metadata = metadata or {}

    combinedtext = _join_text_parts(
        [
            actiontype,
            target,
            content,
            filepath,
            metadata.get("source"),
            metadata.get("origin"),
            metadata.get("retrievedfrom"),
            metadata.get("tooloutput"),
            metadata.get("documenttext"),
            metadata.get("emailbody"),
            metadata.get("prompt"),
            metadata.get("assistantreply"),
        ]
    )

    matchedpatterns: list[str] = []
    categories: list[str] = []
    reasons: list[PromptInjectionReason] = []
    totalscore = 0

    for rule in effectiverules:
        if not combinedtext:
            continue
        match = rule.pattern.search(combinedtext)
        if not match:
            continue

        matchedpatterns.append(rule.ruleid)
        if rule.category not in categories:
            categories.append(rule.category)

        excerpt = match.group(0).strip().replace("\n", " ")
        detailtext = f"{rule.details} Matched content: {excerpt[:220]}"
        reasons.append(
            PromptInjectionReason(
                source="promptinjection",
                label=rule.label,
                details=detailtext,
                score=rule.score,
            )
        )
        totalscore += rule.score

    flagged = bool(reasons)

    if totalscore >= 70:
        severity = "critical"
    elif totalscore >= 40:
        severity = "high"
    elif totalscore >= 20:
        severity = "medium"
    elif totalscore > 0:
        severity = "low"
    else:
        severity = "none"

    shouldreview = totalscore >= 20
    shouldquarantine = totalscore >= 70 or (
        "prompt_exfiltration" in categories and "unsafe_tool_escalation" in categories
    )

    if not flagged:
        summary = "No prompt injection or indirect prompt injection indicators were detected."
    else:
        summary = (
            "Detected prompt injection indicators in runtime-bound content."
            if "indirect_prompt_injection" not in categories
            else "Detected prompt injection and untrusted-content instruction indicators."
        )

    return PromptInjectionScanResult(
        flagged=flagged,
        riskdelta=totalscore,
        severity=severity,
        matchedpatterns=matchedpatterns,
        categories=categories,
        reasons=reasons,
        summary=summary,
        shouldreview=shouldreview,
        shouldquarantine=shouldquarantine,
    )


def scanpromptinjectiondict(
    *,
    actiontype: str | None = None,
    target: str | None = None,
    content: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    rules: Iterable[PromptInjectionRule] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = scanpromptinjection(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata,
        rules=rules,
    )
    return {
        "flagged": result.flagged,
        "riskdelta": result.riskdelta,
        "severity": result.severity,
        "matchedpatterns": list(result.matchedpatterns),
        "categories": list(result.categories),
        "summary": result.summary,
        "shouldreview": result.shouldreview,
        "shouldquarantine": result.shouldquarantine,
        "reasons": [
            {
                "source": reason.source,
                "label": reason.label,
                "details": reason.details,
                "score": reason.score,
            }
            for reason in result.reasons
        ],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field, is_dataclass
from typing import Any

from app.orchestrator.executorboundary import executewithboundary
from app.orchestrator.secureruntimepipeline import (
    SecureRuntimePipeline,
    getactionexecutepipeline,
)

DEFAULT_FILEPATH = "app/api/actionexecute.py"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ExecutionReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ActionExecuteResult:
    executionid: str | None
    executionstate: str
    responseaction: str
    responsestatus: str
    traceid: str | None
    requestid: str | None
    decisionid: str | None
    policyverdict: str
    riskscore: int
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    reviewitemid: str | None
    executorname: str | None
    executorresult: dict[str, Any] | None
    reason: str | None
    reasons: list[ExecutionReason] = field(default_factory=list)
    filepath: str | None = None
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _normalize_mapping(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if is_dataclass(value):
        data = asdict(value)
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    data = getattr(value, "__dict__", None)
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        return dict(data)
    return {}


def _normalize_reason_entry(item: Any) -> ExecutionReason:
    if isinstance(item, ExecutionReason):
        return item

    if is_dataclass(item):
        data = asdict(item)
    elif isinstance(item, Mapping):
        data = dict(item)
    else:
        data = {
            "source": "runtime",
            "label": "Execution reason",
            "details": str(item),
            "score": 0,
        }

    return ExecutionReason(
        source=str(data.get("source", "runtime")),
        label=str(data.get("label", "Execution reason")),
        details=str(data.get("details", "")),
        score=_safe_int(data.get("score", 0)),
    )


def _normalize_reasons(items: Any) -> list[ExecutionReason]:
    if not items:
        return []

    if isinstance(items, (str, bytes)):
        return [
            ExecutionReason(
                source="runtime",
                label="Execution reason",
                details=str(items),
                score=0,
            )
        ]

    if not isinstance(items, Iterable):
        return [_normalize_reason_entry(items)]

    normalized: list[ExecutionReason] = []
    for item in items:
        normalized.append(_normalize_reason_entry(item))
    return normalized


def _extract_summary_from_runtime_result(runtimeresult: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(runtimeresult, Mapping):
        nested = runtimeresult.get("summary")
        if isinstance(nested, Mapping):
            return dict(nested)
        return dict(runtimeresult)

    nested = getattr(runtimeresult, "summary", None)
    if isinstance(nested, Mapping):
        return dict(nested)

    if is_dataclass(runtimeresult):
        data = asdict(runtimeresult)
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            nested = data.get("summary")
            if isinstance(nested, Mapping):
                return dict(nested)
            return data

    data = getattr(runtimeresult, "__dict__", None)
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        nested = data.get("summary")
        if isinstance(nested, Mapping):
            return dict(nested)
        return dict(data)

    return {}


def summarizeexecutionreceipt(receipt: Any, runtimeresult: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    summary = _extract_summary_from_runtime_result(runtimeresult)

    executionstate = (
        summary.get("executionstate")
        or getattr(receipt, "state", None)
        or "executed"
    )
    responseaction = summary.get("responseaction") or getattr(
        receipt, "responseaction", None
    )
    responsestatus = summary.get("responsestatus") or getattr(
        receipt, "responsestatus", None
    )
    policyverdict = (
        summary.get("policyverdict")
        or getattr(receipt, "policyverdict", None)
        or "allow"
    )
    riskscore = _safe_int(summary.get("riskscore", getattr(receipt, "riskscore", 0)))
    shouldexecute = bool(
        summary.get("shouldexecute", getattr(receipt, "shouldexecute", False))
    )
    haltedbyboundary = bool(
        summary.get("haltedbyboundary", getattr(receipt, "haltedbyboundary", False))
    )
    reviewitemid = summary.get("reviewitemid", getattr(receipt, "reviewitemid", None))
    executorname = summary.get("executorname", getattr(receipt, "executorname", None))
    executorresult = summary.get("executorresult")
    reason = summary.get("reason") or getattr(receipt, "reason", None)
    filepath = (
        summary.get("filepath")
        or getattr(receipt, "filepath", None)
        or DEFAULT_FILEPATH
    )
    promptinjection = _normalize_mapping(summary.get("promptinjection"))

    if executorresult is None and isinstance(runtimeresult, Mapping) and "summary" not in runtimeresult:
        executorresult = dict(runtimeresult)

    normalized_executor_result = None
    if executorresult is not None:
        normalized_executor_result = _normalize_mapping(executorresult) or (
            executorresult if isinstance(executorresult, dict) else {"value": executorresult}
        )

    if responseaction is None:
        if executionstate == "denied":
            responseaction = "deny"
        elif executionstate == "queuedforreview":
            responseaction = "review"
        else:
            responseaction = "allow"

    if responsestatus is None:
        if executionstate == "denied":
            responsestatus = "denied"
        elif executionstate == "queuedforreview":
            responsestatus = "queuedforreview"
        else:
            responsestatus = "completed"

    return {
        "executionid": getattr(receipt, "executionid", None),
        "executionstate": str(executionstate),
        "responseaction": str(responseaction),
        "responsestatus": str(responsestatus),
        "traceid": summary.get("traceid") or getattr(receipt, "traceid", None),
        "requestid": summary.get("requestid") or getattr(receipt, "requestid", None),
        "decisionid": summary.get("decisionid") or getattr(receipt, "decisionid", None),
        "policyverdict": str(policyverdict),
        "riskscore": riskscore,
        "shouldexecute": shouldexecute,
        "haltedbyboundary": haltedbyboundary,
        "reviewitemid": reviewitemid,
        "executorname": executorname,
        "executorresult": normalized_executor_result,
        "reason": None if reason is None else str(reason),
        "reasons": _normalize_reasons(
            summary.get("reasons") or getattr(receipt, "reasons", [])
        ),
        "filepath": str(filepath) if filepath is not None else None,
        "promptinjection": promptinjection,
    }


def executeguardedaction(
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> ActionExecuteResult:
    active_pipeline = pipeline or getactionexecutepipeline()
    effective_filepath = filepath or DEFAULT_FILEPATH

    receipt, runtimeresult = executewithboundary(
        pipeline=active_pipeline,
        actorid=clientid or "anonymous-client",
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=effective_filepath,
        metadata={
            "clientid": clientid,
            "sessionid": sessionid,
            "filepath": effective_filepath,
        },
        executor=None,
    )

    summary = summarizeexecutionreceipt(receipt, runtimeresult)

    return ActionExecuteResult(
        executionid=summary.get("executionid"),
        executionstate=str(summary["executionstate"]),
        responseaction=str(summary["responseaction"]),
        responsestatus=str(summary["responsestatus"]),
        traceid=summary.get("traceid"),
        requestid=summary.get("requestid"),
        decisionid=summary.get("decisionid"),
        policyverdict=str(summary["policyverdict"]),
        riskscore=_safe_int(summary["riskscore"]),
        shouldexecute=bool(summary["shouldexecute"]),
        haltedbyboundary=bool(summary["haltedbyboundary"]),
        reviewitemid=summary.get("reviewitemid"),
        executorname=summary.get("executorname"),
        executorresult=summary.get("executorresult"),
        reason=summary.get("reason"),
        reasons=_normalize_reasons(summary.get("reasons")),
        filepath=summary.get("filepath"),
        promptinjection=_normalize_mapping(summary.get("promptinjection")),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from typing import Any, Literal, TypedDict

from app.services.action_guard import (
    ActionGuardDecision,
    ActionType,
    VerdictType,
    analyze_action,
)
from app.services.action_policy import (
    ActionPolicyDecision,
    PolicyMode,
    evaluate_action_policy,
)

FinalDecisionSource = Literal["policy", "scan", "policy_and_scan"]


class ActionExecutionDecision(TypedDict):
    action_type: ActionType
    target: str
    content: str
    policy_mode: PolicyMode
    verdict: VerdictType
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str]
    scan_id: str | None
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    decision_source: FinalDecisionSource
    client_id: str | None
    session_id: str | None
    reasons: list[dict[str, object]]


def _verdict_rank(verdict: VerdictType) -> int:
    order: dict[VerdictType, int] = {
        "allow": 1,
        "warn": 2,
        "quarantine": 3,
        "block": 4,
    }
    return order[verdict]


def _resolve_final_verdict(
    policy_verdict: VerdictType,
    guard_verdict: VerdictType,
) -> VerdictType:
    return (
        policy_verdict
        if _verdict_rank(policy_verdict) >= _verdict_rank(guard_verdict)
        else guard_verdict
    )


def _decision_source(
    policy_decision: ActionPolicyDecision,
    guard_decision: ActionGuardDecision,
    final_verdict: VerdictType,
) -> FinalDecisionSource:
    policy_used = policy_decision["verdict"] == final_verdict
    scan_used = guard_decision["verdict"] == final_verdict

    if policy_used and scan_used:
        return "policy_and_scan"
    if policy_used:
        return "policy"
    return "scan"


def _build_summary(
    policy_decision: ActionPolicyDecision,
    guard_decision: ActionGuardDecision,
    decision_source: FinalDecisionSource,
) -> str:
    policy_summary = policy_decision["summary"].strip()
    guard_summary = guard_decision["summary"].strip()

    if decision_source == "policy_and_scan":
        if policy_summary == guard_summary:
            return policy_summary
        return f"{policy_summary} {guard_summary}".strip()

    if decision_source == "policy":
        return policy_summary

    return guard_summary


def _should_halt(final_verdict: VerdictType) -> bool:
    return final_verdict in ("block", "quarantine")


def _should_warn(final_verdict: VerdictType) -> bool:
    return final_verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")


def _build_ai_reason(
    action_type: ActionType,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    policy_decision: ActionPolicyDecision,
    guard_decision: ActionGuardDecision,
) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    if os.getenv("USE_GROQ_AI_REASONS", "1") != "1":
        return None

    api_key = os.getenv("GROQ_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        return None

    try:
        from groq import Groq
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        return None

    existing_reasons: list[dict[str, object]] = [
        *policy_decision["reasons"],
        *guard_decision["reasons"],
    ]

    system_prompt = (
        "You are a security reasoning engine. "
        "Return only valid JSON with keys: source, label, details, score. "
        "Use source='ai'. "
        "label must be short. "
        "details must be concise and useful. "
        "score must be a float from 0 to 1."
    )

    user_prompt = json.dumps(
        {
            "action_type": action_type,
            "target": target,
            "content": content,
            "policy_mode": policy_decision["policy_mode"],
            "policy_verdict": policy_decision["verdict"],
            "policy_summary": policy_decision["summary"],
            "guard_verdict": guard_decision["verdict"],
            "guard_summary": guard_decision["summary"],
            "risk_score": guard_decision["risk_score"],
            "matched_patterns": guard_decision["matched_patterns"],
            "existing_reasons": existing_reasons,
        }
    )

    try:
        client = Groq(api_key=api_key)
        response = client.chat.completions.create(
            model=os.getenv("GROQ_REASON_MODEL", "llama3-70b-8192"),
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
                {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
            ],
            temperature=0.2,
            response_format={"type": "json_object"},
        )

        raw_content = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
        parsed: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(raw_content)

        label = str(parsed.get("label", "")).strip() or "AI assessment"
        details = str(parsed.get("details", "")).strip()
        score_raw = parsed.get("score")

        try:
            score = float(score_raw) if score_raw is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            score = None

        return {
            "source": "ai",
            "label": label,
            "details": details,
            "score": score,
        }
    except Exception:
        return None


def evaluate_action_execution(
    action_type: ActionType,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
) -> ActionExecutionDecision:
    policy_decision = evaluate_action_policy(
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
    )

    guard_decision = analyze_action(
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
    )

    final_verdict = _resolve_final_verdict(
        policy_decision["verdict"],
        guard_decision["verdict"],
    )

    decision_source = _decision_source(
        policy_decision=policy_decision,
        guard_decision=guard_decision,
        final_verdict=final_verdict,
    )

    summary = _build_summary(
        policy_decision=policy_decision,
        guard_decision=guard_decision,
        decision_source=decision_source,
    )

    reasons: list[dict[str, object]] = [
        *policy_decision["reasons"],
        *guard_decision["reasons"],
    ]

    ai_reason = _build_ai_reason(
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        policy_decision=policy_decision,
        guard_decision=guard_decision,
    )
    if ai_reason is not None:
        reasons.append(ai_reason)

    return {
        "action_type": action_type,
        "target": target,
        "content": content,
        "policy_mode": policy_decision["policy_mode"],
        "verdict": final_verdict,
        "summary": summary,
        "risk_score": guard_decision["risk_score"],
        "matched_patterns": guard_decision["matched_patterns"],
        "scan_id": guard_decision["scan_id"],
        "should_halt": _should_halt(final_verdict),
        "should_warn": _should_warn(final_verdict),
        "decision_source": decision_source,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "reasons": reasons,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TypedDict

from app.services.action_decision import (
    ActionExecutionDecision,
    evaluate_action_execution,
)
from app.services.action_guard import ActionType


class ActionExecuteResult(TypedDict):
    action_type: ActionType
    target: str
    content: str
    policy_mode: str
    verdict: str
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str]
    scan_id: str | None
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    decision_source: str
    client_id: str | None
    session_id: str | None
    executed: bool
    execution_status: str
    execution_message: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, object]]


def execute_guarded_action(
    action_type: ActionType,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
) -> ActionExecuteResult:
    decision: ActionExecutionDecision = evaluate_action_execution(
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
    )

    if decision["should_halt"]:
        execution_status = "halted"
        execution_message = "Action execution was halted by guard controls."
        executed = False
    elif decision["should_warn"]:
        execution_status = "review_required"
        execution_message = "Action requires review before execution."
        executed = False
    else:
        execution_status = "allowed"
        execution_message = "Action passed guard checks and is eligible for execution."
        executed = True

    return {
        "action_type": decision["action_type"],
        "target": decision["target"],
        "content": decision["content"],
        "policy_mode": decision["policy_mode"],
        "verdict": decision["verdict"],
        "summary": decision["summary"],
        "risk_score": decision["risk_score"],
        "matched_patterns": decision["matched_patterns"],
        "scan_id": decision["scan_id"],
        "should_halt": decision["should_halt"],
        "should_warn": decision["should_warn"],
        "decision_source": decision["decision_source"],
        "client_id": decision["client_id"],
        "session_id": decision["session_id"],
        "executed": executed,
        "execution_status": execution_status,
        "execution_message": execution_message,
        "reasons": decision["reasons"],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import cast

from app.dependencies.action_execute import get_action_execute_pipeline
from app.models.action_execute_result import ActionExecuteResult
from app.orchestrator.executor_boundary import (
    execute_with_boundary,
    summarize_execution_receipt,
)
from app.orchestrator.secure_runtime_pipeline import SecureRuntimePipeline


def execute_guarded_action(
    *,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    risk_score: int,
    client_id: str | None,
    session_id: str | None,
    file_path: str | None,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> ActionExecuteResult:
    active_pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline = (
        pipeline if pipeline is not None else get_action_execute_pipeline()
    )

    effective_file_path = file_path or "app/api/action_execute.py"

    receipt, runtime_result = execute_with_boundary(
        pipeline=active_pipeline,
        actor_id=client_id or "anonymous-client",
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        session_id=session_id,
        file_path=effective_file_path,
        metadata={
            "source": "action_execute_api",
            "session_id": session_id,
            "client_id": client_id,
        },
        executor=None,
    )

    summary = summarize_execution_receipt(receipt, runtime_result)
    summary["risk_score"] = risk_score
    summary["file_path"] = effective_file_path
    return cast(ActionExecuteResult, summary)
