from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store

DEFAULT_AUDIT_TABLE = "audit_events"


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_iso8601(value: str | datetime | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return _utc_now()
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return dt.isoformat()
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return _utc_now()
    return text


def _to_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            str(key): val
            for key, val in vars(value).items()
            if not str(key).startswith("_") and not callable(val)
        }
    return {"value": value}


def _clean_mapping(value: dict[str, Any] | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not value:
        return {}
    return {str(key): item for key, item in dict(value).items() if item is not None}


def _string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _ensure_actor(actor: dict[str, Any] | None, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged = _clean_mapping(actor)
    for key in ("actor", "actor_id", "actor_type", "actor_name"):
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None and key not in merged:
            merged[key] = payload[key]
    return merged


def _ensure_target(target: dict[str, Any] | None, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged = _clean_mapping(target)
    for key in ("target", "target_id", "target_type", "resource_id", "resource_type"):
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None and key not in merged:
            merged[key] = payload[key]
    return merged


def _ensure_metadata(metadata: dict[str, Any] | None, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    explicit = _clean_mapping(metadata)
    reserved = {
        "event_id",
        "id",
        "timestamp",
        "created_at",
        "occurred_at",
        "action",
        "event",
        "event_type",
        "category",
        "severity",
        "status",
        "result",
        "message",
        "summary",
        "description",
        "request_id",
        "trace_id",
        "session_id",
        "organization_id",
        "org_id",
        "tenant_id",
        "customer_id",
        "actor",
        "actor_id",
        "actor_type",
        "actor_name",
        "target",
        "target_id",
        "target_type",
        "resource_id",
        "resource_type",
        "metadata",
        "details",
    }
    derived = {
        str(key): value
        for key, value in payload.items()
        if key not in reserved and value is not None
    }
    derived.update(explicit)
    return derived


def _normalize_event_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    event_id: str | None = None,
    action: str | None = None,
    event: str | None = None,
    event_type: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    result: str | None = None,
    message: str | None = None,
    summary: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
    actor: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    target: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    tenant_id: str | None = None,
    customer_id: str | None = None,
    timestamp: str | datetime | None = None,
    created_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    occurred_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source = _clean_mapping(payload or {})
    source.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_event_id = (
        _string(event_id)
        or _string(source.get("event_id"))
        or _string(source.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )
    resolved_action = (
        _string(action)
        or _string(event)
        or _string(event_type)
        or _string(source.get("action"))
        or _string(source.get("event"))
        or _string(source.get("event_type"))
    )
    if not resolved_action:
        raise ValueError("action is required")

    resolved_category = (
        _string(category)
        or _string(source.get("category"))
        or "audit"
    )
    resolved_severity = (
        _string(severity)
        or _string(source.get("severity"))
        or "info"
    )
    resolved_status = (
        _string(status)
        or _string(result)
        or _string(source.get("status"))
        or _string(source.get("result"))
        or "success"
    )
    resolved_message = (
        _string(message)
        or _string(summary)
        or _string(description)
        or _string(source.get("message"))
        or _string(source.get("summary"))
        or _string(source.get("description"))
        or resolved_action
    )
    resolved_timestamp = _normalize_iso8601(
        timestamp
        or created_at
        or occurred_at
        or source.get("timestamp")
        or source.get("created_at")
    )

    resolved_org = (
        _string(organization_id)
        or _string(org_id)
        or _string(tenant_id)
        or _string(customer_id)
        or _string(source.get("organization_id"))
        or _string(source.get("org_id"))
        or _string(source.get("tenant_id"))
        or _string(source.get("customer_id"))
    )
    resolved_request_id = (
        _string(request_id)
        or _string(source.get("request_id"))
    )
    resolved_trace_id = (
        _string(trace_id)
        or _string(source.get("trace_id"))
    )
    resolved_session_id = (
        _string(session_id)
        or _string(source.get("session_id"))
    )

    resolved_actor = _ensure_actor(actor, source)
    resolved_target = _ensure_target(target, source)

    details_payload = _clean_mapping(details) or _clean_mapping(
        _to_dict(source.get("details"))
    )
    metadata_payload = _ensure_metadata(metadata, source)
    if details_payload:
        metadata_payload.setdefault("details", details_payload)

    normalized = {
        "event_id": resolved_event_id,
        "id": resolved_event_id,
        "action": resolved_action,
        "event": resolved_action,
        "event_type": resolved_action,
        "category": resolved_category,
        "severity": resolved_severity,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "result": resolved_status,
        "message": resolved_message,
        "summary": resolved_message,
        "description": resolved_message,
        "timestamp": resolved_timestamp,
        "created_at": resolved_timestamp,
        "occurred_at": resolved_timestamp,
        "actor": resolved_actor,
        "target": resolved_target,
        "metadata": metadata_payload,
        "details": details_payload or metadata_payload.get("details", {}),
        "request_id": resolved_request_id or None,
        "trace_id": resolved_trace_id or None,
        "session_id": resolved_session_id or None,
        "organization_id": resolved_org or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org or None,
        "tenant_id": resolved_org or None,
        "customer_id": resolved_org or None,
    }
    return normalized


def _normalize_rows(rows: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if rows is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(rows, Mapping):
        return [dict(rows)]
    if isinstance(rows, Iterable) and not isinstance(rows, (str, bytes)):
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]
    return []


@dataclass(slots=True)
class AuditStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_AUDIT_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": self.is_ready(),
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        health = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(health):
            try:
                return bool(health())
            except Exception:
                return False
        return True

    def log_event(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        event = _normalize_event_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        insert = getattr(self.backend, "insert", None)
        if not callable(insert):
            return event
        inserted = insert(self.table_name, event)
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return dict(inserted)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return dict(inserted[0])
        return event

    def create_event(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.log_event(payload, **kwargs)

    def write_event(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.log_event(payload, **kwargs)

    def append(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.log_event(payload, **kwargs)

    def record(
        self,
        action: str,
        *,
        actor: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        target: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        severity: str = "info",
        status: str = "success",
        message: str | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        request_id: str | None = None,
        trace_id: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        timestamp: str | datetime | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.log_event(
            None,
            action=action,
            actor=actor,
            target=target,
            metadata=metadata,
            severity=severity,
            status=status,
            message=message,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            request_id=request_id,
            trace_id=trace_id,
            session_id=session_id,
            timestamp=timestamp,
            **kwargs,
        )

    def list_events(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        actor_id: str | None = None,
        action: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        request_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        query_filters = _clean_mapping(filters)
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if action:
            query_filters.setdefault("action", action)
        if severity:
            query_filters.setdefault("severity", severity)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", status)
        if session_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("session_id", session_id)
        if request_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("request_id", request_id)

        select = getattr(self.backend, "select", None)
        if not callable(select):
            return []

        rows = _normalize_rows(
            select(
                self.table_name,
                limit=limit,
                filters=query_filters or None,
            )
        )
        results = [dict(row) for row in rows]

        if actor_id:
            normalized_actor_id = _string(actor_id)
            filtered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for row in results:
                actor = _to_dict(row.get("actor"))
                row_actor_id = _string(actor.get("actor_id") or actor.get("id"))
                if row_actor_id and row_actor_id == normalized_actor_id:
                    filtered.append(row)
            results = filtered

        results.sort(
            key=lambda row: _string(row.get("timestamp") or row.get("created_at")),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return results

    def query(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_events(**kwargs)

    def get_event(self, event_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _string(event_id):
            raise ValueError("event_id is required")

        select = getattr(self.backend, "select", None)
        if not callable(select):
            return None

        for key in ("event_id", "id"):
            rows = _normalize_rows(
                select(self.table_name, filters={key: event_id}, limit=1)
            )
            if rows:
                return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def find_event(self, event_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_event(event_id)

    def delete_event(self, event_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _string(event_id):
            raise ValueError("event_id is required")

        delete = getattr(self.backend, "delete", None)
        if not callable(delete):
            return None

        for key in ("event_id", "id"):
            deleted = delete(self.table_name, filters={key: event_id})
            rows = _normalize_rows(deleted)
            if rows:
                return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 1000,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        rows = self.list_events(limit=limit, organization_id=organization_id)
        by_action: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}

        for row in rows:
            action = _string(row.get("action"), "unknown")
            severity = _string(row.get("severity"), "unknown")
            status = _string(row.get("status"), "unknown")
            by_action[action] = by_action.get(action, 0) + 1
            by_severity[severity] = by_severity.get(severity, 0) + 1
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total": len(rows),
            "by_action": by_action,
            "by_severity": by_severity,
            "by_status": by_status,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }


def build_audit_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_AUDIT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> AuditStore:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    return AuditStore(backend=resolved_backend, table_name=table_name)


def create_audit_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_AUDIT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> AuditStore:
    return build_audit_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_audit_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_AUDIT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> AuditStore:
    return build_audit_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.org_isolation import evaluate_org_isolation
from app.core.permissions import evaluate_permission
from app.core.principals import Principal, build_principal
from app.core.session_security import (
    SessionPolicy,
    SessionRecord,
    SessionValidationResult,
    build_session_principal,
    create_session_record,
    revoke_session_record,
    rotate_session_secret,
    touch_session_record,
    validate_session_record,
)


def _clean(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip()


def _clean_lower(value: object) -> str:
    return _clean(value).lower()


def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(item) for key, item in metadata.items()}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuthResult:
    authenticated: bool
    context: AuthContext
    principal: Principal | None = None
    session: SessionRecord | None = None
    validation: SessionValidationResult | None = None
    reason: str = "unknown"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "authenticated": self.authenticated,
            "context": {
                "authenticated": self.context.authenticated,
                "principal_id": self.context.principal_id,
                "principal_type": self.context.principal_type,
                "org_id": self.context.org_id,
                "roles": list(self.context.roles),
                "permissions": list(self.context.permissions),
                "session_id": self.context.session_id,
                "auth_method": self.context.auth_method,
                "metadata": dict(self.context.metadata),
            },
            "principal": self.principal.to_dict() if self.principal else None,
            "session": self.session.to_dict() if self.session else None,
            "validation": self.validation.to_dict() if self.validation else None,
            "reason": self.reason,
        }


class AuthService:
    def __init__(self, *, session_policy: SessionPolicy | None = None) -> None:
        self._session_policy = session_policy or SessionPolicy()

    @property
    def session_policy(self) -> SessionPolicy:
        return self._session_policy

    def build_principal(
        self,
        *,
        principal_id: str,
        principal_type: str,
        org_id: str | None = None,
        email: str | None = None,
        display_name: str | None = None,
        roles: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
        permissions: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
        active: bool = True,
        service_name: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> Principal:
        return build_principal(
            principal_id=principal_id,
            principal_type=principal_type,
            org_id=org_id,
            email=email,
            display_name=display_name,
            roles=roles,
            permissions=permissions,
            active=active,
            service_name=service_name,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def issue_session(
        self,
        *,
        principal: Principal,
        secret: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        ip_address: str | None = None,
        user_agent: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[SessionRecord, str]:
        session_principal = build_session_principal(
            principal_id=principal.principal_id,
            principal_type=principal.principal_type,
            org_id=principal.org_id,
            roles=principal.roles,
            permissions=principal.permissions,
        )
        return create_session_record(
            principal=session_principal,
            secret=secret,
            session_id=session_id,
            policy=self._session_policy,
            now=now,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def authenticate_session(
        self,
        *,
        principal: Principal,
        session: SessionRecord,
        presented_secret: str,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        ip_address: str | None = None,
        user_agent: str | None = None,
        auth_method: str = "session",
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> AuthResult:
        validation = validate_session_record(
            session,
            presented_secret=presented_secret,
            policy=self._session_policy,
            now=now,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
        )
        context = self._build_auth_context(
            principal=principal,
            session=session,
            authenticated=validation.valid and principal.active,
            auth_method=auth_method,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

        reason = validation.reason
        if validation.valid and not principal.active:
            reason = "principal_inactive"

        return AuthResult(
            authenticated=validation.valid and principal.active,
            context=context,
            principal=principal,
            session=session,
            validation=validation,
            reason=reason,
        )

    def refresh_session(
        self,
        session: SessionRecord,
        *,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        ip_address: str | None = None,
        user_agent: str | None = None,
    ) -> SessionRecord:
        return touch_session_record(
            session,
            policy=self._session_policy,
            now=now,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
        )

    def rotate_session(
        self,
        session: SessionRecord,
        *,
        new_secret: str | None = None,
        now: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[SessionRecord, str]:
        return rotate_session_secret(
            session,
            new_secret=new_secret,
            now=now,
            policy=self._session_policy,
        )

    def revoke_session(
        self,
        session: SessionRecord,
        *,
        reason: str = "revoked",
        now: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> SessionRecord:
        return revoke_session_record(
            session,
            reason=reason,
            now=now,
        )

    def check_permission(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        permission: str,
        *,
        resource_org_id: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        decision = evaluate_permission(
            context,
            permission,
            resource_org_id=resource_org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return decision.allowed

    def check_org_access(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        decision = evaluate_org_isolation(
            context,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return decision.allowed

    def build_anonymous_context(
        self,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> AuthContext:
        return AuthContext(
            authenticated=False,
            principal_id=None,
            principal_type="anonymous",
            org_id=None,
            roles=(),
            permissions=(),
            session_id=None,
            auth_method=None,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def _build_auth_context(
        self,
        *,
        principal: Principal,
        session: SessionRecord | None,
        authenticated: bool,
        auth_method: str | None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> AuthContext:
        combined_metadata = dict(principal.metadata)
        combined_metadata.update(_stringify_metadata(metadata))

        return AuthContext(
            authenticated=authenticated,
            principal_id=principal.principal_id,
            principal_type=_clean_lower(principal.principal_type) or "unknown",
            org_id=_clean(principal.org_id) or None,
            roles=principal.roles,
            permissions=principal.permissions,
            session_id=session.session_id if session else None,
            auth_method=_clean_lower(auth_method) or None,
            metadata=combined_metadata,
        )


def build_auth_service(
    *,
    session_policy: SessionPolicy | None = None,
) -> AuthService:
    return AuthService(session_policy=session_policy)

from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, Protocol, runtime_checkable

BackupKind = Literal["snapshot", "export"]
BackupFormat = Literal["tar.gz", "jsonl.gz"]
RotationTier = Literal["hourly", "daily", "weekly", "monthly"]


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _iso(dt: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if dt is None:
        return None
    return dt.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _sha256_file(path: Path, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(chunk_size), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def _timestamp_slug(dt: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    value = dt or _utc_now()
    return value.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def _env_int(name: str, default: int) -> int:
    raw = os.getenv(name)
    if raw is None:
        return default
    try:
        return int(str(raw).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BackupRotationPolicy:
    """Simple rotation policy expressed as max counts per tier."""

    max_hourly: int = 24
    max_daily: int = 7
    max_weekly: int = 4
    max_monthly: int = 12

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BackupTarget:
    """Logical store that can be snapshotted or exported."""

    name: str
    kind: BackupKind
    format: BackupFormat
    base_path: Path
    rotation_policy: BackupRotationPolicy
    encrypt_at_rest: bool = True
    checksum_required: bool = True

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        data = asdict(self)
        data["base_path"] = str(self.base_path)
        return data


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BackupManifest:
    target_name: str
    target_kind: BackupKind
    backup_format: BackupFormat
    backup_path: str
    created_at: str
    size_bytes: int
    sha256: str | None
    rotation_tier: RotationTier
    encryption_applied: bool
    meta: dict[str, Any]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@runtime_checkable
class SnapshotProvider(Protocol):
    """Abstraction for persistence stores to produce snapshot/export artifacts."""

    def snapshot(self, target: BackupTarget, destination: Path) -> Path: ...
    def export(self, target: BackupTarget, destination: Path) -> Path: ...


class FilesystemSnapshotProvider:
    """
    Default provider that copies or compresses directories/files.

    This is primarily for local development and CI artifacts; production
    integrations should provide a more robust implementation.
    """

    def snapshot(self, target: BackupTarget, destination: Path) -> Path:
        _ensure_dir(destination.parent)
        source = target.base_path
        if not source.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"snapshot source does not exist: {source}")

        if target.format == "tar.gz":
            archive_prefix = destination.parent / destination.name.removesuffix(".tar.gz")
            root_dir = source.parent
            base_name = source.name
            produced = Path(
                shutil.make_archive(
                    str(archive_prefix),
                    "gztar",
                    root_dir=str(root_dir),
                    base_dir=base_name,
                )
            )
            if produced != destination:
                destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                produced.replace(destination)
            return destination

        if target.format == "jsonl.gz":
            entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for path in sorted(source.rglob("*")):
                entries.append(
                    {
                        "path": str(path.relative_to(source)),
                        "is_dir": path.is_dir(),
                        "size": path.stat().st_size if path.is_file() else 0,
                    }
                )
            with gzip.open(destination, "wt", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                for entry in entries:
                    fh.write(json.dumps(entry, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
            return destination

        raise ValueError(f"unsupported backup format for snapshot: {target.format}")

    def export(self, target: BackupTarget, destination: Path) -> Path:
        return self.snapshot(target, destination)


class BackupService:
    """
    Orchestrates IronClaw backup creation, rotation, and verification.

    This service is intentionally filesystem-focused; callers are expected
    to provide the concrete SnapshotProvider that knows how to talk to
    databases, object stores, or other persistence layers.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        root_backup_dir: Path,
        targets: list[BackupTarget],
        snapshot_provider: SnapshotProvider | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._root = root_backup_dir
        self._targets: dict[str, BackupTarget] = {t.name: t for t in targets}
        self._provider: SnapshotProvider = snapshot_provider or FilesystemSnapshotProvider()

    def list_targets(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [t.to_dict() for t in self._targets.values()]

    def run_snapshot(self, target_name: str) -> BackupManifest:
        target = self._get_target(target_name)
        current_time = _utc_now()
        tier = self._determine_rotation_tier(current_time)
        path = self._build_backup_path(target, tier, current_time)
        artifact = self._provider.snapshot(target, path)
        return self._finalize_manifest(target, artifact, tier, current_time)

    def run_export(self, target_name: str) -> BackupManifest:
        target = self._get_target(target_name)
        current_time = _utc_now()
        tier = self._determine_rotation_tier(current_time)
        path = self._build_backup_path(target, tier, current_time)
        artifact = self._provider.export(target, path)
        return self._finalize_manifest(target, artifact, tier, current_time)

    def rotate(self, target_name: str) -> list[Path]:
        target = self._get_target(target_name)
        removed: list[Path] = []
        policy = target.rotation_policy

        for tier, max_count in (
            ("hourly", policy.max_hourly),
            ("daily", policy.max_daily),
            ("weekly", policy.max_weekly),
            ("monthly", policy.max_monthly),
        ):
            tier_dir = self._tier_dir(target, tier)
            if not tier_dir.exists():
                continue
            backups = sorted(
                (
                    p
                    for p in tier_dir.glob("*")
                    if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith(".manifest.json")
                ),
                key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime,
                reverse=True,
            )
            for old in backups[max_count:]:
                old.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                sidecar = self._manifest_sidecar_path(old)
                sidecar.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                removed.append(old)

        return removed

    def verify(self, manifest: BackupManifest) -> bool:
        path = Path(manifest.backup_path)
        if not path.exists() or not path.is_file():
            return False
        if manifest.sha256:
            current = _sha256_file(path)
            return current == manifest.sha256
        return True

    def _get_target(self, target_name: str) -> BackupTarget:
        normalized = target_name.strip()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("target_name cannot be empty")
        try:
            return self._targets[normalized]
        except KeyError:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown backup target: {normalized}") from None

    @staticmethod
    def _determine_rotation_tier(dt: datetime) -> RotationTier:
        if dt.day == 1:
            return "monthly"
        if dt.weekday() == 6:
            return "weekly"
        if dt.hour == 0:
            return "daily"
        return "hourly"

    def _build_backup_path(self, target: BackupTarget, tier: RotationTier, dt: datetime) -> Path:
        slug = _timestamp_slug(dt)
        tier_dir = self._tier_dir(target, tier)
        _ensure_dir(tier_dir)
        suffix = ".tar.gz" if target.format == "tar.gz" else ".jsonl.gz"
        filename = f"{target.name}-{tier}-{slug}{suffix}"
        return tier_dir / filename

    def _tier_dir(self, target: BackupTarget, tier: RotationTier) -> Path:
        return self._root / target.name / tier

    @staticmethod
    def _manifest_sidecar_path(artifact: Path) -> Path:
        return artifact.with_name(f"{artifact.name}.manifest.json")

    def _finalize_manifest(
        self,
        target: BackupTarget,
        artifact: Path,
        tier: RotationTier,
        created_at: datetime,
    ) -> BackupManifest:
        size = artifact.stat().st_size if artifact.exists() else 0
        sha = _sha256_file(artifact) if target.checksum_required and artifact.exists() else None

        manifest = BackupManifest(
            target_name=target.name,
            target_kind=target.kind,
            backup_format=target.format,
            backup_path=str(artifact),
            created_at=_iso(created_at) or "",
            size_bytes=size,
            sha256=sha,
            rotation_tier=tier,
            encryption_applied=target.encrypt_at_rest,
            meta={"rotation_policy": target.rotation_policy.to_dict()},
        )
        self._write_manifest_sidecar(artifact, manifest)
        return manifest

    def _write_manifest_sidecar(self, artifact: Path, manifest: BackupManifest) -> None:
        sidecar = self._manifest_sidecar_path(artifact)
        _ensure_dir(sidecar.parent)
        sidecar.write_text(
            json.dumps(manifest.to_dict(), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )


def default_backup_targets_from_env() -> list[BackupTarget]:
    """
    Construct a default set of backup targets from environment variables.

    This keeps orchestration logic centralized while allowing deployment
    configuration to drive which stores are actually backed up.
    """
    root = Path(os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BACKUP_ROOT", "backups")).resolve()

    db_url = os.getenv("SUPABASE_DB_URL") or os.getenv("DATABASE_URL") or ""
    db_enabled = bool(db_url)

    targets: list[BackupTarget] = []

    if db_enabled:
        db_policy = BackupRotationPolicy(
            max_hourly=_env_int("IRONCLAW_DB_BACKUP_MAX_HOURLY", 24),
            max_daily=_env_int("IRONCLAW_DB_BACKUP_MAX_DAILY", 7),
            max_weekly=_env_int("IRONCLAW_DB_BACKUP_MAX_WEEKLY", 4),
            max_monthly=_env_int("IRONCLAW_DB_BACKUP_MAX_MONTHLY", 12),
        )
        targets.append(
            BackupTarget(
                name="database",
                kind="snapshot",
                format="tar.gz",
                base_path=root / "database-source",
                rotation_policy=db_policy,
                encrypt_at_rest=True,
                checksum_required=True,
            )
        )

    runtime_policy = BackupRotationPolicy(
        max_hourly=_env_int("IRONCLAW_RUNTIME_BACKUP_MAX_HOURLY", 6),
        max_daily=_env_int("IRONCLAW_RUNTIME_BACKUP_MAX_DAILY", 3),
        max_weekly=_env_int("IRONCLAW_RUNTIME_BACKUP_MAX_WEEKLY", 2),
        max_monthly=_env_int("IRONCLAW_RUNTIME_BACKUP_MAX_MONTHLY", 1),
    )
    targets.append(
        BackupTarget(
            name="runtime-metadata",
            kind="export",
            format="jsonl.gz",
            base_path=Path(os.getenv("IRONCLAW_RUNTIME_STATE_DIR", "output")).resolve(),
            rotation_policy=runtime_policy,
            encrypt_at_rest=False,
            checksum_required=True,
        )
    )

    return targets


def build_default_backup_service() -> BackupService:
    root = Path(os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BACKUP_ROOT", "backups")).resolve()
    targets = default_backup_targets_from_env()
    return BackupService(root_backup_dir=root, targets=targets)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4


PlanName = Literal["free", "pro", "enterprise"]
SubscriptionStatus = Literal["trialing", "active", "past_due", "canceled"]
MeterEventType = Literal["scan", "guard_request", "execution", "incident", "quarantine"]


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class MeterEventRecord:
    event_id: str
    org_id: str
    event_type: MeterEventType
    quantity: int
    occurred_at: datetime
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["occurred_at"] = self.occurred_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return payload


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SubscriptionRecord:
    subscription_id: str
    org_id: str
    plan_name: PlanName
    status: SubscriptionStatus
    billing_email: str
    period_start: datetime
    period_end: datetime
    included_units: int
    used_units: int
    overage_units: int
    price_usd_monthly: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["period_start"] = self.period_start.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        payload["period_end"] = self.period_end.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return payload


class BillingStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._subscriptions: list[SubscriptionRecord] = []
        self._meter_events: list[MeterEventRecord] = []

    def seed_defaults(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if self._subscriptions or self._meter_events:
                return

            now = _utcnow()
            period_start = now.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            period_end = now.replace(day=28, hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)

            self._subscriptions.extend(
                [
                    SubscriptionRecord(
                        subscription_id=f"sub-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        org_id="org-seed-001",
                        plan_name="enterprise",
                        status="active",

    def list_subscriptions(self, *, org_id: str | None = None) -> list[SubscriptionRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._subscriptions)

        if org_id is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.org_id == org_id]

        return items

    def get_subscription(self, subscription_id: str) -> SubscriptionRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for item in self._subscriptions:
                if item.subscription_id == subscription_id:
                    return item
        return None

    def create_subscription(
        self,
        *,
        org_id: str,
        plan_name: PlanName,
        status: SubscriptionStatus,
        billing_email: str,
        included_units: int,
        price_usd_monthly: int,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> SubscriptionRecord:
        now = _utcnow()
        period_start = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
        period_end = now.replace(day=28, hour=23, minute=59, second=59, microsecond=0)

        record = SubscriptionRecord(
            subscription_id=f"sub-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            org_id=org_id.strip(),
            plan_name=plan_name,
            status=status,
            billing_email=billing_email.strip(),
            period_start=period_start,
            period_end=period_end,
            included_units=included_units,
            used_units=0,
            overage_units=0,
            price_usd_monthly=price_usd_monthly,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )

        with self._lock:
            self._subscriptions.append(record)

        return record

    def update_subscription(
        self,
        subscription_id: str,
        *,
        status: SubscriptionStatus,
        plan_name: PlanName | None = None,
        billing_email: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> SubscriptionRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for index, item in enumerate(self._subscriptions):
                if item.subscription_id != subscription_id:
                    continue

                updated = SubscriptionRecord(
                    subscription_id=item.subscription_id,
                    org_id=item.org_id,
                    plan_name=plan_name if plan_name is not None else item.plan_name,
                    status=status,
                    billing_email=billing_email.strip() if billing_email is not None else item.billing_email,
                    period_start=item.period_start,
                    period_end=item.period_end,
                    included_units=item.included_units,
                    used_units=item.used_units,
                    overage_units=item.overage_units,
                    price_usd_monthly=item.price_usd_monthly,
                    metadata={
                        **item.metadata,
                        **dict(metadata or {}),
                    },
                )
                self._subscriptions[index] = updated
                return updated

        return None

    def list_meter_events(
        self,
        *,
        org_id: str | None = None,
        event_type: MeterEventType | None = None,
    ) -> list[MeterEventRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._meter_events)

        if org_id is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.org_id == org_id]
        if event_type is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.event_type == event_type]

        return items

    def record_meter_event(
        self,
        *,
        org_id: str,
        event_type: MeterEventType,
        quantity: int,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> MeterEventRecord:
        event = MeterEventRecord(
            event_id=f"mtr-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            org_id=org_id.strip(),
            event_type=event_type,
            quantity=quantity,
            occurred_at=_utcnow(),
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )

        with self._lock:
            self._meter_events.append(event)

            for index, item in enumerate(self._subscriptions):
                if item.org_id != org_id:
                    continue

                used_units = item.used_units + quantity
                overage_units = max(0, used_units - item.included_units)
                self._subscriptions[index] = SubscriptionRecord(
                    subscription_id=item.subscription_id,
                    org_id=item.org_id,
                    plan_name=item.plan_name,
                    status=item.status,
                    billing_email=item.billing_email,
                    period_start=item.period_start,
                    period_end=item.period_end,
                    included_units=item.included_units,
                    used_units=used_units,
                    overage_units=overage_units,
                    price_usd_monthly=item.price_usd_monthly,
                    metadata=dict(item.metadata),
                )

        return event

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._subscriptions.clear()
            self._meter_events.clear()


_BILLING_STORE = BillingStore()
_BILLING_STORE.seed_defaults()


def get_billing_store() -> BillingStore:
    return _BILLING_STORE


def reset_billing_store() -> None:
    _BILLING_STORE.reset()
    _BILLING_STORE.seed_defaults()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP, getcontext
from typing import Any, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store


DEFAULT_BILLING_TABLE = "billing_records"


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()  # [web:127]


def _normalize_timestamp(value: str | datetime | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return _utc_now()
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return dt.isoformat()
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or _utc_now()


def _string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _mapping(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):  # [web:115][web:116]
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: val
            for key, val in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(val)
        }
    raise TypeError("value is not serializable to dict")


def _listify(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _decimal_text(value: Any, default: str = "0") -> str:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return default
    try:
        amount = Decimal(str(value))  # [web:129][web:130]
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("invalid decimal amount") from exc
    quantized = amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)  # [web:125][web:126]
    return format(quantized, "f")


def _normalize_billing_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    billing_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    customer_id: str | None = None,
    package_id: str | None = None,
    package_code: str | None = None,
    package_name: str | None = None,
    plan_id: str | None = None,
    invoice_id: str | None = None,
    purchase_id: str | None = None,
    transaction_id: str | None = None,
    amount: Any = None,
    subtotal: Any = None,
    tax_amount: Any = None,
    total_amount: Any = None,
    currency: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    billing_type: str | None = None,
    interval: str | None = None,
    units: Any = None,
    quota: Any = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    line_items: list[Any] | None = None,
    tags: list[Any] | None = None,
    created_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    updated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    billed_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    paid_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _mapping(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_billing_id = (
        _string(billing_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("billing_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_owner_id = (
        _string(owner_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("owner_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("account_id"))
    )

    resolved_org = (
        _string(organization_id)
        or _string(org_id)
        or _string(customer_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("organization_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("org_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("customer_id"))
    )

    resolved_package_id = (
        _string(package_id)
        or _string(package_code)
        or _string(plan_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("package_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("package_code"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("plan_id"))
    )

    resolved_package_name = (
        _string(package_name)
        or _string(source_payload.get("package_name"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("plan_name"))
        or resolved_package_id
        or "standard"
    )

    resolved_currency = (
        _string(currency)
        or _string(source_payload.get("currency"))
        or "USD"
    ).upper()

    resolved_amount = _decimal_text(
        amount
        if amount is not None
        else source_payload.get("amount", source_payload.get("price"))
    )
    resolved_subtotal = _decimal_text(
        subtotal
        if subtotal is not None
        else source_payload.get("subtotal", resolved_amount)
    )
    resolved_tax_amount = _decimal_text(
        tax_amount
        if tax_amount is not None
        else source_payload.get("tax_amount", source_payload.get("tax", "0"))
    )
    # use Decimal from strings, not floats, for currency-safe math [web:129][web:130]
    resolved_total_amount = _decimal_text(
        total_amount
        if total_amount is not None
        else source_payload.get(
            "total_amount",
            source_payload.get(
                "total",
                Decimal(resolved_subtotal) + Decimal(resolved_tax_amount),
            ),
        )
    )

    resolved_units = int(
        units
        if units is not None
        else source_payload.get("units", source_payload.get("credits", 0))
    )
    resolved_quota = int(
        quota
        if quota is not None
        else source_payload.get("quota", source_payload.get("limit", 0))
    )

    resolved_status = (
        _string(status)
        or _string(source_payload.get("status"))
        or "pending"
    )
    resolved_billing_type = (
        _string(billing_type)
        or _string(source_payload.get("billing_type"))
        or "package_purchase"
    )
    resolved_interval = (
        _string(interval)
        or _string(source_payload.get("interval"))
        or "monthly"
    )
    resolved_source = (
        _string(source)
        or _string(source_payload.get("source"))
        or "ironclaw"
    )

    resolved_created_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        created_at or source_payload.get("created_at") or billed_at or source_payload.get("billed_at")
    )
    resolved_updated_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        updated_at or source_payload.get("updated_at") or resolved_created_at
    )
    resolved_billed_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        billed_at or source_payload.get("billed_at") or resolved_created_at
    )
    resolved_paid_at = (
        _normalize_timestamp(paid_at or source_payload.get("paid_at"))
        if (paid_at is not None or source_payload.get("paid_at") is not None)
        else None
    )

    return {
        "billing_id": resolved_billing_id,
        "id": resolved_billing_id,
        "owner_id": resolved_owner_id or None,
        "organization_id": resolved_org or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org or None,
        "customer_id": resolved_org or None,
        "package_id": resolved_package_id or None,
        "package_code": resolved_package_id or None,
        "package_name": resolved_package_name,
        "plan_id": _string(plan_id) or _string(source_payload.get("plan_id")) or resolved_package_id or None,
        "invoice_id": _string(invoice_id) or _string(source_payload.get("invoice_id")) or None,
        "purchase_id": _string(purchase_id) or _string(source_payload.get("purchase_id")) or None,
        "transaction_id": _string(transaction_id) or _string(source_payload.get("transaction_id")) or None,
        "amount": resolved_amount,
        "subtotal": resolved_subtotal,
        "tax_amount": resolved_tax_amount,
        "total_amount": resolved_total_amount,
        "currency": resolved_currency,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "billing_type": resolved_billing_type,
        "interval": resolved_interval,
        "units": resolved_units,
        "quota": resolved_quota,
        "source": resolved_source,
        "metadata": metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("metadata")),
        "line_items": _listify(line_items if line_items is not None else source_payload.get("line_items")),
        "tags": _listify(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),
        "created_at": resolved_created_at,
        "updated_at": resolved_updated_at,
        "billed_at": resolved_billed_at,
        "paid_at": resolved_paid_at,
    }


@dataclass(slots=True)  # [web:121][web:124]
class BillingStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_BILLING_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        health = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(health):
            return bool(health())
        return True

    def create_record(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = _normalize_billing_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, record)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return dict(inserted[0])
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return dict(inserted)
        return record

    def create(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_record(payload, **kwargs)

    def charge(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_record(payload, **kwargs)

    def purchase_package(
        self,
        *,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        package_id: str | None = None,
        package_name: str | None = None,
        amount: Any = None,
        currency: str = "USD",
        units: int = 0,
        quota: int = 0,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_record(
            owner_id=owner_id,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            package_id=package_id,
            package_name=package_name,
            amount=amount,
            subtotal=amount,
            total_amount=amount,
            currency=currency,
            units=units,
            quota=quota,
            status="active",
            billing_type="package_purchase",
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )

    def list_records(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        package_id: str | None = None,
        invoice_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if owner_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("owner_id", owner_id)
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", status)
        if package_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("package_id", package_id)
        if invoice_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("invoice_id", invoice_id)

        rows = self.backend.select(
            self.table_name,
            limit=limit,
            filters=query_filters or None,
        )
        items = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        items.sort(
            key=lambda row: _normalize_timestamp(row.get("updated_at") or row.get("created_at")),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return items

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_records(**kwargs)

    def get_record(self, billing_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _string(billing_id):
            raise ValueError("billing_id is required")
        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"billing_id": billing_id}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])
        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"id": billing_id}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def get(self, billing_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_record(billing_id)

    def update_record(self, billing_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        existing = self.get_record(billing_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = dict(existing)
        merged.update(_mapping(updates))
        merged["billing_id"] = existing.get("billing_id") or existing.get("id") or billing_id
        merged["id"] = merged["billing_id"]
        merged["updated_at"] = _utc_now()

        if _string(merged.get("status")).lower() in {"paid", "settled"} and not merged.get("paid_at"):
            merged["paid_at"] = merged["updated_at"]

        normalized = _normalize_billing_payload(merged)

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"billing_id": billing_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"id": billing_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        return normalized

    def update(self, billing_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_record(billing_id, updates)

    def mark_paid(
        self,
        billing_id: str,
        *,
        transaction_id: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "paid",
            "paid_at": _utc_now(),
        }
        if transaction_id is not None:
            updates["transaction_id"] = transaction_id
        if metadata:
            current = self.get_record(billing_id) or {}
            merged_metadata = _mapping(current.get("metadata"))
            merged_metadata.update(metadata)
            updates["metadata"] = merged_metadata
        return self.update_record(billing_id, updates)

    def cancel_record(self, billing_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_record(billing_id, {"status": "cancelled"})

    def refund_record(
        self,
        billing_id: str,
        *,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {"status": "refunded"}
        if metadata:
            current = self.get_record(billing_id) or {}
            merged_metadata = _mapping(current.get("metadata"))
            merged_metadata.update(metadata)
            updates["metadata"] = merged_metadata
        return self.update_record(billing_id, updates)

    def delete_record(self, billing_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _string(billing_id):
            raise ValueError("billing_id is required")

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"billing_id": billing_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"id": billing_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        return None

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        records = self.list_records(
            limit=limit,
            owner_id=owner_id,
            organization_id=organization_id,
        )

        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_currency: dict[str, str] = {}
        total_amount = Decimal("0.00")

        for record in records:
            status = _string(record.get("status"), "unknown")
            currency = _string(record.get("currency"), "USD")
            amount = Decimal(str(record.get("total_amount", "0")))  # [web:129]
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1
            total_amount += amount
            running = Decimal(by_currency.get(currency, "0.00")) + amount
            by_currency[currency] = format(running.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), "f")

        return {
            "total_records": len(records),
            "total_amount": format(total_amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP), "f"),
            "by_status": by_status,
            "by_currency": by_currency,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }


def build_billing_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_BILLING_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> BillingStore:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    return BillingStore(backend=resolved_backend, table_name=table_name)


def create_billing_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_BILLING_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> BillingStore:
    return build_billing_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_billing_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_BILLING_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> BillingStore:
    return build_billing_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal


CompatibilityState = Literal["supported", "warning", "unsupported"]
RuntimeFamily = Literal["claude-code", "openclaw", "generic-agent"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


def _parse_version(version: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    normalized = _normalize_text(version)
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("version is required")

    parts = normalized.split(".")
    if len(parts) < 3:
        parts = parts + ["0"] * (3 - len(parts))
    if len(parts) > 3:
        parts = parts[:3]

    try:
        major, minor, patch = (int(part) for part in parts)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid version: {version}") from exc

    return major, minor, patch


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CompatibilityRule:
    runtime_family: RuntimeFamily
    min_version: str
    max_version: str
    state: CompatibilityState
    reason: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "runtime_family": self.runtime_family,
            "min_version": self.min_version,
            "max_version": self.max_version,
            "state": self.state,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CompatibilityMatrix:
    rules: list[CompatibilityRule] = field(default_factory=list)
    generated_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "rules": [rule.to_dict() for rule in self.rules],
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CompatibilityDecision:
    runtime_family: str
    version: str
    state: CompatibilityState
    reason: str
    checked_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    matched_rule: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "runtime_family": self.runtime_family,
            "version": self.version,
            "state": self.state,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "checked_at": self.checked_at,
            "matched_rule": dict(self.matched_rule or {}),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def default_compatibility_rules() -> list[CompatibilityRule]:
    return [
        CompatibilityRule(
            runtime_family="claude-code",
            min_version="0.1.0",
            max_version="1.9.99",
            state="supported",
            reason="Claude Code adapter contract is supported for Gen1.",
            metadata={"priority": 1},
        ),
        CompatibilityRule(
            runtime_family="openclaw",
            min_version="0.1.0",
            max_version="1.9.99",
            state="supported",
            reason="OpenClaw adapter contract is supported for Gen1.",
            metadata={"priority": 1},
        ),
        CompatibilityRule(
            runtime_family="generic-agent",
            min_version="0.1.0",
            max_version="0.9.99",
            state="warning",
            reason="Generic agent support is available but may require custom wrapper hooks.",
            metadata={"priority": 1},
        ),
    ]


def initialize_compatibility_matrix() -> CompatibilityMatrix:
    return CompatibilityMatrix(
        rules=default_compatibility_rules(),
        metadata={
            "matrix_version": "1.0.0",
            "scope": "IronClaw-Security",
        },
    )


def list_compatibility_rules(
    matrix: CompatibilityMatrix,
    *,
    runtime_family: str | None = None,
) -> list[CompatibilityRule]:
    rules = list(matrix.rules)
    if runtime_family:
        normalized = _normalize_text(runtime_family).lower()
        rules = [rule for rule in rules if rule.runtime_family == normalized]

    return sorted(
        rules,
        key=lambda item: (
            item.runtime_family,
            _parse_version(item.min_version),
            _parse_version(item.max_version),
        ),
    )


def evaluate_compatibility(
    matrix: CompatibilityMatrix,
    *,
    runtime_family: str,
    version: str,
) -> CompatibilityDecision:
    normalized_family = _normalize_text(runtime_family).lower()
    normalized_version = _normalize_text(version)

    if not normalized_family:
        raise ValueError("runtime_family is required")
    if not normalized_version:
        raise ValueError("version is required")

    parsed_version = _parse_version(normalized_version)

    candidates = list_compatibility_rules(
        matrix,
        runtime_family=normalized_family,
    )

    for rule in candidates:
        min_version = _parse_version(rule.min_version)
        max_version = _parse_version(rule.max_version)
        if min_version <= parsed_version <= max_version:
            return CompatibilityDecision(
                runtime_family=normalized_family,
                version=normalized_version,
                state=rule.state,
                reason=rule.reason,
                matched_rule=rule.to_dict(),
                metadata={"matched": True},
            )

    return CompatibilityDecision(
        runtime_family=normalized_family,
        version=normalized_version,
        state="unsupported",
        reason="No compatibility rule matched this runtime family and version.",
        matched_rule=None,
        metadata={"matched": False},
    )


def summarize_compatibility_decision(
    decision: CompatibilityDecision,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "runtime_family": decision.runtime_family,
        "version": decision.version,
        "state": decision.state,
        "reason": decision.reason,
        "checked_at": decision.checked_at,
        "matched": bool(decision.matched_rule),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.org_isolation import evaluate_org_isolation
from app.core.permissions import evaluate_permission
from app.core.principals import Principal
from app.services.authservice import AuthService, build_auth_service


def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CustomerAuthResult:
    allowed: bool
    scope: str
    principal_id: str | None
    org_id: str | None
    reason: str
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "principal_id": self.principal_id,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class CustomerAuthService:
    def __init__(self, *, auth_service: AuthService | None = None) -> None:
        self._auth_service = auth_service or build_auth_service()

    @property
    def auth_service(self) -> AuthService:
        return self._auth_service

    def build_customer_context(
        self,
        principal: Principal,
        *,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        auth_method: str = "customer",
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> AuthContext:
        combined_metadata = dict(principal.metadata)
        combined_metadata.update(_stringify_metadata(metadata))

        return AuthContext(
            authenticated=principal.active,
            principal_id=principal.principal_id,
            principal_type=principal.principal_type,
            org_id=principal.org_id,
            roles=principal.roles,
            permissions=principal.permissions,
            session_id=session_id,
            auth_method=auth_method,
            metadata=combined_metadata,
        )

    def validate_customer(
        self,
        principal: Principal,
        *,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        context = self.build_customer_context(
            principal,
            session_id=session_id,
            auth_method="customer",
            metadata=metadata,
        )

        if not principal.active:
            return CustomerAuthResult(
                allowed=False,
                scope="customer_auth",
                principal_id=principal.principal_id,
                org_id=principal.org_id,
                reason="principal_inactive",
                metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
            )

        if principal.principal_type != "customer":
            return CustomerAuthResult(
                allowed=False,
                scope="customer_auth",
                principal_id=principal.principal_id,
                org_id=principal.org_id,
                reason="principal_type_mismatch",
                metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
            )

        if not any(role in principal.roles for role in ("customer_admin", "customer_user")):
            return CustomerAuthResult(
                allowed=False,
                scope="customer_auth",
                principal_id=principal.principal_id,
                org_id=principal.org_id,
                reason="missing_customer_role",
                metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
            )

        return CustomerAuthResult(
            allowed=context.authenticated,
            scope="customer_auth",
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="allowed",
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def authorize_read(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        return self._authorize_permission(
            context,
            permission="customer:read",
            scope="customer_read",
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def authorize_write(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        return self._authorize_permission(
            context,
            permission="customer:write",
            scope="customer_write",
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def authorize_session_access(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        return self._authorize_permission(
            context,
            permission="session:read",
            scope="customer_session_access",
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def authorize_org_access(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        decision = evaluate_org_isolation(
            context,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return CustomerAuthResult(
            allowed=decision.allowed,
            scope="customer_org",
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            org_id=target_org_id or context.org_id,
            reason=decision.reason,
            metadata=dict(decision.metadata),
        )

    def authorize_permission(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        permission: str,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        return self._authorize_permission(
            context,
            permission=permission,
            scope="customer_permission",
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def _authorize_permission(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        permission: str,
        scope: str,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> CustomerAuthResult:
        decision = evaluate_permission(
            context,
            permission,
            resource_org_id=context.org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return CustomerAuthResult(
            allowed=decision.allowed,
            scope=scope,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason=decision.reason,
            metadata=dict(decision.metadata),
        )


def build_customer_auth_service(
    *,
    auth_service: AuthService | None = None,
) -> CustomerAuthService:
    return CustomerAuthService(auth_service=auth_service)
