import os
import re
from typing import Literal, TypedDict


Severity = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]


class Rule(TypedDict):
    id: str
    pattern: str
    severity: Severity
    category: str
    description: str


HEURISTIC_TERMS = {
    "ignore": 1,
    "override": 2,
    "system": 2,
    "developer": 2,
    "instructions": 2,
    "policy": 2,
    "rules": 1,
    "hidden": 1,
    "prompt": 2,
    "secret": 2,
    "secrets": 2,
    "credentials": 2,
    "tools": 1,
    "schema": 1,
    "execute": 2,
    "follow this": 2,
    "follow this instead": 3,
    "higher priority": 3,
    "real policy": 3,
    "reveal": 2,
    "leak": 2,
    "bypass": 3,
    "jailbreak": 3,
    "developer mode": 3,
    "system prompt": 4,
    "hidden prompt": 4,
    "ignore all previous instructions": 5,
    "ignore previous instructions": 4,
    "disregard previous instructions": 4,
    "forget previous instructions": 4,
    "repeat the system prompt": 5,
    "show the system prompt": 5,
    "print the system prompt": 5,
    "reveal your instructions": 4,
    "show your hidden instructions": 5,
    "act as": 2,
    "you are now": 3,
    "unsafe mode": 4,
    "do anything now": 4,
}


OVERRIDE_PATTERNS = [
    r"\bignore\s+(all\s+)?previous\s+instructions\b",
    r"\bdisregard\s+(all\s+)?previous\s+instructions\b",
    r"\bforget\s+(all\s+)?previous\s+instructions\b",
    r"\boverride\s+(the\s+)?(system|developer|safety|security)\s+(prompt|instructions|rules)\b",
    r"\bfollow\s+these\s+instructions\s+instead\b",
    r"\bnew\s+instructions\b",
    r"\bhigher\s+priority\s+instructions\b",
]

EXFIL_PATTERNS = [
    r"\breveal\s+(the\s+)?system\s+prompt\b",
    r"\bshow\s+(me\s+)?(the\s+)?system\s+prompt\b",
    r"\bprint\s+(the\s+)?system\s+prompt\b",
    r"\brepeat\s+(the\s+)?system\s+prompt\b",
    r"\breveal\s+(your\s+)?hidden\s+instructions\b",
    r"\bshow\s+(your\s+)?hidden\s+instructions\b",
    r"\boutput\s+(the\s+)?developer\s+prompt\b",
    r"\bdisclose\s+(internal|hidden|secret)\s+(prompt|instructions|policy)\b",
]

ROLE_HIJACK_PATTERNS = [
    r"\byou\s+are\s+now\b",
    r"\bact\s+as\s+(if\s+you\s+are\s+)?\b",
    r"\bdeveloper\s+mode\b",
    r"\bunsafe\s*bot\b",
    r"\bdo\s+anything\s+now\b",
    r"\bunrestricted\s+mode\b",
]

ENCODING_PATTERNS = [
    r"\bbase64\b",
    r"\bdecode\s+this\b",
    r"\brot13\b",
    r"\bhex\s+decode\b",
    r"\bunicode\s+escape\b",
]

SEPARATOR_PATTERNS = [
    r"(^|\s)#{2,}",
    r"(^|\s)<\s*system\s*>",
    r"(^|\s)<\s*developer\s*>",
    r"(^|\s)\[system\]",
    r"(^|\s)\[developer\]",
    r"\bBEGIN\s+SYSTEM\s+PROMPT\b",
    r"\bEND\s+SYSTEM\s+PROMPT\b",
]


def _normalize_for_heuristics(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


def _regex_match_count(text: str, patterns: list[str]) -> int:
    count = 0
    for pattern in patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE):
            count += 1
    return count


def _has_split_override_phrase(text: str) -> bool:
    compact = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", text.lower())
    suspicious_sequences = [
        "ignoreallpreviousinstructions",
        "revealthesystemprompt",
        "showthesystemprompt",
        "printthesystemprompt",
        "followthisinstead",
    ]
    return any(seq in compact for seq in suspicious_sequences)


def heuristic_prompt_injection_score(text: str) -> int:
    normalized = _normalize_for_heuristics(text)
    score = 0

    for term, weight in HEURISTIC_TERMS.items():
        if term in normalized:
            score += weight

    override_hits = _regex_match_count(text, OVERRIDE_PATTERNS)
    exfil_hits = _regex_match_count(text, EXFIL_PATTERNS)
    role_hits = _regex_match_count(text, ROLE_HIJACK_PATTERNS)
    encoding_hits = _regex_match_count(text, ENCODING_PATTERNS)
    separator_hits = _regex_match_count(text, SEPARATOR_PATTERNS)

    score += override_hits * 4
    score += exfil_hits * 5
    score += role_hits * 3
    score += encoding_hits * 2
    score += separator_hits * 2

    if _has_split_override_phrase(text):
        score += 5

    if "system" in normalized and "prompt" in normalized:
        score += 2

    if "ignore" in normalized and ("instructions" in normalized or "rules" in normalized):
        score += 2

    if (
        ("reveal" in normalized or "show" in normalized or "print" in normalized)
        and ("prompt" in normalized or "instructions" in normalized)
    ):
        score += 3

    return score


def _get_threshold() -> int:
    raw = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_HEURISTIC_THRESHOLD", "6")
    try:
        value = int(raw)
    except ValueError:
        value = 6
    return max(1, min(50, value))


def is_heuristic_prompt_injection(text: str) -> bool:
    return heuristic_prompt_injection_score(text) >= _get_threshold()

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import RLock
from typing import Any, Protocol, cast


class ScanHistoryRepository(Protocol):
    def list_items(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]: ...
    def get_by_scan_id(self, scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None: ...
    def upsert(self, record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]: ...
    def update(self, scan_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None: ...
    def reset(self) -> None: ...


class _InMemoryScanHistoryRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = RLock()
        self._items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def list_items(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self._lock:
            return [dict(item) for item in self._items]

    def get_by_scan_id(self, scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not scan_id:
            return None
        with self._lock:
            for item in self._items:
                if item.get("scan_id") == scan_id:
                    return dict(item)
        return None

    def upsert(self, record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        stored = dict(record)
        scan_id = stored.get("scan_id")

        with self._lock:
            if scan_id:
                for idx, item in enumerate(self._items):
                    if item.get("scan_id") == scan_id:
                        self._items[idx] = stored
                        return dict(stored)
            self._items.append(stored)
            return dict(stored)

    def update(self, scan_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not scan_id:
            return None

        with self._lock:
            for idx, item in enumerate(self._items):
                if item.get("scan_id") == scan_id:
                    merged = {**item, **dict(updates)}
                    self._items[idx] = merged
                    return dict(merged)
        return None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.clear()


_REPOSITORY: ScanHistoryRepository = _InMemoryScanHistoryRepository()


def set_scan_history_repository(repository: ScanHistoryRepository) -> None:
    global _REPOSITORY
    _REPOSITORY = repository


def reset_scan_history_repository() -> None:
    global _REPOSITORY
    _REPOSITORY = _InMemoryScanHistoryRepository()


def _get_repository() -> ScanHistoryRepository:
    return _REPOSITORY


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_timestamp(value: Any) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(timezone.utc) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""
    if not text:
        return datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    try:
        if text.endswith("Z"):
            text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
        return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc) if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    except ValueError:
        return datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def _normalize_list_field(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _coerce_record(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return dict(result)

    if isinstance(result, Mapping):
        return dict(result)

    model_dump = getattr(result, "model_dump", None)
    if callable(model_dump):
        dumped = model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)

    legacy_dict = getattr(result, "dict", None)
    if callable(legacy_dict):
        dumped = legacy_dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)

    if hasattr(result, "__dict__"):
        return {
            str(key): value
            for key, value in vars(result).items()
            if not str(key).startswith("_") and not callable(value)
        }

    raise TypeError("result is not serializable to dict")


def _normalize_record(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized = dict(record)

    if normalized.get("timestamp") is None:
        normalized["timestamp"] = _utc_now_iso()

    if normalized.get("scan_id") is None and normalized.get("scanid") is not None:
        normalized["scan_id"] = normalized.get("scanid")

    if normalized.get("risk_score") is None and normalized.get("riskscore") is not None:
        normalized["risk_score"] = normalized.get("riskscore")

    normalized["matched_patterns"] = _normalize_list_field(normalized.get("matched_patterns"))
    normalized["risky_files"] = _normalize_list_field(normalized.get("risky_files"))
    normalized["checks_loaded"] = _normalize_list_field(normalized.get("checks_loaded"))
    normalized["failed_checks"] = _normalize_list_field(normalized.get("failed_checks"))
    normalized.setdefault("quarantine_reason", None)

    verdict = str(normalized.get("verdict") or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized.get("review_status") is None:
        normalized["review_status"] = "pending" if verdict == "quarantine" else "none"

    if normalized.get("untrusted") is None:
        normalized["untrusted"] = verdict == "quarantine"
    else:
        normalized["untrusted"] = bool(normalized.get("untrusted"))

    risk_score = normalized.get("risk_score")
    if risk_score is not None:
        try:
            normalized["risk_score"] = max(0, min(100, int(risk_score)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            normalized["risk_score"] = 0

    return normalized


def append_scan_result(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    record = _normalize_record(_coerce_record(result))
    stored = _get_repository().upsert(record)
    return _normalize_record(stored)


def read_scan_history(limit: int = 20) -> dict[str, Any]:
    safe_limit = max(0, int(limit))
    items = [_normalize_record(item) for item in _get_repository().list_items()]
    items.sort(key=lambda item: _parse_timestamp(item.get("timestamp")), reverse=True)
    recent = items[:safe_limit] if safe_limit else []
    return {
        "count": len(recent),
        "items": recent,
    }


def get_scan_by_id(scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not scan_id:
        return None

    item = _get_repository().get_by_scan_id(scan_id)
    if item is None:
        return None
    return _normalize_record(item)


def update_scan_by_id(scan_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not scan_id:
        return None

    current = _get_repository().get_by_scan_id(scan_id)
    if current is None:
        return None

    merged = _normalize_record({**current, **dict(updates)})
    updated = _get_repository().upsert(merged)
    return _normalize_record(updated)


def reset_scan_history() -> None:
    _get_repository().reset()


# Backward-compatible aliases for older imports/tests if any still reference them.
appendscanresult = append_scan_result
readscanhistory = read_scan_history
getscanbyid = get_scan_by_id
updatescanbyid = update_scan_by_id
resetscanhistory = reset_scan_history


def get_history_items(limit: int = 20) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return cast(list[dict[str, Any]], read_scan_history(limit=limit).get("items", []))


def get_history_item(scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return get_scan_by_id(scan_id)


def review_scan(scan_id: str, action: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    item = get_scan_by_id(scan_id)
    if item is None:
        raise KeyError(scan_id)

    verdict = str(item.get("verdict") or "").strip().lower()
    if verdict != "quarantine":
        return None

    approved = str(action).strip().lower() == "approve"
    summary = str(item.get("summary") or "").strip()
    review_suffix = f"Review action: {'approve' if approved else 'reject'}."
    if summary:
        if not summary.endswith(review_suffix):
            summary = f"{summary} {review_suffix}"
    else:
        summary = review_suffix

    updates = {
        "review_status": "approved" if approved else "rejected",
        "untrusted": not approved,
        "verdict": "allow" if approved else "block",
        "summary": summary,
    }
    return update_scan_by_id(scan_id, updates)


def apply_review_action(item: Mapping[str, Any], action: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    approved = str(action).strip().lower() == "approve"
    updated = dict(item)
    updated["review_status"] = "approved" if approved else "rejected"
    updated["untrusted"] = not approved
    updated["verdict"] = "allow" if approved else "block"
    summary = str(updated.get("summary") or "").strip()
    review_suffix = f"Review action: {'approve' if approved else 'reject'}."
    if summary:
        if not summary.endswith(review_suffix):
            updated["summary"] = f"{summary} {review_suffix}"
    else:
        updated["summary"] = review_suffix
    return _normalize_record(updated)


gethistoryitems = get_history_items
gethistoryitem = get_history_item
reviewscan = review_scan
applyreviewaction = apply_review_action

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4


IncidentSeverity = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]
IncidentStatus = Literal["open", "triaged", "contained", "resolved"]
IncidentSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system"]


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IncidentRecord:
    incident_id: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    severity: IncidentSeverity
    status: IncidentStatus
    source: IncidentSource
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    asset_ref: str | None = None
    verdict: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["created_at"] = self.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        payload["updated_at"] = self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return payload


class IncidentStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._items: list[IncidentRecord] = []

    def seed_defaults(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if self._items:
                return

            now = _utcnow()
            self._items.extend(
                [
                    IncidentRecord(
                        incident_id=f"inc-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        title="Prompt injection attempt quarantined",
                        summary="A prompt payload matched high-risk injection heuristics and was quarantined before execution.",
                        severity="high",
                        status="open",
                        source="scan",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-seed-001",
                        trace_id="trace-seed-001",
                        asset_ref="prompt:user-input",
                        verdict="quarantine",
                        tags=["prompt-injection", "quarantine", "scanner"],
                        metadata={"seeded": True},
                    ),
                    IncidentRecord(
                        incident_id=f"inc-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        title="Unsafe tool action blocked",
                        summary="A guarded execution request was blocked due to policy restrictions on high-risk tool use.",
                        severity="critical",
                        status="triaged",
                        source="guard",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-seed-002",
                        trace_id="trace-seed-002",
                        asset_ref="tool:filesystem",
                        verdict="block",
                        owner="ironclaw",
                        tags=["tool-guard", "policy", "block"],
                        metadata={"seeded": True},
                    ),
                    IncidentRecord(
                        incident_id=f"inc-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        title="Sandbox isolation event recorded",
                        summary="Returned content was isolated in sandbox flow for additional review after suspicious output analysis.",
                        severity="medium",
                        status="contained",
                        source="sandbox",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-seed-003",
                        trace_id="trace-seed-003",
                        asset_ref="response:model-output",
                        verdict="warn",
                        owner="sandbox-review",
                        tags=["sandbox", "review", "containment"],
                        metadata={"seeded": True},
                    ),
                ]
            )

    def list_incidents(
        self,
        *,
        severity: IncidentSeverity | None = None,
        status: IncidentStatus | None = None,
        source: IncidentSource | None = None,
    ) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._items)

        if severity is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.severity == severity]
        if status is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.status == status]
        if source is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.source == source]

        return items

    def get_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for item in self._items:
                if item.incident_id == incident_id:
                    return item
        return None

    def create_incident(
        self,
        *,
        title: str,
        summary: str,
        severity: IncidentSeverity,
        source: IncidentSource,
        status: IncidentStatus = "open",
        request_id: str | None = None,
        trace_id: str | None = None,
        asset_ref: str | None = None,
        verdict: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
        tags: list[str] | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord:
        now = _utcnow()
        record = IncidentRecord(
            incident_id=f"inc-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            title=title.strip(),
            summary=summary.strip(),
            severity=severity,
            status=status,
            source=source,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            request_id=request_id,
            trace_id=trace_id,
            asset_ref=asset_ref,
            verdict=verdict,
            owner=owner,
            tags=list(tags or []),
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )

        with self._lock:
            self._items.append(record)

        return record

    def update_incident_status(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        *,
        status: IncidentStatus,
        owner: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for index, item in enumerate(self._items):
                if item.incident_id != incident_id:
                    continue

                updated = IncidentRecord(
                    incident_id=item.incident_id,
                    title=item.title,
                    summary=item.summary,
                    severity=item.severity,
                    status=status,
                    source=item.source,
                    created_at=item.created_at,
                    updated_at=_utcnow(),
                    request_id=item.request_id,
                    trace_id=item.trace_id,
                    asset_ref=item.asset_ref,
                    verdict=item.verdict,
                    owner=owner if owner is not None else item.owner,
                    tags=list(item.tags),
                    metadata={
                        **item.metadata,
                        **dict(metadata or {}),
                    },
                )
                self._items[index] = updated
                return updated

        return None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.clear()


_INCIDENT_STORE = IncidentStore()
_INCIDENT_STORE.seed_defaults()


def get_incident_store() -> IncidentStore:
    return _INCIDENT_STORE


def list_incidents(
    *,
    severity: IncidentSeverity | None = None,
    status: IncidentStatus | None = None,
    source: IncidentSource | None = None,
) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
    return _INCIDENT_STORE.list_incidents(
        severity=severity,
        status=status,
        source=source,
    )


def reset_incident_store() -> None:
    _INCIDENT_STORE.reset()
    _INCIDENT_STORE.seed_defaults()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store


DEFAULT_INCIDENT_TABLE = "incidents"
_ALLOWED_INCIDENT_STATUSES = {
    "open",
    "triaged",
    "contained",
    "resolved",
    "closed",
    "investigating",
    "inprogress",
}
_ALLOWED_INCIDENT_SEVERITIES = {"low", "medium", "high", "critical"}
_ALLOWED_INCIDENT_SOURCES = {
    "scan",
    "guard",
    "sandbox",
    "review",
    "system",
    "ironclaw",
    "engine",
    "scanner",
    "tester",
}


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _normalize_timestamp(value: str | datetime | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return _utc_now()
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return dt.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return _utc_now()
    if text.endswith("+00:00"):
        return text[:-6] + "Z"
    return text


def _string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _mapping(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "to_dict") and callable(value.to_dict):
        dumped = value.to_dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "as_dict") and callable(value.as_dict):
        dumped = value.as_dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: val
            for key, val in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(val)
        }
    raise TypeError("value is not serializable to dict")


def _listify(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, set):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in _listify(value):
        text = _string(item)
        if not text or text in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(text)
        result.append(text)
    return result


def _normalize_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = _string(value, "open").lower()
    return normalized if normalized in _ALLOWED_INCIDENT_STATUSES else "open"


def _normalize_severity(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = _string(value, "medium").lower()
    return normalized if normalized in _ALLOWED_INCIDENT_SEVERITIES else "medium"


def _normalize_source(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = _string(value, "ironclaw").lower()
    return normalized if normalized in _ALLOWED_INCIDENT_SOURCES else "ironclaw"


def _normalize_incident_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,

    status: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    priority: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,

    source: str | None = None,
    verdict: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    tenant_id: str | None = None,

    scan_id: str | None = None,

    requestid: str | None = None,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
    traceid: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    owner: str | None = None,
    assigned_to: str | None = None,
    assignedto: str | None = None,
    assetref: str | None = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _mapping(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_incident_id = (
        _string(incidentid)
        or _string(incident_id)
        or _string(id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("incidentid"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("incident_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())

        _string(title)

        or _string(source_payload.get("description"))
        or "Security incident"
    )

    if not resolved_title:
        raise ValueError("title is required")

    resolved_summary = (
        _string(summary)
        or _string(source_payload.get("summary"))
        or _string(description)
        or _string(source_payload.get("description"))
        or resolved_title
    )

    resolved_description = (
        _string(description)
        or _string(source_payload.get("description"))
        or resolved_summary
    )

    resolved_severity = _string(severity or source_payload.get("severity"))
    if not resolved_severity:
        raise ValueError("severity is required")
    resolved_severity = _normalize_severity(resolved_severity)

    resolved_status = _normalize_status(status or source_payload.get("status"))

    resolved_priority = (
        _string(priority)
        or _string(source_payload.get("priority"))
        or resolved_severity
    )

    resolved_category = (
        _string(category)
        or _string(incident_type)
        or _string(source_payload.get("category"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("incident_type"))
        or "security"
    )

    resolved_source = _normalize_source(source or source_payload.get("source"))
    resolved_verdict = _string(verdict) or _string(source_payload.get("verdict")) or "pending"

    resolved_org = (
        _string(organization_id)
        or _string(org_id)
        or _string(tenant_id)
        or _string(customer_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("organization_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("org_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("tenant_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("customer_id"))
    )

    resolved_created_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        created_at
        or createdat
        or source_payload.get("created_at")
        or source_payload.get("createdat")
        or detected_at
        or detectedat
        or timestamp
        or source_payload.get("detected_at")
        or source_payload.get("detectedat")
        or source_payload.get("timestamp")
    )
    resolved_updated_at = _normalize_timestamp(

    )
    resolved_detected_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        detected_at
        or detectedat

        or source_payload.get("detectedat")
        or timestamp
        or source_payload.get("timestamp")
        or resolved_created_at
    )
    resolved_resolved_at = (
        _normalize_timestamp(
            resolved_at

            or source_payload.get("resolved_at")
            or source_payload.get("resolvedat")
        )
        if (
            resolved_at is not None
            or resolvedat is not None
            or source_payload.get("resolved_at") is not None
            or source_payload.get("resolvedat") is not None
        )
        else None
    )

    resolved_actor = actor if isinstance(actor, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("actor"))
    resolved_target = target if isinstance(target, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("target"))

        or _string(source_payload.get("traceid"))
        or None
    )
    resolved_owner = (
        _string(owner)
        or _string(owner_id)
        or _string(assigned_to)
        or _string(assignedto)
        or _string(source_payload.get("owner"))

        or _string(source_payload.get("assigned_to"))

        or _string(source_payload.get("asset_ref"))

    )

    normalized = {

        "id": resolved_incident_id,
        "title": resolved_title,
        "summary": resolved_summary,

        "severity": resolved_severity,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "priority": resolved_priority,
        "category": resolved_category,
        "incident_type": resolved_category,
        "source": resolved_source,
        "verdict": resolved_verdict,
        "organization_id": resolved_org or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org or None,
        "tenant_id": resolved_org or None,
        "customer_id": resolved_org or None,
        "scan_id": _string(scan_id) or _string(source_payload.get("scan_id")) or None,
        "review_id": _string(review_id) or _string(source_payload.get("review_id")) or None,
        "request_id": resolved_request_id,
        "requestid": resolved_request_id,
        "trace_id": resolved_trace_id,
        "traceid": resolved_trace_id,

        "assigned_to": _string(assigned_to) or _string(assignedto) or _string(source_payload.get("assigned_to")) or resolved_owner,
        "assignedto": _string(assignedto) or _string(assigned_to) or _string(source_payload.get("assignedto")) or resolved_owner,
        "owner": resolved_owner,
        "assetref": resolved_assetref,
        "actor": resolved_actor,
        "target": resolved_target,
        "metadata": resolved_metadata,
        "evidence": _listify(evidence if evidence is not None else source_payload.get("evidence")),
        "tags": _string_list(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),

        "detectedat": resolved_detected_at,
        "resolved_at": resolved_resolved_at,

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IncidentRecord:
    incidentid: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    source: str
    createdat: str
    updatedat: str
    requestid: str | None = None
    traceid: str | None = None
    assetref: str | None = None
    verdict: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    description: str | None = None
    timestamp: str | None = None
    category: str | None = None
    incident_type: str | None = None
    organization_id: str | None = None
    assigned_to: str | None = None
    scan_id: str | None = None
    review_id: str | None = None
    resolvedat: str | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_mapping(cls, value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> IncidentRecord:
        normalized = _normalize_incident_payload(dict(value))
        return cls(
            incidentid=_string(normalized.get("incidentid")),
            title=_string(normalized.get("title"), "Security incident"),
            summary=_string(normalized.get("summary")),
            severity=_normalize_severity(normalized.get("severity")),
            status=_normalize_status(normalized.get("status")),
            source=_normalize_source(normalized.get("source")),
            createdat=_string(normalized.get("createdat") or normalized.get("created_at"), _utc_now()),
            updatedat=_string(normalized.get("updatedat") or normalized.get("updated_at"), _utc_now()),
            requestid=_string(normalized.get("requestid") or normalized.get("request_id")) or None,
            traceid=_string(normalized.get("traceid") or normalized.get("trace_id")) or None,
            assetref=_string(normalized.get("assetref")) or None,
            verdict=_string(normalized.get("verdict")) or None,
            owner=_string(normalized.get("owner") or normalized.get("assigned_to") or normalized.get("owner_id")) or None,
            tags=_string_list(normalized.get("tags")),
            metadata=_mapping(normalized.get("metadata")),
            description=_string(normalized.get("description")) or None,
            timestamp=_string(normalized.get("timestamp") or normalized.get("detected_at") or normalized.get("createdat")) or None,
            category=_string(normalized.get("category")) or None,
            incident_type=_string(normalized.get("incident_type") or normalized.get("category")) or None,
            organization_id=_string(normalized.get("organization_id") or normalized.get("org_id")) or None,
            assigned_to=_string(normalized.get("assigned_to") or normalized.get("assignedto")) or None,
            scan_id=_string(normalized.get("scan_id")) or None,
            review_id=_string(normalized.get("review_id")) or None,
            resolvedat=_string(normalized.get("resolvedat") or normalized.get("resolved_at")) or None,
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        description = self.description or self.summary
        category = self.category or "security"
        assigned_to = self.assigned_to or self.owner
        timestamp = self.timestamp or self.createdat
        payload = {
            "incidentid": self.incidentid,
            "incident_id": self.incidentid,
            "id": self.incidentid,
            "title": self.title,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "description": description,
            "severity": _normalize_severity(self.severity),
            "status": _normalize_status(self.status),
            "source": _normalize_source(self.source),
            "category": category,
            "incident_type": self.incident_type or category,
            "timestamp": timestamp,
            "createdat": self.createdat,
            "created_at": self.createdat,
            "updatedat": self.updatedat,
            "updated_at": self.updatedat,
            "resolvedat": self.resolvedat,
            "resolved_at": self.resolvedat,
            "requestid": self.requestid,
            "request_id": self.requestid,
            "traceid": self.traceid,
            "trace_id": self.traceid,
            "assetref": self.assetref,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "owner": self.owner,
            "assigned_to": assigned_to,
            "assignedto": assigned_to,
            "organization_id": self.organization_id,
            "scan_id": self.scan_id,
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }
        return payload

    def dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.to_dict()

    def model_dump(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.to_dict()

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.to_dict()

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IncidentStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_INCIDENT_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.as_dict()

    def model_dump(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.as_dict()

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        health = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(health):
            try:
                return bool(health())
            except Exception:
                return False
        try:
            self.backend.select(self.table_name, limit=1)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _safe_select(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int | None = None,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        try:
            rows = self.backend.select(
                self.table_name,
                limit=limit,
                filters=filters,
            )
        except TypeError:
            rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name)

        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            candidates = [rows]
        elif rows is None:
            candidates = []
        else:
            candidates = list(rows)

        normalized_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for row in candidates:
            try:
                normalized_rows.append(_mapping(row))
            except Exception:
                continue

        if filters:
            filtered_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            for row in normalized_rows:
                matched = True
                for key, expected in filters.items():
                    if expected is None:
                        continue
                    if row.get(key) != expected:
                        matched = False
                        break
                if matched:
                    filtered_rows.append(row)
            normalized_rows = filtered_rows

        if limit is not None:
            normalized_rows = normalized_rows[:limit]

        return normalized_rows

    def _safe_insert(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, payload)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return _mapping(inserted[0])
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return _mapping(inserted)
        return dict(payload)

    def _safe_update(self, payload: dict[str, Any], *, filters: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        try:
            updated = self.backend.update(
                self.table_name,
                payload,
                filters=filters,
            )
        except TypeError:
            updated = self.backend.update(self.table_name, payload)

        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return _mapping(updated[0])
        if isinstance(updated, dict):
            return _mapping(updated)

        rows = self._safe_select(filters=filters, limit=1)
        return rows[0] if rows else None

    def _safe_delete(self, *, filters: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        try:
            deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters=filters)
        except TypeError:
            deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name)

        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return _mapping(deleted[0])
        if isinstance(deleted, dict):
            return _mapping(deleted)
        return None

    def _ensure_seed_data(self) -> None:
        if self.backend_name != "memory":
            return
        existing = self._safe_select(limit=1)
        if existing:
            return
        self._safe_insert(_seed_demo_incident().to_dict())

    def create_incident(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        incident = _normalize_incident_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self._safe_insert(incident)
        return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(inserted)

    def createincident(self, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        payload = _normalize_incident_payload(**kwargs)
        return self.create_incident(payload)

    def create(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def insert(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def add(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def save(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def append(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def write(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def open_incident(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def openincident(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> IncidentRecord:
        return self.create_incident(payload, **kwargs)

    def list_incidents(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        source: str | None = None,
        assigned_to: str | None = None,
        assignedto: str | None = None,
        category: str | None = None,
        scan_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        self._ensure_seed_data()

        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", _normalize_status(status))
        if severity:
            query_filters.setdefault("severity", _normalize_severity(severity))
        if source:
            query_filters.setdefault("source", _normalize_source(source))
        if assigned_to:
            query_filters.setdefault("assigned_to", assigned_to)
        if assignedto:
            query_filters.setdefault("assignedto", assignedto)
        if category:
            query_filters.setdefault("category", category)
        if scan_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("scan_id", scan_id)

        raw_rows = self._safe_select(
            limit=limit,
            filters=query_filters or None,
        )

        incidents = [IncidentRecord.from_mapping(row) for row in raw_rows]
        incidents.sort(
            key=lambda row: _normalize_timestamp(row.updatedat or row.createdat),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return incidents

    def listincidents(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        source: str | None = None,
        assigned_to: str | None = None,
        assignedto: str | None = None,
        category: str | None = None,
        scan_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(
            limit=limit,
            filters=filters,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            status=status,
            severity=severity,
            source=source,
            assigned_to=assigned_to,
            assignedto=assignedto,
            category=category,
            scan_id=scan_id,
        )

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(**kwargs)

    def fetch(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(**kwargs)

    def read(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(**kwargs)

    def all(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(**kwargs)

    def query(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(**kwargs)

    def search(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return self.list_incidents(**kwargs)

    def latest(self) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        incidents = self.list_incidents(limit=100)
        return incidents[0] if incidents else None

    def last(self) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.latest()

    def mostrecent(self) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.latest()

    def getlatest(self) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.latest()

    def get_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        self._ensure_seed_data()

        iid = _string(incident_id)
        if not iid:
            raise ValueError("incident_id is required")

        rows = self._safe_select(filters={"incident_id": iid}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(rows[0])

        rows = self._safe_select(filters={"incidentid": iid}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(rows[0])

        rows = self._safe_select(filters={"id": iid}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(rows[0])

        return None

    def getincident(self, incidentid: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.get_incident(incidentid)

    def get(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.get_incident(incident_id)

    def getbyid(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.get_incident(incident_id)

    def findbyid(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.get_incident(incident_id)

    def fetchone(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.get_incident(incident_id)

    def readone(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.get_incident(incident_id)

    def update_incident(self, incident_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        existing = self.get_incident(incident_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = existing.to_dict()
        merged.update(_mapping(updates))
        merged["incidentid"] = existing.incidentid
        merged["incident_id"] = existing.incidentid
        merged["id"] = existing.incidentid
        merged["updated_at"] = _utc_now()
        merged["updatedat"] = merged["updated_at"]

        normalized = _normalize_incident_payload(merged)

        if _normalize_status(normalized.get("status")) in {"resolved", "closed"} and not normalized.get("resolved_at"):
            normalized["resolved_at"] = normalized["updated_at"]
            normalized["resolvedat"] = normalized["updatedat"]

        updated = self._safe_update(
            normalized,
            filters={"incident_id": existing.incidentid},
        )
        if updated is not None:
            return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(updated)

        updated = self._safe_update(
            normalized,
            filters={"incidentid": existing.incidentid},
        )
        if updated is not None:
            return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(updated)

        updated = self._safe_update(
            normalized,
            filters={"id": existing.incidentid},
        )
        if updated is not None:
            return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(updated)

        return IncidentRecord.from_mapping(normalized)

    def updateincidentstatus(
        self,
        incidentid: str,
        *,
        status: str,
        owner: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {"status": _normalize_status(status)}
        if owner is not None:
            updates["owner"] = owner
            updates["assigned_to"] = owner
            updates["assignedto"] = owner
        if metadata:
            current = self.get_incident(incidentid)
            merged_metadata = current.metadata.copy() if current is not None else {}
            merged_metadata.update(_mapping(metadata))
            updates["metadata"] = merged_metadata
        return self.update_incident(incidentid, updates)

    def update(self, incident_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.update_incident(incident_id, updates)

    def assign_incident(self, incident_id: str, assigned_to: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.update_incident(
            incident_id,
            {
                "assigned_to": assigned_to,
                "assignedto": assigned_to,
                "owner": assigned_to,
                "status": "triaged",
            },
        )

    def assignincident(self, incident_id: str, assigned_to: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.assign_incident(incident_id, assigned_to)

    def resolve_incident(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        *,
        resolution: str | None = None,
        verdict: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        now = _utc_now()
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "resolved",
            "resolved_at": now,
            "resolvedat": now,
        }
        if resolution is not None:
            updates["resolution"] = resolution
        if verdict is not None:
            updates["verdict"] = verdict
        if metadata:
            current = self.get_incident(incident_id)
            merged_metadata = current.metadata.copy() if current is not None else {}
            merged_metadata.update(_mapping(metadata))
            updates["metadata"] = merged_metadata
        return self.update_incident(incident_id, updates)

    def resolveincident(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        *,
        resolution: str | None = None,
        verdict: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.resolve_incident(
            incident_id,
            resolution=resolution,
            verdict=verdict,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def close_incident(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        *,
        resolution: str | None = None,
        verdict: str | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        now = _utc_now()
        return self.update_incident(
            incident_id,
            {
                "status": "closed",
                "resolved_at": now,
                "resolvedat": now,
                "resolution": resolution,
                "verdict": verdict,
            },
        )

    def closeincident(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        *,
        resolution: str | None = None,
        verdict: str | None = None,
    ) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self.close_incident(
            incident_id,
            resolution=resolution,
            verdict=verdict,
        )

    def delete_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        iid = _string(incident_id)
        if not iid:
            raise ValueError("incident_id is required")

        deleted = self._safe_delete(filters={"incident_id": iid})
        if deleted is not None:
            return deleted

        deleted = self._safe_delete(filters={"incidentid": iid})
        if deleted is not None:
            return deleted

        deleted = self._safe_delete(filters={"id": iid})
        if deleted is not None:
            return deleted

        return None

    def deleteincident(self, incident_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.delete_incident(incident_id)

    def delete(self, incident_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.delete_incident(incident_id)

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        incidents = self.list_incidents(limit=limit, organization_id=organization_id)

        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_category: dict[str, int] = {}

        for item in incidents:
            payload = item.to_dict()
            status_value = _string(payload.get("status"), "unknown")
            severity_value = _string(payload.get("severity"), "unknown")
            category_value = _string(payload.get("category"), "unknown")
            by_status[status_value] = by_status.get(status_value, 0) + 1
            by_severity[severity_value] = by_severity.get(severity_value, 0) + 1
            by_category[category_value] = by_category.get(category_value, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total": len(incidents),
            "open": by_status.get("open", 0),
            "triaged": by_status.get("triaged", 0),
            "contained": by_status.get("contained", 0),
            "resolved": by_status.get("resolved", 0),
            "closed": by_status.get("closed", 0),
            "by_status": by_status,
            "by_severity": by_severity,
            "by_category": by_category,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }

    def summary(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.summarize(organization_id=organization_id, limit=limit)

    def reset(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={})
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._ensure_seed_data()

    def seeddefaults(self) -> None:
        self._ensure_seed_data()

def build_incident_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_INCIDENT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> IncidentStore:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    return IncidentStore(backend=resolved_backend, table_name=table_name)

    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_INCIDENT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> IncidentStore:
    return build_incident_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_incident_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_INCIDENT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> IncidentStore:
    global _SINGLETON_STORE
    if backend is None and not store_kwargs and table_name == DEFAULT_INCIDENT_TABLE:
        if _SINGLETON_STORE is None:
            _SINGLETON_STORE = build_incident_store(table_name=table_name)
        return _SINGLETON_STORE
    return build_incident_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

) -> IncidentStore:
    if mode is not None:
        store_kwargs.setdefault("mode", mode)
    return build_incident_store(backend=backend, table_name=tablename, **store_kwargs)

from dataclasses import dataclass

ALLOWED_TARGET_TYPES = {"github_repo", "skill", "archive", "url", "text", "local_path"}
SANDBOX_TARGET_TYPES = {"github_repo", "skill", "archive", "local_path"}


@dataclass
class IntakeDecision:
    target_type: str
    target_value: str
    original_target_value: str
    normalized_target_value: str
    route_mode: str
    requires_sandbox: bool
    content_length: int


def _normalize_target_type(target_type: str) -> str:
    return target_type.strip().lower()


def _strip_null_bytes(target_value: str) -> str:
    return target_value.replace(chr(0), "")


def _normalize_whitespace(target_value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(target_value.split())


def prepare_intake(target_type: str, target_value: str) -> IntakeDecision:
    normalized_type = _normalize_target_type(target_type)
    if normalized_type not in ALLOWED_TARGET_TYPES:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported target_type")

    original_value = target_value
    cleaned_value = _strip_null_bytes(target_value).strip()
    if not cleaned_value:
        raise ValueError("target_value cannot be empty")

    normalized_value = _normalize_whitespace(cleaned_value)
    requires_sandbox = normalized_type in SANDBOX_TARGET_TYPES
    route_mode = "sandbox" if requires_sandbox else "scan"

    return IntakeDecision(
        target_type=normalized_type,
        target_value=normalized_value,
        original_target_value=original_value,
        normalized_target_value=normalized_value,
        route_mode=route_mode,
        requires_sandbox=requires_sandbox,
        content_length=len(normalized_value),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from hashlib import sha256
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Optional
from uuid import uuid4


class AuditSeverity(str, Enum):
    INFO = "info"
    WARNING = "warning"
    ERROR = "error"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IntegrationAuditEvent:
    event_id: str
    integration_id: str
    event_type: str
    severity: AuditSeverity
    occurred_at: datetime
    message: str
    actor: str = "system"
    adapter_id: Optional[str] = None
    metadata: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    content_hash: str = ""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "event_type": self.event_type,
            "severity": self.severity.value,
            "occurred_at": self.occurred_at.isoformat(),
            "message": self.message,
            "actor": self.actor,
            "adapter_id": self.adapter_id,
            "metadata": _normalize_mapping(self.metadata),
            "content_hash": self.content_hash,
        }


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _normalize_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, Enum):
        return value.value
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {str(k): _normalize_value(v) for k, v in sorted(value.items(), key=lambda item: str(item[0]))}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_normalize_value(item) for item in value]
    return value


def _normalize_mapping(metadata: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {str(k): _normalize_value(v) for k, v in sorted(metadata.items(), key=lambda item: str(item[0]))}


def _build_content_hash(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    canonical = repr(_normalize_mapping(payload)).encode("utf-8")
    return sha256(canonical).hexdigest()


def create_audit_event(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    event_type: str,
    severity: AuditSeverity,
    message: str,
    actor: str = "system",
    adapter_id: Optional[str] = None,
    metadata: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    occurred_at: Optional[datetime] = None,
) -> IntegrationAuditEvent:
    timestamp = occurred_at or _utcnow()
    normalized_metadata = _normalize_mapping(metadata or {})
    hash_payload = {
        "integration_id": integration_id,
        "event_type": event_type,
        "severity": severity.value,
        "occurred_at": timestamp.isoformat(),
        "message": message,
        "actor": actor,
        "adapter_id": adapter_id,
        "metadata": normalized_metadata,
    }

    return IntegrationAuditEvent(
        event_id=str(uuid4()),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        event_type=event_type,
        severity=severity,
        occurred_at=timestamp,
        message=message,
        actor=actor,
        adapter_id=adapter_id,
        metadata=normalized_metadata,
        content_hash=_build_content_hash(hash_payload),
    )


def adapter_evaluated_event(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    adapter_id: str,
    runtime_family: str,
    version: str,
    state: str,
    reason: str,
    actor: str = "system",
) -> IntegrationAuditEvent:
    severity = AuditSeverity.ERROR if state == "unsupported" else (
        AuditSeverity.WARNING if state == "warning" else AuditSeverity.INFO
    )
    return create_audit_event(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        event_type="adapter.evaluated",
        severity=severity,
        message=f"Adapter {adapter_id} evaluated as {state}.",
        actor=actor,
        adapter_id=adapter_id,
        metadata={
            "runtime_family": runtime_family,
            "version": version,
            "state": state,
            "reason": reason,
        },
    )


def summary_generated_event(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    overall_state: str,
    risk_score: float,
    total_adapters: int,
    actor: str = "system",
) -> IntegrationAuditEvent:
    severity = AuditSeverity.ERROR if overall_state == "unsupported" else (
        AuditSeverity.WARNING if overall_state == "warning" else AuditSeverity.INFO
    )
    return create_audit_event(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        event_type="integration.summary_generated",
        severity=severity,
        message=f"Integration summary generated with state={overall_state}.",
        actor=actor,
        metadata={
            "overall_state": overall_state,
            "risk_score": risk_score,
            "total_adapters": total_adapters,
        },
    )


def state_changed_event(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    previous_state: str,
    new_state: str,
    actor: str = "system",
    reason: str = "",
) -> IntegrationAuditEvent:
    severity = AuditSeverity.ERROR if new_state == "unsupported" else (
        AuditSeverity.WARNING if new_state == "warning" else AuditSeverity.INFO
    )
    return create_audit_event(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        event_type="integration.state_changed",
        severity=severity,
        message=f"Integration state changed from {previous_state} to {new_state}.",
        actor=actor,
        metadata={
            "previous_state": previous_state,
            "new_state": new_state,
            "reason": reason,
        },
    )


def filter_audit_events(
    events: Iterable[IntegrationAuditEvent],
    *,
    integration_id: Optional[str] = None,
    event_type: Optional[str] = None,
    severity: Optional[AuditSeverity] = None,
    actor: Optional[str] = None,
    adapter_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[IntegrationAuditEvent]:
    filtered: List[IntegrationAuditEvent] = []

    for event in events:
        if integration_id is not None and event.integration_id != integration_id:
            continue
        if event_type is not None and event.event_type != event_type:
            continue
        if severity is not None and event.severity != severity:
            continue
        if actor is not None and event.actor != actor:
            continue
        if adapter_id is not None and event.adapter_id != adapter_id:
            continue
        filtered.append(event)

    return filtered


def sort_audit_events(
    events: Iterable[IntegrationAuditEvent],
    *,
    descending: bool = False,
) -> List[IntegrationAuditEvent]:
    return sorted(events, key=lambda event: event.occurred_at, reverse=descending)


def serialize_audit_events(events: Iterable[IntegrationAuditEvent]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    return [event.to_dict() for event in events]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRecord,
    IntegrationRegistry,
    get_integration,
    update_integration_status,
)

InstallState = Literal["pending", "installed", "skipped", "failed"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


@dataclass(slots=True)
class InstallStepResult:
    name: str
    state: InstallState
    message: str
    command: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "state": self.state,
            "message": self.message,
            "command": self.command,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationInstallResult:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    status_before: str
    status_after: str
    installed: bool
    command_name: str | None
    install_target: str | None
    started_at: str
    completed_at: str
    steps: list[InstallStepResult] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "status_before": self.status_before,
            "status_after": self.status_after,
            "installed": self.installed,
            "command_name": self.command_name,
            "install_target": self.install_target,
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
            "steps": [step.to_dict() for step in self.steps],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def install_integration(
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    requested_by: str | None = None,
    install_target: str | None = None,
    extra_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> IntegrationInstallResult:
    record = get_integration(registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    started_at = _utc_now()
    status_before = record.status
    effective_target = install_target or record.install_target

    steps: list[InstallStepResult] = [
        InstallStepResult(
            name="resolve-integration",
            state="installed",
            message=f"Resolved integration '{record.slug}'.",
            metadata={"platform": record.platform},
        ),
        InstallStepResult(
            name="validate-command",
            state="installed" if record.command_name else "skipped",
            message=(
                "Install command available."
                if record.command_name
                else "No install command registered yet."
            ),
            command=record.command_name,
        ),
        InstallStepResult(
            name="prepare-target",
            state="installed" if effective_target else "skipped",
            message=(
                f"Prepared install target '{effective_target}'."
                if effective_target
                else "No install target declared."
            ),
            metadata={"install_target": effective_target},
        ),
    ]

    metadata = dict(extra_metadata or {})
    if requested_by:
        metadata["requested_by"] = requested_by
    if dry_run:
        metadata["dry_run"] = True

    status_after = status_before
    installed = False

    if dry_run:
        steps.append(
            InstallStepResult(
                name="apply-install",
                state="skipped",
                message="Dry run only; no changes applied.",
            )
        )
    else:
        update_integration_status(registry, integration_id, "active")
        status_after = "active"
        installed = True
        steps.append(
            InstallStepResult(
                name="apply-install",
                state="installed",
                message=f"Integration '{record.slug}' marked active.",
            )
        )

    completed_at = _utc_now()
    refreshed_record = get_integration(registry, integration_id) or record

    return IntegrationInstallResult(
        integration_id=refreshed_record.integration_id,
        slug=refreshed_record.slug,
        status_before=status_before,
        status_after=status_after,
        installed=installed,
        command_name=refreshed_record.command_name,
        install_target=effective_target,
        started_at=started_at,
        completed_at=completed_at,
        steps=steps,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def build_install_plan(record: IntegrationRecord) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        {
            "step": "resolve-integration",
            "description": f"Resolve integration metadata for '{record.slug}'.",
        },
        {
            "step": "validate-command",
            "description": "Confirm one-command installer entrypoint exists.",
            "command": record.command_name,
        },
        {
            "step": "prepare-target",
            "description": "Prepare target platform for local IronClaw attachment.",
            "install_target": record.install_target,
        },
        {
            "step": "apply-install",
            "description": "Activate the integration and expose protected runtime hooks.",
        },
    ]


def summarize_install_result(result: IntegrationInstallResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "integration_id": result.integration_id,
        "slug": result.slug,
        "installed": result.installed,
        "status_before": result.status_before,
        "status_after": result.status_after,
        "step_count": len(result.steps),
        "completed_at": result.completed_at,
        "command_name": result.command_name,
        "install_target": result.install_target,
    }

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationRecord:
    integration_id: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    platform: str
    integration_type: IntegrationType
    status: IntegrationStatus = "planned"
    version: str = "0.1.0"
    command_name: str | None = None

    install_target: str | None = None

    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "slug": self.slug,

            "integration_type": self.integration_type,
            "status": self.status,
            "version": self.version,
            "command_name": self.command_name,
            "description": self.description,
            "entrypoint": self.entrypoint,
            "install_target": self.install_target,
            "capabilities": [capability.to_dict() for capability in self.capabilities],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationRegistry:
    items: dict[str, IntegrationRecord] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        records = sorted(self.items.values(), key=lambda item: (item.platform, item.name, item.integration_id))
        return {
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "total": len(records),
            "items": [record.to_dict() for record in records],
        }


def initialize_integration_registry() -> IntegrationRegistry:
    registry = IntegrationRegistry()
    for record in default_integrations():
        register_integration(registry, record)
    return registry

def register_integration(
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    record: IntegrationRecord,
) -> IntegrationRegistry:
    if not record.integration_id.strip():
        raise ValueError("integration_id is required")
    if not record.slug.strip():
        raise ValueError("slug is required")
    if not record.name.strip():
        raise ValueError("name is required")
    if record.integration_id in registry.items:
        raise ValueError(f"integration already registered: {record.integration_id}")

    now = _utc_now()
    record.created_at = record.created_at or now
    record.updated_at = now
    registry.items[record.integration_id] = record
    registry.updated_at = now
    return registry


def get_integration(
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    integration_id: str,
) -> IntegrationRecord | None:
    return registry.items.get(integration_id)


def list_integrations(
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    *,
    status: IntegrationStatus | None = None,
    platform: str | None = None,
    capability: CapabilityName | None = None,
) -> list[IntegrationRecord]:
    records = list(registry.items.values())

    if status is not None:
        records = [record for record in records if record.status == status]

    if platform is not None:
        normalized_platform = platform.strip().lower()
        records = [record for record in records if record.platform.strip().lower() == normalized_platform]

    if capability is not None:
        records = [
            record
            for record in records
            if any(item.name == capability and item.enabled for item in record.capabilities)
        ]

    return sorted(records, key=lambda item: (item.platform, item.name, item.integration_id))


def update_integration_status(
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    integration_id: str,
    status: IntegrationStatus,
) -> IntegrationRecord:
    record = registry.items.get(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    now = _utc_now()
    record.status = status
    record.updated_at = now
    registry.updated_at = now
    return record


def summarize_integration_registry(registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> dict[str, Any]:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
    by_platform: dict[str, int] = {}
    capability_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for record in records:
        by_status[record.status] = by_status.get(record.status, 0) + 1
        by_platform[record.platform] = by_platform.get(record.platform, 0) + 1

        for capability in record.capabilities:
            if capability.enabled:
                capability_counts[capability.name] = capability_counts.get(capability.name, 0) + 1

    return {
        "created_at": registry.created_at,
        "updated_at": registry.updated_at,
        "total_integrations": len(records),
        "active_integrations": by_status.get("active", 0),
        "planned_integrations": by_status.get("planned", 0),
        "disabled_integrations": by_status.get("disabled", 0),
        "deprecated_integrations": by_status.get("deprecated", 0),
        "platforms": by_platform,
        "capabilities": capability_counts,
        "one_command_ready_targets": [
            record.slug
            for record in records
            if record.command_name
        ],
    }

FILE: app\services\integration_rollout.py
