from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from app.services.organizationstore import (
    OrganizationStore as CanonicalOrganizationStore,
    get_organization_store,
)

OrgRole = Literal["owner", "admin", "analyst", "viewer"]
OrgMemberStatus = Literal["active", "invited", "suspended"]
OrgStatus = Literal["active", "trialing", "suspended"]


def _parse_datetime(value: Any) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return datetime.now(UTC)
    normalized = text.replace("Z", "+00:00")
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
    except ValueError:
        return datetime.now(UTC)
    return parsed.astimezone(UTC) if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _member_status(value: Any) -> OrgMemberStatus:
    normalized = _text(value, "active").lower()
    if normalized in {"active", "invited", "suspended"}:
        return normalized
    return "active"


def _org_status(value: Any) -> OrgStatus:
    normalized = _text(value, "active").lower()
    if normalized in {"active", "trialing", "suspended"}:
        return normalized
    return "active"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrgMemberRecord:
    member_id: str
    user_id: str
    email: str
    display_name: str
    role: OrgRole
    status: OrgMemberStatus
    joined_at: datetime
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "member_id": self.member_id,
            "user_id": self.user_id,
            "email": self.email,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "role": self.role,
            "status": self.status,
            "joined_at": self.joined_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrganizationRecord:
    org_id: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    status: OrgStatus
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    owner_user_id: str
    plan_name: str
    members: list[OrgMemberRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "updated_at": self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "owner_user_id": self.owner_user_id,
            "plan_name": self.plan_name,
            "members": [member.to_dict() for member in self.members],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _member_from_canonical(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> OrgMemberRecord:
    user_id = (
        _text(payload.get("user_id"))
        or _text(payload.get("owner_user_id"))
        or _text(payload.get("owner_id"))
        or f"user-{_text(payload.get('member_id'), 'unknown')}"
    )
    return OrgMemberRecord(
        member_id=_text(payload.get("member_id")) or f"mbr-{user_id}",
        user_id=user_id,
        email=_text(payload.get("email")),
        display_name=_text(payload.get("display_name")),
        role=_text(payload.get("role"), "viewer"),  # type: ignore[assignment]
        status=_member_status(payload.get("status")),
        joined_at=_parse_datetime(payload.get("joined_at") or payload.get("created_at")),
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )


def _organization_from_canonical(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> OrganizationRecord:
    owner_user_id = (
        _text(payload.get("owner_user_id"))
        or _text(payload.get("owner_id"))
        or _text(payload.get("owner_email"))
        or "unknown-owner"
    )
    plan_name = _text(payload.get("plan_name")) or _text(payload.get("tier")) or _text(
        payload.get("plan"),
        "standard",
    )
    members = [
        _member_from_canonical(dict(member))
        for member in list(payload.get("members") or [])
    ]
    return OrganizationRecord(
        org_id=(
            _text(payload.get("org_id"))
            or _text(payload.get("organization_id"))
            or _text(payload.get("id"))
        ),
        name=_text(payload.get("name")),
        slug=_text(payload.get("slug")),
        status=_org_status(payload.get("status")),
        created_at=_parse_datetime(payload.get("created_at")),
        updated_at=_parse_datetime(payload.get("updated_at") or payload.get("created_at")),
        owner_user_id=owner_user_id,
        plan_name=plan_name,
        members=members,
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )


class OrgStore:
    def __init__(self, canonical_store: CanonicalOrganizationStore | None = None) -> None:
        self._canonical_store = canonical_store or get_organization_store()

    def seed_defaults(self) -> None:
        return None

    def list_orgs(self, *, status: OrgStatus | None = None) -> list[OrganizationRecord]:
        items = self._canonical_store.list_organizations(status=status)
        return [_organization_from_canonical(dict(item)) for item in items]

    def get_org(self, org_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        item = self._canonical_store.get_organization(org_id)
        if item is None:
            return None
        return _organization_from_canonical(dict(item))

    def create_org(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        slug: str,
        owner_user_id: str,
        owner_email: str,
        owner_display_name: str,
        plan_name: str,
        status: OrgStatus = "trialing",
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord:
        created = self._canonical_store.create_organization(
            {
                "name": name,
                "slug": slug,
                "owner_id": owner_user_id,
                "owner_email": owner_email,
                "owner_display_name": owner_display_name,
                "status": status,
                "tier": plan_name,
                "plan": plan_name,
                "metadata": dict(metadata or {}),
                "members": [
                    {
                        "member_id": "",
                        "user_id": owner_user_id,
                        "email": owner_email,
                        "display_name": owner_display_name,
                        "role": "owner",
                        "status": "active",
                        "joined_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                        "metadata": {
                            "seeded": False,
                            "provisioned_as": "owner",
                        },
                    }
                ],
                "member_count": 1,
            }
        )
        return _organization_from_canonical(dict(created))

    def add_member(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        *,
        user_id: str,
        email: str,
        display_name: str,
        role: OrgRole,
        status: OrgMemberStatus = "invited",
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        existing = self._canonical_store.get_organization(org_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        members = list(existing.get("members") or [])
        members.append(
            {
                "member_id": f"mbr-{_text(user_id) or _text(email)}",
                "user_id": user_id,
                "email": email,
                "display_name": display_name,
                "role": role,
                "status": status,
                "joined_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "metadata": dict(metadata or {}),
            }
        )

        updated = self._canonical_store.update_organization(
            org_id,
            {
                "members": members,
                "member_count": len(members),
            },
        )
        if updated is None:
            return None
        return _organization_from_canonical(dict(updated))

    def update_member_role(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        member_id: str,
        *,
        role: OrgRole,
        status: OrgMemberStatus | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        existing = self._canonical_store.get_organization(org_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        members = list(existing.get("members") or [])
        updated_any = False
        new_members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        for member in members:
            member_dict = dict(member)
            current_member_id = _text(member_dict.get("member_id"))
            if current_member_id != member_id:
                new_members.append(member_dict)
                continue

            updated_any = True
            merged_metadata = dict(member_dict.get("metadata") or {})
            merged_metadata.update(dict(metadata or {}))
            member_dict["role"] = role
            if status is not None:
                member_dict["status"] = status
            member_dict["metadata"] = merged_metadata
            new_members.append(member_dict)

        if not updated_any:
            return None

        updated = self._canonical_store.update_organization(
            org_id,
            {
                "members": new_members,
                "member_count": len(new_members),
            },
        )
        if updated is None:
            return None
        return _organization_from_canonical(dict(updated))

    def update_org_status(
        self,
        org_id: str,
        *,
        status: OrgStatus,
        plan_name: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": status,
            "metadata": metadata if metadata is not None else None,
        }
        if plan_name is not None:
            updates["tier"] = plan_name
            updates["plan"] = plan_name

        updated = self._canonical_store.update_organization(
            org_id,
            {key: value for key, value in updates.items() if value is not None},
        )
        if updated is None:
            return None
        return _organization_from_canonical(dict(updated))

    def reset(self) -> None:
        return None


_ORG_STORE = OrgStore()


def get_org_store() -> OrgStore:
    return _ORG_STORE


def reset_org_store() -> None:
    global _ORG_STORE
    _ORG_STORE = OrgStore()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4


OrganizationRole = Literal["owner", "admin", "analyst", "viewer"]
OrganizationStatus = Literal["active", "suspended", "invited"]


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _normalize_email(value: str) -> str:
    return value.strip().lower()


def _normalize_slug(value: str) -> str:
    return value.strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrganizationMemberRecord:
    member_id: str
    email: str
    display_name: str
    role: OrganizationRole
    status: OrganizationStatus
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["created_at"] = self.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        payload["updated_at"] = self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return payload


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrganizationRecord:
    organization_id: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    status: Literal["active", "suspended"]
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    owner_email: str
    members: list[OrganizationMemberRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "organization_id": self.organization_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "updated_at": self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "owner_email": self.owner_email,
            "members": [member.to_dict() for member in self.members],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class OrganizationStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._items: list[OrganizationRecord] = []

    def list_organizations(
        self,
        *,
        status: Literal["active", "suspended"] | None = None,
    ) -> list[OrganizationRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._items)

        if status is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.status == status]

        return items

    def get_organization(self, organization_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for item in self._items:
                if item.organization_id == organization_id:
                    return item
        return None

    def create_organization(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        slug: str,
        owner_email: str,
        owner_display_name: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | tuple[Literal["slug_exists"], str]:
        normalized_slug = _normalize_slug(slug)
        normalized_owner_email = _normalize_email(owner_email)

        with self._lock:
            if any(item.slug == normalized_slug for item in self._items):
                return ("slug_exists", normalized_slug)

            now = _utcnow()
            owner = OrganizationMemberRecord(
                member_id=f"member-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                email=normalized_owner_email,
                display_name=owner_display_name.strip(),
                role="owner",
                status="active",
                created_at=now,
                updated_at=now,
                metadata={"source": "organization_create"},
            )
            organization = OrganizationRecord(
                organization_id=f"org-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                name=name.strip(),
                slug=normalized_slug,
                status="active",
                created_at=now,
                updated_at=now,
                owner_email=normalized_owner_email,
                members=[owner],
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            )
            self._items.append(organization)
            return organization

    def add_member(
        self,
        organization_id: str,
        *,
        email: str,
        display_name: str,
        role: OrganizationRole,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | tuple[Literal["not_found", "member_exists"], str]:
        normalized_email = _normalize_email(email)

        with self._lock:
            for index, organization in enumerate(self._items):
                if organization.organization_id != organization_id:
                    continue

                if any(member.email == normalized_email for member in organization.members):
                    return ("member_exists", normalized_email)

                now = _utcnow()
                member = OrganizationMemberRecord(
                    member_id=f"member-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                    email=normalized_email,
                    display_name=display_name.strip(),
                    role=role,
                    status="invited",
                    created_at=now,
                    updated_at=now,
                    metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
                )

                updated = OrganizationRecord(
                    organization_id=organization.organization_id,
                    name=organization.name,
                    slug=organization.slug,
                    status=organization.status,
                    created_at=organization.created_at,
                    updated_at=now,
                    owner_email=organization.owner_email,
                    members=[*organization.members, member],
                    metadata=dict(organization.metadata),
                )
                self._items[index] = updated
                return updated

        return ("not_found", organization_id)

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.clear()


_ORGANIZATION_STORE = OrganizationStore()


def get_organization_store() -> OrganizationStore:
    return _ORGANIZATION_STORE


def reset_organization_store() -> None:
    _ORGANIZATION_STORE.reset()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store

DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_TABLE = "organizations"


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_timestamp(value: str | datetime | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return _utc_now()
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return dt.isoformat()
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or _utc_now()


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    lowered = str(value).strip().lower()
    if lowered in {"1", "true", "yes", "y", "on", "enabled", "active"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"0", "false", "no", "n", "off", "disabled", "inactive"}:
        return False
    return default


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: item
            for key, item in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(item)
        }
    raise TypeError("organization payload must be a mapping-like object")


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _slugify(value: str) -> str:
    text = _text(value).lower()
    cleaned: list[str] = []
    previous_dash = False
    for char in text:
        if char.isalnum():
            cleaned.append(char)
            previous_dash = False
            continue
        if not previous_dash:
            cleaned.append("-")
            previous_dash = True
    slug = "".join(cleaned).strip("-")
    return slug or f"org-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"


def _normalize_organization_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    name: str | None = None,
    slug: str | None = None,
    display_name: str | None = None,
    legal_name: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
    website_url: str | None = None,
    email_domain: str | None = None,
    contact_email: str | None = None,
    billing_email: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    tier: str | None = None,
    plan: str | None = None,
    region: str | None = None,
    country: str | None = None,
    timezone: str | None = None,
    seat_limit: Any = None,
    member_count: Any = None,
    tags: list[Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    settings: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    enabled: Any = None,
    archived: Any = None,
    created_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    updated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source = _as_dict(payload)
    source.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_org_id = (
        _text(organization_id)
        or _text(org_id)
        or _text(source.get("organization_id"))
        or _text(source.get("org_id"))
        or _text(source.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_name = (
        _text(name)
        or _text(display_name)
        or _text(legal_name)
        or _text(source.get("name"))
        or _text(source.get("display_name"))
        or _text(source.get("legal_name"))
        or f"Organization {resolved_org_id[:8]}"
    )

    resolved_slug = (
        _text(slug)
        or _text(source.get("slug"))
        or _slugify(resolved_name)
    )

    resolved_owner_id = (
        _text(owner_id)
        or _text(source.get("owner_id"))
        or None
    )

    resolved_status = (
        _text(status)
        or _text(source.get("status"))
        or "active"
    )

    resolved_tier = (
        _text(tier)
        or _text(plan)
        or _text(source.get("tier"))
        or _text(source.get("plan"))
        or "standard"
    )

    resolved_created_at = _normalize_timestamp(created_at or source.get("created_at"))
    resolved_updated_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        updated_at or source.get("updated_at") or resolved_created_at
    )

    return {
        "organization_id": resolved_org_id,
        "org_id": resolved_org_id,
        "id": resolved_org_id,
        "owner_id": resolved_owner_id,
        "name": resolved_name,
        "display_name": _text(display_name)
        or _text(source.get("display_name"))
        or resolved_name,
        "legal_name": _text(legal_name)
        or _text(source.get("legal_name"))
        or resolved_name,
        "slug": resolved_slug,
        "description": _text(description) or _text(source.get("description")),
        "industry": _text(industry) or _text(source.get("industry")),
        "website_url": _text(website_url) or _text(source.get("website_url")),
        "email_domain": _text(email_domain) or _text(source.get("email_domain")),
        "contact_email": _text(contact_email) or _text(source.get("contact_email")),
        "billing_email": _text(billing_email) or _text(source.get("billing_email")),
        "status": resolved_status,
        "tier": resolved_tier,
        "plan": resolved_tier,
        "region": _text(region) or _text(source.get("region")),
        "country": _text(country) or _text(source.get("country")),
        "timezone": _text(timezone) or _text(source.get("timezone")) or "UTC",
        "seat_limit": int(
            seat_limit if seat_limit is not None else source.get("seat_limit", 0)
        ),
        "member_count": int(
            member_count if member_count is not None else source.get("member_count", 0)
        ),
        "tags": _as_list(tags if tags is not None else source.get("tags")),
        "metadata": metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else _as_dict(
            source.get("metadata")
        ),
        "settings": settings if isinstance(settings, dict) else _as_dict(
            source.get("settings")
        ),
        "enabled": _bool(
            enabled if enabled is not None else source.get("enabled"),
            default=resolved_status.lower() == "active",
        ),
        "archived": _bool(
            archived if archived is not None else source.get("archived"),
            default=resolved_status.lower() == "archived",
        ),
        "created_at": resolved_created_at,
        "updated_at": resolved_updated_at,
    }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrganizationRecord:
    organizationid: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    status: str
    createdat: str
    updatedat: str
    owneremail: str
    tier: str
    plan: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any]

    @classmethod
    def from_row(cls, row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "OrganizationRecord":
        data = dict(row)
        org_id = (
            _text(data.get("organization_id"))
            or _text(data.get("org_id"))
            or _text(data.get("id"))
        )
        created_at = _normalize_timestamp(data.get("created_at"))
        updated_at = _normalize_timestamp(data.get("updated_at") or created_at)
        tier = _text(data.get("tier"), "standard")
        plan = _text(data.get("plan"), tier)
        owner_email = (
            _text(data.get("owner_email"))
            or _text(data.get("contact_email"))
            or _text(data.get("billing_email"))
        )
        return cls(
            organizationid=org_id,
            name=_text(data.get("name")),
            slug=_text(data.get("slug")),
            status=_text(data.get("status"), "active"),
            createdat=created_at,
            updatedat=updated_at,
            owneremail=owner_email,
            tier=tier,
            plan=plan,
            metadata=_as_dict(data.get("metadata")),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "organizationid": self.organizationid,
            "name": self.name,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "status": self.status,
            "createdat": self.createdat,
            "updatedat": self.updatedat,
            "owneremail": self.owneremail,
            "tier": self.tier,
            "plan": self.plan,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrganizationStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        probe = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(probe):
            return bool(probe())
        return True

    def create_organization(
        self,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord:
        record = _normalize_organization_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, record)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            row = dict(inserted[0])
        elif isinstance(inserted, dict):
            row = dict(inserted)
        else:
            row = record
        return OrganizationRecord.from_row(row)

    def create(
        self,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord:
        return self.create_organization(payload, **kwargs)

    def upsert_organization(
        self,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> OrganizationRecord:
        record = _normalize_organization_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        existing = self.get_organization(record["organization_id"])
        if existing is None:
            return self.create_organization(record)
        updated = self.update_organization(record["organization_id"], record)
        return updated or OrganizationRecord.from_row(record)

    def list_organizations(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        tier: str | None = None,
        slug: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[OrganizationRecord]:
        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if owner_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("owner_id", owner_id)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", status)
        if tier:
            query_filters.setdefault("tier", tier)
        if slug:
            query_filters.setdefault("slug", slug)

        rows = self.backend.select(
            self.table_name,
            filters=query_filters or None,
            limit=limit,
        )
        items = [OrganizationRecord.from_row(row) for row in rows]
        items.sort(
            key=lambda rec: rec.updatedat or rec.createdat,
            reverse=True,
        )
        return items

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[OrganizationRecord]:
        return self.list_organizations(**kwargs)

    def get_organization(self, organization_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        oid = _text(organization_id)
        if not oid:
            raise ValueError("organization_id is required")

        for key in ("organization_id", "org_id", "id"):
            rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={key: oid}, limit=1)
            if rows:
                return OrganizationRecord.from_row(rows[0])
        return None

    def get(self, organization_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        return self.get_organization(organization_id)

    def get_by_slug(self, slug: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        normalized = _text(slug)
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("slug is required")
        rows = self.backend.select(
            self.table_name,
            filters={"slug": normalized},
            limit=1,
        )
        if rows:
            return OrganizationRecord.from_row(rows[0])
        return None

    def update_organization(
        self,
        organization_id: str,
        updates: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        existing = self.get_organization(organization_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = _as_dict(existing.to_dict())
        merged.update(_as_dict(updates))
        merged["organization_id"] = organization_id
        merged["org_id"] = organization_id
        merged["id"] = organization_id
        merged["updated_at"] = _utc_now()

        normalized = _normalize_organization_payload(merged)

        for key in ("organization_id", "org_id", "id"):
            updated = self.backend.update(
                self.table_name,
                normalized,
                filters={key: organization_id},
            )
            if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
                return OrganizationRecord.from_row(updated[0])

        return OrganizationRecord.from_row(normalized)

    def update(
        self,
        organization_id: str,
        updates: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        return self.update_organization(organization_id, updates)

    def activate(self, organization_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        return self.update_organization(
            organization_id,
            {"status": "active", "enabled": True, "archived": False},
        )

    def suspend(self, organization_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        return self.update_organization(
            organization_id,
            {"status": "suspended", "enabled": False},
        )

    def archive(self, organization_id: str) -> OrganizationRecord | None:
        return self.update_organization(
            organization_id,
            {"status": "archived", "enabled": False, "archived": True},
        )

    def delete_organization(self, organization_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        oid = _text(organization_id)
        if not oid:
            raise ValueError("organization_id is required")

        for key in ("organization_id", "org_id", "id"):
            deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={key: oid})
            if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
                return dict(deleted[0])
        return None

    def delete(self, organization_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.delete_organization(organization_id)

    def exists(self, organization_id: str) -> bool:
        return self.get_organization(organization_id) is not None

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        organizations = self.list_organizations(limit=limit, owner_id=owner_id)
        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_tier: dict[str, int] = {}

        for organization in organizations:
            status = _text(organization.status, "unknown")
            tier = _text(organization.tier, "unknown")
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1
            by_tier[tier] = by_tier.get(tier, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total_organizations": len(organizations),
            "by_status": by_status,
            "by_tier": by_tier,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }


def build_organization_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> OrganizationStore:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    return OrganizationStore(backend=resolved_backend, table_name=table_name)


def create_organization_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> OrganizationStore:
    return build_organization_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_organization_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> OrganizationStore:
    return build_organization_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.org_isolation import (

def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrgIsolationServiceResult:
    allowed: bool
    scope: str
    reason: str
    actor_org_id: str | None
    target_org_id: str | None
    principal_id: str | None = None

class OrgIsolationService:
    def evaluate(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        bypass_roles: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> OrgIsolationDecision:
        return evaluate_org_isolation(
            context,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            bypass_roles=bypass_roles,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def authorize(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        bypass_roles: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> OrgIsolationServiceResult:
        decision = self.evaluate(
            context,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            bypass_roles=bypass_roles,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return self._to_result(decision, scope="org_isolation")

    def compare_org_ids(
        self,
        *,
        actor_org_id: str | None,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> OrgIsolationServiceResult:
        matched = org_ids_match(actor_org_id, target_org_id)
        return OrgIsolationServiceResult(
            allowed=matched,
            scope="org_id_compare",
            reason="org_match" if matched else "org_mismatch",
            actor_org_id=actor_org_id,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def summarize_context(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> OrgIsolationServiceResult:
        return OrgIsolationServiceResult(
            allowed=context.authenticated,
            scope="org_context_summary",
            reason="authenticated" if context.authenticated else "authentication_required",
            actor_org_id=context.org_id,
            target_org_id=context.org_id,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            matched_roles=context.roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def authorize_same_org(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> OrgIsolationServiceResult:
        return self.authorize(
            context,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            bypass_roles=(),
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def authorize_with_default_bypass(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        target_org_id: str | None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> OrgIsolationServiceResult:
        return self.authorize(
            context,
            target_org_id=target_org_id,
            bypass_roles=DEFAULT_BYPASS_ROLES,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def _to_result(
        self,
        decision: OrgIsolationDecision,
        *,
        scope: str,
    ) -> OrgIsolationServiceResult:
        return OrgIsolationServiceResult(
            allowed=decision.allowed,
            scope=scope,
            reason=decision.reason,
            actor_org_id=decision.actor_org_id,
            target_org_id=decision.target_org_id,
            principal_id=decision.principal_id,
            principal_type=decision.principal_type,
            matched_roles=decision.matched_roles,
            metadata=dict(decision.metadata),
        )


def build_org_isolation_service() -> OrgIsolationService:
    return OrgIsolationService()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping

from app.core.access_control import AccessControlDecision, evaluate_access
from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.permissions import (
    PermissionDecision,
    evaluate_permission,
    expand_role_permissions,
    resolve_effective_permissions,
)
from app.core.roles import (
    describe_roles,
    get_role_permissions,
    normalize_roles,
)


def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PermissionServiceResult:
    allowed: bool
    scope: str
    reason: str
    principal_id: str | None
    org_id: str | None
    permissions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "principal_id": self.principal_id,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "permissions": list(self.permissions),
            "roles": list(self.roles),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PermissionService:
    def resolve_permissions(
        self,
        *,
        direct_permissions: Iterable[object] | None = None,
        roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> PermissionServiceResult:
        normalized_roles = normalize_roles(roles)
        effective_permissions = resolve_effective_permissions(
            direct_permissions=direct_permissions,
            roles=normalized_roles,
        )
        return PermissionServiceResult(
            allowed=True,
            scope="resolve_permissions",
            reason="resolved",
            principal_id=None,
            org_id=None,
            permissions=effective_permissions,
            roles=normalized_roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def expand_roles(
        self,
        *,
        roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> PermissionServiceResult:
        normalized_roles = normalize_roles(roles)
        expanded_permissions = expand_role_permissions(normalized_roles)
        return PermissionServiceResult(
            allowed=True,
            scope="expand_roles",
            reason="expanded",
            principal_id=None,
            org_id=None,
            permissions=expanded_permissions,
            roles=normalized_roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def describe_role_set(
        self,
        *,
        roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        return describe_roles(roles)

    def get_permissions_for_role(
        self,
        role_name: str,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> PermissionServiceResult:
        permissions = get_role_permissions(role_name)
        roles = normalize_roles([role_name])
        return PermissionServiceResult(
            allowed=bool(roles),
            scope="role_permissions",
            reason="resolved" if roles else "unknown_role",
            principal_id=None,
            org_id=None,
            permissions=permissions,
            roles=roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def evaluate_permission(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        permission: str,
        *,
        resource_org_id: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> PermissionDecision:
        return evaluate_permission(
            context,
            permission,
            resource_org_id=resource_org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def evaluate_access(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        action: str,
        required_permission: str | None = None,
        required_roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
        resource_org_id: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> AccessControlDecision:
        normalized_roles = normalize_roles(required_roles)
        return evaluate_access(
            context,
            action=action,
            required_permission=required_permission,
            required_roles=normalized_roles,
            resource_org_id=resource_org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def summarize_context_permissions(
        self,
        context: AuthContext,
        *,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> PermissionServiceResult:
        effective_permissions = resolve_effective_permissions(
            direct_permissions=context.permissions,
            roles=context.roles,
        )
        return PermissionServiceResult(
            allowed=context.authenticated,
            scope="context_permissions",
            reason="authenticated" if context.authenticated else "authentication_required",
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            permissions=effective_permissions,
            roles=context.roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )


def build_permission_service() -> PermissionService:
    return PermissionService()

def list_platform_profiles() -> list[PlatformProfile]:
    return sorted(
        default_platform_profiles(),
        key=lambda item: (item.metadata.get("priority", 999), item.platform),
    )


def get_platform_profile(platform: str) -> PlatformProfile | None:
    normalized = platform.strip().lower()
    for profile in default_platform_profiles():
        if profile.platform == normalized:
            return profile
    return None


def summarize_platform_profile(profile: PlatformProfile) -> dict[str, Any]:
    support_counts = {"native": 0, "partial": 0, "unsupported": 0}
    for capability in profile.capabilities:
        support_counts[capability.support] = support_counts.get(capability.support, 0) + 1

    return {
        "platform": profile.platform,
        "display_name": profile.display_name,
        "install_mode": profile.install_mode,
        "capability_count": len(profile.capabilities),
        "native_capabilities": support_counts["native"],
        "partial_capabilities": support_counts["partial"],
        "unsupported_capabilities": support_counts["unsupported"],
        "checked_at": profile.checked_at,
    }

import os
from typing import Dict, Any

from app.services.rules import ALL_RULE_GROUPS
from app.services.heuristics import _get_threshold  # type: ignore[attr-defined]


def get_policy_status() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    severity_counts: Dict[str, int] = {"low": 0, "medium": 0, "high": 0, "critical": 0}
    category_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}

    for group in ALL_RULE_GROUPS:
        for rule in group:
            sev = rule["severity"]
            cat = rule["category"]
            severity_counts[sev] = severity_counts.get(sev, 0) + 1
            category_counts[cat] = category_counts.get(cat, 0) + 1

    unicode_normalization_enabled = True  # _normalize_text uses NFKC + zero-width stripping

    return {
        "heuristic_threshold": _get_threshold(),
        "heuristic_threshold_env": os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_HEURISTIC_THRESHOLD"),
        "severity_counts": severity_counts,
        "category_counts": category_counts,
        "unicode_normalization_enabled": unicode_normalization_enabled,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import secrets


PolicyBundleFormat = Literal["json", "compact"]
PolicyBundleStatus = Literal["valid", "invalid", "expired", "unsigned"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


def _stable_json_dumps(payload: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)


def _clean_mapping(value: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value or {})


def _clean_policy_list(value: list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not value:
        return []
    return [dict(item) for item in value]


def _require_text(value: str | None, field_name: str) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize_text(value)
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError(f"{field_name} is required")
    return normalized


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyBundle:
    bundle_id: str
    version: str
    created_at: str
    policies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.bundle_id = _require_text(self.bundle_id, "bundle_id")
        self.version = _require_text(self.version, "version")
        self.created_at = _require_text(self.created_at, "created_at")
        self.policies = _clean_policy_list(self.policies)
        self.metadata = _clean_mapping(self.metadata)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "bundle_id": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "policies": [dict(item) for item in self.policies],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SignedPolicyBundle:
    bundle: PolicyBundle
    signature: str
    key_id: str
    algorithm: str = "hs256"
    signed_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.signature = _require_text(self.signature, "signature")
        self.key_id = _require_text(self.key_id, "key_id")
        self.algorithm = _normalize_text(self.algorithm or "hs256") or "hs256"
        self.signed_at = _require_text(self.signed_at, "signed_at")

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "bundle": self.bundle.to_dict(),
            "signature": self.signature,
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "algorithm": self.algorithm,
            "signed_at": self.signed_at,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyBundleVerificationResult:
    bundle_id: str
    version: str
    status: PolicyBundleStatus
    reason: str
    key_id: str | None = None
    algorithm: str | None = None
    verified_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "bundle_id": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "status": self.status,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "algorithm": self.algorithm,
            "verified_at": self.verified_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicySigningKey:
    key_id: str
    secret: str
    algorithm: str = "hs256"
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.key_id = _require_text(self.key_id, "key_id")
        self.secret = _require_text(self.secret, "secret")
        self.algorithm = _normalize_text(self.algorithm or "hs256") or "hs256"
        self.created_at = _require_text(self.created_at, "created_at")
        self.metadata = _clean_mapping(self.metadata)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "algorithm": self.algorithm,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicySigningKeySet:
    active_key_id: str
    keys: dict[str, PolicySigningKey] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.active_key_id = _require_text(self.active_key_id, "active_key_id")
        self.keys = dict(self.keys)
        self.created_at = _require_text(self.created_at, "created_at")
        self.updated_at = _require_text(self.updated_at, "updated_at")

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "active_key_id": self.active_key_id,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "keys": {key_id: key.to_dict() for key_id, key in self.keys.items()},
        }


def create_policy_bundle(
    bundle_id: str,
    version: str,
    *,
    policies: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    created_at: str | None = None,
) -> PolicyBundle:
    return PolicyBundle(
        bundle_id=bundle_id,
        version=version,
        created_at=_normalize_text(created_at) or _utc_now(),
        policies=_clean_policy_list(policies),
        metadata=_clean_mapping(metadata),
    )


def initialize_policy_signing_keys() -> PolicySigningKeySet:
    secret = secrets.token_hex(32)
    key_id = "ironclaw-local-default"
    now = _utc_now()

    key = PolicySigningKey(
        key_id=key_id,
        secret=secret,
        algorithm="hs256",
        created_at=now,
        metadata={"scope": "local", "purpose": "policy-bundle", "active": True},
    )
    return PolicySigningKeySet(
        active_key_id=key_id,
        keys={key_id: key},
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
    )


def get_active_signing_key(keyset: PolicySigningKeySet) -> PolicySigningKey:
    key = keyset.keys.get(keyset.active_key_id)
    if key is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown active key_id: {keyset.active_key_id}")
    return key


def register_signing_key(
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
    *,
    key_id: str,
    secret: str,
    algorithm: str = "hs256",
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    make_active: bool = False,
) -> PolicySigningKeySet:
    now = _utc_now()
    normalized_key_id = _require_text(key_id, "key_id")

    key = PolicySigningKey(
        key_id=normalized_key_id,
        secret=secret,
        algorithm=algorithm,
        created_at=now,
        metadata=_clean_mapping(metadata),
    )

    keys = dict(keyset.keys)
    keys[normalized_key_id] = key

    active_key_id = normalized_key_id if make_active else keyset.active_key_id
    if make_active:
        for existing_key in keys.values():
            existing_key.metadata = dict(existing_key.metadata)
            existing_key.metadata["active"] = existing_key.key_id == normalized_key_id

    return PolicySigningKeySet(
        active_key_id=active_key_id,
        keys=keys,
        created_at=keyset.created_at,
        updated_at=now,
    )


def rotate_active_signing_key(
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
    *,
    key_id: str | None = None,
    secret: str | None = None,
    algorithm: str = "hs256",
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> PolicySigningKeySet:
    next_key_id = _normalize_text(key_id) or f"ironclaw-rotated-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"
    next_secret = _normalize_text(secret) or secrets.token_hex(32)
    next_metadata = dict(metadata or {})
    next_metadata.setdefault("scope", "local")
    next_metadata.setdefault("purpose", "policy-bundle")
    next_metadata["rotated"] = True
    next_metadata["active"] = True

    return register_signing_key(
        keyset,
        key_id=next_key_id,
        secret=next_secret,
        algorithm=algorithm,
        metadata=next_metadata,
        make_active=True,
    )


def _compute_hmac_signature(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    secret: str,
    algorithm: str = "hs256",
) -> str:
    if algorithm != "hs256":
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported algorithm: {algorithm}")

    body = _stable_json_dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return f"{algorithm}:{digest}"


def _validate_bundle(bundle: PolicyBundle) -> None:
    _require_text(bundle.bundle_id, "bundle_id")
    _require_text(bundle.version, "version")
    _require_text(bundle.created_at, "created_at")


def sign_policy_bundle(
    bundle: PolicyBundle,
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
) -> SignedPolicyBundle:
    _validate_bundle(bundle)
    key = get_active_signing_key(keyset)
    payload = bundle.to_dict()
    signature = _compute_hmac_signature(
        payload,
        secret=key.secret,
        algorithm=key.algorithm,
    )
    return SignedPolicyBundle(
        bundle=bundle,
        signature=signature,
        key_id=key.key_id,
        algorithm=key.algorithm,
    )


def verify_policy_bundle_signature(
    signed: SignedPolicyBundle,
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
) -> PolicyBundleVerificationResult:
    bundle_dict = signed.bundle.to_dict()
    key = keyset.keys.get(signed.key_id)

    if key is None:
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason="signing key not found",
            key_id=signed.key_id,
            algorithm=signed.algorithm,
            metadata={"verification": "missing-key"},
        )

    if signed.algorithm != key.algorithm:
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason="algorithm mismatch",
            key_id=key.key_id,
            algorithm=signed.algorithm,
            metadata={"expected_algorithm": key.algorithm},
        )

    try:
        _validate_bundle(signed.bundle)
        expected_signature = _compute_hmac_signature(
            bundle_dict,
            secret=key.secret,
            algorithm=key.algorithm,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason=str(exc),
            key_id=key.key_id,
            algorithm=key.algorithm,
            metadata={"verification": "validation-error"},
        )

    if not hmac.compare_digest(signed.signature, expected_signature):
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason="signature mismatch",
            key_id=key.key_id,
            algorithm=key.algorithm,
            metadata={"verification": "signature-mismatch"},
        )

    return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
        bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
        version=signed.bundle.version,
        status="valid",
        reason="signature verified",
        key_id=key.key_id,
        algorithm=key.algorithm,
        metadata={"verification": "verified"},
    )


def export_signed_bundle(
    signed: SignedPolicyBundle,
    *,
    format: PolicyBundleFormat = "json",
) -> str:
    payload = signed.to_dict()
    if format == "json":
        return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    if format == "compact":
        return _stable_json_dumps(payload)
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported bundle export format: {format}")


def import_signed_bundle(serialized: str) -> SignedPolicyBundle:
    raw = json.loads(serialized)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError("serialized bundle must decode to an object")

    bundle_data = raw.get("bundle")
    if not isinstance(bundle_data, dict):
        raise ValueError("serialized bundle is missing a valid 'bundle' object")

    bundle = PolicyBundle(
        bundle_id=_normalize_text(bundle_data.get("bundle_id")),
        version=_normalize_text(bundle_data.get("version")),
        created_at=_normalize_text(bundle_data.get("created_at")),
        policies=_clean_policy_list(bundle_data.get("policies")),
        metadata=_clean_mapping(bundle_data.get("metadata")),
    )

    return SignedPolicyBundle(
        bundle=bundle,
        signature=_normalize_text(raw.get("signature")),
        key_id=_normalize_text(raw.get("key_id")),
        algorithm=_normalize_text(raw.get("algorithm") or "hs256") or "hs256",
        signed_at=_normalize_text(raw.get("signed_at") or _utc_now()),
    )


def summarize_signed_bundle(
    signed: SignedPolicyBundle,
    verification: PolicyBundleVerificationResult | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    verification_status = verification.status if verification else "unsigned"
    verification_reason = verification.reason if verification else "not verified"

    return {
        "bundle_id": signed.bundle.bundle_id,
        "version": signed.bundle.version,
        "policy_count": len(signed.bundle.policies),
        "key_id": signed.key_id,
        "algorithm": signed.algorithm,
        "signed_at": signed.signed_at,
        "verification_status": verification_status,
        "verification_reason": verification_reason,
    }


def summarize_signing_keyset(keyset: PolicySigningKeySet) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "active_key_id": keyset.active_key_id,
        "key_count": len(keyset.keys),
        "algorithms": sorted({key.algorithm for key in keyset.keys.values()}),
        "created_at": keyset.created_at,
        "updated_at": keyset.updated_at,
    }

PolicyMode = Literal["monitor", "enforce", "lockdown"]
PolicyDecision = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyThresholdRecord:
    prompt_injection_score: float
    malware_score: float
    exfiltration_score: float
    tool_abuse_score: float

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicySettingsRecord:

    default_decision: PolicyDecision
    require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool
    sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool
    block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool

    thresholds: PolicyThresholdRecord
    updated_at: datetime
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

            "mode": self.mode,
            "default_decision": self.default_decision,

            "thresholds": self.thresholds.to_dict(),
            "updated_at": self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PolicyStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._settings = PolicySettingsRecord(
            policy_id="ironclaw-default-policy",
            mode="enforce",
            default_decision="quarantine",
            require_human_review_for_quarantine=False,
            sandbox_all_untrusted_content=True,
            block_high_risk_tool_calls=True,
            strict_prompt_ingress=True,
            thresholds=PolicyThresholdRecord(
                prompt_injection_score=0.70,
                malware_score=0.60,
                exfiltration_score=0.55,
                tool_abuse_score=0.65,
            ),
            updated_at=_utcnow(),
            metadata={
                "owner": "ironclaw",
                "profile": "maximum-protection",
            },
        )

    def get_settings(self) -> PolicySettingsRecord:
        with self._lock:
            return self._settings

    def update_settings(
        self,
        *,
        mode: PolicyMode,
        default_decision: PolicyDecision,
        require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool,
        sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool,
        block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool,
        strict_prompt_ingress: bool,
        thresholds: PolicyThresholdRecord,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> PolicySettingsRecord:
        with self._lock:
            self._settings = PolicySettingsRecord(
                policy_id=self._settings.policy_id,
                mode=mode,
                default_decision=default_decision,
                require_human_review_for_quarantine=require_human_review_for_quarantine,
                sandbox_all_untrusted_content=sandbox_all_untrusted_content,
                block_high_risk_tool_calls=block_high_risk_tool_calls,
                strict_prompt_ingress=strict_prompt_ingress,
                thresholds=thresholds,
                updated_at=_utcnow(),
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            )
            return self._settings

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self.__init__()

    return _POLICY_STORE

from typing import Literal, TypedDict, Optional

from app.services.guard import guard_text


ContextType = Literal["user_prompt", "retrieved_doc", "tool_output", "model_output"]
VerdictType = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class GuardedText(TypedDict):
    context_type: ContextType
    verdict: VerdictType
    scan_id: Optional[str]
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str]
    original_text: str
    effective_text: str
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    client_id: Optional[str]
    session_id: Optional[str]


class PromptGuardBundle(TypedDict):
    user_prompt: Optional[GuardedText]
    retrieved_doc: Optional[GuardedText]
    tool_output: Optional[GuardedText]
    model_output: Optional[GuardedText]
    highest_verdict: VerdictType
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    client_id: Optional[str]
    session_id: Optional[str]


def _verdict_rank(verdict: VerdictType) -> int:
    order: dict[VerdictType, int] = {
        "allow": 1,
        "warn": 2,
        "quarantine": 3,
        "block": 4,
    }
    return order[verdict]


def analyze_text(
    context_type: ContextType,
    text: str,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> GuardedText:
    """
    Run the Ironclaw scan for the given context and return a structured
    decision the agent / UI can act on.

    Policy:

    - allow:
        - proceed normally
        - should_halt = False
        - should_warn = False

    - warn:
        - proceed, but caller should surface a warning banner or log entry
        - should_halt = False
        - should_warn = True

    - quarantine:
        - caller SHOULD NOT execute this automatically
        - typically route to manual review / sandbox
        - should_halt = True
        - should_warn = True

    - block:
        - caller MUST NOT execute this
        - return effective_text equal to the original so the caller can
          decide how to replace or redact before use
        - should_halt = True
        - should_warn = False
    """
    decision = guard_text(context_type, text)
    verdict: VerdictType = decision["verdict"]  # type: ignore[assignment]

    should_halt = verdict in ("block", "quarantine")
    should_warn = verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")

    return {
        "context_type": context_type,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "scan_id": decision.get("scan_id"),
        "summary": decision["summary"],
        "risk_score": decision["risk_score"],
        "matched_patterns": decision["matched_patterns"],
        "original_text": text,
        "effective_text": text,
        "should_halt": should_halt,
        "should_warn": should_warn,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "session_id": session_id,
    }


def analyze_prompt_bundle(
    user_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
    retrieved_doc: Optional[str] = None,
    tool_output: Optional[str] = None,
    model_output: Optional[str] = None,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> PromptGuardBundle:
    """
    Guard multiple text sources that may participate in one agent turn.

    This is useful for internal routing where you want one consolidated
    decision across:
    - the user prompt,
    - retrieved documents,
    - tool output,
    - and model output.

    highest_verdict is chosen using this precedence:
        allow < warn < quarantine < block

    Bundle-level flags follow the same policy as analyze_text:

    - should_halt:
        True if the highest_verdict is 'quarantine' or 'block'

    - should_warn:
        True if the highest_verdict is 'warn' or 'quarantine'
        (we do not warn for 'block' because the action must not proceed anyway)
    """
    guarded_user_prompt = (
        analyze_text("user_prompt", user_prompt, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if user_prompt is not None
        else None
    )
    guarded_retrieved_doc = (
        analyze_text("retrieved_doc", retrieved_doc, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if retrieved_doc is not None
        else None
    )
    guarded_tool_output = (
        analyze_text("tool_output", tool_output, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if tool_output is not None
        else None
    )
    guarded_model_output = (
        analyze_text("model_output", model_output, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if model_output is not None
        else None
    )

    results: list[GuardedText] = [
        item
        for item in (
            guarded_user_prompt,
            guarded_retrieved_doc,
            guarded_tool_output,
            guarded_model_output,
        )
        if item is not None
    ]

    if not results:
        highest_verdict: VerdictType = "allow"
    else:
        highest_verdict = max(
            (item["verdict"] for item in results),
            key=_verdict_rank,
        )

    return {
        "user_prompt": guarded_user_prompt,
        "retrieved_doc": guarded_retrieved_doc,
        "tool_output": guarded_tool_output,
        "model_output": guarded_model_output,
        "highest_verdict": highest_verdict,
        "should_halt": highest_verdict in ("block", "quarantine"),
        "should_warn": highest_verdict in ("warn", "quarantine"),
        "client_id": client_id,
        "session_id": session_id,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4


QuarantineStatus = Literal["isolated", "under_review", "released", "destroyed"]
QuarantineSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system"]
RiskLevel = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class QuarantineRecord:
    quarantine_id: str
    status: QuarantineStatus
    source: QuarantineSource
    title: str
    summary: str
    risk_level: RiskLevel
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    incident_id: str | None = None
    asset_ref: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    release_reason: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["created_at"] = self.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        payload["updated_at"] = self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return payload


class QuarantineStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._items: list[QuarantineRecord] = []

    def seed_defaults(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if self._items:
                return

            now = _utcnow()
            self._items.extend(
                [
                    QuarantineRecord(
                        quarantine_id=f"qtn-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        status="isolated",
                        source="scan",
                        title="Injected prompt bundle isolated",
                        summary="A prompt payload was isolated after matching prompt-injection heuristics during ingress scanning.",
                        risk_level="high",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-qtn-001",
                        trace_id="trace-qtn-001",
                        incident_id="inc-seed-001",
                        asset_ref="prompt:user-input",
                        metadata={"verdict": "quarantine", "seeded": True},
                        tags=["prompt-injection", "ingress", "scanner"],
                    ),
                    QuarantineRecord(
                        quarantine_id=f"qtn-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        status="under_review",
                        source="sandbox",
                        title="Suspicious tool output contained",
                        summary="Tool-returned content was moved into quarantine while sandbox review evaluates potential hostile instructions.",
                        risk_level="critical",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-qtn-002",
                        trace_id="trace-qtn-002",
                        incident_id="inc-seed-002",
                        asset_ref="tool-output:external-content",
                        owner="sandbox-review",
                        metadata={"verdict": "quarantine", "seeded": True},
                        tags=["sandbox", "tool-output", "containment"],
                    ),
                ]
            )

    def list_items(
        self,
        *,
        status: QuarantineStatus | None = None,
        source: QuarantineSource | None = None,
        risk_level: RiskLevel | None = None,
    ) -> list[QuarantineRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._items)

        if status is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.status == status]
        if source is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.source == source]
        if risk_level is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.risk_level == risk_level]

        return items

    def get_item(self, quarantine_id: str) -> QuarantineRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for item in self._items:
                if item.quarantine_id == quarantine_id:
                    return item
        return None

    def create_item(
        self,
        *,
        source: QuarantineSource,
        title: str,
        summary: str,
        risk_level: RiskLevel,
        status: QuarantineStatus = "isolated",
        request_id: str | None = None,
        trace_id: str | None = None,
        incident_id: str | None = None,
        asset_ref: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
        release_reason: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        tags: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> QuarantineRecord:
        now = _utcnow()
        record = QuarantineRecord(
            quarantine_id=f"qtn-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            status=status,
            source=source,
            title=title.strip(),
            summary=summary.strip(),
            risk_level=risk_level,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            request_id=request_id,
            trace_id=trace_id,
            incident_id=incident_id,
            asset_ref=asset_ref,
            owner=owner,
            release_reason=release_reason,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            tags=list(tags or []),
        )

        with self._lock:
            self._items.append(record)

        return record

    def update_item(
        self,
        quarantine_id: str,
        *,
        status: QuarantineStatus,
        owner: str | None = None,
        release_reason: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> QuarantineRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for index, item in enumerate(self._items):
                if item.quarantine_id != quarantine_id:
                    continue

                updated = QuarantineRecord(
                    quarantine_id=item.quarantine_id,
                    status=status,
                    source=item.source,
                    title=item.title,
                    summary=item.summary,
                    risk_level=item.risk_level,
                    created_at=item.created_at,
                    updated_at=_utcnow(),
                    request_id=item.request_id,
                    trace_id=item.trace_id,
                    incident_id=item.incident_id,
                    asset_ref=item.asset_ref,
                    owner=owner if owner is not None else item.owner,
                    release_reason=release_reason if release_reason is not None else item.release_reason,
                    metadata={
                        **item.metadata,
                        **dict(metadata or {}),
                    },
                    tags=list(item.tags),
                )
                self._items[index] = updated
                return updated

        return None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.clear()


_QUARANTINE_STORE = QuarantineStore()
_QUARANTINE_STORE.seed_defaults()


def get_quarantine_store() -> QuarantineStore:
    return _QUARANTINE_STORE


def reset_quarantine_store() -> None:
    _QUARANTINE_STORE.reset()
    _QUARANTINE_STORE.seed_defaults()
