from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_alerts_overview import build_prompt_guard_alerts_overview
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_signals_summary import build_prompt_guard_signals_summary
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_timeline_summary import build_prompt_guard_timeline_summary
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_trends_summary import build_prompt_guard_trends_summary


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/groq",
    tags=["groq-prompt-guard-alerts-timeline-summary"],
)


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


TimelineAlertSeverity = Literal["critical", "high", "medium", "low", "info"]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem:
    id: str
    title: str
    severity: TimelineAlertSeverity
    status: str | None
    timestamp: str
    source_module: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "status": self.status,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
            "source_module": self.source_module,
            "details": dict(self.details),
            "tags": list(self.tags),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummary:
    generated_at: str
    total_alerts: int
    critical_alerts: int
    high_alerts: int
    medium_alerts: int
    low_alerts: int
    entries: list[PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "total_alerts": self.total_alerts,
            "critical_alerts": self.critical_alerts,
            "high_alerts": self.high_alerts,
            "medium_alerts": self.medium_alerts,
            "low_alerts": self.low_alerts,
            "entries": [entry.to_dict() for entry in self.entries],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItemResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    severity: TimelineAlertSeverity
    status: str | None = None
    timestamp: str
    source_module: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    generated_at: str
    total_alerts: int
    critical_alerts: int
    high_alerts: int
    medium_alerts: int
    low_alerts: int
    entries: list[PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItemResponse] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _normalize_severity(value: str | None) -> TimelineAlertSeverity:
    normalized = (value or "info").strip().lower()
    mapping: dict[str, TimelineAlertSeverity] = {
        "critical": "critical",
        "high": "high",
        "medium": "medium",
        "moderate": "medium",
        "low": "low",
        "info": "info",
    }
    return mapping.get(normalized, "info")


def _severity_rank(value: TimelineAlertSeverity) -> int:
    rank: dict[TimelineAlertSeverity, int] = {
        "critical": 0,
        "high": 1,
        "medium": 2,
        "low": 3,
        "info": 4,
    }
    return rank[value]


def build_prompt_guard_alerts_timeline_summary() -> PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummary:
    generated_at = _utc_now()

    alerts = build_prompt_guard_alerts_overview()
    timeline = build_prompt_guard_timeline_summary()
    signals = build_prompt_guard_signals_summary()
    trends = build_prompt_guard_trends_summary()

    entries: list[PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem] = []

    for alert in alerts.latest_alerts:
        entries.append(
            PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem(
                id=f"alerts-timeline:alert:{alert.id}",
                title=alert.title,
                severity=_normalize_severity(alert.severity),
                status=alert.status,
                timestamp=alert.timestamp,
                source_module=alert.source_module,
                details=alert.details,
                tags=list(alert.tags),
            )
        )

    for entry in timeline.entries:
        severity = _normalize_severity(entry.severity)
        if severity == "info":
            continue
        entries.append(
            PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem(
                id=f"alerts-timeline:timeline:{entry.id}",
                title=entry.title,
                severity=severity,
                status=entry.status,
                timestamp=entry.timestamp,
                source_module=entry.source_module,
                details=entry.details,
                tags=list(entry.tags),
            )
        )

    for signal in signals.latest_signals:
        severity = _normalize_severity(signal.severity)
        if severity in {"critical", "high", "medium"}:
            entries.append(
                PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem(
                    id=f"alerts-timeline:signal:{signal.id}",
                    title=signal.title,
                    severity=severity,
                    status=signal.status,
                    timestamp=signal.timestamp,
                    source_module=signal.source_module,
                    details=signal.details,
                    tags=list(signal.tags),
                )
            )

    latest_snapshot = trends.latest_snapshot
    if latest_snapshot is not None:
        blocked = int(latest_snapshot.get("blocked_requests", 0) or 0)
        flagged = int(latest_snapshot.get("flagged_requests", 0) or 0)
        severity: TimelineAlertSeverity = (
            "critical" if blocked >= 10 else
            "high" if blocked > 0 else
            "medium" if flagged > 0 else
            "low"
        )
        entries.append(
            PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItem(
                id=f"alerts-timeline:trend:{latest_snapshot.get('timestamp', generated_at)}",
                title="Latest trend snapshot alert state",
                severity=severity,
                status=trends.trend_status,
                timestamp=latest_snapshot.get("timestamp", generated_at),
                source_module="prompt_guard_trends_summary",
                details=latest_snapshot,
                tags=["trend", "snapshot"],
            )
        )

    entries.sort(key=lambda item: (_severity_rank(item.severity), item.timestamp), reverse=False)
    entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda item: item.timestamp, reverse=True)[:24]

    critical_alerts = sum(1 for item in entries if item.severity == "critical")
    high_alerts = sum(1 for item in entries if item.severity == "high")
    medium_alerts = sum(1 for item in entries if item.severity == "medium")
    low_alerts = sum(1 for item in entries if item.severity == "low")

    return PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummary(
        generated_at=generated_at,
        total_alerts=len(entries),
        critical_alerts=critical_alerts,
        high_alerts=high_alerts,
        medium_alerts=medium_alerts,
        low_alerts=low_alerts,
        entries=entries,
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "prompt_guard_alerts_overview",
                "prompt_guard_timeline_summary",
                "prompt_guard_signals_summary",
                "prompt_guard_trends_summary",
            ],
            "entry_limit": 24,
            "trend_status": trends.trend_status,
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/prompt-guard/alerts-timeline-summary",
    response_model=PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummaryResponse,
)
def get_prompt_guard_alerts_timeline_summary() -> PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummaryResponse:
    summary = build_prompt_guard_alerts_timeline_summary()
    data = summary.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardAlertsTimelineSummaryResponse(
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        total_alerts=data["total_alerts"],
        critical_alerts=data["critical_alerts"],
        high_alerts=data["high_alerts"],
        medium_alerts=data["medium_alerts"],
        low_alerts=data["low_alerts"],
        entries=[
            PromptGuardAlertsTimelineItemResponse(**entry)
            for entry in data["entries"]
        ],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_policy import PromptGuardCategory


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/groq",
    tags=["groq-prompt-guard-allowlist"],
)


AllowlistStatus = Literal["active", "disabled"]
AllowlistScope = Literal["global", "client", "session", "rule"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardAllowlistEntry:
    id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    category: PromptGuardCategory
    status: AllowlistStatus
    scope: AllowlistScope
    pattern: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    created_by: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    rule_id: str | None = None
    expires_at: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "name": self.name,
            "description": self.description,
            "category": self.category,
            "status": self.status,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "pattern": self.pattern,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "created_by": self.created_by,
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "rule_id": self.rule_id,
            "expires_at": self.expires_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardAllowlistPage:
    items: list[PromptGuardAllowlistEntry]
    page: int
    page_size: int
    total_items: int
    total_pages: int
    generated_at: str
    next_page: int | None = None
    prev_page: int | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "page": self.page,
            "page_size": self.page_size,
            "total_items": self.total_items,
            "total_pages": self.total_pages,
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "next_page": self.next_page,
            "prev_page": self.prev_page,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


_ALLOWLIST: list[PromptGuardAllowlistEntry] = []
_ALLOWLIST_COUNTER: int = 0
_ALLOWLIST_MAX_ITEMS: int = 500


class PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    category: PromptGuardCategory
    status: AllowlistStatus
    scope: AllowlistScope
    pattern: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    created_by: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    rule_id: str | None = None
    expires_at: str | None = None

class PromptGuardAllowlistResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView]
    page: int
    page_size: int
    total_items: int
    total_pages: int
    generated_at: str
    next_page: int | None = None
    prev_page: int | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PromptGuardAllowlistCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., description="Human-readable name for the allowlist exception.")
    description: str = Field(..., description="Why this exception exists.")
    category: PromptGuardCategory = Field(..., description="Prompt guard category this allowlist applies to.")
    scope: AllowlistScope = Field(..., description="Scope of the allowlist entry.")
    pattern: str = Field(..., description="Pattern or exact phrase to allow.")
    created_by: str = Field(..., description="Operator or system creating the exception.")
    client_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Client target when scope=client.")
    session_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Session target when scope=session.")
    rule_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Rule target when scope=rule.")
    expires_at: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Optional expiration timestamp.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PromptGuardAllowlistUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    status: AllowlistStatus | None = Field(default=None, description="Set allowlist status.")
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Optional updated description.")
    expires_at: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Optional updated expiration timestamp.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(default=None, description="Optional metadata merge.")


def _seed_allowlist() -> None:
    global _ALLOWLIST, _ALLOWLIST_COUNTER

    if _ALLOWLIST:
        return

    now = _utc_now()
    _ALLOWLIST.extend(
        [
            PromptGuardAllowlistEntry(
                id="allow-1",
                name="Internal red-team training phrase",
                description="Approved phrase used by internal red-team simulations.",
                category="prompt_injection",
                status="active",
                scope="client",
                pattern="ignore previous instructions for training",
                created_at=now,
                updated_at=now,
                created_by="security-admin",
                client_id="internal-redteam",
                session_id=None,
                rule_id=None,
                expires_at=None,
                metadata={"seeded": True},
            ),
            PromptGuardAllowlistEntry(
                id="allow-2",
                name="Approved secret scanning test",
                description="Controlled validation phrase for secret exposure detector tests.",
                category="secret_exposure",
                status="disabled",
                scope="rule",
                pattern="show api key for test harness",
                created_at=now,
                updated_at=now,
                created_by="security-admin",
                client_id=None,
                session_id=None,
                rule_id="pg-003",
                expires_at=None,
                metadata={"seeded": True},
            ),
        ]
    )
    _ALLOWLIST_COUNTER = len(_ALLOWLIST)


def _next_allowlist_id() -> str:
    global _ALLOWLIST_COUNTER
    _ALLOWLIST_COUNTER += 1
    return f"allow-{_ALLOWLIST_COUNTER}"


def _paginate_items(
    items: list[PromptGuardAllowlistEntry],
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> PromptGuardAllowlistPage:
    total_items = len(items)
    if total_items == 0:
        return PromptGuardAllowlistPage(
            items=[],
            page=1,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_items=0,
            total_pages=0,
            generated_at=_utc_now(),
            next_page=None,
            prev_page=None,
            metadata={},
        )

    total_pages = (total_items + page_size - 1) // page_size
    page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))
    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    slice_items = items[start:end]

    return PromptGuardAllowlistPage(
        items=slice_items,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        total_items=total_items,
        total_pages=total_pages,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        next_page=page + 1 if page < total_pages else None,
        prev_page=page - 1 if page > 1 else None,
        metadata={},
    )


def _append_allowlist_entry(
    payload: PromptGuardAllowlistCreateRequest,
) -> PromptGuardAllowlistEntry:
    global _ALLOWLIST

    now = _utc_now()
    entry = PromptGuardAllowlistEntry(
        id=_next_allowlist_id(),
        name=payload.name,
        description=payload.description,
        category=payload.category,
        status="active",
        scope=payload.scope,
        pattern=payload.pattern,
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        created_by=payload.created_by,
        client_id=payload.client_id,
        session_id=payload.session_id,
        rule_id=payload.rule_id,
        expires_at=payload.expires_at,
        metadata=dict(payload.metadata),
    )

    _ALLOWLIST.append(entry)
    if len(_ALLOWLIST) > _ALLOWLIST_MAX_ITEMS:
        _ALLOWLIST = _ALLOWLIST[-_ALLOWLIST_MAX_ITEMS:]

    return entry


def _find_allowlist_entry(entry_id: str) -> PromptGuardAllowlistEntry:
    for entry in _ALLOWLIST:
        if entry.id == entry_id:
            return entry
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Allowlist entry not found")


@router.get("/prompt-guard/allowlist", response_model=PromptGuardAllowlistResponse)
def get_prompt_guard_allowlist(
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number for the allowlist."),
    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of allowlist items per page."),
    status: AllowlistStatus | None = Query(default=None, description="Optional filter by status."),
    scope: AllowlistScope | None = Query(default=None, description="Optional filter by scope."),
    category: PromptGuardCategory | None = Query(default=None, description="Optional filter by category."),
) -> PromptGuardAllowlistResponse:
    _seed_allowlist()

    items = list(reversed(_ALLOWLIST))
    if status is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.status == status]
    if scope is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.scope == scope]
    if category is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.category == category]

    page_obj = _paginate_items(items, page=page, page_size=page_size)
    data = page_obj.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardAllowlistResponse(
        items=[PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView(**item) for item in data["items"]],
        page=data["page"],
        page_size=data["page_size"],
        total_items=data["total_items"],
        total_pages=data["total_pages"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        next_page=data["next_page"],
        prev_page=data["prev_page"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


@router.post("/prompt-guard/allowlist", response_model=PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView, status_code=201)
def create_prompt_guard_allowlist_entry(
    payload: PromptGuardAllowlistCreateRequest,
) -> PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView:
    _seed_allowlist()
    entry = _append_allowlist_entry(payload)
    return PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView(**entry.to_dict())


@router.patch("/prompt-guard/allowlist/{entry_id}", response_model=PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView)
def update_prompt_guard_allowlist_entry(
    entry_id: str,
    payload: PromptGuardAllowlistUpdateRequest,
) -> PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView:
    _seed_allowlist()
    entry = _find_allowlist_entry(entry_id)

    if payload.status is not None:
        entry.status = payload.status
    if payload.description is not None:
        entry.description = payload.description
    if payload.expires_at is not None:
        entry.expires_at = payload.expires_at
    if payload.metadata is not None:
        entry.metadata.update(payload.metadata)

    entry.updated_at = _utc_now()
    return PromptGuardAllowlistEntryView(**entry.to_dict())

def _paginate_events(
    events: list[PromptGuardAuditEvent],
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> PromptGuardAuditTrailPage:
    total_items = len(events)
    if total_items == 0:
        return PromptGuardAuditTrailPage(
            items=[],
            page=1,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_items=0,
            total_pages=0,
            generated_at=_utc_now(),
            next_page=None,
            prev_page=None,
            metadata={},
        )

    total_pages = (total_items + page_size - 1) // page_size
    page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))

    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    slice_items = events[start:end]

    return PromptGuardAuditTrailPage(
        items=slice_items,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        total_items=total_items,
        total_pages=total_pages,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        next_page=page + 1 if page < total_pages else None,
        prev_page=page - 1 if page > 1 else None,
        metadata={},
    )


@router.get("/prompt-guard/audit-trail", response_model=PromptGuardAuditTrailResponse)
def get_prompt_guard_audit_trail(
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number for the prompt guard audit trail."),
    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of audit events per page."),
    event_type: AuditEventType | None = Query(default=None, description="Optional filter by audit event type."),
    actor_type: AuditActorType | None = Query(default=None, description="Optional filter by actor type."),
) -> PromptGuardAuditTrailResponse:
    _seed_audit_trail()

    events = list(reversed(_AUDIT_TRAIL))
    if event_type is not None:
        events = [event for event in events if event.event_type == event_type]
    if actor_type is not None:
        events = [event for event in events if event.actor_type == actor_type]

    page_obj = _paginate_events(events, page=page, page_size=page_size)
    data = page_obj.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardAuditTrailResponse(
        items=[PromptGuardAuditEventView(**item) for item in data["items"]],
        page=data["page"],
        page_size=data["page_size"],
        total_items=data["total_items"],
        total_pages=data["total_pages"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        next_page=data["next_page"],
        prev_page=data["prev_page"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_health_snapshot import build_prompt_guard_health_snapshot
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_incident_summary import build_prompt_guard_incident_summary
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_metrics import build_prompt_guard_metrics_view
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_review_queue_summary import build_prompt_guard_review_queue_summary
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary import build_prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary
from app.ui.groq.prompt_guard_signals_summary import build_prompt_guard_signals_summary


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/groq",
    tags=["groq-prompt-guard-coverage-summary"],
)


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


CoverageStatus = Literal["healthy", "moderate", "elevated", "critical"]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardCoverageArea:
    id: str
    title: str
    status: CoverageStatus
    value: float | int | str
    source_module: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "status": self.status,
            "value": self.value,
            "source_module": self.source_module,
            "details": dict(self.details),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardCoverageSummary:
    generated_at: str
    coverage_status: CoverageStatus
    incident_coverage_ratio: float
    linked_incidents: int
    unlinked_incidents: int
    coverage_areas: list[PromptGuardCoverageArea] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "coverage_status": self.coverage_status,
            "incident_coverage_ratio": self.incident_coverage_ratio,
            "linked_incidents": self.linked_incidents,
            "unlinked_incidents": self.unlinked_incidents,
            "coverage_areas": [area.to_dict() for area in self.coverage_areas],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PromptGuardCoverageAreaResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    status: CoverageStatus
    value: float | int | str
    source_module: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PromptGuardCoverageSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    generated_at: str
    coverage_status: CoverageStatus
    incident_coverage_ratio: float
    linked_incidents: int
    unlinked_incidents: int
    coverage_areas: list[PromptGuardCoverageAreaResponse] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _status_from_ratio(ratio: float) -> CoverageStatus:
    if ratio < 0.35:
        return "critical"
    if ratio < 0.55:
        return "elevated"
    if ratio < 0.8:
        return "moderate"
    return "healthy"


def _status_rank(value: CoverageStatus) -> int:
    rank: dict[CoverageStatus, int] = {
        "healthy": 0,
        "moderate": 1,
        "elevated": 2,
        "critical": 3,
    }
    return rank[value]


def _worst_status(statuses: list[CoverageStatus]) -> CoverageStatus:
    if not statuses:
        return "healthy"
    return max(statuses, key=_status_rank)


def _find_metric_value(metrics: Any, name: str, default: float | int = 0) -> float | int:
    kpi = next((item for item in metrics.kpis if item.name == name), None)
    if kpi is None:
        return default
    return kpi.value


def build_prompt_guard_coverage_summary() -> PromptGuardCoverageSummary:
    generated_at = _utc_now()

    incident_summary = build_prompt_guard_incident_summary()
    metrics = build_prompt_guard_metrics_view()
    queue = build_prompt_guard_review_queue_summary()
    health = build_prompt_guard_health_snapshot()
    risk = build_prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary()
    signals = build_prompt_guard_signals_summary()

    summary = incident_summary.to_dict()
    incident_coverage_ratio = float(summary.get("incident_coverage_ratio", 0.0))
    linked_incidents = int(summary.get("linked_incidents", 0))
    unlinked_incidents = int(summary.get("unlinked_incidents", 0))
    total_incidents = int(summary.get("total_incidents", 0))

    review_queue_total = int(_find_metric_value(metrics, "total_reviews", queue.review_queue_total))
    critical_signals = int(signals.critical_signals)
    signal_pressure = float(signals.signal_pressure)

    coverage_areas = [
        PromptGuardCoverageArea(
            id="coverage:incidents",
            title="Incident linkage coverage",
            status=_status_from_ratio(incident_coverage_ratio),
            value=incident_coverage_ratio,
            source_module="prompt_guard_incident_summary",
            details={
                "total_incidents": total_incidents,
                "linked_incidents": linked_incidents,
                "unlinked_incidents": unlinked_incidents,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardCoverageArea(
            id="coverage:queue",
            title="Review queue coverage pressure",
            status="critical" if review_queue_total >= 15 else "elevated" if review_queue_total >= 8 else "moderate" if review_queue_total > 0 else "healthy",
            value=review_queue_total,
            source_module="prompt_guard_review_queue_summary",
            details={
                "queue_status": queue.queue_status,
                "recommendation_backlog": queue.recommendation_backlog,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardCoverageArea(
            id="coverage:signals",
            title="Signal handling coverage",
            status="critical" if critical_signals > 0 else "elevated" if signal_pressure >= 0.15 else "moderate" if signal_pressure > 0 else "healthy",
            value=signal_pressure,
            source_module="prompt_guard_signals_summary",
            details={
                "critical_signals": critical_signals,
                "total_signals": signals.total_signals,
                "signal_pressure": signal_pressure,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardCoverageArea(
            id="coverage:health",
            title="System coverage posture",
            status="critical" if health.overall_status == "critical" else "elevated" if health.overall_status == "degraded" else "moderate" if health.overall_status == "warning" else "healthy",
            value=health.overall_status,
            source_module="prompt_guard_health_snapshot",
            details={
                "policy_mode": health.policy_mode,
                "policy_health": health.policy_health,
                "trend_status": health.trend_status,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardCoverageArea(
            id="coverage:risk",
            title="Risk-aligned coverage posture",
            status="critical" if risk.overall_risk_level == "critical" else "elevated" if risk.overall_risk_level in {"high", "elevated"} else "moderate" if risk.overall_risk_level == "moderate" else "healthy",
            value=risk.overall_risk_level,
            source_module="prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary",
            details={
                "critical_alerts": risk.critical_alerts,
                "open_alerts": risk.open_alerts,
                "recommendation_pressure": risk.recommendation_pressure,
            },
        ),
    ]

    coverage_status = _worst_status([area.status for area in coverage_areas])

    return PromptGuardCoverageSummary(
        generated_at=generated_at,
        coverage_status=coverage_status,
        incident_coverage_ratio=incident_coverage_ratio,
        linked_incidents=linked_incidents,
        unlinked_incidents=unlinked_incidents,
        coverage_areas=coverage_areas,
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "prompt_guard_incident_summary",
                "prompt_guard_metrics",
                "prompt_guard_review_queue_summary",
                "prompt_guard_health_snapshot",
                "prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary",
                "prompt_guard_signals_summary",
            ],
            "coverage_area_count": len(coverage_areas),
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/prompt-guard/coverage-summary",
    response_model=PromptGuardCoverageSummaryResponse,
)
def get_prompt_guard_coverage_summary() -> PromptGuardCoverageSummaryResponse:
    summary = build_prompt_guard_coverage_summary()
    data = summary.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardCoverageSummaryResponse(
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        coverage_status=data["coverage_status"],
        incident_coverage_ratio=data["incident_coverage_ratio"],
        linked_incidents=data["linked_incidents"],
        unlinked_incidents=data["unlinked_incidents"],
        coverage_areas=[
            PromptGuardCoverageAreaResponse(**area)
            for area in data["coverage_areas"]
        ],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

def _tone_rank(value: str) -> int:
    mapping = {
        "stable": 0,
        "healthy": 0,
        "watch": 1,
        "warning": 1,
        "normal": 1,
        "moderate": 1,
        "action-required": 2,
        "degraded": 2,
        "busy": 2,
        "elevated": 2,
        "high": 2,
        "critical": 3,
    }
    return mapping.get((value or "").strip().lower(), 0)


def _normalize_tone(value: str) -> ExecutiveTone:
    normalized = (value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"critical"}:
        return "critical"
    if normalized in {"action-required", "degraded", "busy", "elevated", "high"}:
        return "action-required"
    if normalized in {"watch", "warning", "normal", "moderate"}:
        return "watch"
    return "stable"


def _derive_headline(overall_tone: ExecutiveTone) -> str:
    if overall_tone == "critical":
        return "Prompt Guard is operating under critical risk pressure"
    if overall_tone == "action-required":
        return "Prompt Guard needs focused operational follow-up"
    if overall_tone == "watch":
        return "Prompt Guard is stable with items to monitor"
    return "Prompt Guard is stable and operating within expected bounds"


def _derive_key_message(
    health: Any,
    risk: Any,
    queue: Any,
    performance: Any,
    alerts: Any,
) -> str:
    if risk.overall_risk_level == "critical" or alerts.critical_alerts > 0:
        return (
            f"Critical signals are present with {alerts.critical_alerts} critical alerts, "
            f"{queue.review_queue_total} reviews queued, and trend status '{health.trend_status}'."
        )
    if queue.queue_status in {"critical", "elevated", "busy"}:
        return (
            f"Review operations are under load with {queue.review_queue_total} queued items "
            f"and {alerts.warning_alerts} warning alerts requiring attention."
        )
    if performance.error_pressure >= 0.1:
        return (
            f"Traffic is flowing, but error pressure is elevated at {performance.error_pressure} "
            f"with {performance.blocked_requests} blocked and {performance.flagged_requests} flagged requests."
        )
    return (
        f"System health is {health.overall_status}, risk posture is {risk.overall_risk_level}, "
        f"and the review queue is at {queue.review_queue_total} items."
    )


def build_prompt_guard_executive_summary() -> PromptGuardExecutiveSummary:
    generated_at = _utc_now()

    health = build_prompt_guard_health_snapshot()
    risk = build_prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary()
    performance = build_prompt_guard_performance_snapshot()
    queue = build_prompt_guard_review_queue_summary()
    alerts = build_prompt_guard_alerts_overview()
    status_board = build_prompt_guard_status_board_summary()

    tones = [
        _normalize_tone(health.overall_status),
        _normalize_tone(risk.overall_risk_level),
        _normalize_tone(queue.queue_status),
        _normalize_tone(status_board.overall_status),
        "critical" if alerts.critical_alerts > 0 else "watch" if alerts.warning_alerts > 0 else "stable",
    ]
    overall_tone = max(tones, key=_tone_rank)

    headline = _derive_headline(overall_tone)
    key_message = _derive_key_message(
        health=health,
        risk=risk,
        queue=queue,
        performance=performance,
        alerts=alerts,
    )

    highlights = [
        PromptGuardExecutiveHighlight(
            id="exec:health",
            title="System health",
            tone=_normalize_tone(health.overall_status),
            summary=(
                f"Overall health is {health.overall_status} with policy mode '{health.policy_mode}' "
                f"and trend status '{health.trend_status}'."
            ),
            source_module="prompt_guard_health_snapshot",
            details={
                "policy_mode": health.policy_mode,
                "policy_health": health.policy_health,
                "trend_status": health.trend_status,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardExecutiveHighlight(
            id="exec:risk",
            title="Risk posture",
            tone=_normalize_tone(risk.overall_risk_level),
            summary=(
                f"Risk posture is {risk.overall_risk_level} with {risk.critical_alerts} critical alerts "
                f"and incident coverage ratio {risk.incident_coverage_ratio}."
            ),
            source_module="prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary",
            details={
                "overall_risk_level": risk.overall_risk_level,
                "critical_alerts": risk.critical_alerts,
                "incident_coverage_ratio": risk.incident_coverage_ratio,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardExecutiveHighlight(
            id="exec:queue",
            title="Review queue",
            tone=_normalize_tone(queue.queue_status),
            summary=(
                f"Queue status is {queue.queue_status} with {queue.review_queue_total} total reviews "
                f"and backlog pressure from {queue.recommendation_backlog} recommendations."
            ),
            source_module="prompt_guard_review_queue_summary",
            details={
                "queue_status": queue.queue_status,
                "review_queue_total": queue.review_queue_total,
                "recommendation_backlog": queue.recommendation_backlog,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardExecutiveHighlight(
            id="exec:performance",
            title="Traffic pressure",
            tone="action-required" if performance.error_pressure >= 0.1 else "watch" if performance.error_pressure > 0 else "stable",
            summary=(
                f"Current request volume is {performance.request_volume} with {performance.blocked_requests} blocked, "
                f"{performance.flagged_requests} flagged, and error pressure {performance.error_pressure}."
            ),
            source_module="prompt_guard_performance_snapshot",
            details={
                "request_volume": performance.request_volume,
                "blocked_requests": performance.blocked_requests,
                "flagged_requests": performance.flagged_requests,
                "error_pressure": performance.error_pressure,
            },
        ),
    ]

    return PromptGuardExecutiveSummary(
        generated_at=generated_at,
        overall_tone=overall_tone,
        headline=headline,
        key_message=key_message,
        highlights=highlights,
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "prompt_guard_health_snapshot",
                "prompt_guard_risk_posture_summary",
                "prompt_guard_performance_snapshot",
                "prompt_guard_review_queue_summary",
                "prompt_guard_alerts_overview",
                "prompt_guard_status_board_summary",
            ],
            "highlight_count": len(highlights),
            "status_board_overall_status": status_board.overall_status,
        },
    )

def _utc_now() -> str:

@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardExplanation:
    prompt: str
    safe_excerpt: str
    normalized_prompt: str
    verdict: GroqSecurityVerdict
    risk_score: int
    risk_level: str
    matched_rules: list[dict[str, Any]]
    explanation: str
    operator_guidance: list[str]
    generated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "prompt": self.prompt,
            "safe_excerpt": self.safe_excerpt,
            "normalized_prompt": self.normalized_prompt,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "risk_level": self.risk_level,
            "matched_rules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "explanation": self.explanation,
            "operator_guidance": list(self.operator_guidance),
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PromptGuardExplainRequest(BaseModel):
    prompt: str = Field(..., description="Prompt to explain using the prompt guard policy.")


class PromptGuardExplanationResponse(BaseModel):
    prompt: str
    safe_excerpt: str
    normalized_prompt: str
    verdict: GroqSecurityVerdict
    risk_score: int
    risk_level: str
    matched_rules: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    explanation: str
    operator_guidance: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    generated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _build_explanation_text(
    *,
    verdict: GroqSecurityVerdict,
    risk_score: int,
    matched_rule_names: list[str],
) -> str:
    if not matched_rule_names:
        return (
            f"The prompt did not trigger any active prompt guard rules, so the system "
            f"returned a {verdict} verdict with a risk score of {risk_score}."
        )

    joined_rules = ", ".join(matched_rule_names)
    return (
        f"The system returned a {verdict} verdict with a risk score of {risk_score} "
        f"because the prompt matched active guard rules: {joined_rules}."
    )


def _build_operator_guidance(
    *,
    verdict: GroqSecurityVerdict,
    risk_score: int,
    matched_rule_names: list[str],
) -> list[str]:
    guidance: list[str] = []

    if matched_rule_names:
        guidance.append("Review the matched rule set and confirm the prompt intent is represented correctly.")
    else:
        guidance.append("No active rule matched; review manually if the prompt still looks suspicious.")

    if verdict in ("block", "quarantine"):
        guidance.append("Keep enforcement in place unless a documented exception or allowlist entry justifies release.")
        guidance.append("If this is a legitimate workflow, route it to the review queue before changing policy.")
    elif verdict == "warn":
        guidance.append("Monitor for repeated attempts and escalate to review if the same pattern appears again.")
    else:
        guidance.append("Allow the prompt, but continue passive monitoring for repeated low-risk patterns.")

    if risk_score >= 85:
        guidance.append("Treat this as critical-risk behavior and preserve an audit trail for investigation.")

    return guidance


def build_prompt_guard_explanation(prompt: str) -> PromptGuardExplanation:
    simulation = _simulate_prompt(prompt)
    policy = build_prompt_guard_policy_view()

    matched_rules: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    matched_rule_names: list[str] = []

    for match in simulation.matches:
        matched_rule_names.append(match.rule_name)
        matched_rules.append(
            {
                "rule_id": match.rule_id,
                "rule_name": match.rule_name,
                "category": match.category,
                "action": match.action,
                "score": match.score,
                "matched_patterns": list(match.matched_patterns),
            }
        )

    explanation = _build_explanation_text(
        verdict=simulation.verdict,
        risk_score=simulation.risk_score,
        matched_rule_names=matched_rule_names,
    )
    operator_guidance = _build_operator_guidance(
        verdict=simulation.verdict,
        risk_score=simulation.risk_score,
        matched_rule_names=matched_rule_names,
    )

    return PromptGuardExplanation(
        prompt=prompt,
        safe_excerpt=_safe_excerpt(prompt),
        normalized_prompt=_normalize_prompt(prompt),
        verdict=simulation.verdict,
        risk_score=simulation.risk_score,
        risk_level=_risk_level_from_score(simulation.risk_score),
        matched_rules=matched_rules,
        explanation=explanation,
        operator_guidance=operator_guidance,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        metadata={
            "policy_mode": policy.mode,
            "policy_health": policy.health,
            "enabled_rule_count": sum(1 for rule in policy.rules if rule.enabled),
            "matched_rule_count": len(matched_rules),
        },
    )


@router.post("/prompt-guard/explain", response_model=PromptGuardExplanationResponse)
def explain_prompt_guard_decision(
    payload: PromptGuardExplainRequest,
) -> PromptGuardExplanationResponse:
    explanation = build_prompt_guard_explanation(payload.prompt)
    data = explanation.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardExplanationResponse(
        prompt=data["prompt"],
        safe_excerpt=data["safe_excerpt"],
        normalized_prompt=data["normalized_prompt"],
        verdict=data["verdict"],
        risk_score=data["risk_score"],
        risk_level=data["risk_level"],
        matched_rules=data["matched_rules"],
        explanation=data["explanation"],
        operator_guidance=data["operator_guidance"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

HealthStatus = Literal["healthy", "degraded", "warning", "critical"]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardHealthSnapshot:
    generated_at: str
    overall_status: HealthStatus
    policy_mode: str
    policy_health: str
    incident_coverage_ratio: float
    review_queue_total: int
    critical_alerts: int
    trend_status: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
            "policy_mode": self.policy_mode,
            "policy_health": self.policy_health,
            "incident_coverage_ratio": self.incident_coverage_ratio,
            "review_queue_total": self.review_queue_total,
            "critical_alerts": self.critical_alerts,
            "trend_status": self.trend_status,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PromptGuardHealthSnapshotResponse(BaseModel):
    generated_at: str
    overall_status: HealthStatus
    policy_mode: str
    policy_health: str
    incident_coverage_ratio: float
    review_queue_total: int
    critical_alerts: int
    trend_status: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _derive_trend_status(
    latest_point: dict[str, Any] | None,
    critical_alerts: int,
) -> str:
    if not latest_point:
        return "no-data"

    blocked = int(latest_point.get("blocked_requests", 0) or 0)
    flagged = int(latest_point.get("flagged_requests", 0) or 0)
    total = int(latest_point.get("total_requests", 0) or 0)

    if critical_alerts > 0:
        return "critical"

    if blocked > 0 or flagged > 0:
        return "elevated"

    if total > 0:
        return "stable"

    return "idle"


def _derive_overall_status(
    policy_health: str,
    incident_coverage_ratio: float,
    review_queue_total: int,
    critical_alerts: int,
    trend_status: str,
) -> HealthStatus:
    normalized_health = (policy_health or "").strip().lower()
    normalized_trend = (trend_status or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized_health in {"critical", "failed"} or critical_alerts > 0:
        return "critical"

    if normalized_health in {"degraded", "warning"}:
        return "degraded"

    if incident_coverage_ratio < 0.5:
        return "warning"

    if review_queue_total >= 10:
        return "warning"

    if normalized_trend in {"critical", "elevated"}:
        return "degraded"

    return "healthy"


def build_prompt_guard_health_snapshot() -> PromptGuardHealthSnapshot:
    policy = build_prompt_guard_policy_view()
    incident_summary = build_prompt_guard_incident_summary()
    alerts = build_prompt_guard_alerts_overview()
    trends = build_prompt_guard_trend_series()

    latest_point: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    if trends.points:
        latest_point = trends.points[-1].to_dict()

    summary = incident_summary.to_dict()
    incident_coverage_ratio = float(summary.get("incident_coverage_ratio", 0.0))
    review_queue_total = int(alerts.review_queue_total)
    critical_alerts = int(alerts.critical_alerts)
    trend_status = _derive_trend_status(latest_point, critical_alerts)

    overall_status = _derive_overall_status(
        policy_health=policy.health,
        incident_coverage_ratio=incident_coverage_ratio,
        review_queue_total=review_queue_total,
        critical_alerts=critical_alerts,
        trend_status=trend_status,
    )

    return PromptGuardHealthSnapshot(
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        overall_status=overall_status,
        policy_mode=policy.mode,
        policy_health=policy.health,
        incident_coverage_ratio=incident_coverage_ratio,
        review_queue_total=review_queue_total,
        critical_alerts=critical_alerts,
        trend_status=trend_status,
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "prompt_guard_policy",
                "prompt_guard_incident_summary",
                "prompt_guard_alerts_overview",
                "prompt_guard_trends",
            ],
            "latest_trend_point": latest_point,
            "trend_interval_minutes": getattr(trends, "interval_minutes", None),
            "trend_lookback_hours": getattr(trends, "lookback_hours", None),
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/prompt-guard/health-snapshot",
    response_model=PromptGuardHealthSnapshotResponse,
)
def get_prompt_guard_health_snapshot() -> PromptGuardHealthSnapshotResponse:
    snapshot = build_prompt_guard_health_snapshot()
    data = snapshot.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardHealthSnapshotResponse(

        overall_status=data["overall_status"],

        trend_status=data["trend_status"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

_INCIDENT_LINKS: list[PromptGuardIncidentLink] = []
_INCIDENT_LINK_COUNTER: int = 0
_INCIDENT_LINK_MAX_ITEMS: int = 1_000

class PromptGuardIncidentLinkCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    incident_id: str = Field(..., description="ID of the incident to link to this guarded prompt.")
    prompt_excerpt: str = Field(..., description="Redacted or safe excerpt of the guarded prompt.")
    verdict: GroqSecurityVerdict = Field(..., description="Prompt guard verdict that contributed to this incident.")
    risk_score: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Risk score associated with the prompt.")
    audit_event_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional audit event id that recorded the original guardrail decision.",
    )
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional extra context such as client/session IDs.",
    )


def _next_incident_link_id() -> str:
    global _INCIDENT_LINK_COUNTER
    _INCIDENT_LINK_COUNTER += 1
    return f"plink-{_INCIDENT_LINK_COUNTER}"


def _seed_incident_links() -> None:
    """
    Seed a few synthetic links so the UI has something to render
    before the real pipeline wires in.[web:1466][web:1469]
    """
    global _INCIDENT_LINKS, _INCIDENT_LINK_COUNTER

    if _INCIDENT_LINKS:
        return

    if not _INCIDENTS:
        return

    now = _utc_now()

    # Try to pair first couple of incidents with matching audit events by simple heuristic
    seeded: list[PromptGuardIncidentLink] = []
    for idx, incident in enumerate(_INCIDENTS[:2], start=1):
        matching_audit = next(
            (
                a
                for a in _AUDIT_TRAIL
                if a.prompt_excerpt
                and incident.title.lower().split()[0] in a.prompt_excerpt.lower()
            ),
            None,
        )
        link = PromptGuardIncidentLink(
            id=f"plink-{idx}",
            incident_id=incident.id,
            prompt_excerpt=(
                matching_audit.prompt_excerpt
                if matching_audit and matching_audit.prompt_excerpt
                else incident.summary[:160]
            ),
            verdict=matching_audit.verdict if matching_audit and matching_audit.verdict else "warn",
            risk_score=matching_audit.risk_score if matching_audit and matching_audit.risk_score is not None else 60,
            audit_event_id=matching_audit.id if matching_audit else None,
            created_at=now,
            metadata={"seeded": True},
        )
        seeded.append(link)

    _INCIDENT_LINKS.extend(seeded)
    _INCIDENT_LINK_COUNTER = len(_INCIDENT_LINKS)


def _append_incident_link(
    payload: PromptGuardIncidentLinkCreateRequest,
) -> PromptGuardIncidentLink:
    """
    Append a new link entry, enforcing a rolling window.[web:1189][web:1188]
    """
    global _INCIDENT_LINKS

    # Basic validation that incident exists; keep cheap and in-memory
    incident_ids = {inc.id for inc in _INCIDENTS}
    if payload.incident_id not in incident_ids:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Unknown incident_id for prompt guard incident link")

    now = _utc_now()
    link = PromptGuardIncidentLink(
        id=_next_incident_link_id(),
        incident_id=payload.incident_id,
        prompt_excerpt=payload.prompt_excerpt,
        verdict=payload.verdict,
        risk_score=payload.risk_score,
        audit_event_id=payload.audit_event_id,
        created_at=now,
        metadata=dict(payload.metadata),
    )

    _INCIDENT_LINKS.append(link)
    if len(_INCIDENT_LINKS) > _INCIDENT_LINK_MAX_ITEMS:
        _INCIDENT_LINKS = _INCIDENT_LINKS[-_INCIDENT_LINK_MAX_ITEMS:]

    return link


def _paginate_links(
    links: list[PromptGuardIncidentLink],
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> PromptGuardIncidentLinksPage:
    total_items = len(links)
    if total_items == 0:
        return PromptGuardIncidentLinksPage(
            items=[],
            page=1,
            page_size=page_size,
            total_items=0,
            total_pages=0,
            generated_at=_utc_now(),
            next_page=None,
            prev_page=None,
            metadata={},
        )

    total_pages = (total_items + page_size - 1) // page_size
    page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))
    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    slice_items = links[start:end]

    next_page = page + 1 if page < total_pages else None
    prev_page = page - 1 if page > 1 else None

    return PromptGuardIncidentLinksPage(
        items=slice_items,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        total_items=total_items,
        total_pages=total_pages,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        next_page=next_page,
        prev_page=prev_page,
        metadata={},
    )


@router.get("/prompt-guard/incident-links", response_model=PromptGuardIncidentLinksResponse)
def get_prompt_guard_incident_links(
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number for prompt guard incident links."),
    page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of links per page."),
    incident_id: str | None = Query(
        default=None,
        description="Optional filter by incident id.",
    ),
) -> PromptGuardIncidentLinksResponse:
    """
    List links between prompt guard decisions and incidents so operators
    can see which guarded prompts escalated into incidents.[web:1464][web:1466]
    """
    _seed_incident_links()

    links = list(reversed(_INCIDENT_LINKS))
    if incident_id is not None:
        links = [link for link in links if link.incident_id == incident_id]

    page_obj = _paginate_links(links, page=page, page_size=page_size)
    data = page_obj.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardIncidentLinksResponse(
        items=[PromptGuardIncidentLinkView(**item) for item in data["items"]],
        page=data["page"],
        page_size=data["page_size"],
        total_items=data["total_items"],
        total_pages=data["total_pages"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        next_page=data["next_page"],
        prev_page=data["prev_page"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


@router.post(
    "/prompt-guard/incident-links",
    response_model=PromptGuardIncidentLinkView,
    status_code=201,
)
def create_prompt_guard_incident_link(
    payload: PromptGuardIncidentLinkCreateRequest,
) -> PromptGuardIncidentLinkView:
    """
    Manually or programmatically link a guarded prompt decision to an
    existing incident, creating a correlation record for audit and UI.[web:1463][web:1468]
    """
    _seed_incident_links()
    link = _append_incident_link(payload)
    return PromptGuardIncidentLinkView(**link.to_dict())

@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardIncidentSummary:
    generated_at: str
    total_incidents: int
    linked_incidents: int
    unlinked_incidents: int
    total_prompt_links: int
    high_risk_links: int
    incident_coverage_ratio: float

            "total_incidents": self.total_incidents,

            "unlinked_incidents": self.unlinked_incidents,
            "total_prompt_links": self.total_prompt_links,
            "high_risk_links": self.high_risk_links,
            "incident_coverage_ratio": self.incident_coverage_ratio,

            "by_status": dict(self.by_status),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),

class PromptGuardIncidentSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    generated_at: str
    total_incidents: int
    linked_incidents: int
    unlinked_incidents: int
    total_prompt_links: int
    high_risk_links: int
    incident_coverage_ratio: float
    by_severity: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    by_status: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def build_prompt_guard_incident_summary() -> PromptGuardIncidentSummary:
    incident_ids_with_links = {link.incident_id for link in _INCIDENT_LINKS}

    total_incidents = len(_INCIDENTS)
    linked_incidents = sum(1 for incident in _INCIDENTS if incident.id in incident_ids_with_links)
    unlinked_incidents = max(0, total_incidents - linked_incidents)

    total_prompt_links = len(_INCIDENT_LINKS)
    high_risk_links = sum(1 for link in _INCIDENT_LINKS if link.risk_score >= 70)

    coverage_ratio = 0.0
    if total_incidents > 0:
        coverage_ratio = round(linked_incidents / total_incidents, 3)

    by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
    by_status: dict[str, int] = {}

    for incident in _INCIDENTS:
        by_severity[incident.severity] = by_severity.get(incident.severity, 0) + 1
        by_status[incident.status] = by_status.get(incident.status, 0) + 1

    metrics = build_prompt_guard_metrics_view()

    return PromptGuardIncidentSummary(
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        total_incidents=total_incidents,
        linked_incidents=linked_incidents,
        unlinked_incidents=unlinked_incidents,
        total_prompt_links=total_prompt_links,
        high_risk_links=high_risk_links,
        incident_coverage_ratio=coverage_ratio,
        by_severity=by_severity,
        by_status=by_status,
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "incidents",
                "prompt_guard_incident_links",
                "prompt_guard_metrics",
            ],
            "review_queue_total": next(
                (kpi.value for kpi in metrics.kpis if kpi.name == "total_reviews"),
                0,
            ),
        },
    )


@router.get("/prompt-guard/incident-summary", response_model=PromptGuardIncidentSummaryResponse)
def get_prompt_guard_incident_summary() -> PromptGuardIncidentSummaryResponse:
    summary = build_prompt_guard_incident_summary()
    data = summary.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardIncidentSummaryResponse(
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        total_incidents=data["total_incidents"],
        linked_incidents=data["linked_incidents"],
        unlinked_incidents=data["unlinked_incidents"],
        total_prompt_links=data["total_prompt_links"],
        high_risk_links=data["high_risk_links"],
        incident_coverage_ratio=data["incident_coverage_ratio"],
        by_severity=data["by_severity"],
        by_status=data["by_status"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptGuardKpiCard:

    trend: str | None

            "details": dict(self.details),

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

        return {
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "cards": [card.to_dict() for card in self.cards],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class PromptGuardKpiCardResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    value: float | int | str
    label: str
    trend: str | None = None
    source_module: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PromptGuardKpiSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    generated_at: str
    cards: list[PromptGuardKpiCardResponse] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _find_kpi_value(metrics: Any, *names: str, default: float | int = 0) -> float | int:
    for name in names:
        match = next((kpi for kpi in metrics.kpis if kpi.name == name), None)
        if match is not None:
            return match.value
    return default


def build_prompt_guard_kpi_summary() -> PromptGuardKpiSummary:
    generated_at = _utc_now()

    metrics = build_prompt_guard_metrics_view()
    health = build_prompt_guard_health_snapshot()
    performance = build_prompt_guard_performance_snapshot()
    queue = build_prompt_guard_review_queue_summary()
    signals = build_prompt_guard_signals_summary()

    throughput_value = _find_kpi_value(metrics, "throughput_rpm", "throughput_rps", default=0)
    total_reviews = _find_kpi_value(metrics, "total_reviews", default=queue.review_queue_total)
    pass_rate = _find_kpi_value(metrics, "pass_rate", "allow_rate", default=0)
    block_rate = _find_kpi_value(metrics, "block_rate", default=0)
    flagged_total = performance.flagged_requests
    blocked_total = performance.blocked_requests
    critical_signals = signals.critical_signals

    cards = [
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:throughput",
            name="throughput",
            value=throughput_value,
            label="Traffic throughput",
            trend=health.trend_status,
            source_module="prompt_guard_metrics",
            details={
                "raw_value": throughput_value,
                "trend_status": health.trend_status,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:review-queue",
            name="review_queue_total",
            value=total_reviews,
            label="Review queue total",
            trend=queue.queue_status,
            source_module="prompt_guard_review_queue_summary",
            details={
                "queue_status": queue.queue_status,
                "recommendation_backlog": queue.recommendation_backlog,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:blocked",
            name="blocked_requests",
            value=blocked_total,
            label="Blocked requests",
            trend="elevated" if blocked_total > 0 else "stable",
            source_module="prompt_guard_performance_snapshot",
            details={
                "error_pressure": performance.error_pressure,
                "request_volume": performance.request_volume,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:flagged",
            name="flagged_requests",
            value=flagged_total,
            label="Flagged requests",
            trend="watch" if flagged_total > 0 else "stable",
            source_module="prompt_guard_performance_snapshot",
            details={
                "error_pressure": performance.error_pressure,
                "request_volume": performance.request_volume,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:critical-signals",
            name="critical_signals",
            value=critical_signals,
            label="Critical signals",
            trend="critical" if critical_signals > 0 else "stable",
            source_module="prompt_guard_signals_summary",
            details={
                "total_signals": signals.total_signals,
                "signal_pressure": signals.signal_pressure,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:pass-rate",
            name="pass_rate",
            value=pass_rate,
            label="Pass rate",
            trend="healthy" if isinstance(pass_rate, (int, float)) and pass_rate >= 0.9 else "watch",
            source_module="prompt_guard_metrics",
            details={
                "health_status": health.overall_status,
                "policy_mode": health.policy_mode,
            },
        ),
        PromptGuardKpiCard(
            id="kpi:block-rate",
            name="block_rate",
            value=block_rate,
            label="Block rate",
            trend="watch" if isinstance(block_rate, (int, float)) and block_rate > 0 else "stable",
            source_module="prompt_guard_metrics",
            details={
                "policy_health": health.policy_health,
                "policy_mode": health.policy_mode,
            },
        ),
    ]

    return PromptGuardKpiSummary(
        generated_at=generated_at,
        cards=cards,
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "prompt_guard_metrics",
                "prompt_guard_health_snapshot",
                "prompt_guard_performance_snapshot",
                "prompt_guard_review_queue_summary",
                "prompt_guard_signals_summary",
            ],
            "card_count": len(cards),
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/prompt-guard/kpi-summary",
    response_model=PromptGuardKpiSummaryResponse,
)
def get_prompt_guard_kpi_summary() -> PromptGuardKpiSummaryResponse:
    summary = build_prompt_guard_kpi_summary()
    data = summary.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardKpiSummaryResponse(
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        cards=[
            PromptGuardKpiCardResponse(**card)
            for card in data["cards"]
        ],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PromptGuardMetricsResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str
    generated_at: str
    kpis: list[PromptGuardKpiView]
    breakdowns: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _count_review_statuses() -> dict[str, int]:
    breakdown = {
        "pending": 0,
        "approved": 0,
        "rejected": 0,
    }
    for item in _REVIEW_QUEUE:
        breakdown[item.status] = breakdown.get(item.status, 0) + 1
    return breakdown


def _count_allowlist_statuses() -> dict[str, int]:
    breakdown = {
        "active": 0,
        "disabled": 0,
    }
    for entry in _ALLOWLIST:
        breakdown[entry.status] = breakdown.get(entry.status, 0) + 1
    return breakdown


def _count_audit_event_types() -> dict[str, int]:
    breakdown: dict[str, int] = {}
    for event in _AUDIT_TRAIL:
        breakdown[event.event_type] = breakdown.get(event.event_type, 0) + 1
    return breakdown


def build_prompt_guard_metrics_view() -> PromptGuardMetricsView:
    review_statuses = _count_review_statuses()
    allowlist_statuses = _count_allowlist_statuses()
    audit_event_types = _count_audit_event_types()

    total_reviews = len(_REVIEW_QUEUE)
    total_allowlist_entries = len(_ALLOWLIST)
    total_audit_events = len(_AUDIT_TRAIL)

    pending_reviews = review_statuses.get("pending", 0)
    active_allowlist_entries = allowlist_statuses.get("active", 0)
    simulation_events = audit_event_types.get("simulation", 0)

    kpis = [
        PromptGuardKpi(
            name="total_reviews",
            value=total_reviews,
            delta=pending_reviews,
            metadata={"delta_label": "pending"},
        ),
        PromptGuardKpi(
            name="total_allowlist_entries",
            value=total_allowlist_entries,
            delta=active_allowlist_entries,
            metadata={"delta_label": "active"},
        ),
        PromptGuardKpi(
            name="total_audit_events",
            value=total_audit_events,
            delta=simulation_events,
            metadata={"delta_label": "simulation"},
        ),
    ]

    return PromptGuardMetricsView(
        title="Groq Prompt Guard Metrics",
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        kpis=kpis,
        breakdowns={
            "review_statuses": review_statuses,
            "allowlist_statuses": allowlist_statuses,
            "audit_event_types": audit_event_types,
        },
        metadata={
            "source_modules": [
                "prompt_guard_review_queue",
                "prompt_guard_allowlist",
                "prompt_guard_audit_trail",
            ],
        },
    )


@router.get("/prompt-guard/metrics", response_model=PromptGuardMetricsResponse)

    data = view.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardMetricsResponse(
        title=data["title"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        kpis=[PromptGuardKpiView(**kpi) for kpi in data["kpis"]],
        breakdowns=data["breakdowns"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

    generated_at: str
    request_volume: int
    blocked_requests: int
    flagged_requests: int
    review_queue_total: int
    error_pressure: float = Field(
        ...,
        description="Ratio of (blocked + flagged) to total requests in the current trend window.",
    )
    trend_window: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Details about the active trend window (interval_minutes, lookback_hours, point_count).",
    )
    latest_point: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Most recent trend bucket, if any.",
    )
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _compute_error_pressure(latest_point: dict[str, Any] | None) -> float:
    if not latest_point:
        return 0.0

    total = int(latest_point.get("total_requests", 0) or 0)
    blocked = int(latest_point.get("blocked_requests", 0) or 0)
    flagged = int(latest_point.get("flagged_requests", 0) or 0)

    if total <= 0:
        return 0.0

    pressure = (blocked + flagged) / total
    return round(pressure, 4)


def build_prompt_guard_performance_snapshot() -> PromptGuardPerformanceSnapshot:
    trends = build_prompt_guard_trend_series()
    metrics = build_prompt_guard_metrics_view()
    alerts = build_prompt_guard_alerts_overview()

    latest_point: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    if trends.points:
        latest_point = trends.points[-1].to_dict()

    if latest_point:
        total_requests = int(latest_point.get("total_requests", 0) or 0)
        blocked_requests = int(latest_point.get("blocked_requests", 0) or 0)
        flagged_requests = int(latest_point.get("flagged_requests", 0) or 0)
    else:
        total_requests = 0
        blocked_requests = 0
        flagged_requests = 0

    error_pressure = _compute_error_pressure(latest_point)

    review_queue_total = int(alerts.review_queue_total)

    trend_window = {
        "interval_minutes": getattr(trends, "interval_minutes", None),
        "lookback_hours": getattr(trends, "lookback_hours", None),
        "point_count": len(trends.points),
    }

    throughput_kpi = next(
        (kpi for kpi in metrics.kpis if kpi.name in {"throughput_rpm", "throughput_rps"}),
        None,
    )

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = {
        "source_modules": [
            "prompt_guard_trends",
            "prompt_guard_metrics",
            "prompt_guard_alerts_overview",
        ],
        "throughput_kpi": throughput_kpi.to_dict() if throughput_kpi is not None else None,
    }

    return PromptGuardPerformanceSnapshot(
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        request_volume=total_requests,
        blocked_requests=blocked_requests,
        flagged_requests=flagged_requests,
        review_queue_total=review_queue_total,
        error_pressure=error_pressure,
        trend_window=trend_window,
        latest_point=latest_point,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


@router.get(
    "/prompt-guard/performance-snapshot",
    response_model=PromptGuardPerformanceSnapshotResponse,
)
def get_prompt_guard_performance_snapshot() -> PromptGuardPerformanceSnapshotResponse:
    snapshot = build_prompt_guard_performance_snapshot()
    data = snapshot.to_dict()
    return PromptGuardPerformanceSnapshotResponse(
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        request_volume=data["request_volume"],
        blocked_requests=data["blocked_requests"],
        flagged_requests=data["flagged_requests"],
        review_queue_total=data["review_queue_total"],
        error_pressure=data["error_pressure"],
        trend_window=data["trend_window"],
        latest_point=data["latest_point"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

def _coerce_policy_mode(mode: GroqMode) -> PolicyMode:
    return mode


def _health_from_mode_and_rules(
    *,
    mode: PolicyMode,
    rules: list[PromptGuardRule],
) -> PolicyHealth:
    if mode == "disabled":
        return "disabled"

    enabled_rules = [rule for rule in rules if rule.enabled]
    if not enabled_rules:
        return "critical"

    critical_categories = {
        "prompt_injection",
        "data_exfiltration",
        "secret_exposure",
        "policy_bypass",
    }
    enabled_categories = {rule.category for rule in enabled_rules}

    if not critical_categories.issubset(enabled_categories):
        return "warning"

    if mode == "observe":
        return "warning"

    return "healthy"

    return [

        ),
        PromptGuardRule(

            enabled=True,
            severity_weight=92,
            default_action="quarantine",
            match_patterns=[
                "export all data",

                "dump memory",
                "print confidential data",
            ],
            metadata={"priority": 2},
        ),
        PromptGuardRule(
            id="pg-003",
            name="Secret Exposure Guard",

            enabled=True,
            severity_weight=90,
            default_action="quarantine",
            match_patterns=[

                "print token",
                "reveal credentials",

            ],
            metadata={"priority": 3},

        PromptGuardRule(

def build_prompt_guard_policy_view(
    *,
    mode: GroqMode = "assist",
) -> PromptGuardPolicyView:
    policy_mode = _coerce_policy_mode(mode)
    rules = _build_default_rules()

    thresholds = PromptGuardThresholds(
        warn_score=35,
        block_score=70,
        quarantine_score=85,
        metadata={
            "scoring_model": "groq-prompt-guard-v1",
        },
    )

    health = _health_from_mode_and_rules(
        mode=policy_mode,
        rules=rules,
    )

    return PromptGuardPolicyView(
        title="Groq Prompt Guard Policy",
        mode=policy_mode,
        health=health,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        thresholds=thresholds,
        rules=rules,
        metadata={
            "protected_surface": "every_user_prompt",
            "total_rules": len(rules),
            "enabled_rules": sum(1 for rule in rules if rule.enabled),
        },
    )

    data = view.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardPolicyResponse(
        title=data["title"],
        mode=data["mode"],
        health=data["health"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        thresholds=PromptGuardThresholdsView(**data["thresholds"]),
        rules=[PromptGuardRuleView(**rule) for rule in data["rules"]],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )

def build_prompt_guard_recommendations_view() -> PromptGuardRecommendationsView:
    policy = build_prompt_guard_policy_view()
    metrics = build_prompt_guard_metrics_view()

    review_statuses = metrics.breakdowns.get("review_statuses", {})
    allowlist_statuses = metrics.breakdowns.get("allowlist_statuses", {})
    audit_event_types = metrics.breakdowns.get("audit_event_types", {})

    pending_reviews = int(review_statuses.get("pending", 0))
    active_allowlists = int(allowlist_statuses.get("active", 0))
    simulation_events = int(audit_event_types.get("simulation", 0))

    items: list[PromptGuardRecommendation] = []

    if policy.mode in ("disabled", "observe"):
        items.append(
            PromptGuardRecommendation(
                id="rec-1",
                title="Increase enforcement strength",
                description="Current prompt guard mode is not fully enforcing risky prompt decisions.",
                recommendation_type="policy_tuning",
                priority="critical" if policy.mode == "disabled" else "high",
                rationale=f"Policy mode is {policy.mode}, which lowers active protection for live prompts.",
                suggested_action="Move the prompt guard into assist or enforce mode after validation testing.",
                metadata={"policy_mode": policy.mode},
            )
        )

    if pending_reviews > 0:
        items.append(
            PromptGuardRecommendation(
                id="rec-2",
                title="Reduce pending review backlog",
                description="There are queued prompt guard cases waiting for operator review.",
                recommendation_type="review_queue",
                priority="high" if pending_reviews >= 5 else "medium",
                rationale=f"{pending_reviews} review item(s) are still pending, which can delay tuning decisions.",
                suggested_action="Triage pending review items and convert validated cases into policy updates or exceptions.",
                metadata={"pending_reviews": pending_reviews},
            )
        )

    if active_allowlists > 0:
        items.append(
            PromptGuardRecommendation(
                id="rec-3",
                title="Audit active allowlist scope",
                description="Active allowlist entries should stay narrow and time-bounded where possible.",
                recommendation_type="allowlist_hygiene",
                priority="medium",
                rationale=f"{active_allowlists} active allowlist entrie(s) are currently in effect.",
                suggested_action="Review each active allowlist entry for expiry, scope, and business justification.",
                metadata={"active_allowlists": active_allowlists},
            )
        )

    if simulation_events == 0:
        items.append(
            PromptGuardRecommendation(
                id="rec-4",
                title="Increase validation simulations",
                description="No simulation activity is visible in the audit trail.",
                recommendation_type="audit_visibility",
                priority="medium",
                rationale="Without simulation evidence, policy quality and operator confidence are harder to validate.",
                suggested_action="Run prompt guard simulation tests against expected safe and unsafe prompt patterns.",
                metadata={"simulation_events": simulation_events},
            )
        )

    if not items:
        items.append(
            PromptGuardRecommendation(
                id="rec-5",
                title="Maintain current guard posture",
                description="Prompt guard posture looks healthy based on current policy and operational signals.",
                recommendation_type="operator_workflow",
                priority="low",
                rationale="No immediate gaps were detected in policy mode, review queue, allowlist activity, or audit visibility.",
                suggested_action="Continue monitoring trends and keep policy reviews in the normal operating cadence.",
                metadata={},
            )
        )

    return PromptGuardRecommendationsView(
        title="Groq Prompt Guard Recommendations",
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "policy_mode": policy.mode,
            "policy_health": policy.health,
            "recommendation_count": len(items),
        },
    )


@router.get("/prompt-guard/recommendations", response_model=PromptGuardRecommendationsResponse)
def get_prompt_guard_recommendations() -> PromptGuardRecommendationsResponse:
    view = build_prompt_guard_recommendations_view()
    data = view.to_dict()

    return PromptGuardRecommendationsResponse(
        title=data["title"],
        generated_at=data["generated_at"],
        items=[PromptGuardRecommendationView(**item) for item in data["items"]],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )
