def build_integration_detail_view(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    strict_verification: bool = False,
) -> IntegrationDetailView:
    record = get_integration(registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    manifest = build_adapter_manifest(record)
    manifest_summary = summarize_adapter_manifest(manifest)

    verification = verify_integration(
        registry,
        integration_id,
        strict=strict_verification,
        requested_by="ui-detail",
    )
    verification_summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

    platform_profile = get_platform_profile(record.platform)
    platform_data = platform_profile.to_dict() if platform_profile is not None else {
        "platform": record.platform,
        "display_name": record.platform,
        "install_mode": "unknown",
        "capabilities": [],
        "metadata": {},
        "checked_at": None,
    }

    sections = [
        IntegrationDetailSection(
            title="Overview",
            data={
                "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                "name": record.name,
                "slug": record.slug,
                "description": record.description,
                "integration_type": record.integration_type,
                "status": record.status,
                "version": record.version,
                "command_name": record.command_name,
                "entrypoint": record.entrypoint,
                "install_target": record.install_target,
            },
        ),
        IntegrationDetailSection(
            title="Capabilities",
            data={
                "enabled": [
                    capability.to_dict()
                    for capability in record.capabilities
                    if capability.enabled
                ],
                "disabled": [
                    capability.to_dict()
                    for capability in record.capabilities
                    if not capability.enabled
                ],
            },
        ),
        IntegrationDetailSection(
            title="Manifest",
            data={
                "summary": manifest_summary,
                "full": manifest.to_dict(),
            },
        ),
        IntegrationDetailSection(
            title="Verification",
            data={
                "summary": verification_summary,
                "full": verification.to_dict(),
            },
        ),
        IntegrationDetailSection(
            title="Platform",
            data=platform_data,
        ),
        IntegrationDetailSection(
            title="Metadata",
            data=dict(record.metadata),
        ),
    ]

    return IntegrationDetailView(
        integration_id=record.integration_id,
        slug=record.slug,
        title=record.name,
        status=record.status,
        platform=record.platform,
        version=record.version,
        sections=sections,
        metadata={
            "strict_verification": strict_verification,
        },
    )

    endpoint: str | None
    base_url: str | None
    command_name: str | None

    endpoint_kind: str
    is_configured: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "endpoint": self.endpoint,
            "base_url": self.base_url,
            "command_name": self.command_name,

            "endpoint_kind": self.endpoint_kind,
            "is_configured": self.is_configured,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationEndpointsView:
    title: str
    total: int
    configured_count: int
    local_count: int
    remote_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationEndpointItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "configured_count": self.configured_count,
            "local_count": self.local_count,
            "remote_count": self.remote_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _endpoint_kind(endpoint: str | None, base_url: str | None) -> str:
    value = endpoint or base_url or ""
    normalized = value.strip().lower()

    if not normalized:
        return "none"
    if normalized.startswith("local://"):
        return "local"
    if normalized.startswith("http://") or normalized.startswith("https://"):
        return "remote"
    return "custom"


def build_integration_endpoints_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-endpoints",
) -> IntegrationEndpointsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationEndpointItem] = []
    configured_count = 0
    local_count = 0
    remote_count = 0

    for record in records:
        endpoint = getattr(record, "endpoint", None)
        base_url = getattr(record, "base_url", None)
        endpoint_kind = _endpoint_kind(endpoint, base_url)
        is_configured = bool(endpoint or base_url)

        if is_configured:
            configured_count += 1
        if endpoint_kind == "local":
            local_count += 1
        elif endpoint_kind == "remote":
            remote_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationEndpointItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                endpoint=endpoint,
                base_url=base_url,
                command_name=getattr(record, "command_name", None),
                install_target=getattr(record, "install_target", None),
                endpoint_kind=endpoint_kind,
                is_configured=is_configured,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.endpoint_kind == "remote"
            else 1 if item.endpoint_kind == "local"
            else 2 if item.endpoint_kind == "custom"
            else 3,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationEndpointsView(
        title="Integration Endpoints",
        total=len(items),
        configured_count=configured_count,
        local_count=local_count,
        remote_count=remote_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)


def _normalize(value: str | None, default: str = "unknown") -> str:
    if not value:
        return default
    normalized = value.strip().lower()
    return normalized or default


def _normalize_tags(raw: Any) -> list[str]:
    if not raw:
        return []
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        for key in ("tags", "labels"):
            value = raw.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
                return sorted({str(tag).strip() for tag in value if str(tag).strip()})
        return sorted({str(value).strip() for value in raw.values() if str(value).strip()})
    if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple, set)):
        return sorted({str(tag).strip() for tag in raw if str(tag).strip()})
    return [str(raw).strip()] if str(raw).strip() else []


@dataclass(slots=True)
class FilterOption:
    value: str
    label: str
    count: int
    active_count: int = 0
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "value": self.value,
            "label": self.label,
            "count": self.count,
            "active_count": self.active_count,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class FilterGroup:
    key: str
    title: str
    multi_select: bool
    options: list[FilterOption] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "title": self.title,
            "multi_select": self.multi_select,
            "options": [option.to_dict() for option in self.options],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationFilterPreset:
    key: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "title": self.title,
            "filters": {key: list(values) for key, values in self.filters.items()},
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationFiltersView:
    title: str
    total_integrations: int
    filter_group_count: int
    preset_count: int
    groups: list[FilterGroup] = field(default_factory=list)
    presets: list[IntegrationFilterPreset] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total_integrations": self.total_integrations,
            "filter_group_count": self.filter_group_count,
            "preset_count": self.preset_count,
            "groups": [group.to_dict() for group in self.groups],
            "presets": [preset.to_dict() for preset in self.presets],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _build_option_map() -> dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, int]]]:
    return {
        "platform": {},
        "status": {},
        "integration_type": {},
        "tags": {},
        "command_ready": {},
    }


def _touch_option(
    bucket: dict[str, dict[str, int]],
    *,
    value: str,
    is_active: bool,
) -> None:
    current = bucket.setdefault(value, {"count": 0, "active_count": 0})
    current["count"] += 1
    if is_active:
        current["active_count"] += 1


def _build_group(
    *,
    key: str,
    title: str,
    multi_select: bool,
    bucket: dict[str, dict[str, int]],
) -> FilterGroup:
    options = [
        FilterOption(
            value=value,
            label=value.replace("_", " ").title(),
            count=counts["count"],
            active_count=counts["active_count"],
        )
        for value, counts in bucket.items()
        if counts["count"] > 0
    ]
    options.sort(key=lambda option: (-option.count, option.label.lower()))

    return FilterGroup(
        key=key,
        title=title,
        multi_select=multi_select,
        options=options,
        metadata={
            "option_count": len(options),
        },
    )


def build_integration_filters_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-filters",
) -> IntegrationFiltersView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)
    option_map = _build_option_map()

    for record in records:
        status = _normalize(getattr(record, "status", None))
        platform = _normalize(getattr(record, "platform", None))
        integration_type = _normalize(getattr(record, "integration_type", None))
        is_active = status in {"active", "enabled"}
        command_ready = "yes" if bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None)) else "no"

        _touch_option(option_map["platform"], value=platform, is_active=is_active)
        _touch_option(option_map["status"], value=status, is_active=is_active)
        _touch_option(
            option_map["integration_type"],
            value=integration_type,
            is_active=is_active,
        )
        _touch_option(
            option_map["command_ready"],
            value=command_ready,
            is_active=is_active,
        )

        record_metadata = dict(getattr(record, "metadata", {}) or {})
        tags = _normalize_tags(record_metadata.get("tags") or record_metadata.get("labels"))
        for tag in tags:
            _touch_option(option_map["tags"], value=tag, is_active=is_active)

    groups = [
        _build_group(
            key="platform",
            title="Platform",
            multi_select=True,
            bucket=option_map["platform"],
        ),
        _build_group(
            key="status",
            title="Status",
            multi_select=True,
            bucket=option_map["status"],
        ),
        _build_group(
            key="integration_type",
            title="Integration Type",
            multi_select=True,
            bucket=option_map["integration_type"],
        ),
        _build_group(
            key="tags",
            title="Tags",
            multi_select=True,
            bucket=option_map["tags"],
        ),
        _build_group(
            key="command_ready",
            title="Command Ready",
            multi_select=False,
            bucket=option_map["command_ready"],
        ),
    ]

    presets = [
        IntegrationFilterPreset(
            key="active_only",
            title="Active Only",
            filters={"status": ["active"]},
        ),
        IntegrationFilterPreset(
            key="ready_to_run",
            title="Ready To Run",
            filters={
                "status": ["active"],
                "command_ready": ["yes"],
            },
        ),
        IntegrationFilterPreset(
            key="planned_work",
            title="Planned Work",
            filters={"status": ["planned", "draft"]},
        ),
    ]

    return IntegrationFiltersView(
        title="Integration Filters",
        total_integrations=len(records),
        filter_group_count=len(groups),
        preset_count=len(presets),
        groups=groups,
        presets=presets,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations


from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


def _clean_text(value: Any, *, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _safe_int(value: Any, *, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _record_status(record: Any) -> str:
    return _clean_text(getattr(record, "status", None), default="unknown").lower()


def _record_platform(record: Any) -> str:
    return _clean_text(getattr(record, "platform", None), default="unknown")


def _record_slug(record: Any) -> str:
    return _clean_text(getattr(record, "slug", None), default="unknown")


def _record_name(record: Any) -> str:
    return _clean_text(getattr(record, "name", None), default="Unnamed Integration")


def _record_id(record: Any) -> str:
    return _clean_text(getattr(record, "integration_id", None), default="unknown")


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationGovernanceItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    verified: bool
    lifecycle_state: str
    control_state: str
    governance_score: int
    governance_state: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "lifecycle_state": self.lifecycle_state,
            "control_state": self.control_state,
            "governance_score": self.governance_score,
            "governance_state": self.governance_state,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationGovernanceView:
    title: str
    total: int
    governed_count: int
    partial_count: int
    at_risk_count: int
    verified_count: int
    enforced_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationGovernanceItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "governed_count": self.governed_count,
            "partial_count": self.partial_count,
            "at_risk_count": self.at_risk_count,
            "verified_count": self.verified_count,
            "enforced_count": self.enforced_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _lifecycle_state(status: str) -> str:
    normalized = _clean_text(status, default="unknown").lower()
    if normalized in {"planned", "draft", "review"}:
        return "draft"
    if normalized in {"disabled", "inactive", "retired", "archived"}:
        return "retired"
    if normalized in {"unknown"}:
        return "unknown"
    return "active"


def _control_state(
    *,
    verified: bool,
    command_ready: bool,
    install_ready: bool,
    endpoint_ready: bool,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0:
        return "at-risk"

    enabled_count = sum(
        (
            verified,
            command_ready,
            install_ready,
            endpoint_ready,
        )
    )
    if enabled_count >= 4:
        return "enforced"
    if enabled_count >= 2:
        return "partial"
    return "minimal"


def _governance_score(
    *,
    lifecycle_state: str,
    verified: bool,
    command_ready: bool,
    install_ready: bool,
    endpoint_ready: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0

    if lifecycle_state == "active":
        score += 20
    elif lifecycle_state == "draft":
        score += 10

    if verified:
        score += 30
    if command_ready:
        score += 15
    if install_ready:
        score += 15
    if endpoint_ready:
        score += 10

    score -= min(warn_count * 3, 15)
    score -= min(fail_count * 20, 60)

    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def _governance_state(score: int) -> str:
    if score >= 75:
        return "governed"
    if score >= 45:
        return "partial"
    return "at-risk"


def build_integration_governance_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-governance",
) -> IntegrationGovernanceView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationGovernanceItem] = []
    governed_count = 0
    partial_count = 0
    at_risk_count = 0
    verified_count = 0
    enforced_count = 0

    for record in records:
        integration_id = _record_id(record)

        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            integration_id,
            strict=True,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = dict(summarize_verification_result(verification) or {})

        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", False))
        checked_at = _clean_text(summary.get("checked_at"))
        pass_count = _safe_int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = _safe_int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = _safe_int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))

        status = _record_status(record)
        lifecycle_state = _lifecycle_state(status)
        command_ready = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        install_ready = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))
        endpoint_ready = bool(
            getattr(record, "endpoint", None) or getattr(record, "base_url", None)
        )

        control_state = _control_state(
            verified=verified,
            command_ready=command_ready,
            install_ready=install_ready,
            endpoint_ready=endpoint_ready,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )

        score = _governance_score(
            lifecycle_state=lifecycle_state,
            verified=verified,
            command_ready=command_ready,
            install_ready=install_ready,
            endpoint_ready=endpoint_ready,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )
        state = _governance_state(score)

        if verified:
            verified_count += 1
        if control_state == "enforced":
            enforced_count += 1

        if state == "governed":
            governed_count += 1
        elif state == "partial":
            partial_count += 1
        else:
            at_risk_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationGovernanceItem(
                integration_id=integration_id,
                slug=_record_slug(record),
                name=_record_name(record),
                platform=_record_platform(record),
                status=status,
                verified=verified,
                lifecycle_state=lifecycle_state,
                control_state=control_state,
                governance_score=score,
                governance_state=state,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "checked_at": checked_at,
                    "pass_count": pass_count,
                    "warn_count": warn_count,
                    "fail_count": fail_count,
                    "verification_summary": summary,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0
            if item.governance_state == "at-risk"
            else 1
            if item.governance_state == "partial"
            else 2,
            -item.governance_score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationGovernanceView(
        title="Integration Governance",
        total=len(items),
        governed_count=governed_count,
        partial_count=partial_count,
        at_risk_count=at_risk_count,
        verified_count=verified_count,
        enforced_count=enforced_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,

    healthy_count: int

    failing_count: int

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

            "total": self.total,

        }


def build_integration_health_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    strict: bool = False,
    requested_by: str = "ui-health",
) -> IntegrationHealthView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationHealthItem] = []
    healthy_count = 0
    warning_count = 0
    failing_count = 0

    for record in records:
        result = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=strict,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(result)

        pass_count = int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))
        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", fail_count == 0))
        checked_at = str(summary.get("checked_at", ""))

        if fail_count > 0:
            failing_count += 1
        elif warn_count > 0:
            warning_count += 1
        else:
            healthy_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationHealthItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                verified=verified,
                pass_count=pass_count,
                warn_count=warn_count,
                fail_count=fail_count,
                checked_at=checked_at,
                metadata={
                    "strict": strict,
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda item: (item.fail_count == 0, item.warn_count == 0, item.platform, item.slug))

    return IntegrationHealthView(
        title="Integration Health",
        total=len(items),
        healthy_count=healthy_count,
        warning_count=warning_count,
        failing_count=failing_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "strict": strict,
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.incident_store import (
    IncidentStore,
    list_incidents,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)

_ACTIVE_STATUSES = {"open", "acknowledged", "investigating"}
_CRITICAL_SEVERITIES = {"critical", "crit", "sev0", "sev1"}
_HIGH_SEVERITIES = {"high", "sev2"}
_BREACHED_SLA_STATES = {"breached", "overdue"}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationIncidentItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    incident_count: int
    open_incident_count: int
    critical_incident_count: int
    high_incident_count: int
    breached_sla_count: int
    last_incident_at: str | None
    health: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "incident_count": self.incident_count,
            "open_incident_count": self.open_incident_count,
            "critical_incident_count": self.critical_incident_count,
            "high_incident_count": self.high_incident_count,
            "breached_sla_count": self.breached_sla_count,
            "last_incident_at": self.last_incident_at,
            "health": self.health,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationIncidentsView:
    title: str
    total: int
    impacted_count: int
    critical_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationIncidentItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "impacted_count": self.impacted_count,
            "critical_count": self.critical_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _normalize_status(value: str | None) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "unknown"
    return value.strip().lower()


def _normalize_severity(value: str | None) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "unknown"
    raw = value.strip().lower()
    if raw in _CRITICAL_SEVERITIES:
        return "critical"
    if raw in _HIGH_SEVERITIES:
        return "high"
    if raw in {"medium", "med", "sev3"}:
        return "medium"
    if raw in {"low", "sev4"}:
        return "low"
    return raw


def _integration_key(incident: Any) -> str | None:
    for attr in ("integration_id", "source_integration_id"):
        value = getattr(incident, attr, None)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return None


def _incident_timestamp(incident: Any) -> str | None:
    for attr in ("updated_at", "opened_at", "created_at"):
        value = getattr(incident, attr, None)
        if value is None:
            continue
        if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
            return value.isoformat()
        return str(value)
    return None


def _sla_state(incident: Any) -> str:
    for attr in ("sla_state", "sla_status"):
        value = getattr(incident, attr, None)
        if value:
            return str(value).strip().lower()
    return "unknown"


def _health_for_counts(
    *,
    open_incident_count: int,
    critical_incident_count: int,
    breached_sla_count: int,
) -> str:
    if critical_incident_count > 0 or breached_sla_count > 0:
        return "critical"
    if open_incident_count > 0:
        return "degraded"
    return "healthy"


def build_integration_incidents_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    incident_store: IncidentStore,
    requested_by: str = "ui-integrations-incidents",
) -> IntegrationIncidentsView:
    integrations = list_integrations(registry)
    incidents = list_incidents(incident_store)

    incident_map: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
    for incident in incidents:
        key = _integration_key(incident)
        if not key:
            continue
        incident_map.setdefault(key, []).append(incident)

    items: list[IntegrationIncidentItem] = []
    impacted_count = 0
    critical_count = 0

    for integration in integrations:
        linked_incidents = incident_map.get(integration.integration_id, [])

        open_incident_count = 0
        critical_incident_count = 0
        high_incident_count = 0
        breached_sla_count = 0
        last_incident_at: str | None = None

        for incident in linked_incidents:
            status = _normalize_status(getattr(incident, "status", None))
            severity = _normalize_severity(getattr(incident, "severity", None))
            sla_state = _sla_state(incident)
            timestamp = _incident_timestamp(incident)

            if status in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
                open_incident_count += 1
            if severity == "critical":
                critical_incident_count += 1
            elif severity == "high":
                high_incident_count += 1
            if sla_state in _BREACHED_SLA_STATES:
                breached_sla_count += 1
            if timestamp and (last_incident_at is None or timestamp > last_incident_at):
                last_incident_at = timestamp

        health = _health_for_counts(
            open_incident_count=open_incident_count,
            critical_incident_count=critical_incident_count,
            breached_sla_count=breached_sla_count,
        )

        if incident_count := len(linked_incidents):
            impacted_count += 1
        if critical_incident_count > 0 or breached_sla_count > 0:
            critical_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationIncidentItem(
                integration_id=integration.integration_id,
                slug=integration.slug,
                name=integration.name,
                platform=integration.platform,
                status=integration.status,
                incident_count=incident_count,
                open_incident_count=open_incident_count,
                critical_incident_count=critical_incident_count,
                high_incident_count=high_incident_count,
                breached_sla_count=breached_sla_count,
                last_incident_at=last_incident_at,
                health=health,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.health == "critical" else 1 if item.health == "degraded" else 2,
            -item.open_incident_count,
            -item.critical_incident_count,
            item.slug,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationIncidentsView(
        title="Integration Incidents",
        total=len(items),
        impacted_count=impacted_count,
        critical_count=critical_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from app.services.integration_installer import (

@dataclass(slots=True)

@dataclass(slots=True)

    integration_id: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    version: str
    command_name: str | None
    install_target: str | None
    description: str

            "name": self.name,

            "status": self.status,
            "version": self.version,
            "command_name": self.command_name,
            "install_target": self.install_target,
            "description": self.description,
            "one_command_ready": self.one_command_ready,
            "capabilities": list(self.capabilities),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationInstallerView:
    title: str
    total: int
    ready_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationInstallerCard] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

        return {
            "title": self.title,

def build_integration_installer_card(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
) -> IntegrationInstallerCard:
    record = get_integration(registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    enabled_capabilities = [
        capability.name
        for capability in record.capabilities
        if capability.enabled
    ]

    return IntegrationInstallerCard(
        integration_id=record.integration_id,
        name=record.name,
        slug=record.slug,
        platform=record.platform,
        status=record.status,
        version=record.version,
        command_name=record.command_name,
        install_target=record.install_target,
        description=record.description,
        one_command_ready=bool(record.command_name),
        capabilities=enabled_capabilities,
        metadata=dict(record.metadata),
    )


def build_integration_installer_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> IntegrationInstallerView:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()
    records = list_integrations(active_registry)

    cards = [
        build_integration_installer_card(
            record.integration_id,
            registry=active_registry,
        )
        for record in records
    ]

    ready_count = sum(1 for card in cards if card.one_command_ready)

    return IntegrationInstallerView(
        title="Integration Installer",
        total=len(cards),
        ready_count=ready_count,
        items=cards,
        metadata={
            "created_at": active_registry.created_at,
            "updated_at": active_registry.updated_at,
        },
    )


def execute_integration_installer_action(
    action: IntegrationInstallerAction,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    result = install_integration(
        active_registry,
        action.integration_id,
        dry_run=action.dry_run,
        requested_by=action.requested_by,
        install_target=action.install_target,
        extra_metadata=dict(action.extra_metadata),
    )
    summary = summarize_install_result(result)

    return {
        "action": action.to_dict(),
        "result": dict(summary),
    }

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationInventoryItem:

    status: str
    version: str
    integration_type: str
    command_name: str | None
    install_target: str | None
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "version": self.version,
            "integration_type": self.integration_type,
            "command_name": self.command_name,
            "install_target": self.install_target,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationInventoryView:
    title: str
    total: int
    active_count: int
    planned_count: int
    disabled_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationInventoryItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "active_count": self.active_count,
            "planned_count": self.planned_count,
            "disabled_count": self.disabled_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _status_bucket(status: str | None) -> str:
    value = (status or "").strip().lower()
    if value in {"active", "enabled"}:
        return "active"
    if value in {"planned", "draft"}:
        return "planned"
    if value in {"disabled", "inactive"}:
        return "disabled"
    return "unknown"


def build_integration_inventory_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-inventory",
) -> IntegrationInventoryView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationInventoryItem] = []
    active_count = 0
    planned_count = 0
    disabled_count = 0

    for record in records:
        bucket = _status_bucket(getattr(record, "status", None))
        if bucket == "active":
            active_count += 1
        elif bucket == "planned":
            planned_count += 1
        elif bucket == "disabled":
            disabled_count += 1

        tags: list[str] = []
        integration_type = getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown") or "unknown"
        tags.append(f"type:{integration_type}")
        if getattr(record, "command_name", None):
            tags.append("one-command")
        if getattr(record, "install_target", None):
            tags.append("installable")

        items.append(
            IntegrationInventoryItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                integration_type=integration_type,
                command_name=getattr(record, "command_name", None),
                install_target=getattr(record, "install_target", None),
                tags=tags,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if _status_bucket(item.status) == "active"
            else 1 if _status_bucket(item.status) == "planned"
            else 2 if _status_bucket(item.status) == "disabled"
            else 3,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationInventoryView(
        title="Integration Inventory",
        total=len(items),
        active_count=active_count,
        planned_count=planned_count,
        disabled_count=disabled_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationLifecycleItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    version: str
    integration_type: str
    phase: str
    verified: bool
    checked_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "version": self.version,
            "integration_type": self.integration_type,
            "phase": self.phase,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "checked_at": self.checked_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationLifecycleView:
    title: str
    total: int
    draft_count: int
    rollout_count: int
    live_count: int
    retired_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationLifecycleItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "draft_count": self.draft_count,
            "rollout_count": self.rollout_count,
            "live_count": self.live_count,
            "retired_count": self.retired_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _phase_for_record(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    command_ready: bool,
    install_ready: bool,
) -> str:
    normalized = (status or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized in {"disabled", "inactive", "retired"}:
        return "retired"
    if normalized in {"planned", "draft"}:
        return "draft"
    if normalized == "active" and verified and command_ready and install_ready:
        return "live"
    return "rollout"


def _phase_rank(phase: str) -> int:
    if phase == "draft":
        return 0
    if phase == "rollout":
        return 1
    if phase == "live":
        return 2
    if phase == "retired":
        return 3
    return 4


def build_integration_lifecycle_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-lifecycle",
) -> IntegrationLifecycleView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationLifecycleItem] = []
    draft_count = 0
    rollout_count = 0
    live_count = 0
    retired_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", False))
        checked_at = str(summary.get("checked_at", ""))
        pass_count = int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))

        phase = _phase_for_record(
            status=getattr(record, "status", ""),
            verified=verified,
            command_ready=bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None)),
            install_ready=bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None)),
        )

        if phase == "draft":
            draft_count += 1
        elif phase == "rollout":
            rollout_count += 1
        elif phase == "live":
            live_count += 1
        elif phase == "retired":
            retired_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationLifecycleItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                integration_type=getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown"),
                phase=phase,
                verified=verified,
                checked_at=checked_at,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "pass_count": pass_count,
                    "warn_count": warn_count,
                    "fail_count": fail_count,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            _phase_rank(item.phase),
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationLifecycleView(
        title="Integration Lifecycle",
        total=len(items),
        draft_count=draft_count,
        rollout_count=rollout_count,
        live_count=live_count,
        retired_count=retired_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(slots=True)

    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str

            "slug": self.slug,

            "compatibility_score": self.compatibility_score,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationMatrixView:
    title: str
    total: int
    high_compatibility_count: int
    medium_compatibility_count: int
    low_compatibility_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationMatrixItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "high_compatibility_count": self.high_compatibility_count,
            "medium_compatibility_count": self.medium_compatibility_count,
            "low_compatibility_count": self.low_compatibility_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),

def _build_adapter_for_integration(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
) -> BaseIntegrationAdapter | None:
    record = get_integration(registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        return None

    if record.slug == "generic-agent":
        return GenericAgentAdapter(record=record)
    if record.slug == "openclaw":
        return McpToolAdapter(record=record)
    if record.slug == "claude-code":
        return GenericAgentAdapter(record=record, runtime="claude-code")

    return BaseIntegrationAdapter(record=record)


def _compatibility_score(
    *,
    status: str,
    supports_install: bool,
    supports_endpoint: bool,
    supports_actions: bool,
    supports_capabilities: bool,
    action_count: int,
    capability_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0

    if status == "active":
        score += 20
    elif status in {"planned", "draft"}:
        score += 10

    if supports_install:
        score += 20
    if supports_endpoint:
        score += 20
    if supports_actions:
        score += 20
    if supports_capabilities:
        score += 10

    score += min(action_count * 2, 5)
    score += min(capability_count, 5)

    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def build_integration_matrix_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-matrix",
) -> IntegrationMatrixView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationMatrixItem] = []
    high_compatibility_count = 0
    medium_compatibility_count = 0
    low_compatibility_count = 0

    for record in records:
        adapter = _build_adapter_for_integration(
            record.integration_id,
            registry=registry,
        )
        if adapter is None:
            continue

        handshake = adapter.handshake()
        capabilities = list(handshake.capabilities)

        supported_action_types: list[str] = []
        supported_action_types_method = getattr(adapter, "supported_action_types", None)
        if callable(supported_action_types_method):
            supported_action_types = list(supported_action_types_method())

        supports_install = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))
        supports_endpoint = bool(
            getattr(record, "endpoint", None) or getattr(record, "base_url", None)
        )
        supports_actions = len(supported_action_types) > 0
        supports_capabilities = len(capabilities) > 0

        score = _compatibility_score(
            status=record.status,
            supports_install=supports_install,
            supports_endpoint=supports_endpoint,
            supports_actions=supports_actions,
            supports_capabilities=supports_capabilities,
            action_count=len(supported_action_types),
            capability_count=len(capabilities),
        )

        if score >= 75:
            high_compatibility_count += 1
        elif score >= 45:
            medium_compatibility_count += 1
        else:
            low_compatibility_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationMatrixItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                protocol_version=adapter.protocol_version,
                supports_install=supports_install,
                supports_endpoint=supports_endpoint,
                supports_actions=supports_actions,
                supports_capabilities=supports_capabilities,
                supported_action_types=supported_action_types,
                capabilities=capabilities,
                compatibility_score=score,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "adapter_class": adapter.__class__.__name__,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -item.compatibility_score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationMatrixView(
        title="Integration Matrix",
        total=len(items),
        high_compatibility_count=high_compatibility_count,
        medium_compatibility_count=medium_compatibility_count,
        low_compatibility_count=low_compatibility_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


def _normalize_status(value: str | None) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "unknown"
    return value.strip().lower()


def _lifecycle_stage(status: str) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize_status(status)
    if normalized in {"planned", "draft"}:
        return "planned"
    if normalized in {"active", "enabled"}:
        return "active"
    if normalized in {"disabled", "inactive"}:
        return "deprecated"
    if normalized in {"retired"}:
        return "retired"
    return "unknown"


def _maturity_score(
    *,
    lifecycle_stage: str,
    verified: bool,
    has_command: bool,
    has_install_target: bool,
    has_endpoint: bool,
    pass_count: int,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0

    # Lifecycle contribution.
    if lifecycle_stage == "active":
        score += 20
    elif lifecycle_stage == "planned":
        score += 10
    elif lifecycle_stage == "deprecated":
        score += 5

    # Capability / readiness.
    if verified:
        score += 25
    if has_command:
        score += 20
    if has_install_target:
        score += 15
    if has_endpoint:
        score += 10

    # Verification outcomes.
    score += min(pass_count * 1, 10)
    score -= min(warn_count * 2, 10)
    score -= min(fail_count * 10, 40)

    # Clamp between 0 and 100.
    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def _maturity_level(score: int) -> str:
    if score >= 80:
        return "optimized"
    if score >= 60:
        return "managed"
    if score >= 40:
        return "defined"
    if score >= 20:
        return "emerging"
    return "ad-hoc"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationMaturityItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    lifecycle_stage: str
    maturity_score: int
    maturity_level: str
    verified: bool
    has_command: bool
    has_install_target: bool
    has_endpoint: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "lifecycle_stage": self.lifecycle_stage,
            "maturity_score": self.maturity_score,
            "maturity_level": self.maturity_level,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "has_command": self.has_command,
            "has_install_target": self.has_install_target,
            "has_endpoint": self.has_endpoint,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationMaturityView:
    title: str
    total: int
    optimized_count: int
    managed_count: int
    defined_count: int
    emerging_count: int
    ad_hoc_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationMaturityItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "optimized_count": self.optimized_count,
            "managed_count": self.managed_count,
            "defined_count": self.defined_count,
            "emerging_count": self.emerging_count,
            "ad_hoc_count": self.ad_hoc_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def build_integration_maturity_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-maturity",
) -> IntegrationMaturityView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationMaturityItem] = []
    optimized_count = 0
    managed_count = 0
    defined_count = 0
    emerging_count = 0
    ad_hoc_count = 0

    for record in records:
        status = getattr(record, "status", "unknown")
        lifecycle_stage = _lifecycle_stage(status)

        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", False))
        pass_count = int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))

        has_command = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        has_install_target = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))
        has_endpoint = bool(
            getattr(record, "endpoint", None) or getattr(record, "base_url", None)
        )

        score = _maturity_score(
            lifecycle_stage=lifecycle_stage,
            verified=verified,
            has_command=has_command,
            has_install_target=has_install_target,
            has_endpoint=has_endpoint,
            pass_count=pass_count,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )
        level = _maturity_level(score)

        if level == "optimized":
            optimized_count += 1
        elif level == "managed":
            managed_count += 1
        elif level == "defined":
            defined_count += 1
        elif level == "emerging":
            emerging_count += 1
        else:
            ad_hoc_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationMaturityItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=status,
                lifecycle_stage=lifecycle_stage,
                maturity_score=score,
                maturity_level=level,
                verified=verified,
                has_command=has_command,
                has_install_target=has_install_target,
                has_endpoint=has_endpoint,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "integration_type": getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown"),
                    "pass_count": pass_count,
                    "warn_count": warn_count,
                    "fail_count": fail_count,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0
            if item.maturity_level in {"ad-hoc", "emerging"}
            else 1
            if item.maturity_level == "defined"
            else 2
            if item.maturity_level == "managed"
            else 3,
            -item.maturity_score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationMaturityView(
        title="Integration Maturity",
        total=len(items),
        optimized_count=optimized_count,
        managed_count=managed_count,
        defined_count=defined_count,
        emerging_count=emerging_count,
        ad_hoc_count=ad_hoc_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

    generated_at: str
    total: int
    active_count: int
    degraded_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationMetricView] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _is_active_status(status: str | None) -> bool:
    if not status:
        return False
    return status.lower() in {"active", "enabled"}


def _count_incidents_for_integration(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    incident_store: IncidentStore,
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    open_count = 0
    critical_count = 0

    incidents = list_incidents(incident_store)
    for incident in incidents:
        incident_integration_id = getattr(incident, "integration_id", None)
        if incident_integration_id != integration_id:
            continue

        status = str(getattr(incident, "status", "")).lower()
        severity = str(getattr(incident, "severity", "")).lower()

        if status in {"open", "acknowledged", "investigating"}:
            open_count += 1

        if severity in {"critical", "crit", "sev0", "sev1"}:
            critical_count += 1

    return open_count, critical_count


def _build_metric_snapshot(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    metrics_store: MetricsStore,
    incident_store: IncidentStore,
) -> list[IntegrationMetricSnapshot]:
    integrations = list_integrations(registry)

    snapshots: list[IntegrationMetricSnapshot] = []
    for record in integrations:
        latency = get_integration_latency_summary(metrics_store, record.integration_id)
        throughput = get_integration_throughput_summary(metrics_store, record.integration_id)
        open_incidents, critical_incidents = _count_incidents_for_integration(
            integration_id=record.integration_id,
            incident_store=incident_store,
        )

        snapshots.append(
            IntegrationMetricSnapshot(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=getattr(record, "status", "unknown"),
                request_count_1m=throughput.requests_1m,
                request_count_1h=throughput.requests_1h,
                request_count_24h=throughput.requests_24h,
                error_count_1m=throughput.errors_1m,
                error_count_1h=throughput.errors_1h,
                error_count_24h=throughput.errors_24h,
                p50_latency_ms=latency.p50_ms,
                p95_latency_ms=latency.p95_ms,
                p99_latency_ms=latency.p99_ms,
                open_incident_count=open_incidents,
                critical_incident_count=critical_incidents,
                metadata={
                    "rate_window_seconds": throughput.window_seconds,
                },
            )
        )

    return snapshots


def _snapshot_to_view(snapshot: IntegrationMetricSnapshot) -> IntegrationMetricView:
    return IntegrationMetricView(**snapshot.to_dict())


@router.get("/metrics", response_model=IntegrationMetricsResponse)
def get_integration_metrics() -> IntegrationMetricsResponse:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    metrics_store = MetricsStore.current()
    incident_store = IncidentStore.current()

    snapshots = _build_metric_snapshot(
        registry=registry,
        metrics_store=metrics_store,
        incident_store=incident_store,
    )

    active_count = sum(
        1 for snap in snapshots if _is_active_status(snap.status)
    )
    degraded_count = sum(
        1
        for snap in snapshots
        if snap.critical_incident_count > 0 or snap.error_count_1h > 0
    )

    snapshots.sort(
        key=lambda s: (
            -s.critical_incident_count,
            -s.error_count_1h,
            -s.request_count_1h,
            s.slug,
        )
    )

    items = [_snapshot_to_view(s) for s in snapshots]

    return IntegrationMetricsResponse(
        generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        total=len(items),
        active_count=active_count,
        degraded_count=degraded_count,
        items=items,
    )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationObservabilityItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str

    request_rate_1m: float
    error_rate_1m: float
    p95_latency_ms: float

    open_incident_count: int
    recent_incident_summaries: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    last_activity_at: str | None = None
    observability_score: int = 0

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "request_rate_1m": self.request_rate_1m,
            "error_rate_1m": self.error_rate_1m,
            "p95_latency_ms": self.p95_latency_ms,
            "open_incident_count": self.open_incident_count,
            "recent_incident_summaries": list(self.recent_incident_summaries),
            "last_activity_at": self.last_activity_at,
            "observability_score": self.observability_score,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationObservabilityView:
    title: str
    generated_at: str
    total: int
    active_count: int
    degraded_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationObservabilityItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "generated_at": self.generated_at,
            "total": self.total,
            "active_count": self.active_count,
            "degraded_count": self.degraded_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _is_active_status(value: str | None) -> bool:
    if not value:
        return False
    return value.strip().lower() in {"active", "enabled"}


def _observability_score(
    *,
    request_rate_1m: float,
    error_rate_1m: float,
    p95_latency_ms: float,
    open_incident_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 100

    # Penalize high error rates.
    if error_rate_1m > 0:
        score -= min(int(error_rate_1m * 50), 40)

    # Penalize high latency.
    if p95_latency_ms > 0:
        if p95_latency_ms > 2000:
            score -= 30
        elif p95_latency_ms > 1000:
            score -= 20
        elif p95_latency_ms > 500:
            score -= 10

    # Penalize open incidents.
    if open_incident_count > 0:
        score -= min(open_incident_count * 10, 40)

    # Clamp between 0 and 100.
    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def _index_incidents_by_integration(
    incident_store: IncidentStore,
) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
    incidents_by_integration: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
    for incident in list_incidents(incident_store):
        integration_id = getattr(incident, "integration_id", None)
        if not integration_id:
            continue
        incidents_by_integration.setdefault(integration_id, []).append(incident)

    # Sort each integration's incidents newest-first by created_at / updated_at.
    for integration_id, incidents in incidents_by_integration.items():
        incidents.sort(
            key=lambda inc: str(
                getattr(inc, "updated_at", getattr(inc, "created_at", ""))
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )

    return incidents_by_integration


def _summarize_recent_incidents(incidents: list[Any], limit: int = 3) -> list[str]:
    summaries: list[str] = []
    for incident in incidents[:limit]:
        status = str(getattr(incident, "status", "unknown")).lower()
        severity = str(getattr(incident, "severity", "unknown")).lower()
        title = str(getattr(incident, "title", "") or "").strip()
        if title:
            summaries.append(f"[{severity}/{status}] {title}")
        else:
            summaries.append(f"[{severity}/{status}] incident {getattr(incident, 'incident_id', 'unknown')}")
    return summaries


def build_integration_observability_view() -> IntegrationObservabilityView:
    registry: IntegrationRegistry = get_integration_registry()
    metrics_store = MetricsStore.current()
    incident_store = IncidentStore.current()

    integrations = list_integrations(registry)
    incidents_by_integration = _index_incidents_by_integration(incident_store)

    items: list[IntegrationObservabilityItem] = []
    active_count = 0
    degraded_count = 0

    for record in integrations:
        status = getattr(record, "status", "unknown")
        if _is_active_status(status):
            active_count += 1

        latency = get_integration_latency_summary(metrics_store, record.integration_id)
        throughput = get_integration_throughput_summary(metrics_store, record.integration_id)

        # Derive simple rates from the 1-minute window.
        request_rate_1m = float(getattr(throughput, "requests_1m", 0))
        error_rate_1m = float(getattr(throughput, "errors_1m", 0))

        p95_latency_ms = float(getattr(latency, "p95_ms", 0.0))

        integration_incidents = incidents_by_integration.get(record.integration_id, [])
        open_incident_count = sum(
            1
            for inc in integration_incidents
            if str(getattr(inc, "status", "")).lower()
            in {"open", "acknowledged", "investigating"}
        )

        if open_incident_count > 0 or error_rate_1m > 0 or p95_latency_ms > 1000:
            degraded_count += 1

        recent_incident_summaries = _summarize_recent_incidents(integration_incidents)

        last_activity_at = str(
            getattr(
                record,
                "updated_at",
                getattr(record, "created_at", ""),
            )
        )

        observability_score = _observability_score(
            request_rate_1m=request_rate_1m,
            error_rate_1m=error_rate_1m,
            p95_latency_ms=p95_latency_ms,
            open_incident_count=open_incident_count,
        )

        items.append(
            IntegrationObservabilityItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=status,
                request_rate_1m=request_rate_1m,
                error_rate_1m=error_rate_1m,
                p95_latency_ms=p95_latency_ms,
                open_incident_count=open_incident_count,
                recent_incident_summaries=recent_incident_summaries,
                last_activity_at=last_activity_at,
                observability_score=observability_score,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": "ui-observability",
                    "rate_window_seconds": getattr(throughput, "window_seconds", None),
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item.observability_score,
            -item.open_incident_count,
            -item.error_rate_1m,
            item.slug,
        ),
        reverse=True,
    )

    return IntegrationObservabilityView(
        title="Integration Observability",
        generated_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        total=len(items),
        active_count=active_count,
        degraded_count=degraded_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": "ui-observability",
        },
    )

    health: str

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationOverviewView:
    title: str
    total: int
    active_count: int
    verified_count: int
    healthy_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationOverviewItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "active_count": self.active_count,
            "verified_count": self.verified_count,
            "healthy_count": self.healthy_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _health_state(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    normalized = (status or "").strip().lower()
    if fail_count > 0:
        return "failing"
    if warn_count > 0 or not verified:
        return "warning"
    if normalized == "active":
        return "healthy"
    return "inactive"


def build_integration_overview_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-overview",
) -> IntegrationOverviewView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationOverviewItem] = []
    active_count = 0
    verified_count = 0
    healthy_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        normalized_status = (record.status or "").strip().lower()
        if normalized_status == "active":
            active_count += 1
        if summary["verified"]:
            verified_count += 1

        health = _health_state(
            status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
        )
        if health == "healthy":
            healthy_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationOverviewItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                verified=summary["verified"],
                health=health,
                command_ready=bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None)),
                install_ready=bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None)),
                endpoint_ready=bool(
                    getattr(record, "endpoint", None) or getattr(record, "base_url", None)
                ),
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "checked_at": summary["checked_at"],
                    "pass_count": summary["pass_count"],
                    "warn_count": summary["warn_count"],
                    "fail_count": summary["fail_count"],
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.health == "failing"
            else 1 if item.health == "warning"
            else 2 if item.health == "healthy"
            else 3,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationOverviewView(
        title="Integration Overview",
        total=len(items),
        active_count=active_count,
        verified_count=verified_count,
        healthy_count=healthy_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationPackageItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    platform: str
    version: str
    manifest_summary: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    bundle_summary: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "platform": self.platform,

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationPackagesView:
    title: str
    total: int
    items: list[IntegrationPackageItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def build_integration_packages_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-packages",
) -> IntegrationPackagesView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)
    keyset = initialize_policy_signing_keys()
    items: list[IntegrationPackageItem] = []

    for record in records:
        manifest = build_adapter_manifest(
            record,
            extra_metadata={"requested_by": requested_by},
        )
        manifest_summary = summarize_adapter_manifest(manifest)

        bundle = PolicyBundle(
            bundle_id=f"bundle-{record.slug}",
            version=record.version,
            created_at=manifest.generated_at,
            policies=[
                {
                    "type": "adapter_manifest",
                    "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                    "slug": record.slug,
                    "manifest": manifest.to_dict(),
                }
            ],
            metadata={
                "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                "slug": record.slug,
                "platform": record.platform,
                "requested_by": requested_by,
            },
        )
        signed_bundle = sign_policy_bundle(bundle, keyset)
        bundle_summary = summarize_signed_bundle(signed_bundle)

        items.append(
            IntegrationPackageItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                platform=record.platform,
                version=record.version,
                manifest_summary=manifest_summary,
                bundle_summary=bundle_summary,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "status": record.status,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda item: (item.platform, item.slug, item.integration_id))

    return IntegrationPackagesView(
        title="Integration Packages",
        total=len(items),
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

def _build_platform_integration_summary(
    platform: str,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
) -> PlatformIntegrationSummary:
    records = [
        record
        for record in list_integrations(registry)
        if record.platform.strip().lower() == platform.strip().lower()
    ]

    status_counts: dict[str, int] = {
        "active": 0,
        "planned": 0,
        "disabled": 0,
        "deprecated": 0,
    }
    capability_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for record in records:
        status_counts[record.status] = status_counts.get(record.status, 0) + 1
        for capability in record.capabilities:
            if capability.enabled:
                capability_counts[capability.name] = capability_counts.get(
                    capability.name, 0
                ) + 1

    if records:
        display_name = records[0].platform
        install_mode = records[0].install_target or "local"
    else:
        default_profiles = {p.platform: p for p in default_platform_profiles()}
        profile = default_profiles.get(platform)
        display_name = profile.display_name if profile else platform
        install_mode = profile.install_mode if profile else "unknown"

    return PlatformIntegrationSummary(
        platform=platform,
        display_name=display_name,
        install_mode=install_mode,
        integration_count=len(records),
        active_integrations=status_counts.get("active", 0),
        planned_integrations=status_counts.get("planned", 0),
        disabled_integrations=status_counts.get("disabled", 0),
        deprecated_integrations=status_counts.get("deprecated", 0),
        capabilities=capability_counts,
        metadata={},
    )


def build_platforms_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
) -> PlatformsView:
    profiles: list[PlatformProfile] = list_platform_profiles()
    registry_summary = summarize_integration_registry(registry)

    items: list[PlatformProfileItem] = []

    for profile in profiles:
        platform_summary = summarize_platform_profile(profile)
        integration_summary = _build_platform_integration_summary(
            profile.platform,
            registry=registry,
        )

        items.append(
            PlatformProfileItem(
                platform=profile.platform,
                display_name=profile.display_name,
                install_mode=profile.install_mode,
                capability_count=platform_summary["capability_count"],
                native_capabilities=platform_summary["native_capabilities"],
                partial_capabilities=platform_summary["partial_capabilities"],
                unsupported_capabilities=platform_summary["unsupported_capabilities"],
                integration_summary=integration_summary,
                profile=profile.to_dict(),
            )
        )

    # Ensure any platforms present in the registry but missing a profile still appear.
    known_platforms = {item.platform for item in items}
    for record in list_integrations(registry):
        if record.platform in known_platforms:
            continue
        integration_summary = _build_platform_integration_summary(
            record.platform,
            registry=registry,
        )
        items.append(
            PlatformProfileItem(
                platform=record.platform,
                display_name=record.platform,
                install_mode=record.install_target or "local",
                capability_count=0,
                native_capabilities=0,
                partial_capabilities=0,
                unsupported_capabilities=0,
                integration_summary=integration_summary,
                profile={
                    "platform": record.platform,
                    "display_name": record.platform,
                    "install_mode": record.install_target or "local",
                    "capabilities": [],
                    "metadata": {},
                    "checked_at": None,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda item: item.platform)

    return PlatformsView(
        title="Integration Platforms",
        total=len(items),
        items=items,
        registry_summary=registry_summary,
        metadata={},
    )
