from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.adapter_manifest import build_adapter_manifest
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.policy_bundle_signing import (
    PolicyBundle,
    initialize_policy_signing_keys,
    sign_policy_bundle,
    summarize_signed_bundle,
    verify_policy_bundle_signature,
)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationPolicyItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    platform: str
    version: str
    policy_count: int
    status: str
    signature_status: str
    bundle_summary: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    verification: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "version": self.version,
            "policy_count": self.policy_count,
            "status": self.status,
            "signature_status": self.signature_status,
            "bundle_summary": dict(self.bundle_summary),
            "verification": dict(self.verification),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationPoliciesView:
    title: str
    total: int
    valid_bundle_count: int
    invalid_bundle_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationPolicyItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "valid_bundle_count": self.valid_bundle_count,
            "invalid_bundle_count": self.invalid_bundle_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def build_integration_policies_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-policies",
) -> IntegrationPoliciesView:
    keyset = initialize_policy_signing_keys()
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationPolicyItem] = []
    valid_bundle_count = 0
    invalid_bundle_count = 0

    for record in records:
        manifest = build_adapter_manifest(
            record,
            extra_metadata={"requested_by": requested_by},
        )

        policies = [
            {
                "type": "adapter_manifest",
                "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                "slug": record.slug,
                "manifest_version": manifest.manifest_version,
                "capabilities": list(manifest.capabilities),
            }
        ]

        bundle = PolicyBundle(
            bundle_id=f"bundle-{record.slug}",
            version=record.version,
            created_at=manifest.generated_at,
            policies=policies,
            metadata={
                "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                "slug": record.slug,
                "platform": record.platform,
                "requested_by": requested_by,
            },
        )

        signed_bundle = sign_policy_bundle(bundle, keyset)
        verification = verify_policy_bundle_signature(signed_bundle, keyset)
        bundle_summary = summarize_signed_bundle(
            signed_bundle,
            verification=verification,
        )

        signature_status = verification.status
        if signature_status == "valid":
            valid_bundle_count += 1
        else:
            invalid_bundle_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationPolicyItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                platform=record.platform,
                version=record.version,
                policy_count=len(bundle.policies),
                status=record.status,
                signature_status=signature_status,
                bundle_summary=bundle_summary,
                verification=verification.to_dict(),
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.signature_status == "valid" else 1,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationPoliciesView(
        title="Integration Policies",
        total=len(items),
        valid_bundle_count=valid_bundle_count,
        invalid_bundle_count=invalid_bundle_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

def build_integration_profile_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    integration_id: str,
    requested_by: str = "ui-profile",
) -> IntegrationProfileView:
    record = get_integration(registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    record_metadata = dict(getattr(record, "metadata", {}) or {})
    integration_type = getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown")
    command_name = getattr(record, "command_name", None)
    install_target = getattr(record, "install_target", None)
    endpoint = getattr(record, "endpoint", None)
    base_url = getattr(record, "base_url", None)

    overview = IntegrationProfileSection(
        key="overview",
        title="Overview",
        items={
            "integration_id": record.integration_id,
            "slug": record.slug,
            "name": record.name,
            "platform": record.platform,
            "integration_type": integration_type,
            "status": record.status,
            "version": record.version,
        },
    )

    execution = IntegrationProfileSection(
        key="execution",
        title="Execution",
        items={
            "command_name": command_name,
            "install_target": install_target,
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "base_url": base_url,
        },
    )

    capabilities = IntegrationProfileSection(
        key="capabilities",
        title="Capabilities",
        items={
            "has_command": bool(command_name),
            "has_install_target": bool(install_target),
            "has_endpoint": bool(endpoint or base_url),
            "metadata_keys": sorted(record_metadata.keys()),
        },
    )

    metadata_section = IntegrationProfileSection(
        key="metadata",
        title="Metadata",
        items={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
            "record_metadata": record_metadata,
        },
    )

    return IntegrationProfileView(
        title=f"{record.name} Profile",
        integration_id=record.integration_id,
        slug=record.slug,
        name=record.name,
        platform=record.platform,
        integration_type=integration_type,
        status=record.status,
        version=record.version,
        command_name=command_name,
        install_target=install_target,
        sections=[overview, execution, capabilities, metadata_section],
        summary=summarize_integration_registry(registry),
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationReadinessItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    verified: bool
    command_ready: bool
    install_ready: bool
    endpoint_ready: bool
    pass_count: int
    warn_count: int
    fail_count: int
    readiness_score: int
    readiness_state: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "command_ready": self.command_ready,
            "install_ready": self.install_ready,
            "endpoint_ready": self.endpoint_ready,
            "pass_count": self.pass_count,
            "warn_count": self.warn_count,
            "fail_count": self.fail_count,
            "readiness_score": self.readiness_score,
            "readiness_state": self.readiness_state,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationReadinessView:
    title: str
    total: int
    ready_count: int
    nearly_ready_count: int
    blocked_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationReadinessItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "ready_count": self.ready_count,
            "nearly_ready_count": self.nearly_ready_count,
            "blocked_count": self.blocked_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _readiness_score(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    command_ready: bool,
    install_ready: bool,
    endpoint_ready: bool,
    pass_count: int,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0

    if status == "active":
        score += 20
    elif status in {"planned", "draft"}:
        score += 10

    if verified:
        score += 25
    if command_ready:
        score += 15
    if install_ready:
        score += 15
    if endpoint_ready:
        score += 10

    score += min(pass_count * 2, 20)
    score -= min(warn_count * 2, 10)
    score -= min(fail_count * 15, 45)

    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def _readiness_state(
    *,
    score: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0 or score < 45:
        return "blocked"
    if score < 75:
        return "nearly-ready"
    return "ready"


def build_integration_readiness_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-readiness",
) -> IntegrationReadinessView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationReadinessItem] = []
    ready_count = 0
    nearly_ready_count = 0
    blocked_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=True,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        command_ready = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        install_ready = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))
        endpoint_ready = bool(
            getattr(record, "endpoint", None) or getattr(record, "base_url", None)
        )

        score = _readiness_score(
            status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            command_ready=command_ready,
            install_ready=install_ready,
            endpoint_ready=endpoint_ready,
            pass_count=summary["pass_count"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
        )
        state = _readiness_state(
            score=score,
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
        )

        if state == "ready":
            ready_count += 1
        elif state == "nearly-ready":
            nearly_ready_count += 1
        else:
            blocked_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationReadinessItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                verified=summary["verified"],
                command_ready=command_ready,
                install_ready=install_ready,
                endpoint_ready=endpoint_ready,
                pass_count=summary["pass_count"],
                warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
                fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
                readiness_score=score,
                readiness_state=state,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "checked_at": summary["checked_at"],
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.readiness_state == "blocked"
            else 1 if item.readiness_state == "nearly-ready"
            else 2,
            -item.readiness_score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationReadinessView(
        title="Integration Readiness",
        total=len(items),
        ready_count=ready_count,
        nearly_ready_count=nearly_ready_count,
        blocked_count=blocked_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationRolloutItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    rollout_state: str
    verification_ready: bool
    install_ready: bool
    pass_count: int
    warn_count: int

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

        return {

            "slug": self.slug,
            "platform": self.platform,

            "install_ready": self.install_ready,

            "warn_count": self.warn_count,
            "fail_count": self.fail_count,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationRolloutsView:
    title: str
    total: int
    ready_count: int
    blocked_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationRolloutItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "ready_count": self.ready_count,
            "blocked_count": self.blocked_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _determine_rollout_state(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    fail_count: int,
    warn_count: int,
    install_ready: bool,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0 or not install_ready:
        return "blocked"
    if verified and status == "active":
        return "live"
    if verified and warn_count > 0:
        return "staged"
    if verified:
        return "ready"
    return "planned"


def build_integration_rollouts_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-rollouts",
) -> IntegrationRolloutsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationRolloutItem] = []
    ready_count = 0
    blocked_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=True,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        install_ready = bool(record.command_name and record.install_target)
        rollout_state = _determine_rollout_state(
            status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            install_ready=install_ready,
        )

        if rollout_state in {"ready", "staged", "live"}:
            ready_count += 1
        if rollout_state == "blocked":
            blocked_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationRolloutItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                rollout_state=rollout_state,
                verification_ready=summary["verified"],
                install_ready=install_ready,
                pass_count=summary["pass_count"],
                warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
                fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "command_name": record.command_name,
                    "install_target": record.install_target,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda item: (item.rollout_state, item.platform, item.slug))

    return IntegrationRolloutsView(
        title="Integration Rollouts",
        total=len(items),
        ready_count=ready_count,
        blocked_count=blocked_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


def _normalize_status(value: str | None) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "unknown"
    return value.strip().lower()


def _runbook_state(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    has_command: bool,
    has_install_target: bool,
) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize_status(status)
    if normalized in {"disabled", "inactive", "retired"}:
        return "retired"
    if normalized in {"planned", "draft"}:
        return "draft"
    if verified and has_command and has_install_target:
        return "ready"
    if verified or has_command or has_install_target:
        return "partial"
    return "missing"


def _runbook_score(
    *,
    verified: bool,
    has_command: bool,
    has_install_target: bool,
    pass_count: int,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0
    if verified:
        score += 35
    if has_command:
        score += 25
    if has_install_target:
        score += 20
    score += min(pass_count * 2, 20)
    score -= min(warn_count * 2, 10)
    score -= min(fail_count * 15, 45)
    return max(0, min(score, 100))

            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "ready_count": self.ready_count,
            "partial_count": self.partial_count,
            "missing_count": self.missing_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def build_integration_runbooks_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-runbooks",
) -> IntegrationRunbooksView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationRunbookItem] = []
    ready_count = 0
    partial_count = 0
    missing_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", False))
        pass_count = int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))
        checked_at = str(summary.get("checked_at", ""))

        has_command = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        has_install_target = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))

        runbook_state = _runbook_state(
            status=getattr(record, "status", "unknown"),
            verified=verified,
            has_command=has_command,
            has_install_target=has_install_target,
        )
        runbook_score = _runbook_score(
            verified=verified,
            has_command=has_command,
            has_install_target=has_install_target,
            pass_count=pass_count,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )

        if runbook_state == "ready":
            ready_count += 1
        elif runbook_state in {"partial", "draft"}:
            partial_count += 1
        else:
            missing_count += 1

        steps = [
            IntegrationRunbookStep(
                key="registered",
                title="Registered",
                completed=True,
                detail=f"{record.name} is present in the integration registry.",
            ),
            IntegrationRunbookStep(
                key="verified",
                title="Verification",
                completed=verified,
                detail=(
                    f"Verification summary: {pass_count} pass, {warn_count} warn, {fail_count} fail."
                ),
            ),
            IntegrationRunbookStep(
                key="command",
                title="Command Ready",
                completed=has_command,
                detail=(
                    f"Command available: {getattr(record, 'command_name', None) or 'not configured'}."
                ),
            ),
            IntegrationRunbookStep(
                key="install_target",
                title="Install Target",
                completed=has_install_target,
                detail=(
                    f"Install target: {getattr(record, 'install_target', None) or 'not configured'}."
                ),
            ),
        ]

        items.append(
            IntegrationRunbookItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=getattr(record, "status", "unknown"),
                runbook_state=runbook_state,
                runbook_score=runbook_score,
                checked_at=checked_at,
                steps=steps,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "integration_type": getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown"),
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.runbook_state in {"missing", "retired"} else 1 if item.runbook_state in {"partial", "draft"} else 2,
            -item.runbook_score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationRunbooksView(
        title="Integration Runbooks",
        total=len(items),
        ready_count=ready_count,
        partial_count=partial_count,
        missing_count=missing_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSearchItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    integration_type: str
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    score: float = 0.0
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "integration_type": self.integration_type,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "score": float(self.score),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSearchView:
    title: str
    total: int
    query: str
    items: list[IntegrationSearchItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "query": self.query,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _normalize(text: str | None) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""
    return text.strip().lower()


def _tokenize(text: str | None) -> list[str]:
    normalized = _normalize(text)
    if not normalized:
        return []
    return [token for token in normalized.replace(",", " ").split() if token]


def _collect_tags(metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    raw_tags = metadata.get("tags") or metadata.get("labels") or []
    if isinstance(raw_tags, dict):
        values: Iterable[Any] = raw_tags.values()
    elif isinstance(raw_tags, (list, tuple, set)):
        values = raw_tags
    else:
        values = [raw_tags]

    tags: list[str] = []
    for value in values:
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            for nested in value:
                token = _normalize(str(nested))
                if token:
                    tags.append(token)
        else:
            token = _normalize(str(value))
            if token:
                tags.append(token)

    # Remove duplicates while preserving order.
    seen: set[str] = set()
    unique: list[str] = []
    for tag in tags:
        if tag not in seen:
            seen.add(tag)
            unique.append(tag)
    return unique


def _match_score(
    *,
    query_tokens: list[str],
    name_tokens: list[str],
    slug_tokens: list[str],
    platform: str,
    integration_type: str,
    tags: list[str],
    status: str,
) -> float:
    if not query_tokens:
        # No query: show everything with a neutral base score.
        return 0.0

    score = 0.0
    status_norm = _normalize(status)
    platform_norm = _normalize(platform)
    type_norm = _normalize(integration_type)

    for q in query_tokens:
        # Exact matches in name get highest weight.
        if q in name_tokens:
            score += 5.0
        # Prefix match on name.
        elif any(token.startswith(q) for token in name_tokens):
            score += 3.0

        # Slug and platform matches.
        if q in slug_tokens:
            score += 2.0
        if q and platform_norm.startswith(q):
            score += 1.5
        if q and type_norm.startswith(q):
            score += 1.5

        # Tag matches.
        if q in tags:
            score += 2.0

        # Status keyword matches.
        if q in {"active", "enabled"} and status_norm in {"active", "enabled"}:
            score += 1.0
        if q in {"planned", "draft"} and status_norm in {"planned", "draft"}:
            score += 0.5

    return score


def build_integration_search_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    query: str = "",
    requested_by: str = "ui-search",
) -> IntegrationSearchView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)
    query_tokens = _tokenize(query)

    items: list[IntegrationSearchItem] = []

    for record in records:
        name_tokens = _tokenize(record.name)
        slug_tokens = _tokenize(record.slug)
        metadata = dict(getattr(record, "metadata", {}) or {})
        tags = _collect_tags(metadata)

        integration_type = getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown")
        status = getattr(record, "status", "unknown")

        score = _match_score(
            query_tokens=query_tokens,
            name_tokens=name_tokens,
            slug_tokens=slug_tokens,
            platform=record.platform,
            integration_type=integration_type,
            tags=tags,
            status=status,
        )

        # If there is a non-empty query and the score is zero, omit the item.
        if query_tokens and score <= 0:
            continue

        items.append(
            IntegrationSearchItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=status,
                integration_type=integration_type,
                tags=tags,
                score=score,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    # Sort by score (desc), then name.
    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -item.score,
            item.name.lower(),
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationSearchView(
        title="Integration Search",
        total=len(items),
        query=query,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSecretItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    has_secrets: bool
    secret_sources: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    redaction_rules: list[RedactionRuleSummary] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "has_secrets": self.has_secrets,
            "secret_sources": list(self.secret_sources),
            "redaction_rules": [rule.to_dict() for rule in self.redaction_rules],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSecretsView:
    title: str
    total: int
    with_secrets_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationSecretItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    redaction_summary: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "with_secrets_count": self.with_secrets_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "redaction_summary": dict(self.redaction_summary),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _infer_secret_sources(metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    sources: list[str] = []
    if metadata.get("supports_local_runtime"):
        sources.append("local_env")
    if metadata.get("transport") == "http":
        sources.append("http_headers")
    if metadata.get("supports_builder_mode"):
        sources.append("builder_config")
    if metadata.get("one_command_install"):
        sources.append("installer_config")
    return sources


def build_integration_secrets_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    redaction_config: SecretsRedactionConfig | None = None,
    requested_by: str = "ui-secrets",
) -> IntegrationSecretsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)
    active_config = redaction_config or build_default_redaction_config()
    redaction_summary = summarize_redaction_config(active_config)

    items: list[IntegrationSecretItem] = []
    with_secrets_count = 0

    for record in records:
        secret_sources = _infer_secret_sources(record.metadata)
        has_secrets = bool(secret_sources)

        if has_secrets:
            with_secrets_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationSecretItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                has_secrets=has_secrets,
                secret_sources=secret_sources,
                redaction_rules=list(active_config.rules),
                metadata={
                    "status": record.status,
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda item: (item.platform, item.name, item.integration_id))

    return IntegrationSecretsView(
        title="Integration Secrets",
        total=len(items),
        with_secrets_count=with_secrets_count,
        items=items,
        redaction_summary=redaction_summary,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

def _health_state(*, status: str, verified: bool, configurationstate: str) -> str:
    normalized_status = status.strip().lower()
    normalized_configuration = configurationstate.strip().lower()

    if normalized_status in {"planned", "draft"}:
        return "planned"
    if normalized_status not in {"active", "enabled"}:
        return "attention"
    if verified and normalized_configuration in {"configured", "managed"}:
        return "healthy"
    if normalized_configuration in {"planned", "pending"}:
        return "pending"
    return "attention"

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSnapshotItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    version: str
    verified: bool
    snapshot_id: str
    created_at: str
    health: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "version": self.version,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "snapshot_id": self.snapshot_id,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "health": self.health,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSnapshotsView:
    title: str
    total: int
    healthy_snapshot_count: int
    warning_snapshot_count: int
    failing_snapshot_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationSnapshotItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "healthy_snapshot_count": self.healthy_snapshot_count,
            "warning_snapshot_count": self.warning_snapshot_count,
            "failing_snapshot_count": self.failing_snapshot_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _snapshot_health(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    normalized = (status or "").strip().lower()
    if fail_count > 0:
        return "failing"
    if warn_count > 0 or not verified:
        return "warning"
    if normalized == "active":
        return "healthy"
    return "inactive"


def build_integration_snapshots_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-snapshots",
) -> IntegrationSnapshotsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationSnapshotItem] = []
    healthy_snapshot_count = 0
    warning_snapshot_count = 0
    failing_snapshot_count = 0

    generated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        health = _snapshot_health(
            status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
        )

        if health == "healthy":
            healthy_snapshot_count += 1
        elif health == "warning":
            warning_snapshot_count += 1
        elif health == "failing":
            failing_snapshot_count += 1

        created_at = summary.get("checked_at") or generated_at.isoformat()

        items.append(
            IntegrationSnapshotItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                verified=summary["verified"],
                snapshot_id=f"snapshot-{record.slug}-{record.version}",
                created_at=created_at,
                health=health,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "pass_count": summary["pass_count"],
                    "warn_count": summary["warn_count"],
                    "fail_count": summary["fail_count"],
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.health == "failing"
            else 1 if item.health == "warning"
            else 2 if item.health == "healthy"
            else 3,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationSnapshotsView(
        title="Integration Snapshots",
        total=len(items),
        healthy_snapshot_count=healthy_snapshot_count,
        warning_snapshot_count=warning_snapshot_count,
        failing_snapshot_count=failing_snapshot_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
            "generated_at": generated_at.isoformat(),
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationStatusItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    lifecycle_status: str
    verification_status: str
    verified: bool
    rollout_state: str
    command_ready: bool
    install_ready: bool
    checked_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "lifecycle_status": self.lifecycle_status,
            "verification_status": self.verification_status,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "rollout_state": self.rollout_state,
            "command_ready": self.command_ready,
            "install_ready": self.install_ready,
            "checked_at": self.checked_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationStatusView:
    title: str
    total: int
    live_count: int
    ready_count: int
    blocked_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationStatusItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "live_count": self.live_count,
            "ready_count": self.ready_count,
            "blocked_count": self.blocked_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _verification_status_from_summary(summary: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if summary["fail_count"] > 0:
        return "failed"
    if summary["warn_count"] > 0:
        return "warning"
    if summary["verified"]:
        return "passed"
    return "unknown"


def _determine_rollout_state(
    *,
    lifecycle_status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
    command_ready: bool,
    install_ready: bool,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0 or not command_ready:
        return "blocked"
    if verified and lifecycle_status == "active" and install_ready:
        return "live"
    if verified and warn_count > 0:
        return "staged"
    if verified:
        return "ready"
    return "planned"


def build_integration_status_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-status",
) -> IntegrationStatusView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationStatusItem] = []
    live_count = 0
    ready_count = 0
    blocked_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=True,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        command_ready = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        install_ready = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))

        rollout_state = _determine_rollout_state(
            lifecycle_status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
            command_ready=command_ready,
            install_ready=install_ready,
        )

        if rollout_state == "live":
            live_count += 1
        elif rollout_state in {"ready", "staged"}:
            ready_count += 1
        elif rollout_state == "blocked":
            blocked_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationStatusItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                lifecycle_status=record.status,
                verification_status=_verification_status_from_summary(summary),
                verified=summary["verified"],
                rollout_state=rollout_state,
                command_ready=command_ready,
                install_ready=install_ready,
                checked_at=summary["checked_at"],
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "pass_count": summary["pass_count"],
                    "warn_count": summary["warn_count"],
                    "fail_count": summary["fail_count"],
                    "verification_summary": summary,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0
            if item.rollout_state == "blocked"
            else 1
            if item.rollout_state == "planned"
            else 2
            if item.rollout_state == "ready"
            else 3
            if item.rollout_state == "staged"
            else 4,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationStatusView(
        title="Integration Status",
        total=len(items),
        live_count=live_count,
        ready_count=ready_count,
        blocked_count=blocked_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSummaryItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    status: str
    version: str
    integration_type: str
    verified: bool
    pass_count: int
    warn_count: int

    has_install_target: bool
    score: int
    health: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "status": self.status,
            "version": self.version,
            "integration_type": self.integration_type,
            "verified": self.verified,
            "pass_count": self.pass_count,
            "warn_count": self.warn_count,
            "fail_count": self.fail_count,
            "has_command": self.has_command,
            "has_install_target": self.has_install_target,
            "score": self.score,
            "health": self.health,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationSummaryView:
    title: str
    total: int
    active_count: int
    verified_count: int
    healthy_count: int
    warning_count: int
    failing_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationSummaryItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total": self.total,
            "active_count": self.active_count,
            "verified_count": self.verified_count,
            "healthy_count": self.healthy_count,
            "warning_count": self.warning_count,
            "failing_count": self.failing_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _normalize_status(value: str | None) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "unknown"
    return value.strip().lower()


def _integration_health(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0:
        return "failing"
    if warn_count > 0 or not verified:
        return "warning"
    if status == "active":
        return "healthy"
    return "inactive"


def _integration_score(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    has_command: bool,
    has_install_target: bool,
    pass_count: int,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0

    if status == "active":
        score += 20
    elif status in {"planned", "draft"}:
        score += 10

    if verified:
        score += 30

    if has_command:
        score += 15
    if has_install_target:
        score += 15

    score += min(pass_count * 2, 20)
    score -= min(warn_count * 2, 10)
    score -= min(fail_count * 10, 30)

    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def build_integration_summary_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-summary",
) -> IntegrationSummaryView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationSummaryItem] = []
    active_count = 0
    verified_count = 0
    healthy_count = 0
    warning_count = 0
    failing_count = 0

    for record in records:
        status = _normalize_status(getattr(record, "status", None))
        if status == "active":
            active_count += 1

        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", False))
        pass_count = int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))

        if verified:
            verified_count += 1

        has_command = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        has_install_target = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))

        health = _integration_health(
            status=status,
            verified=verified,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )

        if health == "healthy":
            healthy_count += 1
        elif health == "warning":
            warning_count += 1
        elif health == "failing":
            failing_count += 1

        score = _integration_score(
            status=status,
            verified=verified,
            has_command=has_command,
            has_install_target=has_install_target,
            pass_count=pass_count,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )

        items.append(
            IntegrationSummaryItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                integration_type=getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown"),
                verified=verified,
                pass_count=pass_count,
                warn_count=warn_count,
                fail_count=fail_count,
                has_command=has_command,
                has_install_target=has_install_target,
                score=score,
                health=health,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "checked_at": summary.get("checked_at"),
                    "verification_summary": summary,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -item.score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationSummaryView(
        title="Integration Summary",
        total=len(items),
        active_count=active_count,
        verified_count=verified_count,
        healthy_count=healthy_count,
        warning_count=warning_count,
        failing_count=failing_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationTagItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    tag_count: int = 0
    status: str = "unknown"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "tag_count": self.tag_count,
            "status": self.status,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class TagSummaryItem:
    name: str
    usage_count: int
    active_usage_count: int
    platforms: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "usage_count": self.usage_count,
            "active_usage_count": self.active_usage_count,
            "platforms": list(sorted(set(self.platforms))),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationTagsView:
    title: str
    total_integrations: int
    tagged_integrations: int
    unique_tag_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationTagItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    tags: list[TagSummaryItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total_integrations": self.total_integrations,
            "tagged_integrations": self.tagged_integrations,
            "unique_tag_count": self.unique_tag_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "tags": [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _normalize_tags(raw: Any) -> list[str]:
    if not raw:
        return []
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        # Support shapes like {"tags": [...]} or {"labels": [...]}
        for key in ("tags", "labels"):
            if key in raw and isinstance(raw[key], list):
                return [str(t).strip() for t in raw[key] if str(t).strip()]
        # Fallback: take all values as tags
        return [str(v).strip() for v in raw.values() if str(v).strip()]
    if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple, set)):
        return [str(t).strip() for t in raw if str(t).strip()]
    # Single string or scalar
    return [str(raw).strip()]


def build_integration_tags_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-tags",
) -> IntegrationTagsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationTagItem] = []
    tag_usage: dict[str, TagSummaryItem] = {}

    total_integrations = len(records)
    tagged_integrations = 0

    for record in records:
        record_metadata = getattr(record, "metadata", {}) or {}
        raw_tags = record_metadata.get("tags") or record_metadata.get("labels") or []
        tags = _normalize_tags(raw_tags)

        status = getattr(record, "status", "unknown")
        status_normalized = str(status or "unknown").strip().lower()

        if tags:
            tagged_integrations += 1

        item = IntegrationTagItem(
            integration_id=record.integration_id,
            slug=record.slug,
            name=record.name,
            platform=record.platform,
            tags=tags,
            tag_count=len(tags),
            status=status,
            metadata={
                "requested_by": requested_by,
            },
        )
        items.append(item)

        for tag in tags:
            existing = tag_usage.get(tag)
            if existing is None:
                existing = TagSummaryItem(
                    name=tag,
                    usage_count=0,
                    active_usage_count=0,
                    platforms=[],
                    metadata={},
                )
                tag_usage[tag] = existing

            existing.usage_count += 1
            if status_normalized in {"active", "enabled"}:
                existing.active_usage_count += 1
            existing.platforms.append(record.platform)

    # Sort integration items by platform then name then slug.
    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item.platform,
            item.name,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    # Build sorted tag summaries: highest usage, then name.
    tag_items: list[TagSummaryItem] = list(tag_usage.values())
    tag_items.sort(
        key=lambda t: (
            -t.usage_count,
            -t.active_usage_count,
            t.name.lower(),
        )
    )

    unique_tag_count = len(tag_items)

    return IntegrationTagsView(
        title="Integration Tags",
        total_integrations=total_integrations,
        tagged_integrations=tagged_integrations,
        unique_tag_count=unique_tag_count,
        items=items,
        tags=tag_items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry


def _generated_at() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def build_ui_integration_settings_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    records = registry.list_integrations()

    settings: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    configurable_count = 0
    verified_count = 0

    for record in records:
        configurable = bool(record.settingsroute)
        verified = bool(record.verified)

        if configurable:
            configurable_count += 1
        if verified:
            verified_count += 1

        settings.append(
            {
                "integrationid": record.integrationid,
                "displayname": record.displayname,
                "platform": record.platform,
                "status": record.status,
                "verified": verified,
                "verifiedat": record.verifiedat,
                "settingsroute": record.settingsroute,
                "verificationroute": record.verificationroute,
                "manifestroute": record.manifestroute,
                "adaptermodule": record.adaptermodule,
                "configurable": configurable,
                "configurationstate": (
                    "configured"
                    if verified
                    else "pending"
                    if configurable
                    else "unavailable"
                ),
                "tags": list(record.tags),
                "metadata": dict(record.metadata),
            }
        )

    return {
        "pageid": "ui-integrations-settings",
        "title": "Integration Settings",
        "section": "platform",
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "IronClaw-Security",
        "generatedat": _generated_at(),
        "summary": {
            "totalintegrations": len(settings),
            "configurableintegrations": configurable_count,
            "verifiedintegrations": verified_count,
            "pendingintegrations": len(settings) - verified_count,
        },
        "actions": {
            "integrationsroute": "/ui/integrations",
            "catalogroute": "/integrations/installers",
            "verificationroute": "/integrations/verifiers",
        },
        "settings": settings,
    }


def get_ui_integration_settings_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    return build_ui_integration_settings_page()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from app.schemas.telemetry import TelemetryEventSummary
from app.services.securityorchestrator import SecurityOrchestrator, initializesecurityorchestrator


@dataclass(slots=True)
class MetricsSummaryViewModel:
    total_events: int
    allow_count: int
    review_count: int
    blocked_count: int
    quarantine_count: int
    latest_event_at: str | None
    telemetry_path: str

    @classmethod
    def from_summary(cls, summary: dict[str, Any]) -> "MetricsSummaryViewModel":
        return cls(
            total_events=int(summary.get("eventcount", 0)),
            allow_count=int(summary.get("allowcount", 0)),
            review_count=int(summary.get("reviewcount", 0)),
            blocked_count=int(summary.get("blockedcount", 0)),
            quarantine_count=int(summary.get("quarantinecount", 0)),
            latest_event_at=summary.get("latesteventat"),
            telemetry_path=str(summary.get("telemetrypath", "")),
        )


def get_metrics_summary_viewmodel(
    *,
    orchestrator: SecurityOrchestrator | None = None,
    limit: int = 250,
) -> MetricsSummaryViewModel:
    runtime_orchestrator = orchestrator or initializesecurityorchestrator()
    summary = runtime_orchestrator.replay_summary(limit=limit)
    return MetricsSummaryViewModel.from_summary(summary)


def get_recent_runtime_events(
    *,
    orchestrator: SecurityOrchestrator | None = None,
    limit: int = 50,
) -> list[TelemetryEventSummary]:
    runtime_orchestrator = orchestrator or initializesecurityorchestrator()
    events = list(runtime_orchestrator.iter_events(limit=limit))

    results: list[TelemetryEventSummary] = []
    for event in events:
        results.append(
            TelemetryEventSummary(
                event_id=event.eventid,
                occurred_at=event.occurredat,
                actor_id=event.actorid,
                session_id=event.sessionid,
                action_type=event.actiontype,
                target=event.target,
                execution_state=event.executionstate,
                policy_verdict=event.policyverdict,
                response_action=event.responseaction,
                adjusted_risk_score=event.adjustedriskscore,
                review_required=event.reviewrequired,
                quarantine=event.quarantine,
            )
        )

    return results

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.services.organization_store import OrganizationStore

router = APIRouter(tags=["ui-organizations"])


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _coerce_member_count(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    members = record.get("members")
    if isinstance(members, list):
        return len(members)

    member_count = record.get("member_count")
    if isinstance(member_count, int):
        return max(member_count, 0)

    return 0


def _coerce_created_at(record: dict[str, Any], fallback: str) -> str:
    value = record.get("created_at") or record.get("createdAt") or fallback
    return value if isinstance(value, str) and value else fallback


def _coerce_metadata(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    metadata = record.get("metadata")
    return metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else {}


def _organization_item(record: dict[str, Any], fallback_timestamp: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    org_id = str(record.get("organization_id") or record.get("id") or "").strip()
    name = str(record.get("name") or org_id or "Unknown organization").strip()
    slug = str(record.get("slug") or "").strip()
    status = str(record.get("status") or "active").strip() or "active"
    created_at = _coerce_created_at(record, fallback_timestamp)
    member_count = _coerce_member_count(record)
    metadata = _coerce_metadata(record)
    owner_email = str(
        record.get("owner_email")
        or metadata.get("owner_email")
        or metadata.get("ownerEmail")
        or ""
    ).strip()

    return {
        "organization_id": org_id,
        "name": name,
        "slug": slug,
        "status": status,
        "owner_email": owner_email,
        "member_count": member_count,
        "created_at": created_at,
        "detail_route": f"/organizations/{org_id}" if org_id else "/organizations",
        "members_route": f"/organizations/{org_id}/members" if org_id else "/organizations",
        "metadata": metadata,
    }


def _empty_response(timestamp: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "summary": {
            "total": 0,
            "active": 0,
            "suspended": 0,
            "member_total": 0,
        },
        "items": [],
        "actions": {
            "list_route": "/organizations",
            "create_route": "/organizations",
        },
    }


@router.get("/ui/organizations")
def get_ui_organizations() -> dict[str, Any]:
    timestamp = _utcnow_iso()

    try:
        records = OrganizationStore().list_organizations()
    except Exception:
        records = []

    if not isinstance(records, list):
        records = []

    items = [
        _organization_item(record, timestamp)
        for record in records
        if isinstance(record, dict)
    ]

    if not items:
        return _empty_response(timestamp)

    status_counts = Counter(item["status"] for item in items)
    member_total = sum(item["member_count"] for item in items)

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "summary": {
            "total": len(items),
            "active": status_counts.get("active", 0),
            "suspended": status_counts.get("suspended", 0),
            "member_total": member_total,
        },
        "items": sorted(items, key=lambda item: (item["name"].lower(), item["organization_id"])),
        "actions": {
            "list_route": "/organizations",
            "create_route": "/organizations",
        },
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/quarantine",
    tags=["quarantine-overview"],
)


class QuarantineKpiView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    value: int
    trendlabel: Optional[str] = None
    status: str = "neutral"


class QuarantineStatusCount(BaseModel):
    status: str
    count: int


class QuarantineSeverityCount(BaseModel):
    severity: str
    count: int


class QuarantineTimelinePoint(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    isolatedcount: int
    releasedcount: int
    activecount: int


class QuarantineItemView(BaseModel):
    quarantineid: str
    executionid: Optional[str] = None
    reviewitemid: Optional[str] = None
    incidentid: Optional[str] = None
    clientid: Optional[str] = None
    sessionid: Optional[str] = None
    target: str
    actiontype: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    policyverdict: str
    riskscore: int
    isolatedat: str
    updatedat: str
    reason: str
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineAlertItem(BaseModel):
    alertid: str
    quarantineid: Optional[str] = None
    timestamp: str
    severity: str
    category: str
    title: str
    acknowledged: bool = False


class QuarantineOverviewResponse(BaseModel):

    environment: str

    items: list[QuarantineItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    activealerts: list[QuarantineAlertItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:

def _to_quarantine_item(record: dict[str, object]) -> QuarantineItemView:
    return QuarantineItemView(
        quarantineid=str(record.get("quarantineid") or "unknown-quarantine"),
        executionid=record.get("executionid") if isinstance(record.get("executionid"), str) else None,
        reviewitemid=record.get("reviewitemid") if isinstance(record.get("reviewitemid"), str) else None,
        incidentid=record.get("incidentid") if isinstance(record.get("incidentid"), str) else None,
        clientid=record.get("clientid") if isinstance(record.get("clientid"), str) else None,
        sessionid=record.get("sessionid") if isinstance(record.get("sessionid"), str) else None,
        target=str(record.get("target") or "unknown"),
        actiontype=str(record.get("actiontype") or "unknown"),
        severity=str(record.get("severity") or "unknown"),
        status=str(record.get("status") or "unknown"),
        policyverdict=str(record.get("policyverdict") or "unknown"),
        riskscore=int(record.get("riskscore") or 0),
        isolatedat=str(record.get("isolatedat") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        updatedat=str(record.get("updatedat") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        reason=str(record.get("reason") or "No reason provided."),
        tags=[str(tag) for tag in record.get("tags", []) if isinstance(tag, str)],
    )


def _build_status_counts(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[QuarantineStatusCount]:
    counts = Counter(str(record.get("status") or "unknown") for record in records)
    return [
        QuarantineStatusCount(status=status, count=count)
        for status, count in sorted(counts.items())
    ]


def _build_severity_counts(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[QuarantineSeverityCount]:
    counts = Counter(str(record.get("severity") or "unknown") for record in records)
    return [
        QuarantineSeverityCount(severity=severity, count=count)
        for severity, count in sorted(counts.items())
    ]


def _build_timeline(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[QuarantineTimelinePoint]:
    hourly_isolated: dict[str, int] = {}
    hourly_released: dict[str, int] = {}
    running_active: dict[str, int] = {}

    buckets = sorted({str(record.get("isolatedat") or "")[:13] + ":00:00+00:00" for record in records})

    active_count = 0
    for bucket in buckets:
        isolated_in_bucket = 0
        released_in_bucket = 0

        for record in records:
            isolatedat = str(record.get("isolatedat") or "")
            updatedat = str(record.get("updatedat") or "")
            status = str(record.get("status") or "unknown")

            if isolatedat.startswith(bucket[:13]):
                isolated_in_bucket += 1
                if status != "released":
                    active_count += 1

            if updatedat.startswith(bucket[:13]) and status == "released":
                released_in_bucket += 1
                if active_count > 0:
                    active_count -= 1

        hourly_isolated[bucket] = isolated_in_bucket
        hourly_released[bucket] = released_in_bucket
        running_active[bucket] = active_count

    return [
        QuarantineTimelinePoint(
            timestamp=bucket,
            isolatedcount=hourly_isolated.get(bucket, 0),
            releasedcount=hourly_released.get(bucket, 0),
            activecount=running_active.get(bucket, 0),
        )
        for bucket in buckets
    ]


@router.get("/overview", response_model=QuarantineOverviewResponse)
def get_quarantine_overview() -> QuarantineOverviewResponse:
    quarantine_records = _sample_quarantine_records()
    items = [
        _to_quarantine_item(record)
        for record in sorted(
            quarantine_records,
            key=lambda item: str(item.get("updatedat") or ""),
            reverse=True,
        )
    ]
    activealerts = _sample_alerts()

    totalitems = len(quarantine_records)
    activeitems = sum(
        1 for record in quarantine_records if str(record.get("status") or "") != "released"
    )
    criticalitems = sum(
        1 for record in quarantine_records if str(record.get("severity") or "") == "critical"
    )
    unacknowledgedalerts = sum(1 for alert in activealerts if not alert.acknowledged)

    kpis = [
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="totalisolated",
            value=totalitems,
            trendlabel="Current quarantine item volume snapshot",
            status="warning" if totalitems > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="activeisolated",
            value=activeitems,
            trendlabel="Items still contained in quarantine",
            status="critical" if activeitems > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="criticalisolated",
            value=criticalitems,
            trendlabel="Highest-severity quarantined items",
            status="critical" if criticalitems > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="unacknowledgedalerts",
            value=unacknowledgedalerts,
            trendlabel="Containment alerts awaiting acknowledgment",
            status="warning" if unacknowledgedalerts > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
    ]

    overallstatus = "healthy"
    if criticalitems > 0:
        overallstatus = "critical"
    elif activeitems > 0 or unacknowledgedalerts > 0:
        overallstatus = "attention"

    return QuarantineOverviewResponse(
        generatedat=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        environment="local",
        overallstatus=overallstatus,
        kpis=kpis,
        statuscounts=_build_status_counts(quarantine_records),
        severitycounts=_build_severity_counts(quarantine_records),
        timeline=_build_timeline(quarantine_records),
        items=items,
        activealerts=activealerts,
        notes=[
            "Quarantine overview aggregates isolated actions, containment status, and alert visibility.",
            "All values are placeholder UI contract data for the current local-first Gen1 build.",
            "This page is ready to be wired to live containment, release, review, and incident correlation services.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(prefix="/request-context", tags=["request-context"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class RequestContextIdentityView(BaseModel):

    session_id: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None

        notes=[
            "Request context provides a normalized view of request identity, runtime state, and policy posture.",
            "This Gen1 UI surface starts with a safe default context when no bound request metadata is available.",
            "Downstream routes can use request, session, and trace identifiers to hydrate richer context later.",
        ],
    )

)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.review.reviewqueueservice import ReviewQueueItem, ReviewStatus
from app.routes.reviewqueue import get_review_queue_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ui/reviews", tags=["ui-review-detail"])


class ReviewDetailField(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    value: str | None = None


class ReviewEvidenceItem(BaseModel):
    index: int
    data: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReviewDetailAction(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    method: str = "POST"
    api_path: str
    body: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    style: str = "default"


class ReviewDetailResponse(BaseModel):
    review_id: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    status: str
    priority: str
    source: str
    source_id: str
    assigned_to: str | None = None
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    completed_at: str | None = None
    fields: list[ReviewDetailField] = Field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[ReviewEvidenceItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    actions: list[ReviewDetailAction] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_actions(item: ReviewQueueItem) -> list[ReviewDetailAction]:
    actions: list[ReviewDetailAction] = []

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.PENDING:
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="assign",
                label="Assign to analyst",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/assign",
                body={"reviewer_id": "analyst-1"},
                style="primary",
            )
        )

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="complete",
                label="Complete review",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/complete",
                body={},
                style="success",
            )
        )
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="dismiss",
                label="Dismiss review",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/dismiss",
                body={"reason": "dismissed-by-analyst"},
                style="danger",
            )
        )

    if item.status in {ReviewStatus.COMPLETED, ReviewStatus.DISMISSED}:
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="reopen",
                label="Reopen review",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/reopen",
                body={},
                style="default",
            )
        )

    return actions


def _build_fields(item: ReviewQueueItem) -> list[ReviewDetailField]:
    return [
        ReviewDetailField(key="review_id", label="Review ID", value=item.review_id),
        ReviewDetailField(key="source", label="Source", value=item.source.value),
        ReviewDetailField(key="source_id", label="Source ID", value=item.source_id),
        ReviewDetailField(key="priority", label="Priority", value=item.priority.value),
        ReviewDetailField(key="status", label="Status", value=item.status.value),
        ReviewDetailField(key="assigned_to", label="Assigned To", value=item.assigned_to),
        ReviewDetailField(key="created_at", label="Created At", value=item.created_at),
        ReviewDetailField(key="updated_at", label="Updated At", value=item.updated_at),
        ReviewDetailField(key="completed_at", label="Completed At", value=item.completed_at),
    ]


@router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewDetailResponse, summary="Get review detail")
def get_review_detail(review_id: str) -> ReviewDetailResponse:
    normalized_review_id = review_id.strip()
    if not normalized_review_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="review item not found")

    service = get_review_queue_service()
    item = service.get(normalized_review_id)

    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"review item not found: {normalized_review_id}")

    return ReviewDetailResponse(
        review_id=item.review_id,
        title=item.title,
        summary=item.summary,
        status=item.status.value,
        priority=item.priority.value,
        source=item.source.value,
        source_id=item.source_id,
        assigned_to=item.assigned_to,
        created_at=item.created_at,
        updated_at=item.updated_at,
        completed_at=item.completed_at,
        fields=_build_fields(item),
        reasons=list(item.reasons),
        evidence=[
            ReviewEvidenceItem(index=index + 1, data=dict(evidence))
            for index, evidence in enumerate(item.evidence)
        ],
        actions=_build_actions(item),
    )
