from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.review.reviewqueueservice import ReviewPriority, ReviewQueueItem, ReviewStatus
from app.routes.reviewqueue import get_review_queue_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ui/review-queue", tags=["ui-review-queue"])


class ReviewQueueFilterOption(BaseModel):
    value: str
    label: str


class ReviewQueueRowAction(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    method: str = "GET"
    href: str | None = None
    api_path: str | None = None
    body: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    style: str = "default"


class ReviewQueueRow(BaseModel):
    review_id: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    source: str
    source_id: str
    priority: str
    status: str
    assigned_to: str | None = None
    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence_count: int = 0
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    completed_at: str | None = None
    detail_href: str
    actions: list[ReviewQueueRowAction] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ReviewQueueFilters(BaseModel):
    statuses: list[ReviewQueueFilterOption] = Field(default_factory=list)
    priorities: list[ReviewQueueFilterOption] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ReviewQueueSummaryCard(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    count: int


class ReviewQueuePageResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str
    description: str
    filters: ReviewQueueFilters
    summary_cards: list[ReviewQueueSummaryCard] = Field(default_factory=list)
    items: list[ReviewQueueRow] = Field(default_factory=list)
    total_items: int


def _labelize(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("_", " ").title()


def _parse_review_status(value: str | None) -> ReviewStatus | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = value.strip().lower()
    if not normalized:
        return None
    try:
        return ReviewStatus(normalized)
    except ValueError as exc:
        allowed = ", ".join(status.value for status in ReviewStatus)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Invalid status '{value}'. Expected one of: {allowed}.",
        ) from exc


def _build_row(item: ReviewQueueItem) -> ReviewQueueRow:
    detail_href = f"/reviews/{item.review_id}"
    actions: list[ReviewQueueRowAction] = [
        ReviewQueueRowAction(
            key="open",
            label="Open review",
            method="GET",
            href=detail_href,
            style="primary",
        )
    ]

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.PENDING:
        actions.append(
            ReviewQueueRowAction(
                key="claim",
                label="Claim",
                method="POST",
                api_path="/api/review-queue/claim-next",
                body={"reviewer_id": "analyst-1"},
                style="default",
            )
        )

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
        actions.append(
            ReviewQueueRowAction(
                key="complete",
                label="Complete",
                method="POST",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/complete",
                body={},
                style="success",
            )
        )
        actions.append(
            ReviewQueueRowAction(
                key="dismiss",
                label="Dismiss",
                method="POST",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/dismiss",
                body={"reason": "dismissed-by-analyst"},
                style="danger",
            )
        )

    return ReviewQueueRow(
        review_id=item.review_id,
        title=item.title,
        summary=item.summary,
        source=item.source.value,
        source_id=item.source_id,
        priority=item.priority.value,
        status=item.status.value,
        assigned_to=item.assigned_to,
        reasons=list(item.reasons),
        evidence_count=len(item.evidence),
        created_at=item.created_at,
        updated_at=item.updated_at,
        completed_at=item.completed_at,
        detail_href=detail_href,
        actions=actions,
    )


@router.get("", response_model=ReviewQueuePageResponse, summary="Get review queue page")
def get_review_queue_page(
    status: str | None = Query(default=None),
    assigned_to: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> ReviewQueuePageResponse:
    service = get_review_queue_service()

    status_enum = _parse_review_status(status)
    normalized_assigned_to = assigned_to.strip() if assigned_to and assigned_to.strip() else None

    items = service.list_items(status=status_enum, assigned_to=normalized_assigned_to)
    counts = service.counts()

    return ReviewQueuePageResponse(
        title="Review Queue",
        description="Analyst queue for escalated review items that require human triage.",
        filters=ReviewQueueFilters(
            statuses=[
                ReviewQueueFilterOption(value=status_member.value, label=_labelize(status_member.value))
                for status_member in ReviewStatus
            ],
            priorities=[
                ReviewQueueFilterOption(value=priority.value, label=_labelize(priority.value))
                for priority in ReviewPriority
            ],
        ),
        summary_cards=[
            ReviewQueueSummaryCard(key="pending", label="Pending", count=counts.get("pending", 0)),
            ReviewQueueSummaryCard(
                key="in_progress",
                label="In Progress",
                count=counts.get("in_progress", 0),
            ),
            ReviewQueueSummaryCard(
                key="completed",
                label="Completed",
                count=counts.get("completed", 0),
            ),
            ReviewQueueSummaryCard(
                key="dismissed",
                label="Dismissed",
                count=counts.get("dismissed", 0),
            ),
        ],
        items=[_build_row(item) for item in items],
        total_items=len(items),
    )

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException

class ReviewReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: Optional[int] = None


class ReviewDecisionOptions(BaseModel):
    canapprove: bool
    canreject: bool
    canresolve: bool


class ReviewItemDetailResponse(BaseModel):
    reviewitemid: str
    reviewstatus: str
    timestamp: str
    updatedat: str
    executionid: str
    clientid: Optional[str] = None
    sessionid: Optional[str] = None
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    content: str
    filepath: Optional[str] = None
    riskscore: int
    executionstate: str
    responsestatus: str
    policyverdict: str
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    traceid: str
    requestid: str
    decisionid: str
    executorname: Optional[str] = None
    executorresult: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None
    reason: Optional[str] = None
    reasons: list[ReviewReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    decisionoptions: ReviewDecisionOptions


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _safe_str(value: Any, default: str) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _safe_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        lowered = value.strip().lower()
        if lowered in {"true", "1", "yes", "y", "on"}:
            return True
        if lowered in {"false", "0", "no", "n", "off"}:
            return False
    return bool(value)


def _normalize_reason(reason: dict[str, Any]) -> ReviewReasonView:
    return ReviewReasonView(
        source=_safe_str(reason.get("source"), "runtime"),
        label=_safe_str(reason.get("label"), "unspecified-reason"),
        details=_safe_str(reason.get("details"), "No additional details provided."),
        score=_safe_int(reason.get("score"), 0) if reason.get("score") is not None else None,
    )

@router.get("/detail/{reviewitemid}", response_model=ReviewItemDetailResponse)
def get_review_item_detail(reviewitemid: str) -> ReviewItemDetailResponse:
    record = _build_placeholder_record(reviewitemid)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Review item not found.")

    reviewstatus = _safe_str(record.get("reviewstatus"), "pending").lower()
    canapprove = reviewstatus == "pending"
    canreject = reviewstatus == "pending"
    canresolve = reviewstatus in {"approved", "rejected"}

    return ReviewItemDetailResponse(
        reviewitemid=_safe_str(record.get("reviewitemid"), "unknown-review"),
        reviewstatus=reviewstatus,
        timestamp=_safe_str(record.get("timestamp"), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        updatedat=_safe_str(record.get("updatedat"), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        executionid=_safe_str(record.get("executionid"), "unknown-execution"),
        clientid=record.get("clientid"),
        sessionid=record.get("sessionid"),
        actiontype=_safe_str(record.get("actiontype"), "unknown"),
        target=_safe_str(record.get("target"), "unknown"),
        content=_safe_str(record.get("content"), ""),
        filepath=record.get("filepath"),
        riskscore=_safe_int(record.get("riskscore"), 0),
        executionstate=_safe_str(record.get("executionstate"), "unknown"),
        responsestatus=_safe_str(record.get("responsestatus"), "completed"),
        policyverdict=_safe_str(record.get("policyverdict"), "allow"),
        shouldexecute=_safe_bool(record.get("shouldexecute"), False),
        haltedbyboundary=_safe_bool(record.get("haltedbyboundary"), False),
        traceid=_safe_str(record.get("traceid"), "unknown-trace"),
        requestid=_safe_str(record.get("requestid"), "unknown-request"),
        decisionid=_safe_str(record.get("decisionid"), "unknown-decision"),
        executorname=record.get("executorname"),
        executorresult=record.get("executorresult"),
        reason=record.get("reason"),
        reasons=[_normalize_reason(reason) for reason in record.get("reasons", [])],
        decisionoptions=ReviewDecisionOptions(
            canapprove=canapprove,
            canreject=canreject,
            canresolve=canresolve,
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/reviews",
    tags=["review-queue"],
)


class ReviewQueueItem(BaseModel):
    reviewitemid: str
    executionid: str
    timestamp: str
    reviewstatus: str
    clientid: Optional[str] = None
    sessionid: Optional[str] = None
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    riskscore: int
    executionstate: str
    responsestatus: str
    policyverdict: str
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    reason: Optional[str] = None
    executorname: Optional[str] = None
    traceid: Optional[str] = None
    requestid: Optional[str] = None
    decisionid: Optional[str] = None


class ReviewQueueResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[ReviewQueueItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    total: int = 0
    pending: int = 0
    approved: int = 0
    rejected: int = 0


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        lowered = value.strip().lower()
        if lowered in {"true", "1", "yes", "y", "on"}:
            return True
        if lowered in {"false", "0", "no", "n", "off"}:
            return False
    return bool(value)


def _normalize_reviewstatus(value: Any) -> str:
    status = _coerce_str(value, "pending").lower()
    if status in {"approved", "rejected", "pending"}:
        return status
    return "pending"


def _normalize_executionstate(value: Any) -> str:
    return _coerce_str(value, "unknown")


def _normalize_responsestatus(value: Any, executionstate: str) -> str:
    status = _coerce_str(value, "").lower()
    if status in {"completed", "queuedforreview", "denied"}:
        return status

    if executionstate in {"denied", "blocked", "quarantined"}:
        return "denied"
    if executionstate in {"dryrun", "queued", "queuedforreview", "review"}:
        return "queuedforreview"
    return "completed"


def _normalize_policyverdict(value: Any, executionstate: str) -> str:
    verdict = _coerce_str(value, "").lower()
    if verdict:
        return verdict

    if executionstate in {"denied", "blocked"}:
        return "block"
    if executionstate in {"quarantined"}:
        return "quarantine"
    if executionstate in {"dryrun", "queued", "queuedforreview", "review"}:
        return "review"
    return "allow"

                sessionid=raw.get("sessionid"),
                actiontype=_coerce_str(raw.get("actiontype"), "unknown"),
                target=_coerce_str(raw.get("target"), "unknown"),
                riskscore=_coerce_int(raw.get("riskscore"), 0),
                executionstate=executionstate,
                responsestatus=_normalize_responsestatus(
                    raw.get("responsestatus"),
                    executionstate,
                ),
                policyverdict=_normalize_policyverdict(
                    raw.get("policyverdict"),
                    executionstate,
                ),
                shouldexecute=_coerce_bool(raw.get("shouldexecute"), False),
                haltedbyboundary=_coerce_bool(raw.get("haltedbyboundary"), False),
                reason=raw.get("reason"),
                executorname=raw.get("executorname"),
                traceid=raw.get("traceid"),
                requestid=raw.get("requestid"),
                decisionid=raw.get("decisionid"),
            )
        )
    return items


@router.get("/queue", response_model=ReviewQueueResponse)
def get_review_queue() -> ReviewQueueResponse:
    items = _build_placeholder_items()
    pending = sum(1 for item in items if item.reviewstatus == "pending")
    approved = sum(1 for item in items if item.reviewstatus == "approved")
    rejected = sum(1 for item in items if item.reviewstatus == "rejected")

    return ReviewQueueResponse(
        items=items,
        total=len(items),
        pending=pending,
        approved=approved,
        rejected=rejected,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from importlib import import_module
from typing import Any, Final, cast

from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI


def _optional_router(module_path: str) -> APIRouter | None:
    try:
        module = import_module(module_path)
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        if exc.name != module_path:
            raise
        return None

    router = getattr(module, "router", None)
    if router is None:
        return None
    return cast(APIRouter, router)


router = APIRouter(tags=["ui"])


UI_ROUTERS: Final[tuple[APIRouter | None, ...]] = (
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.dashboard"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.detail"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.reviews.queue"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.reviews.detail"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.insights.policy"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.activity.clientsession"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.activity.clientprofile"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.activity.sessiontimeline"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.explorer"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.settings.configuration"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.runtime.status"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.audit.log"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.testconsole"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.alerts.notifications"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.system.diagnostics"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.integrations.settings"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.data.retention"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.incidents.triage"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.admin.operators"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.admin.roles"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.groq"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_manifest"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_registry"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_index"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_summary"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_packages"),
)


def get_ui_routers() -> tuple[APIRouter, ...]:
    return tuple(ui_router for ui_router in UI_ROUTERS if ui_router is not None)


def iter_ui_routers() -> Iterable[APIRouter]:
    return iter(get_ui_routers())


def _router_label(ui_router: APIRouter) -> str:
    prefix = str(getattr(ui_router, "prefix", "") or "<no-prefix>")
    route_count = len(getattr(ui_router, "routes", ()))
    return f"{prefix} ({route_count} routes)"


def _route_signature(route: object) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str]:
    path = str(getattr(route, "path", ""))
    methods = tuple(sorted(cast(set[str], getattr(route, "methods", set()) or set())))
    name = str(getattr(route, "name", ""))
    return (path, methods, name)


def validate_ui_routers() -> None:
    seen_router_objects: set[int] = set()
    seen_route_signatures: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str], str] = {}

    for ui_router in get_ui_routers():
        router_id = id(ui_router)
        label = _router_label(ui_router)

        if router_id in seen_router_objects:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate UI router object registration detected: {label}")
        seen_router_objects.add(router_id)

        if not ui_router.routes:
            raise ValueError(f"UI router has no routes: {label}")

        for route in ui_router.routes:
            signature = _route_signature(route)
            path, methods, _ = signature

            if not path:
                raise ValueError(f"UI router contains a route with an empty path: {label}")

            if signature in seen_route_signatures:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"duplicate UI route registration detected: {path} {methods} "
                    f"already registered under {seen_route_signatures[signature]}"
                )

            seen_route_signatures[signature] = label


def include_ui_routers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    validate_ui_routers()

    existing_route_signatures = {
        _route_signature(route)
        for route in app.routes
        if getattr(route, "path", "")
    }

    for ui_router in get_ui_routers():
        router_signatures = {
            _route_signature(route)
            for route in ui_router.routes
            if getattr(route, "path", "")
        }

        if router_signatures and router_signatures.issubset(existing_route_signatures):
            continue

        app.include_router(ui_router)
        existing_route_signatures.update(router_signatures)


def includeuirouters(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    include_ui_routers(app)

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _lookup(items: list[dict[str, Any]], label: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    for item in items:
        if item.get("label") == label:
            return item.get("value", default)
    return default


def _to_bool(value: Any, *, true_values: set[str] | None = None) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        allowed = true_values or {"true", "active", "available", "enabled", "yes"}
        return normalized in allowed
    return bool(value)


def _to_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ui/session-risk", tags=["session-risk"])


class SessionRiskFilterOption(BaseModel):
    value: str
    label: str


class SessionRiskSeverityBreakdown(BaseModel):
    critical: int = 0
    high: int = 0
    medium: int = 0
    low: int = 0


class SessionRiskSummaryCard(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    value: str
    tone: str = "neutral"


class SessionRiskSignalItem(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    value: str
    tone: str = "neutral"


class SessionRiskTimelineEvent(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    title: str
    status: str
    risk_score: int = 0
    severity: str = "low"
    summary: str
    source: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class SessionRiskReviewItem(BaseModel):
    review_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    priority: str
    href: str


class SessionRiskRelatedLink(BaseModel):
    label: str
    href: str


class SessionRiskResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str
    description: str
    session_id: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    overall_risk_level: str
    policy_mode: str
    generated_at: str
    summary_cards: list[SessionRiskSummaryCard] = Field(default_factory=list)
    severity_breakdown: SessionRiskSeverityBreakdown = Field(default_factory=SessionRiskSeverityBreakdown)
    signals: list[SessionRiskSignalItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recent_reviews: list[SessionRiskReviewItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    timeline: list[SessionRiskTimelineEvent] = Field(default_factory=list)
    available_filters: list[SessionRiskFilterOption] = Field(default_factory=list)
    related_links: list[SessionRiskRelatedLink] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


_DEFAULT_FILTERS: tuple[SessionRiskFilterOption, ...] = (
    SessionRiskFilterOption(value="all", label="All activity"),
    SessionRiskFilterOption(value="executions", label="Executions"),
    SessionRiskFilterOption(value="reviews", label="Reviews"),
    SessionRiskFilterOption(value="policy", label="Policy"),
)


def _normalize_session_id(session_id: str) -> str:
    return session_id.strip()


def _normalize_client_id(client_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if client_id is None:
        return None
    normalized = client_id.strip()
    return normalized or None


def _risk_level_from_score(score: int) -> str:
    if score >= 90:
        return "critical"
    if score >= 75:
        return "high"
    if score >= 50:
        return "medium"
    return "low"


def _tone_for_level(level: str) -> str:
    return {
        "critical": "danger",
        "high": "danger",
        "medium": "warning",
        "low": "success",
    }.get(level, "neutral")


def _build_summary_cards(
    highest_risk_score: int,
    total_events: int,
    pending_reviews: int,
    risk_level: str,
) -> list[SessionRiskSummaryCard]:
    return [
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="risk_level",
            label="Overall Risk",
            value=risk_level.replace("_", " ").title(),
            tone=_tone_for_level(risk_level),
        ),
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="highest_risk",
            label="Highest Risk Score",
            value=str(highest_risk_score),
            tone=_tone_for_level(_risk_level_from_score(highest_risk_score)),
        ),
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="pending_reviews",
            label="Pending Reviews",
            value=str(pending_reviews),
            tone="warning" if pending_reviews > 0 else "success",
        ),
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="total_events",
            label="Tracked Events",
            value=str(total_events),
            tone="neutral",
        ),
    ]


def _build_signals(
    *,
    session_id: str,
    client_id: str | None,
    highest_risk_score: int,
    pending_reviews: int,
    policy_mode: str,
    risk_level: str,
) -> list[SessionRiskSignalItem]:
    return [
        SessionRiskSignalItem(key="session_id", label="Session ID", value=session_id),
        SessionRiskSignalItem(key="client_id", label="Client ID", value=client_id or "unknown"),
        SessionRiskSignalItem(key="policy_mode", label="Policy Mode", value=policy_mode.title()),
        SessionRiskSignalItem(
            key="risk_level",
            label="Risk Level",
            value=risk_level.title(),
            tone=_tone_for_level(risk_level),
        ),
        SessionRiskSignalItem(
            key="highest_risk",
            label="Highest Risk",
            value=str(highest_risk_score),
            tone=_tone_for_level(_risk_level_from_score(highest_risk_score)),
        ),
        SessionRiskSignalItem(
            key="pending_reviews",
            label="Pending Reviews",
            value=str(pending_reviews),
            tone="warning" if pending_reviews > 0 else "success",
        ),
    ]


def _build_related_links(session_id: str) -> list[SessionRiskRelatedLink]:
    return [
        SessionRiskRelatedLink(label="Session timeline", href=f"/ui/activity/session/{session_id}"),
        SessionRiskRelatedLink(label="Request context", href="/request-context"),
        SessionRiskRelatedLink(label="Runtime status", href="/ui/runtime-status"),
        SessionRiskRelatedLink(label="Review queue", href="/reviews/queue"),
    ]


@router.get("/{session_id}", response_model=SessionRiskResponse, summary="Get session risk")
def get_session_risk(
    session_id: str,
    client_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> SessionRiskResponse:
    normalized_session_id = _normalize_session_id(session_id)
    normalized_client_id = _normalize_client_id(client_id)

    generated_at = "2026-04-27T15:55:00Z"
    highest_risk_score = 0
    pending_reviews = 0
    total_events = 0
    policy_mode = "review"
    risk_level = _risk_level_from_score(highest_risk_score)

    return SessionRiskResponse(
        title="Session Risk",
        description="Session-scoped risk view for execution pressure, review load, and policy signals.",
        session_id=normalized_session_id,
        client_id=normalized_client_id,
        overall_risk_level=risk_level,
        policy_mode=policy_mode,
        generated_at=generated_at,
        summary_cards=_build_summary_cards(
            highest_risk_score=highest_risk_score,
            total_events=total_events,
            pending_reviews=pending_reviews,
            risk_level=risk_level,
        ),
        severity_breakdown=SessionRiskSeverityBreakdown(),
        signals=_build_signals(
            session_id=normalized_session_id,
            client_id=normalized_client_id,
            highest_risk_score=highest_risk_score,
            pending_reviews=pending_reviews,
            policy_mode=policy_mode,
            risk_level=risk_level,
        ),
        recent_reviews=[],
        timeline=[],
        available_filters=list(_DEFAULT_FILTERS),
        related_links=_build_related_links(normalized_session_id),
        metadata={
            "empty_state": True,
            "session_found": False,
            "integration_mode": "ui-shell",
        },
    )

class ServiceDiagnosticItem(BaseModel):

class SystemDiagnosticsResponse(BaseModel):

@router.get("/diagnostics", response_model=SystemDiagnosticsResponse)
def get_system_diagnostics() -> SystemDiagnosticsResponse:
    services = _build_placeholder_services()
    unhealthy = [service for service in services if service.status != "healthy"]

    return SystemDiagnosticsResponse(
        generatedat=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        overallstatus="healthy" if not unhealthy else "degraded",
        services=services,
        warnings=[] if not unhealthy else ["One or more services require attention."],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

router = APIRouter(tags=["system-diagnostics"])


def _iso_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _iso_before(minutes: int) -> str:
    return (
        (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=minutes))
        .replace(microsecond=0)
        .isoformat()
        .replace("+00:00", "Z")
    )


class DiagnosticsKpi(BaseModel):
    label: str
    value: str
    tone: str = "neutral"


class DiagnosticsCheck(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    status: str
    tone: str
    summary: str
    last_checked_at: str
    latency_ms: int | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    incident_id: str
    severity: str
    status: str

    summary: str
    detected_at: str
    owner: str | None = None

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/telemetry-access-summary",
    tags=["telemetry-access-summary"],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class TelemetrySummaryCounterView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    value: int
    trend: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryWindowView(BaseModel):
    summary_limit: int
    events_limit: int
    time_window: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryEventView(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    occurred_at: str
    event_type: str
    actor_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    outcome: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryLinkView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    path: str
    description: str


class TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    window: TelemetrySummaryWindowView
    counters: list[TelemetrySummaryCounterView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recent_events: list[TelemetrySummaryEventView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    links: list[TelemetrySummaryLinkView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_counters(
    summary_limit: int,
    events_limit: int,
) -> list[TelemetrySummaryCounterView]:
    return [
        TelemetrySummaryCounterView(
            label="Telemetry reads",
            value=0,
            trend="stable",
            metadata={
                "summary_limit": summary_limit,
                "source": "telemetry-access-summary-ui",
            },
        ),
        TelemetrySummaryCounterView(
            label="Audit-linked accesses",
            value=0,
            trend="stable",
            metadata={
                "events_limit": events_limit,
                "source": "telemetry-access-summary-ui",
            },
        ),
        TelemetrySummaryCounterView(
            label="Policy-sensitive events",
            value=0,
            trend="stable",
            metadata={
                "classification": "guard-aware",
                "source": "telemetry-access-summary-ui",
            },
        ),
    ]


def _build_links() -> list[TelemetrySummaryLinkView]:
    return [
        TelemetrySummaryLinkView(
            label="Audit log",
            path="/ui/audit-log",
            description="Inspect audit events related to telemetry access and review activity.",
        ),
        TelemetrySummaryLinkView(
            label="Runtime status",
            path="/ui/runtime-status",
            description="Check runtime health and current service readiness.",
        ),
        TelemetrySummaryLinkView(
            label="Request context",
            path="/ui/request-context",
            description="Inspect normalized request identity and policy context.",
        ),
        TelemetrySummaryLinkView(
            label="Usage reports",
            path="/ui/usage-reports",
            description="Review usage summaries and recent metered events.",
        ),
    ]


@router.get("", response_model=TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse)
def get_telemetry_access_summary(
    summary_limit: int = Query(default=500, ge=1, le=5000),
    events_limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=500),
) -> TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse:
    return TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        window=TelemetrySummaryWindowView(
            summary_limit=summary_limit,
            events_limit=events_limit,
            time_window="rolling",
            metadata={
                "ui_surface": "telemetry-access-summary",
                "default_mode": "safe-empty",
            },
        ),
        counters=_build_counters(
            summary_limit=summary_limit,
            events_limit=events_limit,
        ),
        recent_events=[],
        links=_build_links(),
        notes=[
            "Telemetry access summary provides a UI-safe overview of telemetry reads and related operational activity.",
            "This Gen1 view returns a stable empty-state structure until live telemetry hydration is connected.",
            "Query parameters let operators tune summary and recent-event window sizes without changing the response contract.",
        ],
    )

def _lookup(items: list[dict[str, Any]], label: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    for item in items:
        if item.get("label") == label:
            return item.get("value", default)
    return default


def _to_bool(value: Any, *, true_values: set[str] | None = None) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        allowed = true_values or {"true", "active", "available", "enabled", "ready", "required", "yes", "tracked"}
        return normalized in allowed
    return bool(value)


def _to_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def get_telemetry_access_summary_page() -> dict[str, Any]:
    page = build_telemetry_access_summary_page()
    section_map = {section.sectionid: section for section in page.sections}

    overview_items = section_map["access-overview"].items
    counts_items = section_map["access-counts"].items
    control_items = section_map["control-flags"].items
    recent_event_items = section_map["recent-events"].items

    return {
        "pageid": page.pageid,
        "title": page.title,
        "path": page.path,
        "summary": page.summary,
        "generatedat": _utc_now_iso(),
        "accessavailable": _to_bool(_lookup(overview_items, "Access Layer")),
        "auditvisibilityenabled": _to_bool(_lookup(overview_items, "Audit Visibility")),
        "recenteventsready": _to_bool(_lookup(overview_items, "Recent Events Feed")),
        "exportcontrolled": _to_bool(
            _lookup(overview_items, "Export Posture"),
            true_values={"controlled", "restricted", "limited"},
        ),
        "counts": {
            "totalevents": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Total Access Events", 0)),
            "allowedreads": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Allowed Reads", 0)),
            "flaggedreads": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Flagged Reads", 0)),
            "deniedreads": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Denied Reads", 0)),
            "sensitiveexports": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Sensitive Exports", 0)),
            "latesteventat": _lookup(counts_items, "Latest Event At", "Not yet recorded"),
        },
        "controls": {
            "retentiontracked": _to_bool(
                _lookup(control_items, "Telemetry Retention"),
                true_values={"tracked", "enabled", "true", "yes"},
            ),
            "actorattributionrequired": _to_bool(
                _lookup(control_items, "Actor Attribution"),
                true_values={"required", "true", "yes"},
            ),
            "sessioncorrelationenabled": _to_bool(_lookup(control_items, "Session Correlation")),
            "requestcorrelationenabled": _to_bool(_lookup(control_items, "Request Correlation")),
            "redactionguardavailable": _to_bool(_lookup(control_items, "Redaction Guard")),
        },
        "recentevents": recent_event_items,
        "metadata": page.metadata,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.services.integrationinstaller import get_integration_installer
from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.services.integrationverifier import get_integration_verifier


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def build_ui_integrations_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    installer = get_integration_installer()
    verifier = get_integration_verifier()

    integrations = []
    ready_count = 0
    installed_count = 0

    for record in registry.list_integrations():
        installer_preview = installer.install_integration(
            record.integrationid,
            requestedby="ui-preview",
        )
        verifier_preview = verifier.verify_integration(
            record.integrationid,
            strict=False,
            requestedby="ui-preview",
        )

        integration_payload = {
            "integrationid": record.integrationid,
            "platform": record.platform,
            "displayname": record.displayname,
            "status": record.status,
            "installed": record.installedat is not None,
            "installedat": record.installedat,
            "verified": record.verified,
            "verifiedat": record.verifiedat,
            "settingsroute": record.settingsroute,
            "manifestroute": record.manifestroute,
            "verificationroute": record.verificationroute,
            "adaptermodule": record.adaptermodule,
            "capabilities": [asdict(capability) for capability in record.capabilities],
            "installerpreview": (
                {
                    "installed": installer_preview.installed,
                    "status": installer_preview.status,
                    "summary": installer_preview.summary,
                    "steps": [asdict(step) for step in installer_preview.steps],
                }
                if installer_preview is not None
                else None
            ),
            "verifierpreview": (
                {
                    "verified": verifier_preview.verified,
                    "status": verifier_preview.status,
                    "strict": verifier_preview.strict,
                    "summary": verifier_preview.summary,
                    "checks": [asdict(check) for check in verifier_preview.checks],
                    "missingcapabilities": list(
                        verifier_preview.missingcapabilities
                    ),
                }
                if verifier_preview is not None
                else None
            ),
            "health": "ready" if record.verified else "degraded",
        }
        integrations.append(integration_payload)

        if integration_payload["installed"]:
            installed_count += 1
        if integration_payload["health"] == "ready":
            ready_count += 1

    return {
        "pageid": "ui-integrations",
        "title": "Integrations",
        "section": "platform",
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "IronClaw-Security",
        "generatedat": _utc_now(),
        "summary": {
            "totalintegrations": len(integrations),
            "installedintegrations": installed_count,
            "readyintegrations": ready_count,
            "degradedintegrations": len(integrations) - ready_count,
        },
        "actions": {
            "catalogroute": "/integrations/installers",
            "verificationroute": "/integrations/verifiers",
            "settingsroute": "/ui/integrations/settings",
        },
        "integrations": integrations,
    }


def get_ui_integrations_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    return build_ui_integrations_page()

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

    prefix="/ui/pages",
    tags=["ui-pages"],

    slug: str

    route: str
    category: str
    summary: str

class UIPageSection(BaseModel):

    metadata: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:

            metadata={"surface": "billing", "kind": "reporting"},

def _build_sections(items: list[UIPageItem]) -> list[UIPageSection]:
    category_labels: dict[str, str] = {
        "system": "System",
        "security-admin": "Security Admin",
        "integrations": "Integrations",
        "tenant": "Tenant",
        "billing": "Billing",
    }

    ordered_categories = [
        "system",
        "security-admin",
        "integrations",
        "tenant",
        "billing",
    ]

    sections: list[UIPageSection] = []
    for category in ordered_categories:
        section_items = [item for item in items if item.category == category]
        if not section_items:
            continue
        sections.append(
            UIPageSection(
                category=category,
                label=category_labels.get(category, category.title()),
                total=len(section_items),
                items=section_items,
            )
        )
    return sections


@router.get("", response_model=UIPagesResponse)
def get_ui_pages() -> UIPagesResponse:
    items = _build_ui_pages()
    sections = _build_sections(items)
    return UIPagesResponse(
        generatedat=_utc_now_iso(),
        summary=UIPageSummary(
            totalpages=len(items),
            enabledpages=sum(1 for item in items if item.enabled),
            categories=[section.category for section in sections],
        ),
        sections=sections,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "surface": "ui",
            "scope": "page-catalog",
            "generatedby": "uipages",
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Path
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(prefix="/usage-events/detail", tags=["usage-event-detail"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class UsageEventIdentityView(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventGuardView(BaseModel):
    verdict: str
    guard_mode: str
    policy_profile: str
    blocked: bool
    truncated: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventBillingView(BaseModel):
    units_consumed: int
    unit_type: str
    package_id: str | None = None
    wallet_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventContextView(BaseModel):
    method: str
    path: str
    upstream_url: str | None = None
    ip_address: str | None = None
    user_agent: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventLinkView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    path: str
    description: str


class UsageEventDetailResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    identity: UsageEventIdentityView
    guard: UsageEventGuardView
    billing: UsageEventBillingView
    context: UsageEventContextView
    links: list[UsageEventLinkView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_links(event_id: str, session_id: str | None, client_id: str | None) -> list[UsageEventLinkView]:
    links: list[UsageEventLinkView] = [
        UsageEventLinkView(
            label="Usage reports",
            path="/ui/usage-reports",
            description="Return to aggregated usage summaries and recent events.",
        ),
        UsageEventLinkView(
            label="Audit log",
            path="/ui/audit-log",
            description="Inspect the full audit trail for related decisions.",
        ),
    ]

    if session_id:
        links.append(
            UsageEventLinkView(
                label="Session timeline",
                path=f"/ui/activity/sessiontimeline/{session_id}",
                description="Timeline view for all activity in this session.",
            )
        )

    if client_id:
        links.append(
            UsageEventLinkView(
                label="Client profile",
                path=f"/ui/activity/clientprofile/{client_id}",
                description="Profile view for the client associated with this usage.",
            )
        )

    return links


@router.get("/{event_id}", response_model=UsageEventDetailResponse)
def get_usage_event_detail(
    event_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> UsageEventDetailResponse:
    normalized_event_id = event_id.strip()

    # Gen1 UI returns a safe, self-describing default detail view.
    client_id = "default-client"
    session_id = "default-session"

    identity = UsageEventIdentityView(
        event_id=normalized_event_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        actor_id=None,
        request_id=None,
        trace_id=None,
        metadata={
            "identity_state": "unbound",
            "description": "Usage event identity is currently represented with a default context.",
        },
    )

    guard = UsageEventGuardView(
        verdict="allow",
        guard_mode="assist",
        policy_profile="default-usage-event",
        blocked=False,
        truncated=False,
        metadata={
            "policy_source": "usage-event-detail-ui",
            "supports_prompt_guard": True,
            "supports_action_guard": True,
        },
    )

    billing = UsageEventBillingView(
        units_consumed=0,
        unit_type="unit",
        package_id=None,
        wallet_id=None,
        metadata={
            "billing_state": "not-charged",
            "description": "No units were consumed in this default usage event view.",
        },
    )

    context = UsageEventContextView(
        method="POST",
        path="/scan",
        upstream_url=None,
        ip_address=None,
        user_agent=None,
        metadata={
            "ui_surface": "usage-event-detail",
            "environment": "local",
        },
    )

    return UsageEventDetailResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        identity=identity,
        guard=guard,
        billing=billing,
        context=context,
        links=_build_links(normalized_event_id, session_id=session_id, client_id=client_id),
        notes=[
            "Usage event detail provides a focused view of a single metered security event.",
            "Gen1 UI returns a safe default representation until the usage-reports backend is wired in.",
            "Downstream iterations can hydrate this view with real usage, billing, and guard metadata.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(prefix="/usage-reports", tags=["usage-reports"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class UsageSummaryItemView(BaseModel):
    summary_id: str
    period_start: str
    period_end: str
    total_requests: int
    total_scans: int
    total_blocked: int
    total_warned: int
    total_quarantined: int
    total_allowed: int
    unique_clients: int
    unique_sessions: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageSummaryListView(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    period: str
    limit: int
    items: list[UsageSummaryItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class UsageEventView(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    occurred_at: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    action_type: str
    verdict: str
    units_consumed: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventListView(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    limit: int
    events: list[UsageEventView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class UsageReportsResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    summaries: UsageSummaryListView
    events: UsageEventListView
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_mock_summaries(period: str, limit: int) -> UsageSummaryListView:
    items: list[UsageSummaryItemView] = [
        UsageSummaryItemView(
            summary_id=f"usage-{period}",
            period_start=_utc_now_iso(),
            period_end=_utc_now_iso(),
            total_requests=0,
            total_scans=0,
            total_blocked=0,
            total_warned=0,
            total_quarantined=0,
            total_allowed=0,
            unique_clients=0,
            unique_sessions=0,
            metadata={
                "period": period,
                "sampled": True,
                "limit": limit,
            },
        )
    ]

    return UsageSummaryListView(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        period=period,
        limit=limit,
        items=items[:limit],
        notes=[
            "Usage summaries are aggregated from the underlying usage-reports API.",
            "This UI view provides a safe default zeroed snapshot when no data is available.",
        ],
    )


def _build_mock_events(limit: int) -> UsageEventListView:
    events: list[UsageEventView] = []

    return UsageEventListView(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        limit=limit,
        events=events,
        notes=[
            "Usage events are sourced from the usage-reports events API.",
            "This UI view intentionally returns an empty list when no recent events are present.",
        ],
    )


@router.get("", response_model=UsageReportsResponse)
def get_usage_reports(
    period: str = Query(default="24h", min_length=2, max_length=16),
    limit: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=100),
) -> UsageReportsResponse:
    summaries = _build_mock_summaries(period=period, limit=limit)
    events = _build_mock_events(limit=limit)

    return UsageReportsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        summaries=summaries,
        events=events,
        notes=[
            "Usage reports UI provides a consolidated snapshot of recent security usage.",
            "For full historical exports, use the usage-reports API endpoints directly.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final


REPO_ROOT: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

SECURITY_GATE_FILE: Final[Path] = REPO_ROOT / ".security-quality-gate.json"
ROUTE_INVENTORY_FILE: Final[Path] = REPO_ROOT / ".route-inventory.json"
SMOKETEST_FILE: Final[Path] = REPO_ROOT / ".smoketest-results.json"

RESULT_FILE: Final[Path] = REPO_ROOT / ".verify-results.json"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArtifactStatus:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class VerificationReport:
    overall_status: str
    artifacts: tuple[ArtifactStatus, ...]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
            "artifacts": [a.to_dict() for a in self.artifacts],
        }


def _read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    data = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    return json.loads(data)


def _verify_security_gate() -> ArtifactStatus:
    if not SECURITY_GATE_FILE.exists():
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="security-quality-gate",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"missing artifact: {SECURITY_GATE_FILE.name}",
        )

    try:
        payload = _read_json(SECURITY_GATE_FILE)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="security-quality-gate",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"failed to parse JSON: {exc.__class__.__name__}",
        )

    status = str(payload.get("status", "")).lower()
    if status != "ok":
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="security-quality-gate",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"gate status is {status!r}, expected 'ok'",
        )

    minimum_coverage = payload.get("minimum_coverage")
    if not isinstance(minimum_coverage, int):
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="security-quality-gate",
            ok=False,
            detail="minimum_coverage is missing or not an integer",
        )

    return ArtifactStatus(
        name="security-quality-gate",
        ok=True,
        detail=f"status ok, minimum_coverage={minimum_coverage}",
    )


def _verify_route_inventory() -> ArtifactStatus:
    if not ROUTE_INVENTORY_FILE.exists():
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="route-inventory",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"missing artifact: {ROUTE_INVENTORY_FILE.name}",
        )

    try:
        payload = _read_json(ROUTE_INVENTORY_FILE)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="route-inventory",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"failed to parse JSON: {exc.__class__.__name__}",
        )

    modules = payload.get("modules")
    if not isinstance(modules, list) or not modules:
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="route-inventory",
            ok=False,
            detail="modules list is missing or empty",
        )

    summary = payload.get("summary") or {}
    if not isinstance(summary, dict) or not summary:
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="route-inventory",
            ok=False,
            detail="summary is missing or empty",
        )

    return ArtifactStatus(
        name="route-inventory",
        ok=True,
        detail=f"{len(modules)} modules across {len(summary)} surfaces",
    )


def _verify_smoketest() -> ArtifactStatus:
    if not SMOKETEST_FILE.exists():
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="smoketest",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"missing artifact: {SMOKETEST_FILE.name}",
        )

    try:
        payload = _read_json(SMOKETEST_FILE)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="smoketest",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"failed to parse JSON: {exc.__class__.__name__}",
        )

    overall_status = str(payload.get("overall_status", "")).lower()
    if overall_status != "ok":
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="smoketest",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"overall smoketest status is {overall_status!r}, expected 'ok'",
        )

    checks = payload.get("checks") or []
    if not isinstance(checks, list) or not checks:
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="smoketest",
            ok=False,
            detail="checks list is missing or empty",
        )

    failed = [c for c in checks if not bool(c.get("ok"))]
    if failed:
        names = ", ".join(str(c.get("name")) for c in failed[:5])
        more = "" if len(failed) <= 5 else f" (+{len(failed) - 5} more)"
        return ArtifactStatus(
            name="smoketest",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"{len(failed)} failing checks: {names}{more}",
        )

    return ArtifactStatus(
        name="smoketest",
        ok=True,
        detail=f"{len(checks)} checks all passing",
    )


def _write_report(report: VerificationReport) -> None:
    RESULT_FILE.write_text(
        json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Verify IronClaw deployment artifacts (security gate, route inventory, smoketest)."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Print verification report JSON to stdout in addition to writing it to disk.",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    artifacts = [
        _verify_security_gate(),
        _verify_route_inventory(),
        _verify_smoketest(),
    ]

    overall_ok = all(a.ok for a in artifacts)
    overall_status = "ok" if overall_ok else "fail"

    report = VerificationReport(
        overall_status=overall_status,
        artifacts=tuple(artifacts),
    )
    _write_report(report)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2))

    print("IRONCLAW VERIFY:", overall_status.upper())
    for artifact in artifacts:
        label = "OK" if artifact.ok else "FAIL"
        print(f"[{label}] {artifact.name}: {artifact.detail}")

    return 0 if overall_ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/worker/remediation",
    tags=["remediation-worker"],
)


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


JobStatus = Literal["pending", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"]

RemediationKind = Literal[
    "configuration_change",
    "access_control",
    "network_control",
    "detection_rule",
    "data_protection",
    "process_runbook",
    "other",
]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RemediationJob:
    """Worker-side representation of a remediation action execution job."""

    id: str
    action_id: str
    kind: RemediationKind
    title: str
    description: str
    target: str
    requested_by: str
    status: JobStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    started_at: str | None = None
    completed_at: str | None = None
    attempts: int = 0
    max_attempts: int = 3
    last_error: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "action_id": self.action_id,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "title": self.title,
            "description": self.description,
            "target": self.target,
            "requested_by": self.requested_by,
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
            "attempts": self.attempts,
            "max_attempts": self.max_attempts,
            "last_error": self.last_error,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


# In-memory job store (you can swap this for Redis/DB later)
_JOBS: dict[str, RemediationJob] = {}
_JOB_COUNTER: int = 0


# --------- Pydantic views ----------------------------------------------------


class RemediationJobCreate(BaseModel):
    """
    Job creation payload. This is typically invoked by your queue/bridge
    when a remediation action moves to 'queued' state on the UI side.
    """

    action_id: str = Field(..., description="ID of the remediation action.")
    kind: RemediationKind = Field(..., description="Type of remediation action.")
    title: str = Field(..., description="Short title for this job.")
    description: str = Field(..., description="What this job will attempt to do.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="System/asset this job targets.")
    requested_by: str = Field(..., description="Who requested execution (user, system).")
    max_attempts: int = Field(
        default=3,
        ge=1,
        le=10,
        description="Maximum number of attempts before permanent failure.",
    )
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional extra context (e.g., incident id, environment).",
    )


class RemediationJobView(BaseModel):
    id: str
    action_id: str
    kind: RemediationKind
    title: str
    description: str
    target: str
    requested_by: str
    status: JobStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    started_at: str | None = None
    completed_at: str | None = None
    attempts: int
    max_attempts: int
    last_error: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class RemediationJobListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[RemediationJobView]
    page: int
    page_size: int
    total_items: int
    total_pages: int
    generated_at: str


class RemediationJobStatusUpdate(BaseModel):
    """
    External status update for a job, for example from an out-of-process
    worker executor or orchestrator.[web:1300][web:1303]
    """

    status: JobStatus = Field(
        ...,
        description="New status for this job (running, succeeded, failed, cancelled).",
    )
    last_error: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional error message when marking job as failed.",
    )


# --------- internal helpers --------------------------------------------------


def _next_job_id() -> str:
    global _JOB_COUNTER
    _JOB_COUNTER += 1
    return f"job-{_JOB_COUNTER}"


def _paginate_jobs(
    jobs: list[RemediationJob],
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> tuple[list[RemediationJob], int, int]:
    total_items = len(jobs)
    if total_items == 0:
        return [], 0, 0

    total_pages = (total_items + page_size - 1) // page_size
    page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))

    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    return jobs[start:end], total_items, total_pages


def _simulate_execution(job: RemediationJob) -> None:
    """
    Placeholder execution logic.

    In a real system, this would dispatch to a secure executor engine
    (e.g., workflow engine, Ansible, Terraform, internal tools) and
    update status based on the external result.[web:1299][web:1303]
    """
    from random import random

    job.attempts += 1
    job.started_at = job.started_at or _utc_now()

    # Simple random success/failure for now
    if random() > 0.15:
        job.status = "succeeded"
        job.completed_at = _utc_now()
        job.last_error = None
    else:
        job.status = "failed"
        job.completed_at = _utc_now()
        job.last_error = "Simulated execution failure"
    job.updated_at = _utc_now()


# --------- HTTP endpoints ----------------------------------------------------


@router.post("/jobs", response_model=RemediationJobView, status_code=201)
def create_remediation_job(payload: RemediationJobCreate) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Create a remediation execution job.

    Called by your queue/bridge component when a remediation action
    transitions to 'queued' on the UI side.[web:1300][web:1303]
    """
    job_id = _next_job_id()
    now = _utc_now()
    job = RemediationJob(
        id=job_id,
        action_id=payload.action_id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        title=payload.title,
        description=payload.description,
        target=payload.target,
        requested_by=payload.requested_by,
        status="pending",
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        max_attempts=payload.max_attempts,
        metadata=dict(payload.metadata),
    )
    _JOBS[job_id] = job
    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())


@router.get("/jobs", response_model=RemediationJobListResponse)
def list_remediation_jobs(
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number for remediation jobs."),
    page_size: int = Query(
        20,
        ge=1,
        le=100,
        description="Number of jobs per page (max 100).",
    ),
    status: JobStatus | None = Query(
        default=None,
        description="Optional filter by job status.",
    ),
    action_id: str | None = Query(
        default=None,
        description="Optional filter by remediation action id.",
    ),
) -> RemediationJobListResponse:
    """
    List remediation jobs for monitoring and debugging.

    Supports filtering by status and action_id, and basic pagination.[web:1301][web:1303]
    """
    jobs = list(_JOBS.values())
    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: j.created_at, reverse=True)

    if status is not None:
        jobs = [j for j in jobs if j.status == status]
    if action_id is not None:
        jobs = [j for j in jobs if j.action_id == action_id]

    page_items, total_items, total_pages = _paginate_jobs(jobs, page, page_size)

    return RemediationJobListResponse(
        items=[RemediationJobView(**j.to_dict()) for j in page_items],
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        total_items=total_items,
        total_pages=total_pages,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
    )


@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}", response_model=RemediationJobView)
def get_remediation_job(job_id: str) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Retrieve a single remediation job by id.
    """
    job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")
    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())


@router.post("/jobs/{job_id}/execute", response_model=RemediationJobView)
def execute_remediation_job(job_id: str) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Trigger execution of a remediation job.

    In a real deployment, this would likely be restricted to internal
    workers only (e.g., via network policy, auth scopes, or mTLS).[web:1172][web:1291]
    """
    job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")

    if job.status not in ("pending", "failed"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Cannot execute job in status {job.status}")

    if job.attempts >= job.max_attempts:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Max attempts exceeded for this job")

    job.status = "running"
    job.started_at = job.started_at or _utc_now()
    job.updated_at = _utc_now()

    # Simulate execution inline for now
    _simulate_execution(job)

    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())


@router.patch("/jobs/{job_id}/status", response_model=RemediationJobView)
def update_remediation_job_status(
    job_id: str,
    payload: RemediationJobStatusUpdate,
) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Update job status from an external worker/orchestrator.

    This keeps the worker-side API generic if you later move execution
    out-of-process (e.g., to a queue consumer or Kubernetes Job).[web:1300][web:1303]
    """
    job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")

    now = _utc_now()
    job.status = payload.status
    job.updated_at = now

    if payload.status == "running":
        job.started_at = job.started_at or now
    elif payload.status in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
        job.completed_at = now

    job.last_error = payload.last_error
    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())

from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.errors import register_exception_handlers
from app.core.logging import RequestContextMiddleware, configure_logging
from app.core.ratelimit import install_rate_limit_middleware
from app.core.security import install_security_middleware
from app.core.settings import Settings, get_settings


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    environment: str


class ReadinessComponent(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    details: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    environment: str
    checks: list[ReadinessComponent]


def _safe_attr(obj: Any, *names: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if isinstance(obj, dict) and name in obj:
            return obj[name]
        if hasattr(obj, name):
            return getattr(obj, name)
    return default


def _build_readiness_checks(settings: Settings, app: FastAPI) -> list[ReadinessComponent]:
    checks: list[ReadinessComponent] = []

    checks.append(
        ReadinessComponent(
            name="settings",
            status="ok",
            details={
                "api_prefix": settings.api_prefix,
                "guard_actions_enabled": settings.enable_guard_actions,
                "guard_policy_enabled": settings.enable_guard_action_policy,
                "guard_decision_enabled": settings.enable_guard_action_decision,
                "structured_logging_enabled": settings.structured_logging_enabled,
            },
        )
    )

    scanner_service: Optional[Any] = getattr(app.state, "scanner_service", None)
    checks.append(
        ReadinessComponent(
            name="scanner_service",
            status="ok" if scanner_service is not None else "not_configured",
            details={
                "present": scanner_service is not None,
            },
        )
    )

    history_service: Optional[Any] = getattr(app.state, "history_service", None)
    checks.append(
        ReadinessComponent(
            name="history_service",
            status="ok" if history_service is not None else "not_configured",
            details={
                "present": history_service is not None,
            },
        )
    )

    groq_ready = (not settings.groq_enabled) or bool(settings.groq_api_key)
    checks.append(
        ReadinessComponent(
            name="groq",
            status="ok" if groq_ready else "misconfigured",
            details={
                "enabled": settings.groq_enabled,
                "model": settings.groq_model,
                "api_key_present": bool(settings.groq_api_key),
                "timeout_seconds": settings.groq_timeout_seconds,
            },
        )
    )

    return checks


def _overall_readiness_status(checks: list[ReadinessComponent]) -> str:
    failing_statuses = {"error", "failed", "misconfigured"}
    if any(check.status in failing_statuses for check in checks):
        return "degraded"
    return "ok"


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    settings = get_settings()
    configure_logging(settings)
    app.state.settings = settings
    yield


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()
    configure_logging(settings)

    app = FastAPI(
        title=settings.app_name,
        version=settings.app_version,
        debug=settings.debug,
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )

    register_exception_handlers(app)
    install_security_middleware(app, settings)
    install_rate_limit_middleware(app)
    app.add_middleware(RequestContextMiddleware)

    @app.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse, tags=["system"])
    def health(config: Settings = Depends(get_settings)) -> HealthResponse:
        return HealthResponse(
            status="ok",
            service=config.app_name,
            version=config.app_version,
            environment=config.environment.value,
        )

    @app.get("/ready", response_model=ReadinessResponse, tags=["system"])
    def readiness(config: Settings = Depends(get_settings)) -> ReadinessResponse:
        checks = _build_readiness_checks(config, app)
        return ReadinessResponse(
            status=_overall_readiness_status(checks),
            service=config.app_name,
            version=config.app_version,
            environment=config.environment.value,
            checks=checks,
        )

    return app


app = create_app()

from __future__ import annotations

from time import perf_counter
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

from app.core.settings import get_settings


class InMemoryHistoryService:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def append_scan_result(self, result: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._items.append(dict(result))

    def list_results(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list(self._items)

    def get_result(self, scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        for item in self._items:
            if item.get("scan_id") == scan_id:
                return dict(item)
        return None


class DefaultScannerService:
    def perform_scan(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


class DefaultGuardService:
    def evaluate(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


class DefaultActionPolicyService:
    def evaluate(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


class DefaultActionDecisionService:
    def evaluate(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {}


def configure_app_state(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "settings"):
        app.state.settings = settings

    if not hasattr(app.state, "scanner_service"):
        app.state.scanner_service = DefaultScannerService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "history_service"):
        app.state.history_service = InMemoryHistoryService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "guard_service"):
        app.state.guard_service = DefaultGuardService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "action_policy_service"):
        app.state.action_policy_service = DefaultActionPolicyService()

    if not hasattr(app.state, "action_decision_service"):
        app.state.action_decision_service = DefaultActionDecisionService()

    return app


def add_request_tracing_middleware(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    if getattr(app.state, "_request_tracing_middleware_installed", False):
        return app

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def add_request_tracing(request: Request, call_next):
        request_id = request.headers.get("X-Request-ID") or str(uuid4())
        trace_id = request.headers.get("X-Trace-ID") or request_id
        started_at = perf_counter()

        request.state.request_id = request_id
        request.state.trace_id = trace_id
        request.state.request_started_at = started_at

        response = await call_next(request)

        duration_ms = max(0, int((perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000))

        response.headers.setdefault("X-Request-ID", request_id)
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Trace-ID", trace_id)
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Response-Time-Ms", str(duration_ms))

        return response

    app.state._request_tracing_middleware_installed = True
    return app


def add_security_middleware(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    if getattr(app.state, "_security_middleware_installed", False):
        return app

    @app.middleware("http")
    async def add_security_headers(request: Request, call_next):
        response = await call_next(request)
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
        response.headers.setdefault("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        response.headers.setdefault("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin")
        response.headers.setdefault("X-XSS-Protection", "1; mode=block")
        response.headers.setdefault("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()")
        response.headers.setdefault("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", "same-origin")
        response.headers.setdefault("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", "same-origin")
        if request.url.scheme == "https":
            response.headers.setdefault(
                "Strict-Transport-Security",
                "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains",
            )
        return response

    app.state._security_middleware_installed = True
    return app


def bootstrap_app(app: FastAPI) -> FastAPI:
    """
    Entry point to configure global app state and middleware.
    Call this once, right after creating the FastAPI() instance.
    """
    app = configure_app_state(app)
    app = add_request_tracing_middleware(app)
