from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from app.adapters.base import (
    AdapterExecutionRequest,
    AdapterExecutionResult,
    BaseIntegrationAdapter,
)
from app.orchestrator.policy_enforcer import (
    PolicyDecision,
    PolicyEngine,
    PolicyInput,
    evaluate_policy,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    get_integration,
)

AdapterVerdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]
AdapterExecutionMode = Literal["monitor", "enforce"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


# ---------- Policy-facing adapter request/response ----------


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OpenClawAdapterRequest:
    """
    High-level request wrapper for OpenClaw builder/workflow actions.

    This is the policy-facing representation of an OpenClaw action that will be
    evaluated by the IronClaw policy engine.
    """

    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str = ""
    builder_id: str | None = None
    workflow_id: str | None = None
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_policy_input(self) -> PolicyInput:
        """
        Convert this request into a PolicyInput for the policy engine.

        builder_id and workflow_id are folded into metadata so they can be
        targeted by policy rules without changing the PolicyInput shape.
        """
        merged_metadata: dict[str, Any] = dict(self.metadata)
        if self.builder_id:
            merged_metadata["builder_id"] = self.builder_id
        if self.workflow_id:
            merged_metadata["workflow_id"] = self.workflow_id

        return PolicyInput(
            action_type=self.action_type,
            target=self.target,
            content=self.content,
            client_id=self.client_id,
            session_id=self.session_id,
            metadata=merged_metadata,
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Serialize this request into a JSON-safe dict for logging/telemetry.
        """
        return {
            "action_type": self.action_type,
            "target": self.target,
            "content": self.content,
            "builder_id": self.builder_id,
            "workflow_id": self.workflow_id,
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OpenClawAdapterResponse:
    """
    Normalized policy decision payload for OpenClaw.

    This wraps a PolicyDecision with OpenClaw-specific flags (should_hold, etc.)
    so the builder/workflow runtime can make simple allow/hold decisions.
    """

    adapter_name: str
    platform: str
    mode: AdapterExecutionMode
    verdict: AdapterVerdict
    should_allow: bool
    should_warn: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_hold: bool
    risk_score: int
    risk_level: str
    summary: str
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    decision_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    reviewed_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    request: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Serialize this response into a JSON-safe dict for logging/telemetry.
        """
        return {
            "adapter_name": self.adapter_name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "mode": self.mode,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "should_allow": self.should_allow,
            "should_warn": self.should_warn,
            "should_quarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "should_block": self.should_block,
            "should_hold": self.should_hold,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "risk_level": self.risk_level,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "matched_rules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "decision_id": self.decision_id,
            "trace_id": self.trace_id,
            "reviewed_at": self.reviewed_at,
            "request": dict(self.request),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def build_openclaw_adapter_request(
    *,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    builder_id: str | None = None,
    workflow_id: str | None = None,
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> OpenClawAdapterRequest:
    """
    Convenience constructor that normalizes and validates inbound fields.

    Ensures action_type and target are non-empty, trims string fields, and
    shields callers from having to know about default metadata behavior.
    """
    normalized_action_type = _normalize_text(action_type)
    normalized_target = _normalize_text(target)

    if not normalized_action_type:
        raise ValueError("action_type is required")
    if not normalized_target:
        raise ValueError("target is required")

    return OpenClawAdapterRequest(
        action_type=normalized_action_type,
        target=normalized_target,
        content=content or "",
        builder_id=_normalize_text(builder_id) or None,
        workflow_id=_normalize_text(workflow_id) or None,
        client_id=_normalize_text(client_id) or None,
        session_id=_normalize_text(session_id) or None,
        metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )


def adapt_policy_decision_to_openclaw(
    decision: PolicyDecision,
    *,
    mode: AdapterExecutionMode = "enforce",
    trace_id: str | None = None,
    request: OpenClawAdapterRequest | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> OpenClawAdapterResponse:
    """
    Map a PolicyDecision into an OpenClawAdapterResponse.

    should_hold is when a decision is anything other than allow so the
    OpenClaw runtime can pause the workflow until a human reviews.
    """
    verdict: AdapterVerdict = decision.verdict
    matched_rules = [match.rule_id for match in decision.matches]
    reasons = [match.to_dict() for match in decision.matches]
    should_hold = verdict in {"warn", "quarantine", "block"}

    return OpenClawAdapterResponse(
        adapter_name="ironclaw-openclaw",
        platform="openclaw",
        mode=mode,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_allow=verdict == "allow",
        should_warn=verdict == "warn",
        should_quarantine=verdict == "quarantine",
        should_block=verdict == "block",
        should_hold=should_hold,
        risk_score=decision.risk_score,
        risk_level=decision.risk_level,
        summary=decision.summary,
        matched_rules=matched_rules,
        reasons=reasons,
        decision_id=decision.decision_id,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        request=request.to_dict() if request else {},
        metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )


def evaluate_openclaw_request(
    engine: PolicyEngine,
    request: OpenClawAdapterRequest,
    *,
    risk_score: int = 0,
    mode: AdapterExecutionMode = "enforce",
    trace_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> OpenClawAdapterResponse:
    """
    One-shot helper: evaluate a request and return an OpenClawAdapterResponse.
    """
    decision = evaluate_policy(
        engine,
        request.to_policy_input(),
        risk_score=risk_score,
    )
    return adapt_policy_decision_to_openclaw(
        decision,
        mode=mode,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        request=request,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def summarize_openclaw_adapter_response(
    response: OpenClawAdapterResponse,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Compact summary record for dashboards, logs, or telemetry streams.
    """
    return {
        "adapter_name": response.adapter_name,
        "platform": response.platform,
        "mode": response.mode,
        "verdict": response.verdict,
        "should_hold": response.should_hold,
        "risk_score": response.risk_score,
        "risk_level": response.risk_level,
        "summary": response.summary,
        "matched_rule_count": len(response.matched_rules),
        "decision_id": response.decision_id,
        "trace_id": response.trace_id,
        "reviewed_at": response.reviewed_at,
    }


# ---------- Integration-facing OpenClaw adapter class ----------


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OpenClawAdapter(BaseIntegrationAdapter):
    """
    Integration adapter for the OpenClaw runtime.

    This wraps guarded OpenClaw workflow executions and annotates results so the
    IronClaw UI can show that a builder workflow was gate-kept by policy.
    """

    runtime: str = "openclaw"
    workflow_mode: str = "builder-guard"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        # Ensure core metadata keys are present and stable for handshakes/manifests.
        self.metadata.setdefault("integration_id", self.record.integration_id)
        self.metadata.setdefault("runtime", self.runtime)
        self.metadata.setdefault("workflow_mode", self.workflow_mode)

    def execute(self, request: AdapterExecutionRequest) -> AdapterExecutionResult:
        """
        Execute a guarded OpenClaw workflow action.

        For now we delegate to the BaseIntegrationAdapter for any shared plumbing
        and then mark the result as "guarded" with OpenClaw-specific metadata.
        """
        result = super().execute(request)

        # Mark this as a guarded workflow execution for dashboards/telemetry.
        result.status = "guarded"
        result.summary = (
            f"{self.record.name} guarded workflow action "
            f"'{request.action_type}' for target '{request.target}'."
        )

        # Attach guard-specific output details and a minimal echo of the request.
        result.output.setdefault("guard_applied", True)
        result.output.setdefault("execution_mode", "workflow-gated")
        result.output.setdefault(
            "request",
            {
                "action_type": request.action_type,
                "target": request.target,
                "payload": request.payload,
            },
        )

        # Propagate runtime metadata so tests and UI can assert on it.
        result.metadata.setdefault("runtime", self.runtime)
        result.metadata.setdefault("workflow_mode", self.workflow_mode)

        return result


def build_openclaw_adapter(registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> OpenClawAdapter:
    """
    Factory to construct an OpenClawAdapter from the integration registry.

    Expected to back tests in tests/test_openclaw_adapter.py.

    record = get_integration(registry, "integration-openclaw")
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError("unknown integration_id: integration-openclaw")

    return OpenClawAdapter(
        record=record,
        protocol_version="1.0.0",
        health="ready",
        metadata={
            "integration_id": record.integration_id,
            "runtime": "openclaw",
            "workflow_mode": "builder-guard",
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, Sequence

from app.runtime.sandboxrouter import (
    SandboxExecutionRequest,
    SandboxExecutionResult,
    build_sandbox_router,
)


ExecutorCallable = Callable[..., Any]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxRuntimeAdapter:
    router: Any = field(default_factory=build_sandbox_router)
    executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None
    name: str = "sandboxruntimeadapter"

    def execute(
        self,
        *,
        actiontype: str,
        target: str,
        command: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        network_url: str | None = None,
        network_method: str = "GET",
        artifact_paths: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        content: str | bytes | None = None,
        cwd: str | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: int = 30,
        environment_scope: str = "sandbox",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        request = SandboxExecutionRequest(
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            command=command,
            network_url=network_url,
            network_method=network_method,
            artifact_paths=[str(item) for item in (artifact_paths or []) if str(item).strip()],
            content=content,
            cwd=cwd,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            environment_scope=environment_scope,
            metadata={
                **dict(metadata or {}),
                "adapter": self.name,
            },
        )

        result = self.router.route(
            request=request,
            executor=self.executor,
        )
        return self._normalize_result(result=result)

    def evaluate_only(
        self,
        *,
        actiontype: str,
        target: str,
        command: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        network_url: str | None = None,
        network_method: str = "GET",
        artifact_paths: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        content: str | bytes | None = None,
        cwd: str | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: int = 30,
        environment_scope: str = "sandbox",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        request = SandboxExecutionRequest(
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            command=command,
            network_url=network_url,
            network_method=network_method,
            artifact_paths=[str(item) for item in (artifact_paths or []) if str(item).strip()],
            content=content,
            cwd=cwd,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            environment_scope=environment_scope,
            metadata={
                **dict(metadata or {}),
                "adapter": self.name,
                "mode": "evaluate_only",
            },
        )

        decision = self.router.evaluate(request=request)
        return decision.as_dict()

    def _normalize_result(self, *, result: SandboxExecutionResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = result.as_dict()
        payload.setdefault("adapter", self.name)
        payload.setdefault("runtime", "sandbox")
        return payload


def initialize_sandboxruntimeadapter(
    *,
    router: Any | None = None,
    executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None,
) -> SandboxRuntimeAdapter:
    return SandboxRuntimeAdapter(
        router=router or build_sandbox_router(),
        executor=executor,
    )


def build_sandboxruntimeadapter() -> SandboxRuntimeAdapter:
    return initialize_sandboxruntimeadapter()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.api.actionguard import guardaction


router = APIRouter(prefix="/decision", tags=["action-decision"])


DecisionOutcome = Literal["allow", "review", "quarantine", "deny"]
DecisionState = Literal["approved", "queuedforreview", "quarantined", "denied"]


class ActionDecisionRequest(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str = Field(..., description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="Target such as URL, shell, file path, or tool id.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Prompt or action content to evaluate.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score before decision logic.")
    clientid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Session or workflow id.")
    filepath: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional source filepath for attribution.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional metadata from retrieved docs, tools, files, or model outputs.",
    )


class DecisionReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class ActionDecisionResponse(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    outcome: DecisionOutcome
    state: DecisionState
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    requiresreview: bool
    filepath: str
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    reason: str
    reasons: list[DecisionReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def decideaction(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    guard = guardaction(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata,
    )

    verdict = guard["verdict"]
    if verdict == "allow":
        outcome: DecisionOutcome = "allow"
        state: DecisionState = "approved"
        shouldexecute = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        requiresreview = False
        reason = "Decision engine approved execution."
    elif verdict == "review":
        outcome = "review"
        state = "queuedforreview"
        shouldexecute = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        requiresreview = True
        reason = "Decision engine queued the action for review."
    elif verdict == "quarantine":
        outcome = "quarantine"
        state = "quarantined"
        shouldexecute = False
        haltedbyboundary = True
        requiresreview = False
        reason = "Decision engine quarantined execution."
    else:
        outcome = "deny"
        state = "denied"
        shouldexecute = False
        haltedbyboundary = True
        requiresreview = False
        reason = "Decision engine denied execution."

    return {
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "outcome": outcome,
        "state": state,
        "shouldexecute": shouldexecute,
        "haltedbyboundary": haltedbyboundary,
        "requiresreview": requiresreview,
        "filepath": guard["filepath"],
        "baseriskscore": guard["baseriskscore"],
        "adjustedriskscore": guard["adjustedriskscore"],
        "reason": reason,
        "reasons": guard["reasons"],
        "promptinjection": guard["promptinjection"],
    }


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=ActionDecisionResponse,
    summary="Produce the final runtime action decision with prompt injection awareness.",
)
def actiondecision(payload: ActionDecisionRequest) -> ActionDecisionResponse:
    result = decideaction(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return ActionDecisionResponse(**result)

from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

router = APIRouter(prefix="/action", tags=["action-execution"])

AllowedActionType = Literal[
    "httpfetch",
    "browseropen",

    "fileread",

class ActionExecuteRequestModel(BaseModel):
    actiontype: AllowedActionType = Field(..., description="Type of action requested.")
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Target resource or tool name.")
    content: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Instructional content or payload associated with the action.",

class ActionExecuteResponse(BaseModel):
    status: Literal["allowed", "review", "quarantined", "denied"]
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    ownerkey: str
    requestedunits: int
    finalriskscore: int
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any]
    audit: dict[str, Any]
    executionallowed: bool
    usage: dict[str, Any]
    message: str


def _map_audit_event_to_status(
    eventtype: str,
) -> Literal["allowed", "review", "quarantined", "denied"]:
    if eventtype == "execution_allowed":
        return "allowed"
    if eventtype == "execution_review":
        return "review"
    if eventtype == "execution_quarantined":
        return "quarantined"
    return "denied"


def _empty_usage(reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "executionid": None,
        "executed": False,
        "consumedunits": 0,
        "remainingunits": 0,
        "reason": reason,
        "applied": False,
        "plan": None,
        "subscriptionid": None,
        "walletbalance": None,
    }


def _usage_to_dict(receipt: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    consumption = getattr(receipt, "consumption", None)
    return {
        "executionid": getattr(receipt, "execution_id", None),
        "executed": getattr(receipt, "executed", False),
        "consumedunits": getattr(receipt, "consumed_units", 0),
        "remainingunits": getattr(receipt, "remaining_units", 0),
        "reason": getattr(receipt, "reason", ""),
        "applied": bool(getattr(consumption, "applied", False)) if consumption else False,
        "plan": getattr(consumption, "plan", None) if consumption else None,
        "subscriptionid": getattr(consumption, "subscription_id", None)
        if consumption
        else None,
        "walletbalance": getattr(consumption, "wallet_balance", None)
        if consumption
        else None,
    }


@router.post("/execute", response_model=ActionExecuteResponse)
def executeaction(request: ActionExecuteRequestModel) -> ActionExecuteResponse:
    normalized_target = request.target.strip()
    if not normalized_target:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target must not be empty")

    # 1. Prompt injection and risk
    promptinjection = scanpromptinjectiondict(
        actiontype=request.actiontype,
        target=normalized_target,
        content=request.content,
        filepath=request.filepath,
        metadata=request.metadata,
    )

    finalriskscore = request.riskscore + int(promptinjection["riskdelta"])

    mergedmetadata = dict(request.metadata)
    mergedmetadata["promptinjection"] = promptinjection
    mergedmetadata["ownerkey"] = request.ownerkey
    mergedmetadata["requestedunits"] = request.requestedunits

    # 2. Security audit decides status
    audit = createauditevent(
        actiontype=request.actiontype,
        target=normalized_target,
        content=request.content,
        riskscore=finalriskscore,
        clientid=request.clientid,
        sessionid=request.sessionid,
        filepath=request.filepath,
        metadata=mergedmetadata,
    )

    status = _map_audit_event_to_status(audit["eventtype"])

    # If security does not allow, we never try to consume usage
    if status != "allowed":
        if status == "review":
            message = "Action requires manual review before execution."
        elif status == "quarantined":
            message = "Action has been quarantined due to elevated risk."
        else:
            message = "Action has been denied."

        return ActionExecuteResponse(
            status=status,
            actiontype=request.actiontype,
            target=normalized_target,
            ownerkey=request.ownerkey,
            requestedunits=request.requestedunits,
            finalriskscore=finalriskscore,
            promptinjection=promptinjection,
            audit=audit,
            executionallowed=False,
            usage=_empty_usage(reason="blocked_by_security_review"),
            message=message,
        )

    # 3. Security says allowed; we *attempt* usage metering but do not downgrade status
    service = get_action_execute_service()

    try:
        receipt = service.execute(
            ActionExecutionRequest(
                owner_key=request.ownerkey,
                action_name=f"{request.actiontype}:{normalized_target}",
                requested_units=request.requestedunits,
                payload={
                    "content": request.content,
                    "filepath": request.filepath,
                },
                metadata=mergedmetadata,
            )
        )
        usage = _usage_to_dict(receipt)
    except Exception:
        # Treat metering failures as non-fatal for this boundary
        return ActionExecuteResponse(
            status="allowed",
            actiontype=request.actiontype,
            target=normalized_target,
            ownerkey=request.ownerkey,
            requestedunits=request.requestedunits,
            finalriskscore=finalriskscore,
            promptinjection=promptinjection,
            audit=audit,
            executionallowed=True,
            usage=_empty_usage(reason="usage_metering_unavailable"),
            message="Action approved for execution.",
        )

    # We do not override the audit-driven status; if audit said allowed, we stay allowed
    return ActionExecuteResponse(
        status="allowed",
        actiontype=request.actiontype,
        target=normalized_target,
        ownerkey=request.ownerkey,
        requestedunits=request.requestedunits,
        finalriskscore=finalriskscore,
        promptinjection=promptinjection,
        audit=audit,
        executionallowed=True,
        usage=usage,
        message="Action approved for execution.",
    )

def guardaction(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    policy = evaluateactionpolicy(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata,
    )

    policy_action = policy["action"]
    if policy_action == "allow":
        verdict: GuardVerdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        requiresreview = False
        quarantined = False
        reason = "Guard allowed the action."
    elif policy_action == "review":
        verdict = "review"
        allowed = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        requiresreview = True
        quarantined = False
        reason = "Guard routed the action for review."
    elif policy_action == "quarantine":
        verdict = "quarantine"
        allowed = False
        haltedbyboundary = True
        requiresreview = False
        quarantined = True
        reason = "Guard quarantined the action."
    else:
        verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        haltedbyboundary = True
        requiresreview = False
        quarantined = False
        reason = "Guard denied the action."

    return {
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "allowed": allowed,
        "haltedbyboundary": haltedbyboundary,
        "requiresreview": requiresreview,
        "quarantined": quarantined,
        "baseriskscore": policy["baseriskscore"],
        "adjustedriskscore": policy["adjustedriskscore"],
        "filepath": policy["filepath"],
        "reason": reason,
        "reasons": policy["reasons"],
        "promptinjection": policy["promptinjection"],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.security.promptinjection import scanpromptinjectiondict


router = APIRouter(prefix="/policy", tags=["action-policy"])


PolicyVerdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]
PolicyAction = Literal["allow", "review", "quarantine", "deny"]


class ActionPolicyRequest(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str = Field(..., description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="Target such as URL, shell, filesystem path, or tool id.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Action content, prompt, or instruction text.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score before policy adjustments.")
    clientid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Session or conversation id.")
    filepath: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description="Optional source file path for audit attribution.",
    )
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional contextual metadata from retrieved content, tool outputs, or files.",
    )


class PolicyReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class ActionPolicyResponse(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    verdict: PolicyVerdict
    action: PolicyAction
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    promptinjectionflagged: bool
    indirectpromptinjectionflagged: bool
    shouldreview: bool
    shouldquarantine: bool
    shouldblock: bool
    filepath: str
    summary: str
    reasons: list[PolicyReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _build_policy_reason(source: str, label: str, details: str, score: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "source": source,
        "label": label,
        "details": details,
        "score": score,
    }


def evaluateactionpolicy(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    effective_filepath = filepath or "app/api/actionexecute.py"
    effectivemetadata = dict(metadata or {})
    if clientid:
        effectivemetadata.setdefault("clientid", clientid)
    if sessionid:
        effectivemetadata.setdefault("sessionid", sessionid)
    effectivemetadata.setdefault("filepath", effective_filepath)

    promptscan = scanpromptinjectiondict(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        filepath=effective_filepath,
        metadata=effectivemetadata,
    )

    adjustedriskscore = max(0, min(100, int(riskscore) + int(promptscan.get("riskdelta", 0))))
    categories = set(promptscan.get("categories", []))

    shouldquarantine = bool(promptscan.get("shouldquarantine"))
    shouldblock = adjustedriskscore >= 85 and not shouldquarantine
    shouldreview = bool(promptscan.get("shouldreview")) or adjustedriskscore >= 50

    if shouldquarantine:
        verdict: PolicyVerdict = "quarantine"
        action: PolicyAction = "quarantine"
        summary = "Policy quarantined the action because prompt injection indicators crossed containment thresholds."
    elif shouldblock:
        verdict = "block"
        action = "deny"
        summary = "Policy blocked the action because adjusted runtime risk exceeded the execution threshold."
    elif shouldreview:
        verdict = "warn"
        action = "review"
        summary = "Policy routed the action for review because prompt injection or indirect instruction indicators were detected."
    else:
        verdict = "allow"
        action = "allow"
        summary = "Policy allowed the action because no blocking or review threshold was crossed."

    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        _build_policy_reason(
            source="policy",
            label="Risk policy evaluation",
            details=(
                f"Policy evaluated action '{actiontype}' on target '{target}' with base risk {int(riskscore)} "
                f"and adjusted risk {adjustedriskscore}."
            ),
            score=adjustedriskscore,
        )
    ]

    for item in promptscan.get("reasons", []):
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": str(item.get("source", "promptinjection")),
                    "label": str(item.get("label", "Prompt injection indicator")),
                    "details": str(item.get("details", "")),
                    "score": int(item.get("score", 0)),
                }
            )
        else:
            reasons.append(
                _build_policy_reason(
                    source="promptinjection",
                    label="Prompt injection indicator",
                    details=str(item),
                    score=0,
                )
            )

    return {
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "action": action,
        "baseriskscore": int(riskscore),
        "adjustedriskscore": adjustedriskscore,
        "promptinjectionflagged": bool(promptscan.get("flagged")),
        "indirectpromptinjectionflagged": "indirect_prompt_injection" in categories,
        "shouldreview": shouldreview,
        "shouldquarantine": shouldquarantine,
        "shouldblock": shouldblock,
        "filepath": effective_filepath,
        "summary": summary,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "promptinjection": promptscan,
    }


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=ActionPolicyResponse,
    summary="Evaluate runtime action policy with prompt injection awareness.",
)
def actionpolicy(payload: ActionPolicyRequest) -> ActionPolicyResponse:
    result = evaluateactionpolicy(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return ActionPolicyResponse(**result)

def _request_meta(request: Request) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    return {
        "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
        "trace_id": getattr(request.state, "trace_id", None),
        "path": request.url.path,
        "method": request.method,

@router.post("/execute", response_model=ExecuteResponse)
def guarded_execute(
    payload: ExecuteRequest,
    request: Request,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline = Depends(get_action_execute_pipeline),
) -> ExecuteResponse:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "guard_execute_requested",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "action_type": payload.action_type,
                "target": payload.target,
                "client_id": payload.client_id,
                "session_id": payload.session_id,
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    response_payload = guardandexecuteaction(
        payload,
        pipeline=pipeline,
    )

    response = ExecuteResponse(**response_payload)

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "guard_execute_completed",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "action_type": payload.action_type,
                "target": payload.target,
                "client_id": payload.client_id,
                "session_id": payload.session_id,
                "execution_id": getattr(response, "execution_id", None),
                "execution_state": getattr(response, "execution_state", None),
                "response_action": getattr(response, "response_action", None),
                "response_status": getattr(response, "response_status", None),
                "trace_id_response": getattr(response, "trace_id", None),
                "request_id_response": getattr(response, "request_id", None),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return response

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request

    ActionDecisionResponse,
    ActionGuardRequest,
    ActionGuardResponse,
    ActionPolicyResponse,
)

    ActionExecutionDecision,
    evaluate_action_execution,
)
from app.services.action_guard import (
    ActionGuardDecision,
    analyze_action,
)
from app.services.action_policy import (
    ActionPolicyDecision,
    evaluate_action_policy,
)
from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event


router = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(limit_guard_routes)])


_ALLOWED_REASON_SOURCES = {"policy", "scan", "ai"}
_REASON_SOURCE_MAP = {
    "promptinjection": "scan",
    "prompt_injection": "scan",
}


def _normalize_reason_source(source: object) -> str:
    value = str(source or "scan").strip().lower()
    if value in _ALLOWED_REASON_SOURCES:
        return value
    return _REASON_SOURCE_MAP.get(value, "scan")


def _normalize_reasons(reasons: list[object]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    normalized: list[dict[str, object]] = []

    for item in reasons:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            normalized.append(
                {
                    "source": _normalize_reason_source(item.get("source")),
                    "label": str(item.get("label") or item.get("code") or "Explanation"),
                    "details": str(
                        item.get("details")
                        or item.get("message")
                        or item.get("summary")
                        or ""
                    ),
                    "score": (
                        float(item["score"])
                        if item.get("score") is not None
                        else None
                    ),
                }
            )
        else:
            normalized.append(
                {
                    "source": "scan",
                    "label": "Explanation",
                    "details": str(item),
                    "score": None,
                }
            )

    return normalized


def _request_context(payload: ActionGuardRequest, request: Request) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "action_type": payload.action_type,
        "target": payload.target,
        "client_id": payload.client_id,
        "session_id": payload.session_id,
        "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
        "trace_id": getattr(request.state, "trace_id", None),
        "path": request.url.path,
        "method": request.method,
    }


@router.post("/action", response_model=ActionGuardResponse)
def guard_action(payload: ActionGuardRequest, request: Request) -> ActionGuardResponse:
    append_telemetry_event(
        "guard_action_requested",
        _request_context(payload, request),
    )

    result: ActionGuardDecision = analyze_action(
        action_type=payload.action_type,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        client_id=payload.client_id,
        session_id=payload.session_id,
    )
    result["reasons"] = _normalize_reasons(result.get("reasons", []))

    response = ActionGuardResponse(**result)

    append_telemetry_event(
        "guard_action_completed",
        {
            **_request_context(payload, request),
            "risk_score": getattr(response, "risk_score", None),
            "verdict": getattr(response, "verdict", None),
            "reason_count": len(getattr(response, "reasons", [])),
        },
    )

    return response

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict, field_validator

from app.api.actiondecision import decideaction


router = APIRouter(prefix="/audit", tags=["audit"])


AuditEventType = Literal[
    "execution_allowed",
    "execution_review",
    "execution_quarantined",
    "execution_denied",
]
AuditSeverity = Literal["info", "warning", "high", "critical"]


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _newid(prefix: str) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}_{uuid4().hex}"


def _coerceoutcome(value: Any) -> str:
    outcome = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if outcome in {"allow", "review", "quarantine", "deny", "denied", "block", "blocked"}:
        return outcome
    return "deny"


def _eventshape(outcome: str) -> tuple[AuditEventType, AuditSeverity, str]:
    if outcome == "allow":
        return (
            "execution_allowed",
            "info",
            "Audit recorded an allowed execution path.",
        )
    if outcome == "review":
        return (
            "execution_review",
            "warning",
            "Audit recorded a review-required execution path.",
        )
    if outcome == "quarantine":
        return (
            "execution_quarantined",
            "critical",
            "Audit recorded a quarantined execution path.",
        )
    return (
        "execution_denied",
        "high",
        "Audit recorded a denied execution path.",
    )


class AuditReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int


class AuditRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    actiontype: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Execution target such as URL, shell, or file path.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Prompt or action content that produced the audit event.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Base risk score supplied to the audit pipeline.")
    clientid: str | None = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: str | None = Field(None, description="Session or workflow id.")
    filepath: str | None = Field(None, description="Optional source filepath for attribution.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional external context, tool outputs, retrieved content, or file text.",
    )

    @field_validator("actiontype", "target", "content", "clientid", "sessionid", "filepath", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _stripstrings(cls, value: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            value = value.strip()
        return value

    @field_validator("actiontype", "target")
    @classmethod
    def _requirenonempty(cls, value: str) -> str:
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("must not be empty")
        return value


class AuditResponse(BaseModel):
    auditeventid: str
    eventtype: AuditEventType
    severity: AuditSeverity
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    filepath: str
    traceid: str
    requestid: str
    decisionid: str
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    summary: str
    reasons: list[AuditReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    hostilecontext: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    createdat: str


def createauditevent(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    safe_metadata = metadata or {}
    decision = decideaction(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=safe_metadata,
    )

    outcome = _coerceoutcome(decision.get("outcome"))
    eventtype, severity, summary = _eventshape(outcome)

    return {
        "auditeventid": _newid("audit"),
        "eventtype": eventtype,
        "severity": severity,
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "filepath": str(decision.get("filepath") or filepath or ""),
        "traceid": str(decision.get("traceid") or _newid("trace")),
        "requestid": str(decision.get("requestid") or _newid("req")),
        "decisionid": str(decision.get("decisionid") or _newid("dec")),
        "baseriskscore": int(decision.get("baseriskscore", riskscore)),
        "adjustedriskscore": int(decision.get("adjustedriskscore", riskscore)),
        "summary": str(decision.get("summary") or summary),
        "reasons": decision.get("reasons") or [],
        "promptinjection": decision.get("promptinjection") or {},
        "hostilecontext": decision.get("hostilecontext") or {},
        "createdat": _utcnow(),
    }


@router.post(
    "/event",
    response_model=AuditResponse,
    summary="Create an audit event from the secured action decision path.",
)
def auditevent(payload: AuditRequest) -> AuditResponse:
    result = createauditevent(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return AuditResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.backupservice import (
    BackupManifest,
    BackupService,
    build_default_backup_service,
)


router = APIRouter(prefix="/backup", tags=["backup"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def get_backup_service() -> BackupService:
    return build_default_backup_service()


def _raise_backup_http_error(exc: Exception) -> None:
    if isinstance(exc, KeyError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    raise exc


class BackupTargetResponse(BaseModel):
    name: str
    kind: str
    format: str
    base_path: str
    rotation_policy: dict[str, Any]
    encrypt_at_rest: bool
    checksum_required: bool


class BackupManifestResponse(BaseModel):
    target_name: str
    target_kind: str
    backup_format: str
    backup_path: str
    created_at: str
    size_bytes: int
    sha256: str | None
    rotation_tier: str
    encryption_applied: bool
    meta: dict[str, Any]


class BackupStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Backup Control"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    targets: list[BackupTargetResponse]
    summary: dict[str, Any]


class BackupActionRequest(BaseModel):
    target_name: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    action: Literal["snapshot", "export", "rotate"] = "snapshot"


class BackupActionResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Backup Action"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    action: Literal["snapshot", "export", "rotate"]
    target_name: str
    result: dict[str, Any]


def _manifest_to_response(manifest: BackupManifest) -> BackupManifestResponse:

) -> BackupActionResponse:

        removed = service.rotate(target_name)

@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=BackupActionResponse,
    summary="Run a generic backup control action",
)
def run_backup_action(
    request: BackupActionRequest,
    service: Annotated[BackupService, Depends(get_backup_service)],
) -> BackupActionResponse:
    try:
        if request.action == "snapshot":
            manifest = service.run_snapshot(request.target_name)
            result: dict[str, Any] = _manifest_to_response(manifest).model_dump()
        elif request.action == "export":
            manifest = service.run_export(request.target_name)
            result = _manifest_to_response(manifest).model_dump()
        else:
            removed = service.rotate(request.target_name)
            result = {
                "removed_count": len(removed),
                "removed_paths": [str(path) for path in removed],
            }
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_backup_http_error(exc)

    return BackupActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action=request.action,
        target_name=request.target_name,
        result=result,
    )

def _infer_external_base_url(request: Request) -> str:
    scheme = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto") or request.url.scheme
    host = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Host") or request.headers.get("Host") or request.url.netloc
    return f"{scheme}://{host}".rstrip("/")


def _build_one_command_snippet(
    config: ClaudeGuardClientConfig,
    workspace_name: str,
) -> str:
    safe_name = workspace_name.replace('"', r"\"")
    return (
        "# One-command wiring for Claude Code -> IronClaw guard\n"
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL="{config.guard_base_url}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY="{config.api_key}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE="{config.guard_mode}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS="{config.default_timeout_ms}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_GUARD_MAX_PAYLOAD_KB="{config.max_payload_kb}"\n'
        f'export IRONCLAW_WORKSPACE_NAME="{safe_name}"\n'
        "# Configure your Claude Code proxy/tooling to:\n"
        "#  - Send guarded actions to:  $IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL/guard/execute\n"
        "#  - Send prompt/output bundles to: $IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL/policy/guard-bundle\n"
        "#  - Include header: X-API-Key=$IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY on every call\n"
    )

        use_bundle_guard=True,
        use_guard_execute=True,
    )

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    snippet = _build_one_command_snippet(
        config=client_config,
        workspace_name=payload.display_name,

    notes = [

        "Always include X-API-Key using the value from IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY.",

        generated_at=now,
        platform="claude-code",
        workspace_name=payload.display_name,
        client_config=client_config,
        one_command_snippet=snippet,
        notes=notes,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict, Optional

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, StreamingResponse
from starlette.background import BackgroundTask

from app.core.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/guard-router",
    tags=["claude-guard-router"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


async def _scan_with_policy_guard(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    partial_text: str,
    *,
    context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "userprompt": context.get("userprompt") if context else None,
        "retrieveddoc": context.get("retrieveddoc") if context else None,
        "tooloutput": context.get("tooloutput") if context else None,
        "modeloutput": partial_text,
    }

    resp = await client.post(
        f"{guard_base_url.rstrip('/')}/policy/guard-bundle",
        headers={"X-API-Key": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=payload,
        timeout=5.0,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]


def _build_guard_warning(reason: str, verdict: str) -> bytes:
    return (
        "\n\n[IRONCLAW-GUARD] Stream truncated due to high-risk content. "
        f"Reason: {reason or 'policy guard verdict: ' + verdict}.\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")


async def _guarded_upstream_stream(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
    *,
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    request_body: Dict[str, Any],
    guard_mode: str,
    scan_interval_chars: int = 256,
) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
    context = {
        "userprompt": request_body.get("user_prompt"),
        "retrieveddoc": request_body.get("retrieved_docs"),
        "tooloutput": request_body.get("tool_outputs"),
    }

    buffer = ""
    scanned_upto = 0
    blocked = False

    async for chunk in upstream.aiter_text():
        if not chunk:
            continue

        buffer += chunk

        if len(buffer) - scanned_upto >= scan_interval_chars and not blocked:
            verdict_data = await _scan_with_policy_guard(
                client=client,
                guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                api_key=api_key,
                partial_text=buffer,
                context=context,
            )
            verdict = str(verdict_data.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")).lower()
            reason = str(verdict_data.get("reason", ""))

            if guard_mode == "enforce" and verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
                blocked = True
                yield _build_guard_warning(reason, verdict)
                break

            scanned_upto = len(buffer)

        if not blocked:
            yield chunk.encode("utf-8")

    if not blocked and len(buffer) > scanned_upto:
        verdict_data = await _scan_with_policy_guard(
            client=client,
            guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
            api_key=api_key,
            partial_text=buffer,
            context=context,
        )
        verdict = str(verdict_data.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")).lower()
        reason = str(verdict_data.get("reason", ""))

        if guard_mode == "enforce" and verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
            yield _build_guard_warning(reason, verdict)


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
async def claude_guard_router_proxy(
    request: Request,
) -> Response:
    body = await request.json()

    upstream_url = body.get("upstream_url")
    upstream_payload = body.get("upstream_payload") or {}
    guard_base_url = body.get("guard_base_url") or _infer_guard_base_url(request)
    guard_mode = str(body.get("guard_mode") or "enforce").lower()

    if not upstream_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Missing 'upstream_url' in request body.",
        )

    if guard_mode not in {"enforce", "assist", "dryrun"}:
        guard_mode = "enforce"

    api_key = request.headers.get("X-API-Key")
    if not api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Missing X-API-Key header.",
        )

    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None)
    upstream: httpx.Response | None = None
    try:
        upstream = await client.send(
            client.build_request(
                "POST",
                upstream_url,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                content=json.dumps(upstream_payload, separators=(",", ":")),
            ),
            stream=True,
        )

        if upstream.status_code != status.HTTP_200_OK:
            error_text = (await upstream.aread()).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            return PlainTextResponse(
                error_text,
                status_code=upstream.status_code,
                background=BackgroundTask(_close_client_and_upstream, upstream, client),
            )

        async def event_stream() -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
            prelude = {
                "type": "ironclaw_guard_info",
                "generated_at": _now_iso(),
                "guard_mode": guard_mode,
            }
            yield (json.dumps(prelude) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

            async for chunk in _guarded_upstream_stream(
                upstream,
                client=client,
                guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                api_key=api_key,
                request_body=upstream_payload,
                guard_mode=guard_mode,
            ):
                yield chunk

        return StreamingResponse(
            event_stream(),
            media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
            background=BackgroundTask(_close_client_and_upstream, upstream, client),
        )
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        if upstream is not None:
            await upstream.aclose()
        await client.aclose()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Upstream proxy error: {exc!r}",
        ) from exc
    except Exception:
        if upstream is not None:
            await upstream.aclose()
        await client.aclose()
        raise


async def _close_client_and_upstream(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    await upstream.aclose()
    await client.aclose()


def _infer_guard_base_url(request: Request) -> str:
    scheme = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto") or request.url.scheme
    host = (
        request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Host")
        or request.headers.get("Host")
        or request.url.netloc
    )
    return f"{scheme}://{host}".rstrip("/")

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, Response, status
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, StreamingResponse
from starlette.background import BackgroundTask

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/router-proxy",
    tags=["claude-router-proxy"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


async def _proxy_upstream_stream(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
    async for chunk in upstream.aiter_bytes():
        if chunk:
            yield chunk


async def _close_upstream_and_client(
    upstream: httpx.Response,
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
) -> None:
    await upstream.aclose()
    await client.aclose()


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
async def claude_router_proxy(
    request: Request,
) -> Response:
    body = await request.json()

    upstream_url = body.get("upstream_url")
    upstream_payload = body.get("upstream_payload") or {}

    if not upstream_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Missing 'upstream_url' in request body.",
        )

    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None)
    try:
        upstream = await client.send(
            client.build_request(
                "POST",
                upstream_url,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                content=json.dumps(upstream_payload, separators=(",", ":")),
            ),
            stream=True,
        )

        if upstream.status_code != status.HTTP_200_OK:
            error_text = (await upstream.aread()).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            await upstream.aclose()
            await client.aclose()
            return PlainTextResponse(
                error_text,
                status_code=upstream.status_code,
            )

        return StreamingResponse(
            _proxy_upstream_stream(upstream),
            media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
            background=BackgroundTask(_close_upstream_and_client, upstream, client),
        )
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        await client.aclose()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Upstream proxy error: {exc!r}",
        ) from exc

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, AsyncGenerator, Dict, Optional

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/claude/stream-guard",
    tags=["claude-stream-guard"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


class StreamGuardError(Exception):
    pass


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


async def _scan_chunk_with_policy_guard(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    partial_text: str,
    *,
    context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "userprompt": context.get("userprompt") if context else None,
        "retrieveddoc": context.get("retrieveddoc") if context else None,
        "tooloutput": context.get("tooloutput") if context else None,
        "modeloutput": partial_text,
    }

    url = f"{guard_base_url.rstrip('/')}/policy/guard-bundle"
    resp = await client.post(
        url,
        headers={"X-API-Key": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        json=payload,
        timeout=5.0,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]


def _build_block_warning(reason: str, bundle_verdict: str) -> bytes:
    warning = (
        "\n\n[IRONCLAW-GUARD] Stream truncated due to high-risk content. "
        f"Reason: {reason or 'policy guard verdict: ' + bundle_verdict}.\n"
    )
    return warning.encode("utf-8")


async def _proxy_stream_with_guard(
    upstream_url: str,
    *,
    guard_base_url: str,
    api_key: str,
    request_body: Dict[str, Any],
    guard_mode: str = "enforce",
    scan_interval_chars: int = 256,
) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
    context = {
        "userprompt": request_body.get("user_prompt"),
        "retrieveddoc": request_body.get("retrieved_docs"),
        "tooloutput": request_body.get("tool_outputs"),
    }

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
        try:
            async with client.stream(
                "POST",
                upstream_url,
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                json=request_body,
            ) as upstream:
                if upstream.status_code != status.HTTP_200_OK:
                    text = await upstream.aread()
                    raise StreamGuardError(
                        f"Upstream returned {upstream.status_code}: {text!r}"
                    )

                buffer = ""
                scanned_upto = 0
                blocked = False

                async for chunk in upstream.aiter_text():
                    if not chunk:
                        continue

                    buffer += chunk

                    if len(buffer) - scanned_upto >= scan_interval_chars and not blocked:
                        verdict = await _scan_chunk_with_policy_guard(
                            client=client,
                            guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                            api_key=api_key,
                            partial_text=buffer,
                            context=context,
                        )

                        bundle_verdict = str(
                            verdict.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")
                        ).lower()
                        reason = str(verdict.get("reason", ""))

                        if guard_mode == "enforce" and bundle_verdict in {
                            "block",
                            "quarantine",
                        }:
                            blocked = True
                            yield _build_block_warning(reason, bundle_verdict)
                            break

                        scanned_upto = len(buffer)

                    if not blocked:
                        yield chunk.encode("utf-8")

                if not blocked and len(buffer) > scanned_upto:
                    verdict = await _scan_chunk_with_policy_guard(
                        client=client,
                        guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
                        api_key=api_key,
                        partial_text=buffer,
                        context=context,
                    )

                    bundle_verdict = str(
                        verdict.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")
                    ).lower()
                    reason = str(verdict.get("reason", ""))

                    if guard_mode == "enforce" and bundle_verdict in {
                        "block",
                        "quarantine",
                    }:
                        yield _build_block_warning(reason, bundle_verdict)

        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            error_msg = f"[IRONCLAW-GUARD] Upstream streaming error: {exc!r}"
            yield error_msg.encode("utf-8")


@router.post(
    "/proxy",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
async def claude_stream_guard_proxy(
    request: Request,
) -> StreamingResponse:
    body = await request.json()

    upstream_url = body.get("upstream_url")
    upstream_payload = body.get("upstream_payload") or {}
    guard_base_url = body.get("guard_base_url") or _infer_guard_base_url(request)
    guard_mode = str(body.get("guard_mode") or "enforce").lower()

    if not upstream_url:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Missing 'upstream_url' in request body.",
        )

    if guard_mode not in {"enforce", "assist", "dryrun"}:
        guard_mode = "enforce"

    api_key = request.headers.get("X-API-Key")
    if not api_key:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Missing X-API-Key header.",
        )

    async def event_stream() -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
        prelude = {
            "type": "ironclaw_guard_info",
            "generated_at": _now_iso(),
            "guard_mode": guard_mode,
        }
        import json

        yield (json.dumps(prelude) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

        async for chunk in _proxy_stream_with_guard(
            upstream_url=upstream_url,
            guard_base_url=guard_base_url,
            api_key=api_key,
            request_body=upstream_payload,
            guard_mode=guard_mode,
        ):
            yield chunk

    return StreamingResponse(
        event_stream(),
        media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8",
    )


def _infer_guard_base_url(request: Request) -> str:
    scheme = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Proto") or request.url.scheme
    host = (
        request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-Host")
        or request.headers.get("Host")
        or request.url.netloc
    )
    return f"{scheme}://{host}".rstrip("/")

from __future__ import annotations


from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


from app.core.api_keys import (
    APIKeyRecord,
    generate_api_key,
    get_api_key_registry,
    mask_api_key,
)
from app.core.auth import require_api_key



router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/customer-keys",
    tags=["customer-keys"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)



class CustomerKeyCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class CustomerKeyView(BaseModel):
    key_id: str
    display_name: str
    masked_key: str
    created_at: str
    last_used_at: str | None = None
    active: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class CustomerKeyCreateResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    api_key: str
    key: CustomerKeyView



class CustomerKeyListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_keys: int
    keys: list[CustomerKeyView] = Field(default_factory=list)



class CustomerKeyRevokeResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    revoked_key_id: str



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _to_iso(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _to_view(record: APIKeyRecord, masked_value: str | None = None) -> CustomerKeyView:
    return CustomerKeyView(
        key_id=record.key_id,
        display_name=record.display_name,
        masked_key=masked_value or mask_api_key(record.hashed_secret),
        created_at=_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        active=record.active,
        metadata=record.metadata or {},
    )



@router.get("", response_model=CustomerKeyListResponse)
def list_customer_keys() -> CustomerKeyListResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    records = list(getattr(registry, "_keys_by_id", {}).values())
    records = sorted(records, key=lambda record: record.created_at, reverse=True)


    return CustomerKeyListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_keys=len(records),
        keys=[_to_view(record) for record in records],
    )



@router.post(
    "",
    response_model=CustomerKeyCreateResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def create_customer_key(payload: CustomerKeyCreateRequest) -> CustomerKeyCreateResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    raw_api_key = generate_api_key()
    record = registry.register_key(
        display_name=payload.display_name.strip(),
        raw_secret=raw_api_key,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )


    return CustomerKeyCreateResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        api_key=raw_api_key,
        key=_to_view(record, masked_value=mask_api_key(raw_api_key)),
    )



@router.post("/{key_id}/revoke", response_model=CustomerKeyRevokeResponse)
def revoke_customer_key(key_id: str) -> CustomerKeyRevokeResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    registry.deactivate_key(key_id)


    return CustomerKeyRevokeResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        revoked_key_id=key_id,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter()

SERVICE_NAME = "IronClaw-Security"
OK_STATUS = "ok"


class RequestMeta(BaseModel):
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    path: str
    method: str


class HeadersPresent(BaseModel):
    x_request_id: bool
    x_trace_id: bool
    user_agent: bool


class ClientInfo(BaseModel):
    host: str | None = None
    port: int | None = None


class DiagnosticsDetails(BaseModel):
    request: RequestMeta
    headers_present: HeadersPresent
    client: ClientInfo


class DiagnosticsResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    diagnostics: DiagnosticsDetails


def _request_meta(request: Request) -> RequestMeta:
    return RequestMeta(
        request_id=getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
        trace_id=getattr(request.state, "trace_id", None),
        path=request.url.path,
        method=request.method,
    )


def _client_info(request: Request) -> ClientInfo:
    client = request.client
    return ClientInfo(
        host=client.host if client else None,
        port=client.port if client else None,
    )


def _headers_present(request: Request) -> HeadersPresent:
    return HeadersPresent(
        x_request_id=request.headers.get("x-request-id") is not None,
        x_trace_id=request.headers.get("x-trace-id") is not None,
        user_agent=request.headers.get("user-agent") is not None,
    )


def _safe_append_telemetry_event(event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(event_name, payload)
    except Exception:
        pass


@router.get("/diagnostics", response_model=DiagnosticsResponse, tags=["system"], summary="Diagnostics")
def diagnostics(request: Request) -> DiagnosticsResponse:
    request_meta = _request_meta(request)
    client_info = _client_info(request)
    headers_present = _headers_present(request)

    payload = DiagnosticsResponse(
        status=OK_STATUS,
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        diagnostics=DiagnosticsDetails(
            request=request_meta,
            headers_present=headers_present,
            client=client_info,
        ),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "diagnostics_requested",
        {
            **request_meta.model_dump(),
            "client_host": client_info.host,
            "client_port": client_info.port,
            "headers_present": headers_present.model_dump(),
        },
    )

    return payload

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends

from app.api.executeresult import ExecuteRequest, ExecuteResponse
from app.executeservice import get_action_execute_pipeline, guard_and_execute_action

router = APIRouter(prefix="/guard", tags=["guard"])


def _normalize_response_status(raw: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(raw, str):
        normalized = raw.strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
        if normalized in {"completed", "queued_for_review", "denied"}:
            return normalized

    if raw == 200:
        return "completed"
    if raw in {202, 206, 409}:
        return "queued_for_review"
    if raw in {400, 401, 403}:
        return "denied"

    return "denied"


def _ensure_filepath(summary: dict) -> dict:
    executor_result = summary.get("executor_result")
    if isinstance(executor_result, dict) and not executor_result.get("filepath"):
        executor_result["filepath"] = "app/api/action_execute.py"
    return summary


@router.post("/execute", response_model=ExecuteResponse)
def guarded_execute(
    payload: ExecuteRequest,
    pipeline=Depends(get_action_execute_pipeline),
) -> ExecuteResponse:
    response_payload = guard_and_execute_action(payload, pipeline=pipeline)

    if not isinstance(response_payload, dict):
        response_payload = {"response_status": "denied", "summary": {}}

    response_payload = _ensure_filepath(response_payload)
    response_payload["response_status"] = _normalize_response_status(
        response_payload.get("response_status")
    )

    return ExecuteResponse(**response_payload)

                "should_halt": getattr(response, "should_halt", None),

                "decision_source": getattr(response, "decision_source", None),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.dependencies.action_execute import get_action_execute_pipeline
from app.orchestrator.secure_runtime_pipeline import (
    get_secure_runtime_health_snapshot,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/health", tags=["health"])

SERVICE_NAME = "IronClaw-Security"
SERVICE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
HEALTH_PURPOSE = "compact-readiness"
OK_STATUSES = frozenset({"ok", "healthy"})
WARN_STATUSES = frozenset({"warn", "warning", "degraded"})


class HealthStatus(str, Enum):
    ok = "ok"
    warn = "warn"
    degraded = "degraded"
    error = "error"
    unknown = "unknown"


class ComponentHealth(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: HealthStatus
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class HealthSnapshot(BaseModel):
    status: HealthStatus
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    version: str
    components: list[ComponentHealth] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _normalize_component_status(raw_status: Any) -> HealthStatus:
    value = str(raw_status or "").strip().lower()
    if value in OK_STATUSES:
        return HealthStatus.ok
    if value in WARN_STATUSES:
        return HealthStatus.warn
    if value == HealthStatus.error.value:
        return HealthStatus.error
    return HealthStatus.unknown


def _resolve_overall_status(components: list[ComponentHealth]) -> HealthStatus:
    if any(component.status == HealthStatus.error for component in components):
        return HealthStatus.degraded
    if any(component.status == HealthStatus.unknown for component in components):
        return HealthStatus.degraded
    if any(component.status == HealthStatus.warn for component in components):
        return HealthStatus.warn
    return HealthStatus.ok


def _build_api_component() -> ComponentHealth:
    return ComponentHealth(
        name="api",
        status=HealthStatus.ok,
        details={"reachable": True},
    )


def _build_secure_runtime_component() -> ComponentHealth:
    try:
        pipeline = get_action_execute_pipeline()
        pipeline_health = get_secure_runtime_health_snapshot(pipeline)

        if not isinstance(pipeline_health, dict):
            return ComponentHealth(
                name="secure_runtime_pipeline",
                status=HealthStatus.unknown,
                details={
                    "error": "invalid-health-payload",
                    "observed_type": type(pipeline_health).__name__,
                },
            )

        normalized_status = _normalize_component_status(pipeline_health.get("status"))
        return ComponentHealth(
            name="secure_runtime_pipeline",
            status=normalized_status,
            details=pipeline_health,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return ComponentHealth(
            name="secure_runtime_pipeline",
            status=HealthStatus.error,
            details={"error": repr(exc)},
        )


@router.get("", response_model=HealthSnapshot)
def read_compact_health() -> HealthSnapshot:
    """
    Compact health snapshot for readiness and operational dashboards.

    This endpoint is designed to be:
    - Lightweight enough for frequent polling (readiness / uptime checks),
    - Structured enough to power the UI health snapshot panel,
    - Stable as a public contract for external monitoring tools.
    """
    components = [
        _build_api_component(),
        _build_secure_runtime_component(),
    ]
    overall_status = _resolve_overall_status(components)

    return HealthSnapshot(
        status=overall_status,
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        components=components,
        metadata={
            "purpose": HEALTH_PURPOSE,
            "notes": [
                "This snapshot is safe for external uptime monitoring.",
                "The secure_runtime_pipeline details field is intentionally compact and stable.",
            ],
            "component_count": len(components),
        },
    )
