from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from time import monotonic

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

SERVICE_NAME = "ironclaw-security"
SERVICE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
PROCESS_STARTED_AT = monotonic()

router = APIRouter(tags=["system"])


class ComponentStatus(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    details: dict[str, object] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class LivenessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int


class ReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    ready: bool
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    live: bool
    ready: bool
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


def _timestamp() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _uptime_seconds() -> int:
    return max(0, int(monotonic() - PROCESS_STARTED_AT))


def _readiness_checks() -> list[ComponentStatus]:
    return [
        ComponentStatus(
            name="api_router",
            status="ok",
            details={"registered": True},
        ),
        ComponentStatus(
            name="process",
            status="ok",
            details={"uptime_seconds": _uptime_seconds()},
        ),
    ]


@router.get(
    "/system/live",
    response_model=LivenessResponse,
    summary="Liveness probe",
    description="Fast, dependency-light probe that answers: is the process alive and serving requests?",
)
def get_liveness() -> LivenessResponse:
    return LivenessResponse(
        status="ok",
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        timestamp=_timestamp(),
        uptime_seconds=_uptime_seconds(),
    )


@router.get(
    "/system/ready",
    response_model=ReadinessResponse,
    summary="Readiness probe",
    description="Readiness probe that checks whether core in-process services initialized enough to safely receive traffic.",
)
def get_readiness() -> ReadinessResponse:
    checks = _readiness_checks()
    ready = all(check.status == "ok" for check in checks)
    return ReadinessResponse(
        status="ok" if ready else "degraded",
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        timestamp=_timestamp(),
        uptime_seconds=_uptime_seconds(),
        ready=ready,
        checks=checks,
    )


@router.get(
    "/system/health",
    response_model=HealthResponse,
    summary="Combined health snapshot",
    description="Combined operational health snapshot for dashboards and lightweight UI polling.",
)
def get_health() -> HealthResponse:
    checks = _readiness_checks()
    ready = all(check.status == "ok" for check in checks)
    return HealthResponse(
        status="ok" if ready else "degraded",
        service=SERVICE_NAME,
        version=SERVICE_VERSION,
        timestamp=_timestamp(),
        uptime_seconds=_uptime_seconds(),
        live=True,
        ready=ready,
        checks=checks,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Literal, Mapping, cast

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from app.core.errors import AppError, NotFoundError
from app.schemas.scan import ScanHistoryItem, ScanHistoryResponse
from app.services.audit_log_service import (
    list_audit_events,
    list_audit_events_for_actor,
    list_audit_events_for_session,
)
from app.services.history import get_scan_by_id, read_scan_history, update_scan_by_id

router = APIRouter()

_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_DEFAULT = 100
_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX = 1000
_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_DEFAULT = 20
_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_MAX = 200
_REVIEWABLE_VERDICT = "quarantine"
_HEURISTIC_PROMPT_INJECTION_SCORE_ID = "heuristic_prompt_injection_score"
_REVIEW_STATUS_NONE = "none"
_REVIEW_STATUS_APPROVED = "approved"
_REVIEW_STATUS_REJECTED = "rejected"
_VERDICT_ALLOW = "allow"
_VERDICT_BLOCK = "block"
_DEFAULT_SAFE_SUMMARY = "No risky patterns detected."


class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    """Request body for reviewing a quarantined scan record."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    action: Literal["approve", "reject"]


def _coerce_list(value: Any) -> List[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if value is None:
        return []
    return []


def _derive_summary(matched_patterns: List[Any]) -> str:
    if matched_patterns:
        return f"Detected {len(matched_patterns)} risky pattern(s)."
    return _DEFAULT_SAFE_SUMMARY


def _derive_risk_score(matched_patterns: List[Any]) -> int:
    heuristic_bonus = 0
    for pattern in matched_patterns:
        identifier: Any = None
        if isinstance(pattern, Mapping):
            identifier = pattern.get("id") or pattern.get("name")
        elif isinstance(pattern, str):
            identifier = pattern

        if identifier == _HEURISTIC_PROMPT_INJECTION_SCORE_ID:
            heuristic_bonus = 5
            break

    base_score = len(matched_patterns) * 15 + heuristic_bonus
    return max(0, min(100, base_score))


def _build_review_summary(summary: Any, action: Literal["approve", "reject"]) -> str:
    base_summary = str(summary or "").strip()
    review_suffix = f"Review action: {action}."
    if not base_summary:
        return review_suffix
    if base_summary.endswith(review_suffix):
        return base_summary
    return f"{base_summary} {review_suffix}"


def _normalize_history_item(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Normalize a raw scan history item so downstream code and UI always see
    the expected keys and safe default values.
    """
    normalized: Dict[str, Any] = dict(item)

    matched_patterns = _coerce_list(normalized.get("matched_patterns"))
    normalized["matched_patterns"] = matched_patterns

    if not normalized.get("summary"):
        normalized["summary"] = _derive_summary(matched_patterns)

    risk_score = normalized.get("risk_score")
    if risk_score is None:
        normalized["risk_score"] = _derive_risk_score(matched_patterns)
    else:
        try:
            normalized["risk_score"] = max(0, min(100, int(risk_score)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            normalized["risk_score"] = _derive_risk_score(matched_patterns)

    normalized["risky_files"] = _coerce_list(normalized.get("risky_files"))
    normalized["checks_loaded"] = _coerce_list(normalized.get("checks_loaded"))
    normalized["failed_checks"] = _coerce_list(normalized.get("failed_checks"))
    normalized.setdefault("quarantine_reason", None)
    normalized.setdefault("review_status", _REVIEW_STATUS_NONE)
    normalized["untrusted"] = bool(normalized.get("untrusted", False))

    return normalized


@router.get("/events")
def get_history_events(
    limit: int = Query(

        ge=1,
        le=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

    Return recent security history events, newest-first.

    return cast(List[Dict[str, Any]], list_audit_events(limit=limit))

    """

def get_history_events_by_actor(
    actor_id: str,
    limit: int = Query(
        default=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_DEFAULT,
        ge=1,
        le=_HISTORY_EVENTS_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),

    """

    return cast(

@router.get("/", response_model=ScanHistoryResponse)
def get_scan_history(
    limit: int = Query(
        default=_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_DEFAULT,
        ge=1,
        le=_SCAN_HISTORY_LIMIT_MAX,
    ),
) -> ScanHistoryResponse:
    """
    Return recent scan history records, normalized for UI consumption.
    """
    history = read_scan_history(limit=limit)
    items = history.get("items", [])
    normalized_items = [_normalize_history_item(item) for item in items]

    return ScanHistoryResponse(
        count=len(normalized_items),
        items=normalized_items,
    )


@router.get("/{scan_id}", response_model=ScanHistoryItem)
def get_scan_record(scan_id: str) -> ScanHistoryItem:
    """
    Return a single normalized scan history record by its identifier.
    """
    item = get_scan_by_id(scan_id)
    if not item:
        raise NotFoundError(
            message="Scan not found",
            details={"scan_id": scan_id},
        )
    return ScanHistoryItem(**_normalize_history_item(item))


@router.post("/{scan_id}/review", response_model=ScanHistoryItem)
def review_scan_record(scan_id: str, request: ReviewRequest) -> ScanHistoryItem:
    """
    Review a quarantined scan record and update its verdict + review status.

    Only scans with verdict == "quarantine" are eligible for review.
    """
    item = get_scan_by_id(scan_id)
    if not item:
        raise NotFoundError(
            message="Scan not found",
            details={"scan_id": scan_id},
        )

    item = _normalize_history_item(item)

    if item.get("verdict") != _REVIEWABLE_VERDICT:
        raise AppError(
            error="invalid_review_state",
            message="Only quarantined scans can be reviewed",
            status_code=400,
            details={
                "scan_id": scan_id,
                "verdict": item.get("verdict"),
                "review_action": request.action,
            },
        )

    approved = request.action == "approve"
    updates: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "review_status": _REVIEW_STATUS_APPROVED if approved else _REVIEW_STATUS_REJECTED,
        "untrusted": not approved,
        "verdict": _VERDICT_ALLOW if approved else _VERDICT_BLOCK,
        "summary": _build_review_summary(item.get("summary"), request.action),
    }

    updated = update_scan_by_id(scan_id, updates)
    if not updated:
        raise NotFoundError(
            message="Scan not found",
            details={"scan_id": scan_id},
        )

    return ScanHistoryItem(**_normalize_history_item(updated))

@router.post(
    "/correlate",
    response_model=CorrelateResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
def correlate_incidents(
    payload: CorrelateRequest,
    organization_id: str = Depends(get_current_organization_id),
    service: AttackCorrelationService = Depends(get_attack_correlation_service),
    session_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
    actor_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
) -> CorrelateResponse:
    if not payload.signals:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="At least one signal is required for correlation",
        )

    result = service.correlate(
        [signal.model_dump() for signal in payload.signals],
        session_id=payload.session_id or session_id,
        actor_id=payload.actor_id or actor_id,
        organization_id=organization_id,
        request_id=payload.request_id,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    return CorrelateResponse.model_validate(result)

def _record_slug(record: Any) -> str:
    slug = str(record.metadata.get("slug", "")).strip()
    if slug:
        return slug

    platform = str(record.platform).strip().lower()
    if platform == "claude":
        return "claude-code"
    return str(record.integrationid).strip().lower().replace("_", "-")


def _integration_type(record: Any) -> str:
    return str(record.metadata.get("integration_type", "adapter")).strip() or "adapter"


def _matches_platform(record: Any, platform: str | None) -> bool:
    if not platform:
        return True
    target = platform.strip().lower()
    return _record_slug(record) == target


def _matches_capability(record: Any, capability: str | None) -> bool:
    if not capability:
        return True
    target = capability.strip().lower()
    return any(
        str(item.name).strip().lower() == target and bool(item.enabled)
        for item in record.capabilities
    )


def _serialize_record(record: Any) -> IntegrationRecordResponse:
    slug = _record_slug(record)
    return IntegrationRecordResponse(
        integration_id=record.integrationid,
        slug=slug,
        platform=slug,
        integration_type=_integration_type(record),
        display_name=record.displayname,
        status=record.status,
        description=record.description,
        version=record.version,
        adapter_module=record.adaptermodule,
        verification_route=record.verificationroute,
        settings_route=record.settingsroute,
        manifest_route=record.manifestroute,
        installed_at=record.installedat,
        verified_at=record.verifiedat,
        tags=list(record.tags),
        capabilities=[
            IntegrationCapabilityResponse(
                name=capability.name,
                enabled=capability.enabled,
                maturity=capability.maturity,
                notes=capability.notes,
            )
            for capability in record.capabilities
        ],
        metadata=dict(record.metadata),
    )


def _find_record(integration_id: str) -> Any | None:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    normalized = integration_id.strip().lower()
    for record in registry.list_integrations():
        if str(record.integrationid).strip().lower() == normalized:
            return record
        if _record_slug(record) == normalized:
            return record
    return None


@router.get("", response_model=IntegrationRegistryResponse)
def read_integrations(
    platform: str | None = Query(default=None),
    capability: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> IntegrationRegistryResponse:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    items = [
        item
        for item in registry.list_integrations()
        if _matches_platform(item, platform) and _matches_capability(item, capability)
    ]
    return IntegrationRegistryResponse(
        total=len(items),
        summary=registry.integration_summary(),
        items=[_serialize_record(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.get("/summary", response_model=IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse)
def read_integrations_summary() -> IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    items = registry.list_integrations()
    summary = registry.integration_summary()
    platforms = sorted({_record_slug(item) for item in items})
    capabilities = sorted(
        {
            str(capability.name)
            for item in items
            for capability in item.capabilities
            if capability.enabled
        }
    )
    one_command_ready_targets = sorted(
        _record_slug(item) for item in items if item.status in ("available", "ready")
    )
    return IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse(
        total_integrations=summary["total_integrations"],
        statuses=summary,
        platforms=platforms,
        capabilities=capabilities,
        one_command_ready_targets=one_command_ready_targets,
    )


@router.get("/{integration_id}", response_model=IntegrationRecordResponse)
def read_integration(integration_id: str) -> IntegrationRecordResponse:
    record = _find_record(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")
    return _serialize_record(record)


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/verify",
    response_model=IntegrationVerificationResponse,
)
def verify_integration_route(
    integration_id: str,
    strict: bool = False,
    requested_by: str = "system",
) -> IntegrationVerificationResponse:
    record = _find_record(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    verifier = get_integration_verifier()
    result = verifier.verify_integration(
        record.integrationid,
        strict=strict,
        requestedby=requested_by,
    )
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    return IntegrationVerificationResponse(
        integration_id=result.integrationid,
        platform=_record_slug(record),
        status=result.status,
        verified=result.verified,
        verified_at=result.verifiedat,
        requested_by=result.requestedby,
        strict=result.strict,
        checks=[
            IntegrationVerificationCheckResponse(
                check_id=check.checkid,
                label=check.label,
                passed=check.passed,
                detail=check.detail,
            )
            for check in result.checks
        ],
        missing_capabilities=list(result.missingcapabilities),
        summary=result.summary,
    )


@router.post(
    "/{integration_id}/install",
    response_model=IntegrationInstallResponse,
)
def install_integration_route(
    integration_id: str,
    payload: IntegrationInstallRequest,
) -> IntegrationInstallResponse:
    record = _find_record(integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    installer = get_integration_installer()
    result = installer.install_integration(
        record.integrationid,
        requestedby=payload.requested_by or "system",
    )
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="integration not found")

    return IntegrationInstallResponse(
        integration_id=result.integrationid,
        platform=_record_slug(record),
        status=result.status,
        installed=result.installed,
        installed_at=result.installedat,
        requested_by=result.requestedby,
        steps=[
            IntegrationInstallStepResponse(
                step_id=step.stepid,
                label=step.label,
                completed=step.completed,
                detail=step.detail,
            )
            for step in result.steps
        ],
        summary=result.summary,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.dependencies.rate_limit import limit_policy_routes

from app.services.policy import get_policy_status
from app.services.prompt_service import analyze_prompt_bundle

from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(limit_policy_routes)])


class GuardBundleRequest(BaseModel):
    user_prompt: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20000)
    retrieved_doc: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50000)
    tool_output: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50000)
    model_output: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=50000)


class PolicyBundleDecisionResponse(BaseModel):
    highest_verdict: str
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    user_prompt: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    retrieved_doc: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    tool_output: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    model_output: dict[str, Any] | None = None


class SystemStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    policy: PolicyStatus
    review_summary: dict[str, Any]


def _has_meaningful_content(value: str | None) -> bool:
    return bool(value and value.strip())


def _request_meta(request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "request_id": getattr(request.state, "request_id", None),
        "trace_id": getattr(request.state, "trace_id", None),
        "path": request.url.path,
        "method": request.method,
    }


@router.get("/status", response_model=PolicyStatus)
def read_policy_status(request: Request) -> PolicyStatus:
    status = PolicyStatus(**get_policy_status())

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "policy_status_requested",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "mode": getattr(status, "mode", None),
                "enforcement_enabled": getattr(status, "enforcement_enabled", None),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return status


@router.get("/system-status", response_model=SystemStatusResponse)
def read_system_status(request: Request) -> SystemStatusResponse:
    policy_status = PolicyStatus(**get_policy_status())
    review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "policy_system_status_requested",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "policy_mode": getattr(policy_status, "mode", None),
                "pending_reviews": review_summary.get("pending_items"),
                "critical_items": review_summary.get("critical_items"),
                "total_items": review_summary.get("total_items"),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return SystemStatusResponse(
        policy=policy_status,
        review_summary=review_summary,
    )


@router.post("/guard-bundle", response_model=PolicyBundleDecisionResponse)
def guard_prompt_bundle(
    payload: GuardBundleRequest,
    request: Request,
) -> PolicyBundleDecisionResponse:
    """
    Internal policy route for guarding multi-source prompt context.

    Expected optional JSON fields:
    - user_prompt
    - retrieved_doc
    - tool_output
    - model_output

    Returns a consolidated verdict bundle using:
    allow < warn < quarantine < block
    """
    if not any(
        [
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.user_prompt),
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.retrieved_doc),
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.tool_output),
            _has_meaningful_content(payload.model_output),
        ]
    ):
        raise AppError(
            error="empty_policy_bundle",
            message="At least one non-empty prompt bundle field must be provided",
            status_code=400,
            details={
                "allowed_fields": [
                    "user_prompt",
                    "retrieved_doc",
                    "tool_output",
                    "model_output",
                ]
            },
        )

    result = analyze_prompt_bundle(
        user_prompt=payload.user_prompt.strip() if payload.user_prompt else None,
        retrieved_doc=payload.retrieved_doc.strip() if payload.retrieved_doc else None,
        tool_output=payload.tool_output.strip() if payload.tool_output else None,
        model_output=payload.model_output.strip() if payload.model_output else None,
    )

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "policy_bundle_decision",
            {
                **_request_meta(request),
                "highest_verdict": result.get("highest_verdict"),
                "should_halt": result.get("should_halt"),
                "should_warn": result.get("should_warn"),
                "has_user_prompt": _has_meaningful_content(payload.user_prompt),
                "has_retrieved_doc": _has_meaningful_content(payload.retrieved_doc),
                "has_tool_output": _has_meaningful_content(payload.tool_output),
                "has_model_output": _has_meaningful_content(payload.model_output),
                "user_prompt_verdict": (result.get("user_prompt") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "user_prompt_risk_score": (result.get("user_prompt") or {}).get("risk_score"),
                "retrieved_doc_verdict": (result.get("retrieved_doc") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "retrieved_doc_risk_score": (result.get("retrieved_doc") or {}).get("risk_score"),
                "tool_output_verdict": (result.get("tool_output") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "tool_output_risk_score": (result.get("tool_output") or {}).get("risk_score"),
                "model_output_verdict": (result.get("model_output") or {}).get("verdict"),
                "model_output_risk_score": (result.get("model_output") or {}).get("risk_score"),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return PolicyBundleDecisionResponse(**result)

from app.dependencies.requestcontext import get_request_context
from app.schemas.requestcontext import RequestContextResponse
from app.security.apikey import api_key_header_auth

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/request-context",
    tags=["request-context"],
)


@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=RequestContextResponse,
    summary="Read Request Context",
    include_in_schema=True,
)
async def read_request_context(
    request: Request,
    context: Annotated[RequestContextResponse, Depends(get_request_context)],
    api_key: Annotated[str, Security(api_key_header_auth)],
) -> RequestContextResponse:
    """
    Return a normalized snapshot of the current HTTP request context.

    This is primarily used by UI and diagnostics tooling to quickly inspect
    how IronClaw-Security sees the inbound request at the security boundary.
    All normalization, redaction, and correlation logic is centralized in
    `get_request_context`; this handler simply returns the validated model.
    """
    # We intentionally depend on `get_request_context` so that all normalization,
    # redaction, and correlation logic lives in a single shared dependency.
    # The handler simply returns the already-validated Pydantic model.
    _ = request  # accessed to keep the signature stable and avoid linter warnings
    return context

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.dependencies.request_context import get_request_context
from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter(prefix="/request-context", tags=["request-context"])


class RequestContextResponse(BaseModel):
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    request_started_at: float | None = None
    client_host: str | None = None
    path: str
    method: str
    headers: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


@router.get("", response_model=RequestContextResponse)
def read_request_context(request: Request) -> RequestContextResponse:
    context = get_request_context(request)

    safe_headers = {
        "x-request-id": request.headers.get("X-Request-ID"),
        "x-trace-id": request.headers.get("X-Trace-ID"),
        "user-agent": request.headers.get("User-Agent"),
    }

    try:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "request_context_requested",
            {
                "request_id": context.get("request_id"),
                "trace_id": context.get("trace_id"),
                "path": context.get("path"),
                "method": context.get("method"),
            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return RequestContextResponse(
        request_id=context.get("request_id"),
        trace_id=context.get("trace_id"),
        request_started_at=context.get("request_started_at"),
        client_host=context.get("client_host"),
        path=context.get("path") or request.url.path,
        method=context.get("method") or request.method,
        headers=safe_headers,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.restoreservice import (
    RestoreManifest,
    RestoreService,
    build_default_restore_service,
)


router = APIRouter(prefix="/restore", tags=["restore"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def get_restore_service() -> RestoreService:
    return build_default_restore_service()


def _raise_restore_http_error(exc: Exception) -> None:
    if isinstance(exc, KeyError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    raise exc


class RestoreTargetResponse(BaseModel):
    name: str
    kind: str
    source_path: str
    restore_path: str
    checksum_required: bool
    dry_run_supported: bool


class RestoreManifestResponse(BaseModel):
    target_name: str
    target_kind: str
    source_path: str
    restore_path: str
    restored_at: str
    files_restored: int
    bytes_restored: int
    checksum_verified: bool
    dry_run: bool
    meta: dict[str, Any]


class RestoreStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Restore Control"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    targets: list[RestoreTargetResponse]
    summary: dict[str, Any]


class RestoreActionRequest(BaseModel):
    target_name: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    action: Literal["restore", "validate"] = "restore"
    dry_run: bool = False


class RestoreActionResponse(BaseModel):
    title: str = "Restore Action"
    status: Literal["ok"] = "ok"
    generated_at: str
    action: Literal["restore", "validate"]
    target_name: str
    dry_run: bool
    result: dict[str, Any]


def _manifest_to_response(manifest: RestoreManifest) -> RestoreManifestResponse:
    return RestoreManifestResponse(**manifest.to_dict())


@router.get(
    "",
    response_model=RestoreStatusResponse,
    summary="Get restore control status",
)
def get_restore_status(
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> RestoreStatusResponse:
    targets = service.list_targets()
    typed_targets = [RestoreTargetResponse(**target) for target in targets]

    return RestoreStatusResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        targets=typed_targets,
        summary={
            "target_count": len(typed_targets),
            "checksum_enforced_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.checksum_required),
            "dry_run_supported_targets": sum(1 for item in typed_targets if item.dry_run_supported),
        },
    )


@router.get(
    "/targets",
    response_model=list[RestoreTargetResponse],
    summary="List configured restore targets",
)
def list_restore_targets(
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> list[RestoreTargetResponse]:
    return [RestoreTargetResponse(**target) for target in service.list_targets()]


@router.post(
    "/validate",
    response_model=RestoreActionResponse,
    summary="Validate a restore target before restore",
)
def validate_restore_target(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> RestoreActionResponse:
    try:
        result = service.validate(target_name)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_restore_http_error(exc)

    return RestoreActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action="validate",
        target_name=target_name,
        dry_run=True,
        result=result,
    )


@router.post(
    "/run",
    response_model=RestoreManifestResponse,
    summary="Run an on-demand restore",
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def run_restore(
    target_name: Annotated[str, Query(min_length=1)],
    dry_run: Annotated[bool, Query()] = False,
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)] = None,
) -> RestoreManifestResponse:
    if service is None:
        service = get_restore_service()

    try:
        manifest = service.run_restore(target_name, dry_run=dry_run)
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_restore_http_error(exc)

    return _manifest_to_response(manifest)


@router.post(
    "/action",
    response_model=RestoreActionResponse,
    summary="Run a generic restore control action",
)
def run_restore_action(
    request: RestoreActionRequest,
    service: Annotated[RestoreService, Depends(get_restore_service)],
) -> RestoreActionResponse:
    try:
        if request.action == "validate":
            result: dict[str, Any] = service.validate(request.target_name)
        else:
            manifest = service.run_restore(request.target_name, dry_run=request.dry_run)
            result = _manifest_to_response(manifest).model_dump()
    except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc:
        _raise_restore_http_error(exc)

    return RestoreActionResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        action=request.action,
        target_name=request.target_name,
        dry_run=request.dry_run if request.action == "restore" else True,
        result=result,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict

from app.api.actiondecision import decideaction


router = APIRouter(prefix="/review", tags=["review"])


ReviewStatus = Literal["pending", "approved", "rejected", "quarantined"]
ReviewResolution = Literal["allow", "deny", "quarantine", "needsreview"]


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


class ReviewReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int | None = None


class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    actiontype: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=1,
        description="Action type such as httpfetch or toolcall.",
    )
    target: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=1,
        description="Execution target such as URL, shell, or file path.",
    )
    content: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Prompt or action content under review.",
    )
    riskscore: int = Field(
        ...,
        ge=0,
        le=100,
        description="Base risk score supplied to review.",
    )
    clientid: str | None = Field(None, description="Client or actor id.")
    sessionid: str | None = Field(None, description="Session or workflow id.")
    filepath: str | None = Field(None, description="Optional source filepath for attribution.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Optional external context, tool outputs, file text, or retrieved content.",
    )


class ReviewResponse(BaseModel):
    reviewitemid: str
    status: ReviewStatus
    resolution: ReviewResolution
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    filepath: str
    baseriskscore: int
    adjustedriskscore: int
    reason: str
    reasons: list[ReviewReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    promptinjection: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    hostilecontext: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    createdat: str


def createreviewitem(
    *,
    actiontype: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    riskscore: int,
    clientid: str | None = None,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    filepath: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    decision = decideaction(
        actiontype=actiontype,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        riskscore=riskscore,
        clientid=clientid,
        sessionid=sessionid,
        filepath=filepath,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )

    outcome = decision.get("outcome", "deny")
    if outcome == "allow":
        status: ReviewStatus = "approved"
        resolution: ReviewResolution = "allow"
        reason = "Review workflow approved the action because it remained within safe execution bounds."
    elif outcome == "review":
        status = "pending"
        resolution = "needsreview"
        reason = "Review workflow created a pending item because the action requires human review."
    elif outcome == "quarantine":
        status = "quarantined"
        resolution = "quarantine"
        reason = "Review workflow quarantined the action because the runtime detected containment-level risk."
    else:
        status = "rejected"
        resolution = "deny"
        reason = "Review workflow rejected the action because the runtime denied execution."

    return {
        "reviewitemid": f"review_{uuid4().hex}",
        "status": status,
        "resolution": resolution,
        "actiontype": actiontype,
        "target": target,
        "filepath": str(decision.get("filepath") or filepath or ""),
        "baseriskscore": int(decision.get("baseriskscore", riskscore)),
        "adjustedriskscore": int(decision.get("adjustedriskscore", riskscore)),
        "reason": reason,
        "reasons": decision.get("reasons", []),
        "promptinjection": decision.get("promptinjection") or {},
        "hostilecontext": decision.get("hostilecontext") or {},
        "createdat": _utcnow(),
    }


@router.post(
    "/item",
    response_model=ReviewResponse,
    summary="Create a review workflow item from an action decision.",
)
def createreview(payload: ReviewRequest) -> ReviewResponse:
    result = createreviewitem(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=payload.filepath,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return ReviewResponse(**result)

from __future__ import annotations

from importlib import import_module
from typing import Final, cast

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.routing import APIRoute


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["api"])
inventory_router = APIRouter(tags=["api-inventory"])


OPTIONAL_API_MODULES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.api.routes.incidents",
    "app.api.routes.integrations",
    "app.api.routes.reviewqueue",
)

CORE_API_MODULES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.api.ui_manifest",
    "app.ui.groq_registry",
    "app.api.routes.unit_wallet",
    "app.api.routes.unit_ledger",
    "app.api.routes.actionhistorytest",
)


def _optional_router(module_path: str) -> APIRouter | None:
    try:
        module = import_module(module_path)
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        missing_name = getattr(exc, "name", "") or ""
        if missing_name == module_path or module_path.endswith(f".{missing_name}"):
            return None
        raise

    candidate = getattr(module, "router", None)
    return candidate if isinstance(candidate, APIRouter) else None


def _route_signature(route: APIRoute) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str]:
    methods = tuple(sorted(method for method in (route.methods or set()) if method != "HEAD"))
    return (route.path, methods, route.name)


def _router_label(api_router: APIRouter) -> str:
    prefix = str(getattr(api_router, "prefix", "") or "<no-prefix>")
    return f"{prefix} ({len(api_router.routes)} routes)"


def get_api_routers() -> list[APIRouter]:
    routers: list[APIRouter] = []

    for module_path in CORE_API_MODULES:
        core_router = _optional_router(module_path)
        if core_router is not None:
            routers.append(core_router)

    for module_path in OPTIONAL_API_MODULES:
        optional_router = _optional_router(module_path)
        if optional_router is not None:
            routers.append(optional_router)

    return routers


def validate_api_routers() -> None:
    seen_router_objects: set[int] = set()
    seen_route_signatures: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str], str] = {}

    for api_router in get_api_routers():
        router_id = id(api_router)
        label = _router_label(api_router)

        if router_id in seen_router_objects:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate API router object registration detected: {label}")
        seen_router_objects.add(router_id)

        if not api_router.routes:
            raise ValueError(f"API router has no routes: {label}")

        for route in api_router.routes:
            if not isinstance(route, APIRoute):
                continue

            signature = _route_signature(route)
            path, methods, _ = signature

            if not path:
                raise ValueError(f"API router contains a route with an empty path: {label}")

            if signature in seen_route_signatures:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"duplicate API route registration detected: {path} {methods} "
                    f"already registered under {seen_route_signatures[signature]}"
                )

            seen_route_signatures[signature] = label

def include_api_routers() -> None:
    """
    Build the /api aggregate router from legacy/compat modules only.

    Important:
    - app.main now treats app.api.* as the canonical API surface.
    - This file should remain a compat aggregator for modules mounted under /api.
    - Do not include this router separately anywhere that already mounts the same
      logical endpoints directly, or duplicate routes/OpenAPI collisions will occur.
    """
    validate_api_routers()

    existing_route_signatures = {
        _route_signature(cast(APIRoute, route))
        for route in router.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }

    for api_router in get_api_routers():
        router_signatures = {
            _route_signature(cast(APIRoute, route))
            for route in api_router.routes
            if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
        }

        if router_signatures and router_signatures.issubset(existing_route_signatures):
            continue

        router.include_router(api_router)
        existing_route_signatures.update(router_signatures)

    inventory_signatures = {
        _route_signature(cast(APIRoute, route))
        for route in inventory_router.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }

    if not inventory_signatures.issubset(existing_route_signatures):
        router.include_router(inventory_router)


include_api_routers()

@router.post("/scan/", response_model=ScanResponse)
def scan_target(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResponse:
    ttype = request.target_type
    tvalue = request.target_value

    normalized_value = " ".join(tvalue.split())
    if ttype == "text" and not normalized_value:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target_value is empty after normalization")

    if ttype == "text":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_text(normalized_value)
    elif ttype == "url":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_url(tvalue)
    elif ttype == "github_repo":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_github_repo(tvalue)
    elif ttype == "archive":
        result = scanner_svc.scan_archive(tvalue)
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"unsupported target_type={ttype}")

    stored = history_svc.record_scan_result(
        target_type=ttype,
        target_value=tvalue,
        result=result,
    )

    return ScanResponse(
        scan_id=stored.scan_id,
        verdict=stored.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        summary=stored.summary,
        risk_score=stored.riskscore,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(stored, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        risky_files=list(getattr(stored, "riskyfiles", [])),
        checks_loaded=list(getattr(stored, "checksloaded", [])),
        failed_checks=list(getattr(stored, "failedchecks", [])),
        review_status=getattr(stored, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(stored, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(stored, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.get("/history/", response_model=HistoryListResponse)
def list_history() -> HistoryListResponse:
    items = history_svc.get_history_items()
    return HistoryListResponse(

            HistoryItem(

                review_status=getattr(i, "reviewstatus", None),
                untrusted=getattr(i, "untrusted", None),
                quarantine_reason=getattr(i, "quarantinereason", None),
            )
            for i in items
        ]
    )

@router.post("/history/{scan_id}/review")
def review_history_item(scan_id: str, request: ReviewRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        updated = history_svc.review_scan(scan_id=scan_id, action=request.action)
    except KeyError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="scan_id not found")

    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="review not applicable for this scan")

    history_svc.apply_review_action(updated, request.action)
    return {"status": "ok", "scan_id": scan_id, "action": request.action}


@router.post("/guard/action", response_model=GuardActionResponse)
def guard_action(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardActionResponse:
    # delegate to existing service; it should return verdict + patterns
    scan_result = action_guard_svc.evaluate_action(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
    )

    verdict: Verdict = scan_result.verdict  # type: ignore[assignment]
    matched_patterns = list(getattr(scan_result, "matchedpatterns", []))

    should_halt = verdict in ("block", "quarantine")
    should_warn = verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")

    return GuardActionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_halt=bool(should_halt),
        should_warn=bool(should_warn),
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections import deque, defaultdict

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, Response

from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.schemas.scan import (
    BatchScanRequest,
    BatchScanResponse,
    ScanRequest,
    ScanResult,
)
from app.services.history import append_scan_result
from app.services.intake_service import prepare_intake
from app.services.sandbox_service import apply_sandbox_policy, evaluate_sandbox
from app.services.scanner import RULE_INDEX, get_rule_severities, perform_scan
from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event

router = APIRouter()

_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60
_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS = 30
_rate_limit_buckets: dict[str, deque[float]] = defaultdict(deque)


def _apply_scan_security_headers(response: Response) -> None:
    response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
    response.headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY"
    response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer"
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"


def _client_rate_limit_key(request: Request, payload: ScanRequest | None = None) -> str:
    forwarded = request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for", "")
    if forwarded.strip():
        first_ip = forwarded.split(",")[0].strip()
        if first_ip:
            return first_ip

    if payload is not None and payload.client_id:
        client_id = str(payload.client_id).strip()
        if client_id:
            return f"client:{client_id}"

    host = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
    return f"ip:{host}"


def _enforce_scan_rate_limit(key: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    now = time.time()
    bucket = _rate_limit_buckets[key]

    while bucket and now - bucket[0] > _RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS:
        bucket.popleft()

    if len(bucket) >= _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS:
        retry_after = max(1, int(_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS - (now - bucket[0])))
        raise AppError(
            error="scan_rate_limit_exceeded",
            message="Too many scan requests. Please retry shortly.",
            status_code=429,
            details={
                "rate_limit_key": key,
                "window_seconds": _RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS,
                "max_requests": _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS,
                "retry_after_seconds": retry_after,
            },
        )

    bucket.append(now)
    remaining = max(0, _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS - len(bucket))
    return _RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS, remaining


def _sandbox_decision_to_dict(sandbox_decision):
    if hasattr(sandbox_decision, "model_dump"):
        return sandbox_decision.model_dump()
    if hasattr(sandbox_decision, "dict"):
        return sandbox_decision.dict()
    return getattr(sandbox_decision, "__dict__", sandbox_decision)


def _severity_rank(severity: str) -> int:
    order = {
        "low": 1,
        "medium": 2,
        "high": 3,
        "critical": 4,
    }
    return order.get(severity, 0)


def _max_severity(matched_patterns: list[str]) -> str | None:
    severities = get_rule_severities(matched_patterns)
    if not severities:
        return None
    return max(severities, key=_severity_rank)


def _primary_category(matched_patterns: list[str]) -> str | None:
    for match in matched_patterns:
        if match in RULE_INDEX:
            return RULE_INDEX[match]["category"]
    return None


def _build_explanation(result: dict) -> str:
    matched_patterns = result.get("matched_patterns", [])
    verdict = result.get("verdict", "allow")
    max_severity = _max_severity(matched_patterns)
    primary_category = _primary_category(matched_patterns)

    if not matched_patterns:
        return "No risky patterns were matched."

    parts = [f"Matched {len(matched_patterns)} pattern(s)"]
    if primary_category:
        parts.append(f"primary category: {primary_category}")
    if max_severity:
        parts.append(f"max severity: {max_severity}")
    parts.append(f"final verdict: {verdict}")
    return "; ".join(parts) + "."


def _run_scan(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResult:
    try:
        intake = prepare_intake(request.target_type, request.target_value)
    except ValueError as exc:
        append_telemetry_event(
            "scan_intake_error",
            {
                "target_type": request.target_type,
                "target_value": request.target_value,
                "client_id": request.client_id,
                "error": str(exc),
            },
        )
        raise AppError(
            error="invalid_scan_input",
            message=str(exc),
            status_code=400,
            details={
                "target_type": request.target_type,
                "target_value": request.target_value,
            },
        ) from exc

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_intake_prepared",
        {
            "target_type": intake.target_type,
            "target_value": intake.target_value,
            "client_id": request.client_id,
            "route_mode": intake.route_mode,
            "requires_sandbox": intake.requires_sandbox,
        },
    )

    result = perform_scan(intake.target_type, intake.target_value)

    sandbox_decision = evaluate_sandbox(
        intake.target_type,
        intake.route_mode,
        intake.requires_sandbox,
    )

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_sandbox_evaluated",
        {
            "target_type": intake.target_type,
            "route_mode": intake.route_mode,
            "requires_sandbox": intake.requires_sandbox,
            "client_id": request.client_id,
            "sandbox_decision": _sandbox_decision_to_dict(sandbox_decision),
        },
    )

    result = apply_sandbox_policy(result, sandbox_decision)
    result["client_id"] = request.client_id
    result["max_severity"] = _max_severity(result.get("matched_patterns", []))
    result["primary_category"] = _primary_category(result.get("matched_patterns", []))
    result["explanation"] = _build_explanation(result)

    saved = append_scan_result(result)
    saved["client_id"] = request.client_id

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_completed",
        {
            "scan_id": saved.get("scan_id"),
            "verdict": saved.get("verdict"),
            "risk_score": saved.get("risk_score"),
            "target_type": saved.get("target_type"),
            "untrusted": saved.get("untrusted"),
            "client_id": request.client_id,
            "max_severity": saved.get("max_severity"),
            "primary_category": saved.get("primary_category"),
        },
    )

    return ScanResult(**saved)


@router.post("/", response_model=ScanResult)
def create_scan(request: ScanRequest, http_request: Request, response: Response):
    key = _client_rate_limit_key(http_request, request)
    limit, remaining = _enforce_scan_rate_limit(key)

    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Limit"] = str(limit)
    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Remaining"] = str(remaining)
    _apply_scan_security_headers(response)

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_rate_limit_checked",
        {
            "rate_limit_key": key,
            "limit": limit,
            "remaining": remaining,
            "client_id": request.client_id,
        },
    )

    return _run_scan(request)


@router.post("/batch", response_model=BatchScanResponse)
def create_scan_batch(
    request: BatchScanRequest,
    http_request: Request,
    response: Response,
):
    key = _client_rate_limit_key(http_request)
    limit, remaining = _enforce_scan_rate_limit(key)

    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Limit"] = str(limit)
    response.headers["X-RateLimit-Remaining"] = str(remaining)
    _apply_scan_security_headers(response)

    append_telemetry_event(
        "scan_batch_rate_limit_checked",
        {
            "rate_limit_key": key,
            "limit": limit,
            "remaining": remaining,
            "item_count": len(request.items),
        },
    )

    results = [_run_scan(item) for item in request.items]
    return BatchScanResponse(
        count=len(results),
        items=results,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

class SecretsInspectRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str | None = None
    arguments: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    content: Any | None = None
    tool_name: str | None = None
    context: str | None = None
    redact_secrets: bool = True
    block_unsafe_commands: bool = True


def _service():
    return build_secret_service()


@router.get("")
def get_secrets_api_overview() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "name": "IronClaw secrets api",
        "routes": [
            "/api/secrets",
            "/api/secrets/inspect",
            "/api/secrets/inspect/text",
            "/api/secrets/inspect/arguments",
            "/api/secrets/inspect/metadata",
            "/api/secrets/health",
        ],
    }


@router.get("/health")
def get_secrets_api_health() -> dict[str, Any]:
    service = _service()
    result = service.inspect_text(
        "health probe",
        context="health_check",
        metadata={"direction": "internal"},
    )
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "service": "secrets",
        "verdict": result.verdict,
        "blocked": result.blocked,
    }


@router.post("/inspect")
def inspect_secret_payload(request: SecretsInspectRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    service = _service()

    if request.text is not None:
        result = service.inspect_text(
            request.text,
            context=request.context,
            metadata=request.metadata,
            redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
            block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        return result.as_dict()

    if request.arguments:
        result = service.inspect_arguments(
            request.arguments,
            context=request.context,
            metadata=request.metadata,
            redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
            block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        return result.as_dict()

    if request.metadata and not request.arguments and request.content is None:
        result = service.inspect_metadata(
            request.metadata,
            context=request.context,
            redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
            block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        return result.as_dict()

    result = service.inspect_payload(
        tool_name=request.tool_name,
        arguments=request.arguments,
        metadata=request.metadata,
        content=request.content,
        context=request.context,
        redact_secrets=request.redact_secrets,
        block_unsafe_commands=request.block_unsafe_commands,
    )
    return result.as_dict()

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.review_queue_service import get_review_queue_summary
from app.services.telemetry import (
    append_telemetry_event,
    read_telemetry_events,
    summarize_telemetry_events,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/system", tags=["system"])

SERVICE_NAME = "IronClaw-Security"
SERVICE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
DEGRADED_STATUS = "degraded"
OK_STATUS = "ok"
START_TIME = datetime.now(UTC)


class ComponentStatus(BaseModel):
    name: str
    status: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class LivenessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int


class ReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    live: bool
    ready: bool
    checks: list[ComponentStatus]


class MetricsSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    version: str
    timestamp: str
    uptime_seconds: int
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any]
    review_summary: dict[str, Any]
    recent_telemetry_events: list[dict[str, Any]]


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _iso(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _uptime_seconds() -> int:
    return max(0, int((_utc_now() - START_TIME).total_seconds()))


def _base_response_fields() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "service": SERVICE_NAME,
        "version": _resolve_version(),
        "timestamp": _iso(_utc_now()),
        "uptime_seconds": _uptime_seconds(),
    }


def _safe_append_telemetry_event(event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(event_name, payload)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _resolve_version() -> str:
    return SERVICE_VERSION


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _load_action_execute_pipeline_factory():
    from app.dependencies.action_execute import get_action_execute_pipeline

    return get_action_execute_pipeline


def _build_component_status(
    *,
    name: str,
    ok: bool,
    details: dict[str, Any],
) -> ComponentStatus:
    return ComponentStatus(
        name=name,
        status=OK_STATUS if ok else DEGRADED_STATUS,
        details=details,
    )


def _build_readiness_checks() -> list[ComponentStatus]:
    checks: list[ComponentStatus] = []

    pipeline = None
    pipeline_close_available = False
    pipeline_ready = False
    pipeline_error: str | None = None
    try:
        get_action_execute_pipeline = _load_action_execute_pipeline_factory()
        pipeline = get_action_execute_pipeline()
        pipeline_ready = pipeline is not None
        pipeline_close_available = callable(getattr(pipeline, "close", None)) if pipeline is not None else False
    except Exception as exc:
        pipeline_error = str(exc)

    checks.append(
        _build_component_status(
            name="action_execute_pipeline",
            ok=pipeline_ready,
            details={
                "initialized": pipeline_ready,
                "close_supported": pipeline_close_available,
                **({"error": pipeline_error} if pipeline_error else {}),
            },
        )
    )

    telemetry_ok = True
    telemetry_error: str | None = None
    telemetry_recent_count = 0
    try:
        recent = read_telemetry_events(limit=5)
        telemetry_recent_count = len(recent)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_ok = False
        telemetry_error = str(exc)

    checks.append(
        _build_component_status(
            name="telemetry_store",
            ok=telemetry_ok,
            details={
                "recent_events_checked": telemetry_recent_count,
                **({"error": telemetry_error} if telemetry_error else {}),
            },
        )
    )

    review_ok = True
    review_error: str | None = None
    review_summary: dict[str, Any] = {}
    try:
        review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()
    except Exception as exc:
        review_ok = False
        review_error = str(exc)

    checks.append(
        _build_component_status(
            name="review_queue",
            ok=review_ok,
            details={
                "pending_items": review_summary.get("pending_items"),
                "critical_items": review_summary.get("critical_items"),
                "total_items": review_summary.get("total_items"),
                **({"error": review_error} if review_error else {}),
            },
        )
    )

    return checks


def _overall_status_from_checks(checks: list[ComponentStatus]) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    ready = all(check.status == OK_STATUS for check in checks)
    return (OK_STATUS if ready else DEGRADED_STATUS, ready)


def _status_from_summary_payloads(*payloads: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    degraded_values = {DEGRADED_STATUS, "error", "failed", "unavailable"}
    for payload in payloads:
        if payload.get("status") in degraded_values or "error" in payload:
            return DEGRADED_STATUS
    return OK_STATUS


@router.get("/live", response_model=LivenessResponse, summary="Liveness probe")
def get_liveness() -> LivenessResponse:
    """
    Fast, dependency-light probe that answers:
    is the process alive and serving requests?
    """
    response = LivenessResponse(
        status=OK_STATUS,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_liveness_requested",
        {
            "status": response.status,
            "uptime_seconds": response.uptime_seconds,
        },
    )

    return response


@router.get("/ready", response_model=ReadinessResponse, summary="Readiness probe")
def get_readiness(response: Response) -> ReadinessResponse:
    """
    Readiness probe that checks whether core in-process services
    are initialized enough to safely receive traffic.
    """
    checks = _build_readiness_checks()
    overall_status, ready = _overall_status_from_checks(checks)

    if not ready:
        response.status_code = status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

    result = ReadinessResponse(
        status=overall_status,
        checks=checks,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_readiness_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "ready": ready,
            "check_count": len(checks),
        },
    )

    return result


@router.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse, summary="Combined health snapshot")
def get_health(response: Response) -> HealthResponse:
    """
    Combined operational health snapshot for dashboards and lightweight UI polling.
    """
    checks = _build_readiness_checks()
    overall_status, ready = _overall_status_from_checks(checks)

    if not ready:
        response.status_code = status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE

    result = HealthResponse(
        status=overall_status,
        live=True,
        ready=ready,
        checks=checks,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_health_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "live": result.live,
            "ready": result.ready,
            "check_count": len(checks),
        },
    )

    return result


@router.get(
    "/metrics/summary",
    response_model=MetricsSummaryResponse,
    summary="Lightweight metrics and telemetry summary",
)
def get_metrics_summary() -> MetricsSummaryResponse:
    """
    Lightweight operational summary intended for internal dashboards.
    """
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any]
    try:
        telemetry_summary = summarize_telemetry_events(limit=500)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_summary = {
            "status": DEGRADED_STATUS,
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    review_summary: dict[str, Any]
    try:
        review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()
    except Exception as exc:
        review_summary = {
            "status": DEGRADED_STATUS,
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]]
    try:
        recent_events = read_telemetry_events(limit=25)
    except Exception as exc:
        recent_events = [
            {
                "type": "telemetry_read_error",
                "error": str(exc),
            }
        ]

    overall_status = _status_from_summary_payloads(telemetry_summary, review_summary)

    result = MetricsSummaryResponse(
        status=overall_status,
        telemetry_summary=telemetry_summary,
        review_summary=review_summary,
        recent_telemetry_events=recent_events,
        **_base_response_fields(),
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "system_metrics_summary_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "telemetry_event_count": len(recent_events),
            "has_review_summary": bool(review_summary),
        },
    )

    return result

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

from app.services.telemetry import read_telemetry_events

@router.get(
    "/",
    response_model=TelemetryResponse,
    summary="Get telemetry events",
    description="Return recent telemetry events for operational visibility, newest-first.",
)
def get_telemetry(
    limit: int = Query(
        default=50,
        ge=1,
        le=500,
        description="Maximum number of telemetry events to return.",
    ),
) -> TelemetryResponse:
    events_raw = read_telemetry_events(limit=limit)
    items = [TelemetryEvent(**event) for event in events_raw]
    return TelemetryResponse(count=len(items), items=items)

    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)


@router.get("/summary", response_model=TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse)

            },
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse(
        telemetry_summary=telemetry_summary,
        recent_events=recent_events,
    )

    summarize_threat_scan_result,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/threat-intel", tags=["threat-intel"])


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _ThreatIntelState:
    feed: ThreatIntelFeed
    last_scan_result: ThreatIntelScanResult | None = None


_STATE = _ThreatIntelState(feed=initialize_default_threat_feed())


class ThreatIntelScanRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=1,
        description="Text to scan against the threat intel feed.",
    )


class ThreatIntelMatchResponse(BaseModel):
    indicator_id: str
    indicator_type: str
    value: str
    severity: str
    matched_on: str
    reason: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ThreatIntelScanResponse(BaseModel):
    scanned_text: str
    checked_at: str
    matches: list[ThreatIntelMatchResponse] = Field(default_factory=list)
    highest_severity: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    checked_at: str
    match_count: int
    highest_severity: str
    severity_counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ThreatIntelFeedResponse(BaseModel):
    feed_id: str
    name: str
    source: str
    indicators: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _build_match_response(match: ThreatIntelMatch) -> ThreatIntelMatchResponse:
    return ThreatIntelMatchResponse(
        indicator_id=match.indicator_id,
        indicator_type=match.indicator_type,
        value=match.value,
        severity=match.severity,
        matched_on=match.matched_on,
        reason=match.reason,
        metadata=dict(match.metadata),
    )


def _build_scan_response(result: ThreatIntelScanResult) -> ThreatIntelScanResponse:
    return ThreatIntelScanResponse(
        scanned_text=result.scanned_text,
        checked_at=result.checked_at,
        matches=[_build_match_response(match) for match in result.matches],
        highest_severity=result.highest_severity,
        metadata=dict(result.metadata),
    )


@router.get("/feed", response_model=ThreatIntelFeedResponse)
def get_threat_intel_feed() -> ThreatIntelFeedResponse:
    feed = _STATE.feed
    data = feed.to_dict()
    return ThreatIntelFeedResponse(
        feed_id=data["feed_id"],
        name=data["name"],
        source=data["source"],
        indicators=data["indicators"],
        created_at=data["created_at"],
        updated_at=data["updated_at"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


@router.post("/scan", response_model=ThreatIntelScanResponse)
def scan_threat_intel(request: ThreatIntelScanRequest) -> ThreatIntelScanResponse:
    result = scan_text_against_threat_feed(request.text, _STATE.feed)
    _STATE.last_scan_result = result
    return _build_scan_response(result)


@router.get("/scan/summary", response_model=ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse)
def get_last_threat_intel_scan_summary() -> ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse:
    result = _STATE.last_scan_result
    if result is None:
        return ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse(
            checked_at="",
            match_count=0,
            highest_severity="low",
            severity_counts={},
        )

    summary = summarize_threat_scan_result(result)
    return ThreatIntelScanSummaryResponse(
        checked_at=summary["checked_at"],
        match_count=summary["match_count"],
        highest_severity=summary["highest_severity"],
        severity_counts=summary["severity_counts"],
    )

router = APIRouter(tags=["data-retention"])


class DataRetentionPolicyItem(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    domain: str = Field(min_length=1)
    retention_days: int = Field(ge=0)
    storage_class: Literal["standard", "hot", "protected", "archive"]
    status: Literal["active", "review_required"]


class DataRetentionSummary(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    total_policies: int = Field(ge=0)
    active: int = Field(ge=0)
    review_required: int = Field(ge=0)


class DataRetentionResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    title: str
    status: Literal["ok"]
    summary: DataRetentionSummary
    policies: list[DataRetentionPolicyItem]
    request_id: str | None = None


_POLICIES: tuple[DataRetentionPolicyItem, ...] = (
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="audit_logs",
        retention_days=365,
        storage_class="standard",
        status="active",
    ),
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="request_stream",
        retention_days=30,
        storage_class="hot",
        status="active",
    ),
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="detonation_artifacts",
        retention_days=90,
        storage_class="protected",
        status="active",
    ),
    DataRetentionPolicyItem(
        domain="telemetry_rollups",
        retention_days=180,
        storage_class="archive",
        status="active",
    ),
)


@router.get(
    "/admin/data-retention",
    response_model=DataRetentionResponse,
    summary="Get Data Retention",
)
def get_data_retention_settings(
    request: Request,
    _: str | None = Depends(require_api_key),
) -> DataRetentionResponse:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)

    policies = list(_POLICIES)
    summary = DataRetentionSummary(
        total_policies=len(policies),
        active=sum(1 for policy in policies if policy.status == "active"),
        review_required=sum(
            1 for policy in policies if policy.status == "review_required"
        ),
    )

    return DataRetentionResponse(
        title="Data Retention",
        status="ok",
        summary=summary,
        policies=policies,
        request_id=request_id,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from app.auth import require_operator
from app.ui.runtimestatus import get_runtime_status_page


router = APIRouter(tags=["runtime-status"])


class RuntimeExecutorStatus(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    executorname: str = Field(default="")
    fallbackexecutorname: str = Field(default="")
    defaultmode: str = Field(default="")
    sandboxrequired: bool = Field(default=False)


class RuntimeMetricsStatus(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    totalrequests: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    allowcount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    reviewcount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    blockedcount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    quarantinecount: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    latesteventat: str | None = Field(default=None)


class RuntimePolicyStatus(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    policymode: Literal["dryrun", "enforce", "lockdown"] = Field(default="dryrun")
    defaultaction: Literal["allow", "review", "block"] = Field(default="review")


class RuntimeStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    pageid: str
    title: str
    path: str
    summary: str
    generatedat: str
    runtimeavailable: bool
    boundaryactive: bool
    reviewqueueenabled: bool
    executor: RuntimeExecutorStatus
    metrics: RuntimeMetricsStatus
    policy: RuntimePolicyStatus
    defaultfilepath: str
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


@router.get(
    "/ui/runtime/status",
    response_model=RuntimeStatusResponse,
    summary="Get Runtime Status",
    dependencies=[Depends(require_operator)],
)
def runtime_status_page() -> RuntimeStatusResponse:
    payload: Dict[str, Any] = get_runtime_status_page()

    metrics: Dict[str, Any] = dict(payload.get("metrics", {}))
    if "totalrequests" not in metrics:
        metrics["totalrequests"] = int(metrics.get("totalevents", 0) or 0)
    metrics.pop("totalevents", None)

    if not metrics.get("latesteventat"):
        metrics["latesteventat"] = None

    payload["metrics"] = metrics

    if "policy" not in payload or not isinstance(payload["policy"], dict):
        payload["policy"] = {
            "policymode": "dryrun",
            "defaultaction": "review",
        }

    return RuntimeStatusResponse.model_validate(payload)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Final

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request

from app.core.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(tags=["system-diagnostics"])

_DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKS: Final[tuple[dict[str, str], ...]] = (
    {
        "check_id": "api-health",
        "label": "API Health",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Core API routes responding within expected thresholds.",
    },
    {
        "check_id": "runtime-guard",
        "label": "Runtime Guard",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Guard pipeline loaded and enforcing protected execution boundaries.",
    },
    {
        "check_id": "review-queue",
        "label": "Review Queue",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Human review queue available for operator escalation workflows.",
    },
    {
        "check_id": "telemetry-pipeline",
        "label": "Telemetry Pipeline",
        "status": "ok",
        "severity": "info",
        "detail": "Telemetry ingestion and usage events are available for operator review.",
    },
)


def _build_checks() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    return [dict(check) for check in _DIAGNOSTIC_CHECKS]


def _build_summary(checks: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, int]:
    return {
        "total": len(checks),
        "ok": sum(1 for check in checks if check["status"] == "ok"),
        "warn": sum(1 for check in checks if check["status"] == "warn"),
        "error": sum(1 for check in checks if check["status"] == "error"),
    }


def _overall_status(summary: dict[str, int]) -> str:
    if summary["error"] > 0:
        return "error"
    if summary["warn"] > 0:
        return "warn"
    return "ok"


@router.get("/admin/system-diagnostics")
def get_system_diagnostics(
    request: Request,
    _: str | None = Depends(require_api_key),
) -> dict[str, object]:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    checks = _build_checks()
    summary = _build_summary(checks)

    return {
        "title": "System Diagnostics",
        "status": _overall_status(summary),
        "summary": summary,
        "checks": checks,
        "request_id": request_id,
    }
