from __future__ import annotations


from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


from app.ui.router import get_ui_routers



router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui-manifest", tags=["ui-manifest"])



class UIManifestRoute(BaseModel):
    prefix: str
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    slug: str
    label: str
    category: str
    enabled: bool = True
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class UIManifestResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_routes: int
    routes: list[UIManifestRoute] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _slug_from_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(prefix or "").strip("/")
    return normalized.replace("/", "-") or "root"



def _label_from_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    normalized = str(prefix or "").strip("/")
    if not normalized:
        return "Root"
    parts = [part.replace("-", " ").strip() for part in normalized.split("/") if part.strip()]
    return " / ".join(part.title() for part in parts)



def _category_from_tags(tags: list[str]) -> str:
    if not tags:
        return "general"


    tag = tags[0].strip().lower()


    if tag in {
        "execution-dashboard",
        "execution-detail",
        "execution-explorer",
        "execution-test-console",
    }:
        return "executions"


    if tag in {"review-queue", "review-detail"}:
        return "reviews"


    if tag in {"policy-insights", "request-context"}:
        return "policy"


    if tag in {"client-session-activity", "client-profile", "session-timeline"}:
        return "activity"


    if tag in {"runtime-status", "system-diagnostics", "alerts-notifications", "incident-triage"}:
        return "operations"


    if tag in {"operator-management", "access-control-roles", "settings-configuration"}:
        return "administration"


    if tag in {"integration-settings"}:
        return "integrations"


    if tag in {"audit-log", "data-retention"}:
        return "governance"


    if tag in {"customer-keys", "customer-key-detail", "usage-reports", "usage-event-detail"}:
        return "customer-access"


    if tag in {"ui-manifest"}:
        return "platform"


    if tag.startswith("groq"):
        return "groq"


    if tag.startswith("billing"):
        return "billing"


    return "general"



def _route_metadata(prefix: str, tags: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    slug = _slug_from_prefix(prefix)


    return {
        "slug": slug,
        "label": _label_from_prefix(prefix),
        "category": _category_from_tags(tags),
        "has_detail_view": any(token in slug for token in ("detail", "profile", "timeline")),
    }



@router.get("", response_model=UIManifestResponse)
def read_ui_manifest() -> UIManifestResponse:
    ui_routers = get_ui_routers()


    routes = []
    for ui_router in ui_routers:
        prefix = str(ui_router.prefix or "")
        tags = [str(tag) for tag in (ui_router.tags or [])]
        metadata = _route_metadata(prefix, tags)


        routes.append(
            UIManifestRoute(
                prefix=prefix,
                tags=tags,
                slug=str(metadata["slug"]),
                label=str(metadata["label"]),
                category=str(metadata["category"]),
                enabled=True,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )


    routes = sorted(routes, key=lambda route: route.prefix)


    categories = sorted({route.category for route in routes})
    tags_index = sorted({tag for route in routes for tag in route.tags})


    return UIManifestResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_routes=len(routes),
        routes=routes,
        metadata={
            "ui_router_registry": "app.ui.router",
            "sorted_by": "prefix",
            "categories": categories,
            "tags_index": tags_index,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.review_queue_service import get_review_queue_summary
from app.services.telemetry import (
    append_telemetry_event,
    read_telemetry_events,
    summarize_telemetry_events,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui-status", tags=["ui-status"])


class UIStatusCounts(BaseModel):
    pending_reviews: int = 0
    critical_reviews: int = 0
    total_reviews: int = 0
    recent_telemetry_events: int = 0


class UIStatusFlags(BaseModel):
    has_pending_reviews: bool
    has_critical_reviews: bool
    telemetry_available: bool
    system_degraded: bool


class UIStatusResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    counts: UIStatusCounts
    flags: UIStatusFlags
    review_summary: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _safe_append_telemetry_event(event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    try:
        append_telemetry_event(event_name, payload)
    except Exception:
        pass


@router.get("", response_model=UIStatusResponse)
def read_ui_status() -> UIStatusResponse:
    review_summary: dict[str, Any]
    telemetry_summary: dict[str, Any]
    recent_events: list[dict[str, Any]]

    review_error = False
    telemetry_error = False

    try:
        review_summary = get_review_queue_summary()
    except Exception as exc:
        review_error = True
        review_summary = {
            "status": "degraded",
            "error": str(exc),
            "pending_items": 0,
            "critical_items": 0,
            "total_items": 0,
        }

    try:
        telemetry_summary = summarize_telemetry_events(limit=250)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_error = True
        telemetry_summary = {
            "status": "degraded",
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    try:
        recent_events = read_telemetry_events(limit=20)
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry_error = True
        recent_events = [
            {
                "type": "telemetry_read_error",
                "error": str(exc),
            }
        ]

    pending_reviews = int(review_summary.get("pending_items") or 0)
    critical_reviews = int(review_summary.get("critical_items") or 0)
    total_reviews = int(review_summary.get("total_items") or 0)
    recent_telemetry_events = len(recent_events)

    system_degraded = review_error or telemetry_error
    telemetry_available = not telemetry_error

    result = UIStatusResponse(
        status="degraded" if system_degraded else "ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        counts=UIStatusCounts(
            pending_reviews=pending_reviews,
            critical_reviews=critical_reviews,
            total_reviews=total_reviews,
            recent_telemetry_events=recent_telemetry_events,
        ),
        flags=UIStatusFlags(
            has_pending_reviews=pending_reviews > 0,
            has_critical_reviews=critical_reviews > 0,
            telemetry_available=telemetry_available,
            system_degraded=system_degraded,
        ),
        review_summary=review_summary,
        telemetry_summary=telemetry_summary,
        recent_events=recent_events,
    )

    _safe_append_telemetry_event(
        "ui_status_requested",
        {
            "status": result.status,
            "pending_reviews": pending_reviews,
            "critical_reviews": critical_reviews,
            "total_reviews": total_reviews,
            "recent_telemetry_events": recent_telemetry_events,
            "telemetry_available": telemetry_available,
            "system_degraded": system_degraded,
        },
    )

    return result

@router.get("/system-diagnostics", response_model=SystemDiagnosticsResponse)
def get_system_diagnostics(
    requested_by: str = Query("ui-system-diagnostics", min_length=1),
) -> SystemDiagnosticsResponse:
    checks = _build_checks()
    healthy_count = sum(1 for check in checks if check.status == "healthy")
    warning_count = sum(1 for check in checks if check.status == "warning")
    error_count = sum(1 for check in checks if check.status == "error")

    overall_status = "healthy"
    if error_count > 0:
        overall_status = "error"
    elif warning_count > 0:
        overall_status = "warning"

    return SystemDiagnosticsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        requested_by=requested_by,
        overall_status=overall_status,
        healthy_count=healthy_count,
        warning_count=warning_count,
        error_count=error_count,
        checks=checks,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
            "check_count": len(checks),
        },
    )

class UsageRouteCount(BaseModel):
    route: str
    requests: int



class UsageSummaryView(BaseModel):
    api_key_id: str
    total_requests: int
    total_units: int
    last_seen_at: str | None = None
    routes: list[UsageRouteCount] = Field(default_factory=list)



class UsageEventView(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    api_key_id: str
    route: str
    method: str
    status_code: int
    units: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)



class UsageSummaryListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_keys: int
    summaries: list[UsageSummaryView] = Field(default_factory=list)



class UsageEventListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_events: int
    events: list[UsageEventView] = Field(default_factory=list)



def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _to_iso(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")



def _summary_to_view(summary: UsageSummary) -> UsageSummaryView:
    routes = [
        UsageRouteCount(route=route, requests=requests)
        for route, requests in sorted(
            summary.routes.items(),
            key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
        )
    ]
    return UsageSummaryView(
        api_key_id=summary.api_key_id,
        total_requests=summary.total_requests,
        total_units=summary.total_units,
        last_seen_at=_to_iso(summary.last_seen_at),
        routes=routes,
    )



def _event_to_view(event: UsageEvent) -> UsageEventView:
    return UsageEventView(
        timestamp=_to_iso(event.timestamp) or _utc_now_iso(),
        api_key_id=event.api_key_id,
        route=event.route,
        method=event.method,
        status_code=event.status_code,
        units=event.units,
        metadata=event.metadata or {},
    )



@router.get("", response_model=UsageSummaryListResponse)
def list_usage_summaries() -> UsageSummaryListResponse:
    registry = get_usage_metering_registry()
    summaries = registry.list_summaries()
    summaries = sorted(
        summaries,
        key=lambda summary: (-summary.total_units, -summary.total_requests, summary.api_key_id),
    )


    return UsageSummaryListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_keys=len(summaries),
        summaries=[_summary_to_view(summary) for summary in summaries],
    )



@router.get("/events", response_model=UsageEventListResponse)
def list_usage_events(
    limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200),
) -> UsageEventListResponse:
    registry = get_usage_metering_registry()
    events = registry.recent_events(limit=limit)


    return UsageEventListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_events=len(events),
        events=[_event_to_view(event) for event in reversed(events)],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from http import HTTPStatus
from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ExecuteRequest(BaseModel):
    """
    Incoming request for guarded action execution.
    Mirrors the payload used in testsactionexecute.py.
    """

    actiontype: str = Field(..., description="High-level action type, e.g. httpfetch or toolcall.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="Execution target, e.g. URL or tool identifier.")
    content: str = Field(..., description="Human-readable description or prompt text.")
    riskscore: int = Field(..., ge=0, le=100, description="Pre-computed risk score 0-100.")
    clientid: str = Field(..., description="Logical client identifier.")
    sessionid: str = Field(..., description="Execution/session correlation id.")
    filepath: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description="Logical source filepath for this action; defaults to app/api/action/execute.py.",
    )


ExecutionStatus = Literal["completed", "queuedforreview", "denied"]
ResponseAction = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block", "review"]
PolicyVerdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class ExecuteResponse(BaseModel):
    """
    HTTP facade response for guarded execution.
    Constrained to the literals expected by tests and downâ€‘stream callers.
    """

    # Core execution state
    executionstate: ExecutionStatus = Field(
        ...,
        description="High-level execution outcome: completed, queuedforreview, or denied.",
    )
    responseaction: ResponseAction = Field(
        ...,
        description="Action recommended/applied by policy and boundary.",
    )
    responsestatus: ExecutionStatus = Field(
        ...,
        description="HTTP-style status mapped into the same execution status domain.",
    )

    # Decision / policy metadata
    policyverdict: PolicyVerdict = Field(
        ...,
        description="Final policy verdict: allow, warn, quarantine, or block.",
    )
    riskscore: int = Field(
        ...,
        ge=0,
        le=100,
        description="Echoed risk score, for client-side introspection.",
    )
    shouldexecute: bool = Field(
        ...,
        description="Whether the action should actually execute beyond dry-run.",
    )
    haltedbyboundary: bool = Field(
        ...,
        description="True if boundary logic prevented real execution.",
    )
    reviewitemid: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description="Identifier of a queued review item when queuedforreview.",
    )

    # Tracing / correlation
    executionid: Optional[str] = Field(

    )
    traceid: Optional[str] = Field(

    )

    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(

    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


_DEFAULT_FILEPATH = "app/api/action/execute.py"


def _map_http_status_to_execution_status(status_code: int) -> ExecutionStatus:
    """
    Map numeric HTTP-ish status into the literal status domain required
    by ExecuteResponse.responsestatus and .executionstate.

    Tests assert that only 'completed', 'queuedforreview', or 'denied'
    are ever present here.[file:4]
    """
    if status_code in (HTTPStatus.OK, HTTPStatus.CREATED, HTTPStatus.ACCEPTED):
        return "completed"
    if status_code in (
        HTTPStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
        HTTPStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
        HTTPStatus.LOCKED,
    ):
        return "queuedforreview"
    # 4xx/5xx and anything unexpected collapse to denied
    return "denied"


def _normalize_policy_verdict(raw: Optional[str]) -> PolicyVerdict:
    """
    Ensure policyverdict stays within the allowed literal set.
    Some older components may emit 'deny'; tests expect block/quarantine
    membership checks instead.[file:4]
    """
    if not raw:
        return "allow"

    value = raw.lower()
    if value in {"allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"}:
        return value  # type: ignore[return-value]

    # Backwards-compat: unify any deny/forbid style to 'block'
    return "block"


def _normalize_response_action(raw: Optional[str], verdict: PolicyVerdict) -> ResponseAction:
    """
    Normalize the raw response action from lower layers to the allowed literals.
    Tests assert responseaction is in allow, warn, quarantine, block, review.[file:4]
    """
    if not raw:
        # Derive from verdict when missing.
        if verdict in ("allow", "warn"):
            return verdict
        if verdict in ("quarantine", "block"):
            return verdict
        return "review"

    value = raw.lower()
    if value in {"allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block", "review"}:
        return value  # type: ignore[return-value]

    if value in {"deny", "denied"}:
        return "block"

    # Fallback to verdict alignment.
    if verdict in ("allow", "warn"):
        return verdict
    if verdict in ("quarantine", "block"):
        return verdict
    return "review"


def _normalize_execution_state(raw_state: Optional[str], status: ExecutionStatus) -> ExecutionStatus:
    """
    Normalize executionstate to the literal domain required by the tests,
    using either the raw state emitted by summarizeexecution or the
    mapped HTTPish status code.[file:1]
    """
    if raw_state:
        value = raw_state.lower()
        if value in {"completed", "executed", "succeeded", "ok"}:
            return "completed"
        if value in {"queuedforreview", "queued", "pending_review", "pending"}:
            return "queuedforreview"
        if value in {"denied", "blocked", "failed", "error"}:
            return "denied"

    # Fall back to the mapped status when the raw state is unknown/missing.
    return status


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Route
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@router.post(
    "/execute",
    response_model=ExecuteResponse,
    summary="Guard and execute an action through the secure runtime pipeline.",
)
def guardedexecute(
    payload: ExecuteRequest,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline = Depends(getactionexecutepipeline),
) -> ExecuteResponse:
    """
    Guard and optionally execute an action.

    This is the HTTP facade used by testsactionexecute.py as `client.post('/guard/execute')`
    (or similar alias), and it delegates to the guardandexecuteaction facade which in turn
    calls executeguardedaction and the SecureRuntimePipeline.[file:1]
    """
    effective_filepath = payload.filepath or _DEFAULT_FILEPATH

    # Delegate to facade; this returns an ActionExecuteResult instance.
    responsepayload = guardandexecuteaction(
        actiontype=payload.actiontype,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        riskscore=payload.riskscore,
        clientid=payload.clientid,
        sessionid=payload.sessionid,
        filepath=effective_filepath,
        pipeline=pipeline,
    )

    # Extract raw fields from ActionExecuteResult / summary dict.
    # We access via getattr to tolerate both object-style and dict-style results.[file:1]
    def _get(field: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        if isinstance(responsepayload, dict):
            return responsepayload.get(field, default)
        return getattr(responsepayload, field, default)

    raw_status_code: int = int(_get("responsestatus", HTTPStatus.OK))
    mapped_status: ExecutionStatus = _map_http_status_to_execution_status(raw_status_code)

    raw_exec_state: Optional[str] = _get("executionstate")
    execution_state: ExecutionStatus = _normalize_execution_state(raw_exec_state, mapped_status)

    raw_policy_verdict: Optional[str] = _get("policyverdict")
    policy_verdict: PolicyVerdict = _normalize_policy_verdict(raw_policy_verdict)

    raw_response_action: Optional[str] = _get("responseaction")
    response_action: ResponseAction = _normalize_response_action(raw_response_action, policy_verdict)

    # Build the response with safe fallbacks where older components might omit fields.
    return ExecuteResponse(
        executionstate=execution_state,
        responseaction=response_action,
        responsestatus=mapped_status,
        policyverdict=policy_verdict,
        riskscore=int(_get("riskscore", payload.riskscore)),
        shouldexecute=bool(_get("shouldexecute", False)),
        haltedbyboundary=bool(_get("haltedbyboundary", False)),
        reviewitemid=_get("reviewitemid"),
        executionid=_get("executionid"),
        traceid=_get("traceid"),
        requestid=_get("requestid"),
        decisionid=_get("decisionid"),
        executorname=_get("executorname"),
        executorresult=_get("executorresult"),
        reason=_get("reason"),
        reasons=list(_get("reasons", [])) or [],
    )

from app.core.auth import require_api_key

router = APIRouter(

AlertChannel = Literal["email", "webhook", "slack"]
AlertEventType = Literal["incident_created", "incident_updated", "quarantine_created", "policy_changed"]
AlertDeliveryStatus = Literal["active", "paused", "failed"]


class AlertEndpointView(BaseModel):
    endpoint_id: str
    channel: AlertChannel

    channel: AlertChannel
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)

    subscribed_events: list[AlertEventType] = Field(default_factory=list)

class AlertEndpointResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    endpoint: AlertEndpointView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _to_view(endpoint: StoredAlertEndpointRecord) -> AlertEndpointView:
    return AlertEndpointView(**endpoint.to_dict())


def _find_endpoint_or_404(endpoint_id: str) -> StoredAlertEndpointRecord:
    endpoint = get_alert_store().get_endpoint(endpoint_id)
    if endpoint is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown alert endpoint: {endpoint_id}",
        )
    return endpoint


@router.get("/endpoints", response_model=AlertEndpointListResponse)
def list_alert_endpoints(
    channel: AlertChannel | None = Query(default=None),
    status_filter: AlertDeliveryStatus | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
) -> AlertEndpointListResponse:
    items = get_alert_store().list_endpoints(
        channel=channel,
        status=status_filter,
    )

    return AlertEndpointListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.post("/endpoints", response_model=AlertEndpointResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_alert_endpoint(payload: AlertEndpointCreateRequest) -> AlertEndpointResponse:
    endpoint = get_alert_store().create_endpoint(
        channel=payload.channel,
        name=payload.name,
        target=payload.target,
        subscribed_events=payload.subscribed_events,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    return AlertEndpointResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        endpoint=_to_view(endpoint),
    )


@router.get("/endpoints/{endpoint_id}", response_model=AlertEndpointResponse)
def get_alert_endpoint(endpoint_id: str) -> AlertEndpointResponse:
    endpoint = _find_endpoint_or_404(endpoint_id)
    return AlertEndpointResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        endpoint=_to_view(endpoint),
    )


@router.put("/endpoints/{endpoint_id}", response_model=AlertEndpointResponse)
def update_alert_endpoint(
    endpoint_id: str,
    payload: AlertEndpointUpdateRequest,
) -> AlertEndpointResponse:
    _find_endpoint_or_404(endpoint_id)

    updated = get_alert_store().update_endpoint(
        endpoint_id,
        subscribed_events=payload.subscribed_events,
        status=payload.status,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown alert endpoint: {endpoint_id}",
        )

    return AlertEndpointResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        endpoint=_to_view(updated),
    )

def _filter_events(
    events: list[AuditEventView],
    *,
    severity: AuditSeverity | None,
    category: AuditCategory | None,
    outcome: AuditOutcome | None,
    actor_id: str | None,
    request_id: str | None,
    trace_id: str | None,
    resource_id: str | None,
    search: str | None,
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    filtered = list(events)

    if severity is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.severity == severity]
    if category is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.category == category]
    if outcome is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.outcome == outcome]
    if actor_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.actor_id == actor_id]
    if request_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.request_id == request_id]
    if trace_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.trace_id == trace_id]
    if resource_id is not None:
        filtered = [event for event in filtered if event.resource_id == resource_id]
    if search:
        needle = search.strip().lower()
        filtered = [
            event
            for event in filtered
            if needle in event.summary.lower()
            or needle in event.action.lower()
            or any(needle in tag.lower() for tag in event.tags)
        ]

    return filtered


def _build_kpis(events: list[AuditEventView]) -> list[AuditKpiView]:
    return [
        AuditKpiView(label="total_events", value=len(events)),
        AuditKpiView(label="blocked_events", value=sum(1 for item in events if item.outcome == "blocked"), status="alert"),
        AuditKpiView(label="warning_events", value=sum(1 for item in events if item.outcome == "warning"), status="warning"),
        AuditKpiView(label="failure_events", value=sum(1 for item in events if item.outcome == "failure"), status="critical"),
    ]


def _build_timeline(events: list[AuditEventView]) -> list[AuditTimelinePoint]:
    points: list[AuditTimelinePoint] = []
    for event in events:
        points.append(
            AuditTimelinePoint(
                timestamp=event.timestamp,
                total_events=1,
                blocked_events=1 if event.outcome == "blocked" else 0,
                warning_events=1 if event.outcome == "warning" else 0,
                failure_events=1 if event.outcome == "failure" else 0,
            )
        )
    return points


def _build_filters(events: list[AuditEventView]) -> list[AuditFilterView]:
    def unique(values: list[str | None]) -> list[str]:
        return sorted({value for value in values if value})

    return [
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="severity", values=unique([event.severity for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="category", values=unique([event.category for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="outcome", values=unique([event.outcome for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="actor_id", values=unique([event.actor_id for event in events])),
        AuditFilterView(filter_key="resource_id", values=unique([event.resource_id for event in events])),
    ]


def _build_export_content(events: list[AuditEventView], export_format: ExportFormat) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    if export_format == "json":
        import json

        content = json.dumps([event.model_dump() for event in events], indent=2)
        return "application/json", "audit-export.json", content

    header = [
        "event_id",
        "timestamp",
        "severity",
        "category",
        "action",
        "outcome",
        "actor_id",
        "session_id",
        "request_id",
        "trace_id",
        "resource_type",
        "resource_id",
        "summary",
        "tags",
    ]
    lines = [",".join(header)]
    for event in events:
        row = [
            event.event_id,
            event.timestamp,
            event.severity,
            event.category,
            event.action,
            event.outcome,
            event.actor_id or "",
            event.session_id or "",
            event.request_id or "",
            event.trace_id or "",
            event.resource_type or "",
            event.resource_id or "",
            event.summary.replace(",", ";"),
            "|".join(event.tags),
        ]
        lines.append(",".join(row))
    return "text/csv", "audit-export.csv", "\n".join(lines)


@router.get("/", response_model=AuditExplorerResponse)
def read_audit_explorer(
    severity: AuditSeverity | None = Query(default=None),
    category: AuditCategory | None = Query(default=None),
    outcome: AuditOutcome | None = Query(default=None),
    actor_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    request_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    trace_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    resource_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    search: str | None = Query(default=None, max_length=200),
) -> AuditExplorerResponse:
    seeded = _seed_events()
    filtered = _filter_events(
        seeded,
        severity=severity,
        category=category,
        outcome=outcome,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        request_id=request_id,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        resource_id=resource_id,
        search=search,
    )

    return AuditExplorerResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(filtered),
        applied_filters={
            "severity": severity,
            "category": category,
            "outcome": outcome,
            "actor_id": actor_id,
            "request_id": request_id,
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "resource_id": resource_id,
            "search": search,
        },
        kpis=_build_kpis(filtered),
        timeline=_build_timeline(filtered),
        filters=_build_filters(seeded),
        items=filtered,
        notes=[
            "This explorer currently serves seeded in-memory audit data.",
            "Next upgrade can connect these views to the persistent audit/event pipeline.",
        ],
    )


@router.get("/export", response_model=AuditExportResponse)
def export_audit_explorer(

    severity: AuditSeverity | None = Query(default=None),
    category: AuditCategory | None = Query(default=None),
    outcome: AuditOutcome | None = Query(default=None),
) -> AuditExportResponse:
    seeded = _seed_events()
    filtered = _filter_events(
        seeded,
        severity=severity,
        category=category,
        outcome=outcome,
        actor_id=None,
        request_id=None,
        trace_id=None,
        resource_id=None,
        search=None,
    )
    content_type, filename, content = _build_export_content(filtered, export_format)

    return AuditExportResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        export_format=export_format,
        total=len(filtered),
        content_type=content_type,
        filename=filename,
        content=content,
    )

class TelemetrySummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total_events: int
    severity_counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    event_type_counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _filter_events(
    *,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    actor_id: str | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
) -> list[AuditEventView]:
    items = list(_SAMPLE_AUDIT_EVENTS)

    if session_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.session_id == session_id]

    if actor_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.client_id == actor_id]

    if request_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.request_id == request_id]

    if trace_id is not None:
        items = [item for item in items if item.trace_id == trace_id]

    return items

@router.get("/telemetry/summary", response_model=TelemetrySummaryResponse)
def get_telemetry_summary(
    limit: int = Query(default=500, ge=1, le=5000),
) -> TelemetrySummaryResponse:
    items = list(_SAMPLE_AUDIT_EVENTS[:limit])

    severity_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    event_type_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for item in items:
        severity_counts[item.severity] = severity_counts.get(item.severity, 0) + 1
        event_type_counts[item.event_type] = event_type_counts.get(item.event_type, 0) + 1

    return TelemetrySummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_events=len(items),
        severity_counts=severity_counts,
        event_type_counts=event_type_counts,
    )

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _package_to_view(package_id: str, package_data: dict[str, Any]) -> BillingPackageView:
    return BillingPackageView(package_id=package_id, **package_data)


def _require_known_package(package_id: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    normalized = package_id.strip().lower()
    package = PACKAGE_CATALOG.get(normalized)
    if package is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown billing package: {package_id}",
        )
    return normalized, package

        protection_layers=[
            ProtectionValueView(

                detail="Screens incoming prompts before risky instructions begin spreading through the workflow.",
            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Tool-call guardrails",

            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Source inspection",

            ),
            ProtectionValueView(
                title="Response release control",

            ),
            ProtectionValueView(

    packages = [

    ]

    return BillingPackagesResponse(

@router.post(
    "/packages/purchase",
    response_model=BillingPackagePurchaseResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def purchase_billing_package(
    payload: BillingPackagePurchaseRequest,
) -> BillingPackagePurchaseResponse:
    package_id, package = _require_known_package(payload.package_id)
    purchase = BillingPackagePurchaseView(
        purchase_id=f"pkg_{len(_PURCHASES) + 1}",
        package_id=package_id,
        package_name=str(package["name"]),
        buyer_name=payload.buyer_name.strip(),
        buyer_email=payload.buyer_email.strip().lower(),
        price_usd=float(package["price_usd"]),
        granted_units=int(package["included_units"]),
        created_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    _PURCHASES.append(purchase)

    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()
    wallet = wallet_registry.credit_units(
        owner_key=purchase.buyer_email,
        units=int(package["included_units"]),
        metadata={
            "source": "billing_package_purchase",
            "purchase_id": purchase.purchase_id,
            "package_id": package_id,
            "package_name": purchase.package_name,
            "buyer_name": purchase.buyer_name,
            **payload.metadata,
        },
    )

    return BillingPackagePurchaseResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        purchase=purchase,
        wallet=_wallet_to_view(wallet),
    )


@router.get("/wallet/{owner_key}", response_model=BillingWalletBalanceResponse)
def get_billing_wallet_balance(owner_key: str) -> BillingWalletBalanceResponse:
    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()
    wallet = wallet_registry.get_wallet(owner_key)

    if wallet is None:
        wallet = wallet_registry.get_or_create_wallet(owner_key=owner_key)

    return BillingWalletBalanceResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        wallet=_wallet_to_view(wallet),
    )


@router.get("/ledger", response_model=BillingLedgerResponse)
def list_billing_ledger(
    owner_key: str | None = Query(default=None),
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> BillingLedgerResponse:
    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()
    entries = wallet_registry.list_ledger_entries(owner_key=owner_key, limit=limit)

    normalized_owner = owner_key.strip().lower() if owner_key else None

    return BillingLedgerResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        owner_key=normalized_owner,
        limit=limit,
        entries=[_ledger_entry_to_view(entry) for entry in entries],
    )

def _normalize_label(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()


@router.get("/overview", response_model=DashboardResponse)
def get_dashboard_overview() -> DashboardResponse:
    now = _utc_now_iso()

    incident_store = get_incident_store()
    quarantine_store = get_quarantine_store()
    audit_store = get_audit_store()
    wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()

    incidents = incident_store.list_incidents()
    quarantine_items = quarantine_store.list_items()
    audit_events = audit_store.list_events(limit=500)

    open_incidents = [item for item in incidents if item.status in {"open", "triaged"}]
    blocked_events = [
        item for item in audit_events if (item.verdict or "").lower() in {"block", "quarantine"}
    ]
    integration_rollups: dict[str, dict[str, int | str]] = {}

    for event in audit_events:
        integration_id = event.integration_id or "core-system"
        bucket = integration_rollups.setdefault(
            integration_id,
            {
                "integration_id": integration_id,
                "label": _normalize_label(integration_id),
                "status": "protected",
                "protected_requests_24h": 0,
                "blocked_events_24h": 0,
            },
        )
        bucket["protected_requests_24h"] = int(bucket["protected_requests_24h"]) + 1
        if (event.verdict or "").lower() in {"block", "quarantine"}:
            bucket["blocked_events_24h"] = int(bucket["blocked_events_24h"]) + 1

    integrations = [
        DashboardIntegrationView(
            integration_id=str(item["integration_id"]),
            label=str(item["label"]),
            status=str(item["status"]),
            protected_requests_24h=int(item["protected_requests_24h"]),
            blocked_events_24h=int(item["blocked_events_24h"]),
        )
        for item in sorted(
            integration_rollups.values(),
            key=lambda item: (-int(item["protected_requests_24h"]), str(item["integration_id"])),
        )
    ]

    wallet = wallet_registry.get_wallet("demo@ironclaw.local")
    if wallet is None:
        wallet = wallet_registry.get_or_create_wallet("demo@ironclaw.local")

    recent_incidents = sorted(
        incidents,
        key=lambda item: item.created_at,
        reverse=True,
    )[:5]

    quarantine_pending = [item for item in quarantine_items if item.status in {"isolated", "under_review"}]
    quarantine_completed = [item for item in quarantine_items if item.status in {"released", "destroyed"}]

    return DashboardResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=now,
        stats=[
            DashboardStatView(
                key="protected_requests",
                label="Protected Requests",
                value=len(audit_events),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
            DashboardStatView(
                key="blocked_actions",
                label="Blocked Actions",
                value=len(blocked_events),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
            DashboardStatView(
                key="quarantined_items",
                label="Quarantined Items",
                value=len(quarantine_items),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
            DashboardStatView(
                key="open_incidents",
                label="Open Incidents",
                value=len(open_incidents),
                delta=0,
                metadata={"window": "active"},
            ),
        ],
        recent_incidents=[
            DashboardIncidentView(
                incident_id=item.incident_id,
                title=item.title,
                severity=item.severity,
                status=item.status,
                source=item.source,
                created_at=item.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
                verdict=item.verdict,
            )
            for item in recent_incidents
        ],
        queues=[
            DashboardQueueView(
                queue_name="review_queue",
                pending=len(open_incidents),
                in_progress=len([item for item in open_incidents if item.owner]),
                completed_today=len([item for item in incidents if item.status == "resolved"]),
            ),
            DashboardQueueView(
                queue_name="quarantine_queue",
                pending=len(quarantine_pending),
                in_progress=len([item for item in quarantine_pending if item.owner]),
                completed_today=len(quarantine_completed),
            ),
        ],
        integrations=integrations,
        wallet=DashboardWalletView(
            owner_key=wallet.owner_key,
            balance_units=wallet.balance_units,
            total_purchased_units=wallet.total_purchased_units,
            total_consumed_units=wallet.total_consumed_units,
            updated_at=wallet.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, Request, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.orchestrator.execution_trace import build_trace_id
from app.orchestrator.policy_enforcer import enforce_policy, initialize_policy_engine
from app.services.action_decision import evaluate_action_execution

router = APIRouter(prefix="/guard", tags=["guard"])


_ENGINE = initialize_policy_engine(mode="enforce")
_AUDIT_EVENTS: list[dict[str, Any]] = []


class ActionDecisionRequest(BaseModel):
    action_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    content: str = ""
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    file_path: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ExecuteRequest(BaseModel):
    action_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    content: str = ""
    risk_score: int = Field(default=0, ge=0, le=100)
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    file_path: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _merge_metadata(payload_metadata: dict[str, Any], *, session_id: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    merged = dict(payload_metadata or {})
    if session_id and "session_id" not in merged:
        merged["session_id"] = session_id
    return merged


def _append_audit_event(event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    _AUDIT_EVENTS.append(event)
    if len(_AUDIT_EVENTS) > 500:
        del _AUDIT_EVENTS[:-500]


@router.post("/action-decision", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def action_decision(payload: ActionDecisionRequest, request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trace_id = build_trace_id()

    tool_decision = evaluate_action_execution(
        action_type=payload.action_type,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        client_id=payload.client_id,
        session_id=payload.session_id,
    )

    response = {
        "trace_id": trace_id,
        "verdict": tool_decision["verdict"],
        "risk_score": int(tool_decision["risk_score"]),
        "should_halt": bool(tool_decision["should_halt"]),
        "summary": tool_decision.get("summary", ""),
        "decision_source": tool_decision.get("decision_source", "unknown"),
        "matched_patterns": list(tool_decision.get("matched_patterns", [])),
    }

    _append_audit_event(
        {
            "event_type": "action_decision",
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "path": str(request.url.path),
            "client_id": payload.client_id,
            "session_id": payload.session_id,
            "action_type": payload.action_type,
            "target": payload.target,
            "response": response,
        }
    )

    return response


@router.post("/execute", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def guarded_execute(payload: ExecuteRequest, request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    trace_id = build_trace_id()

    policy_decision = enforce_policy(
        _ENGINE,
        action_type=payload.action_type,
        target=payload.target,
        content=payload.content,
        risk_score=payload.risk_score,
        agent_id=payload.client_id,
        file_path=payload.file_path,
        metadata=_merge_metadata(payload.metadata, session_id=payload.session_id),
    )

    if policy_decision.verdict == "block":
        response_status = "denied"
        execution_state = "denied"
    elif policy_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        execution_state = "held"
    elif policy_decision.allow_execution:
        response_status = "completed"
        execution_state = "executed"
    else:
        response_status = "denied"
        execution_state = "failed"

    response = {
        "execution_id": policy_decision.decision_id,
        "trace_id": trace_id,
        "response_status": response_status,
        "execution_state": execution_state,
        "policy_verdict": policy_decision.verdict,
        "risk_score": int(policy_decision.risk_score),
        "risk_level": policy_decision.risk_level,
        "allow_execution": policy_decision.allow_execution,
        "requires_review": policy_decision.requires_review,
        "matched_rules": [match.to_dict() for match in policy_decision.matched_rules],
        "reasons": list(policy_decision.reasons),
        "target": payload.target,
        "action_type": payload.action_type,
        "file_path": payload.file_path,
    }

    _append_audit_event(
        {
            "event_type": "execute",
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "path": str(request.url.path),
            "client_id": payload.client_id,
            "session_id": payload.session_id,
            "action_type": payload.action_type,
            "target": payload.target,
            "response": response,
        }
    )

    return response


@router.get("/audit/events", dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)])
def get_audit_events(limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=200)) -> dict[str, Any]:
    events = list(reversed(_AUDIT_EVENTS[-limit:]))
    return {
        "events": events,
        "count": len(events),
        "limit": limit,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.incidentstore import (
    IncidentRecord as StoredIncidentRecord,
    build_incident_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/incidents",
    tags=["incidents"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


IncidentSeverity = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]
IncidentStatus = Literal["open", "triaged", "contained", "resolved"]
IncidentSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system", "ironclaw"]


class IncidentRecordView(BaseModel):
    incidentid: str = Field(..., description="Stable incident identifier.")
    title: str = Field(..., description="Short incident title.")
    summary: str = Field(..., description="Human-readable incident summary.")
    severity: IncidentSeverity = Field(..., description="Incident severity.")
    status: IncidentStatus = Field(..., description="Current incident status.")
    source: IncidentSource = Field(..., description="Origin of the incident.")
    createdat: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO-8601 timestamp.")
    updatedat: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO-8601 timestamp.")
    requestid: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related request identifier.")
    traceid: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related trace identifier.")
    assetref: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related asset or object reference.")
    verdict: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Related security verdict if available.")
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Assigned owner.")
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Search and routing tags.")
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict, description="Additional incident metadata.")


class IncidentListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int = Field(..., description="Total incidents returned.")
    items: list[IncidentRecordView] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Incident records.")


class IncidentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=200)
    summary: str = Field(..., min_length=3, max_length=2000)
    severity: IncidentSeverity
    source: IncidentSource
    status: IncidentStatus = "open"
    requestid: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    traceid: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    assetref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    verdict: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=100)
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IncidentStatusUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    status: IncidentStatus
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IncidentResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    incident: IncidentRecordView


def utcnowiso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _normalize_severity(value: Any) -> IncidentSeverity:
    normalized = str(value or "medium").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"low", "medium", "high", "critical"}:
        return normalized  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "medium"


def _normalize_status(value: Any) -> IncidentStatus:
    normalized = str(value or "open").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"open", "triaged", "contained", "resolved"}:
        return normalized  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "open"


def _normalize_source(value: Any) -> IncidentSource:
    normalized = str(value or "system").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system", "ironclaw"}:
        return normalized  # type: ignore[return-value]
    return "system"


def _string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        items = value
    elif isinstance(value, tuple):
        items = list(value)
    elif isinstance(value, set):
        items = list(value)
    else:
        items = [value]
    return [str(item) for item in items if str(item).strip()]


def toview(item: StoredIncidentRecord | dict[str, Any]) -> IncidentRecordView:
    payload = item.to_dict() if hasattr(item, "to_dict") and callable(item.to_dict) else dict(item)

    raw_metadata = payload.get("metadata")
    metadata = dict(raw_metadata) if isinstance(raw_metadata, dict) else {}

    return IncidentRecordView(
        incidentid=str(payload.get("incidentid") or payload.get("incident_id") or payload.get("id") or ""),
        title=str(payload.get("title") or "Security incident"),
        summary=str(payload.get("summary") or payload.get("description") or payload.get("title") or ""),
        severity=_normalize_severity(payload.get("severity")),
        status=_normalize_status(payload.get("status")),
        source=_normalize_source(payload.get("source")),
        createdat=str(payload.get("createdat") or payload.get("created_at") or utcnowiso()),
        updatedat=str(payload.get("updatedat") or payload.get("updated_at") or utcnowiso()),
        requestid=(
            str(payload["requestid"])
            if payload.get("requestid") is not None
            else str(payload["request_id"])
            if payload.get("request_id") is not None
            else None
        ),
        traceid=(
            str(payload["traceid"])
            if payload.get("traceid") is not None
            else str(payload["trace_id"])
            if payload.get("trace_id") is not None
            else None
        ),
        assetref=(
            str(payload["assetref"])
            if payload.get("assetref") is not None
            else str(payload["asset_ref"])
            if payload.get("asset_ref") is not None
            else None
        ),
        verdict=str(payload["verdict"]) if payload.get("verdict") is not None else None,
        owner=(
            str(payload["owner"])
            if payload.get("owner") is not None
            else str(payload["assigned_to"])
            if payload.get("assigned_to") is not None
            else str(payload["owner_id"])
            if payload.get("owner_id") is not None
            else None
        ),
        tags=_string_list(payload.get("tags")),
        metadata=metadata,
    )


@router.get("/", response_model=IncidentListResponse)
def listincidents(
    severity: IncidentSeverity | None = Query(default=None),
    status: IncidentStatus | None = Query(default=None),
    source: IncidentSource | None = Query(default=None),
) -> IncidentListResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    items = store.listincidents(
        severity=severity,
        status=status,
        source=source,
    )
    return IncidentListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[toview(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.get("/{incidentid}", response_model=IncidentResponse)
def getincident(incidentid: str) -> IncidentResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    item = store.getincident(incidentid)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown incident: {incidentid}",
        )

    return IncidentResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        incident=toview(item),
    )


@router.post("/", response_model=IncidentResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def createincident(payload: IncidentCreateRequest) -> IncidentResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    item = store.createincident(
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        severity=payload.severity,
        source=payload.source,
        status=payload.status,
        requestid=payload.requestid,
        traceid=payload.traceid,
        assetref=payload.assetref,
        verdict=payload.verdict,
        owner=payload.owner,
        tags=payload.tags,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    return IncidentResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        incident=toview(item),
    )


@router.put("/{incidentid}/status", response_model=IncidentResponse)
def updateincidentstatus(
    incidentid: str,
    payload: IncidentStatusUpdateRequest,
) -> IncidentResponse:
    store = build_incident_store(mode="memory")
    item = store.updateincidentstatus(
        incidentid,
        status=payload.status,
        owner=payload.owner,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown incident: {incidentid}",
        )

    return IncidentResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=utcnowiso(),
        incident=toview(item),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.organization_store import (
    OrganizationMemberRecord as StoredOrganizationMemberRecord,
    OrganizationRecord as StoredOrganizationRecord,
    get_organization_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/organizations",
    tags=["organizations"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


OrganizationRole = Literal["owner", "admin", "analyst", "viewer"]
OrganizationStatus = Literal["active", "suspended", "invited"]


class OrganizationMemberView(BaseModel):
    member_id: str
    email: str
    display_name: str
    role: OrganizationRole
    status: OrganizationStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationView(BaseModel):
    organization_id: str
    name: str
    slug: str
    status: Literal["active", "suspended"]
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    owner_email: str
    members: list[OrganizationMemberView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    items: list[OrganizationView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class OrganizationCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    slug: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=120)
    owner_email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    owner_display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationMemberCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    role: OrganizationRole
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    organization: OrganizationView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _member_to_view(member: StoredOrganizationMemberRecord) -> OrganizationMemberView:
    return OrganizationMemberView(**member.to_dict())


def _organization_to_view(organization: StoredOrganizationRecord) -> OrganizationView:
    data = organization.to_dict()
    return OrganizationView(
        organization_id=data["organization_id"],
        name=data["name"],
        slug=data["slug"],
        status=data["status"],
        created_at=data["created_at"],
        updated_at=data["updated_at"],
        owner_email=data["owner_email"],
        members=[OrganizationMemberView(**member) for member in data["members"]],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


def _find_organization_or_404(organization_id: str) -> StoredOrganizationRecord:
    organization = get_organization_store().get_organization(organization_id)
    if organization is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {organization_id}",
        )
    return organization


@router.get("/", response_model=OrganizationListResponse)
def list_organizations(
    status_filter: Literal["active", "suspended"] | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
) -> OrganizationListResponse:
    items = get_organization_store().list_organizations(status=status_filter)

    return OrganizationListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_organization_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.post("/", response_model=OrganizationResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_organization(payload: OrganizationCreateRequest) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = get_organization_store().create_organization(
        name=payload.name,
        slug=payload.slug,
        owner_email=payload.owner_email,
        owner_display_name=payload.owner_display_name,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        _, normalized_slug = result
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=f"Organization slug already exists: {normalized_slug}",
        )

    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )


@router.get("/{organization_id}", response_model=OrganizationResponse)
def get_organization(organization_id: str) -> OrganizationResponse:
    organization = _find_organization_or_404(organization_id)
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(organization),
    )


@router.post(
    "/{organization_id}/members",
    response_model=OrganizationResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def add_organization_member(
    organization_id: str,
    payload: OrganizationMemberCreateRequest,
) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = get_organization_store().add_member(
        organization_id,
        email=payload.email,
        display_name=payload.display_name,
        role=payload.role,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        error_type, value = result
        if error_type == "member_exists":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Organization member already exists: {value}",
            )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {value}",
        )

    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )

    display_name: str

    items: list[OrganizationView] = Field(default_factory=list)

    owner_email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=200)
    owner_display_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    plan_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)

    status: OrgMemberStatus = "invited"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.policy_store import (
    PolicySettingsRecord as StoredPolicySettingsRecord,

    get_policy_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/policy",
    tags=["policy"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


PolicyMode = Literal["monitor", "enforce", "lockdown"]
PolicyDecision = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class PolicyThresholdsView(BaseModel):
    prompt_injection_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    malware_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    exfiltration_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    tool_abuse_score: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class PolicySettingsView(BaseModel):
    policy_id: str
    mode: PolicyMode
    default_decision: PolicyDecision
    require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool
    sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool
    block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool
    strict_prompt_ingress: bool
    thresholds: PolicyThresholdsView
    updated_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class PolicySettingsResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    settings: PolicySettingsView


class PolicyUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    mode: PolicyMode
    default_decision: PolicyDecision
    require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool
    sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool
    block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool
    strict_prompt_ingress: bool
    thresholds: PolicyThresholdsView
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _to_view(settings: StoredPolicySettingsRecord) -> PolicySettingsView:
    data = settings.to_dict()
    return PolicySettingsView(
        policy_id=data["policy_id"],
        mode=data["mode"],
        default_decision=data["default_decision"],
        require_human_review_for_quarantine=data["require_human_review_for_quarantine"],
        sandbox_all_untrusted_content=data["sandbox_all_untrusted_content"],
        block_high_risk_tool_calls=data["block_high_risk_tool_calls"],
        strict_prompt_ingress=data["strict_prompt_ingress"],
        thresholds=PolicyThresholdsView(**data["thresholds"]),
        updated_at=data["updated_at"],
        metadata=data["metadata"],
    )


@router.get("/settings", response_model=PolicySettingsResponse)
def get_policy_settings() -> PolicySettingsResponse:
    settings = get_policy_store().get_settings()
    return PolicySettingsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        settings=_to_view(settings),
    )


@router.put("/settings", response_model=PolicySettingsResponse)
def update_policy_settings(payload: PolicyUpdateRequest) -> PolicySettingsResponse:
    settings = get_policy_store().update_settings(
        mode=payload.mode,
        default_decision=payload.default_decision,
        require_human_review_for_quarantine=payload.require_human_review_for_quarantine,
        sandbox_all_untrusted_content=payload.sandbox_all_untrusted_content,
        block_high_risk_tool_calls=payload.block_high_risk_tool_calls,
        strict_prompt_ingress=payload.strict_prompt_ingress,
        thresholds=PolicyThresholdRecord(
            prompt_injection_score=payload.thresholds.prompt_injection_score,
            malware_score=payload.thresholds.malware_score,
            exfiltration_score=payload.thresholds.exfiltration_score,
            tool_abuse_score=payload.thresholds.tool_abuse_score,
        ),
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )

    return PolicySettingsResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        settings=_to_view(settings),
    )

from app.services.quarantine_store import (
    QuarantineRecord as StoredQuarantineRecord,
    get_quarantine_store,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/quarantine",
    tags=["quarantine"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


QuarantineStatus = Literal["isolated", "under_review", "released", "destroyed"]
QuarantineSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system"]
RiskLevel = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]


class QuarantineItemView(BaseModel):
    quarantine_id: str
    status: QuarantineStatus
    source: QuarantineSource
    title: str
    summary: str
    risk_level: RiskLevel
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    incident_id: str | None = None
    asset_ref: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    release_reason: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineListResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    items: list[QuarantineItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    source: QuarantineSource
    title: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=200)
    summary: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=2000)
    risk_level: RiskLevel
    status: QuarantineStatus = "isolated"
    request_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    trace_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    incident_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    asset_ref: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    owner: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    release_reason: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class QuarantineReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    owner: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class QuarantineReleaseRequest(BaseModel):
    release_reason: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    released_by: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class QuarantineDestroyRequest(BaseModel):
    destroyed_by: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    destroy_reason: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=500)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class QuarantineActionResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    item: QuarantineItemView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _to_view(item: StoredQuarantineRecord) -> QuarantineItemView:
    return QuarantineItemView(**item.to_dict())


def _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id: str) -> StoredQuarantineRecord:
    item = get_quarantine_store().get_item(quarantine_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )
    return item


@router.get("/", response_model=QuarantineListResponse)
def list_quarantine_items(
    status_filter: QuarantineStatus | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
    source: QuarantineSource | None = Query(default=None),
    risk_level: RiskLevel | None = Query(default=None),
) -> QuarantineListResponse:
    items = get_quarantine_store().list_items(
        status=status_filter,
        source=source,
        risk_level=risk_level,
    )

    return QuarantineListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.get("/{quarantine_id}", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def get_quarantine_item(quarantine_id: str) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)
    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(item),
    )


@router.post("/", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_quarantine_item(payload: QuarantineCreateRequest) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = get_quarantine_store().create_item(
        source=payload.source,
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        risk_level=payload.risk_level,
        status=payload.status,
        request_id=payload.request_id,
        trace_id=payload.trace_id,
        incident_id=payload.incident_id,
        asset_ref=payload.asset_ref,
        owner=payload.owner,
        release_reason=payload.release_reason,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
        tags=payload.tags,
    )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(item),
    )


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/review", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def review_quarantine_item(
    quarantine_id: str,
    payload: QuarantineReviewRequest,
) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)

    if item.status in {"released", "destroyed"}:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Released or destroyed quarantine items cannot return to review.",
        )

    updated = get_quarantine_store().update_item(
        quarantine_id,
        status="under_review",
        owner=payload.owner.strip(),
        metadata={
            **payload.metadata,
            "reviewed_by": payload.owner.strip(),
        },
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(updated),
    )


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/release", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def release_quarantine_item(
    quarantine_id: str,
    payload: QuarantineReleaseRequest,
) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)

    if item.status == "destroyed":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Destroyed quarantine items cannot be released.",
        )

    updated = get_quarantine_store().update_item(
        quarantine_id,
        status="released",
        owner=payload.released_by.strip(),
        release_reason=payload.release_reason.strip(),
        metadata={
            **payload.metadata,
            "released_by": payload.released_by.strip(),
            "release_reason": payload.release_reason.strip(),
        },
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(updated),
    )


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/destroy", response_model=QuarantineActionResponse)
def destroy_quarantine_item(
    quarantine_id: str,
    payload: QuarantineDestroyRequest,
) -> QuarantineActionResponse:
    item = _find_item_or_404(quarantine_id)

    if item.status == "released":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Released quarantine items cannot be destroyed.",
        )

    updated = get_quarantine_store().update_item(
        quarantine_id,
        status="destroyed",
        owner=payload.destroyed_by.strip(),
        metadata={
            **payload.metadata,
            "destroyed_by": payload.destroyed_by.strip(),
            "destroy_reason": payload.destroy_reason.strip(),
        },
    )
    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown quarantine item: {quarantine_id}",
        )

    return QuarantineActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=_to_view(updated),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/guard/reviews",
    tags=["review-queue"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class ReviewReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int | None = None


class ReviewActionRequest(BaseModel):
    reviewer: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    notes: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class ReviewItemResponse(BaseModel):
    review_id: str
    status: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    risk_score: int
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    requested_by: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    policy_verdict: str
    recommended_action: str
    final_action: str | None = None
    reason: str
    reasons: list[ReviewReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReviewQueueSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    total: int
    pending: int
    approved: int
    rejected: int
