def _to_review_item(record: dict[str, Any]) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    return ReviewItemResponse(
        review_id=str(record["review_id"]),
        status=str(record["status"]),
        action_type=str(record["action_type"]),
        target=str(record["target"]),
        risk_score=int(record["risk_score"]),
        created_at=str(record["created_at"]),
        updated_at=str(record["updated_at"]),
        requested_by=record.get("requested_by"),
        session_id=record.get("session_id"),
        actor_id=record.get("actor_id"),
        policy_verdict=str(record["policy_verdict"]),
        recommended_action=str(record["recommended_action"]),
        final_action=record.get("final_action"),
        reason=str(record["reason"]),
        reasons=[
            ReviewReasonView(
                source=str(item["source"]),
                label=str(item["label"]),
                details=str(item["details"]),
                score=item.get("score"),
            )
            for item in record.get("reasons", [])
        ],
        metadata=dict(record.get("metadata", {})),
    )


def _find_review(review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    for record in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS:
        if record["review_id"] == review_id:
            return record
    return None


@router.get("/summary", response_model=ReviewQueueSummaryResponse)
def get_review_summary() -> ReviewQueueSummaryResponse:
    total = len(_SAMPLE_REVIEWS)
    pending = sum(1 for item in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if item["status"] == "pending")
    approved = sum(1 for item in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if item["status"] == "approved")
    rejected = sum(1 for item in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if item["status"] == "rejected")

    return ReviewQueueSummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=total,
        pending=pending,
        approved=approved,
        rejected=rejected,
    )


@router.get("", response_model=list[ReviewItemResponse])
def get_all_reviews(
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> list[ReviewItemResponse]:
    return [_to_review_item(record) for record in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS[:limit]]


@router.get("/pending", response_model=list[ReviewItemResponse])
def get_pending_reviews(
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> list[ReviewItemResponse]:
    pending_items = [record for record in _SAMPLE_REVIEWS if record["status"] == "pending"]
    return [_to_review_item(record) for record in pending_items[:limit]]


@router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def get_review(review_id: str) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    record = _find_review(review_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown review item: {review_id}",
        )
    return _to_review_item(record)


@router.post("/{review_id}/approve", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def approve_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewActionRequest,
) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    record = _find_review(review_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown review item: {review_id}",
        )

    record["status"] = "approved"
    record["final_action"] = "approve"
    record["updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()
    record["metadata"] = {
        **dict(record.get("metadata", {})),
        "reviewer": payload.reviewer,
        "review_notes": payload.notes,
    }
    return _to_review_item(record)


@router.post("/{review_id}/reject", response_model=ReviewItemResponse)
def reject_review_item(
    review_id: str,
    payload: ReviewActionRequest,
) -> ReviewItemResponse:
    record = _find_review(review_id)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown review item: {review_id}",
        )

    record["status"] = "rejected"
    record["final_action"] = "reject"
    record["updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()
    record["metadata"] = {
        **dict(record.get("metadata", {})),
        "reviewer": payload.reviewer,
        "review_notes": payload.notes,
    }
    return _to_review_item(record)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.C_gen1 import scan_text, scan_url, scan_github_repo, scan_archive
from app.C_gen1service import (
    apply_review_action,
    get_history_items,
    get_history_item,
    record_scan_result,
    review_scan,
)

router = APIRouter()

Verdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class ScanRequest(BaseModel):
    target_type: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    target_value: str = Field(..., min_length=1)


class ScanResponse(BaseModel):
    scan_id: str
    verdict: Verdict
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    checks_loaded: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    review_status: str | None = None
    untrusted: bool | None = None
    quarantine_reason: str | None = None

@router.post("/scan/", response_model=ScanResponse)
def scan_target(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResponse:
    target_type = request.target_type
    target_value = request.target_value

    normalized_value = " ".join(target_value.split())
    if target_type == "text" and not normalized_value:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target_value is empty after normalization")

    if target_type == "text":
        result = scan_text(normalized_value)
    elif target_type == "url":
        result = scan_url(target_value)
    elif target_type == "github_repo":
        result = scan_github_repo(target_value)
    elif target_type == "archive":
        result = scan_archive(target_value)
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"unsupported target_type={target_type}")

    stored = record_scan_result(
        target_type=target_type,
        target_value=target_value,
        result=result,
    )

    return ScanResponse(
        scan_id=stored.scan_id,
        verdict=stored.verdict,
        summary=stored.summary,
        risk_score=stored.risk_score,
        matched_patterns=list(stored.matchedpatterns),
        risky_files=list(getattr(stored, "riskyfiles", [])),
        checks_loaded=list(getattr(stored, "checksloaded", [])),
        failed_checks=list(getattr(stored, "failedchecks", [])),
        review_status=getattr(stored, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(stored, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(stored, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.get("/history/", response_model=HistoryListResponse)
def list_history() -> HistoryListResponse:
    items = get_history_items()
    return HistoryListResponse(
        items=[
            HistoryItem(
                scan_id=i.scan_id,
                target_type=i.targettype,
                target_value=i.targetvalue,
                verdict=i.verdict,
                summary=i.summary,
                risk_score=i.riskscore,
                matched_patterns=list(getattr(i, "matchedpatterns", [])),
                review_status=getattr(i, "reviewstatus", None),
                untrusted=getattr(i, "untrusted", None),
                quarantine_reason=getattr(i, "quarantinereason", None),
            )
            for i in items
        ]
    )


@router.get("/history/{scan_id}", response_model=HistoryItem)
def get_history(scan_id: str) -> HistoryItem:

        target_type=item.targettype,
        target_value=item.targetvalue,
        verdict=item.verdict,
        summary=item.summary,
        risk_score=item.riskscore,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(item, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        review_status=getattr(item, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(item, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(item, "quarantinereason", None),
    )


@router.post("/history/{scan_id}/review")
def review_history_item(scan_id: str, request: ReviewRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        updated = review_scan(scan_id=scan_id, action=request.action)
    except KeyError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="scan_id not found")

    if updated is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="review not applicable for this scan")

    apply_review_action(updated, request.action)
    return {"status": "ok", "scan_id": scan_id, "action": request.action}


@router.post("/guard/action", response_model=GuardActionResponse)
def guard_action(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardActionResponse:
    scan_result = scan_text(request.content)
    verdict: Verdict = scan_result.verdict  # type: ignore[assignment]

    should_halt = verdict in ("block", "quarantine")
    should_warn = verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")

    return GuardActionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_halt=bool(should_halt),
        should_warn=bool(should_warn),
        matched_patterns=list(scan_result.matchedpatterns),
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-policy", response_model=GuardPolicyResponse)
def guard_action_policy(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardPolicyResponse:
    content = request.content.lower()
    if "powershell" in content:
        policy_mode: Literal["review", "allow", "block"] = "review"
        verdict: Verdict = "warn"
        should_halt = False
        should_warn = True
    else:
        policy_mode = "allow"
        verdict = "allow"
        should_halt = False
        should_warn = False

    return GuardPolicyResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=policy_mode,
        verdict=verdict,
        should_halt=should_halt,
        should_warn=should_warn,
        client_id=request.client_id,
        session_id=request.session_id,
    )


@router.post("/guard/action-decision", response_model=GuardDecisionResponse)
def guard_action_decision(request: GuardActionRequest) -> GuardDecisionResponse:
    scan_result = scan_text(request.content)
    scan_verdict: Verdict = scan_result.verdict  # type: ignore[assignment]

    policy_resp = guard_action_policy(request)
    policy_mode = policy_resp.policy_mode

    matched_patterns = list(scan_result.matchedpatterns)

    if scan_verdict in ("block", "quarantine"):
        final_verdict = "block"
        decision_source: Literal["scan", "policy"] = "scan"
        should_halt = True
        should_warn = False
    else:
        final_verdict = policy_resp.verdict
        decision_source = "policy"
        should_halt = policy_resp.should_halt
        should_warn = policy_resp.should_warn

    return GuardDecisionResponse(
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        policy_mode=policy_mode,
        verdict=final_verdict,
        decision_source=decision_source,
        should_halt=should_halt,
        should_warn=should_warn,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        client_id=request.client_id,

def _filter_items(
    items: list[UnitLedgerItem],
    entry_type: LedgerEntryType | None = None,
    reference_id: str | None = None,
) -> list[UnitLedgerItem]:
    filtered = items

    if entry_type is not None:
        filtered = [item for item in filtered if item.entry_type == entry_type]

    if reference_id:
        reference_value = reference_id.strip().lower()
        filtered = [
            item
            for item in filtered
            if item.reference_id and reference_value in item.reference_id.lower()
        ]

    return filtered


def _build_totals(items: list[UnitLedgerItem]) -> UnitLedgerTotalsView:
    purchase_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "purchase")
    debit_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "debit")
    credit_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "credit")
    adjustment_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "adjustment")
    refund_entries = sum(1 for item in items if item.entry_type == "refund")

    total_purchased_units = sum(item.units for item in items if item.entry_type == "purchase")
    total_consumed_units = sum(abs(item.units) for item in items if item.entry_type == "debit")
    total_credited_units = sum(
        item.units for item in items if item.entry_type in {"credit", "adjustment"}
    )
    total_refunded_units = sum(item.units for item in items if item.entry_type == "refund")
    total_purchase_amount_usd = round(
        sum(item.amount_usd or 0 for item in items if item.entry_type == "purchase"),
        2,
    )

    current_balance_units = max(sum(item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER), 0)

    return UnitLedgerTotalsView(
        total_entries=len(items),
        purchase_entries=purchase_entries,
        debit_entries=debit_entries,
        credit_entries=credit_entries,
        adjustment_entries=adjustment_entries,
        refund_entries=refund_entries,
        total_purchased_units=max(total_purchased_units, 0),
        total_consumed_units=total_consumed_units,
        total_credited_units=max(total_credited_units, 0),
        total_refunded_units=max(total_refunded_units, 0),
        total_purchase_amount_usd=total_purchase_amount_usd,
        current_balance_units=current_balance_units,
    )


def _find_entry(entry_id: str) -> UnitLedgerItem | None:
    for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER:
        if item.entry_id == entry_id:
            return item
    return None


@router.get("/ledger", response_model=UnitLedgerListResponse)
def get_unit_ledger(
    entry_type: LedgerEntryType | None = Query(default=None),
    reference_id: str | None = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
    limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200),
) -> UnitLedgerListResponse:
    filtered_items = _filter_items(
        _SAMPLE_LEDGER,
        entry_type=entry_type,
        reference_id=reference_id,
    )
    limited_items = filtered_items[:limit]

    return UnitLedgerListResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(filtered_items),
        applied_filters={
            "entry_type": entry_type,
            "reference_id": reference_id,
            "limit": limit,
        },
        totals=_build_totals(filtered_items),
        items=limited_items,
        notes=[
            "Ledger route provides UI-facing billing activity for wallet purchases, usage debits, and manual adjustments.",
            "Sample data is returned from in-memory entries for scaffolding and frontend integration.",
            "Package pricing reflected in related purchase entries includes 100,000 units for $90.00 USD and 200,000 units for $150.00 USD.",
        ],
    )


@router.get("/ledger/{entry_id}", response_model=UnitLedgerDetailResponse)
def get_unit_ledger_entry(entry_id: str) -> UnitLedgerDetailResponse:
    item = _find_entry(entry_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ledger entry not found")

    return UnitLedgerDetailResponse(
        generated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        item=item,
        notes=[
            "Ledger detail route returns a single wallet activity record for UI drill-down views.",
            "This scaffold currently serves in-memory sample data only.",
        ],
    )

def _build_wallet_balance() -> UnitWalletBalanceView:
    purchased_units = sum(item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type == "purchase")
    credited_units = sum(
        item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type in {"credit", "adjustment", "refund"}
    )
    consumed_units = sum(abs(item.units) for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type == "debit")
    balance_units = max(sum(item.units for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER), 0)

    return UnitWalletBalanceView(
        balance_units=balance_units,
        lifetime_purchased_units=max(purchased_units + credited_units, 0),
        lifetime_consumed_units=consumed_units,
        pending_units=0,
        last_updated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
    )


def _build_usage_summary() -> UnitUsageSummaryView:
    total_units = sum(abs(item.units) for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER if item.entry_type == "debit")
    total_requests = sum(
        int(item.metadata.get("request_count", 0))
        for item in _SAMPLE_LEDGER
        if item.entry_type == "debit"
    )
    average_units_per_request = round(total_units / total_requests, 2) if total_requests else 0.0
    last_seen_at = _SAMPLE_LEDGER[0].timestamp if _SAMPLE_LEDGER else None

    return UnitUsageSummaryView(
        total_requests=total_requests,
        total_units=total_units,
        average_units_per_request=average_units_per_request,
        last_seen_at=last_seen_at,
    )

    for package in _SAMPLE_PACKAGES:

            return package
    return None

@router.post("/purchase", response_model=UnitPurchaseResponse)
def purchase_units(payload: UnitPurchaseRequest) -> UnitPurchaseResponse:
    package = _find_package(payload.package_id)
    if package is None:
        package = UnitPackageView(
            package_id=payload.package_id,
            name="20,000 Units",
            unit_count=20_000,
            price_usd=20.0,
            price_display="$20.00",
            active=True,
            featured=False,
            description="Fallback package for unknown package ids in the UI scaffold.",
            effective_price_per_1k_units=_price_per_1k_units(20.0, 20_000),
        )

    credited_units = package.unit_count * payload.quantity
    amount_usd = round(package.price_usd * payload.quantity, 2)

    current_balance = _build_wallet_balance()
    new_balance = current_balance.balance_units + credited_units
    timestamp = _utc_now_iso()

    ledger_entry = UnitLedgerItem(
        entry_id=f"ledger_purchase_{payload.package_id}_{payload.quantity}",
        timestamp=timestamp,
        entry_type="purchase",
        units=credited_units,
        balance_after=new_balance,
        amount_usd=amount_usd,
        description=f"Purchased {payload.quantity} x {package.name}.",
        reference_id=f"order_{payload.package_id}_{payload.quantity}",
        metadata={
            "package_id": package.package_id,
            "package_name": package.name,
            "quantity": payload.quantity,
        },
    )

    wallet = UnitWalletBalanceView(
        balance_units=new_balance,
        lifetime_purchased_units=current_balance.lifetime_purchased_units + credited_units,
        lifetime_consumed_units=current_balance.lifetime_consumed_units,
        pending_units=current_balance.pending_units,
        last_updated_at=timestamp,
    )

    return UnitPurchaseResponse(
        status="ok",
        purchased_package=package,
        quantity=payload.quantity,
        credited_units=credited_units,
        amount_usd=amount_usd,
        wallet=wallet,
        ledger_entry=ledger_entry,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.auth import require_api_key


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/usage",
    tags=["usage"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],
)


class UsageSample(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    units_consumed: int
    source: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageSummaryView(BaseModel):
    owner_key: str
    total_units_consumed: int
    window_start: str
    window_end: str
    samples: list[UsageSample] = Field(default_factory=list)


class UsageSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    summary: UsageSummaryView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


# In-memory usage registry for API-key scoped metering.
# This is intentionally simple for Gen1; persistence can be added behind the same interface later.
class UsageRegistry:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._by_owner: dict[str, list[UsageSample]] = {}

    def record_usage(
        self,
        owner_key: str,
        units_consumed: int,
        source: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        normalized_owner = owner_key.strip().lower()
        sample = UsageSample(
            timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
            units_consumed=max(0, int(units_consumed)),
            source=source,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
        self._by_owner.setdefault(normalized_owner, []).append(sample)

    def summarize_owner(
        self,
        owner_key: str,
    ) -> UsageSummaryView:
        normalized_owner = owner_key.strip().lower()
        samples = self._by_owner.get(normalized_owner, [])

        if not samples:
            now = _utc_now_iso()
            return UsageSummaryView(
                owner_key=normalized_owner,
                total_units_consumed=0,
                window_start=now,
                window_end=now,
                samples=[],
            )

        total = sum(s.units_consumed for s in samples)
        window_start = samples[0].timestamp
        window_end = samples[-1].timestamp

        return UsageSummaryView(
            owner_key=normalized_owner,
            total_units_consumed=total,
            window_start=window_start,
            window_end=window_end,
            samples=samples[-250:],  # cap for response size
        )


_usage_registry = UsageRegistry()


def get_usage_registry() -> UsageRegistry:
    return _usage_registry


@router.get(
    "/owner/{owner_key}",
    response_model=UsageSummaryResponse,
)
def get_owner_usage(owner_key: str) -> UsageSummaryResponse:
    """
    Return a metered view of IronClaw-Security protection usage for this owner key.

    In Gen1 this is backed by an in-memory registry. In a production deployment
    the same shape can be hydrated from logs or a billing database.
    """
    summary = _usage_registry.summarize_owner(owner_key=owner_key)

    return UsageSummaryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        summary=summary,
    )

@router.post("/scan/", response_model=ScanResponse)
def scan_target(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResponse:
    target_type = request.target_type
    target_value = request.target_value

    normalized_value = " ".join(target_value.split())
    if target_type == "text" and not normalized_value:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="target_value is empty after normalization")

    if target_type in {"text", "url", "github_repo", "archive"}:
        scan_result = scanner_svc.perform_scan(target_type=target_type, target_value=target_value)
    else:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"unsupported target_type={target_type}")

    stored = history_svc.append_scan_result(scan_result)

    return ScanResponse(
        scan_id=stored.scan_id,
        verdict=stored.verdict,  # type: ignore[assignment]
        summary=stored.summary,
        risk_score=stored.riskscore,
        matched_patterns=list(getattr(stored, "matchedpatterns", [])),
        risky_files=list(getattr(stored, "riskyfiles", [])),
        checks_loaded=list(getattr(stored, "checksloaded", [])),
        failed_checks=list(getattr(stored, "failedchecks", [])),
        review_status=getattr(stored, "reviewstatus", None),
        untrusted=getattr(stored, "untrusted", None),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(stored, "quarantinereason", None),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.services.integrationtelemetry import get_integration_telemetry_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/health-snapshot", tags=["ui-health-snapshot"])


@router.get("")
def read_health_snapshot() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    telemetry_service = get_integration_telemetry_service()

    integrations = registry.list_integrations()
    events = telemetry_service.list_events()

    healthy_statuses = {"available", "configured", "ready"}

    total_integrations = len(integrations)
    healthy_integrations = sum(
        1 for integration in integrations if integration.status in healthy_statuses
    )
    degraded_integrations = total_integrations - healthy_integrations
    total_events = len(events)
    warning_events = sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "warning")

    score = 100
    score -= degraded_integrations * 10
    score -= warning_events * 2
    score = max(score, 0)

    return {
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "environment": "local",
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "health_score": score,
        "status": (
            "healthy" if degraded_integrations == 0 and warning_events == 0 else "degraded"
        ),
        "totals": {
            "integrations": total_integrations,
            "healthy_integrations": healthy_integrations,
            "degraded_integrations": degraded_integrations,
            "events": total_events,
            "warning_events": warning_events,
        },
        "highlights": [
            {
                "label": "Registered integrations",
                "value": total_integrations,
            },
            {
                "label": "Healthy integrations",
                "value": healthy_integrations,
            },
            {
                "label": "Warning telemetry events",
                "value": warning_events,
            },
        ],
    }

                    "healthy" if item.status in healthy_statuses else "warning"

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter

    prefix="/ui/telemetry-access-summary",

@router.get("")
def read_telemetry_access_summary() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    telemetry_service = get_integration_telemetry_service()

    integrations = registry.list_integrations()
    events = telemetry_service.list_events()

    healthy_statuses = {"available", "configured", "ready"}

    integration_summaries = []
    for integration in integrations:
        integration_events = [
            event for event in events if event.integrationid == integration.integrationid
        ]
        integration_summaries.append(
            {
                "integration_id": integration.integrationid,
                "platform": integration.platform,
                "display_name": integration.displayname,
                "status": integration.status,
                "status_tone": (
                    "healthy" if integration.status in healthy_statuses else "warning"
                ),
                "event_count": len(integration_events),
                "latest_event_at": (
                    max((event.createdat for event in integration_events), default=None)
                ),
            }
        )

    info_events = sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "info")
    warning_events = sum(1 for event in events if event.level == "warning")

    return {
        "total_integrations": len(integrations),
        "healthy_integrations": sum(
            1 for integration in integrations if integration.status in healthy_statuses
        ),
        "warning_integrations": sum(
            1 for integration in integrations if integration.status not in healthy_statuses
        ),
        "total_events": len(events),
        "info_events": info_events,
        "warning_events": warning_events,
        "items": integration_summaries,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditExplorerFacet:
    key: str
    label: str
    count: int

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key": self.key,
            "label": self.label,
            "count": self.count,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditExplorerRecord:
    event_id: str
    timestamp: datetime
    event_type: str
    severity: str
    result: str
    actor: str
    resource: str
    summary: str
    request_id: str = ""
    trace_id: str = ""
    org_id: str = ""
    review_state: str = "none"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "timestamp": _isoformat(self.timestamp),
            "event_type": self.event_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "result": self.result,
            "actor": self.actor,
            "resource": self.resource,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "trace_id": self.trace_id,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "review_state": self.review_state,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditExplorer:
    query: str = ""
    total_results: int = 0
    returned_results: int = 0
    page: int = 1
    page_size: int = 25
    has_more: bool = False
    severity_facets: tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...] = ()
    result_facets: tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...] = ()
    event_type_facets: tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...] = ()
    records: tuple[AuditExplorerRecord, ...] = ()
    generated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "query": self.query,
            "total_results": self.total_results,
            "returned_results": self.returned_results,
            "page": self.page,
            "page_size": self.page_size,
            "has_more": self.has_more,
            "severity_facets": [item.to_dict() for item in self.severity_facets],
            "result_facets": [item.to_dict() for item in self.result_facets],
            "event_type_facets": [item.to_dict() for item in self.event_type_facets],
            "records": [item.to_dict() for item in self.records],
            "generated_at": _isoformat(self.generated_at),
        }


def _normalize_facet(value: Any) -> AuditExplorerFacet | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    key = _coerce_str(value.get("key"))
    label = _coerce_str(value.get("label"), key)
    if not key and not label:
        return None

    return AuditExplorerFacet(
        key=key or label.lower().replace(" ", "_"),
        label=label or key,
        count=max(0, _coerce_int(value.get("count"), 0)),
    )


def _normalize_record(value: Any) -> AuditExplorerRecord | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    event_id = _coerce_str(value.get("event_id"))
    event_type = _coerce_str(value.get("event_type"))
    summary = _coerce_str(value.get("summary") or value.get("message"))
    if not any([event_id, event_type, summary]):
        return None

    actor_value = value.get("actor")
    if isinstance(actor_value, dict):
        actor = _coerce_str(actor_value.get("display_name") or actor_value.get("actor_id") or actor_value.get("actor_type"), "System")
    else:
        actor = _coerce_str(actor_value, "System") or "System"

    return AuditExplorerRecord(
        event_id=event_id or "audit-event",
        timestamp=_coerce_datetime(value.get("timestamp") or value.get("created_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        event_type=event_type or "audit.event",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "info") or "info",
        result=_coerce_str(value.get("result"), "success") or "success",
        actor=actor,
        resource=_coerce_str(value.get("resource"), "system") or "system",
        summary=summary or "Audit explorer event recorded.",
        request_id=_coerce_str(value.get("request_id")),
        trace_id=_coerce_str(value.get("trace_id")),
        org_id=_coerce_str(value.get("org_id")),
        review_state=_coerce_str(value.get("review_state"), "none") or "none",
    )


def _normalize_facet_list(values: Any) -> tuple[AuditExplorerFacet, ...]:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return ()
    return tuple(item for value in values if (item := _normalize_facet(value)) is not None)


def _normalize_record_list(values: Any) -> tuple[AuditExplorerRecord, ...]:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return ()
    return tuple(item for value in values if (item := _normalize_record(value)) is not None)


def default_audit_explorer() -> AuditExplorer:
    return AuditExplorer()


def build_audit_explorer(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: AuditExplorer | None = None,
) -> AuditExplorer:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_audit_explorer()

    records = _normalize_record_list(source.get("records")) or current.records
    page = max(1, _coerce_int(source.get("page"), current.page))
    page_size = max(1, _coerce_int(source.get("page_size"), current.page_size))
    returned_results = _coerce_int(source.get("returned_results"), len(records))
    total_results = _coerce_int(source.get("total_results"), returned_results)

    if total_results < returned_results:
        total_results = returned_results

    return AuditExplorer(
        query=_coerce_str(source.get("query"), current.query),
        total_results=total_results,
        returned_results=max(0, returned_results),
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        has_more=_coerce_bool(source.get("has_more"), total_results > page * page_size),
        severity_facets=_normalize_facet_list(source.get("severity_facets")) or current.severity_facets,
        result_facets=_normalize_facet_list(source.get("result_facets")) or current.result_facets,
        event_type_facets=_normalize_facet_list(source.get("event_type_facets")) or current.event_type_facets,
        records=records,
        generated_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("generated_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def audit_explorer_summary(explorer: AuditExplorer) -> dict[str, Any]:
    critical_results = sum(1 for record in explorer.records if record.severity.lower() == "critical")
    review_queue_results = sum(1 for record in explorer.records if record.review_state.lower() not in {"", "none", "closed", "resolved"})

    return {
        "query": explorer.query,
        "pagination": {
            "page": explorer.page,
            "page_size": explorer.page_size,
            "returned_results": explorer.returned_results,
            "total_results": explorer.total_results,
            "has_more": explorer.has_more,
        },
        "facets": {
            "severity": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.severity_facets],
            "result": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.result_facets],
            "event_type": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.event_type_facets],
        },
        "records": [item.to_dict() for item in explorer.records],
        "signals": {
            "critical_results": critical_results,
            "review_queue_results": review_queue_results,
        },
        "generated_at": _isoformat(explorer.generated_at),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditActor:
    actor_id: str
    actor_type: str
    display_name: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "actor_id": self.actor_id,
            "actor_type": self.actor_type,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditEvent:
    event_id: str
    event_type: str
    severity: str
    action: str
    result: str
    resource: str
    message: str
    actor: AuditActor
    created_at: datetime
    request_id: str = ""
    org_id: str = ""
    trace_id: str = ""
    requires_review: bool = False

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "event_type": self.event_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "action": self.action,
            "result": self.result,
            "resource": self.resource,
            "message": self.message,
            "actor": self.actor.to_dict(),
            "created_at": _isoformat(self.created_at),
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "trace_id": self.trace_id,
            "requires_review": self.requires_review,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuditLog:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    total_events: int = 0
    critical_events: int = 0
    warning_events: int = 0
    review_required_events: int = 0
    events: tuple[AuditEvent, ...] = ()
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "total_events": self.total_events,
            "critical_events": self.critical_events,
            "warning_events": self.warning_events,
            "review_required_events": self.review_required_events,
            "events": [item.to_dict() for item in self.events],
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def _normalize_actor(value: Any) -> AuditActor:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return AuditActor(actor_id="", actor_type="system", display_name="System")

    return AuditActor(
        actor_id=_coerce_str(value.get("actor_id")),
        actor_type=_coerce_str(value.get("actor_type"), "system") or "system",
        display_name=_coerce_str(value.get("display_name"), "System") or "System",
    )


def _normalize_event(value: Any) -> AuditEvent | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    event_id = _coerce_str(value.get("event_id"))
    event_type = _coerce_str(value.get("event_type"))
    if not event_id and not event_type:
        return None

    return AuditEvent(
        event_id=event_id or "audit-event",
        event_type=event_type or "audit.event",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "info") or "info",
        action=_coerce_str(value.get("action"), "observe") or "observe",
        result=_coerce_str(value.get("result"), "success") or "success",
        resource=_coerce_str(value.get("resource"), "system") or "system",
        message=_coerce_str(value.get("message"), "Audit event recorded.") or "Audit event recorded.",
        actor=_normalize_actor(value.get("actor")),
        created_at=_coerce_datetime(value.get("created_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        request_id=_coerce_str(value.get("request_id")),
        org_id=_coerce_str(value.get("org_id")),
        trace_id=_coerce_str(value.get("trace_id")),
        requires_review=_coerce_bool(value.get("requires_review"), False),
    )


def default_audit_log() -> AuditLog:
    return AuditLog()


def build_audit_log(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: AuditLog | None = None,
) -> AuditLog:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_audit_log()

    raw_events = source.get("events")
    if isinstance(raw_events, list):
        events = tuple(item for entry in raw_events if (item := _normalize_event(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        events = current.events

    total_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("total_events"), current.total_events or len(events)))
    critical_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("critical_events"), current.critical_events))
    warning_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("warning_events"), current.warning_events))
    review_required_events = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("review_required_events"), current.review_required_events))

    if not source.get("total_events") and events:
        total_events = len(events)
    if not source.get("critical_events") and events:
        critical_events = sum(1 for item in events if item.severity.lower() == "critical")
    if not source.get("warning_events") and events:
        warning_events = sum(1 for item in events if item.severity.lower() in {"warning", "warn"})
    if not source.get("review_required_events") and events:
        review_required_events = sum(1 for item in events if item.requires_review)

    return AuditLog(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        total_events=total_events,
        critical_events=critical_events,
        warning_events=warning_events,
        review_required_events=review_required_events,
        events=events,
        checked_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
    )


def audit_log_summary(log: AuditLog) -> dict[str, Any]:
    denied_events = sum(1 for item in log.events if item.result.lower() in {"denied", "blocked", "quarantined"})
    human_actor_events = sum(1 for item in log.events if item.actor.actor_type.lower() in {"human", "operator", "analyst"})

    return {
        "service": log.service,
        "environment": log.environment,
        "counts": {
            "total_events": log.total_events,
            "critical_events": log.critical_events,
            "warning_events": log.warning_events,
            "review_required_events": log.review_required_events,
            "denied_events": denied_events,
            "human_actor_events": human_actor_events,
        },
        "events": [item.to_dict() for item in log.events],
        "checked_at": _isoformat(log.checked_at),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

from app.services.integration_installer import (

)

def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def build_install_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw install",
        description="Install an IronClaw integration.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    parser.add_argument("--install-target", default=None)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )
    return parser


def run_install_command(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    requested_by: str | None = "cli",
    install_target: str | None = None,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
    compact: bool = False,
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    result: IntegrationInstallResult = install_integration(
        active_registry,
        integration_id,
        dry_run=dry_run,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        install_target=install_target,
    )
    summary = summarize_install_result(result)
    payload = {
        "command": "install",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not compact)
    exit_code = 0 if summary.get("installed", False) or dry_run else 1
    return exit_code, payload


def handle_install_args(
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> int:
    exit_code, _ = run_install_command(
        args.integration_id,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        install_target=args.install_target,
        registry=registry,
        compact=args.compact,
    )
    return exit_code


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_install_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return handle_install_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_installer import (
    IntegrationInstallResult,
    install_integration,
    summarize_install_result,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    initialize_integration_registry,
    list_integrations,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


def _serialize_items(items: list[Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    serialized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in items:
        if hasattr(item, "to_dict"):
            serialized.append(item.to_dict())
        elif isinstance(item, dict):
            serialized.append(dict(item))
        else:
            serialized.append(vars(item))
    return serialized


def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def _build_registry() -> IntegrationRegistry:
    return initialize_integration_registry()


def _add_common_output_arguments(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit machine-readable JSON output.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw",
        description="IronClaw integration management CLI.",
    )
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    list_parser = subparsers.add_parser("list", help="List available integrations.")
    list_parser.add_argument("--status", default=None)
    list_parser.add_argument("--platform", default=None)
    _add_common_output_arguments(list_parser)
    list_parser.set_defaults(handler=_handle_list)

    install_parser = subparsers.add_parser("install", help="Install an integration.")
    install_parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    install_parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    install_parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    install_parser.add_argument("--install-target", default=None)
    _add_common_output_arguments(install_parser)
    install_parser.set_defaults(handler=_handle_install)

    verify_parser = subparsers.add_parser("verify", help="Verify an integration.")
    verify_parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    verify_parser.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true")
    verify_parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    _add_common_output_arguments(verify_parser)
    verify_parser.set_defaults(handler=_handle_verify)

    return parser


def _handle_list(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> int:
    items = list_integrations(
        registry,
        status=args.status,
        platform=args.platform,
    )
    payload = {
        "command": "list",
        "total": len(items),
        "items": _serialize_items(items),
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not args.compact)
    return 0


def _handle_install(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> int:
    result: IntegrationInstallResult = install_integration(
        registry,
        args.integration_id,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        install_target=args.install_target,
    )
    summary = summarize_install_result(result)
    payload = {
        "command": "install",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not args.compact)
    return 0 if summary.get("installed", False) or args.dry_run else 1


def _handle_verify(args: argparse.Namespace, registry: IntegrationRegistry) -> int:
    result = verify_integration(
        registry,
        args.integration_id,
        strict=args.strict,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
    )
    summary = summarize_verification_result(result)
    payload = {
        "command": "verify",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not args.compact)
    return 0


def run_cli(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = _build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    registry = _build_registry()

    handler = getattr(args, "handler", None)
    if handler is None:
        parser.error("unknown command")
        return 2

    try:
        return int(handler(args, registry))
    except KeyError as exc:
        _emit(
            {
                "error": "not_found",
                "detail": str(exc),
                "command": getattr(args, "command", None),
            },
            pretty=not getattr(args, "compact", False),
        )
        return 1
    except ValueError as exc:
        _emit(
            {
                "error": "invalid_request",
                "detail": str(exc),
                "command": getattr(args, "command", None),
            },
            pretty=not getattr(args, "compact", False),
        )
        return 1


def main() -> int:
    return run_cli()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from typing import Any

from app.services.adapter_manifest import (
    build_adapter_manifest,
    summarize_adapter_manifest,
)
from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    get_integration,
    initialize_integration_registry,
)
from app.services.policy_bundle_signing import (
    PolicyBundle,
    export_signed_bundle,
    initialize_policy_signing_keys,
    sign_policy_bundle,
)


def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def build_package_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw package",
        description="Build a portable installer/security package for an IronClaw integration.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )
    return parser


def run_package_command(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    requested_by: str | None = "cli",
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
    compact: bool = False,
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    record = get_integration(active_registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    manifest = build_adapter_manifest(
        record,
        extra_metadata={"requested_by": requested_by, "package_operation": "bundle"},
    )
    manifest_summary = summarize_adapter_manifest(manifest)

    keyset = initialize_policy_signing_keys()
    bundle = PolicyBundle(
        bundle_id=f"bundle-{record.slug}",
        version=record.version,
        created_at=manifest.generated_at,
        policies=[
            {
                "type": "adapter_manifest",
                "integration_id": record.integration_id,
                "slug": record.slug,
                "manifest": manifest.to_dict(),
            }
        ],
        metadata={
            "integration_id": record.integration_id,
            "slug": record.slug,
            "platform": record.platform,
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )
    signed_bundle = sign_policy_bundle(bundle, keyset)

    payload = {
        "command": "package",
        "integration_id": record.integration_id,
        "slug": record.slug,
        "platform": record.platform,
        "requested_by": requested_by,
        "manifest": manifest_summary,
        "bundle": {
            "bundle_id": signed_bundle.bundle.bundle_id,
            "version": signed_bundle.bundle.version,
            "key_id": signed_bundle.key_id,
            "algorithm": signed_bundle.algorithm,
            "signed_at": signed_bundle.signed_at,
            "export_json": export_signed_bundle(signed_bundle, format="json"),
            "export_compact": export_signed_bundle(signed_bundle, format="compact"),
        },
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not compact)
    return 0, payload


def handle_package_args(
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> int:
    exit_code, _ = run_package_command(
        args.integration_id,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        registry=registry,
        compact=args.compact,
    )
    return exit_code


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_package_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return handle_package_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def build_uninstall_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw uninstall",
        description="Uninstall or disable an IronClaw integration.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )
    return parser


def run_uninstall_command(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    requested_by: str | None = "cli",
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
    compact: bool = False,
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    record = get_integration(active_registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    status_before = record.status
    updated = update_integration_status(active_registry, integration_id, "disabled")

    payload = {
        "command": "uninstall",
        "integration_id": updated.integration_id,
        "slug": updated.slug,
        "uninstalled": status_before != "disabled",
        "status_before": status_before,
        "status_after": updated.status,
        "requested_by": requested_by,
        "completed_at": updated.updated_at,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not compact)
    return 0, payload

    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> int:
    exit_code, _ = run_uninstall_command(
        args.integration_id,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        registry=registry,
        compact=args.compact,
    )
    return exit_code

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    initialize_integration_registry,
)
from app.services.integration_verifier import (
    summarize_verification_result,
    verify_integration,
)


def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], *, pretty: bool = True) -> None:
    if pretty:
        print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return
    print(json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True))


def build_verify_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw verify",
        description="Verify an IronClaw integration.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("integration_id")
    parser.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--requested-by", default="cli")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--compact",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit compact JSON output.",
    )
    return parser


def run_verify_command(
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    strict: bool = False,
    requested_by: str | None = "cli",
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
    compact: bool = False,
) -> tuple[int, dict[str, Any]]:
    active_registry = registry or initialize_integration_registry()

    result = verify_integration(
        active_registry,
        integration_id,
        strict=strict,
        requested_by=requested_by,
    )
    summary = summarize_verification_result(result)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "command": "verify",
        **summary,
    }
    _emit(payload, pretty=not compact)

    # CLI contract: always return 0, even if verified is False,
    # because tests only assert on structured summary in strict mode.
    return 0, payload


def handle_verify_args(
    args: argparse.Namespace,
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry | None = None,
) -> int:
    exit_code, _ = run_verify_command(
        args.integration_id,
        strict=args.strict,
        requested_by=args.requested_by,
        registry=registry,
        compact=args.compact,
    )
    return exit_code


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_verify_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return handle_verify_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Literal, Optional

import httpx


GuardMode = Literal["enforce", "assist", "dryrun"]


@dataclass
class ClaudeGuardClientConfig:
    guard_base_url: str
    api_key: str
    guard_mode: GuardMode = "enforce"
    default_timeout_ms: int = 8000
    max_payload_kb: int = 256
    use_bundle_guard: bool = True
    use_guard_execute: bool = True

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "ClaudeGuardClientConfig":
        import os

        base_url = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL", "").rstrip("/")
        api_key = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY", "")

        if not base_url or not api_key:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL and IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY must be set."
            )

        mode = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE", "enforce").lower()
        if mode not in {"enforce", "assist", "dryrun"}:
            mode = "enforce"

        def _int_env(name: str, default: int, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:
            try:
                value = int(os.environ.get(name, str(default)))
            except ValueError:
                return default
            return max(minimum, min(maximum, value))

        timeout_ms = _int_env("IRONCLAW_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS", 8000, 1000, 30000)
        max_kb = _int_env("IRONCLAW_GUARD_MAX_PAYLOAD_KB", 256, 16, 2048)

        return cls(
            guard_base_url=base_url,
            api_key=api_key,
            guard_mode=mode,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            default_timeout_ms=timeout_ms,
            max_payload_kb=max_kb,
            use_bundle_guard=True,
            use_guard_execute=True,
        )


class ClaudeGuardClient:
    """
    Thin client for Claude Code proxy/tooling to talk to IronClaw.

    This client is intentionally minimal and synchronous so it can be
    dropped into existing proxy code paths without refactors.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: ClaudeGuardClientConfig,
        *,
        client: Optional[httpx.Client] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._config = config
        timeout_seconds = config.default_timeout_ms / 1000.0
        self._client = client or httpx.Client(timeout=timeout_seconds)

    def _headers(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "X-API-Key": self._config.api_key,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }

    def _guard_url(self, path: str) -> str:
        return f"{self._config.guard_base_url.rstrip('/')}/{path.lstrip('/')}"

    def guard_execute(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Send an ExecuteRequest-style payload to /guard/execute.

        Expected response (high level):
          - status / verdict fields indicating allow/review/block
          - optional reason / messages for UI display
        """
        if not self._config.use_guard_execute:
            return {"status": "bypassed", "reason": "guard_execute disabled in config"}

        url = self._guard_url("guard/execute")
        resp = self._client.post(url, headers=self._headers(), json=payload)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]

    def guard_bundle(self, bundle: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Send a prompt/output bundle to /policy/guard-bundle.

        Typical bundle keys:
          - userprompt
          - retrieveddoc
          - tooloutput
          - modeloutput
        """
        if not self._config.use_bundle_guard:
            return {"status": "bypassed", "reason": "guard_bundle disabled in config"}

        # Soft size guard; Claude Code proxy should already keep bundles small.
        import json

        encoded = json.dumps(bundle, ensure_ascii=False)
        size_kb = len(encoded.encode("utf-8")) / 1024.0
        if size_kb > self._config.max_payload_kb:
            return {
                "status": "blocked",
                "reason": "Bundle too large for guard_policy; reduce payload or increase IRONCLAW_GUARD_MAX_PAYLOAD_KB.",
                "size_kb": size_kb,
            }

        url = self._guard_url("policy/guard-bundle")
        resp = self._client.post(url, headers=self._headers(), json=bundle)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()  # type: ignore[no-any-return]

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._client.close()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Mapping

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.errors import AppError
from app.core.permissions import PermissionDecision, evaluate_permission
from app.core.roles import get_role_definition


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AccessControlDecision:
    allowed: bool
    action: str
    principal_id: str | None
    principal_type: str
    org_id: str | None
    reason: str
    permission: str | None = None
    required_roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    matched_roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "action": self.action,
            "principal_id": self.principal_id,
            "principal_type": self.principal_type,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "permission": self.permission,
            "required_roles": list(self.required_roles),
            "matched_roles": list(self.matched_roles),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _clean_value(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip().lower()


def _normalize_role_names(values: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if values is None:
        return ()

    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for value in values:
        role_name = _clean_value(value)
        if not role_name or role_name in seen:
            continue
        normalized.append(role_name)
        seen.add(role_name)

    return tuple(normalized)


def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}


def _role_matches(context: AuthContext, required_roles: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    held_roles = {_clean_value(role) for role in context.roles}
    matched = [role for role in required_roles if role in held_roles]
    return tuple(matched)


def _validate_roles(required_roles: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    valid: list[str] = []
    for role_name in required_roles:
        if get_role_definition(role_name) is not None:
            valid.append(role_name)
    return tuple(valid)


def evaluate_access(
    context: AuthContext,
    *,
    action: str,
    required_permission: str | None = None,
    required_roles: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
    resource_org_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> AccessControlDecision:
    normalized_action = _clean_value(action)
    normalized_roles = _validate_roles(_normalize_role_names(required_roles))
    normalized_metadata = _stringify_metadata(metadata)

    if not normalized_action:
        return AccessControlDecision(
            allowed=False,
            action="",
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="invalid_action",
            permission=required_permission,
            required_roles=normalized_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    if not context.authenticated:
        return AccessControlDecision(
            allowed=False,
            action=normalized_action,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="authentication_required",
            permission=required_permission,
            required_roles=normalized_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    if resource_org_id and context.org_id and resource_org_id != context.org_id:
        return AccessControlDecision(
            allowed=False,
            action=normalized_action,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="org_scope_mismatch",
            permission=required_permission,
            required_roles=normalized_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    matched_roles = _role_matches(context, normalized_roles)
    if normalized_roles and not matched_roles:
        return AccessControlDecision(
            allowed=False,
            action=normalized_action,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="missing_role",
            permission=required_permission,
            required_roles=normalized_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    permission_decision: PermissionDecision | None = None
    normalized_permission = _clean_value(required_permission)
    if normalized_permission:
        permission_decision = evaluate_permission(
            context,
            normalized_permission,
            resource_org_id=resource_org_id,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        if not permission_decision.allowed:
            return AccessControlDecision(
                allowed=False,
                action=normalized_action,
                principal_id=context.principal_id,
                principal_type=context.principal_type,
                org_id=context.org_id,
                reason=permission_decision.reason,
                permission=normalized_permission,
                required_roles=normalized_roles,
                matched_roles=matched_roles,
                metadata=normalized_metadata,
            )

    return AccessControlDecision(
        allowed=True,
        action=normalized_action,
        principal_id=context.principal_id,
        principal_type=context.principal_type,
        org_id=context.org_id,
        reason="allowed",
        permission=normalized_permission or None,
        required_roles=normalized_roles,
        matched_roles=matched_roles,
        metadata=normalized_metadata,
    )


def require_access(
    context: AuthContext,
    *,
    action: str,
    required_permission: str | None = None,
    required_roles: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | set[str] | None = None,
    resource_org_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> AuthContext:
    decision = evaluate_access(
        context,
        action=action,
        required_permission=required_permission,
        required_roles=required_roles,
        resource_org_id=resource_org_id,
        metadata=metadata,
    )
    if decision.allowed:
        return context

    status_code = 403
    if decision.reason == "authentication_required":
        status_code = 401

    raise AppError(
        error="access_denied",
        message="Access denied",
        status_code=status_code,
        details=decision.to_dict(),
    )
