from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import RLock
from typing import Any

_API_KEY_PREFIX = "ic_"
_API_KEY_SECRET_BYTES = 24
_DEFAULT_OWNER_KEY = "ironclaw-system"
_DEFAULT_SCOPES = ("system",)
_DEFAULT_RATE_PLAN = "internal"
_DEFAULT_CREATED_BY = "system"


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_metadata(metadata: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(metadata or {})


def _normalize_scopes(scopes: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if not scopes:
        return _DEFAULT_SCOPES
    cleaned = tuple(scope.strip() for scope in scopes if str(scope).strip())
    return cleaned or _DEFAULT_SCOPES


def mask_api_key(api_key: str) -> str:
    if len(api_key) <= 10:
        return "*" * len(api_key)
    return f"{api_key[:6]}...{api_key[-4:]}"


def generate_api_key(prefix: str = _API_KEY_PREFIX) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}{secrets.token_urlsafe(_API_KEY_SECRET_BYTES)}"


def fingerprint_api_key(api_key: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(api_key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def constant_time_api_key_match(provided_key: str, expected_key: str) -> bool:
    return hmac.compare_digest(provided_key, expected_key)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class APIKeyRecord:
    key_id: str
    api_key: str
    masked_key: str
    fingerprint: str
    display_name: str
    owner_key: str = _DEFAULT_OWNER_KEY
    scopes: tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=lambda: _DEFAULT_SCOPES)
    active: bool = True
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=utc_now_iso)
    created_by: str = _DEFAULT_CREATED_BY
    last_used_at: str | None = None
    revoked_at: str | None = None
    revoked_by: str | None = None
    rate_plan: str = _DEFAULT_RATE_PLAN
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def touch(self, when: str | None = None) -> "APIKeyRecord":
        return replace(self, last_used_at=when or utc_now_iso())

    def revoke(self, revoked_by: str = _DEFAULT_CREATED_BY, when: str | None = None) -> "APIKeyRecord":
        timestamp = when or utc_now_iso()
        return replace(
            self,
            active=False,
            revoked_at=timestamp,
            revoked_by=revoked_by,
        )

    def public_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "masked_key": self.masked_key,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "last_used_at": self.last_used_at,
            "active": self.active,
            "owner_key": self.owner_key,
            "scopes": list(self.scopes),
            "rate_plan": self.rate_plan,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class APIKeyRegistry:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = RLock()
        self._records_by_id: dict[str, APIKeyRecord] = {}
        self._key_id_by_secret: dict[str, str] = {}

    def create_key(
        self,
        display_name: str,
        *,
        owner_key: str = _DEFAULT_OWNER_KEY,
        scopes: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        created_by: str = _DEFAULT_CREATED_BY,
        rate_plan: str = _DEFAULT_RATE_PLAN,
        api_key: str | None = None,
        key_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> APIKeyRecord:
        issued_key = api_key or generate_api_key()
        issued_key_id = key_id or self._new_key_id()
        record = APIKeyRecord(
            key_id=issued_key_id,
            api_key=issued_key,
            masked_key=mask_api_key(issued_key),
            fingerprint=fingerprint_api_key(issued_key),
            display_name=display_name.strip(),
            owner_key=owner_key.strip() or _DEFAULT_OWNER_KEY,
            scopes=_normalize_scopes(scopes),
            created_by=created_by.strip() or _DEFAULT_CREATED_BY,
            rate_plan=rate_plan.strip() or _DEFAULT_RATE_PLAN,
            metadata=_normalize_metadata(metadata),
        )
        with self._lock:
            self._records_by_id[record.key_id] = record
            self._key_id_by_secret[record.api_key] = record.key_id
        return record

    def list_keys(self, *, active_only: bool = False) -> list[APIKeyRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._records_by_id.values())
        items.sort(key=lambda item: item.created_at, reverse=True)
        if active_only:
            items = [item for item in items if item.active]
        return items

    def get_by_id(self, key_id: str) -> APIKeyRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._records_by_id.get(key_id)

    def resolve_api_key(self, api_key: str) -> APIKeyRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            key_id = self._key_id_by_secret.get(api_key)
            if not key_id:
                return None
            return self._records_by_id.get(key_id)

    def authenticate(self, api_key: str, *, touch: bool = True) -> APIKeyRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            key_id = self._key_id_by_secret.get(api_key)
            if not key_id:
                return None
            record = self._records_by_id.get(key_id)
            if record is None or not record.active:
                return None
            if not constant_time_api_key_match(api_key, record.api_key):
                return None
            if touch:
                record = record.touch()
                self._records_by_id[key_id] = record
            return record

    def revoke_key(self, key_id: str, *, revoked_by: str = _DEFAULT_CREATED_BY) -> APIKeyRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            record = self._records_by_id.get(key_id)
            if record is None:
                return None
            updated = record if not record.active else record.revoke(revoked_by=revoked_by)
            self._records_by_id[key_id] = updated
            return updated

    def rotate_key(
        self,
        key_id: str,
        *,
        rotated_by: str = _DEFAULT_CREATED_BY,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> APIKeyRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            record = self._records_by_id.get(key_id)
            if record is None:
                return None
            new_secret = generate_api_key()
            updated_metadata = dict(record.metadata)
            updated_metadata.update(_normalize_metadata(metadata))
            updated_metadata["rotated_by"] = rotated_by
            updated_metadata["rotated_from_fingerprint"] = record.fingerprint
            updated = replace(
                record,
                api_key=new_secret,
                masked_key=mask_api_key(new_secret),
                fingerprint=fingerprint_api_key(new_secret),
                active=True,
                revoked_at=None,
                revoked_by=None,
                metadata=updated_metadata,
            )
            self._records_by_id[key_id] = updated
            self._key_id_by_secret.pop(record.api_key, None)
            self._key_id_by_secret[updated.api_key] = key_id
            return updated

    def upsert_record(self, record: APIKeyRecord) -> APIKeyRecord:
        with self._lock:
            existing = self._records_by_id.get(record.key_id)
            if existing and existing.api_key != record.api_key:
                self._key_id_by_secret.pop(existing.api_key, None)
            self._records_by_id[record.key_id] = record
            self._key_id_by_secret[record.api_key] = record.key_id
        return record

    def ensure_default_key(self) -> APIKeyRecord:
        with self._lock:
            for record in self._records_by_id.values():
                if record.display_name == "Default System Key" and record.owner_key == _DEFAULT_OWNER_KEY:
                    return record
        return self.create_key(
            "Default System Key",
            owner_key=_DEFAULT_OWNER_KEY,
            scopes=("system", "admin"),
            metadata={"bootstrap": True},
            created_by="bootstrap",
            rate_plan="internal",
        )

    def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            records = list(self._records_by_id.values())
        active = sum(1 for record in records if record.active)
        revoked = len(records) - active
        return {
            "total": len(records),
            "active": active,
            "revoked": revoked,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _new_key_id() -> str:
        return f"key_{secrets.token_hex(8)}"


_registry = APIKeyRegistry()


def get_api_key_registry() -> APIKeyRegistry:
    return _registry

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from secrets import token_urlsafe
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


API_KEY_PREFIX = "icg1_"
API_KEY_LENGTH_BYTES = 32


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class APIKeyRecord:
    """
    In-memory API key record for a single customer or integration.

    Local-first v1 design:
    - No persistence layer required for initial build/test cycles.
    - Contract is stable enough to later back with Supabase or another DB.
    - Raw key material is only returned at creation/rotation time.
    """

    key_id: str
    display_name: str
    hashed_secret: str
    created_at: datetime
    last_used_at: Optional[datetime] = None
    active: bool = True
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    raw_key: Optional[str] = None


class APIKeyRegistry:
    """
    Simple in-memory API key registry.

    Supports:
    - create/register
    - resolve/last-used tracking
    - deactivate/revoke
    - rotate
    - list/get
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._keys_by_id: Dict[str, APIKeyRecord] = {}
        self._keys_by_secret_hash: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def register_key(
        self,
        display_name: str,
        raw_secret: str,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> APIKeyRecord:
        key_id = self._allocate_key_id()
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        secret_hash = self._hash_secret(raw_secret)

        record = APIKeyRecord(
            key_id=key_id,
            display_name=display_name,
            hashed_secret=secret_hash,
            created_at=now,
            last_used_at=None,
            active=True,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            raw_key=raw_secret,
        )

        self._keys_by_id[key_id] = record
        self._keys_by_secret_hash[secret_hash] = key_id
        return record

    def create_key(
        self,
        display_name: str,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> APIKeyRecord:
        raw_secret = generate_api_key()
        return self.register_key(
            display_name=display_name,
            raw_secret=raw_secret,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def list_keys(self) -> Dict[str, APIKeyRecord]:
        return dict(self._keys_by_id)

    def get_key(self, key_id: str) -> Optional[APIKeyRecord]:
        return self._keys_by_id.get(key_id)

    def deactivate_key(self, key_id: str) -> Optional[APIKeyRecord]:
        record = self._keys_by_id.get(key_id)
        if not record:
            return None

        updated = replace(record, active=False, raw_key=None)
        self._keys_by_id[key_id] = updated
        self._keys_by_secret_hash.pop(record.hashed_secret, None)
        return updated

    def revoke_key(self, key_id: str) -> Optional[APIKeyRecord]:
        return self.deactivate_key(key_id)

    def rotate_key(self, key_id: str) -> Optional[APIKeyRecord]:
        record = self._keys_by_id.get(key_id)
        if not record or not record.active:
            return None

        self._keys_by_secret_hash.pop(record.hashed_secret, None)

        new_raw_key = generate_api_key()
        new_secret_hash = self._hash_secret(new_raw_key)

        updated = APIKeyRecord(
            key_id=record.key_id,
            display_name=record.display_name,
            hashed_secret=new_secret_hash,
            created_at=record.created_at,
            last_used_at=None,
            active=True,
            metadata=dict(record.metadata),
            raw_key=new_raw_key,
        )

        self._keys_by_id[key_id] = updated
        self._keys_by_secret_hash[new_secret_hash] = key_id
        return updated

    def resolve_api_key(self, raw_secret: str) -> Optional[APIKeyRecord]:
        secret_hash = self._hash_secret(raw_secret)
        key_id = self._keys_by_secret_hash.get(secret_hash)
        if not key_id:
            return None

        record = self._keys_by_id.get(key_id)
        if not record or not record.active:
            return None

        if not hmac.compare_digest(record.hashed_secret, secret_hash):
            return None

        updated = APIKeyRecord(
            key_id=record.key_id,
            display_name=record.display_name,
            hashed_secret=record.hashed_secret,
            created_at=record.created_at,
            last_used_at=datetime.now(UTC),
            active=record.active,
            metadata=dict(record.metadata),
            raw_key=None,
        )
        self._keys_by_id[key_id] = updated
        return updated

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self._keys_by_id.clear()
        self._keys_by_secret_hash.clear()
        self._next_id = 1

    def _allocate_key_id(self) -> str:
        key_id = f"key_{self._next_id}"
        self._next_id += 1
        return key_id

    @staticmethod
    def _hash_secret(raw_secret: str) -> str:
        return hashlib.sha256(raw_secret.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def generate_api_key() -> str:
    random_part = token_urlsafe(API_KEY_LENGTH_BYTES)
    return f"{API_KEY_PREFIX}{random_part}"


def mask_api_key(api_key: str) -> str:
    if len(api_key) <= 12:
        return api_key
    prefix = api_key[:8]
    suffix = api_key[-4:]
    return f"{prefix}â€¦{suffix}"


_api_key_registry = APIKeyRegistry()


def get_api_key_registry() -> APIKeyRegistry:
    return _api_key_registry


def create_api_key_registry() -> APIKeyRegistry:
    return APIKeyRegistry()

from __future__ import annotations

import hmac
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Optional

from fastapi import Depends, Request, status
from fastapi.security import APIKeyHeader

from app.core.apikeys import APIKeyRecord, get_api_key_registry
from app.core.errors import AppError


API_KEY_HEADER_NAME = "X-API-Key"
SESSION_ID_HEADER_NAME = "X-Session-Id"
ORG_ID_HEADER_NAME = "X-Org-Id"

api_key_header = APIKeyHeader(name=API_KEY_HEADER_NAME, auto_error=False)
session_id_header = APIKeyHeader(name=SESSION_ID_HEADER_NAME, auto_error=False)
org_id_header = APIKeyHeader(name=ORG_ID_HEADER_NAME, auto_error=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AuthContext:
    api_key: Optional[str]
    principal_type: str
    principal_id: Optional[str]
    session_id: Optional[str]
    org_id: Optional[str]
    permissions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    authenticated: bool = False
    auth_source: str = "none"
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)


def _get_settings(request: Request) -> Any | None:
    return getattr(request.app.state, "settings", None)


def _clean_optional_string(value: object) -> Optional[str]:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return None
    value = value.strip()
    return value or None


def _extract_configured_api_key(request: Request) -> Optional[str]:
    settings = _get_settings(request)
    if settings is None:
        return None

    for attr_name in (
        "internal_platform_api_key",
        "platform_api_key",
        "admin_api_key",
        "api_key",
    ):
        value = _clean_optional_string(getattr(settings, attr_name, None))
        if value is not None:
            return value

    return _clean_optional_string(
        getattr(settings, "effective_platform_api_key", None)
    )


def _touch_record_if_possible(record: APIKeyRecord) -> APIKeyRecord:
    touch = getattr(record, "touch", None)
    if not callable(touch):
        return record

    try:
        updated = touch()
    except Exception:
        return record

    if updated is None:
        return record

    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    updater = getattr(registry, "upsert_record", None)
    if callable(updater):
        try:
            updater(updated)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return updated


def _resolve_registry_api_key(provided_api_key: str) -> Optional[APIKeyRecord]:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()

    authenticate = getattr(registry, "authenticate", None)
    if callable(authenticate):
        try:
            record = authenticate(provided_api_key, touch=True)
            if record is not None:
                return record
        except TypeError:
            try:
                record = authenticate(provided_api_key)
                if record is not None:
                    return _touch_record_if_possible(record)
            except Exception:
                pass
        except Exception:
            pass

    for attr_name in (
        "resolve_api_key",
        "get_by_raw_key",
        "get_by_api_key",
        "find_by_api_key",
    ):
        resolver = getattr(registry, attr_name, None)
        if callable(resolver):
            try:
                record = resolver(provided_api_key)
                if record is not None:
                    return _touch_record_if_possible(record)
            except Exception:
                pass

    for attr_name in (
        "_key_id_by_secret",
        "key_id_by_secret",
    ):
        mapping = getattr(registry, attr_name, None)
        if mapping is not None:
            try:
                key_id = mapping.get(provided_api_key)
            except Exception:
                key_id = None
            if key_id:
                getter = getattr(registry, "get_by_id", None)
                if callable(getter):
                    try:
                        record = getter(key_id)
                        if record is not None:
                            return _touch_record_if_possible(record)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                records_by_id = getattr(registry, "_records_by_id", None) or getattr(
                    registry, "keys_by_id", None
                )
                if records_by_id is not None:
                    try:
                        record = records_by_id.get(key_id)
                        if record is not None:
                            return _touch_record_if_possible(record)
                    except Exception:
                        pass

    for attr_name in (
        "_records_by_id",
        "keys_by_id",
        "_keys_by_id",
    ):
        records = getattr(registry, attr_name, None)
        if records is not None:
            try:
                iterable = records.values()
            except Exception:
                iterable = ()
            for record in iterable:
                raw_key = getattr(record, "raw_key", None)
                api_key = getattr(record, "api_key", None)
                if provided_api_key == raw_key or provided_api_key == api_key:
                    return _touch_record_if_possible(record)

    return None


def _has_registry_keys() -> bool:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()

    summary = getattr(registry, "summary", None)
    if callable(summary):
        try:
            data = summary()
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                return int(data.get("total", 0)) > 0
        except Exception:
            pass

    for attr_name in (
        "has_keys",
        "has_api_keys",
        "has_active_keys",
    ):
        method = getattr(registry, attr_name, None)
        if callable(method):
            try:
                return bool(method())
            except TypeError:
                pass

    list_keys = getattr(registry, "list_keys", None)
    if callable(list_keys):
        try:
            return bool(list_keys())
        except TypeError:
            try:
                return bool(list_keys(active_only=False))
            except Exception:
                pass

    for attr_name in (
        "keys_by_id",
        "_keys_by_id",
        "_records_by_id",
    ):
        value = getattr(registry, attr_name, None)
        if value is not None:
            try:
                return bool(value)
            except TypeError:
                return True

    return False


def _is_auth_required(request: Request) -> bool:
    settings = _get_settings(request)
    if settings is None:
        return False

    explicit_flag = getattr(settings, "auth_required", None)
    if explicit_flag is not None:
        return bool(explicit_flag)

    if _extract_configured_api_key(request) is not None:
        return True

    return _has_registry_keys()


def _constant_time_match(left: Optional[str], right: Optional[str]) -> bool:
    if not left or not right:
        return False
    return hmac.compare_digest(left, right)


def _coerce_roles(record: APIKeyRecord | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if record is None:
        return ()

    for attr_name in ("roles", "role_names", "grants"):
        value = getattr(record, attr_name, None)
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            return tuple(str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip())

    role = getattr(record, "role", None)
    role_text = _clean_optional_string(role)
    return (role_text,) if role_text else ()


def _coerce_permissions(record: APIKeyRecord | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if record is None:
        return ()

    for attr_name in ("permissions", "scopes", "allowed_actions"):
        value = getattr(record, attr_name, None)
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            return tuple(str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip())

    return ()


def _coerce_principal_id(record: APIKeyRecord | None) -> Optional[str]:
    if record is None:
        return None

    for attr_name in ("key_id", "id", "client_id", "owner_id", "principal_id"):
        value = _clean_optional_string(getattr(record, attr_name, None))
        if value is not None:
            return value

    return None


def _coerce_org_id(
    request: Request,
    provided_org_id: Optional[str],
    record: APIKeyRecord | None,
) -> Optional[str]:
    header_org_id = _clean_optional_string(provided_org_id)
    if header_org_id is not None:
        return header_org_id

    if record is not None:
        for attr_name in ("org_id", "organization_id", "tenant_id"):
            value = _clean_optional_string(getattr(record, attr_name, None))
            if value is not None:
                return value

    settings = _get_settings(request)
    if settings is not None:
        for attr_name in ("org_id", "organization_id", "default_org_id"):
            value = _clean_optional_string(getattr(settings, attr_name, None))
            if value is not None:
                return value

    return None


def get_api_key(
    request: Request,
    provided_api_key: Optional[str] = Depends(api_key_header),
) -> Optional[str]:
    normalized_api_key = _clean_optional_string(provided_api_key)

    if not _is_auth_required(request):
        return normalized_api_key

    configured_api_key = _extract_configured_api_key(request)
    has_registry_keys = _has_registry_keys()

    if configured_api_key is None and not has_registry_keys:
        raise AppError(
            error="auth_not_configured",
            message="API authentication is enabled but no API key is configured",
            status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
        )

    if normalized_api_key is None:
        raise AppError(
            error="missing_api_key",
            message="Missing API key",
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            details={"header": API_KEY_HEADER_NAME},
        )

    if _constant_time_match(configured_api_key, normalized_api_key):
        return normalized_api_key

    registry_record = _resolve_registry_api_key(normalized_api_key)
    if registry_record is not None and getattr(registry_record, "active", True):
        return normalized_api_key

    raise AppError(
        error="invalid_api_key",
        message="Invalid API key",
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        details={"header": API_KEY_HEADER_NAME},
    )


def get_auth_context(
    request: Request,
    api_key: Optional[str] = Depends(get_api_key),
    session_id: Optional[str] = Depends(session_id_header),
    provided_org_id: Optional[str] = Depends(org_id_header),
) -> AuthContext:
    normalized_session_id = _clean_optional_string(session_id)

    if not _is_auth_required(request):
        return AuthContext(
            api_key=api_key,
            principal_type="anonymous",
            principal_id=None,
            session_id=normalized_session_id,
            org_id=_clean_optional_string(provided_org_id),
            authenticated=False,
            auth_source="disabled",
        )

    if not api_key:
        raise AppError(
            error="missing_api_key",
            message="Missing API key",
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            details={"header": API_KEY_HEADER_NAME},
        )

    registry_record = _resolve_registry_api_key(api_key)
    principal_type = "platform"
    auth_source = "configured"

    if registry_record is not None:
        principal_type = "api_key"
        auth_source = "registry"

    return AuthContext(
        api_key=api_key,
        principal_type=principal_type,
        principal_id=_coerce_principal_id(registry_record),
        session_id=normalized_session_id,
        org_id=_coerce_org_id(request, provided_org_id, registry_record),
        permissions=_coerce_permissions(registry_record),
        roles=_coerce_roles(registry_record),
        authenticated=True,
        auth_source=auth_source,
        metadata={
            "header": API_KEY_HEADER_NAME,
        },
    )


def require_api_key(
    request: Request,
    api_key: Optional[str] = Depends(get_api_key),
) -> Optional[str]:
    if not _is_auth_required(request):
        return api_key

    if not api_key:
        raise AppError(
            error="missing_api_key",
            message="Missing API key",
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            details={"header": API_KEY_HEADER_NAME},
        )

    return api_key


def require_auth_context(
    context: AuthContext = Depends(get_auth_context),
) -> AuthContext:
    if not context.authenticated:
        raise AppError(
            error="authentication_required",
            message="Authentication required",
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            details={"header": API_KEY_HEADER_NAME},
        )
    return context

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Final, Literal, TypedDict


PlanCode = Literal["starter-20k", "growth-100k", "scale-200k"]


class PlanDefinition(TypedDict):
    code: PlanCode
    name: str
    unit_limit: int
    price_usd: int


PLAN_DEFINITIONS: Final[dict[PlanCode, PlanDefinition]] = {
    "starter-20k": {
        "code": "starter-20k",
        "name": "Starter 20k",
        "unit_limit": 20_000,
        "price_usd": 20,
    },
    "growth-100k": {
        "code": "growth-100k",
        "name": "Growth 100k",
        "unit_limit": 100_000,
        "price_usd": 90,
    },
    "scale-200k": {
        "code": "scale-200k",
        "name": "Scale 200k",
        "unit_limit": 200_000,
        "price_usd": 150,
    },
}


@dataclass
class BillingCustomer:
    customer_id: str
    email: str
    display_name: str
    plan: PlanCode
    active: bool = True
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class BillingSubscription:
    subscription_id: str
    customer_id: str
    plan: PlanCode
    status: str
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
    current_period_start: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
    current_period_end: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
    units_consumed: int = 0
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def plan_definition(self) -> PlanDefinition:
        return PLAN_DEFINITIONS[self.plan]

    @property
    def unit_limit(self) -> int:
        return self.plan_definition["unit_limit"]

    @property
    def remaining_units(self) -> int:
        return max(self.unit_limit - self.units_consumed, 0)

    @property
    def is_active(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == "active" and self.remaining_units > 0


class BillingRegistry:
    """
    Local-first billing foundation for fast revenue experiments.

    This keeps the public contract simple so we can later swap in Stripe
    without changing route payloads or dashboard expectations.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._customers: dict[str, BillingCustomer] = {}
        self._subscriptions: dict[str, BillingSubscription] = {}

    def _require_valid_plan(self, plan: str) -> PlanCode:
        plan_code = plan.strip()
        if plan_code not in PLAN_DEFINITIONS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown plan code: {plan_code}")
        return plan_code  # type: ignore[return-value]

    def create_customer(
        self,
        *,
        email: str,
        display_name: str,
        plan: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> BillingCustomer:
        with self._lock:
            plan_code = self._require_valid_plan(plan)
            customer_id = f"cus_{len(self._customers) + 1}"
            customer = BillingCustomer(
                customer_id=customer_id,
                email=email.strip().lower(),
                display_name=display_name.strip(),
                plan=plan_code,
                metadata=metadata or {},
            )
            self._customers[customer_id] = customer
            return customer

    def list_customers(self) -> list[BillingCustomer]:
        with self._lock:
            return list(self._customers.values())

    def get_customer(self, customer_id: str) -> BillingCustomer | None:
        with self._lock:
            return self._customers.get(customer_id)

    def create_subscription(
        self,
        *,
        customer_id: str,
        plan: str,
        status: str = "active",
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> BillingSubscription:
        with self._lock:
            if customer_id not in self._customers:
                raise KeyError(f"Unknown customer_id: {customer_id}")

            plan_code = self._require_valid_plan(plan)
            subscription_id = f"sub_{len(self._subscriptions) + 1}"
            now = datetime.now(UTC)
            subscription = BillingSubscription(
                subscription_id=subscription_id,
                customer_id=customer_id,
                plan=plan_code,
                status=status,
                created_at=now,
                current_period_start=now,
                current_period_end=now,
                units_consumed=0,
                metadata=metadata or {},
            )
            self._subscriptions[subscription_id] = subscription
            return subscription

    def list_subscriptions(self) -> list[BillingSubscription]:
        with self._lock:
            return list(self._subscriptions.values())

    def get_active_subscription_for_customer(
        self,
        customer_id: str,
    ) -> BillingSubscription | None:
        with self._lock:
            for sub in self._subscriptions.values():
                if sub.customer_id == customer_id and sub.is_active:
                    return sub
            return None

    def record_usage(
        self,
        *,
        customer_id: str,
        units: int,
    ) -> BillingSubscription:
        """
        Record usage units for a customer.

        Raises:
            KeyError: if no active subscription exists.
            ValueError: if usage would exceed the subscription's unit limit.
        """
        if units <= 0:
            raise ValueError("units must be positive")

        with self._lock:
            subscription = self.get_active_subscription_for_customer(customer_id)
            if subscription is None:
                raise KeyError(f"No active subscription for customer_id={customer_id}")

            if subscription.units_consumed + units > subscription.unit_limit:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Usage would exceed plan limit: "
                    f"{subscription.units_consumed + units} > {subscription.unit_limit}"
                )

            subscription.units_consumed += units
            return subscription

    def can_consume(
        self,
        *,
        customer_id: str,
        units: int,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Check if a customer can consume the requested units under current plan.
        """
        if units <= 0:
            return False

        with self._lock:
            subscription = self.get_active_subscription_for_customer(customer_id)
            if subscription is None:
                return False
            return subscription.units_consumed + units <= subscription.unit_limit


_billing_registry = BillingRegistry()


def get_billing_registry() -> BillingRegistry:
    return _billing_registry

from __future__ import annotations


import logging
from typing import Any, Mapping, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request, status
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.logging import get_logger, get_request_id


class ErrorResponse(BaseModel):
    error: str
    message: str
    request_id: Optional[str] = None
    details: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class AppError(Exception):
    def __init__(
        self,
        error: str,
        message: str,
        *,
        status_code: int = status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
        details: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
        log_level: int = logging.WARNING,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.error = error
        self.message = message
        self.status_code = int(status_code)
        self.details = dict(details or {})
        self.log_level = int(log_level)


class NotFoundError(AppError):
    def __init__(self, message: str = "Resource not found", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            error="not_found",
            message=message,
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            **kwargs,
        )


class ConflictError(AppError):
    def __init__(self, message: str = "Conflict detected", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            error="conflict",
            message=message,
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            **kwargs,
        )


class GuardRejectedError(AppError):
    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str = "Action blocked by security guard",
        *,
        details: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            error="guard_rejected",
            message=message,
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            details=details,
            **kwargs,
        )


def _request_id_from_request(request: Request) -> Optional[str]:
    request_state_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    if isinstance(request_state_id, str) and request_state_id.strip():
        return request_state_id.strip()
    global_request_id = get_request_id()
    if isinstance(global_request_id, str) and global_request_id.strip():
        return global_request_id.strip()
    return None


def build_error_response(
    *,
    error: str,
    message: str,
    request_id: Optional[str] = None,
    details: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
) -> ErrorResponse:
    return ErrorResponse(
        error=error,
        message=message,
        request_id=request_id or get_request_id() or None,
        details=dict(details or {}),
    )


def _log_exception(
    logger: logging.Logger,
    *,
    level: int,
    event: str,
    request: Request,
    status_code: int,
    message: str,
    error: str,
    details: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    exc_info: bool = False,
) -> None:
    logger.log(
        level,
        message,
        extra={
            "event": event,
            "error": error,
            "status_code": int(status_code),
            "path": request.url.path,
            "http_method": request.method,
            "request_id": _request_id_from_request(request),
            "details": dict(details or {}),
        },
        exc_info=exc_info,
    )


async def app_error_handler(request: Request, exc: AppError) -> JSONResponse:
    logger = get_logger("ironclaw.errors")
    _log_exception(
        logger,
        level=exc.log_level,
        event="app_error",
        request=request,
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        message=exc.message,
        error=exc.error,
        details=exc.details,
    )
    payload = build_error_response(
        error=exc.error,
        message=exc.message,
        request_id=_request_id_from_request(request),
        details=exc.details,
    )
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content=payload.model_dump())


async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException) -> JSONResponse:
    logger = get_logger("ironclaw.errors")

    if isinstance(exc.detail, str):
        message = exc.detail
        details: dict[str, Any] = {}
    elif isinstance(exc.detail, Mapping):
        details = dict(exc.detail)
        message = str(details.get("message") or "Request failed")
    else:
        message = "Request failed"
        details = {}

    _log_exception(
        logger,
        level=logging.WARNING,
        event="http_exception",
        request=request,
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        message=message,
        error="http_error",
        details=details,
    )
    payload = build_error_response(
        error="http_error",
        message=message,
        request_id=_request_id_from_request(request),
        details=details,
    )
    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.status_code, content=payload.model_dump())


async def validation_exception_handler(
    request: Request,
    exc: RequestValidationError,
) -> JSONResponse:
    logger = get_logger("ironclaw.errors")
    details = {"errors": exc.errors()}
    _log_exception(
        logger,
        level=logging.WARNING,
        event="validation_error",
        request=request,
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
        message="Request validation failed",
        error="validation_error",
        details=details,
    )
    payload = build_error_response(
        error="validation_error",
        message="Request validation failed",
        request_id=_request_id_from_request(request),
        details=details,
    )
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
        content=payload.model_dump(),
    )


async def unhandled_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> JSONResponse:
    logger = get_logger("ironclaw.errors")
    _log_exception(
        logger,
        level=logging.ERROR,
        event="unhandled_exception",
        request=request,
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        message="Internal server error",
        error="internal_error",
        details={},
        exc_info=True,
    )
    payload = build_error_response(
        error="internal_error",
        message="Internal server error",
        request_id=_request_id_from_request(request),
    )
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        content=payload.model_dump(),
    )


def register_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    app.add_exception_handler(AppError, app_error_handler)
    app.add_exception_handler(HTTPException, http_exception_handler)
    app.add_exception_handler(RequestValidationError, validation_exception_handler)
    app.add_exception_handler(Exception, unhandled_exception_handler)

from __future__ import annotations


from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from app.core.errors import AppError


def _build_error_payload(
    request: Request,
    *,
    error: str,
    message: str,
    details,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "error": error,
        "message": message,
        "details": details,
        "path": request.url.path,
    }
    if request_id:
        payload["request_id"] = request_id
    return payload


async def app_error_handler(request: Request, exc: AppError) -> JSONResponse:
    status_code = int(getattr(exc, "status_code", 500) or 500)
    payload = _build_error_payload(
        request,
        error=getattr(exc, "error", "application_error"),
        message=str(exc),
        details=getattr(exc, "details", None),
    )
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status_code,
        content=jsonable_encoder(payload),
    )


async def validation_error_handler(
    request: Request,
    exc: RequestValidationError,
) -> JSONResponse:
    payload = _build_error_payload(
        request,
        error="validation_error",
        message="Request validation failed",
        details=exc.errors(),
    )
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=422,
        content=jsonable_encoder(payload),
    )


def install_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    app.add_exception_handler(AppError, app_error_handler)
    app.add_exception_handler(RequestValidationError, validation_error_handler)

from __future__ import annotations

import contextvars
import json
import logging
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Mapping, MutableMapping, Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.responses import Response

from app.core.request_id import REQUEST_ID_HEADER_NAME
from app.core.settings import Settings


request_id_context: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar(
    "request_id",
    default="",
)


def get_request_id() -> str:
    return request_id_context.get()


class RequestContextFilter(logging.Filter):
    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
        record.request_id = get_request_id() or None
        return True


class JsonFormatter(logging.Formatter):
    def format(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> str:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "timestamp": datetime.fromtimestamp(record.created, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "level": record.levelname,
            "logger": record.name,
            "message": record.getMessage(),
            "request_id": getattr(record, "request_id", None),
        }

        extra_fields = _extract_extra_fields(record)
        if extra_fields:
            payload.update(extra_fields)

        if record.exc_info:
            payload["exception"] = self.formatException(record.exc_info)

        return json.dumps(payload, default=str, ensure_ascii=False)


def _extract_extra_fields(record: logging.LogRecord) -> dict[str, Any]:
    standard_fields = {
        "name",
        "msg",
        "args",
        "levelname",
        "levelno",
        "pathname",
        "filename",
        "module",
        "exc_info",
        "exc_text",
        "stack_info",
        "lineno",
        "funcName",
        "created",
        "msecs",
        "relativeCreated",
        "thread",
        "threadName",
        "processName",
        "process",
        "message",
        "asctime",
        "request_id",
    }
    return {
        key: value
        for key, value in record.__dict__.items()
        if key not in standard_fields and not key.startswith("_")
    }


def configure_logging(settings: Settings) -> None:
    root_logger = logging.getLogger()
    root_logger.handlers.clear()

    handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
    handler.addFilter(RequestContextFilter())

    if settings.structured_logging_enabled:
        handler.setFormatter(JsonFormatter())
    else:
        handler.setFormatter(
            logging.Formatter(
                "%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s [request_id=%(request_id)s] %(message)s"
            )
        )

    root_logger.addHandler(handler)
    root_logger.setLevel(settings.log_level)
    root_logger.propagate = False

    for logger_name in ("uvicorn", "uvicorn.error", "uvicorn.access", "fastapi"):
        logger = logging.getLogger(logger_name)
        logger.handlers.clear()
        logger.propagate = True
        logger.setLevel(settings.log_level)


def get_logger(name: str = "ironclaw") -> logging.Logger:
    return logging.getLogger(name)


class RequestContextMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    def __init__(self, app: FastAPI, logger_name: str = "ironclaw.access") -> None:
        super().__init__(app)
        self.logger = get_logger(logger_name)

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next) -> Response:
        request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None) or request.headers.get(
            REQUEST_ID_HEADER_NAME
        )
        if not request_id:
            request_id = "unknown-request-id"

        token = request_id_context.set(str(request_id))
        start = time.perf_counter()

        request.state.request_id = request_id
        client_ip = request.client.host if request.client else None

        self.logger.info(
            "request_started",
            extra={
                "event": "request_started",
                "http_method": request.method,
                "path": request.url.path,
                "query": str(request.url.query) if request.url.query else "",
                "client_ip": client_ip,
            },
        )

        try:
            response = await call_next(request)
        except Exception as exc:
            duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2)
            self.logger.exception(
                "request_failed",
                extra={
                    "event": "request_failed",
                    "http_method": request.method,
                    "path": request.url.path,
                    "client_ip": client_ip,
                    "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                    "error_type": exc.__class__.__name__,
                },
            )
            request_id_context.reset(token)
            raise

        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2)
        response.headers[REQUEST_ID_HEADER_NAME] = str(request_id)

        self.logger.info(
            "request_completed",
            extra={
                "event": "request_completed",
                "http_method": request.method,
                "path": request.url.path,
                "client_ip": client_ip,
                "status_code": response.status_code,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            },
        )

        request_id_context.reset(token)
        return response


def bind_security_event(
    logger: logging.Logger,
    event: str,
    *,
    scan_id: Optional[str] = None,
    verdict: Optional[str] = None,
    risk_score: Optional[int] = None,
    target_type: Optional[str] = None,
    target_value: Optional[str] = None,
    action_type: Optional[str] = None,
    review_status: Optional[str] = None,
    matched_patterns: Optional[list[str]] = None,
    extra_metadata: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
    level: int = logging.INFO,
) -> None:
    payload: MutableMapping[str, Any] = {
        "event": event,
        "scan_id": scan_id,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "risk_score": risk_score,
        "target_type": target_type,
        "target_value": _truncate_value(target_value),
        "action_type": action_type,
        "review_status": review_status,
        "matched_patterns": matched_patterns or [],
    }

    if extra_metadata:
        payload.update(dict(extra_metadata))

    logger.log(level, event, extra=dict(payload))


def _truncate_value(value: Optional[str], limit: int = 500) -> Optional[str]:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if len(value) <= limit:
        return value
    return f"{value[:limit]}...[truncated]"

from __future__ import annotations


from time import perf_counter

from fastapi import Request
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.responses import Response

from app.core.api_keys import get_api_key_registry
from app.core.auth import API_KEY_HEADER_NAME
from app.core.usage_metering import get_usage_metering_registry


def _resolve_api_key_record(raw_api_key: str):
    registry = get_api_key_registry()

    resolver = getattr(registry, "resolve_api_key", None)
    if callable(resolver):
        try:
            record = resolver(raw_api_key)
            if record is not None:
                return record
        except Exception:
            pass

    authenticate = getattr(registry, "authenticate", None)
    if callable(authenticate):
        try:
            record = authenticate(raw_api_key, touch=False)
            if record is not None:
                return record
        except TypeError:
            try:
                record = authenticate(raw_api_key)
                if record is not None:
                    return record
            except Exception:
                pass
        except Exception:
            pass

    return None


def _resolve_route_path(request: Request) -> str:
    route = request.scope.get("route")
    route_path = getattr(route, "path", None)
    if isinstance(route_path, str) and route_path.strip():
        return route_path
    return request.url.path


def _resolve_units(request: Request) -> int:
    path = request.url.path
    if path.startswith("/guard"):
        return 5
    if path.startswith("/scan"):
        return 2
    return 1


class UsageMeteringMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    """
    Middleware that records lightweight per-request usage events.

    Design goals:
    - No hard dependency on auth success.
    - Only meter requests that present a known API key.
    - Keep event payload compact and stable for future billing pipelines.
    """

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next) -> Response:
        started_at = perf_counter()
        response = await call_next(request)
        duration_ms = round((perf_counter() - started_at) * 1000, 3)

        raw_api_key = request.headers.get(API_KEY_HEADER_NAME)
        if not isinstance(raw_api_key, str):
            return response

        raw_api_key = raw_api_key.strip()
        if not raw_api_key:
            return response

        record = _resolve_api_key_record(raw_api_key)
        if record is None or not getattr(record, "active", True):
            return response

        key_id = getattr(record, "key_id", None)
        if not key_id:
            return response

        request_id = getattr(request.state, "request_id", None)

        get_usage_metering_registry().record_event(
            api_key_id=key_id,
            route=_resolve_route_path(request),
            method=request.method,
            status_code=response.status_code,
            units=_resolve_units(request),
            metadata={
                "path": request.url.path,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "request_id": request_id,
            },
        )

        return response

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Iterable, Mapping

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.errors import AppError


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrgIsolationDecision:
    allowed: bool
    principal_id: str | None
    principal_type: str
    actor_org_id: str | None
    target_org_id: str | None
    reason: str
    bypass_roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    matched_roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "principal_id": self.principal_id,
            "principal_type": self.principal_type,
            "actor_org_id": self.actor_org_id,
            "target_org_id": self.target_org_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "bypass_roles": list(self.bypass_roles),
            "matched_roles": list(self.matched_roles),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


DEFAULT_BYPASS_ROLES: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "platform_admin",
    "system_admin",
    "operator_admin",
)


def _clean(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip()


def _clean_lower(value: object) -> str:
    return _clean(value).lower()


def _normalize_roles(values: Iterable[object] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if values is None:
        return ()

    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for value in values:
        role_name = _clean_lower(value)
        if not role_name or role_name in seen:
            continue
        normalized.append(role_name)
        seen.add(role_name)

    return tuple(normalized)


def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}


def _matched_bypass_roles(
    context: AuthContext,
    bypass_roles: tuple[str, ...],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    held_roles = set(_normalize_roles(context.roles))
    return tuple(role for role in bypass_roles if role in held_roles)


def org_ids_match(left_org_id: str | None, right_org_id: str | None) -> bool:
    left = _clean(left_org_id)
    right = _clean(right_org_id)
    return bool(left and right and left == right)


def evaluate_org_isolation(
    context: AuthContext,
    *,
    target_org_id: str | None,
    bypass_roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> OrgIsolationDecision:
    normalized_target_org_id = _clean(target_org_id) or None
    normalized_actor_org_id = _clean(context.org_id) or None
    normalized_bypass_roles = _normalize_roles(bypass_roles) or DEFAULT_BYPASS_ROLES
    normalized_metadata = _stringify_metadata(metadata)

    if not context.authenticated:
        return OrgIsolationDecision(
            allowed=False,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            actor_org_id=normalized_actor_org_id,
            target_org_id=normalized_target_org_id,
            reason="authentication_required",
            bypass_roles=normalized_bypass_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    matched_roles = _matched_bypass_roles(context, normalized_bypass_roles)
    if matched_roles:
        return OrgIsolationDecision(
            allowed=True,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            actor_org_id=normalized_actor_org_id,
            target_org_id=normalized_target_org_id,
            reason="bypass_role",
            bypass_roles=normalized_bypass_roles,
            matched_roles=matched_roles,
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    if normalized_target_org_id is None:
        return OrgIsolationDecision(
            allowed=False,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            actor_org_id=normalized_actor_org_id,
            target_org_id=None,
            reason="target_org_required",
            bypass_roles=normalized_bypass_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    if normalized_actor_org_id is None:
        return OrgIsolationDecision(
            allowed=False,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            actor_org_id=None,
            target_org_id=normalized_target_org_id,
            reason="actor_org_required",
            bypass_roles=normalized_bypass_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    if normalized_actor_org_id != normalized_target_org_id:
        return OrgIsolationDecision(
            allowed=False,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            actor_org_id=normalized_actor_org_id,
            target_org_id=normalized_target_org_id,
            reason="org_isolation_violation",
            bypass_roles=normalized_bypass_roles,
            matched_roles=(),
            metadata=normalized_metadata,
        )

    return OrgIsolationDecision(
        allowed=True,
        principal_id=context.principal_id,
        principal_type=context.principal_type,
        actor_org_id=normalized_actor_org_id,
        target_org_id=normalized_target_org_id,
        reason="org_match",
        bypass_roles=normalized_bypass_roles,
        matched_roles=(),
        metadata=normalized_metadata,
    )


def require_same_org(
    context: AuthContext,
    *,
    target_org_id: str | None,
    bypass_roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Iterable, Mapping

from app.core.auth import AuthContext
from app.core.errors import AppError


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PermissionDecision:
    allowed: bool
    permission: str
    principal_id: str | None
    principal_type: str
    org_id: str | None
    reason: str
    matched_permissions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    matched_roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "permission": self.permission,
            "principal_id": self.principal_id,
            "principal_type": self.principal_type,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "matched_permissions": list(self.matched_permissions),
            "matched_roles": list(self.matched_roles),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


ROLE_PERMISSIONS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "platform_admin": (
        "*",
    ),
    "system_admin": (
        "*",
    ),
    "operator_admin": (
        "operator:read",
        "operator:write",
        "operator:manage",
        "customer:read",
        "org:read",
        "org:write",
        "org:isolate",
        "session:read",
        "session:write",
        "session:revoke",
        "permissions:read",
        "permissions:write",
    ),
    "operator_analyst": (
        "operator:read",
        "customer:read",
        "org:read",
        "session:read",
        "permissions:read",
    ),
    "customer_admin": (
        "customer:read",
        "customer:write",
        "org:read",
        "session:read",
        "session:write",
        "permissions:read",
    ),
    "customer_user": (
        "customer:read",

        "session:read",

    "auditor": (
        "operator:read",

        "org:read",
        "session:read",
        "permissions:read",
    ),
    "service": (
        "system:read",
        "system:write",
        "session:read",
        "permissions:read",
    ),
}


def _clean_permission(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip().lower()


def _normalize_permissions(values: Iterable[object] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if values is None:
        return ()
    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for value in values:
        permission = _clean_permission(value)
        if permission and permission not in seen:
            normalized.append(permission)
            seen.add(permission)
    return tuple(normalized)


def _normalize_roles(values: Iterable[object] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if values is None:
        return ()
    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for value in values:
        role = _clean_permission(value)
        if role and role not in seen:
            normalized.append(role)
            seen.add(role)
    return tuple(normalized)


def expand_role_permissions(roles: Iterable[object] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    expanded: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for role in _normalize_roles(roles):
        for permission in ROLE_PERMISSIONS.get(role, ()):
            if permission not in seen:
                expanded.append(permission)
                seen.add(permission)

    return tuple(expanded)


def resolve_effective_permissions(
    *,
    direct_permissions: Iterable[object] | None = None,
    roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    effective: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for permission in _normalize_permissions(direct_permissions):
        if permission not in seen:
            effective.append(permission)
            seen.add(permission)

    for permission in expand_role_permissions(roles):
        if permission not in seen:
            effective.append(permission)
            seen.add(permission)

    return tuple(effective)


def _permission_matches(granted: str, required: str) -> bool:
    if granted == "*" or granted == required:
        return True

    if granted.endswith(":*"):
        prefix = granted[:-2]
        return required == prefix or required.startswith(f"{prefix}:")

    return False


def has_permission(
    required_permission: str,
    *,
    permissions: Iterable[object] | None = None,
    roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
) -> bool:
    required = _clean_permission(required_permission)
    if not required:
        return False

    effective = resolve_effective_permissions(
        direct_permissions=permissions,
        roles=roles,
    )
    return any(_permission_matches(granted, required) for granted in effective)


def evaluate_permission(
    context: AuthContext,
    required_permission: str,
    *,
    resource_org_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> PermissionDecision:
    required = _clean_permission(required_permission)
    if not required:
        return PermissionDecision(
            allowed=False,
            permission="",
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="invalid_permission",
            matched_permissions=(),
            matched_roles=context.roles,
            metadata={},
        )

    if not context.authenticated:
        return PermissionDecision(
            allowed=False,
            permission=required,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="authentication_required",
            matched_permissions=(),
            matched_roles=context.roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    if resource_org_id and context.org_id and resource_org_id != context.org_id:
        return PermissionDecision(
            allowed=False,
            permission=required,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="org_scope_mismatch",
            matched_permissions=(),
            matched_roles=context.roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    effective = resolve_effective_permissions(
        direct_permissions=context.permissions,
        roles=context.roles,
    )
    matched = tuple(
        granted for granted in effective if _permission_matches(granted, required)
    )

    if matched:
        return PermissionDecision(
            allowed=True,
            permission=required,
            principal_id=context.principal_id,
            principal_type=context.principal_type,
            org_id=context.org_id,
            reason="allowed",
            matched_permissions=matched,
            matched_roles=context.roles,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    return PermissionDecision(
        allowed=False,
        permission=required,
        principal_id=context.principal_id,
        principal_type=context.principal_type,
        org_id=context.org_id,
        reason="missing_permission",
        matched_permissions=(),
        matched_roles=context.roles,
        metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
    )


def require_permission(
    context: AuthContext,
    required_permission: str,
    *,
    resource_org_id: str | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> AuthContext:
    decision = evaluate_permission(
        context,
        required_permission,
        resource_org_id=resource_org_id,
        metadata=metadata,
    )
    if decision.allowed:
        return context

    status_code = 403
    if decision.reason == "authentication_required":
        status_code = 401

    raise AppError(
        error="permission_denied",
        message="Permission denied",
        status_code=status_code,
        details=decision.to_dict(),
    )


def _stringify_metadata(
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Iterable, Mapping


def _clean(value: object) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return ""
    return value.strip()


def _clean_lower(value: object) -> str:
    return _clean(value).lower()


def _normalize_values(values: Iterable[object] | None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if values is None:
        return ()

    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for value in values:
        cleaned = _clean_lower(value)
        if not cleaned or cleaned in seen:
            continue
        normalized.append(cleaned)
        seen.add(cleaned)

    return tuple(normalized)


def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}

class Principal:

    principal_type: str
    org_id: str | None = None
    email: str | None = None
    display_name: str | None = None
    roles: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    permissions: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    active: bool = True
    service_name: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def is_customer(self) -> bool:
        return self.principal_type == "customer"

    @property
    def is_service(self) -> bool:
        return self.principal_type == "service"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "principal_id": self.principal_id,
            "principal_type": self.principal_type,
            "org_id": self.org_id,
            "email": self.email,
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "roles": list(self.roles),

def build_principal(
    *,
    principal_id: str,
    principal_type: str,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    email: str | None = None,
    display_name: str | None = None,
    roles: Iterable[object] | None = None,
    permissions: Iterable[object] | None = None,
    active: bool = True,
    service_name: str | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> Principal:
    normalized_type = _clean_lower(principal_type) or "unknown"
    normalized_org_id = _clean(org_id) or None
    normalized_email = _clean_lower(email) or None
    normalized_display_name = _clean(display_name) or None
    normalized_service_name = _clean(service_name) or None

    return Principal(
        principal_id=_clean(principal_id),
        principal_type=normalized_type,
        org_id=normalized_org_id,
        email=normalized_email,
        display_name=normalized_display_name,
        roles=_normalize_values(roles),
        permissions=_normalize_values(permissions),
        active=bool(active),
        service_name=normalized_service_name,
        metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
    )

    return PrincipalReference(
        principal_id=principal.principal_id,
        principal_type=principal.principal_type,
        org_id=principal.org_id,

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, status
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware

from app.core.logging import get_logger


@dataclass
class RateLimit:
    capacity: int
    refill_rate: float
    scope: str


class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int, refill_rate: float) -> None:
        if capacity <= 0:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be greater than 0")
        if refill_rate <= 0:
            raise ValueError("refill_rate must be greater than 0")

        self.capacity = capacity
        self.refill_rate = refill_rate
        self.tokens = float(capacity)
        self.updated_at = time.monotonic()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def consume(self, amount: float = 1.0) -> bool:
        with self.lock:
            self._refill()
            if self.tokens >= amount:
                self.tokens -= amount
                return True
            return False

    def remaining(self) -> int:
        with self.lock:
            self._refill()
            return max(0, int(self.tokens))

    def retry_after_seconds(self, amount: float = 1.0) -> int:
        with self.lock:
            self._refill()
            if self.tokens >= amount:
                return 0
            missing = amount - self.tokens
            return max(1, math.ceil(missing / self.refill_rate))

    def reset_seconds(self) -> int:
        with self.lock:
            self._refill()
            if self.tokens >= self.capacity:
                return 0
            missing = self.capacity - self.tokens
            return max(1, math.ceil(missing / self.refill_rate))

    def _refill(self) -> None:
        now = time.monotonic()
        elapsed = now - self.updated_at
        if elapsed <= 0:
            return
        self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + (elapsed * self.refill_rate))
        self.updated_at = now


class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._buckets: dict[str, TokenBucket] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def get_bucket(self, key: str, limit: RateLimit) -> TokenBucket:
        with self._lock:
            bucket = self._buckets.get(key)
            if bucket is None:
                bucket = TokenBucket(capacity=limit.capacity, refill_rate=limit.refill_rate)
                self._buckets[key] = bucket
            return bucket


DEFAULT_RATE_LIMITS: dict[str, RateLimit] = {
    "/scan": RateLimit(capacity=30, refill_rate=0.5, scope="scan"),
    "/guard-action": RateLimit(capacity=60, refill_rate=1.0, scope="guard_action"),
    "/guard-action-policy": RateLimit(capacity=60, refill_rate=1.0, scope="guard_action_policy"),
    "/guard-action-decision": RateLimit(capacity=60, refill_rate=1.0, scope="guard_action_decision"),
}


class RateLimitMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    def __init__(
        self,
        app,
        *,
        limiter: Optional[InMemoryRateLimiter] = None,
        route_limits: Optional[dict[str, RateLimit]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(app)
        self.limiter = limiter or InMemoryRateLimiter()
        self.route_limits = route_limits or DEFAULT_RATE_LIMITS
        self.logger = get_logger("ironclaw.ratelimit")

    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        limit = self._match_limit(request.url.path)
        if limit is None:
            return await call_next(request)

        client_id = self._build_client_key(request, limit.scope)
        bucket = self.limiter.get_bucket(client_id, limit)

        if not bucket.consume():
            retry_after = bucket.retry_after_seconds()
            remaining = bucket.remaining()
            headers = self._build_headers(limit, remaining, retry_after, rejected=True)

            self.logger.warning(
                "rate_limit_exceeded",
                extra={
                    "event": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                    "path": request.url.path,
                    "http_method": request.method,
                    "client_key": client_id,
                    "scope": limit.scope,
                    "limit": limit.capacity,
                    "remaining": remaining,
                    "retry_after_seconds": retry_after,
                },
            )

            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
                content={
                    "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
                    "message": "Too many requests. Please try again later.",
                    "details": {
                        "scope": limit.scope,
                        "retry_after_seconds": retry_after,
                    },
                },
                headers=headers,
            )

        response = await call_next(request)
        remaining = bucket.remaining()
        reset_after = bucket.reset_seconds()

        for header, value in self._build_headers(limit, remaining, reset_after).items():
            response.headers[header] = value

        return response

    def _match_limit(self, path: str) -> Optional[RateLimit]:
        return self.route_limits.get(path)

    def _build_client_key(self, request: Request, scope: str) -> str:
        request_id = request.headers.get("X-Client-ID")
        session_id = request.headers.get("X-Session-ID")
        forwarded_for = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For")
        real_ip = request.headers.get("X-Real-IP")
        client_ip = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"

        identity = request_id or session_id or forwarded_for or real_ip or client_ip
        identity = identity.split(",")[0].strip()
        return f"{scope}:{identity}"

    def _build_headers(
        self,
        limit: RateLimit,
        remaining: int,
        reset_after: int,
        *,
        rejected: bool = False,
    ) -> dict[str, str]:
        headers = {
            "X-RateLimit-Limit": str(limit.capacity),
            "X-RateLimit-Remaining": str(max(0, remaining)),
            "X-RateLimit-Reset": str(max(0, reset_after)),
            "X-RateLimit-Scope": limit.scope,
        }
        if rejected:
            headers["Retry-After"] = str(max(1, reset_after))
        return headers


def install_rate_limit_middleware(
    app: FastAPI,
    *,
    limiter: Optional[InMemoryRateLimiter] = None,
    route_limits: Optional[dict[str, RateLimit]] = None,
) -> None:
    app.add_middleware(
        RateLimitMiddleware,
        limiter=limiter,
        route_limits=route_limits or DEFAULT_RATE_LIMITS,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from threading import Lock
from time import time
from typing import Deque

from fastapi import Request, status

from app.core.errors import AppError


class InMemoryRateLimiter:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._events: dict[str, Deque[float]] = {}
        self._lock = Lock()

    def allow(self, key: str, *, limit: int, window_seconds: int) -> bool:
        now = time()

        with self._lock:
            bucket = self._events.setdefault(key, deque())

            while bucket and bucket[0] <= now - window_seconds:
                bucket.popleft()

            if len(bucket) >= limit:
                return False

            bucket.append(now)
            return True


rate_limiter = InMemoryRateLimiter()


def _get_client_ip(request: Request) -> str:
    forwarded_for = request.headers.get("X-Forwarded-For")
    if forwarded_for:
        return forwarded_for.split(",")[0].strip()

    if request.client and request.client.host:
        return request.client.host

    return "unknown"


def enforce_rate_limit(
    request: Request,
    *,
    bucket: str,
    limit: int = 60,
    window_seconds: int = 60,
) -> None:
    client_ip = _get_client_ip(request)
    key = f"{bucket}:{client_ip}"

    allowed = rate_limiter.allow(
        key,
        limit=limit,
        window_seconds=window_seconds,
    )

    if allowed:
        return

    raise AppError(
        error="rate_limit_exceeded",
        message="Rate limit exceeded. Please try again soon.",
        status_code=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
        details={
            "bucket": bucket,
            "limit": limit,
            "window_seconds": window_seconds,
            "client_ip": client_ip,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations


import uuid
from contextvars import ContextVar
from typing import Callable

from fastapi import Request
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from starlette.responses import Response


REQUEST_ID_HEADER_NAME = "X-Request-ID"

_request_id_var: ContextVar[str | None] = ContextVar("ironclaw_request_id", default=None)


def get_request_id() -> str | None:
    return _request_id_var.get()


def set_request_id(request_id: str | None) -> None:
    _request_id_var.set(request_id)


def clear_request_id() -> None:
    _request_id_var.set(None)


def _normalize_request_id(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return None
    value = value.strip()
    if not value:
        return None
    return value[:128]


def generate_request_id() -> str:
    return uuid.uuid4().hex


class RequestIDMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable[..., Response]) -> Response:
        incoming_request_id = _normalize_request_id(request.headers.get(REQUEST_ID_HEADER_NAME))
        request_id = incoming_request_id or generate_request_id()

        token = _request_id_var.set(request_id)
        request.state.request_id = request_id

        try:
            response = await call_next(request)
        finally:
            _request_id_var.reset(token)

        response.headers.setdefault(REQUEST_ID_HEADER_NAME, request_id)
        return response
