from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
from typing import Any

from app.services.threatintel import ThreatIntelService, build_default_threatintel_service
from app.services.malwareservice import MalwareService, build_malware_service
from app.services.detonationservice import DetonationService, build_detonation_service


SEVERITY_RANK = {
    "low": 1,
    "medium": 2,
    "high": 3,
    "critical": 4,
}

VERDICT_RANK = {
    "allow": 1,
    "monitor": 2,
    "review": 3,
    "block": 4,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArtifactAnalysisComponent:
    name: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArtifactAnalysisResult:
    artifact_id: str
    file_name: str | None
    sha256: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    reasons: list[str]
    indicators: list[str]
    components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]
    assessed_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "artifact_id": self.artifact_id,
            "file_name": self.file_name,
            "sha256": self.sha256,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": self.score,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "indicators": list(self.indicators),
            "components": [
                {
                    "name": component.name,
                    "verdict": component.verdict,
                    "severity": component.severity,
                    "score": component.score,
                    "confidence": component.confidence,
                    "details": component.details,
                }
                for component in self.components
            ],
            "assessed_at": self.assessed_at,
        }


class ArtifactAnalyzer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
        malware_service: MalwareService | None = None,
        detonation_service: DetonationService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._threatintel = threatintel_service or build_default_threatintel_service()
        self._malware = malware_service or build_malware_service()
        self._detonation = detonation_service or build_detonation_service()

    def analyze_bytes(
        self,
        payload: bytes,
        *,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        source_url: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
        sandbox_profile: str = "windows-office-user",
    ) -> ArtifactAnalysisResult:
        decoded_text = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        artifact_id = self._build_artifact_id(sha256, file_name=file_name)

        threat_assessment = self._threatintel.assess_artifact(
            url=source_url,
            hashes=[sha256],
            text=decoded_text if decoded_text else None,
            context=context or "artifact-analysis",
        )
        malware_assessment = self._malware.analyze_bytes(payload, file_name=file_name)
        detonation_assessment = self._detonation.detonate_bytes(
            payload,
            file_name=file_name,
            sandbox_profile=sandbox_profile,
        )

        components = self._build_components(
            threat_assessment=threat_assessment,
            malware_assessment=malware_assessment,
            detonation_assessment=detonation_assessment,
        )
        score = self._resolve_score(components)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(components, score)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(components, score)
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(components)
        indicators = self._collect_indicators(
            sha256=sha256,
            source_url=source_url,
            threat_assessment=threat_assessment,
            malware_assessment=malware_assessment,
        )
        reasons = self._build_reasons(
            components=components,
            threat_assessment=threat_assessment,
            malware_assessment=malware_assessment,
            detonation_assessment=detonation_assessment,
            source_url=source_url,
        )

        return ArtifactAnalysisResult(
            artifact_id=artifact_id,
            file_name=file_name,
            sha256=sha256,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            reasons=reasons,
            indicators=indicators,
            components=components,
        )

    def analyze_text(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        source_url: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
        sandbox_profile: str = "windows-office-user",
    ) -> ArtifactAnalysisResult:
        return self.analyze_bytes(
            text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"),
            file_name=file_name,
            source_url=source_url,
            context=context,
            sandbox_profile=sandbox_profile,
        )

    def _build_artifact_id(self, sha256: str, *, file_name: str | None) -> str:
        suffix = (file_name or "artifact").replace(" ", "-").lower()
        return f"artifact-{suffix}-{sha256[:12]}"

    def _build_components(
        self,
        *,
        threat_assessment: Any,
        malware_assessment: Any,
        detonation_assessment: Any,
    ) -> list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]:
        threat_details = {
            "match_count": len(getattr(threat_assessment, "matches", [])),
            "risk_families": list(getattr(threat_assessment, "risk_families", [])),
            "extracted_indicators": list(getattr(threat_assessment, "extracted_indicators", [])),
        }
        malware_details = {
            "detected_family": getattr(malware_assessment, "detected_family", None),
            "signal_count": len(getattr(malware_assessment, "signals", [])),
            "is_probably_binary": bool(getattr(malware_assessment, "is_probably_binary", False)),
        }
        detonation_details = {
            "behavior_tags": list(getattr(detonation_assessment, "behavior_tags", [])),
            "artifact_count": len(getattr(detonation_assessment, "artifacts", [])),
            "execution_time_ms": int(getattr(detonation_assessment, "execution_time_ms", 0)),
        }

        return [
            ArtifactAnalysisComponent(
                name="threatintel",
                verdict=str(getattr(threat_assessment, "verdict", "allow")),
                severity=str(getattr(threat_assessment, "severity", "low")),
                score=round(float(getattr(threat_assessment, "score", 0.0)), 4),
                confidence=round(min(max(float(getattr(threat_assessment, "score", 0.0)) + 0.2, 0.0), 1.0), 4),
                details=threat_details,
            ),
            ArtifactAnalysisComponent(
                name="malware",
                verdict=str(getattr(malware_assessment, "verdict", "allow")),
                severity=str(getattr(malware_assessment, "severity", "low")),
                score=round(float(getattr(malware_assessment, "score", 0.0)), 4),
                confidence=round(float(getattr(malware_assessment, "confidence", 0.0)), 4),
                details=malware_details,
            ),
            ArtifactAnalysisComponent(
                name="detonation",
                verdict=str(getattr(detonation_assessment, "verdict", "allow")),
                severity=str(getattr(detonation_assessment, "severity", "low")),
                score=round(float(getattr(detonation_assessment, "score", 0.0)), 4),
                confidence=round(float(getattr(detonation_assessment, "confidence", 0.0)), 4),
                details=detonation_details,
            ),
        ]

    def _resolve_score(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]) -> float:
        weights = {
            "threatintel": 0.30,
            "malware": 0.35,
            "detonation": 0.35,
        }
        weighted = 0.0
        for component in components:
            weighted += component.score * weights.get(component.name, 0.0)

        max_component = max((component.score for component in components), default=0.0)
        if max_component >= 0.85:
            weighted = max(weighted, max_component * 0.92)

        return round(min(weighted, 1.0), 4)

    def _resolve_verdict(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent], score: float) -> str:
        strongest = max((VERDICT_RANK.get(component.verdict, 1) for component in components), default=1)

        if strongest >= VERDICT_RANK["block"]:
            return "block"
        if score >= 0.70 or strongest >= VERDICT_RANK["review"]:
            return "review"
        if score >= 0.32 or strongest >= VERDICT_RANK["monitor"]:
            return "monitor"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_severity(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent], score: float) -> str:
        strongest = max((SEVERITY_RANK.get(component.severity, 1) for component in components), default=1)

        if strongest >= SEVERITY_RANK["critical"] or score >= 0.85:
            return "critical"
        if strongest >= SEVERITY_RANK["high"] or score >= 0.60:
            return "high"
        if strongest >= SEVERITY_RANK["medium"] or score >= 0.28:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_confidence(self, components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent]) -> float:
        if not components:
            return 0.0
        total = sum(component.confidence for component in components)
        return round(min(total / len(components), 1.0), 4)

    def _collect_indicators(
        self,
        *,
        sha256: str,
        source_url: str | None,
        threat_assessment: Any,
        malware_assessment: Any,
    ) -> list[str]:
        indicators: list[str] = [sha256]
        if source_url:
            indicators.append(source_url)

        indicators.extend(list(getattr(threat_assessment, "extracted_indicators", [])))

        family = getattr(malware_assessment, "detected_family", None)
        if family:
            indicators.append(f"family:{family}")

        deduped: list[str] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for item in indicators:
            normalized = str(item).strip()
            if not normalized or normalized in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(normalized)
            deduped.append(normalized)
        return deduped

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        *,
        components: list[ArtifactAnalysisComponent],
        threat_assessment: Any,
        malware_assessment: Any,
        detonation_assessment: Any,
        source_url: str | None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons: list[str] = []

        if source_url:
            reasons.append(f"Source URL supplied for correlation: {source_url}")

        matches = getattr(threat_assessment, "matches", [])
        if matches:
            reasons.append(f"Threat intel matched {len(matches)} known indicator(s).")

        malware_family = getattr(malware_assessment, "detected_family", None)
        if malware_family:
            reasons.append(f"Static malware analysis resembles {malware_family} behavior.")

        malware_signals = getattr(malware_assessment, "signals", [])
        if malware_signals:
            top_malware = sorted(malware_signals, key=lambda signal: signal.weight, reverse=True)[:3]
            for signal in top_malware:
                reasons.append(f"Static signal {signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        detonation_signals = getattr(detonation_assessment, "signals", [])
        if detonation_signals:
            top_detonation = sorted(detonation_signals, key=lambda signal: signal.weight, reverse=True)[:3]
            for signal in top_detonation:
                reasons.append(f"Detonation signal {signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        strongest_component = max(components, key=lambda component: component.score)
        reasons.append(
            f"Strongest contributing subsystem was {strongest_component.name} with score {strongest_component.score:.4f}."
        )

        if not reasons:
            reasons.append("No material risk indicators were detected across artifact analysis subsystems.")

        return reasons


def build_artifact_analyzer(
    *,
    threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
    malware_service: MalwareService | None = None,
    detonation_service: DetonationService | None = None,
) -> ArtifactAnalyzer:
    return ArtifactAnalyzer(
        threatintel_service=threatintel_service,
        malware_service=malware_service,
        detonation_service=detonation_service,
    )


__all__ = [
    "ArtifactAnalysisComponent",
    "ArtifactAnalysisResult",
    "ArtifactAnalyzer",
    "build_artifact_analyzer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import PurePath
from typing import Any, Mapping


HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".exe",
    ".dll",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".vbs",
    ".jar",
    ".apk",
    ".scr",
    ".msi",
    ".com",
    ".reg",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".zip",
    ".rar",
    ".7z",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".tgz",
    ".docm",
    ".xlsm",
    ".pptm",
    ".html",
    ".svg",
    ".js",
    ".pdf",
}

HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS = {
    "obfuscated": 25,
    "payload": 25,
    "macro": 25,
    "persistence": 20,
    "autorun": 20,
    "credential": 20,
    "token": 15,
    "password": 15,
    "keylogger": 30,
    "powershell": 20,
    "registry": 20,
    "download and execute": 30,
}

MEDIUM_RISK_PATTERNS = {
    "download": 10,
    "archive": 10,
    "embedded": 10,
    "external link": 10,
    "javascript": 10,
    "script": 10,
    "remote content": 10,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArtifactAnalysis:
    detected: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    artifact_name: str
    artifact_path: str
    artifact_extension: str
    reason: str
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_extension(path_value: str, name_value: str) -> str:
    candidate = path_value or name_value
    if not candidate:
        return ""
    return PurePath(candidate).suffix.lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], artifact_name: str, artifact_path: str) -> str:
    parts = [artifact_name, artifact_path]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "description",
        "content_type",
        "source",
        "origin",
        "scan_summary",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("matched_patterns", "failed_checks", "alerts", "tags", "reasons"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _score_extension(extension: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if extension in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 45, [f"high-risk artifact extension detected: {extension}"]
    if extension in MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 20, [f"reviewable artifact extension detected: {extension}"]
    return 0, []


def _score_patterns(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    matched: list[str] = []

    for pattern, weight in HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    for pattern, weight in MEDIUM_RISK_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    return min(100, score), matched


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 70:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 35:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def analyze_artifact(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> ArtifactAnalysis:
    artifact_name = str(_get_value(payload, "artifact_name", "file_name", "name") or "")
    artifact_path = str(_get_value(payload, "artifact_path", "file_path", "filepath", "path") or "")
    artifact_extension = _extract_extension(artifact_path, artifact_name)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, artifact_name, artifact_path)
    extension_score, extension_reasons = _score_extension(artifact_extension)
    pattern_score, matched_patterns = _score_patterns(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + extension_score + pattern_score)
    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(total_risk)

    failed_checks = list(extension_reasons)
    if matched_patterns:
        failed_checks.append("artifact content indicators triggered review")

    if any(pattern in {"macro", "payload", "download and execute"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("artifact shows active execution behavior")

    if any(pattern in {"credential", "token", "password", "keylogger"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("artifact shows credential-risk indicators")

    reason = (
        extension_reasons[0]
        if extension_reasons
        else matched_patterns[0]
        if matched_patterns
        else "no artifact threats detected"
    )

    return ArtifactAnalysis(
        detected=total_risk >= 35,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        artifact_name=artifact_name,
        artifact_path=artifact_path,
        artifact_extension=artifact_extension,
        reason=reason,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "artifact_analyzer"},
    )


def summarize_artifact_analysis(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return analyze_artifact(payload).to_dict()

    "HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS",
    "HIGH_RISK_PATTERNS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_PATTERNS",
    "ArtifactAnalysis",
    "analyze_artifact",
    "summarize_artifact_analysis",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from typing import Any

from app.detection.artifactanalyzer import ArtifactAnalyzer, build_artifact_analyzer
from app.services.threatintel import ThreatIntelService, build_default_threatintel_service


URL_SHORTENER_HOSTS = {
    "bit.ly",
    "t.co",
    "tinyurl.com",
    "goo.gl",
    "is.gd",
    "buff.ly",
    "ow.ly",
    "rebrand.ly",
    "cutt.ly",
    "tiny.one",
}

SUSPICIOUS_TLDS = {
    "zip",
    "mov",
    "top",
    "xyz",
    "click",
    "work",
    "country",
    "gq",
    "tk",
    "quest",
}

HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".exe",
    ".dll",
    ".scr",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".js",
    ".jse",
    ".vbs",
    ".vbe",
    ".msi",
    ".iso",
    ".img",
    ".lnk",
    ".hta",
    ".jar",
}

ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".zip",
    ".rar",
    ".7z",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".bz2",
    ".xz",
}

DOUBLE_EXTENSION_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"\.(?:pdf|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|jpg|jpeg|png|txt|rtf)\.(?:exe|scr|bat|cmd|js|vbs|ps1)$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

IP_LITERAL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$")
HEX_ESCAPE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}")
REPEATED_SUBDOMAIN_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(?:[^.]+\.){4,}")
CREDENTIAL_STYLE_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[^/@:]+:[^/@]+@")


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DownloadSignal:
    name: str
    weight: float
    evidence: str
    category: str = "download"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DownloadAnalysisResult:
    download_id: str
    url: str | None
    file_name: str | None
    sha256: str | None
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    reasons: list[str]
    signals: list[DownloadSignal]
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    analyzed_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "download_id": self.download_id,
            "url": self.url,
            "file_name": self.file_name,
            "sha256": self.sha256,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": self.score,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "signals": [
                {
                    "name": signal.name,
                    "weight": signal.weight,
                    "evidence": signal.evidence,
                    "category": signal.category,
                }
                for signal in self.signals
            ],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "artifact_analysis": self.artifact_analysis,
            "analyzed_at": self.analyzed_at,
        }


class DownloadAnalyzer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer | None = None,
        threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._artifact_analyzer = artifact_analyzer or build_artifact_analyzer()
        self._threatintel = threatintel_service or build_default_threatintel_service()

    def analyze(
        self,
        *,
        url: str | None = None,
        payload: bytes | None = None,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        content_type: str | None = None,
        referrer: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> DownloadAnalysisResult:
        normalized_url = (url or "").strip() or None
        normalized_name = (file_name or "").strip() or None
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() if payload is not None else None
        download_id = self._build_download_id(
            url=normalized_url,
            file_name=normalized_name,
            sha256=sha256,
        )

        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        metadata = {
            "content_type": content_type,
            "referrer": referrer,
            "has_payload": payload is not None,
            "payload_size": len(payload) if payload is not None else 0,
        }

        if normalized_url:
            signals.extend(self._analyze_url(normalized_url))
            threat = self._threatintel.assess_artifact(
                url=normalized_url,
                hashes=[sha256] if sha256 else [],
                text=normalized_name,
                context=context or "download-analysis",
            )
            signals.extend(self._signals_from_threatintel(threat))

        if normalized_name:
            signals.extend(self._analyze_file_name(normalized_name))

        if payload is not None:
            signals.extend(self._analyze_payload(payload, normalized_name, content_type))

        artifact_analysis = None
        if payload is not None:
            artifact_result = self._artifact_analyzer.analyze_bytes(
                payload,
                file_name=normalized_name,
                source_url=normalized_url,
                context=context or "download-analysis",
            )
            artifact_analysis = artifact_result.as_dict()
            signals.extend(self._signals_from_artifact(artifact_result))

        signals = self._dedupe_signals(signals)
        score = self._resolve_score(signals)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(score)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(score, signals)
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(signals, payload_present=payload is not None, artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis)
        reasons = self._build_reasons(signals, verdict, severity, normalized_url, normalized_name, artifact_analysis)

        metadata["signal_count"] = len(signals)
        metadata["host"] = self._extract_host(normalized_url) if normalized_url else None

        return DownloadAnalysisResult(
            download_id=download_id,
            url=normalized_url,
            file_name=normalized_name,
            sha256=sha256,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            reasons=reasons,
            signals=signals,
            metadata=metadata,
            artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
        )

    def analyze_url(
        self,
        url: str,
        *,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        referrer: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> DownloadAnalysisResult:
        return self.analyze(
            url=url,
            file_name=file_name,
            referrer=referrer,
            context=context,
        )

    def analyze_bytes(
        self,
        payload: bytes,
        *,
        url: str | None = None,
        file_name: str | None = None,
        content_type: str | None = None,
        referrer: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> DownloadAnalysisResult:
        return self.analyze(
            url=url,
            payload=payload,
            file_name=file_name,
            content_type=content_type,
            referrer=referrer,
            context=context,
        )

    def _build_download_id(self, *, url: str | None, file_name: str | None, sha256: str | None) -> str:
        seed = "|".join(part for part in [url or "", file_name or "", sha256 or ""] if part)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(seed.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12] if seed else "unknown"
        return f"download-{digest}"

    def _analyze_url(self, url: str) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        parsed = urlparse(url)
        host = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
        path = parsed.path or ""
        query = parsed.query or ""

        if parsed.scheme and parsed.scheme.lower() not in {"http", "https"}:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="non_http_scheme",
                    weight=0.30,
                    evidence=f"Download URL uses {parsed.scheme} scheme.",
                )
            )

        if host in URL_SHORTENER_HOSTS:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="url_shortener",
                    weight=0.28,
                    evidence=f"Host {host} is a known shortening service.",
                )
            )

        tld = host.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in host else ""
        if tld in SUSPICIOUS_TLDS:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="suspicious_tld",
                    weight=0.26,
                    evidence=f"Host uses high-risk top-level domain .{tld}.",
                )
            )

        if IP_LITERAL_PATTERN.match(host):
            try:
                ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
                if not ip.is_private:
                    signals.append(
                        DownloadSignal(
                            name="ip_literal_host",
                            weight=0.24,
                            evidence=f"URL uses literal IP host {host}.",
                        )
                    )
            except ValueError:
                pass

        if REPEATED_SUBDOMAIN_PATTERN.search(host):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="deep_subdomain_chain",
                    weight=0.14,
                    evidence=f"Host {host} contains many chained subdomains.",
                )
            )

        if "@" in parsed.netloc and CREDENTIAL_STYLE_PATTERN.match(parsed.netloc):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="credential_style_url",
                    weight=0.32,
                    evidence="URL contains credential-style userinfo before host.",
                )
            )

        lowered_target = f"{path}?{query}".lower()
        if DOUBLE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.search(lowered_target):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="double_extension_url",
                    weight=0.42,
                    evidence=f"URL path suggests disguised executable: {path}",
                )
            )

        for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
            if lowered_target.endswith(ext):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="executable_download_url",
                        weight=0.38,
                        evidence=f"URL path ends with executable extension {ext}.",
                    )
                )
                break

        if any(token in lowered_target for token in ("download=1", "export=1", "attachment=", "raw=1")) and HEX_ESCAPE_PATTERN.search(query):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="obfuscated_download_query",
                    weight=0.18,
                    evidence="Download query uses encoded characters alongside forced attachment semantics.",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _analyze_file_name(self, file_name: str) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        lowered = file_name.lower()

        if DOUBLE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.search(lowered):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="double_extension_name",
                    weight=0.46,
                    evidence=f"Filename appears disguised with double extension: {file_name}",
                )
            )

        for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
            if lowered.endswith(ext):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="high_risk_extension",
                        weight=0.34,
                        evidence=f"Filename uses high-risk extension {ext}.",
                    )
                )
                break

        archive_match = next((ext for ext in ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS if lowered.endswith(ext)), None)
        if archive_match:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="archive_container",
                    weight=0.12,
                    evidence=f"Filename is an archive container {archive_match}.",
                )
            )

        if any(char in file_name for char in ("\u202e", "\u202d", "\u2066", "\u2067", "\u2068", "\u2069")):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="unicode_direction_override",
                    weight=0.54,
                    evidence="Filename contains Unicode direction override characters.",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _analyze_payload(
        self,
        payload: bytes,
        file_name: str | None,
        content_type: str | None,
    ) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        prefix = payload[:32]
        lowered_name = (file_name or "").lower()

        if prefix.startswith(b"MZ"):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="portable_executable_header",
                    weight=0.48,
                    evidence="Payload starts with MZ executable header.",
                )
            )
        elif prefix.startswith(b"PK\x03\x04"):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="zip_container_header",
                    weight=0.12,
                    evidence="Payload starts with ZIP archive header.",
                )
            )
        elif prefix.startswith(b"%PDF"):
            if any(ext in lowered_name for ext in (".exe", ".scr", ".js", ".bat")):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="extension_mime_mismatch",
                        weight=0.40,
                        evidence="Payload header appears to be PDF but filename extension is executable-like.",
                    )
                )

        if content_type:
            lowered_type = content_type.lower()
            if "octet-stream" in lowered_type and not any(lowered_name.endswith(ext) for ext in ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS | HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="generic_binary_content_type",
                        weight=0.10,
                        evidence=f"Content-Type is generic binary: {content_type}",
                    )
                )
            if "text/html" in lowered_type and any(lowered_name.endswith(ext) for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS):
                signals.append(
                    DownloadSignal(
                        name="content_type_filename_mismatch",
                        weight=0.35,
                        evidence=f"Executable-like filename conflicts with content type {content_type}.",
                    )
                )

        if len(payload) < 180 and any(lowered_name.endswith(ext) for ext in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS):
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="tiny_executable_payload",
                    weight=0.14,
                    evidence="Executable-like payload is unusually small and may be a staged dropper or broken lure.",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _signals_from_threatintel(self, assessment: Any) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        matches = list(getattr(assessment, "matches", []))
        if matches:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="threatintel_match",
                    weight=min(0.50, 0.16 + len(matches) * 0.08),
                    evidence=f"Threat intel matched {len(matches)} indicator(s).",
                    category="threatintel",
                )
            )

        for family in list(getattr(assessment, "risk_families", []))[:3]:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="threatintel_family",
                    weight=0.12,
                    evidence=f"Threat intel associated the target with {family}.",
                    category="threatintel",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _signals_from_artifact(self, result: Any) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        signals: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        score = float(getattr(result, "score", 0.0))
        verdict = str(getattr(result, "verdict", "allow"))
        severity = str(getattr(result, "severity", "low"))

        if score >= 0.20:
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name="artifact_risk_score",
                    weight=min(0.55, score * 0.50),
                    evidence=f"Artifact analysis returned score {score:.4f}, verdict {verdict}, severity {severity}.",
                    category="artifact",
                )
            )

        components = list(getattr(result, "components", []))
        for component in components:
            component_score = float(getattr(component, "score", 0.0))
            if component_score < 0.40:
                continue
            component_name = str(getattr(component, "name", "component"))
            signals.append(
                DownloadSignal(
                    name=f"artifact_component_{component_name}",
                    weight=min(0.22, component_score * 0.18),
                    evidence=f"{component_name} component contributed score {component_score:.4f}.",
                    category="artifact",
                )
            )

        return signals

    def _resolve_score(self, signals: list[DownloadSignal]) -> float:
        total = sum(signal.weight for signal in signals)
        return round(min(total, 1.0), 4)

    def _resolve_severity(self, score: float) -> str:
        if score >= 0.85:
            return "critical"
        if score >= 0.58:
            return "high"
        if score >= 0.28:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_verdict(self, score: float, signals: list[DownloadSignal]) -> str:
        names = {signal.name for signal in signals}

        if score >= 0.82 or "unicode_direction_override" in names or "portable_executable_header" in names and "double_extension_name" in names:
            return "block"
        if score >= 0.52 or "threatintel_match" in names:
            return "review"
        if score >= 0.22:
            return "monitor"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_confidence(
        self,
        signals: list[DownloadSignal],
        *,
        payload_present: bool,
        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> float:
        base = 0.35
        if payload_present:
            base += 0.18
        if artifact_analysis:
            base += 0.18
        base += min(len(signals) * 0.04, 0.25)
        return round(min(base, 0.99), 4)

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        signals: list[DownloadSignal],
        verdict: str,
        severity: str,
        url: str | None,
        file_name: str | None,
        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons: list[str] = [
            f"Download risk classified as {verdict} with {severity} severity."
        ]

        if url:
            reasons.append(f"Evaluated download source {url}.")
        if file_name:
            reasons.append(f"Evaluated target filename {file_name}.")

        for signal in sorted(signals, key=lambda item: item.weight, reverse=True)[:5]:
            reasons.append(f"{signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        if artifact_analysis:
            reasons.append(
                f"Artifact analysis also returned verdict {artifact_analysis.get('verdict')} with score {artifact_analysis.get('score')}."
            )

        if len(reasons) == 1:
            reasons.append("No strong download-specific risk indicators were detected.")

        return reasons

    def _extract_host(self, url: str) -> str | None:
        try:
            return (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower() or None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _dedupe_signals(self, signals: list[DownloadSignal]) -> list[DownloadSignal]:
        deduped: list[DownloadSignal] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        for signal in signals:
            key = (signal.name, signal.evidence)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(signal)
        return deduped


def build_download_analyzer(
    *,
    artifact_analyzer: ArtifactAnalyzer | None = None,
    threatintel_service: ThreatIntelService | None = None,
) -> DownloadAnalyzer:
    return DownloadAnalyzer(
        artifact_analyzer=artifact_analyzer,
        threatintel_service=threatintel_service,
    )


__all__ = [
    "DownloadSignal",
    "DownloadAnalysisResult",
    "DownloadAnalyzer",
    "build_download_analyzer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import PurePath
from typing import Any, Mapping
from urllib.parse import urlparse


HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".exe",
    ".dll",
    ".bat",
    ".cmd",
    ".ps1",
    ".msi",
    ".scr",
    ".jar",
    ".apk",
    ".reg",
    ".vbs",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".zip",
    ".rar",
    ".7z",
    ".tar",
    ".gz",
    ".tgz",
    ".xz",
    ".iso",
    ".img",
    ".docm",
    ".xlsm",
    ".pptm",
    ".html",
    ".svg",
    ".pdf",
    ".js",
}

HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "dropper": 30,
    "payload": 30,
    "macro": 25,
    "autorun": 20,
    "obfuscated": 25,
    "executable": 20,
    "credential": 20,
    "token": 15,
    "password": 15,
    "download and execute": 35,
    "remote script": 25,
}

MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "archive": 10,
    "embedded": 10,
    "attachment": 10,
    "redirect": 10,
    "external": 10,
    "script": 10,
    "installer": 10,
}

HIGH_RISK_HOST_PATTERNS = {
    "raw.githubusercontent.com": 10,
    "pastebin": 25,
    "bit.ly": 25,
    "tinyurl": 25,
    "anonfiles": 25,
    "mediafire": 20,
    "mega.nz": 20,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DownloadAnalysis:
    detected: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    url: str
    hostname: str
    file_name: str
    file_extension: str
    reason: str
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_url(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    return str(_get_value(payload, "url", "target", "target_value", "download_url") or "")


def _extract_file_name(payload: Mapping[str, Any], url: str) -> str:
    explicit = str(_get_value(payload, "file_name", "name") or "")
    if explicit:
        return explicit

    parsed = urlparse(url if "://" in url else f"https://{url}" if url else "")
    return PurePath(parsed.path).name


def _extract_extension(file_name: str) -> str:
    if not file_name:
        return ""
    return PurePath(file_name).suffix.lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], url: str, file_name: str) -> str:
    parts = [url, file_name]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "description",
        "target_type",
        "content_type",
        "source",
        "origin",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("matched_patterns", "failed_checks", "alerts", "tags", "reasons"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _score_extension(extension: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if extension in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 45, [f"high-risk download extension detected: {extension}"]
    if extension in MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 20, [f"reviewable download extension detected: {extension}"]
    return 0, []


def _score_keywords(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    matched: list[str] = []

    for keyword, weight in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS.items():
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(keyword)

    for keyword, weight in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS.items():
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(keyword)

    return min(100, score), matched


def _score_host(hostname: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for host_pattern, weight in HIGH_RISK_HOST_PATTERNS.items():
        if host_pattern in hostname:
            score += weight
            reasons.append(f"reviewable download host detected: {host_pattern}")

    return score, reasons


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 70:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 35:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def analyze_download(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> DownloadAnalysis:
    url = _extract_url(payload)
    parsed = urlparse(url if "://" in url else f"https://{url}" if url else "")
    hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
    file_name = _extract_file_name(payload, url)
    file_extension = _extract_extension(file_name)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, url, file_name)
    extension_score, extension_reasons = _score_extension(file_extension)
    keyword_score, matched_patterns = _score_keywords(signal_text)
    host_score, host_reasons = _score_host(hostname)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + extension_score + keyword_score + host_score)
    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(total_risk)

    failed_checks = [*extension_reasons, *host_reasons]
    if matched_patterns:
        failed_checks.append("download content indicators triggered review")

    if any(pattern in {"dropper", "payload", "download and execute", "remote script"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("download shows executable delivery behavior")

    if any(pattern in {"credential", "token", "password"} for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("download shows secret-risk indicators")

    reason = (
        extension_reasons[0]
        if extension_reasons
        else host_reasons[0]
        if host_reasons
        else matched_patterns[0]
        if matched_patterns
        else "no download threats detected"
    )

    return DownloadAnalysis(
        detected=total_risk >= 35,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        url=url,
        hostname=hostname,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_extension=file_extension,
        reason=reason,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "download_analyzer"},
    )


def summarize_download_analysis(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return analyze_download(payload).to_dict()

    "HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS",
    "HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "HIGH_RISK_HOST_PATTERNS",
    "DownloadAnalysis",
    "analyze_download",
    "summarize_download_analysis",
]

@dataclass(slots=True)
class SanitizerSignal:
    name: str
    weight: float
    evidence: str
    category: str


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SanitizationAction:
    kind: str
    start: int | None = None
    end: int | None = None
    replacement: str | None = None
    detail: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OutputSanitizationResult:
    original_text: str
    sanitized_text: str
    verdict: str
    severity: str
    score: float
    confidence: float
    reasons: list[str]
    signals: list[SanitizerSignal]
    actions: list[SanitizationAction]
    blocked: bool
    sanitized: bool
    analyzed_at: str = field(
        default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    )

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "original_text": self.original_text,
            "sanitized_text": self.sanitized_text,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "score": float(self.score),
            "confidence": float(self.confidence),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "signals": [
                {
                    "name": signal.name,
                    "weight": float(signal.weight),
                    "evidence": signal.evidence,
                    "category": signal.category,
                }
                for signal in self.signals
            ],
            "actions": [
                {
                    "kind": action.kind,
                    "start": action.start,
                    "end": action.end,
                    "replacement": action.replacement,
                    "detail": action.detail,
                }
                for action in self.actions
            ],
            "blocked": bool(self.blocked),
            "sanitized": bool(self.sanitized),
            "analyzed_at": self.analyzed_at,
        }


class OutputSanitizer:
    def sanitize(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        context: str | None = None,
        redact_secrets: bool = True,
        block_unsafe_commands: bool = True,
    ) -> OutputSanitizationResult:
        working = text or ""
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        actions: list[SanitizationAction] = []

        if redact_secrets and working:
            working, secret_signals, secret_actions = self._redact_by_patterns(
                working,
                SECRET_PATTERNS,
                replacement_builder=lambda name: f"[REDACTED_{name.upper()}]",
                category="secret",
            )
            signals.extend(secret_signals)
            actions.extend(secret_actions)

        if working:
            working, path_signals, path_actions = self._redact_by_patterns(
                working,
                PATH_PATTERNS,
                replacement_builder=lambda _name: "[REDACTED_PATH]",
                category="path",
            )
            signals.extend(path_signals)
            actions.extend(path_actions)

        if working:
            command_signals, command_actions = self._scan_commands(
                working,
                block_unsafe_commands=block_unsafe_commands,
            )
            signals.extend(command_signals)
            actions.extend(command_actions)

        if working:
            leak_signals = self._scan_prompt_leaks(working, context=context)
            signals.extend(leak_signals)

        deduped_signals = self._dedupe_signals(signals)
        score = self._resolve_score(deduped_signals)
        severity = self._resolve_severity(score)
        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(
            deduped_signals,
            score,
            block_unsafe_commands=block_unsafe_commands,
        )
        blocked = verdict == "block"

        if blocked:
            blocked_message = self._blocked_message(deduped_signals)
            working = blocked_message
            actions.append(
                SanitizationAction(
                    kind="replace_all",
                    start=0,
                    end=len(blocked_message),
                    replacement=blocked_message,
                    detail="Replaced entire output because blocking indicators were present.",
                )
            )

        sanitized = working != text
        confidence = self._resolve_confidence(
            deduped_signals,
            sanitized=sanitized,
            blocked=blocked,
        )
        reasons = self._build_reasons(
            signals=deduped_signals,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            context=context,
            sanitized=sanitized,
            blocked=blocked,
        )

        return OutputSanitizationResult(
            original_text=text,
            sanitized_text=working,
            verdict=verdict,
            severity=severity,
            score=score,
            confidence=confidence,
            reasons=reasons,
            signals=deduped_signals,
            actions=actions,
            blocked=blocked,
            sanitized=sanitized,
        )

    def _redact_by_patterns(
        self,
        text: str,
        pattern_specs: Iterable[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str], float]],
        *,
        replacement_builder: Callable[[str], str],
        category: str,
    ) -> tuple[str, list[SanitizerSignal], list[SanitizationAction]]:
        updated = text
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        actions: list[SanitizationAction] = []

        for name, pattern, weight in pattern_specs:
            search_offset = 0
            replacement_label = replacement_builder(name)
            while True:
                match = pattern.search(updated, search_offset)
                if not match:
                    break

                matched_value = match.group(0)
                start, end = match.span()
                updated = f"{updated[:start]}{replacement_label}{updated[end:]}"
                search_offset = start + len(replacement_label)

                signals.append(
                    SanitizerSignal(
                        name=name,
                        weight=float(weight),
                        evidence=self._clip_evidence(matched_value),
                        category=category,
                    )
                )
                actions.append(
                    SanitizationAction(
                        kind="redact",
                        start=start,
                        end=start + len(replacement_label),
                        replacement=replacement_label,
                        detail=f"Redacted {name}.",
                    )
                )

        return updated, signals, actions

    def _scan_commands(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        block_unsafe_commands: bool,
    ) -> tuple[list[SanitizerSignal], list[SanitizationAction]]:
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        actions: list[SanitizationAction] = []

        if not text:
            return signals, actions

        for name, pattern, disposition, weight in COMMAND_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                evidence = self._clip_evidence(match.group(0))
                adjusted_weight = float(weight) if block_unsafe_commands else float(
                    min(weight, 0.22)
                )
                signals.append(
                    SanitizerSignal(
                        name=name,
                        weight=adjusted_weight,
                        evidence=evidence,
                        category="command",
                    )
                )
                actions.append(
                    SanitizationAction(
                        kind="flag",
                        start=match.start(),
                        end=match.end(),
                        detail=f"Detected command pattern {name} with disposition {disposition}.",
                    )
                )

        return signals, actions

    def _scan_prompt_leaks(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        context: str | None,
    ) -> list[SanitizerSignal]:
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        if not text:
            return signals

        context_lower = context.lower() if context else ""
        is_prompt_context = "prompt" in context_lower

        for name, pattern, weight in PROMPT_LEAK_PATTERNS:
            for match in pattern.finditer(text):
                adjusted = float(weight)
                if is_prompt_context:
                    adjusted = min(adjusted + 0.06, 0.5)
                signals.append(
                    SanitizerSignal(
                        name=name,
                        weight=adjusted,
                        evidence=self._clip_evidence(match.group(0)),
                        category="policy",
                    )
                )
        return signals

    def _resolve_score(self, signals: list[SanitizerSignal]) -> float:
        if not signals:
            return 0.0
        total = sum(float(signal.weight) for signal in signals)
        if any(signal.name == "private_key_block" for signal in signals):
            total = max(total, 0.92)
        return round(min(total, 1.0), 4)

    def _resolve_severity(self, score: float) -> str:
        if score >= 0.85:
            return "critical"
        if score >= 0.55:
            return "high"
        if score >= 0.25:
            return "medium"
        return "low"

    def _resolve_verdict(
        self,
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal],
        score: float,
        *,
        block_unsafe_commands: bool,
    ) -> str:
        if not signals:
            return "allow"

        names = {signal.name for signal in signals}
        secret_hits = sum(1 for signal in signals if signal.category == "secret")
        command_hits = sum(1 for signal in signals if signal.category == "command")

        if "private_key_block" in names:
            return "block"
        if block_unsafe_commands and command_hits > 0 and score >= 0.48:
            return "block"
        if secret_hits >= 2 or score >= 0.48:
            return "sanitize"
        if score >= 0.18:
            return "review"
        return "allow"

    def _resolve_confidence(
        self,
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal],
        *,
        sanitized: bool,
        blocked: bool,
    ) -> float:
        base = 0.42
        if signals:
            base += min(len(signals) * 0.05, 0.28)
        if sanitized:
            base += 0.10
        if blocked:
            base += 0.12
        return round(min(base, 0.99), 4)

    def _build_reasons(
        self,
        *,
        signals: list[SanitizerSignal],
        verdict: str,
        severity: str,
        context: str | None,
        sanitized: bool,
        blocked: bool,
    ) -> list[str]:
        reasons: list[str] = [
            f"Output sanitation verdict is {verdict} with {severity} severity."
        ]

        if context:
            reasons.append(f"Evaluation context: {context}.")

        if sanitized:
            reasons.append(
                "Sensitive content was redacted or transformed before release."
            )

        if blocked:
            reasons.append("Unsafe output was blocked from leaving the pipeline.")

        if signals:
            for signal in sorted(
                signals,
                key=lambda item: item.weight,
                reverse=True,
            )[:5]:
                reasons.append(f"{signal.name}: {signal.evidence}")

        if len(reasons) == 1:
            reasons.append("No sanitization triggers were detected.")

        return reasons

    def _blocked_message(self, signals: list[SanitizerSignal]) -> str:
        if not signals:
            return "[BLOCKED_OUTPUT] Unsafe output suppressed by OutputSanitizer."
        top_names = [
            signal.name
            for signal in sorted(
                signals,
                key=lambda item: item.weight,
                reverse=True,
            )[:3]
        ]
        joined = ", ".join(top_names)
        return f"[BLOCKED_OUTPUT] Unsafe output suppressed by OutputSanitizer due to: {joined}"

    def _clip_evidence(self, value: str, limit: int = 120) -> str:
        compact = " ".join(value.split())
        if len(compact) <= limit:
            return compact
        return compact[: limit - 3] + "..."

    def _dedupe_signals(self, signals: list[SanitizerSignal]) -> list[SanitizerSignal]:
        deduped: list[SanitizerSignal] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
        for signal in signals:
            key = (signal.name, signal.category, signal.evidence)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(signal)
        return deduped


def build_output_sanitizer() -> OutputSanitizer:
    return OutputSanitizer()


__all__ = [
    "SanitizerSignal",
    "SanitizationAction",
    "OutputSanitizationResult",
    "OutputSanitizer",
    "build_output_sanitizer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping


SECRET_PATTERNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "openai_api_key": r"\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b",
    "aws_access_key": r"\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b",
    "github_token": r"\bghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b",
    "slack_token": r"\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}\b",
    "jwt": r"\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b",
    "private_key_block": r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+PRIVATE KEY-----",
}

DANGEROUS_OUTPUT_PATTERNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "powershell_encoded": r"powershell\s+-enc\b",
    "curl_pipe_bash": r"curl\s+[^|]+\|\s*(bash|sh)\b",
    "wget_pipe_shell": r"wget\s+[^|]+\|\s*(bash|sh)\b",
    "command_chaining_delete": r"(rm\s+-rf|del\s+/f\s+/q|format\s+c:)",
    "script_tag": r"<script\b",
    "data_exfil_url": r"https?://[^\s]+/(collect|exfil|beacon|callback)\b",
}

REDACTION_TOKEN = "[REDACTED]"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OutputSanitizationResult:
    sanitized_text: str
    modified: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    reason: str
    redacted_items: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _extract_text(payload: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        return payload

    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        for key in ("content", "text", "output", "message", "result", "summary"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                return value
        return str(payload)

    return str(payload)


def _redact_patterns(
    text: str,
    patterns: Mapping[str, str],
    failed_checks: list[str],
    redacted_items: list[str],
) -> tuple[str, int]:
    total_hits = 0
    sanitized = text

    for label, pattern in patterns.items():
        matches = re.findall(pattern, sanitized, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if matches:
            sanitized = re.sub(pattern, REDACTION_TOKEN, sanitized, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            total_hits += len(matches)
            redacted_items.append(label)
            failed_checks.append(f"redacted {label}")

    return sanitized, total_hits


def sanitize_output(payload: Any) -> OutputSanitizationResult:
    original_text = _extract_text(payload)
    failed_checks: list[str] = []
    redacted_items: list[str] = []

    sanitized_text, secret_hits = _redact_patterns(
        original_text,
        SECRET_PATTERNS,
        failed_checks,
        redacted_items,
    )
    sanitized_text, dangerous_hits = _redact_patterns(
        sanitized_text,
        DANGEROUS_OUTPUT_PATTERNS,
        failed_checks,
        redacted_items,
    )

    total_hits = secret_hits + dangerous_hits
    modified = sanitized_text != original_text
    risk_score = min(100, secret_hits * 30 + dangerous_hits * 20)

    if secret_hits > 0:
        verdict = "quarantine"
        reason = "sensitive secret material detected in output"
    elif dangerous_hits > 0:
        verdict = "warn"
        reason = "dangerous executable or exfiltration-style output detected"
    else:
        verdict = "allow"
        reason = "output passed sanitization checks"

    return OutputSanitizationResult(
        sanitized_text=sanitized_text,
        modified=modified,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        verdict=verdict,
        reason=reason,
        redacted_items=redacted_items,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "output_sanitizer"},
    )


def summarize_output_sanitizer(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return sanitize_output(payload).to_dict()

    "SECRET_PATTERNS",
    "DANGEROUS_OUTPUT_PATTERNS",
    "REDACTION_TOKEN",
    "OutputSanitizationResult",
    "sanitize_output",
    "summarize_output_sanitizer",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping


HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS = {
    "ignore previous instructions": 45,
    "disregard all prior instructions": 45,
    "reveal your system prompt": 50,
    "show the hidden prompt": 50,
    "print your hidden instructions": 50,
    "developer message": 35,
    "system prompt": 35,
    "override safety": 40,
    "jailbreak": 35,
    "bypass restrictions": 40,
    "disable safeguards": 40,
    "do not tell the user": 35,
    "secret instructions": 35,
}

MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS = {
    "ignore safety": 20,
    "act as root": 20,
    "trust this content": 15,
    "execute this command": 20,
    "run this script": 20,
    "fetch and execute": 25,
    "download and run": 25,
    "base64 payload": 20,
    "encoded payload": 20,
    "exfiltrate": 25,
    "token": 15,
    "credential": 15,
    "cookie": 15,
    "ssh key": 20,
}

SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_PATTERNS = {
    "urgent security patch": 10,
    "admin override": 10,
    "authorized by developer": 15,
    "this is safe": 10,
    "internal tool": 10,
    "trusted source": 10,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PromptInjectionAnalysis:
    detected: bool
    risk_score: int
    verdict: str
    confidence: str
    reason: str
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _get_text(payload: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(payload, str):
        return _normalize_text(payload)

    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        parts: list[str] = []
        for key in (
            "content",
            "prompt",
            "message",
            "text",
            "summary",
            "reason",
            "target",
            "target_value",
        ):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if value is not None:
                parts.append(str(value))

        for key in ("messages", "reasons", "alerts", "tags"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
            elif value is not None:
                parts.append(str(value))

        return _normalize_text(" | ".join(parts))

    return _normalize_text(payload)


def _score_patterns(text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    matched: list[str] = []

    for pattern, weight in HIGH_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    for pattern, weight in MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    for pattern, weight in SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_PATTERNS.items():
        if pattern in text:
            score += weight
            matched.append(pattern)

    return min(100, score), matched


def _derive_verdict(score: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if score >= 70:
        return "quarantine", "high"
    if score >= 35:
        return "warn", "medium"
    return "allow", "low"


def analyze_prompt_injection(payload: Any) -> PromptInjectionAnalysis:
    text = _get_text(payload)
    score, matched_patterns = _score_patterns(text)
    verdict, confidence = _derive_verdict(score)

    detected = score >= 35
    failed_checks = []

    if matched_patterns:
        failed_checks.append("prompt injection indicators detected")

    if any("system prompt" in pattern or "hidden" in pattern for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("sensitive instruction extraction attempt detected")

    if any("execute" in pattern or "run" in pattern for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("execution coercion language detected")

    if any("token" in pattern or "credential" in pattern or "cookie" in pattern for pattern in matched_patterns):
        failed_checks.append("secret extraction language detected")

    reason = (
        matched_patterns[0]
        if matched_patterns
        else "no prompt injection indicators detected"
    )

    return PromptInjectionAnalysis(
        detected=detected,
        risk_score=score,
        verdict=verdict,
        confidence=confidence,
        reason=reason,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        metadata={"source": "prompt_injection_analyzer"},
    )


def summarize_prompt_injection(payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return analyze_prompt_injection(payload).to_dict()

    "SOCIAL_ENGINEERING_PATTERNS",
    "PromptInjectionAnalysis",
    "analyze_prompt_injection",
    "summarize_prompt_injection",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import binascii
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretFinding:
    label: str
    secret_type: str
    severity: str
    confidence: float
    start: int
    end: int
    match_text: str
    redacted_value: str
    risk_delta: int
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "label": self.label,
            "secret_type": self.secret_type,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "start": self.start,
            "end": self.end,
            "match_text": self.match_text,
            "redacted_value": self.redacted_value,
            "risk_delta": self.risk_delta,
            "details": dict(self.details),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretScanResult:
    found: bool
    findings: list[SecretFinding]
    risk_delta: int
    scanned_bytes: int
    truncated: bool
    summary: dict[str, int]

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "found": self.found,
            "findings": [finding.as_dict() for finding in self.findings],
            "risk_delta": self.risk_delta,
            "scanned_bytes": self.scanned_bytes,
            "truncated": self.truncated,
            "summary": dict(self.summary),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _SecretRule:
    label: str
    secret_type: str
    severity: str
    risk_delta: int
    confidence: float
    pattern: re.Pattern[str]
    min_match_length: int = 0


class SecretScanner:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        max_scan_bytes: int = 512_000,
        max_findings: int = 100,
    ) -> None:
        self.max_scan_bytes = max_scan_bytes
        self.max_findings = max_findings
        self._rules = _build_rules()

    def scan_text(self, value: Any) -> SecretScanResult:
        text = self._to_text(value)
        scanned_text, truncated = self._truncate_text(text)
        findings = self._scan_string(scanned_text)
        return SecretScanResult(
            found=bool(findings),
            findings=findings,
            risk_delta=sum(finding.risk_delta for finding in findings),
            scanned_bytes=len(scanned_text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")),
            truncated=truncated,
            summary=self._summarize(findings),
        )

    def scan_arguments(self, arguments: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        normalized = self._serialize_json(arguments or {})
        return self.scan_text(normalized)

    def scan_metadata(self, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        normalized = self._serialize_json(metadata or {})
        return self.scan_text(normalized)

    def scan_payload(
        self,
        *,
        tool_name: str | None = None,
        arguments: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        content: Any = None,
    ) -> SecretScanResult:
        payload = {
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "arguments": arguments or {},
            "metadata": metadata or {},
            "content": content,
        }
        return self.scan_text(self._serialize_json(payload))

    def scan_lines(self, lines: Sequence[str] | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        return self.scan_text("\n".join(lines or []))

    def scan_bytes(self, value: bytes | bytearray | None) -> SecretScanResult:
        if not value:
            return SecretScanResult(
                found=False,
                findings=[],
                risk_delta=0,
                scanned_bytes=0,
                truncated=False,
                summary={},
            )
        text = value.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        return self.scan_text(text)

    def _scan_string(self, text: str) -> list[SecretFinding]:
        findings: list[SecretFinding] = []
        occupied: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []

        for rule in self._rules:
            for match in rule.pattern.finditer(text):
                start, end = match.span()
                token = match.group(0)

                if len(token.strip()) < rule.min_match_length:
                    continue
                if self._should_skip_match(rule, token):
                    continue
                if self._overlaps_more_specific(occupied, start, end, rule.secret_type):
                    continue

                findings.append(
                    SecretFinding(
                        label=rule.label,
                        secret_type=rule.secret_type,
                        severity=rule.severity,
                        confidence=rule.confidence,
                        start=start,
                        end=end,
                        match_text=token,
                        redacted_value=self._redact_token(token),
                        risk_delta=rule.risk_delta,
                        details={
                            "fingerprint": self._fingerprint(token),
                            "length": len(token),
                        },
                    )
                )
                occupied.append((start, end, rule.secret_type))

                if len(findings) >= self.max_findings:
                    return findings

        return findings

    def _should_skip_match(self, rule: _SecretRule, token: str) -> bool:
        lowered = token.lower().strip()

        if "example" in lowered or "sample" in lowered or "test" in lowered:
            if rule.secret_type in {
                "aws_secret_key",
                "github_token",
                "slack_token",
                "private_key",
                "jwt",
                "bearer_token",
                "generic_api_key",
            }:
                return True

        if rule.secret_type == "generic_api_key":
            return self._looks_low_entropy(token)

        if rule.secret_type == "bearer_token":
            return self._looks_low_entropy(token.split(None, 1)[-1])

        if rule.secret_type == "jwt":
            return not self._looks_like_jwt(token)

        if rule.secret_type == "base64_blob":
            return self._looks_low_entropy(token)

        return False

    def _looks_low_entropy(self, token: str) -> bool:
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]", "", token)
        if len(cleaned) < 16:
            return True

        unique_ratio = len(set(cleaned)) / max(len(cleaned), 1)
        if unique_ratio < 0.22:
            return True

        entropy = self._shannon_entropy(cleaned)
        return entropy < 3.2

    def _looks_like_jwt(self, token: str) -> bool:
        parts = token.split(".")
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return False
        for part in parts[:2]:
            if not self._is_base64url_segment(part):
                return False
        return True

    def _is_base64url_segment(self, value: str) -> bool:
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", value):
            return False
        padding = "=" * ((4 - len(value) % 4) % 4)
        try:
            base64.urlsafe_b64decode(value + padding)
        except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
            return False
        return True

    def _shannon_entropy(self, value: str) -> float:
        if not value:
            return 0.0
        counts = {char: value.count(char) for char in set(value)}
        length = len(value)
        return -sum((count / length) * math.log2(count / length) for count in counts.values())

    def _overlaps_more_specific(
        self,
        occupied: Iterable[tuple[int, int, str]],
        start: int,
        end: int,
        secret_type: str,
    ) -> bool:
        for existing_start, existing_end, existing_type in occupied:
            overlap = not (end <= existing_start or start >= existing_end)
            if overlap and existing_type != secret_type:
                return True
        return False

    def _redact_token(self, token: str) -> str:
        stripped = token.strip()
        if len(stripped) <= 8:
            return "[REDACTED]"
        return f"{stripped[:4]}...[REDACTED]...{stripped[-4:]}"

    def _fingerprint(self, token: str) -> str:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")).hexdigest()
        return digest[:16]

    def _to_text(self, value: Any) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
            return value.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            return self._serialize_json(value)
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            return self._serialize_json(list(value))
        return str(value)

    def _serialize_json(self, value: Any) -> str:
        try:
            return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str)
        except Exception:
            return str(value)

    def _truncate_text(self, text: str) -> tuple[str, bool]:
        raw = text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if len(raw) <= self.max_scan_bytes:
            return text, False
        truncated = raw[: self.max_scan_bytes].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        return truncated, True

    def _summarize(self, findings: Sequence[SecretFinding]) -> dict[str, int]:
        summary: dict[str, int] = {}
        for finding in findings:
            summary[finding.secret_type] = summary.get(finding.secret_type, 0) + 1
        return summary


def build_secret_scanner(
    *,
    max_scan_bytes: int = 512_000,
    max_findings: int = 100,
) -> SecretScanner:
    return SecretScanner(
        max_scan_bytes=max_scan_bytes,
        max_findings=max_findings,
    )


def _build_rules() -> list[_SecretRule]:
    return [
        _SecretRule(
            label="aws-access-key-id",
            secret_type="aws_access_key_id",
            severity="high",
            risk_delta=30,
            confidence=0.99,
            pattern=re.compile(r"\b(?:A3T|AKIA|ASIA|AGPA|AIDA|AROA|ANPA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b"),
            min_match_length=20,
        ),
        _SecretRule(
            label="aws-secret-access-key",
            secret_type="aws_secret_key",
            severity="critical",
            risk_delta=60,
            confidence=0.95,
            pattern=re.compile(
                r"(?i)(?:aws[\w\s._-]{0,24})?(?:secret|secret_access_key|secret-access-key)"
                r"[\s\"':=]{1,8}([A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40})"
            ),
            min_match_length=40,
        ),
        _SecretRule(
            label="github-token",
            secret_type="github_token",
            severity="critical",
            risk_delta=55,
            confidence=0.99,
            pattern=re.compile(r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36,255}\b"),
            min_match_length=40,
        ),
        _SecretRule(
