@dataclass(slots=True)
class RuntimeSessionStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_SESSION_TABLE
    checkpoint_store: Any = field(default_factory=build_checkpoint_store)
    decision_trace_store: Any = field(default_factory=build_decision_trace_store)
    review_state_store: Any = field(default_factory=build_review_state_store)

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        probe = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(probe):
            return bool(probe())
        return True

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": self.is_ready(),
        }

    # Session lifecycle

    def _build_session_payload(
        self,
        payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        *,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        request_id: str | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        plan: ExecutionPlan | None = None,
        request: ExecutionRequestBoundary | None = None,
        result: ExecutionResultBoundary | None = None,
        steps_completed: int | None = None,
        total_steps: int | None = None,
        trace_id: str | None = None,
        review_id: str | None = None,
        resume_from_checkpoint_id: str | None = None,
        resume_from_step_index: int | None = None,
        resume_count: int | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        started_at: str | None = None,
        completed_at: str | None = None,
        last_updated_at: str | None = None,
        **extra: Any,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        base = _as_dict(payload)
        base.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

        resolved_session_id = (
            _text(session_id)
            or _text(base.get("session_id"))
            or _text(base.get("id"))
            or str(uuid4())
        )
        resolved_request_id = (
            _text(request_id)
            or _text(base.get("request_id"))
            or _text(getattr(request, "request_id", None))
        )
        resolved_org_id = (
            _text(organization_id)
            or _text(base.get("organization_id"))
            or _text(base.get("org_id"))
        )
        resolved_owner_id = (
            _text(owner_id)
            or _text(base.get("owner_id"))
        )

        now_iso = _utc_now_iso()
        started_iso = started_at or _text(base.get("started_at")) or now_iso
        last_updated_iso = last_updated_at or _text(base.get("last_updated_at")) or now_iso
        completed_iso = completed_at or _text(base.get("completed_at"))

        resolved_status = (
            _text(status)
            or _text(base.get("status"))
            or "pending"
        )

        resolved_total_steps = (
            total_steps
            if total_steps is not None
            else base.get("total_steps")
            if isinstance(base.get("total_steps"), int)
            else None
        )

        resolved_steps_completed = (
            steps_completed
            if steps_completed is not None
            else base.get("steps_completed")
            if isinstance(base.get("steps_completed"), int)
            else 0
        )

        resolved_trace_id = (
            _text(trace_id)
            or _text(base.get("trace_id"))
        )

        resolved_review_id = (
            _text(review_id)
            or _text(base.get("review_id"))
        )

        resolved_resume_from_checkpoint_id = (
            _text(resume_from_checkpoint_id)
            or _text(base.get("resume_from_checkpoint_id"))
        )

        resolved_resume_from_step_index = (
            resume_from_step_index
            if resume_from_step_index is not None
            else base.get("resume_from_step_index")
            if isinstance(base.get("resume_from_step_index"), int)
            else None
        )

        resolved_resume_count = (
            resume_count
            if resume_count is not None
            else base.get("resume_count")
            if isinstance(base.get("resume_count"), int)
            else 0
        )

        resolved_metadata = _merge_metadata(base.get("metadata"), metadata)
        resolved_checkpoints = _as_list(base.get("checkpoints"))

        resolved_plan = plan or base.get("plan")
        resolved_request = request or base.get("request")
        resolved_result = result or base.get("result")

        return {
            "session_id": resolved_session_id,
            "id": resolved_session_id,
            "request_id": resolved_request_id or None,
            "organization_id": resolved_org_id or None,
            "owner_id": resolved_owner_id or None,
            "status": resolved_status,
            "started_at": started_iso,
            "completed_at": completed_iso,
            "last_updated_at": last_updated_iso,
            "steps_completed": resolved_steps_completed,
            "total_steps": resolved_total_steps,
            "trace_id": resolved_trace_id or None,
            "review_id": resolved_review_id or None,
            "resume_from_checkpoint_id": resolved_resume_from_checkpoint_id or None,
            "resume_from_step_index": resolved_resume_from_step_index,
            "resume_count": resolved_resume_count,
            "metadata": resolved_metadata,
            "checkpoints": resolved_checkpoints,
            "plan": (
                resolved_plan.as_dict()
                if hasattr(resolved_plan, "as_dict")
                else _as_dict(resolved_plan) if resolved_plan is not None else None
            ),
            "request": (
                resolved_request.as_dict()
                if hasattr(resolved_request, "as_dict")
                else _as_dict(resolved_request) if resolved_request is not None else None
            ),
            "result": (
                resolved_result.as_dict()
                if hasattr(resolved_result, "as_dict")
                else _as_dict(resolved_result) if resolved_result is not None else None
            ),
        }

    def create_session(
        self,
        payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = self._build_session_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, record)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return dict(inserted[0])
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return dict(inserted)
        return record

    def create(
        self,
        payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_session(payload, **kwargs)

    def get_session(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _text(session_id):
            raise ValueError("session_id is required")

        for key in ("session_id", "id"):
            rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={key: session_id}, limit=1)
            if rows:
                return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_session(session_id)

    def get_by_request_id(self, request_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        normalized = _text(request_id)
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("request_id is required")

        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"request_id": normalized}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def list_sessions(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        active_only: bool | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if owner_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("owner_id", owner_id)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", status)
        if active_only:
            query_filters.setdefault("completed_at", None)

        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters=query_filters or None, limit=limit)
        items = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        items.sort(key=lambda row: _text(row.get("last_updated_at") or row.get("started_at")), reverse=True)
        return items

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_sessions(**kwargs)

    def update_session(self, session_id: str, updates: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        existing = self.get_session(session_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = dict(existing)
        merged.update(_as_dict(updates))
        merged["session_id"] = existing.get("session_id") or existing.get("id") or session_id
        merged["id"] = merged["session_id"]
        merged["last_updated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()

        normalized = self._build_session_payload(merged)

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"session_id": session_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"id": session_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        return normalized

    def update(self, session_id: str, updates: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_session(session_id, updates)

    # Checkpoints & resume

    def add_checkpoint(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        checkpoint: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        step_index: int | None = None,
        label: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        session = self.get_session(session_id)
        if session is None:
            return None

        checkpoint_payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "session_id": session_id,
            "checkpoint_id": str(uuid4()),
            "created_at": _utc_now_iso(),
        }
        checkpoint_payload.update(_as_dict(checkpoint))
        if step_index is not None:
            checkpoint_payload.setdefault("step_index", step_index)
        if label:
            checkpoint_payload.setdefault("label", _text(label))

        try:
            stored = self.checkpoint_store.create_checkpoint(checkpoint_payload)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        except Exception:
            stored = checkpoint_payload

        checkpoints = _as_list(session.get("checkpoints"))
        checkpoints.append(stored)

        updates = {
            "checkpoints": checkpoints,
            "steps_completed": session.get("steps_completed", 0) + 1,
        }
        return self.update_session(session_id, updates)

    def resume_from_latest_checkpoint(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        *,
        mark_status: str = "resuming",
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        session = self.get_session(session_id)
        if session is None:
            return None

        checkpoints = _as_list(session.get("checkpoints"))
        if not checkpoints:
            return None

        latest = checkpoints[-1]
        checkpoint_id = _text(latest.get("checkpoint_id") or latest.get("id") or "")
        step_index = latest.get("step_index")
        resume_count = int(session.get("resume_count") or 0) + 1

        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": mark_status,
            "resume_from_checkpoint_id": checkpoint_id or None,
            "resume_from_step_index": step_index if isinstance(step_index, int) else None,
            "resume_count": resume_count,
        }
        return self.update_session(session_id, updates)

    # Status transitions

    def mark_started(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        *,
        status: str = "running",
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates = {
            "status": status,
            "started_at": _utc_now_iso(),
        }
        return self.update_session(session_id, updates)

    def mark_completed(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        result: ExecutionResultBoundary | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        *,
        status: str = "completed",
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": status,
            "completed_at": _utc_now_iso(),
        }
        if result is not None:
            updates["result"] = result
        return self.update_session(session_id, updates)

    def mark_failed(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        error: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        *,
        status: str = "failed",
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": status,
            "completed_at": _utc_now_iso(),
        }
        if error is not None:
            current = self.get_session(session_id) or {}
            meta = _merge_metadata(current.get("metadata"), {"error": _as_dict(error)})
            updates["metadata"] = meta
        return self.update_session(session_id, updates)

    # Decision trace and review links

    def attach_trace(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        trace_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        trace_record = self.decision_trace_store.create_trace(trace_payload)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        trace_id = _text(trace_record.get("trace_id") or trace_record.get("id"))
        if not trace_id:
            trace_id = str(uuid4())
        return self.update_session(session_id, {"trace_id": trace_id})

    def attach_review_state(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        review_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        session = self.get_session(session_id)
        if session is None:
            return None

        review_record = self.review_state_store.upsert_state(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            review_payload,
            request_id=session.get("request_id"),
            organization_id=session.get("organization_id"),
            owner_id=session.get("owner_id"),
        )
        review_id = _text(review_record.get("review_id") or review_record.get("id"))
        return self.update_session(session_id, {"review_id": review_id})

    # Deletion

    def delete_session(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not _text(session_id):
            raise ValueError("session_id is required")

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"session_id": session_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"id": session_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        return None

    def delete(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.delete_session(session_id)

    # Summary

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1_000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        sessions = self.list_sessions(
            limit=limit,
            organization_id=organization_id,
            owner_id=owner_id,
        )

        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        active = 0
        completed = 0
        failed = 0

        for session in sessions:
            status = _text(session.get("status"), "unknown").lower()
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1
            if status in {"completed"}:
                completed += 1
            elif status in {"failed", "error"}:
                failed += 1
            elif session.get("completed_at") is None:
                active += 1

        return {
            "total_sessions": len(sessions),
            "active_sessions": active,
            "completed_sessions": completed,
            "failed_sessions": failed,
            "by_status": by_status,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }


def build_runtime_session_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_SESSION_TABLE,
    checkpoint_backend: Any | None = None,
    decision_trace_backend: Any | None = None,
    review_state_backend: Any | None = None,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> RuntimeSessionStore:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    checkpoint_store = build_checkpoint_store(backend=checkpoint_backend or resolved_backend)
    decision_trace_store = build_decision_trace_store(backend=decision_trace_backend or resolved_backend)
    review_state_store = build_review_state_store(backend=review_state_backend or resolved_backend)
    return RuntimeSessionStore(
        backend=resolved_backend,
        table_name=table_name,
        checkpoint_store=checkpoint_store,
        decision_trace_store=decision_trace_store,
        review_state_store=review_state_store,
    )


def create_runtime_session_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_SESSION_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> RuntimeSessionStore:
    return build_runtime_session_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_runtime_session_store(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_SESSION_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> RuntimeSessionStore:
    return build_runtime_session_store(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

RuntimeSessionStatus = str


@dataclass
class RuntimeSessionEvent:
    event_id: str
    session_id: str
    agent_id: str
    file_path: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    verdict: str
    lane: str
    summary: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
    risk_score: int = 0
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    scan_id: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class RuntimeSession:
    session_id: str
    agent_id: str
    file_path: str
    profile: AgentProfile
    status: RuntimeSessionStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    current_plan: ExecutionPlan | None = None
    event_log: list[RuntimeSessionEvent] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "file_path": self.file_path,
            "profile": self.profile.to_dict(),
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "current_plan": self.current_plan.to_dict() if self.current_plan else None,
            "event_log": [event.to_dict() for event in self.event_log],
        }


def _status_from_plan(plan: ExecutionPlan) -> RuntimeSessionStatus:
    if plan.verdict == "block":
        return "blocked"
    if plan.verdict == "quarantine":
        return "quarantined"
    if plan.verdict == "warn":
        return "review"
    return "active"


def _build_runtime_event(result: RoutedTaskResult, session_id: str) -> RuntimeSessionEvent:
    plan = result.execution_plan
    return RuntimeSessionEvent(
        event_id=f"rse-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        session_id=session_id,
        agent_id=result.task.agent_id,
        file_path=result.task.file_path,
        action_type=result.task.action_type,
        target=result.task.target,
        verdict=plan.verdict,
        lane=plan.lane,
        summary=plan.summary,
        risk_score=plan.risk_score,
        matched_patterns=plan.matched_patterns,
        scan_id=plan.scan_id,
    )


def create_runtime_session(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    *,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    agent_id: str | None = None,
) -> RuntimeSession:
    descriptor = orchestrator.get_agent(file_path=file_path, agent_id=agent_id)
    profile = build_agent_profile(descriptor)
    now = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()

    return RuntimeSession(
        session_id=f"ics-{uuid4().hex}",
        agent_id=descriptor.agent_id,
        file_path=descriptor.relative_path,
        profile=profile,
        status="initialized",
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        current_plan=None,
        event_log=[],
    )


def execute_routed_task_in_session(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    snapshot: CoordinationSnapshot,
    session: RuntimeSession,
    *,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    use_guard_api: bool = True,
) -> tuple[RuntimeSession, CoordinationSnapshot, RoutedTaskResult]:
    result = route_and_plan(
        orchestrator,
        snapshot,
        action_type=action_type,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        target=target,
        content=content,
        agent_id=session.agent_id,
        session_id=session.session_id,
        use_guard_api=use_guard_api,
    )

    plan = result.execution_plan
    runtime_event = _build_runtime_event(result, session.session_id)
    updated_snapshot = apply_execution_plan(snapshot, plan)

    updated_session = RuntimeSession(
        session_id=session.session_id,
        agent_id=session.agent_id,
        file_path=session.file_path,
        profile=session.profile,
        status=_status_from_plan(plan),
        created_at=session.created_at,
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        current_plan=plan,
        event_log=[*session.event_log, runtime_event],
    )

    return updated_session, updated_snapshot, result


def coordination_events_from_session(session: RuntimeSession) -> list[CoordinationEvent]:
    events: list[CoordinationEvent] = []
    for event in session.event_log:
        if event.verdict == "block":
            status = "blocked"
            priority = "critical"
        elif event.verdict == "quarantine":
            status = "quarantined"
            priority = "high"
        elif event.verdict == "warn":
            status = "review"
            priority = "normal"
        else:
            status = "observing"
            priority = "low"

        events.append(
            CoordinationEvent(
                agent_id=event.agent_id,
                file_path=event.file_path,
                verdict=event.verdict,
                status=status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                priority=priority,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                summary=event.summary,
                risk_score=event.risk_score,
                matched_patterns=event.matched_patterns,
                scan_id=event.scan_id,
                created_at=event.created_at,
            )
        )
    return events


def save_runtime_session(
    session: RuntimeSession,
    output_path: str | Path,
) -> Path:
    path = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(session.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

from app.detection.downloadanalyzer import analyze_download_dict
from app.detection.outputsanitizer import build_output_sanitizer
from app.detection.sessionrisk import SessionEvent, build_session_risk_analyzer

ExecutorCallable = Callable[..., Any]


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


def _int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _clamp_score(value: Any) -> int:
    return max(0, min(100, _int(value, default=0)))


def _as_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "as_dict") and callable(value.as_dict):
        dumped = value.as_dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dict(dumped)
    return {}


def _normalize_reason(
    reason: Any,
    *,
    default_source: str,
    default_label: str,
    default_details: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(reason, dict):
        return {
            "source": _text(reason.get("source"), default_source),
            "label": _text(reason.get("label"), default_label),
            "details": _text(reason.get("details"), default_details),
            "score": _clamp_score(reason.get("score", 0)),
        }
    return {
        "source": default_source,
        "label": default_label,
        "details": _text(reason, default_details),
        "score": 0,
    }


def _safe_detector_result(
    detector_name: str,
    detector_callable: Callable[..., Any],
    /,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str | None]:
    try:
        result = detector_callable(**kwargs)
        normalized = _as_dict(result)
        normalized.setdefault("severity", "low")
        normalized.setdefault("riskdelta", 0)
        normalized.setdefault("reasons", [])
        normalized.setdefault("shouldreview", False)
        normalized.setdefault("shouldquarantine", False)
        normalized.setdefault("degraded", False)
        return normalized, None
    except Exception as exc:
        return (
            {
                "severity": "high",
                "riskdelta": 15,
                "reasons": [
                    {
                        "source": detector_name,
                        "label": "Detector failure",
                        "details": f"{detector_name} failed during runtime evaluation.",
                        "score": 15,
                    }
                ],
                "shouldreview": True,
                "shouldquarantine": False,
                "degraded": True,
                "error": {
                    "type": exc.__class__.__name__,
                    "message": _text(exc),
                },
            },
            detector_name,
        )

@dataclass(slots=True)
class SecureRuntimePipeline:
    reviewthreshold: int = 50
    blockthreshold: int = 85
    dryrunthreshold: int = 15
    toolreviewthreshold: int = 20
    toolblockthreshold: int = 60
    shellreviewthreshold: int = 10
    shellblockthreshold: int = 45
    defaultfilepath: str = "app/api/actionexecute.py"
    executor: Optional[ExecutorCallable] = None
    name: str = "secureruntimepipeline"

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        actorid: str,
        actiontype: str,
        target: str,
        content: str,
        riskscore: int,
        sessionid: str | None = None,
        filepath: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        persistencedegraded: bool = False,
    ) -> SecureRuntimeDecision:
        effective_filepath = filepath or self.defaultfilepath
        effectivemetadata = dict(metadata or {})
        effectivemetadata.setdefault("filepath", effective_filepath)
        if sessionid:
            effectivemetadata.setdefault("sessionid", sessionid)
        if actorid:
            effectivemetadata.setdefault("actorid", actorid)

        normalized_risk = _clamp_score(riskscore)

        promptscan, prompt_failure = _safe_detector_result(
            "promptinjection",
            scanpromptinjectiondict,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            content=content,
            filepath=effective_filepath,
            metadata=effectivemetadata,
        )

        hostilecontext, hostile_failure = _safe_detector_result(
            "hostilecontext",
            scanhostilecontextdict,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            content=content,
            filepath=effective_filepath,
            metadata=effectivemetadata,
        )

        downloadanalysis, download_failure = _safe_detector_result(
            "downloadanalyzer",
            analyze_download_dict,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            content=content,
            filepath=effective_filepath,
            metadata=effectivemetadata,
        )

        output_sanitizer_failure: str | None = None
        try:
            outputsanitizer = build_output_sanitizer()
            outputsanitization_obj = outputsanitizer.sanitize(
                content,
                context=f"action={actiontype}, target={target}",
                redact_secrets=True,
                block_unsafe_commands=True,
            )
            outputsanitization = _as_dict(outputsanitization_obj)
            outputsanitization.setdefault("blocked", False)
            outputsanitization.setdefault("severity", "low")
            outputsanitization.setdefault("score", 0.0)
            outputsanitization.setdefault("reasons", [])
        except Exception as exc:
            output_sanitizer_failure = "outputsanitizer"
            outputsanitization = {
                "blocked": False,
                "severity": "high",
                "score": 0.5,
                "reasons": [
                    "Output sanitizer failed during runtime evaluation.",
                ],
                "degraded": True,
                "error": {
                    "type": exc.__class__.__name__,
                    "message": _text(exc),
                },
            }

        degraded_sources = [
            source
            for source in (
                prompt_failure,
                hostile_failure,
                download_failure,
                output_sanitizer_failure,
            )
            if source
        ]
        if persistencedegraded:
            degraded_sources.append("persistence")

        session_analyzer_failure = False
        try:
            session_analyzer = build_session_risk_analyzer()
            session_event = SessionEvent(
                source="secureruntimepipeline",
                verdict=self._event_verdict_for_detectors(
                    promptscan=promptscan,
                    hostilecontext=hostilecontext,
                    downloadanalysis=downloadanalysis,
                    outputsanitization=outputsanitization,
                    degradedmode=bool(degraded_sources),
                ),
                severity=self._event_severity_for_detectors(
                    promptscan=promptscan,
                    hostilecontext=hostilecontext,
                    downloadanalysis=downloadanalysis,
                    outputsanitization=outputsanitization,
                    degradedmode=bool(degraded_sources),
                ),
                score=float(normalized_risk) / 100.0,
                timestamp=effectivemetadata.get("timestamp") or None,
                detail=f"Aggregated runtime evaluation for action '{actiontype}' and target '{target}'.",
                metadata={
                    "actorid": actorid,
                    "sessionid": sessionid,
                    "filepath": effective_filepath,
                    "actiontype": actiontype,
                    "target": target,
                    "degradedmode": bool(degraded_sources),
                    "degradationsources": list(degraded_sources),
                },
            )
            sessionrisk_obj = session_analyzer.analyze(
                session_id=sessionid or "anonymous",
                events=[session_event],
                active_review=False,
            )
            sessionrisk = _as_dict(sessionrisk_obj)
            sessionrisk_score = float(getattr(sessionrisk_obj, "score", sessionrisk.get("score", 0.0)) or 0.0)
            sessionrisk_verdict = _text(getattr(sessionrisk_obj, "verdict", sessionrisk.get("verdict", "allow")), "allow").lower()
            sessionrisk_severity = _text(getattr(sessionrisk_obj, "severity", sessionrisk.get("severity", "low")), "low").lower()
            sessionrisk.setdefault("score", sessionrisk_score)
            sessionrisk.setdefault("verdict", sessionrisk_verdict)
            sessionrisk.setdefault("severity", sessionrisk_severity)
        except Exception as exc:
            session_analyzer_failure = True
            degraded_sources.append("sessionrisk")
            sessionrisk_score = 0.5
            sessionrisk_verdict = "review"
            sessionrisk_severity = "high"
            sessionrisk = {
                "score": sessionrisk_score,
                "verdict": sessionrisk_verdict,
                "severity": sessionrisk_severity,
                "degraded": True,
                "error": {
                    "type": exc.__class__.__name__,
                    "message": _text(exc),
                },
            }

        adjustedriskscore = _clamp_score(
            normalized_risk
            + _int(promptscan.get("riskdelta", 0))
            + _int(hostilecontext.get("riskdelta", 0))
            + _int(downloadanalysis.get("riskdelta", 0))
        )

        if sessionrisk_score >= 0.5:
            adjustedriskscore = min(100, adjustedriskscore + 10)

        if degraded_sources:
            adjustedriskscore = min(100, adjustedriskscore + 10)

        normalized_action = _text(actiontype).lower()
        normalized_target = _text(target).lower()

        reviewthreshold = self.reviewthreshold
        blockthreshold = self.blockthreshold

        tool_like_actions = {"toolcall", "shell", "command", "execute", "run"}
        shell_like_targets = {"shell", "powershell", "bash", "cmd", "terminal", "sh"}

        if normalized_action in tool_like_actions or normalized_target in shell_like_targets:
            reviewthreshold = min(reviewthreshold, self.toolreviewthreshold)
            blockthreshold = min(blockthreshold, self.toolblockthreshold)

        if normalized_target in shell_like_targets:
            reviewthreshold = min(reviewthreshold, self.shellreviewthreshold)
            blockthreshold = min(blockthreshold, self.shellblockthreshold)

        if sessionrisk_verdict in {"review", "block"}:
            reviewthreshold = min(reviewthreshold, 40)
            blockthreshold = min(blockthreshold, 75)

        if persistencedegraded:
            reviewthreshold = min(reviewthreshold, 25)
            blockthreshold = min(blockthreshold, 70)

        if degraded_sources:
            reviewthreshold = min(reviewthreshold, 35)

        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
            {
                "source": "pipeline",
                "label": "Risk evaluation",
                "details": (
                    f"Pipeline evaluated action '{actiontype}' for target '{target}' "
                    f"with base risk {normalized_risk} and adjusted risk {adjustedriskscore}."
                ),
                "score": adjustedriskscore,
            }
        ]

        if normalized_action in tool_like_actions or normalized_target in shell_like_targets:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "pipeline",
                    "label": "Tool-call hardening",
                    "details": (
                        f"Tool-call sensitive path detected for action '{actiontype}' and target "
                        f"'{target}', so stricter runtime thresholds were applied."
                    ),
                    "score": max(0, blockthreshold - reviewthreshold),
                }
            )

        if normalized_risk <= self.dryrunthreshold and not degraded_sources:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "pipeline",
                    "label": "Low-risk dry-run band",
                    "details": (
                        f"Base risk {normalized_risk} is within the configured dry-run threshold "
                        f"of {self.dryrunthreshold}."
                    ),
                    "score": normalized_risk,
                }
            )

        for reason in downloadanalysis.get("reasons", []):
            reasons.append(
                _normalize_reason(
                    reason,
                    default_source="downloadanalyzer",
                    default_label="Download risk indicator",
                    default_details="Download risk indicator detected.",
                )
            )

        for reason in promptscan.get("reasons", []):
            reasons.append(
                _normalize_reason(
                    reason,
                    default_source="promptinjection",
                    default_label="Prompt injection indicator",
                    default_details="Prompt injection indicator detected.",
                )
            )

        for reason in hostilecontext.get("reasons", []):
            reasons.append(
                _normalize_reason(
                    reason,
                    default_source="hostilecontext",
                    default_label="Hostile context indicator",
                    default_details="Hostile context indicator detected.",
                )
            )

        output_reasons = outputsanitization.get("reasons", [])
        if isinstance(output_reasons, list):
            output_reason_text = "; ".join(_text(item) for item in output_reasons if _text(item))
        else:
            output_reason_text = _text(output_reasons)

        reasons.append(
            {
                "source": "outputsanitizer",
                "label": "Output sanitization",
                "details": output_reason_text or "Output sanitization completed.",
                "score": _clamp_score(round(float(outputsanitization.get("score", 0.0) or 0.0) * 100)),
            }
        )

        reasons.append(
            {
                "source": "sessionrisk",
                "label": "Session risk aggregation",
                "details": (
                    f"Session risk resolved to {sessionrisk_verdict} with "
                    f"{sessionrisk_severity} severity and score {sessionrisk_score:.2f}."
                ),
                "score": _clamp_score(round(sessionrisk_score * 100)),
            }
        )

        degradationreasons: list[str] = []
        if degraded_sources:
            degradationreasons = [f"{source} unavailable or degraded during evaluation" for source in degraded_sources]
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "pipeline",
                    "label": "Degraded mode",
                    "details": "; ".join(degradationreasons),
                    "score": 25,
                }
            )

        executionstate = "executed"
        policyverdict = "allow"
        responseaction = "allow"
        responsestatus = "completed"
        shouldexecute = True
        haltedbyboundary = False
        reviewrequired = False
        quarantine = False

        should_quarantine = bool(promptscan.get("shouldquarantine")) or bool(
            hostilecontext.get("shouldquarantine")
        ) or bool(downloadanalysis.get("shouldquarantine"))

        should_review = bool(promptscan.get("shouldreview")) or bool(
            hostilecontext.get("shouldreview")
        ) or bool(downloadanalysis.get("shouldreview")) or sessionrisk_verdict == "review"

        if outputsanitization.get("blocked"):
            executionstate = "denied"
            policyverdict = "block"
            responseaction = "deny"
            responsestatus = "denied"
            shouldexecute = False
            haltedbyboundary = True
        elif should_quarantine:
            executionstate = "denied"
            policyverdict = "quarantine"
            responseaction = "quarantine"
            responsestatus = "denied"
            shouldexecute = False
            haltedbyboundary = True
            reviewrequired = False
            quarantine = True
        elif persistencedegraded and (
            normalized_action in tool_like_actions or normalized_target in shell_like_targets
        ):
            executionstate = "queuedforreview"
            policyverdict = "warn"
            responseaction = "review"
            responsestatus = "queuedforreview"
            shouldexecute = False
            haltedbyboundary = True
            reviewrequired = True
        elif adjustedriskscore >= blockthreshold or sessionrisk_verdict == "block":
            executionstate = "denied"
            policyverdict = "block"
            responseaction = "deny"
            responsestatus = "denied"
            shouldexecute = False
            haltedbyboundary = True
        elif degraded_sources:
            executionstate = "queuedforreview"
            policyverdict = "warn"
            responseaction = "review"
            responsestatus = "queuedforreview"
            shouldexecute = False
            haltedbyboundary = True
            reviewrequired = True
        elif should_review or adjustedriskscore >= reviewthreshold:
            executionstate = "queuedforreview"
            policyverdict = "warn"
            responseaction = "review"
            responsestatus = "queuedforreview"
            shouldexecute = True
            haltedbyboundary = False
            reviewrequired = True
        elif normalized_risk <= self.dryrunthreshold:
            executionstate = "dryrun"
            policyverdict = "allow"
            responseaction = "dryrun"
            responsestatus = "dryrun"
            shouldexecute = True
            haltedbyboundary = False

        return SecureRuntimeDecision(
            executionstate=executionstate,
            policyverdict=policyverdict,
            responseaction=responseaction,
            responsestatus=responsestatus,
            shouldexecute=shouldexecute,
            haltedbyboundary=haltedbyboundary,
            reviewrequired=reviewrequired,
            quarantine=quarantine,
            degradedmode=bool(degraded_sources),
            adjustedriskscore=adjustedriskscore,
            normalizedriskscore=normalized_risk,
            reviewthresholdused=reviewthreshold,
            blockthresholdused=blockthreshold,
            reasons=reasons,
            degradationreasons=degradationreasons,
            promptinjection=promptscan,
            hostilecontext=hostilecontext,
            downloadanalysis=downloadanalysis,
            outputsanitization=outputsanitization,
            sessionrisk=sessionrisk,
        )

    def _event_verdict_for_detectors(
        self,
        *,
        promptscan: dict[str, Any],
        hostilecontext: dict[str, Any],
        downloadanalysis: dict[str, Any],
        outputsanitization: dict[str, Any],
        degradedmode: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        if outputsanitization.get("blocked"):
            return "block"
        if any(d.get("shouldquarantine") for d in (promptscan, hostilecontext, downloadanalysis)):
            return "block"
        if degradedmode:
            return "review"
        if any(d.get("shouldreview") for d in (promptscan, hostilecontext, downloadanalysis)):
            return "review"
        return "allow"

    def _event_severity_for_detectors(
        self,
        *,
        promptscan: dict[str, Any],
        hostilecontext: dict[str, Any],
        downloadanalysis: dict[str, Any],
        outputsanitization: dict[str, Any],
        degradedmode: bool = False,
    ) -> str:
        candidates: list[str] = []
        for detector in (promptscan, hostilecontext, downloadanalysis):
            severity = _text(detector.get("severity")).lower()
            if severity:
                candidates.append(severity)
        if outputsanitization.get("severity"):
            candidates.append(_text(outputsanitization.get("severity")).lower())
        if degradedmode:
            candidates.append("high")

        if "critical" in candidates:
            return "critical"
        if "high" in candidates:
            return "high"
        if "medium" in candidates:
            return "medium"
        if "low" in candidates:
            return "low"
        return "low"


def initialize_secureruntimepipeline(
    *,
    reviewthreshold: int = 50,
    blockthreshold: int = 85,
    dryrunthreshold: int = 15,
    toolreviewthreshold: int = 20,
    toolblockthreshold: int = 60,
    shellreviewthreshold: int = 10,
    shellblockthreshold: int = 45,
    defaultfilepath: str = "app/api/actionexecute.py",
    executor: Optional[ExecutorCallable] = None,
) -> SecureRuntimePipeline:
    return SecureRuntimePipeline(
        reviewthreshold=reviewthreshold,
        blockthreshold=blockthreshold,
        dryrunthreshold=dryrunthreshold,
        toolreviewthreshold=toolreviewthreshold,
        toolblockthreshold=toolblockthreshold,
        shellreviewthreshold=shellreviewthreshold,
        shellblockthreshold=shellblockthreshold,
        defaultfilepath=defaultfilepath,
        executor=executor,
    )


def getactionexecutepipeline() -> SecureRuntimePipeline:
    return initialize_secureruntimepipeline()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from app.orchestrator.policy_enforcer import (
    PolicyDecision,
    PolicyEngine,
    enforce_policy,
    initialize_policy_engine,
)
from app.orchestrator.response_coordinator import (
    ResponseCoordinatorResult,
    coordinate_response,
    summarize_coordinated_response,
)
from app.orchestrator.review_queue import ReviewQueue, initialize_review_queue
from app.orchestrator.security_audit_log import (
    SecurityAuditLog,
    initialize_security_audit_log,
)
from app.services.telemetry import append_telemetry_event


TOOL_CALL_ACTIONS = {
    "tool_call",
    "shell_command",
    "network_request",
    "git_operation",
    "file_write",
    "file_edit",
    "process_spawn",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RuntimeRequest:
    actor_id: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str
    risk_score: int
    session_id: str | None = None
    file_path: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RuntimeTrace:
    trace_id: str
    request_id: str
    created_at: str
    stages: tuple[str, ...]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class SecureRuntimeResult:
    request: RuntimeRequest
    decision: PolicyDecision
    coordination: ResponseCoordinatorResult
    trace: RuntimeTrace

    @property
    def status(self) -> str:
        return self.coordination.response.status

    @property
    def action(self) -> str:
        return self.coordination.response.action

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "request": self.request.to_dict(),
            "decision": self.decision.to_dict(),
            "coordination": self.coordination.to_dict(),
            "trace": self.trace.to_dict(),
            "status": self.status,
            "action": self.action,
        }


class SecureRuntimePipeline:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        policy_engine: PolicyEngine,
        audit_log: SecurityAuditLog,
        review_queue: ReviewQueue,
    ) -> None:
        self.policy_engine = policy_engine
        self.audit_log = audit_log
        self.review_queue = review_queue

    def run(self, request: RuntimeRequest) -> SecureRuntimeResult:
        trace_id = _build_trace_id()
        request_id = _build_request_id()

        tool_call_protected = _is_tool_call_action(request.action_type)

        enriched_metadata = {
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "request_id": request_id,
            "session_id": request.session_id,
            "file_path": request.file_path,
            "actor_id": request.actor_id,
            "tool_call_protected": tool_call_protected,
            **request.metadata,
        }

        append_telemetry_event(
            "runtime_request_received",
            {
                "trace_id": trace_id,
                "request_id": request_id,
                "actor_id": request.actor_id,
                "action_type": request.action_type,
                "target": request.target,
                "risk_score": request.risk_score,
                "session_id": request.session_id,
                "file_path": request.file_path,
                "tool_call_protected": tool_call_protected,
            },
        )

        decision = enforce_policy(
            self.policy_engine,
            action_type=request.action_type,
            target=request.target,
            content=request.content,
            risk_score=request.risk_score,
            agent_id=request.actor_id,
            file_path=request.file_path,
            metadata=enriched_metadata,
        )

        append_telemetry_event(
            "runtime_policy_decision",
            {
                "trace_id": trace_id,
                "request_id": request_id,
                "actor_id": request.actor_id,
                "action_type": request.action_type,
                "target": request.target,
                "risk_score": request.risk_score,
                "policy_verdict": decision.verdict,
                "policy_mode": decision.mode,
                "tool_call_protected": tool_call_protected,
            },
        )

        coordination = coordinate_response(
            decision=decision,
            audit_log=self.audit_log,
            review_queue=self.review_queue,
            actor_id=request.actor_id,
            action_type=request.action_type,
            target=request.target,
            file_path=request.file_path,
            session_id=request.session_id,
            metadata=enriched_metadata,
        )

        self.audit_log = coordination.audit_log
        self.review_queue = coordination.review_queue

        stages = ["policy_enforced", "audit_logged"]
        if coordination.review_item is not None:
            stages.append("review_queued")
        stages.append("response_coordinated")

        trace = RuntimeTrace(
            trace_id=trace_id,
            request_id=request_id,
            created_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            stages=tuple(stages),
        )

        append_telemetry_event(
            "runtime_response_coordinated",
            {
                "trace_id": trace_id,
                "request_id": request_id,
                "actor_id": request.actor_id,
                "action_type": request.action_type,
                "target": request.target,
                "response_action": coordination.response.action,
                "response_status": coordination.response.status,
                "review_queued": coordination.review_item is not None,
                "tool_call_protected": tool_call_protected,
                "stages": list(trace.stages),
            },
        )

        return SecureRuntimeResult(
            request=request,
            decision=decision,
            coordination=coordination,
            trace=trace,
        )


def initialize_secure_runtime_pipeline(
    *,
    audit_log_path: str = "output/security-events.jsonl",
) -> SecureRuntimePipeline:
    return SecureRuntimePipeline(
        policy_engine=initialize_policy_engine(),
        audit_log=initialize_security_audit_log(audit_log_path),
        review_queue=initialize_review_queue(),
    )


def run_secure_runtime(
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline,
    *,
    actor_id: str,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    risk_score: int,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> SecureRuntimeResult:
    request = RuntimeRequest(
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        session_id=session_id,
        file_path=file_path,
        metadata=metadata or {},
    )
    return pipeline.run(request)


def summarize_secure_runtime_result(result: SecureRuntimeResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
    response_summary = summarize_coordinated_response(result.coordination)
    return {
        "trace_id": result.trace.trace_id,
        "request_id": result.trace.request_id,
        "actor_id": result.request.actor_id,
        "action_type": result.request.action_type,
        "target": result.request.target,
        "policy_verdict": result.decision.verdict,
        "policy_mode": result.decision.mode,
        "risk_score": result.decision.risk_score,
        "response_action": response_summary["action"],
        "response_status": response_summary["status"],
        "review_item_id": response_summary["review_item_id"],
        "review_queue_size": response_summary["review_queue_size"],
        "audit_event_count": response_summary["audit_event_count"],
        "tool_call_protected": _is_tool_call_action(result.request.action_type),
        "stages": list(result.trace.stages),
    }


def _is_tool_call_action(action_type: str) -> bool:
    return action_type in TOOL_CALL_ACTIONS


def _build_trace_id() -> str:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    return f"trace-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}"


def _build_request_id() -> str:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    return f"req-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}"

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal


AuditEventType = Literal[
    "policy_decision",
    "execution_allowed",
    "execution_warned",
    "execution_quarantined",
    "execution_blocked",
    "review_requested",
    "review_completed",
    "supervisor_escalation",
]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecurityAuditEvent:
    event_id: str
    event_type: AuditEventType
    actor_id: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    verdict: str
    risk_score: int
    reason: str
    session_id: str | None = None
    file_path: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class SecurityAuditLog:
    log_path: str
    event_count: int = 0
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def initialize_security_audit_log(
    log_path: str = "security-events.jsonl",
) -> SecurityAuditLog:
    path = Path(log_path)
    if not path.exists():
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.touch()
    event_count = _count_events(path)
    now = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    return SecurityAuditLog(
        log_path=str(path),
        event_count=event_count,
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
    )


def append_security_audit_event(
    audit_log: SecurityAuditLog,
    event: SecurityAuditEvent,
) -> SecurityAuditLog:
    path = Path(audit_log.log_path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(event.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    return SecurityAuditLog(
        log_path=audit_log.log_path,
        event_count=audit_log.event_count + 1,
        created_at=audit_log.created_at,
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    )


def record_policy_decision(
    audit_log: SecurityAuditLog,
    *,
    actor_id: str,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    verdict: str,
    risk_score: int,
    reason: str,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> SecurityAuditLog:
    meta = dict(metadata or {})

    event_type = _event_type_for_verdict(verdict)
    event = SecurityAuditEvent(
        event_id=_build_event_id(),
        event_type=event_type,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        verdict=verdict,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        reason=reason,
        session_id=session_id or meta.get("session_id"),
        file_path=file_path or meta.get("file_path"),
        trace_id=meta.get("trace_id"),
        request_id=meta.get("request_id"),
        metadata=meta,
    )
    return append_security_audit_event(audit_log, event)


def read_security_audit_events(audit_log: SecurityAuditLog) -> list[SecurityAuditEvent]:
    path = Path(audit_log.log_path)
    if not path.exists():
        return []

    events: list[SecurityAuditEvent] = []
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            payload = json.loads(line)
            events.append(
                SecurityAuditEvent(
                    event_id=payload["event_id"],
                    event_type=payload["event_type"],
                    actor_id=payload["actor_id"],
                    action_type=payload["action_type"],
                    target=payload["target"],
                    verdict=payload["verdict"],
                    risk_score=payload["risk_score"],
                    reason=payload["reason"],
                    session_id=payload.get("session_id"),
                    file_path=payload.get("file_path"),
                    trace_id=payload.get("trace_id"),
                    request_id=payload.get("request_id"),
                    metadata=payload.get("metadata", {}),
                    created_at=payload.get(
                        "created_at", datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
                    ),
                )
            )
    return events


def summarize_security_audit_log(audit_log: SecurityAuditLog) -> dict[str, Any]:
    events = read_security_audit_events(audit_log)
    return {
        "log_path": audit_log.log_path,
        "event_count": len(events),
        "policy_decision_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "policy_decision"
        ),
        "execution_allowed_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "execution_allowed"
        ),
        "execution_warned_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "execution_warned"
        ),
        "execution_quarantined_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "execution_quarantined"
        ),
        "execution_blocked_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "execution_blocked"
        ),
        "review_requested_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "review_requested"
        ),
        "review_completed_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "review_completed"
        ),
        "supervisor_escalation_count": sum(
            1 for event in events if event.event_type == "supervisor_escalation"
        ),
        "latest_event_at": max((event.created_at for event in events), default=None),
        "updated_at": audit_log.updated_at,
    }

def _record_explicit_event(
    audit_log: SecurityAuditLog,
    *,
    event_type: AuditEventType,
    actor_id: str,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    verdict: str,
    risk_score: int,
    reason: str,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    file_path: str | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> SecurityAuditLog:
    meta = dict(metadata or {})
    event = SecurityAuditEvent(
        event_id=_build_event_id(),
        event_type=event_type,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        verdict=verdict,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        reason=reason,
        session_id=session_id or meta.get("session_id"),
        file_path=file_path or meta.get("file_path"),
        trace_id=meta.get("trace_id"),
        request_id=meta.get("request_id"),
        metadata=meta,
    )
    return append_security_audit_event(audit_log, event)


def _count_events(path: Path) -> int:
    if not path.exists():
        return 0
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        return sum(1 for line in handle if line.strip())


def _event_type_for_verdict(verdict: str) -> AuditEventType:
    normalized = (verdict or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized == "allow":
        return "execution_allowed"
    if normalized == "warn":
        return "execution_warned"
    if normalized == "quarantine":
        return "execution_quarantined"
    if normalized == "block":
        return "execution_blocked"
    return "policy_decision"


def _build_event_id() -> str:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    return f"audit-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}"

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable
from uuid import uuid4

from app.orchestrator.coordination_state import CoordinationSnapshot
from app.orchestrator.execution_plan import ExecutionPlan
from app.orchestrator.orchestrator import IronClawOrchestrator
from app.orchestrator.runtime_session import (
    RuntimeSession,
    create_runtime_session,
    execute_routed_task_in_session,
)

SupervisorStatus = str
EscalationLevel = str


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _text(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    result = str(value).strip()
    return result or default


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SupervisorEscalation:
    escalation_id: str
    session_id: str
    agent_id: str | None
    file_path: str
    level: EscalationLevel
    reason: str
    verdict: str
    risk_score: int
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now_iso)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SessionExecutionRequest:
    file_path: str
    action_type: str
    target: str
    content: str = ""
    use_guard_api: bool = True
    agent_id: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "file_path": self.file_path,
            "action_type": self.action_type,
            "target": self.target,
            "content": self.content,
            "use_guard_api": self.use_guard_api,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SessionExecutionRecord:
    session: RuntimeSession
    execution_plan: ExecutionPlan
    status: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        session_dict = (
            self.session.as_dict()  # RuntimeSession follows dataclass-style container pattern [web:124]
            if hasattr(self.session, "as_dict")
            else self.session.to_dict()
            if hasattr(self.session, "to_dict")
            else {}
        )
        plan_dict = (
            self.execution_plan.as_dict()
            if hasattr(self.execution_plan, "as_dict")
            else self.execution_plan.to_dict()
            if hasattr(self.execution_plan, "to_dict")
            else {}
        )
        return {
            "session": session_dict,
            "execution_plan": plan_dict,
            "status": self.status,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SupervisorSnapshot:
    supervisor_id: str
    project_root: str
    status: SupervisorStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    active_sessions: dict[str, RuntimeSession] = field(default_factory=dict)
    execution_history: list[SessionExecutionRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    escalations: list[SupervisorEscalation] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "supervisor_id": self.supervisor_id,
            "project_root": self.project_root,
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "active_sessions": {
                key: (
                    value.as_dict()
                    if hasattr(value, "as_dict")
                    else value.to_dict()
                    if hasattr(value, "to_dict")
                    else {}
                )
                for key, value in self.active_sessions.items()
            },
            "execution_history": [record.to_dict() for record in self.execution_history],
            "escalations": [item.to_dict() for item in self.escalations],
        }


def initialize_supervisor(orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator) -> SupervisorSnapshot:
    now = _utc_now_iso()
    return SupervisorSnapshot(
        supervisor_id=f"sup-{uuid4().hex[:16]}",
        project_root=str(Path(orchestrator.project_root).resolve()),
        status="ready",
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
    )


def _session_key(file_path: str, agent_id: str | None = None) -> str:
    return f"{agent_id or 'auto'}::{file_path}"


def _escalation_level_for_plan(plan: ExecutionPlan) -> EscalationLevel | None:
    verdict = getattr(plan, "verdict", None)
    risk_score = int(getattr(plan, "risk_score", 0) or 0)
    if verdict == "block":
        return "critical"
    if verdict == "quarantine":
        return "high"
    if verdict == "warn" and risk_score >= 70:
        return "medium"
    return None


def _escalation_reason(plan: ExecutionPlan) -> str:
    verdict = getattr(plan, "verdict", None)
    if verdict == "block":
        return "Supervisor detected a blocked execution plan requiring immediate halt."
    if verdict == "quarantine":
        return "Supervisor detected a quarantined plan requiring controlled isolation."
    return "Supervisor detected elevated risk requiring review."


def _status_from_history(
    history: Iterable[SessionExecutionRecord],
    escalations: Iterable[SupervisorEscalation],
) -> SupervisorStatus:
    escalations_list = list(escalations)
    history_list = list(history)

    if any(item.level == "critical" for item in escalations_list):
        return "critical"
    if any(item.level == "high" for item in escalations_list):
        return "elevated"
    if any(
        getattr(record.execution_plan, "verdict", None) == "warn"
        for record in history_list
    ):
        return "monitoring"
    if history_list:
        return "active"
    return "ready"


def get_or_create_session(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    supervisor: SupervisorSnapshot,
    *,
    file_path: str,
    agent_id: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[SupervisorSnapshot, RuntimeSession]:
    key = _session_key(file_path, agent_id)

    if key in supervisor.active_sessions:
        return supervisor, supervisor.active_sessions[key]

    session = create_runtime_session(
        orchestrator,
        file_path=file_path,
        agent_id=agent_id,
    )

    updated_sessions = dict(supervisor.active_sessions)
    updated_sessions[key] = session

    updated_supervisor = SupervisorSnapshot(
        supervisor_id=supervisor.supervisor_id,
        project_root=supervisor.project_root,
        status=supervisor.status,
        created_at=supervisor.created_at,
        updated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        active_sessions=updated_sessions,
        execution_history=supervisor.execution_history,
        escalations=supervisor.escalations,
    )
    return updated_supervisor, session


def run_supervised_request(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    coordination_snapshot: CoordinationSnapshot,
    supervisor: SupervisorSnapshot,
    request: SessionExecutionRequest,
) -> tuple[SupervisorSnapshot, CoordinationSnapshot, SessionExecutionRecord]:
    supervisor, session = get_or_create_session(
        orchestrator,
        supervisor,
        file_path=request.file_path,
        agent_id=request.agent_id,
    )

    updated_session, updated_coordination_snapshot, routed_result = execute_routed_task_in_session(
        orchestrator,
        coordination_snapshot,
        session,
        action_type=request.action_type,
        target=request.target,
        content=request.content,
        use_guard_api=request.use_guard_api,
    )

    key = _session_key(request.file_path, request.agent_id)
    updated_sessions = dict(supervisor.active_sessions)
    updated_sessions[key] = updated_session

    record = SessionExecutionRecord(
        session=updated_session,
        execution_plan=routed_result.execution_plan,
        status=getattr(updated_session, "status", "unknown"),
    )

    updated_history = [*supervisor.execution_history, record]
    updated_escalations = list(supervisor.escalations)

    escalation_level = _escalation_level_for_plan(routed_result.execution_plan)
    if escalation_level is not None:
        updated_escalations.append(
            SupervisorEscalation(
                escalation_id=f"esc-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                session_id=getattr(updated_session, "session_id", ""),
                agent_id=getattr(updated_session, "agent_id", None),
                file_path=getattr(updated_session, "file_path", request.file_path),
                level=escalation_level,
                reason=_escalation_reason(routed_result.execution_plan),
                verdict=getattr(routed_result.execution_plan, "verdict", "unknown"),
                risk_score=int(getattr(routed_result.execution_plan, "risk_score", 0) or 0),
            )
        )

    updated_supervisor = SupervisorSnapshot(
        supervisor_id=supervisor.supervisor_id,
        project_root=supervisor.project_root,
        status=_status_from_history(updated_history, updated_escalations),
        created_at=supervisor.created_at,
        updated_at=_utc_now_iso(),
        active_sessions=updated_sessions,
        execution_history=updated_history,
        escalations=updated_escalations,
    )

    return updated_supervisor, updated_coordination_snapshot, record


def summarize_supervisor(supervisor: SupervisorSnapshot) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "supervisor_id": supervisor.supervisor_id,
        "status": supervisor.status,
        "active_session_count": len(supervisor.active_sessions),
        "execution_count": len(supervisor.execution_history),
        "escalation_count": len(supervisor.escalations),
        "critical_escalations": sum(
            1 for item in supervisor.escalations if item.level == "critical"
        ),
        "high_escalations": sum(
            1 for item in supervisor.escalations if item.level == "high"
        ),
        "medium_escalations": sum(
            1 for item in supervisor.escalations if item.level == "medium"
        ),
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

from app.orchestrator.agent_registry import AgentDescriptor, ProtectedAction
from app.orchestrator.coordination_state import (
    AgentState,
    CoordinationSnapshot,
    get_agent_state,
)
from app.orchestrator.execution_plan import ExecutionPlan, build_execution_plan
from app.orchestrator.orchestrator import IronClawOrchestrator, OrchestrationDecision


RoutingMode = Literal[
    "direct_file",
    "agent_id",
    "dependency_inferred",
    "broadcast_security_scope",
]

RoutingPriority = Literal[
    "low",
    "normal",
    "high",
    "critical",
]


@dataclass
class RoutedTask:
    route_id: str
    agent_id: str
    file_path: str
    action_type: ProtectedAction
    target: str
    content: str
    routing_mode: RoutingMode
    priority: RoutingPriority
    summary: str
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    dependency_scope: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass
class RoutedTaskResult:
    task: RoutedTask
    decision: OrchestrationDecision
    execution_plan: ExecutionPlan
    agent_state: AgentState | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "task": self.task.to_dict(),
            "decision": self.decision.to_dict(),
            "execution_plan": self.execution_plan.to_dict(),
            "agent_state": asdict(self.agent_state) if self.agent_state else None,
        }


def _normalize_path(file_path: str) -> str:
    return file_path.replace("\\", "/").strip()


def _priority_for_agent(agent: AgentDescriptor, action_type: ProtectedAction) -> RoutingPriority:
    if agent.threat_profile == "security_critical":
        return "critical"
    if agent.threat_profile == "execution_capable":
        return "high"
    if action_type in {"shell_command", "network_request", "git_operation", "tool_call"}:
        return "high"
    if agent.threat_profile == "sensitive":
        return "normal"
    return "low"


def _build_route_id(agent_id: str, action_type: ProtectedAction, target: str) -> str:
    normalized_target = target.strip().replace("\\", "/")[:80]
    return f"{agent_id}:{action_type}:{normalized_target}"


def _summary_for_route(
    agent: AgentDescriptor,
    action_type: ProtectedAction,
    routing_mode: RoutingMode,
) -> str:
    return (
        f"Routed action '{action_type}' to agent {agent.agent_id} "
        f"for file {agent.relative_path} via mode '{routing_mode}'."
    )


def create_routed_task(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    *,
    action_type: ProtectedAction,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    file_path: str | None = None,
    agent_id: str | None = None,
    routing_mode: RoutingMode | None = None,
    dependency_scope: list[str] | None = None,
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
) -> RoutedTask:
    agent = orchestrator.get_agent(
        file_path=_normalize_path(file_path) if file_path else None,
        agent_id=agent_id,
    )

    resolved_mode: RoutingMode = routing_mode or ("agent_id" if agent_id else "direct_file")

    return RoutedTask(
        route_id=_build_route_id(agent.agent_id, action_type, target),
        agent_id=agent.agent_id,
        file_path=agent.relative_path,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        routing_mode=resolved_mode,
        priority=_priority_for_agent(agent, action_type),
        summary=_summary_for_route(agent, action_type, resolved_mode),
        tags=agent.tags,
        dependency_scope=sorted(set(dependency_scope or [])),
        client_id=client_id or agent.agent_id,
        session_id=session_id,
    )


def route_and_plan(
    orchestrator: IronClawOrchestrator,
    snapshot: CoordinationSnapshot,
    *,
    action_type: ProtectedAction,
    target: str,
    content: str = "",
    file_path: str | None = None,
    agent_id: str | None = None,
    routing_mode: RoutingMode | None = None,
    dependency_scope: list[str] | None = None,
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    use_guard_api: bool = True,
) -> RoutedTaskResult:
    task = create_routed_task(
        orchestrator,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        file_path=file_path,
        agent_id=agent_id,
        routing_mode=routing_mode,
        dependency_scope=dependency_scope,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
    )

    decision = orchestrator.route_action(
        action_type=task.action_type,
        target=task.target,
        content=task.content,
        file_path=task.file_path,
        agent_id=task.agent_id,
        client_id=task.client_id,
        session_id=task.session_id,
        use_guard_api=use_guard_api,
    )

    execution_plan = build_execution_plan(decision)
    state = get_agent_state(snapshot, task.agent_id)

    return RoutedTaskResult(
        task=task,
        decision=decision,

@dataclass
class ServiceRegistry:
    """
    Lightweight registry/factory for shared service clients.

    This keeps construction in one place so the rest of the app can
    depend on stable, lazilyâ€‘created instances.
    """

    _release_policy_client: Optional[ReleasePolicyClient] = field(
        default=None, init=False, repr=False
    )

    def get_release_policy_client(self) -> ReleasePolicyClient:
        """
        Return a singleton ReleasePolicyClient instance.

        The client is created lazily on first access to avoid import
        cycles during application startup.
        """
        if self._release_policy_client is None:
            self._release_policy_client = ReleasePolicyClient()
        return self._release_policy_client

    """
    Factory for a ServiceRegistry instance.

    Hook this into your app startup so other modules can import a
    single registry and retrieve shared services as needed.

    return ServiceRegistry()
