from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QuarantineBucket:
    name: str
    count: int = 0
    severity: str = "medium"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "count": self.count,
            "severity": self.severity,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QuarantineItem:
    item_id: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    verdict: str
    reason: str
    source: str
    status: str = "quarantined"
    review_required: bool = True
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "item_id": self.item_id,
            "category": self.category,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "source": self.source,
            "status": self.status,
            "review_required": self.review_required,
            "created_at": _isoformat(self.created_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(self.updated_at),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class QuarantineOverview:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    total_items: int = 0
    pending_review: int = 0
    auto_contained: int = 0
    high_severity: int = 0
    critical_severity: int = 0
    oldest_item_age_hours: int = 0
    queue_healthy: bool = True
    escalation_required: bool = False
    buckets: tuple[QuarantineBucket, ...] = ()
    recent_items: tuple[QuarantineItem, ...] = ()
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "total_items": self.total_items,
            "pending_review": self.pending_review,
            "auto_contained": self.auto_contained,
            "high_severity": self.high_severity,
            "critical_severity": self.critical_severity,
            "oldest_item_age_hours": self.oldest_item_age_hours,
            "queue_healthy": self.queue_healthy,
            "escalation_required": self.escalation_required,
            "buckets": [bucket.to_dict() for bucket in self.buckets],
            "recent_items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.recent_items],
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def _normalize_bucket(item: Any) -> QuarantineBucket | None:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return None
    name = _coerce_str(item.get("name"))
    if not name:
        return None
    return QuarantineBucket(
        name=name,
        count=max(0, _coerce_int(item.get("count"), 0)),
        severity=_coerce_str(item.get("severity"), "medium") or "medium",
    )


def _normalize_recent_item(item: Any) -> QuarantineItem | None:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return None

    item_id = _coerce_str(item.get("item_id"))
    if not item_id:
        return None

    created_at = _coerce_datetime(item.get("created_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()
    updated_at = _coerce_datetime(item.get("updated_at"), created_at) or created_at

    return QuarantineItem(
        item_id=item_id,
        category=_coerce_str(item.get("category"), "unknown") or "unknown",
        severity=_coerce_str(item.get("severity"), "medium") or "medium",
        verdict=_coerce_str(item.get("verdict"), "quarantine") or "quarantine",
        reason=_coerce_str(item.get("reason"), "Security policy triggered.") or "Security policy triggered.",
        source=_coerce_str(item.get("source"), "runtime") or "runtime",
        status=_coerce_str(item.get("status"), "quarantined") or "quarantined",
        review_required=_coerce_bool(item.get("review_required"), True),
        created_at=created_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
    )


def _default_buckets() -> tuple[QuarantineBucket, ...]:
    return (
        QuarantineBucket(name="prompt_injection", count=0, severity="high"),
        QuarantineBucket(name="unsafe_tool_call", count=0, severity="critical"),
        QuarantineBucket(name="data_exfiltration", count=0, severity="critical"),
        QuarantineBucket(name="sandbox_violation", count=0, severity="high"),
    )


def default_quarantine_overview() -> QuarantineOverview:
    return QuarantineOverview(buckets=_default_buckets())


def build_quarantine_overview(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: QuarantineOverview | None = None,
) -> QuarantineOverview:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_quarantine_overview()

    raw_buckets = source.get("buckets")
    if isinstance(raw_buckets, list):
        normalized_buckets = tuple(bucket for item in raw_buckets if (bucket := _normalize_bucket(item)) is not None)
        buckets = normalized_buckets or current.buckets
    else:
        buckets = current.buckets

    raw_recent_items = source.get("recent_items")
    if isinstance(raw_recent_items, list):
        normalized_items = tuple(item for entry in raw_recent_items if (item := _normalize_recent_item(entry)) is not None)
        recent_items = normalized_items
    else:
        recent_items = current.recent_items

    total_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("total_items"), current.total_items))
    pending_review = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("pending_review"), current.pending_review))
    auto_contained = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("auto_contained"), current.auto_contained))
    high_severity = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("high_severity"), current.high_severity))
    critical_severity = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("critical_severity"), current.critical_severity))
    oldest_item_age_hours = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("oldest_item_age_hours"), current.oldest_item_age_hours))

    queue_healthy = _coerce_bool(source.get("queue_healthy"), current.queue_healthy)
    escalation_required = _coerce_bool(
        source.get("escalation_required"),
        current.escalation_required or critical_severity > 0 or pending_review > 25,
    )

    checked_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    return QuarantineOverview(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        total_items=total_items,
        pending_review=pending_review,
        auto_contained=auto_contained,
        high_severity=high_severity,
        critical_severity=critical_severity,
        oldest_item_age_hours=oldest_item_age_hours,
        queue_healthy=queue_healthy,
        escalation_required=escalation_required,
        buckets=buckets,
        recent_items=recent_items,
        checked_at=checked_at,
    )


def quarantine_overview_summary(overview: QuarantineOverview) -> dict[str, Any]:
    review_required_items = sum(1 for item in overview.recent_items if item.review_required)
    active_buckets = [bucket.to_dict() for bucket in overview.buckets if bucket.count > 0]

    return {
        "service": overview.service,
        "environment": overview.environment,
        "queue_healthy": overview.queue_healthy,
        "escalation_required": overview.escalation_required,
        "counts": {
            "total_items": overview.total_items,
            "pending_review": overview.pending_review,
            "auto_contained": overview.auto_contained,
            "high_severity": overview.high_severity,
            "critical_severity": overview.critical_severity,
            "review_required_recent_items": review_required_items,
        },
        "timing": {
            "oldest_item_age_hours": overview.oldest_item_age_hours,
            "checked_at": _isoformat(overview.checked_at),
        },
        "active_buckets": active_buckets,
        "recent_items": [item.to_dict() for item in overview.recent_items],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from app.supabaseclient import (
    SupabaseAPIError,
    SupabaseClient,
    SupabaseConfigurationError,
    SupabaseConnectionError,
    createsupabaseclient,
)

TABLE_NAME = "scan_history"
MAX_LIST_LIMIT = 500
DEFAULT_LIST_LIMIT = 50


class ScanHistoryRepositoryError(Exception):
    pass


class ScanHistoryRepositoryConnectionError(ScanHistoryRepositoryError):
    pass


class ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError(ScanHistoryRepositoryError):
    pass


def _translate_error(exc: Exception) -> None:
    if isinstance(exc, SupabaseConnectionError):
        raise ScanHistoryRepositoryConnectionError(str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, SupabaseAPIError):
        raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError(str(exc)) from exc
    if isinstance(exc, SupabaseConfigurationError):
        raise ScanHistoryRepositoryConnectionError(str(exc)) from exc
    raise exc


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _clean_text(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int | None = None) -> int | None:
    if value is None:
        return default
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _safe_limit(value: Any, *, default: int = DEFAULT_LIST_LIMIT) -> int:
    parsed = _safe_int(value, default)
    if parsed is None:
        parsed = default
    return max(1, min(parsed, MAX_LIST_LIMIT))


def _normalize_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    text = str(value).strip().lower()
    if text in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
        return True
    if text in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}:
        return False
    return default


def _normalize_record(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    scan_id = _clean_text(row.get("scan_id") or row.get("scanid"))
    verdict = _clean_text(row.get("verdict"))
    review_status = _clean_text(row.get("review_status") or row.get("reviewstatus")) or "none"

    risk_score = _safe_int(row.get("risk_score", row.get("riskscore")), 0)
    if risk_score is not None:
        risk_score = max(0, min(100, risk_score))

    target_value = row.get("target_value", row.get("targetvalue"))
    if target_value is not None:
        target_value = str(target_value)[:5000]

    normalized = {
        "id": row.get("id"),
        "created_at": row.get("created_at") or row.get("createdat"),
        "scan_id": scan_id,
        "target_type": _clean_text(row.get("target_type") or row.get("targettype")),
        "target_value": target_value,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "risk_score": risk_score,
        "matched_patterns": _as_list(row.get("matched_patterns", row.get("matchedpatterns"))),
        "summary": _clean_text(row.get("summary")) or "",
        "risky_files": _as_list(row.get("risky_files", row.get("riskyfiles"))),
        "checks_loaded": _as_list(row.get("checks_loaded", row.get("checksloaded"))),
        "failed_checks": _as_list(row.get("failed_checks", row.get("failedchecks"))),
        "quarantine_reason": _clean_text(row.get("quarantine_reason") or row.get("quarantinereason")),
        "review_status": review_status,
        "reviewer": _clean_text(row.get("reviewer")),
        "reviewed_at": row.get("reviewed_at") or row.get("reviewedat"),
        "untrusted": _normalize_bool(row.get("untrusted"), default=verdict == "quarantine"),
        "sandbox_lane": _clean_text(row.get("sandbox_lane") or row.get("sandboxlane")) or "none",
        "timestamp": row.get("timestamp"),
        "max_severity": _clean_text(row.get("max_severity") or row.get("maxseverity")),
        "primary_category": _clean_text(row.get("primary_category") or row.get("primarycategory")),
        "explanation": _clean_text(row.get("explanation")),
        "source": _clean_text(row.get("source")),
        "session_id": _clean_text(row.get("session_id") or row.get("sessionid")),
        "user_id": _clean_text(row.get("user_id") or row.get("userid")),
        "context": row.get("context"),
    }

    return normalized


def _db_payload(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized = _normalize_record(record)

    payload = {
        "scan_id": normalized["scan_id"],
        "target_type": normalized["target_type"],
        "target_value": normalized["target_value"],
        "verdict": normalized["verdict"],
        "risk_score": normalized["risk_score"],
        "matched_patterns": normalized["matched_patterns"],
        "summary": normalized["summary"],
        "risky_files": normalized["risky_files"],
        "checks_loaded": normalized["checks_loaded"],
        "failed_checks": normalized["failed_checks"],
        "quarantine_reason": normalized["quarantine_reason"],
        "review_status": normalized["review_status"],
        "reviewer": normalized["reviewer"],
        "reviewed_at": normalized["reviewed_at"],
        "untrusted": normalized["untrusted"],
        "sandbox_lane": normalized["sandbox_lane"],
        "timestamp": normalized["timestamp"],
        "max_severity": normalized["max_severity"],
        "primary_category": normalized["primary_category"],
        "explanation": normalized["explanation"],
        "source": normalized["source"],
        "session_id": normalized["session_id"],
        "user_id": normalized["user_id"],
        "context": normalized["context"],
    }

    if not payload["scan_id"]:
        raise ValueError("scan_id is required")
    if not payload["target_type"]:
        raise ValueError("target_type is required")
    if payload["target_value"] is None:
        raise ValueError("target_value is required")
    if not payload["verdict"]:
        raise ValueError("verdict is required")
    if payload["risk_score"] is None:
        payload["risk_score"] = 0

    return payload


class ScanHistoryRepository:
    def __init__(
        self,
        client: SupabaseClient | None = None,
        table_name: str = TABLE_NAME,
    ) -> None:
        self.client = client or createsupabaseclient()
        self.table_name = table_name

    def list_items(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = DEFAULT_LIST_LIMIT,
        verdict: str | None = None,
        sandbox_lane: str | None = None,
        review_status: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        user_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        safe_limit = _safe_limit(limit)
        filters: dict[str, Any] = {}

        cleaned_verdict = _clean_text(verdict)
        cleaned_sandbox_lane = _clean_text(sandbox_lane)
        cleaned_review_status = _clean_text(review_status)
        cleaned_session_id = _clean_text(session_id)
        cleaned_user_id = _clean_text(user_id)

        if cleaned_verdict is not None:
            filters["verdict"] = cleaned_verdict
        if cleaned_sandbox_lane is not None:
            filters["sandbox_lane"] = cleaned_sandbox_lane
        if cleaned_review_status is not None:
            filters["review_status"] = cleaned_review_status
        if cleaned_session_id is not None:
            filters["session_id"] = cleaned_session_id
        if cleaned_user_id is not None:
            filters["user_id"] = cleaned_user_id

        try:
            result = self.client.select(
                self.table_name,
                filters=filters or None,
                limit=safe_limit,
                order=("timestamp", "desc"),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _translate_error(exc)

        if not isinstance(result, list):
            raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError("Unexpected response format from scan_history list query.")

        return [_normalize_record(item) for item in result if isinstance(item, dict)]

    def get_by_scan_id(self, scan_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        value = _clean_text(scan_id)
        if not value:
            return None

        try:
            result = self.client.select(
                self.table_name,
                filters={"scan_id": value},
                limit=1,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _translate_error(exc)

        if not isinstance(result, list):
            raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError("Unexpected response format from scan_history lookup.")

        if not result:
            return None

        first = result[0]
        if not isinstance(first, dict):
            raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError("Unexpected row format from scan_history lookup.")

        return _normalize_record(first)

    def upsert(self, record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = _db_payload(record)

        existing = self.get_by_scan_id(payload["scan_id"])
        if existing is None:
            try:
                result = self.client.insert(self.table_name, payload)
            except Exception as exc:
                _translate_error(exc)

            if isinstance(result, list) and result:
                first = result[0]
                if isinstance(first, dict):
                    return _normalize_record(first)

            if isinstance(result, dict):
                return _normalize_record(result)

            created = self.get_by_scan_id(payload["scan_id"])
            if created is not None:
                return created

            raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError("Unexpected response format from scan_history insert.")

        try:
            result = self.client.update(
                self.table_name,
                payload=payload,
                filters={"scan_id": payload["scan_id"]},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _translate_error(exc)

        if isinstance(result, list) and result:
            first = result[0]
            if isinstance(first, dict):
                return _normalize_record(first)

        if isinstance(result, dict):
            return _normalize_record(result)

        refreshed = self.get_by_scan_id(payload["scan_id"])
        if refreshed is not None:
            return refreshed

        raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError("Unexpected response format from scan_history upsert.")

    def update(self, scan_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        value = _clean_text(scan_id)
        if not value:
            return None

        current = self.get_by_scan_id(value)
        if current is None:
            return None

        merged = {**current, **dict(updates)}
        payload = _db_payload(merged)
        payload["scan_id"] = value

        try:
            result = self.client.update(
                self.table_name,
                payload=payload,
                filters={"scan_id": value},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _translate_error(exc)

        if isinstance(result, list) and result:
            first = result[0]
            if isinstance(first, dict):
                return _normalize_record(first)

        if isinstance(result, dict):
            return _normalize_record(result)

        refreshed = self.get_by_scan_id(value)
        if refreshed is not None:
            return refreshed

        raise ScanHistoryRepositoryAPIError("Unexpected response format from scan_history update.")

    def reset(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.client.delete(
                self.table_name,
                filters={"id": "not.is.null"},
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _translate_error(exc)


def build_scan_history_repository() -> ScanHistoryRepository:
    return ScanHistoryRepository()


def create_scan_history_repository() -> ScanHistoryRepository:
    return build_scan_history_repository()


def get_scan_history_repository() -> ScanHistoryRepository:
    return build_scan_history_repository()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.review.reviewqueueservice import ReviewPriority, ReviewQueueItem, ReviewQueueService


class IncidentRecord(BaseModel):
    incident_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    summary: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    severity: str = Field(default="medium")
    session_id: str | None = None
    artifact_id: str | None = None
    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)


class IncidentReviewEscalationResult(BaseModel):
    incident_id: str
    review_id: str
    queued: bool
    priority: str
    status: str


class IncidentService:
    def __init__(self, review_queue: ReviewQueueService | None = None) -> None:
        self._review_queue = review_queue or ReviewQueueService()
        self._incidents: dict[str, IncidentRecord] = {}

    def get(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord | None:
        return self._incidents.get(incident_id)

    def list_incidents(self) -> list[IncidentRecord]:
        return list(self._incidents.values())

    def register_incident(self, incident: IncidentRecord) -> IncidentRecord:
        self._incidents[incident.incident_id] = incident
        return incident

    def register_and_escalate(self, incident: IncidentRecord) -> IncidentReviewEscalationResult:
        self.register_incident(incident)
        review_item = self.escalate_to_review_queue(incident.incident_id)
        return IncidentReviewEscalationResult(
            incident_id=incident.incident_id,
            review_id=review_item.review_id,
            queued=True,
            priority=review_item.priority.value,
            status=review_item.status.value,
        )

    def escalate_to_review_queue(self, incident_id: str) -> ReviewQueueItem:
        incident = self._incidents.get(incident_id)
        if incident is None:
            raise KeyError(f"incident not found: {incident_id}")

        review_item = self._review_queue.escalate_incident(
            incident_id=incident.incident_id,
            priority=self._severity_to_priority(incident.severity).value,
            title=incident.title,
            summary=incident.summary,
            reasons=self._build_reasons(incident),
            evidence=self._build_evidence(incident),
        )
        return review_item

    def _severity_to_priority(self, severity: str) -> ReviewPriority:
        normalized = (severity or "medium").strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"critical", "sev0", "sev-0", "p0"}:
            return ReviewPriority.CRITICAL
        if normalized in {"high", "sev1", "sev-1", "p1"}:
            return ReviewPriority.HIGH
        if normalized in {"low", "sev3", "sev-3", "p3"}:
            return ReviewPriority.LOW
        return ReviewPriority.MEDIUM

    def _build_reasons(self, incident: IncidentRecord) -> list[str]:
        reasons = list(incident.reasons)
        reasons.append(f"severity:{incident.severity.lower()}")
        if incident.session_id:
            reasons.append(f"session:{incident.session_id}")
        if incident.artifact_id:
            reasons.append(f"artifact:{incident.artifact_id}")
        return self._dedupe_strings(reasons)

    def _build_evidence(self, incident: IncidentRecord) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        evidence = list(incident.evidence)
        if incident.session_id:
            evidence.append({"type": "session", "session_id": incident.session_id})
        if incident.artifact_id:
            evidence.append({"type": "artifact", "artifact_id": incident.artifact_id})
        evidence.append(
            {
                "type": "incident",
                "incident_id": incident.incident_id,
                "severity": incident.severity,
                "title": incident.title,
            }
        )
        return self._dedupe_dicts(evidence)

    def _dedupe_strings(self, values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        seen: set[str] = set()
        result: list[str] = []
        for value in values:
            if not value or value in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(value)
            result.append(value)
        return result

    def _dedupe_dicts(self, values: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        seen: set[tuple[Any, ...]] = set()
        result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for value in values:
            frozen = self._freeze(value)
            if frozen in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(frozen)
            result.append(value)
        return result

    def _freeze(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return tuple(sorted((k, self._freeze(v)) for k, v in value.items()))
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return tuple(self._freeze(v) for v in value)
        if isinstance(value, set):
            return tuple(sorted(self._freeze(v) for v in value))
        return value

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


DEFAULT_INCIDENT_STATUS = "open"
DEFAULT_INCIDENT_SEVERITY = "medium"
ESCALATED_INCIDENT_SEVERITY = "high"
CRITICAL_INCIDENT_SEVERITY = "critical"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IncidentRecord:
    incident_id: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    status: str
    severity: str
    risk_score: int
    client_id: str
    session_id: str
    source: str
    summary: str
    reason: str
    review_item_id: str | None = None
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _derive_severity(risk_score: int) -> str:
    if risk_score >= 90:
        return CRITICAL_INCIDENT_SEVERITY
    if risk_score >= 75:
        return ESCALATED_INCIDENT_SEVERITY
    return DEFAULT_INCIDENT_SEVERITY


def _build_incident_id(source: str, session_id: str, created_at: str) -> str:
    normalized_source = (source or "incident").replace(" ", "_").lower()
    normalized_session = (session_id or "unknown").replace(" ", "_").lower()
    compact_time = created_at.replace(":", "").replace("-", "").replace(".", "")
    return f"{normalized_source}-{normalized_session}-{compact_time}"


def create_incident_record(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> IncidentRecord:
    created_at = _utc_now()
    updated_at = created_at

    risk_score = _safe_int(payload.get("risk_score"), 0)
    source = str(payload.get("source") or "security_runtime")
    session_id = str(payload.get("session_id") or "")
    client_id = str(payload.get("client_id") or "")
    summary = str(payload.get("summary") or payload.get("reason") or "Security incident detected")
    reason = str(payload.get("reason") or "Security incident recorded by incident service")
    incident_id = str(payload.get("incident_id") or _build_incident_id(source, session_id, created_at))

    raw_patterns = payload.get("matched_patterns") or []
    matched_patterns = (
        [str(item) for item in raw_patterns] if isinstance(raw_patterns, list) else [str(raw_patterns)]
    )

    raw_failed_checks = payload.get("failed_checks") or []
    failed_checks = (
        [str(item) for item in raw_failed_checks]
        if isinstance(raw_failed_checks, list)
        else [str(raw_failed_checks)]
    )

    return IncidentRecord(
        incident_id=incident_id,
        created_at=created_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
        status=str(payload.get("status") or DEFAULT_INCIDENT_STATUS),
        severity=str(payload.get("severity") or _derive_severity(risk_score)),
        risk_score=risk_score,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        source=source,
        summary=summary,
        reason=reason,
        review_item_id=str(payload["review_item_id"]) if payload.get("review_item_id") is not None else None,
        matched_patterns=matched_patterns,
        failed_checks=failed_checks,
        payload=dict(payload),
        metadata={"service": "incident_service"},
    )


def summarize_incident_record(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_incident_record(payload).to_dict()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


DEFAULT_FILE_PATH = "app/api/action_execute.py"
ALLOW_VERDICT = "allow"
WARN_VERDICT = "warn"
BLOCK_VERDICT = "block"
REVIEW_VERDICT = "review"

EXECUTED_STATE = "executed"
DENIED_STATE = "denied"

STATUS_COMPLETED = "completed"
STATUS_QUEUED = "queued_for_review"
STATUS_DENIED = "denied"

ACTION_ALLOW = "allow"
ACTION_REVIEW = "review"
ACTION_BLOCK = "block"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ExecutionReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        data: dict[str, Any] = {
            "source": self.source,
            "label": self.label,
            "details": self.details,
        }
        if self.score is not None:
            data["score"] = self.score
        return data


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ActionExecuteResult:
    execution_id: str
    execution_state: str
    response_action: str
    response_status: str
    trace_id: str
    request_id: str
    decision_id: str
    policy_verdict: str
    risk_score: int
    should_execute: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    review_item_id: str | None
    executor_name: str | None
    executor_result: dict[str, Any] | None
    reason: str
    reasons: list[ExecutionReason]
    filepath: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "execution_id": self.execution_id,
            "execution_state": self.execution_state,
            "response_action": self.response_action,
            "response_status": self.response_status,
            "trace_id": self.trace_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "decision_id": self.decision_id,
            "policy_verdict": self.policy_verdict,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "should_execute": self.should_execute,
            "halted_by_boundary": self.halted_by_boundary,
            "review_item_id": self.review_item_id,
            "executor_name": self.executor_name,
            "executor_result": self.executor_result,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "reasons": [item.to_dict() for item in self.reasons],
            "filepath": self.filepath,
        }


def _safe_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None


def _build_reasons(summary: dict[str, Any], risk_score: int) -> list[ExecutionReason]:
    raw_reasons = summary.get("reasons")
    reasons: list[ExecutionReason] = []

    if isinstance(raw_reasons, list):
        for item in raw_reasons:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                reasons.append(
                    ExecutionReason(
                        source=str(item.get("source") or "policy"),
                        label=str(item.get("label") or "decision"),
                        details=str(item.get("details") or summary.get("reason") or "Decision recorded"),
                        score=int(item["score"]) if item.get("score") is not None else None,
                    )
                )
            else:
                reasons.append(
                    ExecutionReason(
                        source="policy",
                        label="decision",
                        details=str(item),
                        score=risk_score,
                    )
                )

    if reasons:
        return reasons

    return [
        ExecutionReason(
            source="policy",
            label="decision",
            details=str(summary.get("reason") or "Decision recorded"),
            score=risk_score,
        )
    ]


def _normalize_summary(summary: dict[str, Any], risk_score: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    policy_verdict = str(summary.get("policyverdict") or summary.get("policy_verdict") or "").lower()

    if policy_verdict in {"block", "quarantine", "deny", "denied"}:
        return {
            "execution_state": DENIED_STATE,
            "response_action": ACTION_BLOCK,
            "response_status": STATUS_DENIED,
            "policy_verdict": BLOCK_VERDICT,
            "should_execute": False,
            "halted_by_boundary": True,
            "review_item_id": summary.get("reviewitemid") or summary.get("review_item_id"),
            "reason": str(summary.get("reason") or "Blocked by policy boundary"),
        }

    if policy_verdict in {"hold", "review", "warn"}:
        return {
            "execution_state": DENIED_STATE,
            "response_action": ACTION_REVIEW,
            "response_status": STATUS_QUEUED,
            "policy_verdict": REVIEW_VERDICT if policy_verdict == "review" else WARN_VERDICT,
            "should_execute": False,
            "halted_by_boundary": True,
            "review_item_id": summary.get("reviewitemid") or summary.get("review_item_id"),
            "reason": str(summary.get("reason") or "Queued for review"),
        }

    return {
        "execution_state": EXECUTED_STATE,
        "response_action": ACTION_ALLOW,
        "response_status": STATUS_COMPLETED,
        "policy_verdict": ALLOW_VERDICT,
        "should_execute": True,
        "halted_by_boundary": False,
        "review_item_id": summary.get("reviewitemid") or summary.get("review_item_id"),
        "reason": str(summary.get("reason") or "Execution completed"),
    }


def evaluate_policy_result(
    summary: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    risk_score: int,
    filepath: str | None = None,
) -> ActionExecuteResult:
    normalized = _normalize_summary(summary, risk_score)
    reasons = _build_reasons(summary, risk_score)

    executor_name_raw = summary.get("executorname") or summary.get("executor_name")
    executor_name = str(executor_name_raw).replace("_", "").lower() if executor_name_raw else None

    return ActionExecuteResult(
        execution_id=str(summary.get("executionid") or summary.get("execution_id") or ""),
        execution_state=normalized["execution_state"],
        response_action=normalized["response_action"],
        response_status=normalized["response_status"],
        trace_id=str(summary.get("traceid") or summary.get("trace_id") or ""),
        request_id=str(summary.get("requestid") or summary.get("request_id") or ""),
        decision_id=str(summary.get("decisionid") or summary.get("decision_id") or ""),
        policy_verdict=normalized["policy_verdict"],
        risk_score=risk_score,
        should_execute=normalized["should_execute"],
        halted_by_boundary=normalized["halted_by_boundary"],
        review_item_id=normalized["review_item_id"],
        executor_name=executor_name,
        executor_result=_safe_dict(summary.get("executorresult") or summary.get("executor_result")),
        reason=normalized["reason"],
        reasons=reasons,
        filepath=filepath or DEFAULT_FILE_PATH,
    )


def summarize_policy_result(
    summary: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    risk_score: int,
    filepath: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_policy_result(summary, risk_score=risk_score, filepath=filepath).to_dict()

from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any


DEFAULT_POLICY_ACTION = "allow"
DEFAULT_OVERRIDE_REASON = "manual review override"
OVERRIDE_SOURCE = "policy_override_service"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyOverrideResult:
    action: str
    reason: str
    policy_id: str | None = None
    matched_rule_ids: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    overridden_fields: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    return str(value).strip()


def _normalize_string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]
    text = str(value).strip()
    return [text] if text else []


def _extract_override_fields(override_payload: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    tracked_fields = ("action", "reason", "policy_id", "matched_rule_ids")
    return [field_name for field_name in tracked_fields if override_payload.get(field_name) not in (None, "", [])]


def build_policy_override_result(override_payload: dict[str, Any] | None) -> PolicyOverrideResult:
    payload = override_payload or {}

    action = _normalize_string(payload.get("action"), DEFAULT_POLICY_ACTION) or DEFAULT_POLICY_ACTION
    reason = _normalize_string(payload.get("reason"), DEFAULT_OVERRIDE_REASON) or DEFAULT_OVERRIDE_REASON
    policy_id_raw = _normalize_string(payload.get("policy_id"))
    policy_id = policy_id_raw or None
    matched_rule_ids = _normalize_string_list(payload.get("matched_rule_ids"))
    overridden_fields = _extract_override_fields(payload)

    metadata = deepcopy(payload.get("metadata") or {})
    metadata["source"] = OVERRIDE_SOURCE

    return PolicyOverrideResult(
        action=action,
        reason=reason,
        policy_id=policy_id,
        matched_rule_ids=matched_rule_ids,
        overridden_fields=overridden_fields,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def apply_policy_override(
    review_result: dict[str, Any],
    override_payload: dict[str, Any] | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result = deepcopy(review_result)
    override = build_policy_override_result(override_payload)

    result["action"] = override.action
    result["reason"] = override.reason

    if override.policy_id is not None:
        result["policy_id"] = override.policy_id
    if override.matched_rule_ids:
        result["matched_rule_ids"] = override.matched_rule_ids

    result["policy_override"] = override.to_dict()
    return result


__all__ = [
    "DEFAULT_POLICY_ACTION",
    "DEFAULT_OVERRIDE_REASON",
    "OVERRIDE_SOURCE",
    "PolicyOverrideResult",
    "build_policy_override_result",
    "apply_policy_override",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from app.services.incidentstore import build_incident_store
from app.services.quarantinestore import build_quarantine_store


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _mapping(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: val
            for key, val in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(val)
        }
    raise TypeError("value is not serializable to dict")


def _listify(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _normalize_priority(value: str | None, *, severity: str | None = None) -> str:
    priority = _string(value).lower()
    if priority:
        return priority
    severity_value = _string(severity).lower()
    if severity_value in {"critical", "high", "medium", "low"}:
        return severity_value
    return "medium"


def _normalize_status(value: str | None) -> str:
    status = _string(value).lower()
    if status:
        return status
    return "pending"


def _normalize_queue_item(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    review_id: str | None = None,
    incident_id: str | None = None,
    quarantine_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    item_type: str | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
    summary: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    priority: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,
    assigned_to: str | None = None,
    requested_by: str | None = None,
    verdict: str | None = None,
    tags: list[Any] | None = None,
    evidence: list[Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    created_at: str | None = None,
    updated_at: str | None = None,
    due_at: str | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _mapping(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_review_id = (
        _string(review_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("review_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_incident_id = (
        _string(incident_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("incident_id"))
    )
    resolved_quarantine_id = (
        _string(quarantine_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("quarantine_id"))
    )

    resolved_item_type = (
        _string(item_type)
        or _string(source_payload.get("item_type"))
        or ("incident" if resolved_incident_id else "quarantine" if resolved_quarantine_id else "review")
    )

    resolved_severity = (
        _string(severity)
        or _string(source_payload.get("severity"))
        or "medium"
    )

    resolved_priority = _normalize_priority(
        priority or source_payload.get("priority"),
        severity=resolved_severity,
    )

    resolved_status = _normalize_status(status or source_payload.get("status"))

    resolved_title = (
        _string(title)
        or _string(source_payload.get("title"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("summary"))
        or f"{resolved_item_type.title()} review"
    )

    resolved_summary = (
        _string(summary)
        or _string(source_payload.get("summary"))
        or resolved_title
    )

    resolved_created_at = _string(created_at) or _string(source_payload.get("created_at")) or _utc_now()
    resolved_updated_at = _string(updated_at) or _string(source_payload.get("updated_at")) or resolved_created_at

    return {
        "review_id": resolved_review_id,
        "id": resolved_review_id,
        "incident_id": resolved_incident_id or None,
        "quarantine_id": resolved_quarantine_id or None,
        "organization_id": _string(organization_id) or _string(source_payload.get("organization_id")) or None,
        "owner_id": _string(owner_id) or _string(source_payload.get("owner_id")) or None,
        "item_type": resolved_item_type,
        "title": resolved_title,
        "summary": resolved_summary,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "priority": resolved_priority,
        "severity": resolved_severity,
        "source": _string(source) or _string(source_payload.get("source")) or "ironclaw",
        "category": _string(category) or _string(source_payload.get("category")) or resolved_item_type,
        "assigned_to": _string(assigned_to) or _string(source_payload.get("assigned_to")) or None,
        "requested_by": _string(requested_by) or _string(source_payload.get("requested_by")) or None,
        "verdict": _string(verdict) or _string(source_payload.get("verdict")) or "pending",
        "tags": _listify(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),
        "evidence": _listify(evidence if evidence is not None else source_payload.get("evidence")),
        "metadata": metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("metadata")),
        "created_at": resolved_created_at,
        "updated_at": resolved_updated_at,
        "due_at": _string(due_at) or _string(source_payload.get("due_at")) or None,
    }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewQueueService:
    incident_store: Any = field(default_factory=build_incident_store)
    quarantine_store: Any = field(default_factory=build_quarantine_store)
    _items: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ready": True,
            "size": len(self._items),
            "stores": {
                "incident_store": bool(self.incident_store),
                "quarantine_store": bool(self.quarantine_store),
            },
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def submit(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        item = _normalize_queue_item(payload, **kwargs)
        self._items[item["review_id"]] = item
        return dict(item)

    def enqueue(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.submit(payload, **kwargs)

    def create_review(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.submit(payload, **kwargs)

    def queue_incident_review(
        self,
        incident_id: str,
        *,
        priority: str | None = None,
        assigned_to: str | None = None,
        requested_by: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        incident = self.incident_store.get_incident(incident_id)
        if incident is None:
            raise ValueError("incident not found")

        return self.submit(
            {
                "incident_id": incident_id,
                "item_type": "incident",
                "title": _string(incident.get("title")) or "Incident review",
                "summary": _string(incident.get("summary")) or _string(incident.get("description")) or "Incident review required",
                "severity": _string(incident.get("severity")) or "medium",
                "priority": priority or _string(incident.get("priority")) or _string(incident.get("severity")) or "medium",
                "organization_id": _string(incident.get("organization_id")),
                "owner_id": _string(incident.get("owner_id")),
                "source": _string(incident.get("source")) or "incident_store",
                "category": _string(incident.get("category")) or "incident",
                "assigned_to": assigned_to,
                "requested_by": requested_by,
                "metadata": metadata or {"origin": "incident_store"},
                "evidence": incident.get("evidence") or [],
                "tags": incident.get("tags") or [],
            }
        )

    def queue_quarantine_review(

                "item_type": "quarantine",

    def list_reviews(
        self,
        *,
        status: str | None = None,
        assigned_to: str | None = None,
        priority: str | None = None,
        item_type: str | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 100,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        items = list(self._items.values())

        if status:
            wanted = _normalize_status(status)
            items = [item for item in items if _normalize_status(item.get("status")) == wanted]
        if assigned_to:
            items = [item for item in items if _string(item.get("assigned_to")) == _string(assigned_to)]
        if priority:
            wanted = _normalize_priority(priority)
            items = [item for item in items if _normalize_priority(item.get("priority")) == wanted]
        if item_type:
            items = [item for item in items if _string(item.get("item_type")) == _string(item_type)]
        if organization_id:
            items = [item for item in items if _string(item.get("organization_id")) == _string(organization_id)]

        items.sort(
            key=lambda item: (
                item.get("priority") == "critical",
                item.get("priority") == "high",
                _string(item.get("updated_at")),
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return [dict(item) for item in items[:limit]]

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_reviews(**kwargs)

    def get_review(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        key = _string(review_id)
        if not key:
            raise ValueError("review_id is required")
        item = self._items.get(key)
        return dict(item) if item else None

    def get(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_review(review_id)

    def assign_review(self, review_id: str, assigned_to: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        item = self._items.get(_string(review_id))
        if item is None:
            return None
        item["assigned_to"] = _string(assigned_to) or None
        item["status"] = "in_review"
        item["updated_at"] = _utc_now()
        self._items[item["review_id"]] = item
        return dict(item)

    def start_review(self, review_id: str, *, assigned_to: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        item = self._items.get(_string(review_id))
        if item is None:
            return None
        if assigned_to is not None:
            item["assigned_to"] = _string(assigned_to) or None
        item["status"] = "in_review"
        item["updated_at"] = _utc_now()
        self._items[item["review_id"]] = item
        return dict(item)

    def complete_review(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        verdict: str,
        notes: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        item = self._items.get(_string(review_id))
        if item is None:
            return None

        item["status"] = "completed"
        item["verdict"] = _string(verdict) or "completed"
        item["updated_at"] = _utc_now()

        merged_metadata = _mapping(item.get("metadata"))
        if notes is not None:
            merged_metadata["notes"] = notes
        if metadata:
            merged_metadata.update(metadata)
        item["metadata"] = merged_metadata

        self._items[item["review_id"]] = item

        incident_id = _string(item.get("incident_id"))
        quarantine_id = _string(item.get("quarantine_id"))

        if incident_id:
            incident_updates: dict[str, Any] = {
                "verdict": item["verdict"],
                "status": "resolved" if item["verdict"] in {"allow", "approved", "resolved"} else "in_progress",
                "metadata": {"review_id": item["review_id"], **merged_metadata},
            }
            self.incident_store.update_incident(incident_id, incident_updates)

        if quarantine_id:
            if item["verdict"] in {"allow", "approved", "release", "released", "restore", "restored"}:
                self.quarantine_store.release_item(
                    quarantine_id,
                    verdict=item["verdict"],
                    metadata={"review_id": item["review_id"], **merged_metadata},
                )
            elif item["verdict"] in {"block", "blocked", "purge", "purged"}:
                self.quarantine_store.purge_item(
                    quarantine_id,
                    verdict=item["verdict"],
                )

        return dict(item)

    def reject_review(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        notes: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        item = self._items.get(_string(review_id))
        if item is None:
            return None
        merged_metadata = _mapping(item.get("metadata"))
        if notes is not None:
            merged_metadata["notes"] = notes
        if metadata:
            merged_metadata.update(metadata)
        item["metadata"] = merged_metadata
        item["status"] = "rejected"
        item["verdict"] = "rejected"
        item["updated_at"] = _utc_now()
        self._items[item["review_id"]] = item
        return dict(item)

    def cancel_review(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        item = self._items.get(_string(review_id))
        if item is None:
            return None
        item["status"] = "cancelled"
        item["updated_at"] = _utc_now()
        self._items[item["review_id"]] = item
        return dict(item)

    def delete_review(self, review_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        key = _string(review_id)
        if not key:
            raise ValueError("review_id is required")
        item = self._items.pop(key, None)
        return dict(item) if item else None

    def summarize(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        items = list(self._items.values())
        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_priority: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_type: dict[str, int] = {}

        for item in items:
            status = _normalize_status(item.get("status"))
            priority = _normalize_priority(item.get("priority"))
            item_type = _string(item.get("item_type"), "review")

            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1
            by_priority[priority] = by_priority.get(priority, 0) + 1
            by_type[item_type] = by_type.get(item_type, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total": len(items),
            "pending": by_status.get("pending", 0),
            "in_review": by_status.get("in_review", 0),
            "completed": by_status.get("completed", 0),
            "rejected": by_status.get("rejected", 0),
            "cancelled": by_status.get("cancelled", 0),
            "by_status": by_status,
            "by_priority": by_priority,
            "by_type": by_type,
        }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATUS = "pending"
DEFAULT_REVIEW_PRIORITY = "normal"
ESCALATED_REVIEW_PRIORITY = "high"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewQueueItem:
    review_item_id: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    review_status: str
    priority: str
    risk_score: int
    client_id: str
    session_id: str
    source: str
    summary: str
    reason: str
    payload: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _build_review_item_id(source: str, session_id: str, created_at: str) -> str:
    normalized_source = (source or "review").replace(" ", "_").lower()
    normalized_session = (session_id or "unknown").replace(" ", "_").lower()
    compact_time = created_at.replace(":", "").replace("-", "").replace(".", "")
    return f"{normalized_source}-{normalized_session}-{compact_time}"


def _derive_priority(risk_score: int) -> str:
    if risk_score >= 80:
        return ESCALATED_REVIEW_PRIORITY
    return DEFAULT_REVIEW_PRIORITY


def create_review_queue_item(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    created_at = _utc_now()
    updated_at = created_at

    risk_score = _safe_int(payload.get("risk_score"), 0)
    source = str(payload.get("source") or "runtime_guard")
    session_id = str(payload.get("session_id") or "")
    client_id = str(payload.get("client_id") or "")
    summary = str(payload.get("summary") or payload.get("reason") or "Review required")
    reason = str(payload.get("reason") or "Review required due to guarded security decision")
    review_item_id = str(payload.get("review_item_id") or _build_review_item_id(source, session_id, created_at))

    raw_tags = payload.get("tags") or []
    tags = [str(tag) for tag in raw_tags] if isinstance(raw_tags, list) else [str(raw_tags)]

    return ReviewQueueItem(
        review_item_id=review_item_id,
        created_at=created_at,
        updated_at=updated_at,
        review_status=str(payload.get("review_status") or DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATUS),
        priority=str(payload.get("priority") or _derive_priority(risk_score)),
        risk_score=risk_score,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        source=source,
        summary=summary,
        reason=reason,
        payload=dict(payload),
        tags=tags,
        metadata={"service": "review_queue_service"},
    )


def summarize_review_queue_item(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_review_queue_item(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATUS",
    "DEFAULT_REVIEW_PRIORITY",
    "ESCALATED_REVIEW_PRIORITY",
    "ReviewQueueItem",
    "create_review_queue_item",
    "summarize_review_queue_item",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


def _coerce_list_of_str(value: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        normalized = []
        for item in value:
            text = _coerce_str(item)
            if text:
                normalized.append(text)
        return tuple(normalized)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        return (text,) if text else ()
    return ()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReviewFinding:
    code: str
    title: str
    severity: str
    confidence: str
    status: str
    summary: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "code": self.code,
            "title": self.title,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "status": self.status,
            "summary": self.summary,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReviewEvidence:

    label: str
    value: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "kind": self.kind,
            "label": self.label,
            "value": self.value,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReviewTimelineEvent:
    at: datetime
    stage: str
    actor: str
    detail: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "at": _isoformat(self.at),
            "stage": self.stage,
            "actor": self.actor,
            "detail": self.detail,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReviewDetail:
    review_id: str
    title: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    verdict: str
    status: str
    source: str
    assignee: str = ""
    summary: str = ""
    rationale: str = ""
    requested_by: str = ""
    escalation_reason: str = ""
    requires_human: bool = True
    policy_refs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    findings: tuple[ReviewFinding, ...] = ()
    evidence: tuple[ReviewEvidence, ...] = ()
    timeline: tuple[ReviewTimelineEvent, ...] = ()
    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    updated_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    due_at: datetime | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "category": self.category,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "status": self.status,
            "source": self.source,
            "assignee": self.assignee,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "rationale": self.rationale,
            "requested_by": self.requested_by,
            "escalation_reason": self.escalation_reason,
            "requires_human": self.requires_human,
            "policy_refs": list(self.policy_refs),
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "findings": [item.to_dict() for item in self.findings],
            "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in self.evidence],
            "timeline": [item.to_dict() for item in self.timeline],
            "created_at": _isoformat(self.created_at),
            "updated_at": _isoformat(self.updated_at),
            "due_at": _isoformat(self.due_at),
        }


def _normalize_finding(value: Any) -> ReviewFinding | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    code = _coerce_str(value.get("code"))
    title = _coerce_str(value.get("title"))
    if not code and not title:
        return None

    return ReviewFinding(
        code=code or "finding",
        title=title or "Review finding",
        severity=_coerce_str(value.get("severity"), "medium") or "medium",
        confidence=_coerce_str(value.get("confidence"), "medium") or "medium",
        status=_coerce_str(value.get("status"), "open") or "open",
        summary=_coerce_str(value.get("summary"), "No finding summary provided.") or "No finding summary provided.",
    )


def _normalize_evidence(value: Any) -> ReviewEvidence | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    label = _coerce_str(value.get("label"))
    item_value = _coerce_str(value.get("value"))
    if not label and not item_value:
        return None

    return ReviewEvidence(
        kind=_coerce_str(value.get("kind"), "artifact") or "artifact",
        label=label or "Evidence",
        value=item_value or "",
    )


def _normalize_timeline_event(value: Any) -> ReviewTimelineEvent | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None

    stage = _coerce_str(value.get("stage"))
    actor = _coerce_str(value.get("actor"))
    detail = _coerce_str(value.get("detail"))
    if not stage and not detail:
        return None

    return ReviewTimelineEvent(
        at=_coerce_datetime(value.get("at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        stage=stage or "queued",
        actor=actor or "system",
        detail=detail or "Review event recorded.",
    )


def default_review_detail(review_id: str = "") -> ReviewDetail:
    normalized_review_id = _coerce_str(review_id)
    return ReviewDetail(
        review_id=normalized_review_id,
        title="Review detail",
        category="general",
        severity="medium",
        verdict="review",
        status="pending",
        source="runtime",
        summary="No review detail is available.",
        rationale="No rationale has been recorded.",
    )


def build_review_detail(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    review_id: str = "",
    baseline: ReviewDetail | None = None,
) -> ReviewDetail:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_review_detail(review_id=review_id)

    raw_findings = source.get("findings")
    if isinstance(raw_findings, list):
        findings = tuple(item for entry in raw_findings if (item := _normalize_finding(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        findings = current.findings

    raw_evidence = source.get("evidence")
    if isinstance(raw_evidence, list):
        evidence = tuple(item for entry in raw_evidence if (item := _normalize_evidence(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        evidence = current.evidence

    raw_timeline = source.get("timeline")
    if isinstance(raw_timeline, list):
        timeline = tuple(item for entry in raw_timeline if (item := _normalize_timeline_event(entry)) is not None)
    else:
        timeline = current.timeline

    detail = ReviewDetail(
        review_id=_coerce_str(source.get("review_id"), current.review_id or review_id),
        title=_coerce_str(source.get("title"), current.title) or current.title,
        category=_coerce_str(source.get("category"), current.category) or current.category,
        severity=_coerce_str(source.get("severity"), current.severity) or current.severity,
        verdict=_coerce_str(source.get("verdict"), current.verdict) or current.verdict,
        status=_coerce_str(source.get("status"), current.status) or current.status,
        source=_coerce_str(source.get("source"), current.source) or current.source,
        assignee=_coerce_str(source.get("assignee"), current.assignee),
        summary=_coerce_str(source.get("summary"), current.summary) or current.summary,
        rationale=_coerce_str(source.get("rationale"), current.rationale) or current.rationale,
        requested_by=_coerce_str(source.get("requested_by"), current.requested_by),
        escalation_reason=_coerce_str(source.get("escalation_reason"), current.escalation_reason),
        requires_human=_coerce_bool(source.get("requires_human"), current.requires_human),
        policy_refs=_coerce_list_of_str(source.get("policy_refs")) or current.policy_refs,
        tags=_coerce_list_of_str(source.get("tags")) or current.tags,
        findings=findings,
        evidence=evidence,
        timeline=timeline,
        created_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("created_at"), current.created_at) or current.created_at,
        updated_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("updated_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now(),
        due_at=_coerce_datetime(source.get("due_at"), current.due_at),
    )

    if not detail.review_id:
        return ReviewDetail(
            **{
                **detail.__dict__,
                "review_id": _coerce_str(review_id),
            }
        )

    return detail


def review_detail_summary(detail: ReviewDetail) -> dict[str, Any]:
    open_findings = sum(1 for item in detail.findings if item.status.lower() not in {"resolved", "closed"})
    critical_findings = sum(1 for item in detail.findings if item.severity.lower() == "critical")
    high_findings = sum(1 for item in detail.findings if item.severity.lower() == "high")

    return {
        "review_id": detail.review_id,
        "title": detail.title,
        "category": detail.category,
        "severity": detail.severity,
        "verdict": detail.verdict,
        "status": detail.status,
        "source": detail.source,
        "assignee": detail.assignee,
        "requested_by": detail.requested_by,
        "requires_human": detail.requires_human,
        "summary": detail.summary,
        "rationale": detail.rationale,
        "escalation_reason": detail.escalation_reason,
        "policy_refs": list(detail.policy_refs),

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReviewQueueItem:
    review_id: str
    title: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    verdict: str
    source: str
    assignee: str = ""
    queued_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    due_at: datetime | None = None
    requires_human: bool = True

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "category": self.category,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "status": self.status,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "source": self.source,
            "assignee": self.assignee,
            "queued_at": _isoformat(self.queued_at),
            "due_at": _isoformat(self.due_at),
            "requires_human": self.requires_human,
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReviewQueue:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    total_items: int = 0
    pending_items: int = 0
    assigned_items: int = 0
    overdue_items: int = 0
    critical_items: int = 0
    high_items: int = 0
    queue_healthy: bool = True
    escalation_required: bool = False
    average_wait_minutes: int = 0
    items: tuple[ReviewQueueItem, ...] = ()
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "total_items": self.total_items,
            "pending_items": self.pending_items,
            "assigned_items": self.assigned_items,
            "overdue_items": self.overdue_items,
            "critical_items": self.critical_items,
            "high_items": self.high_items,
            "queue_healthy": self.queue_healthy,
            "escalation_required": self.escalation_required,
            "average_wait_minutes": self.average_wait_minutes,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def _normalize_item(item: Any) -> ReviewQueueItem | None:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return None

    review_id = _coerce_str(item.get("review_id"))
    if not review_id:
        return None

    queued_at = _coerce_datetime(item.get("queued_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()
    due_at = _coerce_datetime(item.get("due_at"))

    return ReviewQueueItem(
        review_id=review_id,
        title=_coerce_str(item.get("title"), "Untitled review") or "Untitled review",
        category=_coerce_str(item.get("category"), "general") or "general",
        severity=_coerce_str(item.get("severity"), "medium") or "medium",
        status=_coerce_str(item.get("status"), "pending") or "pending",
        verdict=_coerce_str(item.get("verdict"), "review") or "review",
        source=_coerce_str(item.get("source"), "runtime") or "runtime",
        assignee=_coerce_str(item.get("assignee")),
        queued_at=queued_at,
        due_at=due_at,
        requires_human=_coerce_bool(item.get("requires_human"), True),
    )


def default_review_queue() -> ReviewQueue:
    return ReviewQueue()


def build_review_queue(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: ReviewQueue | None = None,
) -> ReviewQueue:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_review_queue()

    raw_items = source.get("items")
    if isinstance(raw_items, list):
        normalized_items = tuple(item for entry in raw_items if (item := _normalize_item(entry)) is not None)
        items = normalized_items
    else:
        items = current.items

    total_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("total_items"), current.total_items or len(items)))
    pending_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("pending_items"), current.pending_items))
    assigned_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("assigned_items"), current.assigned_items))
    overdue_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("overdue_items"), current.overdue_items))
    critical_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("critical_items"), current.critical_items))
    high_items = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("high_items"), current.high_items))
    average_wait_minutes = max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("average_wait_minutes"), current.average_wait_minutes))

    if not source.get("total_items") and items:
        total_items = len(items)
    if not source.get("pending_items") and items:
        pending_items = sum(1 for item in items if item.status.lower() == "pending")
    if not source.get("assigned_items") and items:
        assigned_items = sum(1 for item in items if bool(item.assignee))
    if not source.get("overdue_items") and items:
        now = _utc_now()
        overdue_items = sum(1 for item in items if item.due_at is not None and item.due_at < now and item.status.lower() != "closed")
    if not source.get("critical_items") and items:
        critical_items = sum(1 for item in items if item.severity.lower() == "critical")
    if not source.get("high_items") and items:
        high_items = sum(1 for item in items if item.severity.lower() == "high")

    queue_healthy = _coerce_bool(source.get("queue_healthy"), current.queue_healthy and overdue_items == 0)
    escalation_required = _coerce_bool(
        source.get("escalation_required"),
        current.escalation_required or critical_items > 0 or overdue_items > 0,
    )
    checked_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    return ReviewQueue(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        total_items=total_items,
        pending_items=pending_items,
        assigned_items=assigned_items,
        overdue_items=overdue_items,
        critical_items=critical_items,
        high_items=high_items,
        queue_healthy=queue_healthy,
        escalation_required=escalation_required,
        average_wait_minutes=average_wait_minutes,
        items=items,
        checked_at=checked_at,
    )


def review_queue_summary(queue: ReviewQueue) -> dict[str, Any]:
    human_required_items = sum(1 for item in queue.items if item.requires_human)
    unassigned_items = sum(1 for item in queue.items if not item.assignee)

    return {
        "service": queue.service,
        "environment": queue.environment,
        "queue_healthy": queue.queue_healthy,
        "escalation_required": queue.escalation_required,
        "counts": {
            "total_items": queue.total_items,
            "pending_items": queue.pending_items,
            "assigned_items": queue.assigned_items,
            "unassigned_items": unassigned_items,
            "overdue_items": queue.overdue_items,
            "critical_items": queue.critical_items,
            "high_items": queue.high_items,
            "human_required_items": human_required_items,
        },
        "service_levels": {
            "average_wait_minutes": queue.average_wait_minutes,
            "checked_at": _isoformat(queue.checked_at),
        },
        "items": [item.to_dict() for item in queue.items],
    }
