from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.ui.audit.explorer import get_audit_explorer_data

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/audit", tags=["audit-explorer"])


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _normalize_lower(value: Any) -> str | None:
    text = _normalize_text(value)
    return text.lower() if text else None


def _safe_metadata(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _match_text(value: Any, expected: str | None) -> bool:
    if not expected:
        return True
    candidate = _normalize_lower(value)
    return candidate is not None and expected in candidate


def _coerce_limit(limit: int) -> int:
    return max(1, min(limit, 500))


class AuditExplorerFilterOptions(BaseModel):
    severities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    event_types: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    verdicts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    actor_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    integration_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AuditExplorerCounts(BaseModel):
    total_events: int = 0
    critical_events: int = 0
    high_severity_events: int = 0
    blocked_events: int = 0
    quarantined_events: int = 0
    unique_actors: int = 0
    unique_sessions: int = 0
    unique_traces: int = 0
    unique_integrations: int = 0


class AuditExplorerSummary(BaseModel):
    title: str
    subtitle: str
    generated_at: str
    active_filters: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    counts: AuditExplorerCounts
    severity_breakdown: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    verdict_breakdown: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    event_type_breakdown: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    top_actors: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    top_integrations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AuditExplorerRow(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    created_at: str
    event_type: str
    severity: str
    summary: str
    actor_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    integration_id: str | None = None
    verdict: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    badges: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    risk_flags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    detail_path: str


class AuditExplorerResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    summary: AuditExplorerSummary
    filters: AuditExplorerFilterOptions
    items: list[AuditExplorerRow] = Field(default_factory=list)
    total: int = 0
    limit: int
    has_more: bool = False
    empty_state: str | None = None
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _extract_items(payload: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        items = payload.get("items")
        if isinstance(items, list):
            return [item for item in items if isinstance(item, dict)]
    if isinstance(payload, list):
        return [item for item in payload if isinstance(item, dict)]
    return []


def _collect_filter_options(items: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> AuditExplorerFilterOptions:
    severities = sorted(
        {
            value
            for item in items
            if (value := _normalize_lower(item.get("severity")))
        }
    )
    event_types = sorted(
        {
            value
            for item in items
            if (value := _normalize_lower(item.get("event_type")))
        }
    )
    verdicts = sorted(
        {
            value
            for item in items
            if (value := _normalize_lower(item.get("verdict")))
        }
    )
    actor_ids = sorted(
        {
            value
            for item in items
            if (value := _normalize_text(item.get("actor_id")))
        }
    )
    integration_ids = sorted(
        {
            value
            for item in items
            if (value := _normalize_text(item.get("integration_id")))
        }
    )
    return AuditExplorerFilterOptions(
        severities=severities,
        event_types=event_types,
        verdicts=verdicts,
        actor_ids=actor_ids,
        integration_ids=integration_ids,
    )


def _apply_filters(
    items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    actor_id: str | None,
    request_id: str | None,
    trace_id: str | None,
    event_type: str | None,
    severity: str | None,
    verdict: str | None,
    integration_id: str | None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    filtered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in items:
        if not _match_text(item.get("actor_id"), actor_id):
            continue
        if not _match_text(item.get("request_id"), request_id):
            continue
        if not _match_text(item.get("trace_id"), trace_id):
            continue
        if not _match_text(item.get("event_type"), event_type):
            continue
        if not _match_text(item.get("severity"), severity):
            continue
        if not _match_text(item.get("verdict"), verdict):
            continue
        if not _match_text(item.get("integration_id"), integration_id):
            continue
        filtered.append(item)
    return filtered


def _severity_rank(value: Any) -> int:
    normalized = _normalize_lower(value)
    order = {"critical": 0, "high": 1, "medium": 2, "low": 3}
    return order.get(normalized or "", 4)


def _build_badges(item: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    badges: list[str] = []
    severity = _normalize_lower(item.get("severity"))
    verdict = _normalize_lower(item.get("verdict"))
    event_type = _normalize_text(item.get("event_type"))

    if severity:
        badges.append(severity)
    if verdict and verdict not in badges:
        badges.append(verdict)
    if event_type:
        badges.append(event_type)

    return badges[:4]


def _build_risk_flags(item: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    flags: list[str] = []
    severity = _normalize_lower(item.get("severity"))
    verdict = _normalize_lower(item.get("verdict"))
    metadata = _safe_metadata(item.get("metadata"))

    if severity == "critical":
        flags.append("critical")
    elif severity == "high":
        flags.append("high-risk")

    if verdict in {"block", "blocked"}:
        flags.append("blocked")
    elif verdict == "quarantine":
        flags.append("quarantined")
    elif verdict == "warn":
        flags.append("warned")

    if metadata.get("requires_review") is True:
        flags.append("review")
    if metadata.get("policy_hit_count", 0):
        flags.append("policy-hit")
    if metadata.get("telemetry_gap") is True:
        flags.append("telemetry-gap")

    deduped: list[str] = []
    for flag in flags:
        if flag not in deduped:
            deduped.append(flag)
    return deduped[:5]


def _build_row(item: dict[str, Any]) -> AuditExplorerRow:
    event_id = _normalize_text(item.get("event_id")) or "unknown-event"
    request_id = _normalize_text(item.get("request_id"))
    trace_id = _normalize_text(item.get("trace_id"))
    actor_id = _normalize_text(item.get("actor_id"))
    session_id = _normalize_text(item.get("session_id"))
    integration_id = _normalize_text(item.get("integration_id"))
    event_type = _normalize_text(item.get("event_type")) or "unknown"
    severity = _normalize_lower(item.get("severity")) or "unknown"
    summary = _normalize_text(item.get("summary")) or "Audit event recorded."
    created_at = _normalize_text(item.get("created_at")) or _utcnow_iso()
    verdict = _normalize_lower(item.get("verdict"))
    metadata = _safe_metadata(item.get("metadata"))

    detail_anchor = trace_id or request_id or event_id

    return AuditExplorerRow(
        event_id=event_id,
        created_at=created_at,
        event_type=event_type,
        severity=severity,
        summary=summary,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        request_id=request_id,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        integration_id=integration_id,
        verdict=verdict,
        metadata=metadata,
        badges=_build_badges(item),
        risk_flags=_build_risk_flags(item),
        detail_path=f"/ui/audit-log?selected={detail_anchor}",
    )


def _build_summary(
    *,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    total: int,
    active_filters: dict[str, str],
) -> AuditExplorerSummary:
    severity_counter = Counter(
        _normalize_lower(item.get("severity")) or "unknown"
        for item in items
    )
    verdict_counter = Counter(
        _normalize_lower(item.get("verdict")) or "none"
        for item in items
    )
    event_type_counter = Counter(
        _normalize_text(item.get("event_type")) or "unknown"
        for item in items
    )
    actor_counter = Counter(
        _normalize_text(item.get("actor_id"))
        for item in items
        if _normalize_text(item.get("actor_id"))
    )
    integration_counter = Counter(
        _normalize_text(item.get("integration_id"))
        for item in items
        if _normalize_text(item.get("integration_id"))
    )

    counts = AuditExplorerCounts(
        total_events=total,
        critical_events=severity_counter.get("critical", 0),
        high_severity_events=severity_counter.get("high", 0),
        blocked_events=verdict_counter.get("block", 0) + verdict_counter.get("blocked", 0),
        quarantined_events=verdict_counter.get("quarantine", 0),
        unique_actors=len(actor_counter),
        unique_sessions=len(
            {
                value
                for item in items
                if (value := _normalize_text(item.get("session_id")))
            }
        ),
        unique_traces=len(
            {
                value
                for item in items
                if (value := _normalize_text(item.get("trace_id")))
            }
        ),
        unique_integrations=len(integration_counter),
    )

    subtitle = (
        "Search, filter, and triage security audit events across actors, requests, traces, and policy outcomes."
    )
    if total == 0:
        subtitle = "No audit events matched the current filter set."

    return AuditExplorerSummary(
        title="Audit Explorer",
        subtitle=subtitle,
        generated_at=_utcnow_iso(),
        active_filters=active_filters,
        counts=counts,
        severity_breakdown=dict(sorted(severity_counter.items())),
        verdict_breakdown=dict(sorted(verdict_counter.items())),
        event_type_breakdown=dict(event_type_counter.most_common(10)),
        top_actors=[actor for actor, _ in actor_counter.most_common(5)],
        top_integrations=[integration for integration, _ in integration_counter.most_common(5)],
    )


@router.get("", response_model=AuditExplorerResponse, summary="Get Audit Explorer")
def get_audit_explorer(
    actor_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    request_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    trace_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    event_type: str | None = Query(default=None),
    severity: str | None = Query(default=None),
    verdict: str | None = Query(default=None),
    integration_id: str | None = Query(default=None),
    limit: int = Query(default=100, ge=1, le=500),
) -> AuditExplorerResponse:
    source_payload = get_audit_explorer_data()
    source_items = _extract_items(source_payload)
    available_filters = _collect_filter_options(source_items)

    active_filters = {
        key: value
        for key, value in {
            "actor_id": _normalize_text(actor_id),
            "request_id": _normalize_text(request_id),
            "trace_id": _normalize_text(trace_id),
            "event_type": _normalize_text(event_type),
            "severity": _normalize_lower(severity),
            "verdict": _normalize_lower(verdict),
            "integration_id": _normalize_text(integration_id),
        }.items()
        if value is not None
    }

    filtered_items = _apply_filters(
        source_items,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        request_id=request_id,
        trace_id=trace_id,
        event_type=event_type,
        severity=severity,
        verdict=verdict,
        integration_id=integration_id,
    )
    filtered_items = sorted(
        filtered_items,
        key=lambda item: (
            _severity_rank(item.get("severity")),
            _normalize_text(item.get("created_at")) or "",
        ),
    )

    safe_limit = _coerce_limit(limit)
    page_items = filtered_items[:safe_limit]
    rows = [_build_row(item) for item in page_items]

    notes = [
        "Audit explorer is optimized for operator triage and trace-linked investigation workflows.",
        "Filter options are derived from the live event set returned by the audit explorer data source.",
        "Detail links pivot into the audit log using trace, request, or event identifiers when available.",
    ]

    return AuditExplorerResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="ironclaw-security",
        timestamp=_utcnow_iso(),
        summary=_build_summary(
            items=filtered_items,
            total=len(filtered_items),
            active_filters=active_filters,
        ),
        filters=available_filters,
        items=rows,
        total=len(filtered_items),
        limit=safe_limit,
        has_more=len(filtered_items) > safe_limit,
        empty_state=(
            "No audit events matched the current filters."
            if not rows
            else None
        ),
        notes=notes,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.core.api_keys import APIKeyRecord, get_api_key_registry, mask_api_key


router = APIRouter(prefix="/customer-keys", tags=["customer-keys-management"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _record_status(record: APIKeyRecord) -> str:
    return "active" if record.active else "revoked"


def _record_scopes(record: APIKeyRecord) -> list[str]:
    scopes = record.metadata.get("scopes", [])
    if not isinstance(scopes, list):
        return []
    return [str(scope) for scope in scopes]


def _record_owner_type(record: APIKeyRecord) -> str:
    return str(record.metadata.get("owner_type", "customer"))


def _record_owner_id(record: APIKeyRecord) -> str:
    return str(record.metadata.get("owner_id", "default-customer"))


def _record_environment(record: APIKeyRecord) -> str:
    return str(record.metadata.get("environment", "production"))


class CustomerKeyCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    label: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    owner_type: str = Field(default="customer", min_length=1, max_length=100)
    owner_id: str = Field(default="default-customer", min_length=1, max_length=200)
    scopes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    environment: str = Field(default="production", min_length=1, max_length=100)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CustomerKeyActionResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    operation: str
    key_id: str
    label: str
    key_status: str
    masked_key: str
    revealed_once_key: str | None = None
    created_at: str
    last_used_at: str | None = None
    owner_type: str
    owner_id: str
    scopes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_response(
    *,
    operation: str,
    record: APIKeyRecord,
    revealed_once_key: str | None = None,
    notes: list[str] | None = None,
) -> CustomerKeyActionResponse:
    raw_key = revealed_once_key or record.raw_key
    masked_key = mask_api_key(raw_key) if raw_key else "hidden"

    response_metadata = dict(record.metadata)
    response_metadata["environment"] = _record_environment(record)
    response_metadata["rotation_due"] = bool(record.metadata.get("rotation_due", False))

    return CustomerKeyActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        operation=operation,
        key_id=record.key_id,
        label=record.display_name,
        key_status=_record_status(record),
        masked_key=masked_key,
        revealed_once_key=revealed_once_key,
        created_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        owner_type=_record_owner_type(record),
        owner_id=_record_owner_id(record),
        scopes=_record_scopes(record),
        metadata=response_metadata,
        notes=notes or [],
    )


@router.post("", response_model=CustomerKeyActionResponse)
def create_customer_key(payload: CustomerKeyCreateRequest) -> CustomerKeyActionResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()

    metadata = dict(payload.metadata)
    metadata["owner_type"] = payload.owner_type
    metadata["owner_id"] = payload.owner_id
    metadata["scopes"] = list(payload.scopes)
    metadata["environment"] = payload.environment
    metadata.setdefault("rotation_due", False)

    record = registry.create_key(
        display_name=payload.label.strip(),
        metadata=metadata,
    )

    return _build_response(
        operation="create",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_key=record.raw_key,
        notes=[
            "The raw API key is only returned once during creation.",
            "Store the revealed key securely before leaving this response.",
            "This key is now available for authenticated customer workflows.",
        ],
    )


@router.post("/{key_id}/rotate", response_model=CustomerKeyActionResponse)
def rotate_customer_key(
    key_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> CustomerKeyActionResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    record = registry.rotate_key(key_id.strip())

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer key not found or not active")

    updated_metadata = dict(record.metadata)
    updated_metadata["rotation_due"] = False
    refreshed_record = APIKeyRecord(
        key_id=record.key_id,
        display_name=record.display_name,
        hashed_secret=record.hashed_secret,
        created_at=record.created_at,
        last_used_at=record.last_used_at,
        active=record.active,
        metadata=updated_metadata,
        raw_key=record.raw_key,
    )
    registry._keys_by_id[record.key_id] = refreshed_record

    return _build_response(
        operation="rotate",
        record=refreshed_record,
        revealed_once_key=refreshed_record.raw_key,
        notes=[
            "The previous key secret is no longer valid after rotation.",
            "The new raw API key is only returned once during rotation.",
            "Update any clients or integrations that depended on the prior key.",
        ],
    )


@router.post("/{key_id}/revoke", response_model=CustomerKeyActionResponse)
def revoke_customer_key(
    key_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> CustomerKeyActionResponse:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    record = registry.revoke_key(key_id.strip())

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer key not found")

    return _build_response(
        operation="revoke",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_key=None,
        notes=[
            "Revoked keys can no longer authenticate requests.",
            "The key remains visible in inventory and detail views for auditability.",
            "Create or rotate a replacement key before revoking production traffic keys.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status

from app.services.organizationstore import (

    displayname: str

    email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255)
    displayname: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    role: OrganizationRole
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class OrganizationResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    organization: OrganizationView


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _member_to_view(member: StoredOrganizationMemberRecord) -> OrganizationMemberView:
    payload = member.to_dict()
    return OrganizationMemberView(
        memberid=payload["memberid"],
        email=payload["email"],
        displayname=payload["displayname"],
        role=payload["role"],
        status=payload["status"],
        createdat=payload["createdat"],
        updatedat=payload["updatedat"],
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )


def _organization_to_view(organization: StoredOrganizationRecord) -> OrganizationView:
    payload = organization.to_dict()
    return OrganizationView(
        organizationid=payload["organizationid"],
        name=payload["name"],
        slug=payload["slug"],
        status=payload["status"],
        createdat=payload["createdat"],
        updatedat=payload["updatedat"],
        owneremail=payload["owneremail"],
        members=[_member_to_view(member) for member in organization.members],
        metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
    )


def _find_organization_or_404(organizationid: str) -> StoredOrganizationRecord:
    organization = getorganizationstore().getorganization(organizationid)
    if organization is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {organizationid}",
        )
    return organization


@router.get("", response_model=OrganizationListResponse)
def list_organizations(
    status_filter: OrganizationStatus | None = Query(default=None, alias="status"),
) -> OrganizationListResponse:
    items = getorganizationstore().listorganizations(status=status_filter)
    return OrganizationListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total=len(items),
        items=[_organization_to_view(item) for item in items],
    )


@router.post("", response_model=OrganizationResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_organization(payload: OrganizationCreateRequest) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = getorganizationstore().createorganization(
        name=payload.name,
        slug=payload.slug,
        owneremail=payload.owneremail,
        ownerdisplayname=payload.ownerdisplayname,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        _, normalized_slug = result
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail=f"Organization slug already exists: {normalized_slug}",
        )
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )


@router.get("/{organizationid}", response_model=OrganizationResponse)
def get_organization(organizationid: str) -> OrganizationResponse:
    organization = _find_organization_or_404(organizationid)

        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(organization),
    )


@router.post(
    "/{organizationid}/members",
    response_model=OrganizationResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def add_organization_member(
    organizationid: str,
    payload: OrganizationMemberCreateRequest,
) -> OrganizationResponse:
    result = getorganizationstore().addmember(
        organizationid,
        email=payload.email,
        displayname=payload.displayname,
        role=payload.role,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
    )
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        error_type, value = result
        if error_type == "member_exists":
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Organization member already exists: {value}",
            )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Unknown organization: {value}",
        )
    return OrganizationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        organization=_organization_to_view(result),
    )

from typing import Optional

from app.core.auth import require_api_key
from app.services.quarantinestore import quarantine_store

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/quarantine",
    tags=["quarantine"],
    dependencies=[Depends(require_api_key)],

@router.get("")
def list_quarantine_items(
    status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(
        default=None,
        alias="status",
        pattern="^(isolated|underreview|released|destroyed)$",
    ),
    source: Optional[str] = Query(
        default=None,
        pattern="^(scan|guard|sandbox|review|system)$",
    ),
    risk_level: Optional[str] = Query(
        default=None,
        alias="riskLevel",
        pattern="^(low|medium|high|critical)$",
    ),

        status=status_filter,
        source=source,
        risk_level=risk_level,
    )

def get_quarantine_item(quarantine_id: str):
    item = quarantine_store.get_item(quarantine_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Quarantine item not found.",
        )
    return item


@router.post("/{quarantine_id}/review")
def review_quarantine_item(quarantine_id: str, payload: dict):

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Annotated, Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, Response, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

from app.review.reviewqueueservice import (
    ReviewPriority,
    ReviewQueueItem,
    ReviewQueueService,
    ReviewSource,
    ReviewStatus,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/review-queue", tags=["review-queue"])


class ReviewQueueListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[ReviewQueueItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    counts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReviewQueueCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    source: ReviewSource
    source_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    priority: ReviewPriority = ReviewPriority.MEDIUM
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    summary: str = Field(..., min_length=1)
    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @field_validator("source_id", "title", "summary")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_non_blank_text(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("must not be blank")
        return normalized

    @field_validator("reasons")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_reasons(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        normalized = [reason.strip() for reason in value if reason.strip()]
        return normalized


class ReviewQueueAssignRequest(BaseModel):
    reviewer_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

    @field_validator("reviewer_id")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_reviewer_id(cls, value: str) -> str:
        normalized = value.strip()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("must not be blank")
        return normalized


class ReviewQueueDismissRequest(BaseModel):
    reason: str | None = None

    @field_validator("reason")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_reason(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return None
        normalized = value.strip()
        return normalized or None


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_review_queue_service() -> ReviewQueueService:
    return ReviewQueueService()


def _get_item_or_404(review_id: str) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    item = get_review_queue_service().get(review_id)
    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"review item not found: {review_id}",
        )
    return item


def _parse_review_status(status_filter: str | None) -> ReviewStatus | None:
    if status_filter is None:
        return None
    normalized = status_filter.strip().lower()
    if not normalized:
        return None
    try:
        return ReviewStatus(normalized)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=f"invalid status filter: {status_filter}",
        ) from exc


@router.get("", response_model=ReviewQueueListResponse)
def list_review_queue(
    status_filter: Annotated[str | None, Query(default=None, alias="status")] = None,
    assigned_to: str | None = Query(default=None),
) -> ReviewQueueListResponse:
    service = get_review_queue_service()
    normalized_assigned_to = assigned_to.strip() if assigned_to is not None else None
    if normalized_assigned_to == "":
        normalized_assigned_to = None
    items = service.list_items(
        status=_parse_review_status(status_filter),
        assigned_to=normalized_assigned_to,
    )
    return ReviewQueueListResponse(
        items=items,
        counts=service.counts(),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationverifier import IntegrationVerifier

router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integration-compatibility"])

_service = IntegrationVerifier()


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)

    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class CompatibilityIssueView(BaseModel):
    issue_id: str
    severity: str
    category: str
    message: str
    remediation: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CompatibilityCheckView(BaseModel):
    check_id: str
    name: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CompatibilityTargetView(BaseModel):
    platform: str
    provider: str | None = None
    version: str | None = None
    runtime: str | None = None
    environment: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CompatibilitySummaryView(BaseModel):
    compatible: bool
    score: float
    status: str
    checked_at: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationCompatibilityResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    target: CompatibilityTargetView
    summary: CompatibilitySummaryView
    checks: list[CompatibilityCheckView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    issues: list[CompatibilityIssueView] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _normalize_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "success", "compatible"}:
        return "passed"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "partial"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "error", "incompatible"}:
        return "failed"
    return normalized or "unknown"


def _normalize_severity(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"low", "info"}:
        return "low"
    if normalized in {"medium", "warn", "warning"}:
        return "medium"
    if normalized in {"high", "critical", "error"}:
        return "high"
    return normalized or "medium"


def _coerce_float(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _build_issue_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> CompatibilityIssueView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    issue_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "issue_id", "id", "code") or f"issue-{fallback_index}"
    )
    severity = _normalize_severity(_extract_value(data, "severity", "level"))
    category = str(_extract_value(data, "category", "type") or "compatibility")
    message = str(_extract_value(data, "message", "detail", "description") or "")
    remediation = _extract_value(data, "remediation", "fix", "recommendation")

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("field", "expected", "actual", "platform"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return CompatibilityIssueView(
        issue_id=issue_id,
        severity=severity,
        category=category,
        message=message,
        remediation=str(remediation) if remediation is not None else None,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_check_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> CompatibilityCheckView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    check_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "check_id", "id", "name") or f"check-{fallback_index}"
    )
    name = str(
        _extract_value(data, "name", "title", "check")
        or check_id.replace("-", " ").title()
    )
    status_value = _normalize_status(
        _extract_value(data, "status", "result", "outcome")
    )
    detail = str(_extract_value(data, "detail", "message", "description") or "")

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("required", "actual", "expected", "version"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return CompatibilityCheckView(
        check_id=check_id,
        name=name,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_target_view(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    environment: str | None,
) -> CompatibilityTargetView:
    metadata = _normalize_dict(payload.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("adapter", "adapter_version", "region"):
        if key in payload and key not in metadata and payload.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = payload.get(key)

    provider_value = _extract_value(payload, "provider", "vendor")
    version_value = _extract_value(
        payload, "version", "platform_version", "target_version"
    )
    runtime_value = _extract_value(payload, "runtime", "runtime_version")
    environment_value = _extract_value(payload, "environment") or environment

    return CompatibilityTargetView(
        platform=str(_extract_value(payload, "platform", "target_platform") or "unknown"),
        provider=str(provider_value) if provider_value is not None else None,
        version=str(version_value) if version_value is not None else None,
        runtime=str(runtime_value) if runtime_value is not None else None,
        environment=str(environment_value) if environment_value is not None else None,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_compatibility_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str | None,
) -> IntegrationCompatibilityResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    payload = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "compatibility", "verification") or result)

    raw_checks = _extract_value(payload, "checks", "results", "verifications") or []
    checks = [
        _build_check_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_checks))
    ]

    raw_issues = _extract_value(payload, "issues", "findings", "errors") or []
    issues = [
        _build_issue_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_issues))
    ]

    compatible = bool(_extract_value(payload, "compatible", "is_compatible"))
    if not compatible and checks:
        compatible = all(check.status != "failed" for check in checks)

    score = _coerce_float(
        _extract_value(payload, "score", "compatibility_score"),
        default=100.0 if compatible else 0.0,
    )

    summary_status = _normalize_status(_extract_value(payload, "status", "result"))
    if summary_status == "unknown":
        summary_status = "passed" if compatible else "failed"

    metadata = _normalize_dict(payload.get("summary_metadata"))
    for key in ("profile", "policy", "matrix_version"):
        if key in payload and key not in metadata and payload.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = payload.get(key)

    checked_at_value = _extract_value(
        payload, "checked_at", "verified_at", "timestamp"
    )

    return IntegrationCompatibilityResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        target=_build_target_view(payload, environment=environment),
        summary=CompatibilitySummaryView(
            compatible=compatible,
            score=score,
            status=summary_status,
            checked_at=_datetime_to_iso(checked_at_value) or _utc_now_iso(),
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        checks=checks,
        issues=issues,
    )


def _run_compatibility_lookup(
    integration_id: str,
    environment: str | None,
) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.compatibility(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.compatibility(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.compatibility(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration verifier service does not expose a supported compatibility method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/compatibility",
    response_model=IntegrationCompatibilityResponse,
    summary="Get integration compatibility verification",
)
def get_integration_compatibility(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    environment: str | None = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=100),
) -> IntegrationCompatibilityResponse:
    result = _run_compatibility_lookup(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        environment=environment.strip() if environment is not None else None,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_compatibility_response(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        result=result,
        environment=environment.strip() if environment is not None else None,
    )

def _normalize_step_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "complete", "completed", "success", "installed"}:
        return "completed"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "error", "blocked"}:
        return "failed"
    if normalized in {"running", "installing", "pending", "queued", "in_progress"}:

    if normalized in {"warn", "warning"}:

def _build_step_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> InstallationStepView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    step_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "step_id", "stepid", "id", "name", "key")
        or f"step-{fallback_index}"
    )
    title = str(
        _extract_value(data, "title", "label", "name", "summary")
        or step_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()
    )
    detail = str(
        _extract_value(data, "detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description") or ""
    )
    status_value = _normalize_step_status(
        _extract_value(data, "status", "state", "result")
    )

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("component", "phase", "duration_ms", "started_at", "completed_at"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return InstallationStepView(
        step_id=step_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_install_response(integration_id: str, result: Any) -> IntegrationInstallResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)

    raw_steps = _extract_value(data, "steps", "items", "phases") or []
    steps = [_build_step_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(raw_steps)]

    steps_completed = sum(1 for item in steps if item.status == "completed")
    steps_failed = sum(1 for item in steps if item.status == "failed")

    installed_value = _extract_value(data, "installed", "success")
    installed = (
        bool(installed_value)
        if installed_value is not None
        else steps_failed == 0 and len(steps) > 0
    )

    state = str(
        _extract_value(
            data,
            "state",
            "installation_state",
            "overall_status",
            "status",
        )
        or ("failed" if steps_failed else "completed" if installed else "pending")
    ).strip().lower()

    platform = _extract_value(data, "platform")
    adapter_version = _extract_value(data, "adapter_version", "version")

    blockers = _normalize_list(_extract_value(data, "blockers", "errors"))
    warnings = _normalize_list(_extract_value(data, "warnings"))
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("provider", "adapter_name", "initiated_by", "dry_run", "force"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return IntegrationInstallResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        platform=str(platform) if platform is not None else None,
        adapter_version=str(adapter_version) if adapter_version is not None else None,
        installation=InstallationSummaryView(
            state=state,
            installed=installed,
            steps_total=len(steps),
            steps_completed=steps_completed,
            steps_failed=steps_failed,
            blockers=blockers,
            warnings=warnings,
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        steps=steps,
    )


def _run_installation(integration_id: str, request: IntegrationInstallRequest) -> Any:
    payload = request.model_dump()

    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.install(integration_id=integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.install(integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.install(integration_id=integration_id, payload=payload),
        lambda: _service.install(integration_id, payload),
        lambda: _service.install(integration_id=integration_id),
        lambda: _service.install(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.run(integration_id=integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.run(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.execute(integration_id=integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.execute(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration installer service does not expose a supported install method",
    )


@router.post(
    "/{integration_id}/install",
    response_model=IntegrationInstallResponse,
    summary="Install or provision an integration",
)
def install_integration(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    request: IntegrationInstallRequest | None = None,
) -> IntegrationInstallResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    effective_request = request or IntegrationInstallRequest()

    result = _run_installation(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        request=effective_request,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{normalized_integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_install_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        result=result,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationstatemachine import IntegrationStateMachine

router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integration-state"])

_service = IntegrationStateMachine()


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    return [str(value)]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)

    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class IntegrationStateView(BaseModel):
    state: str
    sub_state: str | None = None
    previous_state: str | None = None
    desired_state: str | None = None
    version: str | None = None
    environment: str | None = None
    is_terminal: bool = False
    can_advance: bool = False
    can_rollback: bool = False
    blockers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationTransitionView(BaseModel):
    transition_id: str
    from_state: str
    to_state: str
    action: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    timestamp: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationStateMachineResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    state: IntegrationStateView
    transitions: list[IntegrationTransitionView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class IntegrationStateChangeRequest(BaseModel):
    desired_state: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=120)
    environment: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120)
    reason: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _normalize_state_name(value: Any) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if text in {"installed", "ready"}:
        return "ready"
    if text in {"enabled", "active", "live"}:
        return "enabled"
    if text in {"disabled", "paused", "stopped"}:
        return "disabled"
    if text in {"failed", "error", "blocked"}:
        return "failed"
    if text in {"installing", "enabling", "rolling_out", "promoting"}:
        return "in_progress"
    return text or "unknown"


def _normalize_transition_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "success", "applied"}:
        return "completed"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "error", "rejected"}:
        return "failed"
    if normalized in {"pending", "queued", "running", "in_progress"}:
        return "in_progress"
    return normalized or "completed"


def _build_state_view(result: Any, environment: str | None) -> IntegrationStateView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)

    state_raw = _extract_value(data, "state", "current_state")
    sub_state = _extract_value(data, "sub_state", "phase")
    previous_state = _extract_value(data, "previous_state", "from_state")
    desired_state = _extract_value(data, "desired_state", "target_state")
    version = _extract_value(data, "version", "adapter_version", "release_id")
    env_value = _extract_value(data, "environment") or environment

    normalized_state = _normalize_state_name(state_raw)

    is_terminal = bool(_extract_value(data, "is_terminal"))
    if not is_terminal:
        is_terminal = normalized_state in {"disabled", "failed"}

    can_advance = bool(_extract_value(data, "can_advance", "may_advance"))
    can_rollback = bool(_extract_value(data, "can_rollback", "may_rollback"))

    blockers = _normalize_list(_extract_value(data, "blockers", "errors"))
    warnings = _normalize_list(_extract_value(data, "warnings"))

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("platform", "provider", "last_updated_at"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return IntegrationStateView(
        state=normalized_state,
        sub_state=str(sub_state) if sub_state is not None else None,
        previous_state=str(previous_state) if previous_state is not None else None,
        desired_state=str(desired_state) if desired_state is not None else None,
        version=str(version) if version is not None else None,
        environment=str(env_value) if env_value is not None else None,
        is_terminal=is_terminal,
        can_advance=can_advance,
        can_rollback=can_rollback,
        blockers=blockers,
        warnings=warnings,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_transition_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> IntegrationTransitionView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    transition_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "transition_id", "id", "event_id", "sequence")
        or f"transition-{fallback_index}"
    )
    from_state = str(_extract_value(data, "from_state", "previous_state") or "unknown")
    to_state = str(_extract_value(data, "to_state", "next_state", "state") or "unknown")
    action = str(_extract_value(data, "action", "event", "reason") or "unknown")
    status_value = _normalize_transition_status(
        _extract_value(data, "status", "result", "outcome")
    )
    detail = str(_extract_value(data, "detail", "details", "message", "description") or "")
    timestamp_value = _extract_value(data, "timestamp", "occurred_at", "created_at")

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("user", "actor", "environment"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return IntegrationTransitionView(
        transition_id=transition_id,
        from_state=from_state,
        to_state=to_state,
        action=action,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        timestamp=_datetime_to_iso(timestamp_value) or _utc_now_iso(),
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_state_machine_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str | None,
) -> IntegrationStateMachineResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)

    state_payload = _extract_value(data, "state", "current", "status") or result
    transitions_payload = _extract_value(data, "transitions", "history", "events") or []

    state_view = _build_state_view(state_payload, environment=environment)
    transitions = [
        _build_transition_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(transitions_payload)
    ]

    return IntegrationStateMachineResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        state=state_view,
        transitions=transitions,
    )


def _run_state_lookup(integration_id: str, environment: str | None) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.status(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.status(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.status(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration state machine service does not expose a supported lookup method",
    )


def _run_state_change(
    integration_id: str,
    request: IntegrationStateChangeRequest,
) -> Any:
    payload = request.model_dump()
    desired_state = request.desired_state

    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.transition(integration_id=integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.transition(integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.transition(
            integration_id=integration_id,
            target_state=desired_state,
        ),
        lambda: _service.transition(integration_id, desired_state),
        lambda: _service.set_state(integration_id=integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.set_state(integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.request(integration_id=integration_id, **payload),
        lambda: _service.request(integration_id, **payload),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration state machine service does not expose a supported transition method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/state",
    response_model=IntegrationStateMachineResponse,
    summary="Get integration lifecycle state",
)
def get_integration_state(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    environment: str | None = Query(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120),
) -> IntegrationStateMachineResponse:
    result = _run_state_lookup(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        environment=environment.strip() if environment is not None else None,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_state_machine_response(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        result=result,
        environment=environment.strip() if environment is not None else None,
    )


@router.post(
    "/{integration_id}/state",
    response_model=IntegrationStateMachineResponse,
    summary="Request an integration state transition",
)
def change_integration_state(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    request: IntegrationStateChangeRequest | None = None,
) -> IntegrationStateMachineResponse:
    effective_request = request or IntegrationStateChangeRequest(
        desired_state="enabled",
        environment=None,
        reason=None,
        metadata={},
    )

    result = _run_state_change(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        request=effective_request,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    if isinstance(result, dict) or hasattr(result, "model_dump"):
        return _build_state_machine_response(
            integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
            result=result,
            environment=effective_request.environment,
        )

    lookup = _run_state_lookup(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        environment=effective_request.environment,
    )
    if lookup is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail="state transition completed but the updated state could not be retrieved",
        )

    return _build_state_machine_response(
        integration_id=integration_id.strip(),
        result=lookup,
        environment=effective_request.environment,
    )
}

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:

def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:

def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:

def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:

        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)

def _normalize_string_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    return [str(item) for item in _normalize_list(value)]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)

    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _safe_float(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _normalize_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "healthy", "active", "enabled", "success"}:
        return "ok"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "error", "critical", "down"}:
        return "error"
    return normalized or "ok"

def _build_metric_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> IntegrationMetricView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    metric_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "metric_id", "metricid", "id", "name", "key")
        or f"metric-{fallback_index}"
    )
    name = str(_extract_value(data, "name", "title", "label") or metric_id)
    value = _safe_float(_extract_value(data, "value", "current_value", "amount"), 0.0)
    unit = _extract_value(data, "unit")
    status_value = _normalize_status(_extract_value(data, "status", "state"))
    updated_at = _datetime_to_iso(_extract_value(data, "updated_at", "timestamp", "observed_at"))

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("description", "source", "provider", "window", "threshold"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return IntegrationMetricView(
        metric_id=metric_id,
        name=name,
        value=value,
        unit=str(unit) if unit is not None else None,
        status=status_value,
        updated_at=updated_at,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_event_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> IntegrationEventView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    event_id = str(

    message = str(

    timestamp = _datetime_to_iso(

def _build_alert_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> IntegrationAlertView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

def _collect_section(data: dict[str, Any], primary: str, *fallbacks: str) -> list[Any]:
    for key in (primary, *fallbacks):
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return _normalize_list(data.get(key))
    return []


def _build_response(
    integration_id: str,
    environment: str,
    result: Any,
) -> IntegrationObservabilityResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    observability = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "observability", "summary") or result)

    metrics_raw = _collect_section(
        observability,
        "metrics",
        "signals",
        "kpis",
    )
    events_raw = _collect_section(
        observability,
        "events",
        "activity",
        "logs",
    )
    alerts_raw = _collect_section(
        observability,
        "alerts",
        "issues",
        "incidents",
    )

    metrics = [
        _build_metric_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(metrics_raw)
    ]
    events = [
        _build_event_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(events_raw)
    ]
    alerts = [
        _build_alert_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(alerts_raw)
    ]

    open_alerts = sum(1 for item in alerts if item.status not in {"ok", "resolved", "closed"})
    warning_alerts = sum(1 for item in alerts if item.severity in {"warning", "warn", "medium"})
    error_alerts = sum(1 for item in alerts if item.severity in {"error", "critical", "high"})

    overall_status = _normalize_status(
        _extract_value(observability, "overall_status", "status", "state")
    )
    if overall_status == "ok":
        if error_alerts:
            overall_status = "error"
        elif warning_alerts:
            overall_status = "warning"

    updated_at = _datetime_to_iso(
        _extract_value(observability, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at")
    ) or _utc_now_iso()

    signal_sources = _normalize_string_list(
        _extract_value(observability, "signal_sources", "sources", "providers")
    )

    metadata = _normalize_dict(observability.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("provider", "platform", "adapter_version", "trace_id"):
        if key in observability and key not in metadata and observability.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = observability.get(key)

    return IntegrationObservabilityResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        summary=IntegrationObservabilitySummaryView(
            overall_status=overall_status,
            updated_at=updated_at,
            environment=str(_extract_value(observability, "environment") or environment),
            integration_id=integration_id,
            total_metrics=len(metrics),
            total_events=len(events),
            total_alerts=len(alerts),
            open_alerts=open_alerts,
            warning_alerts=warning_alerts,
            error_alerts=error_alerts,
            signal_sources=signal_sources,
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        metrics=metrics,
        events=events,
        alerts=alerts,
    )


def _run_observability(integration_id: str, environment: str, limit: int) -> Any:

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.deploymentreadiness import DeploymentReadiness

router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integration-readiness"])

_service = DeploymentReadiness()


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    return [str(value)]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)

    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class ReadinessCheckView(BaseModel):
    check_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReadinessSummaryView(BaseModel):
    overall_status: str
    updated_at: str
    environment: str
    release_id: str | None = None
    total_checks: int
    ready_checks: int
    warning_checks: int
    blocked_checks: int
    blockers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recommendations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    readiness: ReadinessSummaryView
    checks: list[ReadinessCheckView] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _normalize_check_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "ready", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "ready"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error"}:
        return "blocked"
    return normalized or "ready"


def _normalize_overall_status(value: Any, checks: list[ReadinessCheckView]) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "ready", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "ready"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error"}:
        return "blocked"

    blocked_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "blocked")
    warning_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "warning")
    if blocked_checks:
        return "blocked"
    if warning_checks:
        return "warning"
    return "ready"


def _build_check_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> ReadinessCheckView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    check_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "check_id", "checkid", "id", "name", "key")
        or f"check-{fallback_index}"
    )
    title = str(
        _extract_value(data, "title", "label", "name", "summary")
        or check_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()
    )
    detail = str(
        _extract_value(data, "detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description") or ""
    )
    status_value = _normalize_check_status(
        _extract_value(data, "status", "state", "result")
    )

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("category", "severity", "component"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return ReadinessCheckView(
        check_id=check_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_readiness_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str,
) -> IntegrationReadinessResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    readiness = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "readiness") or result)

    raw_checks = _extract_value(readiness, "checks", "items") or []
    checks = [
        _build_check_view(item, index + 1)
        for index, item in enumerate(raw_checks)
    ]

    ready_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "ready")
    warning_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "warning")
    blocked_checks = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "blocked")

    overall_status = _normalize_overall_status(
        _extract_value(readiness, "overall_status", "status", "state"),
        checks,
    )

    updated_at_value = _extract_value(readiness, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at")
    release_id = _extract_value(readiness, "release_id", "integration_release_id")

    blockers = _normalize_list(_extract_value(readiness, "blockers", "errors"))
    recommendations = _normalize_list(_extract_value(readiness, "recommendations", "notes"))
    metadata = _normalize_dict(readiness.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("platform", "adapter_version", "provider"):
        if key in readiness and key not in metadata and readiness.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = readiness.get(key)

    return IntegrationReadinessResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        readiness=ReadinessSummaryView(
            overall_status=overall_status,
            updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(updated_at_value) or _utc_now_iso(),
            environment=str(_extract_value(readiness, "environment") or environment),
            release_id=str(release_id) if release_id is not None else None,
            total_checks=len(checks),
            ready_checks=ready_checks,
            warning_checks=warning_checks,
            blocked_checks=blocked_checks,
            blockers=blockers,
            recommendations=recommendations,
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        checks=checks,
    )


def _run_readiness(integration_id: str, environment: str) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.evaluate(release_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.check(release_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.check(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.check(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.check(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.get(release_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="deployment readiness service does not expose a supported readiness method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/readiness",
    response_model=IntegrationReadinessResponse,
    summary="Get integration deployment readiness",

def get_integration_readiness(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),

def _datetime_to_iso(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

def _normalize_stage_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "complete", "completed", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "completed"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error", "rolled_back", "rollback"}:
        return "failed"
    if normalized in {"pending", "queued", "running", "in_progress", "promoting"}:
        return "in_progress"

    return normalized or "in_progress"


def _normalize_rollout_state(value: Any, stages: list[RolloutStageView]) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()

    if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed", "complete", "completed", "success", "healthy"}:
        return "completed"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "blocked", "error", "rolled_back", "rollback"}:
        return "failed"
    if normalized in {"pending", "queued", "running", "in_progress", "promoting"}:
        return "in_progress"

    if any(stage.status == "failed" for stage in stages):
        return "failed"
    if any(stage.status == "warning" for stage in stages):
        return "warning"
    if stages and all(stage.status == "completed" for stage in stages):
        return "completed"

    return "in_progress"


def _normalize_percent(value: Any) -> int | None:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    try:
        numeric = int(float(str(value)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return max(0, min(100, numeric))


def _build_stage_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> RolloutStageView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)

    stage_id = str(
        _extract_value(data, "stage_id", "stageid", "id", "name", "key")
        or f"stage-{fallback_index}"
    )
    title = str(
        _extract_value(data, "title", "label", "name", "summary")
        or stage_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()
    )
    detail = str(_extract_value(data, "detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description") or "")
    status_value = _normalize_stage_status(_extract_value(data, "status", "state", "result"))

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("percentage", "wave", "cohort", "started_at", "completed_at"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return RolloutStageView(
        stage_id=stage_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_rollout_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str,
) -> IntegrationRolloutResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    rollout = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "rollout") or result)

    raw_stages = _extract_value(rollout, "stages", "steps", "items") or []
    stages = [_build_stage_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(raw_stages)]

    summary_metadata = _normalize_dict(rollout.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("platform", "provider", "release_id"):
        if key in rollout and key not in summary_metadata and rollout.get(key) is not None:
            summary_metadata[key] = rollout.get(key)

    rollout_id_value = _extract_value(rollout, "rollout_id", "id")
    adapter_version_value = _extract_value(rollout, "adapter_version", "version")
    updated_at_value = _extract_value(rollout, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at")

    return IntegrationRolloutResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        rollout=RolloutSummaryView(
            rollout_id=str(rollout_id_value) if rollout_id_value is not None else None,
            state=_normalize_rollout_state(
                _extract_value(rollout, "state", "status", "rollout_state"),
                stages,
            ),
            environment=str(_extract_value(rollout, "environment") or environment),
            adapter_version=str(adapter_version_value) if adapter_version_value is not None else None,
            target_percentage=_normalize_percent(
                _extract_value(rollout, "target_percentage", "target_percent")
            ),
            current_percentage=_normalize_percent(
                _extract_value(rollout, "current_percentage", "current_percent", "percentage")
            ),
            updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(updated_at_value) or _utc_now_iso(),
            blockers=_normalize_list(_extract_value(rollout, "blockers", "errors")),
            warnings=_normalize_list(_extract_value(rollout, "warnings")),
            metadata=summary_metadata,
        ),
        stages=stages,
    )

        lambda: _service.current(integration_id, environment),
        lambda: _service.current(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.rollout(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment),

        lambda: _service.rollout(integration_id),

    )
