def _status_for_record(record: SecretRecord) -> str:
    return "active" if getattr(record, "active", False) else "revoked"


def _record_belongs_to_integration(record: SecretRecord, integration_id: str) -> bool:
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(record, "metadata", {}))
    candidates = {
        str(metadata.get("integration_id", "")).strip(),
        str(metadata.get("integration", "")).strip(),
        str(metadata.get("adapter_id", "")).strip(),
        str(metadata.get("release_id", "")).strip(),
    }
    candidates.discard("")
    return integration_id in candidates


def _filtered_records(integration_id: str) -> list[SecretRecord]:
    service = get_secret_service()
    records = service.list_secrets(include_inactive=True)
    return [record for record in records if _record_belongs_to_integration(record, integration_id)]


def _get_record_for_integration(integration_id: str, secret_id: str) -> SecretRecord | None:
    for record in _filtered_records(integration_id):
        if record.secret_id == secret_id:
            return record
    return None


def _build_action_response(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    operation: str,
    record: SecretRecord,
    revealed_once_value: str | None = None,
    notes: list[str] | None = None,
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(record, "metadata", {}))
    return SecretActionResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        operation=operation,
        secret_id=record.secret_id,
        name=record.name,
        provider=record.provider,
        kind=record.kind,
        secret_status=_status_for_record(record),
        masked_value=record.masked_value,
        revealed_once_value=revealed_once_value,
        created_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.updated_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        metadata=metadata,
        notes=notes or [],
    )


def _build_summary_item(record: SecretRecord) -> SecretSummaryItem:
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(record, "metadata", {}))
    return SecretSummaryItem(
        secret_id=record.secret_id,
        name=record.name,
        provider=record.provider,
        kind=record.kind,
        secret_status=_status_for_record(record),
        masked_value=record.masked_value,
        created_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        updated_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.updated_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
        last_used_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
        metadata=metadata,
    )


@router.get("/{integration_id}/secrets", response_model=SecretListResponse)
def list_integration_secrets(
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretListResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    records = _filtered_records(normalized_integration_id)

    return SecretListResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        total=len(records),
        active=sum(1 for record in records if getattr(record, "active", False)),
        inactive=sum(1 for record in records if not getattr(record, "active", False)),
        secrets=[_build_summary_item(record) for record in records],
    )


@router.post("/{integration_id}/secrets", response_model=SecretActionResponse)
def create_integration_secret(
    payload: SecretCreateRequest,
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    service = get_secret_service()

    metadata = _normalize_metadata(payload.metadata)
    metadata.setdefault("integration_id", normalized_integration_id)

    try:
        record = service.create_secret(
            name=payload.name.strip(),
            value=payload.value,
            provider=payload.provider.strip(),
            kind=payload.kind.strip(),
            metadata=metadata,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    return _build_action_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        operation="create",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_value=getattr(record, "raw_value", None),
        notes=[
            "The raw secret is only returned once during creation.",
            "Store the revealed secret securely before leaving this response.",
            "The secret is now bound to this integration for install, verify, and rollout workflows.",
        ],
    )


@router.post("/{integration_id}/secrets/{secret_id}/rotate", response_model=SecretActionResponse)
def rotate_integration_secret(
    payload: SecretRotateRequest,
    integration_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
    secret_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> SecretActionResponse:
    normalized_integration_id = integration_id.strip()
    normalized_secret_id = secret_id.strip()

    existing = _get_record_for_integration(normalized_integration_id, normalized_secret_id)
    if existing is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found")

    service = get_secret_service()
    metadata = _normalize_metadata(payload.metadata)
    existing_metadata = _normalize_metadata(getattr(existing, "metadata", {}))
    merged_metadata = {**existing_metadata, **metadata, "integration_id": normalized_integration_id}

    try:
        record = service.rotate_secret(
            secret_id=normalized_secret_id,
            new_value=payload.value,
            metadata=merged_metadata,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found or inactive")

    return _build_action_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        operation="rotate",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_value=getattr(record, "raw_value", None),
        notes=[
            "The previous secret value should be considered replaced immediately.",
            "The new secret is only returned once during rotation.",
            "Update any dependent integration configurations after rotating this secret.",
        ],
    )

    if existing is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found")

    service = get_secret_service()
    record = service.revoke_secret(normalized_secret_id)

    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Integration secret not found")

    return _build_action_response(
        integration_id=normalized_integration_id,
        operation="revoke",
        record=record,
        revealed_once_value=None,
        notes=[
            "Revoked secrets can no longer be used by active integrations.",
            "The secret remains visible in the integration inventory for operator auditability.",
            "Create or rotate a replacement secret before revoking production credentials.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationtelemetry import IntegrationTelemetry


router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integrations"])

_service = IntegrationTelemetry()


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)
    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_value(data: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in data and data.get(key) is not None:
            return data.get(key)
    return None


class TelemetrySeriesPoint(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    value: float
    label: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySeriesView(BaseModel):
    metric: str
    unit: str | None = None
    points: list[TelemetrySeriesPoint] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySignalView(BaseModel):
    signal_id: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    status: str
    title: str
    detail: str
    timestamp: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryView(BaseModel):
    environment: str
    window: str
    updated_at: str
    total_signals: int
    healthy_signals: int
    warning_signals: int
    critical_signals: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationTelemetryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    telemetry: TelemetrySummaryView
    metrics: list[TelemetrySeriesView]
    signals: list[TelemetrySignalView]


def _normalize_signal_severity(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"ok", "info", "normal", "healthy"}:
        return "healthy"
    if normalized in {"warn", "warning", "medium", "degraded"}:
        return "warning"
    if normalized in {"critical", "high", "error", "failed"}:
        return "critical"
    return normalized or "healthy"


def _normalize_signal_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"open", "active", "firing"}:
        return "active"
    if normalized in {"closed", "resolved", "cleared"}:
        return "resolved"
    if normalized in {"suppressed", "muted"}:
        return "suppressed"
    return normalized or "active"


def _coerce_float(value: Any) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _build_series_point(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> TelemetrySeriesPoint:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    timestamp = str(_extract_value(data, "timestamp", "time", "at") or _utcnow())
    value = _coerce_float(_extract_value(data, "value", "count", "metric"))
    label = _extract_value(data, "label", "name")
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("min", "max", "avg", "p95"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    if not label and fallback_index >= 0:
        label = f"point-{fallback_index}"

    return TelemetrySeriesPoint(
        timestamp=timestamp,
        value=value,
        label=str(label) if label is not None else None,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_series_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> TelemetrySeriesView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    metric = str(_extract_value(data, "metric", "name", "id") or f"metric-{fallback_index}")
    unit = _extract_value(data, "unit")
    raw_points = _extract_value(data, "points", "values", "samples") or []
    points = [_build_series_point(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_points))]
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("source", "aggregation", "platform"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return TelemetrySeriesView(
        metric=metric,
        unit=str(unit) if unit is not None else None,
        points=points,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_signal_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> TelemetrySignalView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    signal_id = str(_extract_value(data, "signal_id", "id", "event_id") or f"signal-{fallback_index}")
    category = str(_extract_value(data, "category", "type") or "general")
    severity = _normalize_signal_severity(_extract_value(data, "severity", "level"))
    signal_status = _normalize_signal_status(_extract_value(data, "status", "state"))
    title = str(_extract_value(data, "title", "name", "summary") or signal_id.replace("-", " ").title())
    detail = str(_extract_value(data, "detail", "message", "description") or "")
    timestamp = str(_extract_value(data, "timestamp", "occurred_at", "created_at") or _utcnow())
    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))

    for key in ("platform", "provider", "component", "metric"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return TelemetrySignalView(
        signal_id=signal_id,
        category=category,
        severity=severity,
        status=signal_status,
        title=title,
        detail=detail,
        timestamp=timestamp,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_telemetry_response(
    integration_id: str,
    result: Any,
    environment: str,
    window: str,
) -> IntegrationTelemetryResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)
    payload = _coerce_mapping(_extract_value(data, "telemetry") or result)

    raw_metrics = _extract_value(payload, "metrics", "series") or []
    metrics = [_build_series_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_metrics))]

    raw_signals = _extract_value(payload, "signals", "events", "alerts") or []
    signals = [_build_signal_view(item, index + 1) for index, item in enumerate(_normalize_list(raw_signals))]

    healthy_signals = sum(1 for item in signals if item.severity == "healthy")
    warning_signals = sum(1 for item in signals if item.severity == "warning")
    critical_signals = sum(1 for item in signals if item.severity == "critical")

    metadata = _normalize_dict(payload.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("platform", "adapter_version", "provider"):
        if key in payload and key not in metadata and payload.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = payload.get(key)

    return IntegrationTelemetryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-telemetry",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        telemetry=TelemetrySummaryView(
            environment=str(_extract_value(payload, "environment") or environment),
            window=str(_extract_value(payload, "window", "time_window") or window),
            updated_at=str(_extract_value(payload, "updated_at", "timestamp", "generated_at") or _utcnow()),
            total_signals=len(signals),
            healthy_signals=healthy_signals,
            warning_signals=warning_signals,
            critical_signals=critical_signals,
            metadata=metadata,
        ),
        metrics=metrics,
        signals=signals,
    )


def _run_telemetry_lookup(integration_id: str, environment: str, window: str) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment, window=window),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id, environment, window),
        lambda: _service.get(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.summary(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment, window=window),
        lambda: _service.summary(integration_id, environment, window),
        lambda: _service.summary(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.metrics(integration_id=integration_id, environment=environment, window=window),
        lambda: _service.metrics(integration_id, environment, window),
        lambda: _service.metrics(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration telemetry service does not expose a supported telemetry method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/telemetry",
    response_model=IntegrationTelemetryResponse,
    summary="Get integration telemetry and observability signals",
)
def get_integration_telemetry(
    integration_id: str,
    environment: str = Query(default="production"),
    window: str = Query(default="24h"),
) -> IntegrationTelemetryResponse:
    result = _run_telemetry_lookup(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        environment=environment,
        window=window,
    )

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_telemetry_response(
        integration_id=integration_id,
        result=result,
        environment=environment,
        window=window,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationverifier import IntegrationVerifier


router = APIRouter(prefix="/integrations", tags=["integrations"])

_service = IntegrationVerifier()


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


def _normalize_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return [str(item) for item in value]
    return [str(value)]


class VerificationCheckView(BaseModel):
    check_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    detail: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class VerificationSummaryView(BaseModel):
    state: str
    passed: int
    warned: int
    failed: int
    total: int
    blockers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recommendations: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class IntegrationVerificationResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    integration_id: str
    platform: str | None = None
    adapter_version: str | None = None
    verification: VerificationSummaryView
    checks: list[VerificationCheckView]


def _coerce_mapping(record: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if record is None:
        return {}
    if hasattr(record, "model_dump"):
        return record.model_dump()
    if isinstance(record, dict):
        return dict(record)
    data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(record):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        try:
            value = getattr(record, name)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if callable(value):
            continue
        data[name] = value
    return data


def _extract_check_id(data: dict[str, Any], fallback_index: int) -> str:
    for key in ("check_id", "checkid", "id", "name", "key"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return f"check-{fallback_index}"


def _extract_title(data: dict[str, Any], check_id: str) -> str:
    for key in ("title", "label", "name", "summary"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return check_id.replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()


def _extract_status(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("status", "state", "result", "verdict"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
            if normalized in {"pass", "passed", "ok", "ready", "success"}:
                return "pass"
            if normalized in {"warn", "warning"}:
                return "warn"
            if normalized in {"fail", "failed", "error", "blocked"}:
                return "fail"
            return normalized
    return "pass"


def _extract_detail(data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("detail", "details", "message", "summary", "description"):
        value = data.get(key)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    return ""


def _build_check_view(record: Any, fallback_index: int) -> VerificationCheckView:
    data = _coerce_mapping(record)
    check_id = _extract_check_id(data, fallback_index)
    title = _extract_title(data, check_id)
    status_value = _extract_status(data)
    detail = _extract_detail(data)

    metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("severity", "category", "platform", "adapter_version"):
        if key in data and key not in metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return VerificationCheckView(
        check_id=check_id,
        title=title,
        status=status_value,
        detail=detail,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def _build_response(integration_id: str, result: Any) -> IntegrationVerificationResponse:
    data = _coerce_mapping(result)

    raw_checks = data.get("checks") or data.get("items") or []
    checks = [
        _build_check_view(record, index + 1)
        for index, record in enumerate(raw_checks)
    ]

    passed = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "pass")
    warned = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "warn")
    failed = sum(1 for item in checks if item.status == "fail")
    total = len(checks)

    state = (
        data.get("state")
        or data.get("verification_state")
        or data.get("overall_status")
        or data.get("status")
        or ("failed" if failed else "warning" if warned else "passed")
    )
    state = str(state).strip().lower()

    blockers = _normalize_list(data.get("blockers"))
    recommendations = _normalize_list(data.get("recommendations"))
    platform = data.get("platform")
    adapter_version = data.get("adapter_version") or data.get("version")

    summary_metadata = _normalize_dict(data.get("metadata"))
    for key in ("provider", "adapter_name", "compatibility_matrix_version"):
        if key in data and key not in summary_metadata and data.get(key) is not None:
            summary_metadata[key] = data.get(key)

    return IntegrationVerificationResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="integration-verifier",
        timestamp=_utcnow(),
        integration_id=integration_id,
        platform=str(platform) if platform is not None else None,
        adapter_version=str(adapter_version) if adapter_version is not None else None,
        verification=VerificationSummaryView(
            state=state,
            passed=passed,
            warned=warned,
            failed=failed,
            total=total,
            blockers=blockers,
            recommendations=recommendations,
            metadata=summary_metadata,
        ),
        checks=checks,
    )


def _run_verification(integration_id: str, deep: bool) -> Any:
    candidate_calls = [
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id, deep),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id=integration_id),
        lambda: _service.verify(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.run(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep),
        lambda: _service.run(integration_id),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep),
        lambda: _service.evaluate(integration_id),
    ]

    for call in candidate_calls:
        try:
            return call()
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        except TypeError:
            continue

    raise HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        detail="integration verifier service does not expose a supported verify method",
    )


@router.get(
    "/{integration_id}/verify",
    response_model=IntegrationVerificationResponse,
    summary="Verify integration compatibility",
)
def verify_integration(
    integration_id: str,
    deep: bool = Query(default=False),
) -> IntegrationVerificationResponse:
    result = _run_verification(integration_id=integration_id, deep=deep)

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"integration '{integration_id}' not found",
        )

    return _build_response(integration_id=integration_id, result=result)

    ("privilege_escalation", r"(?i)\b(sudo|runas|chmod\s+\+s|setcap)\b", 35),
    ("reverse_shell", r"(?i)\b(nc\s+-e|bash\s+-i|powershell.+tcpclient|socat\s+.*exec:)\b", 60),
    ("sensitive_file_access", r"(?i)(/etc/shadow|/etc/passwd|id_rsa|authorized_keys|\.aws/credentials)", 40),
    ("system_recon", r"(?i)\b(whoami|net\s+user|ipconfig|ifconfig|route\s+print|arp\s+-a)\b", 20),
    ("download_and_execute", r"(?i)\b(curl|wget).*(\||&&|;).*\b(sh|bash|pwsh|powershell|python)\b", 60),
    ("encoded_powershell", r"(?i)\bpowershell(?:\.exe)?\b.*(?:-enc|-encodedcommand)\b", 55),
    ("environment_secret_access", r"(?i)\b(printenv|env|set)\b.*\b(key|token|secret|password)\b", 35),
)

@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int = 0

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "source": self.source,
            "label": self.label,
            "details": self.details,
            "score": int(self.score),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandPolicy:
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    should_review: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    risk_delta: int
    normalized_command: str
    executable: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    cwd: str | None = None
    environment_scope: str = "sandbox"
    command_kind: str = "shell"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.risk_delta),
            "normalizedcommand": self.normalized_command,
            "executable": self.executable,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "cwd": self.cwd,
            "environmentscope": self.environment_scope,
            "commandkind": self.command_kind,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandSupervisor:
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80
    max_command_length: int = 4000
    allowed_binaries: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_BINARIES))
    blocked_basenames: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_BLOCKED_BASENAMES))
    blocked_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATTERNS

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        command: str | Sequence[str],
        actiontype: str = "command",
        target: str = "shell",
        cwd: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> CommandPolicy:
        normalized_command = self._normalize_command(command)
        executable = self._extract_executable(command)
        normalized_action = str(actiontype or "").strip().lower()
        normalized_target = str(target or "").strip().lower()
        command_kind = "shell" if normalized_target in SHELL_LIKE_TARGETS else "subprocess"
        environment_scope = str((metadata or {}).get("environment_scope") or "sandbox")

        reasons: list[CommandReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not normalized_command:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Empty command",
                    details="Command execution was denied because no command content was provided.",
                    score=60,
                )
            )
            return self._finalize(
                reasons=reasons,
                matched_rules=["empty_command"],
                risk_delta=60,
                normalized_command=normalized_command,
                executable=executable,
                cwd=cwd,
                environment_scope=environment_scope,
                command_kind=command_kind,
            )

        if len(normalized_command) > self.max_command_length:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Command too large",
                    details=(
                        f"Command length {len(normalized_command)} exceeded the allowed maximum "
                        f"of {self.max_command_length} characters."
                    ),
                    score=35,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("oversized_command")
            risk_delta += 35

        if normalized_action in COMMAND_LIKE_ACTIONS or normalized_target in SHELL_LIKE_TARGETS:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Execution boundary",
                    details=(
                        f"Command supervision applied hardened policy for action '{actiontype}' "
                        f"targeting '{target}'."
                    ),
                    score=10,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("execution_boundary")
            risk_delta += 10

        if executable:
            basename = executable.rsplit("/", 1)[-1].rsplit("\\", 1)[-1].lower()
            if basename in self.blocked_basenames:
                reasons.append(
                    CommandReason(
                        source="commandsupervisor",
                        label="Blocked executable",
                        details=f"Executable '{basename}' is explicitly blocked by command policy.",
                        score=70,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"blocked_basename:{basename}")
                risk_delta += 70
            elif basename not in {item.lower() for item in self.allowed_binaries}:
                reasons.append(
                    CommandReason(
                        source="commandsupervisor",
                        label="Unapproved executable",
                        details=(
                            f"Executable '{basename}' is outside the approved sandbox command set "
                            "and requires review."
                        ),
                        score=20,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_basename:{basename}")
                risk_delta += 20
        else:
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Unknown executable",
                    details="Unable to determine the executable from the provided command payload.",
                    score=15,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("unknown_executable")
            risk_delta += 15

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.blocked_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, normalized_command):
                reasons.append(
                    CommandReason(
                        source="commandsupervisor",
                        label="Command policy match",
                        details=f"Command matched supervised rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        if self._looks_like_chained_execution(normalized_command):
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Chained execution",
                    details="Command contains chained execution operators and needs stricter review.",
                    score=15,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("chained_execution")
            risk_delta += 15

        if self._references_parent_escape(cwd=cwd, command=normalized_command):
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Path escape attempt",
                    details="Command appears to reference parent-directory traversal outside the sandbox.",
                    score=40,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("path_escape")
            risk_delta += 40

        if self._requests_interactive_session(normalized_command):
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Interactive session request",
                    details="Interactive or long-lived shell behavior was detected.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("interactive_session")
            risk_delta += 25

        if environment_scope.lower() != "sandbox":
            reasons.append(
                CommandReason(
                    source="commandsupervisor",
                    label="Non-sandbox environment",
                    details=(
                        f"Environment scope '{environment_scope}' is outside the default sandbox "
                        "boundary and requires escalation."
                    ),
                    score=45,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("non_sandbox_environment")
            risk_delta += 45

        return self._finalize(
            reasons=reasons,
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            risk_delta=risk_delta,
            normalized_command=normalized_command,
            executable=executable,
            cwd=cwd,
            environment_scope=environment_scope,
            command_kind=command_kind,
        )

    def allow(
        self,
        *,
        command: str | Sequence[str],
        actiontype: str = "command",
        target: str = "shell",
        cwd: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(
            command=command,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            cwd=cwd,
            metadata=metadata,
        ).allowed

    def _finalize(
        self,
        *,
        reasons: Iterable[CommandReason],
        matched_rules: list[str],
        risk_delta: int,
        normalized_command: str,
        executable: str,
        cwd: str | None,
        environment_scope: str,
        command_kind: str,
    ) -> CommandPolicy:
        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        if normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True

        return CommandPolicy(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            normalized_command=normalized_command,
            executable=executable,
            reasons=[reason.as_dict() for reason in reasons],
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            cwd=cwd,
            environment_scope=environment_scope,
            command_kind=command_kind,
        )

    def _normalize_command(self, command: str | Sequence[str]) -> str:
        if isinstance(command, str):
            return command.strip()
        parts = [str(part).strip() for part in command if str(part).strip()]
        return " ".join(parts).strip()

    def _extract_executable(self, command: str | Sequence[str]) -> str:
        if isinstance(command, str):
            try:
                parts = shlex.split(command, posix=False)
            except ValueError:
                parts = command.strip().split()
        else:
            parts = [str(part).strip() for part in command if str(part).strip()]
        return parts[0] if parts else ""

    def _looks_like_chained_execution(self, command: str) -> bool:
        return any(token in command for token in ("&&", "||", "|", ";"))

    def _references_parent_escape(self, *, cwd: str | None, command: str) -> bool:
        if ".." in command.replace("\\", "/"):
            return True
        if cwd and ".." in str(cwd).replace("\\", "/"):
            return True
        return False

    def _requests_interactive_session(self, command: str) -> bool:
        patterns = (
            r"(?i)\bssh\b",
            r"(?i)\btelnet\b",
            r"(?i)\bftp\b",
            r"(?i)\bpython\b.*\s-i\b",
            r"(?i)\bbash\b.*\s-i\b",
            r"(?i)\bpowershell(?:\.exe)?\b.*\s-noexit\b",
        )
        return any(re.search(pattern, command) for pattern in patterns)


def initialize_commandsupervisor(
    *,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
    max_command_length: int = 4000,
    allowed_binaries: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_basenames: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_patterns: Sequence[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
) -> CommandSupervisor:
    return CommandSupervisor(
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
        max_command_length=max_command_length,
        allowed_binaries=set(allowed_binaries or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_BINARIES),
        blocked_basenames=set(blocked_basenames or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_BASENAMES),
        blocked_patterns=tuple(blocked_patterns or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATTERNS),
    )


def build_command_supervisor() -> CommandSupervisor:
    return initialize_commandsupervisor()

@dataclass(slots=True)
class CommandSupervisorDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    risk_score: int
    should_execute: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    sandbox_lane: str
    command: str
    command_name: str
    target: str
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    sanitized_command: str = ""
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip()


def _normalize_lower(value: Any) -> str:
    return _normalize_text(value).lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_command(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    return str(_get_value(payload, "command", "target", "content", "input") or "")


def _extract_command_name(command: str) -> str:
    stripped = command.strip()
    if not stripped:
        return ""
    return stripped.split()[0].lower()


def _score_command(command: str, command_name: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []
    command_lower = command.lower()

    if command_name in RESTRICTED_COMMANDS:
        score += 25
        reasons.append(f"restricted command detected: {command_name}")

    for pattern in DANGEROUS_COMMAND_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.lower() in command_lower:
            score += 50
            reasons.append(f"dangerous command pattern detected: {pattern}")

    for pattern in SENSITIVE_PATH_PATTERNS:
        if pattern.lower() in command_lower:
            score += 20
            reasons.append(f"sensitive path access detected: {pattern}")

    return score, reasons


def _sanitize_command(command: str) -> str:
    sanitized = command
    redactions = [
        "authorization=",
        "token=",
        "apikey=",
        "api_key=",
        "password=",
        "secret=",
    ]

    for marker in redactions:
        lower = sanitized.lower()
        index = lower.find(marker)
        if index >= 0:
            end_index = sanitized.find(" ", index)
            if end_index == -1:
                end_index = len(sanitized)
            sanitized = sanitized[:index] + marker + "[REDACTED]" + sanitized[end_index:]

    return sanitized


def evaluate_command(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> CommandSupervisorDecision:
    command = _extract_command(payload)
    command_name = _extract_command_name(command)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    command_score, reasons = _score_command(command, command_name)
    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + command_score)

    tool_payload = {
        "tool_name": "shell",
        "action_type": "toolcall",
        "target": command,
        "content": command,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict"),
    }
    tool_decision = evaluate_tool_call(tool_payload)

    if not reasons:
        reasons = list(tool_decision.reasons)

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("command accepted under current supervision policy")

    return CommandSupervisorDecision(
        allowed=tool_decision.allowed,
        response_status=tool_decision.response_status,
        policy_verdict=tool_decision.policy_verdict,
        risk_score=tool_decision.risk_score,
        should_execute=tool_decision.should_execute,
        halted_by_boundary=tool_decision.halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=tool_decision.requires_review,
        sandbox_lane=tool_decision.sandbox_lane,
        command=command,
        command_name=command_name,
        target=str(_get_value(payload, "target") or command),
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        sanitized_command=_sanitize_command(command),
        metadata={"source": "command_supervisor"},
    )


def summarize_command_supervisor(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_command(payload).to_dict()

    "SENSITIVE_PATH_PATTERNS",
    "RESTRICTED_COMMANDS",
    "CommandSupervisorDecision",
    "evaluate_command",
    "summarize_command_supervisor",
]

    blocked_mime_prefixes: tuple[str, ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_MIME_PREFIXES
    allowed_root_names: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_ROOT_NAMES))
    sensitive_name_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_NAME_PATTERNS
    file_inspection_service: Any | None = None

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        path: str,
        content: str | bytes | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> FileReturnPolicy:
        normalized_path = str(path or "").strip()
        metadata_dict = dict(metadata or {})
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any] = {}
        download_analysis: dict[str, Any] = {}
        output_sanitization: dict[str, Any] = {}
        file_inspection: dict[str, Any] = {}

        if not normalized_path:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Missing path",
                    details="Artifact return was denied because no file path was provided.",
                    score=80,
                )
            )
            return self._finalize(
                reasons=reasons,
                matched_rules=["missing_path"],
                risk_delta=80,
                path="",
                filename="",
                extension="",
                mime_type="application/octet-stream",
                size_bytes=0,
                artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
                download_analysis=download_analysis,
                output_sanitization=output_sanitization,
                file_inspection=file_inspection,
            )

        candidate = Path(normalized_path)
        normalized_posix = candidate.as_posix().replace("\\", "/")
        filename = candidate.name
        extension = candidate.suffix.lower()
        mime_type = mimetypes.guess_type(filename)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
        size_bytes = self._resolve_size_bytes(candidate=candidate, content=content)

        if self._has_parent_escape(normalized_posix):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Path escape attempt",
                    details="Artifact path references parent-directory traversal outside the return boundary.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("path_escape")
            risk_delta += 85

        if self._has_absolute_path(normalized_posix):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Absolute path denied",
                    details="Artifact path must remain relative to an approved sandbox return directory.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("absolute_path")
            risk_delta += 85

        root_name = self._resolve_root_name(candidate)
        allowed_roots = {item.lower() for item in self.allowed_root_names}
        if root_name and root_name not in allowed_roots:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Unapproved artifact root",
                    details=f"Artifact root '{root_name}' is outside the approved return directories.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_root:{root_name}")
            risk_delta += 25

        if extension in self.blocked_extensions:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Blocked file type",
                    details=f"Extension '{extension}' is blocked from leaving the sandbox.",
                    score=90,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"blocked_extension:{extension}")
            risk_delta += 90
        elif extension and extension not in self.allowed_extensions:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Unapproved file type",
                    details=f"Extension '{extension}' is not in the approved artifact return set.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_extension:{extension}")
            risk_delta += 25
        elif not extension:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Missing extension",
                    details="Artifact has no extension and requires review before return.",
                    score=20,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("missing_extension")
            risk_delta += 20

        for blocked_prefix in self.blocked_mime_prefixes:
            if mime_type.startswith(blocked_prefix):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Blocked MIME type",
                        details=f"MIME type '{mime_type}' is blocked by artifact return policy.",
                        score=85,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"blocked_mime:{blocked_prefix}")
                risk_delta += 85

        allowed_mimes = _ALLOWED_MIME_OVERRIDES.get(extension)
        if allowed_mimes and mime_type not in allowed_mimes:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Unexpected MIME type",
                    details=f"MIME type '{mime_type}' does not match the expected type set for '{extension}'.",
                    score=35,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"mime_mismatch:{extension}")
            risk_delta += 35

        if size_bytes > self.max_file_size_bytes:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Oversized artifact",
                    details=(
                        f"Artifact size {size_bytes} bytes exceeded the allowed maximum "
                        f"of {self.max_file_size_bytes} bytes."
                    ),
                    score=55,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("oversized_artifact")
            risk_delta += 55
        elif size_bytes == 0:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Empty artifact",
                    details="Artifact is empty and requires review before return.",
                    score=10,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("empty_artifact")
            risk_delta += 10

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.sensitive_name_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, normalized_posix):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Sensitive artifact name",
                        details=f"Artifact path matched sensitive rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        payload_bytes = self._resolve_payload_bytes(candidate=candidate, content=content)
        payload_text = self._decode_payload_text(payload_bytes)

        binary_risk, binary_reasons, binary_rules = self._inspect_binary_signature(
            filename=filename or normalized_posix,
            extension=extension,
            payload_bytes=payload_bytes,
        )
        reasons.extend(binary_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(binary_rules)
        risk_delta += binary_risk

        archive_risk, archive_reasons, archive_rules = self._inspect_archive_entries(
            filename=filename or normalized_posix,
            extension=extension,
            payload_bytes=payload_bytes,
        )
        reasons.extend(archive_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(archive_rules)
        risk_delta += archive_risk

        artifact_analysis = analyze_artifact_dict(
            artifact_name=filename or normalized_posix,
            content=payload_text or normalized_posix,
            metadata={
                "path": normalized_posix,
                "mimetype": mime_type,
                "sizebytes": size_bytes,
                **metadata_dict,
            },
        )
        artifact_risk, artifact_reasons, artifact_rules = self._consume_analysis(
            source_default="artifactanalyzer",
            label_default="Artifact analysis",
            analysis=artifact_analysis,
        )
        reasons.extend(artifact_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(artifact_rules)
        risk_delta += artifact_risk

        download_analysis = analyze_download_dict(
            actiontype="artifact_return",
            target=filename or normalized_posix,
            content=payload_text or normalized_posix,
            filepath=normalized_posix,
            metadata={
                "path": normalized_posix,
                "mimetype": mime_type,
                "sizebytes": size_bytes,
                **metadata_dict,
            },
        )
        download_risk, download_reasons, download_rules = self._consume_analysis(
            source_default="downloadanalyzer",
            label_default="Download analysis",
            analysis=download_analysis,
        )
        reasons.extend(download_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(download_rules)
        risk_delta += download_risk

        inspection_service = self.file_inspection_service or build_file_inspection_service(
            max_file_size_bytes=self.max_file_size_bytes,
            max_inline_text_bytes=self.max_text_inspection_bytes,
        )
        inspection_result = inspection_service.inspect_artifact(
            file_name=filename or normalized_posix,
            content=payload_bytes,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            metadata={
                "path": normalized_posix,
                "sizebytes": size_bytes,
                **metadata_dict,
            },
            context="sandbox_return",
        )
        file_inspection = inspection_result.as_dict()
        file_inspection_risk = int(file_inspection.get("riskdelta", 0) or 0)
        risk_delta += file_inspection_risk
        if file_inspection.get("shouldquarantine"):
            matched_rules.append("fileinspection:quarantine")
        elif file_inspection.get("blocked"):
            matched_rules.append("fileinspection:block")
        elif file_inspection.get("shouldreview"):
            matched_rules.append("fileinspection:review")
        for item in file_inspection.get("reasons", []) or []:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="fileinspectionservice",
                        label=str(item.get("label", "File inspection")),
                        details=str(item.get("details", item.get("label", "File inspection detected."))),
                        score=int(item.get("score", 0) or 0),
                    )
                )
            else:
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="fileinspectionservice",
                        label="File inspection",
                        details=str(item),
                        score=0,
                    )
                )

        sanitizer = build_output_sanitizer()
        sanitized = sanitizer.sanitize(
            payload_text or filename or normalized_posix,
            context=f"artifact_return:{normalized_posix}",
            redact_secrets=True,
            block_unsafe_commands=True,
        )
        output_sanitization = sanitized.as_dict()
        if output_sanitization.get("blocked"):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Sanitized output blocked",
                    details="Artifact content triggered output sanitization blocking rules.",
                    score=70,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("output_sanitizer_block")
            risk_delta += 70
        else:
            sanitizer_score = int(round(float(output_sanitization.get("score", 0.0)) * 100))
            if sanitizer_score > 0:
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Sanitized output risk",
                        details="Artifact content triggered output sanitization review signals.",
                        score=sanitizer_score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append("output_sanitizer_risk")
                risk_delta += sanitizer_score

        return self._finalize(
            reasons=reasons,
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            risk_delta=risk_delta,
            path=normalized_posix,
            filename=filename,
            extension=extension,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            size_bytes=size_bytes,
            artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
            download_analysis=download_analysis,
            output_sanitization=output_sanitization,
            file_inspection=file_inspection,
        )

    def allow(
        self,
        *,
        path: str,
        content: str | bytes | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(path=path, content=content, metadata=metadata).allowed

    def _resolve_size_bytes(self, *, candidate: Path, content: str | bytes | None) -> int:
        if content is not None:
            if isinstance(content, bytes):
                return len(content)
            return len(content.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        if candidate.exists() and candidate.is_file():
            try:
                return candidate.stat().st_size
            except OSError:
                return 0
        return 0

    def _resolve_payload_bytes(self, *, candidate: Path, content: str | bytes | None) -> bytes:
        if isinstance(content, bytes):
            return content[: self.max_text_inspection_bytes]
        if isinstance(content, str):
            return content.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")[: self.max_text_inspection_bytes]
        if candidate.exists() and candidate.is_file():
            try:
                with candidate.open("rb") as handle:
                    return handle.read(self.max_text_inspection_bytes)
            except OSError:
                return b""
        return b""

    def _decode_payload_text(self, payload: bytes) -> str:
        if not payload:
            return ""
        return payload.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")

    def _resolve_root_name(self, candidate: Path) -> str:
        parts = [part.lower() for part in candidate.parts if part not in {os.sep, ""}]
        if not parts:
            return ""
        if parts[0] == "." and len(parts) > 1:
            return parts[1]
        return parts[0]

    def _has_parent_escape(self, normalized_posix: str) -> bool:
        parts = [part for part in normalized_posix.replace("\\", "/").split("/") if part]
        return ".." in parts

    def _has_absolute_path(self, normalized_posix: str) -> bool:
        if normalized_posix.startswith("/"):
            return True
        return bool(re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:/", normalized_posix))

    def _inspect_binary_signature(
        self,
        *,
        filename: str,
        extension: str,
        payload_bytes: bytes,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[FileReturnReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for magic, label, score in _BINARY_MAGIC_LABELS:
            if payload_bytes.startswith(magic):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source="filereturnguard",
                        label="Dangerous binary signature",
                        details=f"Artifact '{filename}' matched binary signature '{label}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"binary_signature:{label}")
                risk_delta += score

        if extension in {".zip", ".jar"} and payload_bytes.startswith(b"MZ"):
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Extension/content mismatch",
                    details="Artifact extension indicates an archive but payload signature indicates an executable.",
                    score=90,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("extension_content_mismatch")
            risk_delta += 90

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _inspect_archive_entries(
        self,
        *,
        filename: str,
        extension: str,
        payload_bytes: bytes,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[FileReturnReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if extension != ".zip" and not zipfile.is_zipfile(io.BytesIO(payload_bytes)):
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload_bytes), "r") as archive:
                for info in archive.infolist():
                    entry_name = info.filename.replace("\\", "/")
                    if _SUSPICIOUS_ARCHIVE_ENTRY_RE.search(entry_name):
                        reasons.append(
                            FileReturnReason(
                                source="filereturnguard",
                                label="Archive path traversal",
                                details=f"Archive '{filename}' contains suspicious entry '{entry_name}'.",
                                score=85,
                            )
                        )
                        matched_rules.append("archive_path_traversal")
                        risk_delta += 85
                    entry_extension = Path(entry_name).suffix.lower()
                    if entry_extension in self.blocked_extensions:
                        reasons.append(
                            FileReturnReason(
                                source="filereturnguard",
                                label="Archive contains blocked file",
                                details=f"Archive '{filename}' contains blocked entry '{entry_name}'.",
                                score=90,
                            )
                        )
                        matched_rules.append(f"archive_blocked_extension:{entry_extension}")
                        risk_delta += 90
        except zipfile.BadZipFile:
            reasons.append(
                FileReturnReason(
                    source="filereturnguard",
                    label="Invalid archive",
                    details=f"Artifact '{filename}' claims to be an archive but could not be parsed.",
                    score=60,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("invalid_archive")
            risk_delta += 60

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _consume_analysis(
        self,
        *,
        source_default: str,
        label_default: str,
        analysis: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> tuple[int, list[FileReturnReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = int(analysis.get("riskdelta", 0) or 0)

        for item in analysis.get("reasons", []) or []:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source=str(item.get("source", source_default)),
                        label=str(item.get("label", label_default)),
                        details=str(item.get("details", f"{label_default} detected.")),
                        score=int(item.get("score", 0) or 0),
                    )
                )
            else:
                reasons.append(
                    FileReturnReason(
                        source=source_default,
                        label=label_default,
                        details=str(item),
                        score=0,
                    )
                )

        if analysis.get("shouldquarantine"):
            matched_rules.append(f"{source_default}:quarantine")
        elif analysis.get("shouldblock") or analysis.get("blocked"):
            matched_rules.append(f"{source_default}:block")
        elif analysis.get("shouldreview"):
            matched_rules.append(f"{source_default}:review")

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _finalize(
        self,
        *,
        reasons: Iterable[FileReturnReason],
        matched_rules: list[str],
        risk_delta: int,
        path: str,
        filename: str,
        extension: str,
        mime_type: str,
        size_bytes: int,
        artifact_analysis: dict[str, Any],
        download_analysis: dict[str, Any],
        output_sanitization: dict[str, Any],
        file_inspection: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> FileReturnPolicy:
        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        should_quarantine = (
            bool(artifact_analysis.get("shouldquarantine"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("shouldquarantine"))
            or bool(file_inspection.get("shouldquarantine"))
        )
        should_review = (
            bool(artifact_analysis.get("shouldreview"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("shouldreview"))
            or bool(file_inspection.get("shouldreview"))
        )
        should_block = (
            bool(artifact_analysis.get("shouldblock"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("shouldblock"))
            or bool(download_analysis.get("blocked"))
            or bool(file_inspection.get("blocked"))
        )

        if normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold or should_quarantine:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
            should_review = False
        elif normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold or output_sanitization.get("blocked") or should_block:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold or should_review:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True

        deduped_rules = list(dict.fromkeys(item for item in matched_rules if item))
        materialized_reasons = self._dedupe_reasons(reasons)

        return FileReturnPolicy(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            path=path,
            filename=filename,
            extension=extension,
            mime_type=mime_type,
            size_bytes=size_bytes,
            reasons=[reason.as_dict() for reason in materialized_reasons],
            matched_rules=deduped_rules,
            artifact_analysis=artifact_analysis,
            download_analysis=download_analysis,
            output_sanitization=output_sanitization,
            file_inspection=file_inspection,
        )

    def _dedupe_reasons(self, reasons: Iterable[FileReturnReason]) -> list[FileReturnReason]:
        deduped: list[FileReturnReason] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = set()
        for reason in reasons:
            key = (reason.source, reason.label, reason.details, int(reason.score))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(reason)
        return deduped[:20]


def initialize_filereturnguard(
    *,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
    max_file_size_bytes: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024,
    max_text_inspection_bytes: int = 256 * 1024,
    allowed_extensions: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_extensions: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    blocked_mime_prefixes: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    allowed_root_names: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    sensitive_name_patterns: Iterable[tuple[str, str, int]] | None = None,
    file_inspection_service: Any | None = None,
) -> FileReturnGuard:
    return FileReturnGuard(
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
        max_file_size_bytes=max_file_size_bytes,
        max_text_inspection_bytes=max_text_inspection_bytes,
        allowed_extensions=set(allowed_extensions or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS),
        blocked_extensions=set(blocked_extensions or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_EXTENSIONS),
        blocked_mime_prefixes=tuple(blocked_mime_prefixes or DEFAULT_BLOCKED_MIME_PREFIXES),
        allowed_root_names=set(allowed_root_names or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_ROOT_NAMES),
        sensitive_name_patterns=tuple(sensitive_name_patterns or DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_NAME_PATTERNS),
        file_inspection_service=file_inspection_service,
    )


def build_file_return_guard() -> FileReturnGuard:
    return initialize_filereturnguard()

@dataclass(slots=True)
class FileReturnGuardDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    sandbox_lane: str
    risk_score: int
    should_release: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    file_name: str
    file_path: str
    file_extension: str
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _detect_extension(file_path: str, file_name: str) -> str:
    candidate = file_path or file_name
    if not candidate:
        return ""
    return PurePath(candidate).suffix.lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], file_name: str, file_path: str) -> str:
    parts = [file_name, file_path]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "quarantine_reason",
        "content_type",
        "description",
        "source",
        "origin",
        "scan_summary",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("tags", "alerts", "matched_patterns", "failed_checks", "reasons"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _score_extension(file_extension: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if file_extension in HIGH_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 70, [f"high-risk file extension detected: {file_extension}"]
    if file_extension in MEDIUM_RISK_EXTENSIONS:
        return 25, [f"reviewable file extension detected: {file_extension}"]
    return 0, []


def _score_keywords(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for keyword in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 25
            reasons.append(f"high-risk file keyword detected: {keyword}")

    for keyword in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 10
            reasons.append(f"review keyword detected: {keyword}")

    return score, reasons


def evaluate_file_return(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> FileReturnGuardDecision:
    file_name = str(_get_value(payload, "file_name", "name") or "")
    file_path = str(_get_value(payload, "file_path", "filepath", "path") or "")
    file_extension = _detect_extension(file_path, file_name)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, file_name, file_path)
    extension_score, extension_reasons = _score_extension(file_extension)
    keyword_score, keyword_reasons = _score_keywords(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + extension_score + keyword_score)
    reasons = [*extension_reasons, *keyword_reasons]

    route_payload = {
        "target": file_path or file_name,
        "content": signal_text,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict") or payload.get("verdict"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "quarantine_reason": payload.get("quarantine_reason"),
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
    }
    route_decision = route_to_sandbox(route_payload)

    if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK:
        response_status = "denied"
        policy_verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
        should_release = False
    elif route_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        policy_verdict = "quarantine" if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.FILE_QUARANTINE else "warn"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
        should_release = False
    else:
        response_status = "completed"
        policy_verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        halted_by_boundary = False
        should_release = True

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("file return accepted under current low-risk policy")

    return FileReturnGuardDecision(
        allowed=allowed,
        response_status=response_status,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict,
        sandbox_lane=route_decision.lane.value,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        should_release=should_release,
        halted_by_boundary=halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=route_decision.requires_review,
        file_name=file_name,
        file_path=file_path,
        file_extension=file_extension,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        metadata={"source": "file_return_guard"},
    )


def summarize_file_return_guard(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_file_return(payload).to_dict()

    "FileReturnGuardDecision",
    "evaluate_file_return",
    "summarize_file_return_guard",
]

from __future__ import annotations
