@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkReason:
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: int = 0

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "source": self.source,
            "label": self.label,
            "details": self.details,
            "score": int(self.score),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkPolicy:
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    should_review: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    risk_delta: int
    scheme: str
    host: str
    port: int | None
    path: str
    normalized_url: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    direction: str = "egress"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.risk_delta),
            "scheme": self.scheme,
            "host": self.host,
            "port": self.port,
            "path": self.path,
            "normalizedurl": self.normalized_url,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "direction": self.direction,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkGuard:
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80
    allowed_schemes: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_SCHEMES))
    blocked_schemes: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_BLOCKED_SCHEMES))
    allowed_hosts: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS))
    blocked_host_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_HOST_PATTERNS
    blocked_path_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_BLOCKED_PATH_PATTERNS
    sensitive_field_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_SENSITIVE_FIELD_PATTERNS
    exfil_content_patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str, int], ...] = DEFAULT_EXFIL_CONTENT_PATTERNS
    high_risk_ports: dict[int, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: dict(DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_PORTS))
    allow_private_hosts: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.allowed_schemes = {item.strip().lower() for item in self.allowed_schemes if str(item).strip()}
        self.blocked_schemes = {item.strip().lower() for item in self.blocked_schemes if str(item).strip()}
        self.allowed_hosts = {item.strip().lower() for item in self.allowed_hosts if str(item).strip()}
        self._allowed_host_suffixes = self._expand_allowed_host_suffixes(self.allowed_hosts)
        self._secret_scanner = build_secret_scanner()

    def evaluate(
        self,
        *,
        url: str,
        method: str = "GET",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> NetworkPolicy:
        normalized_url = str(url or "").strip()
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0
        metadata_map = dict(metadata or {})
        direction = str(metadata_map.get("direction") or "egress").strip().lower() or "egress"

        if not normalized_url:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Missing URL",
                    details="Network request was denied because no URL was provided.",
                    score=80,
                )
            )
            return self._finalize(
                reasons=reasons,
                matched_rules=["missing_url"],
                risk_delta=80,
                scheme="",
                host="",
                port=None,
                path="",
                normalized_url=normalized_url,
                direction=direction,
            )

        parsed = urlparse(normalized_url)
        scheme = (parsed.scheme or "").strip().lower()
        host = (parsed.hostname or "").strip().lower()
        port = parsed.port
        path = parsed.path or "/"
        normalized_method = str(method or "GET").upper()

        if not scheme:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Missing scheme",
                    details="Network request must include an explicit scheme such as https.",
                    score=60,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("missing_scheme")
            risk_delta += 60

        if scheme in self.blocked_schemes:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Blocked scheme",
                    details=f"Scheme '{scheme}' is blocked by runtime network policy.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"blocked_scheme:{scheme}")
            risk_delta += 85
        elif scheme and scheme not in self.allowed_schemes:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Unapproved scheme",
                    details=f"Scheme '{scheme}' is outside the approved network policy set.",
                    score=35,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unapproved_scheme:{scheme}")
            risk_delta += 35

        if not host:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Missing host",
                    details="Network request URL did not resolve to a host component.",
                    score=70,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("missing_host")
            risk_delta += 70
        else:
            host_risk, host_reasons, host_rules = self._evaluate_host(host)
            reasons.extend(host_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(host_rules)
            risk_delta += host_risk

        path_risk, path_reasons, path_rules = self._evaluate_path(path)
        reasons.extend(path_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(path_rules)
        risk_delta += path_risk

        port_risk, port_reasons, port_rules = self._evaluate_port(port=port, scheme=scheme)
        reasons.extend(port_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(port_rules)
        risk_delta += port_risk

        query_risk, query_reasons, query_rules = self._evaluate_query(parsed.query)
        reasons.extend(query_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(query_rules)
        risk_delta += query_risk

        header_risk, header_reasons, header_rules = self._evaluate_headers(metadata_map.get("headers"))
        reasons.extend(header_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(header_rules)
        risk_delta += header_risk

        body_risk, body_reasons, body_rules = self._evaluate_outbound_content(metadata_map)
        reasons.extend(body_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(body_rules)
        risk_delta += body_risk

        if normalized_method not in {"GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Unexpected method",
                    details=f"HTTP method '{normalized_method}' is non-standard for this runtime profile.",
                    score=10,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"unexpected_method:{normalized_method}")
            risk_delta += 10

        if host and self._is_explicitly_allowed_host(host):
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Approved destination",
                    details=f"Host '{host}' is explicitly allowlisted for sandbox egress.",
                    score=0,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"allowed_host:{host}")

        return self._finalize(
            reasons=reasons,
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            risk_delta=risk_delta,
            scheme=scheme,
            host=host,
            port=port,
            path=path,
            normalized_url=normalized_url,
            direction=direction,
        )

    def allow(
        self,
        *,
        url: str,
        method: str = "GET",
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(url=url, method=method, metadata=metadata).allowed

    def _evaluate_host(self, host: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.blocked_host_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, host):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Blocked destination",
                        details=f"Destination host matched blocked rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        ip_risk, ip_reasons, ip_rules = self._evaluate_ip_host(host)
        reasons.extend(ip_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(ip_rules)
        risk_delta += ip_risk

        if "." not in host and host not in {"localhost"}:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Single-label host",
                    details=f"Host '{host}' is a single-label destination and requires review.",
                    score=25,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("single_label_host")
            risk_delta += 25

        if host and not self._is_explicitly_allowed_host(host):
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Unapproved destination",
                    details=f"Host '{host}' is not on the approved egress allowlist.",
                    score=20,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("host_not_allowlisted")
            risk_delta += 20

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_ip_host(self, host: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        try:
            ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
        except ValueError:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        if ip.is_loopback:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Loopback destination",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is loopback and is blocked.",
                    score=95,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("loopback_ip")
            risk_delta += 95

        if ip.is_link_local:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Link-local destination",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is link-local and is blocked.",
                    score=95,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("link_local_ip")
            risk_delta += 95

        if ip.is_multicast or ip.is_reserved or ip.is_unspecified:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Restricted IP range",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is in a restricted address range.",
                    score=85,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("restricted_ip_range")
            risk_delta += 85

        if ip.is_private and not self.allow_private_hosts:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Private network destination",
                    details=f"Destination IP '{host}' is private and blocked by sandbox egress policy.",
                    score=90,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append("private_ip")
            risk_delta += 90

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_path(self, path: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.blocked_path_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, path):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Blocked path",
                        details=f"Request path matched blocked rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(rule_name)
                risk_delta += int(score)

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_port(self, *, port: int | None, scheme: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if port is None:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        default_port = 443 if scheme == "https" else 80 if scheme == "http" else None
        if default_port is not None and port != default_port:
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="Non-standard port",
                    details=f"Port '{port}' is non-standard for scheme '{scheme}'.",
                    score=15,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"non_standard_port:{port}")
            risk_delta += 15

        if port in self.high_risk_ports:
            score = int(self.high_risk_ports[port])
            reasons.append(
                NetworkReason(
                    source="networkguard",
                    label="High-risk port",
                    details=f"Port '{port}' is high risk for sandbox egress.",
                    score=score,
                )
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"high_risk_port:{port}")
            risk_delta += score

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_query(self, query: str) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not query:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        pairs = parse_qsl(query, keep_blank_values=True)

        for key, value in pairs:
            field_risk, field_reasons, field_rules = self._evaluate_sensitive_field_name(
                field_name=key,
                location="query parameter",
            )
            reasons.extend(field_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(field_rules)
            risk_delta += field_risk

            combined = f"{key}={value}"
            secret_scan = self._secret_scanner.scan_text(combined)
            if secret_scan.found:
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Secret in query string",
                        details=f"Query parameter '{key}' appears to contain credential or secret material.",
                        score=70,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"secret_query_param:{key.lower()}")
                risk_delta += 70

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_headers(self, headers: Any) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not isinstance(headers, Mapping):
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        for key, value in headers.items():
            header_name = str(key)
            field_risk, field_reasons, field_rules = self._evaluate_sensitive_field_name(
                field_name=header_name,
                location="header",
            )
            reasons.extend(field_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(field_rules)
            risk_delta += field_risk

            combined = f"{header_name}: {self._to_text(value)}"
            secret_scan = self._secret_scanner.scan_text(combined)
            if secret_scan.found:
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Secret-bearing header",
                        details=f"Header '{header_name}' appears to carry secret or credential material.",
                        score=75,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"secret_header:{header_name.lower()}")
                risk_delta += 75

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_outbound_content(self, metadata: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        content_candidates: list[tuple[str, Any]] = [
            ("body", metadata.get("body")),
            ("payload", metadata.get("payload")),
            ("content", metadata.get("content")),
            ("data", metadata.get("data")),
            ("json", metadata.get("json")),
            ("files", metadata.get("files")),
        ]

        for location, value in content_candidates:
            if value in {None, "", b"", bytearray()}:
                continue

            text = self._to_text(value)
            if not text:
                continue

            secret_scan = self._secret_scanner.scan_text(text)
            if secret_scan.found:
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Secret-bearing outbound content",
                        details=f"Outbound {location} appears to contain secret or credential material.",
                        score=min(90, 35 + secret_scan.risk_delta),
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"secret_outbound_content:{location}")
                risk_delta += min(90, 35 + secret_scan.risk_delta)

            pattern_risk, pattern_reasons, pattern_rules = self._evaluate_exfil_text_patterns(
                text=text,
                location=location,
            )
            reasons.extend(pattern_reasons)
            matched_rules.extend(pattern_rules)
            risk_delta += pattern_risk

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_sensitive_field_name(
        self,
        *,
        field_name: str,
        location: str,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        normalized = str(field_name or "").strip()
        if not normalized:
            return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.sensitive_field_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, normalized):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Sensitive outbound field",
                        details=f"{location.title()} '{normalized}' matched sensitive field rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"{location.replace(' ', '_')}:{rule_name}")
                risk_delta += int(score)

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_exfil_text_patterns(
        self,
        *,
        text: str,
        location: str,
    ) -> tuple[int, list[NetworkReason], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[NetworkReason] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        for rule_name, pattern, score in self.exfil_content_patterns:
            if re.search(pattern, text):
                reasons.append(
                    NetworkReason(
                        source="networkguard",
                        label="Exfiltration indicator",
                        details=f"Outbound {location} matched exfiltration rule '{rule_name}'.",
                        score=score,
                    )
                )
                matched_rules.append(f"content:{rule_name}")
                risk_delta += int(score)

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _expand_allowed_host_suffixes(self, hosts: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
        suffixes: set[str] = set()
        for host in hosts:
            normalized = host.strip().lower()
            if not normalized:
                continue
            suffixes.add(normalized)
            suffixes.add(f".{normalized}")
        return suffixes

    def _is_explicitly_allowed_host(self, host: str) -> bool:
        normalized = host.strip().lower()
        if normalized in self.allowed_hosts:
            return True
        return any(normalized.endswith(suffix) for suffix in self._allowed_host_suffixes if suffix.startswith("."))

    def _to_text(self, value: Any) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
            return value.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
            return self._serialize_mapping(value)
        if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            return "\n".join(self._to_text(item) for item in value)
        return str(value)

    def _serialize_mapping(self, value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
        return "\n".join(f"{key}: {self._to_text(item)}" for key, item in value.items())

    def _dedupe_reasons(self, reasons: Iterable[NetworkReason]) -> list[NetworkReason]:
        deduped: list[NetworkReason] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = set()
        for reason in reasons:
            key = (reason.source, reason.label, reason.details, int(reason.score))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(reason)
        return deduped

    def _dedupe_rules(self, matched_rules: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
        deduped: list[str] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for item in matched_rules:
            if item in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(item)
            deduped.append(item)
        return deduped

    def _finalize(
        self,
        *,
        reasons: Iterable[NetworkReason],
        matched_rules: list[str],
        risk_delta: int,
        scheme: str,
        host: str,
        port: int | None,
        path: str,
        normalized_url: str,
        direction: str,
    ) -> NetworkPolicy:
        deduped_reasons = self._dedupe_reasons(reasons)
        deduped_rules = self._dedupe_rules(matched_rules)
        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        if normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
        elif normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True

        return NetworkPolicy(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            scheme=scheme,
            host=host,
            port=port,
            path=path,
            normalized_url=normalized_url,
            reasons=[reason.as_dict() for reason in deduped_reasons],
            matched_rules=deduped_rules,
            direction=direction,
        )


def initialize_networkguard(

    )

    return initialize_networkguard()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Mapping
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from app.runtime.sandbox_router import SandboxLane, route_to_sandbox


LOCAL_HOSTS = {
    "localhost",
    "127.0.0.1",
    "::1",
    "0.0.0.0",
    "host.docker.internal",
}

HIGH_RISK_SCHEMES = {
    "file",
    "ftp",
    "smb",
    "ssh",
}

MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "download",
    "upload",
    "fetch",
    "webhook",
    "remote",
    "external",
    "redirect",
    "archive",
}

HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS = {
    "metadata",
    "credential",
    "token",
    "cookie",
    "exfiltrate",
    "callback",
    "beacon",
    "command and control",
    "c2",
    "internal service",
    "169.254.169.254",
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class NetworkGuardDecision:
    allowed: bool
    response_status: str
    policy_verdict: str
    sandbox_lane: str
    risk_score: int
    should_execute: bool
    halted_by_boundary: bool
    requires_review: bool
    url: str
    hostname: str
    scheme: str
    is_local_target: bool
    is_private_target: bool
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _get_value(payload: Mapping[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _extract_url(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    value = _get_value(payload, "url", "target", "target_value", "resource")
    return str(value or "")


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any], url: str) -> str:
    parts = [url]

    for key in (
        "summary",
        "reason",
        "content",
        "description",
        "action_type",
        "target_type",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("reasons", "failed_checks", "matched_patterns", "tags", "alerts"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            parts.extend(str(item) for item in value if item is not None)
        elif value is not None:
            parts.append(str(value))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _is_private_target(hostname: str) -> bool:
    if not hostname:
        return False

    hostname = hostname.lower()

    if hostname in LOCAL_HOSTS:
        return True

    private_prefixes = (
        "10.",
        "192.168.",
        "172.16.",
        "172.17.",
        "172.18.",
        "172.19.",
        "172.20.",
        "172.21.",
        "172.22.",
        "172.23.",
        "172.24.",
        "172.25.",
        "172.26.",
        "172.27.",
        "172.28.",
        "172.29.",
        "172.30.",
        "172.31.",
    )

    return hostname.startswith(private_prefixes)


def _scheme_score(scheme: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    if scheme in HIGH_RISK_SCHEMES:
        return 50, [f"high-risk network scheme detected: {scheme}"]
    if scheme in {"http", "https"}:
        return 10, [f"external network request detected: {scheme}"]
    if scheme:
        return 20, [f"unrecognized network scheme detected: {scheme}"]
    return 0, []


def _target_score(hostname: str, is_private_target: bool) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    reasons: list[str] = []
    score = 0

    if not hostname:
        return 20, ["missing hostname in network request"]

    if hostname.lower() in LOCAL_HOSTS:
        score += 70
        reasons.append(f"local target detected: {hostname}")
    elif is_private_target:
        score += 60
        reasons.append(f"private-network target detected: {hostname}")

    if hostname.endswith(".local"):
        score += 40
        reasons.append(f"local-domain target detected: {hostname}")

    return score, reasons


def _keyword_score(signal_text: str) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    score = 0
    reasons: list[str] = []

    for keyword in HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 30
            reasons.append(f"high-risk network keyword detected: {keyword}")

    for keyword in MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS:
        if keyword in signal_text:
            score += 10
            reasons.append(f"network review keyword detected: {keyword}")

    return score, reasons


def evaluate_network_request(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> NetworkGuardDecision:
    url = _extract_url(payload)
    parsed = urlparse(url if "://" in url else f"https://{url}" if url else "")
    hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower()
    scheme = _normalize_text(parsed.scheme)
    is_private_target = _is_private_target(hostname)
    base_risk = _safe_int(_get_value(payload, "risk_score", "score"), 0)

    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload, url)
    scheme_score, scheme_reasons = _scheme_score(scheme)
    target_score, target_reasons = _target_score(hostname, is_private_target)
    keyword_score, keyword_reasons = _keyword_score(signal_text)

    total_risk = min(100, base_risk + scheme_score + target_score + keyword_score)
    reasons = [*scheme_reasons, *target_reasons, *keyword_reasons]

    route_payload = {
        "action_type": payload.get("action_type") or "network_request",
        "target": url,
        "content": signal_text,
        "risk_score": total_risk,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "policy_verdict": payload.get("policy_verdict") or payload.get("verdict"),
        "summary": payload.get("summary"),
        "reason": payload.get("reason"),
    }
    route_decision = route_to_sandbox(route_payload)

    if route_decision.lane == SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK:
        response_status = "denied"
        policy_verdict = "deny"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
    elif route_decision.requires_review:
        response_status = "queued_for_review"
        policy_verdict = "warn"
        allowed = False
        halted_by_boundary = True
    else:
        response_status = "completed"
        policy_verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        halted_by_boundary = False

    if not reasons:
        reasons.append("network request accepted under current low-risk policy")

    return NetworkGuardDecision(
        allowed=allowed,
        response_status=response_status,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict,
        sandbox_lane=route_decision.lane.value,
        risk_score=total_risk,
        should_execute=route_decision.should_execute and allowed,
        halted_by_boundary=halted_by_boundary,
        requires_review=route_decision.requires_review,
        url=url,
        hostname=hostname,
        scheme=scheme,
        is_local_target=hostname in LOCAL_HOSTS,
        is_private_target=is_private_target,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        metadata={"source": "network_guard"},
    )


def summarize_network_guard(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_network_request(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "LOCAL_HOSTS",
    "HIGH_RISK_SCHEMES",
    "MEDIUM_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "HIGH_RISK_KEYWORDS",
    "NetworkGuardDecision",
    "evaluate_network_request",
    "summarize_network_guard",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, MutableMapping, Sequence

from app.runtime.commandsupervisor import CommandPolicy, build_command_supervisor
from app.runtime.filereturnguard import FileReturnPolicy, build_file_return_guard
from app.runtime.networkguard import NetworkPolicy, build_network_guard


ExecutorCallable = Callable[..., Any]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxExecutionRequest:
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    command: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
    network_url: str | None = None
    network_method: str = "GET"
    artifact_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    content: str | bytes | None = None
    cwd: str | None = None
    timeout_seconds: int = 30
    environment_scope: str = "sandbox"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "actiontype": self.actiontype,
            "target": self.target,
            "command": self.command,
            "networkurl": self.network_url,
            "networkmethod": self.network_method,
            "artifactpaths": list(self.artifact_paths),
            "cwd": self.cwd,
            "timeoutseconds": int(self.timeout_seconds),
            "environmentscope": self.environment_scope,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxExecutionDecision:
    executionstate: str
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    shouldreview: bool
    shouldblock: bool
    shouldquarantine: bool
    riskdelta: int
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    commandsupervision: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    networkpolicy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    artifactpolicies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "executionstate": self.executionstate,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.shouldreview,
            "shouldblock": self.shouldblock,
            "shouldquarantine": self.shouldquarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.riskdelta),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "commandsupervision": dict(self.commandsupervision),
            "networkpolicy": dict(self.networkpolicy),
            "artifactpolicies": list(self.artifactpolicies),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxExecutionResult:
    executionstate: str
    verdict: str
    executed: bool
    result: Any = None
    decision: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    telemetry: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "executionstate": self.executionstate,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "executed": self.executed,
            "result": self.result,
            "decision": dict(self.decision),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "telemetry": dict(self.telemetry),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxRouter:
    command_supervisor: Any = field(default_factory=build_command_supervisor)
    network_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_network_guard)
    file_return_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_file_return_guard)
    default_executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None
    max_timeout_seconds: int = 300
    name: str = "sandboxrouter"

    def route(
        self,
        *,
        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,
        executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None,
    ) -> SandboxExecutionResult:
        decision = self.evaluate(request=request)

        if not decision.allowed:
            return SandboxExecutionResult(
                executionstate="denied",
                verdict=decision.verdict,
                executed=False,
                result=None,
                decision=decision.as_dict(),
                reasons=list(decision.reasons),
                telemetry=self._build_telemetry(request=request, decision=decision, executed=False),
            )

        runtime_executor = executor or self.default_executor
        if runtime_executor is None:
            return SandboxExecutionResult(
                executionstate="approved",
                verdict=decision.verdict,
                executed=False,
                result=None,
                decision=decision.as_dict(),
                reasons=list(decision.reasons),
                telemetry=self._build_telemetry(request=request, decision=decision, executed=False),
            )

        payload = self._build_executor_payload(request=request, decision=decision)
        result = runtime_executor(**payload)

        return SandboxExecutionResult(
            executionstate="executed",
            verdict=decision.verdict,
            executed=True,
            result=result,
            decision=decision.as_dict(),
            reasons=list(decision.reasons),
            telemetry=self._build_telemetry(request=request, decision=decision, executed=True),
        )

    def evaluate(self, *, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> SandboxExecutionDecision:
        normalized_request = self._normalize_request(request)
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        riskdelta = 0

        command_policy = self._evaluate_command_policy(normalized_request)
        if command_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(command_policy.reasons)
            riskdelta += int(command_policy.risk_delta)

        network_policy = self._evaluate_network_policy(normalized_request)
        if network_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(network_policy.reasons)
            riskdelta += int(network_policy.risk_delta)

        artifact_policies = self._evaluate_artifact_policies(normalized_request)
        for policy in artifact_policies:
            reasons.extend(policy.reasons)
            riskdelta += int(policy.risk_delta)

        if normalized_request.environment_scope.lower() != "sandbox":
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "sandboxrouter",
                    "label": "Environment boundary",
                    "details": (
                        f"Execution requested environment scope '{normalized_request.environment_scope}' "
                        "outside the default sandbox boundary."
                    ),
                    "score": 45,
                }
            )
            riskdelta += 45

        verdict = "allow"
        executionstate = "approved"
        allowed = True
        shouldreview = False
        shouldblock = False
        shouldquarantine = False

        policies = [policy for policy in (command_policy, network_policy, *artifact_policies) if policy is not None]

        if any(getattr(policy, "should_quarantine", False) for policy in policies):
            verdict = "quarantine"
            executionstate = "denied"
            allowed = False
            shouldblock = True
            shouldquarantine = True
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_block", False) for policy in policies):
            verdict = "block"
            executionstate = "denied"
            allowed = False
            shouldblock = True
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_review", False) for policy in policies):
            verdict = "review"
            executionstate = "queuedforreview"
            shouldreview = True

        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(riskdelta)))

        reasons.insert(
            0,
            {
                "source": "sandboxrouter",
                "label": "Sandbox routing",
                "details": (
                    f"Sandbox router evaluated action '{normalized_request.actiontype}' "
                    f"for target '{normalized_request.target}' with cumulative risk {normalized_risk}."
                ),
                "score": normalized_risk,
            },
        )

        return SandboxExecutionDecision(
            executionstate=executionstate,
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            shouldreview=shouldreview,
            shouldblock=shouldblock,
            shouldquarantine=shouldquarantine,
            riskdelta=normalized_risk,
            reasons=reasons,
            commandsupervision=command_policy.as_dict() if command_policy is not None else {},
            networkpolicy=network_policy.as_dict() if network_policy is not None else {},
            artifactpolicies=[policy.as_dict() for policy in artifact_policies],
        )

    def _normalize_request(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> SandboxExecutionRequest:
        timeout_seconds = max(1, min(int(request.timeout_seconds), int(self.max_timeout_seconds)))
        metadata = dict(request.metadata or {})
        metadata.setdefault("router", self.name)
        metadata.setdefault("environment_scope", request.environment_scope)

        return SandboxExecutionRequest(
            actiontype=str(request.actiontype or "").strip().lower(),
            target=str(request.target or "").strip().lower(),
            command=request.command,
            network_url=str(request.network_url or "").strip() or None,
            network_method=str(request.network_method or "GET").upper(),
            artifact_paths=[str(item).strip() for item in request.artifact_paths if str(item).strip()],
            content=request.content,
            cwd=str(request.cwd).strip() if request.cwd else None,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
            environment_scope=str(request.environment_scope or "sandbox").strip(),
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def _evaluate_command_policy(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> CommandPolicy | None:
        if request.command is None:
            return None
        return self.command_supervisor.evaluate(
            command=request.command,
            actiontype=request.actiontype,
            target=request.target,
            cwd=request.cwd,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "environment_scope": request.environment_scope,
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_network_policy(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> NetworkPolicy | None:
        if not request.network_url:
            return None
        return self.network_guard.evaluate(
            url=request.network_url,
            method=request.network_method,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "direction": "egress",
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_artifact_policies(self, request: SandboxExecutionRequest) -> list[FileReturnPolicy]:
        policies: list[FileReturnPolicy] = []
        for artifact_path in request.artifact_paths:
            policies.append(
                self.file_return_guard.evaluate(
                    path=artifact_path,
                    content=request.content,
                    metadata=request.metadata,
                )
            )
        return policies

    def _build_executor_payload(
        self,
        *,
        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,
        decision: SandboxExecutionDecision,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload: MutableMapping[str, Any] = {
            "actiontype": request.actiontype,
            "target": request.target,
            "timeout_seconds": request.timeout_seconds,
            "cwd": request.cwd,
            "environment_scope": request.environment_scope,
            "metadata": {
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "sandboxdecision": decision.as_dict(),
            },
        }
        if request.command is not None:
            payload["command"] = request.command
        if request.network_url is not None:
            payload["network_url"] = request.network_url
            payload["network_method"] = request.network_method
        if request.artifact_paths:
            payload["artifact_paths"] = list(request.artifact_paths)
        if request.content is not None:
            payload["content"] = request.content
        return dict(payload)

    def _build_telemetry(
        self,
        *,
        request: SandboxExecutionRequest,
        decision: SandboxExecutionDecision,
        executed: bool,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "router": self.name,
            "actiontype": request.actiontype,
            "target": request.target,
            "executed": executed,
            "timeoutseconds": int(request.timeout_seconds),
            "environmentscope": request.environment_scope,
            "artifactcount": len(request.artifact_paths),
            "hascommand": request.command is not None,
            "hasnetwork": bool(request.network_url),
            "verdict": decision.verdict,
            "riskdelta": int(decision.riskdelta),
        }


def initialize_sandboxrouter(
    *,
    command_supervisor: Any | None = None,
    network_guard: Any | None = None,
    file_return_guard: Any | None = None,
    default_executor: ExecutorCallable | None = None,
    max_timeout_seconds: int = 300,
) -> SandboxRouter:
    return SandboxRouter(
        command_supervisor=command_supervisor or build_command_supervisor(),
        network_guard=network_guard or build_network_guard(),
        file_return_guard=file_return_guard or build_file_return_guard(),
        default_executor=default_executor,
        max_timeout_seconds=max_timeout_seconds,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Mapping


class SandboxLane(str, Enum):
    SAFE_READONLY = "safe_readonly"
    PROMPT_INJECTION = "prompt_injection"
    DOWNLOAD_REVIEW = "download_review"
    FILE_QUARANTINE = "file_quarantine"
    NETWORK_RESTRICTED = "network_restricted"
    TOOL_CALL_RESTRICTED = "tool_call_restricted"
    HUMAN_REVIEW = "human_review"
    HARD_BLOCK = "hard_block"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SandboxRouteDecision:
    lane: SandboxLane
    should_execute: bool
    requires_review: bool
    isolate_output: bool
    allow_network: bool
    allow_tool_calls: bool
    allow_file_write: bool
    reason: str
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    risk_score: int = 0
    policy_verdict: str = "allow"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _as_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _as_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple | set):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip().lower()


def _collect_signal_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []

    for key in (
        "reason",
        "summary",
        "quarantine_reason",
        "action_type",
        "target",
        "target_type",
        "target_value",
        "content",
        "policy_verdict",
        "review_status",
    ):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value:
            parts.append(str(value))

    for key in ("reasons", "failed_checks", "matched_patterns", "alerts", "tags"):
        for item in _as_list(payload.get(key)):
            if item:
                parts.append(str(item))

    return " | ".join(parts).lower()


def _extract_policy_verdict(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    for key in ("policy_verdict", "verdict", "response_status"):
        value = payload.get(key)
        if value:
            return _normalize_text(value)
    return "allow"


def _extract_risk_score(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int:
    for key in ("risk_score", "score", "severity"):
        if key in payload:
            return _as_int(payload.get(key), 0)
    return 0


def route_to_sandbox(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> SandboxRouteDecision:
    risk_score = _extract_risk_score(payload)
    policy_verdict = _extract_policy_verdict(payload)
    signal_text = _collect_signal_text(payload)

    reasons: list[str] = []

    if policy_verdict in {"block", "blocked", "deny", "denied"} or risk_score >= 95:
        reasons.append("hard block triggered by policy or extreme risk score")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.HARD_BLOCK,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=False,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "deny",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "prompt injection" in signal_text
        or "jailbreak" in signal_text
        or "ignore previous instructions" in signal_text
        or "system prompt" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("prompt injection indicators detected")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.PROMPT_INJECTION,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "quarantine",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "quarantine" in signal_text
        or "malware" in signal_text
        or "payload" in signal_text
        or "executable" in signal_text
        or "macro" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("file or artifact should be isolated in quarantine lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.FILE_QUARANTINE,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "quarantine",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "download" in signal_text
        or "dependency" in signal_text
        or "package" in signal_text
        or "repository" in signal_text
        or "repo" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("downloaded or imported material requires restricted review lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.DOWNLOAD_REVIEW,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "http" in signal_text
        or "network" in signal_text
        or "fetch" in signal_text
        or "url" in signal_text
        or risk_score >= 70
    ):
        reasons.append("network-linked action routed to restricted network lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.NETWORK_RESTRICTED,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if (
        "toolcall" in signal_text
        or "tool call" in signal_text
        or "shell" in signal_text
        or "command" in signal_text
        or "subprocess" in signal_text
    ):
        reasons.append("tool or command execution requires restricted tool-call lane")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.TOOL_CALL_RESTRICTED,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    if policy_verdict in {"warn", "review"} or risk_score >= 40:
        reasons.append("moderate risk routed for human review")
        return SandboxRouteDecision(
            lane=SandboxLane.HUMAN_REVIEW,
            should_execute=False,
            requires_review=True,
            isolate_output=True,
            allow_network=False,
            allow_tool_calls=False,
            allow_file_write=False,
            reason=reasons[0],
            reasons=reasons,
            risk_score=risk_score,
            policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "warn",
            metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
        )

    reasons.append("request qualifies for safe readonly handling")
    return SandboxRouteDecision(
        lane=SandboxLane.SAFE_READONLY,
        should_execute=True,
        requires_review=False,
        isolate_output=False,
        allow_network=False,
        allow_tool_calls=False,
        allow_file_write=False,
        reason=reasons[0],
        reasons=reasons,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        policy_verdict=policy_verdict or "allow",
        metadata={"source": "sandbox_router"},
    )


def summarize_sandbox_route(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return route_to_sandbox(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "SandboxLane",
    "SandboxRouteDecision",
    "route_to_sandbox",
    "summarize_sandbox_route",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled", "healthy", "ready"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled", "unhealthy", "not_ready"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


def _derive_health(ready: bool, degraded: bool, incident_count: int) -> str:
    if not ready:
        return "down"
    if degraded or incident_count > 0:
        return "degraded"
    return "healthy"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RuntimeStatus:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    version: str = "dev"
    runtime_id: str = "primary"
    health: str = "healthy"
    ready: bool = True
    degraded: bool = False
    enforcement_mode: str = "enforce"
    sandbox_available: bool = True
    policy_engine_loaded: bool = True
    telemetry_pipeline_ready: bool = True
    review_queue_available: bool = True
    active_sessions: int = 0
    queued_reviews: int = 0
    quarantined_items: int = 0
    open_incidents: int = 0
    uptime_seconds: int = 0
    started_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "version": self.version,
            "runtime_id": self.runtime_id,
            "health": self.health,
            "ready": self.ready,
            "degraded": self.degraded,
            "enforcement_mode": self.enforcement_mode,
            "sandbox_available": self.sandbox_available,
            "policy_engine_loaded": self.policy_engine_loaded,
            "telemetry_pipeline_ready": self.telemetry_pipeline_ready,
            "review_queue_available": self.review_queue_available,
            "active_sessions": self.active_sessions,
            "queued_reviews": self.queued_reviews,
            "quarantined_items": self.quarantined_items,
            "open_incidents": self.open_incidents,
            "uptime_seconds": self.uptime_seconds,
            "started_at": _isoformat(self.started_at),
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def default_runtime_status() -> RuntimeStatus:
    return RuntimeStatus()


def build_runtime_status(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: RuntimeStatus | None = None,
) -> RuntimeStatus:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_runtime_status()

    ready = _coerce_bool(source.get("ready"), current.ready)
    degraded = _coerce_bool(source.get("degraded"), current.degraded)
    open_incidents = _coerce_int(source.get("open_incidents"), current.open_incidents)

    health = _coerce_str(source.get("health"))
    if not health:
        health = _derive_health(ready=ready, degraded=degraded, incident_count=open_incidents)

    started_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("started_at"), current.started_at) or _utc_now()
    checked_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    return RuntimeStatus(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        version=_coerce_str(source.get("version"), current.version) or current.version,
        runtime_id=_coerce_str(source.get("runtime_id"), current.runtime_id) or current.runtime_id,
        health=health,
        ready=ready,
        degraded=degraded,
        enforcement_mode=_coerce_str(source.get("enforcement_mode"), current.enforcement_mode) or current.enforcement_mode,
        sandbox_available=_coerce_bool(source.get("sandbox_available"), current.sandbox_available),
        policy_engine_loaded=_coerce_bool(source.get("policy_engine_loaded"), current.policy_engine_loaded),
        telemetry_pipeline_ready=_coerce_bool(source.get("telemetry_pipeline_ready"), current.telemetry_pipeline_ready),
        review_queue_available=_coerce_bool(source.get("review_queue_available"), current.review_queue_available),
        active_sessions=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("active_sessions"), current.active_sessions)),
        queued_reviews=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("queued_reviews"), current.queued_reviews)),
        quarantined_items=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("quarantined_items"), current.quarantined_items)),
        open_incidents=max(0, open_incidents),
        uptime_seconds=max(0, _coerce_int(source.get("uptime_seconds"), current.uptime_seconds)),
        started_at=started_at,
        checked_at=checked_at,
    )


def runtime_status_summary(status: RuntimeStatus) -> dict[str, Any]:
    control_plane_ready = all(

        "capabilities": {
            "sandbox_available": status.sandbox_available,
            "policy_engine_loaded": status.policy_engine_loaded,
            "telemetry_pipeline_ready": status.telemetry_pipeline_ready,
            "review_queue_available": status.review_queue_available,

            "uptime_seconds": status.uptime_seconds,
            "started_at": _isoformat(status.started_at),
            "checked_at": _isoformat(status.checked_at),
        },
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence

from app.runtime.commandsupervisor import CommandPolicy, build_command_supervisor
from app.runtime.filereturnguard import FileReturnPolicy, build_file_return_guard
from app.runtime.networkguard import NetworkPolicy, build_network_guard


COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES = {
    "shell",
    "bash",
    "terminal",
    "command",
    "execute",
    "run",
    "subprocess",
}
NETWORK_TOOL_NAMES = {

    "http",
    "https",
    "request",

    "api",

    "cmd",
    "bash",
    "shell",
    "terminal",
    "curl",
    "wget",

@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallRequest:
    tool_name: str
    actiontype: str = "toolcall"
    target: str = "runtime"
    command: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
    network_url: str | None = None
    network_method: str = "GET"
    artifact_paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    content: str | bytes | None = None
    cwd: str | None = None
    environment_scope: str = "sandbox"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

            "toolname": self.tool_name,
            "actiontype": self.actiontype,
            "target": self.target,

            "networkurl": self.network_url,
            "networkmethod": self.network_method,
            "artifactpaths": list(self.artifact_paths),
            "cwd": self.cwd,
            "environmentscope": self.environment_scope,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallDecision:
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    should_review: bool
    should_block: bool
    should_quarantine: bool
    risk_delta: int
    tool_name: str
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    command_policy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    network_policy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    artifact_policies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": int(self.risk_delta),
            "toolname": self.tool_name,
            "actiontype": self.actiontype,
            "target": self.target,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "commandpolicy": dict(self.command_policy),
            "networkpolicy": dict(self.network_policy),
            "artifactpolicies": list(self.artifact_policies),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ToolCallGuard:
    command_supervisor: Any = field(default_factory=build_command_supervisor)
    network_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_network_guard)
    file_return_guard: Any = field(default_factory=build_file_return_guard)
    high_risk_tools: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: set(DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_TOOLS))
    review_threshold: int = 20
    block_threshold: int = 50
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80

    def evaluate(self, *, request: ToolCallRequest) -> ToolCallDecision:
        normalized = self._normalize_request(request)
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        command_policy = self._evaluate_command_policy(normalized)
        if command_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(command_policy.reasons)
            risk_delta += int(command_policy.risk_delta)
            matched_rules.extend(getattr(command_policy, "matched_rules", []))

        network_policy = self._evaluate_network_policy(normalized)
        if network_policy is not None:
            reasons.extend(network_policy.reasons)
            risk_delta += int(network_policy.risk_delta)
            matched_rules.extend(getattr(network_policy, "matched_rules", []))

        artifact_policies = self._evaluate_artifact_policies(normalized)
        for artifact_policy in artifact_policies:
            reasons.extend(artifact_policy.reasons)
            risk_delta += int(artifact_policy.risk_delta)
            matched_rules.extend(getattr(artifact_policy, "matched_rules", []))

        tool_risk, tool_reasons, tool_rules = self._evaluate_tool_identity(normalized)
        reasons.extend(tool_reasons)
        matched_rules.extend(tool_rules)
        risk_delta += tool_risk

        normalized_risk = max(0, min(100, int(risk_delta)))

        verdict = "allow"
        allowed = True
        should_review = False
        should_block = False
        should_quarantine = False

        policies = [policy for policy in (command_policy, network_policy, *artifact_policies) if policy is not None]

        if any(getattr(policy, "should_quarantine", False) for policy in policies) or normalized_risk >= self.quarantine_threshold:
            verdict = "quarantine"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            should_quarantine = True
            should_review = False
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:quarantine")
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_block", False) for policy in policies) or normalized_risk >= self.block_threshold:
            verdict = "block"
            allowed = False
            should_block = True
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:block")
        elif any(getattr(policy, "should_review", False) for policy in policies) or normalized_risk >= self.review_threshold:
            verdict = "review"
            should_review = True
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:review")

        reasons.insert(
            0,
            {
                "source": "toolcallguard",
                "label": "Tool call review",
                "details": (
                    f"Tool '{normalized.tool_name}' was evaluated for action '{normalized.actiontype}' "
                    f"against target '{normalized.target}' with cumulative risk {normalized_risk}."
                ),
                "score": normalized_risk,
            },
        )

        materialized_reasons = self._dedupe_reasons(reasons)
        deduped_rules = list(dict.fromkeys(rule for rule in matched_rules if rule))

        return ToolCallDecision(
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=allowed,
            should_review=should_review,
            should_block=should_block,
            should_quarantine=should_quarantine,
            risk_delta=normalized_risk,
            tool_name=normalized.tool_name,
            actiontype=normalized.actiontype,
            target=normalized.target,
            reasons=materialized_reasons,
            command_policy=command_policy.as_dict() if command_policy is not None else {},
            network_policy=network_policy.as_dict() if network_policy is not None else {},
            artifact_policies=[policy.as_dict() for policy in artifact_policies],
            matched_rules=deduped_rules,
        )

    def allow(self, *, request: ToolCallRequest) -> bool:
        return self.evaluate(request=request).allowed

    def _normalize_request(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> ToolCallRequest:
        return ToolCallRequest(
            tool_name=str(request.tool_name or "").strip().lower(),
            actiontype=str(request.actiontype or "toolcall").strip().lower(),
            target=str(request.target or "runtime").strip().lower(),
            command=request.command,
            network_url=str(request.network_url or "").strip() or None,
            network_method=str(request.network_method or "GET").upper(),
            artifact_paths=[str(item).strip() for item in request.artifact_paths if str(item).strip()],
            content=request.content,
            cwd=str(request.cwd).strip() if request.cwd else None,
            environment_scope=str(request.environment_scope or "sandbox").strip(),
            metadata=dict(request.metadata or {}),
        )

    def _evaluate_tool_identity(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> tuple[int, list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
        reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        matched_rules: list[str] = []
        risk_delta = 0

        if not request.tool_name:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing tool name",
                    "details": "Tool call was denied because no tool name was provided.",
                    "score": 75,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_tool_name")
            return 75, reasons, matched_rules

        if request.tool_name in self.high_risk_tools:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "High-risk tool",
                    "details": f"Tool '{request.tool_name}' is classified as high risk.",
                    "score": 25,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append(f"toolcallguard:high_risk:{request.tool_name}")
            risk_delta += 25

        if request.environment_scope.lower() != "sandbox":
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Non-sandbox scope",
                    "details": (
                        f"Tool '{request.tool_name}' requested environment scope "
                        f"'{request.environment_scope}' outside the sandbox boundary."
                    ),
                    "score": 45,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:non_sandbox_scope")
            risk_delta += 45

        if request.tool_name in COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES and request.command is None:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing command payload",
                    "details": f"Command-like tool '{request.tool_name}' did not provide a command payload.",
                    "score": 40,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_command")
            risk_delta += 40

        if request.tool_name in NETWORK_TOOL_NAMES and not request.network_url:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing network URL",
                    "details": f"Network-like tool '{request.tool_name}' did not provide a network URL.",
                    "score": 40,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_network_url")
            risk_delta += 40

        if request.tool_name in FILE_TOOL_NAMES and not request.artifact_paths:
            reasons.append(
                {
                    "source": "toolcallguard",
                    "label": "Missing artifact paths",
                    "details": f"File-like tool '{request.tool_name}' did not provide any artifact paths.",
                    "score": 30,
                }
            )
            matched_rules.append("toolcallguard:missing_artifact_paths")
            risk_delta += 30

        return risk_delta, reasons, matched_rules

    def _evaluate_command_policy(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> CommandPolicy | None:
        if request.command is None and request.tool_name not in COMMAND_TOOL_NAMES:
            return None
        command_value = request.command if request.command is not None else request.tool_name
        return self.command_supervisor.evaluate(
            command=command_value,
            actiontype=request.actiontype,
            target=request.target or request.tool_name,
            cwd=request.cwd,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "environment_scope": request.environment_scope,
                "tool_name": request.tool_name,
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_network_policy(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> NetworkPolicy | None:
        if not request.network_url and request.tool_name not in NETWORK_TOOL_NAMES:
            return None
        if not request.network_url:
            return None
        return self.network_guard.evaluate(
            url=request.network_url,
            method=request.network_method,
            metadata={
                **dict(request.metadata),
                "direction": "egress",
                "tool_name": request.tool_name,
            },
        )

    def _evaluate_artifact_policies(self, request: ToolCallRequest) -> list[FileReturnPolicy]:
        if not request.artifact_paths and request.tool_name not in FILE_TOOL_NAMES:
            return []

        policies: list[FileReturnPolicy] = []
        for artifact_path in request.artifact_paths:
            policies.append(
                self.file_return_guard.evaluate(
                    path=artifact_path,
                    content=request.content,
                    metadata={
                        **dict(request.metadata),
                        "tool_name": request.tool_name,
                    },
                )
            )
        return policies

    def _dedupe_reasons(self, reasons: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        deduped: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, int]] = set()
        for item in reasons:
            source = str(item.get("source", "toolcallguard"))
            label = str(item.get("label", "Tool call review"))
            details = str(item.get("details", ""))
            score = int(item.get("score", 0) or 0)
            key = (source, label, details, score)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            deduped.append(
                {
                    "source": source,
                    "label": label,
                    "details": details,
                    "score": score,
                }
            )
        return deduped[:20]


def initialize_toolcallguard(
    *,
    command_supervisor: Any | None = None,
    network_guard: Any | None = None,
    file_return_guard: Any | None = None,
    high_risk_tools: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    review_threshold: int = 20,
    block_threshold: int = 50,
    quarantine_threshold: int = 80,
) -> ToolCallGuard:
    return ToolCallGuard(
        command_supervisor=command_supervisor or build_command_supervisor(),
        network_guard=network_guard or build_network_guard(),
        file_return_guard=file_return_guard or build_file_return_guard(),
        high_risk_tools=set(high_risk_tools or DEFAULT_HIGH_RISK_TOOLS),
        review_threshold=review_threshold,
        block_threshold=block_threshold,
        quarantine_threshold=quarantine_threshold,
    )


def build_toolcallguard() -> ToolCallGuard:
    return initialize_toolcallguard()

    "ToolCallDecision",
    "ToolCallGuard",
    "ToolCallRequest",
    "build_toolcallguard",
    "initialize_toolcallguard",
]
