from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import secrets


PolicyBundleFormat = Literal["json", "compact"]
PolicyBundleStatus = Literal["valid", "invalid", "expired", "unsigned"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


def _stable_json_dumps(payload: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)


def _clean_mapping(value: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value or {})


def _clean_policy_list(value: list[dict[str, Any]] | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not value:
        return []
    return [dict(item) for item in value]


def _require_text(value: str | None, field_name: str) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize_text(value)
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError(f"{field_name} is required")
    return normalized


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyBundle:
    bundle_id: str
    version: str
    created_at: str
    policies: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.bundle_id = _require_text(self.bundle_id, "bundle_id")
        self.version = _require_text(self.version, "version")
        self.created_at = _require_text(self.created_at, "created_at")
        self.policies = _clean_policy_list(self.policies)
        self.metadata = _clean_mapping(self.metadata)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "bundle_id": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "policies": [dict(item) for item in self.policies],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SignedPolicyBundle:
    bundle: PolicyBundle
    signature: str
    key_id: str
    algorithm: str = "hs256"
    signed_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.signature = _require_text(self.signature, "signature")
        self.key_id = _require_text(self.key_id, "key_id")
        self.algorithm = _normalize_text(self.algorithm or "hs256") or "hs256"
        self.signed_at = _require_text(self.signed_at, "signed_at")

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "bundle": self.bundle.to_dict(),
            "signature": self.signature,
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "algorithm": self.algorithm,
            "signed_at": self.signed_at,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyBundleVerificationResult:
    bundle_id: str
    version: str
    status: PolicyBundleStatus
    reason: str
    key_id: str | None = None
    algorithm: str | None = None
    verified_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "bundle_id": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "status": self.status,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "algorithm": self.algorithm,
            "verified_at": self.verified_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicySigningKey:
    key_id: str
    secret: str
    algorithm: str = "hs256"
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.key_id = _require_text(self.key_id, "key_id")
        self.secret = _require_text(self.secret, "secret")
        self.algorithm = _normalize_text(self.algorithm or "hs256") or "hs256"
        self.created_at = _require_text(self.created_at, "created_at")
        self.metadata = _clean_mapping(self.metadata)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "key_id": self.key_id,
            "algorithm": self.algorithm,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicySigningKeySet:
    active_key_id: str
    keys: dict[str, PolicySigningKey] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.active_key_id = _require_text(self.active_key_id, "active_key_id")
        self.keys = dict(self.keys)
        self.created_at = _require_text(self.created_at, "created_at")
        self.updated_at = _require_text(self.updated_at, "updated_at")

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "active_key_id": self.active_key_id,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "keys": {key_id: key.to_dict() for key_id, key in self.keys.items()},
        }


def create_policy_bundle(
    bundle_id: str,
    version: str,
    *,
    policies: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    created_at: str | None = None,
) -> PolicyBundle:
    return PolicyBundle(
        bundle_id=bundle_id,
        version=version,
        created_at=_normalize_text(created_at) or _utc_now(),
        policies=_clean_policy_list(policies),
        metadata=_clean_mapping(metadata),
    )


def initialize_policy_signing_keys() -> PolicySigningKeySet:
    secret = secrets.token_hex(32)
    key_id = "ironclaw-local-default"
    now = _utc_now()

    key = PolicySigningKey(
        key_id=key_id,
        secret=secret,
        algorithm="hs256",
        created_at=now,
        metadata={"scope": "local", "purpose": "policy-bundle", "active": True},
    )
    return PolicySigningKeySet(
        active_key_id=key_id,
        keys={key_id: key},
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
    )


def get_active_signing_key(keyset: PolicySigningKeySet) -> PolicySigningKey:
    key = keyset.keys.get(keyset.active_key_id)
    if key is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown active key_id: {keyset.active_key_id}")
    return key


def register_signing_key(
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
    *,
    key_id: str,
    secret: str,
    algorithm: str = "hs256",
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    make_active: bool = False,
) -> PolicySigningKeySet:
    now = _utc_now()
    normalized_key_id = _require_text(key_id, "key_id")

    key = PolicySigningKey(
        key_id=normalized_key_id,
        secret=secret,
        algorithm=algorithm,
        created_at=now,
        metadata=_clean_mapping(metadata),
    )

    keys = dict(keyset.keys)
    keys[normalized_key_id] = key

    active_key_id = normalized_key_id if make_active else keyset.active_key_id
    if make_active:
        for existing_key in keys.values():
            existing_key.metadata = dict(existing_key.metadata)
            existing_key.metadata["active"] = existing_key.key_id == normalized_key_id

    return PolicySigningKeySet(
        active_key_id=active_key_id,
        keys=keys,
        created_at=keyset.created_at,
        updated_at=now,
    )


def rotate_active_signing_key(
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
    *,
    key_id: str | None = None,
    secret: str | None = None,
    algorithm: str = "hs256",
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> PolicySigningKeySet:
    next_key_id = _normalize_text(key_id) or f"ironclaw-rotated-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S')}"
    next_secret = _normalize_text(secret) or secrets.token_hex(32)
    next_metadata = dict(metadata or {})
    next_metadata.setdefault("scope", "local")
    next_metadata.setdefault("purpose", "policy-bundle")
    next_metadata["rotated"] = True
    next_metadata["active"] = True

    return register_signing_key(
        keyset,
        key_id=next_key_id,
        secret=next_secret,
        algorithm=algorithm,
        metadata=next_metadata,
        make_active=True,
    )


def _compute_hmac_signature(
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    secret: str,
    algorithm: str = "hs256",
) -> str:
    if algorithm != "hs256":
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported algorithm: {algorithm}")

    body = _stable_json_dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    digest = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return f"{algorithm}:{digest}"


def _validate_bundle(bundle: PolicyBundle) -> None:
    _require_text(bundle.bundle_id, "bundle_id")
    _require_text(bundle.version, "version")
    _require_text(bundle.created_at, "created_at")


def sign_policy_bundle(
    bundle: PolicyBundle,
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
) -> SignedPolicyBundle:
    _validate_bundle(bundle)
    key = get_active_signing_key(keyset)
    payload = bundle.to_dict()
    signature = _compute_hmac_signature(
        payload,
        secret=key.secret,
        algorithm=key.algorithm,
    )
    return SignedPolicyBundle(
        bundle=bundle,
        signature=signature,
        key_id=key.key_id,
        algorithm=key.algorithm,
    )


def verify_policy_bundle_signature(
    signed: SignedPolicyBundle,
    keyset: PolicySigningKeySet,
) -> PolicyBundleVerificationResult:
    bundle_dict = signed.bundle.to_dict()
    key = keyset.keys.get(signed.key_id)

    if key is None:
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason="signing key not found",
            key_id=signed.key_id,
            algorithm=signed.algorithm,
            metadata={"verification": "missing-key"},
        )

    if signed.algorithm != key.algorithm:
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason="algorithm mismatch",
            key_id=key.key_id,
            algorithm=signed.algorithm,
            metadata={"expected_algorithm": key.algorithm},
        )

    try:
        _validate_bundle(signed.bundle)
        expected_signature = _compute_hmac_signature(
            bundle_dict,
            secret=key.secret,
            algorithm=key.algorithm,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason=str(exc),
            key_id=key.key_id,
            algorithm=key.algorithm,
            metadata={"verification": "validation-error"},
        )

    if not hmac.compare_digest(signed.signature, expected_signature):
        return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
            bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
            version=signed.bundle.version,
            status="invalid",
            reason="signature mismatch",
            key_id=key.key_id,
            algorithm=key.algorithm,
            metadata={"verification": "signature-mismatch"},
        )

    return PolicyBundleVerificationResult(
        bundle_id=signed.bundle.bundle_id,
        version=signed.bundle.version,
        status="valid",
        reason="signature verified",
        key_id=key.key_id,
        algorithm=key.algorithm,
        metadata={"verification": "verified"},
    )


def export_signed_bundle(
    signed: SignedPolicyBundle,
    *,
    format: PolicyBundleFormat = "json",
) -> str:
    payload = signed.to_dict()
    if format == "json":
        return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    if format == "compact":
        return _stable_json_dumps(payload)
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported bundle export format: {format}")


def import_signed_bundle(serialized: str) -> SignedPolicyBundle:
    raw = json.loads(serialized)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise ValueError("serialized bundle must decode to an object")

    bundle_data = raw.get("bundle")
    if not isinstance(bundle_data, dict):
        raise ValueError("serialized bundle is missing a valid 'bundle' object")

    bundle = PolicyBundle(
        bundle_id=_normalize_text(bundle_data.get("bundle_id")),
        version=_normalize_text(bundle_data.get("version")),
        created_at=_normalize_text(bundle_data.get("created_at")),
        policies=_clean_policy_list(bundle_data.get("policies")),
        metadata=_clean_mapping(bundle_data.get("metadata")),
    )

    return SignedPolicyBundle(
        bundle=bundle,
        signature=_normalize_text(raw.get("signature")),
        key_id=_normalize_text(raw.get("key_id")),
        algorithm=_normalize_text(raw.get("algorithm") or "hs256") or "hs256",
        signed_at=_normalize_text(raw.get("signed_at") or _utc_now()),
    )


def summarize_signed_bundle(
    signed: SignedPolicyBundle,
    verification: PolicyBundleVerificationResult | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    verification_status = verification.status if verification else "unsigned"
    verification_reason = verification.reason if verification else "not verified"

    return {
        "bundle_id": signed.bundle.bundle_id,
        "version": signed.bundle.version,
        "policy_count": len(signed.bundle.policies),
        "key_id": signed.key_id,
        "algorithm": signed.algorithm,
        "signed_at": signed.signed_at,
        "verification_status": verification_status,
        "verification_reason": verification_reason,
    }


def summarize_signing_keyset(keyset: PolicySigningKeySet) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "active_key_id": keyset.active_key_id,
        "key_count": len(keyset.keys),
        "algorithms": sorted({key.algorithm for key in keyset.keys.values()}),
        "created_at": keyset.created_at,
        "updated_at": keyset.updated_at,
    }

class PolicyStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._settings = PolicySettingsRecord(
            policy_id="ironclaw-default-policy",
            mode="enforce",
            default_decision="quarantine",
            require_human_review_for_quarantine=False,
            sandbox_all_untrusted_content=True,
            block_high_risk_tool_calls=True,
            strict_prompt_ingress=True,
            thresholds=PolicyThresholdRecord(
                prompt_injection_score=0.70,
                malware_score=0.60,
                exfiltration_score=0.55,
                tool_abuse_score=0.65,
            ),
            updated_at=_utcnow(),
            metadata={
                "owner": "ironclaw",
                "profile": "maximum-protection",
            },
        )

    def get_settings(self) -> PolicySettingsRecord:
        with self._lock:
            return self._settings

    def update_settings(
        self,
        *,
        mode: PolicyMode,
        default_decision: PolicyDecision,
        require_human_review_for_quarantine: bool,
        sandbox_all_untrusted_content: bool,
        block_high_risk_tool_calls: bool,
        strict_prompt_ingress: bool,
        thresholds: PolicyThresholdRecord,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> PolicySettingsRecord:
        with self._lock:
            self._settings = PolicySettingsRecord(
                policy_id=self._settings.policy_id,
                mode=mode,
                default_decision=default_decision,
                require_human_review_for_quarantine=require_human_review_for_quarantine,
                sandbox_all_untrusted_content=sandbox_all_untrusted_content,
                block_high_risk_tool_calls=block_high_risk_tool_calls,
                strict_prompt_ingress=strict_prompt_ingress,
                thresholds=thresholds,
                updated_at=_utcnow(),
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            )
            return self._settings

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self.__init__()


_POLICY_STORE = PolicyStore()


def get_policy_store() -> PolicyStore:
    return _POLICY_STORE


def reset_policy_store() -> None:
    _POLICY_STORE.reset()

from typing import Literal, TypedDict, Optional

from app.services.guard import guard_text


ContextType = Literal["user_prompt", "retrieved_doc", "tool_output", "model_output"]
VerdictType = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class GuardedText(TypedDict):
    context_type: ContextType
    verdict: VerdictType
    scan_id: Optional[str]
    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str]
    original_text: str
    effective_text: str
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    client_id: Optional[str]
    session_id: Optional[str]


class PromptGuardBundle(TypedDict):
    user_prompt: Optional[GuardedText]
    retrieved_doc: Optional[GuardedText]
    tool_output: Optional[GuardedText]
    model_output: Optional[GuardedText]
    highest_verdict: VerdictType
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool
    client_id: Optional[str]
    session_id: Optional[str]


def _verdict_rank(verdict: VerdictType) -> int:
    order: dict[VerdictType, int] = {
        "allow": 1,
        "warn": 2,
        "quarantine": 3,
        "block": 4,
    }
    return order[verdict]


def analyze_text(
    context_type: ContextType,
    text: str,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> GuardedText:
    """
    Run the Ironclaw scan for the given context and return a structured
    decision the agent / UI can act on.

    Policy:

    - allow:
        - proceed normally
        - should_halt = False
        - should_warn = False

    - warn:
        - proceed, but caller should surface a warning banner or log entry
        - should_halt = False
        - should_warn = True

    - quarantine:
        - caller SHOULD NOT execute this automatically
        - typically route to manual review / sandbox
        - should_halt = True
        - should_warn = True

    - block:
        - caller MUST NOT execute this
        - return effective_text equal to the original so the caller can
          decide how to replace or redact before use
        - should_halt = True
        - should_warn = False
    """
    decision = guard_text(context_type, text)
    verdict: VerdictType = decision["verdict"]  # type: ignore[assignment]

    should_halt = verdict in ("block", "quarantine")
    should_warn = verdict in ("warn", "quarantine")

    return {
        "context_type": context_type,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "scan_id": decision.get("scan_id"),
        "summary": decision["summary"],
        "risk_score": decision["risk_score"],
        "matched_patterns": decision["matched_patterns"],
        "original_text": text,
        "effective_text": text,
        "should_halt": should_halt,
        "should_warn": should_warn,
        "client_id": client_id,
        "session_id": session_id,
    }


def analyze_prompt_bundle(
    user_prompt: Optional[str] = None,
    retrieved_doc: Optional[str] = None,
    tool_output: Optional[str] = None,
    model_output: Optional[str] = None,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    session_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> PromptGuardBundle:
    """
    Guard multiple text sources that may participate in one agent turn.

    This is useful for internal routing where you want one consolidated
    decision across:
    - the user prompt,
    - retrieved documents,
    - tool output,
    - and model output.

    highest_verdict is chosen using this precedence:
        allow < warn < quarantine < block

    Bundle-level flags follow the same policy as analyze_text:

    - should_halt:
        True if the highest_verdict is 'quarantine' or 'block'

    - should_warn:
        True if the highest_verdict is 'warn' or 'quarantine'
        (we do not warn for 'block' because the action must not proceed anyway)
    """
    guarded_user_prompt = (
        analyze_text("user_prompt", user_prompt, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if user_prompt is not None
        else None
    )
    guarded_retrieved_doc = (
        analyze_text("retrieved_doc", retrieved_doc, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if retrieved_doc is not None
        else None
    )
    guarded_tool_output = (
        analyze_text("tool_output", tool_output, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if tool_output is not None
        else None
    )
    guarded_model_output = (
        analyze_text("model_output", model_output, client_id=client_id, session_id=session_id)
        if model_output is not None
        else None
    )

    results: list[GuardedText] = [
        item
        for item in (
            guarded_user_prompt,
            guarded_retrieved_doc,
            guarded_tool_output,
            guarded_model_output,
        )
        if item is not None
    ]

    if not results:
        highest_verdict: VerdictType = "allow"
    else:
        highest_verdict = max(
            (item["verdict"] for item in results),
            key=_verdict_rank,
        )

    return {
        "user_prompt": guarded_user_prompt,
        "retrieved_doc": guarded_retrieved_doc,
        "tool_output": guarded_tool_output,
        "model_output": guarded_model_output,
        "highest_verdict": highest_verdict,
        "should_halt": highest_verdict in ("block", "quarantine"),
        "should_warn": highest_verdict in ("warn", "quarantine"),
        "client_id": client_id,
        "session_id": session_id,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store


DEFAULT_QUARANTINE_TABLE = "quarantine"


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_timestamp(value: str | datetime | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return _utc_now()
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return dt.isoformat()
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or _utc_now()


def _string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _mapping(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: val
            for key, val in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(val)
        }
    raise TypeError("value is not serializable to dict")


def _listify(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _normalize_quarantine_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    quarantine_id: str | None = None,
    item_id: str | None = None,
    artifact_id: str | None = None,
    incident_id: str | None = None,
    scan_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    tenant_id: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,
    item_type: str | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    reason: str | None = None,
    verdict: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    location: str | None = None,
    storage_key: str | None = None,
    filename: str | None = None,
    content_hash: str | None = None,
    assigned_to: str | None = None,
    tags: list[Any] | None = None,
    evidence: list[Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    created_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    updated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    quarantined_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    released_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    expires_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _mapping(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_quarantine_id = (
        _string(quarantine_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("quarantine_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_item_id = (
        _string(item_id)
        or _string(artifact_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("item_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("artifact_id"))
        or resolved_quarantine_id
    )

    resolved_org = (
        _string(organization_id)
        or _string(org_id)
        or _string(tenant_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("organization_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("org_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("tenant_id"))
    )

    resolved_category = (
        _string(category)
        or _string(item_type)
        or _string(source_payload.get("category"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("item_type"))
        or "artifact"
    )

    resolved_source = (
        _string(source)
        or _string(source_payload.get("source"))
        or "ironclaw"
    )

    resolved_reason = (
        _string(reason)
        or _string(source_payload.get("reason"))
        or "policy_violation"
    )

    resolved_verdict = (
        _string(verdict)
        or _string(source_payload.get("verdict"))
        or "pending"
    )

    resolved_severity = (
        _string(severity)
        or _string(source_payload.get("severity"))
        or "medium"
    )

    resolved_status = (
        _string(status)
        or _string(source_payload.get("status"))
        or "quarantined"
    )

    resolved_filename = (
        _string(filename)
        or _string(source_payload.get("filename"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("name"))
    )

    resolved_location = (
        _string(location)
        or _string(storage_key)
        or _string(source_payload.get("location"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("storage_key"))
    )

    resolved_created_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        created_at or source_payload.get("created_at") or quarantined_at or source_payload.get("quarantined_at"),
    )
    resolved_updated_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        updated_at or source_payload.get("updated_at") or resolved_created_at,
    )
    resolved_quarantined_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        quarantined_at or source_payload.get("quarantined_at") or resolved_created_at,
    )
    resolved_released_at = (
        _normalize_timestamp(released_at or source_payload.get("released_at"))
        if (released_at is not None or source_payload.get("released_at") is not None)
        else None
    )
    resolved_expires_at = (
        _normalize_timestamp(expires_at or source_payload.get("expires_at"))
        if (expires_at is not None or source_payload.get("expires_at") is not None)
        else None
    )

    normalized = {
        "quarantine_id": resolved_quarantine_id,
        "id": resolved_quarantine_id,
        "item_id": resolved_item_id,
        "artifact_id": _string(artifact_id) or _string(source_payload.get("artifact_id")) or resolved_item_id,
        "incident_id": _string(incident_id) or _string(source_payload.get("incident_id")) or None,
        "scan_id": _string(scan_id) or _string(source_payload.get("scan_id")) or None,
        "organization_id": resolved_org or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org or None,
        "tenant_id": resolved_org or None,
        "owner_id": _string(owner_id) or _string(source_payload.get("owner_id")) or None,
        "category": resolved_category,
        "item_type": resolved_category,
        "source": resolved_source,
        "reason": resolved_reason,
        "verdict": resolved_verdict,
        "severity": resolved_severity,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "location": resolved_location or None,
        "storage_key": resolved_location or None,
        "filename": resolved_filename or None,
        "content_hash": _string(content_hash) or _string(source_payload.get("content_hash")) or None,
        "assigned_to": _string(assigned_to) or _string(source_payload.get("assigned_to")) or None,
        "tags": _listify(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),
        "evidence": _listify(evidence if evidence is not None else source_payload.get("evidence")),
        "metadata": metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("metadata")),
        "created_at": resolved_created_at,
        "updated_at": resolved_updated_at,
        "quarantined_at": resolved_quarantined_at,
        "released_at": resolved_released_at,
        "expires_at": resolved_expires_at,
    }

    return normalized


@dataclass(slots=True)
class QuarantineStore:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_QUARANTINE_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        health = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(health):
            return bool(health())
        return True

    def quarantine_item(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = _normalize_quarantine_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, record)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return dict(inserted[0])
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return dict(inserted)
        return record

    def create(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.quarantine_item(payload, **kwargs)

    def put(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.quarantine_item(payload, **kwargs)

    def list_quarantine(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        severity: str | None = None,
        incident_id: str | None = None,
        scan_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        category: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", status)
        if severity:
            query_filters.setdefault("severity", severity)
        if incident_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("incident_id", incident_id)
        if scan_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("scan_id", scan_id)
        if owner_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("owner_id", owner_id)
        if category:
            query_filters.setdefault("category", category)

        rows = self.backend.select(
            self.table_name,
            limit=limit,
            filters=query_filters or None,
        )
        items = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        items.sort(
            key=lambda row: _normalize_timestamp(
                row.get("updated_at") or row.get("created_at"),
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return items

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_quarantine(**kwargs)

    def get_quarantine_item(self, quarantine_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        qid = _string(quarantine_id)
        if not qid:
            raise ValueError("quarantine_id is required")
        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"quarantine_id": qid}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])
        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"id": qid}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])
        return None

    def get(self, quarantine_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_quarantine_item(quarantine_id)

    def find_by_item_id(self, item_id: str, *, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        iid = _string(item_id)
        if not iid:
            raise ValueError("item_id is required")
        return self.list_quarantine(limit=limit, filters={"item_id": iid})

    def update_quarantine_item(self, quarantine_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        existing = self.get_quarantine_item(quarantine_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = dict(existing)
        merged.update(_mapping(updates))
        merged["quarantine_id"] = existing.get("quarantine_id") or existing.get("id") or quarantine_id
        merged["id"] = merged["quarantine_id"]
        merged["updated_at"] = _utc_now()

        status = _string(merged.get("status")).lower()
        if status in {"released", "restored"} and not merged.get("released_at"):
            merged["released_at"] = merged["updated_at"]

        normalized = _normalize_quarantine_payload(merged)

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"quarantine_id": quarantine_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"id": quarantine_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        return normalized

    def update(self, quarantine_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_quarantine_item(quarantine_id, updates)

    def assign_item(self, quarantine_id: str, assigned_to: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_quarantine_item(
            quarantine_id,
            {
                "assigned_to": assigned_to,
                "status": "under_review",
            },
        )

    def release_item(
        self,
        quarantine_id: str,
        *,
        verdict: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        updates: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "released",
            "released_at": _utc_now(),
        }
        if verdict is not None:
            updates["verdict"] = verdict
        if metadata:
            current = self.get_quarantine_item(quarantine_id) or {}
            merged_metadata = _mapping(current.get("metadata"))
            merged_metadata.update(metadata)
            updates["metadata"] = merged_metadata
        return self.update_quarantine_item(quarantine_id, updates)

    def restore_item(
        self,
        quarantine_id: str,
        *,
        verdict: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_quarantine_item(
            quarantine_id,
            {
                "status": "restored",
                "released_at": _utc_now(),
                "verdict": verdict or "allowed",
            },
        )

    def purge_item(
        self,
        quarantine_id: str,
        *,
        verdict: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_quarantine_item(
            quarantine_id,
            {
                "status": "purged",
                "verdict": verdict or "blocked",
            },
        )

    def delete_quarantine_item(self, quarantine_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        qid = _string(quarantine_id)
        if not qid:
            raise ValueError("quarantine_id is required")

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"quarantine_id": qid})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"id": qid})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        return None

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        items = self.list_quarantine(limit=limit, organization_id=organization_id)

        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_severity: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_category: dict[str, int] = {}

        for item in items:
            status = _string(item.get("status"), "unknown")
            severity = _string(item.get("severity"), "unknown")
            category = _string(item.get("category"), "unknown")
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1
            by_severity[severity] = by_severity.get(severity, 0) + 1
            by_category[category] = by_category.get(category, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total": len(items),
            "quarantined": by_status.get("quarantined", 0),
            "under_review": by_status.get("under_review", 0),
            "released": by_status.get("released", 0),
            "restored": by_status.get("restored", 0),
            "purged": by_status.get("purged", 0),
            "by_status": by_status,
            "by_severity": by_severity,
            "by_category": by_category,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import uuid4


QuarantineStatus = Literal["isolated", "under_review", "released", "destroyed"]
QuarantineSource = Literal["scan", "guard", "sandbox", "review", "system"]
RiskLevel = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class QuarantineRecord:
    quarantine_id: str
    status: QuarantineStatus
    source: QuarantineSource
    title: str
    summary: str
    risk_level: RiskLevel
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    incident_id: str | None = None
    asset_ref: str | None = None
    owner: str | None = None
    release_reason: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["created_at"] = self.created_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        payload["updated_at"] = self.updated_at.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return payload


class QuarantineStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._items: list[QuarantineRecord] = []

    def seed_defaults(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if self._items:
                return

            now = _utcnow()
            self._items.extend(
                [
                    QuarantineRecord(
                        quarantine_id=f"qtn-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        status="isolated",
                        source="scan",
                        title="Injected prompt bundle isolated",
                        summary="A prompt payload was isolated after matching prompt-injection heuristics during ingress scanning.",
                        risk_level="high",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-qtn-001",
                        trace_id="trace-qtn-001",
                        incident_id="inc-seed-001",
                        asset_ref="prompt:user-input",
                        metadata={"verdict": "quarantine", "seeded": True},
                        tags=["prompt-injection", "ingress", "scanner"],
                    ),
                    QuarantineRecord(
                        quarantine_id=f"qtn-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                        status="under_review",
                        source="sandbox",
                        title="Suspicious tool output contained",
                        summary="Tool-returned content was moved into quarantine while sandbox review evaluates potential hostile instructions.",
                        risk_level="critical",
                        created_at=now,
                        updated_at=now,
                        request_id="req-qtn-002",
                        trace_id="trace-qtn-002",
                        incident_id="inc-seed-002",
                        asset_ref="tool-output:external-content",
                        owner="sandbox-review",
                        metadata={"verdict": "quarantine", "seeded": True},
                        tags=["sandbox", "tool-output", "containment"],
                    ),
                ]
            )

    def list_items(
        self,
        *,
        status: QuarantineStatus | None = None,
        source: QuarantineSource | None = None,
        risk_level: RiskLevel | None = None,
    ) -> list[QuarantineRecord]:
        with self._lock:
            items = list(self._items)

        if status is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.status == status]
        if source is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.source == source]
        if risk_level is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.risk_level == risk_level]

        return items

    def get_item(self, quarantine_id: str) -> QuarantineRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for item in self._items:
                if item.quarantine_id == quarantine_id:
                    return item
        return None

    def create_item(
        self,
        *,
        source: QuarantineSource,
        title: str,
        summary: str,
        risk_level: RiskLevel,
        status: QuarantineStatus = "isolated",
        request_id: str | None = None,
        trace_id: str | None = None,
        incident_id: str | None = None,
        asset_ref: str | None = None,
        owner: str | None = None,
        release_reason: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        tags: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> QuarantineRecord:
        now = _utcnow()
        record = QuarantineRecord(
            quarantine_id=f"qtn-{uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            status=status,
            source=source,
            title=title.strip(),
            summary=summary.strip(),
            risk_level=risk_level,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            request_id=request_id,
            trace_id=trace_id,
            incident_id=incident_id,
            asset_ref=asset_ref,
            owner=owner,
            release_reason=release_reason,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            tags=list(tags or []),
        )

        with self._lock:
            self._items.append(record)

        return record

    def update_item(
        self,
        quarantine_id: str,
        *,
        status: QuarantineStatus,
        owner: str | None = None,
        release_reason: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> QuarantineRecord | None:
        with self._lock:
            for index, item in enumerate(self._items):
                if item.quarantine_id != quarantine_id:
                    continue

                updated = QuarantineRecord(
                    quarantine_id=item.quarantine_id,
                    status=status,
                    source=item.source,
                    title=item.title,
                    summary=item.summary,
                    risk_level=item.risk_level,
                    created_at=item.created_at,
                    updated_at=_utcnow(),
                    request_id=item.request_id,
                    trace_id=item.trace_id,
                    incident_id=item.incident_id,
                    asset_ref=item.asset_ref,
                    owner=owner if owner is not None else item.owner,
                    release_reason=release_reason if release_reason is not None else item.release_reason,
                    metadata={
                        **item.metadata,
                        **dict(metadata or {}),
                    },
                    tags=list(item.tags),
                )
                self._items[index] = updated
                return updated

        return None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._items.clear()


_QUARANTINE_STORE = QuarantineStore()
_QUARANTINE_STORE.seed_defaults()


def get_quarantine_store() -> QuarantineStore:
    return _QUARANTINE_STORE


def reset_quarantine_store() -> None:
    _QUARANTINE_STORE.reset()
    _QUARANTINE_STORE.seed_defaults()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field, is_dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Optional


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReleaseSummaryInput:
    integration_id: str
    compatibility_state: str
    telemetry_state: str
    lifecycle_state: str
    rollout_recommendation: str
    readiness_level: str
    risk_score: float
    ready: bool
    reasons: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    next_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReleaseSummary:
    integration_id: str
    release_status: str
    compatibility_state: str
    telemetry_state: str
    lifecycle_state: str
    rollout_recommendation: str
    readiness_level: str
    risk_score: float
    ready: bool
    reasons: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    next_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    generated_at: str = ""
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return _normalize_value(asdict(self))


def build_release_summary(
    summary_input: ReleaseSummaryInput,
) -> ReleaseSummary:
    generated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    release_status = _derive_release_status(summary_input)

    return ReleaseSummary(
        integration_id=summary_input.integration_id,
        release_status=release_status,
        compatibility_state=summary_input.compatibility_state,
        telemetry_state=summary_input.telemetry_state,
        lifecycle_state=summary_input.lifecycle_state,
        rollout_recommendation=summary_input.rollout_recommendation,
        readiness_level=summary_input.readiness_level,
        risk_score=_clamp(summary_input.risk_score, 0.0, 100.0),
        ready=summary_input.ready,
        reasons=_deduplicate(summary_input.reasons),
        next_actions=_deduplicate(summary_input.next_actions),
        generated_at=generated_at,
        metadata=dict(_normalize_value(dict(summary_input.metadata))),
    )


def summarize_release_summary(
    release_summary: ReleaseSummary,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return release_summary.to_dict()


def build_release_summary_from_parts(
    *,
    integration_id: str,
    rollout_decision: Any,
    readiness_result: Any,
    compatibility_state: str,
    telemetry_state: str,
    lifecycle_state: str,
    metadata: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None,
) -> ReleaseSummary:
    rollout_recommendation = _read_attr(
        rollout_decision,
        "recommendation",
        default="unknown",
    )
    if hasattr(rollout_recommendation, "value"):
        rollout_recommendation = rollout_recommendation.value

    readiness_level = _read_attr(
        readiness_result,
        "level",
        default="unknown",
    )
    if hasattr(readiness_level, "value"):
        readiness_level = readiness_level.value

    risk_score = float(
        _read_attr(
            readiness_result,
            "score",
            default=_read_attr(rollout_decision, "score", default=0.0),
        )
    )
    ready = bool(_read_attr(readiness_result, "ready", default=False))

    reasons = _coerce_string_list(_read_attr(rollout_decision, "reasons", default=[]))
    readiness_findings = _read_attr(readiness_result, "findings", default=[])
    reasons.extend(_extract_finding_messages(readiness_findings))

    next_actions = _coerce_string_list(
        _read_attr(readiness_result, "next_actions", default=[])
    )
    next_actions.extend(
        _coerce_string_list(_read_attr(rollout_decision, "required_actions", default=[]))
    )

    return build_release_summary(
        ReleaseSummaryInput(
            integration_id=integration_id,
            compatibility_state=compatibility_state,
            telemetry_state=telemetry_state,
            lifecycle_state=lifecycle_state,
            rollout_recommendation=str(rollout_recommendation),
            readiness_level=str(readiness_level),
            risk_score=risk_score,
            ready=ready,
            reasons=reasons,
            next_actions=next_actions,
            metadata=metadata or {},
        )
    )


def _derive_release_status(summary_input: ReleaseSummaryInput) -> str:
    if summary_input.readiness_level == "fail":
        return "blocked"

    if summary_input.rollout_recommendation == "hold":
        return "blocked"

    if summary_input.rollout_recommendation == "rollback_ready":
        return "rollback_ready"

    if summary_input.rollout_recommendation == "limited_rollout":
        return "limited_rollout"

    if summary_input.ready and summary_input.readiness_level == "pass":
        return "approved"

    if summary_input.readiness_level == "warn":
        return "review_required"

    return "pending"


def _extract_finding_messages(findings: Iterable[Any]) -> List[str]:
    messages: List[str] = []
    for finding in findings:
        message = _read_attr(finding, "message", default=None)
        if message:
            messages.append(str(message))
    return messages


def _coerce_string_list(values: Iterable[Any]) -> List[str]:
    result: List[str] = []
    for value in values:
        if value is None:
            continue
        result.append(str(value))
    return result


def _read_attr(obj: Any, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    if obj is None:
        return default
    return getattr(obj, name, default)


def _deduplicate(values: Iterable[str]) -> List[str]:
    seen = set()
    result: List[str] = []
    for value in values:
        if value in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(value)
        result.append(value)
    return result


def _clamp(value: float, lower: float, upper: float) -> float:
    return max(lower, min(upper, value))


def _normalize_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    if is_dataclass(value):
        return _normalize_value(asdict(value))
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): _normalize_value(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_normalize_value(item) for item in value]
    if hasattr(value, "value"):
        return value.value
    return value

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from app.persistencebootstrap import build_store


DEFAULT_REPORT_TABLE = "reports"

    "executive_summary",
    "incident_report",
    "security_assessment",
    "operations_summary",
    "telemetry_summary",
    "audit_summary",
    "custom",
}

    "draft",
    "ready",
    "published",
    "archived",
}

_DEFAULT_REPORT_TYPE = "custom"
_DEFAULT_REPORT_STATUS = "draft"


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _normalize_timestamp(value: str | datetime | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return _utc_now()
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return dt.isoformat()
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or _utc_now()


def _string(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _mapping(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return dict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):  # Mapping accepts broader mapping-like inputs [web:115]
        return dict(value)
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        dumped = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        dumped = value.dict()
        if isinstance(dumped, Mapping):
            return dict(dumped)
    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return {
            key: item
            for key, item in vars(value).items()
            if not key.startswith("_") and not callable(item)
        }
    raise TypeError("value is not serializable to dict")


def _listify(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    return [value]


def _normalize_report_type(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = _string(value, _DEFAULT_REPORT_TYPE).lower()
    if normalized in {"incident", "incident_summary"}:
        normalized = "incident_report"
    if normalized in {"executive", "executive_report"}:
        normalized = "executive_summary"
    if normalized not in _REPORT_TYPES:
        return _DEFAULT_REPORT_TYPE
    return normalized


def _normalize_report_status(value: Any) -> str:
    normalized = _string(value, _DEFAULT_REPORT_STATUS).lower()
    if normalized in {"complete", "completed"}:
        normalized = "ready"
    if normalized not in _REPORT_STATUSES:
        return _DEFAULT_REPORT_STATUS
    return normalized


def _normalize_report_payload(
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    report_id: str | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
    summary: str | None = None,
    description: str | None = None,
    report_type: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    severity: str | None = None,
    owner_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    org_id: str | None = None,
    customer_id: str | None = None,
    author_id: str | None = None,
    generated_by: str | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    incident_id: str | None = None,
    review_id: str | None = None,
    scan_id: str | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    content: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    findings: list[Any] | None = None,
    recommendations: list[Any] | None = None,
    attachments: list[Any] | None = None,
    tags: list[Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    created_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    updated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    generated_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    published_at: str | datetime | None = None,
    **extra: Any,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_payload = _mapping(payload)
    source_payload.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items() if value is not None})

    resolved_report_id = (
        _string(report_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("report_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("id"))
        or str(uuid4())
    )

    resolved_report_type = _normalize_report_type(
        report_type or source_payload.get("report_type")
    )

    resolved_status = _normalize_report_status(
        status or source_payload.get("status")
    )

    resolved_org = (
        _string(organization_id)
        or _string(org_id)
        or _string(customer_id)
        or _string(source_payload.get("organization_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("org_id"))
        or _string(source_payload.get("customer_id"))
    )

    resolved_title = (
        _string(title)
        or _string(source_payload.get("title"))
        or _string(summary)
        or _string(source_payload.get("summary"))
        or f"{resolved_report_type.replace('_', ' ').title()} Report"
    )

    resolved_summary = (
        _string(summary)
        or _string(source_payload.get("summary"))
        or _string(description)
        or _string(source_payload.get("description"))
        or resolved_title
    )

    resolved_description = (
        _string(description)
        or _string(source_payload.get("description"))
        or resolved_summary
    )

    resolved_source = (
        _string(source)
        or _string(source_payload.get("source"))
        or "ironclaw"
    )

    resolved_created_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        created_at or source_payload.get("created_at") or generated_at or source_payload.get("generated_at")
    )
    resolved_updated_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        updated_at or source_payload.get("updated_at") or resolved_created_at
    )
    resolved_generated_at = _normalize_timestamp(
        generated_at or source_payload.get("generated_at") or resolved_created_at
    )
    resolved_published_at = (
        _normalize_timestamp(published_at or source_payload.get("published_at"))
        if (published_at is not None or source_payload.get("published_at") is not None)
        else None
    )

    if resolved_status == "published" and resolved_published_at is None:
        resolved_published_at = resolved_updated_at

    return {
        "report_id": resolved_report_id,
        "id": resolved_report_id,
        "title": resolved_title,
        "summary": resolved_summary,
        "description": resolved_description,
        "report_type": resolved_report_type,
        "status": resolved_status,
        "severity": _string(severity) or _string(source_payload.get("severity")) or None,
        "owner_id": _string(owner_id) or _string(source_payload.get("owner_id")) or None,
        "organization_id": resolved_org or None,
        "org_id": resolved_org or None,
        "customer_id": resolved_org or None,
        "author_id": _string(author_id) or _string(source_payload.get("author_id")) or None,
        "generated_by": _string(generated_by) or _string(source_payload.get("generated_by")) or None,
        "source": resolved_source,
        "incident_id": _string(incident_id) or _string(source_payload.get("incident_id")) or None,
        "review_id": _string(review_id) or _string(source_payload.get("review_id")) or None,
        "scan_id": _string(scan_id) or _string(source_payload.get("scan_id")) or None,
        "request_id": _string(request_id) or _string(source_payload.get("request_id")) or None,
        "trace_id": _string(trace_id) or _string(source_payload.get("trace_id")) or None,
        "session_id": _string(session_id) or _string(source_payload.get("session_id")) or None,
        "content": content if isinstance(content, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("content")),
        "findings": _listify(findings if findings is not None else source_payload.get("findings")),
        "recommendations": _listify(
            recommendations if recommendations is not None else source_payload.get("recommendations")
        ),
        "attachments": _listify(attachments if attachments is not None else source_payload.get("attachments")),
        "tags": _listify(tags if tags is not None else source_payload.get("tags")),
        "metadata": metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else _mapping(source_payload.get("metadata")),
        "created_at": resolved_created_at,
        "updated_at": resolved_updated_at,
        "generated_at": resolved_generated_at,
        "published_at": resolved_published_at,
    }


@dataclass(slots=True)  # slots help data-container style services stay lean [web:121][web:124]
class ReportService:
    backend: Any = field(default_factory=build_store)
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REPORT_TABLE

    @property
    def backend_name(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.backend, "backend_name", "memory"))

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
            "ready": True,
        }

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def healthcheck(self) -> bool:
        health = getattr(self.backend, "healthcheck", None)
        if callable(health):
            return bool(health())
        return True

    def create_report(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = _normalize_report_payload(payload, **kwargs)
        inserted = self.backend.insert(self.table_name, record)
        if isinstance(inserted, list) and inserted:
            return dict(inserted[0])
        if isinstance(inserted, dict):
            return dict(inserted)
        return record

    def create(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_report(payload, **kwargs)

    def generate_report(self, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.create_report(payload, **kwargs)

    def list_reports(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int = 100,
        filters: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        report_type: str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        incident_id: str | None = None,
        scan_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        query_filters: dict[str, Any] = dict(filters or {})
        if organization_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("organization_id", organization_id)
        if owner_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("owner_id", owner_id)
        if report_type:
            query_filters.setdefault("report_type", _normalize_report_type(report_type))
        if status:
            query_filters.setdefault("status", _normalize_report_status(status))
        if incident_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("incident_id", incident_id)
        if scan_id:
            query_filters.setdefault("scan_id", scan_id)

        rows = self.backend.select(
            self.table_name,
            limit=limit,
            filters=query_filters or None,
        )
        items = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        items.sort(
            key=lambda row: _normalize_timestamp(row.get("updated_at") or row.get("created_at")),
            reverse=True,
        )
        return items

    def list(self, **kwargs: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.list_reports(**kwargs)

    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        normalized_id = _string(report_id)
        if not normalized_id:
            raise ValueError("report_id is required")

        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"report_id": normalized_id}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])

        rows = self.backend.select(self.table_name, filters={"id": normalized_id}, limit=1)
        if rows:
            return dict(rows[0])

        return None

    def get(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.get_report(report_id)

    def update_report(self, report_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        existing = self.get_report(report_id)
        if existing is None:
            return None

        merged = dict(existing)
        merged.update(_mapping(updates))
        merged["report_id"] = existing.get("report_id") or existing.get("id") or report_id
        merged["id"] = merged["report_id"]
        merged["updated_at"] = _utc_now()

        normalized = _normalize_report_payload(merged)

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"report_id": report_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        updated = self.backend.update(
            self.table_name,
            normalized,
            filters={"id": report_id},
        )
        if isinstance(updated, list) and updated:
            return dict(updated[0])

        return normalized

    def update(self, report_id: str, updates: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_report(report_id, updates)

    def publish_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_report(
            report_id,
            {
                "status": "published",
                "published_at": _utc_now(),
            },
        )

    def archive_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        return self.update_report(report_id, {"status": "archived"})

    def delete_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        normalized_id = _string(report_id)
        if not normalized_id:
            raise ValueError("report_id is required")

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"report_id": normalized_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        deleted = self.backend.delete(self.table_name, filters={"id": normalized_id})
        if isinstance(deleted, list) and deleted:
            return dict(deleted[0])

        return None

    def summarize(
        self,
        *,
        organization_id: str | None = None,
        limit: int = 1000,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        reports = self.list_reports(limit=limit, organization_id=organization_id)
        by_type: dict[str, int] = {}
        by_status: dict[str, int] = {}

        for report in reports:
            report_type = _string(report.get("report_type"), "unknown")
            status = _string(report.get("status"), "unknown")
            by_type[report_type] = by_type.get(report_type, 0) + 1
            by_status[status] = by_status.get(status, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total_reports": len(reports),
            "by_type": by_type,
            "by_status": by_status,
            "backend_name": self.backend_name,
            "table_name": self.table_name,
        }


def build_report_service(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REPORT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReportService:
    resolved_backend = backend if backend is not None else build_store(**store_kwargs)
    return ReportService(backend=resolved_backend, table_name=table_name)


def create_report_service(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REPORT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReportService:
    return build_report_service(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)


def get_report_service(
    *,
    backend: Any | None = None,
    table_name: str = DEFAULT_REPORT_TABLE,
    **store_kwargs: Any,
) -> ReportService:
    return build_report_service(backend=backend, table_name=table_name, **store_kwargs)

from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import tarfile
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, Protocol, runtime_checkable


RestoreMode = Literal["validate", "dry-run", "apply", "rollback"]
RestoreStatus = Literal["pending", "validated", "dry-run", "applied", "rolled-back", "failed"]


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _iso(dt: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if dt is None:
        return None
    return dt.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def _sha256_file(path: Path, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(chunk_size), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RestoreManifest:
    target_name: str
    target_kind: str
    backup_format: str
    backup_path: str
    created_at: str
    size_bytes: int
    sha256: str | None
    rotation_tier: str
    encryption_applied: bool
    meta: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> "RestoreManifest":
        return cls(
            target_name=str(payload["target_name"]),
            target_kind=str(payload["target_kind"]),
            backup_format=str(payload["backup_format"]),
            backup_path=str(payload["backup_path"]),
            created_at=str(payload["created_at"]),
            size_bytes=int(payload["size_bytes"]),
            sha256=str(payload["sha256"]) if payload.get("sha256") else None,
            rotation_tier=str(payload["rotation_tier"]),
            encryption_applied=bool(payload.get("encryption_applied", False)),
            meta=dict(payload.get("meta") or {}),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)
