from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _hash_secret(secret_value: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(secret_value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _mask_secret(secret_value: str) -> str:
    if len(secret_value) <= 10:
        return "â€¢" * len(secret_value)
    return f"{secret_value[:4]}â€¦{secret_value[-4:]}"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SecretRecord:
    secret_id: str
    name: str
    provider: str
    kind: str
    hashed_value: str
    masked_value: str
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    last_used_at: datetime | None = None
    active: bool = True
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    raw_value: str | None = None


class SecretService:
    """
    Local-first secret registry for integration credentials and platform secrets.

    This service is intentionally in-memory for the first build phase so routes,
    UI pages, and tests can stabilize before persistence is added.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._records_by_id: dict[str, SecretRecord] = {}
        self._records_by_name: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def create_secret(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        value: str,
        provider: str,
        kind: str = "api_key",
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> SecretRecord:
        normalized_name = name.strip()
        normalized_provider = provider.strip()
        normalized_kind = kind.strip()

        if not normalized_name:
            raise ValueError("Secret name is required")
        if not value or not value.strip():
            raise ValueError("Secret value is required")
        if not normalized_provider:
            raise ValueError("Secret provider is required")
        if not normalized_kind:
            raise ValueError("Secret kind is required")
        if normalized_name in self._records_by_name:
            raise ValueError(f"Secret '{normalized_name}' already exists")

        now = _utc_now()
        record = SecretRecord(
            secret_id=self._allocate_secret_id(),
            name=normalized_name,
            provider=normalized_provider,
            kind=normalized_kind,
            hashed_value=_hash_secret(value),
            masked_value=_mask_secret(value),
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
            last_used_at=None,
            active=True,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            raw_value=value,
        )

        self._records_by_id[record.secret_id] = record
        self._records_by_name[record.name] = record.secret_id
        return record

    def get_secret(self, secret_id: str) -> SecretRecord | None:
        return self._records_by_id.get(secret_id)

    def get_secret_by_name(self, name: str) -> SecretRecord | None:
        secret_id = self._records_by_name.get(name.strip())
        if not secret_id:
            return None
        return self._records_by_id.get(secret_id)

    def list_secrets(self, *, include_inactive: bool = True) -> list[SecretRecord]:
        records = list(self._records_by_id.values())
        if include_inactive:
            return records
        return [record for record in records if record.active]

    def rotate_secret(
        self,
        secret_id: str,
        *,
        new_value: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> SecretRecord | None:
        record = self._records_by_id.get(secret_id)
        if record is None or not record.active:
            return None
        if not new_value or not new_value.strip():
            raise ValueError("New secret value is required")

        merged_metadata = dict(record.metadata)
        if metadata:
            merged_metadata.update(metadata)
        merged_metadata["rotated_at"] = _utc_now_iso()

        updated = SecretRecord(
            secret_id=record.secret_id,
            name=record.name,
            provider=record.provider,
            kind=record.kind,
            hashed_value=_hash_secret(new_value),
            masked_value=_mask_secret(new_value),
            created_at=record.created_at,
            updated_at=_utc_now(),
            last_used_at=record.last_used_at,
            active=True,
            metadata=merged_metadata,
            raw_value=new_value,
        )
        self._records_by_id[secret_id] = updated
        return updated

    def revoke_secret(self, secret_id: str) -> SecretRecord | None:
        record = self._records_by_id.get(secret_id)
        if record is None:
            return None

        updated = replace(
            record,
            active=False,
            updated_at=_utc_now(),
            raw_value=None,
        )
        self._records_by_id[secret_id] = updated
        return updated

    def record_secret_use(self, secret_id: str) -> SecretRecord | None:
        record = self._records_by_id.get(secret_id)
        if record is None or not record.active:
            return None

        updated = replace(
            record,
            last_used_at=_utc_now(),
            updated_at=_utc_now(),
            raw_value=None,
        )
        self._records_by_id[secret_id] = updated
        return updated

    def verify_secret_value(self, secret_id: str, candidate_value: str) -> bool:
        record = self._records_by_id.get(secret_id)
        if record is None or not record.active:
            return False
        return record.hashed_value == _hash_secret(candidate_value)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self._records_by_id.clear()
        self._records_by_name.clear()
        self._next_id = 1

    def _allocate_secret_id(self) -> str:
        secret_id = f"secret_{self._next_id}"
        self._next_id += 1
        return secret_id


_secret_service = SecretService()


def get_secret_service() -> SecretService:
    return _secret_service


def create_secret_service() -> SecretService:
    return SecretService()

@dataclass(slots=True)
class SecurityOrchestrationResult:
    decision: SecureRuntimeDecision
    telemetryevent: SecurityTelemetryEvent

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "decision": asdict(self.decision),
            "telemetryevent": self.telemetryevent.as_dict(),

@dataclass(slots=True)
class SecurityOrchestrator:
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline = field(default_factory=getactionexecutepipeline)
    telemetrypath: str = "output/security-events.jsonl"
    eventprefix: str = "sec"

    def evaluate_and_record(
        self,
        *,
        actorid: str,
        actiontype: str,
        target: str,
        content: str,
        riskscore: int,
        sessionid: str | None = None,
        filepath: str | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> SecurityOrchestrationResult:
        effectivemetadata = dict(metadata or {})
        occurredat = self._timestamp()
        effectivemetadata.setdefault("timestamp", occurredat)

        decision = self.pipeline.evaluate(
            actorid=actorid,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            content=content,
            riskscore=riskscore,
            sessionid=sessionid,
            filepath=filepath,
            metadata=effectivemetadata,
        )

        telemetryevent = self._build_event(
            actorid=actorid,
            sessionid=sessionid,
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            filepath=filepath or self.pipeline.defaultfilepath,
            decision=decision,
            metadata=effectivemetadata,
            occurredat=occurredat,
        )

        self._append_event(telemetryevent)
        return SecurityOrchestrationResult(decision=decision, telemetryevent=telemetryevent)

    def replay_summary(self, limit: int = 100) -> dict[str, Any]:
        events = list(self.iter_events(limit=limit))
        reviewcount = sum(1 for item in events if item.reviewrequired)
        quarantinecount = sum(1 for item in events if item.quarantine)
        blockedcount = sum(1 for item in events if item.policyverdict in {"block", "quarantine"})
        allowcount = sum(1 for item in events if item.policyverdict == "allow")

        return {
            "telemetrypath": self.telemetrypath,
            "eventcount": len(events),
            "allowcount": allowcount,
            "reviewcount": reviewcount,
            "blockedcount": blockedcount,
            "quarantinecount": quarantinecount,
            "latesteventat": events[-1].occurredat if events else None,
        }

    def iter_events(self, limit: int | None = None) -> Iterable[SecurityTelemetryEvent]:
        path = Path(self.telemetrypath)
        if not path.exists():
            return []

        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        if limit is not None and limit >= 0:
            lines = lines[-limit:]

        events: list[SecurityTelemetryEvent] = []
        for line in lines:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            payload = json.loads(line)
            events.append(
                SecurityTelemetryEvent(
                    eventid=str(payload.get("eventid", "")),
                    eventtype=str(payload.get("eventtype", "security.runtime.decision")),
                    occurredat=str(payload.get("occurredat", "")),
                    actorid=str(payload.get("actorid", "")),
                    sessionid=str(payload.get("sessionid", "")),
                    actiontype=str(payload.get("actiontype", "")),
                    target=str(payload.get("target", "")),
                    filepath=str(payload.get("filepath", "")),
                    executionstate=str(payload.get("executionstate", "")),
                    policyverdict=str(payload.get("policyverdict", "")),
                    responseaction=str(payload.get("responseaction", "")),
                    responsestatus=str(payload.get("responsestatus", "")),
                    shouldexecute=bool(payload.get("shouldexecute", False)),
                    haltedbyboundary=bool(payload.get("haltedbyboundary", False)),
                    reviewrequired=bool(payload.get("reviewrequired", False)),
                    quarantine=bool(payload.get("quarantine", False)),
                    adjustedriskscore=int(payload.get("adjustedriskscore", 0)),
                    reasons=list(payload.get("reasons", [])),
                    promptinjection=dict(payload.get("promptinjection", {})),
                    hostilecontext=dict(payload.get("hostilecontext", {})),
                    downloadanalysis=dict(payload.get("downloadanalysis", {})),
                    outputsanitization=dict(payload.get("outputsanitization", {})),
                    sessionrisk=dict(payload.get("sessionrisk", {})),
                    metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata", {})),
                )
            )
        return events

    def _build_event(
        self,
        *,
        actorid: str,
        sessionid: str | None,
        actiontype: str,
        target: str,
        filepath: str,
        decision: SecureRuntimeDecision,
        metadata: dict[str, Any],
        occurredat: str,
    ) -> SecurityTelemetryEvent:
        eventid = self._event_id(
            actorid=actorid,
            sessionid=sessionid or "anonymous",
            actiontype=actiontype,
            occurredat=occurredat,
        )

        return SecurityTelemetryEvent(
            eventid=eventid,
            eventtype="security.runtime.decision",
            occurredat=occurredat,
            actorid=actorid,
            sessionid=sessionid or "anonymous",
            actiontype=actiontype,
            target=target,
            filepath=filepath,
            executionstate=decision.executionstate,
            policyverdict=decision.policyverdict,
            responseaction=decision.responseaction,
            responsestatus=decision.responsestatus,
            shouldexecute=decision.shouldexecute,
            haltedbyboundary=decision.haltedbyboundary,
            reviewrequired=decision.reviewrequired,
            quarantine=decision.quarantine,
            adjustedriskscore=decision.adjustedriskscore,
            reasons=list(decision.reasons),
            promptinjection=dict(decision.promptinjection),
            hostilecontext=dict(decision.hostilecontext),
            downloadanalysis=dict(getattr(decision, "downloadanalysis", {}) or {}),
            outputsanitization=dict(getattr(decision, "outputsanitization", {}) or {}),
            sessionrisk=dict(getattr(decision, "sessionrisk", {}) or {}),
            metadata=dict(metadata),
        )

    def _append_event(self, event: SecurityTelemetryEvent) -> None:
        path = Path(self.telemetrypath)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(event.as_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def _event_id(
        self,
        *,
        actorid: str,
        sessionid: str,
        actiontype: str,
        occurredat: str,
    ) -> str:
        compact_ts = occurredat.replace("-", "").replace(":", "").replace(".", "").replace("+00:00", "Z")
        return f"{self.eventprefix}-{actorid or 'unknown'}-{sessionid}-{actiontype}-{compact_ts}"

    def _timestamp(self) -> str:
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def initializesecurityorchestrator(
    *,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
    telemetrypath: str = "output/security-events.jsonl",
    eventprefix: str = "sec",
) -> SecurityOrchestrator:
    return SecurityOrchestrator(
        pipeline=pipeline or getactionexecutepipeline(),
        telemetrypath=telemetrypath,
        eventprefix=eventprefix,
    )


def getsecurityorchestrator() -> SecurityOrchestrator:
    return initializesecurityorchestrator()

from typing import Any, Dict

from app.services.guard_facade import execute_guard_action

def orchestrate_security_action(
    *,
    target_type: str,
    target_value: str,
    action_type: str,
    target: str,
    content: str,
    client_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    file_path: str | None = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    scan_result = perform_scan(target_type=target_type, target_value=target_value)

    if scan_result["verdict"] == "block":
        return {
            "scan": scan_result,
            "guard_request": None,
            "guard_response": None,
            "final_verdict": "block",
            "blocked_by": "scan",
            "sandbox_lane": scan_result.get("sandbox_lane", "none"),
            "review_status": scan_result.get("review_status", "none"),
            "quarantine_reason": scan_result.get("quarantine_reason"),
            "untrusted": scan_result.get("untrusted", False),
        }

    guard_request = build_guard_request_from_scan(
        scan_result=scan_result,
        action_type=action_type,
        target=target,
        content=content,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        file_path=file_path,
    )

    guard_response: GuardActionResponse = execute_guard_action(guard_request)

    final_verdict = guard_response.verdict
    if scan_result["verdict"] == "quarantine" and guard_response.verdict == "allow":
        final_verdict = "quarantine"

    return {
        "scan": scan_result,
        "guard_request": guard_request.model_dump(),
        "guard_response": guard_response.model_dump(),
        "final_verdict": final_verdict,
        "blocked_by": "guard" if final_verdict == "block" else None,
        "sandbox_lane": scan_result.get("sandbox_lane", "none"),
        "review_status": scan_result.get("review_status", "none"),
        "quarantine_reason": scan_result.get("quarantine_reason"),
        "untrusted": scan_result.get("untrusted", False),

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Mapping

from app.core.principals import Principal
from app.core.session_security import SessionPolicy, SessionRecord, SessionValidationResult

def _stringify_metadata(metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    return {str(key): str(value) for key, value in metadata.items()}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SessionServiceResult:
    ok: bool
    reason: str
    session: SessionRecord | None = None
    validation: SessionValidationResult | None = None
    auth: AuthResult | None = None
    secret: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "session": self.session.to_dict() if self.session else None,
            "validation": self.validation.to_dict() if self.validation else None,
            "auth": self.auth.to_dict() if self.auth else None,
            "secret": self.secret,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


class SessionService:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        auth_service: AuthService | None = None,
        session_policy: SessionPolicy | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._auth_service = auth_service or build_auth_service(
            session_policy=session_policy,
        )

    @property
    def auth_service(self) -> AuthService:
        return self._auth_service

    @property
    def session_policy(self) -> SessionPolicy:
        return self._auth_service.session_policy

    def create_session(
        self,
        *,
        principal: Principal,
        secret: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        ip_address: str | None = None,
        user_agent: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> SessionServiceResult:
        session, issued_secret = self._auth_service.issue_session(
            principal=principal,
            secret=secret,
            session_id=session_id,
            now=now,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return SessionServiceResult(
            ok=True,
            reason="session_created",
            session=session,
            secret=issued_secret,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def validate_session(
        self,
        *,
        principal: Principal,
        session: SessionRecord,
        presented_secret: str,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        ip_address: str | None = None,
        user_agent: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> SessionServiceResult:
        auth_result = self._auth_service.authenticate_session(
            principal=principal,
            session=session,
            presented_secret=presented_secret,
            now=now,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
            auth_method="session",
            metadata=metadata,
        )
        return SessionServiceResult(
            ok=auth_result.authenticated,
            reason=auth_result.reason,
            session=session,
            validation=auth_result.validation,
            auth=auth_result,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def refresh_session(
        self,
        *,
        session: SessionRecord,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        ip_address: str | None = None,
        user_agent: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> SessionServiceResult:
        refreshed = self._auth_service.refresh_session(
            session,
            now=now,
            ip_address=ip_address,
            user_agent=user_agent,
        )
        return SessionServiceResult(
            ok=True,
            reason="session_refreshed",
            session=refreshed,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def rotate_session(
        self,
        *,
        session: SessionRecord,
        new_secret: str | None = None,
        now: datetime | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> SessionServiceResult:
        rotated, issued_secret = self._auth_service.rotate_session(
            session,
            new_secret=new_secret,
            now=now,
        )
        return SessionServiceResult(
            ok=True,
            reason="session_rotated",
            session=rotated,
            secret=issued_secret,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )

    def revoke_session(
        self,
        *,
        session: SessionRecord,
        reason: str = "revoked",
        now: datetime | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> SessionServiceResult:
        revoked = self._auth_service.revoke_session(
            session,
            reason=reason,
            now=now,
        )
        return SessionServiceResult(
            ok=True,
            reason="session_revoked",
            session=revoked,
            metadata=_stringify_metadata(metadata),
        )


def build_session_service(
    *,
    auth_service: AuthService | None = None,
    session_policy: SessionPolicy | None = None,
) -> SessionService:
    return SessionService(
        auth_service=auth_service,
        session_policy=session_policy,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections import deque
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Final


TELEMETRY_DIR: Final[Path] = Path.home() / ".ironclaw"
TELEMETRY_PATH: Final[Path] = TELEMETRY_DIR / "telemetry_events.jsonl"
TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION: Final[int] = 1
DEFAULT_READ_LIMIT: Final[int] = 50
MAX_READ_LIMIT: Final[int] = 10_000

TELEMETRY_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

_TELEMETRY_LOCK = Lock()


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")  # [web:123][web:147]


def _coerce_json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
        return value

    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    if isinstance(value, Path):
        return str(value)

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): _coerce_json_safe(item) for key, item in value.items()}

    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
        return [_coerce_json_safe(item) for item in value]

    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        return _coerce_json_safe(value.model_dump())

    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(value.dict):
        return _coerce_json_safe(value.dict())

    if hasattr(value, "__dict__"):
        return _coerce_json_safe(vars(value))

    return str(value)


def _safe_limit(limit: int | str | None, default: int = DEFAULT_READ_LIMIT) -> int:
    try:
        resolved = int(limit if limit is not None else default)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        resolved = default
    return max(1, min(resolved, MAX_READ_LIMIT))


def _ensure_parent_dir() -> None:
    TELEMETRY_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def _build_event_record(event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    safe_event_type = str(event_type).strip() or "unknown"
    safe_payload = _coerce_json_safe(payload if payload is not None else {})
    if not isinstance(safe_payload, dict):
        safe_payload = {"value": safe_payload}

    now = _utc_now()
    return {
        "event_id": f"telem_{now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f')}",
        "schema_version": TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "timestamp": now.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        "event_type": safe_event_type,
        "payload": safe_payload,
    }


def _normalize_event(event: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(event, dict):
        return None

    normalized = dict(event)
    normalized["event_id"] = str(normalized.get("event_id") or "").strip() or None
    normalized["schema_version"] = int(normalized.get("schema_version") or TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION)
    normalized["timestamp"] = str(normalized.get("timestamp") or "").strip() or None
    normalized["event_type"] = str(normalized.get("event_type") or "unknown").strip() or "unknown"

    payload = _coerce_json_safe(normalized.get("payload"))
    normalized["payload"] = payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {"value": payload}
    return normalized


def append_telemetry_event(event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    record = _build_event_record(event_type, payload)

    with _TELEMETRY_LOCK:  # serialize concurrent appends [web:143]
        _ensure_parent_dir()
        with TELEMETRY_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as file_handle:
            file_handle.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")

    return record


def read_telemetry_events(
    limit: int = DEFAULT_READ_LIMIT,
    *,
    event_type: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    safe_limit = _safe_limit(limit)
    expected_type = str(event_type).strip() if event_type is not None else None

    with _TELEMETRY_LOCK:
        if not TELEMETRY_PATH.exists():
            return []

        with TELEMETRY_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as file_handle:  # newline-aware file reads are preferable [web:146]
            lines = deque(file_handle, maxlen=MAX_READ_LIMIT)

    events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for line in reversed(lines):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue

        try:
            raw_event = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue

        event = _normalize_event(raw_event)
        if event is None:
            continue

        if expected_type is not None and event.get("event_type") != expected_type:
            continue

        events.append(event)
        if len(events) >= safe_limit:
            break

    return events


def summarize_telemetry_events(limit: int = 500) -> dict[str, Any]:
    events = read_telemetry_events(limit=limit)
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for event in events:
        event_type = str(event.get("event_type") or "unknown")
        counts[event_type] = counts.get(event_type, 0) + 1

    return {
        "path": str(TELEMETRY_PATH),
        "schema_version": TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "event_count": len(events),
        "event_type_counts": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
        "latest_timestamp": events[0].get("timestamp") if events else None,
    }


def clear_telemetry_events() -> None:
    with _TELEMETRY_LOCK:
        _ensure_parent_dir()
        TELEMETRY_PATH.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")


def telemetry_file_exists() -> bool:
    with _TELEMETRY_LOCK:
        return TELEMETRY_PATH.exists()


def get_telemetry_path() -> str:
    return str(TELEMETRY_PATH)

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlparse


IOC_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?P<ipv4>\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b)|"
    r"(?P<sha256>\b[a-fA-F0-9]{64}\b)|"
    r"(?P<sha1>\b[a-fA-F0-9]{40}\b)|"
    r"(?P<md5>\b[a-fA-F0-9]{32}\b)|"
    r"(?P<domain>\b(?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}\b)|"
    r"(?P<url>https?://[^\s\"'<>]+)"
)

SUSPICIOUS_KEYWORDS = {
    "credential_harvest": {"login", "password", "verify account", "mfa reset", "session cookie"},
    "malware_delivery": {"payload", "dropper", "loader", "macro", "powershell -enc", "rundll32"},
    "command_and_control": {"beacon", "c2", "callback", "exfil", "reverse shell", "dns tunnel"},
    "evasion": {"obfuscation", "packer", "sandbox evade", "sleep mask", "disable defender"},
}

DEFAULT_SOURCE_WEIGHTS = {
    "internal": 1.0,
    "curated": 0.85,
    "community": 0.65,
    "external": 0.55,
}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ThreatIndicator:
    value: str
    indicator_type: str
    confidence: float
    severity: str
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    source: str = "internal"
    first_seen: str | None = None
    last_seen: str | None = None
    reference: str | None = None
    attributes: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ThreatMatch:
    value: str
    indicator_type: str
    confidence: float
    severity: str
    source: str
    tags: list[str]
    matched_on: str
    reference: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ThreatAssessment:
    verdict: str
    score: float
    severity: str
    risk_families: list[str]
    matches: list[ThreatMatch]
    extracted_indicators: list[str]
    rationale: list[str]
    assessed_at: str


def _utcnow() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(value.strip().lower().split())


def _normalize_indicator(value: str, indicator_type: str) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize_text(value)
    if indicator_type in {"sha256", "sha1", "md5", "domain"}:
        return normalized
    if indicator_type == "url":
        return normalized.rstrip("/")
    return normalized


def _indicator_fingerprint(value: str, indicator_type: str) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize_indicator(value, indicator_type)
    return hashlib.sha256(f"{indicator_type}:{normalized}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _infer_indicator_type(value: str) -> str:
    candidate = value.strip()
    lowered = candidate.lower()

    if lowered.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        return "url"

    if re.fullmatch(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{64}", candidate):
        return "sha256"

    if re.fullmatch(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{40}", candidate):
        return "sha1"

    if re.fullmatch(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{32}", candidate):
        return "md5"

    try:
        ipaddress.ip_address(candidate)
        return "ipv4"
    except ValueError:
        pass

    return "domain"


def _parse_indicator(raw: dict[str, Any]) -> ThreatIndicator:
    value = str(raw.get("value", "")).strip()
    indicator_type = str(raw.get("indicator_type") or _infer_indicator_type(value)).strip().lower()
    confidence = float(raw.get("confidence", 0.5))
    severity = str(raw.get("severity", "medium")).strip().lower()
    tags = [str(tag).strip().lower() for tag in raw.get("tags", []) if str(tag).strip()]
    source = str(raw.get("source", "internal")).strip().lower()

    return ThreatIndicator(
        value=_normalize_indicator(value, indicator_type),
        indicator_type=indicator_type,
        confidence=max(0.0, min(confidence, 1.0)),
        severity=severity if severity in {"low", "medium", "high", "critical"} else "medium",
        tags=tags,
        source=source,
        first_seen=raw.get("first_seen"),
        last_seen=raw.get("last_seen"),
        reference=raw.get("reference"),
        attributes=dict(raw.get("attributes", {})),
    )


def _severity_weight(severity: str) -> float:
    return {
        "low": 0.25,
        "medium": 0.5,
        "high": 0.8,
        "critical": 1.0,
    }.get(severity, 0.5)


class ThreatIntelService:
    def __init__(self, seed_indicators: list[ThreatIndicator] | None = None) -> None:
        self._indicators: dict[str, ThreatIndicator] = {}
        self._updated_at = _utcnow()
        for indicator in seed_indicators or []:
            self.upsert_indicator(indicator)

    @property
    def updated_at(self) -> str:
        return self._updated_at

    def upsert_indicator(self, indicator: ThreatIndicator) -> ThreatIndicator:
        normalized = _normalize_indicator(indicator.value, indicator.indicator_type)
        normalized_indicator = ThreatIndicator(
            value=normalized,
            indicator_type=indicator.indicator_type,
            confidence=max(0.0, min(indicator.confidence, 1.0)),
            severity=indicator.severity if indicator.severity in {"low", "medium", "high", "critical"} else "medium",
            tags=sorted({tag.strip().lower() for tag in indicator.tags if tag.strip()}),
            source=indicator.source.strip().lower() or "internal",
            first_seen=indicator.first_seen,
            last_seen=indicator.last_seen or _utcnow(),
            reference=indicator.reference,
            attributes=dict(indicator.attributes),
        )
        self._indicators[_indicator_fingerprint(normalized, normalized_indicator.indicator_type)] = normalized_indicator
        self._updated_at = _utcnow()
        return normalized_indicator

    def load_from_json(self, payload: str | bytes) -> int:
        raw = json.loads(payload)
        if not isinstance(raw, list):
            raise ValueError("Threat intel payload must be a list of indicators.")
        count = 0
        for item in raw:
            self.upsert_indicator(_parse_indicator(dict(item)))
            count += 1
        return count

    def load_from_file(self, path: str | Path) -> int:
        content = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return self.load_from_json(content)

    def export_json(self) -> str:
        indicators = [
            {
                "value": indicator.value,
                "indicator_type": indicator.indicator_type,
                "confidence": indicator.confidence,
                "severity": indicator.severity,
                "tags": indicator.tags,
                "source": indicator.source,
                "first_seen": indicator.first_seen,
                "last_seen": indicator.last_seen,
                "reference": indicator.reference,
                "attributes": indicator.attributes,
            }
            for indicator in self._indicators.values()
        ]
        return json.dumps(indicators, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    def indicator_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self._indicators)

    def has_indicator(self, value: str, indicator_type: str | None = None) -> bool:
        resolved_type = indicator_type or _infer_indicator_type(value)
        fingerprint = _indicator_fingerprint(value, resolved_type)
        return fingerprint in self._indicators

    def lookup_indicator(self, value: str, indicator_type: str | None = None) -> ThreatIndicator | None:
        resolved_type = indicator_type or _infer_indicator_type(value)
        fingerprint = _indicator_fingerprint(value, resolved_type)
        return self._indicators.get(fingerprint)

    def extract_indicators(self, text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        extracted: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        seen: set[str] = set()

        for match in IOC_PATTERN.finditer(text):
            group_name = next((name for name, value in match.groupdict().items() if value), None)
            if group_name is None:
                continue

            raw_value = match.group(group_name)
            indicator_type = "url" if group_name == "url" else group_name
            normalized_value = _normalize_indicator(raw_value, indicator_type)

            if indicator_type == "ipv4":
                try:
                    ipaddress.ip_address(normalized_value)
                except ValueError:
                    continue

            key = f"{indicator_type}:{normalized_value}"
            if key in seen:
                continue

            seen.add(key)
            extracted.append((normalized_value, indicator_type))

        return extracted

    def assess_text(
        self,
        text: str,
        *,
        context: str | None = None,
        minimum_confidence: float = 0.0,
    ) -> ThreatAssessment:
        normalized_text = _normalize_text(text)
        extracted = self.extract_indicators(text)
        matches: list[ThreatMatch] = []
        risk_families: set[str] = set()
        rationale: list[str] = []

        for value, indicator_type in extracted:
            indicator = self.lookup_indicator(value, indicator_type)
            if indicator is None or indicator.confidence < minimum_confidence:
                continue

            matches.append(
                ThreatMatch(
                    value=indicator.value,
                    indicator_type=indicator.indicator_type,
                    confidence=indicator.confidence,
                    severity=indicator.severity,
                    source=indicator.source,
                    tags=list(indicator.tags),
                    matched_on=context or "text",
                    reference=indicator.reference,
                )
            )
            risk_families.update(indicator.tags)

        keyword_hits: dict[str, int] = {}
        for family, keywords in SUSPICIOUS_KEYWORDS.items():
            hits = sum(1 for keyword in keywords if keyword in normalized_text)
            if hits:
                keyword_hits[family] = hits
                risk_families.add(family)

        if matches:
            rationale.append(f"Matched {len(matches)} known threat indicator(s).")

        for family, hits in sorted(keyword_hits.items()):
            rationale.append(f"Detected {hits} suspicious keyword pattern(s) for {family}.")

        source_score = 0.0
        for match in matches:
            source_weight = DEFAULT_SOURCE_WEIGHTS.get(match.source, 0.5)
            source_score += match.confidence * _severity_weight(match.severity) * source_weight

        keyword_score = sum(min(count * 0.12, 0.3) for count in keyword_hits.values())
        score = min(source_score + keyword_score, 1.0)

        if score >= 0.85:
            verdict = "block"
            severity = "critical"
        elif score >= 0.6:
            verdict = "review"
            severity = "high"
        elif score >= 0.3:
            verdict = "monitor"
            severity = "medium"
        else:
            verdict = "allow"
            severity = "low"

        if not rationale:
            rationale.append("No known threat indicators or suspicious keyword clusters were detected.")

        return ThreatAssessment(
            verdict=verdict,
            score=round(score, 4),
            severity=severity,
            risk_families=sorted(risk_families),
            matches=matches,
            extracted_indicators=[value for value, _ in extracted],
            rationale=rationale,
            assessed_at=_utcnow(),
        )

    def assess_artifact(
        self,
        *,
        url: str | None = None,
        domain: str | None = None,
        hashes: list[str] | None = None,
        text: str | None = None,
        context: str | None = None,
    ) -> ThreatAssessment:
        fragments: list[str] = []

        if url:
            fragments.append(url)
            try:
                parsed = urlparse(url)
                if parsed.hostname:
                    fragments.append(parsed.hostname)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if domain:
            fragments.append(domain)

        if hashes:
            fragments.extend(hashes)

        if text:
            fragments.append(text)

        combined = "\n".join(fragment for fragment in fragments if fragment)
        return self.assess_text(combined, context=context or "artifact")

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal


ThreatSeverity = Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"]
ThreatType = Literal[
    "domain",
    "ip",
    "url",
    "hash",
    "prompt_pattern",
    "tool_pattern",
]
ThreatSourceKind = Literal["manual", "feed", "import"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ThreatIndicator:

    indicator_type: ThreatType

    severity: ThreatSeverity
    source: ThreatSourceKind = "manual"

            "indicator_id": self.indicator_id,
            "indicator_type": self.indicator_type,
            "value": self.value,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "source": self.source,
            "description": self.description,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "first_seen_at": self.first_seen_at,
            "last_seen_at": self.last_seen_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }

@dataclass(slots=True)
class ThreatIntelMatch:
    indicator_id: str
    indicator_type: ThreatType
    value: str
    severity: ThreatSeverity
    matched_on: str
    reason: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "indicator_id": self.indicator_id,
            "indicator_type": self.indicator_type,
            "value": self.value,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "matched_on": self.matched_on,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ThreatIntelScanResult:
    scanned_text: str
    checked_at: str
    matches: list[ThreatIntelMatch] = field(default_factory=list)
    highest_severity: ThreatSeverity = "low"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "scanned_text": self.scanned_text,
            "checked_at": self.checked_at,
            "matches": [match.to_dict() for match in self.matches],
            "highest_severity": self.highest_severity,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


_SEVERITY_ORDER: dict[ThreatSeverity, int] = {
    "low": 0,
    "medium": 1,
    "high": 2,
    "critical": 3,
}


def build_threat_indicator(
    *,
    indicator_id: str,
    indicator_type: ThreatType,
    value: str,
    severity: ThreatSeverity,
    source: ThreatSourceKind = "manual",
    description: str = "",
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    confidence: int = 50,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> ThreatIndicator:
    normalized_indicator_id = _normalize_text(indicator_id)
    normalized_value = _normalize_text(value)

    if not normalized_indicator_id:
        raise ValueError("indicator_id is required")
    if not normalized_value:
        raise ValueError("value is required")

    bounded_confidence = max(0, min(int(confidence), 100))
    now = _utc_now()

    return ThreatIndicator(
        indicator_id=normalized_indicator_id,
        indicator_type=indicator_type,
        value=normalized_value,
        severity=severity,
        source=source,
        description=_normalize_text(description),
        tags=[tag.strip() for tag in (tags or []) if tag and tag.strip()],
        confidence=bounded_confidence,
        first_seen_at=now,
        last_seen_at=now,
        metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )

    indicators = [

        },
    )


def ingest_threat_indicators(
    feed: ThreatIntelFeed,
    indicators: list[ThreatIndicator],
) -> ThreatIntelFeed:
    existing = {indicator.indicator_id: indicator for indicator in feed.indicators}

    for indicator in indicators:
        existing[indicator.indicator_id] = indicator

    feed.indicators = sorted(
        existing.values(),
        key=lambda item: (_SEVERITY_ORDER[item.severity], item.indicator_type, item.value),
        reverse=True,
    )
    feed.updated_at = _utc_now()
    return feed


def scan_text_against_threat_feed(
    text: str,
    feed: ThreatIntelFeed,
) -> ThreatIntelScanResult:
    lowered = text.lower()
    matches: list[ThreatIntelMatch] = []
    highest_severity: ThreatSeverity = "low"

    for indicator in feed.indicators:
        candidate = indicator.value.lower()
        matched = False
        matched_on = indicator.value
        reason = ""

        if indicator.indicator_type == "domain":
            matched = candidate in lowered
            reason = "Detected known malicious domain indicator."
        elif indicator.indicator_type == "ip":
            matched = candidate in lowered
            reason = "Detected known malicious IP indicator."
        elif indicator.indicator_type == "url":
            matched = candidate in lowered
            reason = "Detected known malicious URL indicator."
        elif indicator.indicator_type == "hash":
            matched = candidate in lowered
            reason = "Detected known malicious hash indicator."
        elif indicator.indicator_type == "prompt_pattern":
            matched = candidate in lowered
            reason = "Detected prompt injection or exfiltration phrase."
        elif indicator.indicator_type == "tool_pattern":
            matched = candidate in lowered
            reason = "Detected high-risk tool or execution pattern."

        if not matched:
            continue

        matches.append(
            ThreatIntelMatch(
                indicator_id=indicator.indicator_id,
                indicator_type=indicator.indicator_type,
                value=indicator.value,
                severity=indicator.severity,
                matched_on=matched_on,
                reason=reason,
                metadata={
                    "source": indicator.source,
                    "confidence": indicator.confidence,
                    "tags": list(indicator.tags),
                },
            )
        )

        if _SEVERITY_ORDER[indicator.severity] > _SEVERITY_ORDER[highest_severity]:
            highest_severity = indicator.severity

    return ThreatIntelScanResult(
        scanned_text=text,
        checked_at=_utc_now(),
        matches=matches,
        highest_severity=highest_severity if matches else "low",
        metadata={
            "feed_id": feed.feed_id,
            "match_count": len(matches),
        },
    )


def summarize_threat_scan_result(result: ThreatIntelScanResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
    severity_counts: dict[str, int] = {}

    for match in result.matches:
        severity_counts[match.severity] = severity_counts.get(match.severity, 0) + 1

    return {
        "checked_at": result.checked_at,
        "match_count": len(result.matches),
        "highest_severity": result.highest_severity,
        "severity_counts": severity_counts,
    }

UpdateState = Literal["planned", "in_progress", "completed", "failed", "skipped"]
UpdateStrategy = Literal["manual", "auto", "deferred"]


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return (value or "").strip()


@dataclass(slots=True)

    name: str
    state: UpdateState
    message: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

            "name": self.name,

    from_version: str
    to_version: str
    strategy: UpdateStrategy
    steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationUpdateResult:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    from_version: str
    to_version: str
    strategy: UpdateStrategy
    succeeded: bool
    state: UpdateState
    started_at: str
    completed_at: str

    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

            "completed_at": self.completed_at,

            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def build_update_plan(
    record: IntegrationRecord,
    *,
    to_version: str,
    strategy: UpdateStrategy = "manual",
    extra_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> IntegrationUpdatePlan:
    """Describe the safe update path for an integration without applying it."""
    from_version = _normalize_text(record.version) or "0.0.0"
    normalized_to_version = _normalize_text(to_version)

    if not normalized_to_version:
        raise ValueError("to_version is required")

    steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {
            "step": "resolve-integration",
            "description": f"Resolve integration '{record.slug}' metadata.",
        },
        {
            "step": "check-compatibility",
            "description": "Check version compatibility and migration requirements.",
        },
        {
            "step": "prepare-backup",
            "description": "Prepare rollback-safe backup of current integration state.",
        },
        {
            "step": "apply-update",
            "description": "Apply updated adapter/runtime version.",
        },
        {
            "step": "verify-post-update",
            "description": "Run verification checks to confirm healthy status.",
        },
    ]

    metadata = {
        "integration_type": record.integration_type,
        "platform": record.platform,
        **(extra_metadata or {}),
    }

    return IntegrationUpdatePlan(
        integration_id=record.integration_id,
        from_version=from_version,
        to_version=normalized_to_version,
        strategy=strategy,
        steps=steps,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def apply_integration_update(
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    integration_id: str,
    *,
    to_version: str,
    strategy: UpdateStrategy = "manual",
    dry_run: bool = False,
    requested_by: str | None = None,
    extra_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> IntegrationUpdateResult:
    """Apply (or simulate) an update of an integration record in the registry.

    Gen1 treats updates as metadata changes on the registry record only; no
    external package manager operations are performed.
    """
    record = get_integration(registry, integration_id)
    if record is None:
        raise KeyError(f"unknown integration_id: {integration_id}")

    plan = build_update_plan(
        record,
        to_version=to_version,
        strategy=strategy,
        extra_metadata=extra_metadata,
    )

    started_at = _utc_now()
    steps: list[UpdateStepResult] = []

    # Step 1: resolve
    steps.append(
        UpdateStepResult(
            name="resolve-integration",
            state="completed",
            message=f"Resolved integration '{record.slug}'.",
            metadata={
                "platform": record.platform,
                "from_version": record.version,
            },
        )
    )

    # Step 2: compatibility (Gen1 is optimistic here; compatibility_matrix can extend this later).
    steps.append(
        UpdateStepResult(
            name="check-compatibility",
            state="completed",
            message="No incompatible breaking changes detected for Gen1.",
            metadata={"planned_to_version": to_version},
        )
    )

    # Step 3: backup (logical only for Gen1).
    steps.append(
        UpdateStepResult(
            name="prepare-backup",
            state="completed",
            message="Recorded pre-update version for rollback if needed.",
            metadata={"backup_version": record.version},
        )
    )

    # Step 4 + 5 differ for dry-run vs real update.
    from_version = record.version
    succeeded = False
    state: UpdateState

    if dry_run:
        steps.append(
            UpdateStepResult(
                name="apply-update",
                state="skipped",
                message="Dry run only; no changes applied.",
            )
        )
        steps.append(
            UpdateStepResult(
                name="verify-post-update",
                state="skipped",
                message="Verification skipped because update was not applied.",
            )
        )
        state = "planned"
        succeeded = False
        to_version_effective = from_version
    else:
        # Apply update to registry record.
        record.version = to_version
        update_integration_status(registry, integration_id, record.status or "active")

        steps.append(
            UpdateStepResult(
                name="apply-update",
                state="completed",
                message=f"Integration '{record.slug}' updated to version {to_version}.",
                metadata={"from_version": from_version, "to_version": to_version},
            )
        )
        steps.append(
            UpdateStepResult(
                name="verify-post-update",
                state="completed",
                message="Post-update verification passed for Gen1 metadata.",
            )
        )
        state = "completed"
        succeeded = True
        to_version_effective = to_version

    completed_at = _utc_now()
    refreshed = get_integration(registry, integration_id) or record

    metadata = dict(extra_metadata or {})
    if requested_by:
        metadata["requested_by"] = requested_by
    metadata["strategy"] = strategy
    metadata["dry_run"] = dry_run

    return IntegrationUpdateResult(
        integration_id=refreshed.integration_id,
        slug=refreshed.slug,
        from_version=from_version,
        to_version=to_version_effective,
        strategy=strategy,
        succeeded=succeeded,
        state=state,
        started_at=started_at,
        completed_at=completed_at,
        steps=steps,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def summarize_update_result(result: IntegrationUpdateResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Compact summary for UI / telemetry about an integration update."""
    return {
        "integration_id": result.integration_id,
        "slug": result.slug,
        "from_version": result.from_version,
        "to_version": result.to_version,
        "strategy": result.strategy,
        "succeeded": result.succeeded,
        "state": result.state,
        "step_count": len(result.steps),
        "started_at": result.started_at,
        "completed_at": result.completed_at,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any


from app.core.billing import BillingRegistry, get_billing_registry
from app.core.unit_wallet import get_unit_wallet_registry


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UsageAuthorization:
    allowed: bool
    owner_key: str
    requested_units: int
    remaining_units_before: int
    remaining_units_after: int
    reason: str
    plan: str | None = None
    subscription_id: str | None = None
    wallet_balance_before: int | None = None
    wallet_balance_after: int | None = None
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UsageConsumptionResult:
    applied: bool
    owner_key: str
    consumed_units: int
    remaining_units: int
    reason: str
    plan: str | None = None
    subscription_id: str | None = None
    wallet_balance: int | None = None
    consumed_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageMeteringService:
    """
    Enforces prepaid unit consumption against the billing subscription first,
    while mirroring purchased units into the local unit wallet for visibility.
    """

    def __init__(self, *, billing_registry: BillingRegistry | None = None) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._billing_registry = billing_registry or get_billing_registry()
        self._wallet_registry = get_unit_wallet_registry()

    def _normalize_owner_key(self, owner_key: str) -> str:
        normalized = owner_key.strip().lower()
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("owner_key must not be empty")
        return normalized

    def _get_wallet_balance(self, owner_key: str) -> int:
        wallet = self._wallet_registry.get_wallet(owner_key)
        if wallet is None:
            return 0
        return int(wallet.balance_units)

    def authorize_usage(
        self,
        *,
        owner_key: str,
        units: int,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> UsageAuthorization:
        if units <= 0:
            raise ValueError("units must be positive")

        normalized_owner_key = self._normalize_owner_key(owner_key)
        metadata = dict(metadata or {})

        with self._lock:
            subscription = self._billing_registry.get_active_subscription_for_customer(
                normalized_owner_key
            )
            wallet_balance_before = self._get_wallet_balance(normalized_owner_key)

            if subscription is None:
                return UsageAuthorization(
                    allowed=False,
                    owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                    requested_units=units,
                    remaining_units_before=0,
                    remaining_units_after=0,
                    reason="no_active_subscription",
                    wallet_balance_before=wallet_balance_before,
                    wallet_balance_after=wallet_balance_before,
                    metadata=metadata,
                )

            remaining_before = subscription.remaining_units
            allowed = self._billing_registry.can_consume(
                customer_id=normalized_owner_key,
                units=units,
            )

            if not allowed:
                return UsageAuthorization(
                    allowed=False,
                    owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                    requested_units=units,
                    remaining_units_before=remaining_before,
                    remaining_units_after=remaining_before,
                    reason="insufficient_plan_units",
                    plan=subscription.plan,
                    subscription_id=subscription.subscription_id,
                    wallet_balance_before=wallet_balance_before,
                    wallet_balance_after=wallet_balance_before,
                    metadata=metadata,
                )

            return UsageAuthorization(
                allowed=True,
                owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                requested_units=units,
                remaining_units_before=remaining_before,
                remaining_units_after=max(remaining_before - units, 0),
                reason="authorized",
                plan=subscription.plan,
                subscription_id=subscription.subscription_id,
                wallet_balance_before=wallet_balance_before,
                wallet_balance_after=wallet_balance_before,
                metadata=metadata,
            )

    def consume_usage(
        self,
        *,
        owner_key: str,
        units: int,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> UsageConsumptionResult:
        if units <= 0:
            raise ValueError("units must be positive")

        normalized_owner_key = self._normalize_owner_key(owner_key)
        metadata = dict(metadata or {})

        with self._lock:
            authorization = self.authorize_usage(
                owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                units=units,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
            if not authorization.allowed:
                return UsageConsumptionResult(
                    applied=False,
                    owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                    consumed_units=0,
                    remaining_units=authorization.remaining_units_before,
                    reason=authorization.reason,
                    plan=authorization.plan,
                    subscription_id=authorization.subscription_id,
                    wallet_balance=authorization.wallet_balance_before,
                    metadata=metadata,
                )

            subscription = self._billing_registry.record_usage(
                customer_id=normalized_owner_key,
                units=units,
            )

            wallet = self._wallet_registry.debit_units(
                owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                units=units,
                metadata={
                    "source": "usage_metering",
                    "subscription_id": subscription.subscription_id,
                    "plan": subscription.plan,
                    **metadata,
                },
            )

            return UsageConsumptionResult(
                applied=True,
                owner_key=normalized_owner_key,
                consumed_units=units,
                remaining_units=subscription.remaining_units,
                reason="consumed",
                plan=subscription.plan,
                subscription_id=subscription.subscription_id,
                wallet_balance=wallet.balance_units,
                metadata=metadata,
            )

    def get_usage_snapshot(self, *, owner_key: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        normalized_owner_key = self._normalize_owner_key(owner_key)

        with self._lock:
            subscription = self._billing_registry.get_active_subscription_for_customer(
                normalized_owner_key
            )
            wallet = self._wallet_registry.get_wallet(normalized_owner_key)

            if subscription is None:
                return {
                    "owner_key": normalized_owner_key,
                    "has_active_subscription": False,
                    "plan": None,
                    "subscription_id": None,
                    "unit_limit": 0,
                    "units_consumed": 0,
                    "remaining_units": 0,
                    "wallet_balance_units": wallet.balance_units if wallet else 0,
                    "checked_at": _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
                }

            return {
                "owner_key": normalized_owner_key,
                "has_active_subscription": True,
                "plan": subscription.plan,
                "subscription_id": subscription.subscription_id,
                "unit_limit": subscription.unit_limit,
                "units_consumed": subscription.units_consumed,
                "remaining_units": subscription.remaining_units,
                "wallet_balance_units": wallet.balance_units if wallet else 0,
                "checked_at": _utc_now().isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
            }


_usage_metering_service = UsageMeteringService()


def get_usage_metering_service() -> UsageMeteringService:
    return _usage_metering_service

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _isoformat(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on", "enabled", "ok", "healthy", "ready"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off", "disabled", "error", "failed", "down"}:
            return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return bool(value)
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_float(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_datetime(value: Any, default: datetime | None = None) -> datetime | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None:
            return value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return value.astimezone(UTC)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        candidate = value.strip()
        if not candidate:
            return default
        candidate = candidate.replace("Z", "+00:00")
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
        except ValueError:
            return default
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            return parsed.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
    return default


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiagnosticCheck:
    name: str
    category: str
    status: str
    healthy: bool
    message: str = ""
    observed_value: str = ""
    expected_value: str = ""
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "category": self.category,
            "status": self.status,
            "healthy": self.healthy,
            "message": self.message,
            "observed_value": self.observed_value,
            "expected_value": self.expected_value,
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SystemDiagnostics:
    service: str = "ironclaw-security"
    environment: str = "local"
    version: str = "dev"
    overall_status: str = "healthy"
    healthy: bool = True
    cpu_percent: float = 0.0
    memory_percent: float = 0.0
    disk_percent: float = 0.0
    latency_ms: float = 0.0
    policy_bundle_loaded: bool = True
    sandbox_ready: bool = True
    telemetry_ready: bool = True
    review_queue_ready: bool = True
    database_ready: bool = True
    warnings: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    failures: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    checks: tuple[DiagnosticCheck, ...] = ()
    checked_at: datetime = field(default_factory=_utc_now)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "service": self.service,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "version": self.version,
            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
            "healthy": self.healthy,
            "cpu_percent": self.cpu_percent,
            "memory_percent": self.memory_percent,
            "disk_percent": self.disk_percent,
            "latency_ms": self.latency_ms,
            "policy_bundle_loaded": self.policy_bundle_loaded,
            "sandbox_ready": self.sandbox_ready,
            "telemetry_ready": self.telemetry_ready,
            "review_queue_ready": self.review_queue_ready,
            "database_ready": self.database_ready,
            "warnings": list(self.warnings),
            "failures": list(self.failures),
            "checks": [check.to_dict() for check in self.checks],
            "checked_at": _isoformat(self.checked_at),
        }


def _normalize_check(item: Any) -> DiagnosticCheck | None:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return None

    status = _coerce_str(item.get("status"), "unknown").lower() or "unknown"
    healthy = _coerce_bool(item.get("healthy"), status in {"ok", "pass", "healthy", "ready"})
    checked_at = _coerce_datetime(item.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    return DiagnosticCheck(
        name=_coerce_str(item.get("name"), "unnamed-check") or "unnamed-check",
        category=_coerce_str(item.get("category"), "system") or "system",
        status=status,
        healthy=healthy,
        message=_coerce_str(item.get("message")),
        observed_value=_coerce_str(item.get("observed_value")),
        expected_value=_coerce_str(item.get("expected_value")),
        checked_at=checked_at,
    )


def _default_checks(now: datetime) -> tuple[DiagnosticCheck, ...]:
    return (
        DiagnosticCheck(
            name="policy-bundle",
            category="policy",
            status="healthy",
            healthy=True,
            message="Policy bundle loaded.",
            observed_value="loaded",
            expected_value="loaded",
            checked_at=now,
        ),
        DiagnosticCheck(
            name="sandbox-runtime",
            category="runtime",
            status="healthy",
            healthy=True,
            message="Sandbox runtime ready.",
            observed_value="ready",
            expected_value="ready",
            checked_at=now,
        ),
        DiagnosticCheck(
            name="telemetry-pipeline",
            category="telemetry",
            status="healthy",
            healthy=True,
            message="Telemetry pipeline operational.",
            observed_value="ready",
            expected_value="ready",
            checked_at=now,
        ),
        DiagnosticCheck(
            name="review-queue",
            category="review",
            status="healthy",
            healthy=True,
            message="Review queue available.",
            observed_value="ready",
            expected_value="ready",
            checked_at=now,
        ),
        DiagnosticCheck(
            name="database-connection",
            category="persistence",
            status="healthy",
            healthy=True,
            message="Database connection verified.",
            observed_value="ready",
            expected_value="ready",
            checked_at=now,
        ),
    )


def default_system_diagnostics() -> SystemDiagnostics:
    now = _utc_now()
    return SystemDiagnostics(checks=_default_checks(now), checked_at=now)


def build_system_diagnostics(
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    *,
    baseline: SystemDiagnostics | None = None,
) -> SystemDiagnostics:
    source = data or {}
    current = baseline or default_system_diagnostics()
    checked_at = _coerce_datetime(source.get("checked_at"), _utc_now()) or _utc_now()

    raw_checks = source.get("checks")
    checks: tuple[DiagnosticCheck, ...]
    if isinstance(raw_checks, list):
        normalized = tuple(check for item in raw_checks if (check := _normalize_check(item)) is not None)
        checks = normalized or current.checks
    else:
        checks = current.checks

    policy_bundle_loaded = _coerce_bool(source.get("policy_bundle_loaded"), current.policy_bundle_loaded)
    sandbox_ready = _coerce_bool(source.get("sandbox_ready"), current.sandbox_ready)
    telemetry_ready = _coerce_bool(source.get("telemetry_ready"), current.telemetry_ready)
    review_queue_ready = _coerce_bool(source.get("review_queue_ready"), current.review_queue_ready)
    database_ready = _coerce_bool(source.get("database_ready"), current.database_ready)

    warnings = tuple(
        _coerce_str(item)
        for item in (source.get("warnings") if isinstance(source.get("warnings"), list) else list(current.warnings))
        if _coerce_str(item)
    )
    failures = tuple(
        _coerce_str(item)
        for item in (source.get("failures") if isinstance(source.get("failures"), list) else list(current.failures))
        if _coerce_str(item)
    )

    derived_healthy = all(
        (
            policy_bundle_loaded,
            sandbox_ready,
            telemetry_ready,
            review_queue_ready,
            database_ready,
            not failures,
            all(check.healthy for check in checks),
        )
    )
    derived_status = "healthy" if derived_healthy and not warnings else "degraded" if derived_healthy else "unhealthy"

    overall_status = _coerce_str(source.get("overall_status"), derived_status).lower() or derived_status
    healthy = _coerce_bool(source.get("healthy"), derived_healthy)

    return SystemDiagnostics(
        service=_coerce_str(source.get("service"), current.service) or current.service,
        environment=_coerce_str(source.get("environment"), current.environment) or current.environment,
        version=_coerce_str(source.get("version"), current.version) or current.version,
        overall_status=overall_status,
        healthy=healthy,
        cpu_percent=max(0.0, min(100.0, _coerce_float(source.get("cpu_percent"), current.cpu_percent))),
        memory_percent=max(0.0, min(100.0, _coerce_float(source.get("memory_percent"), current.memory_percent))),
        disk_percent=max(0.0, min(100.0, _coerce_float(source.get("disk_percent"), current.disk_percent))),
        latency_ms=max(0.0, _coerce_float(source.get("latency_ms"), current.latency_ms)),
        policy_bundle_loaded=policy_bundle_loaded,
        sandbox_ready=sandbox_ready,
        telemetry_ready=telemetry_ready,
        review_queue_ready=review_queue_ready,
        database_ready=database_ready,
        warnings=warnings,
        failures=failures,
        checks=checks,
        checked_at=checked_at,
    )


def diagnostics_summary(diagnostics: SystemDiagnostics) -> dict[str, Any]:
    healthy_checks = sum(1 for check in diagnostics.checks if check.healthy)
    degraded_checks = sum(1 for check in diagnostics.checks if check.status in {"warn", "warning", "degraded"})
    failed_checks = sum(1 for check in diagnostics.checks if not check.healthy)

    return {
        "service": diagnostics.service,
        "environment": diagnostics.environment,
        "version": diagnostics.version,
        "overall_status": diagnostics.overall_status,
        "healthy": diagnostics.healthy,
        "resource_usage": {
            "cpu_percent": diagnostics.cpu_percent,
            "memory_percent": diagnostics.memory_percent,
            "disk_percent": diagnostics.disk_percent,
            "latency_ms": diagnostics.latency_ms,
        },
        "dependencies": {
            "policy_bundle_loaded": diagnostics.policy_bundle_loaded,
            "sandbox_ready": diagnostics.sandbox_ready,
            "telemetry_ready": diagnostics.telemetry_ready,
            "review_queue_ready": diagnostics.review_queue_ready,
            "database_ready": diagnostics.database_ready,
        },
        "check_totals": {
            "total": len(diagnostics.checks),
            "healthy": healthy_checks,
            "degraded": degraded_checks,
            "failed": failed_checks,
        },
        "warnings": list(diagnostics.warnings),
        "failures": list(diagnostics.failures),
        "checked_at": _isoformat(diagnostics.checked_at),
    }
