from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return int(value)
    try:
        return int(str(value).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _safe_str(value: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    return str(value)


def _safe_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return dict(value)
    return {}


def _mask_secret(secret: str) -> str:
    cleaned = secret.strip()
    if not cleaned:
        return ""
    if len(cleaned) <= 8:
        return f"{cleaned[:2]}...{cleaned[-2:]}" if len(cleaned) > 4 else "****"
    return f"{cleaned[:4]}...{cleaned[-4:]}"


def _normalize_key(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    metadata = _safe_dict(record.get("metadata"))
    return {
        "key_id": _safe_str(
            record.get("key_id")
            or record.get("keyid")
            or record.get("id")
            or metadata.get("key_id")
        ),
        "display_name": _safe_str(
            record.get("display_name")
            or record.get("displayname")
            or record.get("name")
            or metadata.get("display_name")
            or metadata.get("name")
            or "Unnamed key"
        ),
        "masked_key": _safe_str(
            record.get("masked_key")
            or record.get("maskedkey")
            or record.get("key_preview")
            or record.get("preview")
            or record.get("last4")
        ),
        "created_at": _safe_str(
            record.get("created_at")
            or record.get("createdat")
            or record.get("created")
            or record.get("timestamp")
        ),
        "last_used_at": (
            _safe_str(
                record.get("last_used_at")
                or record.get("lastusedat")
                or record.get("last_used")
                or record.get("last_seen_at")
            )
            or None
        ),
        "active": bool(record.get("active", True)),
        "metadata": metadata,
    }


def _build_empty_state(now_iso: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "ironclaw-ui",
        "timestamp": now_iso,
        "page": {
            "id": "customer-keys",
            "title": "Customer Keys",
            "description": "Manage customer API keys for protected IronClaw access.",
            "path": "/ui/customer-keys",
            "section": "access",
        },
        "summary": {
            "total_keys": 0,
            "active_keys": 0,
            "revoked_keys": 0,
            "keys_used_7d": 0,
        },
        "filters": {
            "available_statuses": ["active", "revoked"],
            "default_status": "all",
            "selected_status": "all",
        },
        "actions": {
            "create": {
                "label": "Create key",
                "method": "POST",
                "path": "/customer-keys",
            }
        },
        "keys": [],
        "empty_state": {
            "title": "No customer keys created",
            "description": "Create a customer API key to start protected access flows.",
            "action": {
                "label": "Create first key",
                "method": "POST",
                "path": "/customer-keys",
            },
        },
    }


def build_customer_keys_view(
    customer_keys_response: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    selected_status: str = "all",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source = _safe_dict(customer_keys_response)
    now_iso = _safe_str(source.get("timestamp"))
    base = _build_empty_state(now_iso)

    raw_keys = source.get("keys")
    if not isinstance(raw_keys, list):
        return base

    normalized_keys = [
        _normalize_key(item) for item in raw_keys if isinstance(item, Mapping)
    ]

    status_filter = _safe_str(selected_status, "all").strip().lower() or "all"
    if status_filter == "active":
        filtered_keys = [item for item in normalized_keys if item["active"]]
    elif status_filter == "revoked":
        filtered_keys = [item for item in normalized_keys if not item["active"]]
    else:
        filtered_keys = normalized_keys

    active_count = sum(1 for item in normalized_keys if item["active"])
    revoked_count = max(len(normalized_keys) - active_count, 0)
    used_7d_count = sum(1 for item in normalized_keys if item["last_used_at"])

    keys = []
    for item in filtered_keys:
        metadata = item["metadata"]
        scopes = metadata.get("scopes")
        environments = metadata.get("environments")
        if not isinstance(scopes, list):
            scopes = []
        if not isinstance(environments, list):
            environments = []

        keys.append(
            {
                "key_id": item["key_id"],
                "display_name": item["display_name"],
                "masked_key": item["masked_key"] or _mask_secret(item["key_id"]),
                "created_at": item["created_at"],
                "last_used_at": item["last_used_at"],
                "active": item["active"],
                "status": "active" if item["active"] else "revoked",
                "detail_path": (
                    f"/ui/customer-keys/{item['key_id']}" if item["key_id"] else None
                ),
                "scopes": [str(scope) for scope in scopes],
                "environments": [str(environment) for environment in environments],
                "metadata": metadata,
                "actions": {
                    "view": {
                        "label": "View details",
                        "method": "GET",
                        "path": (
                            f"/ui/customer-keys/{item['key_id']}"
                            if item["key_id"]
                            else None
                        ),
                    },
                    "revoke": {
                        "label": "Revoke key",
                        "method": "POST",
                        "path": (
                            f"/customer-keys/{item['key_id']}/revoke"
                            if item["key_id"] and item["active"]
                            else None
                        ),
                        "enabled": bool(item["key_id"] and item["active"]),
                    },
                },
            }
        )

    base["timestamp"] = now_iso or base["timestamp"]
    base["service"] = _safe_str(source.get("service"), "ironclaw-ui")
    base["summary"] = {
        "total_keys": _safe_int(source.get("total_keys"), len(normalized_keys)),
        "active_keys": active_count,
        "revoked_keys": revoked_count,
        "keys_used_7d": used_7d_count,
    }
    base["filters"]["selected_status"] = status_filter
    base["keys"] = keys
    base["empty_state"] = (
        {
            "title": "No matching keys",
            "description": "No customer keys match the selected filter.",
            "action": {
                "label": "Clear filter",
                "method": "GET",
                "path": "/ui/customer-keys",
            },
        }
        if not keys and normalized_keys
        else base["empty_state"]
    )
    return base

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _datetime_to_iso(value: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    timestamp: str
    summary: CustomerKeySummaryView
    keys: list[CustomerKeyItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    actions: list[CustomerKeyActionView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_customer_keys() -> list[CustomerKeyItemView]:
    registry = get_api_key_registry()
    records = list(registry.list_keys().values())

    if not records:
        return [
            CustomerKeyItemView(
                key_id="ck_demo_primary",
                label="Primary Production Key",
                status="active",
                owner_type="customer",
                owner_id="default-customer",
                created_at=_utc_now_iso(),
                last_used_at=None,
                scopes=["scan:write", "history:read", "billing:read"],
                metadata={
                    "masked_key": "icg1_demâ€¦mary",
                    "environment": "production",
                    "rotation_due": False,
                    "source": "demo-fallback",
                },
            ),
            CustomerKeyItemView(
                key_id="ck_demo_staging",
                label="Staging Validation Key",
                status="active",
                owner_type="customer",
                owner_id="default-customer",
                created_at=_utc_now_iso(),
                last_used_at=None,
                scopes=["scan:write", "history:read"],
                metadata={
                    "masked_key": "icg1_demâ€¦ging",
                    "environment": "staging",
                    "rotation_due": True,
                    "source": "demo-fallback",
                },
            ),
            CustomerKeyItemView(
                key_id="ck_demo_old",
                label="Legacy Revoked Key",
                status="revoked",
                owner_type="customer",
                owner_id="default-customer",
                created_at=_utc_now_iso(),
                last_used_at=None,
                scopes=["scan:write"],
                metadata={
                    "masked_key": "icg1_demâ€¦gacy",
                    "environment": "production",
                    "rotation_due": False,
                    "source": "demo-fallback",
                },
            ),
        ]

    views: list[CustomerKeyItemView] = []
    for record in records:
        owner_type = str(record.metadata.get("owner_type", "customer"))
        owner_id = str(record.metadata.get("owner_id", "default-customer"))
        scopes_value = record.metadata.get("scopes", [])
        scopes = [str(scope) for scope in scopes_value] if isinstance(scopes_value, list) else []

        raw_key = record.raw_key or ""
        masked_key = mask_api_key(raw_key) if raw_key else "hidden"

        metadata = {
            "masked_key": masked_key,
            "environment": record.metadata.get("environment", "unknown"),
            "rotation_due": bool(record.metadata.get("rotation_due", False)),
            "source": "registry",
        }

        for key, value in record.metadata.items():
            if key not in {"owner_type", "owner_id", "scopes", "environment", "rotation_due"}:
                metadata[key] = value

        views.append(
            CustomerKeyItemView(
                key_id=record.key_id,
                label=record.display_name,
                status="active" if record.active else "revoked",
                owner_type=owner_type,
                owner_id=owner_id,
                created_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.created_at) or _utc_now_iso(),
                last_used_at=_datetime_to_iso(record.last_used_at),
                scopes=scopes,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )

    views.sort(key=lambda item: item.created_at, reverse=True)
    return views


def _build_summary(keys: list[CustomerKeyItemView]) -> CustomerKeySummaryView:
    active_keys = sum(1 for key in keys if key.status == "active")
    revoked_keys = sum(1 for key in keys if key.status == "revoked")
    stale_keys = sum(1 for key in keys if key.last_used_at is None)
    latest_created_at = max((key.created_at for key in keys), default=None)

    return CustomerKeySummaryView(
        total_keys=len(keys),
        active_keys=active_keys,
        revoked_keys=revoked_keys,
        stale_keys=stale_keys,
        rotation_recommended=any(bool(key.metadata.get("rotation_due")) for key in keys),
        latest_created_at=latest_created_at,
    )


def _build_actions() -> list[CustomerKeyActionView]:
    return [
        CustomerKeyActionView(
            action_id="list-customer-keys",
            label="List customer keys",
            method="GET",
            path="/customer-keys",
            description="Returns the currently registered customer API keys.",
        ),
        CustomerKeyActionView(
            action_id="create-customer-key",
            label="Create customer key",
            method="POST",
            path="/customer-keys",
            description="Creates a new customer API key for a tenant or operator workflow.",
        ),
        CustomerKeyActionView(
            action_id="rotate-customer-key",
            label="Rotate customer key",
            method="POST",
            path="/customer-keys/{key_id}/rotate",
            description="Rotates an existing customer API key and returns a new secret once.",
        ),
        CustomerKeyActionView(
            action_id="revoke-customer-key",
            label="Revoke customer key",
            method="POST",
            path="/customer-keys/{key_id}/revoke",
            description="Revokes an existing customer API key and prevents future use.",
        ),
    ]


@router.get("", response_model=CustomerKeysResponse)

            "Rotation recommendations help identify keys that should be replaced proactively.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.ui.router import get_ui_routers


router = APIRouter(prefix="/groq-registry", tags=["groq-registry"])


class GroqRegistryEntry(BaseModel):
    name: str
    prefix: str
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    enabled: bool = True
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class GroqRegistryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    provider: str
    timestamp: str
    total_routes: int
    routes: list[GroqRegistryEntry] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _route_name_from_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    cleaned = prefix.strip("/")
    if not cleaned:
        return "root"
    return cleaned.replace("/", "-")


@router.get("", response_model=GroqRegistryResponse)
def read_groq_registry() -> GroqRegistryResponse:
    ui_routers = get_ui_routers()

    routes = [
        GroqRegistryEntry(
            name=_route_name_from_prefix(str(ui_router.prefix or "")),
            prefix=str(ui_router.prefix or ""),
            tags=[str(tag) for tag in (ui_router.tags or [])],
            enabled=True,
            metadata={
                "source": "app.ui.router",
            },
        )
        for ui_router in ui_routers
    ]

    routes = sorted(routes, key=lambda route: route.prefix)

    return GroqRegistryResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        provider="groq",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        total_routes=len(routes),
        routes=routes,
        metadata={
            "ui_router_registry": "app.ui.router",
            "sorted_by": "prefix",
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.services.integrationregistry import IntegrationRegistryService
from app.services.integrationtelemetry import IntegrationTelemetryService
from app.models.integrations import (
    IntegrationRecord,
    IntegrationStatus,
    IntegrationCapability,
)


class IntegrationsOverviewIntegrationItem(BaseModel):
    """
    Compact integration row for the UI overview.

    This intentionally mirrors the shapes already exposed in the public
    IntegrationRecordResponse / IntegrationSettingsItem schemas but keeps
    only the fields needed for a single overview page so we do not
    accidentally leak internal metadata.
    """

    integration_id: str = Field(..., alias="integrationid")
    slug: str
    display_name: str = Field(..., alias="displayname")
    platform: str
    status: str
    configurable: bool = False
    verified: bool = False
    configuration_state: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, alias="configurationstate")
    settings_route: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, alias="settingsroute")
    manifest_route: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, alias="manifestroute")
    tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    capabilities: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    risk_score: Optional[int] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional normalized risk or posture score (0â€“100) from telemetry.",
    )

    class Config:
        allow_population_by_field_name = True


class IntegrationsOverviewSummary(BaseModel):
    """
    High-level summary metrics for the integrations overview page.

    This is a thin wrapper around the IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse
    and the IntegrationSettingsSummary shapes already exposed via the API.
    """

    total_integrations: int = Field(..., alias="totalintegrations")
    configurable_integrations: int = Field(..., alias="configurableintegrations")
    verified_integrations: int = Field(..., alias="verifiedintegrations")
    pending_integrations: int = Field(..., alias="pendingintegrations")
    platforms: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    capabilities: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    class Config:
        allow_population_by_field_name = True


class IntegrationsOverviewPage(BaseModel):
    """
    View model for the /ui/integrations overview page.

    This is what the ui router will serialize for the UI manifest and
    for any dedicated integrations overview endpoint.
    """

    generated_at: datetime = Field(..., alias="generatedat")
    summary: IntegrationsOverviewSummary
    integrations: List[IntegrationsOverviewIntegrationItem]

    class Config:
        allow_population_by_field_name = True


def _map_integration_record_to_item(
    record: IntegrationRecord,
    risk_score: Optional[int] = None,
) -> IntegrationsOverviewIntegrationItem:
    """
    Map a core IntegrationRecord domain object into the compact
    overview item model used by the UI layer.

    We intentionally normalize enums to their value strings so the UI
    doesnâ€™t need to know about Python enum types.
    """

    status_value = (
        record.status.value
        if isinstance(record.status, IntegrationStatus)
        else str(record.status)
    )

    capabilities: List[str] = []
    if getattr(record, "capabilities", None):
        for cap in record.capabilities:
            if isinstance(cap, IntegrationCapability):
                capabilities.append(cap.value)
            else:
                capabilities.append(str(cap))

    return IntegrationsOverviewIntegrationItem(
        integrationid=record.integration_id,
        slug=record.slug,
        displayname=record.display_name,
        platform=record.platform,
        status=status_value,
        configurable=getattr(record, "configurable", False),
        verified=getattr(record, "verified", False),
        configurationstate=getattr(record, "configuration_state", None),
        settingsroute=getattr(record, "settings_route", None),
        manifestroute=getattr(record, "manifest_route", None),
        tags=list(getattr(record, "tags", []) or []),
        capabilities=capabilities,
        risk_score=risk_score,
    )


def get_page() -> IntegrationsOverviewPage:
    """
    Build the integrations overview UI page model.

    This function is intentionally side-effect free and uses the existing
    integration registry + telemetry services to assemble a consistent view
    for operators. It is designed to be safe to call from tests and from
    the ui router bootstrap.
    """

    registry = IntegrationRegistryService()
    telemetry = IntegrationTelemetryService()

    # Fetch the full registry plus summary so we can hydrate both the
    # top-level summary block and the integration list.
    registry_snapshot = registry.get_registry_snapshot()
    # registry_snapshot is expected to expose:
    #   - items: List[IntegrationRecord]
    #   - summary: object with totalintegrations, configurableintegrations,
    #              verifiedintegrations, pendingintegrations, platforms, capabilities
    # which mirrors IntegrationRegistrySummaryResponse / IntegrationSettingsSummary
    # as declared in the OpenAPI components.[file:2]

    # Build summary view, tolerating missing attributes to avoid brittle failures.
    summary = IntegrationsOverviewSummary(
        totalintegrations=getattr(
            registry_snapshot.summary, "totalintegrations", len(registry_snapshot.items)
        ),
        configurableintegrations=getattr(
            registry_snapshot.summary, "configurableintegrations", 0
        ),
        verifiedintegrations=getattr(
            registry_snapshot.summary, "verifiedintegrations", 0
        ),
        pendingintegrations=getattr(
            registry_snapshot.summary, "pendingintegrations", 0
        ),
        platforms=list(getattr(registry_snapshot.summary, "platforms", []) or []),
        capabilities=list(getattr(registry_snapshot.summary, "capabilities", []) or []),
    )

    # Optionally hydrate per-integration risk or posture scores from telemetry.
    risk_index = telemetry.get_integration_risk_index()
    # risk_index is expected to be a mapping of integration_id -> int score (0â€“100),
    # but we treat it as a generic mapping to keep the page robust.

    items: List[IntegrationsOverviewIntegrationItem] = []
    for record in registry_snapshot.items:
        risk_score = None
        if risk_index and getattr(record, "integration_id", None):
            risk_score = risk_index.get(record.integration_id)
        items.append(_map_integration_record_to_item(record, risk_score=risk_score))

    return IntegrationsOverviewPage(
        generatedat=datetime.utcnow(),
        summary=summary,
        integrations=items,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry


def _generated_at() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def build_ui_integration_settings_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    records = registry.list_integrations()

    settings: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    configurable_count = 0
    verified_count = 0

    for record in records:
        configurable = bool(record.settingsroute)
        verified = bool(record.verified)

        if configurable:
            configurable_count += 1
        if verified:
            verified_count += 1

        settings.append(
            {
                "integrationid": record.integrationid,
                "displayname": record.displayname,
                "platform": record.platform,
                "status": record.status,
                "verified": verified,
                "verifiedat": record.verifiedat,
                "settingsroute": record.settingsroute,
                "verificationroute": record.verificationroute,
                "manifestroute": record.manifestroute,
                "adaptermodule": record.adaptermodule,
                "configurable": configurable,
                "configurationstate": (
                    "configured"
                    if verified
                    else "pending"
                    if configurable
                    else "unavailable"
                ),
                "tags": list(record.tags),
                "metadata": dict(record.metadata),
            }
        )

    return {
        "pageid": "ui-integrations-settings",
        "title": "Integration Settings",
        "section": "platform",
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "IronClaw-Security",
        "generatedat": _generated_at(),
        "summary": {
            "totalintegrations": len(settings),
            "configurableintegrations": configurable_count,
            "verifiedintegrations": verified_count,
            "pendingintegrations": len(settings) - verified_count,
        },
        "actions": {
            "integrationsroute": "/ui/integrations",
            "catalogroute": "/integrations/installers",
            "verificationroute": "/integrations/verifiers",
        },
        "settings": settings,
    }


def get_ui_integration_settings_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    return build_ui_integration_settings_page()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from app.schemas.telemetry import TelemetryEventSummary
from app.services.securityorchestrator import SecurityOrchestrator, initializesecurityorchestrator


@dataclass(slots=True)
class MetricsSummaryViewModel:
    total_events: int
    allow_count: int
    review_count: int
    blocked_count: int
    quarantine_count: int
    latest_event_at: str | None
    telemetry_path: str

    @classmethod
    def from_summary(cls, summary: dict[str, Any]) -> "MetricsSummaryViewModel":
        return cls(
            total_events=int(summary.get("eventcount", 0)),
            allow_count=int(summary.get("allowcount", 0)),
            review_count=int(summary.get("reviewcount", 0)),
            blocked_count=int(summary.get("blockedcount", 0)),
            quarantine_count=int(summary.get("quarantinecount", 0)),
            latest_event_at=summary.get("latesteventat"),
            telemetry_path=str(summary.get("telemetrypath", "")),
        )


def get_metrics_summary_viewmodel(
    *,
    orchestrator: SecurityOrchestrator | None = None,
    limit: int = 250,
) -> MetricsSummaryViewModel:
    runtime_orchestrator = orchestrator or initializesecurityorchestrator()
    summary = runtime_orchestrator.replay_summary(limit=limit)
    return MetricsSummaryViewModel.from_summary(summary)


def get_recent_runtime_events(
    *,
    orchestrator: SecurityOrchestrator | None = None,
    limit: int = 50,
) -> list[TelemetryEventSummary]:
    runtime_orchestrator = orchestrator or initializesecurityorchestrator()
    events = list(runtime_orchestrator.iter_events(limit=limit))

    results: list[TelemetryEventSummary] = []
    for event in events:
        results.append(
            TelemetryEventSummary(
                event_id=event.eventid,
                occurred_at=event.occurredat,
                actor_id=event.actorid,
                session_id=event.sessionid,
                action_type=event.actiontype,
                target=event.target,
                execution_state=event.executionstate,
                policy_verdict=event.policyverdict,
                response_action=event.responseaction,
                adjusted_risk_score=event.adjustedriskscore,
                review_required=event.reviewrequired,
                quarantine=event.quarantine,
            )
        )

    return results

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.services.organization_store import OrganizationStore

router = APIRouter(tags=["ui-organizations"])


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _coerce_member_count(record: dict[str, Any]) -> int:
    members = record.get("members")
    if isinstance(members, list):
        return len(members)

    member_count = record.get("member_count")
    if isinstance(member_count, int):
        return max(member_count, 0)

    return 0


def _coerce_created_at(record: dict[str, Any], fallback: str) -> str:
    value = record.get("created_at") or record.get("createdAt") or fallback
    return value if isinstance(value, str) and value else fallback


def _coerce_metadata(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    metadata = record.get("metadata")
    return metadata if isinstance(metadata, dict) else {}


def _organization_item(record: dict[str, Any], fallback_timestamp: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    org_id = str(record.get("organization_id") or record.get("id") or "").strip()
    name = str(record.get("name") or org_id or "Unknown organization").strip()
    slug = str(record.get("slug") or "").strip()
    status = str(record.get("status") or "active").strip() or "active"
    created_at = _coerce_created_at(record, fallback_timestamp)
    member_count = _coerce_member_count(record)
    metadata = _coerce_metadata(record)
    owner_email = str(
        record.get("owner_email")
        or metadata.get("owner_email")
        or metadata.get("ownerEmail")
        or ""
    ).strip()

    return {
        "organization_id": org_id,
        "name": name,
        "slug": slug,
        "status": status,
        "owner_email": owner_email,
        "member_count": member_count,
        "created_at": created_at,
        "detail_route": f"/organizations/{org_id}" if org_id else "/organizations",
        "members_route": f"/organizations/{org_id}/members" if org_id else "/organizations",
        "metadata": metadata,
    }


def _empty_response(timestamp: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "summary": {
            "total": 0,
            "active": 0,
            "suspended": 0,
            "member_total": 0,
        },
        "items": [],
        "actions": {
            "list_route": "/organizations",
            "create_route": "/organizations",
        },
    }


@router.get("/ui/organizations")
def get_ui_organizations() -> dict[str, Any]:
    timestamp = _utcnow_iso()

    try:
        records = OrganizationStore().list_organizations()
    except Exception:
        records = []

    if not isinstance(records, list):
        records = []

    items = [
        _organization_item(record, timestamp)
        for record in records
        if isinstance(record, dict)
    ]

    if not items:
        return _empty_response(timestamp)

    status_counts = Counter(item["status"] for item in items)
    member_total = sum(item["member_count"] for item in items)

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "ironclaw-security",
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "summary": {
            "total": len(items),
            "active": status_counts.get("active", 0),
            "suspended": status_counts.get("suspended", 0),
            "member_total": member_total,
        },
        "items": sorted(items, key=lambda item: (item["name"].lower(), item["organization_id"])),
        "actions": {
            "list_route": "/organizations",
            "create_route": "/organizations",
        },
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from app.review.reviewqueueservice import ReviewQueueItem, ReviewStatus
from app.routes.reviewqueue import get_review_queue_service


router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ui/reviews", tags=["ui-review-detail"])


class ReviewDetailField(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    value: str | None = None


class ReviewEvidenceItem(BaseModel):
    index: int
    data: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ReviewDetailAction(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    method: str = "POST"
    api_path: str
    body: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    style: str = "default"


class ReviewDetailResponse(BaseModel):
    review_id: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    status: str
    priority: str
    source: str
    source_id: str
    assigned_to: str | None = None
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    completed_at: str | None = None
    fields: list[ReviewDetailField] = Field(default_factory=list)
    reasons: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[ReviewEvidenceItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    actions: list[ReviewDetailAction] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_actions(item: ReviewQueueItem) -> list[ReviewDetailAction]:
    actions: list[ReviewDetailAction] = []

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.PENDING:
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="assign",
                label="Assign to analyst",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/assign",
                body={"reviewer_id": "analyst-1"},
                style="primary",
            )
        )

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="complete",
                label="Complete review",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/complete",
                body={},
                style="success",
            )
        )
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="dismiss",
                label="Dismiss review",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/dismiss",
                body={"reason": "dismissed-by-analyst"},
                style="danger",
            )
        )

    if item.status in {ReviewStatus.COMPLETED, ReviewStatus.DISMISSED}:
        actions.append(
            ReviewDetailAction(
                key="reopen",
                label="Reopen review",
                api_path=f"/api/review-queue/{item.review_id}/reopen",
                body={},
                style="default",
            )
        )

    return actions


def _build_fields(item: ReviewQueueItem) -> list[ReviewDetailField]:
    return [
        ReviewDetailField(key="review_id", label="Review ID", value=item.review_id),
        ReviewDetailField(key="source", label="Source", value=item.source.value),
        ReviewDetailField(key="source_id", label="Source ID", value=item.source_id),
        ReviewDetailField(key="priority", label="Priority", value=item.priority.value),
        ReviewDetailField(key="status", label="Status", value=item.status.value),
        ReviewDetailField(key="assigned_to", label="Assigned To", value=item.assigned_to),
        ReviewDetailField(key="created_at", label="Created At", value=item.created_at),
        ReviewDetailField(key="updated_at", label="Updated At", value=item.updated_at),
        ReviewDetailField(key="completed_at", label="Completed At", value=item.completed_at),
    ]


@router.get("/{review_id}", response_model=ReviewDetailResponse, summary="Get review detail")
def get_review_detail(review_id: str) -> ReviewDetailResponse:
    normalized_review_id = review_id.strip()
    if not normalized_review_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="review item not found")

    service = get_review_queue_service()
    item = service.get(normalized_review_id)

    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"review item not found: {normalized_review_id}")

    return ReviewDetailResponse(
        review_id=item.review_id,
        title=item.title,
        summary=item.summary,
        status=item.status.value,
        priority=item.priority.value,
        source=item.source.value,
        source_id=item.source_id,
        assigned_to=item.assigned_to,
        created_at=item.created_at,
        updated_at=item.updated_at,
        completed_at=item.completed_at,
        fields=_build_fields(item),
        reasons=list(item.reasons),
        evidence=[
            ReviewEvidenceItem(index=index + 1, data=dict(evidence))
            for index, evidence in enumerate(item.evidence)
        ],
        actions=_build_actions(item),
    )

    total_items: int


def _labelize(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("_", " ").title()


def _parse_review_status(value: str | None) -> ReviewStatus | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = value.strip().lower()
    if not normalized:
        return None
    try:
        return ReviewStatus(normalized)
    except ValueError as exc:
        allowed = ", ".join(status.value for status in ReviewStatus)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Invalid status '{value}'. Expected one of: {allowed}.",
        ) from exc


def _build_row(item: ReviewQueueItem) -> ReviewQueueRow:
    detail_href = f"/reviews/{item.review_id}"
    actions: list[ReviewQueueRowAction] = [
        ReviewQueueRowAction(
            key="open",
            label="Open review",
            method="GET",
            href=detail_href,
            style="primary",
        )
    ]

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.PENDING:
        actions.append(
            ReviewQueueRowAction(
                key="claim",
                label="Claim",
                method="POST",
                api_path="/api/review-queue/claim-next",
                body={"reviewer_id": "analyst-1"},
                style="default",
            )
        )

    if item.status == ReviewStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
        actions.append(
            ReviewQueueRowAction(
                key="complete",
                label="Complete",
                method="POST",

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable
from importlib import import_module
from typing import Any, Final, cast

from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI


def _optional_router(module_path: str) -> APIRouter | None:
    try:
        module = import_module(module_path)
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        if exc.name != module_path:
            raise
        return None

    router = getattr(module, "router", None)
    if router is None:
        return None
    return cast(APIRouter, router)


router = APIRouter(tags=["ui"])


UI_ROUTERS: Final[tuple[APIRouter | None, ...]] = (
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.dashboard"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.detail"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.reviews.queue"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.reviews.detail"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.insights.policy"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.activity.clientsession"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.activity.clientprofile"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.activity.sessiontimeline"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.explorer"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.settings.configuration"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.runtime.status"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.audit.log"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.executions.testconsole"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.alerts.notifications"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.system.diagnostics"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.integrations.settings"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.data.retention"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.incidents.triage"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.admin.operators"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.admin.roles"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.groq"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_manifest"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_registry"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_index"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_summary"),
    _optional_router("app.ui.billing_packages"),
)


def get_ui_routers() -> tuple[APIRouter, ...]:
    return tuple(ui_router for ui_router in UI_ROUTERS if ui_router is not None)


def iter_ui_routers() -> Iterable[APIRouter]:
    return iter(get_ui_routers())


def _router_label(ui_router: APIRouter) -> str:
    prefix = str(getattr(ui_router, "prefix", "") or "<no-prefix>")
    route_count = len(getattr(ui_router, "routes", ()))
    return f"{prefix} ({route_count} routes)"


def _route_signature(route: object) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str]:
    path = str(getattr(route, "path", ""))
    methods = tuple(sorted(cast(set[str], getattr(route, "methods", set()) or set())))
    name = str(getattr(route, "name", ""))
    return (path, methods, name)


def validate_ui_routers() -> None:
    seen_router_objects: set[int] = set()
    seen_route_signatures: dict[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...], str], str] = {}

    for ui_router in get_ui_routers():
        router_id = id(ui_router)
        label = _router_label(ui_router)

        if router_id in seen_router_objects:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate UI router object registration detected: {label}")
        seen_router_objects.add(router_id)

        if not ui_router.routes:
            raise ValueError(f"UI router has no routes: {label}")

        for route in ui_router.routes:
            signature = _route_signature(route)
            path, methods, _ = signature

            if not path:
                raise ValueError(f"UI router contains a route with an empty path: {label}")

            if signature in seen_route_signatures:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"duplicate UI route registration detected: {path} {methods} "
                    f"already registered under {seen_route_signatures[signature]}"
                )

            seen_route_signatures[signature] = label


def include_ui_routers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    validate_ui_routers()

    existing_route_signatures = {
        _route_signature(route)
        for route in app.routes
        if getattr(route, "path", "")
    }

    for ui_router in get_ui_routers():
        router_signatures = {
            _route_signature(route)
            for route in ui_router.routes
            if getattr(route, "path", "")
        }

        if router_signatures and router_signatures.issubset(existing_route_signatures):
            continue

        app.include_router(ui_router)
        existing_route_signatures.update(router_signatures)


def includeuirouters(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    include_ui_routers(app)

def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def _lookup(items: list[dict[str, Any]], label: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    for item in items:
        if item.get("label") == label:
            return item.get("value", default)
    return default


def _to_bool(value: Any, *, true_values: set[str] | None = None) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        allowed = true_values or {"true", "active", "available", "enabled", "yes"}
        return normalized in allowed
    return bool(value)


def _to_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default

def _normalize_session_id(session_id: str) -> str:
    return session_id.strip()


def _normalize_client_id(client_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if client_id is None:
        return None
    normalized = client_id.strip()
    return normalized or None


def _risk_level_from_score(score: int) -> str:
    if score >= 90:
        return "critical"
    if score >= 75:
        return "high"
    if score >= 50:
        return "medium"
    return "low"


def _tone_for_level(level: str) -> str:
    return {
        "critical": "danger",
        "high": "danger",
        "medium": "warning",
        "low": "success",
    }.get(level, "neutral")


def _build_summary_cards(
    highest_risk_score: int,
    total_events: int,
    pending_reviews: int,
    risk_level: str,
) -> list[SessionRiskSummaryCard]:
    return [
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="risk_level",
            label="Overall Risk",
            value=risk_level.replace("_", " ").title(),
            tone=_tone_for_level(risk_level),
        ),
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="highest_risk",
            label="Highest Risk Score",
            value=str(highest_risk_score),
            tone=_tone_for_level(_risk_level_from_score(highest_risk_score)),
        ),
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="pending_reviews",
            label="Pending Reviews",
            value=str(pending_reviews),
            tone="warning" if pending_reviews > 0 else "success",
        ),
        SessionRiskSummaryCard(
            key="total_events",
            label="Tracked Events",
            value=str(total_events),
            tone="neutral",
        ),
    ]

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter

router = APIRouter(tags=["system-diagnostics"])


def _iso_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def _iso_before(minutes: int) -> str:
    return (
        (datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=minutes))
        .replace(microsecond=0)
        .isoformat()
        .replace("+00:00", "Z")
    )

def _lookup(items: list[dict[str, Any]], label: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    for item in items:
        if item.get("label") == label:
            return item.get("value", default)
    return default


def _to_bool(value: Any, *, true_values: set[str] | None = None) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        allowed = true_values or {"true", "active", "available", "enabled", "ready", "required", "yes", "tracked"}
        return normalized in allowed
    return bool(value)


def _to_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def get_telemetry_access_summary_page() -> dict[str, Any]:
    page = build_telemetry_access_summary_page()
    section_map = {section.sectionid: section for section in page.sections}

    overview_items = section_map["access-overview"].items
    counts_items = section_map["access-counts"].items
    control_items = section_map["control-flags"].items
    recent_event_items = section_map["recent-events"].items

    return {
        "pageid": page.pageid,
        "title": page.title,
        "path": page.path,
        "summary": page.summary,
        "generatedat": _utc_now_iso(),
        "accessavailable": _to_bool(_lookup(overview_items, "Access Layer")),
        "auditvisibilityenabled": _to_bool(_lookup(overview_items, "Audit Visibility")),
        "recenteventsready": _to_bool(_lookup(overview_items, "Recent Events Feed")),
        "exportcontrolled": _to_bool(
            _lookup(overview_items, "Export Posture"),
            true_values={"controlled", "restricted", "limited"},
        ),
        "counts": {
            "totalevents": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Total Access Events", 0)),
            "allowedreads": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Allowed Reads", 0)),
            "flaggedreads": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Flagged Reads", 0)),
            "deniedreads": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Denied Reads", 0)),
            "sensitiveexports": _to_int(_lookup(counts_items, "Sensitive Exports", 0)),
            "latesteventat": _lookup(counts_items, "Latest Event At", "Not yet recorded"),
        },
        "controls": {
            "retentiontracked": _to_bool(
                _lookup(control_items, "Telemetry Retention"),
                true_values={"tracked", "enabled", "true", "yes"},
            ),
            "actorattributionrequired": _to_bool(
                _lookup(control_items, "Actor Attribution"),
                true_values={"required", "true", "yes"},
            ),
            "sessioncorrelationenabled": _to_bool(_lookup(control_items, "Session Correlation")),
            "requestcorrelationenabled": _to_bool(_lookup(control_items, "Request Correlation")),
            "redactionguardavailable": _to_bool(_lookup(control_items, "Redaction Guard")),
        },
        "recentevents": recent_event_items,
        "metadata": page.metadata,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/telemetry-access-summary",
    tags=["telemetry-access-summary"],
)


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class TelemetrySummaryCounterView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    value: int
    trend: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryWindowView(BaseModel):
    summary_limit: int
    events_limit: int
    time_window: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryEventView(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    occurred_at: str
    event_type: str
    actor_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    outcome: str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TelemetrySummaryLinkView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    path: str
    description: str


class TelemetryAccessSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    window: TelemetrySummaryWindowView
    counters: list[TelemetrySummaryCounterView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recent_events: list[TelemetrySummaryEventView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    links: list[TelemetrySummaryLinkView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

            events_limit=events_limit,

        recent_events=[],

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.services.integrationinstaller import get_integration_installer
from app.services.integrationregistry import get_integration_registry
from app.services.integrationverifier import get_integration_verifier


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def build_ui_integrations_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    registry = get_integration_registry()
    installer = get_integration_installer()
    verifier = get_integration_verifier()

    integrations = []
    ready_count = 0
    installed_count = 0

    for record in registry.list_integrations():
        installer_preview = installer.install_integration(
            record.integrationid,
            requestedby="ui-preview",
        )
        verifier_preview = verifier.verify_integration(
            record.integrationid,
            strict=False,
            requestedby="ui-preview",
        )

        integration_payload = {
            "integrationid": record.integrationid,
            "platform": record.platform,
            "displayname": record.displayname,
            "status": record.status,
            "installed": record.installedat is not None,
            "installedat": record.installedat,
            "verified": record.verified,
            "verifiedat": record.verifiedat,
            "settingsroute": record.settingsroute,
            "manifestroute": record.manifestroute,
            "verificationroute": record.verificationroute,
            "adaptermodule": record.adaptermodule,
            "capabilities": [asdict(capability) for capability in record.capabilities],
            "installerpreview": (
                {
                    "installed": installer_preview.installed,
                    "status": installer_preview.status,
                    "summary": installer_preview.summary,
                    "steps": [asdict(step) for step in installer_preview.steps],
                }
                if installer_preview is not None
                else None
            ),
            "verifierpreview": (
                {
                    "verified": verifier_preview.verified,
                    "status": verifier_preview.status,
                    "strict": verifier_preview.strict,
                    "summary": verifier_preview.summary,
                    "checks": [asdict(check) for check in verifier_preview.checks],
                    "missingcapabilities": list(
                        verifier_preview.missingcapabilities
                    ),
                }
                if verifier_preview is not None
                else None
            ),
            "health": "ready" if record.verified else "degraded",
        }
        integrations.append(integration_payload)

        if integration_payload["installed"]:
            installed_count += 1
        if integration_payload["health"] == "ready":
            ready_count += 1

    return {
        "pageid": "ui-integrations",
        "title": "Integrations",
        "section": "platform",
        "status": "ok",
        "service": "IronClaw-Security",
        "generatedat": _utc_now(),
        "summary": {
            "totalintegrations": len(integrations),
            "installedintegrations": installed_count,
            "readyintegrations": ready_count,
            "degradedintegrations": len(integrations) - ready_count,
        },
        "actions": {
            "catalogroute": "/integrations/installers",
            "verificationroute": "/integrations/verifiers",
            "settingsroute": "/ui/integrations/settings",
        },
        "integrations": integrations,
    }


def get_ui_integrations_page() -> dict[str, object]:
    return build_ui_integrations_page()

def _build_sections(items: list[UIPageItem]) -> list[UIPageSection]:
    category_labels: dict[str, str] = {
        "system": "System",
        "security-admin": "Security Admin",
        "integrations": "Integrations",
        "tenant": "Tenant",
        "billing": "Billing",
    }

    ordered_categories = [
        "system",
        "security-admin",
        "integrations",
        "tenant",
        "billing",
    ]

    sections: list[UIPageSection] = []
    for category in ordered_categories:
        section_items = [item for item in items if item.category == category]
        if not section_items:
            continue
        sections.append(
            UIPageSection(
                category=category,
                label=category_labels.get(category, category.title()),
                total=len(section_items),
                items=section_items,
            )
        )
    return sections


@router.get("", response_model=UIPagesResponse)
def get_ui_pages() -> UIPagesResponse:
    items = _build_ui_pages()
    sections = _build_sections(items)
    return UIPagesResponse(
        generatedat=_utc_now_iso(),
        summary=UIPageSummary(
            totalpages=len(items),
            enabledpages=sum(1 for item in items if item.enabled),
            categories=[section.category for section in sections],
        ),
        sections=sections,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "surface": "ui",
            "scope": "page-catalog",
            "generatedby": "uipages",
        },
    )

def _build_ui_routes() -> list[UIRouteRecord]:

        UIRouteRecord(
            prefix=route.prefix,
            slug=route.slug,
            label=route.label,
            category=route.category,
            enabled=route.enabled,
            metadata=route.metadata.copy(),

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Path
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(prefix="/usage-events/detail", tags=["usage-event-detail"])


def _utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


class UsageEventIdentityView(BaseModel):
    event_id: str
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    trace_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventGuardView(BaseModel):
    verdict: str
    guard_mode: str
    policy_profile: str
    blocked: bool
    truncated: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventBillingView(BaseModel):
    units_consumed: int
    unit_type: str
    package_id: str | None = None
    wallet_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventContextView(BaseModel):
    method: str
    path: str
    upstream_url: str | None = None
    ip_address: str | None = None
    user_agent: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class UsageEventLinkView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    path: str
    description: str


class UsageEventDetailResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    service: str
    timestamp: str
    identity: UsageEventIdentityView
    guard: UsageEventGuardView
    billing: UsageEventBillingView
    context: UsageEventContextView
    links: list[UsageEventLinkView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _build_links(event_id: str, session_id: str | None, client_id: str | None) -> list[UsageEventLinkView]:
    links: list[UsageEventLinkView] = [
        UsageEventLinkView(
            label="Usage reports",
            path="/ui/usage-reports",
            description="Return to aggregated usage summaries and recent events.",
        ),
        UsageEventLinkView(
            label="Audit log",
            path="/ui/audit-log",
            description="Inspect the full audit trail for related decisions.",
        ),
    ]

    if session_id:
        links.append(
            UsageEventLinkView(
                label="Session timeline",
                path=f"/ui/activity/sessiontimeline/{session_id}",
                description="Timeline view for all activity in this session.",
            )
        )

    if client_id:
        links.append(
            UsageEventLinkView(
                label="Client profile",
                path=f"/ui/activity/clientprofile/{client_id}",
                description="Profile view for the client associated with this usage.",
            )
        )

    return links


@router.get("/{event_id}", response_model=UsageEventDetailResponse)
def get_usage_event_detail(
    event_id: str = Path(..., min_length=1, max_length=255),
) -> UsageEventDetailResponse:
    normalized_event_id = event_id.strip()

    # Gen1 UI returns a safe, self-describing default detail view.
    client_id = "default-client"
    session_id = "default-session"

    identity = UsageEventIdentityView(
        event_id=normalized_event_id,
        client_id=client_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        actor_id=None,
        request_id=None,
        trace_id=None,
        metadata={
            "identity_state": "unbound",
            "description": "Usage event identity is currently represented with a default context.",
        },
    )

    guard = UsageEventGuardView(
        verdict="allow",
        guard_mode="assist",
        policy_profile="default-usage-event",
        blocked=False,
        truncated=False,
        metadata={
            "policy_source": "usage-event-detail-ui",
            "supports_prompt_guard": True,
            "supports_action_guard": True,
        },
    )

    billing = UsageEventBillingView(
        units_consumed=0,
        unit_type="unit",
        package_id=None,
        wallet_id=None,
        metadata={
            "billing_state": "not-charged",
            "description": "No units were consumed in this default usage event view.",
        },
    )

    context = UsageEventContextView(
        method="POST",
        path="/scan",
        upstream_url=None,
        ip_address=None,
        user_agent=None,
        metadata={
            "ui_surface": "usage-event-detail",
            "environment": "local",
        },
    )

    return UsageEventDetailResponse(
        status="ok",
        service="IronClaw-Security",
        timestamp=_utc_now_iso(),
        identity=identity,
        guard=guard,
        billing=billing,
        context=context,
        links=_build_links(normalized_event_id, session_id=session_id, client_id=client_id),
        notes=[
            "Usage event detail provides a focused view of a single metered security event.",
            "Gen1 UI returns a safe default representation until the usage-reports backend is wired in.",
            "Downstream iterations can hydrate this view with real usage, billing, and guard metadata.",
        ],
    )

            unique_clients=0,
            unique_sessions=0,

                "period": period,
                "sampled": True,

    return UI_ROUTERS


def iter_ui_routers() -> Iterable[APIRouter]:
    return iter(UI_ROUTERS)


def include_ui_routers(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    for ui_router in iter_ui_routers():
        app.include_router(ui_router)


def includeuirouters(app: FastAPI) -> None:
    include_ui_routers(app)

def ui_router_status() -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "total_routers": len(UI_ROUTERS),
        "routers": [
            {
                "prefix": ui_router.prefix,
                "tags": list(ui_router.tags or []),
            }
            for ui_router in UI_ROUTERS
        ],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/activity",
    tags=["client-session-activity"],
)


class ActivityExecutionItem(BaseModel):
    executionid: str
    timestamp: str
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    riskscore: int
    executionstate: str
    responsestatus: str
    policyverdict: str
    reviewitemid: Optional[str] = None


class ClientActivitySummary(BaseModel):
    clientid: str
    totalexecutions: int
    average_riskscore: float
    highest_riskscore: int
    pendingreviews: int
    verdictcounts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    recentexecutions: list[ActivityExecutionItem] = Field(default_factory=list)


class SessionActivitySummary(BaseModel):
    sessionid: str
    clientid: Optional[str] = None
    totalexecutions: int
    average_riskscore: float
    highest_riskscore: int
    pendingreviews: int
    verdictcounts: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    recentexecutions: list[ActivityExecutionItem] = Field(default_factory=list)


class ClientSessionActivityResponse(BaseModel):
    generatedat: str
    clients: list[ClientActivitySummary] = Field(default_factory=list)
    sessions: list[SessionActivitySummary] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _safe_str(value: Any, default: str) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default

def _to_execution_item(record: dict[str, Any]) -> ActivityExecutionItem:
    return ActivityExecutionItem(
        executionid=_safe_str(record.get("executionid"), "unknown-execution"),
        timestamp=_safe_str(record.get("timestamp"), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        actiontype=_safe_str(record.get("actiontype"), "unknown"),
        target=_safe_str(record.get("target"), "unknown"),
        riskscore=_safe_int(record.get("riskscore"), 0),
        executionstate=_safe_str(record.get("executionstate"), "unknown"),
        responsestatus=_safe_str(record.get("responsestatus"), "completed"),
        policyverdict=_safe_str(record.get("policyverdict"), "allow"),
        reviewitemid=record.get("reviewitemid"),
    )


def _recent_items(records: list[dict[str, Any]], limit: int = 5) -> list[ActivityExecutionItem]:
    sorted_records = sorted(
        records,
        key=lambda item: _safe_str(item.get("timestamp"), ""),
        reverse=True,
    )
    return [_to_execution_item(record) for record in sorted_records[:limit]]


def _verdict_counts(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, int]:
    counts = Counter(_safe_str(record.get("policyverdict"), "unknown") for record in records)
    return dict(sorted(counts.items()))


def _average_risk(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> float:
    if not records:
        return 0.0
    total = sum(_safe_int(record.get("riskscore"), 0) for record in records)
    return round(total / len(records), 2)


def _highest_risk(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
    if not records:
        return 0
    return max(_safe_int(record.get("riskscore"), 0) for record in records)


def _pending_reviews(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
    return sum(1 for record in records if record.get("reviewitemid"))


def _build_client_summaries(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[ClientActivitySummary]:
    grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for record in records:
        clientid = _safe_str(record.get("clientid"), "unknown-client")
        grouped[clientid].append(record)

    summaries: list[ClientActivitySummary] = []
    for clientid in sorted(grouped.keys()):
        group = grouped[clientid]
        summaries.append(
            ClientActivitySummary(
                clientid=clientid,
                totalexecutions=len(group),
                average_riskscore=_average_risk(group),
                highest_riskscore=_highest_risk(group),
                pendingreviews=_pending_reviews(group),
                verdictcounts=_verdict_counts(group),
                recentexecutions=_recent_items(group),
            )
        )
    return summaries


def _build_session_summaries(records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[SessionActivitySummary]:
    grouped: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for record in records:
        sessionid = _safe_str(record.get("sessionid"), "unknown-session")
        grouped[sessionid].append(record)

    summaries: list[SessionActivitySummary] = []
    for sessionid in sorted(grouped.keys()):
        group = grouped[sessionid]
        clientid = _safe_str(group[0].get("clientid"), "unknown-client") if group else None
        summaries.append(
            SessionActivitySummary(
                sessionid=sessionid,
                clientid=clientid,
                totalexecutions=len(group),
                average_riskscore=_average_risk(group),
                highest_riskscore=_highest_risk(group),
                pendingreviews=_pending_reviews(group),
                verdictcounts=_verdict_counts(group),
                recentexecutions=_recent_items(group),
            )
        )
    return summaries


@router.get("/client-session", response_model=ClientSessionActivityResponse)
def get_client_session_activity() -> ClientSessionActivityResponse:
    records = _sample_activity_records()
    return ClientSessionActivityResponse(
        generatedat=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        clients=_build_client_summaries(records),
        sessions=_build_session_summaries(records),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/audit",
    tags=["audit-explorer"],
)


class AuditKpiView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    value: int
    trendlabel: Optional[str] = None
    status: str = "neutral"


class AuditCategoryCount(BaseModel):
    category: str
    count: int


class AuditVerdictCount(BaseModel):
    verdict: str
    count: int


class AuditTimelinePoint(BaseModel):
    timestamp: str
    totalevents: int
    blockedevents: int
    reviewevents: int


class AuditEventView(BaseModel):
    auditeventid: str
    timestamp: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    actorid: Optional[str] = None
    sessionid: Optional[str] = None
    requestid: Optional[str] = None
    traceid: Optional[str] = None
    executionid: Optional[str] = None
    reviewitemid: Optional[str] = None
    incidentid: Optional[str] = None
    verdict: Optional[str] = None
    actiontype: Optional[str] = None
    target: Optional[str] = None
    summary: str
    details: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AuditFilterView(BaseModel):
    filterkey: str
    values: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AuditExplorerResponse(BaseModel):
    generatedat: str
    environment: str
    overallstatus: str
    kpis: list[AuditKpiView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    categorycounts: list[AuditCategoryCount] = Field(default_factory=list)
    verdictcounts: list[AuditVerdictCount] = Field(default_factory=list)
    timeline: list[AuditTimelinePoint] = Field(default_factory=list)
    events: list[AuditEventView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    filters: list[AuditFilterView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()

def _to_audit_event(record: dict[str, object]) -> AuditEventView:
    details = record.get("details")
    details_dict: dict[str, str] = {}
    if isinstance(details, dict):
        details_dict = {
            str(key): str(value)
            for key, value in details.items()
            if value is not None
        }

    return AuditEventView(
        auditeventid=str(record.get("auditeventid") or "unknown-audit-event"),
        timestamp=str(record.get("timestamp") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        category=str(record.get("category") or "unknown"),
        severity=str(record.get("severity") or "unknown"),
        actorid=record.get("actorid") if isinstance(record.get("actorid"), str) else None,
        sessionid=record.get("sessionid") if isinstance(record.get("sessionid"), str) else None,
        requestid=record.get("requestid") if isinstance(record.get("requestid"), str) else None,
        traceid=record.get("traceid") if isinstance(record.get("traceid"), str) else None,
        executionid=record.get("executionid") if isinstance(record.get("executionid"), str) else None,
        reviewitemid=record.get("reviewitemid") if isinstance(record.get("reviewitemid"), str) else None,
        incidentid=record.get("incidentid") if isinstance(record.get("incidentid"), str) else None,
        verdict=record.get("verdict") if isinstance(record.get("verdict"), str) else None,
        actiontype=record.get("actiontype") if isinstance(record.get("actiontype"), str) else None,
        target=record.get("target") if isinstance(record.get("target"), str) else None,
        summary=str(record.get("summary") or "No summary available."),
        details=details_dict,
        tags=[str(tag) for tag in record.get("tags", []) if isinstance(tag, str)],
    )


def _build_category_counts(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[AuditCategoryCount]:
    counts = Counter(str(record.get("category") or "unknown") for record in records)
    return [
        AuditCategoryCount(category=category, count=count)
        for category, count in sorted(counts.items())
    ]


def _build_verdict_counts(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[AuditVerdictCount]:
    counts = Counter(str(record.get("verdict") or "unknown") for record in records)
    return [
        AuditVerdictCount(verdict=verdict, count=count)
        for verdict, count in sorted(counts.items())
    ]


def _build_timeline(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[AuditTimelinePoint]:
    buckets = sorted({str(record.get("timestamp") or "")[:13] + ":00:00+00:00" for record in records})

    points: list[AuditTimelinePoint] = []
    for bucket in buckets:
        bucket_records = [
            record for record in records if str(record.get("timestamp") or "").startswith(bucket[:13])
        ]
        blocked = sum(1 for record in bucket_records if str(record.get("verdict") or "") == "block")
        review = sum(1 for record in bucket_records if str(record.get("verdict") or "") == "review")

        points.append(
            AuditTimelinePoint(
                timestamp=bucket,
                totalevents=len(bucket_records),
                blockedevents=blocked,
                reviewevents=review,
            )
        )
    return points


def _build_filters(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[AuditFilterView]:
    categories = sorted({str(record.get("category") or "unknown") for record in records})
    severities = sorted({str(record.get("severity") or "unknown") for record in records})
    verdicts = sorted({str(record.get("verdict") or "unknown") for record in records})
    actors = sorted(
        {
            str(record.get("actorid"))
            for record in records
            if isinstance(record.get("actorid"), str) and str(record.get("actorid")).strip()
        }
    )

    return [
        AuditFilterView(filterkey="category", values=categories),
        AuditFilterView(filterkey="severity", values=severities),
        AuditFilterView(filterkey="verdict", values=verdicts),
        AuditFilterView(filterkey="actorid", values=actors),
    ]


@router.get("/explorer", response_model=AuditExplorerResponse)
def get_audit_explorer() -> AuditExplorerResponse:
    audit_records = _sample_audit_events()
    events = [
        _to_audit_event(record)
        for record in sorted(
            audit_records,
            key=lambda item: str(item.get("timestamp") or ""),
            reverse=True,
        )
    ]

    totalevents = len(audit_records)
    blockevents = sum(1 for record in audit_records if str(record.get("verdict") or "") == "block")
    reviewevents = sum(1 for record in audit_records if str(record.get("verdict") or "") == "review")
    criticalevents = sum(1 for record in audit_records if str(record.get("severity") or "") == "critical")

    kpis = [
        AuditKpiView(
            label="totalevents",
            value=totalevents,
            trendlabel="Current audit event volume snapshot",
            status="healthy" if totalevents == 0 else "warning",
        ),
        AuditKpiView(
            label="blockevents",
            value=blockevents,
            trendlabel="Events that ended in hard block",
            status="critical" if blockevents > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        AuditKpiView(
            label="reviewevents",
            value=reviewevents,
            trendlabel="Events requiring analyst intervention",
            status="warning" if reviewevents > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        AuditKpiView(
            label="criticalevents",
            value=criticalevents,
            trendlabel="Highest-severity audit events observed",
            status="critical" if criticalevents > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
    ]

    overallstatus = "healthy"
    if criticalevents > 0 or blockevents > 0:
        overallstatus = "critical"
    elif reviewevents > 0:
        overallstatus = "attention"

    return AuditExplorerResponse(
        generatedat=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        environment="local",
        overallstatus=overallstatus,
        kpis=kpis,
        categorycounts=_build_category_counts(audit_records),
        verdictcounts=_build_verdict_counts(audit_records),
        timeline=_build_timeline(audit_records),
        events=events,
        filters=_build_filters(audit_records),
        notes=[
            "Audit explorer aggregates policy, review, quarantine, and analyst action traces into one searchable UI contract.",
            "All values are placeholder UI contract data for the current local-first Gen1 build.",
            "This page is ready to be wired to live guard audit endpoints, trace drilldowns, and filter-backed search services.",
        ],
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/auth",
    tags=["auth-signup"],
)


class SignupStepView(BaseModel):
    stepid: str
    title: str
    description: str
    status: str


class SignupPlanOptionView(BaseModel):
    planid: str
    name: str
    monthlypricecents: int
    highlighted: bool = False
    tagline: str
    executionlimit: int
    reviewlimit: int
    alertlimit: int


class SignupFieldView(BaseModel):
    fieldkey: str
    label: str
    inputtype: str
    required: bool = True
    placeholder: Optional[str] = None
    helptext: Optional[str] = None
    value: Optional[str] = None


class SignupChecklistItemView(BaseModel):
    itemid: str
    label: str
    completed: bool = False


class SignupSummaryView(BaseModel):
    selectedplanid: str
    organizationname: str
    workspaceurl: str
    estimatedtrialdays: int
    recommendednextaction: str


class SignupPageResponse(BaseModel):
    generatedat: str
    environment: str
    pageheadline: str
    pagesubtitle: str
    steps: list[SignupStepView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    planoptions: list[SignupPlanOptionView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    accountfields: list[SignupFieldView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    organizationfields: list[SignupFieldView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    securityfields: list[SignupFieldView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    checklist: list[SignupChecklistItemView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    summary: SignupSummaryView
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

from __future__ import annotations

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/billing",
    tags=["billing-overview"],
)


class BillingKpiView(BaseModel):
    label: str
    value: int
    trendlabel: Optional[str] = None
    status: str = "neutral"


class BillingCurrencyAmountView(BaseModel):
    currency: str
    amountcents: int
    displayamount: str


class BillingUsageBucketView(BaseModel):
    metric: str
    used: int
    included: int
    overage: int
    unit: str
    status: str


class BillingInvoiceView(BaseModel):
    invoiceid: str
    organizationid: str
    organizationname: str
    status: str
    issuedat: str
    dueat: str
    periodstart: str
    periodend: str
    subtotal: BillingCurrencyAmountView
    tax: BillingCurrencyAmountView
    total: BillingCurrencyAmountView


class BillingSubscriptionView(BaseModel):
    subscriptionid: str
    organizationid: str
    organizationname: str
    plan: str
    status: str
    billinginterval: str
    startedat: str
    renewsat: str
    monthlybaseprice: BillingCurrencyAmountView
    usage: list[BillingUsageBucketView] = Field(default_factory=list)


class BillingPlanCount(BaseModel):
    plan: str
    count: int


class BillingInvoiceStatusCount(BaseModel):
    status: str
    count: int


class BillingOverviewResponse(BaseModel):
    generatedat: str
    environment: str
    overallstatus: str
    kpis: list[BillingKpiView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    plancounts: list[BillingPlanCount] = Field(default_factory=list)
    invoicestatuscounts: list[BillingInvoiceStatusCount] = Field(default_factory=list)
    subscriptions: list[BillingSubscriptionView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    invoices: list[BillingInvoiceView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _usd(amountcents: int) -> BillingCurrencyAmountView:
    dollars = amountcents / 100
    return BillingCurrencyAmountView(
        currency="USD",
        amountcents=amountcents,
        displayamount=f"${dollars:,.2f}",
    )
