            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _infer_secret_sources(metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    sources: list[str] = []
    if metadata.get("supports_local_runtime"):
        sources.append("local_env")
    if metadata.get("transport") == "http":
        sources.append("http_headers")
    if metadata.get("supports_builder_mode"):
        sources.append("builder_config")
    if metadata.get("one_command_install"):
        sources.append("installer_config")
    return sources


def build_integration_secrets_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    redaction_config: SecretsRedactionConfig | None = None,
    requested_by: str = "ui-secrets",
) -> IntegrationSecretsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)
    active_config = redaction_config or build_default_redaction_config()
    redaction_summary = summarize_redaction_config(active_config)

    items: list[IntegrationSecretItem] = []
    with_secrets_count = 0

    for record in records:
        secret_sources = _infer_secret_sources(record.metadata)
        has_secrets = bool(secret_sources)

        if has_secrets:
            with_secrets_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationSecretItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                has_secrets=has_secrets,
                secret_sources=secret_sources,
                redaction_rules=list(active_config.rules),
                metadata={
                    "status": record.status,
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(key=lambda item: (item.platform, item.name, item.integration_id))

    return IntegrationSecretsView(
        title="Integration Secrets",
        total=len(items),
        with_secrets_count=with_secrets_count,
        items=items,
        redaction_summary=redaction_summary,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

def _health_state(*, status: str, verified: bool, configurationstate: str) -> str:
    normalized_status = status.strip().lower()
    normalized_configuration = configurationstate.strip().lower()

    if normalized_status in {"planned", "draft"}:
        return "planned"
    if normalized_status not in {"active", "enabled"}:
        return "attention"
    if verified and normalized_configuration in {"configured", "managed"}:
        return "healthy"
    if normalized_configuration in {"planned", "pending"}:
        return "pending"
    return "attention"

def _snapshot_health(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    normalized = (status or "").strip().lower()
    if fail_count > 0:
        return "failing"
    if warn_count > 0 or not verified:
        return "warning"
    if normalized == "active":
        return "healthy"
    return "inactive"


def build_integration_snapshots_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-snapshots",
) -> IntegrationSnapshotsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationSnapshotItem] = []
    healthy_snapshot_count = 0
    warning_snapshot_count = 0
    failing_snapshot_count = 0

    generated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        health = _snapshot_health(
            status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
        )

        if health == "healthy":
            healthy_snapshot_count += 1
        elif health == "warning":
            warning_snapshot_count += 1
        elif health == "failing":
            failing_snapshot_count += 1

        created_at = summary.get("checked_at") or generated_at.isoformat()

        items.append(
            IntegrationSnapshotItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                verified=summary["verified"],
                snapshot_id=f"snapshot-{record.slug}-{record.version}",
                created_at=created_at,
                health=health,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "pass_count": summary["pass_count"],
                    "warn_count": summary["warn_count"],
                    "fail_count": summary["fail_count"],
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0 if item.health == "failing"
            else 1 if item.health == "warning"
            else 2 if item.health == "healthy"
            else 3,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationSnapshotsView(
        title="Integration Snapshots",
        total=len(items),
        healthy_snapshot_count=healthy_snapshot_count,
        warning_snapshot_count=warning_snapshot_count,
        failing_snapshot_count=failing_snapshot_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
            "generated_at": generated_at.isoformat(),
        },
    )

def _verification_status_from_summary(summary: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if summary["fail_count"] > 0:
        return "failed"
    if summary["warn_count"] > 0:
        return "warning"
    if summary["verified"]:
        return "passed"
    return "unknown"


def _determine_rollout_state(
    *,
    lifecycle_status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
    command_ready: bool,
    install_ready: bool,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0 or not command_ready:
        return "blocked"
    if verified and lifecycle_status == "active" and install_ready:
        return "live"
    if verified and warn_count > 0:
        return "staged"
    if verified:
        return "ready"
    return "planned"


def build_integration_status_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-status",
) -> IntegrationStatusView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationStatusItem] = []
    live_count = 0
    ready_count = 0
    blocked_count = 0

    for record in records:
        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=True,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        command_ready = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        install_ready = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))

        rollout_state = _determine_rollout_state(
            lifecycle_status=record.status,
            verified=summary["verified"],
            warn_count=summary["warn_count"],
            fail_count=summary["fail_count"],
            command_ready=command_ready,
            install_ready=install_ready,
        )

        if rollout_state == "live":
            live_count += 1
        elif rollout_state in {"ready", "staged"}:
            ready_count += 1
        elif rollout_state == "blocked":
            blocked_count += 1

        items.append(
            IntegrationStatusItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                lifecycle_status=record.status,
                verification_status=_verification_status_from_summary(summary),
                verified=summary["verified"],
                rollout_state=rollout_state,
                command_ready=command_ready,
                install_ready=install_ready,
                checked_at=summary["checked_at"],
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "pass_count": summary["pass_count"],
                    "warn_count": summary["warn_count"],
                    "fail_count": summary["fail_count"],
                    "verification_summary": summary,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            0
            if item.rollout_state == "blocked"
            else 1
            if item.rollout_state == "planned"
            else 2
            if item.rollout_state == "ready"
            else 3
            if item.rollout_state == "staged"
            else 4,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationStatusView(
        title="Integration Status",
        total=len(items),
        live_count=live_count,
        ready_count=ready_count,
        blocked_count=blocked_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

def _normalize_status(value: str | None) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "unknown"
    return value.strip().lower()


def _integration_health(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> str:
    if fail_count > 0:
        return "failing"
    if warn_count > 0 or not verified:
        return "warning"
    if status == "active":
        return "healthy"
    return "inactive"


def _integration_score(
    *,
    status: str,
    verified: bool,
    has_command: bool,
    has_install_target: bool,
    pass_count: int,
    warn_count: int,
    fail_count: int,
) -> int:
    score = 0

    if status == "active":
        score += 20
    elif status in {"planned", "draft"}:
        score += 10

    if verified:
        score += 30

    if has_command:
        score += 15
    if has_install_target:
        score += 15

    score += min(pass_count * 2, 20)
    score -= min(warn_count * 2, 10)
    score -= min(fail_count * 10, 30)

    return max(0, min(score, 100))


def build_integration_summary_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-summary",
) -> IntegrationSummaryView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationSummaryItem] = []
    active_count = 0
    verified_count = 0
    healthy_count = 0
    warning_count = 0
    failing_count = 0

    for record in records:
        status = _normalize_status(getattr(record, "status", None))
        if status == "active":
            active_count += 1

        verification = verify_integration(
            registry,
            record.integration_id,
            strict=False,
            requested_by=requested_by,
        )
        summary = summarize_verification_result(verification)

        verified = bool(summary.get("verified", False))
        pass_count = int(summary.get("pass_count", 0))
        warn_count = int(summary.get("warn_count", 0))
        fail_count = int(summary.get("fail_count", 0))

        if verified:
            verified_count += 1

        has_command = bool(getattr(record, "command_name", None))
        has_install_target = bool(getattr(record, "install_target", None))

        health = _integration_health(
            status=status,
            verified=verified,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )

        if health == "healthy":
            healthy_count += 1
        elif health == "warning":
            warning_count += 1
        elif health == "failing":
            failing_count += 1

        score = _integration_score(
            status=status,
            verified=verified,
            has_command=has_command,
            has_install_target=has_install_target,
            pass_count=pass_count,
            warn_count=warn_count,
            fail_count=fail_count,
        )

        items.append(
            IntegrationSummaryItem(
                integration_id=record.integration_id,
                slug=record.slug,
                name=record.name,
                platform=record.platform,
                status=record.status,
                version=record.version,
                integration_type=getattr(record, "integration_type", "unknown"),
                verified=verified,
                pass_count=pass_count,
                warn_count=warn_count,
                fail_count=fail_count,
                has_command=has_command,
                has_install_target=has_install_target,
                score=score,
                health=health,
                metadata={
                    "requested_by": requested_by,
                    "checked_at": summary.get("checked_at"),
                    "verification_summary": summary,
                },
            )
        )

    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -item.score,
            item.platform,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    return IntegrationSummaryView(
        title="Integration Summary",
        total=len(items),
        active_count=active_count,
        verified_count=verified_count,
        healthy_count=healthy_count,
        warning_count=warning_count,
        failing_count=failing_count,
        items=items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from app.services.integration_registry import (
    IntegrationRegistry,
    list_integrations,
)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationTagItem:
    integration_id: str
    slug: str
    name: str
    platform: str
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    tag_count: int = 0
    status: str = "unknown"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "integration_id": self.integration_id,
            "slug": self.slug,
            "name": self.name,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "tag_count": self.tag_count,
            "status": self.status,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class TagSummaryItem:
    name: str
    usage_count: int
    active_usage_count: int
    platforms: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "usage_count": self.usage_count,
            "active_usage_count": self.active_usage_count,
            "platforms": list(sorted(set(self.platforms))),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IntegrationTagsView:
    title: str
    total_integrations: int
    tagged_integrations: int
    unique_tag_count: int
    items: list[IntegrationTagItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    tags: list[TagSummaryItem] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "title": self.title,
            "total_integrations": self.total_integrations,
            "tagged_integrations": self.tagged_integrations,
            "unique_tag_count": self.unique_tag_count,
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.items],
            "tags": [tag.to_dict() for tag in self.tags],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


def _normalize_tags(raw: Any) -> list[str]:
    if not raw:
        return []
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        # Support shapes like {"tags": [...]} or {"labels": [...]}
        for key in ("tags", "labels"):
            if key in raw and isinstance(raw[key], list):
                return [str(t).strip() for t in raw[key] if str(t).strip()]
        # Fallback: take all values as tags
        return [str(v).strip() for v in raw.values() if str(v).strip()]
    if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple, set)):
        return [str(t).strip() for t in raw if str(t).strip()]
    # Single string or scalar
    return [str(raw).strip()]


def build_integration_tags_view(
    *,
    registry: IntegrationRegistry,
    requested_by: str = "ui-tags",
) -> IntegrationTagsView:
    records = list_integrations(registry)

    items: list[IntegrationTagItem] = []
    tag_usage: dict[str, TagSummaryItem] = {}

    total_integrations = len(records)
    tagged_integrations = 0

    for record in records:
        record_metadata = getattr(record, "metadata", {}) or {}
        raw_tags = record_metadata.get("tags") or record_metadata.get("labels") or []
        tags = _normalize_tags(raw_tags)

        status = getattr(record, "status", "unknown")
        status_normalized = str(status or "unknown").strip().lower()

        if tags:
            tagged_integrations += 1

        item = IntegrationTagItem(
            integration_id=record.integration_id,
            slug=record.slug,
            name=record.name,
            platform=record.platform,
            tags=tags,
            tag_count=len(tags),
            status=status,
            metadata={
                "requested_by": requested_by,
            },
        )
        items.append(item)

        for tag in tags:
            existing = tag_usage.get(tag)
            if existing is None:
                existing = TagSummaryItem(
                    name=tag,
                    usage_count=0,
                    active_usage_count=0,
                    platforms=[],
                    metadata={},
                )
                tag_usage[tag] = existing

            existing.usage_count += 1
            if status_normalized in {"active", "enabled"}:
                existing.active_usage_count += 1
            existing.platforms.append(record.platform)

    # Sort integration items by platform then name then slug.
    items.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            item.platform,
            item.name,
            item.slug,
            item.integration_id,
        )
    )

    # Build sorted tag summaries: highest usage, then name.
    tag_items: list[TagSummaryItem] = list(tag_usage.values())
    tag_items.sort(
        key=lambda t: (
            -t.usage_count,
            -t.active_usage_count,
            t.name.lower(),
        )
    )

    unique_tag_count = len(tag_items)

    return IntegrationTagsView(
        title="Integration Tags",
        total_integrations=total_integrations,
        tagged_integrations=tagged_integrations,
        unique_tag_count=unique_tag_count,
        items=items,
        tags=tag_items,
        metadata={
            "requested_by": requested_by,
        },
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/policy",
    tags=["policy-settings"],
)


class PolicyToggleView(BaseModel):
    key: str
    enabled: bool
    label: str
    description: str


class PolicyModeOptionView(BaseModel):
    value: str
    label: str
    description: str


class PolicyThresholdView(BaseModel):
    key: str
    label: str
    value: int
    minimum: int
    maximum: int
    unit: str = "score"
    description: str


class PolicyRuleView(BaseModel):
    ruleid: str
    label: str
    category: str
    severity: str
    mode: str
    enabled: bool
    description: str
    patternexamples: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class PolicyAllowlistEntryView(BaseModel):
    entryid: str
    valuetype: str
    value: str
    source: str
    description: Optional[str] = None


class PolicyRecentChangeView(BaseModel):
    changeid: str
    changedat: str
    changedby: str
    changetype: str
    summary: str


class PolicySimulationInputView(BaseModel):
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    riskscore: int
    promptsample: Optional[str] = None


class PolicySimulationResultView(BaseModel):
    verdict: str
    shouldwarn: bool
    shouldquarantine: bool
    shouldblock: bool
    shouldreview: bool
    reason: str


class PolicySettingsResponse(BaseModel):
    generatedat: str
    environment: str
    policyname: str
    policymode: str
    heuristicthreshold: int
    unicode_normalization_enabled: bool
    reviewrequiredabove: int
    quarantineabove: int
    blockabove: int
    toggles: list[PolicyToggleView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    modeoptions: list[PolicyModeOptionView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    thresholds: list[PolicyThresholdView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    activerules: list[PolicyRuleView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    allowlist: list[PolicyAllowlistEntryView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recentchanges: list[PolicyRecentChangeView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    simulationinput: PolicySimulationInputView
    simulationresult: PolicySimulationResultView
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

class QuarantineKpiView(BaseModel):

    trendlabel: Optional[str] = None

class QuarantineStatusCount(BaseModel):
    status: str

    count: int

    isolatedcount: int
    releasedcount: int
    activecount: int

def _to_quarantine_item(record: dict[str, object]) -> QuarantineItemView:
    return QuarantineItemView(
        quarantineid=str(record.get("quarantineid") or "unknown-quarantine"),
        executionid=record.get("executionid") if isinstance(record.get("executionid"), str) else None,
        reviewitemid=record.get("reviewitemid") if isinstance(record.get("reviewitemid"), str) else None,
        incidentid=record.get("incidentid") if isinstance(record.get("incidentid"), str) else None,
        clientid=record.get("clientid") if isinstance(record.get("clientid"), str) else None,
        sessionid=record.get("sessionid") if isinstance(record.get("sessionid"), str) else None,
        target=str(record.get("target") or "unknown"),
        actiontype=str(record.get("actiontype") or "unknown"),
        severity=str(record.get("severity") or "unknown"),
        status=str(record.get("status") or "unknown"),
        policyverdict=str(record.get("policyverdict") or "unknown"),
        riskscore=int(record.get("riskscore") or 0),
        isolatedat=str(record.get("isolatedat") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        updatedat=str(record.get("updatedat") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        reason=str(record.get("reason") or "No reason provided."),
        tags=[str(tag) for tag in record.get("tags", []) if isinstance(tag, str)],
    )


def _build_status_counts(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[QuarantineStatusCount]:
    counts = Counter(str(record.get("status") or "unknown") for record in records)
    return [
        QuarantineStatusCount(status=status, count=count)
        for status, count in sorted(counts.items())
    ]


def _build_severity_counts(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[QuarantineSeverityCount]:
    counts = Counter(str(record.get("severity") or "unknown") for record in records)
    return [
        QuarantineSeverityCount(severity=severity, count=count)
        for severity, count in sorted(counts.items())
    ]


def _build_timeline(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[QuarantineTimelinePoint]:
    hourly_isolated: dict[str, int] = {}
    hourly_released: dict[str, int] = {}
    running_active: dict[str, int] = {}

    buckets = sorted({str(record.get("isolatedat") or "")[:13] + ":00:00+00:00" for record in records})

    active_count = 0
    for bucket in buckets:
        isolated_in_bucket = 0
        released_in_bucket = 0

        for record in records:
            isolatedat = str(record.get("isolatedat") or "")
            updatedat = str(record.get("updatedat") or "")
            status = str(record.get("status") or "unknown")

            if isolatedat.startswith(bucket[:13]):
                isolated_in_bucket += 1
                if status != "released":
                    active_count += 1

            if updatedat.startswith(bucket[:13]) and status == "released":
                released_in_bucket += 1
                if active_count > 0:
                    active_count -= 1

        hourly_isolated[bucket] = isolated_in_bucket
        hourly_released[bucket] = released_in_bucket
        running_active[bucket] = active_count

    return [
        QuarantineTimelinePoint(
            timestamp=bucket,
            isolatedcount=hourly_isolated.get(bucket, 0),
            releasedcount=hourly_released.get(bucket, 0),
            activecount=running_active.get(bucket, 0),
        )
        for bucket in buckets
    ]


@router.get("/overview", response_model=QuarantineOverviewResponse)
def get_quarantine_overview() -> QuarantineOverviewResponse:
    quarantine_records = _sample_quarantine_records()
    items = [
        _to_quarantine_item(record)
        for record in sorted(
            quarantine_records,
            key=lambda item: str(item.get("updatedat") or ""),
            reverse=True,
        )
    ]
    activealerts = _sample_alerts()

    totalitems = len(quarantine_records)
    activeitems = sum(
        1 for record in quarantine_records if str(record.get("status") or "") != "released"
    )
    criticalitems = sum(
        1 for record in quarantine_records if str(record.get("severity") or "") == "critical"
    )
    unacknowledgedalerts = sum(1 for alert in activealerts if not alert.acknowledged)

    kpis = [
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="totalisolated",
            value=totalitems,
            trendlabel="Current quarantine item volume snapshot",
            status="warning" if totalitems > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="activeisolated",
            value=activeitems,
            trendlabel="Items still contained in quarantine",
            status="critical" if activeitems > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="criticalisolated",
            value=criticalitems,
            trendlabel="Highest-severity quarantined items",
            status="critical" if criticalitems > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
        QuarantineKpiView(
            label="unacknowledgedalerts",
            value=unacknowledgedalerts,
            trendlabel="Containment alerts awaiting acknowledgment",
            status="warning" if unacknowledgedalerts > 0 else "healthy",
        ),
    ]

    overallstatus = "healthy"
    if criticalitems > 0:
        overallstatus = "critical"
    elif activeitems > 0 or unacknowledgedalerts > 0:
        overallstatus = "attention"

    return QuarantineOverviewResponse(
        generatedat=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        environment="local",
        overallstatus=overallstatus,
        kpis=kpis,
        statuscounts=_build_status_counts(quarantine_records),
        severitycounts=_build_severity_counts(quarantine_records),
        timeline=_build_timeline(quarantine_records),
        items=items,
        activealerts=activealerts,

class ReviewReasonView(BaseModel):
    source: str
    label: str
    details: str
    score: Optional[int] = None


class ReviewDecisionOptions(BaseModel):
    canapprove: bool
    canreject: bool
    canresolve: bool


class ReviewItemDetailResponse(BaseModel):
    reviewitemid: str
    reviewstatus: str
    timestamp: str
    updatedat: str
    executionid: str
    clientid: Optional[str] = None
    sessionid: Optional[str] = None
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    content: str
    filepath: Optional[str] = None
    riskscore: int
    executionstate: str
    responsestatus: str
    policyverdict: str
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    traceid: str
    requestid: str
    decisionid: str
    executorname: Optional[str] = None
    executorresult: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None
    reason: Optional[str] = None
    reasons: list[ReviewReasonView] = Field(default_factory=list)
    decisionoptions: ReviewDecisionOptions


def _utc_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int = 0) -> str:
    return datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _safe_str(value: Any, default: str) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _safe_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        lowered = value.strip().lower()
        if lowered in {"true", "1", "yes", "y", "on"}:
            return True
        if lowered in {"false", "0", "no", "n", "off"}:
            return False
    return bool(value)


def _normalize_reason(reason: dict[str, Any]) -> ReviewReasonView:
    return ReviewReasonView(
        source=_safe_str(reason.get("source"), "runtime"),
        label=_safe_str(reason.get("label"), "unspecified-reason"),
        details=_safe_str(reason.get("details"), "No additional details provided."),
        score=_safe_int(reason.get("score"), 0) if reason.get("score") is not None else None,
    )

@router.get("/detail/{reviewitemid}", response_model=ReviewItemDetailResponse)
def get_review_item_detail(reviewitemid: str) -> ReviewItemDetailResponse:
    record = _build_placeholder_record(reviewitemid)
    if record is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Review item not found.")

    reviewstatus = _safe_str(record.get("reviewstatus"), "pending").lower()
    canapprove = reviewstatus == "pending"
    canreject = reviewstatus == "pending"
    canresolve = reviewstatus in {"approved", "rejected"}

    return ReviewItemDetailResponse(
        reviewitemid=_safe_str(record.get("reviewitemid"), "unknown-review"),
        reviewstatus=reviewstatus,
        timestamp=_safe_str(record.get("timestamp"), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        updatedat=_safe_str(record.get("updatedat"), datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        executionid=_safe_str(record.get("executionid"), "unknown-execution"),
        clientid=record.get("clientid"),
        sessionid=record.get("sessionid"),
        actiontype=_safe_str(record.get("actiontype"), "unknown"),
        target=_safe_str(record.get("target"), "unknown"),
        content=_safe_str(record.get("content"), ""),
        filepath=record.get("filepath"),
        riskscore=_safe_int(record.get("riskscore"), 0),
        executionstate=_safe_str(record.get("executionstate"), "unknown"),
        responsestatus=_safe_str(record.get("responsestatus"), "completed"),
        policyverdict=_safe_str(record.get("policyverdict"), "allow"),
        shouldexecute=_safe_bool(record.get("shouldexecute"), False),
        haltedbyboundary=_safe_bool(record.get("haltedbyboundary"), False),
        traceid=_safe_str(record.get("traceid"), "unknown-trace"),
        requestid=_safe_str(record.get("requestid"), "unknown-request"),
        decisionid=_safe_str(record.get("decisionid"), "unknown-decision"),
        executorname=record.get("executorname"),
        executorresult=record.get("executorresult"),
        reason=record.get("reason"),
        reasons=[_normalize_reason(reason) for reason in record.get("reasons", [])],
        decisionoptions=ReviewDecisionOptions(
            canapprove=canapprove,
            canreject=canreject,
            canresolve=canresolve,
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/ui/reviews",
    tags=["review-queue"],
)


class ReviewQueueItem(BaseModel):
    reviewitemid: str
    executionid: str
    timestamp: str
    reviewstatus: str
    clientid: Optional[str] = None
    sessionid: Optional[str] = None
    actiontype: str
    target: str
    riskscore: int
    executionstate: str
    responsestatus: str
    policyverdict: str
    shouldexecute: bool
    haltedbyboundary: bool
    reason: Optional[str] = None
    executorname: Optional[str] = None
    traceid: Optional[str] = None
    requestid: Optional[str] = None
    decisionid: Optional[str] = None


class ReviewQueueResponse(BaseModel):
    items: list[ReviewQueueItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    total: int = 0
    pending: int = 0
    approved: int = 0
    rejected: int = 0


def _utcnow_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _coerce_str(value: Any, default: str) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return default
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, str):
        lowered = value.strip().lower()
        if lowered in {"true", "1", "yes", "y", "on"}:
            return True
        if lowered in {"false", "0", "no", "n", "off"}:
            return False
    return bool(value)


def _normalize_reviewstatus(value: Any) -> str:
    status = _coerce_str(value, "pending").lower()
    if status in {"approved", "rejected", "pending"}:
        return status
    return "pending"


def _normalize_executionstate(value: Any) -> str:
    return _coerce_str(value, "unknown")


def _normalize_responsestatus(value: Any, executionstate: str) -> str:
    status = _coerce_str(value, "").lower()
    if status in {"completed", "queuedforreview", "denied"}:
        return status

    if executionstate in {"denied", "blocked", "quarantined"}:
        return "denied"
    if executionstate in {"dryrun", "queued", "queuedforreview", "review"}:
        return "queuedforreview"
    return "completed"


def _normalize_policyverdict(value: Any, executionstate: str) -> str:
    verdict = _coerce_str(value, "").lower()
    if verdict:
        return verdict

    if executionstate in {"denied", "blocked"}:
        return "block"
    if executionstate in {"quarantined"}:
        return "quarantine"
    if executionstate in {"dryrun", "queued", "queuedforreview", "review"}:
        return "review"
    return "allow"

def get_review_queue() -> ReviewQueueResponse:

    pending = sum(1 for item in items if item.reviewstatus == "pending")
    approved = sum(1 for item in items if item.reviewstatus == "approved")
    rejected = sum(1 for item in items if item.reviewstatus == "rejected")

    return ReviewQueueResponse(

        total=len(items),
        pending=pending,
        approved=approved,
        rejected=rejected,

JobStatus = Literal["pending", "running", "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"]

RemediationKind = Literal[
    "configuration_change",
    "access_control",
    "network_control",
    "detection_rule",
    "data_protection",
    "process_runbook",
    "other",
]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RemediationJob:
    """Worker-side representation of a remediation action execution job."""

    id: str
    action_id: str
    kind: RemediationKind
    title: str
    description: str
    target: str
    requested_by: str
    status: JobStatus
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    started_at: str | None = None
    completed_at: str | None = None
    attempts: int = 0
    max_attempts: int = 3
    last_error: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "action_id": self.action_id,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "title": self.title,
            "description": self.description,
            "target": self.target,
            "requested_by": self.requested_by,
            "status": self.status,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
            "attempts": self.attempts,
            "max_attempts": self.max_attempts,
            "last_error": self.last_error,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


# In-memory job store (you can swap this for Redis/DB later)
_JOBS: dict[str, RemediationJob] = {}
_JOB_COUNTER: int = 0


# --------- Pydantic views ----------------------------------------------------


class RemediationJobCreate(BaseModel):
    """
    Job creation payload. This is typically invoked by your queue/bridge
    when a remediation action moves to 'queued' state on the UI side.
    """

    action_id: str = Field(..., description="ID of the remediation action.")
    kind: RemediationKind = Field(..., description="Type of remediation action.")
    title: str = Field(..., description="Short title for this job.")
    description: str = Field(..., description="What this job will attempt to do.")
    target: str = Field(..., description="System/asset this job targets.")
    requested_by: str = Field(..., description="Who requested execution (user, system).")
    max_attempts: int = Field(
        default=3,
        ge=1,
        le=10,
        description="Maximum number of attempts before permanent failure.",
    )
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,

    )

    status: JobStatus = Field(
        ...,

        description="Optional error message when marking job as failed.",
    )


# --------- internal helpers --------------------------------------------------


def _next_job_id() -> str:
    global _JOB_COUNTER
    _JOB_COUNTER += 1
    return f"job-{_JOB_COUNTER}"


def _paginate_jobs(
    jobs: list[RemediationJob],
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> tuple[list[RemediationJob], int, int]:
    total_items = len(jobs)
    if total_items == 0:
        return [], 0, 0

    total_pages = (total_items + page_size - 1) // page_size
    page = max(1, min(page, total_pages))

    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    return jobs[start:end], total_items, total_pages


def _simulate_execution(job: RemediationJob) -> None:
    """
    Placeholder execution logic.

    In a real system, this would dispatch to a secure executor engine
    (e.g., workflow engine, Ansible, Terraform, internal tools) and
    update status based on the external result.[web:1299][web:1303]
    """
    from random import random

    job.attempts += 1
    job.started_at = job.started_at or _utc_now()

    # Simple random success/failure for now
    if random() > 0.15:
        job.status = "succeeded"
        job.completed_at = _utc_now()
        job.last_error = None
    else:
        job.status = "failed"
        job.completed_at = _utc_now()
        job.last_error = "Simulated execution failure"
    job.updated_at = _utc_now()


# --------- HTTP endpoints ----------------------------------------------------


@router.post("/jobs", response_model=RemediationJobView, status_code=201)
def create_remediation_job(payload: RemediationJobCreate) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Create a remediation execution job.

    Called by your queue/bridge component when a remediation action
    transitions to 'queued' on the UI side.[web:1300][web:1303]
    """
    job_id = _next_job_id()
    now = _utc_now()
    job = RemediationJob(
        id=job_id,
        action_id=payload.action_id,
        kind=payload.kind,
        title=payload.title,
        description=payload.description,
        target=payload.target,
        requested_by=payload.requested_by,
        status="pending",
        created_at=now,
        updated_at=now,
        max_attempts=payload.max_attempts,
        metadata=dict(payload.metadata),
    )
    _JOBS[job_id] = job
    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())


@router.get("/jobs", response_model=RemediationJobListResponse)
def list_remediation_jobs(
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number for remediation jobs."),
    page_size: int = Query(
        20,
        ge=1,
        le=100,
        description="Number of jobs per page (max 100).",
    ),
    status: JobStatus | None = Query(
        default=None,
        description="Optional filter by job status.",
    ),
    action_id: str | None = Query(
        default=None,
        description="Optional filter by remediation action id.",
    ),
) -> RemediationJobListResponse:
    """
    List remediation jobs for monitoring and debugging.

    Supports filtering by status and action_id, and basic pagination.[web:1301][web:1303]
    """
    jobs = list(_JOBS.values())
    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: j.created_at, reverse=True)

    if status is not None:
        jobs = [j for j in jobs if j.status == status]
    if action_id is not None:
        jobs = [j for j in jobs if j.action_id == action_id]

    page_items, total_items, total_pages = _paginate_jobs(jobs, page, page_size)

    return RemediationJobListResponse(
        items=[RemediationJobView(**j.to_dict()) for j in page_items],
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        total_items=total_items,
        total_pages=total_pages,
        generated_at=_utc_now(),
    )


@router.get("/jobs/{job_id}", response_model=RemediationJobView)
def get_remediation_job(job_id: str) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Retrieve a single remediation job by id.
    """
    job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")
    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())


@router.post("/jobs/{job_id}/execute", response_model=RemediationJobView)
def execute_remediation_job(job_id: str) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Trigger execution of a remediation job.

    In a real deployment, this would likely be restricted to internal
    workers only (e.g., via network policy, auth scopes, or mTLS).[web:1172][web:1291]
    """
    job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")

    if job.status not in ("pending", "failed"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Cannot execute job in status {job.status}")

    if job.attempts >= job.max_attempts:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Max attempts exceeded for this job")

    job.status = "running"
    job.started_at = job.started_at or _utc_now()
    job.updated_at = _utc_now()

    # Simulate execution inline for now
    _simulate_execution(job)

    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())


@router.patch("/jobs/{job_id}/status", response_model=RemediationJobView)
def update_remediation_job_status(
    job_id: str,
    payload: RemediationJobStatusUpdate,
) -> RemediationJobView:
    """
    Update job status from an external worker/orchestrator.

    This keeps the worker-side API generic if you later move execution
    out-of-process (e.g., to a queue consumer or Kubernetes Job).[web:1300][web:1303]
    """
    job = _JOBS.get(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Job not found")

    now = _utc_now()
    job.status = payload.status
    job.updated_at = now

    if payload.status == "running":
        job.started_at = job.started_at or now
    elif payload.status in ("succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"):
        job.completed_at = now

    job.last_error = payload.last_error
    return RemediationJobView(**job.to_dict())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json
import platform
import sys


@dataclass(slots=True)
class InstallCheck:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str
    recommendation: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class InstallPlan:
    product: str
    version: str
    install_root: str
    platform: str
    python_executable: str
    virtualenv_path: str
    config_path: str
    data_path: str
    log_path: str
    checks: list[InstallCheck]
    next_steps: list[str]


def _default_install_root() -> Path:
    home = Path.home()
    system = platform.system().lower()
    if system == "windows":
        return home / "IronClaw-Security"
    return home / ".ironclaw-security"


def _default_config_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "config.json"


def _default_data_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "data"


def _default_log_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "logs"


def _default_virtualenv_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / ".venv"


def _python_version_ok() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    version = sys.version_info
    ok = (version.major, version.minor) >= (3, 11)
    detail = f"Detected Python {version.major}.{version.minor}.{version.micro}"
    return ok, detail


def _path_writable(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    try:
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        probe = path / ".write_test"
        probe.write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
        probe.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return True, f"Writable: {path}"
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, f"Not writable: {path} ({exc})"


def _build_checks(root: Path) -> list[InstallCheck]:
    python_ok, python_detail = _python_version_ok()
    root_ok, root_detail = _path_writable(root)
    data_ok, data_detail = _path_writable(_default_data_path(root))
    log_ok, log_detail = _path_writable(_default_log_path(root))

    checks = [
        InstallCheck(
            name="python-version",
            ok=python_ok,
            detail=python_detail,
            recommendation=None if python_ok else "Use Python 3.11 or newer.",
        ),
        InstallCheck(
            name="install-root",
            ok=root_ok,
            detail=root_detail,
            recommendation=None if root_ok else "Choose a writable installation directory.",
        ),
        InstallCheck(
            name="data-directory",
            ok=data_ok,
            detail=data_detail,
            recommendation=None if data_ok else "Verify the data directory permissions.",
        ),
        InstallCheck(
            name="log-directory",
            ok=log_ok,
            detail=log_detail,
            recommendation=None if log_ok else "Verify the log directory permissions.",
        ),
    ]
    return checks


def build_install_plan(install_root: Path | None = None) -> InstallPlan:
    root = install_root or _default_install_root()
    checks = _build_checks(root)

    next_steps = [
        f"Create virtual environment at { _default_virtualenv_path(root) }",
        "Install project dependencies",
        "Set required environment variables and API keys",
        "Run CLI verify command after installation completes",
    ]

    return InstallPlan(
        product="IronClaw-Security",
        version="gen1",
        install_root=str(root),
        platform=platform.platform(),
        python_executable=sys.executable,
        virtualenv_path=str(_default_virtualenv_path(root)),
        config_path=str(_default_config_path(root)),
        data_path=str(_default_data_path(root)),
        log_path=str(_default_log_path(root)),
        checks=checks,
        next_steps=next_steps,
    )


def _render_text(plan: InstallPlan) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"{plan.product} installer plan",
        f"version: {plan.version}",
        f"platform: {plan.platform}",
        f"python: {plan.python_executable}",
        f"install_root: {plan.install_root}",
        f"virtualenv_path: {plan.virtualenv_path}",
        f"config_path: {plan.config_path}",
        f"data_path: {plan.data_path}",
        f"log_path: {plan.log_path}",
        "",
        "checks:",
    ]

    for check in plan.checks:
        status = "OK" if check.ok else "FAIL"
        lines.append(f"- [{status}] {check.name}: {check.detail}")
        if check.recommendation:
            lines.append(f"  recommendation: {check.recommendation}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("next_steps:")
    for step in plan.next_steps:
        lines.append(f"- {step}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def _render_json(plan: InstallPlan) -> str:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = asdict(plan)
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw-install",
        description="Prepare a local installation plan for IronClaw-Security.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--install-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the installation root directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Render the install plan as JSON.",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    plan = build_install_plan(args.install_root)

    if args.json:
        print(_render_json(plan))
    else:
        print(_render_text(plan))

    return 0 if all(check.ok for check in plan.checks) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json
import platform
import sys


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PackageCheck:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str
    recommendation: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PackagePlan:
    product: str
    version: str
    platform: str
    python_executable: str
    source_root: str
    output_dir: str
    artifact_name: str
    format: str
    checks: list[PackageCheck]
    includes: list[str]
    next_steps: list[str]


def _default_source_root() -> Path:
    return Path.cwd()


def _default_output_dir(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "dist"


def _python_version_check() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    version = sys.version_info
    ok = (version.major, version.minor) >= (3, 11)
    return ok, f"Detected Python {version.major}.{version.minor}.{version.micro}"


def _path_exists(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    ok = path.exists()
    return ok, f"Path: {path}"


def _path_writable(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    try:
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        probe = path / ".package_write_test"
        probe.write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
        probe.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return True, f"Writable: {path}"
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, f"Not writable: {path} ({exc})"


def _build_checks(source_root: Path, output_dir: Path, package_format: str) -> list[PackageCheck]:
    python_ok, python_detail = _python_version_check()
    source_ok, source_detail = _path_exists(source_root)
    output_ok, output_detail = _path_writable(output_dir)
    format_ok = package_format in {"zip", "tar", "directory"}

    return [
        PackageCheck(
            name="python-version",
            ok=python_ok,
            detail=python_detail,
            recommendation=None if python_ok else "Use Python 3.11 or newer before packaging.",
        ),
        PackageCheck(
            name="source-root",
            ok=source_ok,
            detail=source_detail,
            recommendation=None if source_ok else "Run the packaging command from a valid project directory.",
        ),
        PackageCheck(
            name="output-directory",
            ok=output_ok,
            detail=output_detail,
            recommendation=None if output_ok else "Choose a writable output directory.",
        ),
        PackageCheck(
            name="package-format",
            ok=format_ok,
            detail=f"Requested format: {package_format}",
            recommendation=None if format_ok else "Use zip, tar, or directory as the package format.",
        ),
    ]


def build_package_plan(
    source_root: Path | None = None,
    output_dir: Path | None = None,
    package_format: str = "zip",
) -> PackagePlan:
    root = source_root or _default_source_root()
    out_dir = output_dir or _default_output_dir(root)
    normalized_format = package_format.strip().lower()

    checks = _build_checks(root, out_dir, normalized_format)
    artifact_name = f"ironclaw-security-gen1.{ 'tar.gz' if normalized_format == 'tar' else normalized_format }"

    includes = [
        "app/",
        "core/",
        "ui/",
        "cli/",
        "README.md",
        ".env.example",
    ]

    next_steps = [
        "Verify the package contents before distribution.",
        "Include configuration templates but avoid embedding real secrets.",
        "Run the verify command in a clean environment after unpacking.",
        "Sign or checksum the final artifact if distributing externally.",
    ]

    return PackagePlan(
        product="IronClaw-Security",
        version="gen1",
        platform=platform.platform(),
        python_executable=sys.executable,
        source_root=str(root),
        output_dir=str(out_dir),
        artifact_name=artifact_name,
        format=normalized_format,
        checks=checks,
        includes=includes,
        next_steps=next_steps,
    )


def _render_text(plan: PackagePlan) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"{plan.product} package plan",
        f"version: {plan.version}",
        f"platform: {plan.platform}",
        f"python: {plan.python_executable}",
        f"source_root: {plan.source_root}",
        f"output_dir: {plan.output_dir}",
        f"artifact_name: {plan.artifact_name}",
        f"format: {plan.format}",
        "",
        "checks:",
    ]

    for check in plan.checks:
        status = "OK" if check.ok else "FAIL"
        lines.append(f"- [{status}] {check.name}: {check.detail}")
        if check.recommendation:
            lines.append(f"  recommendation: {check.recommendation}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("includes:")
    for item in plan.includes:
        lines.append(f"- {item}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("next_steps:")
    for item in plan.next_steps:
        lines.append(f"- {item}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def _render_json(plan: PackagePlan) -> str:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = asdict(plan)
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw-package",
        description="Prepare a packaging plan for IronClaw-Security.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--source-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the project source root.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the package output directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--format",
        default="zip",
        help="Package format to target: zip, tar, or directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Render the package plan as JSON.",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    plan = build_package_plan(
        source_root=args.source_root,
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        package_format=str(args.format).strip().lower(),
    )

    if args.json:
        print(_render_json(plan))
    else:
        print(_render_text(plan))

    return 0 if all(check.ok for check in plan.checks) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
import json
import shutil
import sys


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UninstallCheck:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str
    recommendation: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UninstallTarget:
    label: str
    path: str
    exists: bool
    removable: bool


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UninstallPlan:
    product: str
    version: str
    dry_run: bool
    purge_data: bool
    install_root: str
    config_root: str
    data_root: str
    targets: list[UninstallTarget]
    checks: list[UninstallCheck]
    next_steps: list[str]


def _default_install_root() -> Path:
    return Path.cwd()


def _default_config_root() -> Path:
    return Path.home() / ".ironclaw-security"


def _default_data_root() -> Path:
    return Path.home() / ".ironclaw-security-data"


def _path_state(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
    exists = path.exists()
    removable = exists and path != path.anchor and path != Path.home()
    return exists, removable


def _build_targets(install_root: Path, config_root: Path, data_root: Path, purge_data: bool) -> list[UninstallTarget]:
    targets: list[UninstallTarget] = []

    for label, path in [
        ("install-root", install_root),
        ("config-root", config_root),
    ]:
        exists, removable = _path_state(path)
        targets.append(
            UninstallTarget(
                label=label,
                path=str(path),
                exists=exists,
                removable=removable,
            )
        )

    if purge_data:
        exists, removable = _path_state(data_root)
        targets.append(
            UninstallTarget(
                label="data-root",
                path=str(data_root),
                exists=exists,
                removable=removable,
            )
        )

    return targets


def _build_checks(targets: list[UninstallTarget]) -> list[UninstallCheck]:
    checks: list[UninstallCheck] = []

    if not targets:
        checks.append(
            UninstallCheck(
                name="targets",
                ok=False,
                detail="No uninstall targets were generated.",
                recommendation="Provide at least one valid uninstall target.",
            )
        )
        return checks

    checks.append(
        UninstallCheck(
            name="target-count",
            ok=True,
            detail=f"Prepared {len(targets)} uninstall target(s).",
            recommendation=None,
        )
    )

    for target in targets:
        if not target.exists:
            checks.append(
                UninstallCheck(
                    name=f"{target.label}-exists",
                    ok=True,
                    detail=f"Target not present, nothing to remove: {target.path}",
                    recommendation=None,
                )
            )
        else:
            checks.append(
                UninstallCheck(
                    name=f"{target.label}-removable",
                    ok=target.removable,
                    detail=f"Target path: {target.path}",
                    recommendation=None if target.removable else "Refuse uninstall for unsafe root-level paths.",
                )
            )

    return checks


def build_uninstall_plan(
    install_root: Path | None = None,
    config_root: Path | None = None,
    data_root: Path | None = None,
    purge_data: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> UninstallPlan:
    resolved_install_root = (install_root or _default_install_root()).resolve()
    resolved_config_root = (config_root or _default_config_root()).resolve()
    resolved_data_root = (data_root or _default_data_root()).resolve()

    targets = _build_targets(
        install_root=resolved_install_root,
        config_root=resolved_config_root,
        data_root=resolved_data_root,
        purge_data=purge_data,
    )
    checks = _build_checks(targets)

    next_steps = [
        "Review uninstall targets before removing files.",
        "Run without --dry-run only after confirming the paths are correct.",
        "Use --purge-data only when you intend to remove stored runtime data.",
        "Run verify after reinstalling to confirm a clean recovery path.",
    ]

    return UninstallPlan(
        product="IronClaw-Security",
        version="gen1",
        dry_run=dry_run,
        purge_data=purge_data,
        install_root=str(resolved_install_root),
        config_root=str(resolved_config_root),
        data_root=str(resolved_data_root),
        targets=targets,
        checks=checks,
        next_steps=next_steps,
    )


def _remove_target(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        return
    if path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return
    shutil.rmtree(path)


def run_uninstall_command(
    install_root: Path | None = None,
    config_root: Path | None = None,
    data_root: Path | None = None,
    purge_data: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> UninstallPlan:
    plan = build_uninstall_plan(
        install_root=install_root,
        config_root=config_root,
        data_root=data_root,
        purge_data=purge_data,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )

    if not all(check.ok for check in plan.checks):
        return plan

    if dry_run:
        return plan

    for target in plan.targets:
        if target.exists and target.removable:
            _remove_target(Path(target.path))

    return build_uninstall_plan(
        install_root=Path(plan.install_root),
        config_root=Path(plan.config_root),
        data_root=Path(plan.data_root),
        purge_data=purge_data,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )


def _render_text(plan: UninstallPlan) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"{plan.product} uninstall plan",
        f"version: {plan.version}",
        f"dry_run: {str(plan.dry_run).lower()}",
        f"purge_data: {str(plan.purge_data).lower()}",
        f"install_root: {plan.install_root}",
        f"config_root: {plan.config_root}",
        f"data_root: {plan.data_root}",
        "",
        "targets:",
    ]

    for target in plan.targets:
        lines.append(
            f"- {target.label}: path={target.path}, exists={str(target.exists).lower()}, removable={str(target.removable).lower()}"
        )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("checks:")
    for check in plan.checks:
        status = "OK" if check.ok else "FAIL"
        lines.append(f"- [{status}] {check.name}: {check.detail}")
        if check.recommendation:
            lines.append(f"  recommendation: {check.recommendation}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("next_steps:")
    for item in plan.next_steps:
        lines.append(f"- {item}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def _render_json(plan: UninstallPlan) -> str:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = asdict(plan)
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def build_uninstall_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw-uninstall",
        description="Remove an IronClaw-Security installation and optional local data.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--install-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the installed project root.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the user configuration directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the runtime data directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--purge-data",
        action="store_true",
        help="Also remove the runtime data directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Preview what would be removed without deleting anything.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Render the uninstall result as JSON.",
    )
    return parser


def handle_uninstall_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    plan = run_uninstall_command(
        install_root=args.install_root,
        config_root=args.config_root,
        data_root=args.data_root,
        purge_data=bool(args.purge_data),
        dry_run=bool(args.dry_run),
    )

    if args.json:
        print(_render_json(plan))
    else:
        print(_render_text(plan))

    return 0 if all(check.ok for check in plan.checks) else 1


def main() -> int:
    parser = build_uninstall_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not args.dry_run and "--dry-run" not in sys.argv:
        args.dry_run = False

    return handle_uninstall_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

================================================================================

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from typing import Any


_ALLOWED_CHANNELS = {"stable", "preview", "dev"}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UpdateStep:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str
    recommendation: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class UpdatePlan:
    product: str
    version: str
    install_root: str
    platform: str
    python_executable: str
    target_channel: str
    config_path: str
    dry_run: bool
    steps: list[UpdateStep]
    next_steps: list[str]


def _default_install_root() -> Path:
    home = Path.home()
    system = platform.system().lower()
    if system == "windows":
        return home / "IronClaw-Security"
    return home / ".ironclaw-security"


def _default_config_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "config.json"


def _python_ok() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    version = sys.version_info
    ok = (version.major, version.minor) >= (3, 11)
    return ok, f"Detected Python {version.major}.{version.minor}.{version.micro}"


def _path_exists(path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    ok = path.exists()
    return ok, f"Path: {path}"


def _git_ok() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    git_path = shutil.which("git")
    ok = git_path is not None
    return ok, f"Git executable: {git_path or 'not found'}"


def _pip_ok() -> tuple[bool, str]:
    pip_path = shutil.which("pip")
    ok = pip_path is not None
    return ok, f"Pip executable: {pip_path or 'not found'}"


def _read_config_channel(config_path: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    if not config_path.exists():
        return False, "Config file not found."
    try:
        data = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, f"Config is not valid JSON: {exc}"
    configured_channel = str(data.get("channel", "stable")).strip().lower()
    if configured_channel not in _ALLOWED_CHANNELS:
        return False, f"Config channel is invalid: {configured_channel}"
    return True, f"Config channel: {configured_channel}"


def _venv_python(root: Path) -> Path:
    if platform.system().lower() == "windows":
        return root / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"
    return root / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"


def _venv_pip(root: Path) -> Path:
    if platform.system().lower() == "windows":
        return root / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "pip.exe"
    return root / ".venv" / "bin" / "pip"


def _requirements_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "requirements.txt"


def _build_steps(root: Path, channel: str) -> list[UpdateStep]:
    python_ok, python_detail = _python_ok()
    root_ok, root_detail = _path_exists(root)
    config_path = _default_config_path(root)
    config_ok, config_detail = _path_exists(config_path)
    venv_python = _venv_python(root)
    venv_pip = _venv_pip(root)
    venv_ok, venv_detail = _path_exists(venv_python)
    requirements_ok, requirements_detail = _path_exists(_requirements_path(root))
    git_ok, git_detail = _git_ok()
    pip_ok, pip_detail = _pip_ok()
    config_channel_ok, config_channel_detail = _read_config_channel(config_path)

    return [
        UpdateStep(
            name="python-version",
            ok=python_ok,
            detail=python_detail,
            recommendation=None if python_ok else "Use Python 3.11 or newer before updating.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="install-root",
            ok=root_ok,
            detail=root_detail,
            recommendation=None if root_ok else "Run install first to create the installation root.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="config-file",
            ok=config_ok,
            detail=config_detail,
            recommendation=None if config_ok else "Create or restore config.json before updating.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="config-channel",
            ok=config_channel_ok,
            detail=config_channel_detail,
            recommendation=None if config_channel_ok else "Ensure config.json contains a valid channel: stable, preview, or dev.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="virtualenv-python",
            ok=venv_ok,
            detail=f"Virtual environment Python: {venv_python}" if venv_ok else f"Missing virtual environment Python: {venv_python}",
            recommendation=None if venv_ok else "Create the virtual environment before applying updates.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="virtualenv-pip",
            ok=venv_pip.exists(),
            detail=f"Virtual environment pip: {venv_pip}" if venv_pip.exists() else f"Missing virtual environment pip: {venv_pip}",
            recommendation=None if venv_pip.exists() else "Install pip inside the managed virtual environment before updating.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="requirements-file",
            ok=requirements_ok,
            detail=requirements_detail,
            recommendation=None if requirements_ok else "Restore requirements.txt so dependencies can be refreshed.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="git-available",
            ok=git_ok,
            detail=git_detail,
            recommendation=None if git_ok else "Install Git so the update command can refresh tracked source files.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="pip-available",
            ok=pip_ok,
            detail=pip_detail,
            recommendation=None if pip_ok else "Install pip so dependency upgrades can run.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="update-channel",
            ok=channel in _ALLOWED_CHANNELS,
            detail=f"Requested update channel: {channel}",
            recommendation=None if channel in _ALLOWED_CHANNELS else "Use stable, preview, or dev.",
        ),
    ]


def build_update_plan(
    install_root: Path | None = None,
    channel: str = "stable",
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> UpdatePlan:
    root = (install_root or _default_install_root()).resolve()
    normalized_channel = channel.strip().lower()
    steps = _build_steps(root, normalized_channel)

    next_steps = [
        "Back up the current configuration before applying changes.",
        "Fetch the latest tracked source for the selected channel.",
        "Refresh dependencies inside the managed virtual environment.",
        "Re-run the verify command after the update completes.",
    ]

    return UpdatePlan(
        product="IronClaw-Security",
        version="gen1",
        install_root=str(root),
        platform=platform.platform(),
        python_executable=sys.executable,
        target_channel=normalized_channel,
        config_path=str(_default_config_path(root)),
        dry_run=dry_run,
        steps=steps,
        next_steps=next_steps,
    )


def _run_command(command: list[str], cwd: Path) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            command,
            cwd=str(cwd),
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=False,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return False, str(exc)

    output = (completed.stdout or completed.stderr or "").strip()
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        return False, output or f"Command failed with exit code {completed.returncode}"
    return True, output or "ok"


def run_update_command(
    install_root: Path | None = None,
    channel: str = "stable",
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> UpdatePlan:
    plan = build_update_plan(
        install_root=install_root,
        channel=channel,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )

    if not all(step.ok for step in plan.steps):
        return plan

    if dry_run:
        return plan

    root = Path(plan.install_root)
    venv_python = _venv_python(root)

    git_fetch_ok, git_fetch_detail = _run_command(["git", "fetch", "--all", "--tags"], cwd=root)
    git_status_ok, git_status_detail = _run_command(["git", "status", "--short"], cwd=root)
    pip_upgrade_ok, pip_upgrade_detail = _run_command(
        [str(venv_python), "-m", "pip", "install", "--upgrade", "-r", str(_requirements_path(root))],
        cwd=root,
    )

    runtime_steps = [
        UpdateStep(
            name="git-fetch",
            ok=git_fetch_ok,
            detail=git_fetch_detail or "Fetched remote updates.",
            recommendation=None if git_fetch_ok else "Check Git remote access and repository state.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="git-status-cleanliness",
            ok=git_status_ok,
            detail=git_status_detail or "Working tree is clean.",
            recommendation=None if git_status_ok else "Resolve repository state before continuing.",
        ),
        UpdateStep(
            name="dependency-refresh",
            ok=pip_upgrade_ok,
            detail=pip_upgrade_detail or "Dependencies refreshed.",
            recommendation=None if pip_upgrade_ok else "Inspect pip output and fix dependency issues.",
        ),
    ]

    refreshed = build_update_plan(
        install_root=root,
        channel=plan.target_channel,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )
    refreshed.steps.extend(runtime_steps)
    return refreshed


def _render_text(plan: UpdatePlan) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"{plan.product} update plan",
        f"version: {plan.version}",
        f"platform: {plan.platform}",
        f"python: {plan.python_executable}",
        f"install_root: {plan.install_root}",
        f"config_path: {plan.config_path}",
        f"target_channel: {plan.target_channel}",
        f"dry_run: {str(plan.dry_run).lower()}",
        "",
        "steps:",
    ]

    for step in plan.steps:
        status = "OK" if step.ok else "FAIL"
        lines.append(f"- [{status}] {step.name}: {step.detail}")
        if step.recommendation:
            lines.append(f"  recommendation: {step.recommendation}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("next_steps:")
    for item in plan.next_steps:
        lines.append(f"- {item}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def _render_json(plan: UpdatePlan) -> str:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = asdict(plan)
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def build_update_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw-update",
        description="Prepare or execute an update for an IronClaw-Security installation.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--install-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the installation root directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--channel",
        default="stable",
        help="Update channel to target: stable, preview, or dev.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Preview the update plan without applying changes.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Render the update plan as JSON.",
    )
    return parser


def handle_update_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    plan = run_update_command(
        install_root=args.install_root,
        channel=str(args.channel).strip().lower(),
        dry_run=bool(args.dry_run),
    )

    if args.json:
        print(_render_json(plan))
    else:
        print(_render_text(plan))

    return 0 if all(step.ok for step in plan.steps) else 1


def main() -> int:
    parser = build_update_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()
    return handle_update_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
