from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import socket
import sys
from typing import Any


@dataclass(slots=True)
class VerifyCheck:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str
    recommendation: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class VerifyReport:
    product: str
    version: str
    environment: str
    platform: str
    python_executable: str
    install_root: str
    config_path: str
    dry_run: bool
    checks: list[VerifyCheck]
    next_steps: list[str]


def _default_install_root() -> Path:
    home = Path.home()
    system = platform.system().lower()
    if system == "windows":
        return home / "IronClaw-Security"
    return home / ".ironclaw-security"


def _default_config_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "config.json"


def _env_name() -> str:
    return os.getenv("IRONCLAW_ENV", "local")


def _venv_python(root: Path) -> Path:
    if platform.system().lower() == "windows":
        return root / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"
    return root / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"


def _venv_pip(root: Path) -> Path:
    if platform.system().lower() == "windows":
        return root / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "pip.exe"
    return root / ".venv" / "bin" / "pip"


def _requirements_path(root: Path) -> Path:
    return root / "requirements.txt"


def _python_version_check() -> VerifyCheck:
    version = sys.version_info
    ok = (version.major, version.minor) >= (3, 11)
    detail = f"Detected Python {version.major}.{version.minor}.{version.micro}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Use Python 3.11 or newer."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="python-version",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _install_root_check(root: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    ok = root.exists() and root.is_dir()
    detail = f"Install root: {root}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Run install first to create the installation root."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="install-root",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _config_exists_check(config_path: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    ok = config_path.exists() and config_path.is_file()
    detail = f"Config path: {config_path}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Create the configuration file before running verify again."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="config-file",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _config_readable_check(config_path: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    if not config_path.exists():
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="config-readable",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"Config path missing: {config_path}",
            recommendation="Create a readable configuration file.",
        )

    try:
        json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="config-readable",
            ok=True,
            detail=f"Readable JSON configuration: {config_path}",
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="config-readable",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"Unreadable configuration: {config_path} ({exc})",
            recommendation="Fix the configuration file JSON before verifying again.",
        )


def _config_channel_check(config_path: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    if not config_path.exists():
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="config-channel",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"Config path missing: {config_path}",
            recommendation="Create config.json with a valid update channel.",
        )

    try:
        payload = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as exc:
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="config-channel",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"Unable to parse config for channel check: {exc}",
            recommendation="Fix config.json JSON before verifying channel configuration.",
        )

    channel = str(payload.get("channel", "stable")).strip().lower()
    ok = channel in {"stable", "preview", "dev"}
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="config-channel",
        ok=ok,
        detail=f"Configured channel: {channel}",
        recommendation=None if ok else "Use stable, preview, or dev in config.json.",
    )


def _data_directory_check(root: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    data_dir = root / "data"
    ok = data_dir.exists() and data_dir.is_dir()
    detail = f"Data directory: {data_dir}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Create the data directory used by IronClaw-Security."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="data-directory",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _logs_directory_check(root: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    logs_dir = root / "logs"
    ok = logs_dir.exists() and logs_dir.is_dir()
    detail = f"Log directory: {logs_dir}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Create the log directory used by IronClaw-Security."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="log-directory",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _venv_python_check(root: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    path = _venv_python(root)
    ok = path.exists() and path.is_file()
    detail = f"Virtual environment Python: {path}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Create the managed virtual environment before verifying runtime readiness."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="virtualenv-python",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _venv_pip_check(root: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    path = _venv_pip(root)
    ok = path.exists() and path.is_file()
    detail = f"Virtual environment pip: {path}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Ensure pip is installed inside the managed virtual environment."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="virtualenv-pip",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _requirements_file_check(root: Path) -> VerifyCheck:
    path = _requirements_path(root)
    ok = path.exists() and path.is_file()
    detail = f"Requirements file: {path}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Restore requirements.txt so dependency verification can succeed."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="requirements-file",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _git_available_check() -> VerifyCheck:
    git_path = shutil.which("git")
    ok = git_path is not None
    detail = f"Git executable: {git_path or 'not found'}"
    recommendation = None if ok else "Install Git so update and recovery flows work correctly."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="git-available",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _api_key_env_check() -> VerifyCheck:
    candidates = [
        "IRONCLAW_API_KEY",
        "IRONCLAW_INTERNAL_API_KEY",
        "IRONCLAW_PLATFORM_API_KEY",
    ]
    found = [name for name in candidates if os.getenv(name)]
    ok = bool(found)
    detail = "Detected environment keys: " + (", ".join(found) if found else "none")
    recommendation = None if ok else "Set at least one platform API key environment variable."
    return VerifyCheck(
        name="api-key-env",
        ok=ok,
        detail=detail,
        recommendation=recommendation,
    )


def _hostname_check() -> VerifyCheck:
    try:
        hostname = socket.gethostname()
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="hostname",
            ok=bool(hostname),
            detail=f"Hostname: {hostname}",
            recommendation=None if hostname else "Ensure the local hostname is available.",
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        return VerifyCheck(
            name="hostname",
            ok=False,
            detail=f"Unable to resolve hostname ({exc})",
            recommendation="Check basic system networking and hostname configuration.",
        )


def build_verify_report(
    install_root: Path | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> VerifyReport:
    root = (install_root or _default_install_root()).resolve()
    config_path = _default_config_path(root)

    checks = [
        _python_version_check(),
        _install_root_check(root),
        _config_exists_check(config_path),
        _config_readable_check(config_path),
        _config_channel_check(config_path),
        _data_directory_check(root),
        _logs_directory_check(root),
        _venv_python_check(root),
        _venv_pip_check(root),
        _requirements_file_check(root),
        _git_available_check(),
        _api_key_env_check(),
        _hostname_check(),
    ]

    next_steps = [
        "Run the install command if configuration, dependencies, or directories are missing.",
        "Set required environment variables for platform and customer key flows.",
        "Run the update command if the install is present but incomplete.",
        "Start the application and run a protected request after verify succeeds.",
    ]

    return VerifyReport(
        product="IronClaw-Security",
        version="gen1",
        environment=_env_name(),
        platform=platform.platform(),
        python_executable=sys.executable,
        install_root=str(root),
        config_path=str(config_path),
        dry_run=dry_run,
        checks=checks,
        next_steps=next_steps,
    )


def run_verify_command(
    install_root: Path | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = True,
) -> VerifyReport:
    return build_verify_report(
        install_root=install_root,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )


def _render_text(report: VerifyReport) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"{report.product} verification report",
        f"version: {report.version}",
        f"environment: {report.environment}",
        f"platform: {report.platform}",
        f"python: {report.python_executable}",
        f"install_root: {report.install_root}",
        f"config_path: {report.config_path}",
        f"dry_run: {str(report.dry_run).lower()}",
        "",
        "checks:",
    ]

    for check in report.checks:
        status = "OK" if check.ok else "FAIL"
        lines.append(f"- [{status}] {check.name}: {check.detail}")
        if check.recommendation:
            lines.append(f"  recommendation: {check.recommendation}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("next_steps:")
    for step in report.next_steps:
        lines.append(f"- {step}")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def _render_json(report: VerifyReport) -> str:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = asdict(report)
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def build_verify_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclaw-verify",
        description="Verify a local IronClaw-Security installation.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--install-root",
        type=Path,
        default=None,
        help="Optional override for the installation root directory.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Render the verification report without performing any mutating action.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Render the verification report as JSON.",
    )
    return parser


def handle_verify_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    report = run_verify_command(
        install_root=args.install_root,
        dry_run=bool(args.dry_run),
    )

    if args.json:
        print(_render_json(report))
    else:
        print(_render_text(report))

    return 0 if all(check.ok for check in report.checks) else 1


def main() -> int:
    parser = build_verify_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()
    return handle_verify_args(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import uuid
from typing import Any

import requests


API_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8011"


def call_brain_decision(
    *,
    target_type: str,
    target_value: str,
    mode: str = "enforce",
    source: str | None = "cli",
    session_id: str | None = None,
    user_id: str | None = None,
    context: str | None = None,
    use_history: bool = True,
    max_history: int = 20,
    timeout: int = 10,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = {
        "target_type": target_type,
        "target_value": target_value,
        "mode": mode,
        "source": source,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "context": context,
        "use_history": use_history,
        "max_history": max_history,
    }

    resp = requests.post(f"{API_BASE}/brain/decision", json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="IronClaw-Security brain CLI â€” scan text and get a security decision."
    )
    src = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    src.add_argument(
        "--text",
        type=str,
        help="Raw text to scan.",
    )
    src.add_argument(
        "--file",
        type=str,
        help="Path to a text file to scan.",
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--target-type",
        type=str,
        default="text",
        choices=["text"],
        help="Target type. Currently only 'text' is supported in this CLI.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--mode",
        type=str,
        default="enforce",
        choices=["enforce", "monitor", "strict"],
        help="Policy mode for the scan.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--session-id",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Optional session/conversation ID. If omitted, a random one is generated for this run.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--user-id",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Optional user ID.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--context",
        type=str,
        default="cli invocation",
        help="Short description of the context for this scan.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--no-history",
        action="store_true",
        help="Disable history-based reasoning for this decision.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--max-history",
        type=int,
        default=20,
        help="Maximum number of related history items to consider.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Print full JSON response instead of a one-line summary.",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.text is not None:
        target_value = args.text
    else:
        try:
            with open(args.file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                target_value = f.read()
        except OSError as e:
            print(f"Error reading file {args.file}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

    session_id = args.session_id or f"cli-{uuid.uuid4()}"
    user_id = args.user_id or "cli-user"

    try:
        data = call_brain_decision(
            target_type=args.target_type,
            target_value=target_value,
            mode=args.mode,
            source="cli",
            session_id=session_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            context=args.context,
            use_history=not args.no_history,
            max_history=args.max_history,
        )
    except requests.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"HTTP error from IronClaw API: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        if e.response is not None:
            try:
                print(e.response.text, file=sys.stderr)
            except Exception:
                pass
        sys.exit(1)
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error connecting to IronClaw API: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    decision = data.get("decision", {})
    scan = data.get("scan", {})

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
        return

    final_action = decision.get("final_action")
    confidence = decision.get("confidence")
    reason = decision.get("reason", "").strip()
    risk_score = scan.get("risk_score")
    sandbox_lane = scan.get("sandbox_lane")
    matched_patterns = scan.get("matched_patterns") or []

    patterns_str = ",".join(matched_patterns) if matched_patterns else "none"

    print(
        f"ACTION={final_action} "
        f"CONFIDENCE={confidence:.2f} "
        f"RISK_SCORE={risk_score} "
        f"LANE={sandbox_lane} "
        f"PATTERNS={patterns_str}"
    )
    if reason:
        print(f"REASON: {reason}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Literal

import requests
from requests import Response
from requests.exceptions import RequestException, Timeout

Verdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]
TargetType = Literal["text", "url", "githubrepo", "archive"]
ContextType = Literal["user_prompt", "retrieved_doc", "tool_output", "model_output"]
SandboxLane = Literal[
    "none",
    "prompt_injection",
    "code_execution",
    "exfiltration",
    "high_risk_misc",
]

ActionType = Literal[
    "shell_command",
    "file_write",
    "network_request",
    "process_spawn",
]

PolicyMode = Literal["enforce", "review", "observe"]


class IronClawClientError(Exception):
    pass


class IronClawConnectionError(IronClawClientError):
    pass


class IronClawAPIError(IronClawClientError):
    pass


@dataclass
class ScanResult:
    scan_id: str | None
    verdict: Verdict
    summary: str
    target_type: str
    target_value: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    risky_files: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    checks_loaded: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    failed_checks: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    quarantine_reason: str | None = None
    review_status: Literal["none", "pending", "approved", "rejected"] = "none"
    untrusted: bool = False
    sandbox_lane: SandboxLane = "none"
    timestamp: str | None = None
    max_severity: Literal["low", "medium", "high", "critical"] | None = None
    primary_category: str | None = None
    explanation: str | None = None

    @property
    def is_blocked(self) -> bool:
        return self.verdict == "block"

    @property
    def is_quarantined(self) -> bool:
        return self.verdict == "quarantine"

    @property
    def is_warn(self) -> bool:
        return self.verdict == "warn"

    @property
    def is_allow(self) -> bool:
        return self.verdict == "allow"


@dataclass

    verdict: Verdict

    summary: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: list[str]

    effective_text: str

class IronClawClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:8010",
        timeout: int = 20,
    ) -> None:
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout = timeout

    def _build_url(self, path: str) -> str:
        return f"{self.base_url}{path}"

    def _handle_response(self, response: Response) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            response.raise_for_status()
        except RequestException as exc:
            body = response.text.strip()
            detail = f"HTTP {response.status_code}"
            if body:
                detail = f"{detail}: {body}"
            raise IronClawAPIError(detail) from exc

        try:
            return response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise IronClawAPIError("API returned a non-JSON response.") from exc

    def _post(self, path: str, json_body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        url = self._build_url(path)

        try:
            response = requests.post(url, json=json_body, timeout=self.timeout)
        except Timeout as exc:
            raise IronClawConnectionError(
                f"Request to {url} timed out after {self.timeout} seconds."
            ) from exc
        except RequestException as exc:
            raise IronClawConnectionError(f"Could not connect to {url}: {exc}") from exc

        return self._handle_response(response)

    def _get(self, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        url = self._build_url(path)

        try:
            response = requests.get(url, timeout=self.timeout)
        except Timeout as exc:
            raise IronClawConnectionError(
                f"Request to {url} timed out after {self.timeout} seconds."
            ) from exc
        except RequestException as exc:
            raise IronClawConnectionError(f"Could not connect to {url}: {exc}") from exc

        return self._handle_response(response)

    # Basic health & scan -------------------------------------------------

    def health(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._get("/health")

    def scan(
        self,
        target_type: TargetType,
        target_value: str,
    ) -> ScanResult:
        data = self._post(
            "/scan",
            {
                "target_type": target_type,
                "target_value": target_value,
            },
        )

        return ScanResult(
            scan_id=data.get("scan_id"),
            verdict=data["verdict"],
            summary=data["summary"],
            target_type=data["target_type"],
            target_value=data["target_value"],
            risk_score=data["risk_score"],
            matched_patterns=data.get("matched_patterns", []),
            risky_files=data.get("risky_files", []),
            checks_loaded=data.get("checks_loaded", []),
            failed_checks=data.get("failed_checks", []),
            quarantine_reason=data.get("quarantine_reason"),
            review_status=data.get("review_status", "none"),
            untrusted=data.get("untrusted", False),
            sandbox_lane=data.get("sandbox_lane", "none"),
            timestamp=data.get("timestamp"),
            max_severity=data.get("max_severity"),
            primary_category=data.get("primary_category"),
            explanation=data.get("explanation"),
        )

    # Prompt guard --------------------------------------------------------

    def guard_prompt_bundle(
        self,
        user_prompt: str | None = None,
        retrieved_doc: str | None = None,
        tool_output: str | None = None,
        model_output: str | None = None,
    ) -> PromptGuardResult:
        data = self._post(
            "/guard/prompt-bundle",
            {
                "user_prompt": user_prompt,
                "retrieved_doc": retrieved_doc,
                "tool_output": tool_output,
                "model_output": model_output,
            },
        )

        def _make_guarded(item: dict[str, Any] | None) -> GuardedText | None:
            if item is None:
                return None

            return GuardedText(
                context_type=item["context_type"],
                verdict=item["verdict"],
                scan_id=item.get("scan_id"),
                summary=item["summary"],
                risk_score=item["risk_score"],
                matched_patterns=item["matched_patterns"],
                original_text=item["original_text"],
                effective_text=item["effective_text"],
                should_halt=item["should_halt"],
                should_warn=item["should_warn"],
            )

        return PromptGuardResult(
            user_prompt=_make_guarded(data.get("user_prompt")),
            retrieved_doc=_make_guarded(data.get("retrieved_doc")),
            tool_output=_make_guarded(data.get("tool_output")),
            model_output=_make_guarded(data.get("model_output")),
            highest_verdict=data["highest_verdict"],
            should_halt=data["should_halt"],
            should_warn=data["should_warn"],
        )

    # Action guard: scan --------------------------------------------------

    def guard_action(
        self,
        action_type: ActionType,
        target: str | None,
        content: str | None,
        client_id: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> GuardActionResult:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "action_type": action_type,
            "target": target,
            "content": content,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "session_id": session_id,
        }
        data = self._post("/guard/action", payload)

        return GuardActionResult(
            action_type=data["action_type"],
            target=data.get("target"),
            content=data.get("content"),
            verdict=data["verdict"],
            summary=data["summary"],
            risk_score=data["risk_score"],
            matched_patterns=data.get("matched_patterns", []),
            should_halt=data.get("should_halt", False),
            should_warn=data.get("should_warn", False),
            client_id=data.get("client_id"),
            session_id=data.get("session_id"),
        )

    # Action policy -------------------------------------------------------

    def guard_action_policy(
        self,
        action_type: ActionType,
        target: str | None,
        content: str | None,
        client_id: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> GuardActionPolicyResult:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "action_type": action_type,
            "target": target,
            "content": content,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "session_id": session_id,
        }
        data = self._post("/guard/action-policy", payload)

        return GuardActionPolicyResult(
            action_type=data["action_type"],
            target=data.get("target"),
            policy_mode=data["policy_mode"],
            verdict=data["verdict"],
            summary=data["summary"],
            should_halt=data["should_halt"],
            should_warn=data["should_warn"],
            client_id=data.get("client_id"),
            session_id=data.get("session_id"),
        )

    # Action decision (scan + policy â†’ final) -----------------------------

    def guard_action_decision(
        self,
        action_type: ActionType,
        target: str | None,
        content: str | None,
        client_id: str | None = None,
        session_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> GuardActionDecisionResult:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "action_type": action_type,
            "target": target,
            "content": content,
            "client_id": client_id,
            "session_id": session_id,
        }
        data = self._post("/guard/action-decision", payload)

        return GuardActionDecisionResult(
            action_type=data["action_type"],
            target=data.get("target"),
            policy_mode=data["policy_mode"],
            verdict=data["verdict"],
            decision_source=data["decision_source"],
            summary=data["summary"],
            risk_score=data["risk_score"],
            matched_patterns=data.get("matched_patterns", []),
            should_halt=data.get("should_halt", False),
            should_warn=data.get("should_warn", False),
            client_id=data.get("client_id"),
            session_id=data.get("session_id"),
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    client = IronClawClient()

    try:
        health = client.health()
        print(f"[health] {health}")

        # Demo: text scan
        result = client.scan(

    except IronClawClientError as exc:

import asyncio
import inspect

import pytest


def pytest_pyfunc_call(pyfuncitem: pytest.Function) -> bool | None:
    testfunction = pyfuncitem.obj
    if not inspect.iscoroutinefunction(testfunction):
        return None

    kwargs = {
        name: pyfuncitem.funcargs[name]
        for name in pyfuncitem._fixtureinfo.argnames
        if name in pyfuncitem.funcargs
    }
    asyncio.run(testfunction(**kwargs))
    return True

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Iterable, Literal


KeyScope = Literal["internal", "customer", "service"]
KeyStatus = Literal["active", "revoked"]


def utc_now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def hash_api_key(raw_key: str) -> str:
    if not raw_key or not raw_key.strip():
        raise ValueError("raw_key is required")
    return hashlib.sha256(raw_key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def mask_api_key(raw_key: str) -> str:
    if not raw_key:
        return ""
    if len(raw_key) <= 8:
        return "*" * len(raw_key)
    return f"{raw_key[:4]}...{raw_key[-4:]}"


def build_api_key(prefix: str = "ic") -> str:
    normalized_prefix = (prefix or "ic").strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32).replace("-", "").replace("_", "")
    return f"{normalized_prefix}_{token}"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ApiKeyRecord:
    key_id: str
    name: str
    key_prefix: str
    key_hint: str
    key_hash: str
    scope: KeyScope
    status: KeyStatus = "active"
    owner_id: str | None = None
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""
    last_used_at: str | None = None
    revoked_at: str | None = None

    def is_active(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == "active"


class ApiKeyRegistry:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._records_by_id: dict[str, ApiKeyRecord] = {}

    def create_key(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        scope: KeyScope = "customer",
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        prefix: str = "ic",
    ) -> tuple[ApiKeyRecord, str]:
        normalized_name = name.strip()
        if not normalized_name:
            raise ValueError("name is required")

        raw_key = build_api_key(prefix=prefix)
        now = utc_now_iso()
        record = ApiKeyRecord(
            key_id=secrets.token_hex(12),
            name=normalized_name,
            key_prefix=raw_key.split("_", 1)[0],
            key_hint=mask_api_key(raw_key),
            key_hash=hash_api_key(raw_key),
            scope=scope,
            owner_id=owner_id,
            created_at=now,
            updated_at=now,
        )
        self._records_by_id[record.key_id] = record
        return record, raw_key

    def list_keys(
        self,
        *,
        owner_id: str | None = None,
        scope: KeyScope | None = None,
        status: KeyStatus | None = None,
    ) -> list[ApiKeyRecord]:
        records: Iterable[ApiKeyRecord] = self._records_by_id.values()

        if owner_id is not None:
            records = [r for r in records if r.owner_id == owner_id]
        if scope is not None:
            records = [r for r in records if r.scope == scope]
        if status is not None:
            records = [r for r in records if r.status == status]

        return sorted(records, key=lambda r: (r.created_at, r.key_id), reverse=True)

    def get_key(self, key_id: str) -> ApiKeyRecord | None:
        return self._records_by_id.get(key_id)

    def authenticate(self, raw_key: str) -> ApiKeyRecord | None:
        key_hash = hash_api_key(raw_key)
        for record in self._records_by_id.values():
            if record.key_hash == key_hash and record.status == "active":
                record.last_used_at = utc_now_iso()
                record.updated_at = record.last_used_at
                return record
        return None

    def revoke_key(self, key_id: str) -> ApiKeyRecord:
        record = self._records_by_id.get(key_id)
        if record is None:
            raise KeyError(f"API key not found: {key_id}")
        if record.status == "revoked":
            return record

        now = utc_now_iso()
        record.status = "revoked"
        record.revoked_at = now
        record.updated_at = now
        return record

    def rotate_key(self, key_id: str, *, prefix: str = "ic") -> tuple[ApiKeyRecord, str]:
        record = self._records_by_id.get(key_id)
        if record is None:
            raise KeyError(f"API key not found: {key_id}")
        if record.status != "active":
            raise ValueError("only active API keys can be rotated")

        raw_key = build_api_key(prefix=prefix)
        now = utc_now_iso()
        record.key_prefix = raw_key.split("_", 1)[0]
        record.key_hint = mask_api_key(raw_key)
        record.key_hash = hash_api_key(raw_key)
        record.updated_at = now
        record.last_used_at = None
        return record, raw_key


registry = ApiKeyRegistry()


def create_internal_platform_key(name: str = "IronClaw-Security") -> tuple[ApiKeyRecord, str]:
    return registry.create_key(
        name=name,
        scope="internal",
        owner_id="ironclaw-system",
        prefix="ironclaw",
    )


def create_customer_api_key(
    *,
    name: str,
    owner_id: str,
) -> tuple[ApiKeyRecord, str]:
    return registry.create_key(
        name=name,
        scope="customer",
        owner_id=owner_id,
        prefix="icpk",
    )

FILE: core\auth.py

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal

from fastapi import Header, HTTPException, Request, status

from core.apikeys import ApiKeyRecord, registry
from core.settings import get_settings


PrincipalType = Literal["system", "customer", "service"]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class AuthPrincipal:
    subject: str
    principal_type: PrincipalType
    key_id: str
    key_name: str
    scope: str
    is_authenticated: bool = True


def _unauthorized(detail: str) -> HTTPException:
    return HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail=detail,
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )


def _forbidden(detail: str) -> HTTPException:
    return HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
        detail=detail,
    )


def _normalize_scope(scope: str | None) -> str:
    value = (scope or "").strip().lower()
    if not value:
        return "customer"
    return value


def _principal_type_from_scope(scope: str) -> PrincipalType:
    normalized = _normalize_scope(scope)
    if normalized in {"internal", "system", "platform", "admin"}:
        return "system"
    if normalized in {"service", "integration"}:
        return "service"
    return "customer"


def parse_bearer_token(authorization: str | None) -> str | None:
    if authorization is None:
        return None

    value = authorization.strip()
    if not value:
        return None

    scheme, _, token = value.partition(" ")
    if scheme.lower() != "bearer":
        return None

    token = token.strip()
    if not token:
        return None

    return token


def _configured_platform_api_key(request: Request | None = None) -> str | None:
    try:
        settings = get_settings()
    except Exception:
        settings = None

    candidate_names = (
        "internal_api_key",
        "platform_api_key",
        "ironclaw_api_key",
        "api_key",
    )

    if settings is not None:
        for name in candidate_names:
            value = getattr(settings, name, None)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return value.strip()

    if request is not None:
        app_settings = getattr(getattr(request, "app", None), "state", None)
        app_settings = getattr(app_settings, "settings", None)
        if app_settings is not None:
            for name in candidate_names:
                value = getattr(app_settings, name, None)
                if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                    return value.strip()

    return None


def _match_configured_platform_key(candidate: str, request: Request | None = None) -> AuthPrincipal | None:
    configured_key = _configured_platform_api_key(request)
    if not configured_key or candidate != configured_key:
        return None

    return AuthPrincipal(
        subject="ironclaw-platform",
        principal_type="system",
        key_id="internal-platform-key",
        key_name="Internal Platform API Key",
        scope="internal",
        is_authenticated=True,
    )


def get_api_key_record(raw_api_key: str, request: Request | None = None) -> ApiKeyRecord:
    candidate = raw_api_key.strip() if raw_api_key else ""
    if not candidate:
        raise _unauthorized("Missing API key")

    record = registry.authenticate(candidate)
    if record is None:
        platform_principal = _match_configured_platform_key(candidate, request)
        if platform_principal is not None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail="Configured platform key should be resolved through principal authentication, not record lookup.",
            )
        raise _unauthorized("Invalid API key")

    return record


def authenticate_api_key(raw_api_key: str, request: Request | None = None) -> AuthPrincipal:
    candidate = raw_api_key.strip() if raw_api_key else ""
    if not candidate:
        raise _unauthorized("Missing API key")

    platform_principal = _match_configured_platform_key(candidate, request)
    if platform_principal is not None:
        return platform_principal

    record = get_api_key_record(candidate, request)

    return AuthPrincipal(
        subject=record.owner_id or record.key_id,
        principal_type=_principal_type_from_scope(record.scope),
        key_id=record.key_id,
        key_name=record.name,
        scope=_normalize_scope(record.scope),
        is_authenticated=True,
    )


def resolve_api_key(
    request: Request,
    x_api_key: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-API-Key"),
    authorization: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"),
) -> AuthPrincipal:
    bearer_token = parse_bearer_token(authorization)
    candidate = x_api_key or bearer_token
    return authenticate_api_key(candidate or "", request)


def require_scope(principal: AuthPrincipal, *allowed_scopes: str) -> AuthPrincipal:
    normalized_allowed = {_normalize_scope(scope) for scope in allowed_scopes if scope}
    principal_scope = _normalize_scope(principal.scope)

    if normalized_allowed and principal_scope not in normalized_allowed:
        raise _forbidden("Insufficient scope")

    return principal

# Claude Code â†” IronClaw Guard Client
#
# This document describes how to wire Claude Code (or any Claude-based
# proxy/tooling) through IronClaw-Security as a frontâ€‘line security guard.

## 1. Prerequisites

Before wiring Claude Code to IronClaw, you need:

- A running IronClaw-Security deployment, reachable from your Claude Code proxy.
- An IronClaw API key with permission to call guard and policy routes.
- The `claude_bootstrap` API enabled (mounted under `/claude/bootstrap`).
- The Python client available in your proxy/tooling environment:
  - `app/clients/claude_guard_client.py`
  - `httpx` installed (`pip install httpx`)

## 2. Generate oneâ€‘command config from IronClaw

Use the Claude bootstrap endpoint to generate Claudeâ€‘specific guard config
and a readyâ€‘toâ€‘paste shell snippet.

### Request

```bash
curl -X POST "$IRONCLAW_BASE_URL/claude/bootstrap" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $IRONCLAW_OPERATOR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "platform": "claude-code",
    "display_name": "My Claude Workspace",
    "base_guard_url": "'"$IRONCLAW_BASE_URL"'",
    "guard_mode": "enforce",
    "default_timeout_ms": 8000,
    "max_payload_kb": 256
  }'
```

### Response (shape)

```json
{
  "generated_at": "2026-04-21T18:50:00.000000+00:00",
  "platform": "claude-code",
  "workspace_name": "My Claude Workspace",
  "client_config": {
    "guard_base_url": "https://ironclaw.company.com",
    "api_key": "******",
    "guard_mode": "enforce",
    "default_timeout_ms": 8000,
    "max_payload_kb": 256,
    "use_bundle_guard": true,
    "use_guard_execute": true
  },
  "one_command_snippet": "export IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL=...\n...",
  "notes": [
    "Configure Claude Code's proxy to send all external tool calls through /guard/execute.",
    "Send combined prompt/context/model output bundles to /policy/guard-bundle before showing them to the user.",
    "Always include X-API-Key using the value from IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY.",
    "Use IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE to decide whether to enforce blocks or only warn in the UI."
  ]
}
```

### Apply the oneâ€‘command snippet

Copy `one_command_snippet` and run it in the environment where your
Claude Code proxy/tooling process runs, for example:

```bash
# Example (do not paste literally; use the snippet from the API)
export IRONCLAW_GUARD_BASE_URL="https://ironclaw.company.com"
export IRONCLAW_GUARD_API_KEY="your-ironclaw-api-key"
export IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE="enforce"
export IRONCLAW_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS="8000"
export IRONCLAW_GUARD_MAX_PAYLOAD_KB="256"
export IRONCLAW_WORKSPACE_NAME="My Claude Workspace"
```

## 3. Initialize the guard client in your proxy

In the process that proxies Claude Codeâ€™s network/tool calls, create
a `ClaudeGuardClient` from environment variables:

```python
# app/proxy/guard_integration.py

from app.clients.claude_guard_client import ClaudeGuardClient, ClaudeGuardClientConfig

_guard_client: ClaudeGuardClient | None = None


def get_guard_client() -> ClaudeGuardClient:
    global _guard_client
    if _guard_client is None:
        config = ClaudeGuardClientConfig.from_env()
        _guard_client = ClaudeGuardClient(config=config)
    return _guard_client
```

Ensure this module is imported once at proxy startup so the client is ready.

## 4. Guarding tool / action executions

Wrap external actions (HTTP calls, shell tools, DB queries, etc.) that
Claude Code wants to perform with `guard_execute`.

### Example: guarding a tool call

```python
from typing import Any, Dict

from app.proxy.guard_integration import get_guard_client


def execute_tool_with_guard(tool_name: str, args: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
    guard = get_guard_client()

    # Build an ExecuteRequest-style payload compatible with /guard/execute.
    guard_payload = {
        "action_type": "toolcall",
        "target": tool_name,
        "content": args,
        "client_id": args.get("client_id"),
        "session_id": args.get("session_id"),
    }

    verdict = guard.guard_execute(guard_payload)

    # Expected high-level shape:
    # {
    #   "policy_verdict": "allow" | "review" | "block",
    #   "should_execute": true/false,
    #   "halted_by_boundary": true/false,
    #   "reason": "..."
    # }

    if not verdict.get("should_execute", False):
        # Blocked or queued for review â€“ DO NOT execute the tool.
        # Surface a safe message back into Claude Code instead.
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Guard blocked tool '{tool_name}': {verdict.get('reason', 'no reason provided')}"
        )

    # Safe to execute â€“ run the actual tool now.
    return perform_tool_call(tool_name, args)
```

`perform_tool_call` is your existing implementation that actually
invokes the tool. IronClaw never runs the tool itself; it only decides.

## 5. Guarding prompt/output bundles before user display

Before showing any combined AI output to the user, send a bundle to
`/policy/guard-bundle` via `guard_bundle`.

### Example: guarding a response bundle

```python
from typing import Any, Dict

from app.proxy.guard_integration import get_guard_client


def guard_and_render_response(
    user_prompt: str,
    retrieved_docs: list[str] | None,
    tool_outputs: list[Dict[str, Any]] | None,
    model_output: str,
) -> str:
    guard = get_guard_client()

    bundle = {
        "userprompt": user_prompt,
        "retrieveddoc": "\n\n".join(retrieved_docs or []),
        "tooloutput": tool_outputs or [],
        "modeloutput": model_output,
    }

    verdict = guard.guard_bundle(bundle)

    # Expected high-level shape:
    # {
    #   "bundle_verdict": "allow" | "warn" | "quarantine" | "block",
    #   "reason": "..."
    # }

    bundle_verdict = verdict.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")
    reason = verdict.get("reason", "")

    if bundle_verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
        # Replace unsafe content with a safe explanation.
        return (
            "âš ï¸ Response blocked by IronClaw security guard.\n\n"
            f"Reason: {reason or 'high-risk content detected.'}"
        )

    if bundle_verdict == "warn":
        # Optionally annotate the response with a warning banner.
        return (
            "âš ï¸ IronClaw detected potentially risky content. Review carefully.\n\n"
            + model_output
        )

    # bundle_verdict == "allow"
    return model_output
```

Claude Code never sees the raw model output until IronClaw approves or
annotates it, which helps block prompt injections and unsafe content
before it reaches the user.

## 6. Mapping guard modes in Claude Code

Respect `IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE` in your proxy logic:

- `enforce`:
  - Block / quarantine results as shown above.
  - Throw errors or surface warnings in the editor when an action is blocked.
- `assist`:
  - Always return content but annotate warnings instead of hard blocking.
  - Useful during rollout or for less trusted projects.
- `dryrun`:
  - Call the guard endpoints and log results.
  - Never block; use this mode for evaluation in nonâ€‘prod environments.

### Example mode-sensitive handling

```python
import os

from app.proxy.guard_integration import get_guard_client

GUARD_MODE = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE", "enforce").lower()


def guard_and_maybe_block(model_output: str, bundle: dict) -> str:
    guard = get_guard_client()
    verdict = guard.guard_bundle(bundle)
    bundle_verdict = verdict.get("bundle_verdict", "allow")
    reason = verdict.get("reason", "")

    if GUARD_MODE == "dryrun":
        # Log only; never block.
        log_guard_verdict(bundle_verdict, reason)
        return model_output

    if GUARD_MODE == "assist":
        if bundle_verdict in {"block", "quarantine", "warn"}:
            log_guard_verdict(bundle_verdict, reason)
            return (
                "âš ï¸ IronClaw flagged this response as potentially unsafe.\n\n"
                f"Reason: {reason or 'review recommended.'}\n\n"
                + model_output
            )
        return model_output

    # GUARD_MODE == "enforce"
    if bundle_verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}:
        log_guard_verdict(bundle_verdict, reason)
        return (
            "âš ï¸ Response blocked by IronClaw security guard.\n\n"
            f"Reason: {reason or 'high-risk content detected.'}"
        )

    if bundle_verdict == "warn":
        log_guard_verdict(bundle_verdict, reason)
        return (
            "âš ï¸ IronClaw warns this response may be unsafe.\n\n"
            + model_output
        )

    return model_output
```

## 7. Shutdown handling

If your proxy process manages its own lifecycle, close the guard client
gracefully on shutdown:

```python
from app.proxy.guard_integration import _guard_client  # or expose a getter/closer


def on_shutdown() -> None:
    if _guard_client is not None:
        _guard_client.close()
```

## 8. Summary

- Use `/claude/bootstrap` once to generate env + config for a Claude Code workspace.
- Export the env vars (`IRONCLAW_GUARD_*`) into your Claude proxy environment.
- Initialize `ClaudeGuardClientConfig.from_env()` and `ClaudeGuardClient`.
- Guard external actions via `guard_execute`.
- Guard combined prompt/output bundles via `guard_bundle` before displaying
  anything to the user.
- Respect `IRONCLAW_GUARD_MODE` to control enforce/assist/dryrun behavior.

This keeps Claude Code flexible while ensuring IronClaw remains the
frontâ€‘line security boundary for all agent actions and outputs.

                        "summary": "No release policy decision recorded yet",
                        "value": RELEASE_POLICY_LATEST_DECISION_EMPTY_RESPONSE_EXAMPLE,
                    },
                }
            }
        },
    },
    404: {
        "description": "Requested release policy was not found.",
    },
}

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final

PROJECT_ROOT: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

from ironclawclient import IronClawClient, IronClawClientError


DEFAULT_BASE_URL: Final[str] = os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000").rstrip("/")
DEFAULT_BACKUP_TARGET: Final[str] = os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BACKUP_TARGET_NAME", "primary")
DEFAULT_RESTORE_TARGET: Final[str] = os.getenv("IRONCLAW_RESTORE_TARGET_NAME", DEFAULT_BACKUP_TARGET)


def _pretty_print(title: str, payload: Any) -> None:
    print(f"\n=== {title} ===")
    print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))


def _print_step(message: str) -> None:
    print(f"[quickstart] {message}")


def _run_health_demo(client: IronClawClient) -> None:
    _print_step("Checking health surfaces")
    _pretty_print("health", client.health())
    _pretty_print("health_liveness", client.health_liveness())
    _pretty_print("health_readiness", client.health_readiness())
    _pretty_print("system_status", client.system_status())


def _run_ui_demo(client: IronClawClient) -> None:
    _print_step("Checking UI/runtime surfaces")
    _pretty_print("ui_manifest", client.ui_manifest())
    _pretty_print("ui_status", client.ui_status())
    _pretty_print("ui_runtime_status", client.ui_runtime_status())


def _run_backup_demo(client: IronClawClient, target_name: str) -> None:
    _print_step(f"Checking backup surfaces for target={target_name!r}")
    _pretty_print("backup_status", client.backup_status())
    _pretty_print("backup_targets", client.backup_targets())

    try:
        _pretty_print("backup_snapshot", client.backup_snapshot(target_name))
    except IronClawClientError as exc:
        _print_step(f"backup_snapshot unavailable: {exc}")

    try:
        _pretty_print("backup_export", client.backup_export(target_name))
    except IronClawClientError as exc:
        _print_step(f"backup_export unavailable: {exc}")

    try:
        _pretty_print("backup_rotate", client.backup_rotate(target_name))
    except IronClawClientError as exc:
        _print_step(f"backup_rotate unavailable: {exc}")


def _run_restore_demo(client: IronClawClient, target_name: str, *, dry_run: bool) -> None:
    _print_step(f"Checking restore surfaces for target={target_name!r}, dry_run={dry_run}")
    _pretty_print("restore_status", client.restore_status())
    _pretty_print("restore_targets", client.restore_targets())

    try:
        _pretty_print("restore_validate", client.restore_validate(target_name))
    except IronClawClientError as exc:
        _print_step(f"restore_validate unavailable: {exc}")

    try:
        _pretty_print("restore_run", client.restore_run(target_name, dry_run=dry_run))
    except IronClawClientError as exc:
        _print_step(f"restore_run unavailable: {exc}")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="IronClaw quickstart runner for health, UI, backup, and restore examples."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--base-url",
        default=DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        help=f"Base URL for the IronClaw API, default: {DEFAULT_BASE_URL}",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--timeout",
        type=float,
        default=10.0,
        help="Client timeout in seconds.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--backup-target",
        default=DEFAULT_BACKUP_TARGET,
        help=f"Backup target name, default: {DEFAULT_BACKUP_TARGET}",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--restore-target",
        default=DEFAULT_RESTORE_TARGET,
        help=f"Restore target name, default: {DEFAULT_RESTORE_TARGET}",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skip-ui",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip UI/runtime endpoint examples.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skip-backup",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip backup endpoint examples.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skip-restore",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip restore endpoint examples.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--execute-restore",
        action="store_true",
        help="Allow restore execution example with dry_run=False.",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if args.timeout <= 0:
        parser.error("--timeout must be greater than 0")

    _print_step(f"Connecting to IronClaw at {args.base_url}")

    try:
        with IronClawClient(base_url=args.base_url, timeout=args.timeout) as client:
            _run_health_demo(client)

            if not args.skip_ui:
                _run_ui_demo(client)

            if not args.skip_backup:
                _run_backup_demo(client, args.backup_target)

            if not args.skip_restore:
                _run_restore_demo(
                    client,
                    args.restore_target,
                    dry_run=not args.execute_restore,
                )

    except IronClawClientError as exc:
        print(f"[quickstart] failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    _print_step("Quickstart completed successfully")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

================================================================================
FILE: hooks\ironclaw_hook.py

import json
import sys
from urllib import request

IRONCLAW_SCAN_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/scan/"
IRONCLAW_POLICY_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/policy/guard-bundle"


def read_stdin():
    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not raw:
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return {"raw_input": raw}


def extract_text(payload):
    parts = []

    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        session_id = payload.get("session_id")
        if session_id:
            parts.append(f"session_id={session_id}")

        prompt = payload.get("prompt")
        if isinstance(prompt, str):
            parts.append(prompt)

        tool_name = payload.get("tool_name")
        if isinstance(tool_name, str):
            parts.append(f"tool_name={tool_name}")

        tool_input = payload.get("tool_input")
        if isinstance(tool_input, (dict, list)):
            parts.append(json.dumps(tool_input, ensure_ascii=False))
        elif isinstance(tool_input, str):
            parts.append(tool_input)

        for key in ("raw_input", "input", "query", "command"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                parts.append(value)

    return "\n".join(parts).strip()


def build_prompt_bundle(payload):
    """
    Build a minimal prompt bundle from the hook payload.

    We keep this conservative:
    - user_prompt: main user message / prompt
    - retrieved_doc: reserved (unused here, but kept for structure)
    - tool_output: any prior tool result if available
    - model_output: not available at this stage, so None
    """
    user_prompt = None
    retrieved_doc = None
    tool_output = None
    model_output = None

    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        # Primary user text
        if isinstance(payload.get("prompt"), str):
            user_prompt = payload["prompt"]
        elif isinstance(payload.get("input"), str):
            user_prompt = payload["input"]
        elif isinstance(payload.get("query"), str):
            user_prompt = payload["query"]
        elif isinstance(payload.get("command"), str):
            user_prompt = payload["command"]

        # Tool output, if present in a generic field
        if isinstance(payload.get("tool_output"), str):
            tool_output = payload["tool_output"]
        elif isinstance(payload.get("previous_response"), str):
            tool_output = payload["previous_response"]

        # retrieved_doc left as None in this generic hook

    bundle = {}
    if user_prompt is not None:
        bundle["user_prompt"] = user_prompt
    if retrieved_doc is not None:
        bundle["retrieved_doc"] = retrieved_doc
    if tool_output is not None:
        bundle["tool_output"] = tool_output
    if model_output is not None:
        bundle["model_output"] = model_output

    return bundle


def http_post_json(url, payload, timeout=5):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    req = request.Request(
        url,
        data=body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    with request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))


def policy_guard_bundle(bundle):
    """
    Call /policy/guard-bundle with the constructed bundle.
    """
    if not bundle:
        return {
            "highest_verdict": "allow",
            "should_halt": False,
            "should_warn": False,
        }

    return http_post_json(IRONCLAW_POLICY_URL, bundle)


def scan_text(text):
    """
    Legacy single-text scan, kept as a fallback.
    """
    payload = {"target_type": "text", "target_value": text}
    return http_post_json(IRONCLAW_SCAN_URL, payload)


def main():
    payload = read_stdin()
    text = extract_text(payload)

    # If we have nothing, just continue
    if not text and not payload:
        print(json.dumps({"continue": True}))
        return

    # First try the bundle-based guard
    try:
        bundle = build_prompt_bundle(payload)
        policy_result = policy_guard_bundle(bundle)
    except Exception as e:
        # If policy endpoint is unavailable, fall back to previous behavior
        try:
            result = scan_text(text or "")
        except Exception as scan_err:
            print(json.dumps({
                "continue": True,
                "suppressOutput": False,
                "decision_reason": f"IronClaw unavailable: {e}; fallback scan error: {scan_err}",
            }))
            return
        verdict = result.get("verdict", "allow")
        summary = result.get("summary", "")
        matched = result.get("matched_patterns", [])
        if verdict == "block":
            print(json.dumps({
                "continue": False,
                "suppressOutput": False,
                "stopReason": f"IronClaw blocked this action. {summary} Matched: {matched}",
            }))
            return
        print(json.dumps({
            "continue": True,
            "suppressOutput": False,
            "decision_reason": f"IronClaw verdict={verdict}. {summary}",
        }))
        return

    highest_verdict = policy_result.get("highest_verdict", "block")
    should_halt = policy_result.get("should_halt", True)
    should_warn = policy_result.get("should_warn", True)

    # Try to surface the most relevant summary
    user_ctx = (policy_result.get("user_prompt") or {})
    model_ctx = (policy_result.get("model_output") or {})
    summary = (
        user_ctx.get("summary")
        or model_ctx.get("summary")
        or f"Bundle verdict={highest_verdict}"
    )

    if should_halt or highest_verdict in ("block", "quarantine"):
        print(json.dumps({
            "continue": False,
            "suppressOutput": False,
            "stopReason": f"IronClaw policy halted bundle. {summary}",
        }))
        return

    # Allowed, but possibly warn
    decision_reason = f"IronClaw bundle verdict={highest_verdict}. {summary}"
    if should_warn:
        decision_reason = "[WARN] " + decision_reason

    print(json.dumps({
        "continue": True,
        "suppressOutput": False,
        "decision_reason": decision_reason,
    }))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

================================================================================
FILE: ironclaw_client.py
================================================================================
import os
from typing import Literal, TypedDict, List

import httpx


Verdict = Literal["allow", "warn", "quarantine", "block"]


class ScanResult(TypedDict):
    scan_id: str | None
    verdict: Verdict
    summary: str
    target_type: str
    target_value: str
    risk_score: int
    matched_patterns: List[str]
    risky_files: List[str]
    checks_loaded: List[str]
    failed_checks: List[str]
    quarantine_reason: str | None
    review_status: str | None
    untrusted: bool


class PromptBundleResult(TypedDict, total=False):
    user_prompt: dict
    retrieved_doc: dict
    tool_output: dict
    model_output: dict
    highest_verdict: Verdict
    should_halt: bool
    should_warn: bool


class IronclawClient:
    def __init__(self, base_url: str | None = None, timeout: float = 5.0):
        self.base_url = base_url or os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8000")
        self.timeout = timeout

    def scan_text(self, text: str) -> ScanResult:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/scan/"
        payload = {"target_type": "text", "target_value": text}
        with httpx.Client(timeout=self.timeout) as client:
            resp = client.post(url, json=payload)
            resp.raise_for_status()
            data = resp.json()
        return {
            "scan_id": data.get("scan_id"),
            "verdict": data.get("verdict", "block"),
            "summary": data.get("summary", ""),
            "target_type": data.get("target_type", "text"),
            "target_value": data.get("target_value", text),
            "risk_score": data.get("risk_score", 0),
            "matched_patterns": data.get("matched_patterns", []),
            "risky_files": data.get("risky_files", []),
            "checks_loaded": data.get("checks_loaded", []),
            "failed_checks": data.get("failed_checks", []),
            "quarantine_reason": data.get("quarantine_reason"),
            "review_status": data.get("review_status", "none"),
            "untrusted": data.get("untrusted", False),
        }

    def guard_prompt_bundle(
        self,
        user_prompt: str | None = None,
        retrieved_doc: str | None = None,
        tool_output: str | None = None,
        model_output: str | None = None,
    ) -> PromptBundleResult:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/policy/guard-bundle"
        payload = {
            "user_prompt": user_prompt,
            "retrieved_doc": retrieved_doc,
            "tool_output": tool_output,
            "model_output": model_output,
        }
        clean_payload = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if v is not None}

        with httpx.Client(timeout=self.timeout) as client:
            resp = client.post(url, json=clean_payload)
            resp.raise_for_status()
            data = resp.json()

        highest_verdict: Verdict = data.get("highest_verdict", "block")
        should_halt: bool = data.get("should_halt", True)

        if should_halt:
            # Prefer the user_prompt summary; fall back to model_output or generic
            user_ctx = data.get("user_prompt") or {}
            model_ctx = data.get("model_output") or {}
            summary = (
                user_ctx.get("summary")
                or model_ctx.get("summary")
                or "No summary provided."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"IronClaw policy halted bundle with verdict={highest_verdict!r}: {summary}"
            )

        return {
            "user_prompt": data.get("user_prompt", {}),
            "retrieved_doc": data.get("retrieved_doc", {}),
            "tool_output": data.get("tool_output", {}),
            "model_output": data.get("model_output", {}),
            "highest_verdict": highest_verdict,
            "should_halt": should_halt,
            "should_warn": data.get("should_warn", True),
        }

================================================================================
FILE: ironclaw_installer.py
