from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final

from dotenv import load_dotenv


DEFAULT_BASE_URL: Final[str] = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final[float] = 10.0
DEFAULT_POLICY_MODE: Final[str] = "review"
DEFAULT_CONFIG_DIRNAME: Final[str] = ".ironclaw"
DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME: Final[str] = "config.json"
DEFAULT_SKILL_FILENAME: Final[str] = "skill.json"


class IronClawSkillContextError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when IronClaw skill context cannot be resolved."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IronClawSkillContext:
    environment: str
    project_root: Path
    config_dir: Path
    config_file: Path
    skill_file: Path
    env_file: Path
    base_url: str
    openai_api_key: str | None
    groq_api_key: str | None
    api_secret: str | None
    jwt_secret: str | None
    backup_target: str
    restore_target: str
    policy_mode: str
    timeout_seconds: float

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        payload["project_root"] = str(self.project_root)
        payload["config_dir"] = str(self.config_dir)
        payload["config_file"] = str(self.config_file)
        payload["skill_file"] = str(self.skill_file)
        payload["env_file"] = str(self.env_file)
        return payload


def _project_root() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _default_config_dir() -> Path:
    return Path(os.getenv("IRONCLAW_CONFIG_DIR", Path.home() / DEFAULT_CONFIG_DIRNAME)).expanduser().resolve()


def _config_file(config_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return config_dir / DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME


def _skill_file(config_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return config_dir / DEFAULT_SKILL_FILENAME


def _env_file(project_root: Path) -> Path:
    return project_root / ".env"


def _normalize_optional_text(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = value.strip()
    return normalized or None


def _load_json_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.exists():
        return {}
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise IronClawSkillContextError(f"Expected JSON object in {path}")
    return payload


def _coerce_timeout(value: Any, *, default: float) -> float:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return default
    try:
        timeout = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise IronClawSkillContextError(f"Invalid timeout value: {value!r}") from exc
    if timeout <= 0:
        raise IronClawSkillContextError("Timeout must be greater than 0")
    return timeout


def _resolve_base_url(
    *,
    env: dict[str, str],
    config_payload: dict[str, Any],
    skill_payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> str:
    for candidate in (
        env.get("IRONCLAW_BASE_URL"),
        skill_payload.get("base_url"),
        config_payload.get("base_url"),
        DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
    ):
        if isinstance(candidate, str) and candidate.strip():
            return candidate.rstrip("/")
    return DEFAULT_BASE_URL


def _resolve_policy_mode(
    *,
    env: dict[str, str],
    skill_payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> str:
    for candidate in (
        env.get("IRONCLAW_POLICY_MODE"),
        skill_payload.get("default_policy_mode"),
        DEFAULT_POLICY_MODE,
    ):
        if isinstance(candidate, str) and candidate.strip():
            normalized = candidate.strip().lower()
            if normalized in {"allow", "review", "block"}:
                return normalized
    return DEFAULT_POLICY_MODE


def _resolve_target_name(
    *,
    env: dict[str, str],
    config_payload: dict[str, Any],
    key: str,
    default: str,
) -> str:
    candidate = env.get(key)
    if candidate and candidate.strip():
        return candidate.strip()

    config_candidate = config_payload.get(key.lower()) or config_payload.get(key)
    if isinstance(config_candidate, str) and config_candidate.strip():
        return config_candidate.strip()

    return default


def resolve_skill_context(
    *,
    environment: str | None = None,
    project_root: Path | None = None,
    config_dir: Path | None = None,
    load_dotenv_file: bool = True,
) -> IronClawSkillContext:
    resolved_project_root = (project_root or _project_root()).expanduser().resolve()
    resolved_config_dir = (config_dir or _default_config_dir()).expanduser().resolve()
    resolved_config_file = _config_file(resolved_config_dir)
    resolved_skill_file = _skill_file(resolved_config_dir)
    resolved_env_file = _env_file(resolved_project_root)

    if load_dotenv_file and resolved_env_file.exists():
        load_dotenv(dotenv_path=resolved_env_file, override=False)

    env = dict(os.environ)
    config_payload = _load_json_object(resolved_config_file)
    skill_payload = _load_json_object(resolved_skill_file)

    base_url = _resolve_base_url(
        env=env,
        config_payload=config_payload,
        skill_payload=skill_payload,
    )

    timeout_seconds = _coerce_timeout(
        env.get("IRONCLAW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS")
        or skill_payload.get("default_timeout_seconds")
        or config_payload.get("timeout_seconds"),
        default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    )

    resolved_environment = (
        _normalize_optional_text(environment)
        or _normalize_optional_text(env.get("IRONCLAW_ENV"))
        or _normalize_optional_text(env.get("IRONCLAW_MODE"))
        or "development"
    )

    backup_target = (
        _normalize_optional_text(env.get("IRONCLAW_BACKUP_TARGET_NAME"))
        or _normalize_optional_text(env.get("IRONCLAW_BACKUP_TARGET"))
        or _normalize_optional_text(config_payload.get("backup_target"))
        or "primary"
    )

    restore_target = (
        _normalize_optional_text(env.get("IRONCLAW_RESTORE_TARGET_NAME"))
        or _normalize_optional_text(env.get("IRONCLAW_RESTORE_TARGET"))
        or _normalize_optional_text(config_payload.get("restore_target"))
        or "primary"
    )

    return IronClawSkillContext(
        environment=resolved_environment,
        project_root=resolved_project_root,
        config_dir=resolved_config_dir,
        config_file=resolved_config_file,
        skill_file=resolved_skill_file,
        env_file=resolved_env_file,
        base_url=base_url,
        openai_api_key=_normalize_optional_text(env.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")),
        groq_api_key=_normalize_optional_text(env.get("GROQ_API_KEY")),
        api_secret=_normalize_optional_text(env.get("API_SECRET")),
        jwt_secret=_normalize_optional_text(env.get("JWT_SECRET")),
        backup_target=backup_target,
        restore_target=restore_target,
        policy_mode=_resolve_policy_mode(env=env, skill_payload=skill_payload),
        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
    )


def require_skill_context(
    *,
    environment: str | None = None,
    project_root: Path | None = None,
    config_dir: Path | None = None,
    require_api_secret: bool = False,
) -> IronClawSkillContext:
    context = resolve_skill_context(
        environment=environment,
        project_root=project_root,
        config_dir=config_dir,
    )

    if not context.base_url:
        raise IronClawSkillContextError("IronClaw base URL is not configured.")

    if require_api_secret and not context.api_secret:
        raise IronClawSkillContextError("API_SECRET is required but not configured.")

    return context


def skill_env_overrides(context: IronClawSkillContext) -> dict[str, str]:
    overrides = {
        "IRONCLAW_BASE_URL": context.base_url,
        "IRONCLAW_BACKUP_TARGET_NAME": context.backup_target,
        "IRONCLAW_RESTORE_TARGET_NAME": context.restore_target,
        "IRONCLAW_POLICY_MODE": context.policy_mode,
        "IRONCLAW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS": str(context.timeout_seconds),
    }

    if context.openai_api_key:
        overrides["OPENAI_API_KEY"] = context.openai_api_key
    if context.groq_api_key:
        overrides["GROQ_API_KEY"] = context.groq_api_key
    if context.api_secret:
        overrides["API_SECRET"] = context.api_secret
    if context.jwt_secret:
        overrides["JWT_SECRET"] = context.jwt_secret

    return overrides


__all__ = [
    "IronClawSkillContext",
    "IronClawSkillContextError",
    "require_skill_context",
    "resolve_skill_context",
    "skill_env_overrides",
]

# code ironclaw_skill/contracts.py
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated, Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator


def _normalize_optional_text(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = value.strip()
    return normalized or None


def _normalize_required_text(value: str) -> str:
    normalized = value.strip()
    if not normalized:
        raise ValueError("value cannot be empty")
    return normalized


def _normalize_tags(value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    normalized: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in value:
        cleaned = item.strip().lower()
        if not cleaned:
            continue
        if cleaned not in seen:
            seen.add(cleaned)
            normalized.append(cleaned)
    return normalized


class SkillBaseModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(
        extra="forbid",
        str_strip_whitespace=True,
        validate_assignment=True,
        populate_by_name=True,
    )


class SkillReason(SkillBaseModel):
    source: Literal["policy", "scan", "ai", "runtime", "installer", "skill"]
    label: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    details: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4000)
    score: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0)

    @field_validator("label", "details")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_text(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _normalize_required_text(value)


class SkillRequestContext(SkillBaseModel):
    client_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    session_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    user_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    tenant_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    request_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    source_platform: Literal["claude", "openclaw", "unknown"] = "unknown"
    source_version: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=100)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    @field_validator(
        "client_id",
        "session_id",
        "user_id",
        "tenant_id",
        "request_id",
        "source_version",
    )
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_optional_fields(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return _normalize_optional_text(value)

    @field_validator("tags")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_tags(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        return _normalize_tags(value)


class SkillPromptBundleInput(SkillBaseModel):
    user_prompt: str | None = None
    retrieved_doc: str | None = None
    tool_output: str | None = None
    model_output: str | None = None

    @field_validator("user_prompt", "retrieved_doc", "tool_output", "model_output")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_bundle_fields(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return _normalize_optional_text(value)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _require_at_least_one_field(self) -> "SkillPromptBundleInput":
        if not any(
            (
                self.user_prompt,
                self.retrieved_doc,
                self.tool_output,
                self.model_output,
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("at least one prompt bundle field must be provided")
        return self


class SkillScanInput(SkillBaseModel):
    target_type: Literal["text", "url", "file_path", "prompt_bundle"]
    target_value: str | None = None
    bundle: SkillPromptBundleInput | None = None
    policy_mode: Literal["allow", "review", "block"] = "review"

    @field_validator("target_value")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_target_value(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return _normalize_optional_text(value)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _validate_scan_shape(self) -> "SkillScanInput":
        if self.target_type == "prompt_bundle":
            if self.bundle is None:
                raise ValueError("bundle is required when target_type=prompt_bundle")
            if self.target_value is not None:
                raise ValueError("target_value is not allowed when target_type=prompt_bundle")
            return self

        if self.bundle is not None:
            raise ValueError("bundle is only allowed when target_type=prompt_bundle")

        if self.target_value is None:
            raise ValueError("target_value is required for non-bundle scan inputs")

        return self


class SkillActionInput(SkillBaseModel):
    action_type: Literal[
        "shell_command",
        "python_code",
        "tool_invocation",
        "file_write",
        "file_delete",
        "network_request",
        "system_change",
        "other",
    ]
    target: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=1000)
    content: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20000)
    policy_mode: Literal["allow", "review", "block"] = "review"
    dry_run: bool = False

    @field_validator("target")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_target(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _normalize_required_text(value)

    @field_validator("content")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_content(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return _normalize_optional_text(value)


class SkillExecutionInput(SkillBaseModel):
    action: SkillActionInput
    require_confirmation: bool = False
    allow_side_effects: bool = False


class SkillScanRequest(SkillBaseModel):
    operation: Literal["scan"] = "scan"
    input: SkillScanInput
    context: SkillRequestContext = Field(default_factory=SkillRequestContext)


class SkillActionPolicyRequest(SkillBaseModel):
    operation: Literal["action_policy"] = "action_policy"
    input: SkillActionInput
    context: SkillRequestContext = Field(default_factory=SkillRequestContext)


class SkillActionDecisionRequest(SkillBaseModel):
    operation: Literal["action_decision"] = "action_decision"
    input: SkillActionInput
    context: SkillRequestContext = Field(default_factory=SkillRequestContext)


class SkillExecuteRequest(SkillBaseModel):
    operation: Literal["execute"] = "execute"
    input: SkillExecutionInput
    context: SkillRequestContext = Field(default_factory=SkillRequestContext)


SkillRequest = Annotated[
    SkillScanRequest | SkillActionPolicyRequest | SkillActionDecisionRequest | SkillExecuteRequest,
    Field(discriminator="operation"),
]


class SkillDecisionMetadata(SkillBaseModel):
    scan_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    decision_source: Literal["policy", "scan", "ai", "runtime", "combined", "unknown"] = "unknown"
    matched_patterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    risk_score: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100)

    @field_validator("scan_id")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_scan_id(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return _normalize_optional_text(value)

    @field_validator("matched_patterns")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_matched_patterns(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        return _normalize_tags(value)


class SkillResponsePayload(SkillBaseModel):
    verdict: Literal["allow", "review", "block", "error"]
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4000)
    should_halt: bool = False
    should_warn: bool = False
    allowed: bool | None = None
    metadata: SkillDecisionMetadata = Field(default_factory=SkillDecisionMetadata)
    reasons: list[SkillReason] = Field(default_factory=list)
    raw_result: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    @field_validator("summary")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_summary(cls, value: str) -> str:
        return _normalize_required_text(value)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _sync_allowed_field(self) -> "SkillResponsePayload":
        if self.allowed is None:
            self.allowed = self.verdict == "allow"
        return self


class SkillResponseEnvelope(SkillBaseModel):
    ok: bool
    operation: Literal["scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute"]
    payload: SkillResponsePayload
    request_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    error_code: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)

    @field_validator("request_id", "error_code")
    @classmethod
    def _normalize_optional_fields(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
        return _normalize_optional_text(value)


def build_skill_success_response(
    *,
    operation: Literal["scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute"],
    verdict: Literal["allow", "review", "block"],
    summary: str,
    should_halt: bool = False,
    should_warn: bool = False,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    scan_id: str | None = None,
    decision_source: Literal["policy", "scan", "ai", "runtime", "combined", "unknown"] = "unknown",
    matched_patterns: list[str] | None = None,
    risk_score: int | None = None,
    reasons: list[SkillReason] | None = None,
    raw_result: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
    return SkillResponseEnvelope(
        ok=True,
        operation=operation,
        request_id=request_id,
        payload=SkillResponsePayload(
            verdict=verdict,
            summary=summary,
            should_halt=should_halt,
            should_warn=should_warn,
            metadata=SkillDecisionMetadata(
                scan_id=scan_id,
                decision_source=decision_source,
                matched_patterns=matched_patterns or [],
                risk_score=risk_score,
            ),
            reasons=reasons or [],
            raw_result=raw_result,
        ),
    )


def build_skill_error_response(
    *,
    operation: Literal["scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute"],
    summary: str,
    error_code: str,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    reasons: list[SkillReason] | None = None,
    raw_result: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
    return SkillResponseEnvelope(
        ok=False,
        operation=operation,
        request_id=request_id,
        error_code=error_code,
        payload=SkillResponsePayload(
            verdict="error",
            summary=summary,
            should_halt=True,
            should_warn=True,
            allowed=False,
            reasons=reasons or [],
            raw_result=raw_result,
        ),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from ironclaw_skill.contracts import SkillReason, SkillResponseEnvelope, build_skill_error_response


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IronClawSkillError(Exception):
    message: str
    error_code: str = "skill_error"
    operation: str = "scan"
    request_id: str | None = None
    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.message

    def to_reason(self) -> SkillReason:
        return SkillReason(
            source="skill",
            label=self.__class__.__name__,
            details=self.message,
        )

    def to_response(self) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        normalized_operation = self.operation
        if normalized_operation not in {"scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute"}:
            normalized_operation = "scan"

        return build_skill_error_response(
            operation=normalized_operation,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            summary=self.message,
            error_code=self.error_code,
            request_id=self.request_id,
            reasons=[self.to_reason()],
            raw_result=self.details,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillConfigError(IronClawSkillError):
    error_code: str = "skill_config_error"
    operation: str = "scan"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillValidationError(IronClawSkillError):
    error_code: str = "skill_validation_error"
    operation: str = "scan"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillAdapterError(IronClawSkillError):
    error_code: str = "skill_adapter_error"
    operation: str = "scan"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillRuntimeError(IronClawSkillError):
    error_code: str = "skill_runtime_error"
    operation: str = "execute"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillPolicyError(IronClawSkillError):
    error_code: str = "skill_policy_error"
    operation: str = "action_decision"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillExecutionError(IronClawSkillError):
    error_code: str = "skill_execution_error"
    operation: str = "execute"


def error_to_response(exc: Exception) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
    if isinstance(exc, IronClawSkillError):
        return exc.to_response()

    wrapped = IronClawSkillError(
        message=str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__,
        error_code="unhandled_skill_error",
        operation="scan",
        details={"exception_type": exc.__class__.__name__},
    )
    return wrapped.to_response()

    "SkillConfigError",
    "SkillExecutionError",
    "SkillPolicyError",
    "SkillRuntimeError",
    "SkillValidationError",
    "error_to_response",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import inspect
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable, Generic, Literal, TypeVar

from ironclaw_skill.billing import (
    BillingContext,
    BillingHook,
    BillingResult,
    build_billing_context_from_request_context,
    charge_units,
)
from ironclaw_skill.contracts import SkillRequestContext

MiddlewareOperation = Literal["scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute", "unknown"]

RequestT = TypeVar("RequestT")
ResponseT = TypeVar("ResponseT")


class IronClawMiddlewareError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when middleware execution fails."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MiddlewareTrace:
    operation: MiddlewareOperation
    duration_ms: int
    request_id: str | None
    billed: bool
    billing_status: str | None
    units_charged: int
    short_circuited: bool
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "operation": self.operation,
            "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "billed": self.billed,
            "billing_status": self.billing_status,
            "units_charged": self.units_charged,
            "short_circuited": self.short_circuited,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MiddlewareResult(Generic[ResponseT]):
    response: ResponseT
    trace: MiddlewareTrace
    billing: BillingResult | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "trace": self.trace.to_dict(),
        }
        if hasattr(self.response, "model_dump"):
            payload["response"] = self.response.model_dump(mode="json")
        elif hasattr(self.response, "to_dict"):
            payload["response"] = self.response.to_dict()
        else:
            payload["response"] = self.response
        if self.billing is not None:
            payload["billing"] = self.billing.to_dict()
        return payload


@dataclass(slots=True)
class MiddlewareConfig:
    enable_billing: bool = True
    fail_open_on_billing_error: bool = True
    include_trace_metadata: bool = True


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SkillMiddleware(Generic[RequestT, ResponseT]):
    operation: MiddlewareOperation
    handler: Callable[[RequestT], ResponseT | Awaitable[ResponseT]]
    billing_hook: BillingHook | None = None
    config: MiddlewareConfig = field(default_factory=MiddlewareConfig)
    metadata_factory: Callable[[RequestT], dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    async def __call__(self, request: RequestT) -> MiddlewareResult[ResponseT]:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        request_context = _extract_request_context(request)
        request_id = getattr(request_context, "request_id", None)
        metadata = self._build_metadata(request)

        billing_result: BillingResult | None = None
        short_circuited = False

        if self.config.enable_billing:
            try:
                billing_result = charge_units(
                    operation=self.operation,
                    hook=self.billing_hook,
                    context=_billing_context_from_request_context(request_context),
                    metadata=metadata,
                )
                if not billing_result.ok:
                    short_circuited = True
                    raise IronClawMiddlewareError(
                        billing_result.reason or "Billing hook rejected the request."
                    )
            except Exception as exc:
                if not self.config.fail_open_on_billing_error:
                    raise IronClawMiddlewareError(f"Billing middleware failed: {exc}") from exc

        response = await _maybe_await(self.handler(request))
        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

        trace = MiddlewareTrace(
            operation=self.operation,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            request_id=request_id,
            billed=billing_result is not None,
            billing_status=billing_result.status if billing_result else None,
            units_charged=billing_result.units_charged if billing_result else 0,
            short_circuited=short_circuited,
            metadata=metadata if self.config.include_trace_metadata else {},
        )
        return MiddlewareResult(response=response, trace=trace, billing=billing_result)

    def _build_metadata(self, request: RequestT) -> dict[str, Any]:
        base = {"operation": self.operation}
        if self.metadata_factory is None:
            return base

        extra = self.metadata_factory(request)
        if not isinstance(extra, dict):
            raise IronClawMiddlewareError("metadata_factory must return a dict")
        base.update(extra)
        return base


def create_middleware(
    *,
    operation: MiddlewareOperation,
    handler: Callable[[RequestT], ResponseT | Awaitable[ResponseT]],
    billing_hook: BillingHook | None = None,
    config: MiddlewareConfig | None = None,
    metadata_factory: Callable[[RequestT], dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> SkillMiddleware[RequestT, ResponseT]:
    return SkillMiddleware(
        operation=operation,
        handler=handler,
        billing_hook=billing_hook,
        config=config or MiddlewareConfig(),
        metadata_factory=metadata_factory,
    )


def middleware(
    *,
    operation: MiddlewareOperation,
    billing_hook: BillingHook | None = None,
    config: MiddlewareConfig | None = None,
    metadata_factory: Callable[[RequestT], dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> Callable[[Callable[[RequestT], ResponseT | Awaitable[ResponseT]]], SkillMiddleware[RequestT, ResponseT]]:
    def decorator(
        handler: Callable[[RequestT], ResponseT | Awaitable[ResponseT]],
    ) -> SkillMiddleware[RequestT, ResponseT]:
        return create_middleware(
            operation=operation,
            handler=handler,
            billing_hook=billing_hook,
            config=config,
            metadata_factory=metadata_factory,
        )

    return decorator


def attach_trace(response: Any, trace: MiddlewareTrace) -> Any:
    if response is None:
        return {"trace": trace.to_dict()}

    if hasattr(response, "trace"):
        try:
            setattr(response, "trace", trace.to_dict())
            return response
        except Exception:
            return response

    if hasattr(response, "model_copy") and hasattr(response, "model_dump"):
        try:
            data = response.model_dump(mode="json")
            data["trace"] = trace.to_dict()
            return data
        except Exception:
            return response

    if isinstance(response, dict):
        enriched = dict(response)
        enriched["trace"] = trace.to_dict()
        return enriched

    return response


def _extract_request_context(request: Any) -> SkillRequestContext | None:
    if request is None:
        return None

    context = getattr(request, "context", None)
    if isinstance(context, SkillRequestContext):
        return context

    if isinstance(request, SkillRequestContext):
        return request

    return None


def _billing_context_from_request_context(request_context: SkillRequestContext | None) -> BillingContext | None:
    if request_context is None:
        return None
    return build_billing_context_from_request_context(request_context)


async def _maybe_await(value: ResponseT | Awaitable[ResponseT]) -> ResponseT:
    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
        return await value
    return value


def run_middleware(
    middleware_instance: SkillMiddleware[RequestT, ResponseT],
    request: RequestT,
) -> MiddlewareResult[ResponseT]:
    try:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    except RuntimeError:
        return asyncio.run(middleware_instance(request))

    raise IronClawMiddlewareError(
        "run_middleware cannot be used inside an active event loop; await the middleware directly."
    ) from None


__all__ = [
    "IronClawMiddlewareError",
    "MiddlewareConfig",
    "MiddlewareResult",
    "MiddlewareTrace",
    "SkillMiddleware",
    "attach_trace",
    "create_middleware",
    "middleware",
    "run_middleware",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Literal

from ironclaw_skill.contracts import (
    SkillActionDecisionRequest,
    SkillActionPolicyRequest,
    SkillExecuteRequest,
    SkillReason,
    SkillRequest,
    SkillResponseEnvelope,
    SkillScanRequest,
    build_skill_error_response,
    build_skill_success_response,
)


class IronClawSkillRouterError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when routing or handler execution fails."""


HandlerFunc = Callable[[SkillRequest], SkillResponseEnvelope]


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IronClawSkillRouter:
    scan_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None
    action_policy_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None
    action_decision_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None
    execute_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None

    def route(self, request: SkillRequest) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        if isinstance(request, SkillScanRequest):
            return self._dispatch("scan", request, self.scan_handler, self._default_scan_handler)
        if isinstance(request, SkillActionPolicyRequest):
            return self._dispatch(
                "action_policy",
                request,
                self.action_policy_handler,
                self._default_action_policy_handler,
            )
        if isinstance(request, SkillActionDecisionRequest):
            return self._dispatch(
                "action_decision",
                request,
                self.action_decision_handler,
                self._default_action_decision_handler,
            )
        if isinstance(request, SkillExecuteRequest):
            return self._dispatch("execute", request, self.execute_handler, self._default_execute_handler)

        raise IronClawSkillRouterError(f"Unsupported request type: {type(request)!r}")

    def register(
        self,
        operation: Literal["scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute"],
        handler: HandlerFunc,
    ) -> None:
        if operation == "scan":
            self.scan_handler = handler
            return
        if operation == "action_policy":
            self.action_policy_handler = handler
            return
        if operation == "action_decision":
            self.action_decision_handler = handler
            return
        if operation == "execute":
            self.execute_handler = handler
            return
        raise IronClawSkillRouterError(f"Unsupported operation registration: {operation}")

    def _dispatch(
        self,
        operation: Literal["scan", "action_policy", "action_decision", "execute"],
        request: SkillRequest,
        handler: HandlerFunc | None,
        fallback: HandlerFunc,
    ) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        selected_handler = handler or fallback

        try:
            response = selected_handler(request)
        except Exception as exc:
            return build_skill_error_response(
                operation=operation,
                summary=f"Router handler failure for {operation}: {exc}",
                error_code="router_handler_failure",
                request_id=self._request_id(request),
                reasons=[
                    SkillReason(
                        source="runtime",
                        label="Router handler exception",
                        details=str(exc),
                    )
                ],
                raw_result={"operation": operation},
            )

        if response.operation != operation:
            return build_skill_error_response(
                operation=operation,
                summary=f"Handler returned mismatched operation for {operation}",
                error_code="router_operation_mismatch",
                request_id=self._request_id(request),
                reasons=[
                    SkillReason(
                        source="runtime",
                        label="Operation mismatch",
                        details=f"Expected {operation}, got {response.operation}",
                    )
                ],
                raw_result={"expected_operation": operation, "actual_operation": response.operation},
            )

        return response

    @staticmethod
    def _request_id(request: SkillRequest) -> str | None:
        return request.context.request_id

    def _default_scan_handler(self, request: SkillRequest) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        if not isinstance(request, SkillScanRequest):
            raise IronClawSkillRouterError("Invalid request provided to scan handler.")

        details = {
            "target_type": request.input.target_type,
            "policy_mode": request.input.policy_mode,
            "has_bundle": request.input.bundle is not None,
        }

        return build_skill_success_response(
            operation="scan",
            verdict="review",
            summary="Scan request accepted by router placeholder. Runtime scan integration is not wired yet.",
            should_halt=False,
            should_warn=True,
            request_id=request.context.request_id,
            decision_source="runtime",
            matched_patterns=[],
            risk_score=25,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Placeholder scan handler",
                    details="The skill router accepted the scan request, but the downstream IronClaw scan runtime is not connected yet.",
                    score=0.25,
                )
            ],
            raw_result=details,
        )

    def _default_action_policy_handler(self, request: SkillRequest) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        if not isinstance(request, SkillActionPolicyRequest):
            raise IronClawSkillRouterError("Invalid request provided to action policy handler.")

        risk_score = 70 if request.input.action_type in {"shell_command", "system_change", "file_delete"} else 45

        return build_skill_success_response(
            operation="action_policy",
            verdict="review",
            summary="Action policy request accepted by router placeholder. Runtime policy enforcement is not wired yet.",
            should_halt=False,
            should_warn=True,
            request_id=request.context.request_id,
            decision_source="policy",
            matched_patterns=[request.input.action_type],
            risk_score=risk_score,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="policy",
                    label="Placeholder action policy handler",
                    details="The action was normalized successfully, but final policy evaluation is still pending runtime integration.",
                    score=min(risk_score / 100.0, 1.0),
                )
            ],
            raw_result={
                "action_type": request.input.action_type,
                "target": request.input.target,
                "dry_run": request.input.dry_run,
            },
        )

    def _default_action_decision_handler(self, request: SkillRequest) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        if not isinstance(request, SkillActionDecisionRequest):
            raise IronClawSkillRouterError("Invalid request provided to action decision handler.")

        high_risk_actions = {"shell_command", "system_change", "file_delete"}
        verdict: Literal["allow", "review", "block"]
        should_halt = False
        should_warn = False
        risk_score = 35

        if request.input.action_type in high_risk_actions:
            verdict = "review"
            should_warn = True
            risk_score = 72
        else:
            verdict = "allow"
            risk_score = 20

        return build_skill_success_response(
            operation="action_decision",
            verdict=verdict,
            summary="Action decision evaluated by router placeholder using conservative pre-runtime defaults.",
            should_halt=should_halt,
            should_warn=should_warn,
            request_id=request.context.request_id,
            decision_source="combined",
            matched_patterns=[request.input.action_type],
            risk_score=risk_score,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Placeholder decision logic",
                    details="This decision is provisional until the full IronClaw runtime and policy engine are connected.",
                    score=min(risk_score / 100.0, 1.0),
                )
            ],
            raw_result={
                "action_type": request.input.action_type,
                "target": request.input.target,
                "policy_mode": request.input.policy_mode,
            },
        )

    def _default_execute_handler(self, request: SkillRequest) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
        if not isinstance(request, SkillExecuteRequest):
            raise IronClawSkillRouterError("Invalid request provided to execute handler.")

        return build_skill_success_response(
            operation="execute",
            verdict="block",
            summary="Execution blocked by router placeholder because guarded runtime execution is not wired yet.",
            should_halt=True,
            should_warn=True,
            request_id=request.context.request_id,
            decision_source="runtime",
            matched_patterns=[request.input.action.action_type],
            risk_score=85,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Execution runtime unavailable",
                    details="The router intentionally blocks execution until IronClaw guarded execution is connected.",
                    score=0.85,
                )
            ],
            raw_result={
                "action_type": request.input.action.action_type,
                "target": request.input.action.target,
                "require_confirmation": request.input.require_confirmation,
                "allow_side_effects": request.input.allow_side_effects,
            },
        )


def route_skill_request(
    request: SkillRequest,
    *,
    scan_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None,
    action_policy_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None,
    action_decision_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None,
    execute_handler: HandlerFunc | None = None,
) -> SkillResponseEnvelope:
    router = IronClawSkillRouter(
        scan_handler=scan_handler,
        action_policy_handler=action_policy_handler,
        action_decision_handler=action_decision_handler,
        execute_handler=execute_handler,
    )
    return router.route(request)


__all__ = [
    "HandlerFunc",
    "IronClawSkillRouter",
    "IronClawSkillRouterError",
    "route_skill_request",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Literal

import httpx

from ironclawshellguard import GuardedCommandResult, IronClawShellGuard, ShellGuardError
from ironclaw_skill.context import IronClawSkillContext, require_skill_context
from ironclaw_skill.contracts import (
    SkillActionInput,
    SkillReason,
    SkillResponseEnvelope,
    build_skill_error_response,
    build_skill_success_response,
)


class IronClawSkillRuntimeError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when the IronClaw skill runtime cannot complete an operation."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SkillRuntimeResult:
    response: SkillResponseEnvelope
    context: IronClawSkillContext

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "response": self.response.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "context": self.context.to_dict(),
        }


def _normalize_request_id(request_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if request_id is None:
        return None
    normalized = request_id.strip()
    return normalized or None


def _headers(context: IronClawSkillContext) -> dict[str, str]:
    headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
    if context.api_secret:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {context.api_secret}"
    return headers


def _health_url(context: IronClawSkillContext) -> str:
    return f"{context.base_url.rstrip('/')}/health"


def _scan_url(context: IronClawSkillContext) -> str:
    return f"{context.base_url.rstrip('/')}/scan"


def _policy_url(context: IronClawSkillContext) -> str:
    return f"{context.base_url.rstrip('/')}/policy/evaluate"


def _safe_json(response: httpx.Response) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = response.json()
    except ValueError:
        return {}
    return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}


def ping_runtime(
    *,
    context: IronClawSkillContext | None = None,
) -> bool:
    resolved_context = context or require_skill_context()
    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=resolved_context.timeout_seconds, headers=_headers(resolved_context)) as client:
            response = client.get(_health_url(resolved_context))
            return response.status_code < 500
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        return False


def scan_for_skill(
    *,
    target_type: Literal["text", "url", "file_path", "prompt_bundle"],
    target_value: str | None = None,
    bundle: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    policy_mode: Literal["allow", "review", "block"] | None = None,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    context: IronClawSkillContext | None = None,
) -> SkillRuntimeResult:
    resolved_context = context or require_skill_context()
    normalized_request_id = _normalize_request_id(request_id)

    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "target_type": target_type,
        "policy_mode": (policy_mode or resolved_context.policy_mode).lower(),
    }

    if target_type == "prompt_bundle":
        payload["bundle"] = bundle or {}
    else:
        payload["target_value"] = (target_value or "").strip()

    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=resolved_context.timeout_seconds, headers=_headers(resolved_context)) as client:
            response = client.post(_scan_url(resolved_context), json=payload)
            response_payload = _safe_json(response)

            if response.is_success:
                summary = response_payload.get("summary") or "IronClaw scan completed."
                risk_score = response_payload.get("risk_score")
                verdict = str(response_payload.get("verdict") or "review").lower()
                if verdict not in {"allow", "review", "block"}:
                    verdict = "review"

                envelope = build_skill_success_response(
                    operation="scan",
                    verdict=verdict,
                    summary=summary,
                    should_halt=bool(response_payload.get("should_halt", verdict == "block")),
                    should_warn=bool(response_payload.get("should_warn", verdict != "allow")),
                    request_id=normalized_request_id,
                    scan_id=response_payload.get("scan_id"),
                    decision_source="scan",
                    matched_patterns=response_payload.get("matched_patterns") or [],
                    risk_score=risk_score if isinstance(risk_score, int) else None,
                    reasons=[
                        SkillReason(
                            source="scan",
                            label="Runtime scan completed",
                            details=summary,
                            score=(risk_score / 100.0) if isinstance(risk_score, int) else None,
                        )
                    ],
                    raw_result=response_payload,
                )
                return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)

            envelope = build_skill_error_response(
                operation="scan",
                summary=response_payload.get("summary") or f"Scan request failed with status {response.status_code}.",
                error_code="scan_request_failed",
                request_id=normalized_request_id,
                reasons=[
                    SkillReason(
                        source="runtime",
                        label="Scan request failed",
                        details=f"HTTP {response.status_code}",
                    )
                ],
                raw_result=response_payload,
            )
            return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        envelope = build_skill_error_response(
            operation="scan",
            summary=f"Scan request could not reach IronClaw runtime: {exc}",
            error_code="scan_runtime_unreachable",
            request_id=normalized_request_id,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Runtime unreachable",
                    details=str(exc),
                )
            ],
        )
        return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)


def evaluate_action_for_skill(
    *,
    action: SkillActionInput,
    request_id: str | None = None,
    context: IronClawSkillContext | None = None,
) -> SkillRuntimeResult:
    resolved_context = context or require_skill_context()
    normalized_request_id = _normalize_request_id(request_id)

    payload = {
        "action_type": action.action_type,
        "target": action.target,
        "content": action.content,
        "policy_mode": action.policy_mode,
        "dry_run": action.dry_run,
    }

    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=resolved_context.timeout_seconds, headers=_headers(resolved_context)) as client:
            response = client.post(_policy_url(resolved_context), json=payload)
            response_payload = _safe_json(response)

            if response.is_success:
                summary = response_payload.get("summary") or "IronClaw action evaluation completed."
                risk_score = response_payload.get("risk_score")
                verdict = str(response_payload.get("verdict") or "review").lower()
                if verdict not in {"allow", "review", "block"}:
                    verdict = "review"

                envelope = build_skill_success_response(
                    operation="action_decision",
                    verdict=verdict,
                    summary=summary,
                    should_halt=bool(response_payload.get("should_halt", verdict == "block")),
                    should_warn=bool(response_payload.get("should_warn", verdict != "allow")),
                    request_id=normalized_request_id,
                    scan_id=response_payload.get("scan_id"),
                    decision_source="policy",
                    matched_patterns=response_payload.get("matched_patterns") or [action.action_type],
                    risk_score=risk_score if isinstance(risk_score, int) else None,
                    reasons=[
                        SkillReason(
                            source="policy",
                            label="Runtime policy evaluation completed",
                            details=summary,
                            score=(risk_score / 100.0) if isinstance(risk_score, int) else None,
                        )
                    ],
                    raw_result=response_payload,
                )
                return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)

            envelope = build_skill_error_response(
                operation="action_decision",
                summary=response_payload.get("summary") or f"Policy request failed with status {response.status_code}.",
                error_code="policy_request_failed",
                request_id=normalized_request_id,
                reasons=[
                    SkillReason(
                        source="runtime",
                        label="Policy request failed",
                        details=f"HTTP {response.status_code}",
                    )
                ],
                raw_result=response_payload,
            )
            return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        envelope = build_skill_error_response(
            operation="action_decision",
            summary=f"Policy request could not reach IronClaw runtime: {exc}",
            error_code="policy_runtime_unreachable",
            request_id=normalized_request_id,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Runtime unreachable",
                    details=str(exc),
                )
            ],
        )
        return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)


def execute_guarded_for_skill(
    *,
    command: str | list[str],
    request_id: str | None = None,
    cwd: str | None = None,
    timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    allow_side_effects: bool = False,
    context: IronClawSkillContext | None = None,
    shell_guard: IronClawShellGuard | None = None,
) -> SkillRuntimeResult:
    resolved_context = context or require_skill_context()
    normalized_request_id = _normalize_request_id(request_id)
    guard = shell_guard or IronClawShellGuard()

    if allow_side_effects:
        envelope = build_skill_error_response(
            operation="execute",
            summary="Guarded execution rejected because side effects are not allowed in this runtime path.",
            error_code="guarded_execution_side_effects_not_allowed",
            request_id=normalized_request_id,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="policy",
                    label="Side effects blocked",
                    details="This skill runtime path only permits guarded command evaluation without elevated side effects.",
                )
            ],
            raw_result={"command": command},
        )
        return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)

    try:
        result: GuardedCommandResult = guard.run(
            command,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds or resolved_context.timeout_seconds,
            cwd=cwd,
            check=False,
        )

        verdict: Literal["allow", "review", "block"]
        should_warn = False
        should_halt = False

        if result.returncode == 0:
            verdict = "allow"
        else:
            verdict = "review"
            should_warn = True

        envelope = build_skill_success_response(
            operation="execute",
            verdict=verdict,
            summary="Guarded command executed through IronClaw shell guard.",
            should_halt=should_halt,
            should_warn=should_warn,
            request_id=normalized_request_id,
            decision_source="runtime",
            matched_patterns=[],
            risk_score=15 if result.returncode == 0 else 45,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Shell guard execution complete",
                    details=f"Command completed with return code {result.returncode}.",
                    score=0.15 if result.returncode == 0 else 0.45,
                )
            ],
            raw_result=result.to_dict(),
        )
        return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)
    except ShellGuardError as exc:
        envelope = build_skill_error_response(
            operation="execute",
            summary=f"Guarded execution failed: {exc}",
            error_code="guarded_execution_failed",
            request_id=normalized_request_id,
            reasons=[
                SkillReason(
                    source="runtime",
                    label="Shell guard error",
                    details=str(exc),
                )
            ],
            raw_result={"command": command},
        )
        return SkillRuntimeResult(response=envelope, context=resolved_context)


def runtime_snapshot(
    *,
    context: IronClawSkillContext | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    resolved_context = context or require_skill_context()
    return {
        "context": resolved_context.to_dict(),
        "runtime_reachable": ping_runtime(context=resolved_context),
    }


def runtime_snapshot_json(
    *,
    context: IronClawSkillContext | None = None,
) -> str:
    return json.dumps(runtime_snapshot(context=context), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


__all__ = [
    "IronClawSkillRuntimeError",
    "SkillRuntimeResult",
    "evaluate_action_for_skill",
    "execute_guarded_for_skill",
    "ping_runtime",
    "runtime_snapshot",
    "runtime_snapshot_json",
    "scan_for_skill",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from typing import Any

import requests


API_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"


def _read_json_from_stdin() -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = sys.stdin.read()
    if not data.strip():
        raise ValueError("No JSON input received on stdin.")
    return json.loads(data)


def _read_json_from_file(path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def call_scan(payload: dict[str, Any], timeout: int = 10) -> dict[str, Any]:
    resp = requests.post(f"{API_BASE}/scan", json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def call_scan_batch(payload: dict[str, Any], timeout: int = 10) -> dict[str, Any]:
    resp = requests.post(f"{API_BASE}/scan/batch", json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def call_brain_decision(payload: dict[str, Any], timeout: int = 10) -> dict[str, Any]:
    # Maps directly to PromptGuardRequest -> PromptGuardResponse
    # POST /guard/prompt-bundle
    resp = requests.post(f"{API_BASE}/guard/prompt-bundle", json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "IronClaw-Security tool runner.\n"
            "Reads JSON input (tool arguments), calls the IronClaw API, "
            "and prints JSON output for machine consumption."
        )
    )

    parser.add_argument(
        "--tool",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        choices=["scan", "scan_batch", "brain_decision"],
        help="Which IronClaw tool to invoke.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--input-file",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Path to a JSON file containing the tool arguments. If omitted, reads JSON from stdin.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--timeout",
        type=int,
        default=10,
        help="HTTP timeout in seconds.",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        if args.input_file:
            payload = _read_json_from_file(args.input_file)
        else:
            payload = _read_json_from_stdin()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error reading JSON input: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        if args.tool == "scan":
            result = call_scan(payload, timeout=args.timeout)
        elif args.tool == "scan_batch":
            result = call_scan_batch(payload, timeout=args.timeout)
        else:  # brain_decision
            result = call_brain_decision(payload, timeout=args.timeout)
    except requests.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"HTTP error from IronClaw API: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        if e.response is not None:
            try:
                print(e.response.text, file=sys.stderr)
            except Exception:
                pass
        sys.exit(1)
    except requests.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error connecting to IronClaw API: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Unexpected error calling IronClaw API: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any, Final, Mapping

import httpx


DEFAULT_BASE_URL: Final[str] = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final[float] = 10.0


class IronClawClientError(RuntimeError):
    """Base client error for IronClaw API interactions."""


class IronClawRequestError(IronClawClientError):
    """Raised when the request could not be completed."""


class IronClawHTTPStatusError(IronClawClientError):
    """Raised when the API responds with a non-2xx status code."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, *, status_code: int, detail: Any = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.detail = detail


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IronClawResponse:
    method: str
    path: str
    status_code: int
    payload: Any
    headers: dict[str, str]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _env_base_url() -> str:
    value = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_BASE_URL")
    return value.rstrip("/") if value else DEFAULT_BASE_URL


def _env_timeout() -> float:
    value = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_CLIENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS")
    if not value:
        return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    try:
        timeout = float(value.strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    return timeout if timeout > 0 else DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS


class IronClawClient:
    """
    Synchronous API client for IronClaw.

    This client provides a stable typed wrapper around the current
    operational endpoints used in health checks, UI runtime inspection,
    backup control, and restore control.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str | None = None,
        *,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
        follow_redirects: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        resolved_headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
        if headers:
            resolved_headers.update(dict(headers))

        self._client = httpx.Client(
            base_url=(base_url or _env_base_url()).rstrip("/"),
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout if timeout is not None else _env_timeout()),
            headers=resolved_headers,
            follow_redirects=follow_redirects,
        )

    @property
    def base_url(self) -> str:
        return str(self._client.base_url).rstrip("/")

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._client.close()

    def __enter__(self) -> "IronClawClient":
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc: Any, tb: Any) -> None:
        self.close()

    def request(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        *,
        params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        json_body: Any = None,
    ) -> IronClawResponse:
        try:
            response = self._client.request(method=method, url=path, params=params, json=json_body)
        except httpx.RequestError as exc:
            raise IronClawRequestError(f"{method.upper()} {path} failed: {exc}") from exc

        payload = self._decode_payload(response)

        if not (200 <= response.status_code < 300):
            detail = payload.get("detail") if isinstance(payload, dict) else payload
            raise IronClawHTTPStatusError(
                f"{method.upper()} {path} returned {response.status_code}",
                status_code=response.status_code,
                detail=detail,
            )

        return IronClawResponse(
            method=method.upper(),
            path=path,
            status_code=response.status_code,
            payload=payload,
            headers=dict(response.headers),
        )

    def get(self, path: str, *, params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> IronClawResponse:
        return self.request("GET", path, params=params)

    def post(
        self,
        path: str,
        *,
        params: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        json_body: Any = None,
    ) -> IronClawResponse:
        return self.request("POST", path, params=params, json_body=json_body)

    def health(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/health").payload

    def health_liveness(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/health/liveness").payload

    def health_readiness(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/health/readiness").payload

    def system_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/system/status").payload

    def ui_manifest(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/ui/manifest").payload

    def ui_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/ui/status/runtime").payload

    def ui_runtime_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/ui/runtime/status").payload

    def backup_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/backup").payload

    def backup_targets(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        payload = self.get("/api/backup/targets").payload
        return payload if isinstance(payload, list) else [payload]

    def backup_snapshot(self, target_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post("/api/backup/snapshot", params={"target_name": target_name}).payload

    def backup_export(self, target_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post("/api/backup/export", params={"target_name": target_name}).payload

    def backup_rotate(self, target_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post("/api/backup/rotate", params={"target_name": target_name}).payload

    def backup_action(self, target_name: str, action: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post(
            "/api/backup/action",
            json_body={"target_name": target_name, "action": action},
        ).payload

    def restore_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.get("/api/restore").payload

    def restore_targets(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        payload = self.get("/api/restore/targets").payload
        return payload if isinstance(payload, list) else [payload]

    def restore_validate(self, target_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post("/api/restore/validate", params={"target_name": target_name}).payload

    def restore_run(self, target_name: str, *, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post(
            "/api/restore/run",
            params={"target_name": target_name, "dry_run": str(dry_run).lower()},
        ).payload

    def restore_action(self, target_name: str, action: str, *, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.post(
            "/api/restore/action",
            json_body={
                "target_name": target_name,
                "action": action,
                "dry_run": dry_run,
            },
        ).payload

    @staticmethod
    def _decode_payload(response: httpx.Response) -> Any:
        content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "").lower()
        if "application/json" in content_type:
            try:
                return response.json()
            except ValueError:
                return {"raw": response.text}
        try:
            return response.json()
        except ValueError:
            text = response.text.strip()
            if not text:
                return {}
            try:
                return json.loads(text)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                return {"raw": text}


def build_ironclaw_client(
    base_url: str | None = None,
    *,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> IronClawClient:
    return IronClawClient(base_url=base_url, timeout=timeout, headers=headers)

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final, Sequence


DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final[float] = 10.0
DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS: Final[int] = 12000
DEFAULT_AUDIT_FILE: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name(".ironclawshellguard-audit.json")

SAFE_ENV_ALLOWLIST: Final[set[str]] = {
    "PATH",
    "PYTHONPATH",
    "SYSTEMROOT",
    "WINDIR",
    "TEMP",
    "TMP",
    "HOME",
    "USERPROFILE",
    "IRONCLAW_ENV",
    "IRONCLAW_MODE",
}

DEFAULT_ALLOWED_COMMANDS: Final[dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = {
    "python": ("python", "python3", "py"),
    "pip": ("pip", "pip3"),
    "pytest": ("pytest",),
    "uvicorn": ("uvicorn",),
    "ruff": ("ruff",),
    "mypy": ("mypy",),
    "bandit": ("bandit",),
    "npm": ("npm",),
    "node": ("node",),
    "git": ("git",),
}

DANGEROUS_TOKENS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    ";",
    "&&",
    "||",
    "|",
    ">",
    ">>",
    "<",
    "$(",
    "`",
    "\n",
    "\r",
)

WINDOWS_ABSOLUTE_PATH_RE: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z]:\\")
SAFE_TOKEN_RE: Final[re.Pattern[str]] = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9._:/=,@%+\-\\]+$")


class ShellGuardError(RuntimeError):
    """Base error for shell guard failures."""


class ShellGuardPolicyError(ShellGuardError):
    """Raised when a command violates IronClaw shell policy."""


class ShellGuardExecutionError(ShellGuardError):
    """Raised when a guarded command execution fails."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GuardedCommandResult:
    ok: bool
    returncode: int | None
    command: tuple[str, ...]
    duration_ms: int
    stdout: str
    stderr: str
    policy: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class IronClawShellGuard:
    """
    IronClaw shell command policy guard.

    Security goals:
    - never uses shell=True
    - enforces command allowlisting
    - blocks shell metacharacter usage
    - constrains environment exposure
    - captures output safely with timeout support
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        allowed_commands: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] | None = None,
        default_timeout_seconds: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        max_output_chars: int = DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS,
        audit_file: Path | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._allowed_commands = allowed_commands or DEFAULT_ALLOWED_COMMANDS
        self._default_timeout_seconds = default_timeout_seconds if default_timeout_seconds > 0 else DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        self._max_output_chars = max_output_chars if max_output_chars > 0 else DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS
        self._audit_file = (audit_file or DEFAULT_AUDIT_FILE).resolve()

    @property
    def audit_file(self) -> Path:
        return self._audit_file

    def run(
        self,
        command: str | Sequence[str],
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
        cwd: str | Path | None = None,
        env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        check: bool = True,
    ) -> GuardedCommandResult:
        argv = self._normalize_command(command)
        self._validate_command(argv)

        effective_timeout = timeout_seconds if timeout_seconds and timeout_seconds > 0 else self._default_timeout_seconds
        effective_cwd = self._normalize_cwd(cwd)
        effective_env = self._build_env(env)

        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                argv,
                cwd=str(effective_cwd) if effective_cwd else None,
                env=effective_env,
                shell=False,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=effective_timeout,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
            )
            duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
            stdout = self._truncate_output(exc.stdout or "")
            stderr = self._truncate_output(exc.stderr or "")
            result = GuardedCommandResult(
                ok=False,
                returncode=None,
                command=tuple(argv),
                duration_ms=duration_ms,
                stdout=stdout,
                stderr=stderr,
                policy="timeout",
            )
            self._append_audit(result)
            raise ShellGuardExecutionError(
                f"Command timed out after {effective_timeout} seconds: {self._render_command(argv)}"
            ) from exc
        except OSError as exc:
            raise ShellGuardExecutionError(
                f"Command execution failed for {self._render_command(argv)}: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        result = GuardedCommandResult(
            ok=(completed.returncode == 0),
            returncode=completed.returncode,
            command=tuple(argv),
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            stdout=self._truncate_output(completed.stdout),
            stderr=self._truncate_output(completed.stderr),
            policy="allowed",
        )
        self._append_audit(result)

        if check and completed.returncode != 0:
            raise ShellGuardExecutionError(
                f"Command failed with exit code {completed.returncode}: {self._render_command(argv)}"
            )

        return result

    def dry_validate(self, command: str | Sequence[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        argv = self._normalize_command(command)
        self._validate_command(argv)
        return tuple(argv)

    def _normalize_command(self, command: str | Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
        if isinstance(command, str):
            stripped = command.strip()
            if not stripped:
                raise ShellGuardPolicyError("Empty command is not allowed.")
            try:
                argv = shlex.split(stripped, posix=os.name != "nt")
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Invalid command syntax: {exc}") from exc
        else:
            argv = [str(part).strip() for part in command if str(part).strip()]

        if not argv:
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError("Command produced no executable tokens.")
        return argv

    def _validate_command(self, argv: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        executable = argv[0]
        normalized_executable = Path(executable).name.lower()

        if not self._is_allowed_executable(normalized_executable):
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Executable is not allowlisted: {executable}")

        for token in argv:
            self._validate_token(token)

    def _validate_token(self, token: str) -> None:
        if not token:
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError("Empty command token is not allowed.")

        if any(marker in token for marker in DANGEROUS_TOKENS):
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Dangerous shell token rejected: {token!r}")

        if token.startswith(("~", "*", "?", "!")):
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Unsafe shell-expansion token rejected: {token!r}")

        if token.startswith("-") and len(token) > 128:
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Suspicious oversized flag rejected: {token!r}")

        if token.startswith("/"):
            return

        if WINDOWS_ABSOLUTE_PATH_RE.match(token):
            return

        if SAFE_TOKEN_RE.fullmatch(token):
            return

        raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Unsafe command token rejected: {token!r}")

    def _is_allowed_executable(self, executable_name: str) -> bool:
        for aliases in self._allowed_commands.values():
            if executable_name in {item.lower() for item in aliases}:
                return True
        return False

    def _normalize_cwd(self, cwd: str | Path | None) -> Path | None:
        if cwd is None:
            return None

        resolved = Path(cwd).expanduser().resolve()
        workspace_root = Path.cwd().resolve()

        if not self._is_relative_to(resolved, workspace_root):
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Working directory escapes workspace root: {resolved}")

        if not resolved.exists() or not resolved.is_dir():
            raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Working directory does not exist: {resolved}")

        return resolved

    def _build_env(self, env: dict[str, str] | None) -> dict[str, str]:
        safe_env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key in SAFE_ENV_ALLOWLIST}

        if not env:
            return safe_env

        for key, value in env.items():
            if key not in SAFE_ENV_ALLOWLIST:
                raise ShellGuardPolicyError(f"Environment variable is not allowlisted: {key}")
            safe_env[key] = value

        return safe_env

    def _append_audit(self, result: GuardedCommandResult) -> None:
        self._audit_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = result.to_dict()
        record["timestamp"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())

        with self._audit_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def _truncate_output(self, value: str | bytes | None) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if isinstance(value, bytes):
            value = value.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if len(value) <= self._max_output_chars:
            return value
        return value[: self._max_output_chars] + "\n...[truncated]"

    @staticmethod
    def _render_command(argv: Sequence[str]) -> str:
        return " ".join(shlex.quote(part) for part in argv)

    @staticmethod
    def _is_relative_to(path: Path, base: Path) -> bool:
        try:
            path.relative_to(base)
            return True
        except ValueError:
            return False


_default_guard = IronClawShellGuard()


def run_guarded_command(
    command: str | Sequence[str],
    *,
    timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    cwd: str | Path | None = None,
    env: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    check: bool = True,
) -> GuardedCommandResult:
    return _default_guard.run(
        command,
        timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
        cwd=cwd,
        env=env,
        check=check,
    )


def validate_guarded_command(command: str | Sequence[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return _default_guard.dry_validate(command)

__all__ = [
    "__package_name__",
    "__version__",
    *_MODULE_NAMES,
    *_EXPORT_NAMES.keys(),
]


def __dir__() -> list[str]:
    return sorted(set(__all__) | set(globals().keys()))


def __getattr__(name: str) -> Any:
    if name in _MODULE_NAMES:
        module = import_module(f"{__name__}.{name}")
        globals()[name] = module
        return module

    module_name = _EXPORT_NAMES.get(name)
    if module_name is None:
        raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

    module: ModuleType = import_module(f"{__name__}.{module_name}")
    value = getattr(module, name)
    globals()[name] = value
    return value
