from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence

import httpx

from .config import ProviderConfig
from .errors import ProviderAuthenticationError, ProviderExecutionError


def _normalize_messages(messages: Sequence[Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    normalized: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for message in messages:
        role = getattr(message, "role", None)
        content = getattr(message, "content", None)
        if role is None and isinstance(message, Mapping):
            role = message.get("role")
            content = message.get("content")
        normalized.append(
            {
                "role": str(role or "user"),
                "content": str(content or ""),
            }
        )
    return normalized


def _extract_text(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    content = payload.get("content")
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content.strip()

    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts: list[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                if item.get("type") == "text" and isinstance(item.get("text"), str):
                    parts.append(item["text"])
                elif isinstance(item.get("content"), str):
                    parts.append(item["content"])
            elif isinstance(item, str):
                parts.append(item)
        return "\n".join(part for part in parts if part).strip()

    output_text = payload.get("output_text")
    if isinstance(output_text, str):
        return output_text.strip()

    completion = payload.get("completion")
    if isinstance(completion, str):
        return completion.strip()

    return ""


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ClaudeAdapter:
    config: ProviderConfig

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self.config.name

    def healthcheck(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        configured = self.config.enabled and bool(
            self.config.endpoint and self.config.api_key and self.config.model
        )
        return {
            "provider": self.name,
            "ok": configured,
            "message": "ready" if configured else "missing configuration",
        }

    async def execute(self, request: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.config.require_ready()

        headers = {
            "x-api-key": self.config.api_key or "",
            "content-type": "application/json",
            "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
            **dict(self.config.headers),
        }

        if self.config.organization:
            headers["anthropic-organization-id"] = self.config.organization

        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": getattr(request, "model", None) or self.config.model,
            "max_tokens": int(getattr(request, "max_tokens", 1024)),
            "messages": _normalize_messages(getattr(request, "messages", ())),
        }

        system_prompt = getattr(request, "system_prompt", None)
        if system_prompt:
            payload["system"] = system_prompt

        temperature = getattr(request, "temperature", None)
        if temperature is not None:
            payload["temperature"] = temperature

        metadata = getattr(request, "metadata", None)
        if metadata:
            payload["metadata"] = dict(metadata)

        timeout = httpx.Timeout(
            timeout=self.config.timeout_seconds,
            connect=self.config.connect_timeout_seconds,
        )

        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout) as client:
                response = await client.post(
                    self.config.endpoint,
                    headers=headers,
                    json=payload,
                )
        except httpx.TimeoutException as exc:
            raise ProviderExecutionError(f"{self.name} request timed out") from exc
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise ProviderExecutionError(f"{self.name} transport error: {exc}") from exc

        if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
            raise ProviderAuthenticationError(f"{self.name} authentication failed")

        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise ProviderExecutionError(
                f"{self.name} returned {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()
        usage_raw = data.get("usage")
        usage = dict(usage_raw) if isinstance(usage_raw, Mapping) else {}

        return {
            "provider": self.name,
            "model": str(payload["model"]),
            "output_text": _extract_text(data),
            "finish_reason": str(data.get("stop_reason") or data.get("finish_reason") or "unknown"),
            "usage": usage,
            "raw_response": data,
        }


ClaudeSkillAdapter = ClaudeAdapter


def adaptclauderequest(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("Claude request payload must be a JSON object.")
    return dict(payload)


def adaptclauderesponse(response: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if hasattr(response, "model_dump") and callable(response.model_dump):
        dumped = response.model_dump(mode="json")
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dumped
    if hasattr(response, "todict") and callable(response.todict):
        dumped = response.todict()
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dumped
    if isinstance(response, dict):
        return dict(response)
    return {"result": response}


__all__ = [
    "ClaudeAdapter",
    "ClaudeSkillAdapter",
    "adaptclauderequest",
    "adaptclauderesponse",
]

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final, Literal, Protocol

from .contracts import SkillProvider, SkillRequestContext
from .errors import (
    ProviderConfigurationError,
    ProviderExecutionError,
    ProviderUnavailableError,
)

BillingOperation = Literal["scan", "actionpolicy", "actiondecision", "execute", "unknown"]
BillingProvider = Literal["stub", "memory"]
BillingStatus = Literal["accepted", "rejected", "noop"]

DEFAULT_PROVIDER: Final[BillingProvider] = "stub"
DEFAULT_LEDGER_DIRNAME: Final[str] = ".ironclaw"
DEFAULT_LEDGER_FILENAME: Final[str] = "skill-billing-ledger.jsonl"
DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_SCAN: Final[int] = 1
DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_ACTION_POLICY: Final[int] = 1
DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_ACTION_DECISION: Final[int] = 1
DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_EXECUTE: Final[int] = 2
DEFAULT_BLOCK_ON_EXHAUSTED: Final[bool] = False
DEFAULT_BALANCE: Final[int] = 0


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BillingContext:
    request_id: str | None = None
    client_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    user_id: str | None = None
    tenant_id: str | None = None
    organization_id: str | None = None
    customer_id: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    source_platform: str | None = None
    environment: str | None = None
    route: str | None = None
    method: str | None = None
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BillingEvent:
    operation: BillingOperation
    units: int
    provider: BillingProvider
    status: BillingStatus
    timestamp: float
    reason: str | None = None
    request_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    balance_before: int | None = None
    balance_after: int | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class BillingResult:
    ok: bool
    operation: BillingOperation
    units_charged: int
    provider: BillingProvider
    status: BillingStatus
    reason: str | None = None
    balance_before: int | None = None
    balance_after: int | None = None
    event: BillingEvent | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload = asdict(self)
        if self.event is not None:
            payload["event"] = self.event.to_dict()
        return payload


@dataclass(slots=True)
class BillingPolicy:
    provider: BillingProvider = DEFAULT_PROVIDER
    units_per_scan: int = DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_SCAN
    units_per_action_policy: int = DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_ACTION_POLICY
    units_per_action_decision: int = DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_ACTION_DECISION
    units_per_execute: int = DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_EXECUTE
    block_on_exhausted: bool = DEFAULT_BLOCK_ON_EXHAUSTED
    default_balance: int = DEFAULT_BALANCE
    ledger_path: Path | None = None

    def cost_for(self, operation: BillingOperation) -> int:
        if operation == "scan":
            return self.units_per_scan
        if operation == "actionpolicy":
            return self.units_per_action_policy
        if operation == "actiondecision":
            return self.units_per_action_decision
        if operation == "execute":
            return self.units_per_execute
        return 0


class BillingHook(Protocol):
    def charge(
        self,
        *,
        operation: BillingOperation,
        context: BillingContext | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        units: int | None = None,
    ) -> BillingResult: ...


def _normalize_optional_text(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None


def _coerce_bool(value: Any, *, default: bool) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}:
        return True
    if normalized in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}:
        return False
    return default


def _coerce_int(value: Any, *, default: int, field_name: str) -> int:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return default
    try:
        result = int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ProviderConfigurationError(
            f"Invalid integer for {field_name}: {value!r}"
        ) from exc
    if result < 0:
        raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"{field_name} must be >= 0")
    return result


def default_ledger_path() -> Path:
    configured = _normalize_optional_text(os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BILLING_LEDGER_PATH"))
    if configured:
        return Path(configured).expanduser().resolve()
    return (Path.home() / DEFAULT_LEDGER_DIRNAME / DEFAULT_LEDGER_FILENAME).resolve()


def load_billing_policy() -> BillingPolicy:
    provider_raw = (
        _normalize_optional_text(os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BILLING_PROVIDER")) or DEFAULT_PROVIDER
    )
    provider = provider_raw.lower()
    if provider not in {"stub", "memory"}:
        raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Unsupported billing provider: {provider_raw}")

    return BillingPolicy(
        provider=provider,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        units_per_scan=_coerce_int(
            os.getenv("IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_SCAN") or os.getenv("IRONCLAWUNITSPERSCAN"),
            default=DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_SCAN,
            field_name="IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_SCAN",
        ),
        units_per_action_policy=_coerce_int(
            os.getenv("IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_ACTION_POLICY")
            or os.getenv("IRONCLAWUNITSPERACTIONPOLICY"),
            default=DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_ACTION_POLICY,
            field_name="IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_ACTION_POLICY",
        ),
        units_per_action_decision=_coerce_int(
            os.getenv("IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_ACTION_DECISION")
            or os.getenv("IRONCLAWUNITSPERACTIONDECISION"),
            default=DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_ACTION_DECISION,
            field_name="IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_ACTION_DECISION",
        ),
        units_per_execute=_coerce_int(
            os.getenv("IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_EXECUTE") or os.getenv("IRONCLAWUNITSPEREXECUTE"),
            default=DEFAULT_UNITS_PER_EXECUTE,
            field_name="IRONCLAW_UNITS_PER_EXECUTE",
        ),
        block_on_exhausted=_coerce_bool(
            os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BILLING_BLOCK_ON_EXHAUSTED"),
            default=DEFAULT_BLOCK_ON_EXHAUSTED,
        ),
        default_balance=_coerce_int(
            os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BILLING_DEFAULT_BALANCE"),
            default=DEFAULT_BALANCE,
            field_name="IRONCLAW_BILLING_DEFAULT_BALANCE",
        ),
        ledger_path=default_ledger_path(),
    )


class StubBillingHook:
    """No-op provider that records unit charges without enforcing balance."""

    def __init__(self, policy: BillingPolicy | None = None) -> None:
        self.policy = policy or load_billing_policy()

    def charge(
        self,
        *,
        operation: BillingOperation,
        context: BillingContext | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        units: int | None = None,
    ) -> BillingResult:
        effective_units = self.policy.cost_for(operation) if units is None else max(int(units), 0)
        event = BillingEvent(
            operation=operation,
            units=effective_units,
            provider="stub",
            status="noop",
            timestamp=time.time(),
            reason="stub-billing-provider",
            request_id=context.request_id if context else None,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            balance_before=None,
            balance_after=None,
        )
        return BillingResult(
            ok=True,
            operation=operation,
            units_charged=effective_units,
            provider="stub",
            status="noop",
            reason="stub-billing-provider",
            balance_before=None,
            balance_after=None,
            event=event,
        )


class MemoryBillingHook:
    """In-memory unit ledger provider for local testing and future integration."""

    def __init__(self, policy: BillingPolicy | None = None) -> None:
        self.policy = policy or load_billing_policy()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        self._balance = self.policy.default_balance
        self._ledger_path = self.policy.ledger_path or default_ledger_path()

    @property
    def balance(self) -> int:
        return self._balance

    @property
    def ledger_path(self) -> Path:
        return self._ledger_path

    def reset_balance(self, units: int) -> None:
        if units < 0:
            raise ProviderConfigurationError("reset balance must be >= 0")
        with self._lock:
            self._balance = units

    def charge(
        self,
        *,
        operation: BillingOperation,
        context: BillingContext | None = None,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        units: int | None = None,
    ) -> BillingResult:
        effective_units = self.policy.cost_for(operation) if units is None else max(int(units), 0)

        with self._lock:
            before = self._balance

            if self.policy.block_on_exhausted and effective_units > before:
                event = BillingEvent(
                    operation=operation,
                    units=effective_units,
                    provider="memory",
                    status="rejected",
                    timestamp=time.time(),
                    reason="insufficient-units",
                    request_id=context.request_id if context else None,
                    metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
                    balance_before=before,
                    balance_after=before,
                )
                self._append_ledger_event(event)
                return BillingResult(
                    ok=False,
                    operation=operation,
                    units_charged=0,
                    provider="memory",
                    status="rejected",
                    reason="insufficient-units",
                    balance_before=before,
                    balance_after=before,
                    event=event,
                )

            after = before - effective_units
            self._balance = after

            event = BillingEvent(
                operation=operation,
                units=effective_units,
                provider="memory",
                status="accepted",
                timestamp=time.time(),
                reason=None,
                request_id=context.request_id if context else None,
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
                balance_before=before,
                balance_after=after,
            )
            self._append_ledger_event(event)

            return BillingResult(
                ok=True,
                operation=operation,
                units_charged=effective_units,
                provider="memory",
                status="accepted",
                reason=None,
                balance_before=before,
                balance_after=after,
                event=event,
            )

    def _append_ledger_event(self, event: BillingEvent) -> None:
        try:
            self._ledger_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with self._ledger_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                handle.write(json.dumps(event.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        except OSError as exc:
            raise ProviderExecutionError(f"Failed to append billing ledger: {exc}") from exc


def create_billing_hook(policy: BillingPolicy | None = None) -> BillingHook:
    resolved_policy = policy or load_billing_policy()
    if resolved_policy.provider == "stub":
        return StubBillingHook(resolved_policy)
    if resolved_policy.provider == "memory":
        return MemoryBillingHook(resolved_policy)
    raise ProviderUnavailableError(f"Unsupported billing provider: {resolved_policy.provider}")


def _coerce_provider_value(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, SkillProvider):
        return value.value
    enum_value = getattr(value, "value", None)
    if isinstance(enum_value, str) and enum_value.strip():
        return enum_value.strip()
    return _normalize_optional_text(value)


def build_billing_context_from_request_context(
    request_context: SkillRequestContext | Any,
) -> BillingContext | None:
    if request_context is None:
        return None

    tags_value = getattr(request_context, "tags", ())
    if isinstance(tags_value, (list, tuple, set)):
        tags = tuple(str(item).strip() for item in tags_value if str(item).strip())
    elif isinstance(tags_value, str) and tags_value.strip():
        tags = tuple(part.strip() for part in tags_value.split(",") if part.strip())
    else:
        tags = ()

    meta_value = getattr(request_context, "metadata", {})
    metadata = dict(meta_value) if isinstance(meta_value, dict) else {}

    source_platform = _normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "source_platform", None))
    if source_platform is None:
        provider = getattr(request_context, "provider", None)
        source_platform = _coerce_provider_value(provider)

    return BillingContext(
        request_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "request_id", None)),
        client_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "client_id", None)),
        session_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "session_id", None)),
        user_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "user_id", None)),
        tenant_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "tenant_id", None)),
        organization_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "organization_id", None)),
        customer_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "customer_id", None)),
        actor_id=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "actor_id", None)),
        source_platform=source_platform,
        environment=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "environment", None)),
        route=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "route", None)),
        method=_normalize_optional_text(getattr(request_context, "method", None)),
        tags=tags,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


def charge_units(
    *,
    operation: BillingOperation,
    hook: BillingHook | None = None,
    context: BillingContext | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    units: int | None = None,
) -> BillingResult:
    resolved_hook = hook or create_billing_hook()
    return resolved_hook.charge(
        operation=operation,
        context=context,
        metadata=metadata,
        units=units,
    )

chargeunits = charge_units

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final, Literal

from .adapterclaude import adaptclauderesponse, adaptclauderequest
from .adapteropenclaw import adaptopenclawresponse, adaptopenclawrequest
from .billing import BillingResult, chargeunits, createbillinghook
from .config import IronClawSkillConfig, loadconfig
from .contracts import SkillExecutionRequest, SkillResponseEnvelope
from .router import IronClawSkillRouter
from .runtime import runtimesnapshot

CliFormat = Literal["json", "pretty"]
CliProvider = Literal["openclaw", "claude"]
CliOperation = Literal["scan", "actionpolicy", "actiondecision", "execute"]

DEFAULT_INPUT_FILE: Final[str] = "-"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_FORMAT: Final[CliFormat] = "pretty"


class IronClawSkillCliError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when CLI invocation or payload handling fails."""


def buildparser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ironclawskill",
        description="IronClaw skill CLI for request adaptation, routing, runtime inspection, and guarded local testing.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        dest="configpath",
        default=None,
        help="Optional path to an ironclawskill TOML config file.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--provider",
        choices=["openclaw", "claude"],
        default="openclaw",
        help="Request adapter/provider shape for input and output payloads.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--input-file",
        default=DEFAULT_INPUT_FILE,
        help="Path to JSON input payload. Use '-' to read from stdin.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-format",
        choices=["json", "pretty"],
        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT_FORMAT,
        help="Output rendering style.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--fail-on-error",
        action="store_true",
        help="Exit non-zero when routed response indicates failure.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--with-billing",
        action="store_true",
        help="Run billing hook before routing and include billing result in output.",
    )

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    routeparser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "route",
        help="Adapt a provider payload into SkillRequest, route it, and adapt the response back.",
    )
    routeparser.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        choices=["scan", "actionpolicy", "actiondecision", "execute"],
        default=None,
        help="Optional asserted operation for request validation.",
    )

    adaptrequestparser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "adapt-request",
        help="Adapt provider-shaped JSON into canonical SkillRequest JSON.",
    )
    adaptrequestparser.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        choices=["scan", "actionpolicy", "actiondecision", "execute"],
        default=None,
        help="Optional asserted operation for request validation.",
    )

    adaptresponseparser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "adapt-response",
        help="Adapt canonical SkillResponseEnvelope JSON into provider-shaped JSON.",
    )
    adaptresponseparser.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        choices=["scan", "actionpolicy", "actiondecision", "execute"],
        default=None,
        help="Optional asserted operation for response validation.",
    )

    runtimeparser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "runtime",
        help="Print runtime connectivity and resolved config snapshot.",
    )
    runtimeparser.add_argument(
        "--as-text",
        action="store_true",
        help="Emit only the runtime JSON payload without CLI envelope metadata.",
    )

    return parser


def readjson(path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if path == "-" or not path.strip():
        data = sys.stdin.read()
        if not data.strip():
            raise IronClawSkillCliError("No JSON input received on stdin.")
        return parsedictjson(data, source="stdin")

    file_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
    if not file_path.exists() or not file_path.is_file():
        raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Input file does not exist: {file_path}")
    return parsedictjson(file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), source=str(file_path))


def parsedictjson(raw: str, *, source: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Invalid JSON from {source}: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Expected top-level JSON object from {source}.")
    return payload


def loadskillconfig(configpath: str | None) -> IronClawSkillConfig:
    return loadconfig(configpath=configpath) if configpath else loadconfig()


def adaptrequest(provider: CliProvider, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> SkillExecutionRequest:
    if provider == "openclaw":
        return adaptopenclawrequest(payload)
    if provider == "claude":
        return adaptclauderequest(payload)
    raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Unsupported provider: {provider}")


def adaptresponse(provider: CliProvider, response: SkillResponseEnvelope) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if provider == "openclaw":
        return adaptopenclawresponse(response)
    if provider == "claude":
        return adaptclauderesponse(response)
    raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Unsupported provider: {provider}")


def assertrequestoperation(request: SkillExecutionRequest, expected: CliOperation | None) -> None:
    if expected is None:
        return
    actual = getattr(request, "operation", None)
    if actual != expected:
        raise IronClawSkillCliError(
            f"Request operation mismatch: expected {expected}, received {actual}."
        )


def assertresponseoperation(response: SkillResponseEnvelope, expected: CliOperation | None) -> None:
    if expected is None:
        return
    actual = getattr(response, "operation", None)
    if actual != expected:
        raise IronClawSkillCliError(
            f"Response operation mismatch: expected {expected}, received {actual}."
        )


def envelopeok(response: SkillResponseEnvelope) -> bool:
    return bool(getattr(response, "ok", False)) and not bool(getattr(response, "errorcode", None))


def modeljson(value: Any) -> Any:
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(value.model_dump):
        return value.model_dump(mode="json")
    if hasattr(value, "todict") and callable(value.todict):
        return value.todict()
    return value


def renderpayload(payload: Any, *, outputformat: CliFormat) -> str:
    if outputformat == "json":
        return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
    return json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=False)


def billingoperationfromrequest(request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> CliOperation:
    operation = getattr(request, "operation", None)
    if operation in {"scan", "actionpolicy", "actiondecision", "execute"}:
        return operation  # type: ignore[return-value]
    raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Unsupported billing operation: {operation}")


def commandroute(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = readjson(args.input_file)
    request = adaptrequest(args.provider, payload)
    assertrequestoperation(request, args.operation)

    billing: BillingResult | None = None
    if args.with_billing:
        billing = chargeunits(
            operation=billingoperationfromrequest(request),
            hook=createbillinghook(),
            context=None if getattr(request, "context", None) is None else None,
            metadata={
                "source": "cli",
                "provider": args.provider,
                "command": "route",
            },
        )

    router = IronClawSkillRouter()
    response = router.route(request)
    result = adaptresponse(args.provider, response)

    output: dict[str, Any] = {
        "ok": envelopeok(response),
        "provider": args.provider,
        "command": "route",
        "request": modeljson(request),
        "response": result,
    }
    if billing is not None:
        output["billing"] = billing.todict()
    return output


def commandadaptrequest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = readjson(args.input_file)
    request = adaptrequest(args.provider, payload)
    assertrequestoperation(request, args.operation)
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "provider": args.provider,
        "command": "adapt-request",
        "request": modeljson(request),
    }


def commandadaptresponse(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = readjson(args.input_file)
    try:
        response = SkillResponseEnvelope(**payload)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Canonical response payload validation failed: {exc}") from exc
    assertresponseoperation(response, args.operation)
    return {
        "ok": envelopeok(response),
        "provider": args.provider,
        "command": "adapt-response",
        "response": adaptresponse(args.provider, response),
    }


def commandruntime(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    config = loadskillconfig(args.configpath)
    snapshot = runtimesnapshot()
    payload = {
        "ok": True,
        "command": "runtime",
        "config": {
            "appname": config.appname,
            "environment": config.environment,
            "defaultprovider": config.defaultprovider,
            "failclosed": config.failclosed,
            "telemetryenabled": config.telemetryenabled,
            "debug": config.debug,
            "enabledproviders": list(config.enabledproviders),
            "paths": {
                "rootdir": str(config.paths.rootdir),
                "configfile": str(config.paths.configfile) if config.paths.configfile else None,
                "auditlogpath": str(config.paths.auditlogpath) if config.paths.auditlogpath else None,
                "rulesdir": str(config.paths.rulesdir) if config.paths.rulesdir else None,
                "quarantinedir": str(config.paths.quarantinedir) if config.paths.quarantinedir else None,
                "outputdir": str(config.paths.outputdir) if config.paths.outputdir else None,
            },
            "security": {
                "reviewonhighrisk": config.security.reviewonhighrisk,
                "blockonpolicyviolation": config.security.blockonpolicyviolation,
                "allownetwork": config.security.allownetwork,
                "allowtoolinvocation": config.security.allowtoolinvocation,
                "allowfilesystemwrite": config.security.allowfilesystemwrite,
                "enablesandbox": config.security.enablesandbox,
                "enableauditlogging": config.security.enableauditlogging,
                "enablepromptredaction": config.security.enablepromptredaction,
                "maxpayloadbytes": config.security.maxpayloadbytes,
                "maxoutputbytes": config.security.maxoutputbytes,
                "maxexecutionseconds": config.security.maxexecutionseconds,
            },
        },
        "runtime": snapshot,
    }
    if args.as_text:
        return snapshot
    return payload


def dispatch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if args.command == "route":
        return commandroute(args)
    if args.command == "adapt-request":
        return commandadaptrequest(args)
    if args.command == "adapt-response":
        return commandadaptresponse(args)
    if args.command == "runtime":
        return commandruntime(args)
    raise IronClawSkillCliError(f"Unsupported command: {args.command}")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = buildparser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        output = dispatch(args)
        print(renderpayload(output, outputformat=args.output_format))
        if args.fail_on_error and not bool(output.get("ok", False)):
            return 1
        return 0
    except IronClawSkillCliError as exc:
        errorpayload = {
            "ok": False,
            "error": {
                "code": "skill-cli-error",
                "message": str(exc),
            },
        }
        print(renderpayload(errorpayload, outputformat=args.output_format), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:
        errorpayload = {
            "ok": False,
            "error": {
                "code": "skill-cli-unhandled-error",
                "message": str(exc),
            },
        }
        print(renderpayload(errorpayload, outputformat=args.output_format), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping

from .errors import ProviderConfigurationError

try:
    import tomllib
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # pragma: no cover
    tomllib = None  # type: ignore[assignment]

JsonValue = Any


def _env(name: str, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    value = os.getenv(name)
    if value is None:
        return default
    value = value.strip()
    return value or default


def _env_bool(name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    value = _env(name)
    if value is None:
        return default
    return value.lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


def _env_int(name: str, default: int) -> int:
    value = _env(name)
    if value is None:
        return default
    try:
        return int(value)
    except ValueError:
        return default


def _normalize_mapping(value: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value or {})


def _first_present(*values: str | None, default: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    for value in values:
        if value is not None and str(value).strip():
            return str(value).strip()
    return default


def _resolve_path(value: str | None, *, base_dir: Path | None = None) -> Path | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    path = Path(value).expanduser()
    if not path.is_absolute() and base_dir is not None:
        path = base_dir / path
    return path.resolve()


def _load_structured_config(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Backwards-compatible loader for structured config files.

    Primary source of truth is TOML; if TOML parsing fails, fall back to JSON
    so tests can exercise legacy JSON configs without changing the core model.
    """
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    if tomllib is not None:
        try:
            return tomllib.loads(text)
        except Exception:
            # Fall through to JSON for legacy configs written as JSON.
            pass

    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
        raise ProviderConfigurationError(
            f"Failed to parse configuration file '{path}': {exc}"
        ) from exc


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class ProviderConfig:
    name: str
    enabled: bool = True
    model: str | None = None
    endpoint: str | None = None
    api_key: str | None = None
    timeout_seconds: int = 30
    connect_timeout_seconds: int = 10
    max_retries: int = 2
    organization: str | None = None
    project: str | None = None
    headers: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def configured(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.endpoint or self.api_key or self.model)

    def require_ready(self) -> None:
        if not self.enabled:
            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Provider '{self.name}' is disabled")
        if not self.configured:
            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Provider '{self.name}' is not configured")


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class SecurityConfig:
    review_on_high_risk: bool = True
    block_on_policy_violation: bool = True
    allow_network: bool = False
    allow_tool_invocation: bool = False
    allow_filesystem_write: bool = False
    enable_sandbox: bool = True
    enable_audit_logging: bool = True
    enable_prompt_redaction: bool = True
    max_payload_bytes: int = 262_144
    max_output_bytes: int = 262_144
    max_execution_seconds: int = 120


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class PathsConfig:
    root_dir: Path
    config_file: Path | None = None
    audit_log_path: Path | None = None
    rules_dir: Path | None = None
    quarantine_dir: Path | None = None
    output_dir: Path | None = None

    @staticmethod
    def default(root_dir: Path | None = None) -> "PathsConfig":
        root = (root_dir or Path.cwd()).resolve()
        return PathsConfig(
            root_dir=root,
            config_file=None,
            audit_log_path=root / "output" / "security-events.jsonl",
            rules_dir=root / "rules" / "openclaw",
            quarantine_dir=root / "quarantine",
            output_dir=root / "output",
        )


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class IronClawSkillConfig:
    app_name: str = "ironclawskill"
    environment: str = "development"
    default_provider: str = "openclaw"
    fail_closed: bool = True
    telemetry_enabled: bool = True
    debug: bool = False
    paths: PathsConfig = field(default_factory=PathsConfig.default)
    security: SecurityConfig = field(default_factory=SecurityConfig)
    providers: Mapping[str, ProviderConfig] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def get_provider(self, name: str | None = None) -> ProviderConfig:
        provider_name = (name or self.default_provider).strip().lower()
        provider = self.providers.get(provider_name)
        if provider is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Unknown provider '{provider_name}'")
        return provider

    def require_provider(self, name: str | None = None) -> ProviderConfig:
        provider = self.get_provider(name)
        provider.require_ready()
        return provider

    @property
    def enabled_providers(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(name for name, provider in self.providers.items() if provider.enabled)

    # Backwards-compatible alias for older call sites / tests
    @property
    def enabledproviders(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self.enabled_providers

    # Backwards-compatible Pydantic-style export used in tests
    def model_dump(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Provide a Pydantic-like export API so tests can compare configs
        using model_dump() even though this is a dataclass-based model.
        """
        def _provider_dict(p: ProviderConfig) -> dict[str, Any]:
            d = asdict(p)
            return d

        def _paths_dict(p: PathsConfig) -> dict[str, Any]:
            d = asdict(p)
            d["root_dir"] = str(d["root_dir"])
            if d["config_file"] is not None:
                d["config_file"] = str(d["config_file"])
            if d["audit_log_path"] is not None:
                d["audit_log_path"] = str(d["audit_log_path"])
            if d["rules_dir"] is not None:
                d["rules_dir"] = str(d["rules_dir"])
            if d["quarantine_dir"] is not None:
                d["quarantine_dir"] = str(d["quarantine_dir"])
            if d["output_dir"] is not None:
                d["output_dir"] = str(d["output_dir"])
            return d

        base = {
            "app_name": self.app_name,
            "environment": self.environment,
            "default_provider": self.default_provider,
            "fail_closed": self.fail_closed,
            "telemetry_enabled": self.telemetry_enabled,
            "debug": self.debug,
            "paths": _paths_dict(self.paths),
            "security": asdict(self.security),
            "providers": {name: _provider_dict(cfg) for name, cfg in self.providers.items()},
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }
        return base

    @classmethod
    def from_mapping(
        cls,
        data: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        *,
        root_dir: Path | None = None,
        config_file: Path | None = None,
    ) -> "IronClawSkillConfig":
        raw = dict(data or {})
        resolved_root = (root_dir or Path.cwd()).resolve()
        base_dir = (config_file.parent if config_file is not None else resolved_root).resolve()

        app_name = str(raw.get("app_name") or "ironclawskill")
        environment = str(raw.get("environment") or "development")
        default_provider = str(raw.get("default_provider") or "openclaw").lower()
        fail_closed = bool(raw.get("fail_closed", True))
        telemetry_enabled = bool(raw.get("telemetry_enabled", True))
        debug = bool(raw.get("debug", False))

        raw_paths = _normalize_mapping(raw.get("paths"))
        default_paths = PathsConfig.default(resolved_root)
        paths = PathsConfig(
            root_dir=resolved_root,
            config_file=config_file.resolve() if config_file else None,
            audit_log_path=_resolve_path(raw_paths.get("audit_log_path"), base_dir=base_dir)
            or default_paths.audit_log_path,
            rules_dir=_resolve_path(raw_paths.get("rules_dir"), base_dir=base_dir) or default_paths.rules_dir,
            quarantine_dir=_resolve_path(raw_paths.get("quarantine_dir"), base_dir=base_dir)
            or default_paths.quarantine_dir,
            output_dir=_resolve_path(raw_paths.get("output_dir"), base_dir=base_dir) or default_paths.output_dir,
        )

        raw_security = _normalize_mapping(raw.get("security"))
        security = SecurityConfig(
            review_on_high_risk=bool(raw_security.get("review_on_high_risk", True)),
            block_on_policy_violation=bool(raw_security.get("block_on_policy_violation", True)),
            allow_network=bool(raw_security.get("allow_network", False)),
            allow_tool_invocation=bool(raw_security.get("allow_tool_invocation", False)),
            allow_filesystem_write=bool(raw_security.get("allow_filesystem_write", False)),
            enable_sandbox=bool(raw_security.get("enable_sandbox", True)),
            enable_audit_logging=bool(raw_security.get("enable_audit_logging", True)),
            enable_prompt_redaction=bool(raw_security.get("enable_prompt_redaction", True)),
            max_payload_bytes=int(raw_security.get("max_payload_bytes", 262_144)),
            max_output_bytes=int(raw_security.get("max_output_bytes", 262_144)),
            max_execution_seconds=int(raw_security.get("max_execution_seconds", 120)),
        )

        raw_providers = _normalize_mapping(raw.get("providers"))
        providers: dict[str, ProviderConfig] = {}
        for name, item in raw_providers.items():
            item_map = _normalize_mapping(item)
            provider_name = str(name).lower()
            providers[provider_name] = ProviderConfig(
                name=provider_name,
                enabled=bool(item_map.get("enabled", True)),
                model=_first_present(item_map.get("model")),
                endpoint=_first_present(item_map.get("endpoint")),
                api_key=_first_present(item_map.get("api_key")),
                timeout_seconds=int(item_map.get("timeout_seconds", 30)),
                connect_timeout_seconds=int(item_map.get("connect_timeout_seconds", 10)),
                max_retries=int(item_map.get("max_retries", 2)),
                organization=_first_present(item_map.get("organization")),
                project=_first_present(item_map.get("project")),
                headers={str(k): str(v) for k, v in _normalize_mapping(item_map.get("headers")).items()},
                metadata=_normalize_mapping(item_map.get("metadata")),
            )

        config = cls(
            app_name=app_name,
            environment=environment,
            default_provider=default_provider,
            fail_closed=fail_closed,
            telemetry_enabled=telemetry_enabled,
            debug=debug,
            paths=paths,
            security=security,
            providers=providers,
            metadata=_normalize_mapping(raw.get("metadata")),
        )
        return config.with_env_overrides()

    @classmethod
    def from_toml_file(cls, path: str | Path, *, root_dir: Path | None = None) -> "IronClawSkillConfig":
        file_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
        data = _load_structured_config(file_path)
        return cls.from_mapping(data, root_dir=root_dir or file_path.parent, config_file=file_path)

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, *, root_dir: Path | None = None) -> "IronClawSkillConfig":
        base = cls(
            app_name=_env("IRONCLAWSKILL_APP_NAME", "ironclawskill") or "ironclawskill",
            environment=_env("IRONCLAWSKILL_ENV", "development") or "development",
            default_provider=(_env("IRONCLAWSKILL_DEFAULT_PROVIDER", "openclaw") or "openclaw").lower(),
            fail_closed=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_FAIL_CLOSED", True),
            telemetry_enabled=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED", True),
            debug=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_DEBUG", False),
            paths=PathsConfig.default(root_dir),
            security=SecurityConfig(),
            providers={},
            metadata={},
        )
        return base.with_env_overrides()

    @classmethod
    def load(
        cls,
        *,
        root_dir: Path | None = None,
        config_path: str | Path | None = None,
    ) -> "IronClawSkillConfig":
        search_root = (root_dir or Path.cwd()).resolve()
        explicit = _resolve_path(str(config_path), base_dir=search_root) if config_path else None
        env_path = _resolve_path(_env("IRONCLAWSKILL_CONFIG"), base_dir=search_root)
        candidates = [path for path in (explicit, env_path) if path is not None]
        candidates.extend(
            [
                search_root / "config" / "ironclawskill.toml",
                search_root / "config" / "ironclawskill.example.toml",
            ]
        )

        for candidate in candidates:
            if candidate.exists():
                return cls.from_toml_file(candidate, root_dir=search_root)
        return cls.from_env(root_dir=search_root)

    def with_env_overrides(self) -> "IronClawSkillConfig":
        providers = {name: provider for name, provider in self.providers.items()}

        for provider_name in ("openclaw", "claude"):
            prefix = f"IRONCLAWSKILL_{provider_name.upper()}_"
            existing = providers.get(provider_name, ProviderConfig(name=provider_name, enabled=False))
            providers[provider_name] = ProviderConfig(
                name=provider_name,
                enabled=_env_bool(f"{prefix}ENABLED", existing.enabled),
                model=_first_present(_env(f"{prefix}MODEL"), existing.model),
                endpoint=_first_present(_env(f"{prefix}ENDPOINT"), existing.endpoint),
                api_key=_first_present(
                    _env(f"{prefix}API_KEY"),
                    _env(f"{provider_name.upper()}_API_KEY"),
                    existing.api_key,
                ),
                timeout_seconds=_env_int(f"{prefix}TIMEOUT_SECONDS", existing.timeout_seconds),
                connect_timeout_seconds=_env_int(
                    f"{prefix}CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS",
                    existing.connect_timeout_seconds,
                ),
                max_retries=_env_int(f"{prefix}MAX_RETRIES", existing.max_retries),
                organization=_first_present(_env(f"{prefix}ORGANIZATION"), existing.organization),
                project=_first_present(_env(f"{prefix}PROJECT"), existing.project),
                headers=dict(existing.headers),
                metadata=dict(existing.metadata),
            )

        paths = PathsConfig(
            root_dir=self.paths.root_dir,
            config_file=self.paths.config_file,
            audit_log_path=_resolve_path(
                _env("IRONCLAWSKILL_AUDIT_LOG_PATH"),
                base_dir=self.paths.root_dir,
            )
            or self.paths.audit_log_path,
            rules_dir=_resolve_path(
                _env("IRONCLAWSKILL_RULES_DIR"),
                base_dir=self.paths.root_dir,
            )
            or self.paths.rules_dir,
            quarantine_dir=_resolve_path(
                _env("IRONCLAWSKILL_QUARANTINE_DIR"),
                base_dir=self.paths.root_dir,
            )
            or self.paths.quarantine_dir,
            output_dir=_resolve_path(
                _env("IRONCLAWSKILL_OUTPUT_DIR"),
                base_dir=self.paths.root_dir,
            )
            or self.paths.output_dir,
        )

        security = SecurityConfig(
            review_on_high_risk=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_REVIEW_ON_HIGH_RISK",
                self.security.review_on_high_risk,
            ),
            block_on_policy_violation=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_BLOCK_ON_POLICY_VIOLATION",
                self.security.block_on_policy_violation,
            ),
            allow_network=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_ALLOW_NETWORK", self.security.allow_network),
            allow_tool_invocation=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_ALLOW_TOOL_INVOCATION",
                self.security.allow_tool_invocation,
            ),
            allow_filesystem_write=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_ALLOW_FILESYSTEM_WRITE",
                self.security.allow_filesystem_write,
            ),
            enable_sandbox=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_ENABLE_SANDBOX", self.security.enable_sandbox),
            enable_audit_logging=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_ENABLE_AUDIT_LOGGING",
                self.security.enable_audit_logging,
            ),
            enable_prompt_redaction=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_ENABLE_PROMPT_REDACTION",
                self.security.enable_prompt_redaction,
            ),
            max_payload_bytes=_env_int(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES",
                self.security.max_payload_bytes,
            ),
            max_output_bytes=_env_int(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES",
                self.security.max_output_bytes,
            ),
            max_execution_seconds=_env_int(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_MAX_EXECUTION_SECONDS",
                self.security.max_execution_seconds,
            ),
        )

        return IronClawSkillConfig(
            app_name=_env("IRONCLAWSKILL_APP_NAME", self.app_name) or self.app_name,
            environment=_env("IRONCLAWSKILL_ENV", self.environment) or self.environment,
            default_provider=(
                _env("IRONCLAWSKILL_DEFAULT_PROVIDER", self.default_provider) or self.default_provider
            ).lower(),
            fail_closed=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_FAIL_CLOSED", self.fail_closed),
            telemetry_enabled=_env_bool(
                "IRONCLAWSKILL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED",
                self.telemetry_enabled,
            ),
            debug=_env_bool("IRONCLAWSKILL_DEBUG", self.debug),
            paths=paths,
            security=security,
            providers=providers,
            metadata=dict(self.metadata),
        )


def load_config(
    *,
    root_dir: Path | None = None,
    config_path: str | Path | None = None,
) -> IronClawSkillConfig:
    return IronClawSkillConfig.load(root_dir=root_dir, config_path=config_path)


loadconfig = load_config

@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class SkillRequestContext:
    requestid: str = field(default_factory=lambda: newid("req"))
    traceid: str = field(default_factory=lambda: newid("trace"))
    correlationid: str = field(default_factory=lambda: newid("corr"))
    sessionid: str | None = None
    organizationid: str | None = None
    customerid: str | None = None
    actorid: str | None = None
    environment: str = "production"
    region: str | None = None
    sourceip: str | None = None
    useragent: str | None = None
    route: str | None = None
    method: str | None = None
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    labels: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] = field(default_factory=dict)
    createdat: datetime = field(default_factory=utcnow)

    # Backwards-compatible aliases for tests or external callers
    @property
    def request_id(self) -> str:
        return self.requestid

    @property
    def trace_id(self) -> str:
        return self.traceid

    @property
    def correlation_id(self) -> str:
        return self.correlationid

    @property
    def session_id(self) -> str | None:
        return self.sessionid

    @property
    def organization_id(self) -> str | None:
        return self.organizationid

    @property
    def customer_id(self) -> str | None:
        return self.customerid

    @property
    def actor_id(self) -> str | None:
        return self.actorid

    @property
    def source_ip(self) -> str | None:
        return self.sourceip

    @property
    def user_agent(self) -> str | None:
        return self.useragent

    @property
    def created_at(self) -> datetime:
        return self.createdat

    def withmetadata(self, metadata: JsonValue) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        merged = dict(self.metadata)
        if isinstance(metadata, Mapping):
            merged.update(metadata)
        return replace(self, metadata=merged)

    def with_metadata(self, **metadata: JsonValue) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        merged = dict(self.metadata)
        merged.update(metadata)
        return replace(self, metadata=merged)

    def withlabel(self, **labels: str) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        merged = dict(self.labels)
        merged.update(labels)
        return replace(self, labels=merged)

    def with_labels(self, **labels: str) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        merged = dict(self.labels)
        merged.update(labels)
        return replace(self, labels=merged)

    def withtags(self, *tags: str) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        combined = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*self.tags, *tags)))
        return replace(self, tags=combined)

    def with_tags(self, *tags: str) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        combined = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*self.tags, *tags)))
        return replace(self, tags=combined)

    def child(
        self,
        *,
        requestid: str | None = None,
        traceid: str | None = None,
        correlationid: str | None = None,
        sessionid: str | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    ) -> "SkillRequestContext":
        mergedmetadata = dict(self.metadata)
        if metadata:
            mergedmetadata.update(metadata)
        return SkillRequestContext(
            requestid=requestid or newid("req"),
            traceid=traceid or self.traceid,
            correlationid=correlationid or self.correlationid,
            sessionid=sessionid if sessionid is not None else self.sessionid,
            organizationid=self.organizationid,
            customerid=self.customerid,
            actorid=self.actorid,
            environment=self.environment,
            region=self.region,
            sourceip=self.sourceip,
            useragent=self.useragent,
            route=self.route,
            method=self.method,
            tags=self.tags,
            labels=dict(self.labels),
            metadata=mergedmetadata,
        )

    def toheaders(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        headers: dict[str, str] = {
            "x-request-id": self.requestid,
            "x-trace-id": self.traceid,
            "x-correlation-id": self.correlationid,
        }
        if self.sessionid:
            headers["x-session-id"] = self.sessionid
        if self.organizationid:
            headers["x-organization-id"] = self.organizationid
        if self.customerid:
            headers["x-customer-id"] = self.customerid
        if self.actorid:
            headers["x-actor-id"] = self.actorid
        if self.region:
            headers["x-region"] = self.region
        if self.environment:
            headers["x-environment"] = self.environment
        return headers

    def to_headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return self.toheaders()

def createrequestcontext(
    *,
    sessionid: str | None = None,
    organizationid: str | None = None,
    customerid: str | None = None,
    actorid: str | None = None,
    environment: str = "production",
    region: str | None = None,
    sourceip: str | None = None,
    useragent: str | None = None,
    route: str | None = None,
    method: str | None = None,
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    labels: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
) -> SkillRequestContext:
    return SkillRequestContext(

        customerid=customerid,
        actorid=actorid,

        sourceip=sourceip,
        useragent=useragent,

        method=method,

        metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )


def createruntimecontext(
    *,
    provider: str,
    request: SkillRequestContext | None = None,
    operation: str = "execute",
    capability: str | None = None,
    policyid: str | None = None,
    reviewrequired: bool = False,

    networkallowed: bool = False,
    filesystemwriteallowed: bool = False,
    toolinvocationallowed: bool = False,
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
) -> SkillRuntimeContext:

        operation=operation,
        capability=capability,
        policyid=policyid,
        reviewrequired=reviewrequired,
        sandboxenabled=sandboxenabled,
        networkallowed=networkallowed,
        filesystemwriteallowed=filesystemwriteallowed,
        toolinvocationallowed=toolinvocationallowed,
        metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )

    finishedat: datetime = field(default_factory=utcnow)


    @property
    def isallowed(self) -> bool:
        return self.decision is SkillDecision.ALLOW


    @property
    def requiresreview(self) -> bool:
        return self.decision is SkillDecision.REVIEW


    @property
    def isblocked(self) -> bool:
        return self.decision is SkillDecision.BLOCK


    @property
    def iserror(self) -> bool:
        return self.decision is SkillDecision.ERROR


    def asdict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "requestid": self.requestid,
            "provider": self.provider.value if isinstance(self.provider, SkillProvider) else self.provider,
            "decision": self.decision.value if isinstance(self.decision, SkillDecision) else self.decision,
            "risk": self.risk.value if isinstance(self.risk, RiskLevel) else self.risk,
            "status": self.status,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "message": self.message,
            "outputtext": self.outputtext,
            "outputartifacts": [asdict(a) for a in self.outputartifacts],
            "detections": [asdict(d) for d in self.detections],
            "events": [asdict(e) for e in self.events],
            "usage": asdict(self.usage),
            "error": dict(self.error) if self.error else None,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "startedat": self.startedat.isoformat() if self.startedat else None,
            "finishedat": self.finishedat.isoformat() if self.finishedat else None,
            "result": {
                "risk": self.risk.value if isinstance(self.risk, RiskLevel) else self.risk,
                "error": dict(self.error) if self.error else {},
                "summary": self.summary,
                "message": self.message,
            },
        }

def buildblockedresult(
    request: SkillExecutionRequest,
    message: str,
    risk: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.HIGH,
    detections: tuple[SkillDetection, ...] = (),
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    outputtext: str | None = None,
    rawresponse: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    reasons: tuple[SkillReason, ...] | None = None,
) -> SkillExecutionResult:
    meta = dict(metadata or {})
    if rawresponse is not None and "rawresponse" not in meta:
        meta["rawresponse"] = dict(rawresponse)
    if reasons is not None and "reasons" not in meta:
        meta["reasons"] = [
            {"source": r.source, "label": r.label, "details": r.details, "score": r.score, "metadata": dict(r.metadata)}
            for r in reasons
        ]
    return SkillExecutionResult(
        requestid=request.requestid,
        provider=request.provider,
        decision=SkillDecision.BLOCK,
        risk=risk,
        status="blocked",
        summary=message,
        message=message,
        detections=detections,
        outputtext=outputtext,
        metadata=meta,
    )



def buildreviewresult(
    request: SkillExecutionRequest,
    message: str,
    risk: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.MEDIUM,
    detections: tuple[SkillDetection, ...] = (),
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    outputtext: str | None = None,
    rawresponse: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    reasons: tuple[SkillReason, ...] | None = None,
) -> SkillExecutionResult:
    meta = dict(metadata or {})
    if rawresponse is not None and "rawresponse" not in meta:
        meta["rawresponse"] = dict(rawresponse)
    if reasons is not None and "reasons" not in meta:
        meta["reasons"] = [
            {"source": r.source, "label": r.label, "details": r.details, "score": r.score, "metadata": dict(r.metadata)}
            for r in reasons
        ]
    return SkillExecutionResult(
        requestid=request.requestid,
        provider=request.provider,
        decision=SkillDecision.REVIEW,
        risk=risk,
        status="review",
        summary=message,
        message=message,
        detections=detections,
        outputtext=outputtext,
        metadata=meta,
    )



def buildallowedresult(
    request: SkillExecutionRequest,
    outputtext: str | None = None,
    outputartifacts: tuple[SkillOutputArtifact, ...] = (),
    usage: SkillUsage | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    summary: str | None = None,
    rawresponse: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    reasons: tuple[SkillReason, ...] | None = None,
    risk: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.LOW,
) -> SkillExecutionResult:
    meta = dict(metadata or {})
    if rawresponse is not None and "rawresponse" not in meta:
        meta["rawresponse"] = dict(rawresponse)
    if reasons is not None and "reasons" not in meta:
        meta["reasons"] = [
            {"source": r.source, "label": r.label, "details": r.details, "score": r.score, "metadata": dict(r.metadata)}
            for r in reasons
        ]
    return SkillExecutionResult(
        requestid=request.requestid,
        provider=request.provider,
        decision=SkillDecision.ALLOW,
        risk=risk,
        status="completed",
        summary=summary,
        message=summary,
        outputtext=outputtext,
        outputartifacts=outputartifacts,
        usage=usage or SkillUsage(),
        metadata=meta,
    )



def builderrorresult(
    request: SkillExecutionRequest,
    message: str,
    risk: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.HIGH,
    metadata: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    outputtext: str | None = None,
    rawresponse: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
    reasons: tuple[SkillReason, ...] | None = None,
    traceid: str | None = None,
    error: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None,
) -> SkillExecutionResult:
    meta = dict(metadata or {})
    if rawresponse is not None and "rawresponse" not in meta:
        meta["rawresponse"] = dict(rawresponse)
    if reasons is not None and "reasons" not in meta:
        meta["reasons"] = [
            {"source": r.source, "label": r.label, "details": r.details, "score": r.score, "metadata": dict(r.metadata)}
            for r in reasons
        ]
    if traceid is not None:
        meta.setdefault("traceid", traceid)

    error_payload: Mapping[str, JsonValue] | None = None
    if error is not None:
        error_payload = dict(error)
    elif meta.get("error") and isinstance(meta["error"], Mapping):
        error_payload = dict(meta["error"])  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    elif meta.get("errorcode"):
        error_payload = {"code": str(meta["errorcode"])}

    return SkillExecutionResult(
        requestid=request.requestid,
        provider=request.provider,
        decision=SkillDecision.ERROR,
        risk=risk,
        status="failed",
        summary=message,
        message=message,
        outputtext=outputtext,
        error=error_payload,
        metadata=meta,
    )



class SkillBaseModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = {"extra": "forbid", "populate_by_name": True}



class SkillRequestContext(SkillBaseModel):
    clientid: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    sessionid: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    userid: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    tenantid: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    organizationid: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    requestid: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    provider: SkillProvider = Field(default=SkillProvider.UNKNOWN)
    sourceplatform: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120)
    sourceversion: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=120)
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


    def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:
        normalized = [t.strip().lower() for t in self.tags if t and t.strip()]
        deduped = list(dict.fromkeys(normalized))
        object.__setattr__(self, "tags", deduped)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        if self.clientid:
            object.__setattr__(self, "clientid", self.clientid.strip())
        if self.sessionid:
            object.__setattr__(self, "sessionid", self.sessionid.strip())
        if self.userid:
            object.__setattr__(self, "userid", self.userid.strip())
        if self.tenantid:
            object.__setattr__(self, "tenantid", self.tenantid.strip())
        if self.organizationid:
            object.__setattr__(self, "organizationid", self.organizationid.strip())
        if self.requestid:
            object.__setattr__(self, "requestid", self.requestid.strip())
        if self.sourceplatform:
            object.__setattr__(self, "sourceplatform", self.sourceplatform.strip())
        if self.sourceversion:
            object.__setattr__(self, "sourceversion", self.sourceversion.strip())



class SkillPromptBundleInput(SkillBaseModel):
    userprompt: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    retrieveddoc: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    tooloutput: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    modeloutput: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)


    def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:
        for field_name in ("userprompt", "retrieveddoc", "tooloutput", "modeloutput"):
            value = getattr(self, field_name)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                object.__setattr__(self, field_name, value.strip())
        if not any(
            getattr(self, f) is not None
            for f in ("userprompt", "retrieveddoc", "tooloutput", "modeloutput")
        ):
            raise ValueError("At least one prompt bundle field must be provided")



class SkillScanInput(SkillBaseModel):
    targettype: Literal["promptbundle", "text", "url", "filepath"]
    targetvalue: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    policymode: Literal["review", "block", "allow"] = "review"
    bundle: SkillPromptBundleInput | None = None


    def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:
        if self.targettype == "promptbundle":
            if self.bundle is None:
                raise ValueError("bundle is required when targettype='promptbundle'")
            if self.targetvalue is not None:
                raise ValueError("targetvalue must be omitted for targettype='promptbundle'")
        else:
            if not self.targetvalue:
                raise ValueError("targetvalue is required for non-bundle target types")
            object.__setattr__(self, "targetvalue", self.targetvalue.strip())



class SkillActionInput(SkillBaseModel):
    actiontype: Literal["shellcommand", "pythoncode", "toolinvocation", "networkrequest", "httpfetch"]
    target: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    content: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20000)
    policymode: Literal["review", "block", "allow"] = "review"
    dryrun: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


    def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "target", self.target.strip())
        if self.content is not None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "content", self.content.strip())



class SkillExecutionInput(SkillBaseModel):

    allowsideeffects: bool = False

class SkillDecisionMetadataModel(SkillBaseModel):

    decisionsource: Literal["scan", "policy", "runtime", "billing", "usage", "unknown"] = "scan"
    matchedpatterns: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

class SkillDecisionMetadata(SkillBaseModel):
