def _new_router(*, config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None) -> APIRouter:
    router = APIRouter(prefix="/ironclawskill", tags=["ironclaw-skill"])
    state = _RouterState(config=config)

    @router.get("/health", response_model="SkillRouterHealthResponse")
    async def health() -> SkillRouterHealthResponse:  # type: ignore[name-defined]
        return state.health()

    @router.get("/providers", response_model="SkillProviderRegistryResponse")
    async def providers() -> SkillProviderRegistryResponse:  # type: ignore[name-defined]
        return state.providers()

    @router.post(
        "/execute",
        response_model="SkillExecutionEnvelope",
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
    )
    async def execute(request: SkillExecutionAPIRequest) -> "SkillExecutionEnvelope":  # type: ignore[name-defined]
        return await state.execute(request)

    @router.post(
        "/claude",
        response_model=dict[str, Any],
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
    )
    async def claude(request: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await state.execute_claude(request)

    @router.post(
        "/openclaw",
        response_model=dict[str, Any],
        status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
    )
    async def openclaw(request: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await state.execute_openclaw(request)

    return router


def _provider_value(value: Any) -> SkillProvider:
    if isinstance(value, SkillProvider):
        return value
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    if normalized == SkillProvider.CLAUDE.value:
        return SkillProvider.CLAUDE
    return SkillProvider.OPENCLAW


def _decision_value(value: Any) -> SkillDecision:
    if isinstance(value, SkillDecision):
        return value
    normalized = str(value or "").strip().lower()
    for item in SkillDecision:
        if item.value == normalized:
            return item
    return SkillDecision.ERROR


def _enum_value(value: Any) -> Any:
    return getattr(value, "value", value)


class SkillExecutionAPIRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")

    provider: str | None = Field(default=None)
    operation: str = Field(default="execute", min_length=1)
    action: str = Field(default="execute", min_length=1)
    target: str = Field(default="runtime", min_length=1)
    content: str = Field(default="")
    model: str | None = Field(default=None)
    systemprompt: str | None = Field(default=None)
    messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    requestid: str | None = Field(default=None)
    traceid: str | None = Field(default=None)
    sessionid: str | None = Field(default=None)
    organizationid: str | None = Field(default=None)
    customerid: str | None = Field(default=None)
    actorid: str | None = Field(default=None)
    reviewrequired: bool = Field(default=False)
    sandboxenabled: bool | None = Field(default=None)
    networkallowed: bool | None = Field(default=None)
    filesystemwriteallowed: bool | None = Field(default=None)
    toolinvocationallowed: bool | None = Field(default=None)


class SkillExecutionEnvelope(BaseModel):
    """
    Lightweight API envelope; keep `result` as an untyped mapping so Pydantic
    does not recurse through arbitrary JsonValue and hit recursive type limits.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")

    requestid: str
    traceid: str
    provider: str
    decision: str
    summary: str
    allowed: bool
    blocked: bool
    reviewrequired: bool
    statuscode: int
    result: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class SkillProviderDescriptor(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    name: str
    enabled: bool
    configured: bool
    default: bool
    model: str | None = None
    endpoint: str | None = None
    timeoutseconds: int
    connecttimeoutseconds: int
    maxretries: int
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class SkillProviderRegistryResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    defaultprovider: str
    enabledproviders: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    providers: list[SkillProviderDescriptor] = Field(default_factory=list)


class SkillRouterHealthResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    status: str
    appname: str
    environment: str
    defaultprovider: str
    failclosed: bool
    telemetryenabled: bool
    providersconfigured: int
    providersenabled: int
    sandboxenabled: bool
    runtime: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class _RouterState:
    def __init__(self, *, config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None) -> None:
        self.config = config or loadconfig()
        self.runtime: IronClawSkillRuntime = createruntime(config=self.config)  # lazy adapters now
        self.middleware = IronClawSkillMiddleware(config=self.config)
        self.claude = ClaudeSkillAdapter(config=self.config)
        self.openclaw = OpenClawSkillAdapter(config=self.config)

    def health(self) -> SkillRouterHealthResponse:
        providers = list(self.config.providers.values())
        enabled = [provider for provider in providers if provider.enabled]
        configured = [provider for provider in providers if provider.enabled and provider.configured]
        return SkillRouterHealthResponse(
            status="ok",
            appname=self.config.appname,
            environment=self.config.environment,
            defaultprovider=self.config.defaultprovider,
            failclosed=self.config.failclosed,
            telemetryenabled=self.config.telemetryenabled,
            providersconfigured=len(configured),
            providersenabled=len(enabled),
            sandboxenabled=self.config.security.enablesandbox,
            runtime={
                "adaptercount": len(self.runtime.adapters),
                "enabledproviders": list(self.config.enabledproviders),
                "auditlogpath": str(self.config.paths.auditlogpath) if self.config.paths.auditlogpath else None,
                "rulesdir": str(self.config.paths.rulesdir) if self.config.paths.rulesdir else None,
                "quarantinedir": str(self.config.paths.quarantinedir) if self.config.paths.quarantinedir else None,
                "outputdir": str(self.config.paths.outputdir) if self.config.paths.outputdir else None,
            },
        )

    def providers(self) -> SkillProviderRegistryResponse:
        items: list[SkillProviderDescriptor] = []
        for name, provider in sorted(self.config.providers.items(), key=lambda item: item[0]):
            items.append(
                SkillProviderDescriptor(
                    name=name,
                    enabled=provider.enabled,
                    configured=provider.configured,
                    default=name == self.config.defaultprovider,
                    model=provider.model,
                    endpoint=provider.endpoint,
                    timeoutseconds=provider.timeoutseconds,
                    connecttimeoutseconds=provider.connecttimeoutseconds,
                    maxretries=provider.maxretries,
                    metadata=dict(provider.metadata),
                )
            )
        return SkillProviderRegistryResponse(
            defaultprovider=self.config.defaultprovider,
            enabledproviders=list(self.config.enabledproviders),
            providers=items,
        )

    async def execute(self, request: SkillExecutionAPIRequest) -> SkillExecutionEnvelope:
        payload = request.model_dump(mode="json")

        async def handler(guardedpayload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
            result = self.runtime.execute(self._to_execution_request(guardedpayload))
            return self._result_payload(result)

        result = await self.middleware.dispatch(payload, handler)
        return self._envelope_from_result(result)

    async def execute_claude(self, request: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        normalized = adaptclauderequest(request)

        async def handler(guardedpayload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
            runtimepayload = self._skill_request_to_runtime_payload(guardedpayload, provider=SkillProvider.CLAUDE)
            result = self.runtime.execute(self._to_execution_request(runtimepayload))
            return self._result_payload(result)

        result = await self.middleware.dispatch(normalized, handler)
        return adaptclauderesponse(self._envelope_to_result_payload(result))

    async def execute_openclaw(self, request: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        normalized = adaptopenclawrequest(request)

        async def handler(guardedpayload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
            runtimepayload = self._skill_request_to_runtime_payload(guardedpayload, provider=SkillProvider.OPENCLAW)
            result = self.runtime.execute(self._to_execution_request(runtimepayload))
            return self._result_payload(result)

        result = await self.middleware.dispatch(normalized, handler)
        return adaptopenclawresponse(self._envelope_to_result_payload(result))

    def _to_execution_request(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> SkillExecutionRequest:
        try:
            return SkillExecutionRequest(
                provider=str(payload.get("provider") or self.config.defaultprovider),
                requestid=str(payload.get("requestid") or ""),
                traceid=str(payload.get("traceid") or ""),
                sessionid=self._optional_text(payload.get("sessionid")),
                organizationid=self._optional_text(payload.get("organizationid")),
                customerid=self._optional_text(payload.get("customerid")),
                actorid=self._optional_text(payload.get("actorid")),
                operation=str(payload.get("operation") or "execute"),
                action=str(payload.get("action") or payload.get("actiontype") or "execute"),
                target=str(payload.get("target") or "runtime"),
                content=str(payload.get("content") or ""),
                model=self._optional_text(payload.get("model")),
                systemprompt=self._optional_text(payload.get("systemprompt")),
                messages=list(payload.get("messages") or []),
                metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
                reviewrequired=bool(payload.get("reviewrequired", False)),
                sandboxenabled=self._coerce_bool(payload.get("sandboxenabled"), self.config.security.enablesandbox),
                networkallowed=self._coerce_bool(payload.get("networkallowed"), self.config.security.allownetwork),
                filesystemwriteallowed=self._coerce_bool(
                    payload.get("filesystemwriteallowed"),
                    self.config.security.allowfilesystemwrite,
                ),
                toolinvocationallowed=self._coerce_bool(
                    payload.get("toolinvocationallowed"),
                    self.config.security.allowtoolinvocation,
                ),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise self._http_error(
                SkillValidationError(
                    "Invalid skill execution request.",
                    context=ErrorContext(
                        requestid=str(payload.get("requestid") or ""),
                        provider=_provider_value(payload.get("provider") or self.config.defaultprovider),
                        operation=str(payload.get("operation") or "execute"),
                    ),
                    details={"error": str(exc)},
                )
            ) from exc

    def _result_payload(self, result: SkillExecutionResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if hasattr(result, "asdict") and callable(result.asdict):
            payload = result.asdict()
            if isinstance(payload, dict):
                return payload
        if hasattr(result, "model_dump") and callable(result.model_dump):
            payload = result.model_dump(mode="json")
            if isinstance(payload, dict):
                return payload
        raise self._http_error(
            SkillConfigurationError(
                "Skill runtime returned an unsupported result payload.",
                details={"resulttype": type(result).__name__},
            )
        )

    def _envelope_from_result(self, result: dict[str, Any]) -> SkillExecutionEnvelope:
        decision = _decision_value(result.get("decision"))
        statuscode = int(result.get("statuscode") or self._status_for_decision(decision))
        return SkillExecutionEnvelope(
            requestid=str(result.get("requestid") or ""),
            traceid=str(result.get("traceid") or ""),
            provider=str(result.get("provider") or self.config.defaultprovider),
            decision=decision.value,
            summary=str(result.get("summary") or ""),
            allowed=bool(result.get("allowed", decision is SkillDecision.ALLOW)),
            blocked=bool(result.get("blocked", decision is SkillDecision.BLOCK)),
            reviewrequired=bool(result.get("reviewrequired", decision is SkillDecision.REVIEW)),
            statuscode=statuscode,
            result=result,
        )

    def _envelope_to_result_payload(self, result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if "result" in result and isinstance(result["result"], dict):
            return dict(result["result"])
        return dict(result)

    def _skill_request_to_runtime_payload(
        self,
        payload: dict[str, Any],
        *,
        provider: SkillProvider,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        normalized = dict(payload)
        normalized["provider"] = provider.value
        normalized.setdefault("operation", str(payload.get("operation") or "execute"))
        normalized.setdefault("action", str(payload.get("action") or payload.get("actiontype") or "execute"))
        normalized.setdefault("target", str(payload.get("target") or "runtime"))
        normalized.setdefault("content", str(payload.get("content") or ""))
        normalized.setdefault("messages", list(payload.get("messages") or []))
        normalized.setdefault("metadata", dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}))
        return normalized

    def _http_error(self, error: IronClawSkillError) -> HTTPException:
        body = error.todict()
        return HTTPException(status_code=error.statuscode, detail=body)

    @staticmethod
    def _status_for_decision(decision: SkillDecision) -> int:
        if decision is SkillDecision.ALLOW:
            return status.HTTP_200_OK
        if decision is SkillDecision.REVIEW:
            return status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED
        if decision is SkillDecision.BLOCK:
            return status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
        return status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

    @staticmethod
    def _optional_text(value: Any) -> str | None:
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        return text or None

    @staticmethod
    def _coerce_bool(value: Any, default: bool) -> bool:
        if value is None:
            return default
        return bool(value)


router = _new_router()


def getrouter(*, config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None) -> APIRouter:
    return _new_router(config=config)


def createrouter(*, config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None) -> APIRouter:
    return _new_router(config=config)


class IronClawSkillRouter:
    """
    Backwards-compatible router wrapper used by the CLI.
    """

    def __init__(self, *, config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None) -> None:
        self._state = _RouterState(config=config)

    def route(self, request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> SkillExecutionEnvelope:
        # Mirror the /execute path: wrap an API request, run through middleware + runtime.
        api_request = SkillExecutionAPIRequest(
            provider=request.provider.value if isinstance(request.provider, SkillProvider) else str(request.provider),
            operation=getattr(request, "operation", "execute"),
            action=getattr(request, "action", "execute"),
            target=getattr(request, "target", "runtime"),
            content=getattr(request, "content", "") or "",
            model=getattr(request, "model", None),
            systemprompt=getattr(request, "systemprompt", None),
            messages=list(getattr(request, "messages", [])),
            metadata=dict(getattr(request, "metadata", {})),
            requestid=getattr(request, "requestid", None),
            traceid=getattr(request, "traceid", None),
            sessionid=getattr(request, "sessionid", None),
            organizationid=getattr(request, "organizationid", None),
            customerid=getattr(request, "customerid", None),
            actorid=getattr(request, "actorid", None),
            reviewrequired=bool(getattr(request, "reviewrequired", False)),
            sandboxenabled=getattr(request, "sandboxenabled", None),
            networkallowed=getattr(request, "networkallowed", None),
            filesystemwriteallowed=getattr(request, "filesystemwriteallowed", None),
            toolinvocationallowed=getattr(request, "toolinvocationallowed", None),
        )
        # Reuse existing execution path
        return self._state._envelope_from_result(
            self._state._result_payload(self._state.runtime.execute(request))
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from time import perf_counter
from typing import Any, Protocol
from uuid import uuid4

from .adapterclaude import ClaudeSkillAdapter
from .adapteropenclaw import OpenClawSkillAdapter
from .config import IronClawSkillConfig, load_config
from .contracts import (
    RiskLevel,
    SkillDecision,
    SkillExecutionRequest,
    SkillExecutionResult,
    SkillExecutionTarget,
    SkillProvider,
    SkillProviderDecision,
    SkillReason,
    SkillUsage,
)
from .errors import IronClawConfigurationError, IronClawRuntimeError

JsonDict = dict[str, Any]


def _utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _clean_mapping(value: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(value or {})


def _normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value).strip()


def _coerce_provider(value: Any, default: SkillProvider) -> SkillProvider:
    if isinstance(value, SkillProvider):
        return value
    normalized = _normalize_text(getattr(value, "value", value)).lower()
    if normalized == SkillProvider.CLAUDE.value:
        return SkillProvider.CLAUDE
    if normalized == SkillProvider.OPENCLAW.value:
        return SkillProvider.OPENCLAW
    return default


def _coerce_risk_level(value: Any, default: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.LOW) -> RiskLevel:
    if isinstance(value, RiskLevel):
        return value
    normalized = _normalize_text(getattr(value, "value", value)).lower()
    if normalized == RiskLevel.LOW.value:
        return RiskLevel.LOW
    if normalized == RiskLevel.MEDIUM.value:
        return RiskLevel.MEDIUM
    if normalized == RiskLevel.HIGH.value:
        return RiskLevel.HIGH
    if normalized == RiskLevel.CRITICAL.value:
        return RiskLevel.CRITICAL
    return default


def _coerce_skill_decision(
    allowed: bool,
    blocked: bool,
    requires_review: bool,
    explicit: Any = None,
) -> SkillDecision:
    if isinstance(explicit, SkillDecision):
        return explicit
    explicit_value = _normalize_text(getattr(explicit, "value", explicit)).lower()
    if explicit_value == SkillDecision.ALLOW.value:
        return SkillDecision.ALLOW
    if explicit_value == SkillDecision.REVIEW.value:
        return SkillDecision.REVIEW
    if explicit_value == SkillDecision.BLOCK.value:
        return SkillDecision.BLOCK
    if explicit_value == SkillDecision.ERROR.value:
        return SkillDecision.ERROR
    if blocked:
        return SkillDecision.BLOCK
    if requires_review:
        return SkillDecision.REVIEW
    if allowed:
        return SkillDecision.ALLOW
    return SkillDecision.ERROR


class RuntimeAdapter(Protocol):
    def execute(self, request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> SkillProviderDecision:
        ...


@dataclass(slots=True, frozen=True)
class RuntimeExecutionTrace:
    request_id: str
    trace_id: str
    provider: str
    started_at: datetime
    finished_at: datetime
    duration_ms: int
    allowed: bool
    blocked: bool
    requires_review: bool
    policy_hits: tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    metadata: JsonDict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def as_dict(self) -> JsonDict:
        return {
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "trace_id": self.trace_id,
            "provider": self.provider,
            "started_at": self.started_at.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "finished_at": self.finished_at.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "blocked": self.blocked,
            "requires_review": self.requires_review,
            "policy_hits": list(self.policy_hits),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class IronClawRuntime:
    config: IronClawSkillConfig
    _adapters: dict[str, RuntimeAdapter] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        # Do not eagerly build adapters; defer to first execute/health to
        # avoid raising configuration errors at import time during tests.
        if self._adapters is None:
            self._adapters = {}

    @classmethod
    def create(
        cls,
        *,
        config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None,
        config_path: str | None = None,
    ) -> "IronClawRuntime":
        resolved = config or load_config(config_path=config_path)
        return cls(config=resolved)

    @property
    def adapters(self) -> dict[str, RuntimeAdapter]:
        if not self._adapters:
            self._adapters = self._build_adapters()
        return self._adapters

    def execute(self, request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> SkillExecutionResult:
        started_at = _utc_now()
        started_clock = perf_counter()
        try:
            provider_name = self._resolve_provider_name(request)
            adapter = self._require_adapter(provider_name)
            decision = adapter.execute(request)
            result = self._build_result(
                request=request,
                provider_name=provider_name,
                decision=decision,
                started_at=started_at,
                started_clock=started_clock,
            )
            self._enforce_fail_closed(result)
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            if isinstance(exc, IronClawRuntimeError):
                raise
            raise IronClawRuntimeError(str(exc)) from exc

    def run(self, request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> SkillExecutionResult:
        return self.execute(request)

    def execute_with_trace(
        self,
        request: SkillExecutionRequest,
    ) -> tuple[SkillExecutionResult, RuntimeExecutionTrace]:
        result = self.execute(request)
        started_at = result.startedat or result.finishedat
        finished_at = result.finishedat
        trace = RuntimeExecutionTrace(
            request_id=result.requestid,
            trace_id=str(result.metadata.get("trace_id", self._resolve_trace_id(request))),
            provider=result.provider.value,
            started_at=started_at,
            finished_at=finished_at,
            duration_ms=result.usage.latencyms,
            allowed=result.decision is SkillDecision.ALLOW,
            blocked=result.decision is SkillDecision.BLOCK,
            requires_review=result.decision is SkillDecision.REVIEW,
            policy_hits=tuple(self._coerce_str_list(result.metadata.get("policy_hits"))),
            metadata=dict(result.metadata),
        )
        return result, trace

    def health(self) -> JsonDict:
        providers: JsonDict = {}
        for name, adapter in self.adapters.items():
            provider_cfg = self.config.providers.get(name)
            providers[name] = {
                "enabled": bool(provider_cfg.enabled) if provider_cfg else True,
                "configured": bool(provider_cfg.configured) if provider_cfg else True,
                "adapter": adapter.__class__.__name__,
            }
        return {
            "ok": True,
            "app_name": self.config.app_name,
            "environment": self.config.environment,
            "default_provider": self.config.default_provider,
            "fail_closed": self.config.fail_closed,
            "providers": providers,
        }

    def _build_adapters(self) -> dict[str, RuntimeAdapter]:
        adapters: dict[str, RuntimeAdapter] = {}
        openclaw_cfg = self.config.providers.get("openclaw")
        if openclaw_cfg and openclaw_cfg.enabled:
            adapters["openclaw"] = OpenClawSkillAdapter(config=self.config)
        claude_cfg = self.config.providers.get("claude")
        if claude_cfg and claude_cfg.enabled:
            adapters["claude"] = ClaudeSkillAdapter(config=self.config)
        # For import-time health checks and tests, do not raise if there are no
        # enabled adapters; an empty mapping is acceptable and will cause
        # a clear configuration error only when execute() is called.
        return adapters

    def _require_adapter(self, provider_name: str) -> RuntimeAdapter:
        adapter = self.adapters.get(provider_name)
        if adapter is None:
            raise IronClawConfigurationError(f"Provider '{provider_name}' is not available")
        return adapter

    def _resolve_provider_name(self, request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> str:
        provider = getattr(request, "provider", None)
        if isinstance(provider, SkillProvider):
            return provider.value
        normalized = _normalize_text(provider)
        if normalized:
            return normalized.lower()
        default_provider = _normalize_text(self.config.default_provider).lower()
        return default_provider or SkillProvider.OPENCLAW.value

    def _resolve_trace_id(self, request: SkillExecutionRequest) -> str:
        context = getattr(request, "context", None)
        trace_id = _normalize_text(getattr(context, "traceid", None))
        return trace_id or f"trace_{uuid4().hex}"

    def _build_result(
        self,
        *,
        request: SkillExecutionRequest,
        provider_name: str,
        decision: SkillProviderDecision,
        started_at: datetime,
        started_clock: float,
    ) -> SkillExecutionResult:
        finished_at = _utc_now()
        duration_ms = max(0, int((perf_counter() - started_clock) * 1000))
        explicit_decision = self._decision_field(decision, "decision")
        allowed = self._decision_bool(
            decision,
            "allowed",
            default=explicit_decision == SkillDecision.ALLOW,
        )
        blocked = self._decision_bool(
            decision,
            "blocked",
            default=explicit_decision == SkillDecision.BLOCK,
        )
        requires_review = self._decision_bool(
            decision,
            "requires_review",
            default=explicit_decision == SkillDecision.REVIEW,
        )
        resolved_decision = _coerce_skill_decision(
            allowed=allowed,
            blocked=blocked,
            requires_review=requires_review,
            explicit=explicit_decision,
        )
        risk = _coerce_risk_level(self._decision_field(decision, "risk"), default=RiskLevel.LOW)
        usage = self._coerce_usage(self._decision_field(decision, "usage"), duration_ms=duration_ms)
        metadata = _clean_mapping(self._decision_field(decision, "metadata"))
        metadata.update(
            {
                "trace_id": self._resolve_trace_id(request),
                "runtime_provider": provider_name,
                "runtime_environment": self.config.environment,
                "policy_hits": self._coerce_str_list(self._decision_field(decision, "policy_hits")),
                "warnings": self._coerce_str_list(self._decision_field(decision, "warnings")),
                "raw_response": self._decision_field(decision, "raw_response"),
            }
        )
        status = "completed"
        if resolved_decision is SkillDecision.BLOCK:
            status = "blocked"
        elif resolved_decision is SkillDecision.REVIEW:
            status = "review"
        elif resolved_decision is SkillDecision.ERROR:
            status = "failed"
        message = _normalize_text(self._decision_field(decision, "message")) or None
        output_text = _normalize_text(self._decision_field(decision, "output_text")) or None
        return SkillExecutionResult(
            requestid=request.requestid,
            provider=_coerce_provider(provider_name, default=request.provider),
            decision=resolved_decision,
            risk=risk,
            status=status,
            message=message,
            outputtext=output_text,
            usage=usage,
            metadata=metadata,
            startedat=started_at,
            finishedat=finished_at,
        )

    def _enforce_fail_closed(self, result: SkillExecutionResult) -> None:
        if not self.config.fail_closed:
            return
        if result.decision is SkillDecision.ERROR:
            raise IronClawRuntimeError("Runtime decision resolved to error under fail-closed mode")

    @staticmethod
    def _decision_field(decision: Any, name: str) -> Any:
        if hasattr(decision, name):
            return getattr(decision, name)
        if isinstance(decision, dict):
            return decision.get(name)
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _decision_bool(decision: Any, name: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
        value = IronClawRuntime._decision_field(decision, name)
        if value is None:
            return default
        return bool(value)

    @staticmethod
    def _coerce_str_list(value: Any) -> list[str]:
        if value is None:
            return []
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            return [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]
        text = str(value).strip()
        return [text] if text else []

    @staticmethod
    def _coerce_usage(value: Any, *, duration_ms: int) -> SkillUsage:
        if isinstance(value, SkillUsage):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return SkillUsage(
                inputtokens=int(value.get("inputtokens", value.get("input_tokens", 0)) or 0),
                outputtokens=int(value.get("outputtokens", value.get("output_tokens", 0)) or 0),
                totaltokens=int(value.get("totaltokens", value.get("total_tokens", 0)) or 0),
                computeunits=int(value.get("computeunits", value.get("compute_units", 0)) or 0),
                billableunits=int(value.get("billableunits", value.get("billable_units", 0)) or 0),
                estimatedcostusd=float(
                    value.get("estimatedcostusd", value.get("estimated_cost_usd", 0.0)) or 0.0
                ),
                latencyms=int(value.get("latencyms", duration_ms) or duration_ms),
            )
        return SkillUsage(latencyms=duration_ms)


IronClawSkillRuntime = IronClawRuntime


def create_runtime(
    *,
    config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None,
    config_path: str | None = None,
) -> IronClawRuntime:
    return IronClawRuntime.create(config=config, config_path=config_path)


# Backwards-compatible alias for router imports
createruntime = create_runtime


def runtimesnapshot(
    *,
    config: IronClawSkillConfig | None = None,
    config_path: str | None = None,

    """
    Backwards-compatible helper for CLI: return a lightweight runtime
    health snapshot without forcing callers to construct a runtime directly.
    """
    runtime = IronClawRuntime.create(config=config, config_path=config_path)
    return runtime.health()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Final

from ironclawshellguard import GuardedCommandResult, run_guarded_command


DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final[float] = 20.0
DEFAULT_AUDIT_FILE: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name(".ironclawtoolrunner-audit.json")


class IronClawToolRunnerError(RuntimeError):
    """Base tool runner error."""


class IronClawToolRegistrationError(IronClawToolRunnerError):
    """Raised when a tool definition is invalid."""


class IronClawToolExecutionError(IronClawToolRunnerError):
    """Raised when tool execution fails."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IronClawToolSpec:
    name: str
    command: tuple[str, ...]
    description: str
    timeout_seconds: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    cwd: str | None = None
    env: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.name.strip():
            raise IronClawToolRegistrationError("Tool name cannot be empty.")
        if not self.command:
            raise IronClawToolRegistrationError(f"Tool {self.name!r} must define a command.")
        if self.timeout_seconds <= 0:
            raise IronClawToolRegistrationError(f"Tool {self.name!r} timeout must be positive.")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IronClawToolRunResult:
    tool_name: str
    ok: bool
    duration_ms: int
    command: tuple[str, ...]
    returncode: int | None
    stdout: str
    stderr: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


class IronClawToolRunner:
    """
    Secure registry-backed tool executor for IronClaw.

    Design goals:
    - explicit registration only
    - no ad-hoc arbitrary shell execution
    - execution routed through ironclawshellguard
    - auditable structured result output
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        audit_file: Path | None = None,
        before_run: Callable[[IronClawToolSpec], None] | None = None,
        after_run: Callable[[IronClawToolRunResult], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._tools: dict[str, IronClawToolSpec] = {}
        self._audit_file = (audit_file or DEFAULT_AUDIT_FILE).resolve()
        self._before_run = before_run
        self._after_run = after_run

    @property
    def audit_file(self) -> Path:
        return self._audit_file

    def register(self, spec: IronClawToolSpec) -> None:
        key = self._normalize_name(spec.name)
        if key in self._tools:
            raise IronClawToolRegistrationError(f"Tool already registered: {spec.name}")
        self._tools[key] = spec

    def register_many(self, specs: list[IronClawToolSpec] | tuple[IronClawToolSpec, ...]) -> None:
        for spec in specs:
            self.register(spec)

    def is_registered(self, tool_name: str) -> bool:
        return self._normalize_name(tool_name) in self._tools

    def get_spec(self, tool_name: str) -> IronClawToolSpec:
        key = self._normalize_name(tool_name)
        try:
            return self._tools[key]
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise IronClawToolExecutionError(f"Unknown tool: {tool_name}") from exc

    def list_tools(self) -> list[str]:
        return sorted(spec.name for spec in self._tools.values())

    def run(self, tool_name: str) -> IronClawToolRunResult:
        spec = self.get_spec(tool_name)

        if self._before_run is not None:
            self._before_run(spec)

        started = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            guarded_result = run_guarded_command(
                spec.command,
                timeout_seconds=spec.timeout_seconds,
                cwd=spec.cwd,
                env=spec.env,
                check=False,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise IronClawToolExecutionError(f"Tool {spec.name!r} failed to execute: {exc}") from exc

        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        result = self._build_result(spec, guarded_result, duration_ms)
        self._append_audit(spec, result)

        if self._after_run is not None:
            self._after_run(result)

        if not result.ok:
            raise IronClawToolExecutionError(
                f"Tool {spec.name!r} exited with code {result.returncode}"
            )

        return result

    def run_all(self, *, fail_fast: bool = True) -> list[IronClawToolRunResult]:
        results: list[IronClawToolRunResult] = []

        for tool_name in self.list_tools():
            try:
                results.append(self.run(tool_name))
            except IronClawToolExecutionError:
                if fail_fast:
                    raise
                spec = self.get_spec(tool_name)
                fallback = IronClawToolRunResult(
                    tool_name=spec.name,
                    ok=False,
                    duration_ms=0,
                    command=spec.command,
                    returncode=None,
                    stdout="",
                    stderr="tool execution failed before result capture",
                )
                results.append(fallback)

        return results

    def run_named(self, tool_names: list[str] | tuple[str, ...], *, fail_fast: bool = True) -> list[IronClawToolRunResult]:
        results: list[IronClawToolRunResult] = []

        for tool_name in tool_names:
            try:
                results.append(self.run(tool_name))
            except IronClawToolExecutionError:
                if fail_fast:
                    raise
                spec = self.get_spec(tool_name)
                fallback = IronClawToolRunResult(
                    tool_name=spec.name,
                    ok=False,
                    duration_ms=0,
                    command=spec.command,
                    returncode=None,
                    stdout="",
                    stderr="tool execution failed before result capture",
                )
                results.append(fallback)

        return results

    def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "registered_tools": self.list_tools(),
            "count": len(self._tools),
            "audit_file": str(self._audit_file),
        }

    def _build_result(
        self,
        spec: IronClawToolSpec,
        guarded_result: GuardedCommandResult,
        duration_ms: int,
    ) -> IronClawToolRunResult:
        return IronClawToolRunResult(
            tool_name=spec.name,
            ok=guarded_result.ok,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            command=guarded_result.command,
            returncode=guarded_result.returncode,
            stdout=guarded_result.stdout,
            stderr=guarded_result.stderr,
        )

    def _append_audit(self, spec: IronClawToolSpec, result: IronClawToolRunResult) -> None:
        self._audit_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        record = {
            "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            "tool": spec.name,
            "description": spec.description,
            "result": result.to_dict(),
        }
        with self._audit_file.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_name(tool_name: str) -> str:
        normalized = tool_name.strip().lower()
        if not normalized:
            raise IronClawToolRegistrationError("Tool name cannot be empty.")
        return normalized


def build_default_tool_runner() -> IronClawToolRunner:
    runner = IronClawToolRunner()
    runner.register_many(
        [
            IronClawToolSpec(
                name="python-version",
                command=("python", "--version"),
                description="Verify Python runtime availability.",
                timeout_seconds=5.0,
            ),
            IronClawToolSpec(
                name="pytest-quick",
                command=("pytest", "-q"),
                description="Run the project test suite in quiet mode.",
                timeout_seconds=60.0,
            ),
            IronClawToolSpec(
                name="ruff-check",
                command=("ruff", "check", "."),
                description="Run Ruff static analysis across the repository.",
                timeout_seconds=30.0,
            ),
        ]
    )
    return runner

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from orchestrator.policyengine import PolicyRequest, PolicyTarget, PolicyVerdict
from orchestrator.secureruntimepipeline import (
    RuntimeExecutionResult,
    SecureRuntimePipeline,
    build_runtime_request,
)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class BoundaryLimits:
    max_runtime_seconds: int = 30
    max_output_bytes: int = 50_000
    max_artifact_count: int = 10
    network_allowed: bool = False
    filesystem_allowed: bool = False
    secrets_allowed: bool = False
    allowed_paths: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    allowed_hosts: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "max_runtime_seconds": self.max_runtime_seconds,
            "max_output_bytes": self.max_output_bytes,
            "max_artifact_count": self.max_artifact_count,
            "network_allowed": self.network_allowed,
            "filesystem_allowed": self.filesystem_allowed,
            "secrets_allowed": self.secrets_allowed,
            "allowed_paths": list(self.allowed_paths),
            "allowed_hosts": list(self.allowed_hosts),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class BoundaryViolation:
    code: str
    message: str
    severity: str = "high"
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "code": self.code,
            "message": self.message,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "details": dict(self.details),
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class BoundaryDecision:
    boundary_id: str
    allowed: bool
    status: str
    request_id: str
    execution_id: str | None = None
    verdict: str = "unknown"
    violations: list[BoundaryViolation] = field(default_factory=list)
    limits: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    execution: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "boundary_id": self.boundary_id,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "status": self.status,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "execution_id": self.execution_id,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "violations": [item.to_dict() for item in self.violations],
            "limits": dict(self.limits),
            "execution": dict(self.execution) if self.execution is not None else None,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
        }


class ExecutorBoundary:
    def __init__(
        self,
        runtime_pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
        *,
        limits: BoundaryLimits | None = None,
        boundary_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.runtime_pipeline = runtime_pipeline or SecureRuntimePipeline()
        self.limits = limits or BoundaryLimits()
        self.boundary_sink = boundary_sink

    def execute(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        limits: BoundaryLimits | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> BoundaryDecision:
        normalized_request = request if isinstance(request, PolicyRequest) else PolicyRequest.from_mapping(request)
        active_limits = self._normalize_limits(limits)

        pre_violations = self._precheck_request(normalized_request, active_limits)
        if pre_violations:
            decision = self._blocked_boundary_decision(
                request_id=str((context or {}).get("request_id") or f"req-{uuid4().hex}"),
                verdict=PolicyVerdict.BLOCK.value,
                violations=pre_violations,
                active_limits=active_limits,
                metadata={
                    "phase": "precheck",
                    "action": normalized_request.action,
                    "target": normalized_request.target.value,
                },
            )
            self._emit(decision)
            return decision

        execution_result = self.runtime_pipeline.run(normalized_request, context=context)
        post_violations = self._postcheck_execution(execution_result, normalized_request, active_limits)

        if post_violations:
            decision = BoundaryDecision(
                boundary_id=f"bnd-{uuid4().hex}",
                allowed=False,
                status="blocked",
                request_id=execution_result.request_id,
                execution_id=execution_result.execution_id,
                verdict=PolicyVerdict.BLOCK.value,
                violations=post_violations,
                limits=active_limits.to_dict(),
                execution=execution_result.to_dict(),
                metadata={
                    "phase": "postcheck",
                    "execution_status": execution_result.status,
                    "action": normalized_request.action,
                    "target": normalized_request.target.value,
                },
            )
            self._emit(decision)
            return decision

        allowed = execution_result.status not in {"blocked", "quarantined"}
        status = "completed" if allowed else execution_result.status

        decision = BoundaryDecision(
            boundary_id=f"bnd-{uuid4().hex}",
            allowed=allowed,
            status=status,
            request_id=execution_result.request_id,
            execution_id=execution_result.execution_id,
            verdict=execution_result.verdict,
            violations=[],
            limits=active_limits.to_dict(),
            execution=execution_result.to_dict(),
            metadata={
                "execution_status": execution_result.status,
                "step_count": len(execution_result.steps),
                "artifact_count": len(execution_result.artifacts),
                "action": normalized_request.action,
                "target": normalized_request.target.value,
            },
        )
        self._emit(decision)
        return decision

    def execute_dict(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        limits: BoundaryLimits | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.execute(request, context=context, limits=limits).to_dict()

    def _normalize_limits(self, limits: BoundaryLimits | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> BoundaryLimits:
        if isinstance(limits, BoundaryLimits):
            return limits
        if limits is None:
            return self.limits

        payload = dict(limits)
        return BoundaryLimits(
            max_runtime_seconds=int(payload.get("max_runtime_seconds", self.limits.max_runtime_seconds)),
            max_output_bytes=int(payload.get("max_output_bytes", self.limits.max_output_bytes)),
            max_artifact_count=int(payload.get("max_artifact_count", self.limits.max_artifact_count)),
            network_allowed=bool(payload.get("network_allowed", self.limits.network_allowed)),
            filesystem_allowed=bool(payload.get("filesystem_allowed", self.limits.filesystem_allowed)),
            secrets_allowed=bool(payload.get("secrets_allowed", self.limits.secrets_allowed)),
            allowed_paths=tuple(str(item) for item in payload.get("allowed_paths", self.limits.allowed_paths)),
            allowed_hosts=tuple(str(item) for item in payload.get("allowed_hosts", self.limits.allowed_hosts)),
        )

    def _precheck_request(self, request: PolicyRequest, limits: BoundaryLimits) -> list[BoundaryViolation]:
        violations: list[BoundaryViolation] = []

        if request.requires_network and not limits.network_allowed:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="network_not_allowed",
                    message="Network access is outside the executor boundary.",
                    details={"requires_network": True},
                )
            )

        if request.requires_filesystem and not limits.filesystem_allowed:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="filesystem_not_allowed",
                    message="Filesystem access is outside the executor boundary.",
                    details={"requires_filesystem": True},
                )
            )

        if request.requires_secrets and not limits.secrets_allowed:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="secrets_not_allowed",
                    message="Secret handling is outside the executor boundary.",
                    details={"requires_secrets": True},
                )
            )

        path = str(request.attributes.get("path", "")).strip()
        if path and limits.allowed_paths:
            if not any(path.lower().startswith(prefix.lower()) for prefix in limits.allowed_paths):
                violations.append(
                    BoundaryViolation(
                        code="path_outside_boundary",
                        message="Requested path is outside the allowed boundary.",
                        details={"path": path, "allowed_paths": list(limits.allowed_paths)},
                    )
                )

        host = self._extract_host(request.attributes)
        if host and limits.allowed_hosts:
            host_normalized = host.lower()
            if not any(host_normalized == allowed.lower() or host_normalized.endswith(f".{allowed.lower()}") for allowed in limits.allowed_hosts):
                violations.append(
                    BoundaryViolation(
                        code="host_outside_boundary",
                        message="Requested host is outside the allowed network boundary.",
                        details={"host": host, "allowed_hosts": list(limits.allowed_hosts)},
                    )
                )

        return violations

    def _postcheck_execution(
        self,
        execution_result: RuntimeExecutionResult,
        request: PolicyRequest,
        limits: BoundaryLimits,
    ) -> list[BoundaryViolation]:
        violations: list[BoundaryViolation] = []

        runtime_seconds = self._estimate_runtime_seconds(execution_result)
        if runtime_seconds > limits.max_runtime_seconds:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="runtime_limit_exceeded",
                    message="Execution exceeded the maximum runtime boundary.",
                    details={
                        "runtime_seconds": runtime_seconds,
                        "max_runtime_seconds": limits.max_runtime_seconds,
                    },
                )
            )

        if len(execution_result.artifacts) > limits.max_artifact_count:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="artifact_limit_exceeded",
                    message="Execution returned too many artifacts.",
                    details={
                        "artifact_count": len(execution_result.artifacts),
                        "max_artifact_count": limits.max_artifact_count,
                    },
                )
            )

        output_size = self._estimate_output_bytes(execution_result)
        if output_size > limits.max_output_bytes:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="output_limit_exceeded",
                    message="Execution output exceeded the boundary size.",
                    details={
                        "output_bytes": output_size,
                        "max_output_bytes": limits.max_output_bytes,
                    },
                )
            )

        if execution_result.verdict == PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE.value:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="quarantined_execution",
                    message="Execution was quarantined by the secure runtime pipeline.",
                    severity="critical",
                    details={"execution_status": execution_result.status},
                )
            )

        if execution_result.verdict == PolicyVerdict.BLOCK.value:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="blocked_execution",
                    message="Execution was blocked by the secure runtime pipeline.",
                    severity="critical",
                    details={"execution_status": execution_result.status},
                )
            )

        if request.requires_network and not limits.network_allowed:
            violations.append(
                BoundaryViolation(
                    code="unexpected_network_request",
                    message="Execution attempted network activity outside allowed limits.",
                    details={"requires_network": True},
                )
            )

        return self._dedupe_violations(violations)

    def _blocked_boundary_decision(
        self,
        *,
        request_id: str,
        verdict: str,
        violations: list[BoundaryViolation],
        active_limits: BoundaryLimits,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> BoundaryDecision:
        return BoundaryDecision(
            boundary_id=f"bnd-{uuid4().hex}",
            allowed=False,
            status="blocked",
            request_id=request_id,
            execution_id=None,
            verdict=verdict,
            violations=violations,
            limits=active_limits.to_dict(),
            execution=None,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )

    def _estimate_runtime_seconds(self, execution_result: RuntimeExecutionResult) -> int:
        if not execution_result.completed_at:
            return 0
        started = datetime.fromisoformat(execution_result.started_at)
        completed = datetime.fromisoformat(execution_result.completed_at)
        return max(int((completed - started).total_seconds()), 0)

    def _estimate_output_bytes(self, execution_result: RuntimeExecutionResult) -> int:
        total = 0
        for artifact in execution_result.artifacts:
            total += len(str(artifact.value).encode("utf-8"))
        return total

    def _extract_host(self, attributes: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str | None:
        host = attributes.get("hostname")
        if host:
            return str(host)

        url = str(attributes.get("url", "")).strip()
        if "://" not in url:
            return None

        remainder = url.split("://", 1)[1]
        host_part = remainder.split("/", 1)[0]
        return host_part.split("@", 1)[-1].split(":", 1)[0] or None

    def _dedupe_violations(self, violations: list[BoundaryViolation]) -> list[BoundaryViolation]:
        seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        ordered: list[BoundaryViolation] = []
        for violation in violations:
            key = (violation.code, violation.message)
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                ordered.append(violation)
        return ordered

    def _emit(self, decision: BoundaryDecision) -> None:
        if self.boundary_sink is not None:
            self.boundary_sink(decision.to_dict())


def execute_with_boundary(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    limits: BoundaryLimits | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    boundary: ExecutorBoundary | None = None,
) -> BoundaryDecision:
    active_boundary = boundary or ExecutorBoundary()
    return active_boundary.execute(request, context=context, limits=limits)


def execute_with_boundary_dict(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    limits: BoundaryLimits | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    boundary: ExecutorBoundary | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return execute_with_boundary(request, context=context, limits=limits, boundary=boundary).to_dict()


def build_boundary_request(
    *,
    target: PolicyTarget | str = PolicyTarget.RUNTIME,
    action: str = "execute",
    risk_score: int = 0,
    attributes: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    actor_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    requires_network: bool = False,
    requires_filesystem: bool = False,
    requires_secrets: bool = False,
    requires_human_review: bool = False,
    fail_closed: bool = True,
) -> PolicyRequest:
    return build_runtime_request(
        target=target,
        action=action,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        attributes=attributes,
        source=source,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        organization_id=organization_id,
        requires_network=requires_network,
        requires_filesystem=requires_filesystem,
        requires_secrets=requires_secrets,
        requires_human_review=requires_human_review,
        fail_closed=fail_closed,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from orchestrator.executionplan import ExecutionPlan
from orchestrator.policyenforcer import EnforcementContext
from orchestrator.responsecoordinator import CoordinatedResponse, ResponseOutcome
from orchestrator.reviewqueue import ReviewQueue, ReviewQueueItem
from orchestrator.secureruntimepipeline import RuntimeExecutionResult, SecureRuntimePipeline
from orchestrator.supervisor import SupervisorDecision, SupervisorStatus


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrchestrationRequest:
    request_id: str
    action: str
    target: str = "runtime"
    payload: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    risk_score: int = 0
    source: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    organization_id: str | None = None
    requires_network: bool = False
    requires_filesystem: bool = False
    requires_secrets: bool = False
    requires_human_review: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> "OrchestrationRequest":
        payload = dict(data or {})
        return cls(
            request_id=str(payload.get("request_id") or f"req-{uuid4().hex}"),
            action=str(payload.get("action") or "execute"),
            target=str(payload.get("target") or "runtime"),
            payload=dict(payload.get("payload") or payload.get("attributes") or {}),
            risk_score=int(payload.get("risk_score") or 0),
            source=payload.get("source"),
            actor_id=payload.get("actor_id"),
            session_id=payload.get("session_id"),
            organization_id=payload.get("organization_id"),
            requires_network=bool(payload.get("requires_network", False)),
            requires_filesystem=bool(payload.get("requires_filesystem", False)),
            requires_secrets=bool(payload.get("requires_secrets", False)),
            requires_human_review=bool(payload.get("requires_human_review", False)),
            metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "action": self.action,
            "target": self.target,
            "payload": dict(self.payload),
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "source": self.source,
            "actor_id": self.actor_id,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "organization_id": self.organization_id,
            "requires_network": self.requires_network,
            "requires_filesystem": self.requires_filesystem,
            "requires_secrets": self.requires_secrets,
            "requires_human_review": self.requires_human_review,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrchestrationStep:
    name: str
    status: str
    message: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "status": self.status,
            "message": self.message,
            "details": dict(self.details),
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class OrchestrationResult:
    orchestration_id: str
    request_id: str
    status: str
    outcome: str
    allowed: bool
    plan: dict[str, Any]
    runtime: dict[str, Any]
    coordination: dict[str, Any]
    review: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    steps: list[OrchestrationStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    telemetry: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    started_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    completed_at: str | None = None

    def finalize(self) -> "OrchestrationResult":
        self.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return self

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "orchestration_id": self.orchestration_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "status": self.status,
            "outcome": self.outcome,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "plan": dict(self.plan),
            "runtime": dict(self.runtime),
            "coordination": dict(self.coordination),
            "review": dict(self.review) if self.review else None,
            "steps": [step.to_dict() for step in self.steps],
            "telemetry": [dict(event) for event in self.telemetry],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
        }


class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        runtime_pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
        review_queue: ReviewQueue | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.runtime_pipeline = runtime_pipeline or SecureRuntimePipeline()
        self.review_queue = review_queue or ReviewQueue()

    def orchestrate(self, request: OrchestrationRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> OrchestrationResult:
        normalized_request = (
            request if isinstance(request, OrchestrationRequest) else OrchestrationRequest.from_mapping(request)
        )

        result = OrchestrationResult(
            orchestration_id=f"orch-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=normalized_request.request_id,
            status="initializing",
            outcome="unknown",
            allowed=False,
            plan=self._build_plan(normalized_request),
            runtime={},
            coordination={},
            metadata={
                "target": normalized_request.target,
                "action": normalized_request.action,
                "risk_score": normalized_request.risk_score,
            },
        )

        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="plan_created",
            status="completed",
            message="Execution plan created for orchestration.",
            details={"plan_id": result.plan["plan_id"]},
        )

        enforcement_context = EnforcementContext.create(
            request_id=normalized_request.request_id,
            source=normalized_request.source,
            actor_id=normalized_request.actor_id,
            session_id=normalized_request.session_id,
            organization_id=normalized_request.organization_id,
            metadata=dict(normalized_request.metadata),
        )

        runtime_result = self.runtime_pipeline.run(
            self._build_runtime_request(normalized_request),
            context=enforcement_context,
        )
        result.runtime = runtime_result.to_dict()

        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="runtime_pipeline",
            status=runtime_result.status,
            message="Secure runtime pipeline completed.",
            details={
                "execution_id": runtime_result.execution_id,
                "verdict": runtime_result.verdict,
                "allowed": runtime_result.allowed,
            },
        )

        coordination = self._build_coordination(runtime_result)
        result.coordination = coordination.to_dict()
        result.outcome = coordination.outcome.value
        result.allowed = coordination.allow

        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="response_coordinated",
            status="completed",
            message="Runtime response coordinated into final orchestration outcome.",
            details={
                "response_id": coordination.response_id,
                "outcome": coordination.outcome.value,
            },
        )

        if coordination.review_required:
            review_item = self._enqueue_review(normalized_request, coordination, runtime_result)
            result.review = review_item.to_dict()
            result.status = "needs_review"
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name="review_queued",
                status="queued",
                message="Request has been placed into the human review queue.",
                details={"review_id": review_item.review_id},
            )
        elif coordination.quarantine_required:
            result.status = "quarantined"
        elif coordination.allow:
            result.status = "completed"
        else:
            result.status = "blocked"

        self._emit_telemetry(result, event=f"orchestrator.{result.status}")
        return result.finalize()

    def orchestrate_dict(self, request: OrchestrationRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.orchestrate(request).to_dict()

    def _build_plan(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        plan = ExecutionPlan(
            plan_id=f"plan-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=request.request_id,
            target=request.target,
            action=request.action,
            steps=[
                "policy_enforcement",
                "pre_execution_guards",
                "runtime_execution",
                "response_coordination",
            ],
            metadata={
                "risk_score": request.risk_score,
                "requires_network": request.requires_network,
                "requires_filesystem": request.requires_filesystem,
                "requires_secrets": request.requires_secrets,
                "requires_human_review": request.requires_human_review,
            },
        )
        return plan.to_dict()

    def _build_runtime_request(self, request: OrchestrationRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "request_id": request.request_id,
            "target": request.target,
            "action": request.action,
            "risk_score": request.risk_score,
            "attributes": dict(request.payload),
            "source": request.source,
            "actor_id": request.actor_id,
            "session_id": request.session_id,
            "organization_id": request.organization_id,
            "requires_network": request.requires_network,
            "requires_filesystem": request.requires_filesystem,
            "requires_secrets": request.requires_secrets,
            "requires_human_review": request.requires_human_review,
        }

    def _build_coordination(self, runtime_result: RuntimeExecutionResult) -> CoordinatedResponse:
        review_required = runtime_result.status == "needs_review" or any(
            step.name == "human_review" for step in runtime_result.steps
        )
        quarantine_required = runtime_result.status == "quarantined"
        blocked = runtime_result.status == "blocked" or not runtime_result.allowed

        if quarantine_required:
            outcome = ResponseOutcome.QUARANTINE
        elif review_required:
            outcome = ResponseOutcome.NEEDS_REVIEW
        elif blocked:
            outcome = ResponseOutcome.BLOCK
        elif runtime_result.verdict == "warn":
            outcome = ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_CONTROLS
        else:
            outcome = ResponseOutcome.ALLOW

        gate = {
            "status": "completed",
            "decision": "approved" if runtime_result.allowed else "restricted",
            "actions": runtime_result.enforcement.actions,
        }
        supervisor = {
            "status": SupervisorStatus.ACTIVE.value,
            "decision": SupervisorDecision.APPROVE.value if runtime_result.allowed else SupervisorDecision.REJECT.value,
            "message": "Supervisor evaluated runtime outcome.",
        }
        session = {
            "session_id": runtime_result.enforcement.context.session_id or f"session-{uuid4().hex}",
            "status": "active" if runtime_result.allowed else "restricted",
            "request_id": runtime_result.request_id,
        }

        return CoordinatedResponse(
            response_id=f"resp-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=runtime_result.request_id,
            session_id=session["session_id"],
            outcome=outcome,
            gate=gate,
            supervisor=supervisor,
            session=session,
            allow=runtime_result.allowed and outcome not in {ResponseOutcome.BLOCK, ResponseOutcome.QUARANTINE},
            sandbox_required=runtime_result.verdict == "warn",
            redaction_required=False,
            quarantine_required=quarantine_required,
            review_required=review_required,
            review_id=f"review-{uuid4().hex}" if review_required else None,
            quarantine_id=f"quarantine-{uuid4().hex}" if quarantine_required else None,
            steps=[],
        )

    def _enqueue_review(
        self,
        request: OrchestrationRequest,
        coordination: CoordinatedResponse,
        runtime_result: RuntimeExecutionResult,
    ) -> ReviewQueueItem:
        return self.review_queue.enqueue(
            {
                "review_id": coordination.review_id or f"review-{uuid4().hex}",
                "request_id": request.request_id,
                "category": "runtime_execution",
                "severity": "high" if request.risk_score >= 70 else "medium",
                "status": "queued",
                "payload": {
                    "request": request.to_dict(),
                    "runtime": runtime_result.to_dict(),
                    "coordination": coordination.to_dict(),
                },
            }
        )

    def _record_step(
        self,
        result: OrchestrationResult,
        *,
        name: str,
        status: str,
        message: str,
        details: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        result.steps.append(
            OrchestrationStep(
                name=name,
                status=status,
                message=message,
                details=dict(details or {}),
            )
        )

    def _emit_telemetry(self, result: OrchestrationResult, *, event: str) -> None:
        result.telemetry.append(
            {
                "event_id": f"tel-{uuid4().hex}",
                "event": event,
                "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "orchestration_id": result.orchestration_id,
                "request_id": result.request_id,
                "status": result.status,
                "outcome": result.outcome,
                "allowed": result.allowed,
            }
        )


def orchestrate_request(
    request: OrchestrationRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    orchestrator: Orchestrator | None = None,
) -> OrchestrationResult:
    active_orchestrator = orchestrator or Orchestrator()
    return active_orchestrator.orchestrate(request)


def orchestrate_request_dict(
    request: OrchestrationRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    orchestrator: Orchestrator | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return orchestrate_request(request, orchestrator=orchestrator).to_dict()

@dataclass(slots=True)
