class PolicyEnforcer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        policy_engine: PolicyEngine | None = None,
        *,
        audit_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
        review_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
        quarantine_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
        block_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
        warn_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
        allow_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.policy_engine = policy_engine or PolicyEngine()
        self.audit_sink = audit_sink
        self.review_sink = review_sink
        self.quarantine_sink = quarantine_sink
        self.block_sink = block_sink
        self.warn_sink = warn_sink
        self.allow_sink = allow_sink

    def enforce(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> EnforcementResult:
        normalized_request = request if isinstance(request, PolicyRequest) else PolicyRequest.from_mapping(request)
        normalized_context = self._normalize_context(context, normalized_request)

        if normalized_request.source is None and normalized_context.source:
            normalized_request.source = normalized_context.source
        if normalized_request.actor_id is None and normalized_context.actor_id:
            normalized_request.actor_id = normalized_context.actor_id
        if normalized_request.session_id is None and normalized_context.session_id:
            normalized_request.session_id = normalized_context.session_id
        if normalized_request.organization_id is None and normalized_context.organization_id:
            normalized_request.organization_id = normalized_context.organization_id

        decision = self.policy_engine.evaluate(normalized_request)
        result = self._build_result(decision=decision, request=normalized_request, context=normalized_context)
        self._dispatch(result)
        return result

    def enforce_dict(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.enforce(request, context=context).to_dict()

    def enforce_batch(
        self,
        requests: Iterable[PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None],
        *,
        context_factory: Callable[[int, PolicyRequest], EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
    ) -> list[EnforcementResult]:
        results: list[EnforcementResult] = []
        for index, item in enumerate(requests):
            normalized_request = item if isinstance(item, PolicyRequest) else PolicyRequest.from_mapping(item)
            context = context_factory(index, normalized_request) if context_factory else None
            results.append(self.enforce(normalized_request, context=context))
        return results

    def _normalize_context(
        self,
        context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        request: PolicyRequest,
    ) -> EnforcementContext:
        if isinstance(context, EnforcementContext):
            return context

        payload = dict(context or {})
        return EnforcementContext.create(
            request_id=payload.get("request_id"),
            source=payload.get("source") or request.source,
            actor_id=payload.get("actor_id") or request.actor_id,
            session_id=payload.get("session_id") or request.session_id,
            organization_id=payload.get("organization_id") or request.organization_id,
            trace_id=payload.get("trace_id"),
            metadata=payload.get("metadata") or {},
        )

    def _build_result(
        self,
        *,
        decision: PolicyDecision,
        request: PolicyRequest,
        context: EnforcementContext,
    ) -> EnforcementResult:
        actions = self._actions_for_decision(decision, request)
        review_required = decision.requires_human_review or "enqueue_review" in actions
        quarantine_required = decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE
        blocked = decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.BLOCK

        status = self._status_for_verdict(decision.verdict, review_required=review_required)
        audit_record = self._build_audit_record(
            decision=decision,
            request=request,
            context=context,
            actions=actions,
            status=status,
        )

        metadata = {
            "target": request.target.value,
            "action": request.action,
            "risk_score": request.risk_score,
            "trace_id": context.trace_id,
            "decision_confidence": decision.confidence,
        }

        return EnforcementResult(
            enforcement_id=f"enf-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=context.request_id,
            decision=decision,
            status=status,
            actions=actions,
            review_required=review_required,
            quarantine_required=quarantine_required,
            blocked=blocked,
            audit_record=audit_record,
            metadata=metadata,
        )

    def _actions_for_decision(self, decision: PolicyDecision, request: PolicyRequest) -> list[str]:
        actions: list[str] = []

        if decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.ALLOW:
            actions.append("allow_execution")

        if decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.WARN:
            actions.extend(["allow_with_warning", "emit_security_warning"])

        if decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE:
            actions.extend(["quarantine_request", "halt_execution", "preserve_evidence"])

        if decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.BLOCK:
            actions.extend(["block_request", "halt_execution", "preserve_evidence"])

        if decision.requires_human_review:
            actions.append("enqueue_review")

        if request.requires_network:
            actions.append("monitor_network_scope")

        if request.requires_filesystem:
            actions.append("monitor_filesystem_scope")

        if request.requires_secrets:
            actions.append("apply_secret_redaction")

        return _dedupe(actions)

    def _status_for_verdict(self, verdict: PolicyVerdict, *, review_required: bool) -> str:
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.ALLOW and not review_required:
            return "allowed"
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.ALLOW and review_required:
            return "allowed_pending_review"
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.WARN and review_required:
            return "warn_pending_review"
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.WARN:
            return "warned"
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE:
            return "quarantined"
        return "blocked"

    def _build_audit_record(
        self,
        *,
        decision: PolicyDecision,
        request: PolicyRequest,
        context: EnforcementContext,
        actions: list[str],
        status: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "audit_id": f"aud-{uuid4().hex}",
            "request_id": context.request_id,
            "trace_id": context.trace_id,
            "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "status": status,
            "target": request.target.value,
            "action": request.action,
            "risk_score": request.risk_score,
            "verdict": decision.verdict.value,
            "matched_rules": list(decision.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(decision.reasons),
            "actions": list(actions),
            "actor_id": context.actor_id,
            "session_id": context.session_id,
            "organization_id": context.organization_id,
            "source": context.source,
            "context_metadata": dict(context.metadata),
        }

    def _dispatch(self, result: EnforcementResult) -> None:
        if self.audit_sink is not None:
            self.audit_sink(result.audit_record)

        payload = result.to_dict()

        if result.review_required and self.review_sink is not None:
            self.review_sink(payload)

        if result.quarantine_required and self.quarantine_sink is not None:
            self.quarantine_sink(payload)

        if result.blocked and self.block_sink is not None:
            self.block_sink(payload)

        if result.decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.WARN and self.warn_sink is not None:
            self.warn_sink(payload)

        if result.decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.ALLOW and self.allow_sink is not None:
            self.allow_sink(payload)


def enforce_policy(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    enforcer: PolicyEnforcer | None = None,
) -> EnforcementResult:
    active_enforcer = enforcer or PolicyEnforcer()
    return active_enforcer.enforce(request, context=context)


def enforce_policy_dict(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    enforcer: PolicyEnforcer | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return enforce_policy(request, context=context, enforcer=enforcer).to_dict()


def build_policy_request(
    *,
    target: PolicyTarget | str = PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN,
    action: str = "unknown",
    risk_score: int = 0,
    attributes: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    actor_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    requires_network: bool = False,
    requires_filesystem: bool = False,
    requires_secrets: bool = False,
    requires_human_review: bool = False,
    fail_closed: bool = True,
) -> PolicyRequest:
    if not isinstance(target, PolicyTarget):
        target_value = str(target).lower()
        target = PolicyTarget(target_value) if target_value in {item.value for item in PolicyTarget} else PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN

    return PolicyRequest(
        target=target,
        action=action,
        risk_score=int(risk_score),
        attributes=dict(attributes or {}),
        source=source,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        organization_id=organization_id,
        requires_network=requires_network,
        requires_filesystem=requires_filesystem,
        requires_secrets=requires_secrets,
        requires_human_review=requires_human_review,
        fail_closed=fail_closed,
    )


def _dedupe(values: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    ordered: list[str] = []
    for value in values:
        if value not in seen:
            seen.add(value)
            ordered.append(value)
    return ordered


__all__ = [
    "EnforcementContext",
    "EnforcementResult",
    "PolicyEnforcer",
    "build_policy_request",
    "enforce_policy",
    "enforce_policy_dict",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
from uuid import uuid4


class PolicyVerdict(str, Enum):
    ALLOW = "allow"
    WARN = "warn"
    QUARANTINE = "quarantine"
    BLOCK = "block"


class PolicyTarget(str, Enum):
    PROMPT = "prompt"
    ACTION = "action"
    TOOL = "tool"
    RUNTIME = "runtime"
    FILE = "file"
    NETWORK = "network"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


class RiskLevel(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyEvidence:
    code: str
    message: str
    severity: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.MEDIUM
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "code": self.code,
            "message": self.message,
            "severity": self.severity.value,
            "details": dict(self.details),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyRule:
    rule_id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    target: PolicyTarget = PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN
    verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.WARN
    enabled: bool = True
    priority: int = 100
    tags: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    match_any_keys: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    match_all_keys: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    equals: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    contains: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    min_risk_score: int | None = None
    require_human_review: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "PolicyRule":
        target = data.get("target", PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN)
        verdict = data.get("verdict", PolicyVerdict.WARN)

        if not isinstance(target, PolicyTarget):
            target = PolicyTarget(str(target).lower()) if str(target).lower() in {t.value for t in PolicyTarget} else PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN
        if not isinstance(verdict, PolicyVerdict):
            verdict = PolicyVerdict(str(verdict).lower()) if str(verdict).lower() in {v.value for v in PolicyVerdict} else PolicyVerdict.WARN

        contains_raw = data.get("contains", {}) or {}
        normalized_contains: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}
        for key, value in contains_raw.items():
            if isinstance(value, str):
                normalized_contains[str(key)] = (value.lower(),)
            elif isinstance(value, Sequence):
                normalized_contains[str(key)] = tuple(str(item).lower() for item in value)
            else:
                normalized_contains[str(key)] = (str(value).lower(),)

        return cls(
            rule_id=str(data.get("rule_id") or data.get("id") or f"rule-{uuid4().hex[:12]}"),
            name=str(data.get("name") or data.get("rule_id") or "unnamed_rule"),
            description=str(data.get("description") or ""),
            target=target,
            verdict=verdict,
            enabled=bool(data.get("enabled", True)),
            priority=int(data.get("priority", 100)),
            tags=tuple(str(tag) for tag in (data.get("tags") or ())),
            match_any_keys=tuple(str(k) for k in (data.get("match_any_keys") or ())),
            match_all_keys=tuple(str(k) for k in (data.get("match_all_keys") or ())),
            equals={str(k): v for k, v in (data.get("equals") or {}).items()},
            contains=normalized_contains,
            min_risk_score=int(data["min_risk_score"]) if data.get("min_risk_score") is not None else None,
            require_human_review=bool(data.get("require_human_review", False)),
            metadata={str(k): v for k, v in (data.get("metadata") or {}).items()},
        )

    def matches(self, request: "PolicyRequest") -> bool:
        if not self.enabled:
            return False

        if self.target not in (PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN, request.target):
            return False

        if self.match_any_keys and not any(key in request.attributes for key in self.match_any_keys):
            return False

        if self.match_all_keys and not all(key in request.attributes for key in self.match_all_keys):
            return False

        for key, expected in self.equals.items():
            if request.attributes.get(key) != expected:
                return False

        for key, needles in self.contains.items():
            haystack = str(request.attributes.get(key, "")).lower()
            if not all(needle in haystack for needle in needles):
                return False

        if self.min_risk_score is not None and request.risk_score < self.min_risk_score:
            return False

        return True

    def build_evidence(self, request: "PolicyRequest") -> PolicyEvidence:
        return PolicyEvidence(
            code=self.rule_id,
            message=self.description or f"Policy rule '{self.name}' matched.",
            severity=_severity_for_verdict(self.verdict),
            details={
                "rule_id": self.rule_id,
                "rule_name": self.name,
                "target": self.target.value,
                "request_target": request.target.value,
                "tags": list(self.tags),
                "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            },
        )


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyRequest:
    target: PolicyTarget = PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN
    action: str = "unknown"
    risk_score: int = 0
    attributes: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    source: str | None = None
    actor_id: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    organization_id: str | None = None
    requires_network: bool = False
    requires_filesystem: bool = False
    requires_secrets: bool = False
    requires_human_review: bool = False
    fail_closed: bool = True

    @classmethod
    def from_mapping(cls, data: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> "PolicyRequest":
        data = data or {}

        target_raw = data.get("target", PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN)
        if isinstance(target_raw, PolicyTarget):
            target = target_raw
        else:
            target_str = str(target_raw).lower()
            target = PolicyTarget(target_str) if target_str in {t.value for t in PolicyTarget} else PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN

        attributes = dict(data.get("attributes") or {})

        promoted_keys = (
            "prompt",
            "tool_name",
            "command",
            "path",
            "hostname",
            "url",
            "runtime",
            "content",
            "sensitivity",
            "review_reason",
        )
        for key in promoted_keys:
            if key in data and key not in attributes:
                attributes[key] = data[key]

        return cls(
            target=target,
            action=str(data.get("action") or "unknown"),
            risk_score=_safe_int(data.get("risk_score"), default=0),
            attributes=attributes,
            source=_none_if_blank(data.get("source")),
            actor_id=_none_if_blank(data.get("actor_id")),
            session_id=_none_if_blank(data.get("session_id")),
            organization_id=_none_if_blank(data.get("organization_id")),
            requires_network=bool(data.get("requires_network", False)),
            requires_filesystem=bool(data.get("requires_filesystem", False)),
            requires_secrets=bool(data.get("requires_secrets", False)),
            requires_human_review=bool(data.get("requires_human_review", False)),
            fail_closed=bool(data.get("fail_closed", True)),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "target": self.target.value,
            "action": self.action,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "attributes": dict(self.attributes),
            "source": self.source,
            "actor_id": self.actor_id,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "organization_id": self.organization_id,
            "requires_network": self.requires_network,
            "requires_filesystem": self.requires_filesystem,
            "requires_secrets": self.requires_secrets,
            "requires_human_review": self.requires_human_review,
            "fail_closed": self.fail_closed,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class PolicyDecision:
    decision_id: str
    verdict: PolicyVerdict
    allowed: bool
    action: str
    target: PolicyTarget
    risk_score: int
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[PolicyEvidence] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    requires_human_review: bool = False
    confidence: float = 1.0
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "decision_id": self.decision_id,
            "verdict": self.verdict.value,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "action": self.action,
            "target": self.target.value,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in self.evidence],
            "matched_rules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "requires_human_review": self.requires_human_review,
            "confidence": self.confidence,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
        }

class PolicyEngine:
    def __init__(
        self,
        rules: Iterable[PolicyRule | Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
        *,
        default_verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.ALLOW,
        fail_closed_verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.BLOCK,
        enable_default_rules: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        materialized_rules: list[PolicyRule] = []
        if enable_default_rules:
            materialized_rules.extend(DEFAULT_POLICY_RULES)
        if rules:
            for rule in rules:
                materialized_rules.append(rule if isinstance(rule, PolicyRule) else PolicyRule.from_mapping(rule))

        self._rules: list[PolicyRule] = sorted(materialized_rules, key=lambda item: item.priority, reverse=True)
        self.default_verdict = default_verdict
        self.fail_closed_verdict = fail_closed_verdict

    @property
    def rules(self) -> tuple[PolicyRule, ...]:
        return tuple(self._rules)

    def evaluate(self, request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> PolicyDecision:
        normalized = request if isinstance(request, PolicyRequest) else PolicyRequest.from_mapping(request)

        matched_rules: list[PolicyRule] = [rule for rule in self._rules if rule.matches(normalized)]
        evidence: list[PolicyEvidence] = [rule.build_evidence(normalized) for rule in matched_rules]

        verdict = self._resolve_verdict(normalized, matched_rules)
        requires_human_review = normalized.requires_human_review or any(rule.require_human_review for rule in matched_rules)

        reasons = [item.message for item in evidence]
        if not reasons:
            reasons.append(self._default_reason_for_verdict(verdict, normalized))

        metadata = {
            "source": normalized.source,
            "actor_id": normalized.actor_id,
            "session_id": normalized.session_id,
            "organization_id": normalized.organization_id,
            "requires_network": normalized.requires_network,
            "requires_filesystem": normalized.requires_filesystem,
            "requires_secrets": normalized.requires_secrets,
            "fail_closed": normalized.fail_closed,
            "rule_count": len(matched_rules),
        }

        decision = PolicyDecision(
            decision_id=f"pol-{uuid4().hex}",
            verdict=verdict,
            allowed=verdict in {PolicyVerdict.ALLOW, PolicyVerdict.WARN},
            action=normalized.action,
            target=normalized.target,
            risk_score=normalized.risk_score,
            reasons=reasons,
            evidence=evidence,
            matched_rules=[rule.rule_id for rule in matched_rules],
            requires_human_review=requires_human_review,
            confidence=self._calculate_confidence(normalized, matched_rules, verdict),
            metadata=metadata,
        )

        if verdict in {PolicyVerdict.BLOCK, PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE}:
            decision.allowed = False

        if requires_human_review and verdict == PolicyVerdict.ALLOW:
            decision.verdict = PolicyVerdict.WARN
            decision.allowed = True
            if "Human review required before unrestricted execution." not in decision.reasons:
                decision.reasons.append("Human review required before unrestricted execution.")

        return decision

    def decide(self, request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.evaluate(request).to_dict()

    def register_rule(self, rule: PolicyRule | Mapping[str, Any]) -> PolicyRule:
        materialized = rule if isinstance(rule, PolicyRule) else PolicyRule.from_mapping(rule)
        self._rules.append(materialized)
        self._rules.sort(key=lambda item: item.priority, reverse=True)
        return materialized

    def extend_rules(self, rules: Iterable[PolicyRule | Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None:
        for rule in rules:
            self.register_rule(rule)

    def clear_rules(self) -> None:
        self._rules.clear()

    def replace_rules(self, rules: Iterable[PolicyRule | Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self._rules = []
        self.extend_rules(rules)

    def _resolve_verdict(self, request: PolicyRequest, matched_rules: Sequence[PolicyRule]) -> PolicyVerdict:
        if matched_rules:
            return max((rule.verdict for rule in matched_rules), key=_verdict_rank)

        if request.fail_closed and self._request_is_unsafe_or_unknown(request):
            return self.fail_closed_verdict

        return self.default_verdict

    def _request_is_unsafe_or_unknown(self, request: PolicyRequest) -> bool:
        if request.target == PolicyTarget.UNKNOWN:
            return True
        if request.risk_score >= 70:
            return True
        if request.requires_secrets and request.requires_network:
            return True
        return False

    def _default_reason_for_verdict(self, verdict: PolicyVerdict, request: PolicyRequest) -> str:
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.ALLOW:
            return "No blocking policy conditions were matched."
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.WARN:
            return "Request is allowed with elevated caution."
        if verdict == PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE:
            return "Request is quarantined pending containment or review."
        return f"Request was blocked by {request.target.value} policy safeguards."

    def _calculate_confidence(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest,
        matched_rules: Sequence[PolicyRule],
        verdict: PolicyVerdict,
    ) -> float:
        base = 0.55
        if matched_rules:
            base += min(len(matched_rules) * 0.1, 0.3)
        base += min(max(request.risk_score, 0), 100) / 1000.0
        if verdict in {PolicyVerdict.BLOCK, PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE}:
            base += 0.1
        return round(min(base, 0.99), 3)


def evaluate_policy(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    rules: Iterable[PolicyRule | Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
    default_verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.ALLOW,
    fail_closed_verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.BLOCK,
    enable_default_rules: bool = True,
) -> PolicyDecision:
    engine = PolicyEngine(
        rules=rules,
        default_verdict=default_verdict,
        fail_closed_verdict=fail_closed_verdict,
        enable_default_rules=enable_default_rules,
    )
    return engine.evaluate(request)


def decide_policy(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    rules: Iterable[PolicyRule | Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
    default_verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.ALLOW,
    fail_closed_verdict: PolicyVerdict = PolicyVerdict.BLOCK,
    enable_default_rules: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_policy(
        request,
        rules=rules,
        default_verdict=default_verdict,
        fail_closed_verdict=fail_closed_verdict,
        enable_default_rules=enable_default_rules,
    ).to_dict()


def _verdict_rank(verdict: PolicyVerdict) -> int:
    order = {
        PolicyVerdict.ALLOW: 0,
        PolicyVerdict.WARN: 1,
        PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE: 2,
        PolicyVerdict.BLOCK: 3,
    }
    return order[verdict]


def _severity_for_verdict(verdict: PolicyVerdict) -> RiskLevel:
    mapping = {
        PolicyVerdict.ALLOW: RiskLevel.LOW,
        PolicyVerdict.WARN: RiskLevel.MEDIUM,
        PolicyVerdict.QUARANTINE: RiskLevel.HIGH,
        PolicyVerdict.BLOCK: RiskLevel.CRITICAL,
    }
    return mapping[verdict]


def _safe_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _none_if_blank(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value).strip()
    return text or None

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4


class GateStatus(str, Enum):
    OPEN = "open"
    CONDITIONAL = "conditional"
    CLOSED = "closed"
    QUARANTINED = "quarantined"
    NEEDS_REVIEW = "needs_review"


class RemediationAction(str, Enum):
    NONE = "none"
    REQUIRE_REVIEW = "require_review"
    APPLY_REDACTION = "apply_redaction"
    SANDBOX_ONLY = "sandbox_only"
    QUARANTINE = "quarantine"
    BLOCK = "block"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RemediationRule:
    rule_id: str
    name: str
    condition: str
    action: RemediationAction
    severity: str = "medium"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "rule_id": self.rule_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "condition": self.condition,
            "action": self.action.value,
            "severity": self.severity,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class GateEvidence:
    kind: str
    value: Any
    label: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "kind": self.kind,
            "value": self.value,
            "label": self.label,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class GateDecision:
    gate_id: str
    request_id: str
    status: GateStatus
    allowed: bool
    action: RemediationAction
    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    matched_rules: list[RemediationRule] = field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[GateEvidence] = field(default_factory=list)
    review_required: bool = False
    quarantine_required: bool = False
    redaction_required: bool = False
    sandbox_required: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "gate_id": self.gate_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "action": self.action.value,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "matched_rules": [rule.to_dict() for rule in self.matched_rules],
            "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in self.evidence],
            "review_required": self.review_required,
            "quarantine_required": self.quarantine_required,
            "redaction_required": self.redaction_required,
            "sandbox_required": self.sandbox_required,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
        }


class RemediationGate:
    def __init__(
        self,
        rules: Iterable[RemediationRule] | None = None,
        *,
        sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.rules = list(rules) if rules is not None else self._default_rules()
        self.sink = sink

    def evaluate(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> GateDecision:
        request = dict(payload or {})
        request_id = str(request.get("request_id") or f"req-{uuid4().hex}")

        matched_rules: list[RemediationRule] = []
        reasons: list[str] = []
        evidence: list[GateEvidence] = self._build_evidence(request)

        risk_score = int(request.get("risk_score", 0) or 0)
        verdict = str(request.get("verdict", "allow")).lower()
        review_required = bool(request.get("review_required", False))
        quarantine_required = bool(request.get("quarantine_required", False))
        secret_detected = bool(request.get("secret_detected", False))
        prompt_injection_detected = bool(request.get("prompt_injection_detected", False))
        requires_network = bool(request.get("requires_network", False))
        untrusted_output = bool(request.get("untrusted_output", False))
        malware_detected = bool(request.get("malware_detected", False))

        for rule in self.rules:
            if self._matches(rule, request):
                matched_rules.append(rule)
                reasons.append(rule.name)

        action = RemediationAction.NONE
        status = GateStatus.OPEN
        allowed = True
        redaction_required = False
        sandbox_required = False

        if malware_detected or verdict == "block":
            action = RemediationAction.BLOCK
            status = GateStatus.CLOSED
            allowed = False
        elif quarantine_required or verdict == "quarantine":
            action = RemediationAction.QUARANTINE
            status = GateStatus.QUARANTINED
            allowed = False
        elif secret_detected:
            action = RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION
            status = GateStatus.CONDITIONAL
            redaction_required = True
            sandbox_required = requires_network
        elif review_required or verdict == "warn":
            action = RemediationAction.REQUIRE_REVIEW
            status = GateStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW
            allowed = False
            review_required = True
        elif prompt_injection_detected or untrusted_output or risk_score >= 70:
            action = RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY
            status = GateStatus.CONDITIONAL
            sandbox_required = True
        elif requires_network and risk_score >= 40:
            action = RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY
            status = GateStatus.CONDITIONAL
            sandbox_required = True

        if action == RemediationAction.BLOCK:
            reasons.append("Blocking condition met.")
        elif action == RemediationAction.QUARANTINE:
            reasons.append("Quarantine condition met.")
        elif action == RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION:
            reasons.append("Sensitive data requires redaction before release.")
        elif action == RemediationAction.REQUIRE_REVIEW:
            reasons.append("Human review required before continuation.")
        elif action == RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY:
            reasons.append("Execution must remain inside sandbox boundaries.")
        else:
            reasons.append("No additional remediation required.")

        decision = GateDecision(
            gate_id=f"gate-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=request_id,
            status=status,
            allowed=allowed,
            action=action,
            reasons=self._dedupe(reasons),
            matched_rules=matched_rules,
            evidence=evidence,
            review_required=review_required,
            quarantine_required=action == RemediationAction.QUARANTINE or quarantine_required,
            redaction_required=redaction_required,
            sandbox_required=sandbox_required,
            metadata={
                "risk_score": risk_score,
                "verdict": verdict,
                "requires_network": requires_network,
                "secret_detected": secret_detected,
                "prompt_injection_detected": prompt_injection_detected,
                "untrusted_output": untrusted_output,
                "malware_detected": malware_detected,
            },
        )
        self._emit(decision)
        return decision

    def evaluate_dict(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.evaluate(payload).to_dict()

    def _matches(self, rule: RemediationRule, request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
        condition = rule.condition

        if condition == "malware_detected":
            return bool(request.get("malware_detected"))
        if condition == "quarantine_required":
            return bool(request.get("quarantine_required")) or str(request.get("verdict", "")).lower() == "quarantine"
        if condition == "review_required":
            return bool(request.get("review_required")) or str(request.get("verdict", "")).lower() == "warn"
        if condition == "secret_detected":
            return bool(request.get("secret_detected"))
        if condition == "prompt_injection_or_untrusted_output":
            return bool(request.get("prompt_injection_detected")) or bool(request.get("untrusted_output"))
        if condition == "high_risk_network":
            return bool(request.get("requires_network")) and int(request.get("risk_score", 0) or 0) >= 40
        if condition == "high_risk_score":
            return int(request.get("risk_score", 0) or 0) >= 70

        return False

    def _build_evidence(self, request: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[GateEvidence]:
        evidence: list[GateEvidence] = []

        for key in (
            "risk_score",
            "verdict",
            "review_required",
            "quarantine_required",
            "secret_detected",
            "prompt_injection_detected",
            "requires_network",
            "untrusted_output",
            "malware_detected",
            "session_id",
            "execution_id",
            "tool_name",
        ):
            if key in request:
                evidence.append(GateEvidence(kind="signal", label=key, value=request.get(key)))

        if "reasons" in request:
            evidence.append(
                GateEvidence(
                    kind="reasons",
                    label="upstream_reasons",
                    value=list(request.get("reasons") or []),
                )
            )

        return evidence

    def _default_rules(self) -> list[RemediationRule]:
        return [
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-block-malware",
                name="Malware detected",
                condition="malware_detected",
                action=RemediationAction.BLOCK,
                severity="critical",
            ),
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-quarantine",
                name="Quarantine required",
                condition="quarantine_required",
                action=RemediationAction.QUARANTINE,
                severity="critical",
            ),
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-review",
                name="Human review required",
                condition="review_required",
                action=RemediationAction.REQUIRE_REVIEW,
                severity="high",
            ),
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-secret",
                name="Secret detected",
                condition="secret_detected",
                action=RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION,
                severity="high",
            ),
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-untrusted",
                name="Prompt injection or untrusted output detected",
                condition="prompt_injection_or_untrusted_output",
                action=RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY,
                severity="high",
            ),
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-network",
                name="High-risk network execution",
                condition="high_risk_network",
                action=RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY,
                severity="medium",
            ),
            RemediationRule(
                rule_id="rr-risk",
                name="High risk score",
                condition="high_risk_score",
                action=RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY,
                severity="medium",
            ),
        ]

    def _dedupe(self, values: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
        seen: set[str] = set()
        ordered: list[str] = []
        for value in values:
            normalized = str(value).strip()
            if normalized and normalized not in seen:
                seen.add(normalized)
                ordered.append(normalized)
        return ordered

    def _emit(self, decision: GateDecision) -> None:
        if self.sink is not None:
            self.sink(
                {
                    "event": "remediation.gate.evaluated",
                    "decision": decision.to_dict(),
                    "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                }
            )


def evaluate_remediation_gate(payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> GateDecision:
    return RemediationGate().evaluate(payload)


def evaluate_remediation_gate_dict(payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return evaluate_remediation_gate(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "GateDecision",
    "GateEvidence",
    "GateStatus",
    "RemediationAction",
    "RemediationGate",
    "RemediationRule",
    "evaluate_remediation_gate",
    "evaluate_remediation_gate_dict",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, MutableMapping
from uuid import uuid4

from orchestrator.remediationgate import GateDecision, GateStatus, RemediationAction
from orchestrator.runtimesession import RuntimeSession, RuntimeSessionManager, RuntimeSessionStatus
from orchestrator.supervisor import SupervisorDecision, SupervisorStatus


class ResponseOutcome(str, Enum):
    ALLOW = "allow"
    ALLOW_WITH_SANDBOX = "allow_with_sandbox"
    ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION = "allow_with_redaction"
    ALLOW_WITH_CONTROLS = "allow_with_controls"
    NEEDS_REVIEW = "needs_review"
    QUARANTINE = "quarantine"
    BLOCK = "block"
    FAILED = "failed"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ResponseStep:
    step_id: str
    kind: str
    status: str
    message: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "step_id": self.step_id,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "status": self.status,
            "message": self.message,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CoordinatedResponse:
    response_id: str
    request_id: str
    session_id: str
    outcome: ResponseOutcome
    gate: dict[str, Any]
    supervisor: dict[str, Any]
    session: dict[str, Any]
    allow: bool
    sandbox_required: bool
    redaction_required: bool
    quarantine_required: bool
    review_required: bool
    review_id: str | None = None
    quarantine_id: str | None = None
    steps: list[ResponseStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def add_step(self, kind: str, status: str, message: str, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.steps.append(
            ResponseStep(
                step_id=f"step-{uuid4().hex}",
                kind=kind,
                status=status,
                message=message,
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            )
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "response_id": self.response_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "outcome": self.outcome.value,
            "allow": self.allow,
            "sandbox_required": self.sandbox_required,
            "redaction_required": self.redaction_required,
            "quarantine_required": self.quarantine_required,
            "review_required": self.review_required,
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "quarantine_id": self.quarantine_id,
            "gate": dict(self.gate),
            "supervisor": dict(self.supervisor),
            "session": dict(self.session),
            "steps": [step.to_dict() for step in self.steps],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
        }


class ResponseCoordinator:
    """
    ResponseCoordinator is the single place that turns lower-level decisions
    (gate, supervisor, runtime session) into one coherent response envelope
    for the secure runtime pipeline.
    """

    def __init__(self, session_manager: RuntimeSessionManager | None = None) -> None:
        self.session_manager = session_manager or RuntimeSessionManager()

    def coordinate(
        self,
        *,
        request: Mapping[str, Any],
        gate: GateDecision,
        supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
        session: RuntimeSession | None = None,
    ) -> CoordinatedResponse:
        base_request: MutableMapping[str, Any] = dict(request or {})
        request_id = str(base_request.get("request_id") or gate.request_id or supervisor.request_id or f"req-{uuid4().hex}")

        if session is None:
            session = self.session_manager.start(
                {
                    "request_id": request_id,
                    "actor_id": base_request.get("actor_id"),
                    "agent_id": base_request.get("agent_id"),
                    "execution_id": base_request.get("execution_id"),
                    "policy_id": base_request.get("policy_id"),
                    "risk_score": gate.metadata.get("risk_score", 0),
                    "trust_score": base_request.get("trust_score"),
                    "allowed_tools": base_request.get("allowed_tools"),
                    "blocked_tools": base_request.get("blocked_tools"),
                    "tags": base_request.get("tags"),
                    "metadata": {
                        "source": "response_coordinator",
                        "incoming_verdict": gate.metadata.get("verdict"),
                    },
                }
            )
        else:
            session.merge_context(
                {
                    "risk_score": gate.metadata.get("risk_score"),
                    "allowed_tools": base_request.get("allowed_tools"),
                    "blocked_tools": base_request.get("blocked_tools"),
                    "tags": base_request.get("tags"),
                }
            )

        session.apply_supervisor_decision(supervisor.to_dict())

        coordinated = CoordinatedResponse(
            response_id=f"resp-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=request_id,
            session_id=session.session_id,
            outcome=self._derive_outcome(gate, supervisor, session),
            gate=gate.to_dict(),
            supervisor=supervisor.to_dict(),
            session=session.to_dict(),
            allow=self._is_allowed(supervisor, session),
            sandbox_required=self._sandbox_required(gate, supervisor),
            redaction_required=self._redaction_required(gate, supervisor),
            quarantine_required=self._quarantine_required(gate, supervisor, session),
            review_required=self._review_required(supervisor, session),
            review_id=supervisor.review_id,
            quarantine_id=session.quarantine_id,
            metadata={
                "gate_status": gate.status.value,
                "gate_action": gate.action.value,
                "supervisor_status": supervisor.status.value,
                "session_status": session.status.value,
            },
        )

        self._append_steps(coordinated, gate, supervisor, session)
        return coordinated

    def coordinate_dict(
        self,
        *,
        request: Mapping[str, Any],
        gate: GateDecision,
        supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
        session: RuntimeSession | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.coordinate(request=request, gate=gate, supervisor=supervisor, session=session).to_dict()

    def _derive_outcome(
        self,
        gate: GateDecision,
        supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
        session: RuntimeSession,
    ) -> ResponseOutcome:
        if supervisor.status in {SupervisorStatus.BLOCKED, SupervisorStatus.FAILED}:
            return ResponseOutcome.BLOCK
        if supervisor.status == SupervisorStatus.QUARANTINED or session.status == RuntimeSessionStatus.QUARANTINED:
            return ResponseOutcome.QUARANTINE
        if supervisor.status == SupervisorStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW or session.status == RuntimeSessionStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW:
            return ResponseOutcome.NEEDS_REVIEW

        if supervisor.status == SupervisorStatus.CONDITIONAL:
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION and gate.sandbox_required:
                return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_CONTROLS
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION:
                return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY or gate.sandbox_required:
                return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_SANDBOX
            return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_CONTROLS

        if supervisor.status == SupervisorStatus.APPROVED and gate.status in {
            GateStatus.OPEN,
            GateStatus.CONDITIONAL,
        }:
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY or gate.sandbox_required:
                return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_SANDBOX
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION:
                return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION
            return ResponseOutcome.ALLOW

        if gate.status in {GateStatus.CLOSED, GateStatus.QUARANTINED}:
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.QUARANTINE:
                return ResponseOutcome.QUARANTINE
            if gate.action == RemediationAction.BLOCK:
                return ResponseOutcome.BLOCK

        if gate.status == GateStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW:
            return ResponseOutcome.NEEDS_REVIEW

        return ResponseOutcome.FAILED

    def _is_allowed(self, supervisor: SupervisorDecision, session: RuntimeSession) -> bool:
        if supervisor.status in {
            SupervisorStatus.BLOCKED,
            SupervisorStatus.QUARANTINED,
            SupervisorStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW,
            SupervisorStatus.FAILED,
        }:
            return False
        if session.status in {
            RuntimeSessionStatus.BLOCKED,
            RuntimeSessionStatus.QUARANTINED,
            RuntimeSessionStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW,
            RuntimeSessionStatus.FAILED,
        }:
            return False
        return True

    def _sandbox_required(self, gate: GateDecision, supervisor: SupervisorDecision) -> bool:
        if gate.sandbox_required:
            return True
        return bool(supervisor.metadata.get("sandbox_required") or supervisor.metadata.get("sandbox_only"))

    def _redaction_required(self, gate: GateDecision, supervisor: SupervisorDecision) -> bool:
        if gate.redaction_required:
            return True
        return bool(supervisor.metadata.get("redaction_required"))

    def _quarantine_required(
        self,
        gate: GateDecision,
        supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
        session: RuntimeSession,
    ) -> bool:
        if gate.quarantine_required or gate.action == RemediationAction.QUARANTINE:
            return True
        if supervisor.status == SupervisorStatus.QUARANTINED:
            return True
        if session.status == RuntimeSessionStatus.QUARANTINED:
            return True
        return False

    def _review_required(self, supervisor: SupervisorDecision, session: RuntimeSession) -> bool:
        if supervisor.status == SupervisorStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW:
            return True
        if session.status == RuntimeSessionStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW:
            return True
        return False

    def _append_steps(
        self,
        response: CoordinatedResponse,
        gate: GateDecision,
        supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
        session: RuntimeSession,
    ) -> None:
        response.add_step(
            kind="gate",
            status=gate.status.value,
            message=f"Gate evaluated with action={gate.action.value}.",
            metadata={
                "allowed": gate.allowed,
                "review_required": gate.review_required,
                "quarantine_required": gate.quarantine_required,
                "sandbox_required": gate.sandbox_required,
                "redaction_required": gate.redaction_required,
                "reasons": list(gate.reasons),
            },
        )

        response.add_step(
            kind="supervisor",
            status=supervisor.status.value,
            message=f"Supervisor resolved action={supervisor.action}.",
            metadata={
                "allowed": supervisor.allowed,
                "review_id": supervisor.review_id,
                "quarantine_required": supervisor.quarantine_required,
                "sandbox_required": supervisor.sandbox_required,
                "redaction_required": supervisor.redaction_required,
            },
        )

        response.add_step(
            kind="session",
            status=session.status.value,
            message="Runtime session updated.",
            metadata={
                "session_id": session.session_id,
                "review_id": session.review_id,
                "quarantine_id": session.quarantine_id,
                "risk_score": session.risk_score,
                "trust_score": session.trust_score,
            },
        )


def coordinate_response(
    *,
    request: Mapping[str, Any],
    gate: GateDecision,
    supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
    session: RuntimeSession | None = None,
) -> CoordinatedResponse:
    return ResponseCoordinator().coordinate(request=request, gate=gate, supervisor=supervisor, session=session)


def coordinate_response_dict(
    *,
    request: Mapping[str, Any],
    gate: GateDecision,
    supervisor: SupervisorDecision,
    session: RuntimeSession | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return coordinate_response(request=request, gate=gate, supervisor=supervisor, session=session).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "CoordinatedResponse",
    "ResponseCoordinator",
    "ResponseOutcome",
    "ResponseStep",
    "coordinate_response",
    "coordinate_response_dict",
]

FILE: orchestrator\reviewqueue.py

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4


class ReviewStatus(str, Enum):
    PENDING = "pending"
    ASSIGNED = "assigned"
    IN_REVIEW = "in_review"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    ESCALATED = "escalated"
    EXPIRED = "expired"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class ReviewPriority(str, Enum):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewEvidence:
    kind: str
    value: Any
    label: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "kind": self.kind,
            "value": self.value,
            "label": self.label,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewComment:
    comment_id: str
    author_id: str
    message: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "comment_id": self.comment_id,
            "author_id": self.author_id,
            "message": self.message,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewDecision:
    reviewer_id: str
    verdict: str
    reason: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "reviewer_id": self.reviewer_id,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "reason": self.reason,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ReviewItem:
    review_id: str
    request_id: str
    execution_id: str | None
    title: str
    summary: str
    status: ReviewStatus = ReviewStatus.PENDING
    priority: ReviewPriority = ReviewPriority.MEDIUM
    queue: str = "default"
    assigned_to: str | None = None
    created_by: str | None = None
    due_at: str | None = None
    escalation_at: str | None = None
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[ReviewEvidence] = field(default_factory=list)
    comments: list[ReviewComment] = field(default_factory=list)
    decisions: list[ReviewDecision] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def touch(self) -> None:
        self.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def add_comment(self, author_id: str, message: str, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> ReviewComment:
        comment = ReviewComment(
            comment_id=f"cmt-{uuid4().hex}",
            author_id=author_id,
            message=message,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )
        self.comments.append(comment)
        self.touch()
        return comment

    def add_decision(self, reviewer_id: str, verdict: str, reason: str, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> ReviewDecision:
        decision = ReviewDecision(
            reviewer_id=reviewer_id,
            verdict=verdict,
            reason=reason,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )
        self.decisions.append(decision)
        self.touch()
        return decision

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "execution_id": self.execution_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "priority": self.priority.value,
            "queue": self.queue,
            "assigned_to": self.assigned_to,
            "created_by": self.created_by,
            "due_at": self.due_at,
            "escalation_at": self.escalation_at,
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "evidence": [item.to_dict() for item in self.evidence],
            "comments": [item.to_dict() for item in self.comments],
            "decisions": [item.to_dict() for item in self.decisions],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
        }


class ReviewQueue:
    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None,
        sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._items: dict[str, ReviewItem] = {}
        self.clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
        self.sink = sink

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        request_id: str,
        title: str,
        summary: str,
        execution_id: str | None = None,
        priority: ReviewPriority | str = ReviewPriority.MEDIUM,
        queue: str = "default",
        created_by: str | None = None,
        due_in_minutes: int | None = 60,
        escalate_in_minutes: int | None = 30,
        tags: Iterable[str] | None = None,
        evidence: Iterable[ReviewEvidence | Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ReviewItem:
        item = ReviewItem(
            review_id=f"rev-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=request_id,
            execution_id=execution_id,
            title=title,
            summary=summary,
            priority=self._normalize_priority(priority),
            queue=queue,
            created_by=created_by,
            due_at=self._future_iso(due_in_minutes),
            escalation_at=self._future_iso(escalate_in_minutes),
            tags=[str(tag) for tag in (tags or [])],
            evidence=[self._normalize_evidence(ev) for ev in (evidence or [])],
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )
        self._items[item.review_id] = item
        self._emit("review.created", item)
        return item

    def get(self, review_id: str) -> ReviewItem | None:
        return self._items.get(review_id)

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        status: ReviewStatus | str | None = None,
        queue: str | None = None,
        assigned_to: str | None = None,
        priority: ReviewPriority | str | None = None,
    ) -> list[ReviewItem]:
        items = list(self._items.values())

        if status is not None:
            status_value = self._normalize_status(status).value
            items = [item for item in items if item.status.value == status_value]

        if queue is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.queue == queue]

        if assigned_to is not None:
            items = [item for item in items if item.assigned_to == assigned_to]

        if priority is not None:
            priority_value = self._normalize_priority(priority).value
            items = [item for item in items if item.priority.value == priority_value]

        return sorted(items, key=self._sort_key)

    def assign(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str, *, actor_id: str | None = None) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.assigned_to = reviewer_id
        item.status = ReviewStatus.ASSIGNED if item.status == ReviewStatus.PENDING else item.status
        item.touch()
        item.add_comment(
            author_id=actor_id or reviewer_id,
            message=f"Assigned to reviewer {reviewer_id}.",
            metadata={"event": "assigned"},
        )
        self._emit("review.assigned", item)
        return item

    def start(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.assigned_to = reviewer_id
        item.status = ReviewStatus.IN_REVIEW
        item.touch()
        item.add_comment(
            author_id=reviewer_id,
            message="Review started.",
            metadata={"event": "in_review"},
        )
        self._emit("review.started", item)
        return item

    def approve(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str, reason: str, *, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.status = ReviewStatus.APPROVED
        item.assigned_to = reviewer_id
        item.add_decision(reviewer_id, "approved", reason, metadata)
        self._emit("review.approved", item)
        return item

    def reject(self, review_id: str, reviewer_id: str, reason: str, *, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.status = ReviewStatus.REJECTED
        item.assigned_to = reviewer_id
        item.add_decision(reviewer_id, "rejected", reason, metadata)
        self._emit("review.rejected", item)
        return item

    def escalate(self, review_id: str, *, actor_id: str, reason: str, queue: str | None = None) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.status = ReviewStatus.ESCALATED
        if queue:
            item.queue = queue
        item.add_comment(
            author_id=actor_id,
            message=reason,
            metadata={"event": "escalated", "queue": item.queue},
        )
        self._emit("review.escalated", item)
        return item

    def cancel(self, review_id: str, *, actor_id: str, reason: str) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.status = ReviewStatus.CANCELLED
        item.add_comment(
            author_id=actor_id,
            message=reason,
            metadata={"event": "cancelled"},
        )
        self._emit("review.cancelled", item)
        return item

    def add_comment(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        *,
        author_id: str,
        message: str,
        metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ReviewComment:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        comment = item.add_comment(author_id, message, metadata)
        self._emit("review.comment_added", item)
        return comment

    def add_evidence(
        self,
        review_id: str,
        evidence: ReviewEvidence | Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self._require(review_id)
        item.evidence.append(self._normalize_evidence(evidence))
        item.touch()
        self._emit("review.evidence_added", item)
        return item

    def expire_due_items(self) -> list[ReviewItem]:
        now = self.clock()
        expired: list[ReviewItem] = []
        for item in self._items.values():
            if item.status in {
                ReviewStatus.APPROVED,
                ReviewStatus.REJECTED,
                ReviewStatus.CANCELLED,
                ReviewStatus.EXPIRED,
            }:
                continue
            if item.due_at and datetime.fromisoformat(item.due_at) <= now:
                item.status = ReviewStatus.EXPIRED
                item.touch()
                expired.append(item)
                self._emit("review.expired", item)
        return expired

    def auto_escalate(self) -> list[ReviewItem]:
        now = self.clock()
        escalated: list[ReviewItem] = []
        for item in self._items.values():
            if item.status not in {
                ReviewStatus.PENDING,
                ReviewStatus.ASSIGNED,
                ReviewStatus.IN_REVIEW,
            }:
                continue
            if item.escalation_at and datetime.fromisoformat(item.escalation_at) <= now:
                item.status = ReviewStatus.ESCALATED
                item.touch()
                item.add_comment(
                    author_id="system",
                    message="Automatically escalated after SLA threshold.",
                    metadata={"event": "auto_escalated"},
                )
                escalated.append(item)
                self._emit("review.auto_escalated", item)
        return escalated

    def stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        counts_by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
        counts_by_priority: dict[str, int] = {}

        for item in self._items.values():
            counts_by_status[item.status.value] = counts_by_status.get(item.status.value, 0) + 1
            counts_by_priority[item.priority.value] = counts_by_priority.get(item.priority.value, 0) + 1

        return {
            "total": len(self._items),
            "by_status": counts_by_status,
            "by_priority": counts_by_priority,
            "open": sum(
                1
                for item in self._items.values()
                if item.status
                in {
                    ReviewStatus.PENDING,
                    ReviewStatus.ASSIGNED,
                    ReviewStatus.IN_REVIEW,
                    ReviewStatus.ESCALATED,
                }
            ),
        }

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "items": [item.to_dict() for item in self.list()],
            "stats": self.stats(),
        }

    def _require(self, review_id: str) -> ReviewItem:
        item = self.get(review_id)
        if item is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Review item not found: {review_id}")
        return item

    def _normalize_priority(self, value: ReviewPriority | str) -> ReviewPriority:
        if isinstance(value, ReviewPriority):
            return value
        return ReviewPriority(str(value).lower())

    def _normalize_status(self, value: ReviewStatus | str) -> ReviewStatus:
        if isinstance(value, ReviewStatus):
            return value
        return ReviewStatus(str(value).lower())

    def _normalize_evidence(self, value: ReviewEvidence | Mapping[str, Any]) -> ReviewEvidence:
        if isinstance(value, ReviewEvidence):
            return value
        payload = dict(value)
        return ReviewEvidence(
            kind=str(payload.get("kind", "unknown")),
            value=payload.get("value"),
            label=payload.get("label"),
            metadata=dict(payload.get("metadata") or {}),
        )

    def _future_iso(self, minutes: int | None) -> str | None:
        if minutes is None:
            return None
        return (self.clock() + timedelta(minutes=minutes)).isoformat()

    def _sort_key(self, item: ReviewItem) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
        priority_rank = {
            ReviewPriority.CRITICAL.value: 0,
            ReviewPriority.HIGH.value: 1,
            ReviewPriority.MEDIUM.value: 2,
            ReviewPriority.LOW.value: 3,
        }
        return (
            priority_rank.get(item.priority.value, 99),
            item.due_at or "",
            item.created_at,
        )

    def _emit(self, event: str, item: ReviewItem) -> None:
        if self.sink is not None:
            self.sink(
                {
                    "event": event,
                    "review": item.to_dict(),
                    "timestamp": self.clock().isoformat(),
                }
            )


def build_review_item(
    *,
    request_id: str,
    title: str,
    summary: str,
    execution_id: str | None = None,
    priority: ReviewPriority | str = ReviewPriority.MEDIUM,
    queue: str = "default",
    created_by: str | None = None,
    due_in_minutes: int | None = 60,
    escalate_in_minutes: int | None = 30,
    tags: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    evidence: Iterable[ReviewEvidence | Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
    metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> ReviewItem:
    queue_obj = ReviewQueue()
    return queue_obj.create(
        request_id=request_id,
        title=title,
        summary=summary,
        execution_id=execution_id,
        priority=priority,
        queue=queue,
        created_by=created_by,
        due_in_minutes=due_in_minutes,
        escalate_in_minutes=escalate_in_minutes,
        tags=tags,
        evidence=evidence,
        metadata=metadata,
    )


__all__ = [
    "ReviewComment",
    "ReviewDecision",
    "ReviewEvidence",
    "ReviewItem",
    "ReviewPriority",
    "ReviewQueue",
    "ReviewStatus",
    "build_review_item",
]
