from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4


class RuntimeSessionStatus(str, Enum):
    CREATED = "created"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    NEEDS_REVIEW = "needs_review"
    QUARANTINED = "quarantined"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RuntimeSessionEvent:
    event_id: str
    kind: str
    message: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "message": self.message,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RuntimeSession:
    session_id: str
    request_id: str
    status: RuntimeSessionStatus = RuntimeSessionStatus.CREATED
    actor_id: str | None = None
    agent_id: str | None = None
    execution_id: str | None = None
    policy_id: str | None = None
    sandbox_id: str | None = None
    review_id: str | None = None
    quarantine_id: str | None = None
    checkpoint_id: str | None = None
    risk_score: int = 0
    trust_score: int | None = None
    allowed_tools: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    blocked_tools: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    events: list[RuntimeSessionEvent] = field(default_factory=list)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    updated_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    completed_at: str | None = None

    def add_event(self, kind: str, message: str, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> RuntimeSessionEvent:
        event = RuntimeSessionEvent(
            event_id=f"evt-{uuid4().hex}",
            kind=kind,
            message=message,
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )
        self.events.append(event)
        self.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return event

    def activate(self) -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.ACTIVE
        self.add_event("activated", "Runtime session activated.")

    def pause(self, reason: str = "Paused by supervisor.") -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.PAUSED
        self.add_event("paused", reason)

    def mark_needs_review(self, review_id: str | None = None, reason: str = "Human review required.") -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW
        self.review_id = review_id
        self.add_event("needs_review", reason, {"review_id": review_id})

    def quarantine(self, quarantine_id: str | None = None, reason: str = "Session quarantined.") -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.QUARANTINED
        self.quarantine_id = quarantine_id
        self.add_event("quarantined", reason, {"quarantine_id": quarantine_id})

    def block(self, reason: str = "Session blocked.") -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.BLOCKED
        self.add_event("blocked", reason)

    def fail(self, reason: str = "Session failed.") -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.FAILED
        self.add_event("failed", reason)

    def complete(self, reason: str = "Session completed.") -> None:
        self.status = RuntimeSessionStatus.COMPLETED
        self.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        self.add_event("completed", reason)

    def attach_checkpoint(self, checkpoint_id: str) -> None:
        self.checkpoint_id = checkpoint_id
        self.add_event("checkpoint_attached", "Checkpoint attached to runtime session.", {"checkpoint_id": checkpoint_id})

    def apply_supervisor_decision(self, decision: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
        status = str(decision.get("status", "")).lower()
        self.execution_id = self.execution_id or self._optional_str(decision.get("execution_id"))
        self.review_id = self.review_id or self._optional_str(decision.get("review_id"))

        if status == "approved":
            self.activate()
            return
        if status == "conditional":
            self.activate()
            self.add_event(
                "conditional_controls",
                "Conditional safeguards applied to runtime session.",
                {
                    "sandbox_required": bool(decision.get("sandbox_required")),
                    "redaction_required": bool(decision.get("redaction_required")),
                },
            )
            return
        if status == "needs_review":
            self.mark_needs_review(
                review_id=self._optional_str(decision.get("review_id")),
                reason="Supervisor routed runtime session into review.",
            )
            return
        if status == "quarantined":
            self.quarantine(
                quarantine_id=self._optional_str(decision.get("quarantine_id")),
                reason="Supervisor quarantined runtime session.",
            )
            return
        if status == "blocked":
            self.block("Supervisor blocked runtime session.")
            return

        self.fail("Unknown supervisor decision status received.")

    def merge_context(self, context: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> None:
        payload = dict(context or {})
        self.actor_id = self.actor_id or self._optional_str(payload.get("actor_id"))
        self.agent_id = self.agent_id or self._optional_str(payload.get("agent_id"))
        self.execution_id = self.execution_id or self._optional_str(payload.get("execution_id"))
        self.policy_id = self.policy_id or self._optional_str(payload.get("policy_id"))
        self.sandbox_id = self.sandbox_id or self._optional_str(payload.get("sandbox_id"))
        self.risk_score = int(payload.get("risk_score", self.risk_score) or 0)

        trust_score = payload.get("trust_score")
        if trust_score is not None:
            self.trust_score = int(trust_score)

        self.allowed_tools = self._normalize_str_list(payload.get("allowed_tools"), fallback=self.allowed_tools)
        self.blocked_tools = self._normalize_str_list(payload.get("blocked_tools"), fallback=self.blocked_tools)
        self.tags = self._normalize_str_list(payload.get("tags"), fallback=self.tags)

        extra_metadata = payload.get("metadata")
        if isinstance(extra_metadata, Mapping):
            self.metadata.update(dict(extra_metadata))

        self.add_event(
            "context_merged",
            "Runtime session merged new context.",
            {
                "risk_score": self.risk_score,
                "allowed_tools": list(self.allowed_tools),
                "blocked_tools": list(self.blocked_tools),
            },
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "actor_id": self.actor_id,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "execution_id": self.execution_id,
            "policy_id": self.policy_id,
            "sandbox_id": self.sandbox_id,
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "quarantine_id": self.quarantine_id,
            "checkpoint_id": self.checkpoint_id,
            "risk_score": self.risk_score,
            "trust_score": self.trust_score,
            "allowed_tools": list(self.allowed_tools),
            "blocked_tools": list(self.blocked_tools),
            "tags": list(self.tags),
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "events": [event.to_dict() for event in self.events],
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _optional_str(value: Any) -> str | None:
        if value is None:
            return None
        text = str(value).strip()
        return text or None

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_str_list(value: Any, *, fallback: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
        if value is None:
            return list(fallback or [])
        if isinstance(value, str):
            items = [part.strip() for part in value.split(",")]
            return [item for item in items if item]
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
            normalized = [str(item).strip() for item in value]
            return [item for item in normalized if item]
        return list(fallback or [])


class RuntimeSessionStore:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._sessions: dict[str, RuntimeSession] = {}

    def create(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> RuntimeSession:
        data = dict(payload or {})
        session = RuntimeSession(
            session_id=str(data.get("session_id") or f"rts-{uuid4().hex}"),
            request_id=str(data.get("request_id") or f"req-{uuid4().hex}"),
            actor_id=RuntimeSession._optional_str(data.get("actor_id")),
            agent_id=RuntimeSession._optional_str(data.get("agent_id")),
            execution_id=RuntimeSession._optional_str(data.get("execution_id")),
            policy_id=RuntimeSession._optional_str(data.get("policy_id")),
            sandbox_id=RuntimeSession._optional_str(data.get("sandbox_id")),
            risk_score=int(data.get("risk_score", 0) or 0),
            trust_score=int(data["trust_score"]) if data.get("trust_score") is not None else None,
            allowed_tools=RuntimeSession._normalize_str_list(data.get("allowed_tools")),
            blocked_tools=RuntimeSession._normalize_str_list(data.get("blocked_tools")),
            tags=RuntimeSession._normalize_str_list(data.get("tags")),
            metadata=dict(data.get("metadata") or {}),
        )
        session.add_event("created", "Runtime session created.")
        self._sessions[session.session_id] = session
        return session

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> RuntimeSession | None:
        return self._sessions.get(session_id)

    def require(self, session_id: str) -> RuntimeSession:
        session = self.get(session_id)
        if session is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Runtime session not found: {session_id}")
        return session

    def upsert_from_supervisor(
        self,
        payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        supervisor_decision: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> RuntimeSession:
        base = dict(payload or {})
        session_id = base.get("session_id")
        session = self.get(str(session_id)) if session_id else None

        if session is None:
            base["request_id"] = supervisor_decision.get("request_id") or base.get("request_id")
            session = self.create(base)

        session.merge_context(base)
        session.apply_supervisor_decision(supervisor_decision)
        self._sessions[session.session_id] = session
        return session

    def list(self) -> list[RuntimeSession]:
        return list(self._sessions.values())


class RuntimeSessionManager:
    def __init__(
        self,
        store: RuntimeSessionStore | None = None,
        *,
        sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.store = store or RuntimeSessionStore()
        self.sink = sink

    def start(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> RuntimeSession:
        session = self.store.create(payload)
        self._emit("runtime.session.started", session)
        return session

    def apply_supervisor_decision(
        self,
        payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        supervisor_decision: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> RuntimeSession:
        session = self.store.upsert_from_supervisor(payload, supervisor_decision)
        self._emit("runtime.session.updated", session)
        return session

    def complete(self, session_id: str, reason: str = "Runtime session completed.") -> RuntimeSession:
        session = self.store.require(session_id)
        session.complete(reason)
        self._emit("runtime.session.completed", session)
        return session

    def fail(self, session_id: str, reason: str = "Runtime session failed.") -> RuntimeSession:
        session = self.store.require(session_id)
        session.fail(reason)
        self._emit("runtime.session.failed", session)
        return session

    def get(self, session_id: str) -> RuntimeSession | None:
        return self.store.get(session_id)

    def list(self) -> list[RuntimeSession]:
        return self.store.list()

    def _emit(self, event_name: str, session: RuntimeSession) -> None:
        if self.sink is not None:
            self.sink(
                {
                    "event": event_name,
                    "session": session.to_dict(),
                    "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                }
            )


def create_runtime_session(payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> RuntimeSession:
    return RuntimeSessionManager().start(payload)


def create_runtime_session_dict(payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return create_runtime_session(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "RuntimeSession",
    "RuntimeSessionEvent",
    "RuntimeSessionManager",
    "RuntimeSessionStatus",
    "RuntimeSessionStore",
    "create_runtime_session",
    "create_runtime_session_dict",
]

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from orchestrator.policyenforcer import (
    EnforcementContext,
    EnforcementResult,
    PolicyEnforcer,
    build_policy_request,
)
from orchestrator.policyengine import PolicyRequest, PolicyTarget, PolicyVerdict


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RuntimeStep:
    name: str
    status: str
    message: str
    details: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    timestamp: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "status": self.status,
            "message": self.message,
            "details": dict(self.details),
            "timestamp": self.timestamp,
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RuntimeArtifact:
    artifact_id: str
    kind: str
    value: Any
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "artifact_id": self.artifact_id,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "value": self.value,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RuntimeExecutionResult:
    execution_id: str
    request_id: str
    status: str
    verdict: str
    allowed: bool
    enforcement: EnforcementResult
    steps: list[RuntimeStep] = field(default_factory=list)
    artifacts: list[RuntimeArtifact] = field(default_factory=list)
    telemetry: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    runtime_metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    started_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    completed_at: str | None = None

    def finalize(self) -> "RuntimeExecutionResult":
        self.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        return self

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "execution_id": self.execution_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "status": self.status,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "enforcement": self.enforcement.to_dict(),
            "steps": [step.to_dict() for step in self.steps],
            "artifacts": [artifact.to_dict() for artifact in self.artifacts],
            "telemetry": [dict(item) for item in self.telemetry],
            "runtime_metadata": dict(self.runtime_metadata),
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "completed_at": self.completed_at,
        }


class SecureRuntimePipeline:
    def __init__(
        self,
        policy_enforcer: PolicyEnforcer | None = None,
        *,
        network_guard: Callable[[PolicyRequest], Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
        filesystem_guard: Callable[[PolicyRequest], Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
        secrets_guard: Callable[[PolicyRequest], Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
        executor: Callable[[PolicyRequest], Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
        telemetry_sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.policy_enforcer = policy_enforcer or PolicyEnforcer()
        self.network_guard = network_guard
        self.filesystem_guard = filesystem_guard
        self.secrets_guard = secrets_guard
        self.executor = executor
        self.telemetry_sink = telemetry_sink

    def run(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> RuntimeExecutionResult:
        normalized_request = request if isinstance(request, PolicyRequest) else PolicyRequest.from_mapping(request)
        normalized_context = self._normalize_context(context, normalized_request)

        result = RuntimeExecutionResult(
            execution_id=f"run-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=normalized_context.request_id,
            status="initializing",
            verdict="unknown",
            allowed=False,
            enforcement=self.policy_enforcer.enforce(normalized_request, context=normalized_context),
            runtime_metadata={
                "target": normalized_request.target.value,
                "action": normalized_request.action,
                "risk_score": normalized_request.risk_score,
            },
        )

        result.verdict = result.enforcement.decision.verdict.value
        result.allowed = result.enforcement.decision.allowed

        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="policy_enforcement",
            status=result.enforcement.status,
            message="Policy enforcement completed.",
            details={
                "verdict": result.enforcement.decision.verdict.value,
                "matched_rules": result.enforcement.decision.matched_rules,
                "actions": result.enforcement.actions,
            },
        )

        if result.enforcement.blocked:
            result.status = "blocked"
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name="runtime_halt",
                status="blocked",
                message="Execution halted because the request was blocked.",
                details={"reason": "policy_block"},
            )
            self._emit_telemetry(result, event="runtime.blocked")
            return result.finalize()

        if result.enforcement.quarantine_required:
            result.status = "quarantined"
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name="runtime_quarantine",
                status="quarantined",
                message="Execution diverted into quarantine.",
                details={"reason": "policy_quarantine"},
            )
            self._emit_telemetry(result, event="runtime.quarantined")
            return result.finalize()

        if result.enforcement.review_required:
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name="human_review",
                status="pending",
                message="Execution requires human review before unrestricted completion.",
                details={"review_required": True},
            )

        self._run_pre_execution_guards(result, normalized_request)

        if result.status in {"blocked", "quarantined"}:
            self._emit_telemetry(result, event=f"runtime.{result.status}")
            return result.finalize()

        execution_payload = self._execute(normalized_request, result)

        artifact = RuntimeArtifact(
            artifact_id=f"art-{uuid4().hex}",
            kind="execution_result",
            value=execution_payload.get("result"),
            metadata={
                "executor_status": execution_payload.get("status", "completed"),
                "executor_message": execution_payload.get("message", "Execution finished."),
            },
        )
        result.artifacts.append(artifact)

        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="executor",
            status=execution_payload.get("status", "completed"),
            message=execution_payload.get("message", "Execution finished."),
            details={
                "has_result": "result" in execution_payload,
                "artifact_id": artifact.artifact_id,
            },
        )

        result.status = "completed_with_warnings" if result.enforcement.decision.verdict == PolicyVerdict.WARN else "completed"
        self._emit_telemetry(result, event="runtime.completed")
        return result.finalize()

    def run_dict(
        self,
        request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        *,
        context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.run(request, context=context).to_dict()

    def run_batch(
        self,
        requests: Iterable[PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None],
        *,
        context_factory: Callable[[int, PolicyRequest], EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None = None,
    ) -> list[RuntimeExecutionResult]:
        results: list[RuntimeExecutionResult] = []
        for index, item in enumerate(requests):
            normalized_request = item if isinstance(item, PolicyRequest) else PolicyRequest.from_mapping(item)
            context = context_factory(index, normalized_request) if context_factory else None
            results.append(self.run(normalized_request, context=context))
        return results

    def _normalize_context(
        self,
        context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        request: PolicyRequest,
    ) -> EnforcementContext:
        if isinstance(context, EnforcementContext):
            return context

        payload = dict(context or {})
        return EnforcementContext.create(
            request_id=payload.get("request_id"),
            source=payload.get("source") or request.source,
            actor_id=payload.get("actor_id") or request.actor_id,
            session_id=payload.get("session_id") or request.session_id,
            organization_id=payload.get("organization_id") or request.organization_id,
            trace_id=payload.get("trace_id"),
            metadata=payload.get("metadata") or {},
        )

    def _run_pre_execution_guards(self, result: RuntimeExecutionResult, request: PolicyRequest) -> None:
        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="preflight",
            status="running",
            message="Pre-execution runtime guards are evaluating the request.",
            details={},
        )

        if request.requires_network:
            guard_result = self._invoke_guard(self.network_guard, request, guard_name="network_guard")
            self._apply_guard_result(result, guard_result, default_name="network_guard")

        if request.requires_filesystem:
            guard_result = self._invoke_guard(self.filesystem_guard, request, guard_name="filesystem_guard")
            self._apply_guard_result(result, guard_result, default_name="filesystem_guard")

        if request.requires_secrets:
            guard_result = self._invoke_guard(self.secrets_guard, request, guard_name="secrets_guard")
            self._apply_guard_result(result, guard_result, default_name="secrets_guard")

        if result.status not in {"blocked", "quarantined"}:
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name="preflight_complete",
                status="passed",
                message="All configured runtime guards passed.",
                details={},
            )

    def _invoke_guard(
        self,
        guard: Callable[[PolicyRequest], Mapping[str, Any] | None] | None,
        request: PolicyRequest,
        *,
        guard_name: str,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if guard is None:
            return {
                "name": guard_name,
                "status": "passed",
                "message": f"{guard_name} passed using default pipeline behavior.",
                "action": "allow",
            }

        payload = guard(request) or {}
        return {
            "name": payload.get("name", guard_name),
            "status": payload.get("status", "passed"),
            "message": payload.get("message", f"{guard_name} completed."),
            "action": payload.get("action", "allow"),
            "details": dict(payload.get("details") or {}),
        }

    def _apply_guard_result(
        self,
        result: RuntimeExecutionResult,
        guard_result: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        default_name: str,
    ) -> None:
        name = str(guard_result.get("name") or default_name)
        status = str(guard_result.get("status") or "passed")
        message = str(guard_result.get("message") or f"{name} completed.")
        action = str(guard_result.get("action") or "allow")
        details = dict(guard_result.get("details") or {})
        details["guard_action"] = action

        self._record_step(result, name=name, status=status, message=message, details=details)

        if action == "block":
            result.status = "blocked"
            result.allowed = False
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name=f"{name}_halt",
                status="blocked",
                message=f"{name} blocked runtime execution.",
                details={"reason": action},
            )

        if action == "quarantine":
            result.status = "quarantined"
            result.allowed = False
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name=f"{name}_containment",
                status="quarantined",
                message=f"{name} quarantined runtime execution.",
                details={"reason": action},
            )

        if action == "warn" and result.status not in {"blocked", "quarantined"}:
            if result.status == "initializing":
                result.status = "warning"
            self._record_step(
                result,
                name=f"{name}_warning",
                status="warned",
                message=f"{name} raised a runtime warning.",
                details={"reason": action},
            )

    def _execute(self, request: PolicyRequest, result: RuntimeExecutionResult) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._record_step(
            result,
            name="execution_start",
            status="running",
            message="Runtime execution has started.",
            details={"action": request.action, "target": request.target.value},
        )

        if self.executor is None:
            return {
                "status": "completed",
                "message": "Default secure runtime execution completed.",
                "result": {
                    "action": request.action,
                    "target": request.target.value,
                    "attributes": dict(request.attributes),
                    "runtime_mode": "default",
                },
            }

        payload = self.executor(request) or {}
        return {
            "status": payload.get("status", "completed"),
            "message": payload.get("message", "Custom executor completed."),
            "result": payload.get(
                "result",
                {
                    "action": request.action,
                    "target": request.target.value,
                    "attributes": dict(request.attributes),
                    "runtime_mode": "custom",
                },
            ),
        }

    def _record_step(
        self,
        result: RuntimeExecutionResult,
        *,
        name: str,
        status: str,
        message: str,
        details: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        step = RuntimeStep(
            name=name,
            status=status,
            message=message,
            details=dict(details or {}),
        )
        result.steps.append(step)

    def _emit_telemetry(self, result: RuntimeExecutionResult, *, event: str) -> None:
        telemetry_event = {
            "event_id": f"tel-{uuid4().hex}",
            "event": event,
            "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "execution_id": result.execution_id,
            "request_id": result.request_id,
            "status": result.status,
            "verdict": result.verdict,
            "allowed": result.allowed,
            "step_count": len(result.steps),
            "artifact_count": len(result.artifacts),
        }
        result.telemetry.append(telemetry_event)
        if self.telemetry_sink is not None:
            self.telemetry_sink(telemetry_event)


def run_secure_runtime(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> RuntimeExecutionResult:
    active_pipeline = pipeline or SecureRuntimePipeline()
    return active_pipeline.run(request, context=context)


def run_secure_runtime_dict(
    request: PolicyRequest | Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    context: EnforcementContext | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    pipeline: SecureRuntimePipeline | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return run_secure_runtime(request, context=context, pipeline=pipeline).to_dict()


def build_runtime_request(
    *,
    target: PolicyTarget | str = PolicyTarget.RUNTIME,
    action: str = "execute",
    risk_score: int = 0,
    attributes: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    source: str | None = None,
    actor_id: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    organization_id: str | None = None,
    requires_network: bool = False,
    requires_filesystem: bool = False,
    requires_secrets: bool = False,
    requires_human_review: bool = False,
    fail_closed: bool = True,
) -> PolicyRequest:
    return build_policy_request(
        target=target,
        action=action,
        risk_score=risk_score,
        attributes=attributes,
        source=source,
        actor_id=actor_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        organization_id=organization_id,
        requires_network=requires_network,
        requires_filesystem=requires_filesystem,
        requires_secrets=requires_secrets,
        requires_human_review=requires_human_review,
        fail_closed=fail_closed,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from uuid import uuid4

from orchestrator.remediationgate import (
    GateDecision,
    GateStatus,
    RemediationAction,
    RemediationGate,
)
from orchestrator.reviewqueue import ReviewPriority, ReviewQueue


class SupervisorStatus(str, Enum):
    READY = "ready"
    APPROVED = "approved"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"
    QUARANTINED = "quarantined"
    NEEDS_REVIEW = "needs_review"
    CONDITIONAL = "conditional"
    FAILED = "failed"


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SupervisorEvent:
    event_id: str
    kind: str
    message: str
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "event_id": self.event_id,
            "kind": self.kind,
            "message": self.message,
            "created_at": self.created_at,
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SupervisorDecision:
    supervisor_id: str
    request_id: str
    status: SupervisorStatus
    allowed: bool
    action: str
    gate: dict[str, Any]
    review_id: str | None = None
    quarantine_required: bool = False
    sandbox_required: bool = False
    redaction_required: bool = False
    events: list[SupervisorEvent] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at: str = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat())

    def add_event(self, kind: str, message: str, metadata: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self.events.append(
            SupervisorEvent(
                event_id=f"evt-{uuid4().hex}",
                kind=kind,
                message=message,
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            )
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "supervisor_id": self.supervisor_id,
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "action": self.action,
            "gate": dict(self.gate),
            "review_id": self.review_id,
            "quarantine_required": self.quarantine_required,
            "sandbox_required": self.sandbox_required,
            "redaction_required": self.redaction_required,
            "events": [event.to_dict() for event in self.events],
            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
            "created_at": self.created_at,
        }


class Supervisor:
    def __init__(
        self,
        gate: RemediationGate | None = None,
        review_queue: ReviewQueue | None = None,
        *,
        sink: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.gate = gate or RemediationGate()
        self.review_queue = review_queue or ReviewQueue()
        self.sink = sink

    def supervise(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> SupervisorDecision:
        request = dict(payload or {})
        request_id = str(request.get("request_id") or f"req-{uuid4().hex}")

        gate_decision = self.gate.evaluate(request)
        decision = SupervisorDecision(
            supervisor_id=f"sup-{uuid4().hex}",
            request_id=request_id,
            status=SupervisorStatus.READY,
            allowed=True,
            action=gate_decision.action.value,
            gate=gate_decision.to_dict(),
            quarantine_required=gate_decision.quarantine_required,
            sandbox_required=gate_decision.sandbox_required,
            redaction_required=gate_decision.redaction_required,
            metadata={
                "risk_score": gate_decision.metadata.get("risk_score"),
                "verdict": gate_decision.metadata.get("verdict"),
            },
        )
        decision.add_event(
            "gate_evaluated",
            "Remediation gate evaluated request.",
            {"gate_status": gate_decision.status.value, "action": gate_decision.action.value},
        )

        self._apply_gate_outcome(decision, gate_decision, request)
        self._emit(decision)
        return decision

    def supervise_dict(self, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.supervise(payload).to_dict()

    def _apply_gate_outcome(
        self,
        decision: SupervisorDecision,
        gate_decision: GateDecision,
        request: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        if gate_decision.action == RemediationAction.BLOCK:
            decision.status = SupervisorStatus.BLOCKED
            decision.allowed = False
            decision.add_event(
                "blocked",
                "Supervisor blocked the request.",
                {"reasons": gate_decision.reasons},
            )
            return

        if gate_decision.action == RemediationAction.QUARANTINE:
            decision.status = SupervisorStatus.QUARANTINED
            decision.allowed = False
            decision.quarantine_required = True
            decision.add_event(
                "quarantined",
                "Supervisor quarantined the request.",
                {"reasons": gate_decision.reasons},
            )
            return

        if gate_decision.action == RemediationAction.REQUIRE_REVIEW or gate_decision.review_required:
            review_item = self.review_queue.create(
                request_id=decision.request_id,
                execution_id=str(request.get("execution_id")) if request.get("execution_id") else None,
                title=str(request.get("title") or "Security review required"),
                summary=str(request.get("summary") or "Supervisor routed request into review queue."),
                priority=self._review_priority_from_request(request, gate_decision),
                queue=str(request.get("review_queue") or "security"),
                created_by=str(request.get("actor_id") or "supervisor"),
                due_in_minutes=int(request.get("review_due_in_minutes", 60) or 60),
                escalate_in_minutes=int(request.get("review_escalate_in_minutes", 30) or 30),
                tags=request.get("tags") or [],
                metadata={
                    "source": "supervisor",
                    "gate_action": gate_decision.action.value,
                    "gate_status": gate_decision.status.value,
                },
            )
            decision.status = SupervisorStatus.NEEDS_REVIEW
            decision.allowed = False
            decision.review_id = review_item.review_id
            decision.add_event(
                "review_created",
                "Supervisor created a human review item.",
                {"review_id": review_item.review_id, "queue": review_item.queue},
            )
            return

        if gate_decision.action == RemediationAction.APPLY_REDACTION:
            decision.status = SupervisorStatus.CONDITIONAL
            decision.allowed = True
            decision.redaction_required = True
            if gate_decision.sandbox_required:
                decision.sandbox_required = True
            decision.add_event(
                "conditional_redaction",
                "Request allowed with mandatory redaction safeguards.",
                {
                    "sandbox_required": decision.sandbox_required,
                    "reasons": gate_decision.reasons,
                },
            )
            return

        if gate_decision.action == RemediationAction.SANDBOX_ONLY:
            decision.status = SupervisorStatus.CONDITIONAL
            decision.allowed = True
            decision.sandbox_required = True
            decision.add_event(
                "conditional_sandbox",
                "Request allowed only within sandbox boundaries.",
                {"reasons": gate_decision.reasons},
            )
            return

        decision.status = SupervisorStatus.APPROVED
        decision.allowed = True
        decision.add_event(
            "approved",
            "Supervisor approved the request without additional intervention.",
            {"reasons": gate_decision.reasons},
        )

    def _review_priority_from_request(
        self,
        request: Mapping[str, Any],
        gate_decision: GateDecision,
    ) -> ReviewPriority:
        explicit = request.get("review_priority")
        if explicit:
            return ReviewPriority(str(explicit).lower())

        risk_score = int(gate_decision.metadata.get("risk_score", 0) or 0)
        if gate_decision.quarantine_required or risk_score >= 90:
            return ReviewPriority.CRITICAL
        if risk_score >= 70:
            return ReviewPriority.HIGH
        if risk_score >= 40:
            return ReviewPriority.MEDIUM
        return ReviewPriority.LOW

    def _emit(self, decision: SupervisorDecision) -> None:
        if self.sink is not None:
            self.sink(
                {
                    "event": "supervisor.decision",
                    "decision": decision.to_dict(),
                    "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                }
            )


def supervise_request(payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> SupervisorDecision:
    return Supervisor().supervise(payload)


def supervise_request_dict(payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return supervise_request(payload).to_dict()


__all__ = [
    "Supervisor",
    "SupervisorDecision",
    "SupervisorEvent",
    "SupervisorStatus",
    "supervise_request",
    "supervise_request_dict",
]

FILE: README.md

# IronClaw-Security

IronClaw-Security is a local-first AI security system focused on one job in v1: install into Claude Code and OpenClaw with a single setup flow, intercept inbound agent returns before they reach the user workflow, isolate them in a sandbox, verify them with the AI brain plus policy system, and then allow, warn, quarantine, or block the result.

This README is intentionally narrowed to the locked v1 mission. It does not describe every legacy route or every broad platform surface in the repo. It describes the shipping path we are building now.

## V1 mission

- One-command install.
- Claude Code integration.
- OpenClaw integration.
- Intercept inbound agent returns.
- Route inbound returns into sandbox isolation.
- Verify with AI brain plus policy engine.
- Return one final verdict:
  - `allow`
  - `warn`
  - `quarantine`
  - `block`

## What IronClaw-Security protects

IronClaw-Security v1 is designed to act as a front-line defender for agentic AI platforms.

Primary protection scope in this version:

- Agent-returned text.
- Agent-returned files.
- Tool output returned toward the user workflow.
- Risky command or execution payloads discovered during guarded evaluation.
- Suspicious fetched or transformed content that should not be released directly to the user environment.

## Core v1 flow

1. User installs IronClaw-Security.
2. IronClaw-Security connects to Claude Code or OpenClaw.
3. Inbound agent output is intercepted before release.
4. The artifact is normalized and routed into the guarded runtime path.
5. The artifact is isolated in the sandbox.
6. The AI brain and policy layer evaluate the artifact.
7. IronClaw-Security returns a final verdict.
8. Safe content is released, unsafe content is warned, quarantined, or blocked.

## Current product shape

This repo is being narrowed around the following v1 path:

- `app/main.py` â€” main FastAPI app entrypoint and router mounting.
- `ironclaw_installer.py` â€” install/bootstrap entrypoint.
- `service.py` â€” local service lifecycle entrypoint.
- `scripts/ironclaw_service_windows.ps1` â€” Windows service wrapper/start path.
- `ironclaw_skill/config.py` â€” skill/config resolution for integration wiring.
- `ironclaw_skill/context.py` â€” integration context resolution.
- `app/adapters/claude_code_adapter.py` â€” Claude Code adapter.
- `app/adapters/openclaw_adapter.py` â€” OpenClaw adapter.
- `app/runtime/filereturnguard.py` â€” file-return interception and control.
- `app/runtime/toolcallguard.py` â€” guarded tool-call evaluation.
- `app/runtime/sandboxrouter.py` â€” sandbox routing.
- `app/runtime/commandsupervisor.py` â€” command supervision.
- `app/runtime/networkguard.py` â€” network boundary checks.
- `cli_brain.py` â€” AI brain entry layer.
- `app/services/groq_security_brain.py` â€” Groq-backed security reasoning.
- `app/services/policy.py` â€” policy evaluation layer.
- `app/services/verdict_enforcer.py` â€” final verdict execution.
- `app/services/runtime_ingress.py` â€” canonical inbound runtime intake if needed.
- `app/models/runtime_artifact.py` â€” normalized runtime artifact contract if needed.
- `app/models/runtime_verdict.py` â€” normalized verdict contract if needed.

## Supported verdicts

IronClaw-Security uses these verdict states in v1:

- `allow`
- `warn`
- `quarantine`
- `block`

General intent:

- `allow` â€” content may continue through the protected flow.
- `warn` â€” content is risky and should surface caution in the protected flow.
- `quarantine` â€” content is isolated and not released by default.
- `block` â€” content is denied from release or execution.

## Windows service path

For the local machine protection flow, the main Windows-oriented service files are:

- `ironclaw_installer.py`
- `service.py`
- `scripts/ironclaw_service_windows.ps1`

These are part of the one-command install and persistent local protection path.

## Minimal API intent for v1

The app is being shaped around a small protected runtime surface, not a giant public platform surface.

Expected v1 focus areas:

- System health and status routes.
- Claude Code and OpenClaw integration bootstrap routes.
- Guard and action execution routes.
- Sandbox verification flow.
- Policy evaluation routes.
- Incident and quarantine routes needed to support protected decisions.

If a route does not directly support install, integration, interception, sandbox verification, verdicting, or minimal protected status visibility, it is not part of the core v1 shipping path.

## Example mission summary

IronClaw-Security receives inbound agent output, evaluates it inside a guarded runtime path, applies AI-assisted reasoning plus policy enforcement, and returns a controlled release decision.

## Development method

Current build workflow for this repo:

1. Update one page at a time.
2. Replace the full page when needed.
3. Run:

```powershell
py -m pytest -q
```

4. Fix the next failing or incomplete page.
5. Repeat until the v1 mission path is complete.

## Notes

- Keep the public story centered on the locked v1 mission.
- Keep route documentation aligned with the actual mounted routers in `app/main.py`.
- Do not document broad legacy surfaces as if they are part of the release path.
- Prefer narrow, testable, shipping-safe contracts while IronClaw-Security v1 is being completed.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from threading import Lock
from typing import Final

from app.schemas.release_policy import ReleaseChannel, ReleasePolicyDetail


ROOT: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_STORE_FILE: Final[Path] = ROOT / ".release-policy-catalog.json"


class ReleasePolicyRepository:
    def __init__(self, store_file: Path = DEFAULT_STORE_FILE) -> None:
        self._store_file = store_file
        self._lock = Lock()

    def _ensure_parent_dir(self) -> None:
        self._store_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _load_payload(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        if not self._store_file.exists():
            return {"policies": {}}

        raw = self._store_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        if not raw:
            return {"policies": {}}

        payload = json.loads(raw)
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ValueError("release policy repository payload must be a JSON object")

        policies = payload.get("policies")
        if policies is None:
            payload["policies"] = {}
            return payload

        if not isinstance(policies, dict):
            raise ValueError("release policy repository 'policies' must be a JSON object")

        return payload

    def _write_payload(self, payload: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        self._ensure_parent_dir()
        self._store_file.write_text(
            json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

    def list_policies(self) -> list[ReleasePolicyDetail]:
        with self._lock:
            payload = self._load_payload()
            raw_policies = payload.get("policies", {})

            if not isinstance(raw_policies, dict):
                raise ValueError("release policy repository 'policies' must be a JSON object")

            items = [
                ReleasePolicyDetail.model_validate(item)
                for _, item in sorted(raw_policies.items(), key=lambda entry: entry[0])
            ]

        return items

    def get_policy(self, channel: ReleaseChannel) -> ReleasePolicyDetail | None:
        with self._lock:
            payload = self._load_payload()
            raw_policies = payload.get("policies", {})

            if not isinstance(raw_policies, dict):
                raise ValueError("release policy repository 'policies' must be a JSON object")

            item = raw_policies.get(channel)
            if item is None:
                return None

            return ReleasePolicyDetail.model_validate(item)

    def upsert_policy(self, policy: ReleasePolicyDetail) -> ReleasePolicyDetail:
        with self._lock:
            payload = self._load_payload()
            raw_policies = payload.get("policies", {})

            if not isinstance(raw_policies, dict):
                raise ValueError("release policy repository 'policies' must be a JSON object")

            raw_policies[policy.channel] = policy.model_dump(mode="json")
            payload["policies"] = raw_policies
            self._write_payload(payload)

        return policy

    def delete_policy(self, channel: ReleaseChannel) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            payload = self._load_payload()
            raw_policies = payload.get("policies", {})

            if not isinstance(raw_policies, dict):
                raise ValueError("release policy repository 'policies' must be a JSON object")

            existed = channel in raw_policies
            if existed:
                del raw_policies[channel]
                payload["policies"] = raw_policies
                self._write_payload(payload)

        return existed

    @property
    def store_file(self) -> Path:
        return self._store_file


release_policy_repository = ReleasePolicyRepository()

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from review.reviewqueueservice import ReviewPriority, ReviewQueueItem, ReviewQueueService


class IncidentStatus(str):
    OPEN = "open"
    TRIAGED = "triaged"
    RESOLVED = "resolved"
    DISMISSED = "dismissed"


class IncidentSeverity(str):
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"


class IncidentRecord(BaseModel):
    incident_id: str = Field(..., description="Stable incident identifier")
    title: str = Field(..., description="Human-readable incident title")
    summary: str = Field(..., description="Short incident summary")
    severity: str = Field(..., description="Severity level")
    status: str = Field(default=IncidentStatus.OPEN, description="Incident lifecycle state")
    source: str = Field(..., description="Origin of the incident")
    source_id: str = Field(..., description="Source entity identifier")
    reasons: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Why the incident was opened")
    evidence: List[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="Compact evidence payloads for triage",
    )
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Additional orchestration metadata",
    )
    review_id: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Linked review queue item when human review is required",
    )
    assigned_to: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Assigned analyst or responder",
    )
    created_at: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO-8601 creation timestamp")
    updated_at: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO-8601 update timestamp")
    resolved_at: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="UTC ISO-8601 resolution timestamp",
    )


class IncidentService:
    """
    In-memory incident manager with optional review queue escalation.

    Goals:
    - Deterministic lifecycle handling for orchestration/tests.
    - Deduplicate incidents by (source, source_id).
    - Seamlessly create/update linked review queue items.
    - Easy future replacement with a persistent store.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        review_queue_service: Optional[ReviewQueueService] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._incidents: Dict[str, IncidentRecord] = {}
        self._index_by_source: Dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
        self._counter = 1
        self._review_queue_service = review_queue_service

    def list_incidents(
        self,
        *,
        status: Optional[str] = None,
        severity: Optional[str] = None,
        assigned_to: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[IncidentRecord]:
        incidents = list(self._incidents.values())

        if status is not None:
            incidents = [incident for incident in incidents if incident.status == status]

        if severity is not None:
            incidents = [incident for incident in incidents if incident.severity == severity]

        if assigned_to is not None:
            incidents = [
                incident for incident in incidents if incident.assigned_to == assigned_to
            ]

        return sorted(incidents, key=self._sort_key)

    def get_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> Optional[IncidentRecord]:
        return self._incidents.get(incident_id)

    def open_incident(
        self,
        *,
        title: str,
        summary: str,
        severity: str,
        source: str,
        source_id: str,
        reasons: Optional[List[str]] = None,
        evidence: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        escalate_for_review: bool = True,
    ) -> IncidentRecord:
        with self._lock:
            key = (source, source_id)
            existing_id = self._index_by_source.get(key)
            if existing_id:
                return self._update_existing(
                    incident_id=existing_id,
                    title=title,
                    summary=summary,
                    severity=severity,
                    reasons=reasons or [],
                    evidence=evidence or [],
                    metadata=metadata or {},
                    escalate_for_review=escalate_for_review,
                )

            now = self._utcnow()
            incident_id = self._next_incident_id()
            incident = IncidentRecord(
                incident_id=incident_id,
                title=title,
                summary=summary,
                severity=self._coerce_severity(severity),
                status=IncidentStatus.OPEN,
                source=source,
                source_id=source_id,
                reasons=self._dedupe_strings(reasons or []),
                evidence=self._dedupe_evidence(evidence or []),
                metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
                created_at=now,
                updated_at=now,
            )

            if escalate_for_review and self._review_queue_service is not None:
                review_item = self._review_queue_service.escalate_incident(
                    incident_id=incident_id,
                    priority=self._severity_to_priority(incident.severity),
                    title=title,
                    summary=summary,
                    reasons=incident.reasons,
                    evidence=incident.evidence,
                )
                incident = incident.model_copy(update={"review_id": review_item.review_id})

            self._incidents[incident_id] = incident
            self._index_by_source[key] = incident_id
            return incident

    def assign_incident(self, incident_id: str, owner: str) -> IncidentRecord:
        with self._lock:
            incident = self._require(incident_id)
            updated = incident.model_copy(
                update={
                    "assigned_to": owner,
                    "status": IncidentStatus.TRIAGED,
                    "updated_at": self._utcnow(),
                }
            )
            self._incidents[incident_id] = updated
            return updated

    def resolve_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord:
        with self._lock:
            incident = self._require(incident_id)
            updated = incident.model_copy(
                update={
                    "status": IncidentStatus.RESOLVED,
                    "updated_at": self._utcnow(),
                    "resolved_at": self._utcnow(),
                }
            )
            self._incidents[incident_id] = updated

            if updated.review_id and self._review_queue_service is not None:
                review_item = self._review_queue_service.get(updated.review_id)
                if review_item and review_item.status not in {"completed", "dismissed"}:
                    self._review_queue_service.complete(updated.review_id)

            return updated

    def dismiss_incident(self, incident_id: str, reason: Optional[str] = None) -> IncidentRecord:
        with self._lock:
            incident = self._require(incident_id)
            reasons = list(incident.reasons)
            if reason:
                reasons = self._dedupe_strings([*reasons, reason])

            updated = incident.model_copy(
                update={
                    "status": IncidentStatus.DISMISSED,
                    "reasons": reasons,
                    "updated_at": self._utcnow(),
                    "resolved_at": self._utcnow(),
                }
            )
            self._incidents[incident_id] = updated

            if updated.review_id and self._review_queue_service is not None:
                review_item = self._review_queue_service.get(updated.review_id)
                if review_item and review_item.status not in {"completed", "dismissed"}:
                    self._review_queue_service.dismiss(updated.review_id, reason=reason)

            return updated

    def reopen_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord:
        with self._lock:
            incident = self._require(incident_id)
            updated = incident.model_copy(
                update={
                    "status": IncidentStatus.OPEN,
                    "updated_at": self._utcnow(),
                    "resolved_at": None,
                }
            )
            self._incidents[incident_id] = updated

            if updated.review_id and self._review_queue_service is not None:
                review_item = self._review_queue_service.get(updated.review_id)
                if review_item and review_item.status in {"completed", "dismissed"}:
                    self._review_queue_service.reopen(updated.review_id)

            return updated

    def counts(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        counts = {
            IncidentStatus.OPEN: 0,
            IncidentStatus.TRIAGED: 0,
            IncidentStatus.RESOLVED: 0,
            IncidentStatus.DISMISSED: 0,
        }
        for incident in self._incidents.values():
            counts[incident.status] = counts.get(incident.status, 0) + 1
        return counts

    def _update_existing(
        self,
        *,
        incident_id: str,
        title: str,
        summary: str,
        severity: str,
        reasons: List[str],
        evidence: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        metadata: Dict[str, Any],
        escalate_for_review: bool,
    ) -> IncidentRecord:
        incident = self._require(incident_id)
        updated = incident.model_copy(
            update={
                "title": title or incident.title,
                "summary": summary or incident.summary,
                "severity": self._max_severity(incident.severity, self._coerce_severity(severity)),
                "status": IncidentStatus.OPEN
                if incident.status in {IncidentStatus.DISMISSED, IncidentStatus.RESOLVED}
                else incident.status,
                "reasons": self._dedupe_strings([*incident.reasons, *reasons]),
                "evidence": self._dedupe_evidence([*incident.evidence, *evidence]),
                "metadata": {**incident.metadata, **metadata},
                "updated_at": self._utcnow(),
                "resolved_at": None
                if incident.status in {IncidentStatus.DISMISSED, IncidentStatus.RESOLVED}
                else incident.resolved_at,
            }
        )

        if escalate_for_review and self._review_queue_service is not None:
            review_item = self._review_queue_service.escalate_incident(
                incident_id=incident_id,
                priority=self._severity_to_priority(updated.severity),
                title=updated.title,
                summary=updated.summary,
                reasons=updated.reasons,
                evidence=updated.evidence,
            )
            updated = updated.model_copy(update={"review_id": review_item.review_id})

        self._incidents[incident_id] = updated
        return updated

    def _require(self, incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord:
        incident = self._incidents.get(incident_id)
        if incident is None:
            raise KeyError(f"incident not found: {incident_id}")
        return incident

    def _next_incident_id(self) -> str:
        incident_id = f"inc_{self._counter:05d}"
        self._counter += 1
        return incident_id

    def _coerce_severity(self, severity: str) -> str:
        normalized = (severity or IncidentSeverity.MEDIUM).strip().lower()
        if normalized in {
            IncidentSeverity.LOW,
            IncidentSeverity.MEDIUM,
            IncidentSeverity.HIGH,
            IncidentSeverity.CRITICAL,
        }:
            return normalized
        return IncidentSeverity.MEDIUM

    def _max_severity(self, left: str, right: str) -> str:
        rank = {
            IncidentSeverity.LOW: 0,
            IncidentSeverity.MEDIUM: 1,
            IncidentSeverity.HIGH: 2,
            IncidentSeverity.CRITICAL: 3,
        }
        return left if rank[left] >= rank[right] else right

    def _severity_to_priority(self, severity: str) -> str:
        mapping = {
            IncidentSeverity.LOW: ReviewPriority.LOW.value,
            IncidentSeverity.MEDIUM: ReviewPriority.MEDIUM.value,
            IncidentSeverity.HIGH: ReviewPriority.HIGH.value,
            IncidentSeverity.CRITICAL: ReviewPriority.CRITICAL.value,
        }
        return mapping.get(severity, ReviewPriority.MEDIUM.value)

    def _dedupe_strings(self, values: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        seen = set()
        result: List[str] = []
        for value in values:
            if not value or value in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(value)
            result.append(value)
        return result

    def _dedupe_evidence(self, values: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        seen = set()
        result: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        for value in values:
            frozen = self._freeze(value)
            if frozen in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(frozen)
            result.append(value)
        return result

    def _freeze(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return tuple(sorted((k, self._freeze(v)) for k, v in value.items()))
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return tuple(self._freeze(v) for v in value)
        if isinstance(value, set):
            return tuple(sorted(self._freeze(v) for v in value))
        return value

    def _sort_key(self, incident: IncidentRecord) -> tuple[int, int, str]:
        status_rank = {
            IncidentStatus.OPEN: 0,
            IncidentStatus.TRIAGED: 1,
            IncidentStatus.RESOLVED: 2,
            IncidentStatus.DISMISSED: 3,
        }
        severity_rank = {
            IncidentSeverity.CRITICAL: 0,
            IncidentSeverity.HIGH: 1,
            IncidentSeverity.MEDIUM: 2,
            IncidentSeverity.LOW: 3,
        }
        return (
            status_rank.get(incident.status, 99),
            severity_rank.get(incident.severity, 99),
            incident.created_at,
        )

    def _utcnow(self) -> str:
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

from __future__ import annotations

from threading import Lock
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from review.policyevaluator import PolicyOverride


class PolicyOverrideService:
    """
    In-memory override registry for policy evaluation flows.

    Goals:
    - Deterministic behavior for tests and orchestration.
    - Simple CRUD-style interface for override management.
    - Fast applicability lookup for a payload.
    - Drop-in replaceable with a persistent store later.
    """

    def __init__(self, overrides: Optional[List[PolicyOverride]] = None) -> None:
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._overrides: Dict[str, PolicyOverride] = {}
        if overrides:
            for override in overrides:
                self._overrides[override.override_id] = override

    def add_override(self, override: PolicyOverride) -> PolicyOverride:
        with self._lock:
            if override.override_id in self._overrides:
                raise ValueError(f"override already exists: {override.override_id}")
            self._overrides[override.override_id] = override
            return override

    def upsert_override(self, override: PolicyOverride) -> PolicyOverride:
        with self._lock:
            self._overrides[override.override_id] = override
            return override

    def get_override(self, override_id: str) -> Optional[PolicyOverride]:
        return self._overrides.get(override_id)

    def list_overrides(
        self,
        *,
        enabled_only: bool = False,
        target_field: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> List[PolicyOverride]:
        overrides = list(self._overrides.values())

        if enabled_only:
            overrides = [override for override in overrides if override.enabled]

        if target_field is not None:
            overrides = [
                override
                for override in overrides
                if override.target_field == target_field
            ]

        return sorted(overrides, key=self._sort_key)

    def delete_override(self, override_id: str) -> PolicyOverride:
        with self._lock:
            override = self._require(override_id)
            del self._overrides[override_id]
            return override

    def set_enabled(self, override_id: str, enabled: bool) -> PolicyOverride:
        with self._lock:
            override = self._require(override_id)
            updated = PolicyOverride(
                override_id=override.override_id,
                target_field=override.target_field,
                target_value=override.target_value,
                force_decision=override.force_decision,
                add_reasons=list(override.add_reasons),
                metadata=dict(override.metadata),
                enabled=enabled,
            )
            self._overrides[override_id] = updated
            return updated

    def find_applicable(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[PolicyOverride]:
        applicable: List[PolicyOverride] = []
        for override in self.list_overrides(enabled_only=True):
            if self._matches(override, payload):
                applicable.append(override)
        return applicable

    def count(self, *, enabled_only: bool = False) -> int:
        return len(self.list_overrides(enabled_only=enabled_only))

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._overrides.clear()

    def _matches(self, override: PolicyOverride, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        if override.target_field is None:
            return True

        if override.target_field not in payload:
            return False

        actual = payload.get(override.target_field)

        if override.target_value is None:
            return True

        if isinstance(actual, list):
            return override.target_value in actual

        if isinstance(actual, set):
            return override.target_value in actual

        if isinstance(actual, tuple):
            return override.target_value in actual

        return actual == override.target_value

    def _require(self, override_id: str) -> PolicyOverride:
        override = self._overrides.get(override_id)
        if override is None:
            raise KeyError(f"override not found: {override_id}")
        return override

    def _sort_key(self, override: PolicyOverride) -> tuple[int, str, str]:
        return (
            0 if override.enabled else 1,
            override.target_field or "",
            override.override_id,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from review.incidentservice import IncidentRecord, IncidentService
from review.reviewqueueservice import ReviewQueueService

router = APIRouter(prefix="/incidents", tags=["incidents"])

_review_queue_service = ReviewQueueService()
_incident_service = IncidentService(review_queue_service=_review_queue_service)


class IncidentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Human-readable incident title")
    summary: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Short incident summary")
    severity: str = Field(default="medium", description="Incident severity")
    source: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Origin system or detector")
    source_id: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Stable source entity identifier")
    reasons: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Why the incident opened")
    evidence: List[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="Compact evidence payloads for triage",
    )
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Additional incident metadata",
    )
    escalate_for_review: bool = Field(
        default=True,
        description="Whether to create or update a linked review queue item",
    )


class IncidentAssignRequest(BaseModel):
    assigned_to: str = Field(..., min_length=1, description="Responder or analyst owner")


class IncidentDismissRequest(BaseModel):
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Dismissal reason")


class IncidentListResponse(BaseModel):
    items: List[IncidentRecord]
    counts: Dict[str, int]


def get_incident_service() -> IncidentService:
    return _incident_service


@router.get("", response_model=IncidentListResponse)
def list_incidents(
    status: Optional[str] = None,
    severity: Optional[str] = None,
    assigned_to: Optional[str] = None,
) -> IncidentListResponse:
    service = get_incident_service()
    items = service.list_incidents(
        status=status,
        severity=severity,
        assigned_to=assigned_to,
    )
    return IncidentListResponse(items=items, counts=service.counts())


@router.get("/{incident_id}", response_model=IncidentRecord)
def get_incident(incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord:
    incident = get_incident_service().get_incident(incident_id)
    if incident is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"incident not found: {incident_id}")
    return incident


@router.post("", response_model=IncidentRecord, status_code=201)
def create_incident(payload: IncidentCreateRequest) -> IncidentRecord:
    return get_incident_service().open_incident(
        title=payload.title,
        summary=payload.summary,
        severity=payload.severity,
        source=payload.source,
        source_id=payload.source_id,
        reasons=payload.reasons,
        evidence=payload.evidence,
        metadata=payload.metadata,
        escalate_for_review=payload.escalate_for_review,
    )


@router.post("/{incident_id}/assign", response_model=IncidentRecord)
def assign_incident(incident_id: str, payload: IncidentAssignRequest) -> IncidentRecord:
    service = get_incident_service()
    try:
        return service.assign_incident(incident_id, payload.assigned_to)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{incident_id}/resolve", response_model=IncidentRecord)
def resolve_incident(incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord:
    service = get_incident_service()
    try:
        return service.resolve_incident(incident_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{incident_id}/dismiss", response_model=IncidentRecord)
def dismiss_incident(
    incident_id: str,
    payload: IncidentDismissRequest,
) -> IncidentRecord:
    service = get_incident_service()
    try:
        return service.dismiss_incident(incident_id, reason=payload.reason)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{incident_id}/reopen", response_model=IncidentRecord)
def reopen_incident(incident_id: str) -> IncidentRecord:
    service = get_incident_service()
    try:
        return service.reopen_incident(incident_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    if item is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="no pending review items available")
    return item


@router.post("/{review_id}/assign", response_model=ReviewQueueItem)
def assign_review_item(review_id: str, payload: AssignReviewRequest) -> ReviewQueueItem:
    service = get_review_queue_service()
    try:
        return service.assign(review_id, payload.reviewer_id)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc
