from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final


ROOT: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RESULT_FILE: Final[Path] = ROOT / ".security-quality-gate.json"
APP_DIR: Final[Path] = ROOT / "app"
TESTS_DIR: Final[Path] = ROOT / "tests"
REQUIREMENTS_FILE: Final[Path] = ROOT / "requirements.txt"

MIN_COVERAGE_DEFAULT: Final[int] = 80


@dataclass(slots=True)
class GateCheckResult:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: str

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _env_int(name: str, default: int) -> int:
    value = os.environ.get(name)
    if value is None:
        return default
    try:
        parsed = int(value.strip())
    except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return default
    return parsed


def _record(results: list[GateCheckResult], name: str, ok: bool, detail: str) -> None:
    entry = GateCheckResult(name=name, ok=ok, detail=detail)
    results.append(entry)
    label = "OK" if ok else "FAIL"
    print(f"[{label}] {name}: {detail}")


def _trim_output(stdout: str, stderr: str, fallback: str) -> str:
    detail = (stdout + "\n" + stderr).strip()
    if not detail:
        return fallback
    return detail[-1200:]


def _run(cmd: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
        env=os.environ.copy(),
    )


def _tool_exists(name: str) -> bool:
    return shutil.which(name) is not None


def _check_project_surface(results: list[GateCheckResult]) -> None:
    required = [APP_DIR, TESTS_DIR, REQUIREMENTS_FILE]
    missing = [str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) for path in required if not path.exists()]
    if missing:
        _record(results, "project-surface", False, f"missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
        return
    _record(results, "project-surface", True, "app, tests, and requirements are present")


def _check_pytest(results: list[GateCheckResult]) -> None:
    completed = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q"])
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "pytest", True, "test suite passed")
        return

    _record(
        results,
        "pytest",
        False,
        _trim_output(completed.stdout, completed.stderr, "pytest failed"),
    )


def _check_coverage(results: list[GateCheckResult], min_coverage: int) -> None:
    completed = _run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "pytest",
            "--cov=app",
            f"--cov-fail-under={min_coverage}",
            "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered",
            "-q",
        ]
    )
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "coverage", True, f"coverage meets fail-under {min_coverage}%")
        return

    _record(
        results,
        "coverage",
        False,
        _trim_output(completed.stdout, completed.stderr, "coverage gate failed"),
    )


def _check_bandit(results: list[GateCheckResult]) -> None:
    if _tool_exists("bandit"):
        cmd = ["bandit", "-q", "-r", "app"]
    else:
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "bandit", "-q", "-r", "app"]

    completed = _run(cmd)
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "bandit", True, "no Bandit issues detected at current threshold")
        return

    if "No module named bandit" in completed.stderr:
        _record(results, "bandit", False, "bandit is not installed")
        return

    _record(
        results,
        "bandit",
        False,
        _trim_output(completed.stdout, completed.stderr, "bandit reported security findings"),
    )


def _check_pip_audit(results: list[GateCheckResult]) -> None:
    if _tool_exists("pip-audit"):
        cmd = ["pip-audit", "-r", str(REQUIREMENTS_FILE), "--strict"]
    else:
        cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "pip_audit", "-r", str(REQUIREMENTS_FILE), "--strict"]

    completed = _run(cmd)
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "pip-audit", True, "no known dependency vulnerabilities found")
        return

    if "No module named pip_audit" in completed.stderr:
        _record(results, "pip-audit", False, "pip-audit is not installed")
        return

    _record(
        results,
        "pip-audit",
        False,
        _trim_output(completed.stdout, completed.stderr, "pip-audit found vulnerabilities"),
    )


def _write_result(results: list[GateCheckResult], ok: bool, min_coverage: int) -> None:
    RESULT_FILE.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "status": "ok" if ok else "fail",
                "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "minimum_coverage": min_coverage,
                "checks": [item.to_dict() for item in results],
            },
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
    _ = argv
    min_coverage = _env_int("IRONCLAW_MIN_COVERAGE", MIN_COVERAGE_DEFAULT)

    results: list[GateCheckResult] = []

    _check_project_surface(results)
    _check_pytest(results)
    _check_coverage(results, min_coverage)
    _check_bandit(results)
    _check_pip_audit(results)

    ok = all(item.ok for item in results)
    _write_result(results, ok, min_coverage)

    print("SECURITY QUALITY GATE: OK" if ok else "SECURITY QUALITY GATE: FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RESULT_FILE = ROOT / ".smoke-test-results.json"
client = TestClient(app)


def _record(
    results: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    name: str,
    ok: bool,
    detail: str,
    status_code: int | None = None,
) -> None:
    results.append(
        {
            "name": name,
            "ok": ok,
            "detail": detail,
            "status_code": status_code,
        }
    )
    label = "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"
    suffix = f" (status={status_code})" if status_code is not None else ""
    print(f"[{label}] {name}{suffix}: {detail}")


def _get_json(path: str) -> tuple[int, str, Any]:
    response = client.get(path)
    content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "")
    body: Any
    if content_type.startswith("application/json"):
        body = response.json()
    else:
        body = response.text
    return response.status_code, content_type, body


def _smoke_health(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    candidates = ["/health", "/healthz", "/api/health", "/api/healthz"]
    for path in candidates:
        status_code, content_type, body = _get_json(path)
        if status_code == 200:
            if content_type.startswith("application/json") and isinstance(body, dict):
                _record(
                    results,
                    name="health-endpoint",
                    ok=True,
                    detail=f"{path} responded with JSON",
                    status_code=status_code,
                )
                return
            _record(
                results,
                name="health-endpoint",
                ok=True,
                detail=f"{path} responded successfully",
                status_code=status_code,
            )
            return
    _record(
        results,
        name="health-endpoint",
        ok=False,
        detail="no supported health endpoint returned 200",
    )


def _smoke_openapi(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    status_code, content_type, body = _get_json("/openapi.json")
    ok = (
        status_code == 200
        and content_type.startswith("application/json")
        and isinstance(body, dict)
        and "paths" in body
    )
    _record(
        results,
        name="openapi",
        ok=ok,
        detail="OpenAPI document is available" if ok else "OpenAPI document missing or invalid",
        status_code=status_code,
    )


def _smoke_docs(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    response = client.get("/docs")
    ok = response.status_code == 200 and "text/html" in response.headers.get("content-type", "")
    _record(
        results,
        name="docs-ui",
        ok=ok,
        detail="Swagger UI responded" if ok else "Swagger UI unavailable",
        status_code=response.status_code,
    )


def _smoke_key_api(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    candidates = [
        "/system",
        "/api/system",
        "/telemetry/access",
        "/admin/organizations",
        "/ui/pages",
        "/status",
    ]
    for path in candidates:
        status_code, content_type, body = _get_json(path)
        if status_code == 200:
            if content_type.startswith("application/json") and isinstance(body, dict):
                _record(
                    results,
                    name="key-api",
                    ok=True,
                    detail=f"{path} returned JSON object",
                    status_code=status_code,
                )
                return
            if isinstance(body, list):
                _record(
                    results,
                    name="key-api",
                    ok=True,
                    detail=f"{path} returned JSON list",
                    status_code=status_code,
                )
                return
    _record(
        results,
        name="key-api",
        ok=False,
        detail="no candidate key API endpoint returned 200",
    )


def _smoke_basic_ui(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    candidates = ["/", "/ui", "/ui/pages", "/runtime-status", "/status"]
    for path in candidates:
        response = client.get(path)
        content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "")
        if response.status_code == 200:
            if "text/html" in content_type:
                _record(
                    results,
                    name="basic-ui",
                    ok=True,
                    detail=f"{path} returned HTML",
                    status_code=response.status_code,
                )
                return
            if content_type.startswith("application/json"):
                payload = response.json()
                if isinstance(payload, dict):
                    _record(
                        results,
                        name="basic-ui",
                        ok=True,
                        detail=f"{path} returned JSON-backed UI surface",
                        status_code=response.status_code,
                    )
                    return
    _record(
        results,
        name="basic-ui",
        ok=False,
        detail="no candidate UI route returned a usable response",
    )


def _write_results(results: list[dict[str, Any]], ok: bool) -> None:
    RESULT_FILE.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "status": "ok" if ok else "fail",
                "checks": results,
            },
            indent=2,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def main() -> None:
    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    _smoke_health(results)
    _smoke_openapi(results)
    _smoke_docs(results)
    _smoke_key_api(results)
    _smoke_basic_ui(results)

    ok = all(item["ok"] for item in results)
    _write_results(results, ok)

    print("SMOKE TEST STATUS: PASS" if ok else "SMOKE TEST STATUS: FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

================================================================================

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final

import httpx


REPO_ROOT: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RESULT_FILE: Final[Path] = REPO_ROOT / ".smoketest-results.json"

DEFAULT_BASE_URL: Final[str] = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"

HEALTH_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/health"
PROBES_LIVENESS_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/health/liveness"
PROBES_READINESS_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/health/readiness"
SYSTEM_STATUS_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/system/status"

UI_MANIFEST_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/ui/manifest"
UI_STATUS_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/ui/status/runtime"
UI_RUNTIME_STATUS_ENDPOINT: Final[str] = "/api/ui/runtime/status"

TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final[float] = 5.0


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SmokeCheck:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    status_code: int | None
    detail: str
    duration_ms: int

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SmokeTestReport:
    base_url: str
    overall_status: str
    checks: tuple[SmokeCheck, ...]
    total_duration_ms: int

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "base_url": self.base_url,
            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
            "total_duration_ms": self.total_duration_ms,
            "checks": [check.to_dict() for check in self.checks],
        }


def _env_base_url() -> str:
    value = os.environ.get("IRONCLAW_BASE_URL")
    if not value:
        return DEFAULT_BASE_URL
    return value.rstrip("/")


def _record(
    checks: list[SmokeCheck],
    name: str,
    ok: bool,
    status_code: int | None,
    detail: str,
    duration_ms: int,
) -> None:
    entry = SmokeCheck(
        name=name,
        ok=ok,
        status_code=status_code,
        detail=detail,
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
    )
    checks.append(entry)
    label = "OK" if ok else "FAIL"
    status_display = f" ({status_code})" if status_code is not None else ""
    print(f"[{label}] {name}{status_display} [{duration_ms}ms]: {detail}")


def _response_snippet(response: httpx.Response, limit: int = 400) -> str:
    text = response.text
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    return text[:limit] + "...(truncated)"


def _validate_success_payload(name: str, payload: Any) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        if name in {"health", "health-liveness", "health-readiness", "system-status"}:
            status = str(payload.get("status", "")).lower()
            if status not in {"ok", "pass", "healthy"}:
                return False, f"unexpected payload status field: {payload!r}"
            return True, "healthy status"

        if name.startswith("ui-"):
            return True, "ui endpoint reachable"

        return True, "ok"

    return True, "non-dict JSON payload"


def _get(client: httpx.Client, name: str, path: str, checks: list[SmokeCheck]) -> None:
    started = time.perf_counter()

    try:
        response = client.get(path)
    except httpx.RequestError as exc:
        duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        _record(
            checks,
            name,
            False,
            None,
            f"request error: {exc.__class__.__name__}: {exc}",
            duration_ms,
        )
        return

    duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    ok = 200 <= response.status_code < 300
    if not ok:
        _record(
            checks,
            name,
            False,
            response.status_code,
            f"unexpected status {response.status_code}, body: {_response_snippet(response)!r}",
            duration_ms,
        )
        return

    try:
        payload = response.json()
    except ValueError:
        _record(checks, name, True, response.status_code, "non-JSON response body", duration_ms)
        return

    payload_ok, detail = _validate_success_payload(name, payload)
    _record(checks, name, payload_ok, response.status_code, detail, duration_ms)


def _run_smoketests(base_url: str) -> SmokeTestReport:
    checks: list[SmokeCheck] = []
    timeout = httpx.Timeout(TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    started = time.perf_counter()

    with httpx.Client(base_url=base_url, timeout=timeout, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        _get(client, "health", HEALTH_ENDPOINT, checks)
        _get(client, "health-liveness", PROBES_LIVENESS_ENDPOINT, checks)
        _get(client, "health-readiness", PROBES_READINESS_ENDPOINT, checks)
        _get(client, "system-status", SYSTEM_STATUS_ENDPOINT, checks)

        _get(client, "ui-manifest", UI_MANIFEST_ENDPOINT, checks)
        _get(client, "ui-status", UI_STATUS_ENDPOINT, checks)
        _get(client, "ui-runtime-status", UI_RUNTIME_STATUS_ENDPOINT, checks)

    total_duration_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
    overall_status = "ok" if all(check.ok for check in checks) else "fail"
    return SmokeTestReport(
        base_url=base_url,
        overall_status=overall_status,
        checks=tuple(checks),
        total_duration_ms=total_duration_ms,
    )


def _write_report(report: SmokeTestReport) -> None:
    RESULT_FILE.write_text(
        json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Run IronClaw smoke tests against a running instance."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--base-url",
        help=f"Override base URL for the IronClaw API (default: {DEFAULT_BASE_URL!r} or $IRONCLAW_BASE_URL).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--json",
        action="store_true",
        help="Print the smoke test report JSON to stdout in addition to writing it to disk.",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    base_url = (args.base_url or _env_base_url()).rstrip("/")

    print(f"Running IronClaw smoketests against {base_url} ...")
    report = _run_smoketests(base_url)
    _write_report(report)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(report.to_dict(), indent=2))

    print(f"SMOKETEST: {report.overall_status.upper()} ({report.total_duration_ms}ms)")
    return 0 if report.overall_status == "ok" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
VERSION_FILE = ROOT / "VERSION"
CHANGELOG_FILE = ROOT / "CHANGELOG.md"
MIGRATIONS_DIR = ROOT / "migrations"
UPDATE_STATE_FILE = ROOT / ".update-state.json"
ROLLBACK_NOTES_FILE = ROOT / "ROLLBACK_NOTES.md"
VERIFY_SCRIPT = ROOT / "scripts" / "verify.py"

SEMVER_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$")


def _print(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg)


def _fail(msg: str, exit_code: int = 1) -> None:
    _print(f"ERROR: {msg}")
    raise SystemExit(exit_code)


def _run(cmd: list[str], *, cwd: Path | None = None) -> None:
    subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd or ROOT), check=True)


def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    if not path.exists():
        _fail(f"required file is missing: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()


def _load_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not UPDATE_STATE_FILE.exists():
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads(UPDATE_STATE_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        _fail(f"invalid update state file: {exc}")
        return {}


def _save_state(state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    state["updated_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    UPDATE_STATE_FILE.write_text(
        json.dumps(state, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def _read_version() -> str:
    version = _read_text(VERSION_FILE)
    if not SEMVER_RE.match(version):
        _fail("VERSION must use semantic version format like 1.2.3")
    return version


def _parse_semver(version: str) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    major, minor, patch = version.split(".")
    return int(major), int(minor), int(patch)


def _ensure_version_progression(previous: str | None, current: str) -> None:
    if previous is None:
        _print(f"Initial update state created at version {current}")
        return
    if _parse_semver(current) < _parse_semver(previous):
        _fail(f"version regression detected: previous={previous}, current={current}")
    if _parse_semver(current) == _parse_semver(previous):
        _print(f"Version unchanged at {current}; update remains idempotent")
    else:
        _print(f"Version update detected: {previous} -> {current}")


def _ensure_changelog_mentions(version: str) -> None:
    changelog = _read_text(CHANGELOG_FILE)
    if version not in changelog:
        _fail(f"CHANGELOG.md does not mention current version {version}")
    _print("Changelog check passed")


def _discover_migrations() -> list[str]:
    if not MIGRATIONS_DIR.exists():
        _print("No migrations directory found; skipping migration hooks")
        return []
    files = sorted(
        path.name
        for path in MIGRATIONS_DIR.iterdir()
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in {".sql", ".py"}
    )
    _print(f"Discovered {len(files)} migration file(s)")
    return files


def _record_migration_hooks(state: dict[str, Any], migrations: list[str]) -> None:
    state["migration_hooks"] = migrations
    state["migration_hook_status"] = "detected" if migrations else "none"


def _ensure_rollback_notes(version: str) -> None:
    if not ROLLBACK_NOTES_FILE.exists():
        ROLLBACK_NOTES_FILE.write_text(
            "\n".join(
                [
                    "# Rollback Notes",
                    "",
                    f"## Current version: {version}",
                    "",
                    "- Revert application code to the previous known-good release.",
                    "- Reinstall pinned dependencies if requirements changed.",
                    "- Restore database from backup before reverting incompatible migrations.",
                    "- Re-run verification after rollback.",
                    "",
                ]
            )
            + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        _print("Created ROLLBACK_NOTES.md")
        return

    existing = ROLLBACK_NOTES_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if version not in existing:
        with ROLLBACK_NOTES_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(
                "\n"
                f"## Reviewed for version: {version}\n"
                "- Confirm previous deployment artifact is available.\n"
                "- Confirm database rollback or restore path is documented.\n"
                "- Confirm post-rollback verification command is ready.\n"
            )
        _print("Appended version-specific rollback notes")
    else:
        _print("Rollback notes already cover current version")


def _run_migration_hook_if_present() -> None:
    hook = ROOT / "scripts" / "apply_migrations.py"
    if not hook.exists():
        _print("No apply_migrations.py hook found; skipping migration execution hook")
        return
    _print("Running migration hook")
    _run([sys.executable, str(hook)])


def _run_verify_if_present() -> None:
    if not VERIFY_SCRIPT.exists():
        _print("No scripts/verify.py found; skipping post-update verify hook")
        return
    _print("Running post-update verification")
    _run([sys.executable, str(VERIFY_SCRIPT)])


def main() -> None:
    try:
        current_version = _read_version()
        state = _load_state()
        previous_version = state.get("last_version")

        _ensure_version_progression(previous_version, current_version)
        _ensure_changelog_mentions(current_version)

        migrations = _discover_migrations()
        _record_migration_hooks(state, migrations)

        _run_migration_hook_if_present()
        _ensure_rollback_notes(current_version)
        _run_verify_if_present()

        state["last_version"] = current_version
        state["status"] = "ok"
        _save_state(state)

        _print("Update completed successfully")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
        _fail(f"command failed with exit code {exc.returncode}: {' '.join(exc.cmd)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP_DIR = ROOT / "app"
TESTS_DIR = ROOT / "tests"
REQUIREMENTS_FILE = ROOT / "requirements.txt"
ENV_EXAMPLE_FILE = ROOT / ".env.example"
RESULT_FILE = ROOT / ".verify-results.json"


def _print(message: str) -> None:
    print(message)


def _run(cmd: list[str], *, cwd: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        cwd=str(cwd or ROOT),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )


def _record(results: list[dict[str, Any]], name: str, ok: bool, detail: str) -> None:
    results.append({"name": name, "ok": ok, "detail": detail})
    status = "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"
    _print(f"[{status}] {name}: {detail}")


def _check_required_paths(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    required = [
        APP_DIR,
        TESTS_DIR,
        REQUIREMENTS_FILE,
        ROOT / "app" / "main.py",
    ]
    missing = [str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) for path in required if not path.exists()]
    if missing:
        _record(results, "required-paths", False, f"missing: {', '.join(missing)}")
        return
    _record(results, "required-paths", True, "all required project paths are present")


def _check_python_version(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    version = sys.version.split()[0]
    if sys.version_info >= (3, 12):
        _record(results, "python-version", True, version)
        return
    _record(results, "python-version", False, f"{version} is below 3.12")


def _check_env_example_present(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    if ENV_EXAMPLE_FILE.exists():
        _record(results, "env-example-present", True, ".env.example is present")
        return
    _record(results, "env-example-present", False, ".env.example is missing")


def _check_core_imports(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    command = [
        sys.executable,
        "-c",
        "import fastapi, pytest; import app.main; print('ok')",
    ]
    completed = _run(command)
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "core-imports", True, "fastapi, pytest, and app.main imported successfully")
        return
    detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout).strip() or "import failure"
    _record(results, "core-imports", False, detail)


def _check_compile(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    completed = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "compileall", "-q", "app", "tests", "scripts"])
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "compileall", True, "python sources compiled successfully")
        return
    detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout).strip() or "compileall failed"
    _record(results, "compileall", False, detail)


def _check_health_route_declared(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    main_file = ROOT / "app" / "main.py"
    if not main_file.exists():
        _record(results, "health-route-declared", False, "app/main.py not found")
        return

    try:
        source = main_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        tree = ast.parse(source)
    except SyntaxError as exc:
        _record(results, "health-route-declared", False, f"syntax error in app/main.py: {exc}")
        return

    route_markers = {
        "/health",
        "/healthz",
        "/api/health",
        "/api/healthz",
        "/api/health/liveness",
        "/api/health/readiness",
    }
    found = False

    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
            continue
        func = node.func
        if not isinstance(func, ast.Attribute):
            continue
        if func.attr not in {"get", "post", "put", "delete", "patch", "api_route"}:
            continue
        if not node.args:
            continue
        first_arg = node.args[0]
        if isinstance(first_arg, ast.Constant) and isinstance(first_arg.value, str):
            if first_arg.value in route_markers:
                found = True
                break

    if found:
        _record(results, "health-route-declared", True, "health-style route declaration found")
        return
    _record(results, "health-route-declared", False, "no health-style route declaration found in app/main.py")


def _check_key_tests_present(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    candidates = [
        "testmain.py",
        "testapi.py",
        "testliveappsmoke.py",
        "testcliinstall.py",
        "testcliverify.py",
    ]
    present = [name for name in candidates if (TESTS_DIR / name).exists()]
    if present:
        _record(results, "key-tests-present", True, f"found: {', '.join(present)}")
        return
    _record(results, "key-tests-present", False, "no key smoke/api/install tests found")


def _check_pip_check(results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    completed = _run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "check"])
    if completed.returncode == 0:
        _record(results, "pip-check", True, "dependency metadata is consistent")
        return
    detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout).strip() or "pip check failed"
    _record(results, "pip-check", False, detail)


def _write_results(results: list[dict[str, Any]], ok: bool) -> None:
    payload = {
        "status": "ok" if ok else "fail",
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "python_version": sys.version.split()[0],
        "checks": results,
    }
    RESULT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    _check_required_paths(results)
    _check_python_version(results)
    _check_env_example_present(results)
    _check_core_imports(results)
    _check_compile(results)
    _check_health_route_declared(results)
    _check_key_tests_present(results)
    _check_pip_check(results)

    ok = all(item["ok"] for item in results)
    _write_results(results, ok)

    if ok:
        _print("VERIFY STATUS: PASS")
        raise SystemExit(0)

    _print("VERIFY STATUS: FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from client import IronClawClient, ScanResult
from supabaseclient import (
    SupabaseAPIError,
    SupabaseClient,
    SupabaseConfigurationError,
    SupabaseConnectionError,
    createsupabaseclient,
)

TargetType = Literal["text", "url", "githubrepo", "archive"]
SandboxLane = Literal[
    "none",
    "prompt_injection",
    "code_execution",
    "exfiltration",
    "high_risk_misc",
]
ActionType = Literal["allow", "warn", "block", "quarantine"]
ScanMode = Literal["enforce", "monitor", "strict"]

app = FastAPI(title="IronClaw-Security API")

# NOTE: keep this aligned with the real local engine port for IronClaw-Security.
engine_client = IronClawClient(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8010")


class ScanRequest(BaseModel):
    target_type: TargetType
    target_value: str
    mode: ScanMode = "enforce"
    source: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    user_id: str | None = None
    context: str | None = None

    risky_files: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    failed_checks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    quarantine_reason: str | None = None
    review_status: Literal["none", "pending", "approved", "rejected"] = "none"

    reviewed_at: str | None = None
    untrusted: bool = False
    sandbox_lane: SandboxLane = "none"
    timestamp: str | None = None

    primary_category: str | None = None
    explanation: str | None = None
    source: str | None = None
    session_id: str | None = None
    user_id: str | None = None
    context: str | None = None

# --- Supabase wiring for history (using SupabaseClient) ---


def _get_supabase_client() -> SupabaseClient | None:
    """
    Build a SupabaseClient for history operations.

    History is best-effort; if configuration is missing or Supabase is down,
    we return None and treat history as disabled rather than failing scans.
    """
    try:
        return createsupabaseclient()
    except SupabaseConfigurationError:
        # Supabase not configured; history disabled.
        return None
    except Exception:
        # Any other bootstrap failure should not break the service path.
        return None


def _insert_scan_history_row(row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    client = _get_supabase_client()
    if client is None:
        return
    try:
        client.insert("scanhistory", row)
    except (SupabaseConnectionError, SupabaseAPIError):
        # History is non-critical; logging is handled inside the client.
        return
    except Exception:
        return


def _list_scan_history_rows(
    *,
    limit: int = 50,
    verdict: str | None = None,
    sandbox_lane: str | None = None,
    review_status: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    client = _get_supabase_client()
    if client is None:
        return []

    filters: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if verdict:
        filters["verdict"] = verdict
    if sandbox_lane:
        filters["sandbox_lane"] = sandbox_lane
    if review_status:
        filters["review_status"] = review_status

    try:
        rows = client.select(
            "scanhistory",
            filters=filters or None,
            limit=limit,
            order=("timestamp", "desc"),
        )
    except (SupabaseConnectionError, SupabaseAPIError):
        return []
    except Exception:
        return []

    # Ensure dict[str, Any] shape
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def _update_scan_history_status_row(
    *,
    id: str,
    review_status: str,
    reviewer: str,
    reviewed_at: str,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    client = _get_supabase_client()
    if client is None:
        return None
    try:
        rows = client.update(
            "scanhistory",
            payload={
                "review_status": review_status,
                "reviewer": reviewer,
                "reviewed_at": reviewed_at,
            },
            filters={"id": id},
        )
    except (SupabaseConnectionError, SupabaseAPIError):
        return None
    except Exception:
        return None

    if not rows:
        return None
    return dict(rows[0])


# --- Local decision helpers ---


def _normalize_action(verdict: str) -> ActionType:
    v = verdict.lower()
    if v in ("allow",):
        return "allow"
    if v in ("warn", "warning"):
        return "warn"
    if v in ("quarantine", "quarantined"):
        return "quarantine"
    return "block"


def _apply_mode_to_action(action: ActionType, mode: ScanMode) -> ActionType:
    if mode == "monitor":
        if action in ("block", "quarantine"):
            return "warn"
        return action

    if mode == "strict":
        if action == "warn":
            return "quarantine"
        return action

    return action


def _record_history_from_result(result: ScanResult, meta: dict | None = None) -> None:
    meta = meta or {}
    history_row: dict[str, Any] = {
        "scan_id": getattr(result, "scan_id", None),
        "target_type": result.target_type,
        "target_value": result.target_value[:5000],
        "verdict": result.verdict,
        "risk_score": result.risk_score,
        "matched_patterns": getattr(result, "matched_patterns", []),
        "summary": result.summary,
        "sandbox_lane": getattr(result, "sandbox_lane", "none"),
        "quarantine_reason": getattr(result, "quarantine_reason", None),
        "review_status": getattr(result, "review_status", "none"),
        "untrusted": getattr(result, "untrusted", False),
        "max_severity": getattr(result, "max_severity", None),
        "primary_category": getattr(result, "primary_category", None),
        "explanation": getattr(result, "explanation", None),
        "risky_files": getattr(result, "risky_files", []),
        "checks_loaded": getattr(result, "checks_loaded", []),
        "failed_checks": getattr(result, "failed_checks", []),
        "timestamp": getattr(result, "timestamp", None),
        "source": meta.get("source"),
        "session_id": meta.get("session_id"),
        "user_id": meta.get("user_id"),
        "context": meta.get("context"),
    }
    _insert_scan_history_row(history_row)


def _scan_result_to_response(
    result: ScanResult,
    mode: ScanMode,
    source: str | None = None,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    user_id: str | None = None,
    context: str | None = None,
) -> ScanResponse:
    base_action = _normalize_action(result.verdict)
    final_action = _apply_mode_to_action(base_action, mode)

    return ScanResponse(
        scan_id=getattr(result, "scan_id", None),
        verdict=result.verdict,
        action=final_action,
        mode=mode,
        summary=result.summary,
        target_type=result.target_type,
        target_value=result.target_value,
        risk_score=result.risk_score,
        matched_patterns=getattr(result, "matched_patterns", []),
        risky_files=getattr(result, "risky_files", []),
        checks_loaded=getattr(result, "checks_loaded", []),
        failed_checks=getattr(result, "failed_checks", []),
        quarantine_reason=getattr(result, "quarantine_reason", None),
        review_status=getattr(result, "review_status", "none"),
        reviewer=None,
        reviewed_at=None,
        untrusted=getattr(result, "untrusted", False),
        sandbox_lane=getattr(result, "sandbox_lane", "none"),
        timestamp=getattr(result, "timestamp", None),
        max_severity=getattr(result, "max_severity", None),
        primary_category=getattr(result, "primary_category", None),
        explanation=getattr(result, "explanation", None),
        source=source,
        session_id=session_id,
        user_id=user_id,
        context=context,
    )


def _fetch_related_history(
    session_id: str | None,
    user_id: str | None,
    max_history: int,
) -> list[ScanHistoryItem]:
    rows = _list_scan_history_rows(limit=max_history)
    if not rows:
        return []

    related_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in rows:
        if session_id and row.get("session_id") == session_id:
            related_rows.append(row)
        elif user_id and row.get("user_id") == user_id:
            related_rows.append(row)

    items = [
        ScanHistoryItem(
            id=row.get("id"),
            created_at=row.get("created_at"),
            scan_id=row.get("scan_id"),
            verdict=row["verdict"],
            action=_normalize_action(row["verdict"]),
            mode="enforce",
            summary=row["summary"],
            target_type=row["target_type"],
            target_value=row["target_value"],
            risk_score=row["risk_score"],
            matched_patterns=row.get("matched_patterns", []),
            risky_files=row.get("risky_files", []),
            checks_loaded=row.get("checks_loaded", []),
            failed_checks=row.get("failed_checks", []),
            quarantine_reason=row.get("quarantine_reason"),
            review_status=row.get("review_status", "none"),
            reviewer=row.get("reviewer"),
            reviewed_at=row.get("reviewed_at"),
            untrusted=row.get("untrusted", False),
            sandbox_lane=row.get("sandbox_lane", "none"),
            timestamp=row.get("timestamp"),
            max_severity=row.get("max_severity"),
            primary_category=row.get("primary_category"),
            explanation=row.get("explanation"),
            source=row.get("source"),
            session_id=row.get("session_id"),
            user_id=row.get("user_id"),
            context=row.get("context"),
        )
        for row in related_rows
    ]
    return items


def _compute_brain_decision(
    scan: ScanResponse,
    related_history: list[ScanHistoryItem],
) -> BrainDecision:
    if scan.action == "allow":
        base = BrainDecision(
            final_action="allow",
            confidence=0.95,
            reason="No risky patterns detected; content appears safe to use.",
            recommended_mode=scan.mode,
        )
    elif scan.action == "warn":
        base = BrainDecision(
            final_action="warn",
            confidence=0.85,
            reason="Low to moderate risk patterns detected; proceed with caution and consider user confirmation.",
            recommended_mode=scan.mode,
        )
    elif scan.action == "quarantine":
        base = BrainDecision(
            final_action="quarantine",
            confidence=0.9,
            reason="Risky patterns detected; content was quarantined by the engine and should not be executed directly.",
            recommended_mode="enforce",
        )
    else:
        base = BrainDecision(
            final_action="block",
            confidence=0.95,
            reason="High risk detected; execution or use of this content should be blocked.",
            recommended_mode="enforce",
        )

    if not related_history:
        return base

    prior_high_risk = [
        h
        for h in related_history
        if h.verdict in ("quarantine", "block")
        or h.sandbox_lane in ("prompt_injection", "code_execution", "exfiltration")
    ]

    if not prior_high_risk:
        return base

    count = len(prior_high_risk)
    boosted_confidence = min(1.0, base.confidence + 0.05)
    extra_reason = (
        f" There are {count} prior high-risk events for this session or user, "
        "indicating potential ongoing prompt abuse or malicious behavior."
    )

    if base.final_action == "warn" and count >= 2:
        return BrainDecision(
            final_action="quarantine",
            confidence=min(1.0, boosted_confidence + 0.05),
            reason=(
                "Repeated suspicious activity was observed across related history. "
                "The current event should be quarantined pending further review."
                + extra_reason
            ),
            recommended_mode="enforce",
        )

    if base.final_action == "allow" and count >= 3:
        return BrainDecision(
            final_action="warn",
            confidence=0.85,
            reason=(
                "The current content appears safe on its own, but related history shows repeated "
                "high-risk activity. Proceed with caution."
                + extra_reason
            ),
            recommended_mode="enforce",
        )

    return BrainDecision(
        final_action=base.final_action,
        confidence=boosted_confidence,
        reason=base.reason + extra_reason,
        recommended_mode=base.recommended_mode,
    )

            risky_files=row.get("risky_files", []),
            checks_loaded=row.get("checks_loaded", []),
            failed_checks=row.get("failed_checks", []),

            session_id=row.get("session_id"),

    return ScanHistoryResponse(count=len(items), items=items)


@app.post("/history/{id}/review", response_model=ReviewUpdateResponse)
async def review_history_item(id: str, body: ReviewUpdateRequest) -> ReviewUpdateResponse:
    rows = _list_scan_history_rows(limit=500)
    if rows is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Review lookup failed")

    existing = next((row for row in rows if row.get("id") == id), None)
    if not existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Scan history item not found")

    current_status = existing.get("review_status", "none")
    if current_status != "pending":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Cannot review item with status '{current_status}'. Only 'pending' items can be reviewed.",
        )

    reviewer = (body.reviewer or "manual-review").strip() or "manual-review"
    reviewed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    row = _update_scan_history_status_row(
        id=id,
        review_status=body.review_status,
        reviewer=reviewer,
        reviewed_at=reviewed_at,
    )
    if not row or "id" not in row:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Scan history item not found")

    return ReviewUpdateResponse(
        id=row["id"],
        review_status=row.get("review_status", "none"),
        reviewer=row.get("reviewer"),
        reviewed_at=row.get("reviewed_at"),
    )


@app.get("/stats", response_model=StatsResponse)
async def stats_endpoint() -> StatsResponse:
    rows = _list_scan_history_rows(limit=500)
    if rows is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Stats query failed")

    total_scans = len(rows)
    total_quarantined = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("verdict") == "quarantine")
    total_blocked = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("verdict") == "block")
    total_threats_blocked = total_quarantined + total_blocked

    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=24)
    threats_blocked_last_24h = 0
    for r in rows:
        if r.get("verdict") not in ("block", "quarantine"):
            continue
        ts = r.get("timestamp")
        if not ts:
            continue
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(ts).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if dt >= cutoff:
            threats_blocked_last_24h += 1

    return StatsResponse(
        total_scans=total_scans,
        total_threats_blocked=total_threats_blocked,
        total_quarantined=total_quarantined,
        total_blocked=total_blocked,
        threats_blocked_last_24h=threats_blocked_last_24h,
    )


@app.post("/scan", response_model=ScanResponse)
async def scan_endpoint(request: ScanRequest) -> ScanResponse:
    result: ScanResult = engine_client.scan(
        target_type=request.target_type,
        target_value=request.target_value,
    )

    _record_history_from_result(
        result,
        meta={
            "source": request.source,
            "session_id": request.session_id,
            "user_id": request.user_id,
            "context": request.context,
        },
    )

    return _scan_result_to_response(
        result=result,
        mode=request.mode,
        source=request.source,
        session_id=request.session_id,
        user_id=request.user_id,
        context=request.context,
    )


@app.post("/scan/batch", response_model=ScanBatchResponse)
async def scan_batch_endpoint(request: ScanBatchRequest) -> ScanBatchResponse:
    responses: list[ScanBatchItemResponse] = []

    for item in request.items:
        result: ScanResult = engine_client.scan(
            target_type=item.target_type,
            target_value=item.target_value,
        )

        _record_history_from_result(
            result,
            meta={
                "source": item.source,
                "session_id": item.session_id,
                "user_id": item.user_id,
                "context": item.context,
            },
        )

        scan_response = _scan_result_to_response(
            result=result,
            mode=item.mode,
            source=item.source,
            session_id=item.session_id,
            user_id=item.user_id,
            context=item.context,
        )

        responses.append(
            ScanBatchItemResponse(
                client_id=item.client_id,
                **scan_response.model_dump(),
            )
        )

    return ScanBatchResponse(items=responses)


@app.post("/brain/decision", response_model=BrainDecisionResponse)
async def brain_decision_endpoint(body: BrainDecisionRequest) -> BrainDecisionResponse:
    scan_result: ScanResult = engine_client.scan(
        target_type=body.target_type,
        target_value=body.target_value,
    )

    _record_history_from_result(
        scan_result,
        meta={
            "source": body.source,
            "session_id": body.session_id,
            "user_id": body.user_id,
            "context": body.context,
        },
    )

    scan_response = _scan_result_to_response(
        result=scan_result,
        mode=body.mode,
        source=body.source,
        session_id=body.session_id,
        user_id=body.user_id,
        context=body.context,
    )

    related_history: list[ScanHistoryItem] = []
    if body.use_history and (body.session_id or body.user_id):
        related_history = _fetch_related_history(
            session_id=body.session_id,
            user_id=body.user_id,
            max_history=body.max_history,
        )

    decision = _compute_brain_decision(scan_response, related_history)

    return BrainDecisionResponse(
        decision=decision,
        scan=scan_response,
        related_history=related_history,
    )
