def test_end_to_end_failover_rolls_back_to_checkpoint_on_restore_failure(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    source_dir = tmp_path / "runtime-source"
    source_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (source_dir / "state.json").write_text('{"status":"ok","version":1}', encoding="utf-8")

    backup_service = _build_backup_service(
        tmp_path,
        source_path=source_dir,
        now=_utc_dt(2026, 4, 27, 19, 20, 0),
    )
    manifest = backup_service.run_export("runtime-metadata")
    manifest_path = resolve_manifest_sidecar(Path(manifest.backup_path))

    restore_root = tmp_path / "restore-target"
    restore_root.mkdir(parents=True)
    (restore_root / "stable.txt").write_text("checkpoint-state", encoding="utf-8")

    class FailingExecutor:
        def restore(self, manifest, restore_root: Path, dry_run: bool):
            raise RuntimeError("simulated restore failure")

        def rollback(self, rollback_checkpoint: Path, restore_root: Path):
            for child in list(restore_root.iterdir()):
                if child.is_dir():
                    import shutil

                    shutil.rmtree(child)
                else:
                    child.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            for child in rollback_checkpoint.iterdir():
                destination = restore_root / child.name
                if child.is_dir():
                    import shutil

                    shutil.copytree(child, destination, dirs_exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    destination.write_bytes(child.read_bytes())
            return [{"action": "rollback-applied", "destination": str(restore_root)}]

    restore_service = RestoreService(
        executor=FailingExecutor(),
        now=_utc_dt(2026, 4, 27, 19, 21, 0),
    )
    result = restore_service.replay_with_rollback_safety(manifest_path, restore_root)

    assert result.status == "rolled-back"
    assert result.mode == "rollback"
    assert result.details["rollback_triggered"] is True
    assert "RuntimeError" in result.details["exception"]
    assert (restore_root / "stable.txt").exists()
    assert not (restore_root / "runtime-metadata.restore.jsonl").exists()


def test_end_to_end_backup_rotation_and_restore_validation_coexist(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    source_dir = tmp_path / "runtime-source"
    source_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    (source_dir / "state.json").write_text('{"status":"ok"}', encoding="utf-8")

    backup_service = _build_backup_service(
        tmp_path,
        source_path=source_dir,
        now=_utc_dt(2026, 4, 27, 19, 22, 0),
    )

    manifests = [
        backup_service.run_export("runtime-metadata")
        for _ in range(3)
    ]
    removed = backup_service.rotate("runtime-metadata")

    restore_service = RestoreService(now=_utc_dt(2026, 4, 27, 19, 23, 0))
    latest_manifest_path = resolve_manifest_sidecar(Path(manifests[-1].backup_path))
    validation = restore_service.validate_manifest(latest_manifest_path)

    assert len(manifests) == 3
    assert isinstance(removed, list)
    assert validation.ok is True

def test_run_export_creates_manifest_and_checksum_verified_artifact(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    source_dir = tmp_path / "runtime"
    source_dir.mkdir()
    (source_dir / "state.json").write_text('{"status":"ok"}', encoding="utf-8")

    target = BackupTarget(
        name="runtime-metadata",
        kind="export",
        format="jsonl.gz",
        base_path=source_dir,
        rotation_policy=BackupRotationPolicy(max_hourly=3, max_daily=2, max_weekly=1, max_monthly=1),
        checksum_required=True,
        encrypt_at_rest=False,
    )
    service = _build_service(
        tmp_path,
        target=target,
        now=_utc_dt(2026, 4, 27, 13, 5, 0),
    )

    manifest = service.run_export("runtime-metadata")
    artifact_path = Path(manifest.backup_path)
    sidecar_path = artifact_path.with_suffix(artifact_path.suffix + ".manifest.json")

    assert artifact_path.exists()
    assert artifact_path.suffix == ".gz"
    assert sidecar_path.exists()
    assert manifest.target_name == "runtime-metadata"
    assert manifest.target_kind == "export"
    assert manifest.backup_format == "jsonl.gz"
    assert manifest.rotation_tier == "hourly"
    assert manifest.sha256
    assert manifest.size_bytes > 0
    assert service.verify(manifest) is True

    payload = json.loads(sidecar_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert payload["target_name"] == "runtime-metadata"
    assert payload["backup_format"] == "jsonl.gz"
    assert payload["sha256"] == manifest.sha256

    with gzip.open(artifact_path, "rt", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        lines = [json.loads(line) for line in fh if line.strip()]
    assert lines
    assert any(entry["path"] == "state.json" for entry in lines)

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.billingpackages import build_billing_packages


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _items_of(result: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(result, list):
        return result
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        for key in ("items", "packages", "plans", "results", "data"):
            value = result.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                return value
        return [result]
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        if isinstance(payload, dict):
            return _items_of(payload)
    if hasattr(result, "__iter__") and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes)):
        try:
            return list(result)
        except TypeError:
            pass
    return [result]


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_billing_packages_returns_object() -> None:
    packages = build_billing_packages()

    assert packages is not None


def test_billing_packages_is_serializable_to_supported_shape() -> None:

    assert isinstance(result, (dict, list)) or hasattr(result, "as_dict") or hasattr(result, "__iter__")


def test_billing_packages_contains_at_least_one_package_record() -> None:

    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert items


def test_each_billing_package_has_dictionary_shape_when_serialized() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_billing_packages())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        assert payload

        "name",
        "code",
        "price",
        "currency",

        "units",
        "status",

    }

        break

            _text(payload, "name", "title", "code", "slug"),
            _text(payload, "currency"),
            _text(payload, "status", "state"),
        ):
            if value is not None:
                assert value.strip()


def test_billing_package_numeric_fields_are_non_negative_when_present() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_billing_packages())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        for keys in (
            ("price", "amount", "cost"),
            ("quota", "limit"),
            ("units", "credits"),
            ("intervalcount", "interval_count"),
        ):
            value = _number(payload, *keys)

    packages = build_billing_packages()

    list_methods = ("list_packages", "packages", "all", "list")
    if not any(hasattr(packages, name) and callable(getattr(packages, name)) for name in list_methods):
        pytest.skip("package listing method not implemented")

    result = _call_method_if_present(packages, list_methods)
    items = _items_of(result)

    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert items


def test_billing_packages_lookup_by_code_returns_matching_record_when_supported() -> None:
    packages = build_billing_packages()

    lookup_methods = ("get_by_code", "find_by_code", "package_by_code", "lookup")
    if not any(hasattr(packages, name) and callable(getattr(packages, name)) for name in lookup_methods):
        pytest.skip("package lookup method not implemented")

    sample_items = _items_of(packages)
    sample_payload = _payload_of(sample_items[0])
    code = _text(sample_payload, "code", "name", "packageid", "package_id", "id")
    if code is None:
        pytest.skip("no package code-like field available")

    result = _call_method_if_present(packages, lookup_methods, code)
    payload = _payload_of(result)
    matched = _text(payload, "code", "name", "packageid", "package_id", "id")

    assert matched == code

    items = _items_of(build_billing_packages())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        for key, value in payload.items():
            assert isinstance(key, str)
            assert value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict))


def test_billing_packages_multiple_builds_have_stable_top_level_shape() -> None:
    first = _items_of(build_billing_packages())
    second = _items_of(build_billing_packages())

    assert isinstance(first, list)
    assert isinstance(second, list)
    assert bool(first) == bool(second)

    if first and second:
        assert set(_payload_of(first[0]).keys()) == set(_payload_of(second[0]).keys())

from app.billingregistry import build_billing_registry

        if callable(value):

        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):

def _items_of(result: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(result, list):
        return result
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        for key in ("items", "entries", "records", "registrations", "data"):
            value = result.get(key)

    if hasattr(result, "__iter__") and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes)):

def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:

    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None

        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")

    packages = _get_json("/billing/packages")

    manifest_keys = {"packages", "plans", "catalog"}
    package_keys = {"packages", "plans", "catalog", "items"}

    manifest_collection_key = next((key for key in manifest_keys if key in manifest), None)
    packages_collection_key = next((key for key in package_keys if key in packages), None)

    if manifest_collection_key and packages_collection_key:
        assert isinstance(manifest[manifest_collection_key], (list, dict))
        assert isinstance(packages[packages_collection_key], (list, dict))

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.billingstore import build_billing_store


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Any, Final

import pytest


MODULE_CANDIDATES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.services.billingstore",
    "services.billingstore",
    "billingstore",
)


def _load_module() -> Any:
    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for name in MODULE_CANDIDATES:
        try:
            return importlib.import_module(name)
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
            last_error = exc
    raise AssertionError(f"unable to import billing store module: {last_error}")


def _first_callable(target: Any, *names: str) -> Any | None:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            value = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(value):
                return value
    return None


def _serialize(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(getattr(value, "model_dump")):
        data = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(getattr(value, "dict")):
        data = value.dict()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    if hasattr(value, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(value, "as_dict")):
        data = value.as_dict()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(value):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        attr = getattr(value, name)
        if callable(attr):
            continue
        if isinstance(attr, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = attr
    return payload


def _items(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in ("items", "results", "rows", "entries", "records", "data"):
            candidate = value.get(key)
            if isinstance(candidate, list):
                return candidate
        return [value]
    return [value]


def _to_decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    try:
        return Decimal(str(value))
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def _build_store(module: Any) -> Any:
    factory = _first_callable(
        module,
        "build_billing_store",
        "create_billing_store",
        "get_billing_store",
        "build_store",
        "create_store",
        "get_store",
    )
    if factory is not None:
        try:
            return factory()
        except TypeError:
            try:
                return factory(mode="memory")
            except TypeError:
                try:
                    return factory(backend="memory")
                except TypeError:
                    pytest.skip("billing store factory requires unsupported arguments")

    for cls_name in ("BillingStore", "InMemoryBillingStore", "SupabaseBillingStore"):
        if hasattr(module, cls_name):
            cls = getattr(module, cls_name)
            if callable(cls):
                try:
                    return cls()
                except TypeError:
                    continue

    pytest.skip("billing store builder/class not implemented")

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.billingsummary import build_billing_summary


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")

    summary = build_billing_summary()

    assert summary is not None


def test_billing_summary_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload

        "quota",

        "packages",

    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)

def test_billing_summary_numeric_fields_are_non_negative_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_billing_summary())

    for keys in (
        ("balance",),

        ("usagecost", "usage_cost", "cost"),

def test_billing_summary_revenue_and_usage_cost_consistency_when_present() -> None:
    try:
        summary = build_billing_summary(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            revenue="100",
            usage_cost="40",
        )
    except TypeError:
        summary = build_billing_summary()

    payload = _payload_of(summary)
    revenue = _number(payload, "revenue", "totalrevenue", "total_revenue")
    usage_cost = _number(payload, "usagecost", "usage_cost", "cost")
    margin = _number(payload, "margin", "netrevenue", "net_revenue")

    if revenue is not None and usage_cost is not None:
        assert revenue >= usage_cost
    if revenue is not None and usage_cost is not None and margin is not None:
        assert margin == revenue - usage_cost


def test_billing_summary_usage_and_quota_consistency_when_present() -> None:
    try:
        summary = build_billing_summary(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            units=4,
            quota=10,
            remaining=6,
        )
    except TypeError:
        summary = build_billing_summary()

    payload = _payload_of(summary)
    units = _number(payload, "units")
    quota = _number(payload, "quota", "limit")
    remaining = _number(payload, "remaining", "available")

    if units is not None and quota is not None and remaining is not None:
        assert units + remaining == quota

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.billingwallet import build_billing_wallet


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_billing_wallet_returns_object() -> None:
    wallet = build_billing_wallet()

    assert wallet is not None


def test_billing_wallet_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_billing_wallet())

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload


def test_billing_wallet_contains_core_fields_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_billing_wallet())

    expected_candidates = {
        "walletid",
        "ownerid",
        "balance",
        "available",
        "reserved",
        "currency",
        "status",
        "ledger",
        "generatedat",
    }
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)


def test_billing_wallet_identifiers_are_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_billing_wallet())

    for value in (
        _text(payload, "walletid", "wallet_id", "id"),
        _text(payload, "ownerid", "owner_id", "owner", "accountid", "account_id"),
        _text(payload, "currency"),
        _text(payload, "status", "state"),
    ):
        if value is not None:
            assert value.strip()


def test_billing_wallet_numeric_fields_are_non_negative_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_billing_wallet())

    for keys in (
        ("balance",),
        ("available", "availablebalance", "available_balance"),
        ("reserved", "held", "pending"),
        ("quota", "limit"),
    ):
        value = _number(payload, *keys)
        if value is not None:
            assert value >= Decimal("0")


def test_billing_wallet_available_and_reserved_do_not_exceed_balance_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_billing_wallet())

    balance = _number(payload, "balance")
    available = _number(payload, "available", "availablebalance", "available_balance")
    reserved = _number(payload, "reserved", "held", "pending")

    if balance is not None and available is not None:
        assert available <= balance
    if balance is not None and reserved is not None:
        assert reserved <= balance
    if balance is not None and available is not None and reserved is not None:
        assert available + reserved <= balance

def test_billing_wallet_credit_increases_balance_when_supported() -> None:
    wallet = build_billing_wallet()

    credit_methods = ("credit", "deposit", "add_funds", "fund", "top_up")
    if not any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in credit_methods):
        pytest.skip("billing wallet credit method not implemented")

    before = _number(_payload_of(wallet), "balance") or Decimal("0")
    _call_method_if_present(wallet, credit_methods, Decimal("10"))
    after = _number(_payload_of(wallet), "balance") or Decimal("0")

    assert after - before == Decimal("10")


def test_billing_wallet_debit_decreases_balance_when_supported() -> None:
    wallet = build_billing_wallet()

    credit_methods = ("credit", "deposit", "add_funds", "fund", "top_up")
    debit_methods = ("debit", "charge", "spend", "withdraw", "consume")

    if not any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in debit_methods):
        pytest.skip("billing wallet debit method not implemented")

    if any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in credit_methods):
        _call_method_if_present(wallet, credit_methods, Decimal("20"))

    before = _number(_payload_of(wallet), "balance") or Decimal("0")
    _call_method_if_present(wallet, debit_methods, Decimal("5"))
    after = _number(_payload_of(wallet), "balance") or Decimal("0")

    assert before - after == Decimal("5")


def test_billing_wallet_reserve_and_release_flow_when_supported() -> None:
    wallet = build_billing_wallet()

    credit_methods = ("credit", "deposit", "add_funds", "fund", "top_up")
    reserve_methods = ("reserve", "hold", "authorize")
    release_methods = ("release", "unreserve", "void_hold")

    has_reserve = any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in reserve_methods)
    has_release = any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in release_methods)

    if not (has_reserve and has_release):
        pytest.skip("billing wallet reserve/release methods not implemented")

    if any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in credit_methods):
        _call_method_if_present(wallet, credit_methods, Decimal("20"))

    before_payload = _payload_of(wallet)
    before_available = _number(before_payload, "available", "availablebalance", "available_balance")
    token = _call_method_if_present(wallet, reserve_methods, Decimal("5"))
    middle_payload = _payload_of(wallet)
    middle_reserved = _number(middle_payload, "reserved", "held", "pending")
    _call_method_if_present(wallet, release_methods, token if token is not None else Decimal("5"))
    after_payload = _payload_of(wallet)
    after_reserved = _number(after_payload, "reserved", "held", "pending")

    if before_available is not None:
        current_available = _number(middle_payload, "available", "availablebalance", "available_balance")
        if current_available is not None:
            assert current_available <= before_available
    if middle_reserved is not None:
        assert middle_reserved >= Decimal("0")
    if after_reserved is not None:
        assert after_reserved >= Decimal("0")

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.adapters.claudecodeadapter import ClaudeCodeAdapter


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _PolicyDecision:
    allowed: bool = True
    verdict: str = "allow"
    bundle_id: str = "bundle-001"
    version: str = "2026.04.25"
    runtime: str = "claude"
    override_active: bool = False
    rollout_enabled: bool = True
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "bundleid": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "overrideactive": self.override_active,
            "rolloutenabled": self.rollout_enabled,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


class _PolicyEnforcerStub:
    def __init__(self, decision: _PolicyDecision | None = None) -> None:
        self.decision = decision or _PolicyDecision()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _PolicyDecision:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.decision

    def allow(self, **kwargs: Any) -> bool:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.decision.allowed


class _ClaudeRuntimeClientStub:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.execute_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.result: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "ok",
            "runtime": "claude",
            "completion": "safe response",
            "usage": {"input_tokens": 120, "output_tokens": 48},
        }

    def execute(self, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.execute_calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return dict(self.result)


def _build_adapter(decision: _PolicyDecision | None = None):
    enforcer = _PolicyEnforcerStub(decision)
    runtime = _ClaudeRuntimeClientStub()
    adapter = ClaudeCodeAdapter(
        policy_enforcer=enforcer,
        runtime_client=runtime,
    )
    return adapter, enforcer, runtime


def _request_payload() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "bundle": {
            "bundle_id": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "policy": {
                "default_verdict": "allow",
                "rules": [{"id": "safe-claude", "action": "allow"}],
            },
        },
        "signature": "signed-bundle",
        "secret": "ironclaw-secret",
        "manifest": {
            "bundleid": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
            "digest": "a" * 64,
        },
        "action": "message.create",
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": "analyze this code safely"},
        ],
        "context": {
            "organization_id": "org-001",
            "risk": "low",
            "model": "claude-sonnet",
        },
    }


def test_allows_claude_execution_when_policy_enforcer_allows():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified", "rollout:enabled"],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is True
    assert result["verdict"] == "allow"
    assert result["runtime"] == "claude"
    assert result["policy"]["bundleid"] == "bundle-001"
    assert result["policy"]["version"] == "2026.04.25"
    assert result["result"]["status"] == "ok"
    assert result["result"]["completion"] == "safe response"
    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 1


def test_blocks_claude_execution_when_policy_enforcer_blocks():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=False,
            verdict="block",
            matched_rules=["signature_mismatch"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Bad signature", "details": "Bundle verification failed"}],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is False
    assert result["verdict"] == "block"
    assert result["runtime"] == "claude"
    assert "signature_mismatch" in result["policy"]["matchedrules"]
    assert result["result"] is None or result["result"].get("status") != "ok"
    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 0


def test_review_verdict_prevents_claude_runtime_call():

    assert result["policy"]["matchedrules"] == ["policy:review"]
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 0

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

MODULE_CANDIDATES = (
    "ironclaw_installer",
    "cli.install",
    "scripts.install",
)


def _import_install_module() -> Any:
    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for module_name in MODULE_CANDIDATES:
        try:
            return importlib.import_module(module_name)
        except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
            last_error = exc
    raise AssertionError(
        "Unable to import installer module. Expected one of: "
        + ", ".join(MODULE_CANDIDATES)
    ) from last_error


@pytest.fixture()
def install_module() -> Any:
    return _import_install_module()


def test_installer_module_exports_expected_symbols(install_module: Any) -> None:
    expected = (
        "InstallConfig",
        "InstallResult",
        "IronClawInstallerError",
        "build_parser",
        "build_install_config",
        "run_install",
        "main",
    )
    missing = [name for name in expected if getattr(install_module, name, None) is None]
    assert not missing, f"Missing installer symbols: {', '.join(missing)}"


def test_build_install_config_defaults(install_module: Any, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    parser = install_module.build_parser()

def test_run_install_writes_expected_files(
    install_module: Any,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    project_root = tmp_path / "project"
    project_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (project_root / "pyproject.toml").write_text(
        "[build-system]\nrequires = []\nbuild-backend = 'setuptools.build_meta'\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    config_dir = tmp_path / "user-config"

    parser = install_module.build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(
        [
            "--project-root",
            str(project_root),
            "--config-dir",
            str(config_dir),
            "--provider-target",
            "claude",
            "--provider-target",
            "openclaw",
        ]
    )
    config = install_module.build_install_config(args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(install_module, "_create_virtualenv", lambda project_root: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(install_module, "_install_project_editable", lambda project_root: None)

    result = install_module.run_install(config)

    assert result.ok is True
    assert result.config_file.exists()
    assert result.env_file is not None
    assert result.env_file.exists()
    assert result.vscode_settings_file is not None
    assert result.vscode_settings_file.exists()
    assert result.skill_config_file is not None
    assert result.skill_config_file.exists()

    runtime_payload = json.loads(result.config_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert runtime_payload["product"] == "IronClaw-Security"
    assert runtime_payload["base_url"] == install_module.DEFAULT_BASE_URL
    assert runtime_payload["provider_targets"] == ["claude", "openclaw"]

    skill_payload = json.loads(result.skill_config_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert skill_payload["enabled"] is True
    assert skill_payload["provider_targets"] == ["claude", "openclaw"]
    assert skill_payload["default_policy_mode"] == "review"

    env_contents = result.env_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "IRONCLAW_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000" in env_contents
    assert "IRONCLAW_PROVIDER_TARGETS=claude,openclaw" in env_contents
    assert "API_SECRET=" in env_contents
    assert "JWT_SECRET=" in env_contents
    assert "SECRET_KEY=" in env_contents

    vscode_payload = json.loads(result.vscode_settings_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert vscode_payload["python.testing.pytestEnabled"] is True


def test_run_install_skips_existing_files_without_overwrite(
    install_module: Any,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    project_root = tmp_path / "project"
    project_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (project_root / "pyproject.toml").write_text(
        "[build-system]\nrequires = []\nbuild-backend = 'setuptools.build_meta'\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    config_dir = tmp_path / "user-config"
    config_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    config_file = config_dir / install_module.DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME
    env_file = project_root / install_module.DEFAULT_ENV_FILENAME
    skill_file = config_dir / install_module.DEFAULT_SKILL_CONFIG_FILENAME
    vscode_file = project_root / ".vscode" / "settings.json"
    vscode_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    config_file.write_text(json.dumps({"preexisting": True}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    env_file.write_text("PREEXISTING_ENV=true\n", encoding="utf-8")
    skill_file.write_text(json.dumps({"enabled": False}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    vscode_file.write_text(json.dumps({"editor.formatOnSave": False}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    parser = install_module.build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(
        [
            "--project-root",
            str(project_root),
            "--config-dir",
            str(config_dir),
        ]
    )
    config = install_module.build_install_config(args)

    monkeypatch.setattr(install_module, "_create_virtualenv", lambda project_root: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(install_module, "_install_project_editable", lambda project_root: None)

    result = install_module.run_install(config)

    skipped = set(result.skipped_paths)
    assert str(config_file) in skipped
    assert str(env_file) in skipped
    assert str(skill_file) in skipped
    assert str(vscode_file) in skipped

    assert json.loads(config_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == {"preexisting": True}
    assert env_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "PREEXISTING_ENV=true\n"
    assert json.loads(skill_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == {"enabled": False}
    assert json.loads(vscode_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == {"editor.formatOnSave": False}

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from typing import Any

import pytest


MODULE_CANDIDATES = (
    "cliverify",
    "ironclaw.cliverify",
    "app.cliverify",
)


def _import_cliverify_module() -> Any:
    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for module_name in MODULE_CANDIDATES:
        try:
            return importlib.import_module(module_name)
        except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
            last_error = exc
    raise AssertionError(
        "Unable to import cliverify module. Expected one of: "
        + ", ".join(MODULE_CANDIDATES)
    ) from last_error


@pytest.fixture()
def cliverify_module() -> Any:
    return _import_cliverify_module()


def _resolve_callable(module: Any, *names: str) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        value = getattr(module, name, None)
        if callable(value):
            return value
    raise AssertionError(f"Expected one of these callables to exist: {', '.join(names)}")


def _invoke_with_supported_kwargs(func: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    code = getattr(func, "__code__", None)
    if code is None:
        return func()

    accepted = set(code.co_varnames[: code.co_argcount])
    filtered = {key: value for key, value in kwargs.items() if key in accepted}
    return func(**filtered)


def test_cliverify_module_exposes_expected_entrypoints(cliverify_module: Any) -> None:
    candidates = (
        "verify_cli",
        "run_verify",
        "verify",
        "main",
    )
    resolved = [name for name in candidates if callable(getattr(cliverify_module, name, None))]
    assert resolved, f"Expected at least one verify entrypoint, checked: {', '.join(candidates)}"


def test_cliverify_help_style_main_returns_none_or_int(
    cliverify_module: Any,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    main_func = getattr(cliverify_module, "main", None)
    if not callable(main_func):
        pytest.skip("main() not exposed by cliverify module")

    try:
        result = _invoke_with_supported_kwargs(main_func, argv=["--help"])
    except SystemExit as exc:
        result = exc.code

    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    combined_output = f"{captured.out}\n{captured.err}".strip().lower()

    assert result is None or isinstance(result, int)
    if combined_output:
        assert "help" in combined_output or "usage" in combined_output or "verify" in combined_output


def test_cliverify_verify_like_entrypoint_accepts_noninteractive_invocation(cliverify_module: Any) -> None:
    verify_func = _resolve_callable(
        cliverify_module,
        "verify_cli",
        "run_verify",
        "verify",
    )

    try:
        result = _invoke_with_supported_kwargs(
            verify_func,
            argv=[],
            args=[],
            strict=False,
            json_output=False,
        )
    except SystemExit as exc:
        result = exc.code
    except TypeError:
        result = verify_func()

    assert result is None or isinstance(result, (int, bool, dict, str, tuple))


def test_cliverify_main_noninteractive_execution_is_process_safe(cliverify_module: Any) -> None:
    main_func = getattr(cliverify_module, "main", None)
    if not callable(main_func):
        pytest.skip("main() not exposed by cliverify module")

    try:
        result = _invoke_with_supported_kwargs(main_func, argv=[])
    except SystemExit as exc:
        result = exc.code

    assert result is None or isinstance(result, int)

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.runtime.commandsupervisor import build_command_supervisor


def _decision_attr(decision: Any, name: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
    if hasattr(decision, name):
        return getattr(decision, name)
    return default


def _decision_dict(decision: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if hasattr(decision, "as_dict"):
        body = decision.as_dict()
        if isinstance(body, dict):
            return body
    return {}


def test_allow_safe_echo_command():
    supervisor = build_command_supervisor()

    decision = supervisor.evaluate(
        command="echo hello",
        cwd="/workspace",
        metadata={"source": "unit-test"},
    )

    assert _decision_attr(decision, "allowed") is True
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "verdict") == "allow"
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "command") == "echo hello"
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "cwd") == "/workspace"
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "should_review") is False
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "should_block") is False
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "should_quarantine") is False


def test_missing_command_quarantines():
    supervisor = build_command_supervisor()

    decision = supervisor.evaluate(command="")

    matched_rules = list(_decision_attr(decision, "matched_rules", []) or [])

    assert _decision_attr(decision, "allowed") is False
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "verdict") == "quarantine"
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "should_quarantine") is True
    assert "missing_command" in matched_rules


def test_whitespace_command_quarantines():
    supervisor = build_command_supervisor()

    decision = supervisor.evaluate(command="   ")

    matched_rules = list(_decision_attr(decision, "matched_rules", []) or [])

    assert _decision_attr(decision, "allowed") is False
    assert _decision_attr(decision, "verdict") == "quarantine"
    assert "missing_command" in matched_rules

        ("dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sda", "dangerous_token:dd"),
    ],
)

    assert _decision_attr(decision, "verdict") in {"review", "block", "quarantine"}

    ]
    assert len(sudo_reasons) <= 1

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.corebilling import build_core_billing


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_core_billing_returns_object() -> None:
    core = build_core_billing()

    assert core is not None


def test_core_billing_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_core_billing())

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload


def test_core_billing_contains_core_fields_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_core_billing())

    expected_candidates = {
        "billingid",
        "ownerid",
        "wallet",
        "ledger",
        "packages",
        "usage",
        "quota",
        "remaining",
        "status",
        "generatedat",
    }
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)


def test_core_billing_identifiers_are_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_core_billing())

    if result is not None:

        package_id = _text(payload, "packageid", "package_id", "planid", "plan_id")
        if package_id is not None:
            assert package_id.strip()

client = TestClient(app)


def _install_fresh_registry():
    registry = create_api_key_registry()

    original_get_api_key_registry = app.routes[0].endpoint.__globals__.get("get_api_key_registry")
    return registry, original_get_api_key_registry


def test_create_customer_key_returns_revealed_once_secret(monkeypatch) -> None:
    from app.routes import customerkeys as customerkeys_module

    registry = create_api_key_registry()
    monkeypatch.setattr(customerkeys_module, "get_api_key_registry", lambda: registry)

    response = client.post(
        "/customer-keys",
        json={
            "label": "Primary Production Key",
            "owner_type": "customer",
            "owner_id": "tenant-123",
            "scopes": ["scan:write", "history:read"],
            "environment": "production",
            "metadata": {"rotation_due": False},
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")

    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert data["operation"] == "create"
    assert data["label"] == "Primary Production Key"
    assert data["key_status"] == "active"
    assert data["owner_type"] == "customer"
    assert data["owner_id"] == "tenant-123"
    assert data["scopes"] == ["scan:write", "history:read"]
    assert data["revealed_once_key"]
    assert data["revealed_once_key"].startswith("icg1_")
    assert "â€¦" in data["masked_key"] or len(data["masked_key"]) <= 12


def test_rotate_customer_key_invalidates_old_secret_and_returns_new_one(monkeypatch) -> None:
    from app.routes import customerkeys as customerkeys_module

    registry = create_api_key_registry()
    monkeypatch.setattr(customerkeys_module, "get_api_key_registry", lambda: registry)

    created = registry.create_key(
        display_name="Rotate Me",
        metadata={
            "owner_type": "customer",
            "owner_id": "tenant-rotate",
            "scopes": ["scan:write"],
            "environment": "production",
            "rotation_due": True,
        },
    )
    old_secret = created.raw_key
    assert old_secret is not None

    response = client.post(f"/customer-keys/{created.key_id}/rotate")
    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert data["operation"] == "rotate"
    assert data["key_id"] == created.key_id
    assert data["revealed_once_key"]
    assert data["revealed_once_key"] != old_secret
    assert data["metadata"]["rotation_due"] is False

    assert registry.resolve_api_key(old_secret) is None
    assert registry.resolve_api_key(data["revealed_once_key"]) is not None


def test_revoke_customer_key_marks_key_revoked(monkeypatch) -> None:
    from app.routes import customerkeys as customerkeys_module

    registry = create_api_key_registry()
    monkeypatch.setattr(customerkeys_module, "get_api_key_registry", lambda: registry)

    created = registry.create_key(
        display_name="Revoke Me",
        metadata={
            "owner_type": "customer",
            "owner_id": "tenant-revoke",
            "scopes": ["history:read"],
            "environment": "staging",
        },
    )
    created_secret = created.raw_key
    assert created_secret is not None

    response = client.post(f"/customer-keys/{created.key_id}/revoke")
    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert data["operation"] == "revoke"
    assert data["key_id"] == created.key_id
    assert data["key_status"] == "revoked"
    assert data["revealed_once_key"] is None

    revoked_record = registry.get_key(created.key_id)
    assert revoked_record is not None
    assert revoked_record.active is False
    assert registry.resolve_api_key(created_secret) is None

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Final

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app


DATA_RETENTION_PATH: Final[str] = "/data/retention"


@pytest.fixture()
def client() -> TestClient:
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def _get_payload(client: TestClient) -> tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]:
    response = client.get(DATA_RETENTION_PATH)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    return response, payload


def test_data_retention_route_is_registered(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.get(DATA_RETENTION_PATH)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text


def test_data_retention_returns_json_object(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response, data = _get_payload(client)

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(data, dict)


def test_data_retention_contains_basic_shape(client: TestClient) -> None:
    _, data = _get_payload(client)

    assert data
    assert any(
        key in data
        for key in (
            "title",
            "policies",
            "items",
            "summary",
            "status",
        )
    )


def test_data_retention_surface_does_not_return_array_root(client: TestClient) -> None:
    _, data = _get_payload(client)
    assert not isinstance(data, list)


def test_data_retention_nested_collections_are_json_safe_when_present(client: TestClient) -> None:
    _, data = _get_payload(client)

    for key in ("policies", "items"):
        if key in data:
            assert isinstance(data[key], list)


def test_data_retention_status_field_is_string_when_present(client: TestClient) -> None:

    if "status" in data:
        assert isinstance(data["status"], str)
        assert data["status"].strip()

    if "title" in data:
        assert isinstance(data["title"], str)
        assert data["title"].strip()

    _, data = _get_payload(client)

    if "summary" in data:
        assert isinstance(data["summary"], (str, dict, list))


def test_data_retention_response_is_stable_across_repeated_reads(client: TestClient) -> None:

    second_response, second_payload = _get_payload(client)

FILE: tests\testdeploymentreadiness.py
================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Final

import pytest


ROOT: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPT_CANDIDATES: Final[tuple[Path, ...]] = (
    ROOT / "scripts" / "deploymentreadiness.py",
    ROOT / "scripts" / "deployment_readiness.py",
)
SCRIPT: Final[Path] = next((path for path in SCRIPT_CANDIDATES if path.exists()), SCRIPT_CANDIDATES[0])
RESULT_FILE_CANDIDATES: Final[tuple[Path, ...]] = (
    ROOT / ".deployment-readiness.json",
    ROOT / "output" / "deployment-readiness.json",
)

PASS_STATUSES: Final[set[str]] = {"ok", "pass"}
NONPASS_STATUSES: Final[set[str]] = {"warn", "fail"}
ALL_STATUSES: Final[set[str]] = PASS_STATUSES | NONPASS_STATUSES


def _run_with_env(env: dict[str, str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT)],
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        env=env,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    )


def _base_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(
        {
            "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql://ironclaw:secret@localhost:5432/ironclaw",
            "SUPABASE_DB_URL": "postgresql://ironclaw:secret@localhost:5432/ironclaw",
            "POSTGRES_URL": "postgresql://ironclaw:secret@localhost:5432/ironclaw",
            "SUPABASE_URL": "https://example.supabase.co",
            "SUPABASE_KEY": "supabase_key_for_test_validation",
            "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY": "supabase_service_role_for_test_validation",
            "OPENAI_API_KEY": "openai_key_for_test_validation",
            "GROQ_API_KEY": "groq_key_for_test_validation",
            "SECRET_KEY": "very_strong_secret_key_value",
            "JWT_SECRET": "very_strong_jwt_secret_value",
            "API_SECRET": "very_strong_api_secret_value",
            "IRONCLAW_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS": "30",
            "IRONCLAW_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION": "true",
            "IRONCLAW_BACKUP_CHECKSUM": "true",
        }
    )
    return env


def _cleanup_result_files() -> None:
    for path in RESULT_FILE_CANDIDATES:
        try:
            path.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass


def _result_file_path() -> Path:
    for path in RESULT_FILE_CANDIDATES:
        if path.exists():
            return path
    return RESULT_FILE_CANDIDATES[0]


def _normalize_top_level_status(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    status = payload.get("status")
    if isinstance(status, str):
        normalized = status.strip().lower()
        assert normalized in ALL_STATUSES
        return normalized

    overall_status = payload.get("overall_status")
    if isinstance(overall_status, str):
        normalized = overall_status.strip().lower()
        assert normalized in ALL_STATUSES
        return normalized

    raise AssertionError("result payload missing status field")


def _payload_checks(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    checks = payload.get("checks")
    assert isinstance(checks, list)
    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in checks:
        assert isinstance(item, dict)
        normalized.append(item)
    return normalized


def _read_result_file() -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = _result_file_path()
    assert path.exists(), f"missing deployment readiness result file: {path}"
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    _normalize_top_level_status(payload)
    _payload_checks(payload)
    return payload


def _check_name(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    name = item.get("name")
    assert isinstance(name, str)
    assert name.strip()
    return name


def _check_ok(item: dict[str, Any]) -> bool | None:
    ok = item.get("ok")
    if isinstance(ok, bool):
        return ok

    status = item.get("status")
    if isinstance(status, str):
        normalized = status.strip().lower()
        if normalized in PASS_STATUSES:
            return True
        if normalized in NONPASS_STATUSES:
            return False

    return None


def _combined_output(completed: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]) -> str:
    return f"{completed.stdout}\n{completed.stderr}".strip()


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _isolate_result_files() -> Iterator[None]:
    _cleanup_result_files()
    yield
    _cleanup_result_files()


def test_deployment_readiness_script_exists() -> None:
    assert SCRIPT.exists()
    assert SCRIPT.is_file()


def test_deployment_readiness_passes_with_valid_environment() -> None:
    env = _base_env()
    completed = _run_with_env(env)

    assert completed.returncode == 0, _combined_output(completed)

    payload = _read_result_file()
    assert _normalize_top_level_status(payload) in PASS_STATUSES

    checks = _payload_checks(payload)
    normalized = [_check_ok(check) for check in checks]
    assert normalized
    assert all(value is True for value in normalized if value is not None)


def test_deployment_readiness_fails_with_missing_supabase_configuration() -> None:
    env = _base_env()
    env.pop("SUPABASE_URL", None)
    env.pop("SUPABASE_KEY", None)
    env.pop("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", None)

    completed = _run_with_env(env)

    assert completed.returncode in {0, 1}, _combined_output(completed)

    payload = _read_result_file()
    assert _normalize_top_level_status(payload) in NONPASS_STATUSES

    checks = _payload_checks(payload)
    assert any(
        _check_name(check) in {"supabase-config", "environment_configuration"} and _check_ok(check) is False
        for check in checks
    )


def test_deployment_readiness_fails_with_missing_database_configuration() -> None:
    env = _base_env()
    env.pop("DATABASE_URL", None)
    env.pop("SUPABASE_DB_URL", None)
    env.pop("POSTGRES_URL", None)

    completed = _run_with_env(env)

    assert completed.returncode in {0, 1}, _combined_output(completed)

    payload = _read_result_file()
    assert _normalize_top_level_status(payload) in NONPASS_STATUSES

    checks = _payload_checks(payload)
    check_names = {_check_name(check) for check in checks}
    assert check_names

    database_related = {"database-config", "supabase_migrations", "environment_configuration"}
    assert any(name in database_related for name in check_names)


def test_deployment_readiness_fails_on_weak_secret_values_when_enforced() -> None:
    env = _base_env()
    env["SECRET_KEY"] = "changeme"
    env["JWT_SECRET"] = "short"

    completed = _run_with_env(env)
    payload = _read_result_file()

    assert completed.returncode in {0, 1}, _combined_output(completed)
    assert _normalize_top_level_status(payload) in ALL_STATUSES

    checks = _payload_checks(payload)
    if any(_check_name(check) == "secrets-quality" for check in checks):
        assert any(
            _check_name(check) == "secrets-quality" and _check_ok(check) is False
            for check in checks
        )
    else:
        pytest.skip("secrets-quality readiness check is not implemented by this script")


def test_deployment_readiness_result_surface_is_strict_status_shape() -> None:
    env = _base_env()
    completed = _run_with_env(env)

    assert completed.returncode in {0, 1}, _combined_output(completed)

    payload = _read_result_file()
    assert _normalize_top_level_status(payload) in ALL_STATUSES
    assert isinstance(_payload_checks(payload), list)

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import io
import zipfile

from app.services.fileinspectionservice import build_file_inspection_service


def _zip_bytes(entries: dict[str, bytes]) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        for name, content in entries.items():
            archive.writestr(name, content)
    return buffer.getvalue()


def test_file_inspection_service_builds() -> None:
    service = build_file_inspection_service()
    assert service is not None


def test_upload_allows_clean_text_file() -> None:
    service = build_file_inspection_service()

    result = service.inspect_upload(
        file_name="notes.txt",
        content=b"Normal operational summary only.",
        mime_type="text/plain",
        metadata={"source": "ui"},
    )

    assert result.verdict == "allow"
    assert result.allowed is True
    assert result.blocked is False
    assert result.should_review is False
    assert result.should_quarantine is False
    assert result.findings_detected >= 0
    assert result.secrets_redacted == 0
    assert result.file_name == "notes.txt"
    assert result.mime_type == "text/plain"
    assert result.checksum_sha256
    assert result.content["is_text"] is True
    assert result.output["blocked"] is False


def test_upload_reviews_secret_text_and_redacts() -> None:
    service = build_file_inspection_service()

    result = service.inspect_upload(
        file_name="export.txt",
        content=b"OpenAI token sk-1234567890abcdefghijklmnop inside report.",
        mime_type="text/plain",
        metadata={"source": "api"},
    )

    assert result.verdict in {"review", "sanitize", "block", "quarantine"}
    assert result.findings_detected >= 1
    assert result.secrets_redacted >= 1
    assert result.redaction["changed"] is True
    assert "[REDACTED_" in result.redaction["text"] or "[REDACTED_" in result.output["sanitized_text"]


def test_upload_blocks_private_key_material() -> None:
    service = build_file_inspection_service()

    private_key = (
        b"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n"
        b"MIIEvQIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAASC\n"
        b"FAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE\n"
        b"-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"
    )
    result = service.inspect_upload(
        file_name="id_rsa.pem",
        content=private_key,
        mime_type="application/x-pem-file",
        metadata={"source": "api"},
    )

    assert result.verdict in {"block", "quarantine"}
    assert result.allowed is False
    assert result.blocked is True
    assert result.should_quarantine is True

def test_as_dict_shape_is_stable() -> None:
    service = build_file_inspection_service()

    result = service.inspect_upload(
        file_name="notes.txt",
        content=b"safe text",
        mime_type="text/plain",
        metadata={"source": "ui"},
    )
    payload = result.as_dict()

    assert payload["verdict"] == result.verdict
    assert payload["allowed"] == result.allowed
    assert payload["blocked"] == result.blocked
    assert payload["shouldreview"] == result.should_review
    assert payload["shouldquarantine"] == result.should_quarantine
    assert payload["findingsdetected"] == result.findings_detected
    assert payload["secretsredacted"] == result.secrets_redacted
    assert payload["sizebytes"] == result.size_bytes
    assert payload["filename"] == result.file_name
    assert payload["mimetype"] == result.mime_type
    assert payload["checksumsha256"] == result.checksum_sha256
    assert isinstance(payload["reasons"], list)
    assert isinstance(payload["findings"], list)
    assert isinstance(payload["redaction"], dict)
    assert isinstance(payload["content"], dict)
    assert isinstance(payload["archive"], dict)
    assert isinstance(payload["output"], dict)

def test_policy_dict_contains_expected_shapes(guard):
    policy = guard.evaluate(path="artifacts/report.txt", content="safe content")
    body = policy.as_dict()

    assert body["verdict"] == policy.verdict
    assert body["allowed"] is True
    assert isinstance(body["reasons"], list)
    assert isinstance(body["matchedrules"], list)
    assert "artifactanalysis" in body
    assert "downloadanalysis" in body
    assert "outputsanitization" in body
    assert "fileinspection" in body


def test_reasons_and_rules_are_deduplicated_when_analyzers_repeat_signals(monkeypatch, guard):
    repeated_analysis = {
        "riskdelta": 25,
        "shouldreview": True,
        "reasons": [
            {
                "source": "artifactanalyzer",
                "label": "Repeated",
                "details": "Same reason",
                "score": 25,
            },
            {
                "source": "artifactanalyzer",
                "label": "Repeated",
                "details": "Same reason",
                "score": 25,
            },
        ],
    }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "app.runtime.filereturnguard.analyze_artifact_dict",
        lambda **kwargs: repeated_analysis,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "app.runtime.filereturnguard.analyze_download_dict",
        lambda **kwargs: {"riskdelta": 0, "reasons": []},
    )

    class _Sanitized:
        def as_dict(self):
            return {"blocked": False, "score": 0.0}

    class _Sanitizer:
        def sanitize(self, *args, **kwargs):
            return _Sanitized()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "app.runtime.filereturnguard.build_output_sanitizer",
        lambda: _Sanitizer(),
    )

    class _InspectionResult:
        def as_dict(self):
            return {"riskdelta": 0, "reasons": [], "blocked": False, "shouldreview": False}

    class _InspectionService:
        def inspect_artifact(self, **kwargs):
            return _InspectionResult()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "app.runtime.filereturnguard.build_file_inspection_service",
        lambda **kwargs: _InspectionService(),
    )

    policy = guard.evaluate(path="artifacts/report.txt", content="safe")

    repeated = [
        item
        for item in policy.reasons
        if item["label"] == "Repeated" and item["details"] == "Same reason"
    ]
    assert len(repeated) == 1
    assert policy.matched_rules.count("artifactanalyzer:review") == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.core.auth import API_KEY_HEADER_NAME
from app.main import create_app


def _make_app() -> FastAPI:
    return create_app()


def _auth_headers(api_key: str = "test-api-key", **extra_headers: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    headers = {API_KEY_HEADER_NAME: api_key}
    headers.update(extra_headers)
    return headers


def test_missing_api_key_returns_unauthorized_or_forbidden() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.get("/organizations")

    assert response.status_code in {401, 403}


def test_blank_api_key_keeps_error_contract() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.get("/organizations", headers=_auth_headers(api_key=""))

    assert response.status_code in {401, 403, 422}


def test_protected_auth_routes_reject_missing_api_key() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    paths = [
        "/api/auth/context",
        "/api/operator-auth/context",
        "/api/customer-auth/context",
        "/api/session-security/context",
        "/api/access-control/context",
        "/api/org-context/context",
    ]

    for path in paths:
        response = client.get(path)
        assert response.status_code in {401, 403}


def test_permission_routes_reject_missing_api_key() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    paths = [
        "/api/operator-auth/permissions/read",
        "/api/operator-auth/permissions/write",
        "/api/customer-auth/permissions/read",
        "/api/customer-auth/permissions/write",
    ]

    for path in paths:
        response = client.get(path)
        assert response.status_code in {401, 403}


def test_explicit_org_context_endpoint_rejects_missing_auth() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.get(
        "/api/org-context/explicit",
        headers={"x-org-id": "org-test"},
    )

    assert response.status_code in {401, 403}


def test_invalid_auth_requests_keep_json_error_shape_when_present() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.get("/api/auth/context")

    assert response.status_code in {401, 403}
    if response.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("application/json"):
        body = response.json()
        assert isinstance(body, dict)


def test_forbidden_style_responses_do_not_return_success_status() -> None:
    app = _make_app()
    client = TestClient(app)

    paths = [
        "/organizations",
        "/dashboard/overview",
        "/api/auth/context",
        "/api/operator-auth/context",
        "/api/customer-auth/context",
    ]

    for path in paths:
        response = client.get(path)
        assert response.status_code not in {200, 201, 202, 204}

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.adapters.genericagentadapter import GenericAgentAdapter


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _PolicyDecision:
    allowed: bool = True
    verdict: str = "allow"
    bundle_id: str = "bundle-001"
    version: str = "2026.04.25"
    runtime: str = "future-runtime"
    override_active: bool = False
    rollout_enabled: bool = True
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "bundleid": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "overrideactive": self.override_active,
            "rolloutenabled": self.rollout_enabled,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


class _PolicyEnforcerStub:
    def __init__(self, decision: _PolicyDecision | None = None) -> None:
        self.decision = decision or _PolicyDecision()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _PolicyDecision:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.decision

    def allow(self, **kwargs: Any) -> bool:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.decision.allowed


class _GenericRuntimeClientStub:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.execute_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.result: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "ok",
            "runtime": "future-runtime",
            "response": {"message": "generic adapter executed safely"},
            "usage": {"input_units": 10, "output_units": 4},
        }

    def execute(self, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.execute_calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return dict(self.result)


def _build_adapter(decision: _PolicyDecision | None = None):
    enforcer = _PolicyEnforcerStub(decision)
    runtime = _GenericRuntimeClientStub()
    adapter = GenericAgentAdapter(
        policy_enforcer=enforcer,
        runtime_client=runtime,
    )
    return adapter, enforcer, runtime


def _request_payload() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "bundle": {
            "bundle_id": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "policy": {
                "default_verdict": "allow",
                "rules": [{"id": "safe-generic", "action": "allow"}],
            },
        },
        "signature": "signed-bundle",
        "secret": "ironclaw-secret",
        "manifest": {
            "bundleid": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
            "digest": "a" * 64,
        },
        "runtime": "future-runtime",
        "action": "agent.execute",
        "payload": {
            "instructions": "perform safe analysis",
            "input": {"repo": "ironclaw"},
        },
        "context": {
            "organization_id": "org-001",
            "risk": "low",
            "capability": "generic-agent",
        },
    }


def test_allows_generic_runtime_execution_when_policy_allows():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            runtime="future-runtime",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified", "rollout:enabled"],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is True
    assert result["verdict"] == "allow"
    assert result["runtime"] == "future-runtime"
    assert result["policy"]["bundleid"] == "bundle-001"
    assert result["policy"]["version"] == "2026.04.25"
    assert result["result"]["status"] == "ok"
    assert result["result"]["response"]["message"] == "generic adapter executed safely"
    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 1


def test_blocks_generic_runtime_when_policy_blocks():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=False,
            verdict="block",
            runtime="future-runtime",
            matched_rules=["signature_mismatch"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Bad signature", "details": "Bundle verification failed"}],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is False
    assert result["verdict"] == "block"
    assert result["runtime"] == "future-runtime"
    assert "signature_mismatch" in result["policy"]["matchedrules"]
    assert result["result"] is None or result["result"].get("status") != "ok"
    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 0


def test_review_verdict_prevents_generic_runtime_call():

            matched_rules=["bundle:verified"],
        )
    )

    payload = _request_payload()
    payload["prompt"] = ""

    result = brain.evaluate_request(**payload)

    assert result["allowed"] is True
    assert result["verdict"] == "allow"
    assert len(client.generate_calls) == 1


def test_override_and_rollout_flags_are_exposed():

        _PolicyDecision(

        )
    )

    assert result["policy"]["rolloutenabled"] is False
    assert "override:allow" in result["policy"]["matchedrules"]

        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified"],
        )
    )

    def _boom(**kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        raise RuntimeError("groq failure")

    client.generate = _boom  # type: ignore[method-assign]

    result = brain.evaluate_request(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is False
    assert result["verdict"] in {"error", "block"}
    assert "runtime_execution_error" in result["policy"]["matchedrules"]
    assert result["result"] is None or "error" in result

    duplicates = [
        item
        for item in result["policy"]["reasons"]
        if item["label"] == "Same" and item["details"] == "duplicate"
    ]
    assert len(duplicates) == 1
