from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


import pytest


from app.history import build_history



def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_history_returns_object() -> None:
    history = build_history()

    assert history is not None


def test_history_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_history())

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload


def test_history_contains_core_fields_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_history())

    expected_candidates = {
        "historyid",
        "sessionid",
        "entries",
        "events",
        "items",
        "status",
        "generatedat",
        "createdat",
    }
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)


def test_history_identifiers_are_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_history())

    for value in (
        _text(payload, "historyid", "history_id", "id"),
        _text(payload, "sessionid", "session_id", "runtime_session_id"),
        _text(payload, "status", "state"),
    ):
        if value is not None:
            assert value.strip()


def test_history_collections_have_expected_types_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_history())

    entries = _value(payload, "entries", "events", "items", "records")

    if entries is not None:
        assert isinstance(entries, (list, dict))


def test_history_supports_session_bound_build_when_available() -> None:
    try:
        history = build_history(session_id="session-001")
    except TypeError:
        history = build_history()

    payload = _payload_of(history)
    session_id = _text(payload, "sessionid", "session_id", "runtime_session_id")
    if session_id is not None:
        assert session_id.strip()


def test_history_append_event_flow_when_supported() -> None:
    history = build_history()

    append_methods = ("append_event", "add_event", "record_event", "push_event")
    if not any(hasattr(history, name) and callable(getattr(history, name)) for name in append_methods):
        pytest.skip("history append method not implemented")

    try:
        result = _call_method_if_present(
            history,
            append_methods,
            event_type="scan.completed",
            message="scan complete",
            status="ok",
        )
    except TypeError:
        result = _call_method_if_present(
            history,
            append_methods,
            "scan.completed",
            "scan complete",
            "ok",
        )

    if result is not None:
        payload = _payload_of(result)
        event_type = _text(payload, "eventtype", "event_type", "type")
        if event_type is not None:
            assert event_type.strip()


def test_history_rejects_blank_event_type_when_supported() -> None:
    history = build_history()

    append_methods = ("append_event", "add_event", "record_event", "push_event")
    if not any(hasattr(history, name) and callable(getattr(history, name)) for name in append_methods):
        pytest.skip("history append method not implemented")

    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        try:
            _call_method_if_present(
                history,
                append_methods,
                event_type="",
                message="scan complete",
                status="ok",
            )
        except TypeError:
            _call_method_if_present(history, append_methods, "", "scan complete", "ok")


def test_history_entries_have_stable_shape_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_history())
    entries = _value(payload, "entries", "events", "items", "records")

    if entries is None:
        pytest.skip("history does not expose entries collection")

    if isinstance(entries, dict):
        iterable = list(entries.values())
    else:
        iterable = list(entries)

    for entry in iterable:
        assert isinstance(entry, dict)
        assert any(
            key in entry
            for key in (
                "eventtype",
                "event_type",
                "message",
                "status",
                "timestamp",
                "createdat",
                "created_at",
            )
        )


def test_history_multiple_builds_have_stable_key_sets() -> None:
    first = _payload_of(build_history())
    second = _payload_of(build_history())

    assert set(first.keys()) == set(second.keys())


def test_history_payload_uses_json_friendly_values() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_history())

    for key, value in payload.items():
        assert isinstance(key, str)
        assert value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict))

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Final

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app


HISTORY_PATHS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "/history",
    "/api/history",
    "/api/v1/history",
)
HISTORY_DETAIL_PATHS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "/history/history-001",
    "/api/history/history-001",
    "/api/v1/history/history-001",
)


@pytest.fixture()
def client() -> TestClient:
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def _items_payload(payload: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(payload, list):
        return [item for item in payload if isinstance(item, dict)]
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        for key in ("items", "entries", "events", "history", "results", "data"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                return [item for item in value if isinstance(item, dict)]
    return []


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            value = payload[key]
            if isinstance(value, str):
                return value
            return str(value)
    return None


def _assert_historyish_entry(entry: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    assert isinstance(entry, dict)
    assert any(
        key in entry
        for key in (
            "eventtype",
            "event_type",
            "message",
            "status",
            "timestamp",
            "createdat",
            "created_at",
            "historyid",
            "history_id",
            "id",
        )
    )


def _first_available_history_response(
    client: TestClient,
    *,
    params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, Any]:
    observed_statuses: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    for path in HISTORY_PATHS:
        response = client.get(path, params=params)
        observed_statuses.append((path, response.status_code))
        if response.status_code == 200:
            assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
            return path, response

    raise AssertionError(f"history endpoint not available on expected paths: {observed_statuses}")


def test_history_endpoint_is_available_on_common_paths(client: TestClient) -> None:
    observed_statuses: list[int] = []

    for path in HISTORY_PATHS:
        response = client.get(path)
        observed_statuses.append(response.status_code)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
            return

    assert any(status not in {404, 405} for status in observed_statuses), observed_statuses


def test_history_endpoint_returns_json_when_available(client: TestClient) -> None:
    _, response = _first_available_history_response(client)

    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, (list, dict))


def test_history_endpoint_returns_collection_shape_when_available(
    client: TestClient,
) -> None:
    _, response = _first_available_history_response(client)

    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, (list, dict))

    items = _items_payload(payload)
    if isinstance(payload, list):
        assert isinstance(payload, list)
    else:
        assert items or any(
            key in payload
            for key in ("items", "entries", "events", "history", "results", "data")
        )

) -> None:

    items = _items_payload(response.json())
    for entry in items:
        _assert_historyish_entry(entry)


def test_history_endpoint_supports_session_filter_when_implemented(
    client: TestClient,
) -> None:
    observed_statuses: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    for path in HISTORY_PATHS:
        response = client.get(path, params={"session_id": "session-001"})
        observed_statuses.append((path, response.status_code))
        if response.status_code == 200:
            payload = response.json()
            assert isinstance(payload, (list, dict))
            return
        if response.status_code in {400, 422}:
            return

    raise AssertionError(
        f"history endpoint not available on expected paths: {observed_statuses}"
    )


def test_history_detail_endpoint_behaves_reasonably_when_available(
    client: TestClient,
) -> None:
    observed_statuses: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    for path in HISTORY_DETAIL_PATHS:
        response = client.get(path)
        observed_statuses.append((path, response.status_code))
        if response.status_code == 404:
            continue

        assert response.status_code in {200, 400, 422}, observed_statuses
        if response.status_code == 200:
            assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
            payload = response.json()
            assert isinstance(payload, dict)
            assert _text(payload, "historyid", "history_id", "id")
        return

    assert all(status == 404 for _, status in observed_statuses), observed_statuses

    client: TestClient,
) -> None:
    path, get_response = _first_available_history_response(client)

    assert get_response.status_code == 200
    post_response = client.post(path, json={})
    assert post_response.status_code in {400, 404, 405, 422}


def test_history_endpoint_response_is_json_friendly(client: TestClient) -> None:

    assert isinstance(payload, (list, dict))

    client: TestClient,
) -> None:

    second_response = client.get(path)

    assert first_response.status_code == 200
    assert second_response.status_code == 200
    assert second_response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
    assert first_response.json() == second_response.json()

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from typing import Any, Final

import pytest


MODULE_CANDIDATES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.services.history",
    "services.history",
    "history",
)


def _load_module() -> Any:
    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for name in MODULE_CANDIDATES:
        try:
            return importlib.import_module(name)
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
            last_error = exc
    raise AssertionError(f"unable to import history module: {last_error}")


def _first_callable(target: Any, *names: str) -> Any | None:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            value = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(value):
                return value
    return None


def _serialize(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(getattr(value, "model_dump")):
        data = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(getattr(value, "dict")):
        data = value.dict()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    if hasattr(value, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(value, "as_dict")):
        data = value.as_dict()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(value):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        attr = getattr(value, name)
        if callable(attr):
            continue
        if isinstance(attr, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = attr
    return payload


def _items(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in ("items", "results", "rows", "history", "entries", "events", "data"):
            candidate = value.get(key)
            if isinstance(candidate, list):
                return candidate
        return [value]
    return [value]


def _build_history_store(module: Any) -> Any:
    factory = _first_callable(
        module,
        "build_history_store",
        "create_history_store",
        "get_history_store",
        "build_history",
        "create_history",
        "get_history",
    )
    if factory is not None:
        try:
            return factory()
        except TypeError:
            try:
                return factory(mode="memory")
            except TypeError:
                try:
                    return factory(backend="memory")
                except TypeError:
                    pytest.skip("history factory requires unsupported arguments")

    for cls_name in ("HistoryStore", "HistoryService", "InMemoryHistoryStore", "SupabaseHistoryStore"):
        if hasattr(module, cls_name):
            cls = getattr(module, cls_name)
            if callable(cls):
                try:
                    return cls()
                except TypeError:
                    continue

    pytest.skip("history store/service builder not implemented")


def test_history_module_imports() -> None:
    module = _load_module()
    assert module is not None


def test_history_exposes_public_surface() -> None:

def test_history_store_can_be_built() -> None:

    )

    )
    latest = _first_callable(store, "latest", "last", "most_recent", "get_latest")
    reader = _first_callable(store, "list", "fetch", "all", "read")

    if writer is None:
        pytest.skip("history write operation not implemented")

    first_entry = {
        "entry_id": "hist-order-001",
        "session_id": "sess-order-001",
        "actor": "system",
        "action": "history.first",
        "status": "ok",
        "timestamp": "2026-04-26T10:45:00Z",
    }
    second_entry = {
        "entry_id": "hist-order-002",
        "session_id": "sess-order-001",
        "actor": "system",
        "action": "history.second",
        "status": "ok",
        "timestamp": "2026-04-26T10:46:00Z",
    }

    try:
        writer(first_entry)
        writer(second_entry)
    except TypeError:
        try:
            writer(**first_entry)
            writer(**second_entry)
        except TypeError:
            pytest.skip("writer signature unsupported")

    if latest is not None:
        result = latest()
        assert result is not None
        return

    if reader is not None:
        try:
            rows = reader()
        except TypeError:
            try:
                rows = reader(limit=10)
            except TypeError:
                pytest.skip("reader signature unsupported")
        assert rows is not None
        return

    pytest.skip("no latest/read operation implemented")

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.api.incidents import (
    get_attack_correlation_service,
    router,
)


class StubAttackCorrelationService:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls = []

    def correlate(
        self,
        signals,
        *,
        session_id=None,
        actor_id=None,
        organization_id=None,
        request_id=None,
        metadata=None,
    ):
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "signals": signals,
                "session_id": session_id,
                "actor_id": actor_id,
                "organization_id": organization_id,
                "request_id": request_id,
                "metadata": metadata,
            }
        )
        return {
            "risk_score": 72,
            "risk_band": "high",
            "confidence": 0.88,
            "incident": {
                "incident_id": "inc-001",
                "status": "action_required",
                "severity": "high",
                "signal_count": len(signals),
                "indicators": {
                    "prompt_fingerprints": ["pf-001"],
                    "tools": ["shell"],
                    "files": [],
                    "hashes": [],
                    "domains": [],
                    "ips": [],
                    "campaigns": [],
                    "clusters": [],
                    "ttp_ids": [],
                },
                "linked_reviews": ["rev-001"],
                "linked_quarantine_records": [],
                "escalation_actions": [
                    {
                        "action_id": "act-001",
                        "action": "disable-session",
                        "status": "open",
                    }
                ],
                "malware_summary": None,
                "detonation_summary": None,
                "hostile_context": None,
            },
            "signals": signals,
            "linked_reviews": ["rev-001"],
            "linked_quarantine_records": [],
            "recommended_playbooks": ["prompt-injection-containment"],
            "escalation_actions": [
                {
                    "action_id": "act-001",
                    "action": "disable-session",
                    "status": "open",
                }
            ],
        }


def _build_client(service: StubAttackCorrelationService) -> TestClient:
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(router)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_attack_correlation_service] = lambda: service
    return TestClient(app)


def test_correlate_incidents_returns_correlation_response():
    service = StubAttackCorrelationService()
    client = _build_client(service)

    response = client.post(
        "/incidents/correlate",
        json={
            "signals": [
                {
                    "signal_id": "sig-001",
                    "signal_type": "prompt_injection",
                    "source": "prompt_guard",
                    "severity": "high",
                    "summary": "Prompt attempted tool hijack",
                    "score": 72,
                    "evidence": {
                        "prompt_fingerprints": ["pf-001"],
                        "tools": ["shell"],
                    },
                    "metadata": {"origin": "unit-test"},
                }
            ],
            "session_id": "sess-001",
            "actor_id": "actor-001",
            "request_id": "req-001",
            "metadata": {"origin": "api-test"},
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body["risk_score"] == 72
    assert body["risk_band"] == "high"
    assert body["incident"]["incident_id"] == "inc-001"
    assert body["incident"]["status"] == "action_required"
    assert body["incident"]["linked_reviews"] == ["rev-001"]
    assert body["recommended_playbooks"] == ["prompt-injection-containment"]
    assert service.calls[0]["session_id"] == "sess-001"
    assert service.calls[0]["actor_id"] == "actor-001"
    assert service.calls[0]["request_id"] == "req-001"
    assert service.calls[0]["metadata"] == {"origin": "api-test"}
    assert service.calls[0]["signals"][0]["evidence"]["tools"] == ["shell"]

    assert service.calls[0]["actor_id"] == "actor-query"

    }

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from typing import Any, Final

import pytest


MODULE_CANDIDATES: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "app.services.incidentstore",
    "services.incidentstore",
    "incidentstore",
)


def _load_module() -> Any:
    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for name in MODULE_CANDIDATES:
        try:
            return importlib.import_module(name)
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover
            last_error = exc
    raise AssertionError(f"unable to import incident store module: {last_error}")


def _first_callable(target: Any, *names: str) -> Any | None:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            value = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(value):
                return value
    return None


def _serialize(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump") and callable(getattr(value, "model_dump")):
        data = value.model_dump()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    if hasattr(value, "dict") and callable(getattr(value, "dict")):
        data = value.dict()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    if hasattr(value, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(value, "as_dict")):
        data = value.as_dict()
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(value):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        attr = getattr(value, name)
        if callable(attr):
            continue
        if isinstance(attr, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = attr
    return payload


def _items(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in ("items", "results", "rows", "incidents", "data"):
            candidate = value.get(key)
            if isinstance(candidate, list):
                return candidate
        return [value]
    return [value]


def _build_store(module: Any) -> Any:
    factory = _first_callable(
        module,
        "build_incident_store",
        "create_incident_store",
        "get_incident_store",
        "build_store",
        "create_store",
        "get_store",
    )
    if factory is not None:
        try:
            return factory()
        except TypeError:
            try:
                return factory(mode="memory")
            except TypeError:
                try:
                    return factory(backend="memory")
                except TypeError:
                    pytest.skip("incident store factory requires unsupported arguments")

    for cls_name in ("IncidentStore", "InMemoryIncidentStore", "SupabaseIncidentStore"):
        if hasattr(module, cls_name):
            cls = getattr(module, cls_name)
            if callable(cls):
                try:
                    return cls()
                except TypeError:
                    continue

    pytest.skip("incident store builder/class not implemented")


def test_incident_store_module_imports() -> None:
    module = _load_module()
    assert module is not None


def test_incident_store_exposes_public_surface() -> None:
    module = _load_module()
    public_names = {name for name in dir(module) if not name.startswith("_")}
    assert public_names


def test_incident_store_can_be_built() -> None:
    module = _load_module()
    store = _build_store(module)
    assert store is not None

        result = lookup(incident_id)
    except TypeError:
        try:
            result = lookup(incident_id=incident_id)
        except TypeError:
            pytest.skip("lookup signature unsupported")

    assert result is not None


def test_incident_store_supports_latest_or_ordered_reads_when_available() -> None:
    module = _load_module()
    store = _build_store(module)

    writer = _first_callable(
        store,
        "create",
        "insert",
        "add",
        "record",
        "save",
        "open_incident",
        "append",
        "write",
    )
    latest = _first_callable(store, "latest", "last", "most_recent", "get_latest")
    reader = _first_callable(store, "list", "fetch", "all", "read")

    if writer is None:
        pytest.skip("incident write operation not implemented")

    first_incident = {
        "incident_id": "inc-order-001",
        "title": "First incident",
        "severity": "low",
        "status": "open",
        "source": "engine",
        "summary": "First ordered incident.",
        "timestamp": "2026-04-26T10:56:00Z",
    }
    second_incident = {
        "incident_id": "inc-order-002",
        "title": "Second incident",
        "severity": "high",
        "status": "open",
        "source": "engine",
        "summary": "Second ordered incident.",
        "timestamp": "2026-04-26T10:57:00Z",
    }

    try:
        writer(first_incident)
        writer(second_incident)
    except TypeError:
        try:
            writer(**first_incident)
            writer(**second_incident)
        except TypeError:
            pytest.skip("writer signature unsupported")

    if latest is not None:
        result = latest()
        assert result is not None
        return

    if reader is not None:
        try:
            rows = reader()
        except TypeError:
            try:
                rows = reader(limit=10)
            except TypeError:
                pytest.skip("reader signature unsupported")
        assert rows is not None
        return

    pytest.skip("no latest/read operation implemented")


def test_incident_store_supports_supabase_mode_when_available(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    module = _load_module()

    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_URL", "https://example.supabase.co")
    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_KEY", "test-service-role-key")
    monkeypatch.setenv("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY", "test-service-role-key")

    factory = _first_callable(
        module,
        "build_incident_store",
        "create_incident_store",
        "get_incident_store",
        "build_store",
        "create_store",
        "get_store",
    )
    if factory is None:
        pytest.skip("incident store factory not implemented")

    try:
        store = factory(mode="supabase")
    except TypeError:
        try:
            store = factory(backend="supabase")
        except TypeError:
            pytest.skip("explicit supabase backend selection not implemented")

    assert store is not None

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.services.integrationinstaller import build_integration_installer


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _VerificationResult:
    ok: bool = True
    allowed: bool = True
    runtime: str = "openclaw"
    verdict: str = "allow"
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _RegistryInstallResult:
    ok: bool = True
    installed: bool = True
    runtime: str = "openclaw"
    adapter: str = "openclaw"
    status: str = "installed"
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "installed": self.installed,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "adapter": self.adapter,
            "status": self.status,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _ActivateResult:
    ok: bool = True
    active: bool = True
    runtime: str = "openclaw"
    status: str = "active"
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "active": self.active,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "status": self.status,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


class _IntegrationVerifierStub:
    def __init__(self, result: _VerificationResult | None = None) -> None:
        self.result = result or _VerificationResult()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def verify(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _VerificationResult:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.result


class _IntegrationRegistryStub:
    def __init__(
        self,
        install_result: _RegistryInstallResult | None = None,
        activate_result: _ActivateResult | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.install_result = install_result or _RegistryInstallResult()
        self.activate_result = activate_result or _ActivateResult()
        self.install_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.activate_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def install_runtime(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _RegistryInstallResult:
        self.install_calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.install_result

    def activate_runtime(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _ActivateResult:
        self.activate_calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.activate_result


def _build(
    *,
    verification: _VerificationResult | None = None,
    install_result: _RegistryInstallResult | None = None,
    activate_result: _ActivateResult | None = None,
):
    verifier = _IntegrationVerifierStub(verification)
    registry = _IntegrationRegistryStub(install_result, activate_result)
    installer = build_integration_installer(
        integration_verifier=verifier,
        integration_registry=registry,
    )
    return installer, verifier, registry


def _bundle() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "bundle_id": "bundle-001",
        "version": "2026.04.25",
        "policy": {
            "default_verdict": "allow",
            "rules": [{"id": "safe-rule", "action": "allow"}],
        },
        "metadata": {"issuer": "ironclaw"},
    }


def test_installer_verifies_then_installs_runtime():
    installer, verifier, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            ok=True,
            allowed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified", "adapter:ready"],
        ),
        install_result=_RegistryInstallResult(
            ok=True,
            installed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            adapter="openclaw",
            status="installed",
            matched_rules=["install:complete"],
        ),
        activate_result=_ActivateResult(
            ok=True,
            active=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            status="active",
            matched_rules=["activate:complete"],
        ),
    )

    result = installer.install(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="install",
        context={"organization_id": "org-001"},
        activate=True,
    )

    assert result.ok is True
    assert result.installed is True
    assert result.active is True
    assert result.runtime == "openclaw"
    assert result.status in {"active", "installed"}
    assert "bundle:verified" in result.matched_rules
    assert "install:complete" in result.matched_rules
    assert "activate:complete" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(verifier.calls) == 1
    assert len(registry.install_calls) == 1
    assert len(registry.activate_calls) == 1


def test_installer_stops_when_verification_fails():
    installer, verifier, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            ok=False,
            allowed=False,
            runtime="claude",
            verdict="block",
            matched_rules=["signature_mismatch"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Bad signature", "details": "Bundle verification failed"}],
        )
    )

    result = installer.install(
        runtime="claude",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="bad-signature",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="install",
    )

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.installed is False
    assert result.active is False
    assert result.verdict in {"block", "reject"}
    assert "signature_mismatch" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(verifier.calls) == 1
    assert len(registry.install_calls) == 0
    assert len(registry.activate_calls) == 0

def test_rules_and_reasons_are_deduplicated_across_steps():
    repeated_reason = {"label": "Same", "details": "duplicate", "score": 10}
    installer, verifier, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            ok=True,
            allowed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["dup-rule", "dup-rule"],
            reasons=[repeated_reason, repeated_reason],
        ),
        install_result=_RegistryInstallResult(
            ok=True,
            installed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            adapter="openclaw",
            status="installed",
            matched_rules=["dup-rule"],
            reasons=[repeated_reason],
        ),
        activate_result=_ActivateResult(
            ok=True,
            active=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            status="active",
            matched_rules=["dup-rule"],
            reasons=[repeated_reason],
        ),
    )

    result = installer.install(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="install",
        activate=True,
    )

    assert result.matched_rules.count("dup-rule") == 1
    duplicates = [
        item
        for item in result.reasons
        if item.get("label") == "Same" and item.get("details") == "duplicate"
    ]
    assert len(duplicates) == 1

    assert "totalintegrations" in registry

    registry = build_integration_registry()

    integrations = registry["integrations"]
    assert registry["totalintegrations"] == len(integrations)


def test_enabled_integrations_matches_enabled_entries() -> None:
    registry = build_integration_registry()

    integrations = registry["integrations"]
    enabled_count = sum(1 for item in integrations if item["enabled"] is True)
    assert registry["enabledintegrations"] == enabled_count

def test_integrations_expose_policy_related_metadata_when_present() -> None:

    found_policy_shape = False
    for integration in registry["integrations"]:
        keys = set(integration.keys())
        if {
            "supportedbundlesigning",
            "supportsrolloutcontrols",
            "supportsoverrides",
        }.issubset(keys):
            found_policy_shape = True
            assert isinstance(integration["supportedbundlesigning"], bool)
            assert isinstance(integration["supportsrolloutcontrols"], bool)
            assert isinstance(integration["supportsoverrides"], bool)

    assert found_policy_shape is True


def test_enabled_integrations_are_not_marked_missing_when_health_fields_exist() -> None:
    registry = build_integration_registry()

    for integration in registry["integrations"]:
        if integration["enabled"] is True and "installed" in integration:
            assert isinstance(integration["installed"], bool)
            if integration["installed"] is True:
                assert integration["status"] not in {"missing", "not_installed"}

    first_providers = {item["provider"] for item in first["integrations"]}
    second_providers = {item["provider"] for item in second["integrations"]}

    assert first_providers == second_providers

from __future__ import annotations

@pytest.fixture()
def client() -> Iterator[TestClient]:
    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(integrations_router)
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_integrations_router_registers_expected_paths(client: TestClient) -> None:
    route_paths = {route.path for route in client.app.routes}
    expected_paths = {
        "/integrations/installers",
        "/integrations/installers/{integration_id}",
        "/integrations/verifiers",
        "/integrations/verifiers/{integration_id}",
    }

    missing_paths = expected_paths - route_paths
    assert not missing_paths, f"missing integration routes: {sorted(missing_paths)}"


def test_integrations_router_exposes_expected_http_methods(client: TestClient) -> None:
    route_methods = {
        (
            route.path,
            tuple(
                sorted(
                    method
                    for method in route.methods
                    if method not in {"HEAD", "OPTIONS"}
                )
            ),
        )
        for route in client.app.routes
        if route.path.startswith("/integrations")
    }

    expected_methods = {
        ("/integrations/installers", ("GET",)),
        ("/integrations/installers/{integration_id}", ("GET",)),
        ("/integrations/verifiers", ("GET",)),
        ("/integrations/verifiers/{integration_id}", ("GET",)),
    }

    missing_methods = expected_methods - route_methods
    assert not missing_methods, (
        f"missing integration route methods: {sorted(missing_methods)}"
    )

def test_rotate_integration_secret_returns_new_revealed_value(monkeypatch) -> None:
    from app.routes.integrations import secrets as secrets_module

    service = create_secret_service()
    monkeypatch.setattr(secrets_module, "get_secret_service", lambda: service)

    created = service.create_secret(
        name="groq-primary",
        value="gsk_live_primary_secret",
        provider="groq",
        kind="api_key",
        metadata={"environment": "production"},
    )

    response = client.post(
        f"/integrations/secrets/{created.secret_id}/rotate",
        json={
            "value": "gsk_live_rotated_secret",
            "metadata": {"rotation_reason": "scheduled"},
        },
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert data["operation"] == "rotate"
    assert data["secret_id"] == created.secret_id
    assert data["revealed_once_value"] == "gsk_live_rotated_secret"
    assert data["metadata"]["rotation_reason"] == "scheduled"

    rotated = service.get_secret(created.secret_id)
    assert rotated is not None
    assert service.verify_secret_value(created.secret_id, "gsk_live_rotated_secret") is True
    assert service.verify_secret_value(created.secret_id, "gsk_live_primary_secret") is False

    assert payload["title"] == "Integration Settings"
    assert payload["section"] == "platform"
    assert payload["status"] == "ok"
    assert payload["service"] == "IronClaw-Security"
    assert isinstance(payload["generatedat"], str)


def test_integrations_settings_returns_expected_summary_and_actions() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations/settings")

    payload = response.json()
    summary = payload["summary"]
    actions = payload["actions"]

    assert set(summary) >= {
        "totalintegrations",
        "configurableintegrations",
        "verifiedintegrations",
        "pendingintegrations",
    }
    assert isinstance(summary["totalintegrations"], int)
    assert isinstance(summary["configurableintegrations"], int)
    assert isinstance(summary["verifiedintegrations"], int)
    assert isinstance(summary["pendingintegrations"], int)

    assert actions == {
        "integrationsroute": "/ui/integrations",
        "catalogroute": "/integrations/installers",
        "verificationroute": "/integrations/verifiers",
    }


def test_integrations_settings_returns_settings_collection() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations/settings")

    payload = response.json()
    settings = payload["settings"]

    assert isinstance(settings, list)
    assert len(settings) >= 1

    item = settings[0]
    assert set(item) >= {
        "integrationid",
        "displayname",
        "platform",
        "status",
        "verified",
        "verifiedat",
        "settingsroute",
        "verificationroute",
        "manifestroute",
        "adaptermodule",
        "configurable",
        "configurationstate",
        "tags",
        "metadata",
    }


def test_integrations_settings_summary_matches_settings_collection() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations/settings")

    payload = response.json()
    settings = payload["settings"]
    summary = payload["summary"]

    configurable_count = sum(1 for item in settings if item["configurable"])
    verified_count = sum(1 for item in settings if item["verified"])
    pending_count = sum(1 for item in settings if not item["verified"])

    assert summary["totalintegrations"] == len(settings)
    assert summary["configurableintegrations"] == configurable_count
    assert summary["verifiedintegrations"] == verified_count
    assert summary["pendingintegrations"] == pending_count

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.services.integrationverifier import build_integration_verifier


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _VerificationResult:
    valid: bool = True
    allowed: bool = True
    verdict: str = "allow"
    bundle_id: str = "bundle-001"
    version: str = "2026.04.25"
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "valid": self.valid,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "bundleid": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _RolloutDecision:
    enabled: bool = True
    allowed: bool = True
    verdict: str = "allow"
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "enabled": self.enabled,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _AdapterProbeResult:
    ok: bool = True
    installed: bool = True
    runtime: str = "openclaw"
    adapter: str = "openclaw"
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None
    capabilities: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []
        if self.capabilities is None:
            self.capabilities = {
                "supports_policy_bundles": True,
                "supports_overrides": True,
                "supports_rollout_controls": True,
            }

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "installed": self.installed,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "adapter": self.adapter,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
            "capabilities": dict(self.capabilities),
        }


class _BundleSigningServiceStub:
    def __init__(self, result: _VerificationResult | None = None) -> None:
        self.result = result or _VerificationResult()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def verify_bundle(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _VerificationResult:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.result


class _ReleasePolicyServiceStub:
    def __init__(self, result: _RolloutDecision | None = None) -> None:
        self.result = result or _RolloutDecision()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _RolloutDecision:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.result


class _AdapterRegistryStub:
    def __init__(self, result: _AdapterProbeResult | None = None) -> None:
        self.result = result or _AdapterProbeResult()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def verify_runtime(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _AdapterProbeResult:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.result


def _build(
    *,
    verification: _VerificationResult | None = None,
    rollout: _RolloutDecision | None = None,
    adapter_probe: _AdapterProbeResult | None = None,
):
    signing = _BundleSigningServiceStub(verification)
    release = _ReleasePolicyServiceStub(rollout)
    registry = _AdapterRegistryStub(adapter_probe)
    verifier = build_integration_verifier(
        policy_bundle_signing_service=signing,
        release_policy_service=release,
        adapter_registry=registry,
    )
    return verifier, signing, release, registry


def _bundle() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "bundle_id": "bundle-001",
        "version": "2026.04.25",
        "policy": {
            "default_verdict": "allow",
            "rules": [{"id": "safe-rule", "action": "allow"}],
        },
        "metadata": {"issuer": "ironclaw"},
    }


def test_verifier_accepts_valid_bundle_and_supported_runtime():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            valid=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified"],
        ),
        rollout=_RolloutDecision(
            enabled=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["rollout:enabled"],
        ),
        adapter_probe=_AdapterProbeResult(
            ok=True,
            installed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            adapter="openclaw",
            matched_rules=["adapter:ready"],
        ),
    )

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={
            "bundleid": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
            "digest": "a" * 64,
        },
        action="execute",
        context={"organization_id": "org-001"},
    )

    assert result.ok is True
    assert result.allowed is True
    assert result.runtime == "openclaw"
    assert result.verdict == "allow"
    assert "bundle:verified" in result.matched_rules
    assert "rollout:enabled" in result.matched_rules
    assert "adapter:ready" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(signing.calls) == 1
    assert len(release.calls) == 1
    assert len(registry.calls) == 1


def test_verifier_rejects_invalid_bundle_signature():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            valid=False,
            allowed=False,
            verdict="block",
            matched_rules=["signature_mismatch"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Bad signature", "details": "Bundle verification failed"}],
        )
    )

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="claude",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="bad-signature",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.allowed is False
    assert result.verdict in {"block", "reject"}
    assert "signature_mismatch" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(signing.calls) == 1
    assert len(release.calls) == 0
    assert len(registry.calls) == 0


def test_verifier_rejects_disabled_rollout():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            valid=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified"],
        ),
        rollout=_RolloutDecision(
            enabled=False,
            allowed=False,
            verdict="block",
            matched_rules=["rollout:disabled"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Disabled", "details": "Rollout disabled"}],
        ),
    )

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="groq",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.allowed is False
    assert result.verdict == "block"
    assert "rollout:disabled" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(signing.calls) == 1
    assert len(release.calls) == 1
    assert len(registry.calls) == 0


def test_verifier_rejects_missing_runtime_adapter():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            valid=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified"],
        ),
        rollout=_RolloutDecision(
            enabled=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["rollout:enabled"],
        ),
        adapter_probe=_AdapterProbeResult(
            ok=False,
            installed=False,
            runtime="future-runtime",
            adapter="future-runtime",
            matched_rules=["adapter:not-installed"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Missing adapter", "details": "Runtime adapter unavailable"}],
        ),
    )

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="future-runtime",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.allowed is False
    assert result.verdict in {"block", "reject"}
    assert "adapter:not-installed" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(registry.calls) == 1


def test_verifier_passes_runtime_action_and_context_to_dependencies():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build()

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="tool.execute",
        context={"organization_id": "org-001", "risk": "low"},
    )

    assert result.ok is True
    assert signing.calls[0]["bundle"]["bundle_id"] == "bundle-001"
    assert release.calls[0]["runtime"] == "openclaw"
    assert release.calls[0]["action"] == "tool.execute"
    assert release.calls[0]["context"]["organization_id"] == "org-001"
    assert registry.calls[0]["runtime"] == "openclaw"


def test_missing_bundle_is_rejected_early():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build()

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=None,
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.allowed is False
    assert result.verdict == "block"
    assert "missing_bundle" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(signing.calls) == 0
    assert len(release.calls) == 0
    assert len(registry.calls) == 0


def test_missing_signature_is_rejected_early():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build()

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",

        action="execute",
    )

    assert result.ok is False
    assert result.allowed is False
    assert result.verdict == "block"
    assert "missing_signature" in result.matched_rules
    assert len(signing.calls) == 0


def test_missing_runtime_is_rejected_early():

def test_verifier_supports_cross_platform_runtimes():
    for runtime_name in ["openclaw", "claude", "groq", "future-runtime"]:
        verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
            adapter_probe=_AdapterProbeResult(
                ok=True,
                installed=True,
                runtime=runtime_name,
                adapter=runtime_name,
                matched_rules=[f"adapter:{runtime_name}:ready"],
            )
        )

        result = verifier.verify(
            runtime=runtime_name,
            bundle=_bundle(),
            signature="signed-bundle",
            secret="ironclaw-secret",
            manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
            action="execute",
        )

        assert result.ok is True
        assert result.runtime == runtime_name
        assert registry.calls[0]["runtime"] == runtime_name


def test_json_shape_contains_component_sections():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            valid=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Verified", "details": "Signature valid"}],
        ),
        rollout=_RolloutDecision(
            enabled=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["rollout:enabled"],
        ),
        adapter_probe=_AdapterProbeResult(
            ok=True,
            installed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            adapter="openclaw",
            matched_rules=["adapter:ready"],
        ),
    )

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )
    body = result.as_dict()

    assert body["ok"] is True
    assert body["allowed"] is True
    assert body["runtime"] == "openclaw"
    assert isinstance(body["matchedrules"], list)
    assert isinstance(body["reasons"], list)
    assert isinstance(body["bundleverification"], dict)
    assert isinstance(body["rolloutevaluation"], dict)
    assert isinstance(body["adapterverification"], dict)


def test_rules_and_reasons_are_deduplicated_across_checks():
    repeated_reason = {"label": "Same", "details": "duplicate", "score": 10}
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(
            valid=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["dup-rule", "dup-rule"],
            reasons=[repeated_reason, repeated_reason],
        ),
        rollout=_RolloutDecision(
            enabled=True,
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["dup-rule"],
            reasons=[repeated_reason],
        ),
        adapter_probe=_AdapterProbeResult(
            ok=True,
            installed=True,
            runtime="openclaw",
            adapter="openclaw",
            matched_rules=["dup-rule"],
            reasons=[repeated_reason],
        ),
    )

    result = verifier.verify(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert result.matched_rules.count("dup-rule") == 1
    duplicates = [
        item
        for item in result.reasons
        if item.get("label") == "Same" and item.get("details") == "duplicate"
    ]
    assert len(duplicates) == 1


def test_allow_helper_matches_verify_result():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(valid=True, allowed=True, verdict="allow"),
        rollout=_RolloutDecision(enabled=True, allowed=True, verdict="allow"),
        adapter_probe=_AdapterProbeResult(ok=True, installed=True, runtime="openclaw", adapter="openclaw"),
    )

    allowed = verifier.allow(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="signed-bundle",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert allowed is True


def test_allow_helper_false_when_verification_fails():
    verifier, signing, release, registry = _build(
        verification=_VerificationResult(valid=False, allowed=False, verdict="block"),
    )

    allowed = verifier.allow(
        runtime="openclaw",
        bundle=_bundle(),
        signature="bad-signature",
        secret="ironclaw-secret",
        manifest={"bundleid": "bundle-001", "version": "2026.04.25"},
        action="execute",
    )

    assert allowed is False

FILE: tests\testliveappsmoke.py

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Final

import httpx
import pytest


DEFAULT_BASE_URL: Final[str] = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final[float] = 5.0

HEALTH_PATHS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "/api/health",
    "/api/health/liveness",
    "/api/health/readiness",
)

OPTIONAL_PATHS: Final[tuple[str, ...]] = (
    "/api/system/status",
    "/api/ui/manifest",
    "/api/ui/status/runtime",
    "/api/ui/runtime/status",
)

HEALTHY_STATUS_VALUES: Final[set[str]] = {"ok", "pass", "healthy", "ready", "live", "alive"}


def _base_url() -> str:
    return os.getenv("IRONCLAW_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE_URL).rstrip("/")


def _client() -> httpx.Client:
    return httpx.Client(
        base_url=_base_url(),
        timeout=httpx.Timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS),
        follow_redirects=True,
        headers={"Accept": "application/json"},
    )


def _ensure_live_app_available() -> None:
    try:
        with _client() as client:
            response = client.get("/api/health")
            if response.status_code >= 500:
                pytest.skip(f"Live IronClaw app unhealthy at {_base_url()} (status {response.status_code})")
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        pytest.skip(f"Live IronClaw app unavailable at {_base_url()}: {exc}")


def _assert_json_health_response(response: httpx.Response) -> None:
    assert 200 <= response.status_code < 300, response.text

    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, dict), payload

    status_value = str(payload.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
    assert status_value in HEALTHY_STATUS_VALUES, payload


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
def ensure_live_app() -> None:
    _ensure_live_app_available()


@pytest.mark.integration
@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", HEALTH_PATHS)
def test_live_health_endpoints_return_healthy_json(path: str) -> None:
    with _client() as client:
        response = client.get(path)
    _assert_json_health_response(response)


@pytest.mark.integration
@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", OPTIONAL_PATHS)
def test_live_optional_endpoints_are_reachable(path: str) -> None:
    with _client() as client:
        response = client.get(path)

    if response.status_code == 404:
        pytest.skip(f"Optional endpoint not present on this layer: {path}")

    assert 200 <= response.status_code < 300, response.text


@pytest.mark.integration
def test_live_health_endpoint_response_time_is_reasonable() -> None:
    with _client() as client:
        response = client.get("/api/health")

    _assert_json_health_response(response)
    assert response.elapsed.total_seconds() < REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.routing import APIRoute

from app.main import create_app


def test_create_app_registers_core_health_routes() -> None:
    app = create_app()
    route_map = {
        route.path: route
        for route in app.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }

    assert "/" in route_map
    assert "/health" in route_map

    root_methods = route_map["/"].methods or set()
    health_methods = route_map["/health"].methods or set()

    assert "GET" in root_methods
    assert "GET" in health_methods


def test_create_app_registers_integrations_routes() -> None:
    app = create_app()
    route_paths = {
        route.path
        for route in app.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }

    expected_paths = {
        "/integrations/installers",
        "/integrations/installers/{integration_id}",
        "/integrations/verifiers",
        "/integrations/verifiers/{integration_id}",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/compatibility",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/secrets",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/rollouts",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/telemetry",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/health",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/lifecycle",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/readiness",
        "/integrations/{integration_id}/observability",
    }

    missing_paths = expected_paths - route_paths
    assert not missing_paths, f"main app missing integration routes: {sorted(missing_paths)}"


def test_create_app_integrations_routes_are_api_key_protected() -> None:
    app = create_app()

    integration_routes = [
        route
        for route in app.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute) and route.path.startswith("/integrations")
    ]

    assert integration_routes, "expected integrations routes to be registered"

    for route in integration_routes:
        dependency_calls = {
            getattr(dependency.dependency, "__name__", repr(dependency.dependency))
            for dependency in route.dependant.dependencies
            if dependency.dependency is not None
        }
        assert "require_api_key" in dependency_calls, (
            f"route {route.path} is missing require_api_key protection"
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_marketing_nav_route_is_registered() -> None:
    response = client.get("/marketing/nav")
    assert response.status_code == 200


def test_marketing_nav_returns_list_of_items() -> None:
    response = client.get("/marketing/nav")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")

    data = response.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)

    if data:
        first = data[0]
        assert isinstance(first, dict)

        # minimal flexible contract
        assert any(k in first for k in ("id", "slug", "key", "name"))
        assert any(k in first for k in ("href", "path", "url"))
        # optional grouping metadata
        assert any(
            k in first
            for k in (
                "section",
                "group",
                "category",
                "position",
                "items",  # nested children
            )
        )

FILE: tests\testmonetizationreporting.py

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.monetizationreporting import build_monetization_reporting


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_monetization_reporting_returns_object() -> None:
    reporting = build_monetization_reporting()

    assert reporting is not None


def test_monetization_reporting_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_monetization_reporting())

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload


def test_monetization_reporting_contains_core_fields_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_monetization_reporting())

    expected_candidates = {
        "reportid",
        "ownerid",
        "currency",
        "revenue",
        "usagecost",
        "purchases",
        "packages",
        "quota",
        "remaining",
        "summary",
        "generatedat",
        "status",
    }
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)

def test_monetization_reporting_revenue_and_usage_cost_are_consistent_when_present() -> None:
    try:
        reporting = build_monetization_reporting(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            revenue="100",
            usage_cost="40",
        )
    except TypeError:
        reporting = build_monetization_reporting()

    payload = _payload_of(reporting)
    revenue = _number(payload, "revenue", "totalrevenue", "total_revenue")
    usage_cost = _number(payload, "usagecost", "usage_cost", "cost")
    margin = _number(payload, "margin", "netrevenue", "net_revenue")

    if revenue is not None and usage_cost is not None:
        assert revenue >= usage_cost
    if revenue is not None and usage_cost is not None and margin is not None:
        assert margin == revenue - usage_cost

def test_reasons_and_rules_are_deduplicated_when_detectors_repeat(monkeypatch, guard):
    repeated_reason = {
        "source": "networkguard",
        "label": "Repeated",
        "details": "Same reason",
        "score": 15,
    }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        guard,
        "_analyze_url",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: (
            15,
            [repeated_reason, repeated_reason],
            ["repeat_rule", "repeat_rule"],
        ),
    )

    policy = guard.evaluate(url="https://api.example.com/v1/status", method="GET")

    repeated = [
        item
        for item in policy.reasons
        if item["label"] == "Repeated" and item["details"] == "Same reason"
    ]
    assert len(repeated) == 1
    assert policy.matched_rules.count("repeat_rule") == 1

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.adapters.openclawadapter import OpenClawAdapter


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _PolicyDecision:
    allowed: bool = True
    verdict: str = "allow"
    bundle_id: str = "bundle-001"
    version: str = "2026.04.25"
    runtime: str = "openclaw"
    override_active: bool = False
    rollout_enabled: bool = True
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "bundleid": self.bundle_id,
            "version": self.version,
            "runtime": self.runtime,
            "overrideactive": self.override_active,
            "rolloutenabled": self.rollout_enabled,
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules),
            "reasons": list(self.reasons),
        }


class _PolicyEnforcerStub:
    def __init__(self, decision: _PolicyDecision | None = None) -> None:
        self.decision = decision or _PolicyDecision()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _PolicyDecision:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.decision

    def allow(self, **kwargs: Any) -> bool:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.decision.allowed


class _RuntimeClientStub:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.execute_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.result: dict[str, Any] = {
            "status": "ok",
            "runtime": "openclaw",
            "output": {"message": "executed"},
        }

    def execute(self, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.execute_calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return dict(self.result)


def _build_adapter(decision: _PolicyDecision | None = None):
    enforcer = _PolicyEnforcerStub(decision)
    runtime = _RuntimeClientStub()
    adapter = OpenClawAdapter(
        policy_enforcer=enforcer,
        runtime_client=runtime,
    )
    return adapter, enforcer, runtime


def _request_payload() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "bundle": {
            "bundle_id": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "policy": {
                "default_verdict": "allow",
                "rules": [{"id": "safe-shell", "action": "allow"}],
            },
        },
        "signature": "signed-bundle",
        "secret": "ironclaw-secret",
        "manifest": {
            "bundleid": "bundle-001",
            "version": "2026.04.25",
            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
            "digest": "a" * 64,
        },
        "action": "execute",
        "prompt": "list safe files",
        "context": {
            "organization_id": "org-001",
            "risk": "low",
        },
    }


def test_allows_execution_when_policy_enforcer_allows():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=True,
            verdict="allow",
            matched_rules=["bundle:verified", "rollout:enabled"],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is True
    assert result["verdict"] == "allow"
    assert result["runtime"] == "openclaw"
    assert result["policy"]["bundleid"] == "bundle-001"
    assert result["policy"]["version"] == "2026.04.25"
    assert result["result"]["status"] == "ok"
    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 1


def test_blocks_execution_when_policy_enforcer_blocks():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=False,
            verdict="block",
            matched_rules=["signature_mismatch"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Bad signature", "details": "Bundle verification failed"}],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is False
    assert result["verdict"] == "block"
    assert result["runtime"] == "openclaw"
    assert "signature_mismatch" in result["policy"]["matchedrules"]
    assert result["result"] is None or result["result"].get("status") != "ok"
    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 0


def test_review_verdict_prevents_runtime_execution():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter(
        _PolicyDecision(
            allowed=False,
            verdict="review",
            matched_rules=["policy:review"],
            reasons=[{"label": "Review", "details": "Needs analyst approval"}],
        )
    )

    result = adapter.execute(**_request_payload())

    assert result["allowed"] is False
    assert result["verdict"] == "review"
    assert result["policy"]["matchedrules"] == ["policy:review"]
    assert len(runtime.execute_calls) == 0


def test_passes_policy_material_to_enforcer():
    adapter, enforcer, runtime = _build_adapter()

    payload = _request_payload()
    adapter.execute(**payload)

    assert len(enforcer.calls) == 1
    call = enforcer.calls[0]
    assert call["bundle"]["bundle_id"] == "bundle-001"
    assert call["signature"] == "signed-bundle"
    assert call["secret"] == "ironclaw-secret"
    assert call["manifest"]["bundleid"] == "bundle-001"
    assert call["runtime"] == "openclaw"
    assert call["action"] == "execute"
    assert call["context"]["organization_id"] == "org-001"

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.routing import APIRoute

from app.main import app


def _route_map() -> dict[str, APIRoute]:
    return {
        route.path: route
        for route in app.routes
        if isinstance(route, APIRoute)
    }


def test_operations_dashboard_route_is_registered() -> None:
    route_map = _route_map()

    assert "/dashboard/overview" in route_map


def test_operations_organizations_route_is_registered() -> None:
    route_map = _route_map()

    assert "/organizations" in route_map


def test_operations_ui_routes_are_registered() -> None:
    route_map = _route_map()

    assert "/ui/routes" in route_map
    assert "/ui/pages" in route_map
    assert "/ui/manifest" in route_map


def test_operations_admin_surfaces_are_registered() -> None:
    route_map = _route_map()

    assert "/admin/request-stream" in route_map
    assert "/admin/system-diagnostics" in route_map
    assert "/admin/execution-test-console" in route_map


def test_operations_core_routes_support_get() -> None:
    route_map = _route_map()

    required_paths = [
        "/dashboard/overview",
        "/organizations",
        "/ui/routes",
        "/ui/pages",
        "/ui/manifest",
        "/admin/request-stream",
        "/admin/system-diagnostics",
        "/admin/execution-test-console",
    ]

    for path in required_paths:
        methods = route_map[path].methods or set()
        assert "GET" in methods

from app.core.auth import API_KEY_HEADER_NAME

def _make_app() -> FastAPI:
