from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.runtime.toolcallguard import ToolCallRequest, build_toolcallguard


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _Policy:
    verdict: str = "allow"
    allowed: bool = True
    should_review: bool = False
    should_block: bool = False
    should_quarantine: bool = False
    risk_delta: int = 0
    reasons: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None
    matched_rules: list[str] | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.reasons is None:
            self.reasons = []
        if self.matched_rules is None:
            self.matched_rules = []

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "verdict": self.verdict,
            "allowed": self.allowed,
            "shouldreview": self.should_review,
            "shouldblock": self.should_block,
            "shouldquarantine": self.should_quarantine,
            "riskdelta": self.risk_delta,
            "reasons": list(self.reasons or []),
            "matchedrules": list(self.matched_rules or []),
        }


class _CommandSupervisorStub:
    def __init__(self, policy: _Policy | None = None) -> None:
        self.policy = policy or _Policy()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _Policy:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.policy


class _NetworkGuardStub:
    def __init__(self, policy: _Policy | None = None) -> None:
        self.policy = policy or _Policy()
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _Policy:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        return self.policy


class _FileReturnGuardStub:
    def __init__(self, policies: list[_Policy] | None = None) -> None:
        self.policies = list(policies or [_Policy()])
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def evaluate(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _Policy:
        self.calls.append(dict(kwargs))
        if self.policies:
            return self.policies.pop(0)
        return _Policy()


def _build_guard(
    *,
    command_policy: _Policy | None = None,
    network_policy: _Policy | None = None,
    artifact_policies: list[_Policy] | None = None,
):
    command_supervisor = _CommandSupervisorStub(command_policy)
    network_guard = _NetworkGuardStub(network_policy)
    file_return_guard = _FileReturnGuardStub(artifact_policies)
    guard = build_toolcallguard(
        command_supervisor=command_supervisor,
        network_guard=network_guard,
        file_return_guard=file_return_guard,
    )
    return guard, command_supervisor, network_guard, file_return_guard


def test_allow_safe_command_request():
    command_policy = _Policy(
        verdict="allow",
        allowed=True,
        risk_delta=5,
        reasons=[{"source": "commandsupervisor", "label": "Safe", "details": "Safe command.", "score": 5}],
        matched_rules=["commandsupervisor:allow"],
    )
    guard, command_supervisor, network_guard, file_return_guard = _build_guard(command_policy=command_policy)

    decision = guard.evaluate(
        request=ToolCallRequest(
            tool_name="bash",
            command="echo hello",
            cwd="/workspace",
            metadata={"request_id": "req-1"},
        )
    )

    assert decision.allowed is True
    assert decision.verdict == "allow"
    assert decision.tool_name == "bash"
    assert decision.actiontype == "toolcall"
    assert decision.target == "runtime"
    assert decision.risk_delta == 30
    assert "toolcallguard:high_risk:bash" in decision.matched_rules
    assert "commandsupervisor:allow" in decision.matched_rules
    assert len(command_supervisor.calls) == 1
    assert len(network_guard.calls) == 0
    assert len(file_return_guard.calls) == 0


def test_normalizes_request_fields_before_evaluation():
    command_policy = _Policy(risk_delta=0)
    guard, command_supervisor, _, _ = _build_guard(command_policy=command_policy)

    decision = guard.evaluate(
        request=ToolCallRequest(
            tool_name="  BASH  ",
            actiontype="  EXECUTE  ",
            target="  RUNTIME  ",
            command="echo hi",
            cwd=" /tmp/run ",
            environment_scope="  sandbox  ",
            metadata={"trace": "abc"},
        )
    )

    assert decision.tool_name == "bash"
    assert decision.actiontype == "execute"
    assert decision.target == "runtime"
    assert command_supervisor.calls[0]["cwd"] == "/tmp/run"
    assert command_supervisor.calls[0]["metadata"]["environment_scope"] == "sandbox"
    assert command_supervisor.calls[0]["metadata"]["tool_name"] == "bash"

def test_reasons_and_rules_are_deduplicated():
    repeated_reason = {
        "source": "commandsupervisor",
        "label": "Repeated",
        "details": "Same reason",
        "score": 10,
    }
    command_policy = _Policy(
        verdict="review",
        allowed=True,
        should_review=True,
        risk_delta=10,
        reasons=[repeated_reason, repeated_reason],
        matched_rules=["repeat_rule", "repeat_rule"],
    )
    guard, _, _, _ = _build_guard(command_policy=command_policy)

    decision = guard.evaluate(
        request=ToolCallRequest(
            tool_name="bash",
            command="echo duplicate",
        )
    )

    repeated = [
        item
        for item in decision.reasons
        if item["label"] == "Repeated" and item["details"] == "Same reason"
    ]
    assert len(repeated) == 1
    assert decision.matched_rules.count("repeat_rule") == 1

    file_return_guard = _FileReturnGuardStub([_Policy()])

        command_supervisor=command_supervisor,
        network_guard=network_guard,
        file_return_guard=file_return_guard,
        high_risk_tools={"custom_exec"},
    )

    decision = guard.evaluate(
        request=ToolCallRequest(
            tool_name="custom_exec",
            command="do-something",
        )
    )

    assert "toolcallguard:high_risk:custom_exec" in decision.matched_rules

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Final

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app


UI_AUDIT_EXPLORER_PATH: Final[str] = "/ui/audit-explorer"


@pytest.fixture()
def client() -> TestClient:
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def _get_payload(client: TestClient) -> tuple[Any, dict[str, Any]]:
    response = client.get(UI_AUDIT_EXPLORER_PATH)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
    payload = response.json()
    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    return response, payload


def test_ui_audit_explorer_route_is_registered(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.get(UI_AUDIT_EXPLORER_PATH)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text


def test_ui_audit_explorer_returns_json_object(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response, data = _get_payload(client)

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(data, dict)


def test_ui_audit_explorer_contains_core_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    _, data = _get_payload(client)

    assert data

def test_ui_integrations_contains_summary_actions_and_integrations() -> None:

    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()

    summary = data.get("summary")
    actions = data.get("actions")
    integrations = data.get("integrations")

    assert isinstance(actions, dict)
    assert isinstance(integrations, list)

    assert "installedintegrations" in summary
    assert "readyintegrations" in summary
    assert "degradedintegrations" in summary

    assert actions.get("catalogroute") == "/integrations/installers"
    assert actions.get("verificationroute") == "/integrations/verifiers"
    assert actions.get("settingsroute") == "/ui/integrations/settings"


def test_ui_integrations_entries_expose_expected_shape() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations")
    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()
    integrations = data.get("integrations")

    assert isinstance(integrations, list)
    assert integrations, "expected at least one integration entry"

    entry = integrations[0]
    assert isinstance(entry, dict)

    expected_keys = {
        "integrationid",
        "platform",
        "displayname",
        "status",
        "installed",
        "installedat",
        "verified",
        "verifiedat",
        "settingsroute",
        "manifestroute",
        "verificationroute",
        "adaptermodule",
        "capabilities",
        "installerpreview",
        "verifierpreview",
        "health",
    }
    missing_keys = expected_keys - set(entry)
    assert not missing_keys, f"missing integration keys: {sorted(missing_keys)}"


def test_ui_integrations_entries_echo_preview_shapes() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations")
    assert response.status_code == 200

    data = response.json()
    entry = data["integrations"][0]

    installerpreview = entry.get("installerpreview")
    verifierpreview = entry.get("verifierpreview")

    assert isinstance(installerpreview, dict)
    assert installerpreview.get("status")
    assert "installed" in installerpreview
    assert "summary" in installerpreview
    assert isinstance(installerpreview.get("steps"), list)

    assert isinstance(verifierpreview, dict)
    assert verifierpreview.get("status")
    assert "verified" in verifierpreview
    assert "strict" in verifierpreview
    assert "summary" in verifierpreview
    assert isinstance(verifierpreview.get("checks"), list)
    assert isinstance(verifierpreview.get("missingcapabilities"), list)

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app


client = TestClient(app)


def test_ui_integration_settings_api_returns_settings_page_contract() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations/settings")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    payload = response.json()

    assert payload["pageid"] == "ui-integrations-settings"
    assert payload["title"] == "Integration Settings"
    assert payload["section"] == "platform"
    assert payload["status"] == "ok"
    assert payload["service"] == "IronClaw-Security"
    assert isinstance(payload["generatedat"], str)

    summary = payload["summary"]
    assert isinstance(summary, dict)
    assert set(summary) >= {
        "totalintegrations",
        "configurableintegrations",
        "verifiedintegrations",
        "pendingintegrations",
    }

    actions = payload["actions"]
    assert actions["integrationsroute"] == "/ui/integrations"
    assert actions["catalogroute"] == "/integrations/installers"
    assert actions["verificationroute"] == "/integrations/verifiers"

    settings = payload["settings"]
    assert isinstance(settings, list)
    assert len(settings) >= 1

    item = settings[0]
    assert set(item) >= {
        "integrationid",
        "displayname",
        "platform",
        "status",
        "verified",
        "verifiedat",
        "settingsroute",
        "verificationroute",
        "manifestroute",
        "adaptermodule",
        "configurable",
        "configurationstate",
        "tags",
        "metadata",
    }
    assert isinstance(item["integrationid"], str)
    assert isinstance(item["displayname"], str)
    assert isinstance(item["platform"], str)
    assert isinstance(item["status"], str)
    assert isinstance(item["verified"], bool)
    assert item["verifiedat"] is None or isinstance(item["verifiedat"], str)
    assert item["settingsroute"] is None or isinstance(item["settingsroute"], str)
    assert item["verificationroute"] is None or isinstance(item["verificationroute"], str)
    assert item["manifestroute"] is None or isinstance(item["manifestroute"], str)
    assert isinstance(item["adaptermodule"], str)
    assert isinstance(item["configurable"], bool)
    assert item["configurationstate"] in {"configured", "pending", "unavailable"}
    assert isinstance(item["tags"], list)
    assert isinstance(item["metadata"], dict)


def test_ui_integration_settings_api_summary_matches_settings_collection() -> None:
    response = client.get("/ui/integrations/settings")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    payload = response.json()

    settings = payload["settings"]
    summary = payload["summary"]

    configurable_count = sum(1 for item in settings if item["configurable"])
    verified_count = sum(1 for item in settings if item["verified"])
    pending_count = sum(1 for item in settings if not item["verified"])

    assert summary["totalintegrations"] == len(settings)
    assert summary["configurableintegrations"] == configurable_count
    assert summary["verifiedintegrations"] == verified_count
    assert summary["pendingintegrations"] == pending_count


def test_ui_integration_settings_api_is_registered_in_openapi() -> None:
    schema = app.openapi()
    assert "/ui/integrations/settings" in schema["paths"]

    operation = schema["paths"]["/ui/integrations/settings"]["get"]
    assert "ui-integrations" in operation["tags"]
    assert operation["operationId"] == "read_ui_integration_settings_ui_integrations_settings_get"

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app
from app.routes.reviewqueue import get_review_queue_service

client = TestClient(app)


def setup_function() -> None:
    service = get_review_queue_service()
    service._items.clear()
    service._index_by_source.clear()
    service._pending_order.clear()
    service._counter = 1


def _seed_review_item() -> str:
    service = get_review_queue_service()
    item = service.escalate_incident(
        incident_id="inc_301",
        priority="critical",
        title="Critical prompt injection review",
        summary="Escalated session requires human decision.",
        reasons=["critical severity", "hostile pattern"],
        evidence=[
            {"type": "signal", "name": "prompt_injection", "score": 0.995},
            {"type": "session", "session_id": "sess_301"},
        ],
    )

FILE: tests\testunitledger.py

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.unitledger import build_unit_ledger


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(result, "as_dict")):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _entries_of(ledger: Any) -> list[Any] | None:
    payload = _payload_of(ledger)
    for key in ("entries", "records", "transactions", "journal"):
        if key in payload:
            value = payload[key]
            if value is not None:
                assert isinstance(value, list)
                return value
    for name in ("entries", "records", "transactions", "journal"):
        if hasattr(ledger, name):
            value = getattr(ledger, name)
            if callable(value):
                value = value()
            if value is not None:
                assert isinstance(value, list)
                return value
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_unit_ledger_returns_object() -> None:
    ledger = build_unit_ledger()

    assert ledger is not None


def test_unit_ledger_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_unit_ledger())

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload


def test_unit_ledger_contains_stable_top_level_fields_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_unit_ledger())

    expected_candidates = {
        "ledgerid",
        "ledger_id",
        "ownerid",
        "owner_id",
        "balance",
        "units",
        "available",
        "entrycount",
        "entry_count",
        "entries",
        "records",
        "transactions",
        "journal",
        "currency",
        "status",
        "state",
        "generatedat",
        "generated_at",
        "createdat",
        "created_at",
    }
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)


def test_unit_ledger_owner_identifier_is_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_unit_ledger())

    owner = _text(payload, "ownerid", "owner_id", "owner", "accountid", "account_id")
    if owner is not None:
        assert owner.strip()


def test_unit_ledger_balance_is_non_negative_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_unit_ledger())

    balance = _number(payload, "balance", "units", "available", "credits", "available_units")
    if balance is not None:

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.unitwallet import build_unit_wallet


def _balance_of(wallet: Any) -> Decimal:
    # Prefer payload view when available for consistency
    if hasattr(wallet, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(wallet, "as_dict")):
        payload = wallet.as_dict()
        for name in ("balance", "units", "available_units", "available", "credits"):
            if name in payload and payload[name] is not None:
                return Decimal(str(payload[name]))

    for name in ("balance", "units", "available_units", "available", "credits"):
        if isinstance(wallet, dict) and name in wallet:
            return Decimal(str(wallet[name]))
        if hasattr(wallet, name):
            value = getattr(wallet, name)
            if callable(value):
                value = value()
            return Decimal(str(value))

    if hasattr(wallet, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(wallet, "as_dict")):
        payload = wallet.as_dict()
        for name in ("balance", "units", "available_units", "available", "credits"):
            if name in payload:
                return Decimal(str(payload[name]))

    raise AssertionError("wallet balance field not found")


def _owner_of(wallet: Any) -> str | None:
    for name in ("owner_id", "ownerid", "owner", "account_id", "accountid"):
        if hasattr(wallet, name):
            value = getattr(wallet, name)
            if callable(value):
                value = value()
            return None if value is None else str(value)
        if isinstance(wallet, dict) and name in wallet:
            value = wallet[name]
            return None if value is None else str(value)
    if hasattr(wallet, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(wallet, "as_dict")):
        payload = wallet.as_dict()
        for name in ("owner_id", "ownerid", "owner", "account_id", "accountid"):
            if name in payload:
                value = payload[name]
                return None if value is None else str(value)
    return None


def _status_of(wallet: Any) -> str | None:
    for name in ("status", "state"):
        if hasattr(wallet, name):
            value = getattr(wallet, name)
            if callable(value):
                value = value()
            return None if value is None else str(value)
        if isinstance(wallet, dict) and name in wallet:
            return str(wallet[name])
    if hasattr(wallet, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(wallet, "as_dict")):
        payload = wallet.as_dict()
        for name in ("status", "state"):
            if name in payload:
                return str(payload[name])
    return None


def _payload_of(wallet: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(wallet, dict):
        return wallet
    if hasattr(wallet, "as_dict") and callable(getattr(wallet, "as_dict")):
        payload = wallet.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(wallet):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(wallet, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            result[name] = value
    return result


def _call_method_if_present(wallet: Any, method_names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in method_names:
        if hasattr(wallet, name):
            method = getattr(wallet, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {method_names}")

    if any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in credit_methods):
        _call_method_if_present(wallet, credit_methods, Decimal("30"))

    before = _balance_of(wallet)
    _call_method_if_present(wallet, debit_methods, Decimal("10"))

    assert before - after == Decimal("10")

def test_wallet_supports_reserve_and_release_when_available() -> None:
    wallet = build_unit_wallet()

    reserve_methods = ("reserve", "hold", "authorize")
    release_methods = ("release", "unreserve", "void_hold")

    has_reserve = any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in reserve_methods)
    has_release = any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in release_methods)

    if not (has_reserve and has_release):
        pytest.skip("wallet reserve/release methods not implemented")

    credit_methods = ("credit", "deposit", "add_units", "fund", "top_up")
    if any(hasattr(wallet, name) and callable(getattr(wallet, name)) for name in credit_methods):
        _call_method_if_present(wallet, credit_methods, Decimal("20"))

    before = _balance_of(wallet)
    token = _call_method_if_present(wallet, reserve_methods, Decimal("5"))
    middle = _balance_of(wallet)
    _call_method_if_present(wallet, release_methods, token if token is not None else Decimal("5"))
    after = _balance_of(wallet)

    assert middle <= before
    assert after >= middle

def test_wallet_multiple_instances_are_independent() -> None:
    first = build_unit_wallet()
    second = build_unit_wallet()

    assert first is not second

    credit_methods = ("credit", "deposit", "add_units", "fund", "top_up")
    if any(hasattr(first, name) and callable(getattr(first, name)) for name in credit_methods):
        before_first = _balance_of(first)
        before_second = _balance_of(second)
        _call_method_if_present(first, credit_methods, Decimal("7"))
        after_first = _balance_of(first)
        after_second = _balance_of(second)

        assert after_first - before_first == Decimal("7")
        assert after_second == before_second

        assert first_owner != second_owner

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.usageeventdetail import build_usage_event_detail


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.usagemetering import build_usage_metering


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _collection(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def test_build_usage_metering_returns_object() -> None:
    metering = build_usage_metering()

    assert metering is not None


def test_usage_metering_is_serializable_to_dictionary_shape() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    assert isinstance(payload, dict)
    assert payload


def test_usage_metering_contains_core_fields_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    expected_candidates = {
        "ownerid",
        "meterid",
        "metric",
        "units",
        "unitcost",
        "totalcost",
        "quota",
        "remaining",
        "window",
        "periodstart",
        "periodend",
        "events",
        "generatedat",
    }
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)


def test_usage_metering_owner_and_meter_identifiers_are_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    for value in (
        _text(payload, "ownerid", "owner_id", "owner", "accountid", "account_id"),
        _text(payload, "meterid", "meter_id", "metric", "metric_code"),
    ):
        if value is not None:
            assert value.strip()


def test_usage_metering_numeric_fields_are_non_negative_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    for keys in (
        ("units",),
        ("unitcost", "unit_cost"),
        ("totalcost", "total_cost"),
        ("quota", "limit"),
        ("remaining", "remainingunits", "available"),
    ):
        value = _number(payload, *keys)
        if value is not None:
            assert value >= Decimal("0")


def test_usage_metering_remaining_does_not_exceed_quota_when_both_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    quota = _number(payload, "quota", "limit")
    remaining = _number(payload, "remaining", "remainingunits", "available")
    if quota is not None and remaining is not None:
        assert remaining <= quota


def test_usage_metering_total_cost_matches_units_times_unit_cost_when_present() -> None:
    try:
        metering = build_usage_metering(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            meter_id="api_calls",
            units=5,
            unit_cost="2",
        )
    except TypeError:
        metering = build_usage_metering()

    payload = _payload_of(metering)
    units = _number(payload, "units")
    unit_cost = _number(payload, "unitcost", "unit_cost")
    total_cost = _number(payload, "totalcost", "total_cost")

    if units is not None and unit_cost is not None and total_cost is not None:
        assert total_cost == units * unit_cost


def test_usage_metering_window_or_period_fields_are_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    for value in (
        _text(payload, "window"),
        _text(payload, "periodstart", "period_start"),
        _text(payload, "periodend", "period_end"),
        _text(payload, "generatedat", "timestamp"),
    ):
        if value is not None:
            assert value.strip()


def test_usage_metering_events_collection_is_list_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    events = _collection(payload, "events", "records", "entries", "usage")
    if events is not None:
        assert isinstance(events, list)


def test_usage_metering_metadata_is_dict_when_present() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    metadata = _collection(payload, "metadata", "context", "dimensions")
    if metadata is not None:
        assert isinstance(metadata, dict)


def test_usage_metering_multiple_builds_have_stable_key_sets() -> None:
    first = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())
    second = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    assert set(first.keys()) == set(second.keys())


def test_usage_metering_payload_uses_json_friendly_values() -> None:
    payload = _payload_of(build_usage_metering())

    for key, value in payload.items():
        assert isinstance(key, str)
        assert value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict))


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("units", "unit_cost", "quota"),
    [
        (1, "1", 10),
        (5, "0.5", 100),
        (10, "2", 1000),
    ],
)
def test_usage_metering_accepts_positive_metering_inputs_when_supported(
    units: int,
    unit_cost: str,
    quota: int,
) -> None:
    try:
        metering = build_usage_metering(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            meter_id="api_calls",
            units=units,
            unit_cost=unit_cost,
            quota=quota,
        )
    except TypeError:
        pytest.skip("usage metering builder does not accept direct inputs")

    payload = _payload_of(metering)
    actual_units = _number(payload, "units")
    if actual_units is not None:
        assert actual_units == Decimal(str(units))


def test_usage_metering_rejects_negative_units_when_supported() -> None:
    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        build_usage_metering(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            meter_id="api_calls",
            units=-1,
            unit_cost="1",
            quota=10,
        )


def test_usage_metering_rejects_negative_unit_cost_when_supported() -> None:
    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        build_usage_metering(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            meter_id="api_calls",
            units=1,
            unit_cost="-1",
            quota=10,
        )


def test_usage_metering_rejects_negative_quota_when_supported() -> None:
    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        build_usage_metering(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            meter_id="api_calls",
            units=1,
            unit_cost="1",
            quota=-10,
        )


def test_usage_metering_rejects_quota_exceeded_when_supported() -> None:
    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        build_usage_metering(
            owner_id="owner-001",
            meter_id="api_calls",
            units=11,
            unit_cost="1",
            quota=10,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

import pytest

from app.usagereports import build_usage_reports


def _payload_of(result: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result
    if hasattr(result, "as_dict") and callable(result.as_dict):
        payload = result.as_dict()
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        return payload
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for name in dir(result):
        if name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        value = getattr(result, name)
        if callable(value):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict, type(None))):
            payload[name] = value
    return payload


def _items_of(result: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(result, list):
        return result
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        for key in ("items", "summaries", "reports", "events", "data"):
            value = result.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                return value
        return [result]
    if hasattr(result, "__iter__") and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes)):
        try:
            return list(result)
        except TypeError:
            pass
    return [result]


def _number(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Decimal | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return Decimal(str(payload[key]))
    return None


def _text(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> str | None:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload and payload[key] is not None:
            return str(payload[key])
    return None


def _value(payload: dict[str, Any], *keys: str) -> Any:
    for key in keys:
        if key in payload:
            return payload[key]
    return None


def _call_method_if_present(target: Any, names: tuple[str, ...], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    for name in names:
        if hasattr(target, name):
            method = getattr(target, name)
            if callable(method):
                return method(*args, **kwargs)
    raise AssertionError(f"missing expected method from candidates: {names}")


def test_build_usage_reports_returns_object() -> None:
    reports = build_usage_reports()

    assert reports is not None


def test_usage_reports_is_serializable_to_supported_shape() -> None:
    reports = build_usage_reports()

    assert isinstance(reports, (dict, list)) or hasattr(reports, "as_dict") or hasattr(reports, "__iter__")


def test_usage_reports_contains_at_least_one_record() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert items


def test_each_usage_report_has_dictionary_shape_when_serialized() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        assert payload


def test_usage_reports_contains_core_fields_when_present() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())
    expected_candidates = {
        "apikeyid",
        "api_key_id",
        "ownerkey",
        "owner_key",
        "totalrequests",
        "total_requests",
        "totalunits",
        "total_units",
        "lastseenat",
        "last_seen_at",
        "routes",
        "status",
        "timestamp",
    }

    payload = _payload_of(items[0])
    assert set(payload.keys()).intersection(expected_candidates)


def test_usage_reports_identifiers_are_non_empty_when_present() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        for value in (
            _text(payload, "apikeyid", "api_key_id", "id"),
            _text(payload, "ownerkey", "owner_key", "ownerid", "owner_id"),
            _text(payload, "status", "state"),
            _text(payload, "timestamp", "generatedat", "generated_at"),
        ):
            if value is not None:
                assert value.strip()


def test_usage_reports_numeric_fields_are_non_negative_when_present() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        for keys in (
            ("totalrequests", "total_requests"),
            ("totalunits", "total_units"),
            ("averageunitsperrequest", "average_units_per_request"),
            ("units",),
            ("requests",),
        ):
            value = _number(payload, *keys)
            if value is not None:
                assert value >= Decimal("0")


def test_usage_reports_routes_are_list_or_dict_when_present() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        routes = _value(payload, "routes", "samples", "events", "history")
        if routes is not None:
            assert isinstance(routes, (list, dict))


def test_usage_reports_average_is_consistent_with_totals_when_present() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        total_requests = _number(payload, "totalrequests", "total_requests")
        total_units = _number(payload, "totalunits", "total_units")
        average = _number(payload, "averageunitsperrequest", "average_units_per_request")

        if total_requests is not None and total_units is not None and average is not None:
            if total_requests == 0:
                assert average == Decimal("0")
            else:
                assert average == total_units / total_requests


def test_usage_reports_support_owner_bound_build_when_available() -> None:
    try:
        reports = build_usage_reports(owner_key="owner-001")
    except TypeError:
        reports = build_usage_reports()

    items = _items_of(reports)
    assert items


def test_usage_reports_support_limit_parameter_when_available() -> None:
    try:
        reports = build_usage_reports(limit=5)
    except TypeError:
        reports = build_usage_reports()

    items = _items_of(reports)
    assert len(items) >= 1


def test_usage_reports_rejects_blank_owner_key_when_supported() -> None:
    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        build_usage_reports(owner_key="")


def test_usage_reports_rejects_invalid_limit_when_supported() -> None:
    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, AssertionError)):
        build_usage_reports(limit=0)


def test_usage_reports_list_events_method_returns_collection_when_supported() -> None:
    reports = build_usage_reports()

    event_methods = ("list_events", "events", "usage_events", "get_events")
    if not any(hasattr(reports, name) and callable(getattr(reports, name)) for name in event_methods):
        pytest.skip("usage event listing method not implemented")

    result = _call_method_if_present(reports, event_methods)
    items = _items_of(result)

    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert items


def test_usage_reports_lookup_by_api_key_returns_matching_record_when_supported() -> None:
    reports = build_usage_reports()

    lookup_methods = ("get_by_api_key", "find_by_api_key", "report_for_key", "lookup")
    if not any(hasattr(reports, name) and callable(getattr(reports, name)) for name in lookup_methods):
        pytest.skip("usage report lookup method not implemented")

    items = _items_of(reports)
    sample_payload = _payload_of(items[0])
    api_key_id = _text(sample_payload, "apikeyid", "api_key_id", "id")
    if api_key_id is None:
        pytest.skip("no api key identifier available")

    result = _call_method_if_present(reports, lookup_methods, api_key_id)
    payload = _payload_of(result)
    matched = _text(payload, "apikeyid", "api_key_id", "id")

    assert matched == api_key_id


def test_usage_reports_payload_uses_json_friendly_values() -> None:
    items = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    for item in items:
        payload = _payload_of(item)
        for key, value in payload.items():
            assert isinstance(key, str)
            assert value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, list, dict))


def test_usage_reports_multiple_builds_have_stable_top_level_shape() -> None:
    first = _items_of(build_usage_reports())
    second = _items_of(build_usage_reports())

    assert isinstance(first, list)
    assert isinstance(second, list)
    assert bool(first) == bool(second)

    if first and second:
        assert set(_payload_of(first[0]).keys()) == set(_payload_of(second[0]).keys())

ironclaw_scan_tool = {
    "name": "ironclaw_scan",
    "description": (
        "Evaluate a single target (text, URL, GitHub repo, or archive) for security "

        "malicious patterns. Returns a normalized action ('allow', 'warn', 'block', "
        "or 'quarantine') plus detailed findings. Use this BEFORE executing or "
        "following untrusted content."
    ),
    "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": ["target_type", "target_value"],
        "properties": {
            "target_type": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["text", "url", "githubrepo", "archive"],
                "description": "Type of target to scan."
            },
            "target_value": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": (
                    "Content to scan: raw text, URL string, GitHub repo identifier, "
                    "or archive name/path."
                )
            },
            "mode": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["enforce", "monitor", "strict"],
                "default": "enforce",
                "description": (
                    "Policy mode. 'enforce' uses the engine decision as-is. "
                    "'monitor' only warns on risky items (no hard block). "
                    "'strict' escalates warnings to quarantine."
                )
            },
            "source": {
                "type": "string",
                "nullable": True,
                "description": (
                    "Where this input came from, e.g. 'chat', 'file', 'github', "
                    "'url', 'system_prompt'."

            "session_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "nullable": True,
                "description": "Caller-defined session or conversation identifier."
            },
            "user_id": {
                "type": "string",

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Path, status

from api.customerkeys import (
    CustomerApiKeyResponse,
    CustomerApiKeyRotateResponse,
    CustomerApiKeyCreateRequest,
    create_customer_key,
    get_customer_key,
    rotate_customer_key,
    revoke_customer_key,
)
from core.auth import AuthPrincipal, resolve_api_key

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/customerkeys", tags=["ui-customer-key-detail"])


def _action(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    method: str,
    path: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "method": method,
        "path": path,
        "payload": payload,
    }


@router.get(
    "/{key_id}/detail",
    response_model=dict[str, Any],
)
def customer_key_detail_view(
    key_id: str = Path(..., description="Customer API key identifier."),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    UI metadata endpoint for a single customer key.

    Returns a shape that UI routers can use to render:
    - the key metadata pane
    - allowed actions (rotate, revoke, inspect)
    - example payloads for convenience
    """
    return {
        "page": "customer-key-detail",
        "title": "Customer API Key Detail",
        "summary": "Inspect and manage a single customer-scoped API key.",
        "key_id": key_id,
        "actions": [
            _action(
                id="inspect",
                title="Inspect key",
                description="Fetch the latest metadata for this customer API key.",
                method="GET",
                path=f"/customerkeys/{key_id}",
            ),
            _action(
                id="rotate",
                title="Rotate key",
                description=(
                    "Rotate this customer API key and receive a new raw key value. "
                    "The previous raw key becomes invalid."
                ),
                method="POST",
                path=f"/customerkeys/{key_id}/rotate",
            ),
            _action(
                id="revoke",
                title="Revoke key",
                description=(
                    "Revoke this customer API key. Once revoked, it can no longer be used "
                    "for authentication."
                ),
                method="POST",
                path=f"/customerkeys/{key_id}/revoke",
            ),
        ],
    }


@router.get(
    "/{key_id}",
    response_model=CustomerApiKeyResponse,
)
def ui_get_customer_key(
    key_id: str = Path(..., description="Customer API key identifier."),
) -> CustomerApiKeyResponse:
    """
    Thin UI-facing wrapper around the core get_customer_key endpoint.

    This exists so the UI router namespace stays consistent (`/ui/customerkeys/...`)
    while delegating all logic to the core API implementation.
    """
    return get_customer_key(key_id)


@router.post(
    "/{key_id}/rotate",
    response_model=CustomerApiKeyRotateResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
def ui_rotate_customer_key(
    key_id: str = Path(..., description="Customer API key identifier."),
) -> CustomerApiKeyRotateResponse:
    """
    UI-facing rotate endpoint that delegates to the core rotate_customer_key.

    The raw key is returned in the response exactly once and should be treated
    as sensitive.
    """
    return rotate_customer_key(key_id)


@router.post(
    "/{key_id}/revoke",
    response_model=CustomerApiKeyResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK,
)
def ui_revoke_customer_key(
    key_id: str = Path(..., description="Customer API key identifier."),
) -> CustomerApiKeyResponse:
    """
    UI-facing revoke endpoint that delegates to the core revoke_customer_key.

    The operation is idempotent; revoking an already-revoked key simply returns
    the current record.
    """
    return revoke_customer_key(key_id)


@router.post(
    "/create-and-detail",
    response_model=CustomerApiKeyResponse,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
def ui_create_customer_key_and_return_detail(
    body: CustomerApiKeyCreateRequest,
    principal: AuthPrincipal = Depends(resolve_api_key),
) -> CustomerApiKeyResponse:
    """
    Convenience endpoint primarily for UI flows that need to:
    - create a new customer key
    - immediately display the full persisted record (without raw key)

    It calls the core create_customer_key, then fetches the stored record to
    ensure the UI is working with the canonical view from the registry.
    """
    created = create_customer_key(body, principal)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    if not created.key_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail="Customer key was created but key_id is missing.",
        )

    # Fetch the canonical record (without raw key) for display
    return get_customer_key(created.key_id)

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

from api.customerkeys import (
    CustomerApiKeyCreateRequest,
    CustomerApiKeyListResponse,
    CustomerApiKeyResponse,
    CustomerApiKeyRotateResponse,
    create_customer_key,
    get_customer_key,
    list_customer_keys,
    revoke_customer_key,
    rotate_customer_key,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/customerkeys", tags=["ui-customer-keys"])


def _metric(
    *,
    metric_id: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "metric_id": metric_id,
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _section(
    *,
    section_id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    method: str,
    path: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    notes: list[str] | None = None,
    example_response_shape: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "section_id": section_id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "method": method,
        "path": path,
        "payload": payload,
        "notes": notes or [],
        "example_response_shape": example_response_shape,
    }


def _field(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    field_type: str,
    required: bool,
    default: Any | None = None,
    placeholder: str | None = None,
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "required": required,
        "default": default,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _table_column(
    *,
    key: str,
    label: str,
    value_type: str = "text",
) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "key": key,
        "label": label,
        "value_type": value_type,
    }

@router.get("/list", response_model=CustomerApiKeyListResponse)
def customer_keys_list() -> CustomerApiKeyListResponse:
    return list_customer_keys()


@router.post("/create", response_model=CustomerApiKeyResponse)
def customer_keys_create(body: CustomerApiKeyCreateRequest) -> CustomerApiKeyResponse:
    return create_customer_key(body)


@router.get("/{key_id}", response_model=CustomerApiKeyResponse)
def customer_keys_detail(key_id: str) -> CustomerApiKeyResponse:
    return get_customer_key(key_id)


@router.post("/{key_id}/rotate", response_model=CustomerApiKeyRotateResponse)
def customer_keys_rotate(key_id: str) -> CustomerApiKeyRotateResponse:
    return rotate_customer_key(key_id)


@router.post("/{key_id}/revoke", response_model=CustomerApiKeyResponse)
def customer_keys_revoke(key_id: str) -> CustomerApiKeyResponse:
    return revoke_customer_key(key_id)

def _metric(
    *,
    id: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    trend: str | None = None,

        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "trend": trend,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _filter(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any | None,
    field_type: str = "text",
    placeholder: str | None = None,
    options: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "value": value,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
        "options": options or [],
    }


def _section(

    description: str,

) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "items": items or [],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/requestcontext", tags=["ui-request-context"])


def _field(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    field_type: str,
    required: bool,
    placeholder: str | None = None,
    help_text: str | None = None,
    default: Any | None = None,
    options: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    validation: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "required": required,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
        "help_text": help_text,
        "default": default,
        "options": options or [],
        "validation": validation or {},
    }


def _section(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    fields: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "fields": fields or [],
    }


def _metric(
    *,
    metric_id: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "metric_id": metric_id,
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _example_payload(
    *,
    target_type: str = "text",
    target_value: str = "Summarize this document safely.",
    mode: str = "enforce",
    source: str = "ui-console",
    session_id: str = "sess_demo_001",
    user_id: str = "user_demo_001",
    context: str = "Interactive request from customer UI",
    customer_key_id: str = "ck_demo_primary",
    trace_id: str = "trace_demo_001",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "target_type": target_type,
        "target_value": target_value,
        "mode": mode,
        "source": source,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "customer_key_id": customer_key_id,
        "trace_id": trace_id,
        "context": context,
    }


def _target_type_options() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    return [
        {"label": "Text", "value": "text"},
        {"label": "URL", "value": "url"},
        {"label": "GitHub Repository", "value": "githubrepo"},
        {"label": "Archive", "value": "archive"},
    ]


def _mode_options() -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    return [
        {"label": "Enforce", "value": "enforce"},
        {"label": "Monitor", "value": "monitor"},
        {"label": "Strict", "value": "strict"},
    ]

    return [
        {"label": "UI Console", "value": "ui-console"},

        {"label": "API", "value": "api"},
        {"label": "CLI", "value": "cli"},
        {"label": "Security Review", "value": "security-review"},
        {"label": "Integration", "value": "integration"},
    ]

                "user_id": "<optional-user-id>",
                "customer_key_id": "<optional-customer-key-id>",
                "trace_id": "<optional-trace-id>",
                "context": "<optional-context>",
            },
        },
        "decision_request": {
            "method": "POST",
            "path": "/brain/decision",

                "target_type": target_type,
                "target_value": "<user-supplied>",
                "mode": mode,
                "use_history": True,
                "max_history": 20,
                "source": "<optional-source>",
                "session_id": "<optional-session-id>",
                "user_id": "<optional-user-id>",
                "customer_key_id": "<optional-customer-key-id>",
                "trace_id": "<optional-trace-id>",
                "context": "<optional-context>",
            },
        },
    }


@router.get("")
def request_context_page(
    target_type: str = Query(default="text"),
    mode: str = Query(default="enforce"),
    source: str = Query(default="ui-console"),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    selected_target_type = (
        target_type
        if target_type in {option["value"] for option in _target_type_options()}
        else "text"
    )
    selected_mode = (
        mode
        if mode in {option["value"] for option in _mode_options()}
        else "enforce"
    )
    selected_source = (
        source
        if source in {option["value"] for option in _source_options()}
        else "ui-console"
    )

    return {
        "page": "request-context",

            "Build, inspect, and submit context metadata attached to scans, "
            "brain decisions, history lookups, and customer-key-driven actions."

def _filter(

    name: str,
    label: str,

def _column(
    *,

    kind: str = "text",
) -> dict[str, str]:

        "key": key,
        "label": label,
        "kind": kind,
    }


def _row(
    *,
    review_id: str,
    created_at: str,
    queue: str,
    category: str,
    severity: str,
    status: str,
    principal_id: str | None,
    source: str,
    score: int | float | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "review_id": review_id,
        "created_at": created_at,
        "queue": queue,
        "category": category,
        "severity": severity,
        "status": status,
        "principal_id": principal_id,
        "source": source,
        "score": score,
        "detail_path": f"/reviews/detail?review_id={review_id}",
    }


def _section(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "items": items or [],
    }


def _item(

) -> dict[str, Any]:

from __future__ import annotations

def _metric(
    *,
    id: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    trend: str | None = None,
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "trend": trend,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _filter(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any | None,
    field_type: str = "text",
    placeholder: str | None = None,
    options: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "value": value,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
        "options": options or [],
    }


def _section(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "items": items or [],
    }


def _item(
    *,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _event(
    *,
    event_id: str,
    timestamp: str,
    category: str,
    verdict: str,
    score: int | float,
    source: str,
    detail_path: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "event_id": event_id,
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "category": category,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "score": score,
        "source": source,
        "detail_path": detail_path,
    }

def _metric(
    *,
    id: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    trend: str | None = None,
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "trend": trend,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _filter(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any | None,
    field_type: str = "text",
    placeholder: str | None = None,
    options: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "value": value,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
        "options": options or [],
    }


def _section(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "items": items or [],
    }


def _item(
    *,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    tone: str = "neutral",
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "tone": tone,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _policy_row(
    *,
    policy_id: str,

    status: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:

        "disposition": disposition,
        "scope": scope,
        "status": status,

    }

def _page(
    *,
    page_id: str,
    title: str,
    path: str,
    category: str,
    summary: str,
    status: str = "available",
    related_paths: list[str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "page_id": page_id,
        "title": title,
        "path": path,
        "category": category,
        "summary": summary,
        "status": status,
        "related_paths": related_paths or [],
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Path, Query, status

from telemetryaccess import get_usage_event_by_id

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/usageevents", tags=["ui-usage-events"])


def _field(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any | None = None,
    field_type: str = "text",
    help_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "value": value,
        "help_text": help_text,
    }


def _section(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    fields: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "fields": fields or [],
    }


def _action(
    *,
    id: str,
    title: str,
    method: str,
    path: str,
    description: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "title": title,
        "method": method,
        "path": path,
        "description": description,
        "payload": payload,
    }


@router.get(
    "/{event_id}/detail",
    response_model=dict[str, Any],
)
def usage_event_detail_page(
    event_id: str = Path(..., description="Usage / telemetry event identifier."),
    include_raw_payload: bool = Query(
        default=False,
        description="If true, include raw event payload in the UI metadata.",
    ),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    UI metadata endpoint for a single usage / telemetry event.

    This returns a shape optimized for route-driven UI:
    - High-level attributes for quick scan (timestamp, source, principal, key)
    - Context and classification fields
    - Optional raw payload for deep debugging
    """
    try:
        event = get_usage_event_by_id(event_id)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Failed to load usage event: {exc}",
        ) from exc

    if event is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Usage event not found",
        )

    # Expect `event` to be a dict-like structure; keep access defensive.
    def g(key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        return event.get(key, default)

    identity_section = _section(
        id="identity",
        title="Identity",
        description="Who initiated this event and under which API context it ran.",
        fields=[
            _field(
                name="event_id",
                label="Event ID",
                value=g("id", event_id),
            ),
            _field(
                name="timestamp",
                label="Timestamp",
                value=g("timestamp"),
                help_text="UTC timestamp when this event was recorded.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="principal_type",
                label="Principal Type",
                value=g("principal_type"),
                help_text="Type of principal (customer, operator, system, integration, etc.).",
            ),
            _field(
                name="principal_id",
                label="Principal ID",
                value=g("principal_id"),
                help_text="Stable identifier for the authenticated principal.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="api_key_id",
                label="API Key ID",
                value=g("api_key_id"),
                help_text="Internal identifier of the API key used, if applicable.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="api_key_scope",
                label="API Key Scope",
                value=g("api_key_scope"),
                help_text="Scope of the API key (customer, operator, internal).",
            ),
        ],
    )

    request_section = _section(
        id="request",
        title="Request Context",
        description="Context attached at the time of the request to enable correlation and decisions.",
        fields=[
            _field(
                name="request_id",
                label="Request ID",
                value=g("request_id"),
                help_text="Correlates this event with other logs and traces.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="session_id",
                label="Session ID",
                value=g("session_id"),
                help_text="Session identifier used for related-event history.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="user_id",
                label="User ID",
                value=g("user_id"),
                help_text="End-user identity, when the principal represents a broader account.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="source",
                label="Source",
                value=g("source"),
                help_text="Origin of the request (api, ui-console, integration, cli, etc.).",
            ),
            _field(
                name="route",
                label="Route",
                value=g("route"),
                help_text="API route that handled this event.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="method",
                label="HTTP Method",
                value=g("method"),
            ),
            _field(
                name="client_ip",
                label="Client IP",
                value=g("client_ip"),
                help_text="Remote address if captured by the telemetry pipeline.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="user_agent",
                label="User Agent",
                value=g("user_agent"),
                help_text="Reported user agent string, if present.",
            ),
        ],
    )

    metering_section = _section(
        id="metering",
        title="Usage & Metering",
        description="Metered usage for billing, limits, and analytics.",
        fields=[
            _field(
                name="unit_type",
                label="Unit Type",
                value=g("unit_type"),
                help_text="Logical unit type tracked for this event (requests, tokens, scans, etc.).",
            ),
            _field(
                name="unit_count",
                label="Unit Count",
                value=g("unit_count"),
                field_type="number",
                help_text="Quantity of the metered unit consumed by this event.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="plan",
                label="Plan",
                value=g("plan"),
                help_text="Billing or subscription plan associated with this usage.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="billing_account_id",
                label="Billing Account ID",
                value=g("billing_account_id"),
            ),
            _field(
                name="trace_id",
                label="Trace ID",
                value=g("trace_id"),
                help_text="Distributed trace identifier when available.",
            ),
        ],
    )

    guard_section = _section(
        id="guard",
        title="Security / Guardrail Context",
        description="How this event interacted with IronClaw guardrails and decisioning.",
        fields=[
            _field(
                name="guard_policy_id",
                label="Guard Policy ID",
                value=g("guard_policy_id"),
                help_text="Identifier of the guardrail policy that applied to this request.",
            ),
            _field(
                name="guard_verdict",
                label="Guard Verdict",
                value=g("guard_verdict"),
                help_text="High-level verdict (allow, warn, block, quarantine).",
            ),
            _field(
                name="guard_mode",
                label="Guard Mode",
                value=g("guard_mode"),
                help_text="Mode in effect (enforce, monitor, strict).",
            ),
            _field(
                name="risk_score",
                label="Risk Score",
                value=g("risk_score"),
                field_type="number",
            ),
            _field(
                name="sandbox_lane",
                label="Sandbox Lane",
                value=g("sandbox_lane"),
                help_text="Lane used when content was detonated or isolated.",
            ),
        ],
    )

    sections = [identity_section, request_section, metering_section, guard_section]

    raw_payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    if include_raw_payload:
        raw_payload = {
            "event": event,
        }

    actions = [
        _action(
            id="related-events",
            title="View related events",
            method="GET",
            path="/ui/usagereports",
            description=(
                "Open usage reports filtered to the same principal, session, or request "
                "for broader investigation."
            ),
            payload={
                "principal_id": g("principal_id"),
                "session_id": g("session_id"),
                "request_id": g("request_id"),
            },
        ),
        _action(
            id="open-request-context",
            title="Open request context view",
            method="GET",
            path="/ui/requestcontext",
            description="Jump to the request context builder pre-populated with identifiers from this event.",
            payload={
                "mode": g("guard_mode") or "enforce",
                "target_type": g("target_type") or "text",
            },
        ),
    ]

    return {
        "page": "usage-event-detail",
        "title": "Usage Event Detail",
        "summary": "Inspect a single metered usage event and its security context.",
        "event_id": event_id,
        "sections": sections,
        "actions": actions,
        "raw": raw_payload,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

router = APIRouter(prefix="/ui/usagereports", tags=["ui-usage-reports"])


def _metric(
    *,
    id: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any,
    unit: str | None = None,
    trend: str | None = None,
    tone: str = "neutral",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": id,
        "label": label,
        "value": value,
        "unit": unit,
        "trend": trend,
        "tone": tone,
    }


def _filter(
    *,
    name: str,
    label: str,
    value: Any | None,
    field_type: str = "text",
    placeholder: str | None = None,
    options: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "name": name,
        "label": label,
        "type": field_type,
        "value": value,
        "placeholder": placeholder,
        "options": options or [],
    }


def _column(
    *,
    key: str,
    label: str,
    kind: str = "text",
) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        "key": key,
        "label": label,
        "kind": kind,
    }


def _row(
    *,
    event_id: str,
    timestamp: str,
    principal_id: str | None,
    principal_type: str | None,
    source: str | None,
    route: str | None,
    unit_type: str | None,
    unit_count: int | float | None,
    verdict: str | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "event_id": event_id,
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "principal_id": principal_id,
        "principal_type": principal_type,
        "source": source,
        "route": route,
        "unit_type": unit_type,
        "unit_count": unit_count,
        "verdict": verdict,
        "detail_path": f"/ui/usageevents/{event_id}/detail",
    }


@router.get("")
def usage_reports_page(
    principal_id: str | None = Query(default=None),

    """

    This route intentionally returns a presentation-oriented schema so the UI layer
    can render:
    - filter controls

            name="session_id",
            label="Session ID",

            placeholder="sess_123",
        ),
        _filter(
            name="request_id",

            value=request_id,
            placeholder="req_123",
        ),
        _filter(
            name="source",

    metrics = [

        _column(key="route", label="Route"),

        _column(key="unit_count", label="Unit Count", kind="number"),
        _column(key="verdict", label="Verdict"),
        _column(key="detail_path", label="Detail Path", kind="link"),

    rows = [
        _row(
            event_id="evt_001",
            timestamp="2026-04-23T18:00:00Z",

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class ReleasePolicyDecisionLatestView(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(
        extra="forbid",
        frozen=True,
        str_strip_whitespace=True,
    )

    title: str = Field(default="Latest Release Policy Decision", min_length=1, max_length=128)
    channel: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=32)
    decision_id: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=128)
    allowed: bool
    requested_version: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    minimum_upgrade_from: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    decision_reason: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=512)
    actor: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    decided_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
    status_label: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=32)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
